description: Suffrutex basi ramosus, caulibus erectis inferne albo-tomentosis, dense foliosis, superne hirto-glandulosis, laxe foliosis, circa 59 cm. altis. Folia oblanceolata, lanceolata, vel lineari-lanceolata, apice acuta, basi minute auriculata, vel exauriculata, margine (saepe revoluto) superne dentata vel sublobata, inferiora dense laxeve albo-tomentosa (tomento subtus persistente, supra magis minusve caduco), superiora hirto-glandulosa, 7-10 cm. longa, 2.5-10 mm. lata. Capitula pauca, radiata, longe pedunculata, apice caulium in cymis corymbi- formibus disposita; pedunculis 2-7 cm. longis, hirto-glandulosis. Involucrum campanulatum, calyculatum, 10-12 mm. altum, 12-15 mm. crassum. Bracteolae calyculi lineares, longae. Bracteae involucrales 20-24, lineares, apice attenu- atae, dorso hirto.glandulosae. Flores aurei, dimorphi: marginales 14-20, feminei, ligulati, tubulo 6.5 mm. longo, ligula oblonga 12-17 mm. longa, 3-4 mm. lata, apice obtuse tridentata. Flores disci copiosi, hermaphroditi, tubulosi, corolla 10-12 mm. longa apice pentadentata: dentibus deltoideis, apice papillosis, 0.7-0.8 mm. longis, ad medium conspicue venosis. Achaenia cylindracea, costata, laxe sericeo-pubescentia, 5-6 mm. longa. Pappus albus, 9-11 mm. longus.
bibliographicCitation: Cabrera, Ángel L. 1950. Notes on the Brazilian Senecioneae. Brittonia. 7: 53-74.

description: Frutex ramis terminalibus tenuibus striatis glabris. Folia coriacea alterna. Petiolus 1 cm longus glaber. Lamina obovato-orbiculata basi obtuse cuneata apice rotundata vel obtusa margine minute repando-denticulata subintegra, cir- citer 3 cm longa 2.5 cm lata; supra viridis nitida glabra nervis principalibus prominulis; subtus pallidior aspectu glabra sed minute sparseque puberula costa crassa elevata nervis secundariis 4-5 utroque latere prominulis nervulis in reticulum minutum elevatum anastomosantibus. Inflorescentia subcorymboso-paniculata folia valde superans ramis ramulisque striolatis parcissime puberulis, bracteis linearibus acutis. Capitula discoidea. Pedicelli graciles sparsissime puberuli 3-6 mm longi. Calyculus 6-7 bracteolis angiiste linearibus acutissimis 1.5-3 mm longis. Involucrum tubuloso-campanu- latum 5 mm latum, 8 bracteis herbaceo-paleaceis linearibus 4.5-5 mm longis 1- 1.4 mm latis, margine subscariosis dorso crassiusculis glabris, apice acutiusculo parce ciliolato. Flores omnes tubulosi circiter 10, corolla 4 mm longa glabra tubulo 1.8 mm longo dentibus oblongis 1.4 mm longis. Antherae 1.5 mm longae basi sagittatae. Ovarium striatum glabrum. Pappus sericeus pallidus 3.5 mm longus.
bibliographicCitation: Cuatrecasas, José. 1956. Studies on Andean Compositae - III. Brittonia. 8 (3): 179-193.

description: Herba dioica pluricaulls, rosula maxima humo appressa, caulibus palmaribus sordide arachnoideo-lanatis dense foliosis simplicibus monocephalis, centrali erecto lateralibus decumbentibus; folia rosulae (vel ima caulina?) figiira anguste oblonga brevipetiolata ca. 22 cm. longa 4.5 cm. lata alte pinnato-partita, segmentis ca. 9-13-jugis, mediis et superioribus triangularibus v. quadratis saepius bifidis margine breviter spinosa et spinis validis stramineis 7-14 mm. longis terminatis, inferioribus ad spinas 1-3 reductis, apice anguste triangularia acuminata spinosa (spina 10-13 mm. longa), lamina supra glaberrima subtus tenuiter obscureque arachnoidea glabrata, costa lata brunneo-straminea utrinque praecipue versus basin articulato-pilosa pilis pallide bruneis, petiolo tenuiter arachnoideo; folia caulina similia breviora petiolata non amplectentia non decurrentia, superiora sub capitulo aggregata et id superantia; capitula mediocria dioica sessilia; involueri foeminei ca. 3.5 cm. alti late campanulati ca. 6-seriati valde gradati basi foliis capitulum superantibus lavandulaceis valde spinosis suffulti phyllaria lanceolata appressa acuminata integra viridi-brunnea sine linea glandulosa,  spina valida straminea basi paullum complanata 3-5 mm. longa terminata; corollae albae purpureo-tinetae, tubo ca. 18 mm. longo faucibus cum dentibus plusquam duplo longiore; pappus saturate brunneus.
bibliographicCitation: Blake, Sidney F. 1937. New Asteraceae from Guatemala and Costa Rica Collected by A. F. Skutch. Brittonia. 2 (4): 329 -361.

description: Herba annua, non nisi ad summam ramosa, caule 0.5-1 mm crasso, tetragono, faciebus sulcato, inferne subglabrato vel interdum (praecipue prope nodos) aegre retrorso-setuloso, superne patenti- vel reflexo-setuloso, internodiis elongatis ea 1 dm longis folia multo superantibus. Folia minima, opposita, tripartita, petiolo adjecto sub 2.5 cm longa, petiolo angusto sed minime marginato hispido usque ad 13 mm longo, lamina membranacea foliolis lateralibus ovatis terminali lanceolato, omnibus supra viridibus moderate infra pallidioribus perspicue adpresso-hispidis, utrinque acriter inflexo-serrulatis ea 4-7 dentibus, marginibus acriter setuloso-ciliatis. Capitula corymboideo-disposita, perpauca (plerumque 3- 5), tenuissime pedunecLlata pedunculo capilliformi (sub 0.1 mm crasso) saepius nudo et 3-6 cm longo, radiata, pansa ad anthesin 5-7 mm lata et ea 5 mm alta. In- volucri bracteae exteriores ea 8, anguste lineares, ciliatae, apice (interdum dila- tato) acutae, interiores oblongas subaequantes. Flores ligulati ea 4-6, minimi (sub 2 mm longi), nune aegre subrosacei (viventes albidi-), lingula ovati, apice truneato rotundato-dentati, longitudinaliter ea 5-striati, Achaenia non visa.
bibliographicCitation: Sherff, Earl E. 1964. Some new or otherwise noteworthy Coreopsidinae (Compositae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 18: 58-73.

description: Annual herb, not branched unless at tip, stem 0.5-1 mm thick, 4-angled, grooved upon the faces, in lower part subglabrate or at times (especially near the nodes) weakly retrorse-setulose, in upper part spreading- or reflexed-setulose, the elongate internodes ea 1 dm long and much surpassing the leaves. Leaves very small, opposite, tripartite, under 2.5 en long including the petiole, this narrow but very slightly margined, hispid and up to 13 mm long; blade membranaceous, its lateral leaflets ovate, its terminal one lanceolate, all green on upper surface, on lower surface moderately paler and conspicuously appressed-hispid, on both edges sharply inflexed-serrulate with ea 4-7 teeth to each edge, the margins sharply setulose-ciliate. Heads corymbosely disposed, very few (commonlly 3-5), very delicately pedunculate with a capilliform peduncle (this under 0.1 mm thick) more often nude and 3-6 cm long, radiate, 5-7 mm wide and ca 5 mm tall when expanded at flowering-time. Outer phyllaries ca 8, narrowly linear, ciliate, at apex (this at times dilated) acute, subequal to the inner, oblong ones. Ligulate florets ea 4-6, very minute (under 2 mm long), now weakly subrosaceous (in the live state whitish?); ligule ovate, rounded- dentate at the truncate apex, lengthwise about 5-striate. Achenes not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Sherff, Earl E. 1964. Some new or otherwise noteworthy Coreopsidinae (Compositae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 18: 58-73.

description: Perennial herb with a stout taproot and branching caudex; stems several, about 10-35 cm. high, stout, silvery-white with a dense villous-strigose appressed pubescence, more densely so toward the base, where the hairs may be looser anld villous; leaves pubescent like the stem, but less densely so and merely grayish, all linear or linear-oblanceolate, the basal ones up to 6 cm. long and 4 mm. wide, often deciduous by flowering time, the cauline ones a little smaller, plentiful but not crowded; heads solitary or several, sometimes 10, disk about 10-15 mm. wide; involucre 5-7 mm. high, glandular and usually also with a few short white hairs near the base; phyllaries evidently imbricate, olive-greenish, the inner sometimes with brown midrib and straw-colored margins; ligules about 30-55, pink or white, 6-13 mm. long, 1.5-2.6 mm. wide; disk-corollas 3.5-5.0 mm. long, the tube 0.7-1.4 mm., the lobes 0.4-0.7 mm.; style-appendages broadly triangular, obtuse, 0.05-0.15 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of 18-26 coarse and firm white or sordid bristles, the outer of conspicuous long slender squamellae; akenes 4-nerved, pilose or sparsely hirsute.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Rhizomes 1.0-3.0 mm. in diam., horizontal, the branches sometimes more than 20 cm. long, light brown, the internodes up to 3 em. long, only moderately rooting, with thin brownish 0.5-1.0 cm. long ovate-lanceolate scales at the nodes, otherwise naked except occasionally at the summit, and there clothed with remnants of previous leaves; innovations commonly produced stems solitary or rarely 2-3 close together, 0.8-6.0 dm. high, simple or branched above, glabrate, puberulent, or thinly strigosely subpilose, and also frequently uniformly sparsely or densely glandular toward the base, increasingly pubescent above, particularly as to glandulosity; leaves of the innovations 8 (5)-25 (30) cm. long, 3.0-10 cm. broad, ovate to lanceolate, the base abruptly narrowed to the long petiole, acutish, obtuse, or frequently cordate, the petiole equaling or exceeding the blade, otherwise similar to the cauline leaves; cauline leaves 2 (3)-4 pairs, 2-14 cm. long, 1.5-8.0 cm. broad, all sessile, or the median and lower leaves amply petiolate, broadly ovate to elliptic-lanceolate, thin, or moderately firm, crenate-serrulate to coarsely dentate, obtuse or only acutish, the base broadly to somewhat narrowly sessile, or abruptly narrowed to a winged petiole and subcordate cordate or subreniform, subglabrate, puberulent to sparsely and thinly subpilose, mostly sparsely or densely and uniformly short-stipitate-glandular, the pubescence on the upper surface usually somewhat exceeding that of the lower surface, the upper stem leaves frequently larger than the lower, usually only the leaves of the infloreseence reduced; peduncles slender, 2.0-10 cm. long; heads 1-5(9), narrowly turbinate to broadly campanulate-hemispheric, 10-20(22) mm. high; perielinium sparsely hispidulous-puberulent and more or less densely short-stipitate-glandular, sometimes also scantily subpilose, or occasionally subglabrate and entirely eglandular; involueral bracts 8-16 (18), mostly only uniseriate, or indistinctly biserial, 1.0-3.0 (5.0) mm. broad, 10(8)-15(17) mm. long, lanceolate to oblanceolate, short-acute to caudate-acute or acuminate, with pubescence similar to that of the periclinium but less dense, frequently ciliolate, the tip glabrate within; ray flowers mostly 8-12, ligules 4.0-6.0 mm. broad, 12-22(25) mm. long, yellow, occasionally sparsely strigose on the back, narrowly oblong-linear, shallowly and usually bluntly 3-dentate, the teeth acutish, 0.5-1.0(1.5) mm. long; disc corollas 7.0(6.0)-9.0(10.6) mm. long, goblet-shaped, sometimes narrowly so, the base of the limb and the tube moderately or sparsely villous or short pilose, the collar scarcely obvious, the tube 2.8 (2.1)-3.6 (4.2) mm. long, lobes ca. 0.8(1.0) mm. long, glabrate or hispidulous; achenes 6.0(4.8)-8.0(9.3) mm. long, slender-cylindrical, nerveless or only moderately 5-nerved, entirely glabrous or sparsely uniformly pubescent above with double hairs, frequently sparsely intermixed with septate hairs, and also sparsely shortstipitate-glandular, if pubescent then mostly glabrate toward the base; annulus infrequently well developed, 0.2-0.35 mm. long; pappus usually shorter than the corolla, white-barbellate, the setae 0.1-0.18(0.2) mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Camp, Wendell H. & Gilly, Charles L. 1943. Part II: Systematic Treatment, [Arnica alpina-Arnica discoidea]. Brittonia. 4 (3): 405-457.

description: Climbing vines; stems subterete, finely striate, puberulent to pubescent; nodes commonly with a pubescent stipule-like appendage. Leaves with slender petioles 6-17 mm long; blade membranaceous, narrowly elliptic, 3-12 cm long, 0.8-4 cm wide, basally attenuate to cuneate, narrowly acuminate to acute at apex, pinnately 3- or 5-veined from above base, upper surface glabrous to weakly puberulent, lower surface glandular-punctate, frequently puberulent. Capitulescence terminal and axillary from uppermost nodes, corymbiform; capitula shortly pedunculate; phyllaries basally gibbous, glabrate to weakly glandular and also sometimes sparsely puberulent to- ward apex, 4.5-6.5 mm long; subinvolucral bracts commonly present, nearly equal to half as long as the phyllaries. Corollas tubular, shortly 5-lobed, thinly glandular, 3.9- 4.5 mm long, lobes deltoid to triangular, 0.2-0.8 mm long. Achenes 3-3.7 mm long, glabrous to weakly glandular at apex.
bibliographicCitation: Pruski, John F. 1992. Compositae of the Guayana highland VII. Noteworthy species of Chromolaena and Mikania (Eupatorieae) from Venezuela. Brittonia. 44: 213-219.

description: Frutex arboreus, ramis principalibus procurrentibus usque ad 3 m longis, ramificantibus solum in inflorescentia, alis herbaceis munitis. Folia opposita, ovata, acuta, usque ad 23 x 18 cm, in inflorescentia integra et multum deminuta, marginibus dentatis, interdum cluobus lobis latis in quoque latere, petiolo alato decurreniti in caule. Inflorescentia paniculata, axillaris terminalisque, 15-45 cm lata, 15-70 capitUlis, pedunculis 0.5-7 cm longis. Capitula discoidea, 1-1.8 cm lata, involucro 4-6 mm alto. Phyllaria 25-35, herbacea, lanceolata, plana, ciliata, inequalia, extima 2-3 mm longa et intima 5-6 mm longa. Paleae luteae, 5-7 mm longae, supra hispidae et fuscae. Flores lutei, 30-70, extimi 5.5 mm longi et intimi 6.8 mm longi, tubis et lobis corollarum pilosis, faucibus glabris. Antherae 1.2-3 mm longae, thecis infuscatis, apicibus et connectivis pallidis. Styli 1.2-2 mm longi. Achenia grisea, aispera, glabra, oblanceolata, 4-5 mm longa, alis non cilialtis, slpra dilatatis usque 2.5 mm lat's duobus aristis inequalibus productis.

description: Arborescent shrubs, leaning or sprawling, the primary branches 2.5-3 m long, 1-1.5 cm diam. at base, branching only in axillary and terminal inflorescences. Brunches light brown, slightly pubescent with short multicellular lax hairs congested at leaf nodes, bearing herbaceous scarcely pubescent wings to 3 mm wide, these becoming dry, brown and deciduous below. Leaves opposite; blades thin, green on both surfaces, ovate in outline, sometimes with two broad lobes on each side at right angles to the midvein and with rounded sinuses divided at most to ca. half the distance toward the midvein, the largest 23 X 18 cm, including the 6 X 5 cm petiole; leaves in the inflorescence similarly shaped, unlobed, and greatly reduced in size to 1.5 X 1 cm, the apex acute, the base truncate and decurrent into the broadly winged petioles continuous with the stem wings; petiole wings 0.3-2.2 cm wide, densely pubescent with spreading multicellular hairs; margins of larger leaves inrolled, irregularly doubly dentate, with a few small mucronate serrations in between each of 3-4 larger, more acuminate teeth; adaxial surface scabrellous with short, curved, cone-shaped hairs slightly denser on the veins, the abaxial surface short-pubescent; large veins of the cauline leaves few, white, raised below, strigose, the smaller veins reticulate. Infiorescences forming terminal or axillary, open, round-topped panicles, 10-30 cm high and 15-45 cm broad, with 5-7 heads in each ultimate panicle, the whole inflorescence with 15-70 heads, the branches extending at 45-60º angles, the peduncles 0.5-7 cm long, widened at point of attachment to heads, densely strigose; bracts lanceolate, 2-3 mm long, acute. Heads discoid, indurate at base, hemispheric, 1-1.8 cm across, the involucre 4-6 mm high. Phyllaries 25-35, herbaceous, flat, erect to spreading at anthesis, lanceolate, acute, ciliate, in three graduated series, the outermost shortest, 2-3 X 0.8-1 mm, strigose, the inner series 5-6 X ca. 0.8 mm wide graduating into the pales and less pubescent. Receptacle slightly convex, 5-7 mm diam. Pales pale yellow, 5-7 mm long, boat-shaped with mucronate tip, abaxially darkened, distally hispid, occasionally with a few hairs near the base. Flowers yellow, 30-70 per head, the peripheral discoid florets ca. 5.5 mm long and the central ones ca. 6.8 mm long, the tube greenish, sparsely pilose, 0.7-1.5 mm long, the throat cylindric, glabrous, the lobes sparsely pilose with hairs 1 mm long. Anthers 1.2-3 mm long, the thecae dark, ca. 0.6 mm long, acute, the apices and connectives cream-colored; tails abruptly sagittate. Pollen grains tricolporate, oblate-spheroidal, 34.1 X 37.6 µm. Polar view circular 35.9 µm diam. Exine tectate, echinate. Spines variable sizes, conical with small translucent cavities: on the equator 3.8-4.4 µm high; between the equator and the poles 2.8-3.2 jim high; and in the poles 2-3 spinules 1.9-2.4 jim high. Colpus 27.2 X 6.1 µm, membrane characterized by an ellipticalrectangular pore with irregular edges 9 X 4.2 jm; colpus transversalis with central constriction and acute ends, 11.9 X 2.5 µm in the widest part, the constriction 1 µm wide. Index of polar area 0.17, small. Styles 1.2-2 mm long, sparsely pubescent. Achenes gray, rough, oblanceolate to obovate in outline, 4-5 X 1.2-1.5 mm exclusive of wings and awns, truncate at apex, tapering to base; awns at base adnate to the wings, unequal, 2-4 mm long, without barbs or very sparsely antrorsely barbed on the external edge, protruding only slightly above the pales in mature heads; wings with ruffled entire margin, not ciliate, sometimes unequal, tapering to base, 1-2.5 mm wide at the widest part, the upper lobe extending 0.8-1.5 mm above the achene body.

description: Suffrutex dioicus, usque ad 15 cm altus. Folia deltoidea, 3.5 mm longa, 3.5 mm lata, petiolis 4-10 mm longis. description: Herbaceous perennial, 5-8 (10+) dm tall, densely lanate-tomentose, especially on the undersides of leaves, on lower stems and petioles, glabrate in age; inflorescence early glabrescent; stems arising singly or loosely clustered from a coarse, ligneous rootstock; taproot early prominent but with short, stout rhizomes developing in age. Leaves alternate, lower and mid-cauline well-developed, petiolate, the blade ovate to broadly lanceolate, tapering to truncate at the base, serrate-dentate to incised or weakly lobed, especially proximally, or merely callose-denticulate, 5-9 (15) cm long and 2.5-5 (11) cm wide, about two times longer than wide; petiole about as long as the blade, usually winged and often with 2-4 prominent, denticulate lobes; upper leaves progressively reduced, the uppermost becoming mere sessile bracts. Inflorescence an open, compound corymbiform cyme with 20-40 (+?) heads; principal involucral bracts ca (18) 21 in number, 6-7 mm long, green to yellow-green, the margin scarious, especially upward, the apex weakly erose-fimbriate; calyculate bracts few and inconspicuous; receptacle naked and flat; ray florets pistillate, ca (10) 13, the ligule 6-8 mm long and 3 mm wide in dried specimens; disc florets equaling or but slightly exceeding the involucre at anthesis; corolla 6-7 mm long, gradually tapering from the tube to limb; pappus a single series of abundant, white, capillary bristles; achene 3 mm long, short-puberulent or hirtellous, especially along the angles; n = 23.

description: Perennial herb with a stout taproot and short branching caudex; stemY slender, branching, up to about 2 dm. high, hirsute, with appressed hairs, except under the heads, where the hairs are spreading; leaves strigose-hirsute with appressed hairs, the basal oblanceolate to obovate, up to 4 cm. long, the blade shorter than the petiole; cauline leaves linear, or the lower oblanceolate; heads several, the involuere about 4-5 mm. high, finely glandular and moderately or sparsely hirsute with short spreading hairs; phyllaries greenish, with slightly darker midrib and sometimes lighter margins, slightly imbricate, the outer a little shorter and evidently narrower than the relatively broad thin inner ones; ligules about 75, lilac or white, about 5-7 mm. long and 0.6 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 2.5 mm. long, the tube 0.5 mm., the lobes 0.4-0.5 mm., the limb white and strongly indurated near the base, flaring above; style-appendages very short and blunt, less than 0.1 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of 5-8 slender bristles, the outer of evident and sometimes more or less united squamellae; akenes 2-nerved, hairy.

description: Erect herbaceous plants, to 1.5 m tall, with few to several branches departing from close to the base of the stem. Stems striate, sticky, glandular-pubescent, the lower 2/3 with large auriculate-clasping leaves. Leaves oval to obovate, 4-26 X 1.5-15 cm, the apex rounded and apiculate, the base auriculate to auriculate-clasping, the margin spinulose-dentate, chartaceous, glutinous, densely glandular-pubescent on both surfaces, with crispy hairs on the veins, the smallest leaves associated with the inflorescence obovate to oblong. Inflorescence a terminal, leafy, flat corymbiform cyme; capitula in cymules; peduncles to 8 mm long, densely glandular-pubescent; involucre 3-4-seriate, narrowly campanulate, 12 mm high, the phyllaries all acute, shortly acuminate, ciliolate, densely glandular-pubescent on the dorsal surface, the outermost lanceolate, 4- 5 X ca. 1 mm, the central ones obtriangular, 5-7 X ca. 2 mm, the innermost lanceolate, 8-9 X 1-2 mm. Florets 10-12 (in bud); corolla glandular-puberulent. Achenes densely hirsute; pappus 11 mm long, white, biseriate.

description: Coarse perennial with a strong taproot and a simple or slightly branched caudex; bases of leaves anid stems of one year often persisting until flowering season of the next; stem usually decumbent at the base, strigose or hirsutestrigose with appressed or ascending hairs, 10-30 mm. high; leaves strigose or short-hirsute, the basal ones tufted, colnspicuous, triple-nerved, acute or sometimes obtuse at the apex, tapering gradually to the petiole, up to 20 cm. long and 1 cm. wide, usually smaller; cauline leaves few, abruptly reduced; head solitary, usually on a long subnaked peduncle, the disk 10-20 mm. wide; involuere 7.5-10 mm. high, villous-hirsute, scarcely or not at all glandular, the phyllaries subequal, broad, dark green, usually somewhat indurate and brownish at the base (as in Aster), the tips searious, merely acute; ligules about 20-40, white or blue, relatively short and broad, about 5-11 mm. long and 1.5-3.0 mm. wide; disk-corollas mostly 5.0-7.0 mm. long, the tube usually obscure, the lobes 0.8-1.2 mm. long; style-appendages triangular-lanceolate, distinctly acute, 0.3-0.4 mm. long; pappus coarse, the inner of about 25-40 firm bristles, the outer of a few slender and inconspicuous setae; akenes 2-nerved, usually glabrous near the base, progressively hairy upwards. Open places; Nevada and occasionally eastern California.

description: Branched annual herbs ca. 3 dm tall, rooting at the lower decumbent nodes; stems striate, reddish-brown, lightly hispid with ca. 5-celled trichomes, more densely hispid at the nodes; leaves sessile to subpetiolate, thin, lightly hispid on both surfaces, upper surface darker, ovate to lanceolate, ca. 3 cm long, 1 cm wide but highly variable, margins nearly entire but often minutely dentate with dark glands at the apices of the teeth, apices acute, bases obtuse to subtruncate; peduncles usually shorter than the subtending internode, up to ca. 7 cm long, lightly hispid, more densely so at the flaring apex; heads campanulate, ca. 5 mm wide; phyllaries 8-13, more or less flat dorsally, linear with acute generally dark-tipped apices, densely hirsute on lower half, sparsely so on upper, ca. 4 mm long; alae ca. 2 mm long, thin membranous, transparent, overlapping and enfolding the achene, margins erose, the upper third free; ray corollas short tubed, yellow but sometimes with faded tips, glabrous, narrowly oblong, thin and chartaceous when dry, ca. 5 mm long, readily deciduous, bases obtuse, apices emarginate, dorsal veins prominent; ray achene ca. 1.4 mm long, linear to cuneate; disk flowers numerous, corollas 2.0 to 2.5 mm long, gently narrowed basally for 0.5-0.7 mm, the constriction pubescent; disk achenes cuneate to turbinate, ca. 1.0 mm long, only slightly or not at all compressed; paleae marginally ciliate, somewhat keeled, dorsally convex but not completely surrounding the achene, ca. 2.5 mm long, broadly lanceolate, inner ones somewhat narrower, glabrous, translucent, apices acuminate but tips not at all rigid; receptacle conical; 2n = 18, 36.

description: Plants 1 m tall; stems long-villous with loosely spreading hairs; leaves opposite except the uppermost; petioles 0.5-3.5 mm long; blades ovate, 8 cm long, 5 cm wide, acute, broadly rounded at base, serrulate or crenate-serrulate, above densely cinerous-pilose with mostly spreading hairs, beneath densely and softly white-tomentose; heads 2-5 on peduncles 1-7 cm long; disks 0.8-1.5 cm in diameter; phyllaries oblong or oblong-ovate, 0.7 cm long, 2.5 mm wide, obtuse, with indurated, blackish, glabrate base and densely pilose-tomentose apex; rays about 8, 10 mm long, 4 mm wide; disk corollas 7 mm long, yellow, sparsely hispidulous chiefly on veins and teeth; anthers black; pales acute, pilose and ciliolate above, straw-colored; achene 3.5 mm long, glabrous; pa,ppus of 2 linear- lanceolate awns, about 3 mm long; pappus of ray achenes lacking or of 2 linear- lanceolate awns.
bibliographicCitation: Heiser, Charles B. 1957. A revision of the South American Species of Helianthus. Brittonia. 8: 283-285.

description: Shrubs, ca 3 m tall; stems pachycladous, alveolate, with dense tufted trichomes ca 3-4 mm long, velutinous. Leaves cauline, crowded, usually deciduous except at ends of branches, the sessile blades 3-7.5 (11) x 0.4-0.7 cm wide, linear to linear-elliptic, widest at the middle, apically obtuse, basally cuneate, marginally strongly revolute, leathery, glabrous except at the pilose base above, lanate below. Inflorescences terminal, of semispherical glomerules. Heads 4-flowered. Inner phyllaries villous on tip of outer surface, glossy on inner surface, 5.8-7 (8.2) x 1-1.5 (2.4) mm wide; outer phyllaries densely villous on outer surface, glossy on inner surface, 4-6 x 1 mm. Pappus white; inner paleas flattened, twist- ed, 4.5-7 mm long, outer scales 1-2 mm long. Corollas not observed. Achenes 3.5-4 mm long, 10-ribbed, 3- or 4-sided, glabrous. Pollen type: A. Flowering and fruiting from July to September.

description: Plants perennial, some perhaps short-lived, herbaceous, 14-25 cm tall, usually with a woody, often branching taproot, or sometimes with fibrous roots; some branches arising near base to 6.5 cm long and bearing leaf scars along their length, decumbent or ascending, often woody, bearing tufts of leaves at their apices and often rooting below the tufts, the plants sometimes forming large clones in deeper soil by these stoloniferous (or rhizomatous) branches. Stems erect to ascending, or occasionally decumbent, branched, 9.5-22(-39) cm long. Trichomes of the stem of three types: Type A (Fig. 1), thick-walled, uniseriate, 200-600 ju long, mostly appressed or closely ascending but spreading just under the heads, conspicuous but sparse; Type B (Fig. 3), thin-walled, uniseriate, 110-160 ,u long, appressed, in- conspicuous; Type C (Fig. 2), biseriate, capitate, 27-32 ju long, rare. Basal leaves spatulate to oblanceolate, entire or pinnately few-lobed, 5-76 mm long, the shorter range characteristic of early season growth, increasing during the summer, blade length from 1/2 to 1/3 of the leaf length, blade width 3-11 mm, glabrous to sparsely strigose, usually less pubescent above than below, the trichome complement and lengths similar to those of the stem; cauline leaves entire or the lowest sometime tri-lobed, linear to oblanceolate, 5-21 mm long, gradually reduced upwards, pubescence similar to that of the basal leaves. Heads numerous, the first solitary at the ends of erect stems, shorter peduncles developed later in the axils of cauline leaves; disks 3.5-7.0 mm wide; involucre 2.5-4.5 mm high or long, sparsely to moderately hirtellous, with short, biseriate trichomes of Type C which impart a finely glandular appearance, the phyllaries with brown midrib, the outer with a conspicuous purplish cast and slightly shorter and sometimes narrower than the inner, the inner light green with chartaceous margins; ligules (22-) 27-38 (-46), white to dark lilac above and below or sometimes with a lilac midstripe below, drying light blue to purple, 5.4-8.4 mm long and 1.0-1.4 mm wide, with 4 or 5 veins; disk corollas 1.9-2.6 mm long, inconspicuously pubescent with a few scattered biseriate trichomes, the tube well-defined, about 0.3 mm long, the lower part of the limb white, with nerves usually visible, the corolla lobes 0.3-0.4 mm long; style appendages triangular, obtuse to acute, 0.3-0.4 mm long; pappus double, the inner of 10-19 bristles, the outer of inconspicuous squamellose setae up to 0.2 mm high. Achenes 2-nerved or rarely 4-nerved, 1.1-1.5 mm long, sparsely pubescent; n = 9. Abundant in crevices and moist, limy soil in spruce-fir zone of Cedar Canyon, 12 miles east of Cedar City, Iron Co., Utah. Known only from this locality. June-September.

description: Arbuscula 2-4 m alta comosa ramis tenninalibus extremo dense foliatis parte exfoliata striatis tuberculato-cicatricosis, glabris resinoso-viscosis. Folia brevia alterna rigide coriacea. Petiolus 2 mm longus complanatus glaber basi ampliatus. Lamina elliptica basi obtuse cuneata apice rotundata vel obtusa saepe abrupte minuteque calloso-mucronata, margine revoluta, 8-12 mm longa 4-7 mm lata; supra laevis viridis glabra nitida resinosa-viscosa; subtus costa crassa eminenti glabraque dense adpresseque albo-lanato-tomentosa cinerea nervis secundariis transversis plerumque inconspicuis. Capitula breviter radiata pedicellata congesta in paniculis oligocephalis brevibus folia paulo excedentibus instructa. Pedicelli rigidi 2-3 mm longi lanuginoso-puberuli. Involucrum campanulatum 6 mm altum bracteis 3-4-seriatis rigide paleaceis sursum rubescentibus, interioribus 5-5.5 mm longis 1 mm latis, exterioribus brevibus ovato-oblongis et ovatis, infimis 2 mm longis 1.2 mm latis. Flores-radii feminei ligulati 5-7, corolla 6-7 mm longa glabra tubulo 2.8 mm longo, lamina lineari 0.5 mm longa; ovario glabro, pappo pallide stramineo 4.5 mm longo. description: Perennial herb with a branched caudex; stem 2-15 enr. high, more or less villous with spreading or somfetimes appressed-aseending hairs; leaves finely hirsute or villous-hirsute with short appressed or loose hairs, the basal ones up to 8 cm. long and 13 mm. wide, with broad elliptical or obovate to subrotund blades more or less abruptly contracted to the petiole; cauline leaves few, reduced, narrow, head solitary, the disk 7-16 mm. wide; involuere 5-8 mm. high, sparsely to densely woolly-villous with multicellular hairs, the cross-walls sometimes strongly purple-tinged, sometimes clear; phyllaries about equal, loose, herbaceous in texture, green with purple tips and sometimes also purple margins, or more or less purplish throughout; ligules about 25-70, yellow, 6-9 mm. long, 1.4-2.5 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.6-4.9 mm. long, the tube 0.8-1.3 mm., the lobes 0.6-1.0 mm.; style-appendages lanceolate, acute, 0.3-0.5 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 10-20 coarse bristles, the outer of setae or narrow squamellae, conspicuous or sometimes obscure; akenes 2-nerved, hairy. Rocky places or sometimes peat bogs, at high elevations, mountains of southern Alberta, southern British Columbia, and the Cascade Mountains of Washington.

description: Rhizomnes short, coarse, 1.5-7.5 mm. in diam., profusely rooting, thickly clothed with the bases of previous leaves, in the axils of which are conspicu- ous dense tufts of long tawny hair, giving the rhizome an apparent diam. of 5.0-12 mm.; innovations frequently produced; stems moderately stout, 2.0(1.5)-4.0 mm. thick, 2.0(1.5)-6.0(7.0) dm. high, sparingly to moderately puberulent, long- and short-stipitate-glandular, and occasionally with a few scattered long septate hairs, the pubescence increasing upwards; cauline leaves 5 (4-6) pairs, extending to the middle of the stem or somewhat above, the upper two pairs mostly remote and reduced, the lower leaves 5.0 (3.0)- 10(15) cm. long, 1.0(0.5)-3.0 cm. broad, broadly or narrowly oblanceolate, obtuse, the petioles narrowly or broadly wiing-margined, mostly much shorter than the blade, entire or rarely remotely denticulate, more or less promi- nently 3-5-nerved, more or less uniformly crisp puberulent, sessile- or short- stipitate-glandular, the sessile glands appearing atomiferous and conspicuous, or sometimes strigosely long-stipitate-glandular, and with sparse long septate hairs; peduncles mostly 10-20 cm. long; heads solitary or frequently 3, broadly hemispheric, 12-18 (20) mm. high, the periclinium short, densely villous or subpilose and long- or short-stipitate-glandular; involueral bracts 14-20(24), 11(9)--15 mm. long, 2.0(1.5)-3.5(4.5) mm. wide, broadly lanceo- late to elliptic-oblong, obtuse or only acutish, uniformly villous-puberulent or somewhat scantily so above, ciliolate, the tips pubescent within; ray flowers 12-20, the ligules light or mostly dark to orange yellow, broadly elliptic-oblong, 1.5-2.5 cm. long, 5.0 (4.0)-8.0 (10) mm. wide, bluntly 3- toothed, the lobes 0.3-1.0(1.5) mm. long; disc corollas 7.5(6.7)-9.5(11.5) mm. long, numerous, yellow, goblet-shaped, the tube and the base of the limb densely pilose with long septate hairs, the collar conspicuous, also occasion- ally sparsely short-stipitate-glandular, the tube 3.0(2.4)-4.2(4.5) mm. long, lobes ca. 0.8-0.9 mm. long, acutish, sparsely hispidulous; achenes 4.5(4.0)- 5.5(5.8) mm. long, densely and uniformly hirsute with douLble hairs, occa- sionally also with a few scattered longer septate hairs; pappus cream-colored to tawny, ? as long as the corolla, barbellate, the setae 0.08-0.14 mm. long.

description: Plant biennial or short-lived perennial from a short simple or subsimple caudex, and producing slender stoloniform rhizomes; herbage moderately to densely hirsute with long spreading hairs, the upper surfaces of the leaves often glabrous, or in var. brainiae the whole plant nearly glabrous; stem 15-60 cm. high; basal leaves oblanceolate to suborbicular, tapering to short petioles or petioliform bases, mostly 2-13 cm. long, 6-50 mm. wide, shallowly toothed above the middle, or subentire (sometimes toothed to near the base in var. tolsteadii), rounded or obtuse at the tips; cauline leaves lanceolate or oblong to more commonly ovate, obtuse or rounded to somewhat acute (sharply acute in var. tolsteadii), often apiculate, entire or nearly so (except in var. tolsteadii), usually rather distant, the middle and lower ones 2-7 cm. long, 6-20 mm. wide, occasionally larger, becoming smaller and more scattered upwards; heads mostly 1-4 (rarely 9) in a short flat-topped infloreseence; involucre 5-7 mm. high; phyllaries subequal, or a few of the outer somewhat shorter, about 1 mm. wide or a little less, more or less hirsute with long flattened hairs, and somewhat viscid or glandular (stipitate-glaildular in var. brauniae), greenish, purplish toward the long acuminate tips (except in var. tolsteadii), the searious margins narrow and often obscure; disk about 12-20 mm. wide; disk-corollas mostly 4.5-6.0 mm. long (only 4.0-4.5 mm. in var. tolsteadii), with lobes about 0.6 mm. long, and a rather ill-defined tube mostly about 1.5 mm. long; style-appendages triangular, clearly acute, about 0.2-0.3 mm. long, or occasionally a little shorter and merely acutish; akenes glabrous or nearly so (except in var. tolsteadii), usually 2-nerved, sometimes 4-nerved; pappus simple, of about 30-35 bristles; ligules mostly about 1 mm. wide, sometimes nearly 2 mm. wide, 6-10 mm. long, blue or rarely pinkish (white in var. tolsteadii), usually 50-80, sometimes as many as 100.

description:
Varietas foliis ovatis vel ellipticis basi cuneatis apice acutis, venis in pagina in- feriore albis, petiolis brevibus (0.8-1.5 cm longis) a var. glandulosa distinguenda.

Suffrutex vel herba ad 0.7 m altus. Caules plures, parce ramosi vel simplices 1.5- 2.0 mm diametro brunnei laeves; rami (si adsunt) ob abortionem unius surculorum oppositorum plerumque alterni, rubelli vel saepissime pallidi parce pubescentes. Folia opposita petiolata; laminae 3-4 cm longae 1.2-3.0 cm latae ovatae vel ellipticae serratae, apicibus serraturae saepe callosis, moderate vel sparsim glanduloso-pubes- centes, supra infraque virides, apice acutae, basi truncatae vel cuneatae; venae plerumque albidae, infra elevatae reticulataeque, pinnatae (vel folia aliquantum triplinervia); petioli 0.8-1.5 cm longi sparsim vel moderate glandulosi. Inflorescentiae corymbosae terminales 4.0-5.5 cm diametro saepe tripartitae foliaceae; ramuli oppositi glandulosi. Involucra angusta, phyllariis 7-8 mm longis 0.9 mm latis glandulosis, acutis vel acuminatis et ad apicem purpurellis. Corollae per anthesin 6 mm longae vivide lavandulae; lobi 0.8-1.2 mm longi sparsim pubescentes; fauces 2.5 mm longae; tubus 3.0 mm longus. Achenia fuliginea glabra 3.5 mm longa pappo excluso; pappus 0.2 mm altus, ex squamellis irregularibus translucidis in coronam conjunctis constans.

description: Herba perennis, subglabra, 0.6-1 mm alta, caulibus 1 vel 2 erectis a radice sub-horizontali, glabris, siceis brunneis, tetragonis, suleulatis, ea 3 mm crassis. Folia opposita, tenuiter petiolata petiolo subglabrato 1-3.5 cm longo, petiolo adjecto 6-13 cm longa et ea 7 cm lata, pulchriter pinnata vel interdum irregulariter sub-bipinnatisecta, circumambitu deltoideo-ovata pinnis lateralibus ea 3-6 jugis antrorsum spectantibus, valde membranaceis linearibus integris, utrinque attenuatis apice acribus margine minutissime ciliolatis alibi vix hispidulis longitudilnaliter 1-nervatis (nerviis lateralibus obsoletis) jugo basali tenuiter petiolulato, segmentis ultimis 3-6 mm latis; rhachi petiolum versus nuda sed apicem versus minute marginata. Capitula non numerosa, peduneulos tenues glabros 4-14 cm longos, solitarios vel corymbose 2-3-adgregatos terminantia, radiata, pansa ad anthesin 5-6 cm lata et -1.4 cm alta. Involucri bracteae exteriores ea 6-12, oblongo-obovatae, apice obtusae, extus glabratae et conspicue plurinervtae; interiores paulo longiores, superne angustatae, apice setulis cristatae. Flores ligulati ea 8, pulcherrime albi, ligulis subanguste obovatis 2.3-2.7 cm longis et ca 1 cm latis, apice rotundato-obtusis et obscure denticulatis. Paleae oblongae, glabrae, supra attenuatae, nitidae, multilineatae. Flores tubulosi flavi. Achaenia nigra, lineariter clavato-fusiformia, obtuse tetragona, utraque facie 1-suleata, glabrata, ea 6-9 mm longa et 1 mm lata, apice brunnescenti exaristata.

description: Perennial herb, subglabrous, 0.6-1 m tall; stems 1 or 2, erect from a sub-horizontal root, glabrous, browvn when dried, tetragonal, minutely grooved, ea 3 mm thick. Leaves opposite, slenderly petiolate (with a petiole subglabrous and 1-3.5 em long), 6-13 cm long including the petiole and ea 7 cm wide, beautifully pinnate or at times irregularly subbipinnatisect, in outline deltoid-ovate; lateral pinnae about 3-6 pairs pointing forward or distally, strongly membranlaceous, linear, entire, attenuate at both ends, sharp at the tip, at edges very minutely ciliolate elsewhere barely hispidulous, lengthwise 1-nerved (with lateral nerves obsolete), basal pair slenderly petiolulate, ultimate segments 3-6 mm wide; rhachis naked toward petiole but minutely margined toward tip. Heads not numerous, terminating slender peduncles (these glabrous, 4-14 cm long, solitary or corymbosely 2-3-aggregated), radiate, 5-6 cm wide when expanded at flower- ing and ea 1.4 cm tall. Outer phyllaries about 6-12, oblong-obovate, obtuse at apex, externally glabrate and conspicuously several-nerved; inner ones slightly longer, narrowed above and at tip crested wth minute bristles. Ligulate florets about 8, very beautifully white; ligules somewhat narrowly obovate, 2.3-2.7 cm long and ca 1 cm wide, at apex rounded-obtuse and obscurely denticulate. Chaff-scales oblong, glabrous, attenuate above, glistening, many-lined. Tubular florets yellow. Achenes black, slenderly clavate-fusiform, obtusely quadrangulate, 1-grooved on each face, glabrate, about 6-9 mm long and 1 mm wide, exaristate at the browning apex.

description: Plants 3-5 dm high. Stems glabrous to sparsely pubescent below becoming densely pubescent above. Leaf margins entire; upper leaves elliptic to ovate with acuminate apices, glabrous to sparsely pubescent; middle leaves narrowly elliptic to oblanceo- late, glabrous; lower and radical leaves oblanceolate, glabrous. Peduncles 3-8 cm long, lanate. Heads 4-6 per plant, ca. 15 mm high, ca. 25 mm wide. Involucre of 3 series of lanceolate bracts, the outer 2 series similar, weakly united and densely pubescent basally, sparsely pubescent apically; the inner bracts half the size of the outer, not united, sparsely pubescent. Ray florets ca. 30; ligules shallowly 3-4-lobed. Disc corollas 4.6-5.1 mm long, 1.0-1.4 mm wide. Achenes ca. 4.5 mm long, ca. 1.0 mm wide, moderately pubescent. Pappus scales 3.1-3.9 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm wide. Distribution: Plants apparently endemic to Nuevo Leon, Mexico in the vicinity of the peak of Cerro Potosi about 20 mi NE of Galeana; occurring at an elevation of ca. 3650 m under pine forest and in moist meadows; flowering from June to August.

description: Plants 2.6 m high; stem stout, loosely spreading-pilose with hairs less than 1 mm long, glabrescent; leaves alternate; petioles 1.5 cm long; blades ovate, 10 cm long, 5 cm wide, acuminate, cuneate at base, crenate-serrate, densely and rather softly pilose above, becoming somewhat hispidulous, beneath densely and softly pilose-tomentose with griseous, flexous or matted hairs; heads 1-3 on peduncles 2.5-14 cm long; disk 2.0-2.5 cm in diameter; phyllaries oblong-lanceolate to ovate-oblong, 1.4 cm long, 3-3.5 mm broad, acuminate, herbaceous with indurate basal portion, sparsely to densely short-pilose, loose and reflexed or spreading in age; rays about 14, 2.2 cm long, 4 mm wide; disk corollas yellow with blackish teeth 6 mm long, sparsely hispidulous; pales obtuse or acutish, nearly glabrous, blackish-green at apex; disk achenes 3.8 mm long; pappus of 1 or 2 linear-lanceolate awns, 2.5 mm long; pappus of ray flowers of 4-5 lacerate squamellae.

description: Stout herb, the caudex subterranean or short erect; leaves thin coriaceous, linear, 25-45 cm. long, 12-20 mm. broad, scarcely narrowed distally, acute at apex, entire at margins, appressed sericeous on both surfaces with fine silvery hairs, the costa stout, the secondary nerves obscured; flowering branches erect, up to 125 cm. high, silvery or einereous or ferruginous sericeous, bearing a few cauline leaves towards base, much-branched, the branches opposite, subtended by small oblong foliaceous bracts; heads semi-globose, at maturity about 20 mm. in diameter; phyllaries about 20, 2- or 3-seriate, broadly ovate, acute, the outer ones 5-6 mm. long, 4-6 mm. broad, densely sericeous without; ray florets numerous, about 3-seriate, the corolla 7-8 mm. long, the tube 1.5-2 mm. long, densely spreading-pubescent with short several-celled hairs, the lamina oblong, about 1.5 mm. broad, 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas 3-4 mm. long, the achene about 2 mm. long; disk florets 6-7 mm. long, sparsely hispidulous on tube and lobes, the tube shorter than the limb, the lobes ovate-deltoid, sparsely glandular, the stamens 4-4.5 mm. long, the filaments exceeding the anthers in length; paleae subcoriaceous, stramineous, ovate-oblong, subacute, ineurved at margins, the outer ones 5-6 mm. long, about 2.5 mm. broad, brownish strigose distally without, the hairs 1-1.3 mm. long.

description: Perennial with taproot and relatively slender branching caudex; stem about 3-4 dm. high, densely spreading-hirsute; leaves hirsute on both surfaces, only obscurely if at all ciliate on the margins, the basal and lowermost cauline ones with elliptic blade up to 4 cm. long and 15 mm. wide, the petiole up to 3 cm. long; leaves next upwards on the stem sessile, oblong-lanceolate, acute, more or less triple-nerved, up to 6 cm. long and 15 mm. wide; middle and upper stem leaves reduced, lanceolate or linear-lanceolate, the uppermost ones mere scattered linear bracts scarcely 2 cm. long; plant simple, or branching moderately from the base to near the middle, the heads solitary, or termiinating the branches; disk 12-16 mm. wide; involuere about 6-7 mm. high; phyllaries conspicuously hirsute and obscurely viscid, thick, greenish, with darker midrib and purple tips, the outer ones slightly shorter; ligules about 65-80, white, about 10 mm. long and 1.5 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.7-4.3 mm. long, broad-based, gradually expanded upwards, with no division into tube and limb, or the tube obscure, the lobes about 0.5-0.6 mm. long; style-appendages very short and broad,.obtuse, about 0.1 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 15 bristles, the outer narrowly squamellate; akenes hairy, 2-nerved.

description: Non-scented fibrous-rooted annual, much-branched from base, mat-forming, seldom radicant. Stems 4-25 cm long, 0.2-1 mm diameter, dark purplish, densely leafy with internodes mostly 0.8-2.5 mm long, hirtellous in decurrent lines with erect whitish trichomes 0.1-0.2 mm long. Leaves linear oblanceolate, 8-20 mm long, 2-4 mm broad, at apex rounded and usually mucronulate, glabrous on both surfaces, minutely antrorsely scaberulous on margins toward apex with trichomes 0.1-0.2 mm long, hirtellous proximally on margins with trichomes like those on the stem, ciliate on proximal 1/3-1/5 with 3-5 pairs of bristles 1-2 mm long, punctate on undersurface with submarginal and scattered circular glands 0.1-0.2 mm diameter. Heads solitary or in 3-5 headed terminal cymes, subsessile or on peduncles to 5 mm long, subtended by a pair of opposite foliaceous or scale-like bractlets somewhat smaller than foliage leaves and by a single ovate bractlet 1-2 mm long. Involucre cylindric, deciduous at maturity with enclosed achenes; phyllaries 3-5, dark green and often with reddish-brown patch near apex, cohering at base and broadly overlapping on margins, oblanceolate to obovate, 5.6-6.6 mm long, 2.2- 3.2 mm broad, at apex obtuse and sometimes mucronulate, with margins narrowly scarious, minutely erosulate to entire at apex, otherwise entire, on abaxial surface round-keeled nearly to apex, glabrous, punctate near apex with several narrowly elliptic glands 0.1-0.2 mm long and with similar but smaller submarginal glands that decrease in size toward base. Ray florets 3-5; corollas bright yellow, usually with the tube purplish and the ligule bearing a reddish-purple patch abaxially below apex, 3.2-4.2 mm long, the tube and ligule subequal, 1.6-2.1 mm long, glabrous or very sparsely puberulent on the tube with minute gland-tipped trichomes. Diskflorets 3-6 (10); corolla bright yellow, 2.2-3 mm long, the tube and throat each 0.8-1.2 mm long, the limb 5-lobed, weakly bilabiate with the anterior lip ca 3 x as long as the lobes on the posterior lip, glabrous to sparsely puberulent with minute gland-tipped trichomes; style 2.4-3.6 mm long, barely exserted; anthers 0.7-0.8 mm long; pollen grains 34-36 gm diameter. Ray achenes 2.9- 3.6 mm long, blackish, adaxially puberulent with ascending whitish bicellular trichomes 0.2-0.3 mm long, abaxially glabrous, at apex just below pappus bearing brownish gland-tipped multicellular trichomes ca 0. 1 mm long. Disk achenes 2.8- 3.2 mm long, puberulent throughout with bicellular trichomes 0.2-0.3 mm long, and at apex with gland-tipped trichomes. Pappus usually included in involucre at anthesis; ray pappus a crown of low scales 0.2-0.8 mm long; disk pappus double with 0-4 bristle-tipped scales up to 3.2 mm long and 1 to 5 minute scales or reduced bristles 0.2-0.8 mm long. Chromosome number: n = 48 (Table I).

description: Perennial herb; caudex with several or many slender almost rhizomatous branches, these bearing many fibrous roots, and without a well developed taproot or long central axis; stem 5-25 cm. high, strongly purplish at the usually curved base, sparsely or moderately strigose or hirsute with appressed hairs, the hairs occasionally somewhat spreading and viscid under the heads, rarely spreading below as well; leaves glabrous, with ciliate margins, occasionally sparsely hirsute-strigose on the faces, the basal ones oblanceolate, usually acute or acutish at the apex, sometimes obtuse or rounded, usually tapering gradually to the petiole, up to about 12 cm. long and 11 mm. wide, usually much smaller, purplish at the base; cauline leaves several, reduced, linear or lanceolate, acuminate or long-acute; head solitary, the disk about 9-19 mm. wide; involucre 5-7 mm. high, glandular or viscid and sparsely or moderately hirsute or hirsute-villous with spreading hairs; phyllaries green, more or less herbaceous, nearly equal, the purplish tips loose and often reflexed; ligules about 30-100, usually blue, sometimes pink- purple, about 7-15 mm. long and 1.0-2.0 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.2-4.7 mm. long, the tube 0.7-1.3 mm., the lobes 0.6-1.0 mm., the limb rather widely flaring; style-appendages deltoid, acutish, 0.15-0.2 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 10-20 bristles, the outer of evident setae or setose squamellae; akenes 2-nerved, short-hairy.

description: Herba ad 15 cm alta tota adpresse lanata ablo-einerea, rhizomate inclinato apice paulo ramoso ramis brevibus congestis cespitosis fasciculum vel rosulam foliorum desinentibus, tantum singulo scaposo-florifero. Folia basilaria (rosulorum) longe vaginata, vagina seariosa glabra 2.5-3 cm longa 5-6 mm lata, limbo crasse subherbaceo subspathulato-oblongo integerrimo apice rotundato vel obtusissimo basim versus sine sensu in petiolum angustatum, tantum costa plus minusve conspicua ceterum laevi utrinque tomento lanoso mediocri subeompresso albo-cinereo tecto; parte dilatata 1.5-3 cm longo, 5-10 mm lato, petiolo 2.5-4 cm longo circa 2 mm lato. Scapi solitarii 8-12 cm longi mediocres erecti albo-cinereo-lanati sparse foliosi; foliis subspathulato-linearibus obtusissimis basim versus paulo attenuatis basi ampliato-amplectentibus 3-5 cm longis 4-8 mm latis. Capitula homooama discoidea globulosa cernua solitaria vel paucissirna (1-2 vidi) in herbario circa 3 cm diamitentia; extremo pedunculo (scapo) et basi capituli numierosis (plus quain 20) bracteolis tenuibus subulatis acutis purpuraseelutibus sed albo-laniginosis 13-10 mm longis basi 1-1.6 mm latis involucrum fere attingentem calyculum formantibus. Involucrum cupulare bracteis crassiusculis purpuraceis circa 37 subbiseriatis laieeolatis acutis circa 10 mm longis, 1.3-1.8 mm latis, dorso costatis miiargine breviter ciliatis apice penicillato-ciliatis ceterum glabris vel pilis lanosis sparsis deciduis. Flores omnes hermaphroditi circa 250 in capitulo, corolla flava glabra 7-8 mm longa tubulo 3-3.5 mm lonoo basi inerassato limbo tubuloso campaliulato extremo 5 dentibus circa 1 mm longis crassis deltoideis apice acutis ineurvis; antherae 2 mm longae basi obtusiusculae. Stylus ramnis crassiusculis curvatis apice truneato papilloso-penicillato. Ovarium glabrumn. Pappus pallide stramiuleus circa 6 mm longus pilis biseriatis rigidis strigulosis. Receptaculum 10 mm diamitens leviter alveolatum marginibus alveolorum delitibus brevibus acutis.

description: Erect herbs, to 70 cm tall. Stems striate, densely glandular-pubescent. Leaves ascendent, overlapping and covering most of the stem, oblong-lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, 2-17 X 0.8-7.5 cm, the apices obtuse to acutish, shortly apiculate, the base auriculate-clasping, the auricles rounded, the margin finely spinulose-denticulate, coriaceous, scabrid, both surfaces glandular-pubescent and with curly nonglandular hairs on the veins. Inflorescence terminal, thyrsiform, narrow; capitula in cymules; peduncles to 2 cm long, densely stipitate-glandular, sparse- ly bracteolate, the bracteoles grading into the phyllaries; involucre 3-4-seriate, campanulate, ca. 1.3 cm high, the phyllaries acute, the innermost acuminate, densely glandular on the dorsal surface, the outer-most lanceolate, ca. 5 X 1.1 mm, the central ones oblong-lanceolate, 5-9 X ca. 1 mm, the innermost oblanceolate, 11-13 X ca. 1 mm. Florets 17-20; corolla purple, glandular-puberulent, 11.5 mm long, the tube 6.5 mm long, the lips ca. 5 mm long, the innermost slightly shorter; stamens 7 mm long, the apical appendage ca. 2 mm long, pink, the anther thecae ca. 2.5 mm long, the tails ca. 2 mm long, the filaments ca. 2 mm long; styles orange to red, ca. II mm long, including the ca. 1 mm long branches. Achenes cylindric, 5 mm long, hirsute with glandular hairs scattered throughout; pap- pus ca. 8 mm long, white, biseriate.

description: Frutex glaber; caulis striato-angulatus; folia opposita ovata mediocria tenuiter coriacea acuLta basi cuneato-rotundata brevipetiolata supra medium serrulata 5-plinervia et reticulata infra obscure impresso-punctata; capitula radiata majuscula apice caulis et ramulorum 1-3, in pedunculis nudis 3-4 cm. longis; involueri campanulati v. hemisphaerici 12-18 mm. alti phyllaria extima 4 omnino herbacea ovata obtusa integra 5-7-nervia interioribus 2-3-seriatis ovalibus v. oblongis apice rotundatis siceis paullo longiora; radii ca. 11 aurei 1-1.3 cm. longi; pappi paleae 15 lineari-lanceolatae achaenio sparse hispidulo duplo longiores.

description: Probably a shrub, appearing very glabrous throughout, but really minutely strigillose on the leaves; stems or branches available (pieces about 20 cm. long) usually simple; stem purplish-brown, the branehlets somewhat 4- or 6-angled; internodes 1.5-4.5 cm. lonig; petioles stoutish, narrowly margined above, 1.5-3 mm. long; leaf-blades 2.5-3.7 cm. long, 1.3-1.7 cm. wide, acute butt the extreme apex obtuse and somewhat calloused, plane, serrulate above middle (teeth 3-5 pairs, acutish, calloused, 2-3 mm. apart, about 0.5 mm. high), 5-pli-nerved within 2-4 mim. of base (the upper pair of nerves stronger) and prominulous-reticulate benea-th- (the veins lucid by transmitted light), above dark green, somewhat shining, sparsely and minutely strigillose, glabrate or glabrescent, beneath lighter green, rather evenly but sparsely and minutely strigillose (the hairs visible under strong magnification and in a good light); peduncles slender, thickened toward the head, strongly suleate; involuere double, the 4 outermost phyllaries similar to the leaves but smaller and entire, erect, ovate or ellipticovate, 12-18 mm. long, 5-9 mm. wide, glabrous, the inner 2-3-seriate, slightly graduate, multi-vittate, the outer coriaceous-herbaceous in upper half, the inner stramineous with narrow searious ciliolate margin; pales oblonig, acute, thinnish, 3-vittate, lacerate-ciliolate above, 5-6.5 mm. long; rays fertile, the tube glabrous, 4.5 mm. long, the lamina narrowly elliptic, densely gland-dotted on back, about 9-nerved, 3-denticulate, 10-13 mm. long, about 3 mm. wide; disk corollas rather numerous, goldeni yellow, glabrous, 6.4 mm. long (tube 2 mm., throat sleniderly obconic, 3.2 mm. long, teeth 5, acute, 1.2 mm. long) ; achenes oblong, 2.8 inm. long, 4-angled, sparsely hirsutulous; pappus of 15 subequal linear-lanceolate acuminiate paleae, serrulate above, 5.5 mm. long.

description: Frutex; rami crassi dense cano-tomentosi apice conferte foliosi infra denudati; folia parva spathulata crasse coriacea integerrima sessilia basi calearata apice rotundata eymbiformia 1-nervia evenia mox glabrata puncticulata; capitula apice ramorum solitaria sessilia majuscula discoidea ca. 11-flora; involueri ca. 6-seriati valde gradati 3 cm. alti phyllaria coriaceo-straminea sparse pilosa mox glabrata ciliata aeuta, extima brevissima deltoideo-ovata intima lanceolata; corollae ca. 22 mm. longae tubo apice intus hirsuto-barbato, fauce nulla, dentibus lineari-lanceolatis tubo ca. 4-plo lolngioribus; achenium oblongum quadrangulum glabrum ca. 10-costatum 6 mm. longum; pappus rufescens persistens ca. 3-seriatus valde gradatus 2 cm. longus, aristis interioribus infra distincte complanatis apice parum dilatatis.

description: Twigs (two pieces about 10 cm. long) simple or branched, 4-5 mm. thick; leaves alternate, crowded, aseending, leaving brown holes in the gray tomentum after falling, 12-21 mm. long, 2.5-4 mm. wide, rounded or occasiolnally bluntly apiculate at apex, narrowed to the sessile and rounded-calearate base, boat-shaped but not involute-margined, not marginate, yellowish or brownish-greeln, thinly and obscurely pilosuIous, soon glabrate, light-puncticulate on both sides; phyllaries rather few (about 20), the outermost about 7 mm. long, 4.5 mm. wide, 1-ribbed, the inmost about 28 mm. long, 4 mm. wide, about 7-nerved, the inmost obscurely ciliolate, the others laxly white-ciliate, all lightpuncticulate; pales of receptacle very narrowly linear, folded, carinate, hispidulous-ciliolate above, 2.8 cm. long, 0.7 mm. wide; corollas 21-23 mm. long (tube 3.5-5 mm., throat wanting, teeth 17.5-18 mm. long, with a terminal denticulate crest); anthers 9.5 mm. long, the terminal appendages lance-linear, aculuilnate, about 3 mm. long, the tails about 3 mm. long, linear, acuminate, subentire, those of adjacent anthers free; style asperulous above, the branches lnarrowly triangular-ovate, aeutish, erect, glabrous, 0.5 mm. long.

description: Perennial herbs, ca 0.6-1.6 m tall; stems velutinous, cream-colored, darkening with age. Leaves cauline; petioles 1-3 cm long, velutinous; blades 10-15 cm long, 5.5-9.5 cm wide, ovate, apically acute, basally cordate-truncate or sometimes cuneate, marginally revolute and remotely toothed, glabrous, basally tomentose along the midvein above, velutinous and cream-colored beneath. Inflorescences cymose, paniculate. Heads 9-16 (20)-flowered, sessile or shortly pedunculate, conspicuously velutinous. Involucre narrowly campanulate, 8.2-10.5 mm high, 6-9 mm wide; phyllaries loosely imbricate in several series, comose apically, the inner ones oblong-lanceolate, acuminate, 8-9 mm long, 1.3-2.1 mm wide, the outer ones ovate-lanceolate, 3-5.2 mm long, 1-1.6 mm wide. Pappus straw-col- ored, the inner bristles 6.5-7 mm long and outer bristles 1.5-1.8 (2.5) mm long. Corollas 6.7-8 mm long, reddish-purple, glabrous. Anthers 3.2-4.5 mm long. Achenes 2.3-3.5 mm long, the strigose-pilose vesture obscuring any surface features. Flowering and fruiting from April to July.

description: Perennis; eaule 3-4 dm. alto, superne ramoso, hirsuto vel hispido;  foliis oblanceolatis, 2-4 cm. longis, obtusis vel acutis, hirsutis; pilis  aseendentibus, basibus pustulatis; foliis inferioribus petiolatis, superioribus  sessilibus; involuero hemisphaerico, 15 mm. lato; bracteis dense hirsutis, vix resinoso-granuliferis; ligulis 10-12 mm. longis;  acheniis 3 mm. longis sericeo-hirsutis.

description: Frutex usque ad 1 m altus; rami pubescentia lanata alba valde adpressa tecti; cortex pallide brunneus. Folia linearia, rigida, alterna vel in fasciculis axillaribus disposita, usque ad 13 mm longa, +/- 1 mm lata, apice acuta et plus minusve apiculata, marginibus integris et valde revolutis, versus basim sessilem attenuata, uninervata, costa subtus valde prominenti, supra plus minusve manifesta; lamina supra glabra, subtus praeter costam glabram albo-lanata. Capitula in inflorescentiis spiciformibus foliosis aggregata, unumquidque in folii longioris axilla portatum et foliis brevioribus pluribus circumcinctum. Capitula feminea 8-10 mm longa; involucrum turbinatum, 7-9 mm longum, plus minusve glutinosum, glabrum, flavidum; phyllaria 15-21, 4-5- serialia, lineari-oblonga usque ovata, apice acuta usque rotundata, marginibus scariosis; receptaculum planum, nudum; flores per capitulum 8-10. Flores feminei: corolla anguste tubulosa, 3.5-4.5 mm longa, breviter lobata, supra pallide purpurea; styli rami lineares, obtusi vel acuti, papillosi; achaenia lineari-oblonga, 2.5-3 mm longa, leviter compressa, 4-costata, antrorse sericea; pappi setae +50, capillares, cremeae, aliquantum inaequales, 4-5 mm longae, breviter barbellatae. Capitula floresque masculi ignoti.

description: Herba perennis ca 1 m alta, inferne lignea et fruticosa, glabrata, caulibus simplicibus angulatis valde sulculatis purpuraseentibus, ca 3-4 mm crassis minutissime obscurissimeque setulosis setulis adpressis vel patentibus, supra corymbose graciliterque ramosis ca 16 capitula subtendentibus. Folia rigida, viridia, petiolata petiolo anguste marginato (in rhachin conspicue planum alatumque 1-3 mm latum decurrente), ca 1 cm longo et minutissime pulverulento, eleganter pinnata vel bipinnatisecta pinnis primariis ea 2 vel 3 jugis ea 1.5-3.5 mm latis, minutissime hispidulis ciliatisque mediane 1-costatis plus minusve retrorsum arcuatis, segmentis ultimis apice acerrimis. Capitula radiata, pansa ad anthesin 3.5-4.5 cm lata et ca 1 cm alta, elongate pedunculata pedunculis gracillimis viridibusque, superne sub 0.3 mm crassis. Involueri bracteae exteriores ea 8, lineari-lanceolatae, subglabrae, primum adpressae demum reflexae, ca 5-striatae, 4-7 mm longae; interiores late lanceolato-oblongae, duplo longiores. Flores ligulati ea 5, purpureo-rubri (sicei purpuraseentes), ligula 1.7-2 cm longa et 1-1.8 cm lata, obovata, supra medium rotundata et apice saepe truneato acriter 2- vel 3-dentata. Paleae lanceolato-oblongae, flosculos tubulosos interdum aequantes. Flosculi tubulosi flavi, basim versus albidi, corollae dentibus dense ciliolatis. Achaenia atra vel brunneo-atra, linearia, aegre arcuata, obcompresso-tetragona, suleata, basim versus glabrata, superne antrorso-setulosa, apice suberecte tri- vel raro imperfecte quadriaristata aristis substramineis retrorsum hamosis ea 2 mm longis.

description: Perennial herb ca 1 m tall, woody and shrubby below, subglabrous; stems simple, angulate, strongly sulculate, purplish, about 3-4 mm thick, very minutely and obscurely setulose with appressed or spreading setulae, corymbosely and delicately branched, bearing ca 16 heads. Leaves rigid, green, petioled with a narrowly margined petiole (this ca 1 mm long and very minutely pulverulent, decurrent into a flat and winged rhachis 1-3 mm wide), beautifully pinnate or bipinnatisect with ca 2 or 3 pairs of primary pinnae, these 1.5-3.5 mm wide, very minutely hispidulous and ciliate, medianly 1-ribbed, more or less retrorsely curved, the ultimate segments apically very acute. Heads radiate, expanded at anthesis 3.5-4.5 cmn wide alnd ca 1 cm tall, elongately peduncled with very deli- cate and green peduncles, these under 0.3 mm thick above. Outer phyllaries ca 8, linear-lanceolate, subglabrous, at first appressed finally reflexed, ca 5-striate, 4-7 mm long; inner ones broadly lanceolate-oblong, twice longer. Liaulate florets ca 5, purplish-red (becoming purple on drying); ligule 1.7-2 cm long and 1-1.8 cm wide, obovate, rounded above the middle and sharply 2- or 3-dentate at the often truncate distal end. Chaff-scales lanceolate-oblong, at times equalling the tubular florets. Florets of the disk yellow, whitish toward base, teeth of their corolla densely ciliolate. Achenes black or brownish-black, linear, weakly curved, obcompressed-quadrangulate, grooved, olabrate near base, antrorsely setulose above, at apex suberectly 3- or rarely and imperfectly 4-aristate with straw-colored aristae, these retrorsely barbed and about 2 mm long.

description: Herba perennis e caudice ligneo orta, usque ad 6-8 din alta, caulibus gracilibus, viridibus, acriter tetragonis et subalnguilatis, ea 1.5-2 mm crassis, glabris, summam versus corymbose pauci-ramosis ramis suberectis, glabratis, sub 1 mm crassis. Folia opposita, quam internodia multo breviora, tenuiter petiolata petiolo glabro ea 1 cm longo, petiolo adjecto 4-6 cm longo, lamina eircumambitu del- toideo-ovata, bi- vel tripinnata, seogmentis ultimis oblonge linearibus ca 1-2.5 mm latis, marginbus minutissime spinuloso-ciliatis apice acriter mucronulatis, faciebus obscure hispidulis. Capitula subsolitaria, pedunculata pedunculis teniuissimis glabris, radiata, pansa ad anthesin 2.5-3.5 cm lata et ca 1 cm alta. Involucri bracteae exteriores ea 12, anguste lineares, extus aegre puberulae, apice acutae et callosae, basi auriculato-dilatatae et imbricatae, virides sed longitudinialiter ea 3-striatae, ca 4 mm longae, quam interiores lanceolato-oblongae paulo breviores. Flores ligulati plerumque 8, flavi, ligula lineari-oblonga vel oblanceolata, apice ineurvato-denticulata. Paleae anguste lineares, superne attenuatae, ca 7 mm longae. Flores tubulosi flavi. Achaenia atra, apicem versus plerumque brunnea, glabra, tetragona, paleas demum multo superantia, infra ea 0.5 mm crassa et subrecta supra arcuata et angustiora, apice truneato biaristata aristis oracillimis irregulariter squarroso-reflexis glaberrimis et 2-3 mm longis.

description: Perennial herb rising from a woody caudex, up to 6-8 dm tall; steims slender, green, sharply tetragonal and weakly angulate, ea 1.5-2 mm thick, glabrous, toward top corymbosely few-branched with suberect branches, these glabrate and under 1 mm thick. Leaves opposite, much shorter than the cauline internodes, slenderly petiolate with the glabrous petiole ca 1 cm lonog, 4-6 cm lono including a petiole; blade deltoid-ovate in outline, bi- or tripinnate, the ultimate segments oblongly linear, ca 1-2.5 mm wide, their margins very minutely spinulose-ciliate and their tips sharply mucronulate, the faces obscurely hispidulous. Heads sub-solitary, peduncles very delicate, 5-12 mm long, glabrous; radiate; expanided at flowering-time 2.5-3.5 cm wide and ca 1 cm tall. Outer phyllaries ea 12, narrowly linear, weakly puberulous on outer surface, at apex acute and indurate, at base auriculate-dilated and imbricated, green but longitudinally about 3-striate, ca 4 mm long, than the inner lanceolate-oblong ones a little shorter. Liogulate florets commonly 8, yellow; ligule linear-oblong or oblanceolate, apically incurved-denticulate. Chaff-scales narrowly linear, attenuate above, ca 7 mm long. Tubular florets yellow. Achenes black but comnionly brown toward the apex, glabrous, quadrangulate, finally much exceeding the chaff-scales, ca 0.5 mm thick below and also straightish, near top curved and more slender, at apex truncate and biaristate; aristae very slender and irregularly squarrose-reflexed, very glabrous and 2-3 mm long.

description: Plants annual or perennial, 10-37 cm high; stems prostrate to erect, in perennials often rhizomatous, sparsely to densely pubescent with spreading trichomes; leaves extremely variable, from lanceolate to oblanceolate, 1.5-7(-8.5) cm long, 0.2-2 cm wide, entire to acutely lobed, varying to palmately to pinnately dissected, the lobes often secondarily lobed or divided, slightly to densely pubescent on both surfaces, the trichomes rather coarse, spreading to slightly appressed, the blade attenuate at the base and thus pseudopetiolate; heads broadly campanulate, 0.5-1.5 cm in diameter, solitary on usually long, slender peduncles (5-)7.0-18(-22) cm long, glabrous to densely pubescent with spreading trichomes (rarely with glandular trichomes interspersed); receptacle subconial, 3-6 mm across, 3-4 mm high; chaff persistent, membranous, 4.5-7 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, glabrous or nearly so, the apex emarginate, truncate-dentate or rarely acute-mucronate; inivolucre in 2-3 series, the outer bracts 4.0-6.5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, broadly lanceolate, acute to mucronate at the apex, glabrate or densely pubescent, scarious margined, completely purple or partially so at the margins and apex; inner bracts glabrous, 5-7 mm long, 2-3.5 mm wide, oblong to slightly obovate, the apex acute, truncate, emarginate, or often dentate, the margins scarious, usually purple; ray florets ca 8, white or yellow, perfect and fertile, like the disc florets except conspicuously zygomorphic, tube 0.5-1 mm long, the throat 1.7-3 mm long, the outer lobes 2-5.5 mm long, 1-2.5 mm long, 1-2.5 mm wide, acute, obtuse or rounded at the apex, the inner lobelets 1-2 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide, attenuate-acute at the apex; disc corollas yellow, 3.5-5(-5.5) mm long, the tube 0.5-1 mm long, pubescent with a few glandular trichomes, the throat broadly tubular, glabrous, 2.5-3 (-3.5) mm long, the lobes reflexed, 0.5-1.3 mm long, acute, minutely pubescent; style branches rather flattened, slender, pubescent, recurved, 1.2-1.5(-1.8) mm long, with obscure stigmatic lines, tapering to a rather inconspicuous subulate tip; achenes obconical or indistinctly 4-sided to subturbinate (tangentially compressed near periphery of head), 2-2.8(-3) mm long, blackish, densely silky villous, the hairs 0.5-2 mm long; pappus of alternately attached lanceolat'e-fimbriate scales (narrowest outside, broadest inside), spreading at maturity, 1.5-3.8(-4.5) mm long; anthers 1.7-3 mm long, obscurely sagittate at the base; chromosome numbers, n = 9 (19 populations), 18 (9 populations), 27 (5 populations), indicated below with one, two and three asterisks respectively.

description: Erect herb or suffrutescent shrub to 3 m tall, sparingly branched; leaves, phyllaries, corollas, and styles bearing glandular hairs. Stems finely striate, smooth, light brown, becoming more woody at base. Leaves usually alternate, rarely subopposite; petioles to 4 cm long, not winged; blades ovate to suborbicular, usually somewhat angular in outline, 5-10 cm long, up to 10 cm wide, rather palmately veined; the margin crenate-serrate; apex slightly acuminate. Inflorescence a thyrsoid panicle, up to 30 cm long, to 15 cm wide. Heads numerous, ca. 5-6 mm high, ca. 4-13-flowered. Phyllaries ca. 10, oblong to suborbicular, with apex rounded to obtusely pointed, with few or no striae, green, pubescent with densely fringed margin. Receptacle slightly to strongly convex, chaffy. Corollas white, funnelform, ca. 2 mm long. Pappus of ca. 20-27 white setae, ca. 2 mm long. Achenes dark brown or black, ca. 1.25 mm long, 4-5-ribbed, ribs setose; carpopodium well developed. Pollen tricolpate, spherical, minutely papillose, ca. 20 µ in diameter.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Stems erect, to 70 cm tall, terete, densely stipitate-glandular (yellow to red-purple), reddish green, well-branched from lower part; branches ascending, bearing a few pairs of small leaves. Leaves opposite, sessile; lamina thin, herbaceous, oval to elliptic, trinerved, 40-60 X 10-20 mm in the middle part of stems, subacute at apex, cuneate at base, stipitate-glandular (yellow) on both surfaces, the margin entire, sometimes having a few crenulate teeth, ciliate with stipitate glands (yellow). Heads many, 11-13 X 5- 6 mm, in many small compound corymbs; each corymb 10-20 mm wide consisting of 5-10 heads. Inflorescence branches and peduncles stipitate-glandular (yellow); peduncles short. Phyllaries 7-8 mm long, acuminate at apex, pale green, often red-purple near the apex, stipitate-glandular (yellow to red-purple) outside. Corolla pale pink, sparsely stipitate-glandular outside; tubes ca. 6 mm long; lobes ca. 2 mm long. Achenes 5-6 mm long, brown-black, hispid. Pappus scales membranous, ca. 0.3 mm high, not awned.

description: Rhizome slender, 1.0-2.0 mm. in diam., somewhat extensively branching, clothed with remnants of bracts and leaf-bases, rooting freely along the under side; innovations freely produced; stems slender, 1.0-2.0(3.0) mm. in diam., simple or sometimes branching from below the middle, 15-40 cm. high, striate, sparsely scabrid-puberulent and short-stipitate-glandular, sometimes also sparsely pilose, pubeseence becoming denser above, leafy mostly below the middle; eauline leaves 3(2)-4 pairs, 3.0-10 cm. long. 1.0(0.7)-3.5 cm. broad, 3-5-nerved, those of the base and the innovations narrowly to broadly elliptic-lanceolate, sometimes ovate, acute, narrowed to a slender winged petiole approximately equaling the blade, denticulate to strongly dentate, subglabrate, scaberulous-puberulent and short-stipitate- glandular, and sometimes also sparingly pilose with septate attenuate hairs, the leaf margins, particularly on the petioles, ciliolate or ciliate, the upper leaves sessile and reduced, bracts of the infloreseence narrowly lanceolate; peduncles slender, 2.0-10(15) cm. long; heads 1-7(11), campanulate to turbinate, 15-18 mm. high; periclinium campanulate-turbinate, only hispidu- lous-puberulent and densely short-stipitate-glandular; involueral bracts 10- 16, more or less obviously 2-ranked, 1.0-3.0 mm. broad, 8.0-12 mm. long, lanceolate, acute, densely glandular throughout, also sometimes sparingly pilose; ray flowers 7-12(15), the ligules yellow, oblong-linear, 10-20 mm. long, 5.0(4.0)-8.0 mm. broad, 3-dentate, the teeth short, 0.5-1.5(2.0) mm. long, aeutish; disc corollas 6.0-? min. long, goblet-shaped, the base of the limb and the tube sparingly to densely pilose, the lobes aeutish, scarcely or moderately hispid; achenes 4.0-6.3 mm. long, uniformly but only moderately Iispid with double hairs equaling in length 1/2 or less the diam. of the achene, sparingly intermixed with septate hairs, not at all or conspicuously short- stipitate-glandular, frequently more densely pubeseent at the base, the annulus short; pappus white, -+ as long as the corolla, the setae barbellate, 0.1-1.18 mm. long.

description: Shrubs, densely branched; stems densely strigose, hairs straight, 0.3-0.4 mm long. Leaves sessile; blades linear to linear-lanceolate, 10-16 X 2-3 cm, 3-veined, bases narrow-attenuate, amplexicaule, margins crenate, remotely serrate, and distantly revolute, apices acuminate, faces sparsely strigose, hairs to 0.2 mm long. Capitulescences thyrsoid, capitula 10-25; peduncles 2 mm long. Capitula disciform, 3 mm high, 2.5 mm diam.; involucres subglobose, 2.5 mm diam.; phyllaries 2, ovate, 2.5 X 2 mm, 5-7-veined, scarcely strigose, hairs 0.5 mm long, distal one-third ciliate, apices acute, bases fleshy at maturity. Pistillate florets 30, multiseriate, subtended by ovate-lanceolate, 5-veined paleae, 2.5 X 1.5 mm, the paleae sparsely strigose at apex, hairs 0.1 mm long, bases fleshy at maturity; corollas white, glabrous, 2.5 mm long, tubes 1.5 mm long, 0.4 mm diam., lobes 4, deltoid, 0.6 mm long, scarcely pubescent, hairs 0.1 mm long; styles 1 mm long, branches 0.1-0.2 mm long. Staminate florets about 24, subtended by narrowly lanceolate paleae 2.2 X 0.5 mm, 3-veined, sparsely strigose with distal one-third ciliate with hairs 0.1 mm long; corollas 1.5 mm long, throats 1 mm long, 0.5 mm diam.; lobes 4-5, deltoid, 0.3 mm long, sparsely strigose at apex, hairs 0.1 mm long; anthers black 1 mm long; styles 1-1.2 mm long, branches 0.5 mm long; ovaries, 1 mm long, pilose at apex, hairs 0.1 mm long. Cypselae drupaceous, 3 X 2 mm, compressed, bases attenuate-stipitate, distal one-third, hirsute, hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long. Chromosome numbers unknown.

description: Frutex; rami subteretes minute glandulosi et patenti-hirsuti infra glabreseentes; folia ovata acuminata basri leviter cordata lateribus rotundatis crenato-serrata triplinervia supra brevipilosa basibus pilorum tuberculatis persistentibus subtus paullo pallidiora molliter pilosa et glanduloso-adspersa; capitula saepius 3 terminalia longepedun- culata majuscula radiata; phyllaria inaequalia lanceolata acuminata dense pilosa extima majora ca. 1.5 cm. longa; radii ca. 13-21; paleae maturae rigidae pilosae apice sensim acuminato reflexo, capitulum echiniforme 2.5 cm. diam. efformantes.

description: "Slender erect shrub to 7 ft. (2.1 m.) high"; branches dark purplish or greenish, 1.5-3 mm. thick, densely and minutely glandular with sessile or very short-stipitate persistent glands and rather sparsely spreading-hirsute with several-celled tuberculate-based mostly deciduous hairs; internodes toward base of branches mostly 0.5-2 cm., the upper ones 4-13 cm. long; leaves opposite; petioles slender, naked, suleate above, 2-4 cm. long, fine glandular, spreading-hirsute, and in the sulcus densely canescent-pilose; blades regularly ovate, 8-14 cm. long, 4-7 cm. wide, long falcate-acuminate, at base shallowly cordate or the smaller rounded, crenate-serrate essentially throughout except on the long pointed tip (teeth about 24-29 pairs, 2-7 mm. apart, depressed, callous-mucronulate, the mucros dark, about 0.5 mm. long), triplinerved and prominulous-reticulate beneath, papery, above light or dark green, not shining, densely and softly or harshly pilose all over (especially densely along chief nerves and at base of costa) with mostly deciduous antrorse-curved hairs with persistent tuberculate bases and also finely pilosulous and somewhat sesisile-glandular, beneath somewhat paler green, rather softly and densely spreading-pilose with several- celled tuberculate hairs and sessile-glandular; heads ternate at apex of stem, also occasionally 1-3 in the upper axils, 3-4 cm. wide in flower, the peduncles naked, pubescent like the stem but with more numerous long hairs, 2.5-10 cm. long; involucre about 3-seriate, obgraduate, 1.2-1.8 cm. long, the phyllaries densely pilose or pilosulous on both sides (the outermost glabreseent toward base) subherbaceous, blackish- green, soon reflexed, the outermost 3-4.5 mm. wide at base; disk in flower 1-1.2 cm. high, 1.8-2 cm. thick (as pressed); rays white, the tube glabrous, 2 mm. long, the lamina elliptic, 2-denticulate, about 8-nerved, hispidulous on nerves on back, 13-18 mm. long, 3.5-4.6 mm. wide; disk flowers numerous, their corollas white, hispidulous on tube, short-hirsute on throat and teeth, 6 mm. long (tube 1.8 mm., throat campanulate, 3.2-3.5 mm., teeth ovate, 0.7-1 mm. long); pales pilose and pilosulous dorsally except toward tip and finely glandular, about 1 cm. long, fuscous outside, stramineous inside, striate, rather gradually narrowed into the strongly recurved or reflexed spinescent tip; achenes obovoid, bluntly quadrangular, blackish, glabrous, epappose, 3 mm. long.

description: Stout herb, the caudex subterranean (?); leaves somewhat papyraceous, elliptic-oblong, 15-30 cm. long, 4-5 cm. broad, narrowed proximally to about 5 mm., acute at apex, sinuate-denticulate at margins, glabrescent above, closely cinereous tomentose beneath, the costa prominent, the secondary nerves 8-12 per centimeter, spreading nearly at right angles, the veinlets obscure; flowering branches erect, subligneous, glabrescent, bearing cauline leaves proximally, corymbose-paniculate, the branches subtended by foliaceous bracts; heads at maturity 20-25 cm. in diameter; phyllaries about 20, 2- or 3-seriate, papyraceous, broadly ovate, cuspidate, the outer ones 7-9 mm. long, 5-7 mm. broad, sparsely short hispid without; ray florets 40-60, about 2-seriate, the corolla about 8 mm. long, the tube 1 mm. long, densely viscid-glandular-hispid, the lamina oblong, 2.5-3 mm. broad, usually 2-lobed at apex, sparsely pilose without, the style and stigmas 3-4 mm. long, the achene about 3 mm. long; disk florets 5-6 mm. long, the tube and lobes glandular-hispid, the tube and limb subequal, the lobes deltoid, the stamens 3.5-4 mm. long; paleae membranaceous, obovate, 5-6 mm. long, 3-3.5 mm. broad, acute, densely atropurpureous glandular-viscid distally without.
