description: Shrubs, 2-4 m tall; stems strigillose, hairs 0.5 mm long. Leaves petiolate; blades 16-24 X 10-14 cm, ovate, apices acuminate, bases cuneate to cuneate-rounded, narrowly decurrent on the distal one-third of the petiole, margins shortly serrate to serrulate, sparcely strigose both faces, hairs 1 mm long; petioles 3-6 cm long, strigillose, hairs 1 mm long. Capitulescences paniculiform, ternate at apex of stem and formed by two aggregated groups of 3-4 capitula on each one. Capitula radiate, 5 mm high, 2-3 mm diam.; involucres oblong cylindric, 2-3 mm diam.; phyllaries 3, suborbicular-ovate, 2.5-3 X 2-2.5 mm, 4-6 veined, apices obtuse, ciliate on distal one-third, glabrous dorsally. Pistillate fiorets 3, subtend- ed by ovate paleae, 2.5 X 2 mm, 5-veined, strigillose toward apex, hairs 1 mm long; corollas 2 mm long, white, tubes 1.2-1.4 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., 4-lobed, lobes del- toid, shortly ciliate at margins. Staminate florets 3, epaleate; corollas 1.5-1.8 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., white, shortly 5-lobed, lobes deltoid, 0.2 mm long, scarcely pilose at apex, hairs 0.5 mm long; anthers I mm long, black; styles 2 mm long, undivided, ovaries pilose toward apex, hairs 0.5 mm long. Cypselae 2 X 1.5 mm, obovoid, pilose on distal one-third, hairs 1 mm long. Chromosome number, n = 16 (Robinson, 1981; Stuessy & Arriagada, 1993).

description: Herbs with short stems up to 10-12 cm high. Long, leafless or nearly leafless scapes usually bearing a single head 1.6-1.9 cm wide. Leaves petiolate or sessile, scabrous to subscabrous, alternately sinuate-pinnatifid. Ray-flower ligules 10-12.6 mm long, 5-7.8 mm wide, lemon yellow with veins beneath green. Disk-flower corollas yellow. Achenes 5.2-7 mm long, 3-3.8 mm wide. Plants of sandy lawns and roadsides.

description: Herbaceous or weakly ligneous perennial 6-8+ dm tall; herbage sparsely pilose- tomentose, white or brown-villous at the base of the receptacle, densely white-villous in and near the axils of the middle and lower cauline leaves; lowermost stem and upper caudex densely brown villous-lanate; stems arising singly or more often loosely clustered from a short, stout coarsely fibrous rooted caudex-like rhizome. Leaves about equally distributed along the stem, pinnate-veined, ovate in gross outline but deeply pinnate-lobed with (1) 2-3 pairs of lateral lobes which are about as long as wide or slightly longer, the sinuses wide and rounded, the margins of lobes subentire to irregularly shallow-dentate, the teeth rounded or terminated with a minute callous denticle; blade overall 5-8+ cm long and 4-7 cm wide, about as long as wide or slightly longer; petiole well-developed, distinct, about one-third to one-half as long as the blade; uppermost leaves reduced to small, inconspicuous bracts. Inflorescence of 4-6 (8) conspicuous heads loosely clustered in an open, corymbiform cyme, the lateral heads supported by peduncles 10-20+ cm long arising from the axils of the upper leaves. Heads yellow, 1.5-2 cm across exclusive of ray ligules; principal involucral bracts ca 13, 12-15 mm long, elliptic-oblanceolate, of uniform length but prominently divided into an inner and outer series, with overlapping margins; calyculate bracts few, inconspicuous, linear-subulate, 5 mm long or less; receptacle essentially flat, naked; ray florets conspicuous, mostly 8, the ligule 2.5-3.5 cm long and 0.7-1.0 cm wide; disc florets numerous; corollas ca 12 mm long, the tube and limb not sharply separated, the sinuses between corolla lobes + 3 mm deep; style branches abruptly terminated by a penicillate tuft; pappus of 2-3 close series of white, capillary bristles, 8-10 mm long, minutely barbellate; achene terete, columnar, 6-7 mm long and 1-2 mm wide, glabrous, prominently ribbed but not prismatic, arising from a distinct but short carpopodium.

description: Stout herb, the caudex essentially subterranean; leaves coriaceous, oblong-obovate, 25-40 cm. long, 3-5 cm. broad, attenuate proximally to 8-15 mm., acute at apex, entire at margins, appressed einereous tomentose on both surfaces, the costa prominent, the secondary nerves 1 or 2 per centimeter, ascending, visible beneath, the veinlets immersed; flowering branches erect, up to 1 m. or more high, einereous tomentose, branched distally, corymbose-paniculate, the branches alternate or subopposite, subtended by linear-oblong foliaceous bracts 2-6 cm. long and 4-8 mm. broad; heads numerous, at maturity 15-22 mm. in diameter; phyllaries numerous, 3- or 4-seriate, thin coriaceous, lanceolate-oblong, short acuminate, 5-6 mm. long, 1.5-2 mm. broad, pilose without; ray florets numerous, about 3-seriate, the corolla about 10 mm. long, the tube about 2 mm. long, truncate introrsely distally, densely hispid, the lamina often reflexed, linear-oblong, 1.5-2 mm. broad, usually 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas about 5 mm. long, the achene 2-2.5 mm. long; disk florets essentially glabrous, 6-7 mm. long, the tube slightly shorter than the limb, the lobes ovatedeltoid, the stamens about 4.5 mm. long; paleae membranous, oblongoblanceolate, 5-6 mm. long, about 1.5 mm. broad, cuspidate at apex, crisp-strigose distally without.

description: Rami herbacei erecti in sicco rubescentes teretes sparse glanduloso-pubescentes. Folia simplicia alterna. Petiolus 15-25 mm longus crassiusculus pubescenti- glandulosus basi incrassatus auriculatusque, auriculis semi-orbiculi-oblongis paulo et obtuse dentatis circa 15 mm longis 10 mm latis. Lamina membranacea ambitu late ovata margine 9-11 lobata lobis oblongis obtusis vel rotundatis basi 7-nervia, 6 cm longa, 5-6 cm lata; supra hirsutulo-pubescens pilis copiosis longis basi callosis, nervis paulo conspicuis, subtus dilute molliter pubescens nervis principalibus prominentibus marginem versus ramoso-anastomosantibus nervulis prominulis laxe reticulatis. Inflorescentia terminalis circa 25 cm longa panicula corymbosa oligocephala valde gracili instructa. Capitula 2.5 cm lata (compressa) longe pedicellata. Ramuli pedicellique (4.10 cm longi) tenues erecti striati breviter pubescenti-glandulosi, aliquis bracteis late lanceolatis tenuiter membraneceis 6-12 mm longis 3-4 mm latis muniti. Involucrum 10-12 bracteis biseriatis sterilibus ovato- acuminatis acutissimis 12-13 mm longis 4-7 mm latis sparse pubescentibus glandulosisque; margine ciliatis bracteis fertiles exterioribus lineari-lanceolatis paleaceis acutis plus minusve complicatis 9-11 mm longis 2 mm latis puberulis, parce glandulosis margine ciliatis. Squamae receptaculi fertiles lineari-oblongae acutissimae 8-7 mm longae 1 mm latae. Corollae radiorum bilabiatae circa 13 mm longae, tubulo 6.5 mm longo sparsissime puberulo, labio infero ligulato ligula oblonga tridentata 6-6.5 mm longa 2 mm lata, labio superiore 4 mm longo in duas lacinias lineares convolutas usque circa basim diviso. Corollae florum disci etiam bilabiatae tubulo 7 mm longo ligula et laciniis 3 mm longis. Ovarium oblongum glabrum 3 mm longum in rostrum 1.5-2 mm longum attenuatum. Pappus albus plumosus 7 mm longus.

description: Trailing or ascending plants sometimes up to a meter long, with erect naked peduncles; stem frequently rooting at the nodes, parts of it often with reduced leaves and sometimes apparently a little under the surf ace of the ground, but still pubescent; herbage more or less hirsute or villous-hirsute, the hairs of the leaves mostly appressed, or at least not widely spreading, those of the stem and peduncles spreading or more commonly reflexed; leaves obovate or spatulate. coarsely dentate or crenate to shallowly lobed, the blade mostly 5-25 mm. wide and 1-4 cm. long, rarely a little larger, the base cuneate, sessile, or more coimonly tapering to a petiole 1-4 cm. long; peduncles 5-20 cm. long, terminal or axillary; heads solitary, the disk 8-13 mm. wide; involuere 6-8 mm. high, villous-hirsute and more or less viscid; phyllaries narrow, dark, the tips often purplish, slightly or moderately imbricate, the inner sometimes wholly searious; ligules very numerous, in several rows, 150 or more, white or pinkish, about 0.3 mm. wide and 5-7 mm. long, usually eireinately rolled at least in herbarium specimens; disk-corollas about 3.5-4.5 mm. long, the lobes 0.4-0.5 mm., the tube about 1.1-1.6 mm. long and tapering into the limb; style-append4ges broadly triangular, obtuse, about 0.1 mm. long or a little more; pappus simple, of about 20-25 very fragile bristles; akenes 2-nerved, moderately villous-hirsute.

description: Herbae perennes; caudicibus brevibus, breviter ramosis, marceseentibus; caulibus 1.5-7.0 cm. altis, simplicibus, erectis vel decumbentibus, sparse strigosis; foliis basilaribus (1) 2-5 cm. longis, laminis 3-10 mm. longis, 2-4 mm. latis, oblanceolatis aut spatulatis aut ellipticis aut subrotundis, apicibus obtusis; capitulis solitariis, rare 2; discis 5-8 mm. latis; involueris 3-5 mm. altis, granulo- glandulosis vel sparse aut moderate hirsutis; ligulis 10-20 (25), 5-6 mm. longis, 1.3-2.1 mm. latis, albidis vel roseis; acheniis bicostatis, subtiliter et sparse hirsutis.
bibliographicCitation: Maguire, Bassett. 1944. Great Basin plants--VIII. New Species in Carex and Erigeron. Brittonia. 5: 199-202.

description: Perennial herbs with short, closely-branched caudices, clothed with marceseent leaf bases; stems 1.5-7.0 cm. high, simple, more or less erect or decumbent at the base, sparsely strigose; basal leaves several, conspicuous, (1) 2-5 cm. long, the blades 3-10 mm. long, mostly 2-4 mm. wide, oblanceolate or spatulate to elliptical or subrotund, rounded or obtuse at the apex, sparsely strigose, the petiole slender; eauline leaves 5 or fewer, sometimes wanting, small linear or linear-oblanceolate; heads solitary, occasionally 2, the disc 5-8 mm. wide; involuere 3-5 mm. high, finely granular-glandular and sparsely or moderately hirsute with short spread- incg hairs, involueral bracts, imbricate, thin, the outer narrow, the inner broader and with prominent searious margins, green, with purple tips or sometimes purplish throughout; ligules 10-20 (25), 5-6 mm. long, 1.3-2.1 mm. wide, white or pinkish; disc corollas 2.4-3.4 mm. long, the tube 0.5-0.8 mm. long, the lobes 0.4- 0.6 mm. long; style appendages 0.15-0.25 mm. long, acute, triangular-lanceolate or sometimes nearly deltoid; pappus of mostly 12-20 very slender and fragile bristles, shorter than the disc corolla 's, sometimes with a few slender inconspic- uous outer setae; achenes 2-nerved, finely and sparsely hirsute.

description: Perennial herb with a short branched caudex to which the chaffy leaf bases of several seasons may adhere; stem sparsely strigose, 1.5-7 cm. high; leaves sparsely strigose, the basal ones 1-4 cm. long, petiolate, the blade oblanceolate or spatulate to elliptical, rounded at the apex, 3-10 mm. long, mostly 2-4 mm. wide; cauline leaves few and small, linear, or wanting; heads solitary, occasionlally 2, the disk 5-8 mm. wide; involuere 3-5 mm. high, very finely granular-glandular and sparsely or moderately hirsute with short spreading hairs; phyllaries imbricate, thin, green, with purplish tips or sometimes purplish throughout, the outer narrow, the inner broader and with prominent searious margins; ligules 10-20, rarely 25, white or light pink, 5-6 mm. long, 1.3-2.1 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 2.4-3.4 mm. long, the tube 0.5-0.8 mm., the lobes 0.4-0.6 mm.; style-appendages acute, triangular-lanceolate or sometimes a little-wider and nearly deltoid, 0.15-0.25 mm. long; pappus of about 12-20 very slender and fragile bristles, much shorter than the disk-corollas, sometimes with a few slender and inconspicuous outer setae; akenes 2-nerved, finely and sparsely hairy.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Plants perennial, 15-20 cm high, decumbent, profusely branched and copiously leafy except at the base; stems and foliage very densely white-tomentose, the hairs ca 3 mm long when extended; leaves linear, subterete, blunt at the apex, 2.5-6 cm long, 1.5-2 mm wide; heads solitary, broadly campanulate, 1.5-2.5 cm in diameter; peduncles 6-10 cm long, woolly-tomentose; receptacle short conical or convex, ca 4 mm across, ca 2 mm high; chaff persistent, glabrous, oblong, 10-12 mm long, 2-2.5 mm wide, scarious-margined, becoming striate and thickened toward the center, abruptly contracting to form an attenuate, awn-like beak; involucre 2(-3)-seriate, the outer bracts broadly lanceolate, densely tomentose, 5-8 mm long, 2-3.5 mm wide, acute at the apex; inner bracts lanceolate, densely tomentose except for the membranous, purple-tinged margins, 9-11 mm long, 3-3.5 mm wide, acute at the apex; ray flowers absent; disc corollas pale yellow, 9-10.5 mm long, the tube glabrous, ca 2.5 mm long, gradually merging into the narrowly funnelform (or subtubular), glabrous throat, 5.5-7 mm long, the lobes acute, 1-1.5 mm long, sparsely pilose at the apex; style branches slender, linear, slightly flattened, ca 2 mm long, minutely pubescent at the subulate to obtuse apex; achenes narrowly turbinate, dark brown, 2.5 mm long, densely long-pilose, the hairs ca 1 mm long; pappus of 20 unequal, plumose bristles, 9-11 mm long, the shortest ca 34 the length of the longest, with fine, silky cilia ca 1 mm long; anthers ca 4 mm long, obscurely sagittate at the base.

description: Suffrutex robustus ramis erectis striatis parce araneosis. Folia crassiuscule membranacea alterna. Petiolus circa 2 cm longus angustus flexuosus basi ampliato-vaginatus plus minusve lanato-arachnoideus. Lamina lanceolato-elliptico-oblonga basi late obtuseque cuneata apice angustato-cuspi- data, margine argute serrata anguste revoluta, 11-14 cm longa, 3.5-4.5 cm lata; supra primum parce araneosa demum glabrata nervis reticulatis parce impressis superficie leviter rugosa; subtus lanuginosoaraneosa vel glabrata costa elevata nervis secundariis 16-18 utroque latere angustis prominentibusque arcuato ascendentibus marginem versus anastomosantibus ceteris nervis in reticulum elevatum anastomosatis. Inflorescentia thyrsoideo-paniculata terminalis folia suprema valde superans, 30 cm longa, ramis ramulisque striatis nitidis subglabris, breviter sparsissime puberulis araneosisque; bracteis anguste linearibus acutis elongatis. Capitula pedicellata radiata. Pedicelli 15-30 mm longi mediocriter rigidi vel paulo flex- uosi ad apicem plurimis bracteolis linearibus subcapillaribus involucrum subae- quilongis calyculum formantibus. Involucrum campanulatum circa 9 mm altum, 13 bracteis crassiusculis ovato-acuminatis vel oblongo-lanceolatis 8-9 mm longis, 2.5-3.5 mm latis, margine anguste scariosis dorso valde incrassatis parce arach- noideis apice ciliatis. Flores-radii feminei ligulati circiter 14, corolla lutea glabra 11 mm longa, tubulo 4 mm longo lamina 1-8 mm lata 5-nervata. Flores disci hermaphroditi circiter 80, corolla lutea tubulosa glabra 8-9 mm longa dentibus oblongis obtusis papillosis; antheris 2.5 mm longis; ramis stigmaticis tribus 2 mm longis apice obtuse truncatis. Ovarium glabrum. Pappus stramineus 8 mm longus.
bibliographicCitation: Cuatrecasas, José. 1956. Studies on Andean Compositae - III. Brittonia. 8 (3): 179-193.

description: Plant up to 2.2 dm tall; stems greenish, strigose-hispid; leaves linear, 3- nerved at least half way up, 2.5 cm long, 2.2 mm wide, strigose-scabrous; ped- uncles of varying lengths, up to 1.1 cm long; heads narrow-campanulate to cylindrical, 5-8 mm high; phyllaries oblong, obtuse with or without a dark summit balid, subsquarrose, their apical margins erose-ciliate, often red-tipped; rays 3-6, yellow on both sides, ovate to orbicular, up to 18 mm long, scarcely tubed, glabrous on the upper surface, sparsely ciliate or glabrous beneath; ray style glabrous, its branches ca 1 mm long; ray achenes oblanceolate-linear, 3-angled, the lateral awns generally adnate to the ray, or only slightly free at the apex, the awn of the inner angle none or minute; disk flowers usually 18-24, red, or greeln in the same population, up to 10 mm long, with lobes 1 mm long, glabrous on the outer surface or essentially so; disk achenes oblanceolate, angular or compressed, 4-5 mm long; awns 0-4, mostly 2 and unequal; chaff obtuse, erose, often red-tipped; receptacles mostly truncate.

description: Erect shrubs to 1.5 m tall, moderately to densely branched, branches 1.5-3(-4) mm diam., ascending at 25-45º angles, whitish with dense white tomentum, with vertical brownish lines decurrent from leaf bases, denudate and cicatricose-nodose proximally, in age becoming blackish, but usually glabrescent; bark tan-grayish, fissured-rugose. Leaves spirally inserted, sessile, linear, 15-45(-50) X 1.5-2.5 mm, slightly narrower above the slightly broadened base, margins entire, narrowly but strongly revolute, apex blunt with a short reflexed mucro, adaxial surface and margins glabrous and resinous, somewhat shining, midrib impressed, abaxial surface with a stout glabrous brownish midrib and a band of dense white tomentum on each side; younger leaves crowded at the branch apices, generally with the adaxial surface covered by a whitish arachnoid tomentum. Capitulescence with capitula sessile at the apex of main branches or on short lateral branches, often with 1-2 laterals closely grouped with terminal capitula. Capitula discoid; involucre campanulate (broadly campanulate when dry), 10-12 X 8-10 mm, phyllaries 21-23(-25) in 4-5 series, persistent, outer phyllaries lanceolate, 6 X 2-3 mm, middle and innermost phyllaries lanceolate to gradually oblong-lanceolate, 7-10 X 2.5-3 mm, all with light-colored, thickened bases, thickened distally with a vertical green median nerve, all but outer bracts with broad scarious densely lacerate-ciliate margins, apical apiculum without margin, abaxial surface resin-covered, with minute puberulence along the thickened midnerve, adaxial surface almost totally glabrous, glandular-pilose at the tips; pales of receptacle similar to inner phyllaries, 10-1 1 X 2-3 mm, more oblong-lanceolate, conduplicate, partially enclosing florets, carinate, slightly arcuate, the margins hyaline-scarious and rather lacerate-ciliate. Ray florets absent. Disk florets 30-35; corollas brownish yellow to yellow, narrowly funnelform, (6.5-)7-8 mm long, mostly glabrous, 5-veined, basal tube ca. 3 mm long, throat 2-3 mm long, lobes 5 (rarely 6 as in Rauh 424a), narrowly ovate, (1.5-)2-2.2 X 0.8-1 mm, recurved, with numerous glands at the abaxial tips; anther thecae 2.3-2.5(-2.7) mm long, with short unsclerified tails at base; anther appendages narrowly ovate to lanceolate, weakly sclerified, 0.7-1 mm long; style (4-)5-6 mm long (incl. branches), with large sclerified node at the base; style branches 2.7-3(-3.2) mm long, broadly linear, acute, the densely papillate abaxial portion covering 3/4-4/5 the length of the branches, including the astigmatic terminal portion, stigmatic lines beginning at the base of the branches and continuous to 0.5 mm from the apex. Cypselae 6-8 X (I-)2 mm, narrowly oblanceolate in outline, apically truncate, slightly arcuate, distinctly compressed, with thickened margins, usually with both faces veinless but sometimes (at least in one of them) with a conspicuous central or submarginal nerve, densely strigose-sericeous, with numerous intermixed short-stipitate, capitate, resin-producing glands; pappus of a persistent crown of (11-)13-15(-16) scales, ca. 2.5 mm long, lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, lacerate-fimbriate, stramineous. Pollen grains ca. 37 µm.
bibliographicCitation: Nesom, Guy L., et al. 2001. A new species of Chiliotrichiopsis (Asteraceae: Astereae) from Peru. Brittonia. 53: 430-434.

description: Biennial or short-lived pereniial herb with a weak root; stem erect, about 2-60 cm. high, sparsely or sometimes fairly densely spreading-hirsute; leaves sparsely or moderately hirsute, or, especially the lower ones, glabrate, often conspicuously hirsute-ciliate on the margins; basal leaves oblanceolate or sometimes spatulate, up to 15 cm. long and 12 mm. wide; cauline leaves narrower, commonly linear, but generally long and well developed except in depauperates; heads several or many, or occasionally solitary, borne on nearly erect peduncles, usually some of the lower ones, at least, equalled or surpassed by their subtending leaves; disk 7-17 mm. wide; involuere 4-9 mm. high, sparsely or moderately hirsute, not glandular; phyllaries thin, light green, commonly purplish near the sharply acute or acuminate but scarcely attenuate tips, usually evidently imbricate; ligules numerous, about 2-3 mm. long, 0.25-0.5 mm. wide, white or sometimes pinkish, only slightly surpassing the disk; eligulate pistillate corollas absent; disk-corollas slender, mostly 3.5-5.0 mm. long, the tube 1.5-2.5 mm. long, the lobes 0.3-0.4 mm.; stye-appenda7ges deltoid or ovate, acutish, 0.1-0.15 mm. long; pappus of about 20-30 slender generally white bristles, evidently surpassing the disk-corollas, sometimes with a few slender and inconspicuous short setae; akenes 2-nerved, sparsely hirsute.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Coarse herbs to 5 m tall; stems furrowed, purple-spotted, glabrous to hispid-pilose or scabrous; leaves sessile or with a winged petiole to base, to 45 cm long and 30 cm wide, basally connate, variable in shape, deltoid to broadly ovate, the main veins and lobes of lower leaves palmate or sometimes pinnate, the lobes serrate and dentate, acute or acuminate, sometimes hastate, the base truncate or cuneate, densely canescent below, hispid-pilose or sparsely puberulent, sometimes with yellowish sessile glands and hairs; upper leaves unlobed, ovate-lanceolate; peduncles glabrous, densely stipitate-glandular, hispid-pilose or pilose and glandular; phyllaries 5-6, in 1 series, basally united, ovate to lanceolate, to 16 mm long and 10 mm wide, vesture like that of peduncles, the margin hairy; ray flowers to ca 20, the corrollas yellow, tridentate, to lcm wide and 2.5 cm long; disc flowers to 8 mm long, the corolla yel- low, puberulent on the lower surface of lobes; achene black, flattened-ovoid, longitudinally striate, to ca 5 mm long and 4 mm wide.
bibliographicCitation: Wells, James R. 1965. A taxonomic study of Polymnia (Compositae). Brittonia. 17: 144-159.

description: Coarse, robust subshrubs 1-2.5 m tall, with short lived aerial stems. Leaves opposite; petioles 0.5-2 cm long; blades 8-12(1 5) x 3-6(7.5) cm, membranous, ovate or some- times narrowly ovate, shortly attenuate, sometimes slightly oblique at the base, acuminate at the apex, margins serrulate or sometimes serrate, adaxial surface sparsely scabridulous with scattered larger trichomes, abaxial surface paler, strigillose, with larger trichomes along the veins. Outer phyllaries 10-30 x 2.5-8 mm, much longer than the inner, oblong to narrowly oblong or oblong- elliptic, then slightly constricted and indurate at the base; inner phyllaries 5-10 x 2-4 mm, oblong-elliptic, constricted and indurate at the base. Paleae 9-10 x ca. 1.5 mm when folded, with rigid, linear, pungent tip up to 3.5 mm long. Ray florets fertile, tube 1-2 mm long, lamina 17-32 x 4-8 mm, oblanceolate to elliptic, slightly setulose abaxially. Disc florets with corolla 4-5.5 mm long, lobes abaxially moderately setulose. Cypselae 3-6 x 1.2-1.5 mm, wings up to 2 mm wide, those of the peripheral flowers thickened, trigonous, with much reduced wings to wingless or sometimes with well developed wings on much smaller bodies, densely tuberculate at maturity, the inner flatter, less tuberculate; pappus with awns reduced to tooth-like projections or sometimes up to 3 mm long, then 1/2 of the cypsela body length or less, the peripheral mostly awnless, crown 0.2-1 mm tall, almost totally fused to the body (more than 2/3 the lenght), lacerate to fimbriolate.

description: Small, straggly shrubs 1-2 m tall; stems terete to slightly quadratic, herbaceous parts sparsely to densely puberulent, pubescence arachnose with some stipitate, whitish glandular trichomes interspersed in the matter pubescence, pubescence conspicuously denser below leaf nodes and distally, woody parts gray-brown. Leaves opposite, triplinerved; blades 5-20 cm long, 2.5-20 cm wide, smaller distally toward the capi- tulescence, deltate to ovate, adaxial surface sparsely pubescent with erect, tapered, whitish to translucent trichomes, green, abaxial surface densely pubescent, pubes- cence arachnose and matted, white, veins essentially glabrous, brown-green and con- spicuously raised against white background; margins shallowly serrate, each serration terminated in an aristate mucro 1- 3 mm long, apex acuminate, base obtuse or truncate and cuneately narrowed into petiole; petiole 1-15 cm long, 1/5 to totally winged in leaves associated with the capitulescence, pubescence like stems. Capitulescence of 3-21+ heads, arranged in an open paniculiform cyme; peduncles 1.5-6 cm long, densely pubescent with arachnose and stipitate glandular trichomes, cream white. Heads discoid, campanulate, some- what pendulous, 1.8-2.5 cm high, 1.5-2 cm wide; receptacle epaleate. Phyllaries 22-28 in 3-4 graduated series; phyllaries of first series 0.8-1.2 cm long, 2.5-3 mm wide, ap- pressed, basal half indurate, distal half herbaceous, ovate to deltate, moderately pubescent, pubescence arachnose, light green; phyllaries of second series 1.1-1.4 cm long, 2.5-3.5 mm wide, appressed, herbaceous, chartaceous, narrowly ovate to oblong, sparsely puberulent, pubescence strigose to arachnose, light green; phyllaries of third and fourth series 1.4-1.6 cm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, appressed, chartaceous, oblong, essentialy glabrous with a few strigose tri- chomes at apex, light green. Ray flowers absent. Disk flowers 24-29, perfect, the corollas urceolate, yellow; throat ca. 3.5 mm long, 2.3-2.5 mm wide, basal half moder- ately pubescent, distal half glabrous; tube 4-4.3 mm long, essentially glabrous, yellow; lobes 2.5-2.7 mm long, glabrous, yellow; anthers 3.7-4 mm long, creamy yellow-orange, the appendages 0.5 mm long, oval, translucent to stramineous-yellow; styles 1.2 cm long, yellow; style branches 2 mm long, acuminate to truncate, without appendages. Disk cypsela ca. 2.5 mm long, obconical to urceolate, with 10-12 ribs, carpopodium present, resembling a ring around base of cypsela, densely pubescent, trichomes significantly longer around neck, silvery cream; pappus of two sets of bristles, the outer set 0.5-0.7 mm long, in tufts, the inner set 1 cm long.

description: Wiry perennial from a tough rooterown; basal rosette absent; stems apparently weakly ascending or procumbent, 15-45 cm long, glabrous, terete, 1-2 mm in diameter, leafy throughout, mostly unbranched; leaves linear to linear-lanceolate, glabrous, sessile, clasping at the base, the basal flanges sometimes with distinct auricles, 0.5-3 cm long, 1.5-5 mm wide, irregularly toothed, the teeth 0.1-1.5 mm long; heads on primary shoots few, 1-6 (-10), the primary, as well as each major secondary branch, bearing but 1 or 2 heads; involuere hemispheric, with 70-90 florets (fewer in late flowering heads), 8-10(-11) mm across, (4-)5-6 mm high, erect at anthesis, in age spreading but not reflexing as in M. bottoniae and M. brevilingulata; peduncle (i.e. above the uppermost, bract-like leaf) 0.2-1 cm long, minutely glandular-puberulent, glabrate in age; involueral bracts ea 40, in 3-5 series, imbricated, green or purplish-green and herbaceons above, searions and chartaceous below; principal involueral bracts linear-lanceolate, 3.5-5 mm long, 1.3-1.6 mm wide, densely glandular-puberulent to nearly glabrate; receptacle flat; ray florets ca 33 (often less in late-flowering heads), the lig,ules 5-8 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, apparently purplish, enrolling on drying, the tube 2.4-3.2 mm long; style-branches 0.5-1 mm lolng; disk corollas yellow, 3.5-4.0 mm long, the tube 1.7-2.0 mm long, the throat 1.7-2.0 mm long; corolla-lobes erect, 0.15-0.2 mm long; anthers scarcely exserted, ca 2.5 mm long; achenes 1-1.5 mm long, with 5-7 indistinct ribs, thinly pubescent with spreading or ascending hairs; pappns with 30-40 bristles 1.5-3.5 mm long; ray achenes usually without pappus but sometimes. with a well defined pappus of 20-30 bristles 1.6-1.8 mm long; chromosome number, unknown.

description: Shrubs, branched at the base; 3-10 (-12) dm tall. Stems often wand-like, unbranched; evenly and densely pannose. Primary leaves lance-linear (rarely spatulate), becoming very rigid and pungent-tipped; 2-4 (-6) cm long, 2-3 (-5) mm wide; tomentose. Secondary leaves seldom present; spatulate; 8-15 mm long; tomentose. Capitula borne in compact, corymbose clusters of 3-6 at branch tips. Peduncles 3-8 mm long; tomentose; usually bearing a short, lance-subulate bract; readily disarticulating at the base. Involucres hemispheric to broadly campanulate; ca. 8 mm high. Phyllaries 5 (-6); slightly thickened medially, weakly keeled; obtuse or (sometimes) acute; tomentose to pannose. Florets 6-7 (5-9) per capitulum. Corollas yellow to yellowish brown, 8-9 mm long; throat 1.5 mm long; lobes ca. 3 mm long. Achenes ca. 4 mm long; copiously clothed with fine, white hairs 6-10 mm long. Pappus wanting. Style branches ca. 2 mm long; rounded-truncate; papillate. Anthers ca. 3.5 mm long; sagittate; sterile tips narrowly triangular. Pollen grains mostly 37-47 µm in diameter.

description: Annual herbs with stiffly erect, little-branched stems up to 1 m tall, the young stems and the leaves with a hispid pubescence of spreading, bulbous-based, white hairs and sessile glands. Leaves opposite at the extreme base of the plant, oth- erwise alternate, up to 11 x 4 cm, the lamina elliptic to narrowly elliptic, the apex acuminate, the base tapered to a winged petiole, the first pair of secondary veins at the top of the petiole very strong resulting in a 3-nerved appearance. Inflorescence of clusters of 4-5 capitula on peduncles 4-10 mm long. Involucre ovoid, 7 mm long at anthesis. Bracts multiseriate, pale green with darker radiating lines below, at the tip dark green and spreading with a pectinate pubescence of very robust white hairs. Ray florets 6-7 mm long, neutral, yellow, the tube very slender, 2-5 mm long, with scattered spreading hairs, the ligule broadly ovate, 3.5-4.5 mm long, shallowly 2- or 3-lobed. Ray achenes well-formed but sterile, 4 x 1 mm, columnar, black-walled, bearing a pappus of lacerate scales ca 0.5 mm long. Disc florets yellow, the tube 1.5 mm long, with hairs and glands, the limb 3.5 mm long with 5 lobes 1.5 mm long, glabrous on the outer surface and papillose-hairy on the inner surface of the lobes. Disc achenes elliptical, 4 x 2 mm, radially compressed, blackish, shining, at the apex bearing 2 barbellate whit- ish awns and between them a ring of lacerate scales 0.3 mm long. Receptacular paleae cartilaginous, lanceolate, subacute, somewhat lacerate, a little shorter than the disc florets.

description: Acaulescent perennial herbs 20-40 cm tall. Leaves alternate; blades 10-36.5 X 8- 12 cm, the innermost leaves smaller, obovate to pandurate, uninerved with pinnate venation, adaxial surfaces essentially glabrous, bright green, abaxial surfaces sparsely strigose with scattered short stipitate or sessile glandular trichomes, slightly lighter in color than adaxial surfaces, bases atten- uate, margins runcinate, apices acute; petioles 5-15 mm long. Capitulescence of 1-9 heads, arranged in open paniculiform cymes, peduncles 2-10 cm long, essentially glabrous, green. Heads discoid, involucres campanulate, 9-10.5 mm high, 4.5-4.7 mm wide; receptacle ca. 3 mm high, 0.5-0.7 mm diam., columnar, epaleate. Phyllaries 35-45 in 5 series, mostly ovate, sparsely puberulent with scattered short stipitate-glandular trichomes, ciliate at margins, appressed, greenish-stramineous, apices strongly mucronate, the mucro spreading; phyllaries of first and second series 1.2-5 X 0.5-1.5 mm; phyllaries of third and fourth series 6-7.5 X 1.2-1.7 mm; phyllaries of fifth series 7-7.5 X 0. 8-1.7 mm. Flowers 18-23, perfect, the corollas tubular, bilabiate, essentially glabrous, white, drying ochroleucous; tubes 3-3.2 mm long, essentially glabrous; throats ca. 1.7 X ca. 0.9 mm, 3-lobed limb ca. 3 X ca. 1.1 mm, 2-lobed limb 1.8-2 X 0.5-0.6 mm, essentially glabrous; lobes ca. 1 mm long, deltate, glabrous; anther thecae ca. 1.5 mm long, the tails ca. 1.1 mm long, brown-yellow, the appendages 0.7-0.8 mm long, elliptical, stramineous; styles ca. 5.5 mm long, brownish yellow when dry, the branches 0.5-0.6 mm long, apex rounded, brown-yellow when dry. Cypselae ca. 2 mm long, cylindrical, stramineous, densely pubescent; pappus of numerous, subequal bristles 5.3- 5.5 mm long.

description: Arbores ca 3.5 m usque altae. Folia opposita; petioli 5-10 mm longi, dense ferrugineo-tomentosi; laminae late ovatae vel ovales, 1.2-2.4 cm longae, 1-2 cm latae, coriaceae, basi cordatae, apice obtusae vel rotundatae, infeme dense ferrugineo-tomentosae, superne atrovirides, nitidae, margine integrae. Capitulescentiae terminales cymosae. Capitula heterogama radiata, 6-7 mm alta, 4-5 mm lata; bracteae calyculi 3-5 lineares, ca 3 mm longae, dense ferrugineo-tomentosae; phyllaria ca 8, subbiseriata, extima lanceolata, ca 5 mm longa, ca 1.5 mm lata. Flores radiati pistillati ca 5; ligulae luteae, 5-6 mm longae, 1.5-2 mm latae. Flores disci hermaphroditi 8-10; corollae tubulosae luteae, ea 6 mm longae; limbus 2-2.5 mm longus, campanulatus quinquelobus; lobi ca 1 mm longi, ca 0.5 mm lati. Achaenia (immatura) ca 1 mm longa, glabra, costata; pappi setae 4-5 mm longae.

description: Trees to 3.5 m tall; stems much-branched, leafy. Leaves opposite; petiole 5-10 mm long, densely ferruginous-tomentose; blade broadly ovate to oval, 1.2-2.4 cm long, 1-2 cm wide, coriaceous, discolorous, the base cordate, the apex broadly obtuse to rounded, the lower surface densely ferruginous-tomentose, the upper surface nitidous, glabrous, reticulately veined, dark green, drying dark brown, the margins entire. Capitulescences cymose, terminal, 10-20-headed. Capitula ra- diate, 6-7 mm high, 4-5 mm wide; involucre campanulate; calyculus of 3-5, linear bracts, ca 3 mm long, densely ferruginous-tomentose; phyllaries ca 8, weakly biseriate, coriaceous, the outer lanceolate, ca 5 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide, the apex acute to attenuate, densely ferruginous-tomentose, the inner lance-ovate, 4.5-5 mm long, 2-2.5 mm wide, the apex obtuse, sometimes 3-fid, the dorsal ridge ferruginous-tomentose, the margins glabrous, ciliolate; ray florets ca 5, pis- tillate, the corolla yellow, the tube 2-3 mm long, glabrous, the ligule 5-6 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, the apex 3-toothed; disc florets 8-10, the corolla yellow, ca 6 mm long, the tube ca 2.5 mm long, glabrous, the limb campanulate, 2-2.5 mm long, 5-lobed, the lobes lanceolate, ca 1 mm long, ca 0.5 mm wide, the anthers ca 2 mm long, the style branches 6-7 mm long, the apex triangular, penicillate. Achenes (immature) cylindrical, ca 1 mm long, glabrous, costate; pappus of 25- 50, scaberulous bristles, 4-5 mm long, stramineous.

description: Herbae perennes ca 4 dm usque altae; caules adscendentes. Folia altema; petioli 2-12 mm longi; laminae lineares, 3-6.5 mm longae, 2-7 mm latae, infeme dense albo-tomentosae, supeme canae lanatae, basi acuminatae, apice acutae, margine repandae, revolutae, remote denticulatae. Capitulescentiae scaposae, terminales; pedunculi ca 20 cm longi, solitarii. Capitula heterogama, radiata, 12-15 mm alta, ca 12 mm lata; phyllaria 6-7-seriata, lineari-lanceolata, extima (2) 4-6 mm longa, 0.5-1.5 mm lata, intima (10) 13-17 (20) mm longa, 1-2 (3) mm lata. Flores radiati pistillati ca 15; ligulae lilacinae, 20-25 mm longae, 4-5 mm latae. Flores disci hermaphroditi ca 25-40; corollae tubulosae lilacinae, 5-6 mm longae; limbus quinquelobus; lobi 1.5-2.5 mm longi. description: Perennial herbs to 4 dm tall, branched; stems ascending, cylindrical, costate, lanulose. Leaves alternate, clustered at apices of branchlets; petiole 2-12 mm long; blade linear, 3-6.5 cm long, 2-7 mm wide, the lower surface densely tomentose, white, the upper surface lanate, grey, basally acuminate, apically acute, the margins shallowly repand and remotely denticulate, revolute. Capitulescences solitary, scapose, the peduncle to 20 cm long, minutely bracteolate distally, striate, lanate. Capitula radiate, 12-15 mm high, ca 12 mm wide; involucre campanulate; phyllaries 6-7-seriate, linear-lanceolate, the outer (2) 4-6 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide, dorsally lanate, apically attenuate, the inner (10) 13-17 (20) mm long, 1-2 (3) mm wide, dorsally tomentose, the margins scarious, apically acuminate; receptacle with prominent laciniate crests, planar; ray florets ca 15, uniseriate, pistillate, the corollas lilac, bilabiate, the external lip ligulate, 20-25 mm long, 4-5 mm wide, 6-nerved, apically tridentate, dorsally lanate, the inner lip reduced to 2 linear lobes, 3-5 mm long, apically clavate, glabrous; disc florets 25-40, hermaphroditic, the corollas lilac, tubular, 5-6 mm long, glabrous, the 5 lobes 1.5-2.5 mm long. Achenes cylindrical, (3) 4-5 (6) mm long, ribbed, glabrous or sparsely pilose apically; pappus of scaberulous bristles, 8-12 mm long, multiseriate, stramineous.

description: Stout herb, the caudex erect, up to 60 cm. high and 10 cm. thick, clothed with crowded persistent leaf bases; leaves coriaceous, linear, 25-45 cm. long, 1-1.8 cm. broad, gradually narrowed towards the base, acute at apex, entire and slightly thickened at margins, densely ferruginous lanate on both surfaces, the costa prominent, the secondary nerves 3 or 4 per centimeter, straight, ascending, often obscured by the wool; flowering branches unbranched, erect at maturity, exceeding the leaves in length, covered with a copious ferruginous wool, bearing a few alternate small linear cauline leaves; heads solitary, terminal, at maturity 4-6 cm. in diameter, often completely enclosed in a mass of pale ferruginous tomentum (the individual hairs 1-3 cm. long); phyllaries very numerous, papyraceous, lanceolate-oblong, up to 15 mm. long and 3 mm. broad, long attenuate distally, densely lanate without; ray florets very numerous, several-seriate, the corollas 7-9 mm. long, the tube about 3 mm. long, glandular-hispidulous (the hairs 0.1 mm. long), bearing introrsely 1 or 2 distal lobes (lobes sometimes up to 2;5 mm. long), the lamina ovate-oblong, 4-6 mm. long, 1-1.5 mm. broad, usually 2-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas about 6 mm. long, the achene about 2.5 mm. long; disk florets sparsely hispidulous, about 7 mm. long, the tube shorter than the limb, the lobes deltoid, the stamens aboul 4.5 mum. long; paleae papyraceous, lanceolate, 7-9 mm.

description: Pileus glutinous, viscid, fibrillose or floccose; hymenophore separable, tubular, typically boletinoid with pores usually large, angular, irregular and radiately arranged; stipe solid, annulate and without glandules, viscid or dry and floccose; spores purple, porphyry red, dark vinaceous brown or chocolate grey in mass, often partly dextrinoid, smooth, medium to large; eystidia typically fasciculate, with brown incrustation near the base, often with brown content in KOH; clamp connections absent. description: Frutex vagans; caulis tenuiter sordido-tomentulosus et sparse pilosus glabrescens lenticellatus; folia late ovata breviter acuminata basi subtruneata v. latissime rotundata in petiolum breviter cuneatocontracta margine subdense calloso-mucrollulata chartacea supra viridia venis tenuiter tomentulosis exceptis glabra, subtus venis brunneo- tomentulosis et -pilosis exceptis dense albo-tomentosa; capitula numerosa panieulata pedicellata 11-flora flava radiata; involueri ca. 4-seriati 6-7 mm. alti gradati phyllaria exteriora lanceolata aciiminata interiora oblonga obtusiuscula calloso-apiculata sordide ciliata et plusminusve pilosula 2-3-costata; achenia dense hispidula; pappi duplicis series exterior squamellosa interior capillacea.

description: Biennial or short-lived perennial with a short simple or subsimple caudex, occasionally annual, or at least blooming the first season; stem and leaves more or less pubescent with long spreading hairs, sometimes nearly glabrous; stem 2-7 dm. high, rarely shorter; basal leaves narrowly to broadly oblanceolate or even obovate, coarsely crenate-toothed or lobed, rounded at the apex, tapering to the short petiole or petioliform base, mostly not over 15 cm. long and 3 cm. widey but variable according to the habitat, the extremes as small as 15 mm. long and 3 mm. wide, as large as 30 cm. long and 12 cm. wide; cauline leaves ample, clasping at the base, more conspicuously so in larger forms, crenate, dentate, or subentire; heads 1-many in an open infloresecnce; involuere 4-6 mm. high; phyllaries subequal, variable in width, light greenish or brownish, the brown midvein more or less hirsute with flattened hairs, or nearly glabrous, the broad hyaline margins occasionally purplish; disk 6-15 mm. broad; ligules very numerous and narrow, mostly 150 or more, 0.2-0.6 mm. wide, 5-10 mm. long, deep pink or rose-purple to white; disk-corollas about 2.5-3.2 mm. long, with lobes about 0.4 mm. long, the limb narrowed to a sometimes very sharply set off tube about 0.8-1.2 mm. long; style-appendages deltoid-ovate, acutish or obtuse, about 0.1 mm. long or a little more; akenes sparsely pubescent, 2-nerved; pappus quite simple, often much shorter than the disk-corollas, of about 20-30 fragile bristles.

description: Caule 5-15 dim. alto, plus minus pubeseente, pilis carnosis; foliis anguste laneeolatis, 10-15 ecn. longis, 1.5-3 cm. latis, argute serratis, dentibus aseelidentibus, basi amplectenti, margine scabro; capitulis eymosis; bracteis exterioribus foliaceis, lineari-lanceolatis, acutis vel obtusis, hispidulo-ciliatis, frequenter radiis aequantibus; disco 1 cm. alto et circa 2 cm. lato; ligulis livide luteis; paleis interioribus pallidis, 3-4-striatis; acheniis fusco-olivaceis, angulis retrorse hispidculis; aristis 4, aseenidentibus.

description: Biennial or perennial herb with a simple or slightly braniehed caudex and fibrous root system; stem erect, or occasionally curved at the base, 1-5 (rarely 7) dm. high; herbage sparsely to densely hirsute or strigose with appressed or spreading hairs; basal and lowermost cauline leaves oblanceolate, entire or irregularly toothed, acute to obtuse or rarely rounded at the tip, tapering gradually to the winged petiole or petioliform base, the blade and petiole if present mostly 4-15 cm. long and 3-15 mm. wide, sometimes wider; middle stem leaves linear or lance- olate, usually conspicuously smaller than the lower ones, often bract-like; heads 1-15, usually borne on long nearly naked peduneles, the disk 10-20 nmm. broad; involuere 5-9 mm. high; phyllaries subequal or slightly imbricate, linear, the outer ones mostly 0.5-0.9 mm. wide, acuminate, the inner often with the tips curled and wholly searious, all hirsute or strigose, not glandular, appressed, and often with an evident brown midvein; ligules numerous, about 125-175, 8-15 mm. long, about 1 mm. wide, blue or pink, less commonly white; disk-corollas about 4.0-5.5 mm. long, the tube 0.7-1.5 mm. long, the lobes 0.6-0.9 mm.; stvle-appen- dages deltoid or lance-ovate, acute or acutish, about 0.15 mm. long; pappus double, the outer setulose and sometimes very scanty; akenes 2-nerved, hairy. Meadows, prairies, and open ground; Alaska and Northwest Territories, south to Montana, Utah, Colorado, South Dakota, and Wisconsin.

description: Perennial, reproducing vegetatively by rhizomes. Stems erect, pubescent to tomentose throughout, simple to the inflorescence, 10-20 dm high. Leaves cauline, numerous, 8-20 cm long, 2-6 cm wide, elliptic to ovate - lanceolate, with sparses L- shaped trichomes above, dense L- shaped trichomes and sparse stalkless trichomes and bilobed glands below, with acute tips, acute to cuneate bases, and serrate margins. Inflorescence loose to irregular, center heads openeing first. Heads 32-58 flowered. Involucre campanulate to cylindric, 7.0 - 10.3 mm high, 5.5-8.0 mm wide; inner bracts oblong, 5.5 - 10.5 mm long, obtuse to mucronate; outer bracts cordate to deltoid, 2.5 - 5.0 mm long, acute to acuminate; bracts greenish to brownish, pubescent along margins and sometimes on outer surface. Achenes puberulent to nearly glabrous on the ribs, 4-6mm long. Pappus tawny to brown sometimes with a purple tinge, inner bristles 6-8 mm long, outer scales 0.6 - 1.0 mm long. Flowers from July through early September.

description: Low herb, the caudex essentially subterranean; leaves coriaceous, linear, 20-35 cm. long, 3-6 mm. broad, acute at apex, expanded at base to a coriaceous sheath about 10 mm. broad, strongly revolute at margins, densely cinereous lanate on both surfaces, glabrescent with age, the costa prominent, the nerves obscure; flowering branches stout, erect, up to 25 cm. high, densely and loosely fulvous matted-tomentose, branched distally, crowded corymbose-paniculate, the branches alternate, subtended by small linear bracts; heads 12-15, densely crowded, at maturity 9-12 mm. in diameter; phyllaries 10-15, 1- or 2-seriate, lanceolate-oblong, acute, the outer ones about 9 mm. long and 2.5 mm. broad, fulvous lanate without, the hairs up to 5 mm. long; ray florets 2- or 3-seriate, the corolla reduced to an irregularly lobed tube about 1.5 mm. long, densely glandular-hispid, the hairs 0.3-0.4 mm. long, the style and stigmas about 2.5 mm. long, the achene stramineous, 2.5-3 mm. long; disk florets glandular-hispid, about 4.5 mm. long, the tube  slightly shorter than the limb, the limb 5-costate to the sinuses, the lobes oblong, the stamens about 3 mm. long, the filaments short; paleae papyraceous, obovate-spatulate, about 4.5 mm. long and 1.5 mm. broad, obtuse, densely glandular-hispid distally without.

description: Slender trailing plant apparently with a central slender taproot, the basal portion of the several stems subnaked and rhizomatous in appearance,. but apparently not subterranean; herbage hirsute or villous-hirsute with spreading hairs, also finely glandular; stem reported to reach 2 feet in length, much shorter in herbarium specimens, sometimes apparently giving rise to erect flowering branches; leaves numerous, oblanceolate to obovate, up to 2.5 cm. long and 7 mm. wide, usually some of the lower coarsely few-toothed or pinnately lobed; heads usually solitary at the ends of leafy branches, sometimes several grouped into a more obvious and less leafy inflorescence; disk about 4-6 mm. wide; involucre 2.5-4 mm. high, finely glandular and sparsely hirsute with long spreading hairs; phyllaries nearly equal, thin, green, with light brown midvein, the inner with searious margins; ligules about 40-65, white or light purple, about 3 mm. long, 0.3-0.5 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 2.0 mm. long, the tube well defined, about 0.5 mm. long or a little less, the lobes about 0.25-0.3 mm.; style-appendages very short and broad, about 0.05 mm. long, or, in most of my specimens, the style-branches poorly developed and partly fused, without evident appendages, this condition perhaps abnormal; pappus double, the inner of about 7-10 slender and fragile bristles, the outer of slender nearly setose squamellae; akenes 2-nerved, sparsely hairy.

description: Herba robusta, ramosa ultra metralis alta, caulibus crassis, fistulosis, pluricostatis, laxe lanosis vel glabris. Folia sparsa, alterna, petiolata, petiolo alato, basi subvaginato vel subauriculato, 4-6 cm. longo, lamina ovata vel ovato- lanceolata, apice acuta, basi rotundata cordatave, margine calloso-dentata, supra lanuginosa vel glabrescente, subtus dense griseo-tomentosa, 16-23 cm. longa, 6-12 cm. lata. Capitula copiosa, discoidea vel radiata, in panicula ampla a cymis corymbiformibus formata disposita; pedicellis bracteolatis, 8-15 mm. longis. Involucrum campanulatum, subecalyculatum, 7-8 mm. altum, 3.5-5 mm. crassum; bracteolis calyculi paucis, linearibus, brevissimis; bracteis involucri 8, oblongis, apice acutis penicillatisque, dorso glabris, trinervatis. Flores isomorphi vel dimorphi, lutei. Flores marginales 0-4, feminei, ligulati, tubulo 5 mm. longo, ligula oblonga 8-11 mm. longa, 1.2-2 mm. lata. Flores disci 7-13, hermaphroditi, corolla tubulosa 6-7 mm. longa, limbo late campanulato pentalobato, lobulis lanceolatis 1.7-2 mm. longis, ad medium nervatis. Styli rami apice truncati hir- suti. Achaenia cylindracea, 3, 5 mm. longa, coatata, breviter papilloso-pube-. scentia. Pappus albus, 5-6 mm. longus.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Stems erect, 40-100 cm tall, terete, branched in upper part, densely lanate with short glandular hairs and longer eglandular woolly hairs. Basal leaves withered at anthesis. Leaves opposite; lamina cordate, 55-75 X 40-50 mm in the middle part of stems, acute at apex, cordate at base, crenate along margin, trinerved or weakly palminerved, puberulous and punctate-glandular (yellow) on both surfaces, pilose on veins; petioles 15-40 mm long, winged. Heads many, short-pedunculate, 7-8 x ca. 4 mm, in several compound dense corymbs 10-40 mm wide; each corymb consisting of 5-25 heads. Inflorescence branches and peduncles densely stipitate-glandular (yellow to red-purple). Phyllaries ca. 6 mm long, acuminate at apex, pale green, sometimes reddish at apex, stip- itate-glandular mixed with several long or short hairs outside. Corolla white, sometimes pale-pink, sparsely puberulous and sparsely sessile-glandular outside above; tubes 4-5 mm long; lobes ca. 1.5 mm long. Achenes ca. 3 mm long, dark brown, gla- brous. Pappus absent.

description: Dioecious shrubs, much-branched from the base, 20-60 cm tall, branches erect, densely lanate-tomentose, white or rarely glabrescent. Leaves with petioles 1-2 mm long; blades elliptic to lanceolate or oblong, 15-25 mm long, 4-11 mm wide, the base attenuate, the apex obtuse, the margins entire or rarely with a few teeth, strongly rev- olute, white lanate-tomentose to glabrescent. Capitulescences of solitary capitula on distal branchlets and lateral short-shoots; peduncles 3-6 mm long. Capitula with involucres campanulate, 5-7 mm tall, 4-6 mm wide, subtended by 1-2 bracteoles, 1.5-2 mm long, ovate; phyllaries 5, dimorphic, the inner 2 ovate to oval, 6.5-7 mm long, ca. 3.5 mm wide, apically obtuse, ciliolate, hyaline-margined, dorsally tomentose, the outer 3 oblong-lanceolate, 6.5-7 mm long, 1.5-1.7 mm wide, apically acute. Functionally staminate individuals with ca- pitula containing 10-15 florets, the corollas yellow or violet, narrowly campanulate, ca. 7.5 mm long, the tube ca. 3.5 mm long, the throat 2-2.5 mm long, the lobes lanceolate, 2 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide; anthers ca. 3 mm long, filament not enlarged; style branches 0.5 mm long, apically obtuse; ovaries sterile; pappus bristles ca. 6.5 mm long, stramineous to violet, apical cells slender, acute. Pistillate individuals with capitula containing 10-20 florets, the corollas narrowly tubular, ca. 7.5 mm long, the tube ca. 3 mm long, the throat ca. 2.5 mm long, the lobes linear, ca. 2 mm long, ca. 0.2 mm wide; anthers nonfunctional; style branches ca. 1 mm long, apically rounded, dorsally papillose. Achenes cylindrical, costate, glabrous, 4-5 mm long, ca. 1 mm diam. pappus ca. 8 mm long, stra- mineous to violet, apical cells slender, acute. Chromosome number: 2n = 20 (Hunziker et al., 1989).

description: Perennial herb with a stout branched caudex to which the old leaf-bases of several or many seasons may adhere; stem 5-25 cm. high, more or less glandular, and sometimes also sparsely hirsute with spreading hairs; leaves more or less densely glandular, occasionally obscurely so, or even essentially eglandular, some or all of them with the margins sparsely and coarsely ciliate with stiff spreading hairs, particularly near the base, occasionally the surfaces also sparsely hirsute; basal leaves oblanceolate, up to 15 cm. long and 7 mm. wide, usually much less, the blade tapering very gradually to the petiole; cauline leaves several. reduced, linear or linear-oblong, seldom over about 3 cm. long and 3 mm. wide, usually less; heads solitary, on subnaked peduncles, the disk 7-15 mm. wide; involuere densely glandular and usually also sparsely hirsute, 4-8 mm. high; phyllaries subequal or slightly imbricate, mostly light green, sometimes with darker midrib, often with purplish tips, the inner with evident searious or subsearious margins; ligules about 30-90, blue, sometimes pink or pink-purple, rarely white, 6-16 mm. long, 1.1-1.7 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.2-5.3 mm. long, the tube about 0.8-1.4 mm., the lobes 0.5-0.7 mm.; style-appendages about 0.2-0.3 mm. long, from ovate and obtuse to lance-subulate and sharply acute; pappus double, the inner of about 18-25 slender and fragile sordid bristles, the outer mostly setose, sometimes obscure; akenes 2-nerved, strigose-hirsute.

description: Stemn stout, 1-4 m high, glabrous and glaucous, light red, or with scattered light-red patches, sometimes green or light-purple, becoming pubescent or scab- rous near the top; leaves lanceolate or lanceolate-ovate, alternate, 13-32 cm long, 2-8 cm waide; petioles 1.5-6 cm long; upper leaf surface with many short hairs, the lowver surface typically white-tomentose; margins variable, usually serrate, sometimiies coarsely so; phyllaries 1-1.2 cm long, frequently with short marginal cilia, the surface usually bearing only scattered pubescence; heads in terminal panicles or occasionally racemes, the peduncles variable in length, 3-15 cm long, seabrous near the top; heads mostly 5-8 cm in diameter, the disk 1.5-2.5 eni wide; ligules 14-20, bright yellow, mnostly 2.5-4.4 cm long, 0.9-1.5 cm wide; disk florets 1-1.2 cm long, glabrous or glabrescenit near the base of the corolla; chaff pubescent at tip, linear-acuminate, obscurely three-cuspidate.

description: Herba crassa, caudice erecto 1-4 m. alto; foliis et ramis floriferis summo dense arctatis, ubique dense canescente-tomentosis; foliis tenu-iter coriaceis obovato-spathulatis, 30-35 cm. longis, 5-7 cm. latis (apicem versus latissimis), prope basin ad 10-15 mm. angustatis, ad vaginam coriaceam dilatatis, apice subacutis, margine integris, nervis secundariis 6 vel 7 per decimetrum, angulo 35-40° adscendentibus; ramis floriferis axillaribus quam foliis longioribus, 6-10-capitulatis; capitulis maturitate 25-30 mm. diametro, corymboso-paniculatis, paniculis 8-15 cm. longis, ramis inflorescentiae bracteis oblongo-lanceolatis  4-6 cm. longis et 1.5 cm. latis subtentis; involucro ut videtur 2-seriato, phyllaribus circiter 15 deltoideo-oblongis, circiter 10 mm. longis et 4-6 mm. latis, apice acutis, extra dense canescente-tomentosis intus glabris; floribus radii circiter 100, 2-3-seriatis, lamina lanceolato-ob-longa, 11-12 mm. longa, 1.5 mm. lata, basin versus pilis crassis fuscis 0.4 mm. longis parce hispidula, achenio trigono maturitate 3.5 mm. longo; floribus disci circiter 8 mm. longis, tubo quam limbo paullo breviore, lobis deltoideo-ovatis circiter 0.7 mm. longis; staminibus et stylo desideratis; paleis oblongo-spathulatis, 8-9 mm. longis, 2.5-3 mm. latis, apice acutis, extra apicem versus pilis fuscis circiter 0.8 mm. longis strigosis.

description: Plantae 1-4 m altae, interdum erectae plerumque ascendentes vel serpentes. Glandes partium vegetativarum 30-90k longae. Caules juveniles rami juveniles inflorescentia que pilosi plerumque sine glandibus. Folia auriculata; laminae supra sparse strigosae, interdum sparse glandulosae vel glabratae, subtus sparse vel densius strigosae vel pilosae, interdum sparse glandulosae. Pedunculi 0.7-2.7 (-5.5) mm longi, pilosi et interdum sparse glandulosi. Bracteae accessoriae utrinque strigosae vel sparse pilosae et interdum sparse glandulosae, vel glabratae. Phyllaria 10.5-13.5 mm longa, (1.3-) 1.6-2 mm lata, subulata vel linearia acuminataque, convexa, pagina adaxiali distaliter strigosa, pagina abaxiali sparse strigosa glandulosaque, co,sta non prominenti. description: Plants annual, erect, slender, much braniched, ca 1.4 dm high; stems short-strigose; leaves linear, sessile, entire, scabrous, ca 2.1 cm long and 1 mm wide; peduncles 0-3 mm long; heads broadly hemispherical, ca 9 mm wide; phyllaries 6-9, imbricate, graduated, rarely foliaceous, obovate, apices rounded, lightly pubescent; rays semi-persistent, ca 5, yellow, narrowly ovate, ca 2.5 mm long 2-lobed at apex, base very narrow, style glabrous, branch apices obtuse; ray achenes awnless, obovate with thickened, ciliate, margins cartilagenous, inwardly with a medial rib, tuberculate, outwardly lightly striate, tuberculate; disk corollas numerous, of uniform width, ca 2 mm long, lobes yellow-red, glabrous outside, velvety inside, purplish below the lobes, style glabrous, base dilated, branch apices rounded, anther apices concave and lanceolate, filaments thickened above; disk achenes dimorphic, broadly obovate to cuneate, ca 2.5 mm long, with a single slender caducous awn, essentially glabrous, margins with thick, finely ciliate cartilage; paleae about equaling the disk flowers, light purple-tipped, minutely pubescent on the keel, apices acute; receptacle conical.

description: Shrubs ca 1 m tall, sometimes prostrate; stems ochroleucous-tomentose, be- coming dark with age. Leaves cauline, uncrowded; petioles 0-2.5 mm long, tomentose, the blades (1.5) 3.2-8.5 x 0.5-5 cm, elliptic-oblong to oval, widest at or below the middle, apically rounded to obtuse to acute, basally rounded to cuneate, marginally slightly revolute, tomentose above when young, becoming glabrate and revealing a leathery lacuno-rugose texture, pannose to velvety-tomentose below. Inflorescences terminal, flattened, composed of I to several compound glomerules surrounded by bracts. Heads 4- to 8-flowered. Phyllaries 5.3-10 x 1-1.8 mm, tips dorsally arachnoid, pilose or glandular. Pappus whitish to straw-colored; inner paleas flattened, twisted, 5-8.2 mm long, outer ones minute scales 0.1-0.2 mm long. Corollas 6-10 mm long, reddish-purple, sometimes glandular. Anthers 3-4 mm long. Achenes 3-3.2 mm long, ca 10-ribbed, glabrous, glossy, dark brown. Flowering and fruiting from February to April.

description: Perennial herbs; stems 3-5 dm tall, densely white-arachnoid; leaves of basal rosette 19-28 cm long, arachnoid-tomentose on both sides, sinuately pinnatifid, armed with spines 3-5 mm long; cauline leaves similar to the basal, to 7.5 cm wide, reduced upwards; heads solitary or 2 to few tightly clustered 2.3-3 cm high, 2-3 cm wide; involucres 1.5-2.2 cm high, 2-3 cm wide; bracts glabrate or sparingly arachnoid on margins, dorsal glutinous ridge inconspicuous, the outer attenuate into a spine 2-7 mm long, flattened apically and more or less spreading; corollas bluish-pink.

description: Plants about 2 m high; stems finely canescent-tomentose; leaves alternate; petioles 1.5 cm long; blades ovate-lanceolate to lanceolate, 7 cm long, 4 cm wide, cuneate at base, attenuate, acuminate, serrulate to subentire, above canescent with dark scattered hairs, beneath griseous-canescent-tomentose; heads 3-9 on peduncles 1-3 cm long; disks about 1 cm in diameter; phyllaries lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 7-8 m long, 2 mm wide, sparingly appressed-canescent, indurate below; rays about 10, 8 mm long, 3 mm wide; disk corollas yellow, 3-4 mm long, the teeth with scattered hairs, otherwise glabrous; anthers yellow; pales obtuse, straw-colored and dark-striate, puberulent on upper part of keel; achene 3 mm long, when immature with scattered hairs, glabrous at maturity; pappus of 2 subulate awns, 2-3 mm long, and 2-5 short squamellae; pappus of ray achenes none.
bibliographicCitation: Heiser, Charles B. 1957. A revision of the South American Species of Helianthus. Brittonia. 8: 283-285.

description: Perennial herb with a short taproot or short brittle caudex and usually some fibrous roots, sometimes apparently blooming the first year; stem generally lax, erect or suberect, about 2-25 cm. high, more or less spreading-villous, the hairs, particularly near the top of the stem, generally with some purple cross-walls; leaves loosely villous or villous-hirsute when young, the lower ones commonly glabrate or nearly so by flowering time; basal leaves oblanceolate or occasionally spatulate, up to about 8 cm. long and 11 mm. wide; cauline leaves more or less reduced, mostly linear or linear-lanceolate, the lower ones generally acute, the upper ones attenuate; heads solitary, the disk 10-20 mm. wide; involucre 6-9 mm. high, more or less densely woolly-villous, the hairs with dark purple or blackish cross-walls; phyllaries relatively narrow, not more than 1 mm. wide, loose and attenuate, generally heavily tinted with blackish purple, rarely more greenish, subequal, or sometimes a few of the outer evidently shorter than the others; ligules about 50-150, white to purplish, about 3.5-6 mm. long, 0.55-1.0 mm. wide; diskcorollas about 3.4-4.8 mm. long, the tube 1.3-2.0 mm., the lobes 0.4-0.6 mm.; styleappendages broadly to narrowly triangular, 0.05-0.15 mm. long; pappus of about 20-30 bristles, exceeding the disk-corollas, with a few short and inconspicuous outer setae; akenes 2-nerved, more or less hairy.

description: Unarmed shrubs to 5 dm high. Stems at first tomentose, becoming glabrescent, reddish brown to gray. Primary leaves filiform, ascending to gently recurved; 2.5-4.5 cm long; tomentose to glabrescent. Secondary leaves wanting or in fascicles in the axils of the primary leaves; similar to primary leaves; 1-3 cm long. Capitula borne in compact, corymbose clusters at the tips of branches. Peduncles 5-15 (-20) mm long; ebracteate; tomentose. Involucres narrowly cylindrical; 6-12 mm high. Phyl- laries 4; linear-oblong to narrowly ovate; obtuse; canescent. Florets 4 per capitulum. Corollas yellow; 10-15 mm long; very slender; throat narrow; lobes lance-linear 4-5 mm long. Achenes slender, cylindrical to narrowly obpyramidal; 3-5 mm long; glabrous, tawny with slightly darker ribs. Pappus of 80-100 tawny, slender, penicil- late bristles 10-13 mm long. Style branches obtuse; hispidulous. Anthers ca. 3.5 mm long; sagittate; sterile tips narrow, obtuse. Pollen grains mostly 38-44 tum in diameter. Fig. 2,B.
bibliographicCitation: Strother, John L. 1974. Taxonomy of Tetradymia (Compositae: Senecioneae). Brittonia. 26: 177-202.

description: Volubilis suffrutescens; caulis teres non alatus dense rufo-pilosus; folia majuscula ovata acuminata basi rotundata petiolata papyracea subintegra penninervia supra subdense subtus dense rufo-pilosa; capitula 9-10 mm. alta numerosa maxima ex parte sessilia in paniculis pyramidalibus terminalibus et axillaribus; phyllaria 5 mm. longa oblonga obtusa tenuiter subherbacea pluristriata apice ciliata dorso sparse pilosa margine et apice scariosa, bracteolis ovatis acutis v. obtusis involuero duplo brevioribus; corollae fauces campanulatae; achenia apice sparse pilosula.
bibliographicCitation: Blake, Sidney F. 1937. New Asteraceae from Guatemala and Costa Rica Collected by A. F. Skutch. Brittonia. 2 (4): 329 -361.

description: Ser. Thyrsigerae; "twining vine, somewhat woody"; stem and widely spreading branches pithy, solid, multistriate, densely pilose with spreading or deflexed many-celled reddish-brown hairs, slightly enlarged at base, at length deciduous but with persistent bases; leaves opposite; petioles stout, unmargined, not decurrent, 1-2.5 cm. long, very densely pubescent like the stem; blades ovate or the smaller lance- ovate, 9-21 cm. long, 3.5-9.5 cm. wide, falcate-acuminate, at base rounded or the larger slightly cordate, or the smaller somewhat cuneate- rounded, essentially entire or obscurely and remotely callous-denticulate, above deep green, scarcely shining, evenly pilose on surface with curved-spreading several-celled rufous hairs with slightly enlarged bases, densely so along costa, beneath brownish-green, densely pilose on surface and veinlets and more densely along chief veins with spreading several-celled brownish hairs slightly enlarged at base, feather-veined, 2 pairs of veins much stronger than the others and arising within 2-3.5 cm. of base of leaf; panicles axillary and terminal, rather dense, many- headed, pubescent like the stem, 9-14 cm. long, 5-10 cm. wide, the lateral ones pedunculate (peduncle 3-4 cm. long, about equaling the floriferous part of panicle), the terminal sessile and subtended by a pair of reduced leaves; bracts small, lanceolate or subulate, 1.2 cm. long or less; heads cylindric, 4-flowered, all or nearly all sessile in clusters of 3-5 at tips of the short ultimate branches of the inflorescence; bractlets single, ovate, 2.5 mm. long, thinnish, greenish-centered, subscarious- margined, several-striate, ciliate and pilose; phyllaries 4, oblong, ob- tuse, 5 mm. long, about 1.2 mm. wide, with pale greenish center and narrow pale searious margin and tip, 4-7-vittate, ciliate chiefly toward apex and sparsely pilose on back, with corky-thickened not spurred base; corollas "white," glabrous except for the apically very sparsely hispidulous teeth, 4.3 mm. long (tube 2 mm., throat campanulate, 1 mm. long, about 1.5 mm. wide, teeth ovate, acute, 1.3 mm. long); achenes pale yellowish, with 5 white ribs, sparsely pilosulous toward apex, eglandular, 3.2 mm. long; pappus whitish, of 39 or 40 finely hispidulous bristles, very slightly thickened at apex, 4.7 mm. long.

description: Herbae caespitosae; caules 1.5-2 cm longi. Folia lanceolata, 6-9 mm longa, 0.5-2 mm lata, apiculata. Capitulescentiae solitariae, pedunculo 3-5 mm longo. Capitula 2-2.5 mm alta, 1-1.5 mm lata; involucrum ovoideum; phyllaria aequalia, extima ovato-lanceolata 1.8-2 mm longa, 0.5-0.7 mm lata, apice acuta usque ad acuminata, intima lanceolata, 1.8-2 mm longa, 0.5-0.7 mm lata, apice acuta. Flores feminei S or 6, corolla ca 1.25 mm longa; styli rami ca 0.25 mm longi; flores hermaphroditi 5 or 6; corolla ca 1.6 mm longa, limbo 4-lobulato, lobis 0.2 mm longis, lanceolatis; antherae ca 0.75 mm longae; styli rami clavati, ca 0.4 mm longi. Achaenia ovoidea, 0.8-0.9 mm longa, 0.4 mm lata; pappi aristae 1.2-1.4 mm longae.

description: Cespitose herbs; stems 1.5-2 cm long. Leaves lanceolate, 6-9 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, mucronate. Capitulescences solitary, the peduncle 3-5 mm long. Capitula 2-2.5 mm tall, 1-1.5 mm wide; involucre ovoid; phyllaries equal, the outer ovate-lanceolate, 1.8-2 mm long, 0.7-0.8 mm wide, apically acute to acuminate, the inner lanceolate, 1.8-2 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm wide, apically acute; pistillate florets 5 or 6, the corolla ca 1.25 mm long, the style branches 0.25 mm long; hermaphrodite florets 5 or 6, the corolla ca 1.6 mm long, 4-lobed, the lobes 0.2 mm long, the anthers 0.75 mm long, the style branches clavate, ca 0.4 mm long. Achenes ovoid, 0.8-0.9 mm long, ca 0.4 mm wide; pappus bristles 1.2-1.4 mm long.

description: Frutices ca 1.5 m usque alti; caules dense fulvo-tomentosi foliati ad apicem subquadrangulati. Folia opposita, decussata, sessilia vel breviter petiolata; petioli 0-5 mm longi dense fulvo-tomentosi; laminae late ovatae vel orbiculatae, (1.5) 2-5 cm longae, (1.4) 1.8-3.5 cm latae, coriaceae, basi cordatae, apice rotundatae vel late obtusae, inferne dense fulvo-tomentosae, superne glabrae reticulato-venosae atrobrunnescentes, margine integrae. Capitulescentiae terminales cymosae; pedunculi 1-1. 5 cm longi dense fulvo-tomentosi. Capitula heterogama radiata, 10-12 mm alta, 10-12 mm lata; bracteae calyculi 5-7 mm longae, teretiusculae dense fulvo-tomentosae; involucra campanulata; phyllaria 8, uniseriata, coriacea, extima oblonga, 6.5-7 mm longa, 2-2.5 mm lata, obtusa vel rotundata dense fulvo-tomentosa, intima elliptica, 7-8 mm longa, 3-4 mm lata, apice obtusa vel rotundata dense fulvo-tomentosa ipso apice ciliolata margine scariosa. Flores radiati pistillati 3-5; ligulae luteae, oblongae vel ellipticae, 5-6 mm longae, 2-3 mm latae, apice 3-dentatae. Flores disci hermaphroditi 18-20; corollae tubulosae luteae, 8-10 mm longae; limbus cylindrico-campanulatus quinquelobus; lobi ca 1.5 mm longi, ca 0.5 mm lati, apice obtusi; antherae ca 2.5 mm longae basi subcaudatae; rami stylorum lineares apice triangulari-penicillati ca 2 mm longi. Achaenia (immatura) ca 3.5 mm longa, glabra, 5-10-costata brunnea; pappi setae 45-50, ca 10 mm longae uniseriatae fulvae apice leviter dilatatae acutae.

description: Frutex scandens ramis terminalibus teretibus leviter adpresseque squamoso-tomentosis. Folia petiolata alterna firmule chartacea. Petiolus 1 cm longus sulcatus dense adpresseque lepidotus argentato-cinereus. Lamina obovata vel elliptico-obovata basi obtuse attenuata apice subite cuspidata margine anguste revoluta sursum brevissime remoteque sinuato-denticulata reliqua integerrima, 10-14 cm longa 5-8 cm lata; supra plumbeo-viridis glabra costa notata nerviis secundariis filiformibus impressis, nervulis prominulis minute reticulatis; subtus argenteo-albida adpressissime mucido-pubescenti lepidotaque, costa elevata, nervis secundariis 5-7 utroque latere arcuato-ascendentibus marginem versus tenuioribus anastomosatisque nervulis prominulis sublaxe reticulatis. Inflorescentiae cymoso-paniculatae axillares sessiles ramis 2-4, lepidoto-stellatis tomentellis 1-4 cm longis. Capitula sessilia vel subsessilia ad apicem ramulorum 1-3 mm longorum glomerata. Involucrum campanulatum circa 4.5 mm longum bracteis subcoriaceis stramineis apicem versus brunneis subglabris margine parce ciliatis, exterioribus ovatis acutiusculis et obtusis, interioribus oblongis acutiusculis 4-4.5 mm longis, 1.2-1.5 mm latis, valde deciduis revolu- tisque. Flores 6 in capitulo, corolla 5-5.5 mm longa tubulo glabro 3 mm longo, limbo parce puberulo dentibus oblongis acutiusculis 1.2-1.5 mm longis. Antherae 3 mm longae basi acutissiinae. Ovarium glabrum. Pappus 4.2 mm longus strami- neus, paleis exterioribus angustis strigosis 0.5-1.2 mm longis, pilis interioribus capillaribus sursum paulo crassioribus strigosis.
bibliographicCitation: Cowan, Richard S. 1955. Studies in Tropical American Leguminosae-II. Brittonia. 8 (2): 113.

description: Perennial herb; stem deeumbent at the base, 4-25 cm. high, sparsely to moderately pilose; leaves hirsute-pilose, the basal oblanceolate, tapering to the petiole, acute or sometimes obtuse at the apex, 1-9 cm. long, 4-8 mm. wide; cauline leaves several, relatively well developed, narrowly lanceolate to ovate, up to 5 cm. long and 7 mm. wide, usually smaller; head solitary; involucre 8-10 mm. high, densely long-villous or pilose with flattened multicellular heairs; cross-walls of the hairs clear or occasionally the basal ones bright reddish purple; phyllaries about equal, loose, some often reflexed above the middle, greenish below, more or less purplish on the margins above and at the nearly naked and somewhat glandular tips; ligules about 100-125, blue, 1.0-2.0 mm. wide, 10-15 mm. long; disk-corollas mostly 4.0-5.0 mm. long, the tube about 1 mm. long or less when well defined, the lobes 0.7-0.8 min.; style-appendages about 0.2 mm. long, deltoid-ovate; pappus double, the inner of about 15-20 bristles, the outer of a few very slender and inconspicuous setae; akenes copiously hirsute, 2-nerved, one of the nerves occasionally double.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Perennial herb with a slender taproot and short branched caudex; stem 3-15 cm. high, ordinarily scapose above and much exceeding the leaves, spreading-hirsute with long hairs and also more or less spreading-hirtellous with very short hairs; leaves usually nearly all in a basal dluster, sometimes a few reduced ones scattered along the stem, oblanceolate, straight or sometimes arcuate, occasionally a little curled, 1-3 mm. wide, up to 9 cm. long, hispid-ciliate on the margins, especially near their bases, and more or less hirsute on the surfaces, the lowermnost ones commonly somewhat enlarged, indurated, and whitish at their bases, but not so conspicuously so as in E. piperianus; head solitary, the disk commonly 9-17 mm. wide, in depauperate forms sometimes only 6 mm. wide; involucre mostly 5-7.5 mm. high, sometimes only 4 mm., hispid-hirsute and sometimes a little glutinous or obscurely glandular; phyllaries subequal, narrow, usually green or greenish, sometimes broader and with chartaceous margins, firm, commonly somewhat thickened on the midrib, the slender acuminate tips sometimes a little searious; pistillate flowers about 20-50, the ligule varying from absent to 10 mm. long and 2.5 mm. wide, yellow; disk-corollas commonly 4.0-4.5 mm. long, sometimes only 3.0 mm., the tube 0.4-1.0 mm., the lobes 0.6-0.9 mm.; styleappendages commonly deltoid or narrower, acute, 0.2-0.25 mm. long, or sometimes, especially in subsp. austinae, short, broad, and obtuse, only about 0.1 mm. long; pappus of about 15-25 slender bristles, commonly with a few slender outer setae; akenes 2-nerved, hairy.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Suffrutex 2.5 m. alta caule cylindrico leviter striato hirsuto, pilis teneribus patentibus copiosis praedito. Folia simplicia alterna exstipulata grandia. Petiolus 15 cm. longus (in specimine typo) robustus striolatus hirsutulus vel tomentoso-hirsutulus. Lamina crassiusculo-membranacea ambitu suborbiculato-cordata 9-11 lobulata lobulis ovato-triangularibus mucronulatis margine grosse irregulariterque dentata, praecipue basi, 5-plinervis et duo nervis secundariis ascendentibus parte mediam nascentibus magis evolutis, 21.5 cm. longa et 23 cm. lata (specimine unico); supra subpubescentibus, pilis rectis acutis basi incrassatis copiose sparsis munita, nervis principalibus conspicuis ceteris obsoletis; subtus crasse molliter sublaxeque tomentosa pilis gracilibus longis parum flexuosis vestita, nervis principalibus (praecipue tres) valde crassis prominentibus secundariis parcis prominulis reliquis nervulis reticulatis cum indumento fere velatis. Inflorescentia verisimiliter magna paniculata, terminalis et in axillis foliorum superiorum (in specimine incompleta). Panicula singula longe pedunculata (15 cm.) parte florifera thyrsoidea circa 20 cm. longa 12 cm. lata; pedunculo axi ramulisque copiose longeque hirsutis. Bracteae oblongae-lineares acutae herba- ceae molliter hirsutis. Ramuli ultimi pedicellique gracilissimi recti vel pauce flexuosi hirsutuli. Pedicelli subcapillares 3-20 mm. longi. Capitula campanulata circa 20 floribus. Bracteolae calyculares 1-2 anguste lineares. Involucrum circa 11 bracteis lanceolatis rigidis complicatis 6.5 mm. longis 2 mm. latis dorso hirto- puberulis margine late scariosis apicem versus ciliatis. Corolla 6.2 mm. longa bilabiata tubulo apicem versus ampliato 3.6 mm. longo labio inferiore elliptico-ovato oblongo 2.6 mm. longo, labio superiore in lacinias lineares convolutas bipartito. Antherae tubo 2.5 mm. longo basi longe caudatae. Styli rami arcuati extremo truncato et papilloso. Achaenia inmatura angusta 3 mm. longa sparsis pilis munita subapice angustato-apiculata apice in receptaculum ampliato. Pappus 4.5-5 mm. longo sordide albido pilis uniseriatis plumosis.
bibliographicCitation: Cuatrecasas, José. 1954. New species of Compositae from Ecuador, collected by W. H. Camp. Brittonia. 8: 39-79.

description: Dioecious, suffrutescent, perennial herbs, stems stoloniferous, 5-25 cm tall, ascending to decumbent, densely sericeo-tomentose. Leaves with petioles 1-10(15) mm long; blades oval to elliptic or elliptic-lanceolate, 5-25 mm long, 3-15 mm wide, prominently 3-nerved, the base cuneate to rounded, the apex broadly obtuse to rounded, the abaxial surfaces sericeous-tomentose, cinereous, the adaxial densely sericeous-tomentose, canescent, the margins entire to 1-2-dentate or weakly crenate or repand, revolute. Capitulescences of solitary capitula on distal branchlets; peduncles 1-5 cm long, densely sericeous-tomentose, 1-3-bracteolate, the bracts linear, 5-10 mm long. Capitula with involucres campanulate, 10-12 mm tall, 10-15 mm wide; phyllaries 18, the outer linear-lanceolate, 8-12 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide, apically atten- uate, purple, dorsally sericeous tomentose, the inner ovate-lanceolate, ca. 10 mm long, 2-2.5 mm wide, apically acute, purple, hyaline-margined, dorsally sericeous-tomen- tose. Functionally staminate individuals with capitula containing ca. 100 florets, the corollas yellow, narrowly campanulate, ca. 6.5-8.5 mm long, the tube 1.5-2.5 mm long, the throat ca. 4.5-5 mm long, the lobes lanceolate, ca. 0.8 mm long, ca. 0.4 mm wide, central-nerved; anthers ca. 2 mm long; style branches ca. 1 mm long, apically rounded, dorsally papillose; ovaries sterile; pappus bristles 8-9 mm long, white, apical cells slender to clavate, acute to rounded. Pistillate individuals with capitula containing ca. 100 florets, the corollas yellow, narrowly tubular, ca. 8 mm long, the tube ca. 2 mm long, the throat ca. 5 mm long, indistinct, the lobes linear, ca. 0.8 mm long, ca. 0.4 mm wide; anthers sterile; style branches linear, ca. 1 mm long, apically rounded, dorsally papillose. Achenes cylindrical, costate, glabrous, ca. 2 mm long; pappus 10-12 mm long, white, apical cells slender, acute.

description: Annual emergent aquatic herbs, rooting at the lower nodes, ca. 6 cm high in our limited material; stems thickened, hollow, striate, yellowish brown with conspicuous nodes; leaves sessile, essentially glabrous, lance-linear, ca. 13 mm long, 4 mm wide; peduncles axillary, essentially glabrous, flaring slightly at apex, ca. 8 mm long; heads more or less elongate cylindrical; phyllaries ca. 5, green, ca. 4 mm high, uniseriate, lance-linear, glabrous; alae hyaline, enclosing and slightly longer than the ray achenes, apically erose, ray corollas suborbicular, ca. 2 mm long, yellow, tube 0.5 mm long, 3-lobed at apex; ray achene finely striate, oblanceolate, somewhat dorsally compressed, ca. 2 mm long; disk flowers ca. 10; disk corollas ca. 1.5 mm long, yellow, 4-5 lobed, essentially glabrous even on the short abrupt constriction at the base; disk achenes minutely striate, terete to slightly compressed, linear ca. 2.5 mm long; paleae shorter than the disk flowers, broad but not distinctly keeled, more or less persistent on the receptacle, apices subacute, amrgins essentially entire; receptacle low conical.
