description: Rhizome 1.5 mm. in diam., light brown, short-branching from under side of node, the internodes of the last several seasons clothed with remnants of leaf bases; innovations apparently rarely produeed; stems solitary, or 2-3 from the short branching caudex, slender 1.5-2.5 mm. diam., 1.0-3.0(4.5) dm. high, light green, becoming reddish below, subglabrate to sparingly villous-hispid toward the base, becoming more obviously pubescent and con- spicuously stipitate-glandular above, leafy to the middle or upper part of the stem; cauline leaves 5.0-12 cm. long, 0.8 (0.5)-1.8 cm. wide, lanceolate, elliptic to oblanceolate, acutish or obtuse, sessile, the lowermost leaves narrowed to a broad- or narrow-winged petiole which is sometimes as long as the blade, entire, rarely remotely callus-denticulate, 3-5-nerved, subglabrate to sparingly strigose-pilose and short-stipitate-glandular, the margins hispidu- lous-eiliolate; upper leaves reduced; peduncles 5-12 cm. long, frequently with a pair of or several singly disposed small bracteoles; heads 1-3, cam- panulate, 12-15 mm. high; perielinium densely viscid, short and long stipi- tate-glandular, and obviously pilose but not lanate, when mature conspicu- ously turbinate, white-chartaceous; involueral bracts 10-14, oblanceolate, obtuse or only acutish, 8.0-11 mm. long, 2.0-3.5 mm. broad, scantily strigose- villous and short-stipitate-glandular, less conspicuously so above, the margins searious, scabrid-ciliolate, pilose within; ray flowers 9-13, light yellow, the ligules 12-16 mm. long, with 3 mostly rounded teeth, 0.5-1.5 (2.4) mm. long, frequently strigose-pilose on the back; disc flowers yellow, 7.4(6.9)- 8.2(8.5) mm. long, narrowly goblet-shaped, the base of the limb and the tube densely white-pilose, the collar obvious, the tube 3.0-3.9 mm. long, corolla lobes acute, 0.6-0.9 mm. long, hispidulous; achenes 5.5(4.9)-6.3 mm. long, uniformly and only moderately ascending-appressed hispid with double hairs, in length less than i diam. of the achene, intermixed only sparingly with septate-attenuate hairs; annulus poorly developed, the pappus whitish, becoming slightly yellowed, mostly somewhat longer than the corolla, barbel- late, the setae 0.12-0.18 mm. long.

description: Plantae 1-2 m altae, erectae vel ascendentes. Glandes partium vegetativarum 50-1 50A longae; pili cum (1-) 2-4 cellulis basilaribus. Caules sine alis; caules juveniles rami juveniles inflorescentiaque strigosi plerumque glandulosi; internodia 0.7-3.4 cm longa. Folia petiolata; petioli 2.4-6 mm longi plerumque non alati; laminae 2.2-8.2 cm longae, 0.6-2.2 cm latae, lineari-lanceolatae vel lanceolatae interdum falcatae, acutae vel apiculatae, basi attenuatae, supra sparse vel densius glandulosae et sparse vel densius strigosae, subtus glandulosae et strigosae vel pilosae, marginibus denticulatis vel integris, plerumque recurvatis vel revolutis, costa nervisque subtus prominentibus; stomata subtus solum. Inflorescentia paniculata vel corymbosa; pedunculi 0.2-1.2 (-2) mm longi, pilosi vel sericei et saep,e sparse glandulosi. Bracteae accessoriae 5-6 (-7), 4.5-8.5 (-10) mm longae, (0.4-) 0.8-3 mm latae, lineari- lanceolatae vel lanceolatae vel spathulatae, acutae, subsessiles vel breviter petiolatae, utrinque glandulosae et strigosae vel pilosae, marginibus integris, planis, costa subtus prominenti. Phyllaria 8, 8-11.5 mm longa, 1-1.7 mm lata, linearia, acuta, convexa, pagina adaxiali distaliter strigosa, pagina abaxiali glandulosa et strigosa vel sparse pilosa, costa aliquantum prominenti. Receptaculum 1.6-1.8 mm latum, pilis usque 0.6 (-5.5) mm longis onustum. Flores 11-13. Corollae tubus (florum exteriorum interiorumque) 6-7.5 mm longus, basi 0.4-0.5 mm latus, ore 0.8-1 mm latus, distaliter sparse glandulosus; labium exterius 2.3-2.7 (-3.5) mm longum, 1.1-1.5 mm latum, sparse glandulosum, paucipiliferum sub dentibus, revolutum; lobi labii interioris 1.8- 2.7 (-3.2) mm longi, basi 0.3-0.4 mm lati, sparse glandulosi, paucipiliferi sub apice. Filamenta 1.4-1.8 mm longa. Antherae 4.9-6 (-6.4) mm longae: appendices 1.5-1.7 (-2.1) mm longae, thecae 2.3-2.7 mm longae, caudae 1.1-1.6 mm longae. Stylus (5.1-) 6.6-7.8 mm longus usque ad furcam, ramis 1.2-1.7 mm longis. Achenia (5.3-) 6.5-8 mm longa, 0.4-0.6 mm lata, rostro (0.9-) 1.4-2.5 mm longo, pilis duplicibus mucum emittenibus, raro glandes parvas (ca. 30U longas) ferentia; embryo 4.1-4.3 mm longus, 0.5-0.6 mm latus sub cotyledonibus, cotyledonibus 2.1-2.5 mm longis. Pappus 7-9 mm longus, fulvus.

description: Perennial herb with a branching caudex; stem aseendinlg, 7-13 cm. high, copiously spreading-hirsute; leaves densely hirsute like the stem, the basal ones spatulate or broadly oblanceolate, rounded at the apex, mostly 2-4 em. long, 6-8 mm. wide; cauline leaves well developed, not much reduced upwards. oblanceo- late, becoming lanceolate or narrowly elliptic upwards, sessile or short-petiolate, 1-2 cm. long, 2-5 mm. wide; heads 1-3, the disk 8-10 mm. wide; involuere 5-6.5 mm. high, moderately hirsute and very finely glandular; phyllaries imbricate but not much thickened, green, sometimes with darker midrib, the inner with scarious purplish tips; ligules 15-20, white or pink, about 6-8 mm. long, 1.5-2.0 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.5-3.8 mm. long, the tube 0.7-0.8 mm., the lobes 0.6-0.7 mm, style-appendages triangular-lanceolate, acute, but the apex itself somewhat rounded, 0.2-0.25 mm. long; pappus of about 13-17 slender but firm sordid bristles, commonly with a few outer or intermingled setae resembling the hairs of the akene; akenes 2-nerved, plentifully hirsute-villous with appressed white hairs. Known only from the type collection.

description: Herbaceous to semi-shrubby perennial, (1.5) 2-3 (4) dm tall, glabrate or irregularly short-pilose, especially along the upper stem and among the heads in the inflorescence; stems arising singly or 2-5 loosely clustered from a branching, subligneous caudex surmounting a prominent taproot, or small or young plants appear merely as taprooted annuals. Leaves alternate, equally distributed along the stem, weakly turgid to subcoriaceous, linear to linear-lanceolate, sessile or nearly so, sometimes weakly amplexicaul, the margins entire or merely denticulate to pinnatilobulate, the well- developed mid-cauline leaves (2) 3-6 (9) cm long and 0.5-1.0 (1.5) cm wide, the lateral lobes, when present, linear-acute and up to 5 mm long. Inflorescence an open corymbiform cyme with 5-20+ heads, surmounting the major branches. Heads radiate, yellow; involucral bracts ca 13, green or reddish-purple tinged, oblong to lanceolate, 6-8 mm long, the margins scarious, especially upward, the apex minutely to conspicuously black or purplish-black, erose-fimbriate; calyculate bracts 2-6 (8), black-tipped, 1-2 mm long; receptacle naked; ray florets pistillate, ca 5 or 8, the ligule 6-7 (9) mm long in dried specimens (sometimes apparently bitten off by insects or other animals); disc florets exceeding the involucre by 1-2 mm at anthesis; corolla 6-7 mm long, prominently separated into tube and limb, the corolla lobes with thickened, weakly-glandular tips; pollen often sparse but regular in shape and apparently functional; pappus a single series of white capillary bristles, only slightly exceeding the involucral bracts; no mature achenes seen, but immature achenes 3+ mm long, weakly angled, short silvery-pubescent, at least on the angles.
bibliographicCitation: Barkeley, T. M. 1978. Three new species of Senecio (Asteraceae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 30: 69-75.

description: Perennial herb resembling E. pumilus in habit; leaves green, sparsely hirsute strigose or subglabrous, the basal ones tufted, linear-oblaneeolate, up to about 6 cm. long and 2.5 mm. wide, the cauline ones few, scattered, not over 2 cm. long; stem about 15 cm. high, sparsely spreading-hirsute; heads solitary, or borne singly at the ends of several long branches; involucre about 4 mm. high, very finely glandular and with a few long hairs; phyllaries slightly imbricate, firm with dark midrib and yellowish brown borders; ligules about 30-40, white, 6-8 mm. long, about 1 mm. wide or less; disk-corollas about 3.5-4.0 mm. long, the tube 0.7-0.8 mm. long, the lobes about 0.5 mm. long, the portion above the tube slightly indurated; style-appendages deltoid or ovate, obtuse or acutish, about 0.1-0.15 mm. long; pappus of a long paleaceous tube, splitting irregularly at the top into 10-15 coarse bristles, or a few of the bristles distinct to the base; akenes sparsely shorthairy, 2-nerved. Known only from the type collection, southwestern Colorado.

description: Perennial, reproducing vegetatively from root stocks; 5-9 dm tall, stems 1-3 branched, simple to the inflorescence. Cauline leaves few, linear-spatulate, 3.8-6.2 cm long, 0.2-0.6 cm wide; basal leaves linear-spatulate, 7-32 cm long, 0.4-1 cm wide. Inflorescence of 1-3 heads; ray flowers 16-32 mm long, 2.3-4.7 mm wide at apex; disk flowers 40-190, purple, 4-7 mm long, 1.2-1.8 mm wide. Outer involucral bracts 2.9-5.4 mm long, 1.7-3.1 mm wide, ovate-acute at apex; inner involucral bracts 4.5-7.6 mm long, 1.3-1.9 mm wide lanceolate, acuminate at apex. description: Slender erect annual; stems (0.9) 1.5-2.4 (2.7) dm high, corymbosely branching from near base and again distally, sparsely white-hirsute, the upper stems minutely black-stipitate glandular; leaves linear, 1.5-2.2 cm long, 0.7-1.5 mm wide, hirsute, marginally revolute, mostly crowded at base of stems and at each branching point above; heads cymose, terminating the branches; involucre ovoid, 4.5-5.5 mm high; phyllaries linear, acuminate, purple-tipped, pilose, black-stipitate-glandular; ray-flowers 4-6, fertile; disk-flowers 8-20, those of the outer row fertile, the others sterile; anthers yellow; ray-achenes 2-3.5 mm long, clavate, slightly arcuate; disk-achenes 2-4 mm long, slightly clavate, strongly dilated at base; ray-pappus 0.5-1.0 mm long, slightly plumose; paleae of disk-pappus 8-10, 1.2-3.5 mm long, plumose.

description: Plants up to 1.3 m tall; stems brown to reddish, lightly pubescent at the nodes, inconspicuously striate; leaves ovate to trullate, darker green on the upper surface, lightly scabrous, margins dentate with the teeth protracted into acuminate apices, petioles up to 3 cm long, blades ca. 5 cm wide and up to 10 cm long, bases obtuse, sometimes oblique, apices acute; peduncles up to 7 cm long, striate, slightly flaring and lightly pubescent at the apex; heads ca. 1 cm in diameter; involucre of 2 or 3 series of unequal, narrowly trullate, convex, lightly strigose sometimes keeled phyllaries with mostly acute apices; rays 13-20, elliptic, ca. 9 mm long, essentially glabrous; ray achene ca. 2 mm long, obpyramidal, the awn ca. 2 mm long, very lightly ciliate on the margins; disk flowers glabrous; disk achenes ca. 2.4 mm long, mostly flattened, sometimes 3-angled and obpyramidal, lightly pubescent, generally with unequal stout tapering awns, the longer toward the center of the head, sometimes with a third very reduced awn; paleae narrowly trullate, apices acuminate, often uncinate, not greatly exceeding the disk florets; receptacle conical; 2n = 56.

description: Perennial herb from a slender branching caudex; stem about 5 cm. high or less, scapose, loosely woolly-villous with long tangled hairs, especially upwards; leaves basal, oblanceolate, up to 3 cm. long and 5 cm. wide, often 3-toothed at the apex, loosely lanate-villous to pilose; head solitary, the disk about 13-23 mm. wide; involuere 9-13 mm. high, moderately to very copiously lanate; cross-walls of the hairs clear, or some of the lower ones obscurely purplish; phyllaries a little narrower and thicker than in related species, strongly purplish, especially upwards, the outer a little shorter than the inner; ligules about 30-80, white, sometimes blue or pink, 8-11 mm. long, 1.4-2.0 mm. wide; disk-corollas mostly 5.0-6.5 mm. long, sometimes a little shorter, the tube 1.5-2.0 mm. long when well defined, the lobes about 0.8-1.1 mm.; style-appendages deltoid-ovate, acute, about 0.2 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 25-35 slender white often somewhat twisted bristles, the outer of a few very slender and inconspicuous setae; akenes 2-nerved, very finely hirtellous or subglabrous.

description: Plants rarely becoming more than 9 dm tall; stems strigose to hirsute, striate, at first green, becoming yellow to purplish; leaves variable, lance-linear to broadly ovate or elliptic, up to 7 cm long and 3 cm wide, glandular-punctate, 3- to 5-nerved; peduncles up to 7 cm long, sometimes inflated distally, or so only on the central heads, striate, the pubescence as on the stem; heads campanulate, up to 18 mm high; phyllaries erect, spreading at maturity, obovate, glabrous or searious, their apices rounded, entire or erose and/or ciliate with one or two summit bands or only discolored; ray flowers scarlet red or yellow, 6-15, linear to spatulate or suborbicular, 8-25 mm long, ciliately margined, pubescent at the throat, glanduliferous above and below, otherwise glabrous, the tube ea 1.1 mm long, or none; ray achenes oblance-linear to narrowly elliptic, striate, sericeous, 9-10 mm long, awnless or with two low tufts of hairs; disk flowers 12-50, the lobes yellow inside, purplish to black and essentially glabrous outside, the tube yellow below; disk achenes oblance-linear, 3-angled to compressed, striate, lightly ciliate becoming rugose, 7-9 mm long, provided with a single awn at the emarginate apex; chaff glabrous, the apices obtuse, erose, red to purple to black, yellow below, exceeded by the disk flowers; receptacle convex to elongate-conical.

description: Shrub to 2 m tall; stems winged by decurrent leaf bases, densely tomentose along entire length. Leaves alternate; blades ovate to elliptical to 20 cm long and 11 cm wide, margins serrate to serratulate, apex acuminate, base attenuate to a winged petiole, hispidulous above, densely tomentose below with finely interwoven hairs; petiole to 10 cm long. Capitulescence of dense panicles of small heads 0.3-0.5 cm in diam on pilose peduncles to 0.5 cm long. Involucre 2-seriate; outer bracts obovate, 1.4-2.4 mm long, 0.8-1.3 mm wide, glabrous to sparsely pubescent, chartaceous, margins ciliate, apex acute; inner bracts longer, grading into the pales. Pales oblanceolate, 4.0-4.3 mm long, 1.5-1.9 mm wide, prominently keeled, ciliate-margined along upper 1/3, apex acute, herbaceous. Ray florets 7-9, ligule white, 2-3 dentate, 2.7-3.4 mm long, 0.9-1.3 mm wide, tube sparsely pubescent, 0.9-1.0 mm long, 0.2-0.3 mm wide. Discflorets ca 25, corolla white, cylindric, 1.5-1.7 mm long, 0.6-1.0 mm wide, tube sparsely pubescent, 0.6-0.8 mm long, 0.4-0.5 mm wide. description: Annual with slender taproot or occasionally apparently perennial with coarse woody taproot; herbage faintly scented. Stems branched from the base, prostrate to ascending, 3-40 cm long, with internodes usually 1-4 cm long, puberulent with spreading to recurved trichomes 0.1-0.2 mm long, the hairs in decurrent lines or uniformly distributed. Leaves linear to very narrowly linear-lanceolate, 1-2.5 cm long, 1-2.5 mm broad, often revolute and appearing narrower, on the proximal 1/5-1/3 of the margin bearing 3-5 pairs of bristles 2-4 mm long, on the adaxial surface densely antrorsely hispidulous with trichomes up to 0.3 mm long, abaxially on the midrib scaberulous to pilosulous with trichomes up to 0.3 mm long, punctate on the undersurface with scattered circular oil glands 0.1-0.2 mm di- ameter. Heads solitary, terminal, or in 3-5 headed cymes. Peduncles 0.5-4 cm long, densely puberulent. Bractlets 1-4, alternate, scarious, linear to lanceolate, attenuate, 2-5 mm long, marginally ciliolate, sometimes bearing 1 or 2 bristles 0.5-1.5 mm long. Receptacle convex or sometimes depressed at summit, ca 1 mm tall, glabrous. Involucre broadly fusiform to campanulate, green to brownish, with the bases of the phyllaries connate into an indurate 5-lobed ring that is adnate to the connate carpopodia of the disk achenes forming a glandular-puberulent pseudoreceptacle that is deciduous at maturity from the true receptacle, the entire head thus falling as a unit. Phyllaries 5, coriaceous, oblancolate to obovate, 6-8 mm long, 2-3 mm broad, connate in the basal 1 mm, quincuncial above, weakly to strongly conduplicate, the apex subacute to retuse, squarrose, minutely ciliolate to glabrate, the base shallowly subcordate, the abaxial surface longitudinally many- nerved with a prominent arcuate midrib, in age incrassate forming a protruding corky ridge with numerous deep glandular pits, lightly puberulent on the midrib when young, in age glabrate. Ray florets 5; corollas yellow, sometimes reddened on the abaxial surface, 5-8 mm long with the tube 2 mm long, with the ligule elliptic, 3-6 mm long and 1.5-2.5 mm broad, glabrous to sparsely glandular- puberulent on the tube and lower portions of the ligule. Diskflorets 14-20; corollas yellow, 4.5-6 mm long, with tube 1-1.5 mm long, the throat 1 mm long, and the limb 2.5-3.5 mm long, deeply bilabiate with the anterior lip 3-3.5 mm long, 0.2- 0.3 mm broad, 7-8 x as long as the 4 lobes on the posterior lip, sparsely glandular-puberulent on the throat and ciliolate with eglandular trichormes on the margins of the lips, papillose at the apices of the lobes; style equalling the corolla; anthers ca 2 mm long; pollen grains 29-30 gm diameter. Ray achenes 3.5-4.5 mm long, slightly arcuate, abaxially glabrous, adaxially pilose with ascending whitish trichomes up to 1 mm long. Disk achenes 3-4 mm long, straight, pilose in vertical lines with ascending whitish trichomes up to 0.6 mm long. Pappus of both ray and disk achenes similar, of 2 (ray) or 5 (disk) lacerate-margined membranous scales 0.8-1.5 mm long. Chromosome number: n = 12 (Table I).

description: Suffrutex 0.8 m alta ramis rigidis erectis striatis glabris, cum foliis alternis copiosis erectis subtectis. Folia sessilia anguste linearia crassiuscula, apice acutiuscula, basi dilatatovaginaintia, margine sparsis dentibus callosis et revoluta, supra costa paulo conspicua subtus elevata, juvenilia praecipue subtus plus minusve lanuginoso-arachnoidea mox glabra, 1.5-3 cm longa 1-1.5 mm lata. Infloreseentia terminalis corymboso-paniculata circa 5 cm diamitens 20-24-capitulata, ramulis elongatis fastigiatis angulatis glabris. Pedicelli 1-2 cm longi subcapillari flexuosi angulosi glabri apicem versus 3-4 bracteolis anguste lanceolatis acutis apice penicillatis circa 2 mm longis, 2-3 superioribus ad modum calyculi. Capitula discoidea homogama semiglobosa circa 9 mm diamitentia. Involucrum hemisphaericum circa 4 mm altum 13 bracteis subbiseriatis crassis sublanceolatis acutis circa 3.5 mm longis exterioribus 1-1.3 mm latis interioribus margine seariosis 1.6-1.8 mm latis apice breviter penicillatis ceteris glabris. Receptaculum 3 mm diam. alveolatum marginibus alveolorum breviter dentatis. Flores omnes hermaphroditi circa 30 in capitulo, corolla lutea 4.5-5.5 mm longa subglabra, tubulo 2.6-3 mm longo angusto sed basi dilatato sursum sparsis pilis crassis, limbo late campanulato 2-2.5 mm longo basi rotundato dentibus deltoideis 1 mm longis apice crassiusculis. Antherae 2 mm longae basi obtusae. Styli ramuli crassiusculi apice truneati breviterque papilloso-pilosi. Ovarium glabrum. Pappus albus circa 3.4 mm longus pilis biseriatis sericeis pilosulis.

description: Herba perennis caulibus erectis ad 45 cm altis; folia sessilia laminis obovatis vel oblanceolatis; ligulae albae saepe apice purpureae 10-15 mm longae 2-5 mm latae.

description: Perennial herb, stems erect to 45 cm tall, pubescent with white, uniseriate hairs sometimes interspersed with glandular trichomes; leaves sessile, blades obovate to oblanceolate, lower cauline leaves usually the largest, 1.2-3.5 cm wide, 2.5-6 cm long, inflorescence usually cymose, with peduncles 1.5-20 cm long; involucres hemispherica 4-6.5 mm high, 6-10 mm wide; phyllaries imbricated in 2-3 series, elliptic, often with attenuate tips, subequal, herbaceous, sometimes with narrow scarious margins, striate, pubescent with uniseriate and glandular trichomes; palea scarious-lanceolate, entire or rarely trifid with shallow lateral lobes; rays 5-8, ligules white, usually purple-tipped, 10-15 mm long, 2-5 mm wide; disk corollas ampliate or abruptly flaring into a tubular throat, pubescent with 2-5-celled uniseriate trichomes; ray and disk achenes similar, obconical, ca. 2 mm long, black at maturity, pubescent; pappus of 15-20 spinulose-fimbriate, linear-lanceolate scales, 3-5 mm long, ray achenes sometimes epappose.

description: Frutex ramis scandentibus terminalibus striolatis dense rufo-tomentosis. Folia submembranacea alterna. Petiolus 4-12 mm. longus tener flexuosus subtus rufo-tomentellus. Lamina elliptico-ovata vel elliptica basi obtuse cuneata apice obtusa vel subrotundata minute mucronulata, margine paulo revoluta integra, 2-5 cm. longa 0.8-2.4 cm. lata; supra nitida viridis glabra vel sparsis pilis minutis praedita, nervo medio filiformi depresso conspicuo, reliquis nervis nervulisque obsoletis vel impresso-reticulatis; subtus tomentello-puberula vel glabrescens, costa eminenti tomentulosa, nervis secundariis ascendentibus ramoso-anastomosatis, venulis in reticulo plus minusve conspicuo. Inflorescentiae terminales corymboso-paniculatae floribundae 10-15 cm. latae basi foliosae, ramis axique erectis vel flexuosis rufescenti-tomentulosis. Ca- pitula radiata erecta vel deflexa longe pedicellata. Bracteis ramulorum anguste linearibus acutis 5-10 mm. longis 0.5-1 mm. latis puberulis. Pedicelli tenues 5-20 mm. longi pluritnis bracteolis 4-5 mm. longis 0.5 mm. latis. gracilibus praediti ad apicem 3-4 bracteolis plus minusve ad modum calyculi dispositis. Involucrum campanulatum 12 bracteis oblongis acutis 6.6 mm. longis 1-2 mm. latis margine anguste scariosis dorso herbaceis pallido-viridibus glabris apice ciliolatis. Receptaculum 2 mm. diam. minute fimbriatum. Flores marginales feminei ligulati 7-8, corolla lutea 12-13 mm. longa tubulo angusto 4 mm. lamina 2 mm. lata 4-nervata apice minute 3-denticulata. Flores disci hermaphroditi tubulosi 16-17, corolla lutea glabra 7.5 mm. longa tubulo 2.5 mm. dentibus ob- longis 1.2 mm. longis. Antherae 3 mm. longae basi breviter caudatae. Rami stigmatici truncati. Ovarium glabrum. Pappus albidus.

description: Plant basally woody, the branches almost vinelike, scram- bling to 1.5 m. through low shrubs. Pubescence on stems deep reddish brown. Lvs. deep green, nitid above, paler below. Bracts pale green. Ray and disc fls. yellow, the anthers yellow tipped with nigrescent brown. W. H. Camp E-4703 (F, holotype).

description: Arborescent shrubs 1-4 m tall; stems robust, woody, young stems ochroleucous-tomentose, becoming dark with age. Leaves cauline, uncrowded; petioles 1.4-4.3 cm long, leaf blades 5-16 x 2-8.4 cm, ovate to elliptic, widest at or below the middle, apically obtuse to rounded, basally cuneate, marginally entire and revolute, above tomentose when young, glabrate with age, tomentose below. Inflorescences terminal, of tertiary glomerules forming a tight, large globose mass. Heads 6-9-flowered. Phyllaries 8-9 x 1-1.5 mm, densely tomentose dorsally. Pappus brownish to straw-colored; inner paleas twisted, 7-8 mm long, outer scales 1-1.5 mm long. Corollas 8 mm long, reddish-purple, lobes pilose and glandular. Anthers ca 3.5 mm long. Achenes 2.5-3 mm long, ca 8-ribbed, glandular. Chromosome number: n = 17 Ils, Smith 1006 (GA). Pollen type: A. Flowering and fruiting throughout the year.

description: Erect and rather stout biennial or short-lived perennial, monoecious herbs, from a stout taproot; caudex sometimes branched, stems 4-15 dm tall, much branched above, aromatic. Leaves in a prominent basal rosette (except apparently reduced in var. neomexicana) and cauline, alternate, quickly reduced above, pinnatisect, the lobes filiform. Capitula in paniculiform cymes, small, radiate, yellow; involucre obpyramidal, in 2 rows, the outer row composed of 3-5 ovate-oblong, obtuse, carinate bracts, 3.5-6 mm long, connate 1/2-3/4 their length into a coriaceous or cartilaginous cupule, the inner row of as many cuneate, oblan- ceolate or rhombic, alternating bracts, their apex cuspidate, mucronate or truncate to rounded, weakly scarious to broadly erose-scarious; ray florets 3-4, pistillate, corollas glabrous, or the tube and the abaxial surface of the ligule sparsely puberulent, the hairs short, thick, ligule 2.6-5.2 mm long, mi- nutely 3-lobed; disk florets 7-13, function- ally staminate, corollas tubular-funnelform, 2.5-3.5 mm long, 5-toothed, densely to sparsely puberulent with short, thick hairs; receptacle flat, naked; ray achenes obovoid, plump, ca. 15-ribbed, villous with straight or flexuous hairs; pappus none, or of 2-6 unequal, oblong or lanceolate, obtuse to acuminate, lacerate, ribless, hyaline squamellae 1-2 mm long; disk ovaries sterile, usually trigonous, with evident but aborted ovule, pubescence as in ray achenes; pappus as in ray florets or absent. Chromosome number, n = 15II (in vars. ambigens and floribunda, Bierner, 1994).

description: Outer involucral bracts 4, (3.5-)4-5 mm long, connate 1/2-3/4 of their length, the inner set rhombic, 3.5-5 mm long, the cusp 0.6-1 mm long, scarious margins flanking cusp narrow, entire or nearly so; ray florets 4, the ligule 3.5-5.2 mm long, sometimes the tube and the abaxial face of ligule sparsely puberulent; disk florets 7-11, the corollas 2.7- 3.5 mm long, moderately to densely puberulent; pappus scales 3-6 or sometimes absent on disk florets, the scales 1-1.8 mm long; achene hairs dense, straight, 1.5-2.5 mm long, opaque, white.

description: Shrubs 0.7-0.75 m tall; stems gray- brown, with noticeable but not prominent leaf-scars; leaves clustered toward tips of branches, lanceolate, 3.0-6.0 cm long, 4.0- 9.0 mm wide, margins minutely denticulate, scabrate. Capitulescences crowded, rounded, bracteate; involucres ca. 5.0 mm high, 2.5-3.0 mm wide, phyllaries 20-21 in 3-4 series, 2.0-6.0 mm long, 0.6-0.7 mm wide, apices herbaceous to 1/4 the total length; ray florets 4, corollas ca. 3.8 mm long, tubes ca. 1.8 mm long, limbs ca. 2.0 mm long, 1.0-2.0 mm wide; disk florets 4, corollas ca. 5.0 mm high, tubes 1.0-2.2 mm long. Cypselas cylindric, 1.5-2.0 mm high, 0.3- 0.6 mm diam.; pappus of ca. 35 bristles in 1 series, 3.5-4.0 mm high.

description: Frutex 2-3 m altus; folia opposita 10-22 cm longa, 2-5 cm lata; petioli 1-2 cm longi; laminae angustiovales. Capitula lavandulacea vel purpurea; capitulescentiae 5-50-cipites terminales corymboso-paniculiformes; involucrum 4-5-seriatum 8-10 mm longum; bracteae lanceolatae; receptaculum convexum epaleatum vel fere epaleatum ca 2 mm diametro pubescens; flores multi; corolla tubulosa sursum aliquantum expansa glabra; achaenium 4-5-angulatum glabrum vel fere glabrum; pappi setae circa 30 eciliatae.

description: Shrub 2-3 m high. Stems pentagonal to terete, densely hirsute with grayish hairs. Leaves opposite throughout, 10-22 cm long, 2-5 cm wide; petioles 1-2 cm long, densely hirsute; blades narrowly oval, widest at the middle, entire to crenulo-dentate, acute at both ends, sparsely appressed pubescent above, densely pubescent beneath with erect hairs, the lower surface also densely atomiferous-glandular. Heads hemispheric, purple or lavender, 5-50 in terminal corymbose panicles about as wide as long. Involucre 4-5-seriate, imbricate, 8-10 mm long; bracts lanceolate, acute to acuminate, the outermost pubescent and 1/3-1/2 the length of the inner, 3-5-nervate, somewhat scarious, especially the innermost. Receptacle convex, ca 2 mm across, pubescent, epaleate or rarely a few peripheral pales present. Florets numerous (50+); corolla tubular, somewhat flaring above, ca 4.5 mm long; lobes 5, ca 0.3 mm long, obtuse, wider than long, glabrous or atomiferous-glandular. Anthers ca 2.5 mm long, the appendages obtuse or rounded, ca 0.3 mm long. Style branches slender, linear-oblanceolate, 6-10 mm long. Achenes ca 2 mm long, glabrous or rarely sparsely hispid near the apex; pappus of ca 30, seemingly eciliate, setae 4-5 mm long.

description: Plants perennial, 35-40 cm high, few-branched, nearly naked above, densely hispid-pilose, with short spreading trichomes and glandular trichomes; leaves ovate (sometimes oval) 2.5-4,5 cm long, 0.8-1.5 cm wide, acute at the apex, cuneatedecurrent at the base, serrulate, densely pilose on both surfaces; petioles 6-8 mm long; heads campanulate, 1-1.5 cm in diameter; peduncles 1.5-9 cm long, densely short-hispid-pilose and densely with spreading glandular trichomes; receptacle conical; chaff persistent, scarious, glabrous, 7-8 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide, tapering to an awn-like beak ca 13 as long as the body; involucre 4-5-seriate, outer bracts oblong-oval, 3-4 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, light greenish toward the base, deep purple toward the rounded apex, minutely pubescent and with short glandular trichomes, the margins minutely ciliate; inner bracts progressively longer, oblong, becoming membranous, puberulent, the longest 8-10 mm long, 2.7-3.2 mm wide, light green or purple-tinged except at the deep purple apex, rounded at the apex, the margins subscarious, minutely ciliate; ray flowers ca 5, pistillate and fertile, tubular at the base for ca 6 mm, with conspicuous light lavender-pink ligules, 9-11 mm long, 8-10 mm wide, cuneate to suborbicular, 3-crenate at the apex; ray corollas with inner lobelets obscure, and with 1-3 staminodia; pappus of the ray florets reduced to less than 2 mm, or absent; disc corollas greenish-yellow, 7-8 mm long, the tube ca 2.8 mm long, pilose at least toward the top, the throat subcylindric, ca 3.8 mm long, pilose at the base, the lobes acutish, 1-1.2 mm long; style branches recurved, brownish, slightly flattened, ca. 1.5 mm long, minutely pubescent beaneth and near the abruptly formed, short, subulate tips; achenes black, narrowly turbinate, 3-3.5 mm long, tangentially compressed, densely silky-pilose; pappus of 20 light brown, unequal, linear-lanceolate, plumose scales, or scale-like bristles, 2.5-4.5 mm long, alternately longer and shorter, the shortest, usually slender, bristles, 1/2 to 3/4 the length of the longest; anthers nigrescent, ca 3 mm long, obscurely sagittate at the base.

description: Fibrous rooted annual. Stems erect, 5-30 cm tall, terete, well-branched from the base, lanulose at basal part and stipitate-glandular with a few short woolly hairs at upper part, usually pale green but sometimes reddish. Leaves opposite below, alternate above; lamina membranous, deltoid to subrhombic, 15-30 X 15-30 mm in the middle part of stems, acute at apex, subtruncate to cuneate at base, crenulate along margin, nearly glabrous on both surfaces, punctate-glandular on lower surface; petioles 5-12 mm long in the middle part of stems, unwinged. Heads many, 7-8 X ca. 4 mm, in terminal and lateral diffuse panicles. Peduncles 3-8 mm, densely stipitate-glandular (red-purple). Phyllaries 5-6 mm long, acuminate at apex, pale green, sometimes red-purplish at the apex, stipitate-glandular (red-purple) mixed with sparse short hairs and several sessile yellow glands outside. Corolla sparsely puberulous with several transparent sessile glands outside; tubes deep red-purple, ca. 4 mm long; lobes white, ca. I mm long. Achenes ca. 3 mm long, dark black-brown, hispidulous. Pappus awns 3(-4), almost as long as corolla, white to red-purple, covered with minute spines; scales between awns membranous; sometimes one of the 5 florets in a head lacking awns.

description: Biennial herbs, occasionally perennial by means of new basal rosettes; stems erect and unbranched, 0.3-2.0 m tall, glabrous, often reddish-purple; leaves of the basal rosette to 10 cm long, oblanceolate to linear, glabrous or wooly; stem leaves entire, linear to linear-lanceolate or oblanceolate, occasionally undulate margined, acute to obtuse apex, glabrous; inflorescence subumbellate or loosely open-corymbose, heads (4) 20-100; involucre campanulate, 6-10 (12) mm high, phyllaries in 4-5 im- bricate series, glabrous, acute, appressed; ray florets 10-30, pistillate, yellow, 9-12 mm long; disc floretes 30-100, yellow, 5-6 mm long; achenes compressed, cuneate-obovate, 2-2.5 mm long, pale in color, sparsely strigose, with many weak ribs and 1-3 golden- yellow to red translucent clavate ridges on each side; pappus in two whorls, the inner of barbellate bristles 4-6 mm long, the outer of very short bristles; chromosome number n = 5; endemic to Florida.

description: Herba perennis, caespitosa, caulibus abbreviatis. Folia caulina rosulata, sessilia; lamina linearis 14- 15 mm longa, 0.5 mm lata, coriacea, 3-costata, margine revoluta, apice acuta mucronata, basi adpresse dilatata, supra glabra, infra dense albido-tomentosa. Capitula heterogama, campanulata, 3-3.5 mm longa, 3-4 mm lata, solitaria, ad anthesin sessilia, post anthesin in pedunculo filiformi, tenuissime arachnoideo disposita. Bracteae involucri 3-4 seriatae, subaequales, flores superantes, scariosae, stramineae, margine laciniatae, extimae ovato-lanceolatae, apice acutae vel subacutae; intimae lanceolatae, obtusae; stereoma indivisum. Receptaculum convexum, epaleatum, breviter tuberculosum. Flores feminei ca 50, corolla filiformi. Flores hermaphroditi ca 5, corolla tubulosa 4-lobata. Styli rami truncati, dorso breviter pilosi. Antherum appendix apicalis parvus deltoideus, acutus et caudiculae parvae. Cypsela cylindrica vel ovoidea, pilis globosis myxogenis conspersa. Pappi setae corollam aequantes, basi in annulum concretae, cellulae apicem versus acutae.

description: Perennial herb with leaf rosettes crowning a short woody rhizome. Leaves linear, sessile and clasping the stem, 14-15 mm long, 0.5 mm wide, 3-veined, upper surface glabrous, lower surface white-woolly; apex acute, mucronate; base broad, shortly adpressed; margins slightly revolute. Capitula heterogamous, broadly cam- panulate, ca 3.5 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, solitary, sessile but becoming pedunculate with age. Peduncles at maturity ca 4 mm long, sparsely arachnoid. Involucral bracts ca 25, in 3 or 4 series, subequal, scarious, slightly laciniate, stramineous, ovate, outer 3 mm long, 1 mm wide, inner ovate slightly longer. Receptacle convex, epaleate, somewhat tubercled. Female flowers ca 50, corolla filiform, 2-2.5 mm long, apically glandular-hairy. Style bifid ca 3 mm long, minutely papillose, stylopodium distinct. Cypselas narrowly elliptic somewhat less than 1 mm long, with minute, 2-celled, globose, myxogenic twin-hairs. Pappus of many scabrid bristles fused into a basal ring, apically with acute cells. Hermaphroditic flowers ca 5, corolla tubular, shortly 4-lobed, campanulate above, ca 2.5 mm long, apically glandular-hairy. Style bifid ca 3 mm long; style-branches truncate and dorsally with obtuse sweeping hairs. Anthers 4 with a small acute apical appendage and short tails which are slightly longer than the filament collar. Cypselas narrowly elliptic, somewhat less than 1 mm long, with minute 2-celled, globose, myxogenic twin-hairs. Pappus of almost smooth, capillary bristles fused into a basal ring, deciduous as a unit, apically with acute cells. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Frutex vel suffrutex 0.5-1-metralis, caulibus vegetativis arcte cinereo-tomentellis internodiis confertis brevibus; foliis alternis arcte confertis ad apicem caulis rosulatis, subsessilibus vel in petiolum crassiusculum 3-4 mm longum angustatis, laminis elliptico-oblanceolatis apice obtusis vet rotundatis basi angustatis 13-17 mm longis 2-5 mm latis valde revolutis, subtus dense cinereopannosis; capitulis sessilibus 11-floris, involucro ca. 4-seriato 2 cm longo superne 1.5 cm lato, phyllariis 16-17; corollis 15 mm longis, tubo 5.5 mm longo, lobis linearibus 7-7.5 mm longis 0.6-0.7 mm latis.

description: Shrub or subshrub 0.5-1 m tall, vegetative stems gray tomentose with short crowded internodes; leaves subsessile, crowded, mainly in terminal rosettes, elliptic-oblanceo-late, obtuse or rounded at apex, narrowed to the base, 13-17 mm long, 2-5 mm wide, densely gray-white pannose below, gray pannose above at base of blade, becoming glabrescent, strongly revolute, midrib sulcate above, impressed below, lateral nerves absent; petiole thickish, up to 4 mm long; keads sessile, 11-flowered; involucre turbinate-campanulate, ca. 4-seriate, 2 cm long, 1.5 cm wide above, 0.7 cm wide at base; bracts 16-17, sparsely or moderately cinereous-floccose-tomentose without above the middle and along margins, glabrous within and at the base, 3 outermost bracts shortest, ovate-lanceolate, subacute, obtusely carinate, 7.5-8 mm long, 3.5-4.5 mm wide; median bracts linear-lanceolate, subacute, 11-12 mm long, 4 mm wide; interior bracts thinner, linear-lanceolate, subacute, 14-15 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide; receptacle deeply alveolate, alveolae pilose at apex; paleae none; corollas bilabiate, homogamous, 15 mm long, tube infundibuliform, 5.5 mm long, 2 mm wide above, 0.8-0.9 mm wide at base, sparsely glandular in upper half; lower (inner) lip deeply 2-cleft, lobes linear, acute, 7-7.5 mm long, 0.6-0.7 mm wide, revolute at apex; upper (outer) ligulate lip larger, subelliptic-oblanceolate, 3-dentate at apex, 9 mm long, 3.5 mm wide, teeth 0.5 mm long; anthers bicaudate at base, 6 mm long, apex with an appendage 3.8 mm long, basal caudicles linear, 2 mm long, papillose; filaments 3 mm long, glabrous; style 11-12 mm long, glabrous; stigmas linear, truncate at apex; pappus numerous, many-seriate, 9-9.5 mm long, antrorsely serrulate; ackenes narrowly cylindrical, terete, 6 mm long, 1-1.1 mm wide, glabrous, deeply 10-sulcate.

description: Herbacea vel suffruticosa, ramosa, dense pubescens; folia opposita, petiolata; foliorum lamina elliptico- lanceolata, subcoriacea, subtriplinervis, (1) 2.5-3.5 cm longa, (0.3) 0.6-1 (1.6) cm lata, serrata, utrinque dense pubescens; petioli 3-5 mm longi; capitulescentia terminalis, corymbiformis; pedunculi ca 3-5 mm longi; capitula homogama; involucrum cylindricum, 6-8 mm longum, 3-4 mm latum; flosculi radiati nulli; flosculi disci ca 12, corolla aurea, 3.8-4.2 mm longa, lobis purpureis erectis, 1.1-1.4 mm longis; paleae anguste ellipticae, 6.5-7 mm longae; achaenia obconica, nigra vel olivacea, 2.3-2.8 mm longa, glabra; pappi squamae ca 12, ovatae, ca 0.4 mm longae.

description: Herbs or semishrubs to 50 cm tall, apparently short-lived perennials branching annually from base, stems erect, subterete, densely pubescent, striate, axillary branches commonly suppressed, usually not longer than the subtending leaf, this giving the leaves a temate aspect, internodes of the central axis mostly 2-4 (5) cm long. Leaves opposite, petiolate; the blade elliptic-lanceolate, subcoriaceous, (1) 2.5-3.5 cm long, (0.3) 0.6-1 (1.6) cm wide, obscurely 3-veined from near base, apically acute, basally cuneate, serrate with 4-7 pairs of teeth, upper surface dull green, glandular with multitiered, biseriate, densely resinous, globular trichomes, and villose with uniseriate, multicellular, arcuate trichomes and moniliform tri- chomes, lower surface dull green, glandular and villose to tomentose, trichome types as on upper surface; petiole 3-5 mm long, densely pubescent. Capitulescence essentially terminal, corymbiform, to ca 3.5 cm wide, of 3-30 capitula; peduncles ca 3-5 mm long, densely pubescent. Capitula discoid, ca 12-flowered; involucre broadly cylindric to hemispheric, 6-8 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, ca 3-seriate; phyllaries ca 9, imbricate, graduated, the outer series ovate, 2-3.5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, scarious, 5- (7)-nerved, abaxially glabrous, ciliate, apically purple, basally golden with purple veins, acute to obtuse, inner phyllaries broadly elliptic, 4-6 mm long, ca 1.8 mm wide, otherwise similar to outer ones; receptacle clavate, ca 2 mm high, ca 1.2 mm wide, paleaceous; paleae narrowly elliptic, 6.5-7 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide, pale yellow or purple-tipped, somewhat conduplicate, margins entire, irregular, supramedially ciliate, pale yellow or purple-tipped. Disc corollas golden or more commonly golden with purple lobes, 3.8-4.2 mm long, glabrous or slightly glandular at the juncture of tube and throat, tube 1.1-1.4 mm long, throat 1.7-1.9 mm long, only slightly wider than tube, lobes erect, 1.1-1.4 mm long; anthers not exserted, yellow, ca 2 mm long, apical appendage deltoid, often minutely glandular abaxially; style ca 4.5 mm long. Achenes obconic, ob- scurely prismatic, black to olivaceous, 2.3-2.8 mm long, glabrous; carpopodium tan, non-sculptured; pappus of ca 12 distinct but imbricate, ovate, apically obtuse, serrulate, yellow to purplish squamellae, ca 0.4 mm long. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Stems erect, 20-50 cm tall, terete, lanulose at base, puberulous above, red-purple, sparsely branched in the upper part. Cauline leaves opposite; lamina thick, oval to rhombic, trinerved with conspicuous secondary veins, 30-50 X 20-35 mm in the lower part of stems, smaller in the upper part, acute at apex, truncate to cuneate at base, crenulate along margin, hispid above, lanate beneath and punctate-glandular (yellow) on both surfaces; petioles 10-20 mm long. Heads many, 8-11 x ca. 4 mm, in several compound corymbs; each corymb 8-25 mm wide consisting of 5-25 heads. Inflorescence branches and peduncles densely stipitate-glandular (red-purple) mixed with short hairs; peduncles short. Phyllaries ca. 7 mm long, acuminate at apex, pale green, sometimes red-purple at apex, stipitate-glandular (red-purple) outside. Corolla white, sometimes pale-pink, sparsely sessile-glandular and sparsely puberulous outside; tubes ca. 6 mm long; lobes ca. 2 mm long. Achenes ca. 5 mm long, pale brown, hispidulous. Pappus awns 2-5, as long as corolla, red-purple, covered with minute spines; scales between awns membranous, white.

description: Plantae e radice terete annuae, 5-30(-40) cm alt., a basi plerumque ramo- sissimae, caules rigide aseendentes diverse pubeseentes, plerumque supra dense infra minus, glandulari-puberulentes, pilis glandularibus saepe trichomnatibus longioribus eglandularibus intermixtis, rosula basalis vix aut haud evoluta; caules teretes, costis parum evolutis, onmnino foliacei, stirpe primaria infra perspicue in linea anfracta, praecipue post creseentiam plenam ramorum lateralium; folia inferiora stirpium primariarum oblanceolata aut oblonga, petiolo alato gradatim attenuato, lamina profunde pinnatisecta ad solummodo laciniate lobatam, lobis saepe eacumina parum effecta spineseeiitia habentibus; folia superiora manifeste alterna, simplicia sessilia, late lanceolata ad linearia, lacineate lobata vel fere integra, laminae plerumque pilis glandularibus, petiolum brevem habentibus, praecipue parte inferiore satis aequaliter pubeseentes; capi- tula in plantis plene maturis multa, in caule principali, autem, solumn 2-aliquot flores ferentia; involucrum hemisphericum 75-120 flosculos 5-10 mm lat., 3-5 (-6) mm alt., tempore anthesis aetate erectos includeiis; peduineuli 3-15 (-20) mm long., bracteae involueri 2-5 seriebus, imbricatae, lanci-lineares, acutae, supra virides herbaceaeque, infra chartaceae albaeque, 3-5 mm long., 0.8-1.3 mnm lat., dense glandulari-puberulentes; receptaculum planum; flosculi radii 20-40, ligulae 6-10 mm long., 1.8-2.2 mm lat., caeruleo-violaceae (lavendulae) vel albae, siceatae parum involutae, tubo ca 2.5 mm long.; corollae disci flavae, 3.5-6 mm long.; lobi corollae, ca 0.5 mm long.; achaenia 1.4-1.8 mm long.; pappo e singulo 30-40 setarum 1.5-3 mm long. colnstante; nunuerus chromo- somatalis, n = 5.

description: Biennial or short-lived perennial with a taproot; stems slender, flexuous, irregularly branched, 1.5-4 dm. high, conspicuously spreading-hirsute below with hairs about 1 mm. long, more finely appressed-hairy above the middle; leaves loosely appressed-hirsute on both surfaces, the basal ones with broadly oblanceolate to spatulate, obovate, or elliptic, coarsely few-toothed or shallowly lobed blade about 12-35 mm. long and 6-11 mm. wide, tapering or abruptly contracted to the conspicuous petiole about 1.5-4 cm. long; cauline leaves more or less reduced upwards, the middle ones about 3-6 mm. wide; heads solitary at the ends of the several branches, conspicuously naked-pedunculate, the disk about 8-10 mm. wide; involuere hispid-hirsute with spreading or somewhat curved hairs, about 4-5 mm. high; phyllaries subequal or slightly imbricate, thickened on the back, with dark midrib, the outer narrow, the inner broader and with evident searious margins; ligules about 75-100, white or lilac-tinged, mostly 5-8 mm. long and 0.7-1.2 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 2.6-3.2 mm. long, the tube 0.5-0.8 mm., the lobes 0.5-0.6 mm.; style-appendages short and broad, about 0.05-0.1 mm. long; pappus double, the, inner of a few slender and fragile bristles, the outer of evident shoi-t setae; achenes 2-nerved, short-hairy.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Herba biennis vel quasi-perennis radice maximo caulibus laxis vel flexuosis moderate ramosis usque ad 3 dm. altis infra hirsutis pilis longis patentibus supra strigosis pilis appressis, foliis sub-appresso-hirsutis, imis petiolatis lamina late oblanceolata vel obovata vel elliptica 12-35 mm. longa 6-11 mm. lata dentibus paucis et grossis vel sublobata, caulinis reductis mediis ca. 3-4 mm. latis; capitulis conspicue nudo-pedunculatis disco 8-10 mm. lato involucro 4-5 mm. alto, bracteis subaequalibus hispido-hirsutis, ligulis ca. 75-100 albis vel sublilacinis 5-8 mm. longis 0.7-1.2 mm. latis, corollis disci 2.6-3.2 mm. longis, pappo duplici, achaeniis 2-neryis.

description: Herba crassa, summo dense foliosa; foliis tenuiter coriaceis oblongo-lanceolatis, 30-35 cm. longis, circiter 4 cm. latis, ad basin angustatis (loco angustissimo circiter 12 mm. latis), ad vaginam rigide coriaceam circiter 4 cm. latam dilatatis, apice subacutis, margine integris, utrinque arete ferrugineo-tomentosis, nervis secundariis circiter 14 per decimetrum angulo circiter 45° adscendentibus; ramis floriferis ad 60 cm. longis 7-12-capitulatis densissime canescente-lanatis, folia 4 vel 6 opposita parva 10-12 cm. longa gerentibus; capitulis corymboso-paniculatis maturitate circiter 2 cm. latis, ramulis inflorescentiae bracteis ovatis subtentis (bracteis 5-7 cm. longis, 3 cm. latis, apice subacutis); involucro ut videtur 2-seriato, phyllaribus 1015 (interioribus minoribus) late oblongo-ovatis, 8-12 mm. longis, 710 mm. latis, apice subacutis, extra dense ferrugineo-tomentosis intus glabris; floribus radii circiter 100 circiter 3-seriatis, lamina oblonga, circiter 10 mm. longa et 2.5 mm. lata, basi pilis fuscis 0.2 mm. longis hispidula, achenio nigro trigono 3 mm. longo; floribus disci medio parce hispidulis, circiter 6.5 mm. longis (limbo quam tubo duplo longiore), lobis deltoideo-ovatis circiter 0.8 mm. longis; staminibus maturitate exsertis, circiter 5.5 mm. longis, filamentis quam antheris longioribus; stylo exserto; paleis tenuiter coriaceis oblongis, circiter 7 mm. longis et 1.5-2 mm. latis, basi contractis, apice acutis, extra prope apicem dense fusco-tomentosis, pilis circiter 0.8 mm. longis.

description: Fruticulum basi caule rhizomatoso repente ramis erectis ascendentibusve 12-18 cm. altis parce cymoso-ramosis vel simplicibus, glabris superne dense aciculato-foliosis cetera parte grisea cum vaginis foliorum mortuorum persistentibus intus lanatis imbricatis adpressissimis obtectis. Folia imbricata vagina plana stramineo-scariosa uninervia 3-3.5 mm. longa 1.6 mm. lata intus marginibusque latissime adpressissimeque lanata, limbo aciculato coriaceo glabro nitido extus tereti supra subplano apice acutissime filiforme apiculato, 4.5 mm. longi 1-1.2 mm. lato (apiculo 0.7-1 mm. longo). Capitula radiata mediocria solitaria apicibus ramulorum sessilia, folia superiora paulo excedentia. Involucrum hemisphaericum 10 mm. altum 12-13 bracteis crassiusculis tertio inferiori concrescentibus, parte liberi anguste lanceolatis acutis plus minusve purpurascentibus margine anguste scariosis breviterque ciliolatis reliquis glabris. Flores marginales feminei praecipue 12 ligulatae, corolla 12 mm. longa 2-3 mm. lata apice breviter tridentata tubulo brevi 2.4 mm. longo, extus purpurea intus alba vel pallide caesia. Flores disci hermaphroditi tubulosi circa 46 corolla lutea glabra 4.2 mm. longa tubulo crassiusculo 1.6 mm. Longo, limbo tubuloso-campanulato apice 5-dentato dentibus triangulari- bus obtusiusculis. Antherae 1.2 mm. longae apice apiculatae basi brevissime obtuseque appendiculatae. Rami stigmatici crassiusculi apice incrassati truncatique papillosi. Ovarium glabrum vel sparsissimis brevibus pilis. Pappus och- raceus setis pilosiusculis uniseriatis basi in brevem annulum coalitis, 3-3.5 mm. longis.

description: Stout herb, the caudex stout, short erect; leaves crowded, coriaceous, linear, 25-40 cm. long, 9-15 mm. broad, scarcely narrowed proximally, acute or subacute at apex, entire and slightly thickened at margins, silvery sericeous lanate on both surfaces, the costa stout, the secondary nerves ascending, obscured by the tomentum; flowering branches stout, erect, up to 1 m. high, densely floccose with long white wool, bearing a few alternate cauline leaves towards base, corymbosely branched above, the branches alternate, ascending, subtended by foliaceous linear bracts, bearing several heads distally; heads numerous, at maturity 20-30 mm. in diameter; phyllaries numerous, papyraceous, lanceolate-oblong, subacute, the outer ones 7-8 mm. long, 1.5-2 mm. broad, densely floccose without, the inner ones hispid; ray florets 50-60, 2- or 3-seriate, the corolla 15-17 mm. long, the tube 2.5- 3 mm. long, densely puberulous, the lamina oblong-lanceolate, 2-2.3 mm. broad, 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas 5-6 mm. long, the achene stout, 2-3 mm. long; disk florets about 6 mm. long, the tube sparsely glandular-hispidulous, subequal to the limb, the lobes oblong, the stamens about 4 mm. long; paleae membranous, linear-oblong, about 6 mm. long and 0.7 mm. broad, acute, pilose distally without.

description: Annual herbs with one to several stems originating at the base, sparingly branched above, 2.7-7.8 dm tall. Stems glabrous to very sparsely pubescent. Peduncles 2-12 cm long, only slightly broadened at the top, sparsely pubescent. Leaves variable but most irregularly laciniate or at least irregularly lobed, apices rounded to obtuse or sometimes acute, glabrous to very sparsely pubescent, midrib prominent but lateral veins obscure, scarcely decurrent at all along the stem. Heads few to several, globose to slightly ovoid, 8-14 mm high, 8-14 mm wide (excluding rays). Receptacle globoid to ovoid, 2.5-6.0 mm high, 3.0-6.0 mm wide. Involucral bracts united at the base, reflexed at anthesis, sparsely pubescent. Ray florets 14-15; ligules 4.5-13.0 mm long, 2.5-6.0 mm wide, yellow, glabrous to very sparsely pubescent. Disc corollas 5-lobed, cyclindri- cal to cylindric-campanulate, 1.6-2.7 mm long, 0.8-1.1 mm wide, yellow with purple lobes. Achenes 1.2-1.7 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm wide, pubescent. Pappus scales 6, 0.7-1.2 mm long, including the terminal awn which is ca. 1/3 the length of the body, 0.3-0.5 mm wide.

description: Perennial herb with a stout woody taproot and branching caudex; stems 10-50 cm. high, erect, raore or less strigose and usually somewhat gray-green, nearly always more densely strigose and white at the base leaves more or less strigose, usually gray-green, the basal and lowermost cauline ones linear-oblainceolate, up to about 10 cm. long and 6 mm. wide, usually much smaller, commonly withered or deciduous by flowering time; cauline leaves linear, up to about 7 cm. long and 3 mm. wide, varying from erect and much shorter than the internodes to arcuate-spreading and much longer than the internodes; heads solitary or several, sometimes as many as 10, the disk 5-15 mm. wide; involuere 3-6 mm. high, more or less strigose, especially below, and often finely glandular, especially above; phyllaries strongly imbricate, the outer greenish, the inner straw-colored, usually with brown midrib and sometimes also green-tinged, the margins and tips occasionally purplish; ligules about 10-40, blue, pink, or white, 4-18 mm. long, 1.0-2.7 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.1-4.6 mm. long, the tube 0.6-1.1 mm., the lobes 0.4-0.7 mm.; style-appendages varying from triangular-lanceolate and acute to broadly triangular and obtuse, 0.1-0.25 mm. long; pappus double, the outer of inconspicuous, though well-developed setae; akenes 4-nerved, or rarely 6-nerved, pilose, or sometimes merely sparsely hirsute.

description: Arching or scandent shrubs, to 2 m tall; stem scabrous to strigose, hairs appressed, 1 mm long. Leaves petiolate; blades ovate to ovate-lanceolate, thick, coriaceous, 7-16 X 3-7 cm, 5-nerved, primary and second- ary veins abaxially prominent, apices acuminate, bases cuneate to round-cuneate, margins serrate, teeth less than 1 mm high; both faces dark green and sparcely strigose, hairs 0.5-1 mm long; petioles 10-15 mm long scabrous to strigose, hairs 1 mm long. Capitulescences paniculiform, always trichotomously divided at ending of branches and stems. Capitula sessile, or on 2 mm long pedicels, subglobose, 4-5 X 3-4 mm; phyllaries 3-4, 4-5 X 3-4 mm, suborbicular, 5-veined, apices obtuse, glabrous, slightly hirsute and ciliate on distal one-third. Pistillate fiorets 5-6, subtended by ovate paleae, 4 X 3 mm, white, 4-veined, slightly hirsute on distal one-third; corollas 2 to 2.5 mm long, throats 1 to 1.5 mm diam., 3-lobed, lobes irregularly deltoid, 0.5 mm long, apices scarcely pubescent; styles 1.5 mm long, branches 1 mm long. Staminate florets 5-8, subtended by lanceolate paleae (exceptionally, epaleaceous central disc floret), 3.5 X 1.5 mm, apices slightly ciliate, 2-veined; corollas 2.5 mm long, white, tubes 1.5 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., 5-lobed, lobes 0.5 mm long, deltoid, apices slightly pilose; anthers 1 mm long, black; styles 2 mm long, undivided; ovaries 1.5 mm long, 1 mm diam., apices pilose, hairs 0.5 mm long. Cypselae 2 X 1.5 mm, piloses on distal half, hairs 0.5 mm long. Chromosome number, n = 16 (Stuessy & Arriagada, 1993).

description: Frutex circa 80 cm. alta ramis tortuosis cicatricosis cortice peridermato-squamoso fusci. Ramuli terminales copiosi congesti dense foliosi, breviter albido- lanuginosi. Folia alterna, lamina anguste linearia aciculata apice acuta margine valde revoluta 3.5-5 mm. longa, 0.8-1 mm. lata, supra nitida glabra vel sparsissimis minutis pilis munita, subtus dense adpresseque lanato-tomentosa, basi vaginam persistentem 1.5-2 mm. longam amplectentem articulata. Capitula terminalia solitaria sessilia. Involucrum campanulatum bracteis circa 5-seriatis sparse pubescentibus araneosisque margine anguste lacerato-ciliatis, lineari-lanceolatis et linearibus, interioribus 6-5 mm. longis 1 mm. latis ceteris gradatim minoribus exterioribus 3-4 mm. longis acutissimis basi paulo latioribus. Receptaculum profunde alveolatum marginibus alveolorum membranaceis dentatis, 2 mm. diamitente. Flores exteriores feminei circa 25 ligulati corolla alba vel subtus pallide-lilacina circa 7 mm. longa tubulo glabro 2 mm. longo. Lamina anguste lineari 0.6 mm. lata ovario subglabro sparsissimis pilis munito. Flores disci hermaphroditi tubulosi circa 21, corolla lutea glabra circa 5 mm. longa tubulo 1.5 mm. longo; rami stigmatici elongati sublanceolati papillosi, ovario sparsissime puberulo. Pappus rubellus 4-5 mm. longus pilis exterioribus brevibus 0.6-1 mm. longis.

description: Round-topped shrub, 0.8 m., the branches densely compacted. Bracts green with reddish purple tinge. Ray flowers white, tipped with pale lavender below. Disc flowers dull yellow. F. Prieto P-288 (F, holotype).

description: Plants biennial or perennial, occasionally flowering the first year; scapose, subscapose, or occasionally branched above the basal rosette, 1-10 dm tall; leaves of the basal rosette spatulate, entire to lobed, not tapering markedly at the base, 1-8 cm long, 1-3 cm wide, densely villous or lanate, the upper reduced, lanceolate to linear-lanceo- late, glandular, sparsely to densely villous, sessile; capitula solitary, cymosely or racemosely disposed on short peduncles; involucres 1-2 cm wide, 1-2 cm broad, hemi- spherical-ovoid, the phyllaries lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, 6-12 mm long, glandu- lar, sparsely to densely villous; ray flowers 9-30, yellow to red; disk flowers yellow, occasionally tinged with red; achenes clavate, silky-villous, 5-10 mm long, the pappus paleae subequal, 1-2 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Wilken, Dieter H. 1975. A systematic study of the genus Hulsea (Asteraceae). Brittonia. 27: 228-244.

description: Profusely branched (at least above), stems glabrous; leaves 1-5 cm long, 1-6 cm wide, deltoid, pinnately or bipinnately divided, the ultimate segments narrowly linear to filiform, entire or sometimes lobed, 5-25 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide, mostly glabrous or sparsely pilose, petioles less than 2 cm long; heads mostly (1-) 3 cymosely disposed and peduncles 1-6 cm long, densely pilose when young, glabrate with age; heads 2-3 cm wide at anthesis; outer involucral bracts 8, narrowly oblong to linear, or sometimes spatulate, 3-6 mm long, sparsely pilose at the base; inner involucral bracts 8, oblong, ovate or obovate, 5-8 mm long, glabrous or sparsely pilose; chaff narrowly oblong to linear, villous on outer surface, 5-6 mm long at anthesis; ray florets 7-9; disk florets 25-35; achenes linear or narrowly to broadly oblanceolate, sparsely erect-villous on the outer surface, 4-6 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide, aristae 3-4 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Crawford, Daniel J. 1976. Taxonomy of Coreposis sect. Pseudo-Agarista (Compositae) in Mexico with additional comments on sectional relationships in Mexican Coreopsis. Brittonia. 28: 329-336.

description: Erect shrub with xylopodia, 1-1.5 m height, stems striate, purple, ascending, glabrous, laxly leafy to the inflorescence, basal internodes 4-6 cm long. Leaves alternate, subsessile, coriaceous. Leaf blades 4- 10 x 1.3-2.5 cm, oblanceolate to lanceolate, denticulate, acute at the apex, basally attenuate, scabrous and glandular dotted above, tomentose below. Inflorescence laxly paniculate, 5-15 cm long, with individual branches corymbose, bracts reduced or absent. Capitula shortly pedicellate, pedicels 3-14 mm long. Involucre turbinate, 6-7 mm high, 6-7 mm diam. Phyllaries 5 or 6 seriate, densely imbricate, outer phyllaries 3-3.5 x 2-2.4 mm, ovate, acute at the apex, inner phyllaries 5-7 x 2.5-3 mm, ovate-lanceolate, apically obtuse. Florets 10-16. Corollas 6-7 mm long, violet, glabrous, lobes lanceolate, 1.8- 2.3 mm long. Anthers 2.5-3 mm long, sagit- tate at the base. Stylus 7-8 mm long, branches linear, 1.8-2.2 mm long. Cypselas 2.7-3 mm long, glandular dotted, sparsely sericeous-pubescent. Pappus yellowish, outer scales 0.5-0.7 mm long, inner bristles 5-6 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Dematteis, Massimiliano. 2006. Vernonanthura warmingiana (Asteraceae: Vernonieae), a new species from Brazil. Brittonia. 58 (2): 182-188.

description: Shrub 2-3 m tall, the foliage and young stems closely cinereous-pubescent. Leaves elliptical, broadest at the middle, 15-40 cm long, 6-14 cm wide; blades sparsely cinerous above, more densely so below, especially along the ribs, grad- ually tapering into a winged petiole; margins nearly entire to irregularly dentate. Heads 1 or 2 on peduncles 5-12 cm long which arise from the uppermost leaf axils. Involucre broadly hemispheric, 15-20 mm high; receptacle alveolate, gla- brous; outer bracts foliaceous, narrowly to broadly ovate, 12-18 mm long, 6-9 mm wide, loosely spreading for 1/2 their length or more, softly cinereous throughout; inner bracts chartaceous, 18-20 mm long, brownish or brownish-purple, the base appressed, glabrous, ca 10 mm long, the apex thin, ascending, 6-9 mm long, broadly rounded to acute (innermost), erose, puberulent. Florets "violet," "pink" or "purple"; corolla atomiferous-glandular, ca 25 mm long, the lobes ca 6 mm long. Achene somewhat clavate, 4-5-sided, glabrous. Pappus tawny, of numerous intergrading, caducous bristles 1-7 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Turner, Billie L. 1981. New species and combinations in Vernonia sections Leiboldia and Lepidonia (Asteraceae), with a revisional conspectus of the groups. Brittonia. 33: 401-412.

description: Perennial herb with a branched woody caudex; stems coarse and stout, 3-8 dm. high or more, only rarely less than 5 dm. high, pubescent at least above with long stiffly spreading hairs, often glandular as well; leaves crowded, more or less triple-nerved, entire but with strongly ciliate margins, at ieast the middle and upper ones rather densely glandular or more commonly glandular-scabrous, rarely with a few long hairs along the midrib, the basal and lowermost cauline ones oblanceolate to spatulate, narrowed to winged petioles, the blad'e and petiole mostly 4-15 cm. long and 7-25 mm. wide, often deciduous or withered by flowerinig time; middle cauline leaves as large as those below, lanceolate to oblong or ovate, sessile, 4-11 cm. long and 10-25 mm. wide; upper leaves not markedly reduced, narrowly lanceolate to narrowly ovate; heads 1-22, the infloreseence usually short and broad, the disk 10-15 (rarely 18) mm. wide; involuere 6-9 mm. high; phyllaries equal or niearly so, glandular and sometimes with a few long hairs, the outer ones mostly 0.5-0.9 mm. wide, noticeably broadest near the base, acuminate. the tips a little loose; ligules about 75-150, 1 mm. wide and 9-17 mm. long, blue or rarely rose; pappus double; disk-corollas slender, 3.0-4.0 mm. long, rarely a ]ittle longer, tne, tube up to 1.0 mm. long, the lobes up to about 0.8 mm. long; style-appendages triangular-lanceolate, sharply acute, about 0.2 mm. long; akenes hairy, 2-nerved.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Erect suffrutescent shrub to 3 m tall, sparingly branched; completely lacking glandular hairs. Stems finely striate, light brown, pubescent, becoming more woody at base. Leaves alternate, very short-petioled; blades elliptical, sometimes lower leaves with a pair of sharp lobes, 8.5-2 5 cm long and up to 10 cm wide, sparingly pubescent on both surfaces, pinnately veined, the margin sharply serrate, apex usually slightly acuminate. Inflorescence a thyrsoid panicle up to 30 cm long and as much as 15 cm wide. Heads numerous, ca. 7-9 mm high, ca. 25-flowered. Phyllaries ca. 10, im- bricated, oblong to suborbicular with apex rounded, with ca. 5 striae, green to light yellow or brown, pubescent with densely fringed margin. Receptacle slightly to strongly convex, chaffy. Corollas white, narrowly tubular, ca. 4 mm long. Pappus of ca. 15 (10-18) very often deciduous white setae ca. 4 mm long, very slender with distinctly dilated tips. Achenes dark brown or black, ca. 1.5 mm long, prismatic, 4-5 ribbed; ribs setose, carpopodium slightly developed. Pollen tricolpate, spherical, minutely papillose, ca. 20 µ in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: King, Robert M. & Robinson, Harold E. 1969. Studies in the Eupatoricae (Compositae). XVI. A monograph of the genus Decachaeta DC. Brittonia. 21: 275-284.

description: Frutex 1.5-2.5-metralis, caule erecto solitario simplici vel superne vix breviter ramoso infra denudato basi tumido apice tantum folioso tomentello pilis vermiformibus haud malpighiaceis munito; foliis erectis sessilibus oblanceolato-spatulatis apice rotundatis 4.5-8 x 1-2 cm praeter basin tomen- tellam glabris, nervis lateralibus obsoletis; capitulis solitariis anguste cylindricis 5-6-floris homogamis; involucro 3.3-3.5 cm longo; phyllariis 5-6-seriatis ca. 19 arcte adpressis obtuse carinatis glabris; receptaculo nudo alveolato; floribus magenteis; corolla actinomorpha valde 5-fissa 5.1 cm longa ubique glabra, tubo ut videtur 5-nervato, lobis erectis anguste linearibus subacutis 2.2-2.4 cm longis; antheris 17.5 mm longis, appendicibus caudatis, filamentis glabris; achaeniis anguste prismatico-columnaribus quadrangularibus 12 mm longis 10-costatis, angulis minute ciliolatis, annulo nullo; pappo setis numerosis minute serrulatis.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1980. New species from the summit of Cerro Guaiquinima, Venezuela. Brittonia. 32: 17-23.

description: Shrub 1.5-2.5 m tall with a solitary, erect, ligneous stem, simple or scarcely shortly branched above, leafless below, the base swollen, the apex minutely to- mentellous with vermiform (not malpighiaceous) hairs. Leaves in a terminal ro- sette, sessile, rigid-coriaceous, strongly revolute, dull green both sides, oblan- ceolate-spathulate, rounded at apex, gradually narrowed at base, 4.5-8 x 1-2 cm, glabrous except for the tomentellous thickened base, the margins thickened, the midrib impressed above, subimpressed below; lateral nerves scarcely manifest or obsolete. Heads solitary, narrowly cylindrical, 5-6-flowered, homogamous; involucre 3.3-3.5 cm long, 7 mm wide at the base, 6 mm wide above; bracts 5- 6-seriate, ca. 19, strongly appressed, obtuse, carinate, glabrous, the lowest ovate, subobtuse, 3-4 x 2-2.5 mm, middle ones ovate-lanceolate, 13 x 5 mm, upper-most interior ones linear-lanceolate, 35 x 4 mm. Receptacle naked, alveolate. Flowers magenta; corollas actinomorphic, strongly 5-cleft, 5.1 cm long, glabrous throughout, the tube apparently 5-nerved, 2.7 cm long, infundibuliform, 1.3 cm long and 4 mm wide above, 1.5 mm wide below; lobes erect, narrowly linear, subacute, 2.2-2.4 cm x 1 mm, 3-nerved; anthers narrowly linear, 17.5 mm long, appendages caudate, 2.1 mm long, rounded at apex; filaments glabrous, inserted in the sinus between the lobes; style 7-7.5 cm long, glabrous except asperulous toward the apex; stigma lobes lanceolate, acute, erect, 2 mm long. Achenes narrowly prismatic-columnar, quadrangular, 12 x 2.5 mm, 10-costate, angles minutely ciliolate with ascending hairs; annulus absent; pappus setae numerous, 20-33 mm long, minutely serrulate, in several unequal series.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1980. New species from the summit of Cerro Guaiquinima, Venezuela. Brittonia. 32: 17-23.

description: Subshrubs 20-40 cm tall, stems intricately pseudo-dichotomous branched, tortuose, procumbent to ascending, white lanate-tomentose to glabrescent. Leaves concolorous; proximal blades elliptic or oblong, 12-18 mm long, 6-9 mm wide, the bases cuneate, the apices acute, mucronate, the margins repand-dentate, 2-3 pairs of acute, mucronate teeth, the adaxial surfaces sparsely tomentose, gray, the abaxial densely lanate-tomentose, white; petioles 5-6 mm long, the bases expanded into amplexicaul auricles; distal cauline blades obovate elliptic to oblong, 2-3 cm long, 6-13 mm wide, sessile, the apices long-attenuate, the bases rotund-auriculate, amplexicaul, the margins entire to sinuate-dentate or incised, 2-3 pairs of acute, mucronate teeth. Capitulescences of solitary capitula or weakly cymose with 2-3 capitula on terminal branchlets, peduncles 5-40 mm long, 4-5- bracteolate. Capitula with tubular-campan- ulate involucres, 5-6.6 mm tall; phyllaries 8-10, linear, (5) 7-8 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, yellowish green, the apex acute, purple-tinged, dorsally tomentose to glabrate, the margins hyaline. Functionally staminate individuals with capitula containing 12-17 florets, the corollas yellow, tubular, 5-6.5 mm long, the tube 2-3 mm long, the throat indistinct, the lobes ca. 1 mm long, ca. 0.4 mm wide; anthers 2.2 mm long; style branches 0.8-1 mm long, the apices rounded, dorsally papillose; ovary sterile, densely villose with inflated, oblong trichomes, 130-185 pm long; pappus bristles 4.5-5 mm long, white, apical cells slender, acute. Pistillate individuals with capitula containing ca. 12 florets, the corollas yellow, narrowly campanulate, ca. 4 mm long, the tube ca. 2 mm long, the throat ca. 1 mm long the lobes 1-1.2 mm long, ca. 0.3 mm wide; anthers atrophied; style branches linear, ca. 1 mm long, the apex rounded, dorsally papillose. Achenes cylindrical, ca. 2.5 mm long, densely villous with inflated, oblong trichomes, 130-185 pm long; pappus 4.5- 5 mm long, white, apical cells slender, acute.

description: Herbae perennes 15-50 cm altae. Caules erecti, solitarii vel numerosi, longe villosi. Folia infima rosulata, laxe vel dense villosa, oblanceolata vel lineari-oblanceolata 80 cm usque longa, integerrima vel raro paucidentata vel subpinnatifida. Folia caulina parva, anguste oblanceolata vel linearia, apice acuta vel obtusa. Capitula laxe corymbosa, corymbis ramos terminantibus, pedunculis 10-30 cm longis. Involucrum cylin- dricum 5-8 mm longum, 3-4 mm diam., dense lanatum. Flosculi luteo-aurantiaci. Ligulae 3-5, obovato-orbiculatae 3-lobae, 5-8 mm longae. Disci flosculi 7-10, corollis 4.3-5 mm longis. Achaenia sublineari-oblonga, longissime villosa. Pappi paleae 4-6, lanceolatae vel lineares, marginibus lacerato-villosae. Chromosomatum numerus: n = 32.
bibliographicCitation: Brown, Roy C. 1974. A new species of Pailostrophe [P. mexicana] (Compositae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 26: 115-118.

description: Shrubs or small trees to 8 m tall; branches glabrous to pubescent; leaves sessile or with a winged petiole, rhombic-ovate, acuminate, entire, sparingly puberulent to tomentose and resin-dotted below, glabrous except along the puberulent veins above, the broadened portion of blade attenuate at base; peduncles slender, to ca 3 cm long; phyllaries 4-5, ovate-lanceolate, 2-5 mm long; ray flowers ca 10, the corollas yellow, to ca 7 mm long and 3 mm wide; disc flowers ca 25, 2-3 mm long; ray paleae ovate, to 3 mm long and 2 mm wide, glabrous; disc paleae ca 2 mm long; achene black, smooth, obovoid, laterally flattened, to ca 2.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Wells, James R. 1965. A taxonomic study of Polymnia (Compositae). Brittonia. 17: 144-159.

description: Rhizomes slender, light brown, branching, invested toward the sumnmit with light or darker colored thin scales, frequently producing a short approximate crown with several close growing stems and innovations; stems single, or more often several and cespitose, slender, 1.5-3.0 dm. high, mostly branched at or just above the middle, glabrate, or sometimes feebly shortstipitate-glandular, or with few strigose septate hairs below, becoming uniformly and mostly densely short-stipitate-glandular above, and also rarely scantily strigose; cauline leaves 2(3) pairs, including the broadly ovate sessile pair subtending the first braliehes of the infloreseence, the lower pair (or rarely 2 pairs), with blades 3.0-6.0 cm. long, 1.3-2.8 cm. broad, ovate to ovate-lanceolate, acute, irregularly and sharply or spinosely serrate, abruptly contracted to an equally long, broadly or scarcely winged petiole, the blades of the innovation leaves similar but with narrow petioles, 1.5-2.5 times longer than the blades, all of the leaves scantily scaberulous, glandular beneath, the upper surface densely and uniformly short-stipitate-glandular, the leaves of the infloreseence reduced and ovate, except the alternate narrowly lanceolate bracts; peduncles 2.0 (1.5)-5.0 (8.0) cm. long, slender, sometimes subcapillary, densely scabrid, short-stipitate-glandular; the inflorescence characteristically comprising the upper half of the plant, broadly corymbosely branching; heads numerous, 5(rarely 1-3)-11, small, 12(10)-15(18) mm. high, campanulate-turbinate; perielinium densely short-stipitate-glandular and somewhat scaberulous, seldom only scantily so; involueral bracts, 14-18 (20), inconspicuously biseriate, 7.0-9.0 mm. long, 1.0-1.5 mm. broad, narrowly lanceolate acute to acuminate, the pubescence similar to that of perielinium but less dense; ray flowers 8-11, the ligules pale yellow, 12-20 mm. long, 3.5-5.0 mm. broad, linear-elliptic, frequently obviously glandular on the back, the three blunt teeth ca. 0.5(1.0) mm. long; disc flowers 6.5(6.0)-8.0(9.1) mm. long, the tube 2.0 (1.8)-3.0 mm. long, narrowly goblet-shaped to tubular, the base of the limb and the tube only moderately to sparsely short villous, the collar inconspicuous, the limb and lobes mostly also scantily short-stipitate-glandular; achenes 5.5 (5.0)-6.5 (7.1) mm. long, obviously short-stipitate-glandular above, scantily so or glabrate below, often scantily short-hispid above with double hairs; annulus ca. 0.3 mm. long; pappus creamy-white, or occasionally straw-colored, mostly shorter than the corolla, barbellate, the setae 0.1-1.15 (0.18) mm. long, stiffly divergent.
bibliographicCitation: Camp, Wendell H. & Gilly, Charles L. 1943. Part II: Systematic Treatment, [Arnica alpina-Arnica discoidea]. Brittonia. 4 (3): 405-457.

description: Plants, annual, 30-60 cm high; stems erect, scarcely branched below, densely short-pubescent with coarse, spreading hairs interspersed with longer glandtipped trichomes; leaves simple, the lower ones distinctly opposite, the upper ones alternate, all densely short-pubescent with stiff spreading hairs; mid-stem leaves petiolate, the petioles 1-5 cm long; blades broadly triangular to ovate, finely pubescent on both surfaces, conspicuously serrate or rarely irregularly notched, 1.5-6 cm wide, 2.5-8 cm long, acute at the apex, broadly obtuse to truncate at the base; inflorescence open, dichotomously branched, the major branches bearing from 10 to 80 heads; head broadly turbinate, 0.5-1 cm across, (15-) 20-40-flowered, on ultimate peduncles 1-5 cm long; principal involueral bracts 7-10, 5-9 mm long, 2.5-6 mm wide, purplish for 1-4 mm from the mostly obtuse or rounded tip, pubescent with short, stiff, spreading hairs interspersed with somewhat longer, glandular trichomes; florets "pinkish-red" to "purple," distinctly zygomorphic; corolla (4-) 6-7 mm long, the tube (1-) 1.5-2 mm long, the throat cylindric, (3-) 4-5 mm long, the lobes of different lengths, 0.5-2.5 mm long; anthers (1.5-) 3 mm long with obtuse terminal appendages; style branches flattened, about 2.5 mm long, with well defined stigmatic lines, abruptly terminated by a short, penicillate cuspidate appendage, otherwise glabrous; achenes obpyramidal, 4-sided, each side distinctly to indistincely 3-ribbed, densely shortpubescent with incurved white hairs to nearly glabrous (often so in the same head), 4-5.5 mm long; pappus of 8 scales, the longer scales lanceolate, (3-) 4-6 (-7) mm long, often terminated by distinct awns or mueros, these usually alternating with 4 shorter, truncate, obtuse or awnless scales (the pappus scales often all alike); chromosome number, n - 12.
bibliographicCitation: Turner, Billie L. 1963. Taxonomy of Forestina (Helenleae, Compositae). Brittonia. 15: 27-46.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Slender, erect annual herbs, ca 2.7 dm tall; stems reddish brown to yellow, obscurely striate, strigose, sericeous when young; leaves strigose, subsessile, lanceolate to elliptic, up to 3.5 cm long and 8 mm wide; peduncles up to 3 cm long but usually shorter, strigose, becoming densely so upwardly; heads mostly hemispheric, ca 8 mm in diameter; phyllaries ca 8, obtuse to rounded at the apices, oblong, brownish purple, lightly pubescent all over, with or without a dark summit band; rays 5-6, yellow, often with a reddish basal spot, oblong to suborbicular, 8.4 mm long or less, smooth above, with ciliated green nerves beneath, sometimes marginally minutely ciliate, the pubescent tube ea 1.0 mm long; ray achenes ca 4 mm long, obovate to cuneate with a prominent inner angle, truncate to concave at apex, black and glabrous with crustose-ciliated margins later becoming entirely tuberculate, the pappus at first of 2 horns, these becoming less obvious as the cartilage develops; disk corollas 4 mm long, yellow below, the lobes orange outside with purple marginal lines, yellow inside; disk achenes obovate to cuneate, 3.5 mm long, deeply emarginate at apex, the margins at first ciliated, later crenate-crustose, the projections retaining their hairs; pales of the receptable bronze, purplish or yellow, often with orange tips, the apices mostly acute, entire; receptacles conical.
bibliographicCitation: Torres, Andrew M. 1963. Taxonomy of Zinnia. Brittonia. 15: 1-25.

description: Trees, to 14 m. Leaves with petioles ca. 10 cm long, densely woolly-tomentose; blade oblong-elliptic, 45-65 X 15-26 cm, coriaceous, base oblique, deeply cordate or rounded-cordate, apex rounded, abaxial surface woolly-tomentose, adaxial surface glabescent except for the midrib tomentose, reticulate veined, secondary veins 10-16 in each side of the midrib, margins entire. Cap itulescences thyrsoid-paniculate. Capitula homogamous, discoid; involucre cylindrical; phyllaries 5, weakly biseriate, subcoriaceous, outer phyllaries oblong, ca. 6 X 2 mm, curled-tomentulose or glabrate, the apex subobtuse, inner phyllaries oblong-elliptic, ca. 6 X 3 mm, curled-tomentulose or glabrate medially, apex obtuse, margins scarious. Florets 5, hermaphroditic, corolla 7-9 mm long, tube 2.5-4 mm long, limb ca. 4.5 mm long, lobes linear, ca. 4 mm long, apex acute; anthers ca. 3 mm long, base sagittate, caudate, terminal appendage lanceolate, acute; style branches with the apex acute, dorsally papillose-hirsutulous. Achenes oblong, ca. 3 mm long; pappus ca. 8 mm long.

description: Frutices ca 1.5 m usque alti. Folia alterna; petioli ca 2 mm longi, basi biauriti, auriculis 1.5-2.5 mm longis; laminae ellipticae, 25-45 mm longae, 5-12 mm latae, coriaceae, inferne tomentosae, supeme araneoso-lanatae, glabrescentes, basi acuminatae, apice acutae, margine denticulatae et revolutae. Capitulescentiae terminales et axillares corymboso-paniculatae; pedunculi 3-5 cm longi; pedicelli 1-2 cm longi. Capitula heterogama radiata, 6-8 mm alta, 5-6 mm lata; phyllaria ca 8, 2-seriata, extima anguste ovata, 3-4 mm longa ca 1.5 mm lata, intima ovata, ca 4 mm longa, ca 2.5 mm lata. Flores radiati pistillati ca 5; ligulae luteae, ca 8 mm longae, 1.5-2 mm latae. Flores disci hermaphroditi 10-15; corollae tubulosae luteae, 6-6.5 mm longae; limbus quinquelobus; lobi ca 2 mm longi. Achaenia 1.5-2 mm longa glabra; pappi setae 4.5-5 mm longae.
