description: Shrubs to 1.5 m tall. Leaves alternate; petiole ca 2 mm long, basally with paired auricles, these 1.5-2.5 mm long, blade elliptic, 25-45 mm long, 5-12 mm wide, coriaceous, the lower surface tomentose, prominently penninerved, the upper surface arachnoid-lanate, glabrescent, the margins denticulate, revolute. Capitulescences terminal and axillary, corymbose-paniculate, the peduncles 3-5 cm long, tomentose, bracteate, the pedicels 1-2 cm long, bracteolate. Capitula radiate, 6- 8 mm high, 5-6 mm wide; involucre campanulate; phyllaries ca 8, 2-seriate, subequal, the outer narrowly ovate, 3-4 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide, apically acute, the inner ovate, ca 4 mm long, ca 2.5 mm wide, apically obtuse; receptacle planar; ray florets ca 5, pistillate, the corollas yellow, ligulate, the ligules ca 8 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, apically tridentate, the style branches ca 1 mm long; disc florets 10-15, hermaphroditic, the corollas cylindrical, yellow, 6-6.5 mm long, the tube ca 2 mm long, the limb narrowly campanulate, the 5 lobes linear, ca 2 mm long, ca 0.3 mm wide, the anthers ca 2 mm long, basally sagittate, the terminal appendages ovate, obtuse to rounded, the style branches ca 2 mm long, apically obtuse, penicillate. Achenes cylindrical to fusiform, 1.5-2 mm long, glabrous; pappus of scaberulous bristles, 4.5-5 mm long, uniseriate, stramineous.

description: Herbaceous, tap-rooted annual, 0.6-3.0 dm tall; stems sparingly glandular-pubescent, gray-brown, paniculately branched; lower leaves 1.5-3.0 cm long, 0.4-0.8 cm wide, spatulate to oblanceolate, forming a basal rosette (often deciduous), runcinate, glabrous except for ciliate margins, midrib obscure; cauline leaves similar to basal, 2.0 cm or less in length, 0.4 cm or less in width, reduced upward to subulate scales; heads solitary, erect, terminating the branches, of 3 or 4 florets; involucres cylindroid, 3-5 mm long, 1.2-1.6 mm wide; the 3 or 4 principal involucral bracts linear, imbricate, 4-5 mm long at maturity, subequal, apices unappendaged; the 2-3 outer involucral bracts ca. 0.8 mm or less in length, forming a much reduced calyculum; ligules light pink or rarely white, 1.5 to 2.0 mm long, ca. 1.5 mm wide; corolla tube ca. 2.0 mm long, glabrous; anthers ca. 1.0 mm long, exserted ca. 0.5 mm above the corolla tube; style branches ca. 0.5 mm long; receptacle minute; achenes columnar, 3.0-3.5 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide, truncate at each end, with 5 ridges, the latter being minutely sulcate and scabrate; pappus bristles unequal in length, 2-3 mm long, capillary, white, fused at their bases; pollen grains echinate, with mean equatorial diameter 31 , mean spine length 2.2µ chromosome number, n = 7

description: Stout herb, the caudex up to 5 m. high, 2 cm. thick above (ex Blake), loosely cinereous lanate, leafy above; leaves pergamentaceous, oblong or oblanceolate, 25-40 cm. long, 5-6 cm. broad, slightly narrowed proximally to about 2 cm., obtuse or acute at apex, minutely denticulate at margins, glabrescent on both surfaces or sparsely glandular-hispid beneath, the costa prominent, the secondary nerves 2 or 3 per centimeter, irregularly spreading, densely prominulous-reticulate beneath; flowering branches erect, subligneous, hollow, short hispid-pilose, bearing cauline leaves towards the base, copiously branching, corymbose-paniculate, many-headed, the branches subtended by bracts resembling small leaves; heads at maturity 25-35 mm. in diameter; involucre 2-seriate, the phyllaries pergamentaceous, broadly ovate, the outer ones about 15 mm. long and 10-12 mm. broad, acute, conspicuously net-veined, densely glandular-tuberculate without; ray florets 50-60, about 3-seriate, the corolla about 12 mm. long, the tube 1-2 mm. long, glandular-hispidulous, the lamina obovate-oblong, 3.5-4 mm. broad, 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas about 5 mm. long, the achene 2-3 mm. long; disk florets hispidulous on tube and lobes, about 6 mm. long, the tube shorter than the limb, the lobes ovate, 1.5 mm. long, the stamens about 4 mm. long; paleae oblong, about 6 mm. long, obtuse, glandular-ciliolate, setose distally without.

description: Stout herb, the caudex up to 5 m. high, 2 cm. thick above (ex Blake), loosely einereous lanate, leafy above; leaves pergamentaceous, oblong or oblanceolate, 25-40 cm. long, 5-6 cm. broad, slightly narrowed proximally to about 2 cm., obtuse or acute at apex, minutely denticulate at margins, glabreseent on both surfaces or sparsely glandular- hispid beneath, the costa prominent, the secondary nerves 2 or 3 per centimeter, irregularly spreading, densely prominulous-reticulate beneath; flowering branches erect, subligneous, hollow, short hispidpilose, bearing cauline leaves towards the base, copiously branching, corymbose-paniculate, many-headed, the branches subtended by bracts resembling small leaves; heads at maturity 25-35 mm. in diameter; involuere 2-seriate, the phyllaries pergamentaceous, broadly ovate, the outer ones about 15 mm. long and 10-12 mm. broad, acute, conspicuously net-veined, densely glandular-tuberculate without; ray florets 50-60, about 3-seriate, the corolla about 12 mm. long, the tube 1-2 mm. long, glandular-hispidulous, the lamina obovate-oblong, 3.5-4 mm. broad, 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas-about 5 mm. long, the achene 2-3 mm. long; disk florets hispidulous on tube and lobes, about 6 mm. long, the tube shorter than the limb, the lobes ovate, 1.5 mm. long, the stamens about 4 mm. long; paleae oblong, about 6 mm. long, obtuse, glandular-ciliolate, setose distally without.

description: Rhizomes 1.5-2.0 mm. thick, rather extensively spreading and branching; innovations apparently commonly produced; stems simple, occasionally branching above, 1.5-2.5 mm. thick, 2.5-5.0 dm. high, mostly subglabrate below, becoming sparsely pilose with weak moniliform white hairs; cauline leaves 4(3-6) pairs, all sessile, or the lower several pairs obviously petiolate (the petiole in the lowermost frequently approaching the length of the blade), the blade lanceolate, elliptic-lanceolate, or oblanceolate, rarely ovate, the uppermost little reduced, sharply and irregularly serrate, sometimes only inconspicuously so, glabrate, frequently punctate-glandular and with a few weak moniliform hairs above, somewhat ciliolate; peduncles 3-8 cm. long, slender, more strongly pubescent than the stem and upwards conspicuously long-stipitate-glandular; heads 1-3 (5), campanulate-turbinate, 12-15(17) mm. high; perielinium obviously long-stipitate-glandular and white-monili. form-pilose; involueral bracts 13-16, in 2 obvious series, lanceolate, acuteacuminate, 1.5 (1)-2.5 mm. broad, 11-13 mm. long, conspicuously pilose toward the base, less pubescent toward the apex, frequently glandularciliolate; ray flowers mostly 12-15, the ligules oblong-elliptic 16-20 mm. long, 4-6 mm. broad, bluntly 3-dentate, the teeth 0.5-1.0 mm. long; disc flowers narrowly, sometimes broadly goblet-shaped, 5.5-7.2(7.5) mm. long, sparsely to moderately villous with moniliform or merely septate hairs, the collar obvious; aehenes 4.5(4)-5.5(6.2) mm. long, plump, uniformly and moderately appressed- or ascending-hispid with double hairs, stipitateglandular; annulus well formed; pappus tawny, -+ length of the corolla, mostly subplumose, the setae 0.2 (1.8)-0.3 mm. long.

description: Plants up to 0.8 m high; older stems grayish, younger ones reddish and pilose; leaves obovate to deltoid with 3-5 main veins, pilose, darker green above, marginally dentate, bases obtuse, apices acute, petioles up to 1 cm long, pilose; blades up to 5 cm wide and 5.5 cm long, but generally smaller; peduncles up to 5 cm long, lightly pilose; heads ca. 0.8 cm in diameter; phyllaries irregularly 2- or 3-seriate, lightly pilose, elongate triangular, inconspicuously striate, apices acute to broadened and foliaceous; rays narrowly oblong, ca. 19 mm long, dorsally lightly pilose basally and on the veins; ray achene glabrous except along the angles, ca. 3 mm long, the central awn 2 mm long and lightly pubescent, sometimes with a minute lateral awn; disk corollas 3.5 mm long, glabrous; disk achene 2-3 mm long, flattened to 4-angled, pubescent, usually with 4 unequal ciliated awns, the longest ca. 2 mm; paleae lightly pubescent, tending to be ciliate on the margins and the keel, generally exceeded by the disk flowers; receptacle low conical; n = 42, 2n = 84.
bibliographicCitation: Torres, Andrew M. 1970. Revision of the genus Philactis (Compositae). Brittonia. 21: 322-331.

description: Suffrutescent, 1-1.5 m tall; stems terete, brown or olive, densely villous to sericeous when young, thinly sericeous to glabrate with age, trichomes white, multicellular, sinuous, appressed to suberect, 0.8-1.5 mm long; leaves opposite at base, alternative above, thinly sericeous adaxially, trichomes as on stems, only slightly enlarged at base, 0.8-1.5 mm long, densely sericeous and silvery abaxially, trichomes as on adaxial surface, subsessile capitate glands lacking; blades of lower leaves 6-9 cm long, 27-62 mm wide, deltate to ovate or lance-ovate, apex acuminate, base cordate and then cuneately narrowed to petiole, the 2 major lateral veins bounding the cuneate base, margins minutely dentate with 6-10 teeth per side; blades of upper leaves 3-6 cm long, 12-22 mm wide, lance-ovate to rhombic or trullate, apex acute to acuminate, base attenuate to cuneate, margins entire or subentire; petioles 4-25 mm long, sericeous; synflorescence monochasial, thyrsoid, with successive paracladia arranged alternately at lower nodes and later paracladia commonly exceeding height of earlier ones, of 2-12 heads per paracladium; peduncles 1.5-8 cm long, thinly sericeous; heads 8-15 mm high, hemispherical, disk 8-15 mm in diam; phyllaries 10-15 in 2 (3) graduated series, 2.8-6 mm long, 1.1-2.1 mm wide, lanceolate to ovate, the base somewhat thickened but not markedly different in texture from the apex, puberulent or somewhat mealy, with few and scattered to numerous longer trichomes similar to those of leaves and stem; pales conduplicate, lance-ovate to lanceolate, 6-9 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, stramineus with upper part of midrib and apex darker brown, abaxial surface puberulent along midrib, adaxial surface glabrous, apex acute to slightly 3-lobed; ray flowers 6-1 1, sterile, corolla golden-yellow, ligule 12-14 mm long, 6-7 mm wide, oval to lanceolate, abaxial surface glabrate, puberulent along veins, apex bifid or trifid, tube 1.6-1.8 mm long, sparsely puberulent and glandular, ray ovary 2.8-3 mm long, 1 mm wide, flattened and slightly triquetrous, pubescent, epappose or with pappus of 2 or 3 awns ca 0.8 mm long; disk flowers 32-60, corollas yellow to orange-yellow, slightly campanulate, tube 0.9-1.5 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm wide, slightly wider and thicker at base, puberulent and glandular, throat 3.5-4.3 mm long, 1.1-1.5 mm wide, sometimes slightly bulbous at base, sparsely puberulent; lobes deltate, reflexed, orange-yellow, 0.8-1 mm long, puberulent abaxially; anthers 3.6-3.7 mm long, thecae brown to black, appendages 0.7-0.8 mm long, light yellow, filaments and connectives glabrous; style 6-7 mm long, branches 1.8-2 mm long, tipped by a short, acute appendage; disk achenes obovate, biconvex, 3-3.5 (5) mm long, sericeous, pappus of 2 awns and ca 8 intermediate scales, awns slender, subequal, 2.8-3.2 mm long, scales 0.5-0.7 mm long; n = 17 (Fig. ig).

description: Perennial herb with a stout woody root and somewhat woody base; stem 10-30 cm. high, more or less branched, green, hispid-hirsute with stiff spreading hairs, sometimes also very finely glandular; leaves pubescent like the stem, the lowermost ones oblanceolate, deciduous, the others niumerous, linear or nearly so, not over about 2 cm. long and 2 mm. wide; heads solitary at the ends of leafy branches, the disk about 7-10 mm. wide; involuere 4-5 mm. high, finely glandular and sparsely hispid-hirsute, with short stiff subcoAical hairs; phyllaries imbricate in several series, the outer firm, acute, with dark brown midrib and green or greenish borders, the inner thin, acuminate-attenuate, mostly light straw-colored except for the brown midrib, the inner and sometimes also the outer phyllaries sometimes purplish toward the tips; ligules about 30-50, pink to purple or violet, about 5-7 mm. long, 0.9-1.2 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.5-4.0 mm. long, the tube 0.7-1.0 mm. long, the lobes 0.5-0.7 mm.; style-appendages broadly'triangular and obtuse to deltoid and acutish, 0.15-0.2 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 10-20 firm bristles, some of which may be united into a chaffy palea, the outer of conspicuous slender subulate squamellae, about 3 as long as the inner; akenes 2-nerved, sometimes with a faint third nerve, sparsely hairy. Rio Grande, near the borders of Texas, New Mexico, and Chihuahua.

description: Shrubs, 1.5-4 m tall, 8 cm diam. at base, branches densely pilose to tomentose, hairs 1-2 mm long. Leaves petiolate; blades broadly ovate, 10-20 X 5-15 cm, apices acute, bases obtuse, subtruncate, subcordate or cordate; margins irregularly crenate-serrulate to serrulate-dentate; pilose on both surfaces, hairs 1-2 mm long; petioles 5-8 cm long, 1-1.5 mm diam., strigose, hairs 0.5-1 mm long. Capitulescences thyrsoid, branches scabrous to tomentose, hairs 1-2 mm long; glomerules 5-10 mm diam. with 10-20 tightly sessile capitula. Capitula 3- 4 mm high, 2-3 mm diam.; phyllaries 6, orbicular, 3 X 2.5 mm, arranged in 2 series, nearly glabrous below, ciliate on distal one-third, 9-12-nerved. Pistillateflorets 5, subtended by ovate paleae, 3 X 2 mm wide, glabrous, 7-veined, margin ciliate at distal one-third; corollas 1 mm long, tube 0.6 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., 4-lobed, lobes deltoid, scarcely pubescent at apex; styles 1 mm long, branches 0.5 mm long. Staminate-florets 5, epalaceous, corollas 1 mm long, 5- lobed, lobes deltoid, 0.5 mm long, throats 0.6 mm long, 0.3 mm diam.; anthers black, 1 mm long; styles undivided, 1 mm long; ovaries villose toward apex, hairs 0.5 mm long. Cypselae 2 X 1.5 mm wide, villous on distal one-third, hairs 0.5 mm long. Chromosome number, n = 16 (Robinson et al., 1981).

description: Arbor parva, ramis oppositis cinereo-lepidotis. Folia opposita, decussata, coriacea, elliptica, 3.5- 10 x 1-3 (4) cm, supra glabra, infra cinereo-lepidota; petioli (3) 5-11 (15) mm. Inflorescentiae axillares glomeratae. Capitula 8-9-flosculosa, subsessilia, pedunculis brevibus, tomentosis; involucrum turbi- natum 8-11 x (4) 4.5-5.5 mm; phyllaria imbricata 4-5-seriata, infra medium flavo-virentia, supra rubro-brunnea, ad apicem tomentosa. Corollae pallidae purpuratae vel albae, tubo 4-5 mm longo, lobis 2-3 mm longis; antherae purpuratae ca 3.5 mm longae, basi auriculis ca 0.5 mm longis, elongatis et angustatis, ad apicem leviter expansis et papillatis praeditae. Pappi albi vel straminei biseriati setae interiores filiformes 5.5-6.5 mm longae, exteriores filiformes vel lineares, interdum deciduae (0.5) 1- 2 (2.5) mm longae. Achaenia 3.5-4 (4.5) mm longa, aliquantum 4-angulata, 10-costata, glanduloso- punctata.
bibliographicCitation: Soderstrom, Thomas R. 1982. New species of Crytochloa and Piresia (Poaceae: Bambusoideae). Brittonia. 34: 199-209.

description: Small trees 3-8 m high; branchlets slender, brittle, subopposite to opposite, terete, cinereous-lepidote, upper ones with axillary glomerules. Leaves opposite to subopposite, decussate, somewhat crowded towards the end of branchlets; petioles slightly furrowed, cinereous-lepidote (3) 5-11 (15); blades coriaceous, elliptic, 3.5-10 x 1-3 (4) cm, apex variably acute, subapiculate or obtuse, cuneate at base, margins coarsely toothed above middle, glabrate above, cinereous-lepi- dote beneath, 5-9 lateral veins on each side. Inflorescences axillary clusters of 1-2, rarely 3 heads, those of each opposite pair often appearing as a single cluster. Heads of 8-9 florets on short tomentose peduncles; involucre turbinate 8-11 x (4) 4.5-5.5 mm; phyllaries imbricate in 4-5 series, deciduous, below middle green-yellow, above rusty-brown-tomentose, margins arachnoid, outer ones triangular- ovate, subacute, inner ones ovate to lanceolate, obtuse. Corollas light purple to white, glabrate, tube 4-5 mm long, lobes 2-3 mm long, glandular at apex; anthers purple ca 3.5 mm long, basal auricles ca 0.5 mm long, elongated and slender, slightly expanded and papillate at tip. Pappus white to straw-colored, biseriate, inner bristles filiform 5.5-6.5 mm long, outer bristles filiform to linear, often deciduous (0.5) 1-2 (2.5) mm long. Achenes 3.5-4 (4.5) mm long, somewhat 4-angled, 10-costate, gland-dotted.

description: Perennial herbs from a simple caudex with numerous, thick, fibrous roots, producing a basal rosette and a long scape. Leaves elliptic to ovate or oblanceolate, those of spring-flowering plants appearing after or concurrently with the first heads, 3-19 cm long, (0.9) 1.7-4.8 (5.3) cm wide, margins sometimes purple, thickened or slightly revolute and without tomentum, with 5-9 pairs of shallow, dentate, or retrorsely serrate, mucronulate lobes or teeth, apex acute or rounded, base attenuate or abruptly narrowed to a thin petiole 1/8-5/8 the length of the leaf, glabrous above, thinly gray-tomentose below. Mature scape 8-64 cm tall, often noticeably dilated under the heads, loosely tomentose when young but becoming floccose or glabrate with maturity, with (3) 5-10 (15) lanceolate to linear bracts 5-27 mm long. Heads 1 per stem, 1-4 per plant, erect in bud and flower; involucre turbinate; phyllaries in 3-4 imbricated series, lanceolate, acute, lightly tomentose to glabrate, margins of the inner with a narrow scarious rim, usually with a strongly differ- entiated, glabrous mid-region, light green to yellow-green, usually with purple- margined tips, innermost 9-20 mm long, 0.8-2.8 mm wide, outer 1/3-?/2 as long as the inner, all reflexing upon release of achenes; receptacles very shallowly convex, foveolate. Flowers all with fertile ovaries, dimorphic with pistillate flowers ligulate and hermaphroditic tubular, chasmogamous heads with (6) 8-12 (15) pistillate ligulate flowers, pistillate of cleistogamous heads always with reduced ligules, pistillate corollas bilabiate with the inner lip 2-parted, chasmogamous 9.5- 13.5 mm long, cleistogamous 4.1-7 (9) mm long, tubular portion 3.5-6 mm long, ligules rarely deeply cleft, white or sometimes purple-tipped, turning purplish with age, (3) 5-7 nerved, chasmogamous 0.6-2.1 mm wide, cleistogamous up to 0.7 mm wide, style branches 0.4-0.9 mm long; chasmogamous hermaphroditic flowers with strongly bilabiate corollas, cleistogamous much narrower and nearly regular with very short lobes, white to cream colored with lobes often tinged pink or purple, 5.5-8.4 mm long, 0.3-0.8 mm wide; anthers with thecae 1.5-2.1 mm long, apical appendages weakly differentiated, lanceolate, 0.1-0.6 mm long; style branches linear with rounded apices, 0.3-0.5 mm long. Achenes fusiform, 6-10 mm long, 1-1.3 mm wide, with only a slightly constricted area near the apex or with a relatively broad neck 1/5-1/3 the length of the achene, tan or rarely purplish, with 8 lighter colored nerves, densely pubescent over the whole surface with long, sharp-pointed duplex trichomes; carpopodium a minute, constricted, cartilaginous ring; pappus bristles numerous, very slender and minutely barbellate, tawny, 7-13 mm long at maturity, equalling or often much longer in fruit than the disc corollas. Chromosome number 2n = 46.

description: Shrubs, 2.5 m tall; stems striate, strigose, hairs 1 mm long, adpressed. Leaves petiolate; blades ovate to ovate-lanceolate, coriaceous, 8-15 X 3-8 cm, apices acuminate, bases cuneate to rounded cuneate, margins crenate-serrate, adaxially strigose, hairs 0.5 mm long, scarcely pilose abaxially, hairs 1 mm long, 3 main veins, primary and secondary veins prominent; petioles 0.5-2.5 cm long, striate, strigose, hairs 1 mm long. Capitulescences thyrsoid, at terminal branches, branches strigose, hairs 1 mm long. Capitula subglobose, 4-5 X 4-5 mm diam.; phyllaries 2-3, 4-5 X 3.5-4 mm, suborbicular, abaxially strigose, hairs 0.5- 0.8 mm long, apices markedly acuminate- mucronate, margins shortly ciliate on distal half, 5-veined. Pistillate forets 9-13, subtended by ovate paleae, 4-4.5 X 3.5-4 mm, 5-veined, strigose, hairs 0.5 mm long, margins ciliate on distal one-third; corollas 2.5 mm long, 1 mm diam., white, tubulate, 3-lobed, lobes 0.5 mm long, apices scarcely pubescent; styles 1.5 mm long, branches 1 mm long. Staminate florets 15, subtended by lanceolate paleae, 3-3.5 X 1.5-2 mm, margin ciliate on distal one-third, 2-veined; corollas 3 mm long, white, throats 1 mm diam., 5-lobed, lobes 0.5 mm long, apices scarcely pubescent; anthers 1.5 mm long, dark brown-purple; styles undivided, 2 mm long, ovaries 1 mm long, 0.6 mm diam., apices pilose, hairs 1 mm long. Cypselae 2.5 X 2 mm, obovoid, apices pilose, hairs 1 mm long. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Spreading, spinescent shrubs to 12 (-15) dm high; freely branched. Young stems evenly pannose; often tortuous. Primary leaves forming fierce, persistent spines 1-5 cm long, straight, more or less squarrose; initially tomentose, soon becoming glabrous, reddish brown. Secondary leaves filiform to weakly spatulate or clavate, 2-12 (-20) mm long; glabrous or very sparsely arachnose. Capitula borne singly or in 2 's or 3 's from nodes of the previous season. Peduncle-s 4-15 mm long; usually bracteate; glabrous. Involucres broadly turbinate to campanulate; 7-9 mm high. Phyllaries 5; subequal; ovate; obtuse to acute; often navicular; glabrous. Florets 5-7 per capitulum. Corollas pale yellow; 7.5-9.0 mm long; throat dilated, ca. 1.5 mm long; lobes narrowly lanceolate, ca. 2.5 mm long. Achenes 4.5-5.5 mm long; densely clothed with very fine, white hairs 6-8 (-10) mm long. Pappus of ca. 25 slender squamellae; 6.0-7.5 mm long. Style branches truncate; papillate; 1.5-2.0 mm long. Anthers 2.5-3.0 mm long; sagittate; sterile tips lanceolate, acute. Pollen grains mostly 3 5-41 ,µm in diameter.

description: Plants about 30 dm tall; stems white canescent-tomentose; leaves alternate to subopposite; petioles 2 mm long; blades of main stem lanceolate, 2.7 cm long, 0.7 mm wide, obtuse, cuneate, entire, slightly revolute, strigose-canescent above, beneath very densely white-tomentose; leaf blades of axillary fascicles oblong, 1.4 cm long, 0.3 mm wide; heads 1-3, nodding, on peduncles 2-5 cm long; disk 0.9 mm in diameter; phyllaries linear-oblong or lanceolate, 5 mm long, 2 mm wide, obtuse, canescent-tomentose above, pilose and indurated below, the outer some- what spreading or reflexed; rays about 16 (?) small; corolla 3.5 mm long, puberu- lent; pales obtuse, glabrous except for a few hairs on the upper portion of the keel; achene 3 mm long; pappus of 2 narrow lanceolate awns, 2 mm long, one small squamella sometimes present; pappus of ray achenes not seen.

description: Perennial with short rhizomes. Stems erect, 40-70 cm tall, terete, glabrous in lower part, stipitate-glandular in upper part, brownish green to brown-purple, remotely branched; branches elongate, bearing few pairs of leaves; subscapose with basal nodes shorter. Radical leaves well developed at anthesis. Cauline leaves opposite; lamina relatively thick, herbaceous, lance- olate to oblong-lanceolate, 70-90 X 15-25 mm, subacute at apex, cuneate at base, crenate along margin, triplinerved, yellowish green, often purplish beneath, nearly glabrous but punctate-glandular on both surfaces; petioles conspicuous, to 10 mm long in the lower leaves, winged. Heads numerous, 6-7 X ca. 3 mm, sessile, in several glomerulous clusters; each cluster 20-30 mm wide consisting of 30-80 heads. Inflo- rescence branches and peduncles densely stipitate-glandular (red-purple). Phyllaries ca. 5 mm long, acuminate at apex, pale green and usually red-purple at apex, stipitate-glandular (red-purple) with sparse short hairs and several scattered yellow ses- sile glands outside. Corolla dark pink, sparsely puberulous outside below; tubes ca. 3 mm long; lobes ca. 1 mm long. Pappus united into a membranous brush-like margined crown, ca. 0.2 mm high. Achenes ca. 3 mm long, dark brown, upper part his- pidulous.

description: Perennial herbs 3-6 (10) dm tall; stems tomentose. Leaves cauline, gradually reduced above; petioles 2-6 mm long; blades (6.7) 8-14 cm long, 2.2-3.3 cm wide, elliptic to elliptic-oblong or elliptic-lanceolate, widest at the middle, apically ob- tuse to rounded or acute or acuminate to long-acuminate, basally cuneate to slightly rounded, marginally slightly revolute and remotely callous-toothed, pilose (especially on veins) above, cream-colored- to light brown-, gray- or greenish- tomentose beneath. Inflorescences cymose. Heads (37) 46-78 (85)-flowered; peduncles ca 0.5-7 cm long, tomentose. Involucre broadly campanulate, 10-15 (18) mm high, 12-18 mm wide; phyllaries imbricate in several series, pilose, the inner ones linear-lanceolate, acuminate, apically pilose dorsally and ventrally, 8-10.7 mm long, 1.5-3.2 mm wide, the outer ones lanceolate, 4.5-7.5 mm long, 0.7-2.1 mm wide. Pappus straw-colored, the inner bristles 7.2-10.2 mm long and outer scale-like bristles 1.2-2 mm long. Corollas 11-16 mm long, reddish-purple, glabrous. Anthers 3.5-4.5 mm long. Achenes 3.5-6.2 mm long, (8) 10 (12)-ribbed, strigose. Flowering and fruiting from September to February.

description: Plants to 2 m tall, stems cinerous-pilosulous to lanate-hirsute; leaves alter- nate; petioles to 2.2 cm long; blades lance-ovate to lanceolate, 15.0 cm long, 7.3 cm wide, acute to acuminate, cuneate at base, entire, serrulate, or rarely serrate, above dark green, sparingly to densely sericeous-pilose, beneath light green or grayish, canescent to sericeous-tomentose; heads 3-5 on peduncles 0.5-3.0 cm long; disk 0.8-1.1 cm in diameter; phyllaries ovate-lanceolate or lanceo-late, 6-8 mm long, 2 mm wide, obtuse to acute, griseous-tomentose with ciliate margins, not reflexed; rays 6-12, 6-13 mm long, 3-5 mm wide; disk corollas yellow, 3.5-5.0 mm long, puberulent; anthers yellow; pales obtuse, straw-colored throughout or tipped with black, scattered-pilose on back chiefly along keel; achenes black, 3 mm long; pappus of 2 lanceolate awns, sometimes each sub-tended by a pair of squamellae; pappus of ray flowers lacking, or of one or a few squamellae. Chromosome number: n=17.

description: Herbaceous perennial 6-10(3-12) dm tall, glabrous or even glaucous at maturity but with tufts of lanate hairs in the axils of the leaves and among the heads in the inflorescence, occasionally the basal leaves lightly tomentose; stems arising singly or rarely several loosely clustered; underground parts taprooted or weakly creeping the first year, becoming a stiff vertical or creeping caudex with age. Basal and lower cauline leaves petiolate, fundamentally obovate but deeply pinnate-lyrate; the terminal lobe large and conspicuous, contracted to a weakly winged midrib bearing 2-4(8) broad based lobes; margins of the terminal and lateral lobes dentate to crenate-dentate; leaves including petiole 6-18(4-25) cm long and 2-4(1-7) cm wide. Upper cauline leaves similar to basal leaves but progressively reduced up- wards; terminal lobe less pronounced and lobing less deep, producing a more obviously winged midrib than on the basal leaves; uppermost leaves reduced to dentate bracts. Inflorescence cymose, loose, open; heads 15-40(60+); principal involucral bracts about 21 or sometimes about 13, 5-7(4-8) mm long, green or yellowish green, with tips sometimes pubescent; rays about (8)13, the ligule 6-10+ mm long. Achenes 3-4 mm long, glabrous or rarely lightly scaberulous.

description: Perennial herb with a taproot and branching caudex; stem 3-12 cm. high, erect or sometimes aseeinding-spreading, spreading-hairy and sometimes somewhat viscid, with very unequal hairs, the longer hairs several times as long as the shorter ones; leaves nearly all in a basal cluster, finely hirsute, linear or linear oblanceolate, up to about 4 cm. long and 2 mm. wide, the eauline ones, except those near the base and forming part of the basal tuft, few and reduced, mostly below the middle of the stem; head solitary, the disk 8-16 mm. wide; involuere 5-7 mm. high, more or less spreading-hirsute and usually finely glandular or slightly viscid; phyllaries subequal or slightly imbricate, green, acuminate, with or without a slightly darker midrib, sometimes with narrow searious borders; ligules about 30-55, rarely and perhaps abnormally as many as 100, white, commonly turning pinkish in age, 5-10 mm. long, 1:5-2.3 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.5-4.3 mm. long, the tube 0.7-1.0 mm., the lower part of the limb distinctly less indurate than in E. pumilus, especially after boiling, the lobes 0.5-0.7 mm. long, the whole corolla coarser and heavier than in E. pumilus; style-appendages deltoid, acute or acutish, 0.15-0.25 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 15-25 fairly firm barbellate bristles, the outer of not very conspicuous setae; akenes rather densely short-hairy, 2-nerved.

description: Perennial herbs to 2.5 m tall; roots fibrous, shallow; stems glabrous or puberulent, irregularly purple-striped, hollow, to 2 cm thick; nodes often purple; leaves light green, spicy-aromatic, thin, glabrous or puberulent, petiolate, the adaxial surface of the petiole and veins puberulent; lower leaves 5-11-pinnately-lobed serrate, acum- inate, to 27 cm wide and 41 cm long; upper leaves with 0-few lobes; peduncles pube- scent and glandular; heads nodding; phyllaries of 2 types, the outer lanceolate, 1 mm wide, 2-3 mm long, the inner broadly ovate, 3 mm wide and long with minutely- bristled margins; ray flowers 4-6, the corolla yellowish-white, tridentate, ca 3 mm broad and long, the tube densely pilose outside; disc flowers ca 15, pale yellow, the acute lobes with fimbriate margins; ray paleae broadly ovate; disc paleae obovate with large veins; achene brown, 5-ribbed, ca 3 mm long and wide.

description: Small (op. cit.) gives the habitat and range of this species as follows: "Mt. slopes, often in somewhat acid soil over siliceous rocks, Appalachian Plateau, Ga. and Tenn." At the Marianna Caverns it is abundant and conspicuous on the limestone ledges. It is a coarse plant, commonly reaching 2m in height and is markedly different from Polymnia canadensis L. and P. uvedalia L. The larger leaves, including the petiolps, are about 30 cm long and 15 cm broad. The leaf blades, lustrous above, roughly elliptic-oblong in outline, are deeply pinnately divided, the primary divisions irregularly and prominently lobed and toothed. The heads are small, mostly about 6 mm high and 10 mm broad, the rays small and inconspicuous. The heads are borne one to several on slender peduncles reaching a length of at least 6 cm.

description: Trees, to 3 m. Leaves with petioles 5-7 cm long, densely pubescent; blade elliptic 20-30 X 10-15 cm, coriaceous, base rounded or cordate, apex obtuse to rounded, lower surface somewhat pubescent, upper surface glabrous except for the woolly mid- rib, reticulate veined, 5-8 secondary veins on each side of the midrib, margins entire, revolute. Capitulescences paniculate-subcorymbose. Capitula often heterogamous or rarely homogamous, discoid; involucre cylindrical; phyllaries 5, uniseriate, coriaceous, ovate-oblong, ca. 4.5 X 3 mm, puberulent, apex obtuse, margins scarious. Florets 5, hermaphroditic or pistillate, co- rolla ca. 8.5 mm long, tube ca. 3 mm long, limb ca. 5.5 mm long, lobes linear, ca. 5.5 mm long, apex acute; anthers 2.5-3 mm long, base slightly auriculate, terminal appendage lanceolate, acute, often abortive but with the filaments persistent; style branches with the apex obtuse, dorsally papillose-pilose. Achenes oblong, 2-3 mm long; pappus 7-7.5 mm long.

description: Subshrubs or shrubs, 0.5-2 (5) m tall; stems simple to much-branched, subterete to somewhat hexagonal, coarsely striate, puberulent, becoming glabrous with age, internodes ca 1.5-5 cm long, as long as, or often shorter than the subtending leaves. Leaves opposite, petiolate; blade subcoriaceous, smooth, elliptic to elliptic- lanceolate, 2.5-6.5 cm long, 0.8-2.6 cm wide, basally cuneate, apically obtuse, less commonly acute, entire or serrulate with up to 3 (5) pairs of teeth, sometimes undulate, trinervate from near base, upper surface dull green, glabrous, lower surface paler green, glabrous or punctate; petiole ca 2-3.5 cm long. Capitulescence essentially terminal, cymose, of ca 3-25 capitula from the apex and uppermost lateral branches; peduncles ca 1-3 cm long, glabrous to pubescent, striate or sulcate. Capitula discoid, ca 15-16-flowered; involucre hemispheric, ca 10 mm high, ca 8 mm broad, ca 3-4-seriate; phyllaries ca 14, dimorphic, imbricate, graduated but appearing subequal, the outer ca 4 phyllaries broadly to narrowly elliptic, 7.5-12 mm long, 3.3-4.4 mm wide, generally much longer than the next series, herbaceous but paler in color than leaves, reticulate or trinervate, glabrous, apically obtuse to rounded, margins entire, the inner series of phyllaries elliptic- ovate, 4.6-8.5 mm long, 3.2-4.1 mm wide, scarious or sometimes membranous marginally and/or apically, with 5-9 parallel nerves, glabrous, apically obtuse to rounded, entire; receptacle dome-shaped, 1.3-1.8 mm tall, 2.4-3 mm broad, paleaceous, the paleae elliptic-lanceolate, 8-8.5 mm long, 1.3-2 mm wide, yellow, outer ones somewhat conduplicate to inner ones conduplicate, margins entire, irregular. Disc corollas somewhat campanulate, 6.1-6.8 mm long, glabrous, yellow or golden-yellow, tube 2.2-2.9 mm long, throat 1.6-2.5 mm long, lobes 5, as- cending or recurved, 1.5-2 mm long; anthers partially exserted, pale yellow, ca 2.5 mm long, apical appendage deltoid, abaxially obscurely glandular, less com- monly glabrous; style to 8 mm long, branches 1-1.5 mm long. Achenes turbinate, prismatic, 2.5 mm long when young, elongating to 3.8 mm long when mature, black, glabrous or puberulent; carpopodium tan, non-sculptured; pappus of 17- 27 linear-lanceolate, acuminate, minutely serrulate, stramineous scales, 4.6-5.9 mm long, generally reaching to the middle of the corolla lobes. Pollen heliantheous, ca 32 Am diam. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Suffruticosa vel fruticosa, ca 0.5-2 (5) m alta; caules simplices vel ramosissimi, teretiusculi vel hexagoni, glabriusculi, internodiis ca 1.5-5 cm longis; folia opposita, petiolata; foliorum lamina sub- coriacea, elliptica vel elliptico-lanceolata, 2.5-6.5 cm longa, 0.8-2.6 cm lata, integra vel serrulata, subtriplinervis, plerumque glabra; capitulescentia terminalis, cymosa; pedunculi 1-3 cm longi; capitula homogama, paleacea; involucrum hemisphericum, ca 10 mm longum, ca 8 mm latum, phyllaria dimorpha, imbricata, 3-4-seriata, receptaculi paleae elliptico-lanceolatae, 8-8.5 mm longae, plerumque integrae; flosculi radiati nulli; flosculi disci ca 15-16, corolla lutea, glabra, 6.1-6.8 mm longa, tubo 2.2-2.9 mm longo, lobis 1.5-2 mm longis, triangularibus; achaenia turbinata, prismatica, nigra, glabra vel pubescentia, 2.5-3.8 mm longa; pappi squamae ca 17-27, lineari-lanceolatae, 4.6-5.9 mm longae.

description: Arbores ca 5 m usque altae. Folia opposita; petioli 2-3 mm longi, dense stellato-tomentosi; laminae ovatae vel ellipticae, 7-17 cm longae, 3-8 cm latae, infeme stellatae-tomentosae, supeme sparse villosae, basi acutae vel obtusae, saepe obliquae, apice acutae vel obtusae, margine integrae. Capitulescentiae terminales et axillares corymbosopaniculatae congestae; pedunculi primarii 3-10 cm longi, secundarii 1-2.5 cm longi; pedicelli 1-5 mm longi. Capitula heterogama radiata, ca 6 mm alta, ca 2.5 mm lata; phyllaria ca 8, 2-seriata, extima lanceolata, ca 4 mm longa, ca 1 mm lata, intima oblonga-elliptica, ca 4 mm longa, 1.5-2 mm lata. Flores radiati pistillati ca 3; ligulae luteae, 4-5 mm longae, 1.5-2 mm latae. Flores disci hermaphroditi 6-8; corollae tubulosae luteae, ca 5 mm longae; limbus quinquelobus; lobi 2-2.5 mm longi. Achaenia (immatura) ca 1 mm longa, glabra; pappi setae ca 5 mm longae.

description: Trees to 5 m tall. Leaves opposite; petiole 2-3 mm long, densely stellate-tomentose; blade ovate to elliptic, 7-17 cm long, 3-8 cm wide, the lower surface stellate-tomentose with irregularly-branched trichomes, the upper surface sparsely villous, midrib prominent below, densely villous, basally acute to obtuse, often oblique, apically acute to obtuse, the margins entire. Capitulescences terminal and axillary, corymbose-paniculate, divaricately branched, pyramidal, the primary peduncles 3-10 cm long, stellate-tomentose, bracteate, the secondary peduncles 1-2.5 cm long, villose, bracteate, the pedicels 1-5 mm long, villose, bracteolate. Capitula radiate, ca 6 mm high, ca 2.5 mm wide; involucre campanulate; phyllaries 8, 2-seriate, equal, the outer lanceolate, ca 4 mm long, ca 1 mm wide, apically acute, ciliolate, the inner oblong-elliptic, ca 4 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, the margins scarious, apically obtuse, ciliolate; receptacle planar; ray florets 3, pis- tillate, the corolla yellow, the ligule 4-5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, 4-5-nerved, apically tridentate, the style branches ca 1.3 mm long, clavate, apically acute, penicillate; disc florets 6-8, hermaphroditic, the corolla yellow, tubular, ca 5 mm long, glabrous, the limb narrowly funnelform, the 5 lobes 2-2.5 mm long, ca 0.5 mm wide, the anthers ca 2.5 mm long, basally sagittate, the terminal appendages lanceolate to oblong, the style branches ca 1.2 mm long, linear, apically obtuse, penicillate. description: Perennial herbs, (3.2) 4-6.4 dm tall; stems canescent. Leaves cauline, gradually reduced upwards; petioles 0-3 mm long; blades 4-7.1 cm long, 1.5-2.8 cm wide, oblanceolate, apically acute-acuminate, basally cuneate-rounded, marginally revolute and often remotely callus-toothed, glabrate to slightly villous above, canescent beneath. Inflorescences spicate-cymose. Heads 39-60-flowered, sessile. Involucre broadly campanulate, 9-17 mm high, 9-13 mm wide; phyllaries tightly imbricate in 7-8 series, canescent to arachnoid, the inner ones oblong, longacuminate, 8-14 mm long, 1.1-2.5 mm wide, the outer ones lanceolate, acuminate-filiform, 3.6-7 mm long, 0.9-1.4 mm wide. description: Twining liana with opposite to whorled, mostly broadly ovate leaves that are 8-23 cm long and 3-12 cm wide. Leaf apices are narrowed to a cuspidate tip. description: Biennial herb, branching widely from the base; stem about 1 dm. high, hirsute with long spreading hairs, and, especially under the heads, finely glandular; leaves spreading-hirsute with long hairs, the basal ones numerous, with oblong to obovate blade 1-1.5 cm. long, tapering to a petiole twice as long; cauline leaves reduced, oblanceolate to spatulate; heads solitary at the ends of branches; disk about 13-14 mm. wide; involuere about 5 mm. high, coarsely spreading-hirsute and finely glandular; phyllaries acuminate, greenish, sometimes with chaffy margins, moderately imbricate; pistillate flowers with the ligules absent, or inconspicuous and much shorter than the style; disk-corollas about 4.0-5.1 mm. long, the tube 0.8-1.2 mm., the lobes 0.5 mm.; style-appendages deltoid or ovate, acute or acutish, 0.15-0.25 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of 15-20 firm sordid bristles, the outer of several long firm setae; akenes 2-nerved, hairy. description: Stout herb, the caudex subterranean, densely leafy at summit; leaves somewhat papyraceous, elliptic-oblong, 15-25 cm. long, 3-4 cm. broad, long attenuate proximally to a margined petiole 3-5 mm. broad, acute or subacute at apex, subentire or crenulate at margins, loosely lanate and glabrescent above, densely fulvous matted-tomentose beneath, the costa prominent beneath, the secondary nerves about 2 per centimeter, ascending, the veinlets obscurely reticulate; flowering branches erect, subligneous, 40-60 cm. high, loosely lanate and glabrescent, bearing a few reduced cauline leaves, spreading corymbose-paniculate, the branches subtended by foliaceous bracts 2-6 cm. long; heads at maturity 12-20 cm. in diameter; phyllaries about 20, 2- or  3-seriate, membranaceous, oblong, acute, the outer ones about 8 mm. long, 3.5-4 mm. broad, strigose without with reddish hairs about 0.8 mm. long; ray florets 40-50, about 2-seriate, the corolla 6-7 mm. long, the tube about 1.5 mm. long, pale hispid, the lamina obovate-oblong, about 2.5 mm. broad, 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas 3-4 mm. long, the achene 2-2.5 mm. long, narrowly winged; disk florets 5.5-6 mm. long, the tube and lobes reddish viscid-hispid, the tube shorter than the limb, the lobes oblong-deltoid, the stamens about 3.5 mm. long; paleae obovate-oblong, about 6 mm. long and 2 mm. broad, acute, densely reddish brown viscid-hispid distally without.

description: Viscid, spreading shrubs to 1.5 m high from a thick, woody taproot; branching at the root apex and above. Stems and branches white; main stems to 8 mm in diameter; upper branches to 4 mm in diameter; stems and branches glabrous, rarely with very few, minute hairs just beneath the heads. Leaves spatulate to oblong or lanceolate, 2.2-5.8 cm long, 0.5-2.6 cm wide, glabrous or with a sparse to dense vestiture of long, flattened hairs along the margins, never glandular; apex acute or obtuse, spinulose or mucronate; base attenuate, cuneate, or subauriculate and clasping; margins spinulose - dentate or, less commonly, entire, 2-36 teeth per leaf; leaves not much reduced upwards. Heads solitary at ends of branches, broadly campanulate or hemispherical, 2-4.5 cm in diameter, sessile or less often pedunculate, the peduncles to 7.5 cm long. Involucre tightly imbricated; phyllaries in 4-7 series; outermost phyllaries lanceolate, herbaceous for 1/4 to 3/4 of their length, scarious below, usually keeled basally, 0.5-1.2 cm long, 1.6-3.8 mm wide, glabrous, with thin, hyaline, fimbriate margins, the apex acute or short-acuminate; innermost phyllaries equal to or longer than the immediately preceding series, herbaceous for ?/2 the length or largely scarious, usually keeled basally, 1.3-2.2 cm long, 1.5-3.5 mm wide, the apex acute or acuminate. Ray flowers (18) 27-38 (45) per head; tube slender, 4-6 mm long, ligule light blue, oblong to elliptic, 1.2-3.2 cm long, 2.7-7.2 mm wide, obscurely to distinctly 3-toothed. Disc flowers 56-140 per head; corolla 7.8-10.5 mm long, narrowed below into a slender tube, 3-6 mm long, and expanded above into a narrowly funnelform throat; style branches linear, 1.4-3.6 mm long, 0.4-0.5 mm wide, the appendages acute, 0.4-0.7 mm long, shorter than the stigmatic lines. Pappus of about 40-90 stout, unequal bristles, the largest up to 12 mm long. Achenes linear, clavate, or broadly turbinate, 3-4 mm long, woolly with long, silky, subappressed hairs. Chromosome number n = 6.

description: Erect, herbaceous plants, to 1 m tall. Stems striate, glandular-puberulent, with imbricate leaves. Leaves ovate, oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 1.5-10 X 1.5-5.5 cm, the apex rounded, the base auriculate, doubly spinulose-denticulate, coriaceous, glandular-punctate on both surfaces, sometimes obscurely so. Inflorescence a small terminal corymbiform panicle; capitula congested, subsessile to pedunculate; peduncles to 5 mm long, densely tawny villosulous; involucre 4-5-seriate, campanulate, 6-9 mm high, the phyllaries tawny-villose to tomen- tulose on the margins, more so toward the apex, sparsely glandular to glandular-pubescent on the dorsal surfaces, the outer series lanceolate to ovate, 2-3 X 1-2 mm, obtuse, mucronate, the central ones oblong to obovate, 4-5 X ca. 2 mm, obtuse, mucronate, the innermost oblanceolate, 6-8 X ca. 1 mm, acute to obtuse, mucronate. Florets 8-10; corollas lilac to white, glandular-puberulent, ca. 10 mm long, the tubes ca. 6 mm long, the lips ca. 4 mm long; stamens ca. 7 mm long, the apical appendages ca. 2.2 mm long, magenta, the anther thecae ca. 2.3 mm long, the tails ca. 2 mm long, the filaments ca. 2.2 mm long; style ca. 10 mm long, including the branches ca. 1.2 mm long. description: Coarse, robust subshrubs 1-1.7 m tall, from a xylopodium. Leaves opposite; petioles up to 5 mm long; blades 2.8-9 x 1-3.5 cm, subchartaceous, ovate or sometimes oblong to elliptic, attenuate at the base, acute to shortly acuminate at the apex, margins serrate to serrulate, the adaxial surface scabridulous with scattered larger trichomes to densely strigose, sometimes subullate, the abaxial paler, densely strigose to vilous, prominentely reticulate. Outer phyllaries 10-34 x 1 .2- 1.5 mm, much longer than the inner, spread- ing mostly linear or elliptic with a long linear base, rarely narrowly oblong, indurate and broader at the very base, acute to very shortly acuminate and mucronulate at the apex; inner phyllaries 4.5-6 x 2-4mm, elliptic to obovate to oblong, acute to shortly acuminate or shortly caudate at the apex. Paleae 7-10 x1-1.5 mm when folded, with mostly purple, triangular, rigid and acute tip. Ray florets sterile, tube ca. 1 mm long, lamina 8-10 x 3-4 mm, purplish, yellowish with purple veins or sometimes yellow, elliptic to ovate to oblong, lobes mostly shallowly cut or entire, abaxially glabrous or sparsely setulose toward the base. Disc florets with corollas 4-5 mm long, sometimes sparsely setulose along the veins and at the abaxial side of lobes. Cypselae 3.5-4.8 x 1.5- 2 mm, slightly thickened, subquadrangular, with a tendency for being smooth, wings 0.2- 0.8 mm wide; pappus with awns reduced to tooth-like projection or less than one half of the cypsela body length or sometimes awnless, crown 0.2-0.8 mm high, usually almost completely fused to the body, with fimbriolate to lacerate or laciniate margins.

description: Frutex scandens ramis dense crasseque ferrugineo-tomentosis. Folia alterna subcoriacea in sicco brunneo-olivacea. Lamina ovata vel oblongo-ovata basi cordata vel rotundata apice attenuata acuta, margine integra vel repando minuteque denticulata, 10-14 cm. longa, 5.5-7.5 cm. lata; supra atroviridis subnitida glabra (costa depressa tomentella excepto) nervis secundariis paulo notatis reticulo minuto prominulo satis conspicuo; subtus dilute tomentella, costa elevata crassa hirsutulo-tomentosa, nervis secundariis circa 10 utroque latere angustis prominentibus patulis et furcato-anastomosantibus nervulis prominulis reticulatis. description: Perennial herbs 1.9-5.7 (8) dm tall; stems glabrate to slightly tomentose or arachnoid. Leaves cauline, remote; petioles 1-3 mm long; blades 8-15 cm long, 0.7-3.2 (4) cm wide, narrowly oblong-lanceolate or sometimes elliptic, widest at the middle, apically acute, basally cuneate, marginally revolute, glabrous above, gray-felted to thinly felted beneath. description: Viscid, spreading shrubs to 1.5 m high from a thick, woody taproot; branching at the root apex and above. Stems and branches white; main stems to 1 cm in diameter; upper branches to 4 mm in diameter; younger stems and branches glabrate to densely covered with short or minute, stipitate-glandular trichomes; older stems and branches becoming glabrous. Leaves spatulate to ovate, 1-4.8 cm long, 0.3-2 cm wide, glabrous to moderately glandular with sessile or stipitate glands; apex obtuse or acute, spinulose; base attenuate or cuneate to subauriculate; margins spinulose-dentate, sometimes entire, 2-20 teeth per leaf; leaves not markedly reduced upwards. Heads solitary at the ends of the branches, broadly campanulate or hemispherical, 2-4 cm wide, sessile or pedunculate, the peduncles to 11 cm long. Ray flowers (12) 20-29 (32) per head; tube slender, 5-8 mm long; ligule light blue, oblong to elliptic, 1.8-2.5 cm long, 4-7 mm wide, obscurely to distinctly 3-toothed. Pappus of about 60-100 stout, unequal bristles, the largest up to 9.5 mm long. Achenes linear to clavate, 3-4.5 mm long, woolly with long, silky, subappressed hairs. Chromo- some number n = 6.

description: Annual emergent aquatic herbs ca. 4 dm high, lower nodes decumbent and rooting; stems reddish-brown, striate, hispid, nodes conspicuous; leaves sessile, mostly lanceolate, up to 5 cm long, 1.5 cm wide, hirsute on both surfaces, margins toothed, apices acute, bases subconnate, upper leaves sublinear; peduncles very slender, ca. 3-5 cm long, hispid, flaring slightly at apex; phyllaries 7-10, uniseriate, lance-linear, ca. 4 mm long, hispid the entire length; alae 1.6 mm long, thin and hyaline; rays thin, readily separating from the achene, yellow, elliptic, ca. 5 mm long, 2 mm wide, 2-lobed at apex, short-tubed; ray achenes turbinate, ca. 1.3 mm long, minutely striate; disk flowers numerous; corollas yellow, ca. 2 mm long, the basal 1/4-1/3 abruptly constricted and hirsute, otherwise glabrous, the base enlarged, upper portion of the corolla often with reddish veins; disk achenes turbinate, more or less terete, ca. 1.5 mm long; outermost paleae thick, tough, the lower 2/3 expanded and enclosing the outermost disk florets, not persistent but apparently they readily fall away bearing the enclosed achene, the apex acuminate, minutely ciliate near the apex, other paleae slender, thin, glabrous, more or less persistent on the conical receptacle; 2n = 18.

description: Perennial herbs or shrubs to 4 m tall; stems glabrous to densely villous; leaves to 34 cm wide and 50 cm long, sessile or with winged petioles, the winged portion narrower toward base; lower leaves deltoid to broadly ovate, often with small lobes and broad, shallow sinuses, the margin dentate with callous-tipped teeth, the upper surface scabrous to sparsely pilose, the lower surface densely pilose to sparsely velutinous; upper leaves ovate to ovate-lanceolate or rhombate; peduncles glandular or pilose with glands; phyllaries ca 5, broadly ovate or ovate-lanceolate, to 12 mm long and 10 mm wide, glabrous or sometimes puberulous to glandular-pilose; ray corollas yellow, ca 10 mm long, to 6 mm wide, the tube pilose especially on lower portion or pilose with glands; disc flowers ca 6 mm long, the corollas yellow (sometimes purple at least when dried), puberulous outside; ray paleae ovate-lanceolate, the upper mar- gins involute, this resulting in a spear-shaped point to 1 cm long above the broadened basal portion, the lower surface of ray paleae with large stalked glands to 1mm long, and sometimes with pilose hairs; disc paleae about as long as disc flowers, lanceolate; achene flattened-obovoid, dark brown, striate, ca 3.5 mm long and 3 mm wide.

description: Plantae 0.5-3 m altae, plerumque ascendentes vel serpentes, ramosae. Glandes partium vegetativarum 90-300k longae; pili cum 1-6 (-8) cellulis basilaribus. Caulis alae usque 11 mm latae; caules juveniles rami juveniles inflorescentiaque dense glandulosi interdum setosi vel pilosi raro dense hirsuti; internodia 0.2-4 cm longa. Folia sessilia vel subsessilia interdum petiolata; petioli 3-22 mm longi, plerumque alati; laminae 2.6-21.3 cm longae, 1.4-6.8 cm latae, lineari-lanceolatae vel lanceolatae vel ellipticae, acuminatae, basi attenuatae vel decurrentes, supra dense glandulosae et sparse vel densius strigosae vel pilosae, subtus dense glandulosae et pilosae, vel sparse glandulosae et villosae vel lanatae, marginibus denticulatis vel integris, recurvatis vel revolutis, costa nervisque subtus prominentibus; stomata subtus solum. Inflorescentia dense corymbosa vel paniculata vel thyrsiformis; pedunculi 3-16 (-29) mm longi, dense glandulosi et interdum setosi vel pilosi vel dense hirsuti. Bracteae accessoriae 4-5, 6-18 (-23) mm longae, (1.2-) 1.5-8.5 (-11) mm latae, lineari- lanceolatae vel lanceolatae vel ellipticae vel oblanceolatae, acutae vel brevi-acuminatae, petiolatae vel subsessiles, utrinque dense glandulosae et interdum setosae, pilosae vel villosae, marginibus integris recurvatis, costa subtus prominenti. Phyllaria 8 (-9), (9-) 10.5-16 mm longa, 1.1-2.7 mm lata, linearia, acuta vel acuminata, convexa, pagina adaxiali distaliter strigosa, pagina abaxiali dense glandulosa et saepe setosa  vel pilosa, costa nervisque prominentibus. Receptaculum 3-3.5 mm latum pilis usque 6 mm longis onustum. Flores (13-) 16-21. Corollae tubus (florum exteriorum interiorumque) 5.7-9.4 mm longus, basi 0.4-0.6 mm latus, ore 0.8-1.2 mm latus, glandulosus, distaliter paucipiliferus; labium exterius 3.4-5.2 (-6) mm longum, 1.7-2.5 mm latum, glandulosum, plerumque paucipiliferum, raro glabratum, plerumque revolutum, interdum patens; lobi labii interioris 3.3-4.8 mm longi, basi 0.4-0.6 mm lati, glandulosi et paucipiliferi, raro glabrati. Filamenta 1.8-2.5 mm longa. Antherae 6.4-8.6 mm longae: appendices 2-2.8 mm longae, thecae 2.9-3.8 (-4.2) mm longae, caudae 1.4-2.1 mm longae. Stylus (5-) 6.6-10 mm longus usque ad furcam, ramis 1.3-2.2 mm longis. Achenia 7.2-9.5 mm longa, 0.5-0.9 mm lata, rostro 1.1-1.9 (-2.5) mm longo, pilis duplicibus mucum emittentibus et raro glandes parvas (50-70Q longas) ferentia; embryo 5.4-5.8 mm longus, 0.6-0.9 mm latus sub cotyledonibus, cotyledonibus 3-4.1 mm longis. Pappus 7-11 mm longus, albus vel fulvus.

description: This species is distinguished from other members of Krigia by its chromosome number (2n = 60), globose tubers, long-scapose peduncles, and rosette leaves. Individuals usually produce many slender stolons that at their tips develop either new shoots or new tubers. Krigia dandelion is the only species in the genus with vegetative reproduction, a feature rare in tribe Lactuceae. In the subtribe Microseridinae, only Pyrrhopappus grandiflora produces a tuber-like structure in its root-system. However, the tuber of Krigia dandelion is a modified stem, while the tuber of Pyrrhopappus grandiflora is a modified root.

description: Herbae caespitosae; caules 1-2 cm longi. Folia oblongae-lanceolata ad obpyramiformae, 3.5-5 mm longa, 0.5-1.5 mm lata, apice rotundata. Capitulescentiae solitariae, pedunculo 1-3 mm longo. Capitula 2-2.5 mm alta, 1-1.4 mm lata; involucrum campanulatum; phyllaria subaequalia, extima ovato-lanceolata 2-2.3 mm longa, 0.5-0.6 mm lata, apice acuta usque ad obtusa, lacerata, intima lanceolata, 1.8-2.1 mm longa, 0.4-0.5 mm lata, apice acuta. Flores feminei ca 4, corolla ca 1.25 mm longa; styli rami ca 0.2 mm longi; flores hermaphroditi ca 2, corolla ca 1.75 mm longa, limbo 5-lobulato, lobis 0.25 mm longis; antherae ca 1 mm longae; styli rami truncati, ca 0.1 mm longi. Achaenia ovoidea, ca 0.75 mm longa, 0.4 mm lata; pappi aristae 1.2-1.5 mm longae.

description: Cespitose herbs; stems 1-2 cm long. Leaves oblong-lanceolate to obpyramidal, 3.5-5 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide, apically rounded, often with tomentose tuft. Capitulescences solitary, the peduncle 1-3 mm long. Capitula 2-2.5 mm tall, 1-1.4 mm wide; involucre campanulate; phyllaries subequal, the outer ovate-lanceolate, 2-2.3 mm long, 0.5-0.6 mm wide, apically acute to obtuse, lacerate, the inner lanceolate, 1.8-2.1 mm long, 0.4-0.5 mm wide, apically acute; pistillate fiorets ca 4, the corolla ca 1.25 mm long, the style branches ca 0.2 mm long; hermaphrodite florets ca 2, the corolla ca 1.75 mm long, the limb 5-lobed, the lobes 0.25 mm long, the anthers ca 1 mm long, the style branches truncate, ca 0.1 mm long. Achenes ovoid, ca 0.75 mm long, ca 0.4 mm wide; pappus bristles 1.2-1.5 mm long.

description: Winter annuals or biennials, 2-5 dm. high (or, according to Nelson, up to 8 dm. high); stem stout, ereet, freely branching, sparsely to moderately pilose with spreading hairs 1-3 mm. long, and more or less glandular, especially upwards, the peduncles usually obviously glandular and only sparsely pilose; leaves sparsely to moderately pilose with long hairs like those of the stem, also usually more or less glandular (especially the upper ones); basal and lowermost cauline leaves broadly oblanceolate or spatulate to obovate in outline, shallowly to deeply pinnately lobed with broad rounded or obtuse lobes, up to 15 cm. long and 2.5 cm. wide, usually smaller; cauline leaves smaller and less lobed upwards, the middle ones rarely more than coarsely toothed, the teeth becoming acute; heads several or numerous, the disk 5-10 mm. wide; involucre about 3.5-5 mm. high, glandular, miore or less villous-hirsute with long hairs, especially toward the base; phyllaries unequal, broad, green, with faint brown midvein, the tips searious-margined; ligules about 60-120, occasionally more numerous, blue or occasionally white, 4-9 mm. long, about 0.8-1.1 mm. wide; disk-corollas and style-appendages about like those of E. divergens; pappus like that of E. divergens, but the bristles less fragile; akenes 2-nerved, sparsely hairy or glabrate. Open, often sandy places; southern and western Arizona. Reported by Blake from Mohave, Gila, Maricopa, Pinal, Pima, and Yuma Counties.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Volubilis; caulibus teretibus glabris; foliis petiolatis ovatis vel elliptico-ovatis obtuse acutis subintegris vel minute obscureque denticulatis basi acutis supra basin pinnate 5-nervatis supra nitidis lucidis glabris 3-6 cm. longis 1.5-3.0 cm. latis; petiolo 5-8 mm. longo glabro; corymbis convexis puberulis 3-8 cm. latis; pedicellis 3.0-4.5 mm. longis parce vel moderate puberulis; capitulis 6.5-7.5 mm. longis; phyllariis lineari- oblongis vel anguste oblongis (3.5) 4.5-5.5 mm. longis 1.0-1.2 mm. latis parce vel moderate puberulis; corollis 3.5-4.0 mm. longis, tubo glanduloso sessile vestito, cetera glabris; achaeniis glandulosis sessiilibus 2.5-3.0 mm. longis; pappi setis 30-38 albidis 3.5-4.0 mm. longis.

description: Climbing plant; stem glabrous or rarely sparsely puberulent, terete, smooth, many-costate; internodes 3.5-4.5 cm. long; branches opposite divaricate- ascending; leaves ovate to elliptic-ovate, obtusely acute at apex, narrowed to an acute base, conspicuously pinnately 5-nerved above the base, the other lateral nerves inconspicuous, entire or subentire or with 1-2 minute denticulations on each margin, 1.5-2.5 cm. wide, glabrous, firmly membranaceous, deep green and shining above, pale green and punctate-dotted or punctations absent below, the 2 conspicuous pairs of lateral nerves sulcate above, below conspicuously raised; petioles slender, glabrous, 5-8 mm. long, curved at base; corymbs on short or elongated leafy branches, convex, often binate, moderately dense, 3-8 cm. broad; bractlets linear-lanceolate, 3.5-4.0 mm. long; heads peduncled; inflorescence at length interruptedly paniculate, up to 1.5 dm. long, the branches and peduncles sordid-puberulous at least above; pedicels 3.0-4.5 mm. long, sparsely to densely puberulous; phyllaries linear-lanceolate to narrowly oblong, obtuse, (3.5) 4.5-5.5 mm. long, 1.0-1.25 mm. wide, sparsely to moderately puberulous; corollas whitish, the proper tube narrow, 1.5-1.8 mm. long, moderately covered with sessile glandu- lar excrescences, throat subturbinate, glabrous, 1.1-1.2 mm. long, lobes elliptic- ovate or ovate, 0.8-1.0 mm. long, glabrous; achenes strongly angled, 2.5-3.0 mm. long, angles sparsely or not at all puberulous, the faces sparsely to more or less densely covered with sessile glands, sparsely puberulous around summit of achene; pappus bristles 30-38, whitish, 3.5-4.0 mm. long.

description: Herba lignescens ca 1 m alta, videtur perennis (radice ignota). Caules glabri, erecti, tetragoni, sulculati, infra ca 3 mm crassi, simplices vel subsimplices. Folia opposita, pinnatim tripartita, petiolata petiolo tenui, sulculato glabroque usque ad 4 cm longo; foliolis lanceolatis, membranaceis supra viridibus, glabris vel ad venulas et rarius alibi minutissime adpresso-setulosis vel arcuato-setulosis, apice acriter acuminata, marginibus acriter serrulatis, lateralibus 5-7.5 cm longis et ca 3 cm latis, terminali vix majore, omnibus tenuiter vel subtenuiter petiolulatis petiolulo interdum ca 1.5 cm longo. Capitula corymbose disposita pedunculos paucos (ca 10) erectos simplices vel ramulosos terminantia, discoidea, ad an- thesin ca 1.3 cm lata et 1.4 cm alta. Involucri basi hispiduli bracteae exteriores circ. 9-12 tenuiter lineares, 6-9 mm lon,ae, setulosae, apice acres, arcuato-recurvatae, quam interiores oblongo-lanceolatae paulo longiores. Flores ligulati ab- sentes. Paleae anguste lanceolatae glabrae quain flores tubulosi breviores. Flores tubulosi flavi. Achaenia linearia, tetragona, glaberrima, sulcata, supra arcuata et patentia, apice biaristata aristis tenuibus flavidis retrorsum hamnosis arcuatis ca 5 mm longis, corpore submaturo atro-brunneo ca 8 mm longo et 1 mm crasso.

description: Lignescent herb about 1 m tall, seemingly perennial (root unknown). Stems glabrous, erect, tetraoonal, finely grooved, ea 3 mm thick below, simple or nearly so. Leaves opposite, pinniately tripartite, petiolate; petiole slender, suleulate and glabrous, up to 4 cm long; leaflets lanceolate, membranaceous, on upper surface green, glabrous or at the veinlets and more rarely elsewhere very minutelv appressed-setulose or arcuate-setulose, at tip sharply acuminate, at margins sharply serrulate, lateral ones 5-7.5 cm long and 3 cm wide, terminal one scarcely laroger, all delicately or subdelicately petiolulate with a petiolule at times ea 1.5 cm long 1-leads corymbosely disposed on the few (ca 10) erect simple or branched peduncles, diskoid, at flowering-time ea 1.3 cm wide and 1.4 cm tall. Involuere basally hispidulous; outer phyllaries ca 9-12, slenderly linear, 6-9 mm long, setulose, apically acute, arcuate-recurved, slightly longyer than the inner, oblong- lanceolate on-es. Ligulate florets missing. Chaff-scales narrowly lanceolate, glab- rous, shorter than the disk-florets. Tubular florets yellow. Achenes linear, tetragonal, very glabrous, suleate, curved and spreading above, apically biaristate with slender, yellowish, retrorsely barbed curved aristae ca 5 mm long, a sub-mature body dark-brown and ea 8 mm long by 1 mm thick.

description: Shrubs, 6-15 cm tall, much branched, glaucous. Stems erect, leafy, with solitary terminal heads. Leaves 3.5-4 X 1.4-1.7 cm, glaucous, sessile, widened at base, clasping, broadly spathulate-obovate, coriaceous, reticulate, margins dentate with curved aristate teeth, with stipitate glands and simple hairs on both surfaces, or only on the abaxial veins. Capitula radiate, 25 mm diam. (including rays florets), solitary at the end of leafy stems, peduncles 1-2 cm long, densely covered with simple rigid hairs and shorts stipitate glands. Involucre 12-15 mm high, phyllaries in 3-4 series. External phyllaries elliptic, reflexed, 9 X 2-2.5 mm, terminal bristle, stipitate glands on both surfaces. Internal phyllaries 10 X 2.5 mm, membranaceous margins, terminal bristle, stipitate glands only at the distal portion. Ray florets yellow, pistillate, fertile, tube 4-8 X 0.3-0.4 mm, glabrous, limb 7.5-14 X 2-2.5 mm, apex tridentate. Disk florets yellow, perfect, corolla tube 6.5-8 X 0.5-0.8 mm, hairy in the middle portion. Achenes fusiform, downy. Pappus of disk and ray florets persistent with numerous bristles, 8-9 mm long, yellowish.

description: Low herb, the caudex essentially subterranean, rounded, up to 8 cm. in diameter, leafy at summit; leaves thin coriaceous, linear-oblong, 4-7 cm. long, 4-10 mm. broad, scarcely narrowed towards base, obtuse at apex, entire and slightly thickened at margins, densely pale or cinereous lanate, the costa and few secondary nerves obscured by the wool; flowering branches unbranched, erect at maturity, 8-35 cm. long, copiously lanate, bearing 2 or 4 opposite or alternate cauline leaves 1.5-2 cm. long; heads solitary, terminal, at maturity 20-25 mm. in diameter; phyllaries 25-35, papyraceous, lanceolate-oblong, about 5 mm. long, 1—1.5 mm. broad, acute, densely lanate; ray florets numerous, 2- or 3-seriate, the corollas about 10 mm. long, the tube 1.5-2 mm. long, strigose with hairs about 0.4 mm. long, the lamina lanceolate-oblong, about 8 mm. long and 1-1.5 mm. broad, usually 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas 3-4 mm. long, the achene about 1.5 mm. long; disk florets sparsely pilose, 5-5.5 mm. long, the tube shorter than the limb, the lobes deltoid, the stamens 3-3.5 mm. long; paleae thin membranous, oblong, about 5 mm. long, 1.5-1.8 mm. broad, acute, hispid without, the hairs 0.5 mm. long.

description: Low herb, the caudex essentially subterranean, rounded, up to 8 cm. in diameter, leafy at summit; leaves thin coriaceous, linear-oblong, 4-7 cm. long, 4-10 mm. broad, scarcely narrowed towards base, obtuse at apex, entire and slightly thickened at margins, densely pale or einereous lanate, the costa and few secondary nerves obscured by the wool; flowering branches unbranched, erect at maturity, 8-35 cm. long, copiously lanate, bearing 2 or 4 opposite or alternate cauline leaves 1.5-2 cm. long; heads solitary, terminal, at maturity 20-25 mmn. in diameter; phyllaries 25-35, papyraceous, lanceolate-oblong, about 5 mm. long, 1-1.5 mm. broad, acute, densely lanate; ray florets numerous, 2- or 3-seriate, the corollas about 10 mm. long, the tube 1.5-2 mm. long, strigose with hairs about 0.4 mm. long, the lamina lanceolateoblong, about 8 mm. long and 1-1.5 mm. broad, usually 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas 3-4 mm. long, the achene about 1.5 mm. long; disk florets sparsely pilose, 5-5.5 mm. long, the tube shorter than the limb, the lobes deltoid, the stamens 3-3.5 mm. long; paleae thin membranous, oblong, about 5 mm. long, 1.5-1.8 mm. broad, acute, hispid without, the hairs 0.5 mm. long.

description: Plants annual, 25-65 cm high, erect, branching, spreading-hirsute and with glandular trichomes; leaves ovate to ovate-lanceolate, the largest 4-6.5(-7) cm long, 1.5-3.5 cm wide, progressively smaller and fewer upwards, obtuse to acute at the apex, cuneate and then long attenuate at the base, subentire-repand to distinctly serrate, scarcely to sparsely hirsute on both surfaces, especially along the veins beneath; petioles 0.5-1.5(-2) cm long; heads subcampanulate, 6-9 mm wide, sparsely spreading-hirsute and solitary on slender peduncles which branch profusely in paniculate fashion; peduncles 0.5-4 cm long, with glandular trichomes; receptacle short-conical, ca 2 mm wide, 1.5 mm high; chaff readily deciduous, oblong, glabrous, membranous, 4-5 mm long, rounded, and minutely laciniate at the apex, the margins scarious, greenish toward the center and tip; involucre subuniseriate, usually with one or two bracts to the outside or on the peduncle near the head, the phyllaries proper oblong, (2.5-)3-4(-4.5) mmlong, 1.5-2 mm wide, sparsely hirsute or with glandular trichomes, rounded to obtuse and laciniate or minutely ciliate at the apex, the margins scarious, entire or minutely ciliate, purpletinged; inner bracts about equal in length to the outer, less green and slightly menibranous, purple-tinged, glabrous; ray flowers absent; disc corollas white, 3-3.5 mm long, the tube ca 1 mm long, densely alnd minutely pubescent, the throat tubular, 1-1.8 mm long, on outer florets slightly broader, pubescent at the base, otherwise glabrous, the lobes slightly longer (to 1.2 mm long) and broader on outer florets, acute, 0.5(-1) mm long, pubescent on outer surface, involute or reflexed, style branches slender, slightly flattened, ca 1.2 mm long, tapering to a short, minutely pubescent, subulate tip; achenes black, narrowly obconical, ca 2 mm long, conspicuously 5-sulcate, pentagonal, short-pubescent with hairs mostly in the sulci and toward the base; pappus of 20 unequal, whitish, fimbriate, lanceolate scales, ca 1 mm long, shorter than the achene; anthers 1.5-2 mm long, sagittate at the base.

description: Short-lived perennial herbs with fibrous roots from slender, horizontal, woody rhizomes up to 5 cm long, with a cluster of basal leaves and sometimes an erect stem produced at the apex of each rhizome branch. Erect stems 5-14 cm high, simple or with several short, lateral, primary branches; very sparsely pubescent with spreading, often flattened and twisted, Type A trichomes, densely spreading just under the heads but ascending or appressed near the base of the stem, Type B trichomes common and conspicuous on all the stem, Type C rare or absent. Leaf lamina very sparsely pubescent with strigose or arching Type A trichomes or lacking Type A, usually with numerous but mostly inconspicuous Type B trichomes in either case, margins of lamina and petioles sparsely ciliate with Type A trichomes or sometimes more or less eciliate, basal and cauline leaves essentially similar in pubescence; basal leaves spatulate, 1.2-6.0 cm long, the blades elliptic, entire, apex rounded or acute, 3-10 mm wide, base attenuate to a narrow petiole from 1/2 to % as long as the leaf, widening slightly at the base but not membranaceous or purplish; cauline leaves about 5-8 in number, alternate, clasping, entire, the lowermost similar in size and shape to the basal leaves but often with a broad (up to 3.2 mm wide) petiole, becoming smaller and obovate to oblong to lanceolate upwards, the uppermost sometimes a linear bract as short as 4 mm. Heads solitary at the ends of erect branches, peduncles 12-40 mm long; involucre 8-10 mm wide, about 5 mm high, composed of phyllaries in about 3 equal series; phyllaries lanceolate to oblanceolate or narrowly elliptic, thin, acuminate, usually with loose or spreading tips, the inner 4-5 mm long, 0.7-1.1 mm wide, light green with purple tips or with purple margins on the upper 1/2, the margins very narrow and scarious, sometimes with a narrowed green midrib and thicker white margins on the lower 1/3, very sparsely hirsute on midrib and margins with thick, often flattened and twisted, Type A trichomes, densely punctate-glandular with Type C trichomes; receptacle probably shallowly convex but not directly ob- served. Ray flowers pistillate, fertile, 32-45 in number, in a single series, corollas white, drying white, 3-4-nerved, apex rounded or with shallow notches, 8.5-11.0 mm long, 1.0-1.8 mm wide, the tubular portion about 1.5 mm long, sparsely pubescent in the region of the tube with long Type C trichomes. Disc flowers perfect, fertile, numerous, corollas yellowish, sparsely pubescent with long Type C trichomes, funnel- form, most without a conspicuous constriction but some much narrower in the lower 1/4, without an indurated portion, 2.5-3.0 mm high, 0.7-0.9 mm wide, the 5 erect lobes 0.5-0.6 mm long; anthers with thecae 1.0-1.1 mm long, with lanceolate apical appendages about 0.2 mm long; style with branches 0.6-0.7 mm long, including the deltate collecting appendages 0.15-0.24 mm long. Achenes narrowly oblong-oblanceo- late, laterally compressed, about 1.6 mm long and 0.6 mm wide, stramineous with 2 slightly darker ribs, sparsely strigose; carpopodium a tiny cartilaginous ring about 0.05 mm high; pappus of ray and disc flowers simple, of 15-19 sordid-white, barbellate bristles, the longest 2.1-2.8 mm long, sometimes with a few, short, outer setae, pappus of the ray flowers not exceeding the involucre, pappus of the disc flowers from 3/4 to slightly greater than the length of the corolla. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Perennial herb with a slender somewhat branched caudex; stem 5-15 cm. high, erect, sparsely hirsute-strigose with appressed or ascending hairs below, spreading-hirsute under the head; leaves glabrous ozr sparsely appressed-hirsute on the surfaces, sparsely and irregularly hirsute-ciliate on the margins, the basal ones oblanceolate to spatulate, all but the earliest ones with the petiole much exceeding the short blade, which is about 5-25 mm. long, 3-10 mm. wide, and broadly obtuse, rounded, or slightly emarginate at the apex; cauline leaves several, lanceolate or oblong, up to at least 25 mm. long and 8 mm. wide; head solitary, the disk 6-9 mm. wide; involuere about 5 mm. high, the subequal, broad, green phyllaries villous-hirsute on the darker and slightly thickened midrib, and finely glandularviscid; ligules about 25-50, white, 6-10 mm. long, about 1 mm. wide or a little more; disk-corollas about 2.8-3.5 mm. long, the tube 0.8-1.1 mm., the lobes about 0.6 mm.; style-appendages deltoid or a little narrower, acute or acutish, 0.15-0.2 mm. long; pappus of about 15 slender white bristles, occasionally with a few short and inconspicuous outer setae; akenes sparsely hirsute-strigose, 2-nerved.

description: Rhizomatous perennial herbs 0.5-1 m tall; stems 3-15, only 1-3 producing flowers, terete, sparsely to moderately pubescent, trichomes appressed and matted, burgundy. Leaves alternate, shallowly triplinerved; blades 1.3-6 cm long, 1.3-6.5 cm wide, generally slightly wider than long, smaller distally, suborbicular to deltate with 5-7 shallow, angular lobes ending in a mucro, adaxial surface glabrous, bright green, abaxial surface sparsely to moderately pubescent with long, appressed, matted trichomes resembling fungal hyphae, creamy green to white, some leaves turning purple with age, margins entire and glabrescent, apex broadly acute, base cordate; petiole 0.3-2.7 cm long. Capitulescence of 3-24 heads, arranged in a corymbiform cyme; peduncles 2.5-6 cm long, sparsely pubescent, green. Heads heterogamous, radiate, campanulate, 1.2-1.5 cm high, 0.7-1 cm wide (excluding ligules); receptacle epaleate. Phyllaries 25-35 in 5 graduated, somewhat dimorphic series; phyllaries of first to third series 2-7 mm long, 1.2-1.7 mm wide, appressed, chartaceous, ovate to lanceolate, glabrous, stramineous-green rimmed with purple; phyllaries of fourth to fifth series 1 cm long, 1.7-2 mm wide, appressed, chartaceous, ovate to oblong, glabrous, stramineous. Ray flowers 5-7, pistillate, the corollas bright yellow; ligules 0.9-1 cm long, 3- 4 mm wide, oval, glabrous, apex shallowly trifid, broadly acuminate to truncate; tube 4 mm long, glabrous, yellow; style 4.5 mm long; style branches 0.7 mm long, truncate without appendages. Ray cypsela ca. 2.5 mm long, obconical to narrowly urceolate, glabrous, stramineous; pappus of 35-50 bristles of equivalent length, 5.5-6.5 mm long, white, easily caducous. Disk flowers 20-27, perfect, the corollas campanulate, yellow;  throat 2 mm long, 0.5 mm wide at base, 1 mm wide at top, essentially glabrous; tube 3.5 mm long, glabrous, yellow; lobes 2-2.5 mm long, lanceolate, revolute, glabrous; anthers 2 mm long, yellow, the appendages 0.5 mm long, lanceolate, yellow; styles 7 mm long, yellow; style branches 1-1.2 mm long, truncate, appendiculate. Disk cypselae like those of rays.

description: Stems densely fulvous-tomentose; leaves alternate; petioles 5 mm long; blades ovate or ovate-lanceolate, 5.5 cm long, 2.5 cm wide, acuminate, the base round- ish, subentire or remotely serrate, chartaceous, densely scabrous-setose above, below fulvous lanate-tomentose; monocephalous; disk 2.0-3.0 cm in diameter; phyllaries ovate-lanceolate, 2 cm long, 3 mm wide, acuminate, densely fulvous lanate; rays about 30, 2-3 cm long, 3 mm wide; disk corollas yellow with brown- ish teeth, about 6 mm long, nearly glabrous; pales glabrous or obscurely pubescent on tips and keel; achenes 4 mm long; pappus of 2 narrowly lanceolate awns.
bibliographicCitation: Heiser, Charles B. 1957. A revision of the South American Species of Helianthus. Brittonia. 8: 283-285.

description: Frutex ramis hirtulo-tomentosis pilis rigidis crassis patentibus munitis. Folia alterna petiolata rigide coriacea. Petiolus 3-5 mm longus plus minusve araneosus basi ampliato-vaginatus. Lamina oblongo-elliptica utrinque attenuata basi cuneata apice acutiuscula vel obtusiuscula margine revoluta, 8-18 mm longa 3-8 mm lata; supra viridis vernicoso-nitentissima glabra vel pilis araneosis deciduis nervo medio impresso cetera laevissima; subtus adpresse denseque ochraceo-tomentosa costa elevata reliquis nervis inconspicuis. Capitula radiata longe pedicellata solitaria vel saepe plurima ad terminationem ramusculorum corymoso-paniculata. Pedicelli 2-4 cm longi gracillimi striati sparse minutesque setulosi et araneosi aliquis bracteolis subcapillaribus acutis flexuosis 5-8 mm longis muniti, 2-4 supremis involucrum adpressis ad modum calyculi. Involucrum anguste campanulatum 7-7.5 mm altum, 8 bracteis crassiusculis oblongis apice acutis margine anguste scariosis dorso glabris nitentibus 6.5 mm longis 1.4-2 mm latis. Flores-radii feminei ligulati circiter 6, corolla lutea glabra 15 mm longa tubulo 5 mm longo, lamina 5-nervata 4 mm lata. Flores disci hermaphroditi circiter 12, corolla lutea glabra 8-9 mm longa, tubulo 3-3.5 mm longo, limbo campanulato dentibus 1 mm longis, antheris 2.5 mm longis, ramis styli obtuse truncati papilloso-coronatis. Ovarium oblongum 4 mm longum striatum glabrum. Pappus albus 7 mm longus.
