description: Subshrub, 1-2 m tall; stems golden-brownish-tomentose. Leaves cauline; petioles 3-11 (25) mm long, tomentose, blades 7.4-13.4 cm long, 4.3-7 cm wide, ovate to ovate-elliptic or elliptic to elliptic-oblong, widest at or below the middle, apically rounded, basally rounded to rounded-cuneate or slightly oblique, marginally slightly revolute and remotely toothed at vein endings, glabrate to slightly golden-brownish-tomentose (especially along veins and margins) above, tomentose and prominently pinnately veined beneath. Inflorescences compact, cymose-paniculate. Heads ca 85-122-flowered; peduncles 0.2-1.5 cm long, tomentose. Involucre broadly campanulate, 11-13 (18) mm high, 14-19 mm wide; phyllaries imbricate in several series, tightly appressed, glabrate to floccose near the tips, the inner ones oblong, acuminate, 8.5-10 mm long, 1.9-2.6 mm wide, the outer ones oblong, 5.5-7 mm long, 1.3-1.7 (2.2) mm wide. Pappus straw-colored, the inner bristles 7.5-10 mm long and outer scales 2.5-3 mm long. Corollas 6.2-9 (13) mm long, reddish-purple, hispid on the lobes. Anthers 3.5-4.3 mm long. Achenes 2.5-3.2 mm long, densely strigose-pilose. Flowering and fruiting from March to June.

description: Rami terminales striati cicatricosi granulato-glandulosi terminationibus conferte foliatis. Folia coriacea alterna petiolo 2-3 mm longo. Lamina ovato-lanceolata basi cuneata apice attenuata acutaque margine minute serrata dentibus callosis acutis, 18-28 mm longa 9-14 mm lata; supra sublaevis glabra subnitida parce resi- nosa nervis reticuloque leviter notatis; subtus sparse granulata reticulo venulorum minuto elevato costa crassiuscula. Inflorescentiae paniculatae terminales breves folia suprema attingentes vel breviores, ramusculis brevibus glandulosis, bracteis ovalibus glandulosis. Pedicelli 1-3 mm longi glandulosi. Capitula mascula circa 5 mm diamitentia subglobosa, involucro multibracteato bracteis subscariosis rigidis basim stramineis sursum purpurascentibus nitidis glabris margine laceratis, ovato-oblongis inferioribus 1.5 mm longis ceteris gradatim brevioribus. Flores masculi praeflorationem corolla 2 mm longa glabra. Pili pappi 2 mm longi sursum incrassati.
bibliographicCitation: Cuatrecasas, José. 1956. Studies on Andean Compositae - III. Brittonia. 8 (3): 179-193.

description: Frutex scandens. Rami flexuosi paulo striati breviter tomentelli pilis sub-stellatis pediculatisque vel squamosis tecti. Folia alterna viridula rigide chartacea. Petiolus 10-15 mm longus striatus tomentellus flexuosus. Lamina ovato-oblonga basi asymmetrica obtusiuscula apice angustata subacuta vel acuta, margine integerrima, 11-15 cm longa 5-6 cm lata; supra copiose calloso-punctata leviter asperula costa conspicua breviter tomentulosa nervis secundariis filiformibus impressis, venulis minutum reticulum prominulum forrnantibus; subtus aspectu glabra sed sparsis pilis minutis callosis vel squamosis nmunita, costa eminenti magis puberuli, nervis secundariis 9-10 utroque latere filiformibus eminentibus subpatulis prope marginem curvato- anastomosatis, ceteris nervulis venulisque minutum reticulum prominentem con- spicuum formantibus. Inflorescentiae in paniculis cymosis valde congestis gloirerulos axillares petiolos subaequales formantibus; pedunculo crasso brevissimo vel nullo, cymu- lis 1-5-floris pedicellatis, pedicellis angustis striatis rigidis vel flexuosis tomentellis 1-8 mm longis, praecipue umbellatim dispositis. Involucrum bracteis exterioribus ovatis 1-2 mm longis interioribus absentibus. Corolla glabra 5-5.5 mm longa tubulo 2.8 mm longo. Antherae 2.6 mm longae basi acutissime sagit- tatae. Achaenia linearia 3 mm longa striata sparse glandulosa. Pappus 6 mm longus sericeus albus, paleis exterioribus paucis capillaribus (sicut interioribus pilosis) circa 1 mm longis.

description: Suffrutex ramosus ramis tenuibus flexuosis dense adpresseque albo-vel einereolanatis vetustis glabreseentibus. Rami fertiles erecti copiose f oliosi monocephali. Folia alterna sessilia anguste linearia subite acutata margine revoluta, costa supra impressa subtus elevata, supra laetiviridia arachnoideo-lanuginosa deinde glabreseentia, subtus crasse albo-lanata, basi dilatato-amplectentia, 1-2 cm longa, 1-2 mm lata. Capitula radiata solitaria terminalia peduneulo elongato adpresse albo-lanato sparse folioso sursum bracteolis angustissime linearibus lanuginosis munito. Calyculum circa 20-22 bracteolis angustissime linearibus acutis herbaceis flexuosis plus minusve 2-seriatis circa 10 mm longis 1 mm latis involuerum attingentibus exterioribus ad peduneulum descendentibus. Involucrun sub-hemisphaericum 23 bracteis subbiseriatis circa 10 mm longis acutis, herbaceis exterioribus lanceolatis 2 mm latis, interioribus oblongo-lanceolatis margine late seariosis 3.5 mm latis, omnibus margine parce eroso-ciliatis apice pilosulis dorso albo lanatis. Flores radii feminei ligulati 21, corolla lutea circa 30 mm longa 2.5 mm lata 5-nervata apice breviter 3-dentata tubulo lato glabro 4.5 mm longo stylo paulo exserto ramulis glabris truneatis, ovario glabro, pappo albo sericeo circa 5 mm-l longo. Flores disci hermaphroditi circa 270 in capitulo corolla lutea glabra tubulosa 5.5 mm longa, tubulo lato 1.2 mm longo limbo angusto dentibus brevibus obtusiusculis apice papillosis. Antherae circa 2 mm longae basi obtusiusculae. Rami styli truneati apice papilloso-penicillati, ovario glabro; pappus albo-sericeus pilis biseriatis parce breviterque strigosis.
bibliographicCitation: Cuatrecasas, José. 1960. Studies on Andean Compositae--IV. Brittonia. 12: 182-195.

description: This species is a shrub to 2 m tall with capitula ca 5 cm long containing about 12 to 16 flowers. As in the above species, the flowers are reported as being rose- colored, but likely are white (as in related genera) and fade to rose-colored. Originally described from six collections, this species has been recollected several times and appears to be common, growing at lower elevations than does G. bilabiatum. Variety bracteatum was described as distinct due to its tomentose phyllaries, the outermost of which are long attenuate (vs puberulent to densely pubescent and shortly acuminate or attenuate in the typical variety). Recent collections, however, show assorted combinations of these features and the two proposed varieties are taken herein to represent differing expressions of a single entity. This species is endemic to Cerro de la Neblina at elevations of 1670 to 2300 m and is known to flower from October until April with an apparent peak in January and February.

description: Shrubs 0.1-2 m tall; stems tomentose to glabrate, sometimes sprawling. Leaves simple, alternate, petiolate; blade lanceolate to narrowly obovate, coriaceous, glabrate and dark green above, buff-tomentose below, venation pinnate, obviously reticulate, margins entire; petiole clasping. Capitulescence commonly of a solitary, terminal capitulum, less frequently with a second, lower, axillary capitulum. Capitula either isomorphic (ligulate or bilabiate) or heteromorphic (ligulate and bilabiate), ca 12-22-flowered, flowers perfect; involucres cylindric; phyllaries imbricate, elliptic to lanceolate, sometimes caudate, subcoriaceous to scarious, floc- cose to glabrescent; receptacle naked. Corollas zygomorphic, bilabiate or ligulate, glabrous; ligulate corollas, when present, apically coiled; bilabiate corollas, when present, with the larger, outer lip apically coiled or not so, apically 3- or 5-toothed, the inner lip either deeply 2- or 3-cleft, tightly coiled and much shorter than the outer lip or deeply 2-cleft, flexuous and coiled only at apex, frequently nearly as long as the outer lip; anthers cream-colored, generally exserted, apically acute, basally long-sagittate, tails linear, connate; styles red, glabrous, branches clavate, erect or slightly spreading. Achenes glabrous, prismatic, ca 10-nerved, dark brown; pappus multiseriate, of many cream-colored setae, longer than the achenes and about as long as the corolla.

description: Heterothecae horridae ssp. cinerascenti accedens sed foliis utrinque et pedunculis canescentibus, pilis strigosis densis sparsusque hispidis, et phyllaniis dense glandulosis glabratis vel dense strigosis.

description: Perennial from stout woody taproots, the stems several to many, ascending-erect, 1-6 dm tall, white-canescent, densely appressed strigose, hispid hairs very infrequent. Lower stem leaves ovate to oblanceolate, 1.5-4 cm long, 4-12 mm wide, subpetiolate to sessile, cuneate, mucronate, strigose-canescent on both surfaces, margins entire, strigose, a few longer hispid hairs near base; upper stem leaves similar, sessile, reduced upward, sparsely glandular. Capitulescence cymose-corymbiform, heads few to many. Peduncles strigose-canescent, sparsely stipitate-glandular; bracts few, lower ones oblanceolate, strigose like leaves, becoming linear and less pubescent and more glandular near heads. Involucre cylindrical to turbinate when fresh, but campanulate-hemispheric upon drying, 4.5- 7 mm high; phyllaries imbricate, 4-5-seriate, outer ones 1-1.8 mm long, narrowly triangular, stipitate-glandular and glabrate to densely strigose, margins hyaline, fimbriate-ciliate apically; inner ones similar, 4-6 mm long, lower portion somewhat keeled along midrib. Ray florets 12-18, strap yellow, 4-6 mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm wide, tube 3-3.5 mm long, glabrate. Disc florets 25-45, yellow, glabrous, corolla barely ampliate, 3.6-4.2 mm long, lobes 0.4-0.6 mm long, glabrous. Achenes 2.5 mm long, moderately strigose; pappus off-white, double, outer whorl of linear scales 0.4-0.6 mm long, inner whorl of 35-45 barbellate bristles 3-4 mm long.

description: Leaves with the first pair of lateral veins united with the midrib 2-10 mm above its base; length-width ratios 1.2-1.6; apex angles more acute, 50-80º; leaf bases cordate to rounded or subtruncate. Chromosome numbers: n = 15, 20.

description: Shrubs, 2-5 m tall; stems usually densely branched, striate-angulate, 4-10 cm at base, strigose to densely pilose-tomentose, hairs to 1 mm long. Leaves petiolate; blades lanceolate to ovate, 5-10 X 2-10 cm, apices acuminate, bases narrowly attenuate, margins serrate; both faces hirsute-tomentose to strigose, hairs to 1 mm long; petioles 2-6 cm long, 1-3 mm diam., tomentose to to- mentose-lanate, hairs 1 mm long. Capitulescences thyrsoid, with < 100 capitula; peduncles 0.5-1.0 mm long, densely strigose. Capitula radiate, 5 mm high, 3-3.5 mm diam.; phyllaries 3, suborbicular to broadly ovate, 3.5-4.5 X 3-4 mm, 8-9-veined, abaxially glabrous, apices acute, margins ciliate. Pistillate florets 7-9, subtended by ovate paleae, 3.5-4 X 3-3.5 mm, glabrous, scarcely ciliate at apex, 7-veined; corollas white, 1.5 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., glabrous, 3-lobed, lobes 0.4 mm long; styles 2 mm long, branches 0.5-0.8 mm long. Staminute florets 10-15, subtended by lanceolate paleae (occasionally 1-2 central disc florets epaleaceous), 2.5 X 1-1.5 mm, 3-veined; corollas white, 2.5-3 mm long, throats 2 mm long, 1 mm diam., 4-lobed, lobes 0.5 mm long, apices strigillose, hairs 0.3 mm long; anthers black, 1.5 mm long; styles undivided; ovaries 2 mm long, 1 mm diam., glabrous. Cypselae 1.5-1.7 X 1 mm, black, glabrous or sparsely pilose at apex. Chromosome number, n = 16 (Stuessy & Arriagada, 1993).
bibliographicCitation: Arriagada, J. E. 2003. Revision of the genus Clibadium (Asteraceae, Heliantheae). Brittonia. 55: 245-301.

description: Stems several, subligneous at the base, spreading outward and curving upward from a woody caudex; herbage covered with a close, silver-grayish tomentum or glabrate in age. Leaves finely and regularly dissected, with the lateral lobes in turn dissected; the midrib only weakly winged or not winged.

description: Plants annual (or perennial ?), 30-60 cm high; stems erect, 1 to several from the crown of a tap root, the lower portion pubescent with long, spreading hairs, the upper portions glabrous or nearly so (rarely pubeseent throughout); leaves alternate, the lower ones pinnately twice or thrice ternately dissected, the upper ones less dissected, the lowermost forming a rosette but the later ones conspicuously alternate; mid-stem leaves glabrous (rarely pubescent), with petioles 0.6-2 mm long, dissected, the ultimate divisions 5-40 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide; infloreseence a subeorymbose eyme with 15-many heads; heads broadly turbinate, without rays, 7-10 mm across, 9-12 mm high (iucluding the projecting florets), 15- to 30-flowered, on glabrous (rarely viscid) peduncles 5-30 mm long; principal involueral bracts 12-16, linear-oblong, 5-7 mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm wide, glabrous, with white or rose-tinged, membranous margins, broadly obtuse or rounded at the apex; florets white to "lavender-pink" or purplish, distinctly zygomorphic; corolla 5-6 mm long (including the lobes), the tube glandular- pubescent, 2-2.5 mm long; 3 lobes linear and distinct nearly to the tube, the 2 remaining lobes united for 4/5 their length; style branches flattened, 1.5 mm long, stigmatic for about 1/3 their length, just below the acute apex; achenes obpyramidal, 4-sided, 4-5 mm long, villous; pappus of 14-18 linear to lanceolate paleaceous scales, the mid-nerve of each scale forming a conspicuous awn (1-3 mm long) at the apex; chromosome number, n-12 (Fig. 2).

description: Frutices humiles et suffrutices 3 dm usque alti, caulibus herbaceis foliosis e caudice lignoso ra- mosissimo ortis infra inflorescentiam simplicibus glabris; folia caulina majora oblanceolata vel obovata integra cuspidata 4-8 X 1-2.5 cm coriacea reticulatim venosa, vestusta persistentia albicantia; capitula 6.4-8.8 mm longa, bracteis involucri 19-30 modo verticali ordinatis, apice obtusis vel acuminatis; disci flosculi 5-6 flavi, corollis 4.2-4.6 mm, lobis 0.8-1.2 mm longis; lineae stigmaticae styli appen- dicibus aequilongae vel breviores; achaenia pilis 0.5-0.75 mm longis abundanter pubescentia.

description: Low shrubs 2-3 dm tall, much branched from a woody caudex, leafy stems annual, ascending and branching only in the inflorescence, older stems white, younger ones green, glabrous, somewhat glutinous; lowest cauline leaves obovate to orbicular, 2-3 cm long, 10-17 mm wide, old leaves faded white, parchment-like and persistent, major leaves (4) 5-8 cm long, 10-25 mm wide, entire, lacking marginal cilia as in most C. viscidiflorus (Hook.) Nutt., oblanceolate to narrowly obovate, cuspidate, coriaceous, appearing glabrous and lightly glutinous, veins reticulate, leaves near the inflorescence reduced in size and narrowly lanceolate; inflorescence a congested, relatively few-headed, sparingly elongate to flat-topped paniculate cyme; heads (6.4) 6.7-8.5 (8.8) mm long, 1.8-2.1 mm wide, cylindric to somewhat turbinate, bracts (19) 20-24 (30), ovate to lanceolate, vertically aligned, stramineous with apical green spot, tips obtuse to acuminate; disk flowers 5 (6), yellow, corollas 4.2-4.6 mm long, lobes 0.8-1.2 mm long, styles 4.8-5.3 mm long, stigmatic lines usually shorter than style appendages (40-52% of total style branch length); achenes 2.5-3 mm long, cylindric, copiously pubescent with hairs 0.5-0.75 mm long; pappus 3.1-3.9 mm long; n = 9.

description: Frutex; rami crassi dense et compacte ciliereo-pannoso-tomelitosi, innovationibus ochroleucis; folia alterlna v. subverticillata obovata apice late rotundata basi cuLLneata v. cuneato-rotuilndata crasse coriacea mediocria integerrima plana petiolata supra ficte glabra (costa tomentosula excepta) subtus delnsissime einereo- vel ochroleuco-pailnoso-tomentosa penninervia venis primariis 6-7-jugis talntum subtus manifestis, secondariis lnullis; capitula solitaria apice ramorum subsessilia pro genere mediocria ca. 18-flora; involueri anguste campanulati 2.8 cm. alti ca. 12-seriati phyllaria exteriora (ca. 9-seriata) arete gradata anguste lanceolata acuminata subrigida dense einereo-piloso-tomentosa apice glabrato excepto, interiora (ca. 3-seriata) subabrupte lolngiora gradata linearia acuminata substraminea minus dense piloso-tomentosa supra tantum strigillosa; receptaculum paleiferum paleis deciduis angustissimis, aetate areolatum marginibus areolarum pilosis; corollae 19 mm. longae, tubo ca. 3 mm. longo prope apicem intus et externe piloso-barbato, fauce nulla, lobis 5 erectis rigidis 3-nerviis externe prope apicem longe pilosis 16 mm. longis; achenia angulata ca. 10-costata 7 mm. longa dense pilosa; pappus rufeseens 2 cm. longus.

description: Shrub (or tree?) ; branches subterete or subangulate, 5-6 mm. thick, the younger irregularly sulcate; leaves sometimes scattered, sometimes subverticillate (the pseudo-verticels 2-3-leaved), the internodes 1-4 cm. long; petioles thick, pannose-tomentose, 4-8 mm. long; blades 5.8-7 cm. long, 2.5-4 cm. wide, above brownish-green, light-papillate, appearing glabrous but under the binocular microscope rather densely hispidulous with few-celled erect hairs, beneath very densely pannose-tomentose, the costa more or less suleate above and cinereous-tomentulose below the middle, prominent beneath, the lateral veins straightish for most of their length, visible belneath the tomentum but not prominent; involuere about 13 mm. thick, the short outer phyllaries (about 9 series) erect, altogether about 1.5 cm. high, the ininer (about 3 series) rather abruptly longer and less tomentose, spreading when dry or in age strongly reflexed; receptacular pales linear, acute, 25 mm. long, 0.5 mm. wide, somewhat concave below, stramineouis, densely strigillose outside; achenes slenderly obpyramidal, 4-angled, slightly curved, densely subtomentose-pilose with erectish ochroleucous hairs; pappus graduate, the bristles numerous, hispidulous, the inner longer and slightly dilated toward apex; style (unopened flower) about 18 mm. long, roughened in upper half like the back of the style branches, the style branches narrowly triangular-ovate, acute, glabrous, erect, 0.4 mm. long; anthers 10 mm. long, the terminal appendages lanceolate, acuminate, about 1 mm. long, the tails about 1.5 mm. long, linear, bluntish, essentially smooth and entire, those of adjacent anthers connate for about half their length.

description: Shrubs ca 1 m tall; stems lanate to tomentose. Leaves cauline; petioles 0.2-0.3 mm long; blades 7-11 cm long, 2-3.3 cm wide, oblanceolate, apically acute with a minute mucro, basally cuneate, marginally revolute, glabrous to slightly scabrous, often arachnoid basally above, gray-felted beneath. Inflorescences paniculate-cymose, with usually (1) 2 heads and a bracteal leaf at each node, sessile. Heads 15-28-flowered. Involucre campanulate, 8-9 mm high, 6.6-8 mm wide; phyllaries tightly imbricate in 5-6 series, arachnoid, reddish-purple, the inner ones oblong-lanceolate, acute, 6.5-8.5 mm long, 1.6-2.5 mm wide, the outer ones ovate, 2.1-3.2 mm long, 1.6-2.2 mm wide. Pappus brownish, the inner bristles 4.5-6.5 (8) mm long and outer scales 1.3-1.8 mm long. Corollas 7.3-10 mm long, reddish-purple, glabrous. Anthers ca 4-5.5 mm long. Achenes 2-4 mm long, 9-10 ribbed, thinly strigose between ribs, thickly strigose basally. Flowering and fruiting from March to May.
bibliographicCitation: Jones, Jr., Samuel B. 1982. A revision of Vernonia series Buddleiifoliae (Compositae: Vernonieae). Brittonia. 34: 102-117.

description: Lobes of the disk-corollas proportionately very long (0.6-0.9. mm.); style7 branches with very short and broad obtuse appendages; ligules about equaling the disk.

description: Herba perennis, caulibus erectis fistulosis, costatis, glabris, usque ad inflorescentiam foliosis. Folia alterna breviter petiolata, papyracea, oblanceolata, apice acuta, basi longe attenuata, superne minute serrata, utrinque glaberrima reticulato-venosa, circa 9 cm. longa, 12-15 mm. lata; petiolo circa 5 mm. longo. Folia suprema lineari-lanceolata, margine revoluta. Capitula multa, radiata, in paniculis elongatis fastigiatis disposita; pedicellis 8-12 mm. longis, bracteolatis. Involucrum turbinatum, ecalyculatum, 7 mm. altum, 5 mm. crassum, quam floribus disci breviore; bracteis circa 7, lanceolatis, acutis, dorso glabris. Flores di. morphi: marginales 4-5, feminei, ligulati, tubulo 5 mm. longo, ligula oblongo- lanceolata, 7-10 mm. longa, 1.5 mm. lata. Flores disci 8-10, hermaphroditi, corolla tubulosa 7 mm. longa, apice breviter pentadentata: dentibus 1 mm. longis. Achaenia cylindracea, costata, glabra, 2.5 mm. longa. Pappus albus, exasperatus, copiosus, 6-7 mm. longus.

description: Perennial herb with a much-branched moderately slender eaudex; stem and leaves glabrous to edpiously white-strigose with fine mostly appressed hairs; stem 5-15 cm. high, the base usually somewhat indurated and shining, sometimes obscurely so, often purplish; leaves all basal or in the basal cluster, or occasionally a few reduced ones scattered along the stem, linear, 2-7 cm. long, 3-2 mm. wide, or in var. nudatus sometimes 3 mm. wide; head solitary, turbinate or sometimes nearly hemispheric, the disk 7-20 mm. wide; involucre 5-10 mm. high, glabrous or strigose to villous with long slender hairs, especially near the base; phyllaries broad, acute, firm, imbricate, usually green, equaling or shorter than the disk; pistillate flowers absent; disk-corollas mostly 4.5-7.0 mm. long, sometimes a little shorter, the tube 1.0-2.0 mm., the lobes 0.7-1.0 mm.; style-appendages from deltoid and 0.2 mm. long to narrowly triangular and 0.5 mm. long; pappus of about 25-40 slender white or occasionally slightly sordid bristles, usually some of them evidently shorter and slenderer than the others, occasionally with a few fine and inconspicuous outer setae; akenes 2-nerved, glabrous below, short-hairy above. Dry often rocky places at moderate or sometimes high elevations; central Washington to Idaho, central Nevada, and northern California.

description: Arching branched shrubs, 3-4 m tall; stems 3 cm diam., branches forming a right angle, tomentose, hairs 1-2 mm long. Leaves petiolate; blades ovate-lanceolate to widely ovate, 10-18 X 8-13 cm, apices acuminate, bases attenuate exceptionally rounded and truncate; both faces strigose, hairs 1 mm long, margins irregularly dentate-serrate to serrate, teeth ending in short mucro; petioles 2-6 cm long, strigose, hairs 1 mm long. Capitulescences thyrsoid, branches scabrous to lightly strigose, hairs 1 mm long, 5-7 capitula per cluster, radiate, organized in globose glomerules, 1.0 to 1.5 cm diam. with 20-30 tightly aggregated capitula. Capitula 5 mm high, 4 mm diam.; phyllaries 6, 4.5 X 3.5 mm, ovate, nearly glabrous abaxially, margins ciliate on distal one-third, 9-12 veined, apices acute. Pistillate florets 5, subtended by ovate paleae, 4 X 3 mm, 7-veined, glabrous, ciliate at distal one-third; corollas 3.5 mm long, white, tubes 3 mm long, 2 mm diam., 4-lobed, lobes deltoid, shortly ciliate at margins; styles 3 mm long, branches 1.5 mm long. Staminate florets 5-6, epalaceous, corollas 3.5 mm long, throats 2.5 mm long, 1 mm diam., 5-lobed, lobes deltoid, margins scarcely ciliate; anthers 2.5 mm long, black; styles 2.5 mm long, undivided; ovaries 2 mm long, 1.5 mm diam., pilose toward apex, hairs 1-2 mm long. Cypselae 2.5 X 1.8-2 mm, obovate, villous on distal one-third, hairs 1.5 mm long. Chromosome number, n = 16 (Stuessy & Arriagada, 1993).

description: Perennial herb with a usually stout taproot and crown or short slightly branched caudex; stem decumbent or rarely erect at the usually conspicuously reddish-purple base, sparsely to moderately strigose or villous-hirsute with appressed or closely ascending hairs, 5-30 cm. high; leaves pubescent like the stem, the basal ones tufted, conspicuous, triple-nerved (occasionally linear and uninervate in depauperates), acute at the apex, tapering very gradually to the petiole, up to 15 cm. long and 10 mm. wide, usually smaller; cauline leaves several, conspicuously reduced and smaller than the basal ones except in some forms with long linear leaves equaling the heads; heads usually solitary, rarely as many as 7, the involucre 5-7 (rarely 8) mm. high, obscurely to conspicuously glandular, sparsely hirsute to rather densely white-villous-hirsute; phyllaries subequal or clearly imbricate, distinctly green except for the purple tips and sometimes a narrow dark midvein; ligules about 20-50, white or occasionally blue or pink, relatively short and broad, about 5-10 mm. long and 1.0-3.0 mm. wide; disk-corollas mostly 3.5-5.0 mm. long, the tube about 0.7-1.4 mm. long when distinguishable, the lobes about 0.5-0.8 mm. long; style-appendages deltoid to very broadly triangular, obtuse to acutish, about 0.1-0.2 mm. long; pappus of about 15-20 (sometimes 25) fragile bristles, with a few very fine and inconspicuous outer setae; akenes 2-nerved, or occasionally 3-nerved, strigose to shortly villoushirsute. Open places at various elevations; northern Arizona, north through Utah and Colorado to Wyoming and Idaho, thence northwestward to Oregon and Washington (east of the Cascade summits), and southward to central California and adjacent Nevada.

description: Perennial herbs from a simple caudex with numerous, thick, fibrous roots, producing a basal rosette and a long scape. Leaves obovate, elliptic, or obovate, those of spring-flowering plants appearing concurrently with the first heads, 4-16 cm long, 1.2-4.2 cm wide, margins sometimes purple, thickened or slightly revolute and without tomentum, with 5-9 pairs of shallow, dentate, or retrorsely serrate, mucronulate lobes or teeth, apex rounded to oblique, base lyrate to sublyrate, abruptly narrowed to a thin petiole 1/3-1/2 the length of the leaf, glabrous above, thinly tomentose below. Mature scape 22-60 cm tall, slightly dilated under the heads, loosely tomentose when young but becoming floccose or glabrate with maturity, with 1 1-14 lanceolate to linear bracts 4-7 mm long. Heads 1 per stem, 1-3 per plant, erect in bud and flower; involucre turbinate; phyllaries in 3-4 imbricated series, lanceolate, acute, glabrous or less commonly very thinly to- mentose, margins of the inner with a narrow scarious rim, usually with a strongly differentiated mid-region, light green to yellow-green, usually with purple-margined tips, innermost 13-18 mm long, 1.1-1.7 mm wide, outer ?/4-l/2 the length of the inner, all reflexing upon release of achenes; receptacles very shallowly convex, foveolate. Flowers all with fertile ovaries, dimorphic with pistillate flowers ligulate and hermaphroditic flowers tubular, chasmogamous heads with 12-14 (17) pistillate ligulate flowers, pistillate of cleistogamous heads always with re- duced ligules, pistillate corollas bilabiate with the inner lip 2-parted, chasmoga- mous 9.5-14 mm long, cleistogamous 4-7.5 mm long, tubular portion 3.5-6 mm long, ligules rarely deeply cleft, white or sometimes purple-tipped, turning purplish with age, 3-5 nerved, chasmogamous 0.8-1.3 mm wide, cleistogamous up to 0.6 mm wide, styles 6-7.1 mm long with branches 0.2-0.6 mm long; chasmogamous hermaphroditic flowers with strongly to weakly bilabiate corollas, cleistogamous much narrower and nearly regular with very short lobes, white to creamy with lobes often tinged pink or purple, 7.5-8.4 mm long, 0.3-0.8 mm wide; anthers with thecae 1.9-2.1 mm long, apical appendages weakly differentiated, lanceolate, 0.6-0.8 mm long; style branches linear with rounded apices, 0.3-0.5 mm long. Achenes fusiform, 8-8.5 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide with a very slender neck 1/3 to slightly over 1/2 the length of the achene, dark brown or sometimes purple, with 5 lighter colored nerves, densely pubescent over the whole surface with basally bifurcate duplex trichomes; carpopodium a minute, constricted, cartilaginous ring; pappus bristles numerous, very slender and minutely barbellate, silvery-white, 5- 6 mm long at maturity and shorter than the disc corollas. Chromosome number unknown.

description:
Steviae ovatae Willd. maxime affinis sed caulibus simplicibus, foliis crassimembranaceis scabro-pilosis, capitulis (corollis acheniisque quoque) multo majoribus ca. 14 mm latis per anthesin distincta.

Herba perennis ad 5 dm alta. Caules subsimplices erecti infra articulato-pilosi supra crispo-pilulosi; internodia laminis foliorum 11/3-2-plo longiora. Folia opposita petiolata viridia (infima ut videtur purpurascentis); laminae ovatae 3-4 cm longae 1.5-2 cm latae (supra minores) crassomembranaceae venosae subtriplinerviae valde serratae, apice et basi obtusae, supra infraque scabro-pilosae et glanduloso-punctatae; petioli 1-2 cm longi pilosi, infra anguste alati, supra ad laminas expansi; venae supra infraque elevatae. Inflorescentia corymbiformis portione terminali 4 cm lata, saepe inflorescentiis paucis minoribus lateralibus 2-3-capitulatis subtenta; ramuli oppositi crispe vel adpresse puberuli, principales elongati, secundarii deminuti; bracteae brevissimae inconspicuae. Capitula brevipedunculata approximata ca. 14 mm longa per anthesin, phyllariis 11 mm longis 1.5 mm latis viridibus adpresse pilosis, apice acutis vel attentuatis saepe purpurascentibus. Corollae albae (infra virides) ca. 7 mm altae per anthesin, pilulosae; lobi 1.5-2.0 mm longi; fauces 3 mm longae; tubus 2 mm longus. Achenia hetermorpha 5 mm longa pappo excluso, hispida umbrina costis albis brunneisve; pappus 4 adelphocarpiorum 2-3-aristatus, aristis 7.5 mm longis ad apicem purpureis, pappus idiocarpii coroniformis; squamellis unitis 0.7 mm longis flavidis translucentibus irregulariter serrulatis.

description: Shrubs, 0.3-3 m tall; stems extensively branched in candelabra pattern, (co- nifer-like), pachycladous, slightly aveolate, with dense tufts of hairs 2 mm long, dark gray. Leaves crowded, cauline, the sessile blades (1.3) 2-6 (12) cm x (0.1) 1-2 (3) mm, linear (leaves from sprout ca 8 x ca 0.6-0.9 cm wide, linear-elliptic, widest at or below the middle), apically acute to obtuse, basally cuneate to truncate, marginally entire, revolute, rugulose and sometimes remotely glandular, slightly waxy villous to glabrous, midvein sunken above, cinereous-tomentose below. Inflorescences terminal, of subglobose glomerules. Heads 3-5-flowered. Phyllaries 5-8 x 1-1.5 mm, tips fimbriate, sometimes slightly arachnoid. Pappus straw-colored; inner paleas flattened, twisted, (4) 5-7 (8) mm long, outer scales (0.3) 1-2.5 (3.6) mm long. Corollas 5.3-10 mm long, reddish-purple, glabrous. Anthers 3-4.5 mm long. Achenes 2.5-3.5 mm long, ca 10-ribbed, glabrous to sparsely glandular. Chromosome number: n = 17 Ils, Smith 1035 (GA). Pollen type: A to A-B. Flowering and fruiting from November to January or throughout the year.

description: Plants annual, 15-40 cm high, sparsely hirsute, generally erect, divaricate, some of the outer branches decumbent; leaves filiform, linear, lanceolate to lanceolate-ovate, 2.0-7.5 cm long, subentire or trilobed to pinnately lobed or divided, sessile or long-attenuate and subpetiolate at the base, hirsute, often with glandular-capitate trichomes on both surfaces; heads solitary, broadly campanulate, 7-20 mm in diameter; peduncles 7-25 cm long, solitary or dichotomously branched (rarely 3 from the same node), often with a modified, bract-like leaf near the base, densely to sparsely hirsute, rarely subtomentose, trichomes spreading, rarely retrorsely appressed, sparsely to densely interspersed with glandular-capitate trichomes, especially near the head; receptacle conical, 4-5 mm across, 5-7(-8) mm high; chaff persistent, 2-4 mm wide, scarious, glabrous, obovate, 6-8.5(-9.5) mm long, attenuate or awn-like at the apex; involucre (3-)4-5-seriate, outer bracts oblong to obovate, green to purple-tinged, 1.5-5 mm long, 1-2.5 mm wide, sparsely pubescent, usually with short, glandular-capitate trichomes, rounded at the apex; inner bracts progressively longer, oblong to obovate, becoming membranous, the longest 6-7 (-11) mm long, 3-4.5 mm wide, completely or partially purple, the margins membranous, usually purple, rounded to obtuse at the apex; ray flowers 8, pistillate and fertile, tubular at the base for 3-4.5(-7) mm, with conspicuous yellow ligules, (2-)4-7(-13) mm long, (3-)4-10 mm wide, typically reflexed, broadly oblong to suborbicular, obscurely to distinctly 3-lobed at the apex; ray corolla with 2 linear inner lobelets, ca 1 mm long; pappus of the ray florets like that of the disc; disc corollas yellow, 4-6.5(-8) mm long, the tube 1-2.5(-3) mm long. glabrous to pilose the throat abruptly formed, broadly tubular to narrowly funnelform, 2-3.5 mm long, glabrous to pilose at the base, the lobes acute-attenuate, 0.5-2 mm long, densely and minutely pubescent at the apex; style branches revolute, slender (rarely broadened), rather flattened, 1.5-3 mm long, pubescent beneath along the margins, with obscure stigmatic lines on the inner surface, subulate at the apex; achenes black, strongly turbinate, 2-2.5(-3) mm long, densely long hirsute-pilose the hairs to 1.5 mm long; pappus of 25-38 unequal, plumose bristles (with rather short cilia), whitish, brownish, or gray to nearly black, some of the bristles minute between the longer ones and varying from 14 to 34 the length of the longest, 1.5-5.5(-7) mm long; anthers sagittate at the base, 2-3.5(-4) mm long; chromosome number, n = 10, determined in the 7 populations indicated below with an asterisk.

description: Herbaceous annual to winter annual, glabrous, erect, mostly 3-8 (2-12) dm high. Stems terete, striate, variously branching. Leaves opposite, petiolate below to sub- sessile above, mostly 5-15 cm long; lower and median leaves 1- to 2-pinnatified; upper leaves undivided or with a few divisions; all leaflets entire; the terminal leaflet of the median leaves linear-lanceolate to narrowly oblanceolate, mostly 1-6 mm wide. Heads loosely panicled, 2-4 cm across including the rays, on slender peduncles. Involucral bracts glabrous; outer bracts triangular-lanceolate, mostly 1-3 mm long; inner bracts deltoid-oblong to ovate-lanceolate, mostly 4.5-8.0 mm long. Rays 8, rarely 7 or 9, mostly 6-15 mm long, commonly yellow with a reddish-brown base, but with variations ranging from all yellow to all reddish brown. Disk flowers reddish purple toward the apex, yellow to reddish purple toward the base. Style branches broadly obtuse. Achenes linear-oblong, mostly 1.5-2.5 mm long, black wingless or narrowly to broadly (up to 1.1 mm) winged, minutely papillate on one or both sides or glabrous. Chaff of the receptacle linear-acute, deciduous with the achenes. Flowering late June/Aug or later. Habitat in roadside ditches, sandy or gravelly lowlands, railroad ballast. Chromosome number n = 12, 13.

description: Stout herb, the caudex usually subterranean, sometimes short erect; leaves thin coriaceous, ligulate-oblong, 20-40 cm. long, 3-6 cm. broad, scarcely narrowed proximally, obtuse or subacute at apex, entire at margins, copiously einereous lanate on both surfaces, the costa stout, the secondary nerves 1 or 2 per centimeter, irregularly spreading, the veinlets reticulate, usually obscured; flowering branches erect, often 1 m. high, copiously lanate, much-branched, bearing a few small opposite cauline leaves, corymbose-paniculate, the branches subtended by small foliaceous bracts; heads at maturity 2.5-3.5 cm. in diameter; involuere enclosed in a dense mass of fulvous tomentum, the phyllaries numerous, submembranous, lanceolate-oblong, acute, the outer ones 8-10 mm. long, 1.5-3 mm. broad, conspicuously net-veined, densely lanate without; ray florets numerous, 2- or 3-seriate, the corolla 12-16 mm. long, the tube about 1.5 mm. long, truncate distally introrsely, densely pilose with translucent hairs, the lamina linearoblong, 0.8-1.5 mm. broad, usually 2-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas about 5 mm. long, the achene 1.5-2 mm. long; disk florets 6-7 mm. long, the tube hispidulous, shorter than the limb, the lobes oblongdeltoid, the stamens about 5 mm. long; paleae subeoriaceous, stramineous, oblanceolate, 6-7 mm. long, 1-1.5 mm. broad, acute, the outer ones pilose distally without, the inner ones essentially glabrous.

description: Plants 1 m or less tall, much branched; stems lightly pilose, leaf bases prominent; leaves opposite below, subopposite or alternate above; petioles 8 mm long; blades lanceolate, 4.3 cm long, 1.3 cm wide, acuminate to acutish, cuneate at base, entire or nearly so, above canescently appressed-subsericeous-pilose, glabrescent, beneath canescently appressed-silky-pilose, less densely so in age; heads single on peduncles to 15 cm long; disks about 2.3 cm in diameter; phyllaries lanceolate, 8 mm long, 3 mm wide, acuminate with blackish-green tips, densely and loosely pilose above, lighter and indurate below; rays about 9, 15 mm long, 4 mm wide; disk corollas 7 mm long, yellow with dark teeth, sparsely pilosulous; anthers black; pales acuminate, blackish and sparingly pilose above; mature achenes not seen; pappus of 2 lanceolate awns; 3 mm long; pappus of ray achenes of 1 to several lacerate squamrellae, and occasionally 2-3 lanceolate awns.

description:
Frutex scandens ramis tortuosis lenticellato-tuberculatis terminalibus adpre sse squamoso-tomentosis pilis squamosis et substellatis irregularibus munitis.

Folia alterna petiolata firme coriacea. Petiolus 7-10 mm longus crassiusculus plus minusve flexuosus basi incrassato-vaginatus adpresse tomentosus. Lamina ovata vel late ovato4anceolata acuminata basi rotundata vel obtusa margine integerrima, 11-14 cm longa 5-6.5 cm lata; supra viridis in sico tabacina gJabra sed plus minusve pruinosa et costa pubescenti, nervis secundariis filiformibus reticulo nervulorum obsoleto; subtus ochroleuca vel cinerea dense crasseque crispo-tomentosa, pilis stellatis vel substellatis intricatisque tecta costa crassa elevata, nervis secundariis circa 8 utroque latere prominentibus ascendentibus marginem versus minus conspicuis anastomosatisque, venulis in reticulo laxo paulo conspicuo.

Inflorescentiae in cymis corymbiformibus vel paniculatis brevibus axillaribus et subterminalibus quam folia valde breviores 1.5-4 cm longis ramis ramusculisque crassis brevibus adpresse lepidoto-tomentosis. Capitula sessilia vel breviter pedicellata glomerata. Involucrum tubuloso-campanulatum 8 mm altum bracteis scarioso-coriaceis 4-5 seriatis margine ciliatis dorso praecipue subapicem tomentellis vel pruinosis, interioribus 7 mm longis 2-2.5 mm latis oblongis apice acutatis, reliquis gradatim brevioribus oblongo-ovatis et ovatis subobtusis, deciduis. Flores 6 in capitulo, corolla 7 mm longa, tubulo 2.5 mm longo, laciniis 3 mm longis, antheris 3 mnm longis basi acutissime sagittatis. Achaenia oblonga striata glabra 4 mm longa. description: Branching shrub 3-5 m. high, the branchlets woody, subterete, white or einereous lanate; leaves aggregated near ends of branchlets, coriaceous, oblong, 20-35 cm. long, 4-7 cm. broad, narrowed towards the base to 8-10 mm., obtuse or subacute at apex, entire or crenulate at margins, glabrous above, densely and closely pale yellow lanate beneath, the costa prominent, the secondary nerves numerous, parallel, straight, spreading, the veinlets reticulate; iifloreseence amply corymbose- paniculate, many-headed, the branches einereous lanate, subtended by bracts resembling small leaves; expanded heads at maturity 20-25 mm. in diameter; involuere 3- or 4-seriate, the phyllaries about 20, ovate, the outer ones 6-7 mm. long, about 5 mm. broad, acute, densely pilose without; ray florets 17-25, in 1 or 2 series, the corolla 6-7 mm. long, the tube densely pilose, the lamina oblongelliptic, about 3.5 mm. broad, 2- or 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas about 4 mm. long, the achene about 2 mm. long; disk florets sparsely pilose without, 4-5 mm. long, the limb slightly longer than the tube, the lobes deltoid, the stamens about 3 mm. long, the anthers exceeding the filaments; paleae obovate, about 4 mm. long and 3 mm. broad, subacute, pilose distally without.

description: Branching shrub 3-5 m. high, the branchlets woody, subterete, white or cinereous lanate; leaves aggregated near ends of branchlets, coriaceous, oblong, 20-35 cm. long, 4-7 cm. broad, narrowed towards the base to 8-10 mm., obtuse or subacute at apex, entire or crenulate at margins, glabrous above, densely and closely pale yellow lanate beneath, the costa prominent, the secondary nerves numerous, parallel, straight, spreading, the veinlets reticulate; inflorescence amply corymbose-paniculate, many-headed, the branches cinereous lanate, subtended by bracts resembling small leaves; expanded heads at maturity 20-25 mm. in diameter; involucre 3- or 4-seriate, the phyllaries about 20, ovate, the outer ones 6-7 mm. long, about 5 mm. broad, acute, densely pilose without; ray florets 17-25, in 1 or 2 series, the corolla 6-7 mm. long, the tube densely pilose, the lamina oblong-elliptic, about 3.5 mm. broad, 2- or 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas about 4 mm. long, the achene about 2 mm. long; disk florets sparsely pilose without, 4-5 mm. long, the limb slightly longer than the tube, the lobes deltoid, the stamens about 3 mm. long, the anthers exceeding the filaments; paleae obovate, about 4 mm. long and 3 mm. broad, subacute, pilose distally without.

description: Perennial from a taproot that bears thick (4-7 mm), erect caudex branches with adherent, chaffy leaf bases. Stems glabrous, 15-35 cm long. Basal leaves entire, 1-nerved, linear-oblanceolate, (3) 6-1 1 cm long, the blade 2-4 mm wide, gradually tapering to a petiolar base, the lamina glabrous or nearly so, the margins sparsely appressed-ciliate with hairs 0.1-0.3 mm long; cauline leaves similar to the basal, not clasping, very gradually diminished in size upwards. Heads terminal, mostly solitary but occasionally 2 or 3 per stem, hemispheric, 5-6 mm wide (pressed); peduncles 2-7 cm long, naked or minutely bracteate; phyllaries thin, greenish, with scarious margins, densely and minutely granular-glandular, otherwise gla- brous, 2 or 3 seriate, the inner 3-3.5 mm long, the outermost ca half as long. Rays glabrate, 1 1-1 5 in 1 series, 8-9 mm long, the ligules 1.5-2 mm wide, white, drying prominently lilac, the color often concentrated in a midstripe on the lower surface, not coiling or reflexing with maturity. Disc corollas glabrate, funnelform, neither indurate nor inflated, 2.1-2.5 mm long, the throat sharply constricted, ca 0.5 mm long. Style branches 0.6-0.7 mm long, including the shallowly deltate to shallowly or very shallowly triangular collecting appendages 0.1-0.2 mm long. Achenes oblong-obovate, 1.5-2.2 mm long, 0.4-0.6 mm wide, compressed with 2 lateral nerves, very sparsely strigose; pappus of 12-15 barbellate bristles 1.8-2 mm long and a few outer setae 0.1-0.2 mm long. Chromosome number, n = 9.

description: Trees, up to 8 m. Leaves with petioles 10-12 cm long, moderately verrucose and densely woolly-tomentose, blade ovate, 36-50 X 27-36 cm, coriaceous, base deeply cordate, apex obtuse, lower surface densely woolly-tomentose, verrucose at the midrib, the lower surface glabrescent except for the strongly tomentose midrib, reticulate veined, 8-10 secondary veins in each side of the midrib, margins entire. Capitulescences paniculate. Capitula often heterogamous or rarely homogamous, discoid; involucre cylindrical; phyllaries 5, uniseriate, membranous, elliptic-linear, 7.5 x 2.5-3 mm, lightly tomentose-woolly, apex attenuate, slightly acute, ciliolate. Florets 5, hermaphroditic or pistillate, corolla 7-10 mm long, tube 3-4 mm long, limb ca. 6 mm long, lobes linear, ca. 5.5 mm long, apex acute; anthers ca. 3 mm long, base slightly auriculate, terminal appendage lanceolate, acute, sometimes abortive but with persistent filaments; style branches with the apex obtuse, dorsally papillose-pilosulous. Achenes fusiform, ca. 4.5 mm long; pappus 9 mm long.

description: Plant annual, occasionally biennial, tall and stout, mostly 6-15 dm. high, amply leafy; stem sparsely to rather densely hirsute with long spreading hairs, those toward the top commonly shorter and appressed; basal leaf blades moderately hirsute, ample, coarsely toothed, elliptical to broadly ovate or suborbicular, up to 10 cm. long and 7 cm. wide, or even larger, obtusish to rounded at the tip, abruptly or sometimes gradually contracted to the long petiole up to 10 cm. long; cauline leaves numerous, ample, broadly lanceolate or usually wider, usually acute, commonly less pubescent upwards, all except sometimes the upper ones toothed, often very conspicuously so, rarely subentire; heads several to very numerous in a large usually leafy infloreseence; disk 6-10 mm. broad; involuere 3-5 mm. high, the phyllaries subequal or the outer slightly shorter, light greenish or light brownish, variable in width, acuminate or attenuate, finely glandular, and sparsely villous-hirsute with long flattened several-celled transparent hairs; ligules about 80-125, white or occasionally bluish, 0.5-1.0 mm. wide, up to 10 mm. long; disk-corollas about 2.0-2.8 mm. long, with a sharply marked tube 0.5-0.8 mm. long, the limb constricted in its lower half or third, flaring slightly above, with lobes 0.3-0.9 mm. long; style-branches truncate at the apex, or in var. discoideus with very short broad obtuse or rounded appendages; akenes hairy, 2-nerved; pappus double, the outer of slender squamellae, the inner of about 10-15 very fragile bristles, these wanting from the ray flowers.

description: Suffrutex volubilis. Foliis ovatis, 5-12 x 1.8-7 cm, apice caudatis, basi rotundatis vel truncatis, marginibus denticulatis. Capitulis in spicas dispositis. Capitulis ca 3 mm longis. Corollis ca 2 mm longis, dentibus limbi triangularibus, ca 0.3 mm longis. Achaeniis ca 0.5 mm longis. Pappi setis 28-30, 2.5 mm longis, scabridis.

description: Semiwoody liana; stems striate-sulcate, twisted, at first puberulent, soon glabrate; internodes to 18 cm long. Leaves ovate, 5-12 x 1.8-7 cm, at apex narrowed to a caudate tip, margin remotely denticulate, the teeth 1-1.5 cm apart, at base rounded to truncate, subpinnately 5-nerved with two pairs of secondary nerves originating within the basal 1.5 cm of the blade, these arching forward and somewhat parallel to the margins, the tertiary veins forming a somewhat discernible transverse pattern, the major nerves puberulent toward the base of the blade; puberulent to pilose below, glandular-punctate, the tertiary veins forming a trans- verse pattern, but obscured by the smaller prominently reticulate veins; petiole 2-3.5 cm long, puberulent; stipule-like enation formed by opposite petioles, ovate, to 2 x 1.3 cm, puberulent, margins entire to lightly and obscurely sinuate, veins visible. Capitulescence a panicle to 20 cm or more long, the heads ultimately disposed in spikes 1-1.5 cm long, on shorter branchlets the heads sessile and ternately disposed at the tips; bracts lance-ovate, similar to cauline leaves but much reduced; branchlets sulcate, puberulent. Heads ca 3 mm long; outer bract linear-lanceolate, 1-1.5 mm long, pilose to strigose. Phyllaries ovate-oblong, ca 3 mm long, lightly glandular, at apex rounded, densely pilose. Corollas (immature) reddish-brown, ca 2 mm long, tube 0.5-0.6 mm long, throat tubular, ca 1.2 mm long, teeth triangular, glandular, 0.2-0.3 mm long. Achenes (immature) ca 0.5 mm long. Pappus bristles 28-30, ca 2.5 mm long, white, margins scabrid.

description: Stout herb, the caudex subterranean, densely leafy at summit; leaves somewhat papyraceous, oblong, 15-30 cm. long, 1.5-3.5 cm. broad, slightly narrowed proximally to 6-15 mm., obtuse at apex, entire and thickened at margins, loosely lanate and glabrescent above, covered with copious cinereous tomentum beneath, the costa prominent, the secondary nerves 3 or 4 per centimeter, irregularly spreading, the veinlets obscurely reticulate; flowering branches erect, often ligneous, sparsely cinereous lanate, up to 1 m. in height, bearing near base cauline leaves resembling the basal leaves but often subglabrous beneath, copiously branching distally, spreading corymbose-paniculate, many-headed, the branches subtended by foliaceous bracts (bracts ovate-oblong, conspicuously veined, often glandular-hispidulous); heads at maturity 20-30 mm. in diameter; involucre 2- or 3-seriate, the phyllaries about 20, thin membranous, broadly ovate, the outer ones 12-14 mm. long, 7-9 mm. broad, cuspidate, conspicuously net-veined, uniformly viscid-glandular-hispid without; ray florets 40-60, about 2-seriate, the corolla about 12 mm. long, the tube 2 mm. long, viscid-glandular-hispid, the lamina oblong, about 2.5 mm. broad, 3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas about 5 mm. long, the achene 2.5-3 mm. long; disk florets 7-8 mm. long, the tube shorter than the limb, glandular-hispidulous, the limb glabrous, the lobes deltoid-ovate  the stamens about 6 mm. long, the anthers and filaments subequal; paleae membranaceous, linear-oblong, about 7 mm. long, 0.5-1.5 mm. broad, acute, minutely glandular-hispidulous without.

description: Rami terminales angulati glabri parce granulato.glandulosi, plus minusve flexuosi. Folia subcoriacea altema sessilia anguste oblanceolato-oblonga apice acuta basi anguste attenuata, margine integra revolutaque, 3-5.5 cm longa 0.8-1.2 cm lata; supra viridia glabra nitentia laevia nervis inconspicuis; subtus in sicco tabacina glabra tantum costa elevata, nervis secundariis paucis remotis ascen- dentibus prope marginem anastomosatis fere obsoletis, venulis laxe reticulatis vix invisibilibus. Flores masculi valde juveniles pappo pilis strigulosis subcapillaribus acutis.

description: Erect annual herb up to 3.8 dm tall; stems strigose-hirsute, sericeous at the younger nodes; leaves linear to lance-linear, sessile to subsessile, strigose-scabrous, up to 7 cm long and 7 mm wide; peduncles strigose below, tomentose above, up to 7 cm long but generally shorter; heads hemispheric, ea 9.8 mm wide; phyllaries broadly obovate, yellowish brown with a dark summit band, searious to sericeous, their apices rounded; rays 7-9, bright orange, oblong, ca 15 mm long, smooth above, the two prominent nerves below and the apical one third of the ray pubescent, the tube pubescent ea 1.1 mm long; ray achenes oblanceolate, 3-angled, ea 3 mm long the margins ciliate when young; achene entirely tubereulate when older, the pappus of 2 horns; disk corollas 4.8 mm long, orange with yellow marginal hairs inside the lobes, black or dark purple and lightly pubescent outside and below; disk achenes obovate, laterally flattened to 3-angled, up to 3 mm long, the margins ciliate when young, otherwise smooth, the pappus of a single long eaducous awn; chaff entirely yellow or orange only at the tips, glabrous, the apices acute to obtuse, entire to minutely erose, subeuspidate; receptable conical.
bibliographicCitation: Torres, Andrew M. 1963. Taxonomy of Zinnia. Brittonia. 15: 1-25.

description: Perennial plants, 3-13 dm tall, one to several stems originating from rootstock, either unbranched or sparingly branched above. Stems narrowly to occasionally moderately winged, glabrous below, glabrous to sparsely pubescent above with short crisped hairs. Peduncles (6-)10-30 cm long, sparsely to moderately pubescent with short crisped hairs, ca. 2-4 times as wide at the top as at the base. Leaves glabrous to sparsely pubescent, entire, apices acute to obtuse, midrib prominent, and lateral veins easily visible in most leaves; radical leaves usually oblanceolate to oblong- elliptic with clasping petioliform bases; lower and middle leaves lanceolate to oblong- elliptic, often clasping the stem; upper leaves linear to lanceolate. Heads one to few, hemispherical to usually globoid, 12-20 mm high, (14-)17-22(-25) mm wide (ex- cluding rays). Receptacle globoid, (2-)3-5 (-7) mm high, 4-8 mm wide. In- volucral bracts united at the base, reflexed at anthesis, moderately to densely pubescent. Ray florets 14-20; ligules 13-25 mm long, 5-10(-12) mm wide, yellow, moderately pubescent on the undersurface. Disc corollas 5-lobed, cylindrical to cylindric-campanulate, 3.0-4.4(-4.8) mm long, 1.0-1.4 mm wide, yellow with yellow to brown to purple lobes. Achenes 1.8-2.4 mm long, 0.7-1.0 mm wide, moderately pubescent with relatively long hairs. Pappus scales 6-8, 1.3-2.2 (-2.7) mm long, including the terminal awn, 0.3-0.4 mm wide, ca. 1/3-2/3 as long as the disc corolla. Chromosome number, n = 16.

description: Plant mostly 3-8 dm. high, erect; leaves tending to be relatively narrower than in var. debiltis; heads several or many, the penducles stiffly ascending-spreading or more or less areuate; peduncles and involueres glandular, often also more or less hirsute; ligules generally pinkish, commonly narrower than in var debitis, only slightly if at all exceeding the pappus; pistillate flowers averaging more numerous than in the other varieties; pappus averaging longer and more reddish than in the other varieties.

description: Suffrutex basi ramosus, dense glanduloso-pubescens, usque ad inflorescentiam foliosus, circa 70 cm. altus. Folia alterna (internodiis 8-40 mm. longis), sessilia, late elliptica, obtusa, inferne angustata, basi dilatata auriculato-semiamplexicaulia, margine et auriculis dentata vel serrata, utrinque glanduloso-pubescentia, 5-11 cm. longa, 2.5-4.5 cm. lata. Capitula multa, radiata, in cymis corymbiformibus apice caulium disposita; pedunculis divaricatis 20(40 mm. longis, glanduloso-pubescentibus. Involucrum campanulatum, calyculatum, 7-9 mm. altum, 7-8 4mm. crassum. Bracteolae calyculi breves, lineares. Bracteae involucrales circa 20, lineares, apice attenuatae, dorso glanduloso-pubescentes. Flores lutei, dimorphi, marginales feminei 10-12, ligulati: tubulo 5 mm. longo, ligula oblonga 12 mm. longa, 3 mm. lata, apice tridentata. Flores disci multi, hermaphroditi, corolla tubulosa 7 mm. longa, apice pentadentata: dentibus 0.7 mm. longis, deltoideis. Achaenia cylindracea, costata, laxe sericeo-pubescentia. Pappus albus, 7 mm. longus.

description: Herbs to subshrubs ca 0.5-1.5 m tall; stems single or clumped, erect, subterete, coarsely striate, puberulent to moderately pubescent, branched only in the uppermost nodes, internodes ca 2-9 cm long, generally as long as, or in the upper nodes, longer than leaf whorls. Leaves whorled with (3) 4 (5) leaves per verticel, essentially sessile; blade subcoriaceous (fleshy fide Irwin et al. 18778), elliptic to elliptic-ovate, (2.5) 3.5-6.5 cm long, (1.3) 2-3 cm wide, basally cuneate, apically acute, coarsely serrate, with ca 4-7 pairs of sharp-tipped teeth, venation pinnate, less commonly somewhat triplinerved, upper surface green or greenish-brown, smooth, less commonly rugulose, puberulent, less often strigulose with uniseriate, multicellular, arcuate trichomes, lower surface paler green, smooth but generally with veins darker than areoles and thus appearing reticulate, puberulent to pubescent with arcuate trichomes as on upper surface and glandular pubescent, sometimes densely so with multicellular, biseriate, globular trichomes (glands), less commonly obscurely glandular or pustulate. Capitulescence essentially ter- minal, cymose, of ca 4-20 capitula, each of these terminal on axillary branches which occur in the upper 2 to 4 nodes; peduncles ca 3-15 cm long, weakly puberulent to strongly pubescent. Capitula radiate, ca 45-76-flowered; involucre hemispheric, 12-15 mm high, 12-15 (18) mm broad, 4-6-seriate; phyllaries ca 35-40, imbricate, graduated, the ca 3-8 outer ones elliptic to ovate, 6-9 mm long, 3.5-4.5 mm wide, entirely herbaceous or at least apically so, with ca 5 parallel nerves, abaxially puberulent and sometimes also lightly glandular, apically acute, less commonly obtuse, margins entire or once-toothed, the inner series of phyllaries elliptic-ovate to elliptic, 10-13 mm long, 4-6 mm wide, scarious or mem- branous apically, with ca 20 parallel nerves, glabrous, apically acute to obtuse, entire; receptacle clavate, 8-9 mm tall, 3-3.5 mm broad, paleaceous, the paleae narrowly elliptic, 9-11 mm long, 1.8-2.5 mm wide, pale yellow, slightly conduplicate, entire. Rayflorets ca 14-23 in 2 series; corolla ca 15-16 mm long, yellow, the tube 3-4 mm long, glabrous, the ligule 5-13-nerved, ca 12 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, apically obtuse, abaxially glandular; style ca 6-7 mm long, branches re- curved, ca 0.7 mm long. Discflorets ca 30-5 3; corolla cylindric, 6.7-7.1 mm long, glabrous, yellow to golden-yellow, tube 2.2-2.5 mm long, limb only slightly wider than tube, throat 3.1-3.6 mm long, lobes 5, erect, triangular, 1-1.3 mm long; anthers only slightly exserted, yellow, ca 3 mm long, apical appendage deltoid, often densely glandular abaxially; style to ca 7.3 mm long, branches ca 0.7 mm long. Achenes of ray and disc florets similar, turbinate, strongly 4-angled, 3-3.5 nm long, black, puberulent on angles, otherwise glabrous; carpopodium tan, non- sculptured; pappus of ca 10, subequal, lanceolate, apically acute, marginally ser- rulate, stramineous scales, 1.5-2.2 mm long. Pollen heliantheous, ca 21-30 ,gm diam. Chromosome number, n = 1811 (based on Turner 9143 reported as Calea reticulata Gardner by Turner et al., 1979; also see discussion below).

description: Herbacea vel suffruticosa ca 0.5-1.5 m alta; caules puberuli, striati, intemodiis ca 2-9 cm longis; folia verticillata plerumque quatema, sessilia; lamina subcoriacea, elliptica vel elliptico-ovata, (2.5)3.5-6.5 cm longa, (1.3) 2-3 cm lata, serrata, pinnatim venosa, glabriuscula vel pubescens, plerumque glandulosa; capitulescentia terminalis, cymosa; pedunculi 3-15 cm longi; capitula heterogama, pale- acea; involucrum hemisphaericum, 12-15 mm longum, 12-15 (18) mm latum; phyllaria gradata, 4- 6-seriata; receptaculi paleae ellipticae, 9-11 mm longae, integrae; flosculi radiati ca 14-23, biseriati, corolla ca 15-16 mm longa, luteola, tubo 3-4 mm longo, limbo 5-13-nervio, ca 12 mm longo, glandulifero; flosculi disci ca 30-53, corolla 6.7-7.1 mm longa, glabra, luteola, lobis 1-1.3 mm longis; achaenia turbinata, 4-angulata, nigra, puberula, 3-3.5 mm longa; pappi squamae ca 10, lanceolatae, 1.5-2.2 mm longae.

description: Perennial, reproducing vegetatively by rhizomes. Stems erect, pubescent throughout, simple to the inflorescence, 8-15 dm high. Leaves cauline, numerous, 7-17 cm long, 2-6 cm wide, elliptic to ovate-lanceolate, with sparse T-shaped and L-shaped trichomes above, dense T-shaped trichomes together with sparse L-shaped trichomes and stalkless trichomes and bilobed glands below, with acute tips, acute to cuneate bases, and serrate margins. Inflorescence loose to irregular, center heads opening first. Heads 17-34 flowered. Involucre cylindric to hemispheric with involucral bract tips loosely spreading to recurved, 4.7-8.0 mm high, 4.0-6.0 mm wide; inner bracts lanceolate, 4.8-8.1 mm long, acute to acuminate; outer bracts cordate to attenuate, 2.0-4.0 mm long, acute to acuminate; bracts brownish to purplish sometimes with a prominent midrib, pubescent along margins, sometimes on inner or outer surface. Achenes puberulent to glabrous on the ribs, 2.5-4.0 mm long. Pappus straw-colored to brown sometimes with a purple tinge, inner bristles 5.0-6.5 mm long, outer scales 0.5-0.8 mm long. Flowers from July through August.

description: Perennial herb with a branched usually stout caudex; stem 2-30 cm. high, hirsute with loosely spreading hairs, and more or less viscid or finely glandular; leaves hirtellous or short-hirsute with more or less spreading hairs, sometimes obscurely viscid or glandular as.well, occasionally becoming glabrous at maturity; basal leaves oblanceolate to elliptic or obovate, up to about 7 cm. long and 12 mm. wide, usually much smaller, obtuse or rounded at the apex, the blade commonly rather abruptly contracted to the petiole; cauline leaves few, reduced and linear, or none, or the lowermost sometimes oblanceolate; head solitary, the disk 8-18 mm. wide; involuere 5-8 mm. high, equaling or surpassing the disk, glandular and more or less hirsute or villous-hirsute with spreading hairs, sometimes only sparsely so; phyllaries about equal, green, with purple margins and tips, or more or less purplish throughout; ligules about 25-125, blue, rose-purple, or pink, about 5-13 mm. long and 1.2-2.6 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.0-4.8 mm. long, the tube 0.6-1.5 mm., the lobes 0.5-0.7 mm.; style-appendages deltoid-ovate, acutish, 0.15-0.3 mm. long; pappus of about 10-15 (occasionally 20) coarse but rather fragile bristles, with or without a few obscure outer setae; akenes 2-nerved, somewhat hairy.

description: Frutex 2 met. altus ramulis terminalibus robustis plus minusve flexuosis angulatis dense crispo-tomentosis cinereis vel fuliginosis. Folia opposita petiolata crasse rigideque coriacea. Petiolus 10-15 mm. longus crassus flexuosus supra sulcatus infra carinatus dense adpresseque tomentosus. Lamina ovata basi profunde cordata apice obtusa vel subrotundata margine integra plana, 4.5-6.5 cm. longa 3-5 cm. lata; supra atroviridis juvenilis crispo-ochraceo-pubescens, mox nervo medio excepto glabra subnitida costa angusta impressa tomentella nervis secundariis obsoletis vel paulo impressis, venulis minutum reticulum prominulum formantibus; infra ochracea vel ochraceo-cinerea dense crispulo-tomentosa costa crassa elevata, nervis secundariis elevatis 7-8 utroque latere patulis marginem versus furcato-anastomrosatist nervulis laxe reticulatis crassiusculis prominulis. Inflorescentiae terminales cymoso-paniculatae basi foliosae folia excedentes axi robusto basi 4-angulato extremo compresso, ramulis valide crassis ancipite compressis; pedicellis 4.10 mm. longis crassis compressis plurimis bracteolis crassiusculis 1-1.5 mm. longis ad apicern brevitem calyculum formantibus munitis. Axi ramuli pedunculique dense compresseque crispulo-tomentosi griseo- ochracei vel fuliginosi. Capitula radiata involucro cylindraceo 8 bracteis sub- coriaceis 8 mm. longis circa 3 mm. latis exterioribus dense tomentosis, interiori- bus margine late scariosis, costa crassa dense tomentosa. Flores marginales feminei 5-7 ligulatae, corolla circa 14 mm. longa tubulo 5 mm. longo ligula elliptico-oblonga 3-3.2 mm. lata. Flores disci hermaphroditi 12, tubulosi corolla 7.5 mm. longa glabra tubulo 3 mm. longo dentibus linearibus circa 1.8 mm. longis. Stigmata conica apiculata. Ovarium glabrum. Pappus stramineus 6 mm. longus pilis apice paulo dilatatis.
bibliographicCitation: Cuatrecasas, José. 1954. New species of Compositae from Ecuador, collected by W. H. Camp. Brittonia. 8: 39-79.

description: Lvs. leathery deep green above, ochraceous pubescent below. Ray and disc fls. and style branches bright yellow; anthers pale yellow with brown ribs. W. H. Camp E-5156 (F, holotype).
bibliographicCitation: Cuatrecasas, José. 1954. New species of Compositae from Ecuador, collected by W. H. Camp. Brittonia. 8: 39-79.

description: Perennis, rhizomatifer. Caule 6-10 dm. alto, glabro ad inflorentiain; ramis parse pilosis secunndun lineas decurrentes; foliis caulis ovatis, sessilibus, amplexis, parce serratis, 6-10 cm. longis, 2-4 cm. latis, acutis, glabris marginibus ciliolatis exceptis; foliis superioribus magis cordato-sagittatis, integris; capitulis numerosis, in panieula magna; disco 7-8 mm. alto, 1 cm. lato; bracteis imbricatis; apicibus viridibus rhombico-oblanceolatis; ligulis 20, lucide caeruleis, 8 mm. longis.
bibliographicCitation: Rydberg, Per A. 1934. Taxonomic notes on the flora of the prairies and plains of central North America. Brittonia. 1: 79-104.

description: Plantae fruticosae ca 1-1.5 m altae; caules pubescentes, intemodiis 8-13 cm longis; folia opposita et decussata, petiolo 6-9 mm longo, leviter canaliculato, lamina elliptica, chartacea vel coriacea, penninervia, 3.5-8 x 2-4 cm, subrubella, tomentosa; capitulescentia terminalis, corymbosa; pedunculi 0-2.5 cm longi; involucrum cylindricum, 3-5-seriatum; capitula heterogama; flosculi radiati 3-5, corollis 9-11.5 mm longis, glanduliferis, luteolis, tubo 3-3.5 mm longo, limbo 5-nervio, 6-8 mm longo, apice inciso; flosculi disci 14-17, corolla 6-7 mm longa, glandulifera, luteola, lobis 2.2-3 mm longis; paleae ellipticae, 8.5-9.7 mm longae; pappi squamae ca 10, lanceolatae, 2.2-3 mm longae; achaenia 3-4 mm longa, confertim pubescentia.
bibliographicCitation: Pruski, John F. 1984. Galea brittoniana and Galea kristiniae: two new Compositae from Brazil. Brittonia. 36: 98-103.

description: Shrubs ca 1-1.5 m tall; stems erect, subterete, densely pubescent, finely striate, internodes mostly 8-13 cm long; leaves opposite and decussate, the petiole 6-9 mm long, slightly canaliculate, pubescent, the blade elliptic, chartaceous to coriaceous, slightly rugose, penninerved, 3.5-8 x 2-4 cm, at apex acute or rounded, at base cuneate, the margins serrate with 5-15 pairs of teeth, the upper surface reddish when young, sometimes turning pale green with age, densely tomentose with multicellular trichomes and moniliform hairs, and when young with obscure resinous, biseriate, globular trichomes (glands), these glands becoming apparent and the dominant type of indumentum on the upper surfaces of older leaves, the lower surface reddish when young and becoming only slightly paler with age, often prominently reticulate, densely tomentose at all ages, pubescence as on upper surface; inflorescence terminal, corymbose, ca 8 cm broad, of many densely packed, branched, 5-9-headed clusters; peduncles 0-2.5 cm long, densely pubescent; involucre cylindric, 9-12 x 7-10 mm, 3-5-seriate, phyllaries 15-19, imbricate, graduated, the outer ones elliptic-lanceolate, 3-4 x ca 1 mm, either herbaceous and densely pubescent abaxially or scarious with herbaceous, abaxially densely pubescent, commonly rounded apices, the inner ones ovate to elliptic, 7.5-9 x 3.4-4.2 mm, ca 5-7-striate, scarious with herbaceous tips, commonly densely pubescent abaxially towards the acute or rounded apex; capitula radiate, 17-22-flowered; ray flowers 3-5, the corolla 9-11.5 mm long, yellow, the tube 3-3.5 mm long, glandular, the ligule 5-nerved, 6-8 x 2-3 mm, notched at apex, abaxially glandular; disk flowers 14-17, the corolla yellow, 6-7 mm long, glandular especially near the tube and throat juncture, the tube 2-2.8 mm long, throat broad and campanulate, the lobes slightly reflexed, 2.2-3 mm long, the anthers only partially exserted, yellow, 2.2-3 mm long, rounded at base, the apical appendage deltoid, abaxially glandular, the style 7.2-7.8 mm long with truncate branches ca 1.2 mm long; receptacle clavate, ca 2.5 x 1.5 mm; paleae elliptic, 8.5-9.7 x 2-3 mm, conduplicate, entire or slightly trifid, pale yellow, scarious; pappus of ray and disk florets similar, of ca 10, subequal, lanceolate, stramineous, serrulate, essentially distinct scales, 2.2-3 mm long; achenes of rays and disks similar, linear, prismatic or somewhat flattened, ca 4-angled, 3-4 mm long, densely pubescent, carpopodium non-sculptured; pollen heliantheous, ca 33-38 µm in diam. Chromosome number unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Pruski, John F. 1984. Galea brittoniana and Galea kristiniae: two new Compositae from Brazil. Brittonia. 36: 98-103.

description: Trees, to 3 m. Leaves with petioles 12-30 mm long, tomentulose; blade obovate-elliptic, 9-15 X 4-7 cm, coriaceous, base cuneate, apex obtuse, lower surface tomentose, upper surface glabrous, reticulate veined, 9-11 secondary veins on each side of the midrib, the margins sinuate or suben- tire, but with minute callous teeth. Capitulescences paniculate-corymbiform. Capitula homogamous, discoid; involucre cylindrical; phylaries 5, weakly biseriate, subcoriaceous, outer phyllaries oblong-elliptic, 9.5 X 2 mm, glabrous, apex slightly attenuate, subobtuse, slightly barbellate-ciliolate, inner phyllaries elliptic, 8.5 X 3 mm, glabrous, apex obtuse, margins scarious. Florets 5-6, hermaphroditic, corolla 11-12.5 mm long, tube ca. 6 mm long, limb ca. 5.5 mm long, deeply 5-lobed, lobes linear, ca. 5 mm long, apex acute; anthers ca. 3.5 mm long, base sagittate, deeply caudate, terminal appendage oblong-attenuate, acute; style branches with the apex somewhat attenuate, subacute, dorsally papillose-pilosulose. Achenes oblong, ca. 3 mm long; pappus 8-9 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Correa, A. 2003. Revision of the genus Paragynoxys (Asteraceae, Senecioneae-Tussilagininae). Brittonia. 55: 157-168.

description: Trees, to 10 m. Leaves with petioles 8-9 cm long, densely tomentose; blade oblong-elliptic, 25-30 X 12-14 cm, coriaceous, base cordate, apex obtuse, lower surface densely tomentose, upper surface glabrous except for the tomentose midrib, reticulate veined, ca. 12 secondary veins on each side of the midrib, the margins entire. Capitulescences thyrsoid-paniculate. Capitula homogamous, discoid; involucre cylindrical; phyllaries 8, weakly biseriate, subcoriaceous, outer phyllaries lanceolate, ca. 7.5 X 2 mm, densely tomentose, apex subacute, inner phyllaries ovate, ca. 7 X 3 mm, tomentose medially, apex subacute, margins scarious. Florets 8, hermaphroditic, corolla ca. 10 mm long, tube ca. 7 mm long, limb ca. 3.3 mm long, lobes ca. 3 mm long, linear, apex acute; anthers ca. 4 mm long, base slightly caudate, terminal appendage apiculate, obtuse; style branches with the apex obtuse, dorsally pilose. Achenes ca. 3.5 mm long; pappus 10 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Correa, A. 2003. Revision of the genus Paragynoxys (Asteraceae, Senecioneae-Tussilagininae). Brittonia. 55: 157-168.

description: Stem commonly glabrous except directly under the heads; uppermost leaves ovate, rarely strongly ciliate all around, not at all hairy on the surfaces; phyllaries without hairs.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Plant perennial from a stout rhizome or often a well developed woody caudex; stem more or less hirsute with spreading or appressed hairs, sometimes nearly glabrous, about 3-8 dm. high; foliage ample and equable, or sometimes the cauline leaves reduced and smaller than the numerous basal ones; leaves entire or sometinmes coarsely toothed, hirsute on both surfaces, the basal and lowermost cauline ones 8-20 cm. long and 15-35 mm. broad, the blade oblanceolate or elliptical, tapering to the petiole; middle eauline leaves narrowly lanceolate to oblong or ovate, rather acute, 4-12 cm. long, 7-30 mm. wide, sessile; uppermost leaves linear to ovate, 1-4 cm. long, 2-10 mm. wide, often few and distant; heads 1-4 or rarely 7,the disk about 6-10 mm. high and 12-20 mm. wide; phyllaries more thickened and less herbaceous than in E. peregrinus, attenuate, loose at the tips, subequal, 0.3-0.8 mm. wide, conspicuously white-hirsute on the lower 1-3, glandular thence to the tips, the outermost sometimes hirsute nearly to the tips; ligules 45-80, about 10-15 mm. long, 2-3 mm. wide, white to pink-purple; disk-corollas mostly 3-4 mm. long, gradually widening upwards, with no well-defined tube at the base, the holes about 0.6-0.9 mm. long; stvle-appendages deltoid-ovate, barely acute, mostly about 0.25 mm. long; akenes sparsely hairy, obscurely 4-angled anid prominently 2-nerved, or sometimes 4-nerved, with 1 nerve on each angle; pappus simple, of about 20-30 bristles.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Stems 3-6 dm high. Middle stem leaves 1.1 (0.5-3.1) cm wide, 7.2 (3.7-10.4) cm long, ovate-lanceolate, scabrous above especially near the margins, margin serrate. Inflorescence very dense, the heads often in rounded clusters. Inner phyllaries up to 2.5 mm wide.
bibliographicCitation: Jones, Jr., Samuel B. 1972. A systematic study of the Fasiculatae group of Vernonia (Compositae). Brittonia. 24: 28-45.

description: Plant biennial or short-lived pereninial with a simple or subsimple caudex and taproot; heads mostly solitary on erect sparsely leafy or subnaked stems 5-40 cm. long; some of the main stems, or branches of the flowering stems, becoming long, trailing, sparsely leafy stolons, these apparently sometimes rooting at the ends, sometimes turning upwards and bearing each a head; stem and leaves slightly to moderately hirsute or strigose with appressed hairs, or the hairs at the base of the stem rarely spreading; basal leaves oblanceolate, petiolate, acute or obtuse, persistent, up to 5 cm. long and 8 mm. wide, usually smaller, entire to pinnately fewlobed; cauline leaves linear to narrowly linear-oblanceolate, mostly 1-3 cm. long (sometimes smaller), 1-4 mm. wide; disk 7-13 mm. wide; involuere 3.5-5 mm. high, finely glandular, and sparsely to moderately hirsute with usually appressed or sometimes spreading short hairs; phyllaries variable in texture and color, often greener than in E. divergens, sometimes with a purplish cast, sometimes more chartaceous at the base than above, suggesting Aster, the outer ones, as in E. divergens, usually narrower than the inner; ligules mostly 50-100, sometimes only 30 in var. trilobatus, or as many as 125, white, occasionally pink or blue, 5-10 mm. long, mostly about 1 mm. wide; disk-corollas much like those of E. divergens, but averaging larger, 2.5-3.5 mm. long, the nerveless white part of the limb not so prominent nor well developed; style-appendages mostly -0.1-0.15 mm. long, ovate, obtuse; pappus double, the inner of about 10-15 bristles, the outer of fine inconspicuous setae; akenes sparsely pubescent to nearly glabrous, 2-nerved.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Arching shrubs, 3 m tall; stem 10 cm diam.; stems and branches strigose-pilose, older branches tomentose, hairs 1 mm long. Leaves petiolate; blades ovate to ovate-lanceolate, subcoriaceous, 7-13 X 2-5 cm, densely strigose, hairs 0.6-1 mm long, apices briefly acuminate, bases obtuse, margins serrate to serrate-serrulate, veins prominent; petioles 1-2 cm long, strigose, hairs 1 mm long. Capitulescences thyrsoid, with 3 terminal glomerules. Capitula radiate, ovoid-subglobose, short-pedicellate, 4-4.5 mm high, 3.3-4 mm diam.; phyllaries 3, ovate, 4.5 X 2.5-3 mm, margin shortly ciliate at distal one-third, 4-5-veined. Pistil- late fiorets 5-10, subtended by ovate paleae, 4 X 3 mm, margins ciliate on distal one-third, 3-veined; corollas 2 mm long, 0.6 mm diam., white, tubulate, 2-lobed, lobes irregularly deltoid, 0.5 mm long, scarcely pilose toward apex. Staminate fiorets 5-10, subtended by ovate to ovate-rhomboid paleae, 3 X 1.5-2 mm, apices acuminate, margins shortly ciliate on distal one-third, 1-veined; corollas 3 mm long, 0.8 mm diam., white, 5-lobed, lobes 0.6 mm long, scarcely strigose toward apex; anthers 1-1.2 mm long, black, glabrous; styles 1.5 mm long, undivided, ovaries 2 mm long, 1 mm diam., distal half pilose, hairs 0.5 mm long. Cypselae 2 X 1.5 mm, with short ring-shaped apical projection, exocarp fleshy, glabrous. Chromosome number, n = 16 (Stuessy & Arriagada, 1993).
bibliographicCitation: Arriagada, J. E. 2003. Revision of the genus Clibadium (Asteraceae, Heliantheae). Brittonia. 55: 245-301.

description: Stems 5-14 dm high. Middle stem leaves 1.8 (0.9-4.5) cm wide, 12.2 (8-18) cm long, narrowly lanceolate to broadly lanceolate, glabrous to minutely puberulent above, margin denticulate to sharply serrate. Inflorescence usually flat and dense. Inner phyllaries up to 1.8 mm wide.
bibliographicCitation: Jones, Jr., Samuel B. 1972. A systematic study of the Fasiculatae group of Vernonia (Compositae). Brittonia. 24: 28-45.

description: Suffrutex, caule tereti, striato, 50-100 cm alto, adpresse pubescente; foliis alternis, membranaceis, petiolatis, deltoideis, dentatis, glabris, 4 cm longis 2 cm latis; capitulis 5 vel 6 apice ramorum glomeratis; receptaculo, nudo,, conico; involucro biseriato, bracteis ovalibus, membranaceis, apice rotundatis, + aequalibus, 3 mm longis; floris 25-30; corolla alba, infundibuliformi, 1.8 mm longa, basi tubi pilis hispidis munita; achaenio nigro, glabro, 5-costato, 1.2 mm longo, apice callo caliciformi munito.
bibliographicCitation: Barroso, G. & King, Robert M. 1971. New taxa of Compositae (Eupatorieae) from Brazil. Brittonia. 23: 118-121.

description: Shrubs 1-2 m high; stems brownish pubescent. Leaves very stiff, cauline, spaced 3-4 cm apart; petioles 2-5 mm long, pubescent; blades 10-14 x 5-6 cm, elliptic, apically acute, terminated by a callous tooth, basally cuneate, marginally slightly revolute with prominent callous teeth, glabrous but pubescent along mid- vein, prominently reticulate-veined above, pubescent and prominently veined below. Inflorescences paniculate-corymbose. Heads 1-flowered; peduncles almost sessile to 1 mm long, pubescent. Involucre cylindric, 6-7.5 x 2-2.5 mm. Phyllaries loosely appressed in ca 6 series, greenish tinged with purple; inner phyllaries deciduous, oblong-lanceolate, acuminate, 5.4-6.2 x 1-1.4 mm, outer ones ovate, 0.6-0.9 x 0.6-0.8 mm. Pappus white, the inner bristles 8-9 mm, outer ones 0.7-2 mm long. Corollas ca 8 mm long, pubescent. Anthers ca 2.5 mm long. Achenes 3-3.2 mm long, 8-9-ribbed, strigose, soon deciduous. Pollen type A. Flowering and fruiting from January to February.
bibliographicCitation: Jones, Jr., Samuel B. & Stutts, John G. 1981. Three new species of Vernonia (Compositae: Vernonieae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 33: 544-546.

description: Frutex ligneus 1-2 m altus. Folia 10-14 x 5-6 cm. Capitula uniflora. Corollae pubescentes. Achaenia strigosa, 8-9-nervia, 3-3.2 mm longa.
bibliographicCitation: Jones, Jr., Samuel B. & Stutts, John G. 1981. Three new species of Vernonia (Compositae: Vernonieae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 33: 544-546.

description: Perennial herbs. Stems erect, glabrous or minutely puberulent, simple to the inflo- rescence, 3-7 dm high. Leaves numerous; middle stem leaves 0.5 (0.2-1.3) cm wide, 8.8 (5.2-15.4) cm long, broadly linear, essentially glabrous on both sides but scabrous along the upper margins and deeply pitted beneath with sessile glandular trichomes, apically acute, narrowed to a sessile base, margin entire to remotely dentate. Inflores- cence compact with few heads. Heads 19 (8-26) flowered. Involucre cylindric to campanulate, 8.0 (5.2-11.2) mm high, 5.3 (3.2-7.0) mm wide. Phyllaries imbricated and appressed, sharply acute to acuminate, glabrous or slightly puberulent, ciliate. Achenes glabrous, often resinous, 3.5-4.2 mm long. Pappus purple to tawny purple, inner bristles 8-10 mm long, outer scales 1.2-1.8 mm long. Chromosome number: n = 17 (Jones, 1970).
bibliographicCitation: Jones, Jr., Samuel B. 1972. A systematic study of the Fasiculatae group of Vernonia (Compositae). Brittonia. 24: 28-45.
