description: Densely caespitose perennial with a subterranean woody caudex arising from a branching taproot, the old leaf-bases persisting, the branches terminated by rosulate basal leaves, numerous flowering scapes radiating outward; leaves spatulate to linear-spatulate, somewhat fleshy, entire, obtuse to slightly mucronate, (1.5) 3.5-6 (8) cm long, (2) 4-6 (7) mm wide, narrowing to 1 mm wide at base, sparsely canescent with simple hairs; flower heads solitary, showy, up to 5 cm broad with expanded rays; scapes 3-8 cm long, rarely with one or two linear, reduced bract-like leaves, sparsely to densely pubescent with short appressed hairs; receptacle minutely pubescent, slightly convex; phyllaries in 2-3 series, mostly lanceolate, sometimes oblong-lanceolate, 5-8 mm long, 1.5-3 mm wide, the midrib green and canescent, margins lacerate-scarious and grading outward from pink to white; ray florets pistillate, (12) 17-18 (20), the ligules with abaxial stripe turning dark pink to red on drying, 6-10 (12) mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm wide; disk florets perfect, more than 50 per head, yellow, 3.5-5 mm long, glabrous; style branches lanceolate, included; ray achenes light brown, triquetrously compressed, mostly 3 ribbed, slightly pubescent, oblanceolate, 2.5-3 mm long; disk achenes brown, compressed, with 2 prominent lateral ribs, oblanceolate, pubescent with simple hairs, 2.5-3.5 mm long; pappus of the ray and disk flowers similar, much reduced, of 16-18 lacerate squamellae uneven in length, less than 0.8 mm long; pollen stainable, viable; reproduction apparently sexual; 2n = 18.

description: Shrubs, 1.5-4 (5) m tall; stems 1-2 cm diam. at base, hispidulous to scabrous, hairs 0.1 mm long. Leaves petiolate; blades lanceolate to broadly ovate, rough chartaceous, 5-12(-20) X 2-6(-12) cm, apices acute to acuminate, bases obtuse (sometimes attenuate or slightly decurrent to petiole), margins serrate, crenate-serrulate or serrate-dentate, adaxial surface weakly to moderate hispidulous, hairs 0.5 mm long (occasionally with close erect hispid pubescence), dark green, abaxial surface strongly hispidulous, pale gray green; petioles 1.5-5 cm long, hirsute, hairs 0.2-0.5 mm long. Capitulescences thyrsoid or paniculiform, with 10-80 capitula. Capitula sessile, obovoid, 3-5 mm high, 3-4 mm diam., yellowish; phyllaries 3-4, coriaceous, concave, broadly ovate, 4 X 3-5 mm, apices acute, strigose, hairs 0.5-0.8 mm long, margins distal one-third ciliate, 5-veined. Pistillate florets 3-5, subtended by ovate paleae, 4 X 3-4 mm, 5-veined, apices acute, strigose, hairs 0.5 mm long, margins distal one-third cili- ate; corollas 2 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., 3- lobed, lobes irregularly deltoid, 0.4 mm long, scarcely pubescent at apex; styles 3 mm long, branches 1.5 mm long. Staminate fiorets 10-14, epaleaceous; corollas tubular, 3 mm long, throats 2 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., 4-lobed, lobes irregularly deltoid, 0.5 mm long, scarcely pubescent at apex; an- thers purple to black, 1.6-1.8 mm long; styles 4 mm long, branches 2.5 mm long; ovaries 2 mm long, 0.5 mm diam, villous at apex, hairs 0.5 mm long. Cypselae 2.5 X 2 mm, villose on upper half. Chromosome number, n = 16 (Stuessy & Arriagada, 1993).
bibliographicCitation: Arriagada, J. E. 2003. Revision of the genus Clibadium (Asteraceae, Heliantheae). Brittonia. 55: 245-301.

description: Herbs 0.3 m tall. Stems terete, yellow-green to brown-purple, glabrous at base, sub- glabrous to rarely villous near apex with hairs 1 mm long. Leaves with petioles 1-6 cm long, 1 mm diam; blades simple and ovate to pinnately compound with 5 divisions, 2-8.5 cm long, 1.6-8.3 cm broad, at apex acute to acuminate, at base truncate to attenuate, at the margin serrate to parted, on upper surface subglabrous to hispid, on lower surface subglabrous (villous on immature leaves). Heads 0.5-1 cm tall, 0.6-2.7 cm diam. Peduncles 1-5.8 cm long, 0.3-0.5 mm diam, glabrous to less often villous with hairs more than 1 mm long. Receptacle 1 mm diam. Paleae narrowly elliptic, 4 mm long, 1.6 mm wide, glabrous, rounded at apex with margin entire to erose, with midrib weak. Phyllaries 12-15, 4-15 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, at the apex acute, glabrous to subglabrous on abaxial surface, at the margin ciliate especially near base. Ray florets 3-5; ligules yellow, 1.5-6 mm long, 2.5-5 mm wide, on undersurface strigillose on veins with hairs 0.1 mm long; tube 1 mm long, 0.6 mm diam, strigillose with hairs 0.1 mm long; stigma bifid, with branches 0.7 mm long, at apex rounded, with 2 brown-orange longitudinal lines; fruits 3.8-5 mm long, 2-2.7 mm diam. Disc florets 15-30; corollas orange; throat narrowly funnel-form, 1.5 mm long, 0.8 mm diam; corolla lobes triangular, 0.5 mm long, 0.4 mm wide; tube 2 mm long, 0.3 mm diam; anthers 1 mm long, at base sagittate, with auricles acuminate, with apical appendage acute-obtuse, with collar of filaments at least 0.2 mm long; style 3 mm long, puberulent at apex; ovary 0.7 mm long, 0.4 mm diam. Flowering February to September.

description: Planta annua ad 3-5 dm alta; caulibus repentibus, partibus humilibus radicantibus; foliis puberulis, oppositis, subsessilibus, ellipticis, apicibus acutis, basibus attenuatis, minute dentibus, ad 5 cm longis, ad 2 cm latis; capitulis terminantibus in pedunculis gracilibus ad 2 cm longis; phyllaribus ca. 6, lanceolatis vel triangularibus, striatis, uniseriatis, viridibus, convexis, crassis, apicibus acuminatis, flores radii firme involventibus; floribus radii viridi-flavis, parvioribus quam phyllaribus; achaeniis radii fertilibus, glabris, minute striatis, calvis; floribus disci hermaphroditis, fertilibus, corollis 1.6 mm longis, viridi-flavis, tubis breviter constrictis; (disci achaeniis radii achaeniis similibus); paleis exterioribus crassis, achaenia disci involventibus, paleis interioribus gradatim tenuioribus, non involventibus; receptaculis conicis. description: Perennial herbs to subshrubs 6-10 dm tall; stems canescent, becoming glabrate. Leaves cauline, crowded; petioles 1-5 mm long, canescent; blades 4.7-11.5 cm long, 1.9-4.6 cm wide, elliptic to elliptic-oblong or elliptic-ovate, widest at or sometimes below the middle, apically acute, basally attenuate, marginally revo- lute and callous-toothed, glabrous and yellow-green-reticulate veined above, ca- nescent and brownish-reticulate veined beneath. Inflorescences of 1-2 (4) large terminal heads. Heads ca 100-180-flowered. Involucre broadly campanulate, 21-35 mm high, 22-40 mm wide; phyllaries tightly imbricate in 5-7 poorly defined series, canescent, the inner ones oblong-lanceolate, acuminate, 19-28 mm long, 19-30 mm wide, the outer ones ovate-lanceolate, 4.8-11 mm long, 1.8-4 mm wide. Pappus light brown, inner bristles 12-16 mm long and outer ones, 1.5-3.5 mm long. Corollas 17-19 mm long, reddish-purple, glabrous. Anthers 4-6.7 mm long. Achenes 4-6.5 mm long, pilose. Flowering and fruiting from April to June.

description: Perennial herb with a stout root and branched caudex; stems several, more or less strigose, 5-20 cm. high, the base glabrous or nearly so, conspicuously indurated and somewhat enlarged, straw-colored to sometimes purplish; leaves sparsely to copiously strigose, linear or narrowly linear-oblanceolate, 1.5-9 cm. long, 0.5-3.0 mm. wide, sometimes all in a basal cluster, sometimes well distributed along the stem, the lower ones with smooth conspicuously enlarged, indurated or chartaceous and sometimes sheathing, light-colored bases, sometimes with a purplish cast; heads solitary or occasionally 2 or 3, the disk about 8-13 mm. wide; involuere about 4-7 mm. high, more or less strigose or strigose-villous and often finely glandular; phyllaries subequal or somewhat imbricate, green or greenish-straw-colored, bften with darker midrib, acute, firm, somewhat thickened on the back, the inner sometimes with purplish tips and ill-defined searious margins; ligules about 20-45, bright yellow or sometimes rather pale, 4-11 mm. long, 1.3-2.5 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.5-5.3 mm. long, the tube when 'well defined about 1 mm. long or a little less, the lobes 0.5-0.7 mm. long; style-appendages 'deltoid or a little narrower, acute, about 0.15-0.25 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 10-20 firm bristles, the outer of squamellae or squamellate setae; akenes 2-nerved, moderately short-hairy.

description: Plants annual, 16-52 cm high, erect, sparsely hirsute; basal leaves ovate, 7-12.5 cm long, 4-6 cm wide, becoming progressively smaller upwards, acuminate at the apex, long attenuate at the base, margins subentire to deeply serrate-dentate, rather sparsely hispid on both surfaces, the trichomes tuberculate at the base; petioles 1.5-3 cm long; heads solitary on rather stout peduncles, campanulate, 8-15 mm in diameter; inflorescence sub-cymose with usually 3 peduncles arising from a node and further modified with peduncular dichotomy; peduncles 8-15(-20) cm long, with spreading trichomes; receptacle convex, 3-4 mm across, ca 1.5 mm high; chaff persistent, membranous, glabrous 9-11 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, attenuate at the apex; in.Volucre obscurely 2-seriate, the outer bracts oblong to lanceolate, sparsely hirsute, striate, (7-)8.5-11 mm long, (2-)2.5-5 mm wide, attenuate at the apex; inner bracts subequal to the outer, membranous, purpletinged; ray flowers ca 5, pistillate and fertile, tubular at the base for 3.5-5 mm, with conspicuous whitish to pale yellow ligules, these 6-9 mm long, 4-6.5(-7.5) mm wide, broadly oblong, three-lobed at the apex; ray corollas with linear inner lobelets, these 1-2 mm long; pappus of the ray florets reduced, 1-2.5 mm long; disc corollas pale yellow, (7-)8-9 mm long, the tube 1.5-1.8 mm long, glabrous, the throat tubular, 5-5.5 mm long, the glabrous lobes linear, 1.5-2 mm long, minutely pubescent at the apex; style branches recurved, slightly flattened, 2-2.5 mm long with obscure stigmatic lines on the inner margins, pubescent near the subulate tip; achenes blackish, narrowly turbinate, 2-2.5 mm long, rather flattened and incurved toward the periphery, densely pilose; pappus of 20 plumose, subequal bristles, alternately longer and shorter, (4.5-)5-6(-7) mm long, the short cilia becoming minute near the apex; anthers 3-3.5 mm long, obscurely sagittate at the base.

description: Annual herb. Stems 35-55 cm tall, 0.7-1.3 cm diam, highly branched at base and overall shape of plant hemispherical or urn-shaped, brown to greenish-yellow, pubescent. Leaves sessile to subsessile; blades 5-12 cm long, 1.5-4.5 cm wide, lanceolate to ovate to oblanceolate; scabrous and sessile, glandular ad and abaxially; base cuneate; apex acute to acuminate; margins entire. Capitulescences solitary; peduncles 1-10 cm long, 1-3 mm diam, tomentose. Heads radiate, 15-20 mm long, 40-60 mm diam across extended rays. Involucre campanulate, 9-10 mm long, 18-22 mm diam, phyllaries imbricate, 20-32, 4-seriate, reflexed api- cally, light green to yellow or brown, dark brown and erose at the apex, glabrous to glandular-tomentose; outer phyllaries broadly obovate, 6-8.5 mm long, 5-8 mm wide; inner phyllaries obovate, 10-12 mm long, 4-6 mm wide. Pales conduplicate, 10-14 mm long, 2-2.2 mm wide, stramineous, glabrous except strigose on keel, acute to erose at apex. Ray florets 13-17; pistillate and fertile, persistent on the achenes, ligules creamy white to yellow to red-orange adaxially, greenish- yellow abaxially; 15-28 mm long, 8-15 mm wide; achenes 4-7.5 mm long, 2.5- 3.2 mm wide, oblanceolate, 3-angled, strigose, margins ciliate, tuberculate when mature. Disc florets 120-150, corollas yellow to red-orange, 10-11 mm long, 1- 1.3 mm diam; lobes 2-4.5 mm long, 0.5-0.8 mm wide; achenes 5-7 mm long, 2.8-3.2 mm wide, obovate, laterally flattened, strigose, ciliate at margins, black, brown or black-brown mottled or with whitish longitudinal lines; pappus of 1 or 2 persistent awns to 4.5 mm long.

description: Scandens ramis flexuosis striatis glaberrimis. Folia crasse membranacea petiolata opposita vel subopposita glabra. Petiolus 5-7 mm longus tener flexuosus. Lamina elliptico-lanceolata basi cuneata apice angustata acuta vel cuspidata, margine integra revoluta utrinque in sicco tabacina, supra sublaevis nervis inconspicuis, subtus costa elevata, 4-5 nervis secundariis utroque latere ascendentibus prominulis, ceteris nervulis laxe reticulatis fere inconspicuis, 5-7 cm longa 1.6-4.2 cm lata. Panicula terminalis densa folia superans, circa 9 cm longa ramis rarnulisque minute tomentello-hirtulis et sparse glandulosis. Pedicelli 1-5 mm longi teneres puberuli. Capitula radiata. Calyculus 3-4 bracteolis ovato-lanceolatis 1.5-2 mm longis. Involucrum tubuloso-campanulatum 6 mm altum, 8 bracteis herbaceis oblongis 5.5 mm longis 1.2-2 mm latis margine membranaceis apice acutiusculis ciliolatis reliquis glabris. Flores-radii feminei ligulati circiter 5, corolla 5.5 mm longa glabra tubulo 3 mm longo lamina elliptico-oblonga 1.2 mm lata apice minute tridentata. Flores disci hermaphroditi circa 20, corolla 5.5 mm longa infundibuliformis tubulo parum notato 2 mm longo dentibus 1 mm longis oblongis apice obtusis papillosisque; antheris 2 mm longis basi rotundatis; ramis styli truncatis papilloso-piloso coronatis. Ovarium glabrum. Pappus albus 5 mm longus.

description: Plantae e radice terete tenuique annuae, 20-60 cm alt., ubique partibus superioribus dense glandulari-pubescentes (interdum trichomatibus subpurpureis praeditae); rosula basalis parum aut haud evoluta; pedunculus capitulorum 5-15 mm long., dense glandulari-pubescens; bracteae involueri ea 40, in 2-3 seriebus, imbricatae, ad apicem anguste acutae vel subulatae; bracteae involueri principales lineari- lan,ceolatae, 4-6 mm long., 0.75-1.8 mm lat., virides (purpureo saepe suffusae), per pleramque longitudinem herbaceae, bracteae interiores autem marginibus seariosis praecipue parte in inferiore praeditae; description: Weak, scandent shrubs or small trees, 2-4 (8) m tall; stems arachnoid-pubescent, glabrescent. Leaves alternate, sessile to subsessile; petiole rarely to 3 mm long; blade narrowly lanceolate to linear, coriaceous, (3.5) 5-7.5 cm long, (0.4) 0.6-1.1 (1.4) cm wide, base acute to cuneate, apex acute to attenuate, the lower surface thickly lanate, the nerves inconspicuous, the upper surface glabrous, the margins entire or remotely denticulate towards the apex. Capitulescences corymbiform paniculate, terminal and axillary, pendent, the peduncles (3) 5-20 mm long, densely lanate. Capitula discoid, ca 14 mm high; involucre cylindrical, ca 10 mm high, ca 4 mm in diam; phyllaries 13-15, 4-6-seriate, strongly imbricated, the outer phyllaries ovate, 2.5-4 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide, tomentose, ciliolate, the intermediate series oblong, 5-6 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, glabrous, the inner series oblong to lanceolate, 8-10 mm long, 2-2.5 mm wide, all coriaceous, apically subacute, sparsely pilose, glandular; receptacle naked or with 1 palea, linear, membranous, apically attenuate, fimbrillate; florets (4) 5, hermaphroditic, the corolla narrowly funnelform, ca 11 mm long, yellow, the limb 8-9 mm, 5-lobed, the lobes linear, 2.5-3 mm long, apically acute, glabrous; anthers ca 4.5 mm long, basally sagittate, the collar balusterform, ca 1.25 mm long, the apical appendage lanceolate, acute, ca 1 mm long; style branches ca 3 mm long, the terminal appendage lanceolate, acute, pilosulose. Achenes cylindrical, 3-5-costate, 4-6 mm long, glandular with multicellular, biseriate, capitate glands; pappus of scaberulous bristles, 6-9 mm long, stramineous.

description: Compact, intricately branched shrubs to 12 dm high. Young stems pannose, but for glabrous to sparsely floccose streaks on the internodes subtending the primary leaves. Primary leaves linear-subulate, mucronate, ascending to appressed; 5-10 (-20) mm long; glabrate to sparsely floccose. Secondary leaves linear-filiform to slightly clavate; 3-10 (-15) mm long; glabrous. Capitula in loose or compact, corymbose clusters of 3-7 at branch tips. Peduncles 5-10 (3-15) mm long; loosely floccose to tomentose or glabrous; ebracteate. Involucres turbinate; 9 (7-10) mm high. Phyl- laries 4; lanceolate to obovate; obtuse to acute; weakly navicular; subequal; floccose- tomentose to canescent or glabrous. Florets 4 per capitulum. Corollas bright golden yellow to cream; 9-10 mm long; throat funnelform or abruptly dilated and cylindri- cal, ca. 2 mm long; lobes lanceolate, ca. 3 mm long. Achenes 3-4 (-5) mm long; slender; hirsute, the indumentum obscuring the 5 glandular ribs. Pappus of ca. 100- 130 subequal, barbellate bristles; 6-8 mm long. Style branches truncate; papillate; ca. 1 mm long. Anthers 2.5-3.5 mm long; weakly sagittate; sterile tips narrowly triangular to lanceolate. Pollen grains mostly 31-46 jAm in diameter. Figs. 2,C; 3,B.

description: Rhizomes extensive, 1.5-3.0 mm. in diam., branching, frequently producing several approximate stems from a loose caudex, light brown, the thin brown scales inconspicuous except at apex; innovations frequent, sometimes abundant, producing leaves similar to those of the lower stem; stems simple (seldom branched below), 2.0(1.0)-4.5 dm. tall, 2.0(1.5)-4.0 mm. in diam., obviously glandular-puberulent to conspicuously loosely pilose with white septate hairs; cauline leaves 2-3 pairs, seldom only 1 or as many as 4 pairs, the upper 1-2 pairs reduced, sessile, ovate to lanceolate, the lower with petioles mostly equaling or exceeding the blades, which are 1.5-9.0 cm. broad, 2.0-11.0 cm. long, laneeolate, ovate to ovate-orbicular, acutish to broadly obtuse, cordate, subcordate, or truncate, the sinus broad and shallow, or deep and acute with the lobes overlapping, rarely the base contracted and acute, margin entire, repand dentate to coarsely dentate, surface puberulent to weakly pilosulose, and also sometimes short-stipitate-glandular, especially above, seldom subglabrate, the upper leaves reduced; peduncles 5.0(2.0)-10.0(15) cm. long, above densely short- and also someti-mes long-stipitate-glanidular, and sparingly to decidedly pilose, mostly with 1-2 pairs of small bracteoles or these single or absent; heads 1-3, rarely 5-7, broadly turbinate sometimes campanulate, large, 1.8(1.5)-2.5(3.0) cm. high; the periclinium campanulate, densely pilose, the glands underneath mostly obscured; inivolueral bracts 10-14(18), biseriate, 14(10)-18(22) mm. long, 2.0-4.0(6.0) mm. broad, narrowly to broadly lanceolate or oblanceolate, aeuminate, or only acute, the margins particularly of inner bracts searious and frequently somewhat lacinate, the bracts pilose at the base, becoming puberulent only above, obscurely or conspicuously ciliolate, frequently obviously glandular to the summit, pubescent within; ray flowers 9-13 (16), the ligules 6.0 (5.0)-8.0 (10) mm. broad, 20(15) -28(30) mm. long, yellow, sometimes pale, elliptic-oblong, sometimes sparsely strigose oni the back, subentire to 3-dentate, the acutish teeth 1.0 (0.5)-2.0 (3.5) mm. long; disc flowers numerous, -+ 100, yellow, the corolla 9.0(8.0)-11.5(12.2) mm. long, narrowly goblet-shaped, the base of the limb and the tube only moderately pilosulose and sometimes sparsely glandular, the collar detectible or obvious, but never conspicuous, the tube 4.0(3.3)-3.5(5.8) mm. long, the lobes 1.0-1.5 lum. long, hispidulous; achenes slender, 6.5 (6.0)-8.0 (10.8) mm. long, mostly uniformly but lnot densely hirsute with double hairs 1/2 as long as the diam. of the achene, and frequelntly also sparingly stipitate-glandular; annulus when developed 0.3-0.5 mm. long; pappus white, in age sometimes becoming stained, barbellate, the setae 0.1-0.2 mm. long.

description: Herba perennis, erecta, glabra, e radice tuberifera fasciculata, ca 7 dm alta, caule infra simplici supra adscendenti-ramoso ramis tenuissimis sub 0.5 mm crassis subbrunneo-stramineis in pedunculos 1-2.1 dm longos terminantibus, infloreseentia omnino ca 14-capitulata. Capitula discoidea, ad anthesin sub 1.3 cm lata et sub-9 mm alta. Involucri bracteae exteriores ca 10-12, anguste lineares, ea 3-5-nervatae, fere glabrae, fine nitido- induratae, 4-6 mm longae; interiores lanceolato-oblongae dimidio longiores. description: Perennial herb, erect, glabrous, from a tuberiferous fasciculate root, ca 7 dm tall; stem simple below, suberectly branched above with very slender branches under 0.5 mm thick and brownish-stramineous, terminating in peduncles 1-2.1 dm long; inflorescence with a total of ca 14 heads. Leaves opposite, sessile, principal ones shorter than the internodes, finally somewhat drooping, blade up to 4.3 cm long and a little wider, sharply pinnate, lateral pinnae more often 2 pairs the bottom ones again dissected, ultimate segments linear-oblong, green above and paler beneath, at apex very sharp, at edge very narrowly thickened-involute and setulose-ciliate, 3-7 mm wide. Heads diskoid, at flowering under 1.3 cm wide and under 9 mm tall. Outer phyllaries ca 10-12, narrowly linear, ca 3-5-nerved, almost glabrous, at the tip glistening-indurate, 4-6 mm long; inner ones lanceolate-oblong, a half longer. Chaff-scales very narrowly linear-attenuate, surpassing the yellow disk-florets. Mature and submature achenes not seen. Ovaries exaristate.

description: Perennial herb with a taproot and caudex, the caudex varying from usually short and little-branched to sometimes long and moderately branched; stem 5-50 cm. high, usually more or less leafy, naked in a few forms, hirsute with spreading hairs (hairs appressed in forma diabolicus), often also finely glandular or slightly viscid, especially under the heads; leaves hirsute, sometimes sparsely so, oblanceolate, sometimes very narrowly so, up to 8 cm. long and 5 or even 8 mm. wide, usually much smaller, the basal and lowermost ones commonly tufted and persistent in smaller forms, fewer and deciduous in larger forms, the middle and upper cauline ones varying from numerous and nearly as large as the basal ones, in large forms, to much reduced or absent, in small forms; heads solitary to numerous, sometimes as many as 75, the disk 7-15 mm. wide, usually hemispherical or nearly so; involuere 4-7 mm. high, sparsely to densely spreading-hirsute, and very finely glandular; phyllaries subequal, narrow, acuminate or attenuate, green, with brown midrib and sometimes very narrow searious margins; ligules mostly 50-100 or more, occasionally fewer in small forms, white or pink to deep blue, 6-15 mm. long, mostly 0.7-1.5 mm. wide, or in certain unusual forms such as at Logan, Utah, sometimes up to 2.5 mm. wide; disk-corollas mostly 3.0-5.0 mm. long, the tube 0.7-1.4 mm., the lobes 0.4-0.7 mm., the lower part of the limb white and conspicuously indurated, commonly also slightly inflated; style-appendages deltoid to broadly triangular, obtuse to acutish, 0.1-0.15 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 7-27 slender or coarse somewhat fragile bristles, the outer of evident bristles or broad conspicuous squamellae; akenes 2-nerved, sparsely or moderately short-hairy. Open places at moderate and low elevations, often among sagebrush; plains of Saskatchewar; south to western Kansas, west the Rocky Mountains to the Cascade Mountains of Washington and southernmost British Columbia, south to northern New Mexico, northern Arizona, and the coast of southern California.

description: Frutex ramis terminalibus satis foliosis crasse adpresseque ochraceo-lanato-tomentosi s. Folia alterna rigide coriacea. Petiolus 2 mm longus articulatus dense lanatus basi vaginans. Lamina lanceolata basi rotundata, apice attenuata acuta, margine valde revoluta, 8-14 mm longa 3-5 mm lata; supra laevis opaca glabra, costa minute impressa fere inconspicua; subtus crassissime tomentoso-lanata ochracea nervis invisibilibus. Capitula solitaria terminalia sessilia. Involucrum 10 mm altum bracteis multi- seriatis anguste linearibus acutis interioribus 9 mm longis 1 mm latis, ceteris gradatim brevioribus, externis basi dense lanatis ceteris villoso-lanuginosis. Flores-radii feminei numerosi corolla anguste ligulati praeantesim 10 mm longa glabra. description: Shrubs and trees, to 6 m tall; stems to 5 cm diam., densely tomentose, hairs, gray, 2 mm long. Leaves petiolate; blades below capitulescences ovate, 30 X 20-25 cm, apices acuminate, bases broadly rounded or slightly cordate, some slightly decurrent on the petiole, 3-5 pliveined, margins crenate-dentate; blades from branches, ovate, 6-15 X 5-10 cm, apices falcate-acuminate, bases subtruncate or shortly cuneate; densely pilose, hairs 1-1.5 mm long; margins crenate-toothed. Capitulescences paniculiform, convex or flattish at twig tips, many capitula (to 219), branches densely and griseously tomentose-pilose with spreading hairs, hairs 1.5-2 mm long. Capitula small, obovoid-subglobose, 3-4 mm high, 2-3 mm diam.; phyllaries 3, 3-3.5 X 3 mm, whitish, ovate, 5-7 veined, strigose, hairs 1 mm long, apices acute, margin shortly ciliate on distal one-third. Pistillate florets 3(-5), subtended by suborbicular paleae, 3-3.5 X 3 mm, 5-veined, apices obtuse, margin shortly ciliate at distal one-third; corollas 2 mm long, 1 mm diam., white, tubulate, subequally 3- lobed, lobes irregularly deltoid, 0.5 mm long, apices scarcely pubescent; styles 1.5 mm long, branches 0.6-1 mm long. Staminate florets 6, epaleaceous; corollas 2 mm long, 1 mm diam., white, 4 lobed, lobes 0.5 mm long, apices shortly pilose; anthers 1 mm long, black; ovaries 2 mm long, 1-1.5 mm diam., pilose toward apex, hairs I mm long. Cypselae 2.5 X 2 mm, broadly obovate, rounded at base, densely short pilose at distal one-third, hairs 0.5-0.8 mm long. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Plants, annual, 30-45 cm high; stems erect, single from a relatively small taproot, glandular-pubescent throughout, the trichomes interspersed with a short appressed pubescence; lowermost leaves opposite, the upper ones alternate; basal rosette apparently not formed; lower leaves biternately dissected, the upper ones less so; mid-stem leaves puberulent or glandular-pubescent on the petioles, the latter 1-2 cm long; ultimate divisions-linear to linear-lanceolate, 10-30 mm long, 1-3 mm wide; inflorescence a subcorymbose cyme with 15 to numerous heads; heads rayless, broadly turbinate, 6-10 mm across, 8-10 mm high (including the projecting florets), 20- to 28-flowered, on glandular-pubescent peduncles 12-30 mm long; principal involucral bracts 8-10, linear-lanceolate to linear-oblong, 5-6 mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm wide, minutely white-puberulent to nearly glabrous with purple, membranous margins, narrowly obtuse to broadly rounded at the apex; florets ochroleucous, distinctly zygomorphic; corolla 3-4 mm long (including the lobes), the tube glabrous, about 1.5 mm long, the lobes of various lengths, 0.5-1.5 mm long; style branches flattened, about 1.3 mm long, stigmatic from the base with purplish lines, the apex abruptly termninated by a penicillate caudate appendage; achenes obpyramidal, 3-3.5 mm long, 4-sided, somewhat compressed dorsally, glabrous above with smooth faces, pubescent at the base with stiff ascending hairs; pappus of 8 ovate to ovate-lanceolate scales, 1.5-2 mm long, midnerve forming a short awn or mucro 0.1-0.2 mm long at the apex; chromosome number not determined.
bibliographicCitation: Turner, Billie L. 1963. Taxonomy of Forestina (Helenleae, Compositae). Brittonia. 15: 27-46.

description: Perennial herbs 5-6 dm tall, from well developed, semi-woody rhizomes; stems ridged, pilose-tomentose to hirsute. Leaves cauline, somewhat reduced upwards, the sessile blades (3) 7.3-11 cm long, 1-4.6 cm wide, obovate-elliptic, widest above the middle, apically acute to acuminate, basally cuneate, the margins re- volute, entire or remotely toothed with callous teeth, softly and thinly strigose to pilose, or becoming glabrate with age above, velutinous to thinly pilose, pilose or softly strigose beneath. Inflorescences cymose to paniculate and scorpioid. Heads (28) 34-41-flowered; peduncles wanting to 2-3 cm long, velutinous. In- volucre broadly campanulate, (10) 11-15 mm high, (11) 13-17 (20) mm wide. Phyllaries loosely imbricated in 3-4 series, velutinous to tomentose, greenish- purple, the inner ones linear-lanceolate, 9-13 mm long, 1.2-2.1 mm wide, long acuminate, the outer ones linear-lanceolate, 8-12 mm long, 0.7-1.8 mm wide. Pappus whitish, the inner bristles 10.5-14 mm long, the outer scale-like ones 1.4-2.5 mm long. Corollas 9.5-14.5 mm long, reddish-purple, glabrous. Anthers 3.1-4.2 mm long. Achenes 2.4-2.8 mm long, densely strigose. Flowering and fruiting from December to March.

description: Perennial, somewhat recumbent herbs 20-60 cm tall. Leaves lanceolate-ovate, opposite below, alternate on the upper 2/3 of the stem, the blades entire, densely softly appressed pubescent above and below, the lower surface atomiferous-glan- dular, 3-nerved from just above the base from whence they gradually taper into a distinct petiole, 3-10 mm long. Heads 5-8 in terminal clusters. Involucre 7-8 mm long, urceolate at maturity, covered with a loose, crispy-white pubescence; outermost bracts broadly ovate, apiculate; innermost bracts ovate-linear, obtuse at apex, becoming, along with the receptacle, sclerotinized at maturity, difficult to break open, even in the living condition. Receptacular paleae persistent, ovate below but soon abruptly contracted into an elongate, linear extension which is obtuse in the outer members, becoming acute inward. Ray florets neutral, yellow, the ligule 2-lobed, ca 7 mm long, the tube very slender, ca 2 mm long, pubescent. Ray achenes, while sterile, nevertheless developing into a black ligulate sterile structure ca 7 mm long bearing an abortive lacerate pappus. Disc florets yellow, 5-lobed, 7 mm long, the tube ca 1.5 mm long, the throat about as long as the pubescent lobes. Anthers yellow with ovate appendages. Style branches linear, cuspidate at apex, densely pubescent from near the base. Disc achenes 3.0-3.5 mm long, elliptical, radially compressed, much-enclosed in the lower bracts, gla- brous, the carpodium absent or seemingly so; pappus of 2 stout ciliate awns ca 1.5 mm long between which on each side are 4 short lacerate scales. Chromosome number: 2n = 17 pairs.

description: Perhaps to 1.5 dm, stems densely hispid; leaves 4-8 cm long, 2.5-5.5 cm wide, ovate, pinnately divided into 5-7 primary segments, these cuneate or lanceolate, often pinnatifid, densely hispid on both surfaces, glandular-punctate, petioles 1-2.5 cm long; heads mostly 15-30 cymosely disposed, peduncles 0.5-2 cm long, very hispid and pilose; heads 2.5 cm wide at anthesis; outer involucral bracts about 8, linear or lanceolate, 3.5-5.5 mm long, very hispid; inner involucral bracts about 8, oblong or obovate, 7-8 mm long, hispid; chaff oblong, deeply 3-lobed at apex, erect-villous on the outer surface, 5-6 mm long at anthesis; ray florets probably 6-8; disk florets about 35; achenes narrowly linear-oblanceolate, 4-5 mm long, 0.7-1 mm wide, aristae 2-3 mm long.

description: Stems 3-15 dm, profusely branched, glabrate; leaves 2-7 cm long, 1.5-5 cm wide, ovate, pinnately parted or divided into 5-9 segments, these linear, subulate, or filiform, entire or sometimes lobed, 0.5-2.5 cm long, 2-8 mm wide, glabrous to quite pubescent, glandular-punctate, petioles 0.5-2.5 cm long; heads (1-)3-25, cymosely disposed, peduncles 0.5-3 cm long, pubescent; heads 1.5-2 (-2.5) cm wide at anthesis; outer involucral bracts 5-6, mostly linear (sometimes narrowly oblong or spatulate), 1-5 mm long, glabrate or sometimes pubescent; inner involucral bracts 5, oblong (tending toward ovate), glabrate to moderately hispid, 4-6 mm long; chaff oblan- ceolate to obovate, extremely erect-villous on the outer surface, 3-lobed at the apex, very scarious, 3.5-7 mm long at anthesis; ray florets 5(6), disk florets 10-16; achenes obovate (rarely oblong or linear) 3-5 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, aristae 3-5 mm long.

description: Perennial herb with usually several stems arising from a slightly branched caudex; stem mostly 5-15 cm. high, villous, especially above, with hairs having black or dark purple cross-walls; leaves glabrous, or somewhat hirsute, rather obseurely or scarcely ciliate on the margins, largely basal, these obianceolate or spatulate, up to 6 cm. long and nearly 1 cm. wide, usually smaller, rounded or retuse at the apex; cauline leaves few aild reduced; head solitary, the disk 10-15 mm. wide; involuere 6-9 mm. high, surpassing the disk, more or less densely villous with flattened multicellular hairs, these with conspicuously black or dark purple cross-walls; phyllaries equal, attenuate, thin, distinctly green except for the purplish tips; ligules 50-70, white or pink, 7-11 mm. long, about 1.4-2.0 mm. wide; disk-corollas 2.4-3.2 mm. long, the tube 0.5-0.9 mm., the lobes 0.5-0.7 mm.; style-appendages deltoid, acute, about 0.2 mm. long or a little less; pappus of about 20-25 conspicuously unequal bristles, but without a well-defined outer series; akenes 2-nerved, slightly hairy.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Plants annual, 17-40 cm high, erect or decumbent, branching mostly from the base, sparsely hirsute; leaves 2.5-5 cm long, sessile, sparsely hirsute, linear, trifid to pinnately divided, the lobes linear; heads solitary on slender peduncles, campanulate, 7-10 mm in diameter; peduncles 10-15 cm long, sparsely antrorsely appressed-hirsute, interspersed with spreading, glandular trichomes especially near the heads; receptacle ca 2 mm across, 1-1.5 mm high, short-conical; chaff persistent,scarious, 6-7 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, linear-lanceolate, attenuate at the apex, pubescent with glandular trichomes; inner bracts about equal to the outer in length, 2-2.5 mm wide, lanceolate to lanceolate-ovate, acuminate to obscurely cuspidate at the apex, mostly purple with scarious, usually purple-tinged, margins, glabrate; ray flowers absent; disc corollas yellow, bilabiate, 6.5-7 mm long, the tube abruptly giving way to the throat, glabrate, 0.5 mm long, the throat tubular, glabrate toward the base, otherwise rather densely pubescent with stiff hairs, 2.8-3.5 mm long, the lobes linear-lanceolate, pubescent on outer surface, the inner (lower) lobes equal, ca 2 mm long, the outer (upper) lobes unequal, 1-2.5 mm long; style branches 1.3-1.4 mm long, only slightly recurved, dark brown, rather slender, tapering from the base to a very slender, subulate tip, flattened on the upper surface, minutely but coarsely pubescent beneath; achenes blackish, broadly turbinate, densely pilose-hirsute, 2.5-3 mm long, 1.5-1.8 mm wide at the truncate apex; pappus of 10 stiff plumose bristles, 4-5.5 mm long, inserted alternately with 10 dark purple, rectangular-based plumose bristles, the base 0.7-0.8 mm long, 0.2-0.3 mm wide, with two peripheral minute horns at the apex, the bristles arising between the horns; cilia ca 0.8 mm long, stiff gradually reduced toward the tips of the bristles; anthers 2.5-3 mm long, sagittate at the base, the apical appendages deltoid.

description: Herba perennis (2-) 3.5-8 + dm alta, nunc glaberrima nunc imo caule vel inter capitula pilis parcis conspersa, foliis saepe purpureo-suffusis. Caulis singulus e caudice tenui suberecto vel debiliter adscendente fibroso-radicato rosula foliorum basalium coronato emissus, rosulis interdum inter se confertis. Foliorum basalium petiolus lamina sua 1.5-2-plo longior, interdum lobulis 1-3 utrinque instructus, lamina e petiolo verticali saepissime per angulum subrectum divergens, subsucculenta vel coriacea ovato-deltata vel suborbicularis 4-6 (-8) cm longa, 4-6 (-7) cm lata, basi truncata vel cordata, marginibus dentatis vel subpartitis, lobulis tunc rotundatis vel apiculatis. Folia caulina pauca superiora valde decrescentia, ima basalibus simillima, media oblanceolata petiolum versus lacerata, summa lacerata vel pinnatifida in bracteas sessiles abeuntia. Inflorescentia confertim vel sublaxe cymosa (1-) 3-6 (-9+) - capitulata. Bracteae extimae calyculosae inconspicuae vel 0, interiores 1-seriatae numero incerto sed saepe + 21, interdum ? 13, lanceolatae 8-11 mm longae, mar- ginibus scarioso-chartaceae apicem versus subfimbriolatae, luteo-virides vel sub- hyalinae, apice haud atro-maculatae. Radii flosculi numero incerto sed saepe + 13, interdum + 21, ligula 10-12 (-15) mm longa, luteo-aurantiaca. Achaenia turbinata longitrorsus striata 5-6 mm longa glabra.

description: Erect herb to 3 m tall, sparingly branched; leaves, phyllaries, corollas, and styles bearing glandular hairs. Stems striate, sometimes smooth, light brown. Leaves usually alternate, rarely subopposite; petioles as much as 5 cm long, winged; blades ovate, sparingly lobed, with broad shallow sinuses, up to 20 cm long and as much as 15 cm wide, rather palmately veined; margin entire to serrate; apex slightly acuminate. Inflorescence a thyrsoid panicle, up to 30 cm long, and up to 15 cm wide. Heads numerous, ca. 5-6 mm high, ca. 8-16-flowered. Phyllaries ca. 12, narrowly oblong with apex rather obtuse, with few or no striae, green, pubescent with densely fringed margin. Receptacle slightly to strongly convex, chaffy. Corollas white, narrowly tubular, 2.5-3 mm long. Pappus of ca. 20-27 white setae, ca. 3 mm long, slightly to distinctly dilated apically. Achenes dark brown, ca. 2 mm long, 4-5-ribbed, ribs setose; carpopodium well developed. Pollen tricolpate, spherical, minutely papillose, ca. 20 µ in diameter.

description: Herba perennis pluricaulis; eaules tenues simplices v. supra paullum ramosi pilosi, pilis appressis v. erectiusculis; folia figura triangularia submembranacea alte trilobata, lobis linearibus v. lineari-lanceolatis acutis terminali lateralibus multo longiore prope basin saepius utrinque 1-dentato, petiolo anguste alato lineari-cuneato utrinque saepius 1- vel 2-dentato; capitula mediocria longe peduiiculata subterminalia 1-3 ad apices eaulis et ramorum; involueri 4-seriati gradati appressi phyllaria linearia acuminata substraminea late 1-vittata subappresse pilosa; radii ilumerosi angusti breves albi; achenia subsparse adscendenti-pilosula; pappus inconspicue duplex, exterior setulosus, interior capillaris.

description: Stems apparently erectish, 4.5-5.5 dm. high, 2 mm. thick, subterete, striatulate, greenish, evenly but not densely pilose with appressed or  erectish hairs, usually with a few erectish branches above; internodes mostly about 1 cm. long; leaves (including petiole) 2.5-6.5 cm. long, 6-22 mm. wide across the lobes; petiole 1.3-2.8 cm. long, 0.5-2 mm. wide, pubescent like the stem, in the larger leaves bearing near middle 1 or 2 triangular to lanceolate acute teeth 1-4 (-10) mm. long; blade triangular in outline, the lateral lobes linear, acute or acuminate, pubes- cent like the stem, divergent or erectish, usually not exactly opposite, 6-15 mm. long, 0.8-3 mm. wide, the terminal lobe similar but larger, lillear, linear-lanceolate, or linear-oblanceolate, often with a triangular tooth on one or both sides below the middle, 15-27 mm. long, 1.5-4 mm. wide; peduncles 1-3 at apex of stems alnd branches, monocephalous, slender, naked or with a few setaceous bracts, 4-8 ecm. long, pubescent like the stem; heads hemispheric, about 1.5 cm. wide; disk 5-6 mm. high, 1 cm. wide (as pressed); involucre about equalinig the disk, the phyllaries about 0.5 mm. wide, the outer densely erectish-pilose with several-celled hairs chiefly along the broadish vitta and obscurely ciliolate, the inner with narrower vitta, sparsely pubescent or subglabrous, with subsearious tip; rays ca. 100, sometimes purplish at tip when dried, sparsely pubeseent toward base of limb, the tube 1.8 mm. long, the lamiina essentially linear, 2-3-denticulate, 3-4-nerved, 3-3.5 mm. long, 0.3 mm. wide; disk corollas very numerous, yellow, glabrous except for a few hairs toward base of throat and on teeth, 3 mm. long (tube 1.1 mm., throat cylindric-funnelform, 1.4 mm., teeth ovate, 0.5 mm. long); achenes oblong, plumpish, 2-nerved, whitish, ascending- pilosulous, 1.3 mm. long, 0.4 mm. wide; pappus double, the outer setu- lose, about 0.3 mm. long, the inner of about 18 whitish hispidulous bristles 2.5-3 mm. long.

description: Erect perennial herbs, 3-6 dm tall; stems canescent. Leaves cauline, gradually reduced both basally and terminally; petioles 0-2 mm long, canescent; blades 4.5-8.6 cm long, 2.1-5 cm wide, ovate to ovate-elliptic, glabrous, slightly arachnoid along lower mid-vein, reticulate-veined above, apically acute, basally rounded-cuneate, marginally revolute and faintly crenate, canescent and brownish-re- ticulate-veined beneath. Inflorescences of 1 to several large heads, reduced paniculate-cymose. Heads ca 60-140-flowered; peduncles 1-7 cm long, canescent. Involucre broadly campanulate, (10) 12-18 (21) mm high, 15-22 mm wide; phyllaries imbricate in 7-8 series, tightly appressed, grayish- to brownish-pubescent; the inner ones oblong-lanceolate, acuminate, 8.5-11.5 mm long, 1.9-4.2 mm wide, the outer ones ovate-lanceolate, 2-4.2 mm long, 1.2-3.8 mm wide. Pappus brown- ish, slightly clavate at apex, the inner bristles 8-10.5 mm long and outer scales 2-4.5 mm long. Corollas 13-18 mm long, reddish-purple, glabrous. Anthers 3.6-5.5 mm long. Achenes 3.2-3.5 mm long, 8-9-ribbed, pilose. Flowering and fruiting from December to February, occasionally to June.

description:
A Stevia triflora DC. foliis in pagina inferiore tantum puberulis, phyllariis strigoso- puberulis, flosculis roseis, acheniis glabris, pappo obsoleto (0.05-0.1 mm alto) differt.

Herba perennis lignescens saltem ad 0.5 m alta, basi incognita. Caules erecti, basin versus lignescentes et glabri, superne dense puberulo-tomentosi, brunnei; rami oppositi, infime breves et immaturi in axillis foliorum, superne elongati et in- florescentiam ferentes; internodia laminas foliorum quasi aequantia, infime breviora. Folia opposita tenuia petiolata; laminae 3.5-5.5 cm longae 1.8-3.0 cm latae, lanceolato- ellipticae subintegrae vel remote et non profunde crenatae, apice acutae vel obtusae, basi obtusae sed ad petiolum decurrentes, supra infraque puberulae glanduloso- punctatae vel sessiliglandulosae; pagina inferior ea superiore plus grisea; petioli ad 1.5 cm longi alati, alis ad basin decrescentibus; venae majores infra elevatae albidae dense strigoso-puberulae vel pilulosae, venae minores inconspicuae reticulatae non elevatae. Inflorescentia e corymbo rotundato saepe 3+-partito constata; ramuli plerumque oppositi sed saepe alterni in specimenibus majoribus, subtomentelli; bracteae foliaceae, minoribus inconspicuis. Capitula ca. 6 mm longa per anthesin sessilia in gregibus rotundatis; involucra 4.0-4.5 mm alta viridia cylindrica, phyllariis linearibus vel lineari-oblanceolatis sessiliglandulosis strigoso-puberulis, apice obtusis ciliatisque. Corollae 4.0-4.5 mm longae; lobi 0.5-0.7 mm longi albi pilis paucibus brevibus acutis extus obsiti; fauces ca. 2 mm longae rosae (siccae); tubus ca. 2 mm longus albus vel viridis glandulosus. Achenia isomorpha 2.3-3.3 mm longa exaristata nigra glabra; pappus ex annulo brevissimo integro squamellato 0.05-0.1 mm alto (fere obsoleto) constans.

description: Perennial herb with a slender branched caudex to which chaffy leaf bases of several seasons adhere; stem and leaves sparsely to usually moderately strigose, the young leaves sometimes densely so; stem slender, ascending or sometimes erect, 3-15 cm. tall; basal leaves 1.5-7.5 cm. long, the petiole up to 5 cm. long, the blade mostly 7-25 mm. long, 2-7 mm. wide, oblanceolate to elliptic, diambnd-shaped, or obovate, acute or acutish at the apex, sometimes some of the earliest leaves of a season considerably smaller than the others, with a proportionately shorter and broader blade that is rounded at the apex; cauline leaves few, linear, 5-20 mm. long, seldom over 1 mm. wide; heads solitary, occasionally 2 or 3, the disk 6-12 mm. wide; involuere 3.5-5 mm. high, finely glandular and usually sparsely or moderately hirsute with short spreading hairs; phyllaries distinctly imbricate, firm, scarcely herbaceous, somewhat thickened, especially the outer, mostly greenish-brown, with darker midrib, the inner with thin, membranous or slightly searious, finely erose margins, sometimes purple-tinged, especially toward the tips; ligules about 20-40, sometimes only 15, blue or sometimes purple, 4-8 mm. long, 1.0-1.7 mm. wide; disk-corollas 2.7-4.1 mm. long, the tube 0.5-1.0 mm., the lobes 0.5-0.6 mm.; style-appendages mostly deltoid, acutish, 0.15-0.25 mm. long; pappus bristles mostly 15-25, sometimes 30, nearly or quite equaling the diskcorollas, usually with some slender outer or intermingled setae; akenes 2-nerved, more or less short-hairy, or nearly glabrous. Rock crevices and dry rocky soil in the mountains; western Wyoming to central California, central Nevada, and central Utah; reported from Montana, and to be expected in the southwestern part of the state.

description: Basally woody perennial herbs or subshrubs 25-60 cm tall, caespitose from a xylopodium. Leaves opposite, sometimes alternate distally on the peduncles; petioles up to 2 mm long; blades 2-4(-5.5)x 1-1.4(-2.5) cm, sub- membranous, oblong to elliptic, mostly drying conduplicate and thus becoming falcate shaped, shortly cunéate at the base, the proximal blades usually obtuse to acute at the apex, the distal ones acute to shortly acuminate, margins minutely serrate, both surfaces with trichomes so small, appressed and sparse that the blades appear subglabrate to the naked eye, appressed strigillose along the veins, the abaxial veins more densely so, rarely both surfaces pilose (in H. S. Irwin et al. 8065, NY). Heads solitary at the end of primary shoots; outer phylla- ries 10-20x2-7 mm, elliptic to narrowly oblong, slightly constricted at the base; inner phyllaries 7-12x2-3 mm, like the outer but narrower. Paleae 7-9x8-12 mm when folded, with subulate or triangular tip up to ca. 1.5 mm long. Ray florets sterile, tube 1.5-1.8 mm long, lamina 17-22x4- 6 mm, oblanceolate to narrowly oblong, sparsely setulose abaxially, 2 or 3 lobes irregularly cut or sometimes entire. Disc florets with corollas 4-5 mm long, lobes glabrous. Cypselae 3.5-5 xca. 2 mm, moderately flattened, subquadrangular, usually with longitudinal ridges, not tuberculate, wings 0.2 - 0.8 mm wide; pappus with awns 1-2.8 mm long, relatively narrow at the base, mostly less than one half the cypsela length, crown 0.5 -1.2 mm high, partially fused to the body  (less than 1/3), with lacinate to lacerate margins.

description: Erect, perennial herbs from a much branched caudex atop a woody taproot; branch- ing confined to lower 1/3 of plant. Stems whitish, occasionally tinged with purple, stout, usually 1.5-2.5 mm wide at midstem, (10) 18-36 (38) cm long, glabrous to densely pilose. Leaves narrowly or broadly oblanceolate to spatulate, always wider distal to the base, (2.4) 2.5-7 (9.5) cm long, (2) 4-12 (17) mm wide, sparsely villous to densely villous-canescent with long, stout, flattened, white hairs, often the pubescence confined to the margin of the blade, rarely glabrous; apex acute to obtuse, spinulose to mucronate; base attenuate; margins entire. Heads solitary at the ends of the stems, hemispherical, 1.8-5 cm wide, pedunculate, the peduncles (5.5) 8-21 (24) cm long. Involucre tightly imbricated to merely loose; phyllaries in 2-4 series; outermost phyllaries lanceolate or linear, herbaceous from 3/4 to their entire length, usually keeled basally, 0.5-3 cm long, 0.7-3.6 mm wide, entire or with a thin, hyaline, fimbriate-ciliate margin, the apex acuminate to attenuate; innermost phyllaries similar to the outer phyllaries but usually larger, more scarious, and less pubescent, usually keeled basally. Ray flowers (12) 16-24 (36) per head; tube slender, 2.5-6.5 mm long; ligule white, often tinged with blue, oblong to elliptic, 1.2-2.7 cm long, 3-6.6 mm wide, obscurely to distinctly 3-toothed. Disc flowers 58-126 per head; corolla 3.5-9.5 mm long, gradually ampliate into a broadly funnelform throat; style branches linear, 0.7-1.8 mm long, 0.1-0.3 mm wide, the appendages acute, 0.3-0.7 mm long, shorter than the stigmatic lines. Pappus of about 30-100 stout, unequal bristles, the largest up to 10 mm long. Achenes linear to clavate, 4.5-6.5 mm long, laterally compressed, velutinous with long silky, subappressed hairs, and with numerous weak striations which are obscured by the vestiture. Chromosome numbers n = 6, 12.

description: Herba rhizomatosa ad 40 cm alta. Caules fertiles terminales erecti herbacei striato-angulati tenuiter lanuginoso-arachnoidei. Folia caulina inferiora plus minusve fasciculata, alterna, crasse herbacea late laneeolata acuta basi in petiolum alatum subite attenuata margine denticulata revolutaque superficie in sieco rugulosa lanuginoso-arachnoidea supra tantum costa impressa visibili subtus costa elevata alteris nervis inconspicuis; limbo 5.5-7 cm longo 2-2.6 cm lato, pseudopetiolo circa 2 cm longo 0.5-0.7 mm lato. Folia caulina similia, lanceolata vel lineari-lanceolata sessilia auriculato-amplectentia ad 9 X 2 cm (deorsumn) sursum gradatim decrescentia. Infloreseentia terminalis laxe subcorymboso-paniculata 8-12 capitulis longe pedicellatis. Rami 14-8 cm longi erecti 1-3 capitulati, vulgo moniocephali, striolati parce vel parcissime lanuginosi-arachnoidei, bracteis subtendentibus anguste linearibus acutis 1-2.5 cm longis. Capitula homogama semiglobosa nutantia 2-2.5 cm diamitentia. Involucrum hemisphaericum 21 bracteis biseriatis herbaceis 8 mm longis lineari-lanceolatis aeutis dorso costatis apice penicillatis ceteris leviter arachnoideis exterioribus 1.8-2 mm latis interioribus margine searioso 4 mm latis. Calyculum 14-18 bracteolis subulatis 6-7 nmm longis circa 1 mm latis ad apicem pedicelli deseendentibus, subglabris tenuiter lana arachnoidea decidua munitis. Flores hermaphroditi actinomorphi ultra 200 in capitulo. Corolla lutea, glabra 6-7.5 mm longa tubulo 3.5-4.5 mm longo basi dilatato, limbo campanulato dentibus brevibus deltoideis apice incurvis. Antherae 1.6 mm longae saccis basi acutiusculis. Ramuli styli crassiusculi apice dilatati truneati penicillato-coroniati. Pappus albo-sericeus pilis 2-3-seriatis tenuibus minute strigosis circa 6 mm longis. Achaenia sub-5-costata oblolnga pilis crassis subadpressis dense tecta. Pedicelli sursum bracteolis subulatis 10-5 mm longis muniti, parce lanuginosi vel glabrati, apice plus minusve deflexi.

description: Shrubs 2-3 m tall; stems terete, herbaceous parts glabrous, bright green, woody parts gray. Leaves opposite with pinnate venation; blades 7-14 cm long, 2-4 cm wide, slightly smaller distally, narrowly elliptical, adaxial surface glabrous, bright green, abaxial surface glabrous, creamy green-blue with a whitish bloom, margins shallowly serrate, each serration ending in a prominent mucro, apex acuminate, base attenuate; petiole 2 mm long. Capitulescence of 3-12 heads arranged in a compact corymbiform cyme; peduncles 2-7 cm long, glabrous, bright green. Heads heterogamous, radiate, hemispheric, 1.3-1.8 cm high, 1-1.6 cm wide (excluding ligules); receptacle paleate. Phyllaries 5-9(12) in 1-2 graduated series; phyllaries of two series essentially identical in morphology and differing only in size, innermost phyllaries normally smaller than outermost, 1.5-4 cm long, 1-2.5 cm wide, spreading, slightly reflexed at anthesis and fruit, foliaceous, ovate, glabrous. Pales 5-6 mm long, ca. 2 mm wide, lanceolate to oblong, conduplicate, concave, sparsely puberulent at base, stramineous, greenish black at midrib and distal end, apex acuminate. Ray flowers 9-14, the corollas golden-yellow, pistillate; ligules 1.6-2 cm long, 5-6 mm wide, oblong, sparsely puberulent abaxially especially on veins, apex bifid or trifid; tubes 1-1.2 mm long, mod- erately pubescent. Ray cypselae ca. 3 mm long, 2-2.2 mm wide, obovate, shallowly biconvex, essentially glabrous with a few trichomes on distal third central portion; pappus of 2 awns 1.2-1.3 mm long. Disk flowers 110-160, the corollas yellow, perfect; throat 2.4-2.7 mm long, tubular to slightly urceolate, glabrous; tube 1 mm long, moderately puberulent, greenish yellow; lobes 0.5 mm long, glabrous, yellow; anthers 1.8-2 mm long, black, the appendages 0.4 mm long, stramineous; styles 4-4.2 mm long, yellow; style branches 1-1.2 mm long, acute with small appendages, yellow. Disk cypselae like those of the rays.

description: Plant perennial from a diffuse slenderly branching caudex; leaves sparsely to moderately villous and obscurely viscid, oblanceolate or spatulate, up to about 2.5 cm. long and 4 mm. wide on young shoots, mostly smaller, some of them, particularly the early ones and those on young shoots, 3-lobed at the apex, with broad rounded lobes; peduncles scapiform, about 3 cm. long or less, loosely and sometimes sparsely villous with long spreading hairs, also glandular; heads solitary; disk 9-13 mm. wide; involucre 6-8 mm. high, loosely viscid-villous with long slender flattened hairs; phyllaries few, subequal, thin, green, sometimes distinctly yellowish toward the tips, sometimes purplish; ligules about 60 or less, white or light pinkish, up to 5 mm. long and 0.8 mm. wide, mostly a little more slender; disk-corollas about 3.5-4.4 mm. long, the tube 1.2-1.4 mm., the lobes 0.5-0.6 mm.; style-appendages ovate-lanceolate, acute, about 0.2-0.25 mm. long; pappus bristles about 25-30, surpassing the disk-corollas by about 1 mm. or a little more or less; outer pappus short and inconspicuous; akenes 2-nerved, moderately short-hairy.

description: Plants annual (or biennial?), from a weakly developed taproot, 30-90, cm high, sparsely pubeseent with crisp spreading hairs, rarely interspersed with short, glandular trichomes on the upper branches; basal rosette distinct but soon deciduous; stems terete below but somewhat angled above, leafy through- out, single at first but often developing several primary stems from the crown with age or following injury; lower leaves of primary shoots broadly oblanecolate to linear-oblanceolate, the blades irregularly lobed or merely dentate, 3-5 cm long, 0.5-2 cm wide, conspicuously ciliate along the margins and midribs with crisp, spreading hairs, otherwise subglabrous (rarely more evenly pubescent but always ciliate along the margins.), passing gradually or abruptly into a narrow, winged petiole, the upper leaves on primary shoots becoming succes- sively reduced and entire (older plants are usually composed of only the small subulate leaves from secondary branches); heads on primary shoot 3-50, becom- ing more numerous with secondary branching; involuere broadly turbinate to nearly hemispheric, enclosing 30-75(-90) florets, 5-7 mm wide, 3-5 mm high, erect at anthesis but usually reflexing in age; peduncles 3-15 mm long, sparsely to densely glandular-pubescent or merely pubescent; involueral bracts 25-30 in 2-3(-4) series, imbricated, linea.r-subulate, usually green and herbaceous throughout except for an inconspicuous searious portion near the base and along, the margins of the inner ones, 2-5(-6) mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm wide, glabrous to rather densely glandular-pubescent; receptacle flat; ray florets 9- 32 (-40), the ligules 5-7 mm long, 0.8-1 mm wide, blue-violet to white, enrolling on drying, the tube 1.3-1.8 mm long; disk corollas yellow, 3-5 mm long; corolla lobes erect, 0.5-0.8 mm long; pappus of 20-30 bristles, 2.2-4.5 mm long; chromo- some number, n = 4.

description: Herb, apparently perennial (roots not seen); stems erect or arching, to 5 m long and 3-4 cm in diameter at base, hexagonal or round in cross section, often purplestriped, sparingly tomentose; leaves opposite, ovate to obovate, membranaceous, to 55 cm long, 26 cm wide, sessile and connate-perfoliate, or the petiole winged to the connate-perfoliate base; principal leaves pinnately 5-7-lobed and -veined (upper leaves lobed or unlobed), some lobes incised or parted or both; the margins dentate, the teeth callous-tipped; adaxial surface dark green, scabrous, tomentulose on the main veins; abaxial surface pale green, the lamina glandular-dotted, puberulous, remotely strigose to puberulous on the main veins; inflorescence axillary and terminal, branched, bracteate, often 1/3 the length of entire plant; peduncles to 24 cm long, sometimes purple-striped, densely stipitate-glandular and pilose; heads several to many, expanded at anthesis to ca. 1-1.5 cm wide, ca. 1 cm high, convex, the receptacle flattened; phyllaries 5, linear-lanceolate, basally connate, 2-3 mm wide, to 17 mm long, adaxially densely stipitate-glandular and sparsely tomentose, the abaxial surface with fewer glands and hairs, reflexed in fruit; paleae of the ray flowers ovate, long-acuminate, ca. 9 mm long, 3 mm wide, often purple-tinged, glabrous adaxially at least in the expanded concave base, the margins hirtellous-pilose, eventually laterally involute, stipitate-glandular and pilose abaxially; ray flowers ca. 10-12, their corollas yellow (when dried, y 8/8 as per the Munsell Book of Color), 12-22 mm long, 6-11 mm wide, broadly obovate, the tube ca. 2 mm long, pilose and stipitate-glandular outside, the style and stigma to about 5 mm long; disc flowers ca. 60-75, yellow, ca. 8 mm long, the upper half 1-1.5 mm wide; the lower portion ca. 0.5 mm wide, minutely stipitate-glandular and hirtellous outside especially on the tube; paleae of the disc flowers lanceolate to oblanceolate, 3-6 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, the abaxial surface and margins hirtellous or pilose or both, adaxial surface sparsely hirtellous or pilose or both; achenes black (immature ones green then purple), asymmetrically obovoid, often apically papillate, obscurely 4-angled, remotely sulcate, radially flattened, glabrous, ca. 5 mm long, ca. 4 mm wide in greatest dimension.

description: Perennial 1-3.5(0.5-5) dm tall, glabrous or lightly pubescent in the axils of the inflorescence and leaves; stems arising singly or several loosely clustered from a well developed, perennial rhizomatous caudex. Basal leaves broadly ovate to obovate in outline but deeply dissected and therefore pinnatifid or sublyrate; the margins of the lobes crenate to crenate-dentate; midrib weakly winged, petiole well developed, about as long as the blade; overall dimensions 5-12(3-18) cm long and 1-4 cm wide. Cauline leaves usually 1-3 or sometimes absent; the lower ones resembling the basal leaves but smaller, the upper reduced to mere bracts, giving the plant a subscapose aspect. Inflorescence a subumbellate cyme of (2)4-10+ heads; principal involucral bracts about 13 or sometimes only 8, 4-7 mm long, green or yellowish tipped; ray florets ca. 5 or 8, the ligules 5-10 mm long. description: Herbs to ca 2 m tall; stems stout, angular, furrowed, densely pilose above, often orange-yellow when dry; lower leaves broadly ovate and subhastate, to 33 cm long- and 22 cm wide, the short lobes separated by broad shallow sinuses, the margin den- tate, the teeth callous-tipped; base of expanded portion of leaf deltoid or abruptly cuneate, the lower part with wings to 4 cm wide and 14 cm long; leaves auriculate at the base, the main veins 3; upper surface pilose, the lower pubescent; upper leaves ovate-lanceolate, without lobes and hastate bases; peduncles densely glandular- pilose; phyllaries 5, uniseriate, ovate-lanceolate, to 15 mm long and 10 mm wide, glandular-pilose below, nearly glabrous above, the margins pilose; ray flowers to ca 15, the corollas yellow, to 12 mm long and 7 mm broad, the tube densely pilose out- side; disc flowers ca 7 mm long, the corollas yellow, slightly pubescent outside; ray paleae ovate-lanceolate, ca 6 mm long and 2 mmn wide; disc paleae obovate, the upper margin denticulate, ca 3 mm long and 2 mm wide; achene purple (mature achene not seen).

description: Slender, erect, slightly aromatic annual, (6) 9-26 cm tall, corymbosely branching above, sparsely white-hirsute, the upper stem densely black-stipitate-glandular; leaves sparsely hirsute, sessile, linear to narrowly oblanceolate, denticulate, the lower opposite, the upper alternate, 1.2-4.2 cm long, 0.5-3 mm wide; involucre ovoid, pilose, 3-5 mm high; receptacle glabrous; ray flowers 4-8, pistillate, corolla yellow, 3-6 mm long, the tube 0.5-1 mm long, the ligule 3-lobed; disk flowers 8-20, functionally staminate, corolla yellow, 2.5-3.5 mm long; anthers yellow; achenes kyphotic, black with stramineous beak, 2-3 mm long; ray pappus a ring of rudimentary paleae less than 0.3 mm long; disk pappus of 7-10 fimbriate paleae, 0.25-0.9 mm long.

description: Perennial herbs (1) 2-4 (6) dm tall, from a short, stout rhizome with pubescent bud scales; stems sometimes slightly curved, pilose-hirsute or pilose-hispid to densely pilose-hirsute or pilose-tomentose, pubescence often brownish, sometimes with stipitate glandular trichomes. Leaves cauline, gradually reduced upwards, sometimes absent below the inflorescence, the subsessile blades (2.3) 3-7 (10.5) cm long, 0.2-1 (2.3) cm wide, oblanceolate to oblong-elliptic, linear-elliptic or linear, widest at or above the middle, apically acute to acute-mucronate, basally cuneate, the margins revolute, remotely blunt-callous-toothed, pilose to hirsute-villous above, silkily long-strigose to pilose on veins beneath. Inflorescences cymose-scorpioid, often curved downwards, very rarely with only one head. Heads 16-26 (34)-flowered; peduncles generally absent, or up to 1 cm long, pilose-tomentose, sometimes stipitate-glandular. Involucre broadly campanulate, (7) 8-12 (15) mm high, (6) 7-10 (14) mm wide. Phyllaries loosely imbricate in several series, pilose on back, especially at tips, sometimes with stipitate-glan- dular trichomes, the inner ones linear-lanceolate, (6.5) 8-11 (14) mm long, (0.9) 1.1-1.5 (1.7) mm wide, acuminate, the outer ones linear-lanceolate, (2.5) 4.5-9 (11) mm long, (0.3) 5-8 (11) mm wide. Pappus brownish, the inner bristles (6.2) 8-10 (13) mm long, the outer ones (0.8) 1-2 (2.5) mm long. Corollas (7.5) 9-14 mm long, reddish-purple, bearded at tip of lobes. Anthers 2.7-3.8 mm long. Achenes 2-3.2 mm long, densely strigose-pilose. Flowering and fruiting mostly from September to December or occasionally throughout the year.

description: Perennial herb with a taproot and stout branehed caudex; stem 3-8 cm. high, finely glandular, and sparsely hirsute with coarse spreading hairs; leaf surfaces finely glandular-hirtellous and coarsely hirsute in varying proportions; leaf margins coarsely ciliate toward the base with stiff hairs over 1 mm. long; basal leaves oblanceolate to spatulate, rounded to acute at the apex, up to 6 cm. long and 6 mm. wide; cauline leaves inconspicuous and linlear, or absent; heads large, solitary, turbinate, the disk 10-20 mm. broad; involuere 8-10 mm. high, finely and densely glandular, and sparsely or moderately hispid-hirsute with long coarse hairs well over 1 mm. long; phyllaries subequal or slightly imbricate, with brown midrib, yellowish or greenish borders, and attenuate-acuminate purplish tips, the outermost sometimes like the others, sonetimes narrower and shorter; ligules about 15-25, purple, 7-10 mm. long, 1.5-2.2 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 4.7-6.0 mm. long, the tube 1.1-1.7 mm., the lobes 0.7-0.9 mm.; style-appendages a little narrower than deltoid, acuLte, 0.2-0.35 mm. long; pappus esseintially simple, of about 20-27 coarse firm bristles; akenes 2-nerved, occasionally 3-nerved, hirsute when young, becoming nearly glabrous.

description: Biennial or perennial herb, usually with a short simple or slightly branched caudex; stem about 0.5-8 dm. high, or perhaps more, subglabrous to more or less spreading-hirsute, often also glandular, especially under the heads; leaves subglabrous or more or less hirsute, sometimes, especially the upper ones, glandular; basal leaves oblanceolate to sometimes spatulate, entire or sometimes remotely serrulate, up to about 10 cm. long and 15 mm. wide, rounded at the apex; cauline leaves, except in extreme depauperates, relatively well developed, narrowly lanceolate or lance-oblong to ovate, generally acute, more evidently so upwards; heads solitary or few to many, the peduncles usually well developed and obliquely ascending to arcuate-aseending; involuere about 5-12 mm. high, finely glandular, or hirsute, or both; phyllaries generally subequal, or occasionally the outer evidently shorter, green or more or less purplish, the inner long-attenuate, often almost caudate, the outer merely acuminate or attenuate-acuminate; pistillate flowers numerous, in several series, of two kinds, the outer with long filiform tube and narrow pink to purplish or white erect ligules about 2.5-4.5 mm. long, and 0.2-0.55 mm. wide, the inner nearly or quite eligulate, with tubular corolla from nearly as long as the style to less than half as long, and often few; disk-corollas slender, 4.2-6.2 mm. long, the tube 1.6-3.0 mm., the lobes 0.4-0.5 mm.; style appendages triangular-lanceolate to deltoid-ovate, acute or obtusish, 0.05-0.2 mm. long; pappus of about 25-35 slender remotely barbellate white or more or less reddish bristles, surpassing the disk-corollas, sometimes with a few inconspicuous short outer setae; akenes 2-nerved, sparsely hairy.

description: Stems short, less than 1 cm usually 1-5 mm high; leaves twisted and somewhat recurved when dry, 3-5 mm long, erect-spreading to somewhat seeund, narrowly ovate at the base, gradually narrowed and becoming linear-subulate; leaves serrulate at the apex; basal cells oblong to hexagonal, up to 10 m long, the upper cells linear, bistratose along the margin; costa thin and indistinct at the base, excurrent into a long subula composed entirely of costal cells. Autoicous: perigonial buds numerous, often dehiscing; perichaetial leaves not or only slightly clasping at the base; seta 1-4 cm long, bright yellow, glossy; capsules erect or somewhat inclined, ovoid-cylindric, suleate when dry; annulus of 1-3 rows of cells, deciduous; operculum conic, obtuse; mouth small, bordered; peristome brownish-yellow, slightly twisted, not exceeding 1 mm in length; teeth 16, irregularly split to a short basal membrane into 32 filiform, spinose-papillose, nodose divisions; spores brownish in mass, papillose, 16-23 (rarely 27) µ, maturing February to June.

description: Herbaceous to suffrutescent perennials, erect, usually branching. Leaves well distributed along stem; without a persistent basal rosette. Central leaves ovate, usually 94 to 1 I4 times as broad as long, velvety, with crenate margins, unlobed (except intergrades to B. X humilis), often long petioled. description: Perennial herb with a stout branching caudex; stem, leaves, and involucre sparsely to moderately hirsute-villous with flattened flexuous hairs, and more or less stipitate-glandular, sometimes obscurely so; stem about 7-25 cm. high; basal leaves broadly oblanceolate to obovate or elliptic, with short or fairly long petioles, sometimes triple-nerved, sometimes merely pinnately veined, the veins directed forward, occasionally irregularly denticulate on the margin, rounded to acute at the apex, up to 12 cm. long and 20 mm. wide; cauline leaves several, only slightly: or moderately reduced, ovate to oblong or narrowly lanceolate, commonly acute, sometimes obtuse; heads usually solitary, rarely as many as 5, the disk 7-14 mm. wide;- involucre 5-8 mm. high, about equaling the disk, sparsely to moderately hirsute-villous, and densely to obscurely glandular;, phyllaries thin, green, subequal, loose, attenuate, or the outer sometimes merely acuminate, often purplish at the tip, the outer not infrequently narrowed toward the base and slightly enlarged upwards; ligules about 20-45, blue, pink, or occasionally white, about 5-12 mm. long, 1.3-2.0 mm. wide, prominently 2-3-toothed at the apex, occasionally irregularly cleft; disk-corollas about 3.0-4.3 mm. long, the tube 0.8-1.1 mm., the lobes 0.7-1.3 mm.; style-appendages lance-ovate or narrowly triangular, acute, about 0.2-0.25 mm. long, occasionally a little shorter and broader; pappus of about 12-16 bristles, sometimes with a few slender outer setae; akenes sparsely hirsute, 2-nerved.

description: Herbaceous or subligneous-based perennial 2-5 (7) dm tall, tomentose or arachnoid tomentulose, often glabrate in age; stems arising singly or most often several clustered from a branched, woody, erect, taprooted caudex, rarely creeping by lateral rootstocks 5-10 cm beneath the surface of the ground. Basal leaves early deciduous, fundamentally ovate-obovate to spatulate but variously lyrate to pin- natifid, sometimes deeply and finely divided; terminal lobe often well defined and subtended by one or more pairs of lateral lobes on the weakly winged midrib; terminal and lateral lobes dentate to serrate-dentate or parted; petiole about as long or up to twice as long as the blade; overall dimensions 7-10(5-15) cm long and 2-3(1.5-5) cm wide. Lower cauline leaves similar to the basal leaves but shorter and without a well defined terminal lobe; lateral lobes more numerous, often 5-8 pairs, bifid or trifid at the apex; petiole poorly defined, about one-half as long as the blade. Middle and upper cauline leaves progressively reduced upward, becoming merely incised bracts. Inflorescence an open or rarely contracted cyme of 5-15(2-20) heads; principal involucral bracts about 13 or 21, 8-10(7-12) mm long with tips green or yellowish; calyculate bracts inconspicuous; rays about 8 or 13, the ligule 10-15 mm long. Achenes 4-5(6) mm long, glabrous.

description: Rhizomes 2-3 mm. thick, dark brown, frequently forming an approximate crown, the branches toward the apex becoming 4-6 mm. in diam., and clothed with imbricate scales; stems coarse, 3-5 mm. diam., 3-4(6.5) dm. high, frequently branched from the base, mostly densely short-stipitate-glandular and with few septate hairs; cauline leaves 3-many pairs mostly crowded toward the base, there opposite, these and the leaves of innovations with wing-margined or wingless petioles shorter than or subequal to the blades; blades lance-elliptic, oblanceolate or rarely ovate, obtusish or acute, sharply or undulately dentate, short-stipitate-glandular and sparsely pilose with septate hairs, upwards the leaves frequently alternating by disjunction of the nodes, reduced, broadly winged-petioled or sessile; peduncles 3-7 (10) cm. long; toward the top more or less densely long- and short-stipitate-glandular and scabrid-puberulent; infloreseence appearing paniculate by disjunction of the nodes; heads 7-30, seldom fewer, 15-18 mm. high, campanulate; perielinium densely pilose and long- and short-stipitate-glandular; involueral bracts 11-13, 9.0-11 mm. long, lanceolate, acutish, with pubescence toward the base similar to that of perielinium, above becoming less pilose, but conspicuously short-stipitate-glandular, the tips pilose within; ray flowers none; marginal disc flowers rarely ampliate; normal disc corollas 9.0(8.0)-9.5 (11) mm. long, goblet-shaped, the limb frequently sparingly pubescent to summit, the tube and the base of the limb uniformly densely and coarsely pilose, the collar conspicuous, the tube 3.6-4.6 mm. long; achenes 6.0-7.0 mm. long, somewhat tapering at both ends, hirsute and glandular above, glabrate toward the base; pappus -+ the length of a corolla, white, barbellate, the setae 0.1-0.18 mm. long.

description: Herba circa 60 cm alta tota albo adpresseque villoso-lanata. Folia basilaria rosulata vagina oblonga subseariosa nervata 8-9 cm longa basi circa 1 cm lata, limrbo crasse herbaceo anguste lineari-laileeolato basim versus sensim sine sensu angustato 26-30 cm longo ad tertium superiore 1.5-1.6 cm lato basi (petiolo) 4 mm lato utrinque lana alba densa subadpressa obtecto, costa supra anguste impressa subtus prominenti, nervulis secundariis aseendentibus prominulis. Folia caulina similia sed subsessilia vagina brevi crassiuscula leiviter subamplectente. Caulis florifer terminalis solitarius folia excedens erectus striatus paulo foliosus dense subadpresseque albo-lanatus extremo panicula subsimplice pyranidata floribunda circa 20 cm longa instructa. Pedunculi patuli inferiores 3-4 capitula ferentes 6-7 cm longi sursum decreseentibus superioribus 1-0.3 cm longis monocephalis. Bracteae anguste lineares albo lanatae pedunculum aequilongae vel excedentes. Capitula grandia subcampanulata 15 mm alta, 11-12 mm diamitentia, late (3 cm diamitens) radiata. Involucrum cylindrico-campanulatum basi rotundatum circa 10 mm altum, 21 bracteis congeste biseriatis herbaceis linearibus acutis 9-10 mm longis exterioribus 1.6-1.7 mm latis interioribus 2.5-2.6 mm latis margine searioso, omnibus dorso albo-lanatis sursumi apiceque purpurascentibus. Basi capitulo calyculo majuseulo 26-30 bracteis subulato-linearibus acutis 8-11 mm longis 1-1.6 mm latis subbiseriatis plus minusve purpuraseentibus sed dense arachnoideo albo-lanatis iinvolucrum adpressis tectis instructo. Flores radii feminei ligulati circa 22, corolla flava glabra 19-20 mm longo tubulo 7 mm subcapillaceo limubo lingulato 12-13 mm longo circa 3.5 mm lato apice attenuato angustato ramis styli 1.5-2 mm exsertis apice truneatis; ovario glabro; pappo albo sericeo pilis biseriatis breviter strigulosis 6-7 mm lonois. Flores disci circa 110 in capitulo, hermaphroditi tubulosi, corolla lutea 8.5-9.5 mm longa glabra tubulo angusto 4-4.5 mm longo limbo tubuloso 5 dentibus atratis anguste linearibus margine incrassato minutissime papillosulo; antheris 2 mm longis basi muticis; ovario oblongo glabro 2 mm longo; pappo sericeo pilis triseriatis milnute strigulosis circa 7 mm longis.

description: Plants perennial from a lignescent base, 30-42 cm high, sparsely hirsute, erect or nearly so; leaves trilobed to pinnately lobed or divided, the segments subfiliform to linear, 2-7.5 cm long, sessile to subpetiolate, sparsely hirsute; heads solitary, narrowly to broadly campanulate, 7-15(-20) mm in diameter; peduncles 11-23 cm long, single or dichotomously branched, often with a modified bract-like leaf at the base, hirtellous and with short, glandular-capitate trichomes, especially near the head; receptacle conical 2-3 mm wide, 4-5 mm high; chaff persistent, scarious, glabrous, 7.5-9 mm long, 2.5-3.5 mm wide, attenuate or with an awn-like beak at the apex; involucre 4-5-seriate, outer bracts oblong, green to purple-tinged, 1-2.5 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, glabrate or sparsely pubescent, rounded at the apex; inner bracts progressively longer, the longest 6-10 mm long, 2-3 mnm wide, oblong to oblong-lanceolate, becoming membranous, completely to partially purple, glabrous, or with glandular-capitate trichomes near the rounded to obtuse apex; ray flowers ca 8, pistillate and fertile, tubular at the base for 6.5-8 mm, with small, rather inconspicuous yellow ligules, these 1.5-3 mm long, 2-4 mm wide, suborbicular, obscurely 3-lobed at the apex; disc corollas yellow, 6.5-8.5 mm long, the tube 2.5-3 mm long, glabrous to sparsely short pilose, often with minute glandular hairs, the throat broadly tubular to narrowly funnelform, 2-3.5(-4) mm long, glabrous to pilose at the base, the lobes acute-attenuate, minutely pubescent at the apex, 1.5-2 mm long; style branches slender, slightly flattened, ca 2.5 mm long, revolute, subulate at the tip, pubescent beneath and along the margins, stigmatic lines obscure on the inner surface; achenes black, turbinate, 2-2.5 mm long, densely long hirsute-pilose; pappus of 25-38 unequal, brownish, plumose bristles (with rather short cilia), 3.5-6.5 mm long, with some of the shorter almost equaling the longest; anthers 2.5-3.5 mm long, sagittate at the base.

description: Arching branched shrubs, to 4 m tall, one main stem at base in juvenile plants, 2.5- 3.5 cm diam., branched at base in older plants; stems many-angled, often flattened near new branches, densely short strigose, hairs 1 mm long. Leaves petiolate, winged, blades ovate, 14-23(-30) X 8-15(-23) cm, apices acuminate, bases truncate-rounded, shortly decurrent on the petiole, margins serrate to irregularly serrate, both faces strigillose, hairs 1 mm long; petioles sulcate above, marginate by the decurrent blades, 3-6 cm long, strigillose, hairs 1 mm long. Capitulescences paniculiform, with many loose clusters of capitula, usually ternately divided on peduncles to 6 cm long. Capitula 5-6 mm high, 3-4 mm diam.; phyllaries 3-4, 4 X 2.5-3.5 mm, obovate, 5-7 veined, adaxially whitish, abaxially green, apices acute, strigose, hairs 1 mm long, distal one-third margin ciliate. Pistillateflorets 9, subtended by ovate paleae, 3.5-4 X 2.5- 3 mm, strigose, hairs 0.8 mm long, apices acute, 5-nerved; corollas 2 mm long, 0.8 mm diam., white, glabrous, 3-lobed, lobes deltoid, 0.5 mm long, apices scarcely pubescent; styles 1.5 mm long, branches 1 mm long. Staminate-florets 8-14, subtended by lanceolate (occasionally, 1-2 epaleaceous central florets), paleae, 3-3.5 X 1.5 mm, apices scarcely ciliate, 3-veined; corollas 1.8-2 mm long, 1 mm diam., white, 4-lobed, lobes deltoid, 0.5 mm long, apices scarcely pubescent; anthers 1 mm long, black; ovaries 2 mm long, 1.5 mm diam., pilose toward apex, hairs 1 mm long. Cypselae 2.5 X 1.5-2 mm, pilose toward distal one-third, hairs 1 mm long. Chromosome number, n = 16 (Stuessy & Arriagada, 1993).

description: Basally woody perennial herbs or subshrubs to 1 m tall, mostly caespitose, from a xylopodium. Leaves mostly alternate, sometimes opposite at the base or throughout, or shoots may be opposite and alternate leaved in the same plant; petioles up to 5 mm long; blades 2- 4.5(-6.5)x 2 - 4.5(7) cm, chartaceous, ovate to broadly ovate or orbicular, cordate or sometimes subcordate or subtruncate at the base, rounded to rarely obtuse at the apex, margins crenate-serrulate, both surfaces mostly tomentose or subtomentose, rarely pilose-strigillose, usually soft to the touch, the abaxial dull cinereous, more densely indumented, 3 nerved from near to well above the base and reticulate. Heads branching regularly out of prophylls or sometimes solitary; peduncles stout, rarely somewhat elongated, mostly with leaves sub- tending the heads; outer phyllaries 12-30 x 9- 22 mm, elliptic or sometimes ovate, strongly indurate at the base; inner phyllaries 6-20 x 4- 15 mm, like the outer, but slightly constricted at the base to oblong and more scarious. Paleae 8.5-1 Ox 1-2 m when folded, with subulate or triangular tips 1-1. 5 mm long. Ray florets sterile, tube 1.5-2.5 mm long, lamina 13.5- 21x3-5 mm, elliptic to oblong-elliptic or oblong, densely setulose abaxially, 2 or 3 lobes shallowly or deeply cut. Disc florets with corollas 5-6 mm long, lobes abaxially setulose. Cypselae 3-4 x 1.8-2 mm, thickened, subqua- drangular, with 1-3 longitudinal ridges, smooth, mostly setulose, rarely finely and sparsely tuberculate, wingless or wings reduced to a narrow margin, often paler, ciliate on the margin opposite the paleae; pappus with awns 0.5- 2.5 mm high, relatively broad at the base, mostly unequal, the longest being Vi or less than % of the cypsela lengh, crown reduced to a ciliate or rarely entire margin.
