description: Herbaceous perennial to 1 m tall; stems prominently winged, pubescence sparse below to hispidulous above. Leaves alternate; blades lanceolate to broadly ovate, to 20 cm long and 11.5 cm wide, margins crenate to irregularly dentate (almost pinnatifid in some immature leaves), apex acute, sessile or base narrowing to a petiole to 1 cm long, nearly glabrous to scabrous above and below with mostly appressed hairs. Capitulescence weakly racemiform, usually with fewer than 6 heads less than 2 cm in diam on hispidulous pedicels to 13 cm long. Involucre 2-3-seriate; outer bracts lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, 3.4-4.1 mm long, 0.7- 1.2 mm wide, pubescent, sessile glands present or absent, apex broadly acute to rounded, base indurate; inner bracts longer, grading into the paleae. Paleae ob- lanceolate, 4.6-4.9 mm long, 1-1.2 mm wide, keeled, ciliate and pubescent on upper 1/3, apex acute, herbaceous. Receptacle conical. Ray florets 35-37, 2-3- seriate, ligules yellow-orange to orange, glabrous, 1-1.9 mm long, 0.5-0.8 mm wide, apex 2-dentate (occasionally deeply 3-lobed in the inner series), tube glabrous or sparsely pubescent, 0.5-0.9 mm long, 0.2-0.3 mm wide. Disc florets ca 60, corolla yellow-orange to orange, funnelform, 1.6-1.8 mm long, 1.1-1.4 mm wide, tube glabrous, 0.7-1 mm long, 0.2-0.3 mm wide, anthers black, apical appendages acute, style branches acute. Ray and disc achenes similar, brown, 3.7- 5.5 mm long, 1.2-2 mm wide, sparsely pubescent over the entire surface, wings 1.2-1.6 mm wide, pappus of 2 unequal awns, the shorter one to 1.8 mm long, uncinate or with an easily deciduous bristle tip, the longer one to 3.7 mm long, strongly uncinate.
bibliographicCitation: Olsen, John S. 1986. Revision of Verbesina section Verbesina (Asteraceae: Heliantheae). Brittonia. 38: 362-368.

description: Shrubs, 2-4 m tall; stems subangulate, 10 cm diam., branches strigose-pilose, hairs 1 mm long. Leaves largely petiolate; blades 20-50 X 20-40 cm, ovate, rounded-ovate, membraneous, densely strigose, hairs 0.6-1 mm long, apices briefly acuminate, bases deeply cordate (mainly in old leaves); margins serrate to crenate-serrate, veins 7-9, prominent; petioles 16-22 cm long, 1.5-2.5 mm diam., striate, strigose, hairs 1 mm long. Capitulescences cymose or paniculiform, broadly branched. Capitula ovoid, 4- 5 mm high, 3 mm diam., shortly pedicellate or sessile, clustered in aggregations at terminal branches; phyllaries 3, 4-5 X 3-4 mm, obovate to obovate-ovate, apices mucronate-acuminate, strigose, hairs 1 mm long, margins ciliate at upper half, 5-veined. Pistillate fiorets 7, paleate, subtended by ovate paleae, 4.5 X 3-3.5 mm, strigose hairs 0.3-0.4 mm long, margins shortly ciliate at distal half, 4-veined; corollas 2 mm long, white, tubes 1.4 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., 3-lobed, lobes irregularly deltoid, 0.5 mm long, shortly ciliate at margin; styles 2.5 mm long, branches 1 mm long. Staminate fiorets 8(-9), subtended by lanceolate paleae, 3-4 X 0.5-1 mm, 2-veined, margins shortly ciliate at apex; corollas 3 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., white, 5-lobed, lobes deltoid, 0.5 mm long, scarcely pubescent at apex; anthers 1-1.5 mm long, black; styles 2 mm long, undivided; ovaries pilose toward apex, hairs 1 mm long. Cypselae 2 X 1.6 mm, pilose on the distal one-third, hairs 1-1.5 mm long. Chromosome number, n = 16 (Stuessy & Arriagada, 1993).
bibliographicCitation: Arriagada, J. E. 2003. Revision of the genus Clibadium (Asteraceae, Heliantheae). Brittonia. 55: 245-301.

description: Stout perennial herbs to 1.7 m, erect, rhizomatous, fibrous-rooted. Stems 6-15 dm, solid, terete, greenish-purple or sometimes evenly purplish, conspicuously glandular pubescent nearly or quite to the base with long, spreading, persistent hairs, occasionally merely densely puberulent and sparingly glandular. Leaves firm, verticillate, mostly in 3's or 4's, blade lance-ovate or ovate to deltate-ovate, mostly 7-30 x 2.5-18 cm, relatively abruptly or sometimes gradually tapering to the short-petiolate base, acuminate at the apex, pinnately veined, usually coarsely serrate with a large gland at apex of each marginal tooth, petiole (0.7) 1.3-2.8 (3.6) mm; adaxial surface glabrescent to more often scabrous-hirsute, abaxial surface conspicuously to sparsely glandular pubescent and loosely hirsute on the midrib and main veins, usually rather sparsely so over the surface as well. Inflo- rescence a loosely convex compound cyme; peduncles 1-8 mm long, conspicuously glandular pubescent. Involucre 6.5-9 mm high, often purplish; bracts 10-22, lan- ceolate, obtuse at apex, well imbricate, few-striate or at least with prominent midvein; receptacle naked, flat or weakly convex. Flowers perfect, (5) 6-9 (10) in a head; corollas discoid 4.5-7.5 mm, 5-toothed, generally very pale pinkish or purplish, funnelform, outer surface usually minutely atomiferous-glandular, lobes ovate to deltate, usually slightly longer than wide; style base puberulous, enlarged (as in Eupatorium s. str. of King & Robinson, 1987), style branches slightly broadened or flattened distally, only lower half fertile, with paired stigmatic lines. Achenes prismatic, 3-4.5 mm long, 5-ribbed, atomiferous-glandular, sometimes with a few setulae along the nerves; pappus a single series of 25-40 slender, capillary, scabrous, persistent bristles. 2n = 20.

description: Stout herb, the caudex subterranean or essentially so; leaves thin coriaceous, linear or oblanceolate-linear, 15-40 cm. long, 4-16 mm. broad, scarcely narrowed proximally, obtuse or subacute at apex, strongly revolute at margins, silvery or cinereous sericeous above, tomentose beneath, the costa stout, the secondary nerves obscured; flowering branches up to 60 cm. high, cinereous tomentose below, brown or ferruginous tomentose distally, bearing alternate linear cauline leaves, corymbosely branched above, the branches suberect, alternate, subtended by small foliaceous linear-oblong bracts; heads numerous, at maturity 15-20 mm. in diameter; phyllaries about 60, 2-or 3-seriate, oblong-lanceolate, acute, the outer ones 4-7 mm. long, 1-2.5 mm. broad, densely brown pilose without, the hairs 1.5-2.5 mm. long; ray florets numerous, about 3-seriate, the corolla 9-10 mm. long, the tube very slender, about 2 mm. long, densely hispid with hairs 0.5-1 mm. long, the lamina linear-oblong, 1.5-2 mm. broad, 2- or  3-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas 4-5 mm. long, the achene 1-2 mm. long; disk florets about 5 mm. long, the tube shorter than the limb, the lobes ovate-deltoid, densely brown hispid with hairs 0.5 mm. long, the stamens about 4 mm. long; paleae oblong or obovate, 3.5-5.5 mm. long, 0.7-1.2 mm. broad, acute, densely hispid, the hairs 1-2 mm. long.

description: Erect, herbaceous plants, densely branched, to 70 cm tall. Stems striate, densely leafy, somewhat flexuous apically, glandular-pubescent. Leaves oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 2-8 X 1-4 cm, the apex acute, mucronate, the base truncate, sharply denticulate, coriaceous, glandular-punctate on both surfaces, more so on the lower surface. Inflorescence a loose, rounded panicle; capitula solitary or in pairs, sometimes in a small corymbiform arrangement, 1.5-1.8 cm high; peduncles 0.2-1.3 cm long, bracteolate, densely pubescent with both glandular and eglandular hairs; bracteoles foliose, lanceolate to oblong, 0.5-1 X 0.1- 0.3 cm, entire to sharply denticulate; involucre 3-seriate, campanulate, ca. 1.3 cm high, the phyllaries ciliate, abaxially glandular, frequently obscurely so, the outer most ovate, 5-6 X ca. 3 mm, obtuse to acute and abruptly sharply mucronate, densely ciliate, the central ones oblong, 6- 7 X 2 mm, obtuse to acute and abruptly mucronate, the innermost oblanceolate, ca. 12 X ca. 1 mm, acute and mucronulate. Florets 18 or 19; corollas pink, scarcely glandular-puberulent, ca. 12 mm long, the tube as long as the lips; stamens ca. 7.5 mm long; the apical appendages ca. 2 mm long, the anther thecae 3.5 mm long, the tails ca. 2 mm long, the filaments ca. 2.5 mm long; styles ca. 12 mm long, including the truncate branches ca. 1 mm long. Achenes fusiform, ca. 4 mm long (immature), glandular-pubescent and hirsute; pappus ca. 11 mm long, white, biseriate.

description: Pachycladous, loosely branched shrubs becoming arborescent, ca 0.1-2 m; stems lanate to tomentose, becoming glabrate, leaf scars or bases usually evident. Leaves crowded toward tips of stems; blades sessile (2.5) 5-14 x (0.6) 0.9-1.5 (2.6) cm, linear-lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, widest at or below the middle, apically acute to sometimes rounded, basally broad-sheathing or cuneate to truncate, marginally entire and revolute, leathery and usually tomentose at the base above, canescent-tomentose and often basally floccose below, main veins parallel, but sometimes a reticulation obvious (Fig. 3). Inflorescences terminating short lateral branches, glomerules subtended by spreading to recurved foliaceous bracts and compacted into a larger structure (Fig. 3). Heads 5-10-flowered. Phyllaries 8.5-13 x 1.2-2.5 mm, with tuft of hairs at tip. Pappus straw-colored; inner paleas flattened, twisted, 8-10.8 mm long, outer scales 1-1.8 (2.5) mm long. Corollas (7) 12-17 mm long, reddish-purple, lobes glandular. Anthers 2.5-5 mm long. Achenes 3-3.6 mm long, 3-4-angled, ca 10-ribbed, glandular between ribs, dark brown. Pollen type: A. Flowering and fruiting from December to March, or throughout the year.

description: Suffrutescent perennials, 13-25 dm tall. Stems 1.5-8 mm diam, subglabrous near base to copiously pubescent on upper portions with hairs ca. 0.3 mm long. Peduncles up to 7 mm long, ca. 0.6 mm diam, pubescent with hairs ca. 0.3 mm long. Leaves 4-10 cm long, 1.5-2.7 cm wide, margin entire to obsoletely crenate; base obtuse, upper surface pubescent with hairs ca. 0.3 mm long, lower surface with conspicuous reticulate venation and pubescent-tomentose with hairs ca. 0.3 mm long. Mature heads ca. 7 mm tall, ca. 12 mm diam. Receptacle ca. 0.2 mm tall, ca. 3 mm diam. Involucral bracts ca. 5 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide; inner bracts ca. 8. Ray florets ca. 6; ligules 1.8-3 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide; tube ca. 1 mm long, ca. 0.3 mm diam, strigillose with hairs ca. 0.2 mm long; style branches ca. 0.6 mm long; achenes ca. 2.3 mm long, ca. 1.5 mm wide (radially), ca. 1.2 mm wide (laterally). Disc florets ca. 20; corollas ca. 1 mm diam, lobes ca. 0.8 mm long, ca. 0.4 mm wide, throat ca. 1.5 mm long, ca. 0.6 mm diam, tube ca. 1.8 mm long, ca. 0.7 mm diam, tube sparsely hirtellous with hairs ca. 0.1 mm long; anthers ca. 1.8 mm long; style ca. 3.5 mm long; ovary ovoid, ca. 0.3 mm long, ca. 0.3 mm diam. Paleae 1.3-3 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide, midrib very weak. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Annua, 3-10 dm. alta; caule tenuo, hispidulo, suleato, plerumque atro-striato; foliis inferioribus integris, vel ad mediam 3-lobatis, his- pidulis, sinubus angustis; lobis ovatis, acutis vel rariter breviter acu- minatis, serratis, laete-viridis; involuero staminato 4 mm. lato; fructu 6 mm. longo, brevirostrato, rotunde 5-anoulato, suleato, atri-striato inter angulos, cum tuberculis 5, brevibus lati-conicis, 0.5 mm. longis.

description: Perennial herbs from a thick, woody taproot with exfoliating periderm, producing numerous, thick, short (1-4 cm long) caudex branches from the crown, each of these in turn producing numerous, basally crowded, slender, erect, green stems 12-25 cm tall, unbranched below the capitulescence, about 15 such stems arising during the current season and many dead stem bases persisting from previous years; stems roughened by numerous very short, blunt, thick-walled, biseriate trichomes (Type C trichomes, see Nesom, 1976), without a resinous head and otherwise eglandular), the lowermost portions with a few, minute, crisped-appressed, uniseriate hairs (Type B trichomes), these sometimes as long as 1 mm, Type A trichomes absent; stems, leaves, and phyllaries with prominent, sessile, yellow-orange resin droplets, these rarely short-stalked. Leaves oblong-obovate, entire, sharply ascending, basally truncate and sessile, some slightly amplexicaul, the blades and margins hispidulous with short, thick-based and thick-walled, uniseriate, sharply ascending hairs (Type A trichomes), the lower leaves 4-6 mm long, about equalling the internode length, 2-3 mm wide, markedly reduced in size about halfway up the stem, becoming ovate-lanceolate to merely bracteate immediately beneath the heads. Heads turbinate-campanulate, 5-7 mm wide, without a basal depression, usually solitary but often up to 5 in loose cymes at the stem apices, the peduncles 1-3 cm long; buds apparently erect; phyllaries lanceolate-ovate with acute apices, rigid, in 4-6 strongly graduated se- ries, the inner 6.5-7.0 mm long, the margins hyaline, usually fimbriolate and purplish near the apex, the surfaces shiny-indurated adaxially, abaxially white-indurated on the lower half, the upper half with a narrow, medial herbaceous patch, with a thin, white, raised, medial keel along most of the phyllary length, with resin droplets (especially prominent on the young phyllaries and the basal portions of the outer) or the whole surface viscid, otherwise glabrous or with a few, short, thick hairs along the keel. Ray flowers 7-8, the corollas 7-8 mm long, with long trichomes near the tube apex, the ligules 1.5-1.8 mm wide, 4-5 nerved, tightly  coiling after stigma receptivity, with 2 small notches at the apex, apparently blue to blue-violet; style branches 0.5-0.7 mm long. Disc flowers ca 15-20, the ovaries apparently sterile, the corollas yellowish, producing only stellate "sand" crystals within the cells, nar- rowly funnelform, not indurated or inflated, 4.0-4.5 mm long, with orange veins extending ca halfway to the base, the tube 1 mm long, the lobes deltate, 0.4-0.5 mm long, prominently viscid-pubescent with short, biseriate trichomes; style branches 0.8-1.0 mm long, the appendages linear-lanceolate, 0.3-0.4 mm long with long, round-tipped sweeping hairs marginally and abaxially, the lateral stigmatic areas at the base of the branches weakly if at all differentiated, with marginal hairs similar to those of the appendage but shorter; anthers with lanceolate apical appendages 0.2-0.3 mm long. Achenes oblanceolate, brown, 2.5-2.8 mm long, moderately sericeous with hairs 0.4-0.6 mm long, the disc ovaries with 2, thin, non-resinous nerves, often with a third much thinner vascular bundle weakly associated with one of the lateral ones, elongating but mature embryos not seen and apparently not produced, the ray achenes 3-nerved, plump at maturity and somewhat 3-sided, with embryo; carpopodium cylindric, hollow, strongly asymmetric; pappus of 18-28, terete, antrorsely barbellate bristles 4.0-4.5 mm long, about equal to the disc corolla length, with a prominent outer series of much shorter, flattened, linear-lanceolate scales 0.8-1.0 mm long. Chromosome number, 2n = 9 II.

description: Stems 10-50 cm, the younger ones densely hispid; leaves 1.5-7 cm long, 1-4.5 cm wide, ovate, pinnately cleft or parted into 5-7 segments, these in  turn lobed, densely hispid on both surfaces, glandular-punctate, petioles 0.5-2.5 cm long; heads (1-) 3-7 cymosely disposed, peduncles 1.5-6 cm long, hispid and pilose; heads 2-3.5 cm wide at anthesis; outer involucral bracts 5(6), spatulate, 4-7 mm long, very hispid and pilose, glandular-punctate; inner involucral bracts 8, ovate to lanceolate, 5-7 mm long, hispid; chaff linear, 3-lobed at apex, villous on the outer surface, 5-7 mm long at anthesis; ray florets 8, disk florets (25) 40-65; achenes oblong to narrowly obovate or oblanceolate, with a prominent, erect-villous rib on the inner surface, 3-6 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, aristae 2(3), 1-3 mm long. 2n 26 (Crawford, 1969).

description: Plantae fruticosae, 10-50 cm altae; folia ovata, 5-7-pinnatifida, in superficiebus ambabus dense hispida, punctata, 1.5-9.0 cm longa, 1.0-4.5 cm lata; petioli 0.5-2.5 cm longi; capitula 3-7 nunc cymose aggregata nunc solitaria, per anthesin 2.0-3.5 cm lata; bracteae externae involucrales 5, late spathulatae, dense hispidae, 4-7 mm longae, internae involucrales 8, obovatae, hispidae, 5-7 mm longae; palea linearis, ad apicem triloba, in dorsali pagina villosa, per anthesin 5-7 mm longa; flores radii 8, ligula oblonga, 8-15 mm longa, 3-6 mm lata, disci 40-65; achaenia oblonga usque anguste obovata vel oblanceolata, nigra, valde obcompressa, costa in ventrali pagina prominente, in marginibus dense villosa, 3-6 mm longa, 1.5-2.0 mm lata, aristis 2, antrorse hispidis, 1-3 mm longis; chromosomatum numerus, n = 13.

description: Annual, 3-7 dm tall, stems with 1-20 branches. Cauline leaves numerous, linear, 1.5-4.2 cm long, 0.5-1.9 mm wide; basal leaves linear-spatulate, deciduous. Outer involucral bracts, 2.4-6.7 mm long, 0.6-1.7 mm wide, lanceolate, acuminate at apex; inner involucral bracts, 4.2-7 mm long, 0.6-1.5 mm wide, lanceolate, acuminate at apex. description: Herbaceous perennial, biennial, or winter annual 2-4 (1-5) dm tall, glabrous or glabrate in age except for occasional tufts of villous hairs in and near the axils of the basal leaves and among the heads in the inflorescence, or occasional individuals remaining lightly tomentose throughout; stems arising singly or loosely clustered; underground parts basically a taproot which may terminate in a weakly branched caudex. Basal leaves spatulate to obovate in overall outline, but deeply and con- spicuously pinnatifid to lyrate or sublyrate with the segments toothed or sometimes rounded, 5-9(2.5-12) cm long and 1-2(0.6-3.5) cm wide, generally 4-5 times as long as wide; petiole about as long as the blade. Cauline leaves progressively reduced upwards but the lowermost ones often as well developed as the basal leaves; distinctly pinnatifid except the uppermost ones which may be reduced to subentire bracts. Inflorescence a loose to clustered corymbose or occasionally subumbellate cyme of 10-30 heads, fewer in depauperate plants and rarely more; principal involucral bracts 13-21, 4-9+ mm long, green or yellowish tipped but not black tipped; ray florets 8-13, the ligules 5-10 mm long or sometimes absent. Achenes 2-4 mm long, glabrous or occasionally hispidulous on the angles. n = 23, 24, 46 (Ornduff et al., 1963, 1967).

description: Shrubs, to 3 m tall; stems woody toward base, striate, strigose, hairs, 1 mm long. Leaves petiolate; blades broad-ovate, 10-20 X 4-14 cm, 3-veined, apices acute, bases obtuse, attenuate, margins finely serrate to crenate-serrate, adaxial surface glabrate to strigose, abaxial surface strigose, hairs 0.5 mm long; petioles 3-5 cm long, striate, strigose, hairs 0.5 mm long. Capitulescences thyrsoid, <100 capitula loosely clustered in terminal open branches, peduncles 0.5 mm long. Capitula radiate; 5 mm high, 4 mm diam.; involucres cupulate, 4 mm diam.; phyllaries 3, ovate to ovate-suborbicular, 4 X 3 mm, light-green, 5-7-veined, abaxially glabrate to strigose, hairs 0.5 mm long, margins distal one-third ciliate, bases fleshy at maturity. Pistillate florets 12(-16), subtended by ovate paleae, 3.5-4 X 3 mm, 3- veined, strigillose toward apex, bases fleshy at maturity; corollas white, 2.5 mm long, 0.5 mm diam, 3-lobed, lobes deltoid, 0.5 mm long; styles 2.5 mm long, branches 1.5 mm long. Staminate florets 5-7, subtended by lanceolate paleae, 3-veined; corollas white, 3 mm long, throats 1 mm diam., 5- lobed, lobes 0.4 mm long; styles undivided, 2 mm long, branches 0.5 mm long. Cypselae drupaceous, obovoid, black, 3 X 2 mm, villous on the distal one-third. Chromosome numbers unknown.

description: Stems densely lanate; leaves opposite; petioles 1-3 cm long; blades ovate to ovate-oblong, 7.5 cm long, 4.5 cm long, 4.5 cm wide, acute or obtuse, subcordate to broadly rounded at base, entire or remotely serrate, above chartaceous, dark green, appressed-long-hispid, beneath thickly pubescent-lanate-tomentose; heads borne singly on peduncles 2-5 cm long; disks ca. 3.0 cm in diameter; phyllaries ovate-oblong or oblong-lanceolate, 1.6 cm long, 4.5 mm wide, densely arachnoid- lanate; rays 16-25, 1.5-2.0 cm long, 5-7 mm wide; disk corollas yellow with tips of teeth dark, puberulent or short-scattered-pilose on tube and throat, glabrous on teeth; anthers black; pales short-acute, glabrous, or obscurely pubescent on keel, mostly straw-colored; achene 4 mm long; pappus of 2-4 subulate or lanceolate awns; pappus of ray achenes of 2 lacerate squamellae or lacking.

description: Shrubs 1-6 m tall, basiramous, stems ascending to erect, bark dark brown, twigs moderately pubescent, trichomes uniseriate, tortuous or appressed, often tipped with a resin droplet; leaves evergreen, opposite, simple, exstipulate, petiolate, blades ovate- elliptic, 5-15 cm long, 1.5-7.0 cm wide, coriaceous, darker green above, pale green below, apices acute-acuminate, bases attenuate, margins remotely serrulate, glabrous to sparsely pubescent above, sparsely to moderately pubescent below, trichomes uniseriate, venation aucamptodromous; capitulescence corymbose, 6-30 cm broad, peduncles ca. 1-2 cm long; involucres turbinate-hemispheric, 4-10 mm long and wide, phyllaries imbricate, 2-3-seriate, elliptic-obovate, chartaceous, 2-7.5 mm long, 0.6- 4.0 mm wide, yellow-green, apices acute-obtuse, membranous, margins narrowly mem- branous; capitula 30-150-flowered; receptacle conic, ca. 2 mm long; palea ca. 4 mm long, obovate, concave, scarious; ray flowers 6-13, pappus of 4-10 scales, triangular to narrowly linear, lacerate, stramineous, unequal, 0.5-2 mm long, corollas 5-15 mm long, tube ca. 1 mm long, sparsely pubescent, trichomes uniseriate, ligules yellow, narrowly elliptic, 3.5-12 mm long, 1.5-4.0 mm wide; disk flowers yellow, 24-140, pappus same as on rays, corollas 2.5-4 mm long, lobes triangular, ca. 0.5 mm long, tube abruptly enlarged at the throat, glabrous to sparsely pubescent, style branches 0.5-1.0 mm long, apices acute; achenes (3-)4-angled, ca. 2 mm long, black, angles pubescent, remaining surface glabrous to moderately pubescent, trichomes biseriate; chromosome number n = 16.

description: Plants up to 2 dm high; stems greenish, strigose; leaves narrowly linear, 1-nerved, 3.5 cm long, 0.8-1.9 mm wide, sparsely strigose or becoming g,labrous, sparsely glandular-punctate; peduncles up to 2 cm long; heads subhemispheric, ea 5 mm high; phyllaries oblong, their apices obtuse, ciliate, minutely glanduliferous; rays ea 7, lemon, oblong, ca 8 mm long, tubeless or essentially so, green-nerved beneath; ray achenes oblanceolate, 4.2 mm long, tuberculate and becoming black at maturity, awnless; disk flowers numerous, 4.5 mm long, lemon above, green below; disk achenes oblanceolate, compressed, 2.6 mm long, sparsely ciliate or essentially glabrous, the margins ciliate, the pappus of 2 unequal awns; pales of the receptacle lanceolate, greenish, the apices acutish, minutely dentate; receptacle convex.

description: Perennial herb with a deep-seated rooterown, which gives rise to very slender branched rhizomatous stems, these becoming aerial stems on reaching the surface; stems slender, erect or aseendilng, 10-20 cm. high, sparsely or moderately spreading-hirsute with relatively long hairs, also finely more or less glandular; leaves hirsute and glandular like the stems, oblanceolate or narrowly elliptic-oblong, exceeding the internodes, all about alike, without a basal tuft, and only gradually reduced upwards, 5-20 mm. long, 1.5-3 mm. wide, often with a very filie mucro at the apex; heads 1-3, the disk about 8-13 mm. wide; involuere about 4-5 mm. high, finely glandular and sometimes also sparsely hirsute; phyllaries strongly imbricate, with brown midvein, the outer otherwise greenish, the inner more chartaceous and developing narrow scarious margins; ligules about 20-40, blue, about 6 mm. long and 1.3 mm. wide; disk-corollas 3.6-4.3 mm. long, the tube 0.7-1.1 mm., the lobes 0.4-0.7 mm.; style-appendages deltoid or ovate, obtusish, 0.1 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 20-35 slender white bristles, the outer of a few well developed setae; akenes 2-nerved, sparsely hairy.

description: Rosettes on prostrate or ascending stems to 10 cm long, often with roots from nodes, internodes 3-5 mm long, glabrous. Leaves sessile on basal sheaths; blades oblong, 1- 1.5 cm long, 0.6-1 cm wide, base obtuse, margins entire to remotely subdenticulate, apex rounded, upper surface densely puberulous along main insculpate veins, pilose and pilosulous below mostly on main veins. Peduncles not seen. Heads sessile at early anthesis, ca. 5 mm high, 6 mm wide; involucral bracts 8, oblong with rounded tips, ca. 4 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, margins weakly ciliate, mostly glabrous outside, with sparse hairs on some veins; pales subulate, ca. 1 mm long. Ray florets ca. 12; corollas yellowish green, ca. 1 mm long, hirtellous with hairs about as long as width of tube, with minute glabrous limb ca. 0.3 mm long. Disk florets ca. 17; corollas yel- lowish green, tube ca. 1 mm long, spread- ing hirtellous with hairs scarcely as long as width of tube, throat broadly campanulate, ca. 0.8 mm long, mostly glabrous, lobes ca. 0.5 mm long, 0.4-0.6 mm wide, glabrous; anther thecae ca. 0.5 mm long. Achenes ca. 1.8 mm long, ray achenes tardily blackened.
bibliographicCitation: Robinson, H. 1997. New species of Aphanactis in Ecuador and Bolivia and new combinations in Selloa (Heliantheae: Asteraceae). Brittonia. 49: 71-78.

description: Plants annual or sometimes perennial, 5-16 dm tall, paniculately branched above. Stems strongly winged, glabrous below, sparsely pubescent above with short crisped hairs. Peduncles (6-)9-17(-23) cm long, sparsely to moderately pubescent, ca. 2 times as wide at the top as at the base. Leaves glabrous to sparsely pubescent, entire, apices obtuse to acute or narrowly acuminate, midrib prominent and lateral veins apparent in larger leaves; radical leaves oblanceolate to oblong-elliptic with petioliform base; lower and middle leaves lanceolate to oblong-elliptic; upper leaves linear- lanceolate. Heads few to many, globose to depressed globose, 9-15 mm high, 9-17 (-19) mm wide (excluding rays). Receptacle globoid, 2.5-6.5 mm high, 5.0-10.0 mm wide. Involucral bracts occasionally united at the base, reflexed at anthesis, moderately pubescent. Ray florets 13-15 or occasionally absent, ligules 3.8-10.0 mm long, 2.0-4.0 mm wide, yellow, sparsely pubescent on the undersurface. Disc corollas 4(-5)-lobed, cylindrical to cylindric-campanulate, (1.6-)1.9-2.7 mm long, 0.6-0.8 mm wide, yellow with yellow to reddish brown or purple lobes. Achenes 1.2-1.9 mm long, 0.4-0.7 mm wide, moderately pubescent with relatively long hairs. Pappus scales 5-6, 0.4-1.0 mm long, including the terminal awn, 0.2-0.3 mm wide. Chromo- some number, n = 2 9.

description: Suffrutex usque ad 60 cm altus ramoso-intricatus ramis foliosis tenuibus leviter striolatis viridibus glabris. Folia alterna herbaceo-membranacea sessilia. Lamina lineari-oblonga apice subite angustata vel paulo attenuata acuta vel obtusiuscula, basi amplectenti plus minusve latius auriculata, margine breviter repandoque dentata vel laevis, 2-5 cm longa 3-10 mm lata, utrinque glabra, supra viridis subtus pallidior, nervo medio supra filiformi subtus crassiuscule prominulo, reliquis nervis paucis o bsol etis. Capitula discoidea in corymbis terminalibus oligocephalis dispositis; axi ramulisque floriferis sparse glandulosis. Pedicelli 5-15 mm longi tenues plus minusve glandulosi, aliquis bracteolis lanceolatis brevibus muniti. Calyculus 3-5 bracteolis oblongo-lanceolatis 1-3 mm longis sparse glandulosis ad apicem nigro-macul atis. Involucrum cylindricum 13 bracteis herbaceis lineari-oblongis apice acutis ciliatisque margine scariosis ceteris subglabris sparse glandu- losulis, 7 mm longis, 1.2-2 mm latis. Flores omnes hermaphroditi circa 32 in capitulo, corolla lutea glabra 6-7 mm longa infundibuliforrni tubulo 2-2.5 mm longo dentibus 1 mm longis. Antherae 2.6 mm longae basi acutiusculae. Rami styli truncati breviter penicillati. Ovarium villosum. Pappus albus 6-6.5 mm longus setis capillaribus tenuissimis scabrosis.

description: Perennial herb with a taproot and generally subterranean rooterown, this giving rise to slender rhizomatous branches rarely more than 1.5 mm. thick, which become aerial stems on reaching the surface; stems slender, trailing to suberect, 1-3 din. or sometimes 5 dm. high, branched at or near the ground level into nearly equal parts, sometimes also branched above, but then with an evident main axis, glabrous or strigose (in var. elmeri) to usually rather densely retrorse-hirtellous; leaves glabrous or strigose to usually spreading-hirtellous or somewhat hirsute, narrowly linear to oblong or oblong-oblanceolate, about 4-40 mm. long and 1-8 mm. wide, acute to obtuse or rounded at the apex, nearly uniform in size, surpassing the internodes, without a basal tuft, only very gradually reduced upwards; heads solitary or commonly several, the disk 6-15 mm. wide; involuere rather densely glandular and sometimes also hispidulous, 3-8 mm. high; phyllaries evidently imbricate, usually with brown midrib, otherwise greenish or chartaceous, sometimes all narrow and long-acuminate, sometimes the inner conspicuously wider, acute or abruptly acuminate, and with a more or less evident ill-defined greenish spot near the tip; ligules about 10-45, blue or pink to white, about 4-10 mm. long, 1.0-2.0 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.5-6.1 mm. long, the tube 0.7-1.6 mm., the lobes 0.5-0.7 mm.; style-appendages about 0.05-0.15 mm. long, blunt; pappus double, the inner of about 20-50 white or usually brownish coarse bristles of very unequal diameter, the outer of a few inconspicuous setae; akenes 2-nerved, sparsely hairy.

Turner & Horne caulis pubescentia tenui plerumque appressa nec grossa ascendenti vel patenti, disci achaeniis glabris vel fere glabris asymmetricis 2.5-2.9 mm longis 14-18- nerviis, nec rare pubescentibus symmetricis 1.4-2 (2.2) mm longis 7-9-nerviis, et chromosomatis numero 2n = 6 nec 8 differt.

description: Plants annual, from a taproot, 25-100 cm tall; stems inconspicuously pubescent with fine, antrorsely-appressed to ascending white hairs which are replaced by or mixed with minute, stipitate-glandular trichomes in the capitulescence, erect, light brown, terete to obscurely angled, 1-6 mm in diam at base, appearing woody, often with exfoliating epidermis, much-branched in the upper 1/3-2/3; leaves alternate, sessile, narrowly lanceolate to linear or subulate, 0.3-3.5 cm long, 0.1-0.3 cm wide, progressively reduced in size above, pubescent beneath, glabrate above or those of the capitulescence uniformly glandular-pubescent above, often densely so, entire, slightly tapered, if at all, at the sessile base, aristulate at the apex, the basal and lower cauline ones soon deciduous, absent from lower 1/4 to 3/4 of primary stem on mature plants; peduncles 1-3 (5) mm long, densely glandular-pubescent; capitula 5-100 or more, borne singly; involucre hemispheric, enclosing 43-55 florets, 3.5-5 mm tall, 5-7 mm wide, erect at anthesis, reflexed in fruit, the phyllaries 26-32, in 2 or 3 series of increasing length, imbricate, linear-subulate, 2-4.5 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm wide, glandular-pubescent, those of outer series green and herbaceous throughout or nearly so, those of the inner series white to tan and chartaceous in lower half, herbaceous above, with a hyaline margin; receptacle flat to broadly convex, 1.7-2.3 mm in diam, alveolate; ray florets pistillate, 18- 23, the ligules 4-5 mm long, 1-1.2 mm wide, light blue to blue-violet, revolutely rolled when dry, the tube 1-1.2 mm long, thinly puberulent, the style branches ca 0.4 mm long; disc florets perfect, 25-32, corolla yellow or with purplish lobes, cylindric below, gradually enlarging upward, 3.5-4 mm long, the lobes erect, 0.5- 0.7 mm long, sparsely pubescent abaxially, the style branches 1.1-1.3 mm long, linear, flat, stigmatic along the margin, with an acute, ciliate appendage, the anthers 1.5-1.7 mm long, rounded at base, with a broadly lanceolate appendage at the apex, exserted to 0.5 mm; achenes of ray florets fusiform, oval in cross section, 1.3-1.5 mm long, with 9-12 indistinct ribs, thinly puberulent with simple to bifurcate hairs, epappose; achenes of disc florets irregularly oblanceoloid, narrowly elliptic in cross section, 2.5-2.9 mm long, with 14-18 distinct ribs, glabrous or essentially so, the pappus of 26-40 fine, minutely barbellate, tawny, subequal bristles in a single series, 3.2-4 mm long; chromosome number, 2n = 6.

description: Plants annual, up to 70 cm high, from a taproot; stems with scattered appressed pubescence below and dense glandular pubescence above; primary stems typically single, but often much-branched from the base, especially following injury; mid-stem leaves linear-oblanceolate to lanceolate, entire to crenate, 1.5- 3.5 cm long, 1-3 mm. wide, sessile and clasping, covered with a short slightly appressed pubeseelee and glandular trichomes; heads on primary shoot 3-50, becoming more numerous with secondary branching; involucre hemispheric, with 25-50 florets, 3-4 mm wide, 2-4 mm high, erect at anthesis but generally reflexing with ag e; peduncle 2-15 mm long, sparsely to densely glandular-pubescent; involueral bracts 25-35 in 2-3 series, linear-lanceolate, herbaceous and green throughout, 1.5-2.5 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide; receptacle flat, 1-2 mm across; ray florets 13-30 the ligules 2.5-3.5 mm long, 0.3-0.6 mm wide, white to violet, revolute on drying, tube 1-1.5 mm long; disk corollas yellow, 2-3 mm long; corolla lobes erect, 0.2-0.4 mm long; achenes 1-2 mm long; pappus composed of 20-25 bristles in a single whorl, 1-2.5 mm long; chromosome number, n = 9.
bibliographicCitation: Turner, Billie L. & Horne, David B. 1964. Taxonomy of Machaeranthera sect. Psilactis (Compositae-Astereae). Brittonia. 16: 316-331.

description: Perennial herb with a more or less branched woody caudex; stem 2-5 dm. high, glandular at least above, rather sparsely pubescent throughout with spreading several-celled hairs sometimes as much as 2 mm. long; leaves entire, more or less glandular and hirsute like the stem, the lower ones generally more hirsute, the upper ones more glandular, all more or less ciliate on the margins; basal and lowermost cauline leaves oblanceolate, mostly 4-10 cm. long, 6-18 mm. wide, often deciduous by flowering time; middle cauline leaves as large as those below, or larger, oblong or lanceolate to ovate, sessile and somewhat clasping, 3-10 em. long, 8-20 mm. wide; upper leaves niot markedly reduced, ovate or lanceolate; heads 1-5, the disk 12-18 mm. broad; involuere about 5.5-7 mm. high, glandular and bearing a few villous hairs; phyllaries subequal, greenish, narrow, the loose and attenuate tips often purplish; ligules about 75-125, 9-15 mm. long and about 1 mm. wide, blue or rose-purple; disk corollas mostly 4.4-5.0 mm. long, the tube 1.2-1.4 mm., the lobes 0.6-0.7 mm.; style-appendages lance-ovate, acute, about 0.25 11mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 20-25 bristles, the outer of more or less evident short setose squamellae, akenes 2-nerved, more or less hairy.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Stout herb, the caudex erect, up to 80 cm. high and 20 cm. thick, densely clothed with persistent leaf bases; leaves coriaceous, linear-oblong, 30-45 cm. long, 2-3.5 cm. broad, gradually attenuate .towards base, subacute at apex, entire and thickened at margins, closely ferruginous or cinereous lanate on both surfaces, the costa prominent, often grooved above, the secondary nerves 2 or 3 per centimeter, ascending, often obscured by the tomentum; flowering branches stout, erect at maturity, up to 95 cm. long, copiously lanate, simply racemose, 10-20-headed; peduncles alternate, stout, 5-15 cm. long, each subtended by an oblong foliaceous bract 3-10 cm. long; heads at maturity 3-4 cm. in diameter; phyllaries numerous, 2- or 3-seriate, papyraceous, lanceolate-oblong, about 10 mm. long and 3.5 mm. broad, acute or acuminate, densely lanate without; ray florets numerous, several-seriate, the corollas 6-7 mm. long, the tube about 1.5 mm. long, glan-dular-hispidulous (the hairs 0.1 mm. long), faintly lobed distally introrsely, the lamina ovate-oblong, about 5 mm. long and 1.5 mm. broad, usually 2-lobed at apex, the style and stigmas nearly as long as the corolla, the achene about 3 mm. long; disk florets glabrous, 6-7 mm. long, the tube slightly shorter than the limb, the limb conspicuously 5-costate to the sinuses, the lobes deltoid, thick-margined, the stamens about 4.5 mm. long, the anthers and filaments subequal; paleae lanceolate, about 8 mm. long and 1.3 mm. broad, acuminate, sparsely hispid distally without.

description: Planta fruticosa, valde ramosa, parva. Foliis alteriiis, sessilibus vel subsessilibus; lamina oblanceolata vel obovato-elliptica, ad 11 mm longa et 4 mm lata, utraque superficie cana vel argenteo-laneo-tomentosa; sine lobis vel 1 usque ad 4 parvis lobis supra partem mediam instructis. Racemis capitulorum florentium in finibus brevium, lateralium ramorum, racemoso-spicatis, staminatis supra, pistillatis infra. Involucra mascula scaposa vel sessilia, scapis ad 3 mm longis, aliquando 2 vel pluribus capitulis cuniunctis, ut videtur, in parte summa, quae capitula singula, grandia, terminalia esse videntur; involucro ad 4 inm lato, lobis 5-7, angustis; sinibus procurrentibus longius via dimnidia ad locuin ubi scapus connectitur; receptaculo, ut videtur, nudo; flosculis 10-30, rufulis. Involucra feminea sessilia, singula vel in racemis parvis disposita in axillis foliorum sub racemis masculis; involucro nraturo obovato in sectione longitudinali, ad 8 mm longo et 5 mm lato, rubro-fusco, tomentoso et cum glandibius minutis; cum 2 floribus, ramnis stili exertis per rostrum commune; rostro prominenti, ad 2 mm longo, quod 2 vel pluribus aculeis constat; aculeis 20-60, dispersis supra superficiem involucri, teretibus, uncinatis, usque ad 3 mm longis.
bibliographicCitation: Casper, S. J. 1966. Once more: the orchid-flowered butterworts. Brittonia. 18: 19-28.

description: Paniculately branched annual, 2.5-12.0 dm tall. Stems moderately to strongly winged, glabrous to sparsely pubescent with short antrorse hairs. Peduncles 1.8-8.0 cm long, pubescent with short antrorse hairs, slightly broadened at the top. Leaves narrowly elliptic to narrowly oblong-elliptic or occasionally irregularly laciniate, 3-10 times as long as wide, apices obtuse to acute or narrowly acuminate, serrate to undulate-serrate or occasionally deeply toothed in the laciniate leaves, glabrous to moderately pubescent, midrib prominent and lateral veins often apparent in larger leaves. Heads few to numerous, globose to usually ovoid, 4-12 mm high, 4-12 mm wide (excluding rays). Receptacle short conic-globular to ovoid, 1.6-6.0 mm high, 1.4-5.0 mm wide. Involucral bracts united at the base, reflexed at anthesis, moderately pubescent. Ray florets 7-13; ligules 2.6-9.1 mm long, 1.5-6.7 mm wide, completely yellow or reddish at the base, sparsely to moderately pubescent on the undersurface. Disc corollas (4-) 5-lobed, cylindrical to urceolate, 1.2-2.4 mm long, 0.6-1.1 mm wide, yellow-green to yellow with brown to reddish brown lobes. Achenes 0.7-1.4 mm long, 0.4-0.6 mm wide, pubescent with short hairs. Pappus scales usually 6, (0.2-)0.3-0.7 mm long, 0.2-0.4 mm wide. Chromosome number, n = 13.
bibliographicCitation: Bierner, Mark W. 1972. Taxonomy of Helenium sect. Tetrodus and a conspectus of North American Helenium (Compositae). Brittonia. 24: 331-355.

description: Plants perennial, caespitose, less than 4 dm tall; basal rosettes 1-8 from a thickened subterranean caudex; leaves of the basal rosette lanceolate to oblanceolate, 5-10 cm long, 0.5-2 cm wide, with a broad petiole, the blade sinuate-margined to, lobed with small, triangular, obtuse divisions, the upper leaves much reduced, few, lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, entire, glandular, sparsely to moderately villous; capitula solitary, scapose; the involucre 1-2 cm high, 1-2.5 cm broad; the involucral bracts linear- lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, attenuate, 8-15 mm long, 1-3 mm wide, glandular, the outer bracts sparsely to moderately villous; ray corollas yellow, 28-59; disk corollas yellow; achenes 6-10 mm long, sparsely villous, the pappus paleae subequal, short, lacerate, 1-1.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Wilken, Dieter H. 1975. A systematic study of the genus Hulsea (Asteraceae). Brittonia. 27: 228-244.

description: Flat-topped shrubs, to 3 m tall (small plants sometimes have a basal rosette of linear leaves terminating the rootstock, stems often arising below the basal rosette); stems robust, brittle, sometimes decumbent, with candelabra branching, tomentose. Leaves cauline, crowded, rigid, the sessile blades (0.4) 0.7-1.1 (2.5) x 1.8-2.6 (4.5) mm, subulate to lanceolate or linear, apically apiculate to cuspidate, basally slightly auriculate, marginally entire, strongly revolute, glossy dark green, glabrous or sometimes waxy-velutinous or tomentose above, densely tomentose below. Basal leaves, when present, linear, 4-8 x ca 2 mm. Inflores- cences terminal, of semiglobose glomerules. Heads 1-flowered. Phyllaries imbricate in several series, inner ones 5-5.5 (6.1) x ca 1 mm, tips arachnose or glan- dular. Pappus white; inner paleas flattened, twisted, 5-6.5 mm long, outer of 12- 25 scales 0.5-1 mm long. Corollas 7-7.5 mm long, reddish-purple, glabrous. Anthers 3.8-4 mm long. Achenes 3-3.8 mm long, strongly 10-ribbed, faintly glandular. Pollen type: A-B. Flowering and fruiting from November to June.

description: Erect herbs, 60-80 cm tall. Stems striate, flexuose in the younger branches, puberulous with a mixture of glandular and non-glandular hairs. Leaves oblong-lanceolate, 5-18.5 X 1.5-6.5 cm, the apex acute, the base truncate, the margin doubly denticulate, membranaceous, the upper surface puberulent only on the veins, the lower surface glandular-punctate, the veins puberulent. Capitula in loose cymules, either terminal or lateral, ca. 1.5 cm high; peduncles 3-5 mm long, bracteolate, glandular-pubescent, the bracts lanceolate, 2-3 mm long, acute, dorsally glandular, scattered along the peduncle, grading into the phyllaries; involucre 3-seriate, obconic, 1 cm long; phyllaries lanceolate, acuminate, abaxially glandular-pubescent, glandular-ciliate, the outermost 3-4 X ca. 1 mm, the central ones 4-7 X ca. 1.2 mm, the innermost ca. 10 X ca. 12 mm. Florets 10 or 11, the corolla white, glandular-puberulent, 8 mm long, with the tube as long as the lips; stamens ca. 5.5 mm long, the apical appendages ca. 1.5 mm long, the anther thecae 2 mm long, the tails 2 mm long, the filaments 2 mm long; styles 7-8 mm long, including the ca. 1 mm long branches. Achenes fusiform, ca. 5 mm long, hirsute and scattered glandular-pubescent; pappus ca. 6 mm long, white.

description: Plants perennial, 10-25 cm tall; stems procumbent or decumbent, hirsute, tomentose to villous, adventitious roots developing at the nodes; leaves serrate, ovate, ovate-lanceolate to obscurely trilobate (rarely pinnately lobed), attenuate to acute at the apex, cuneate to attenuate at the base, sparsely to densely strigose on both surfaces, 0.6-2.5(-3.2) cm long, 0.4-1(-1.8) cm wide; leaves subsessile or with short petioles to 0.5-0.7 cm long; heads 6-12 mm wide, solitary on rather slender peduncles 6-15(-18) cm long, with spreading, matted, typically retrorsely appressed trichomes, interspersed with glandular trichomes; receptacle 2-3 (-3.5) mm across, ca 2 mm high, convex; chaff persistent, 5-7(-7.5) mm long, ca 1 mm wide, membranous, pilose toward the acuminate-(rarely attenuate-) cuspidate apex, partially enclosing the disc florets; involucre 2(-3)-seriate, the outer bracts 4-5(-6.5) mm long, 1-1.5(-2) mm long wide, lanceolate-attenuate, hirsute to villous-hirsute, often with fine glandular hairs interspersed, the inner bracts 5-6(-7) mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, lanceolate to oblong, acute to attenuate, mucronate at the apex, the scarious margins and apex usually purple-tinged; ray flowers 8, pistillate and fertile, tubular at the base for 2-2.5 mm, with inconspicuous white, to pinkish-tinged ligules, these (2-)2.5-4(-5) mm long, 1.5-3 mm wide, oblong, usually trilobed (rarely bilobed), or divided, the lobes obtuse to acute, the corolla with one or usually two small inner lobelets; pappus of the ray florets often as long as the tube, 1.5-3(-4) mm long; disc corollas lavender to yellowish-white, 4-5(-5.5) mm long, the tube glabrate to thinly pilose, 0.5-0.7 mm long, the throat tubular, 2.5-3.2(-3.8) mm long, glabrate to finely pilose at the base, the lobes erect to reflexed, 0.5 mm long, obtuse to acute, minutely pubescent; style branches recurved (revolute), 1-1.2 mm long, slender, tapering to a sublate tip, pubescent beneath; achenes black or often brownish toward the base, (1.5-)2(-2.7) mm long, tomentose, with longer tufted hairs at the base, cylindrical, terete, obscurely 4-ridged, slightly flattened and incurved near the periphery of the heads, truncate at the apex, rounded at the base; pappus of 20 plumose bristles, slightly broadened and devoid of cilia at the base, (2-)3.5-4.5(-5) mm long, unequal, but alternate bristles only slightly shorter; cilia silky, ca 1 mm long; anthers exserted. 2-2.5(-3) mnm long, obscurely sagittate at the base; chromosome number, n = 9, determined in the 5 populations indicated below with an asterisk.

description: Shrubs, 2-4 m tall; stems strigillose, hairs 0.1 mm long. Leaves petiolate; blades ovate to ovate-lanceolate; 8-10 X 4-12 cm, apices acuminate to caudate, bases attenuate, margins serrate, pauciserrate, dentate, or crenate-serrate; both faces strigillose (hairs usually more abundant along main veins), hairs 1 mm long; petioles 1-5 cm long, to 2 mm diam., strigillose, hairs 1 mm long. Capitulescences thyrsoid, ca. 100 ca- pitula at end of leafy twigs; peduncles 1-2 mm long. Capitula radiate, 4-5 mm high, 3-4 mm diam.; involucres cupulate; phyllaries 3(-4), ovate to obovate, 3-4 X 2-3 mm, 7-11-veined, abaxially strigose, hairs 0.5 mm long. Pistillate florets 5-9, subtended by ovate paleae, 3-4 X 2-3 mm, 7-veined, abaxially shortly strigose, margins shortly ciliate on distal one-third; corollas 1.5-2 mm long, 0.3-4 mm diam., 3-lobed, 0.4 mm long, styles 2-2.5 mm long, branches 1 mm long; reduced pappus of two short awns. Staminate florets 9-22, subtended by lanceolate paleae, 2 mm X 1 mm, 3-veined; corollas 2.5 mm long, throats 2 mm long, 4-lobed, lobes 0.5 mm long, tubes 0.3 mm diam.; anthers 1.4 mm long, styles 4 mm long, ovaries 1.2 mm long, villous (frequently only the distal one- third). Cypselae 2 X 1.5 mm, villose at apex (distal one-third). Chromosome number unknown.

description: Perennial herb apparently arising from a slender rhizome, this perhaps connecting with a subterranean rooterown; stem 5-35 cm. high, ascending or erect, generally curved at the base, sparsely spreading- or retrorse-hairy, generally more evidently so above, the hairs varying from fine and short to longer and hispid; leaves more or less hirsute or hispid with rather short hairs, the lower surfaces often essentially glabrous, generally ciliate on the margins, often very coarsely so; basal leaves 2-5 cm. long, 3-10 mm. wide, petiolate, oblanceolate, or with well defined elliptic blade; cauline leaves evidently reduced upwards, becoming linear and sessile; heads solitary or occasionally 2 or 3, borne on a naked or subnaked peduncle about 2-10 cm. long; disk about 12-1-7 mm. broad; involuere about 6-9 mm. high, more or less densely hirsute with long flattened multicellular hairs; phyllaries subequal, narrow, attenuate, green, with evident brown midvein; ligules about 45-90, blue, 7-13 mm. long, 1.3-1.9 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 5.0-6.5 mm. long, the tube 1.3-2.0 mm. long, the lobes 0.6-0.8 mm.; style-appendages 0.1-0.25 mm. long, obtuse or acutish; pappus of about 18-25 bristles, simple or with some short and inconspicuous outer setae; akenes 2-nerved, sparsely hairy.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Stems erect, 20- 50 cm tall, terete, sparsely lanulose, reddish; upper branches terminating in a large diffuse inflorescence. Basal leaves withered at anthesis. Cauline leaves opposite, sessile; lamina elliptic to oblanceolate, 50-70 X 12-20 mm, acute at apex, attenuate at base, triplinerved, serrulate near apex along margin, sparsely hispidulous and punctate-glandular (yellow) on both surfaces, the lower surface whitish green. Heads many, ca. 10 X ca. 5 mm, in a diffuse panicle; peduncles 10-20 mm, stipitate-glandular (red-purple). Phyllaries ca. 7 mm long, acuminate at apex, pale green, stipitate-glandular and sparsely sessile-glandular outside. Corolla white, sparsely sessile-glandular outside; tubes 5-6 mm long; lobes ca. 2 mm long. Achenes ca. 4 mm long, grayish dark brown, hispidulous. Pappus heteromorphic; four of the 5 florets in a head possessing 4-5 awns as long as corolla, the fifth one with a membranous crown.

description: Herbacea 12 cm alta; caules repentes subteretes puberuli simplices ad nodos inferiores radicantes;folia simplicia opposita sessilia, lamina membranacea elliptico-lanceolata, 1.2-2.5 x 0.5-1.2 cm subpalmatinervia saepius glabra; capitulescentia saepius terminalis cymosa; capitula homogama brevipedunculata, pedunculis leviter puberulis, 13-20-flora; involucrum campanulatum, 2-3 X 3-4 mm; phyllaria ca. 9, eximbricata subaequalia 1-2-seriata nec articulata lanceolata 2-3 X 0.6-1 mm praeter cilia glabra; receptaculum convexum vel conicum glabrum nudum; corollae discoideae cylindricae vel infundibulares breviter quinquelobatae 1.5-1.8 mm longae, tubo glabro, lobis extus distaliter papillosis; antherae ca. 0.8 mm longae, appendicibus apicalibus ovatis hyalinis; collum ca. 0.12 mm longum; stylus ca. 2 mm longus inferne puberulus, ramis ca. 1.2 mm longis; cypselae (immaturae) angustae obconicae 4-5-angulatae glabrae ca. 1.2 mm longae, carpopodio non bulboso; pappus nullus vel aliquando 1-setosus.
bibliographicCitation: Pruski, John F. 1996. Compositae of the Guyana Highland --- XII. Siapaea liesneri (Eupatorieae), a new genus and species from Amazonas, Venezuela. Brittonia. 48: 188-191.

description: Annual (?), eglandular herbs to 12 cm tall; stems subterete, finely striate, puberulent, creeping along the ground for 10 or more cm, rooting at the proximal nodes, unbranched below capitulescence, tips ascending, internodes to ca. 1.3 cm long, much shorter than the leaves; roots filiform, to 10 cm long. Leaves simple, opposite, sessile though base of blade petiolariform; blade membranous, elliptic-lanceolate, 1.2-2.5 X 0.5-1.2 cm, serrate, palmately 3- or 5- veined from stem but with some veins also arising pinnately from the midrib and forming a fine reticulum, glabrous or the young leaves weakly puberulent abaxially. Capitulescence terminating main stems or short lateral branches from uppermost nodes, cymose, of 2 short-pedunculate heads, not held above subtending leaves; peduncles 2.5-4 mm long, weakly puberulous. Capitula (immature) discoid, 13-20-flowered; involucre campanulate, 2-3 X 3-4 mm; phyllaries ca. 9, eximbricate, subequal, 1-2-se- riate, membranous, non-articulated at base, lanceolate to lanceolate-ovate, 2-3 X 0.6-1 mm, margin ciliate, otherwise glabrous, 3- 7-nerved, apex acuminate; receptacle con- vex to conical, 0.3-0.5 mm tall, glabrous, epaleate. Florets (immature) bisexual; corolla regular, cylindric or funnelform, 5- lobed, 1.5-1.8 mm long, cream-colored, lobes papillose, corolla otherwise glabrous, the tube 0.3-0.4 mm long, the throat broad- ening, 0.8-1 mm long, the lobes short-triangular, erect, with a few papillae on the distal part of the outer surface, 0.3-0.4 mm long, cells of the throat and the lobes not sharply differentiated; anthers included, ca. 0.8 mm long, base rounded, the collar ca. 0.12 mm long, cylindrical, the cell walls with nodular thickenings, the apical appendage hyaline, indistinct, ovate, 0.1-0.15 mm long; style short-exserted, ca. 2 mm long, the base slightly enlarged, appressed pubescent, the shaft ca. 0.8 mm long, the branches erect, ca. 1.2 mm long, with a filiform sterile apical appendage ca. 0.7 mm long, the stigmatic lines ca. 0.5 mm long, in pairs in lower part of branch. Cypselas (immature) narrowly obconic, ca. 4-5-angled or slightly compressed, glabrous, ca. 1.2 mm long; pappus reduced to an annular callus to ca. 0.1 mm tall, sometimes also with a single elongated bristle to ca. 0.4 mm long and reaching to about the corolla tube-throat juncture; the carpopodium not developed, though seeminlgy tapered, neither bulbous nor inflated.

description: Subherbaceous twiner with palmately 3-foliolate leaves that are ovate in general outline. The capitulescence is a compound corymb composed of heads 8-9 mm long. The corolla is also distinctive in possessing teeth 5-6 times the length of the very short and nearly non-existent throat.

description: Perennis; rhizoma horizontali; caule circa 3 dm. alto, glabro, folioso; foliis inferioribus oblanceolatis, brevi-petiolatis, 4-7 cm. longis, serratis, acutis, margine scabro-ciliolato, superioribus sessilibus; inflorentia paniculata, breviter corynibiformi; ramis minus quam 4 mum. longis, recurvato-secundis; involuero 5 mm. longo; bracteis imbricatis, lineari-lanceolatis, glabris, acutis; acheniis glabris.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Stems erect, to 25 cm tall, terete, minutely lanulose, reddish green, rarely branched. Leaves opposite, but alternate in upper part; lamina herbaceous, ovate to oval, 15-25 X 11-15 mm at the middle part of stems, subacute at apex, round or shortly attenuate at base, crenulate along margin, sparsely hispidulous and punctate-glandular on both surfaces; veins rather conspicuous and raised below; petioles short. Lateral shoots from leaf axils sometimes shortly developed, bearing a few pairs of small leaves. Heads 10-25, 8-9 X ca. 4 mm, in a terminal corymb 15-30 mm wide. Peduncles 2-5 mm, sparsely lanulose. Phyllaries 5-6 mm long, acumi- nate at apex, pale green and usually red- purple toward the apex, sparsely puberulous and sessile-glandular outside. Corolla sparsely puberulous and sparsely sessile-glandular outside; tubes dark pink to purple, ca. 4 mm long; lobes paler, ca. 1.5 mm long. Pappus awns 3(-4), almost as long as corolla, red-purple, covered with minute spines; scales between awns membranous. Achenes ca. 3.5 mm long, black, hispidu- lous on the ribs.

description: Shrubs, 3 m tall; stems angled, often flattened near new branches, densely strigose, hairs 1 mm long; internodes 6-9 cm long. Leaves petiolate; blades ovate, 10-20(-35) X 6-15(-25) cm, membraneous, apices acuminate, bases attenuate (new leaves), truncate-rounded, and shortly decurrent on the petiole, margins serrulate to irregularly serrate, both faces strigose, hairs 1 mm long; petioles 2-5 cm long, sulcate, narrowly winged, strigillose, hairs 1 mm long, marginate by the decurrent leaf blades. Capitulescences paniculiform, with clusters of capitula tightly condensed (ca. 100 capitula/cluster, 3-4 cm diam.) at the end of trichotomously divided terminal branches. Capitula sessile, or shortly pedicellated, 8 mm high, 3-4 mm diam.; phyllaries 4, 7-8 X 3-4 mm wide, ovate, ovate-lanceolate, apices acute, 4-5 veined, abaxially strigose, hairs 1 mm long, margins ciliate on distal one-third. Pistillate florets 4, subtended by ovate-lanceolate paleae, 6-7 X 3-4 mm, 3- veined; corollas 4.5 mm long, 2 mm diam., white, glabrous, narrowly tubulate, 4-lobed, lobes 1 mm long, margin shortly pilose, hairs 0.5 mm long; styles 3.5 mm long, branches 2 mm long. Staminate fiorets 4(-5), subtended by lanceolate paleae, 5-5.5 X 2 mm, 1-veined, apex slightly ciliate; corollas light-purple, tubulate, 5 mm long. 2.4 mm diam., 5-lobed, lobes 1 mm long, apices slightly hirsute, hairs 0.2 mm long; styles undivided, 2.5 mm long; ovaries pilose, hairs 1 mm long. Cypselae 2.5 X 1.8- 2.1 mm, obovoid, glabrous. Chromosome numbers unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Arriagada, J. E. 2003. Revision of the genus Clibadium (Asteraceae, Heliantheae). Brittonia. 55: 245-301.

description: Perennial herb with a stout branching caudex; stems several, erect or nearly so, but usually curved at the base, 5-15 cm. high, sparsely pilose or villous with spreading hairs, often also somewhat viscid-glandular; leaves largely basal, spatulate or oblanceolate, up to 5 cm. long and 12 mm. wide, the blade roulided at the tip, tapering or somewhat abruptly contracted to the petiole, glabrous or somewhat hirsute, ciliate on the margins;' cauline leaves reduced and inconspicuous; head solitary, the disk about 10-15 mm. wide; involuere 6-8 mm. high, about equaling the disk, sparsely to moderately pilose and sometimes also viscid, the cross-walls of the hairs clear or the lower ones often bright purple; phyllaries about equal, thin, green, usually purplish above the middle; ligules 25-50, white, 1.5-2.5 mm. wide, 7-10 mm. long; disk-corollas 3.5-4.5 mm. long, the tube 0.8-1.2 mm., the lobes 0.7-1.0 mm.; style-appendages deltoid, acute, about 0.25 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 15-20 brittle strongly barbellate bristles, the outer of numerous slender setae; akenes 2-nerved, sparsely hirsute.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Perennial herb with a taproot and crown; stem about 5 cm. high, finely and densely villous-hirsute with short spreading white hairs; leaves villous or villous hirsute like the stem, the hairs averaging a little shorter and finer; basal leaves linear-oblanceolate, 3 cm. long or less, about 2 mm. wide or less, their bases more or less enlarged and chaffy, slightly purplish; cauline leaves several, linear, 1.5 cm. long or less; heads solitary or two, the disk 10-13 mm. wide; involucre 5-7 mm. high, finely villous and obscurely viscid; phyllaries subequal, linear-lanceo-late, greenish-brownish, with acuminiate loQse purplish tips; ligules about 25-35, white, 5-6 mm. long, about 2 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.5-3.8 mm. long, the tube 0.5-0.7 mm., the lobes about 0.6 mm.; style-appendages about 0.2-0.25 mm. long, deltoid; pappus bristles about 12, with some evident outer setae; akenes 2-nerved, hairy. Known onlv from the type collection, Beaverhead County, Montana.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Stout herbs, up to 1.2 m high, the stems little to much-branched above, striate; submerged leaves divided into irregular segments or pinnately parted, often clustered, soon deciduous, the lower short and narrow, the tupper longer, often linear and entire; aerial leaves linear to lanceolate, the margins somewhat sinuate, entire throughout, or entire (rarely few-toothed) from the base toward the middle and then distally serrate or variously toothed, rarely serrate throughout; lower leaves sessile, 4-10 cm long, 0.5-1.5 cm wide; upper leaves clasping, sometimes auriculate, reduced, 1-3.5 cm long, or unreduced and about as long as the lower leaves; heads large, few to about 20; receptacle naked or alveolate; involuere 1.5-2 cm wide, 1-1.5 cm high-; phyllaries united below into a broad cup, the outer ones widely-spaced, herbaceous above, chartaceous and resinous below, oblong-lanceolate, cuspidate, 0.7-1 cm long, abaxially and marginally capitate-glandular toward the base; inner phyllaries ovate to lanceolate, acute, 5-6 mm long, abaxially and marginally capitate-glandular throughout, searious-margined, chartaceous at the base; ray florets 25-35, yellow, sometimes orange when dried, 1-1.6 cm long, 2-3.5 mm wide, slightly 3-toothed or entire at the apex, the ligules coiling from apex toward base upon drying; disk florets 200- 250, 4.5-5.5 mm long, with dilated throat, the corolla lobes equal or unequal in width at the base; style branches of the disk florets with ovate appendages, about as long as or shorter than the stigmatic lines; pappus of ray- and disk florets similar, of 5-12 unequal bristles, the longest bristles of the ray florets about equaling the length of the corolla throat, the longest of the disk florets about two-thirds the length of the tube; ray achenes 3-winged, disk achenes 2-winged or those nearest the rays often 3-winged, callous-thickened at base and apex, 2-3 mm long, 2.5-3.2 mm wide, squarish, greenish-brown, light brown, or stramineous; chromosome number n = 6 (Fig. 8), determined from PMC squashes (voucher, De Jong & Longpre 1017, MSC).
bibliographicCitation: De Jong, D. D. D. & Beaman, John H. 1963. The genus Olivaea (Compositae-Astereae). Brittonia. 15: 86-92.

description: Shrubs or herbs to 2 m tall, the branching often dichotomous; stems terete or nearly so densely pilose upward, less so below; leaves small, ovate-lanceolate, to 10 cm long and 3 cm wide, their margins crenulate, densely pilose and glandular above and below; petioles to 1 cm long on larger leaves, the smaller leaves subsessile; peduncles ca 1 cm long, densely pilose; phyllaries in 2 series, the lower 2 (-3) ovate-lanceolate, pilose opposite, and at right angles with the upper pair which are broadly ovate, puberulent below and on tip above, shining-coriaceous, with a texture similar to that of ray pales; ray flowers ca 7, the corollas yellow, to 3 mm wide and 4 mm long, the tube to 1.8 mm long, pilose outside, with a persistent annular disc at base of the corolla; disc flowers 15-20, 5 mm long, the lobes of the corolla bordered by a prominent vein; ray paleae coriaceous, petaloid, yellowish (at least when dried), broadly ovate, 3 mm wide and 5 mm long, with several prominent, longitudinal, parallel veins persistent almost to edge of pale; disc paleae narrowly lanceolate, a prominent midvein persisting to the tip, ca 3 mm long, the outer ones somewhat wider than the inner ones; achene brown, oblong-quadrangular, ca 3 mm long and 1.5 mm wide, with an annular disc ca 0.3 mm high persistent on the upper end.
bibliographicCitation: Wells, James R. 1965. A taxonomic study of Polymnia (Compositae). Brittonia. 17: 144-159.

description: Paniculately branched annual, 4-10 dm tall. Stems moderately winged, sparsely pubescent below becoming moderately pubescent above with short, unbranched antrorse hairs. Peduncles 3-10 cm long, ca. 2 times as wide at the top as at the base. Leaves glabrous to sparsely pubescent, midrib prominent and lateral veins easily visible in larger leaves, 5-10 times as long as wide, apices acute to narrowly acuminate; lower leaves variable, usually irregularly laciniate; middle and upper leaves linear-lanceolate, entire. Heads several to many, ovoid to conical, 6-10 mm high, 5-10 mm wide. Receptacle ovoid to narrowly conical, 4-7 mm high, 3-6 mm wide. Involucral bracts strongly united at the base, reflexed at anthesis, pubescent with short, antrorse hairs. Ray florets absent. Disc corollas 4-lobed, cylindrical to cylindric-campanulate or somewhat urceolate, 1.0-1.3 mm long, 0.4-0.7 mm wide, yellow-green with yellow, brown or reddish brown lobes. Achenes 0.9-1.2(-1.5) mm long, 0.3-0.6 mm wide, pubescent with short hairs. Pappus scales 6(-7), obtuse to broadly acute, 0.2-0.5 mm long, 0.2-0.3 mm wide.
bibliographicCitation: Bierner, Mark W. 1972. Taxonomy of Helenium sect. Tetrodus and a conspectus of North American Helenium (Compositae). Brittonia. 24: 331-355.

description: Frutex volubilis ramis valde flexuosis laevibus glabris. Folia alterna petiolata chartacea glaberrima. Petiolus tenuissimus 10-12 mm. longus rectus vel flexuosus. Lamina lanceolata basi rotundata paulo inaequilatera apice longe cuspidata margine integra, 4-6.5 cm. longa 1.2-2.2 cm. lata; supra viridis costa nervisque secundariis paulo prominulis reticulo parum conspicuo; subtus pallidior costa angusta prominula 3 nerviis secundariis utroque latere prominulis curvato-ascendentibus ceteris paucis nervulis laxe reticulatis. Capitula radiata in cymis corymbosis paucifloris terminalibus, ramulis pe'dunculisque glabris teneribus flexuosis, bracteolis brevibus anguste lineari- lanceolatis. Pedicelli graciles 10-20 mm. longi 3-5 bracteolas lineares minutas 1-2 mm. longas ferentes. Calyculus nullus sed 1-2 bracteolis brevissimis ad apicem pedunculi. Involucrum glabrum subcampanulatum 8 bracteis 4.5 mm. longis exterioribus linearibus apice subite acutatis 1 mm. latis, interioribus oblongis apice mucronatis margine scariosis 2 mm. latis. Flores marginales feminei 7-8 ligulati, corolla lutea 13 mm. longa, tubulo glabro 3 mm. longo lamina oblonga 2-3 denticulata obtusa 7-8 nervata 2.5 mm. lata. Flores disci hermaphroditi tubul'osi 9-10, corolla lutea glabra 6.5-7 mm. longa tubulo 3 mm. longo dentibus 1 mm. longis. Antherae 2.2 mm. longae basi breviter sagittatae. Rami stigmatici truncati. Ovarium glabrum. Pappus stramineus 6 mm. longus. Achaenia striata 3 mm. longa.

description: Perennial herb with a branched caudex or sometimes merely a crown; stem more or less densely strigose, prostrate to ascending or erect, 4-20 cm. long; leaves gray with a fine and dense silky-strigose pubescence, sometimes becoming less densely pubescent in age; basal leaf blades obovate to elliptical or suborbicular, up to 25 mm. long and 13 mm. wide, rounded or obtuse to sometimes acutish at the apex, more or less abruptly contracted to the petioles which are longer than the blades and up to 4 cm. long; cauline leaves reduced, few, the lower usually spatulate-oblanceolate, the upper linear or linear-oblong, in reduced specimens only 2 or 3 linear leaves present on the stem; heads solitary, or as many as 4 on relatively long arching branches; disk 9-14 mm. wide; involucre 4-6 mm. high, sparsely to densely strigose, the hairs fine and appressed, sometimes also slightly glutinous; phyllaries imbricate, firm, greenish brown, the outer sometimes straw-colored near the margins, the inner mostly straw-colored except for the midrib; ligules about 20-50 mostly blue or purple, sometimes white, 5-9 mm. long, 1.0-2.0 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.1-4.3 mm. long, the tube 0.6-0.9 mm., the lobes 0.5-0.7 mm.; style-appendages triangular-lanceolate or a little broader, acute, 0.2-0.3 mm. long; pappus of about 20-30 fragile bristles, sometimes with a few inconspicuous outer or intermingled setae; akenes more or less silky-strigose, 2-nerved. Dry places at moderate elevations in the mountains; northwestern Wyoming, southwestern Montana, and adjacent Idaho.

description: Herba perennis 20-40 cm. alta ut videtur A. trinervio Roxb. affinis, caulibus erectis, haud ramosis, deorsum 2 mm. diametro, teretibus, glabris, supra basin, longe efoliatis, internodiis plerumque 4-10 mm. longis; sursum inter foliis breviter subeinereo-hirsutis; foliis basalibus longe (2-5 cm.) petiolatis, oblonge-ellipticis (lamina 4-6 cm. longa, 1-2 cm. lata, margine pauciter grosse dentata), caulinis magis numerosis, lanceolatis, 5-7 cm. longis, 5-12 mm. latis, utrinque subaequaliter angustatis, apice graciliter acute acuminatis, base longe cuneatis, petiolo breviter hirsuto, 4-7 mm. longo, margine distanter pauciter serrato-dentatis, dentibus acutis, utrinque plerumque 3 vel 4, omnibus pallidis vel pallide olivaceis, supra breviter consperse hispidulo-scaberulis, subtus conspersissime breviter hispidulis praesertim ad costam nervosque, nervis primariis utrinque 2 vel 3, adscendentibus, arcuato-anastomosantibus, reticulis laxis, basi 3-plinerviis; infloreseentiis corymbosis, 4-5 cm. longis, 5-7 cm. latis, foliosis, capitulis 5-15, longe graciliter pedunculatis, pedunculis breviter einereo-hirsutis, 1-2 cm. longis, paucibracteatis, bracteis 2 vel 3, linearis, 2-5 mm. longis; capitulis 8-9 mm. longis, sub anthesin eirciter 12 mm. diametro; involueri bracteis ca. 3-seriatis, anguste oblongis vel lineari-oblongis, omnibus acuminatis, exterioribus brevioribus angustioribusque, interioribus eirciter 4 mm. longis et 0.7 mm. latis, externis subadpresse einereo-hirsutis internis tenuioribus, margine late submembranaceis, subglabris; floribus radialibus eirciter 20, ligulis pallide purpureis, anguste oblongis, eirciter 6 mm. longis et 1 mm. latis, circa ad marginem graciliter 2-nerviis, apice rotundatis, basi subeuneatis; florum discis numerosis, corolla eirciter 6 mm. longa, sursum ampliata, lobis oblongis, acutis vel acuminatis, recurvatis, 1.2 mm. longis; acheniis compressis, oblongis, deorsum angustatis, parcissime consperse breviter hirsutis vel deorsum glabris, eirciter 2 mm. longis.

Perennial herbs 30-60 cm tall; stems terete, essentially glabrous with scattered glandular dots, purplish green. Leaves opposite, uninerved; blades linear, 1-7 cm long, 1-7 mm wide, smaller distally toward the capitulescence, linear, adaxial surface essentially glabrous with scattered glandular dots, bright green, abaxial surface essentially glabrous with a few appressed, whitish trichomes, slightly lighter in color than adaxial surface, margins mucronate with tapered trichomes having broad bases at the tip of each mucro, smaller, tapered, appressed trichomes on margin in between mucronate segments; petiole 0.2-1 mm long. Capitulescence of 3-30+ heads, arranged in open corymbiform cymes; peduncles 1.5-5 cm long, essentially glabrous, with a few glandular dots. Heads heterogamous, radiate, narrowly campanulate, 0.9- 1.2 cm high, ca. 4 mm wide (excluding lig- ules); receptacle epaleate; involucre of 5 or 6 fused phyllaries, apex acuminate and ending in a 1 mm long arista, glabrescent, with a few scattered glandular dots, greenish purple. Ray flowers 3-5, pistillate, the corollas bright yellow or yellow-orange; ligules 4.5-5.5 mm long, 6-7 mm wide, oblong, glabrous, apices truncate to slightly trilobed; tubes 1.5-1.8 mm long, glabrous, yellow; style 3 mm long, style branches 0.7-0.8 mm long. Ray cypselae 5-6 mm long, 0.8-0.9 mm wide, oblong, glabrous, densely ciliate along flattened margins, pubescence somewhat denser at distal and basal ends, black-brown; pappus of 2 awns and 2 squamellae, awns 4-5 mm long, squamellae 1-1.5 mm long, stramineous to stramineous-brown. Disk flowers 18-25, perfect, the corollas campanulate, yellow; throat 5-6 mm long, 0.7-0.8 mm wide at base, 1.5 mm wide at top, essentially gla- brous; tube 1.5 mm long, glabrous, yellow; lobes 2 mm long, narrowly ovate to lanceolate; anthers 1.8 mm long, yellow-orange, the appendages 0.5 mm long, lanceolate, stramineous; styles 3.5-3.8 mm long, style branches 1 mm long, truncate, appendiculate. Disk cypselae like those of the rays.

description: Suffrutex ascendens, 31-40 cm altus. Caules basi lignosi, bruneoli, glabri, rhizomatibus gracilibus. Folia alterna, spathulata, bruneolo-viridia, 18-22 mm longa, 3-5 mm lata, glabra, apice obtusa, basi attenuata, marginibus integris, breviter ciliatis; petiolus gradatim in laminam dilatatus, 3-5 mm longus, 1-2 mm latus, glabrer. Capitulescentia paniculata (interdum simplex), e 4-10 capitulis constans; pedunculi usque ad 8 cm longi, glabri vel minute glandulosi, bracteati, bracteis lineari-lanceolatis, quasi subulatis, sparsim glanduloso-pubescentibus; involucrum turbinatum, 5-7 mm altum, 8-10 mm latum; phyllaria 28-36, imbricata, glabra, 2-3-seriata, lineari-lanceolata, 5-8 mm longa, 1 mm lata, bracteis externis sparsim glandulosis, ad marginem hyalinis luteolis, in centro atroviridibus, laterale luteolis. Flosculi radiati 18-27, uniseriati; corollae albae, limbo 4-5 mm longo, 1-2 mm lato, tubo 1.5-2 mm longo. Flosculi disci 32-47, hermaphroditi; corollae anguste infundibuliformes, 5-lobatae, albae, 3.8-4 mm longae, 0.6-0.8 mm diametro; stylus 0.6-0.7 mm longus, apice appendiculis rotun- datis 0.2 mm longo et pilis instructus. Pappus capillaris, albus, 2.5 mm longus. Achenia compressa, pubescentia, 1-1.5 mm longa.

description: Ascending suffruticose shrub, 31-40 cm tall. Stems near base woody, light- brown, glabrous, with slender rhizomes. Leaves alternate, spathulate, brownish-green, 18-25 mm long, 3-5 mm wide, at apex obtuse, at base attenuate, with margins entire, glabrous, shortly ciliate; petiole gradually expanding into the lamina, 3-5 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, glabrous. Capitulescence paniculate (occasionally simple), with (1) 4-10 heads; peduncles up to 8 cm long, glabrous or minutely glandular; bracts linear-lanceolate, becoming nearly subulate, sparsely glandular-pubescent; involucre turbinate, 5-7 mm high, 8-10 mm wide; phyllaries 28-36, imbricate, glabrous, 2-3-seriate, linear-lanceolate, 5-8 mm long, 1 mm wide; outer bracts sparsely glandular, with margin hyaline, with central portion of phyllary dark green, and outer portion pale yellow. Ray florets 18-27, uniseriate; corollas white, with limb 4-5 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, and tube 1.5-2 mm long. Disc florets 32-47, hermaphrodite; corollas narrowly funnelform, 5-lobed, white, 3.8-4 mm long, 0.6-0.8 mm diam; style 0.6-0.7 mm long, with rounded apical appendages 0.2 mm long and covered with collecting hairs. Pappus capillary, white, 2.5 mm long. Achenes compressed, pubescent, 1-1.5 mm long.

description: Rhizoines resembling those of A. Chamissonis, slender, 1-2 mm. in diam., extensive, little branehed, the summit rarely invested with scales and leafbases, light reddish-brown, the thin scales inconspicuous at the remote nodes, the rootlets rhizome-like, long, little branched; iniovations rarely produced; stems solitary or rarely 2 or 3 from the long branching caudex, slender, 8-25(30) cm. high, simple, thinly loose-pilose with moniliform, septate hairs which are pigmented at the septa, and also coarsely moniliform-puberulent, becoming densely pilose toward the summit, eglandular; cauline leaves 4(3)-5 pairs, mostly basal, 0.8-2.5 cm. broad, 3(2)-10 cm. long, lanceolate, elliptic to oblanceolate or rarely obovate, narrowed to a short winged petiole or sessiLe, entire, denticulate or rarely sharply dentate, pale, glabrous or sometimes sparingly puberulent beneath, usually more obviously pubescent above, prominently ciliolate; peduncles 6-15 (20) cm. long, becoming densely pilose towards the summit; heads solitary, mostly nodding, broadly turbinate-campanulate; perielinium densely pilose with pigmented septate moniliform hairs; involueral bracts 11-15, in 2 series, lanceolate to lance-elliptic, 12-15(17) mm. long, 2.5-4(5) mm. broad, obtuse with a broad callose tip, deeply red-pigmented, becoming less pubescent upwards, ciliolate; ray flowers 8-13, the ligules yellow to orange, 4-8 mm. broad, 14-20 mm. long, elliptic-oblong, the teeth acute, 1-2.5(3) mm. long; disc corollas 6.5(6.3)-8.5(9.3) mm. long, yellow, broadly goblet-shaped, the tube 2.4(2.1)-3.0(3.3) mm. long, the limb 4.5 (4.2)-5.7 (6.0) mm. long, the base of the limb and the tube sparingly to moderately pilose, the lobes glabrous or sparsely hirsutulose; anthers purple, moderately exserted; achenes cylindrical, tapered somewhat at the base, strongly 10-nerved, sparsely short strigose with single, ,eptate hairs, eglandular, sometimes glabrous; annulus ca. 0.15-0.3 mm. long; pappus tawny, barbellate, rarely subp]umose, the setae 0.12-0.2(0.25) mm. long.

description: Perennial herb with a stout taproot and usually branched caudex; stem lax, spreading or suberect, mostly 3-20 cm. long, moderately or densely pubescent with short spreading hairs; old leaf bases commonly persistent as long chaffy scales; leaves uniformly pubescent with short spreading hairs, sometimes a few coarser hairs on the margins of the petioles; basal leaves mostly oblanceolate, sometimes rather broadly so, mostly less than 8 cm. long and 4 mm. wide, rarely as much as 1 cm. wide, sometimes slightly triple-nerved at the base; cauline leaves several or rather many, reduced, mostly linear or linear-lanceolate; heads solitary or sometimes two, hemispherical to somewhat turbinate, the disk 8-11 mm. wide; involLcere 4-7 mm. high, the phyllaries slightly thickened and slightly or moderately imbricate, glandular, and, especially on the midrib, more or less spreading hirsute; ligules about 20-50, variously blue or pink, 6-10 mm. long, 1.0-2.2 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 2.9-4.9 mm. long, the tube 0.7-1.3 -mm., the lobes 0.4-0.8 mm.; style-appendages short and blunt, 0.1-0.15 mm. long; pappus of about 13-25 bristles which are less firm than those of E. asperugineus, apparently always with some slender and inconispicuous outer setae; akenes hairy, 2-nerved. Dry rocky places at moderate and fairly high elevations in the mountains, often in dry meadows or flats; eastern California, across central and southern Nevada, to western Utah.

description: Herba perennis radice maximo crasso caudice plerumque ramoso, caulibus laxis non erectis circa 3-20 cm. longis moderate vel dense hirtellis pilis patentibus, foliis hirtellis pilis patentibus imis oblanceolatis plerumque usque ad 8 cm. longis 4 mm. latis insolite latioribus, caulinis reductis linearibus vel lineari-oblanceolatis, capitulis .solitariis vel 2, disco 8-11 mm. lato, involuero 4-7 mm. alto bracteis imbricatis glandulosis plus minusve hirsutis pilis patentibus, ligulis circa 20-50 roseis vel caeruleis 6-10 mm. longis 1.0-2.2 mm. latis, corollis disci circa 2.9-4.9 mm. longis, pappo obscure duplici, achaeniis hirsutis 2-nervis.

description: Frutex dichotomus; caulis teres glabratus; rami erecti compacte albido- v. niigreseenti-piloso-tomelntosi demum infra glabrati, infra capitulum obtuse 5-6-alngulati; folia alterna maxima ex parte prope medium inerementorum alnlnuorum et basi capituli aggregata obovata ad ovalia parva obtusa basi cuneata v. rotundata integerrima coriacea brevissime petiolata flavido-viridia 1-nervia obseurissime penninervia fliarginata glaberrima (basi subsericea excepta); capitula apice ramorum solitaria sessilia foliaceo-involuerata ca. 21-30-flora ca. 2.5-3.2 cm. alta (pappo ineluso); involueri valde gradati ca. 6-seriati 2.2-2.7 cm. alti phyllaria stramineo-coriacea, extima brevissima late triangulari-ovata acuta v. obtusiuscula tenuiter appresse tomentoso-pilosa in intima linearia acuta glabra (apice obscure ciliolato excepto) transeuntia; paleae receptaculi angustissime lineares ca. 2.2 cm. longae 0.5 mm. latae stramineae acutae enerviae glaberrimae, apice minute ciliolato excepto; corollae 20-21 mm. longae, tubo 4 mm. longo obeonico intus in apice piloso-barbato, fauce nulla, dentibus erectis angustissirne lineari-triangularibus glabris 16-17 mm. longis; achenia obovoidea glabra 4-6-angulata 4 mm. longa; pappus gradatus 1.7-2.2 cm. longus straniineus v. rufidulus.
