description: Stems 30 cm. high and more, 3-5 mul. thick, gray-barked in age, at first clothed with a thin, compact, whitish or yellowish tomentum, this becoming blackish; leaves nearly all crowded within 1-2 cm. near the middle and at the tip of each yearly growth; petioles thick, glabrate, 1-3 mm. long; blades mostly obovate or oval, rarely cuneate or the smaller elliptic, 1.7-4 cm. long, 7-18 mm. wide, mostly obtuse or rounded, rarely subtrulncate, usually with short blunt apiculation or the upper short-mucronate, plane, essentially glabrous except for some appressed whitish pubeseenee at base above and usually chiefly toward base beneath, light-papillate on both sides, with yellowish costa and thickened margin, the lateral veins 3-4 pairs, barely indicated below or oln both sides; outer phyllaries 1-ribbed above, the middle ones indistinetly 5-7-nerved, all yellowish or light brown; stamens 11 mm. long, the terminal appendages narrowly triangular, acuminate, about 2.8 mm. long, the cells about 3.5 mm. long, the tails connate in pairs at least toward base, about 4.5 mm. long; style minutely roughened above, the branches narrowly triangular, acutish, about 0.4 mm. long.

description: Basally woody perennial herbs or subshrubs 0.5-1 m tall, caespitose from a xylopodium. Leaves mostly opposite throughout or sometimes alternate distally; petioles up to 7 mm long; blades 3-7x2.8-6 cm, subchartaceous, broadly elliptic to broadly ovate to orbicular, rounded to truncate at the base, rounded to obtuse at the apex, margins serrulate or sometimes crenulate-serrulate, both surfaces mostly hispidulous or rarely subtomentose, usually asperous to the touch, the abaxial dull cinereous, more densely indumented, always 3 -nerved from the base and prominently reticulate. Peduncles stout, mostly elongated and leafless; heads campanulate. Outer phyllaries 7-24 x 5-20 mm, eleptic or sometimes ovate, not or slightly indurate at the base; inner phyllaries 6-16 x 4-10 mm, elliptic, constricted and indurate at the base to oblong and more scarious. Paleae 8-9.5 x 1.2 - 2 mm when folded, with a triangular tip up to 1mm long, Ray florets sterile, lacking a style, tube 2-3 mm long, lamina 8-20 x 2.5 - 4 mm, oblong, sometimes elliptic or obovate, sparsely setulose abaxially. Disc florets with corollas 5-6.8 mm long, lobes with a few trichomes abaxially. Cypselae 3.5 -5 x 1.2-2.2 mm, laterally flattened, mostly with smooth faces, without ridges, broadly winged, wings 0.7-1.8 mm wide, ciliate on the margin opposite the paleae; pappus with awns 1-3 mm long, broad to very broad at the base, mostly subequal, the longest awn mostly ca. 1/2 or less than 3A of the cypsela length, crown ca. 0.2(-0.5) mm tall, inconspicuous, almost totally fused to the cypsela body, with margins entire, sometimes with squamelloid processes, partially fused to the awn base.
bibliographicCitation: Moraes, M. D. & Semir, J. 2009. A revision of Brazilian Dimerostemma (Asteraceae, Heliantheae, Ecliptinae), with a new species and taxonomic adjustments. Brittonia. 61 (4): 341-365.

description: Fruticose perennial with a xylopodium, ca 1 m tall. Leaves linear, 2-5 cm long, 2-4 mm wide (length/width ratio 10-1 5), sessile, rigid, cuneate to attenuate at the base, acute at the apex, the margins entire and revolute, strigose-pubescent above, sometimes becoming nearly glabrous with age, densely strigose-pubescent below. Heads 8-10 mm tall, with 10-12 flowers, sessile or pedicels up to 4 mm long. Corollas purple, ca 6 mm long. Pappus biseriate, the inner series of ca 40 bristles, 5-6 mm long, the outer series 0.5-1 mm long. Achenes ca 2.5 mm long, pubescent and glandular-dotted.

description: Herbae annuae, 8-28 cm altae. Caules erecti vel decumbentes, pilosi, pilis usque ad 1.5 mm longis. Pedunculi 3-3.7 cm longi. Folia petiolata, petiolis 2 mm longis, laminis lanceolatis vel anguste ovatis, 3-6 cm longis, 1-1.3 cm latis, apice acutis basi obtusis, supra strigosis pilis 0.3 mm longis (basalibus longioribus), subtus valde sericeis; marginibus integris (raro 1-2-lobatis), irregulariter ciliatis, pilis 0.3 mm longis (basalibus longioribus). Capitula 6-7 mm alta, 7.5-11 mm diainetro. Involucrum extimum cupulatum, 6.5-9 mm diametro; bracteae 5, ovatae vel anguste ovatae, basi leviter connatae, 4-5 mm longae, 2-2.5 mm latae, apice acuminatae, extus pilosae, pilis 1 mm longis, marginibus opacis, ciliatis, pilis 1 mm longis. Bracteae intimae involucri extensae sursum in cucullo, apice mucronatae vel cirrhosae, lateribus laevibus vel tuberculatis; fructus 1.6-2.5 mm longi. Flosculi radii 7-8; ligulae flavo-aurantiacae, ovato-oblongae, 3-4.5 mm longae, 2-3 mm latae, apice bi- vel tridentatae. Flosculi disci 55-80; corollae flavae, lobis apice comosis. Paleae flavae apicem versus, oblanceolatae, 3 mm longae, apice obtusae, marginibus apicum erosi-dentatis in centro, lateribus laciniatis, costa conspicua, basi hirsutula, pilis 0.3 mm longis. Chromosomatum numerus, n = 10.

description: Plants perennial, branching from a woody, tuber-like rootstock, 45-90 cm high or subdecumbent, hirsute and with glandular trichomes; leaves lanceolate to lancolate-rhombic, 4-7.5 cm long, 1-2.3 cm wide, subentire to repand-serrate, acute at the apex, long attenuate and subpetiolate at the base, evenly but not densely appressed-hirsute on both surfaces; heads campanulate, 8-12 mm in diameter, solitary on peduncles; peduncles 1-17 cm long, sparsely to densely covered with spreading, glandular trichomes, especially near the heads; receptacle conical; chaff persistent, scarious, obovate, glabrous, 5-6 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, the upper margins incised or laciniate; involucre 4-5-seriate, outer bracts light green, oblong, 1.5-3 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, with scarious, ciliate margins and rounded, often purple-tinged apex, pubescent with glandular trichomes; inner bracts progressively longer, becoming membranous, the longest 10-12 mm long, 2-4 mm wide, oblong, with scarious, ciliate margins and rounded apex, purple-tinged, especially near the apex; ray flowers 3, pistillate and fertile, tubular at the base for 5.5-6.5 mm, with conspicuous pinkish-purple to deep rose ligules, these 11-15 mm long, 9-10 mm wide, broadly obovate to cuneate, subtruncate to obscurely lobed or toothed at the apex; ray corollas with 1-2 inner lobelets and 1-3 staminodia; disc corollas yellow, 8.5-9 mm long, the tube 2.5-3 mm long, densely pilose, the throat broadly tubular, 4.5-5 mm long, pilose at the base, the lobes acute, ca 1.5 mm long; style branches flattened, linear-lanceolate, ca 1.7 mm long, sparsely but coarsely pubescent except near the finely pubescent, long subulate tips; achenes blackish, subturbinate, 3-3.5 mm long, obscurely 4-5-ridged, rather short and evenly pilose or the hairs appearing concentrated on the ridges; pappus of 10-14 short, unequal, lanceolate or oblong, fimbriate scales, 1-1.5 mm long; anthers 4-4.5 mm long, sagittate at the base.

description: Herba perennis pluricaulis e radice crasso tuberoso; caules adscendentes simplices v. basi parum ramosi usque ad medium foliosi supra subnudi, usque ad medium hispido-hirsuti supra medium glandularipilosi; folia lanceolata acuta basi acute cuneata petiolata hispido-hirsuta; capitula ca. 3 majuscula longe pedunculata, radiis 3 roseo-purpureis disco flavo; involueri valde gradati phyllaria oblonga rotundata minute ciliolata ceterum glabra, exterioribus dorso glandulari-pilosis exceptis; achenia appresse pilosa; pappi aristae ca. 10 lanceolatae ciliatae achenio triplo breviores.

description: Frutex; caulis dense puberulus non flexuosus; folia ovata acuminata basi leviter cordata brevissime petiolata firma dentato-serrulata supra scaberula subtus glanduloso-adspersa et in venis et venulis minute hispidula penninervia; capitula (submascula) numerosa panieulata minima ca. 3.5 mm. alta ca. 40-flora; involucri 3 mm. alti phyllaria oblonga acuta v. acuminata ciliata et sparse puberula; corolla fl. fem. (12-14) ligulata, lamina patente ovali 1.3 mm. longa.

description: Slender shrub 10 ft. high, the stem (or larger branches) branched only in the infloreseence; stem (or branch) scarcely or not at all zigzag, slender, 2-3.5 mm. thick, terete, striatulate, yellowish- brown, densely puberulous with short spreading or curved-ascendinc several-celled whitish hairs interspersed with shorter sordid but non- glandular hairs; leaves alternate; internodes 2-3 cm. long; petioles puberulous, not margined, 1-2 mm. long; blades ovate or oblong-ovate, 5-8 cm. long, 2.2-3.4 cm. wide, at apex short-acuminate and somewhat falcate, at base very shallowly cordate, dentate-serrulate above the entire lower quarter or third (teeth 7-10 pairs, subacutely callous- mucronulate, about 0.5 mm. high, 4-9 mm. apart), firm-papery, feather- veined (principal veins 5-9 pairs, barely prominulous above, whitish and prominulous beneath, the veinlets loosely reticulate), rather light green above, somewhat paler green beneath; panicles terminal and on few-leaved branches from the upper axils, many-headed, the whole compound panicle 8-15 cm. wide, flattish or rounded to oblong, densely puberulous with somewhat spreading whitish, brownish, or purplish several-celled hairs and with a few scattered sessile glands, the ultimate bracts minute, subulate, the pedicels very slender, 2-9 mm. long; heads 38-44-flowered, broadly campanulate, 5-5.5 mm. wide (moistened), 3.5 mm. high; involuere graduate, about 5-seriate, 2.8-3 mm. high, the outermost phyllaries narrowly lance-triangular, the others lance-oblong to oblong or the inmost oblong-linear, acuminate to acute, with greenish midline (1-vittate at least below) and about equally broad subscarious whitish margin, often purplish toward tip, ciliate especially above, somewhat puberulous, and sessile-glandular; receptacle alveolate, naked; rays 12-14, white, the tube 1.3-1.5 mm. long, densely puberulous with several-celled clavellate hairs, the lamina oval, weakly 2-3-dentate, 2-3-nerved, 1.2-1.3 mm. long, 0.7-0.8 mm. wide, twice as long as the exserted part of the style; disk flowers 26-30, hermaphrodite but func- tionally staminate, their corollas white, clavellate-puberulous on upper part of tube, base of throat, and tips of teeth, 2.8 mm. long (tube 1.2 mm., throat campanulate, 0.4 mm., teeth oblong, acute, 1.2 mm. long); ray achenes oblong, trigonous, 0.7 mmn. long, densely subsessile-glandu- lar and sparsely hirsutulous; disk achenes (infertile) oblong, 0.4 mm. long, similarly pubescenlt; pappus of ray achenes of about 30 whitish hispidulous bristles, contorted toward base, slightly clavellate at apex, 2.2 mm. long, that of the disk achenes of about 24 similar bristles, 2.4 mm. long; style branches (in disk flowers) oblong, acute, 0.7 mm. long, finely hispidulous with thick blunt hairs.

description: Plants annual, 25-50 cm high, erect to subdecumbent, hirsute; leaves linearlanceolate, sparsely hirsute on both surfaces, 3-7.2 cm long, 0.7-1.8 mm wide, pinnately toothed or lobed, the lobes acute, attenuate, the blade decurrent along the petiole; petioles 5-11 mm long; heads campanulate, 1.2-1.8 mm in diameter, solitary; peduncles 0.8-5(-11) cm long, sparsely to densely hirsute, especially near the heads, with spreading, glandular-capitate trichomes; receptacle short-conical, 5-6 mm across, ca 2.5 mm high; chaff persistent, glabrous, scarious, light greenishyellow, oval, 9-10 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide, tapering to a purple awn-like beak, ca 1/3 as long as the body; involucre 4-5-seriate, the outer bracts oblong (rarely lanceolate-ovate), hirsute, or with short glandular-tipped trichomes at the rounded, purplish apex, the shortest 2.5-3 mm long, 1-2.5 mm wide; inner bracts progressively longer and more membranous, oblong to slightly obovate, the longest 7.5-10 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, rounded to obtuse at the apex, dark purple and sparsely hirsute, or with short glandular-tipped trichomes, the margins scarious, light reddish-purple; ray flowers ca 13, pistillate and fertile, tubular at the base for 5.5-6.5 mm, with inconspicuous whitish or purplish ligules, 2.5-3 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide, oblong to slightly obovate, three-toothed at the apex, the teeth obtuse to acute, ca 0.2 mm long; ray corollas with one or two linear, inner lobelets, these 0.5-1 mm long; pappus of the ray florets like that of the disc; disc corollas glabrous, pale yellow, partially cyanic, 5-5.5 mm long, the slender tube as long as the throat, 2-2.5 mm long, lobes acute, suberect, 0.5-0.8 mm long; style branches slender, flattened, brownish, recurved, essentially glabrous, ca 1 mm long, tapering to an obscure, subulate tip; achenes turbinate, black, ca 3 mm long, densely pilose, the hairs ca 1.2 mm long; pappus of 35-40 light-brownish, slender, unequal, plumose bristles, 4-6.5 mm long, alternately longer and shorter, the shortest 1/2 to 3/4 the length of the longest; anthers 1.5-2 mm long, sagittate at the base.

description: Perennial, reproducing vegetatively from root stocks; 7-10 dm tall, stems 1-3 branched, simple to the inflorescence. Cauline leaves few, linear-spatulate, 2.7-4.3 cm long, 0.2-0.7 cm wide; basal leaves spatulate, 4.9-10.4 cm long, 0.5-1.3 cm wide. Inflorescence of 1-3 heads; ray flowers 8-22, 13.1-34 mm long, 3.2-8.6 mm wide at apex; disk flowers 50-180, yellow, 5.5-8.2 mm long, 1-2 mm wide. Outer involucral bracts 4-7.2 mm long, 2.1-2.9 mm wide, ovate, broadly acuminate at apex; inner involucral bracts 5.1-11 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, lanceolate, acuminate at apex. Achenes 1.3-2.2 mm long, 0.7-1.1 mm wide. Pappus scales lanceolate, 1.3- 2.2 mm long, 0.5-0.6 mm wide. Chromosome number, n = 36.
bibliographicCitation: Parker, Earl S. & Jones, Jr., Samuel B. 1975. A systematic study of the genus Balduina (Compositae, Heliantheae). Brittonia. 27: 355-361.

description: Plants annual (?), 13-25 cm high, suberect, short-hirsute; leaves 1.8-4(-4.5) cm long, 1.2-2(-2.5) cm wide, ovate, thickish, the margins repand-serrate, cuneate at the base, the apex obtuse to acute, short hirsute on both surfaces; petioles 3-10 mm long; heads campanulate, 8-13 mm in diameter, solitary on rather stout peduncles; peduncles 2.5-7.5(-11.5) cm long, with trichomes antrorsely appressed, at least near the head; receptacle short-conical, 3-5 mm across, 2-3 mm high; chaff persistent, scarious, 7-8.5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, attenuate to cuspidate at the apex; involucre 2-3-seriate, the outer bracts alternately very broad, 4-6 mm long, 2.5-7.5 mm wide, ovate to obovate, dark green, often purple-tinged, costate, attenuate-acute at the apex; inner bracts more elongate, lighter in color, often purple-tinged, cuspidate at the apex; ray flowers 4-8, pistillate and fertile (?), tube 3.5-4 mm long, densely fine pilose, with conspicuous yellow (?) ligules, these 4.5-5 mm long, 3-5.5(-7) mm wide, elongate, obovate to suborbicular, often broader than long, 3-lobed at the apex; ray corolla with inner lobelets present or absent, when present these up to 1-3 mm long; pappus of the ray florets reduced, 1.5-3 (-3.5) mm long; disc corollas yellow, 7-8(-9) mm long, the tube 1.2-1.5 mm long, finely long pilose on the upper half, the throat tubular at the base, becoming subfunnelform at the top, 4.5-5 mm long, finely long pilose on the lower half, the lobes lanceolate, ca 1.5 mm long, short-pubescent at the apex; style branches slender and slightly flattened, 1.7-2 mm long, sparsely pubescent, reflexed or subrevolute, tapering to a subulate tip; achenes grayish-blacki, 2.2-2.8(-3) mm long, densely pilose (the hairs 0.7-1 mm long), turbinate, often narrowly so, slightly flattened anid incurved near the periphery; pappus of 20 plumose bristles, shorter than the corolla, the bristles alternately long and short, the longest 5-6(-6.5) mm long, the shortest ca 3/4 the length of the longest, the cilia short, less than 0.5 mm long, becoming minute 2.5-3 mm from the tip; anthers 2.7-3.5 mm long, obscurely sagittate at the base.

description: Perennial herbs to subshrubs 0.3-2 m tall; stems brownish to golden-brown, velutinous, becoming glabrate. Leaves cauline; petioles indistinct to 13 mm long; blades (7) 10-14 cm long, 4-8.7 cm wide, ovate-elliptic, widest below the middle, apically acute, rounded to cuneate basally or cuneate, marginally revolute, cre- nate to serrate or almost entire, nearly glabrate with well spaced tiny trichomes to pilose above, tomentose to velutinous or hirsute-villous or pilose beneath. Inflorescences relatively small, of a few large heads, paniculate-cymose. Heads ca 110-175-flowered; peduncles 0.5-3 cm long, velutinous to tomentose. Invo- lucre campanulate, 14-23 mm high, 17-19 mm wide; phyllaries tightly imbricate and appressed in ca 8 to 10 series, velutinous to tomentose or strigose-pilose, the inner ones oblong-lanceolate, acuminate, 11-20 mm long, 2-4 mm wide, the outer ones ovate, 2.5-5.5 mm long, 1.5-3 mm wide. Pappus brownish, the inner bristles 10-13.5 mm long and outer scales 1.3-2.5 mm long. Corollas 14-20 mm long, reddish-purple, slightly ciliate on the lobes. Anthers 4.6-6 mm long. Achenes 4.5-6.7 mm long, ribbed, pilose-strigose. Flowering and fruiting from March to April.
bibliographicCitation: Jones, Jr., Samuel B. 1982. A revision of Vernonia series Buddleiifoliae (Compositae: Vernonieae). Brittonia. 34: 102-117.

description: Herba perennis, 6-9 dm alta, erecta, caule tetragono, adpresse hispido vel superne glabro, inferne subpurpureo, minute sulculato, 1.5-3 mm crasso, summam versus corymbose ramoso, internodiis folia valde superantibus, usque ad 1.2 dm longis. Folia opposita, petiolo tenui adpresse hispido 1-2 cm lon(go adjecto 3-6 cm longa, pinnatim tripartita, coeruleo-viridia, supra minute vel moderate adpresso-setosa infra pallidiora et conspicue adpresso-hispida (glandulis numerosissimis minimis cum difficultate manifestis, foliolis serratis; terminali ovato-sublanceolato usque ad 4.2 cm longo et 2.6 cm lato, apice acuto basi sinuato-cuneato sessili; lateralibus ovatis, sessilibus, ca 2 cm longis. Capitula tenuiter pedunculata pedunculis glabris sulculatis paucis (ca 10-12) adgregatis, sub 0.5 mm crassis et usque ad ea 1.1 dm longis, radiata, pansa ad anthesin ea 3-3.5 cm lata et 1.3-1.5 cm alta. Involueri bracteae exteriores ca 8, glabratae, lineares, virides vel purpurascentes, terminaliter nitido-callosae et acres, 7-10 mm longae, ca 5-striatae, quam interiores oblongae demuin atro-purpureae apice saepe hispidulae paulum breviores. Flores ligulati ea 7 vel 8, intense rubri usque ad atro-rubri ligula lineari-obovata, faciebus angustissime lineata lineis sparsim adpresseque albido-setulosis, apice obtuse obscureque denticulata, ca 1.2 cm longa et 4-6 mm lata. Flores tubulosi omnino saltem superne intense atro-rubri (sicei oculis vere atri). Achaenia linearia, plus minusve fusiformia, obtuse tetragona, faciebus profunde suleata et griseo-atra, glaberrima vel brunneo-papillata papillis adpresse antrorso-setosis, corpore 7-12 mm longa et ca 1 mm crassa, apice interdum truneato-expanso biaristata aristis tenuibus 2-2.5 mm longis divergentibus, retrorsum hamosis.
bibliographicCitation: Sherff, Earl E. 1964. Some new or otherwise noteworthy Coreopsidinae (Compositae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 18: 58-73.

description: Perennial herb 6-9 dm tall, erect; stem tetragonal, appressedly hispid or in upper part glabrous, purplish and minutely sulculate below, 1.5-3 mm thick, corymbosely branched near top, internodes much surpassing the leaves, up to 1.2 dm long. Leaves opposite, including the slender petiole (this appressedly hispid, 1-2 cm long) 3-6 cm long, pinnately tripartite, bluish-green, on upper surface minutely or moderately appressed-setose, underneath paler and conspicuously appressed-hispid, also glandular with very numerous and minute glands, these visible with difficulty, leaflets serrate; terminal one ovate-sublanceolate and up to 4.2 cm long and 2.6 cm wide, the apex acute, the base sinuate-cuneate and sessile; lateral ones ovate, sessile, ca 2 cm long. Heads slenderly peduncled with few peduncles (these 10-12, clustered, under 0.5 mm thick and up to ca 1.1 dm long), radiate, expanded at flowering-time ca 3-3.5 cm wide and 1.3-1.5 cm tall. Outer phyllaries ea 8, glabrate, linear, green or purplish, apically shining-cal- loused and sharp, 7-10 mm long, ca 5-striate, a little shorter than the inner ones, these latter oblong, finally blackish-purple, often hispidulous at the apex. Ligulate florets ea 7 or 8, intensely red to dark-red, ligule linear-obovate, its surfaces very narrowly lined with sparsely and appressedly whitish-setulose lines, at apex obtusely and obseurely denticulate, ea 1.2 cm long and 4-6 mm wide. Tubular florets entirely an intensely dark-red at least above (when dried out appearing truly black). Achenes linear, more or less fusiform, obtusely tetragonal, the Taces deeply grooved and grayish-black, very glabrous or brown-papillate with papillae appressedly antrorse-setose, the body 7-12 mm long and ea 1 mm thick, at the sometimes truncate-expanded apex biaristate, the slender aristae 2-2.5 mm long and spreading apart, retrorsely barbed.

description: Perennial herb with a branching caudex; stem 1-5 cm. high, naked, more or less hirsute or villous-hirsute, especially under the head, the hairs under the head spreading, those lower down spreading or appressed; leaves all basal, hirsute or hirsute-strigose with loose or appressed hairs, sometimes one or both surfaces glabrate, up to about 4 cm. long and 8 mm. wide, the blade subrotund to broadly oblanceolate, rounded to acute at the apex, rather abruptly contracted to and much shorter than the petiole; head solitary, the disk 6-11 mm. wide; involuere 4.5-5 mm. high, finely and sometimes obscurely glandular, and more or less villous-hirsute, especially toward the base; phyllaries acuminate or attenuate, slightly imbricate, thin, green or with green midrib, the inner and sometimes to a lesser extent the outer with broad subsearious reddish-purple margins, occasionally even the midrib greenish-purple; ligules about 15-40, white or light rose, about 4-6 mm. long; 0.7-1.4 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 2.7-3.4 mm. long, the tube about 0.7-0.8 mm., the lobes 0.5-0.7 mm.; style-appendages deltoid or a little wider, acutish, 0.15-0.2 mm. long; pappus of about 13-22 firm bristles, with some inconspicuous outer or intermingled setae; akenes 2-nerved, short-hairy. Cliff-crevices; mountains of southern Nevada and adjacent California.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Perennial from a thick branching caudex, often also with a taproot; stem 5-15 cm. high, curved at base, nearly glabrous, bearing a few scattered glands and/or spreading hairs; leaves firm, glabrous, or sometimes sparsely and irregularly glandular, especially at the margins; basal leaves oblanceolate or spatulate to sometimes obovate, sometimes obviously 3-nerved, narrowed to petioliform bases or winged petioles, 2.5-9 cm. long, 5-17 mm. wide, entire or with a few obscure teeth near the rounded or broadly obtuse tips; cauline leaves smaller, narrowly lanceolate to ovate, sessile, 1-3.5 cm. lo'ng, 2-9 mm. wide, commonly broadest at or below the middle, the upper nearly as large as the lower; heads solitary, or rarely 2 or 3, the disk 8-14 mm. wide; involuere 5-8 mm. high, equaling the disk, glandular-viscid or glutinous and very sparsely to moderately villous-hirsute; phyllaries green, subequal, a little loose at the acuminate or attenuate purplish tips; ligules white, or sometimes purple, about 30-50, 1.2-2.0 mm. wide, 6-10 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 15-20 firm bristles, the outer setosesquamellate; disk-corollas about 3.7-4.4 mm. long, the clearly defined tube about 0.9-1.2 mm., the lobes about 0.6-0.8 mm.; style-appendages triangular-lanceolate to deltoid, acute, sometimes very sharply so, about 0.2-0.3 mm. long; akenes 2-nerved, sparsely white-hirsute to occasionally glabrous. Moderate to high elevations, often in rocky places; mountains of western Oregon.

description: Plant annual or perhaps occasionally biennial, mostly 10-50 cm. high, moderately to intricately branched; herbage finely hirsute with ineurved hairs that are commonly broadest near the base; leaves numerous, near or oblanceolate, entire, or occasionally 3-toothed at the apex, or even pinnatifid, the blade up to 4 cm. long and 9 mm. wide, usually smaller, the lower ones sometimes tapering to slender petioles up to 3 or 4 cm. long, and often deciduous by flowering time; heads more or less numerous (few or solitary when depauperate); disks 5-8 mm. wide; involucre 3-5 mm. high, coarsely hirsute with curved hairs like those of the stem but coarser, also more or less glandular; phyllaries thick, greenish, usually with a distinct brown midrib, subequal, or the outermost narrower and shorter than the others; ligules about 30-70, white or pink, 4-6 mm. long and about 1 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 2.5-3.0 mm. long, the tube about 0.5-0.7 mm. long, abruptly surmounted by a white nerveless part of the limb about 0.5-0.7 mm. long (as in E. divergens, but less conspicuously so), the lobes about 0.3-0.4 mm. long; styleappendages deltoid, acutish, about 0.1 mm. long or a little less; pappus of about 15 very fragile readily deciduous bristles; akenes 2-nerved, moderately shorthairy.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Plants annual, much branched from the base, up to 2 dm tall; stems strigose; leaves ovate to obovate, strigose-hispid,c darker on the upper surface, petioles up to 1 em long, blades up to 2.3 cm long and 1.8 cm wide, bases cuneate, apices rounded; heads sessile, hemispherical, up to 8 mm wide; phyllaries imbricate, graduated, obovate, sometimes foliaceous, pubescent on the upper third, margins ciliated, apices sometimes mucronate; rays 8-11, yellow, persistent, reflexed, obovate, ea 2 mm long, glabrous, apex entire to 2-lobed, base adnate to the enitire achene apex, style bifid, glabrous, branch apices truncate to rounded; ray achene obtriangular, 3-angled, striate, ca 3.4 mm long, essentially glabrous, becoming tuberculate, the 3 diveriginog awns ea 2.7 mm long, slender, expanded basally; disk corollas numerous with distinct tube and limb, glabrous., ca 2 mm long, tube dilated basally and bearing a few red-tipped hairs, lobes purple with thickened margins, style bifid, dilated basally, branches flattened inwardly, anther apices concave, broadly lanceolate; peripheral disk achenes 3-4-angled, tuberculate, usually awnless or simply with slender hairs, central achenes generally compressed, 0-2 winged,. ciliate on inner wing, inner wing often larger, 0-2 awned; paleae about equalling the disk flowers, persistent, apices cuspidate and purple-tipped, keel lightly pubeseenit; receptacle conical; n = 16.
bibliographicCitation: Torres, Andrew M. 1964. Revision of Sanvitalia (Compositae-Heliantheae). Brittonia. 16: 417-433.

description: Perennial herbs to more than 1 m tall; roots fibrous, shallow; stems terete or angular, yellowish-green and often purple-spotted, densely glandular-pubescent, especially upward; leaves petiolate, thin, dark green above, pale green below, both surfaces glabrous to puberulent, variable in shape; lower leaves deeply pinnatifid, to 26 cm wide and 39 cm long, the lobes usually 5-7; upper leaves with fewer lobes or entire, the leaves then ovate or ovate-lanceolate, dentate to nearly entire; phyl- laries ca 5, densely stipitate-glandular and sticky, broadly or narrowly ovate; ray flowers ca 5, their corollas white or pale yellow, 3-10 mm wide and to 15 mm long; disc flowers ca 30, ca 7 mm long, the corollas yellowish; ray paleae ovate to ovate- lanceolate; disc paleae elliptic to oblanceolate, about as long as disc flowers, the par- allel main veins 8 or fewer, the upper margin ciliate; achene dark brown to black, sometimes mottled with light brown spots, trigonous, ca 2 mm wide and 4 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Wells, James R. 1965. A taxonomic study of Polymnia (Compositae). Brittonia. 17: 144-159.

description: Herba caule basi plusminusve prostrato-radicanti cetero erecto 30-40 cm. alto in specimine, striato sparse lanuginoso denique glabrato. Folia opposita crassiuscula in petiolum attenuata. Petiolus 2-3 cm. longus late alatus basi amplectens. Lamina ovato"rhomboidea apice triangularia acuteque basi cuneiforme angustata secundum petiolum decurrens margine grosse serrato-dentata leviter revoluta, 5-6 cm. longa et lata; supra puberula pilis brevibus crassis sparsis munita nervis principalibus visibilibus reliquis subobsoletis; subtus albida crasse denseque lanata, tribus nerviis principalibus magis elevatis discoloribus notatis secundariis circa 5 quoque latere ascendentibus etiam con- spicuis venulis pallidioribus laxe reticulatis. Inflorescentia terminalis pauciflora ramulis pedunculisque elongatis flexuosis hirsutulis. Capitula radiata. Involucrum hemisphaericum bracteis numerosis im- bricatis viridibus glabris 4-seriatis, interioribus linearibus 9-10 mm. longis 1-1.5 mm. latis apice acutis plus minusve lacerato-dentatis mediis gradatim brevioribus et magis oblongo-ovatis exterioribus ovatis acutis 5 mm. longis 3-4 mm. latis apice nigro-maculatis. Receptaculum 4 mm. diam. alveolatum margini- bus alveolorum membranaceis denticulatis. Corolla radii feminei circa 30, corolla lutea 20 mm. longa tubulo angusto hirsuto 5 mm. longo lamina lineari 4-nervis apice 3-dentata 2 mm. lata. Flores disci hermaphroditi plus 50, corolla lutea 8-8.5 mm. longa tubulo 3-5 mm. longo pubescenti-hirtulo limbo campanulato profunde inciso laciniis linearibus circa 3 mm. longis apice convolutis. Antherae 3.5 mm. longae basi rotundatae. Rami stigmatici elongati flexuosi papillosi. Ovarium pubescente. Pappus brunnescens.

description: Plants single-stemed, to 1 m. Leaves deep green above, pallid below. Bracts green, the lowermost black tipped. Ray and disc flowers yellow.

description: Annual or biennial herbs usually with a single stem originating at the base and sparingly branched above, 3-7 dm tall. Stems glabrous to very sparsely pubescent. Peduncles 4-13 cm long, 2-4 times as wide at the top as at the base, glabrous to moderately pubescent. Leaves linear-lanceolate, entire to coarsely few-toothed, 5-15 times as long as wide, apices acute to narrowly acuminate, glabrous to very sparsely pubescent, midrib prominent and lateral veins easily visible in most leaves, scarcely decurrent at all along the stem. Heads few to several, globoid to ovoid, 11-16 mm high, 14-20 mm wide (excluding rays). Receptacle ovoid, 5-6 mm high, 4-6 mm wide. Involucral bracts not noticeably united at the base, reflexed at anthesis, sparsely to densely pubescent. Ray florets 12 or more; ligules ca. 10-20 mm long, yellow, glabrous to sparsely pubescent. Disc corollas 5-lobed, cylindrical to cylindric-cam- panulate, 3.2-3.6 mm long, 0.9-1.2 mm wide, yellow or yellow in the lower part and purple in the upper part with dark, blue-purple lobes. Achenes 2.0-2.9 mm long, 0.8-1.0 mm wide, pubescent. Pappus scales 6-7, 1.5-2.0 mm long including the terminal awn which is ca. 2-3 times the length of the body, 0.2-0.4 mm wide.

description: Fruticosa ramosa, ca 0.8-2.5 m alta; caules teretes lanati vel glabrati, internodiis 6 cm usque longis; folia alterna pseudoverticillata petiolata; foliorum lamina coriacea obovata vel oblanceolata 3.5-7 x 1.5-4 cm cuneata, plerumque obtusata, integra vel revoluta, pinnativenia, villosulosa vel glabrata; petioli ca 3-8 mm longi; capitula solitaria sessilia epaleacea homogama, flosculis ca 20; involucrum hemisphaericum vel cylindricum ca 3 x 1.4 cm, 4-6-seriatum; phyllaria acuminata vel attenuata; corolla cremea actinomorpha 18-23 mm longa, tubo 4.2-5.8 mm longo, apice intus hirsuto, lobis erectis rigidis glabris, anguste linearibus 13-17 mm longis; antherae 7.3-7.8 mm longae sagittatae; styli brevibifidi; achaenia anguste prismatico-columnaria ca 4-6 mm longa; pappi setae numerosae ca 10-15 mm longae.
bibliographicCitation: Pruski, John F. 1989. Notes on the Compositae of the Guayana Highland-I. A new species of Stomatochaeta and the reduction of Guaicaia to Glossarion (Compositae: Mutisieae). Brittonia. 41: 35-40.

description: Shrubs, much branched, 0.8-2.5 m tall; stems terete, lanate and leafy distally, glabrate and leafless proximally, internodes to ca 6 cm long and thus shorter than the leaves. Leaves simple, alternate, pseudoverticillate, petiolate; blade rigid-coriaceous, obovate to oblanceolate, 3.5-7 x 1.5-4 cm, basally cuneate, apically broadly obtuse, rounded or retuse, often mucronate, margins entire, thickened, somewhat revolute, venation pinnate, lateral veins somewhat obscure, upper surface dark green, puberulent when young, especially so along midrib, glabrate with age, lower surface light green, commonly villosulous when young, often glabrate with age; petiole ca 3-8 mm long, not clasping. Capitula solitary, terminal, sessile, homogamous, ca 20-flowered; involucre hemispheric to cylindric, ca 3 x 1.4 cm, 4-6-seriate; phyllaries ca 25-30, imbricate, graduated, erect and only slightly spreading, stiffly coriaceous, pustulate, outer phyllaries carinulate, elliptic-lanceolate, to ca 6.5-10 mm long, apex acuminate, glabrous to floccose, basally glabrous, margins entire, ciliate, inner phyllaries narrowly lanceolate, to ca 30 mm long, puberulent, apex attenuate, obscurely nerved proximally; receptacle flat on top, naked. Corollas actinomorphic, tubular, strongly 5-cleft, 18-23 mm long, cream-colored, pubescent within at the sinus of the lobes, otherwise completely glabrous; tube 4.2-5.8 mm long, obscurely nerved, upper portion hirsute within; lobes stiffly erect, glabrous, 13-17 mm long, narrowly linear, 2-nerved, nerves marginal, adaxial; anthers exserted, linear, cream-colored, 7.3-7.8 mm long, api- cally acuminate, basally sagittate, tails clavate, hispidulous, those of adjacent anthers appressed but not fused; filaments flexuous, glabrous, inserted within the corolla tube, brown except cream-colored at point of attachment to anthers; styles obscurely bifid, brown, glabrous but asperulous towards apex, ca 32-35 mm long, branches triangular, erect, frequently appressed, ca 0.5 mm long. Achenes (immature) narrowly prismatic-cylindric, obscurely 10 costate, ca 4-6 mm long, dark brown, glabrous; pappus setae numerous, cream-colored, ca 10-15 mm long, in ca 4-6 unequal series. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Herba scandens, partibus junioribus plus minusve subferrugineo-pubescentibus, eaulibus teretibus, glabris, longitudinaliter striatis, circiter 3 mm. diametro, internodiis 4-7 cm. longis; foliis perspicue subhastato-cordatis, obloilgo-lanceolatis, chartaceis vel subeoriaceis, 8-12 cm. longis, 2.5-4 cm. latis, sursum angustatis, perspicue acuminatis, lobis basalibus rotundatis, 1.5-2 cm. longis latisque, margine distanter (3-6 mm.) apiculato-dentatis vel apiculato-serratis, dentibus angustis, inerassatis, vix 0.5 mmn. longis, supra olivaceo-viridibus praesertim ad costam nervosque plus minusve breviter pubeseentibus, subtus pallidioribus ad costam nervosque breviter pubescentibus, nervis basalibus 5-7, supra basin utrinque 3-4, omnibus distinctis, gracilibus, arcuato-anastomosantibus, retieulis distinctis; petiolo 2-3.5 cm. longo, glabro, vel juniore parce pubeseente; eymis axillaribus terminalibus-que, 4-6 cm. longis, subferrugineo-pubeseentibus, plerumque paucifloris; capitulis 5-12, eirciter 11-floris, 12 mm. longis, 6 mm. diametro; involueri bracteis extus plus minusve brunneo, pubeseentibus, exterioribus ovatis vel oblongo-ovatis, 2-3 mm. longis, intermediis gradatim longioribus, interioribus eirciter 8, oblongis vel oblongo-lanceolatis, acutis vel subobtusis, 1 cm. longis, 3-4 mm. latis; floribus purpureis eirciter 11, omnibus ligulatis, tubo gracili, 5 mm. longi extus sursum leviter ciliato, ligulis oblongis, glabris, eirciter 6.5 mm. longis, 3-3.5 mm. latis, lobis 5, parvis, oblongis, obtusis vel acutis, 0.5 mm. longis; antheris 4 mm. longis, acutis vel acuminatis; acheniis linearibus, haud rostratis, glabris, eirciter 4 mm. longis (immaturis), setis copiosis, albidis, 6-7 mm. longis, scaberulis.

description: Frutices ca 2 m usque alti. Folia alterna; petioli (0.5) 1-2 cm longi, tomentosi; laminae ellipticae, (2) 3-6 cm longae, (1.2) 2.5-3.5 cm latae, coriaceae, basi obtusae vel sagittatae, apice obtusae vel rotundatae, inferne dense tomentosae, superne tomentoso-araneosae, olivaceae, glabrescentes, nitidae, reticulato-venosae, margine integrae. Capitulescentiae cymoso-paniculatae. Capitula discoidea homo- gama, ca 12 mm alta, ca 5 mm lata; phyllaria 5, subbiseriata, omnino albo-tomentosa, extima lanceolata vel oblanceolata, 7-8 mm longa, ca 2 mm lata, intima elliptica vel anguste ovata, 7-8 mm longa, 2- 3 mm lata. Flores 5, hermaphroditi; corollae tubulosae luteae, ca 10 mm longae; limbus ca 6 mm longus, quinquelobus; lobi ca 5.5 mm longi, 0.5 mm lati. Achaenia (immatura) oblonga, ca 3.5 mm longa, glabra, costata; pappi setae 8-9 mm longae, biseriatae.

description: Shrubs to 2 m; stems cylindrical, striate, puberulent. Leaves alternate; petiole (0.5) 1-2 cm long, tomentose; blade elliptic, (2) 3-6 cm long, (1.2) 2.5-3.5 cm wide, coriaceous, discolorous, the base obtuse to sagittate, the apex obtuse to rounded, the lower surface tomentose, the upper surface sparsely arachnoid-to- mentose, glabrescent, nitid, reticulate-veined, olivaceous, the margins entire. Capitulescences cymose-paniculate, 10-20-headed. Capitula homogamous, dis- coid, ca 12 mm high, ca 5 mm wide; involucre cylindrical; phyllaries 5, weakly biseriate, subequal, coriaceous, the outer lanceolate to oblanceolate, 7-8 mm long, ca 2 mm wide, densely white-tomentose, the apex obtuse, ciliolate, thinly mar- ginate, the inner elliptic to narrowly ovate, 7-8 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, densely white-tomentose medially, the apex obtuse to rounded, the margins hyaline; florets 5, hermaphroditic, the corolla yellow, ca 10 mm long, glabrous, the tube ca 4 mm long, the limb ca 6 mm long, deeply 5-lobed, the lobes linear, ca 5.5 mm long, ca 0.5 mm wide, the apex acute, the anthers ca 4 mm long, the base sagittate, caudate, the terminal appendage lanceolate, acute, the style branches linear, the apex obtuse, dorsally pilosous. Achenes (immature) oblong, ca 3.5 mm long, glabrous, costate; pappus of 75-100, strigillose bristles, 8-9 mm long, biqeriate, straminous.
bibliographicCitation: Dillon, M. O. & Alva, A. S. 1988. Additions to South American Senecioneae (Asteraceae). Brittonia. 40: 221-228.

description: Herbae annuae, 2 5-3 5 cm altae. Caules decumbentes, interdum hispiduli, pilis 0.3 mm longis. Pedunculi 1-2.9 cm longi. Folia petiolata, petiolis 1-1.5 cm longis, laminis ovatis, 3.5-5 cm longis, 2-2.5 cm latis, apice acutis, basi attenuatis, ambabus paginis leviter strigosis, pilis 0.3-1.2 mm longis, marginibus serratis, ciliatis, pilis 0.3 mm longis. Capitula 3-5 mm alta, 3-4 mm diametro. Involucrum extimum cupulatum, 5-10 mm diametro; bracteae 5, ellipticae vel anguste ellipticae, basi leviter connatae, 2.5-6 mm longae, 1.2-1.5 mm latae, apice obtusae, extus hispidae, 2-5 pilis 0.3 mm longis in costa et principalibus lateralibus venis, marginibus opacis, ciliatis, pilis 0.3 mm longis. Bracteae intimae involucri omnes includentes achenia, lateribus tuberculatis; fructus 1.8-2 mm longi. Flosculi radii 6; ligulae pallide flavae, ellipticae, 1.5--2 mm longae, 1-1.2 mm latae, apice bidentatae. Flosculi disci circa 14; corollae pallide flavae, lobis apice acutis. Paleae pallide flavae apicem versus, ellipticae, 2.5 mm longae, apice acutato-obtusae, marginibus irregulariter et leniter dentatis; costa debili, glabra. Chromosomatum numerus ignotus.
bibliographicCitation: Stuessy, Tod F. 1970. Six new species of Melampodium (Compositae: Heliantheae) from Mexico and Central America. Brittonia. 22: 112-124.

description: Perennial herb with a stout branching caudex; stem 5-15 cm. high, slightly curved at the base, or suberect, finely stipitate-glandular; leaves stipitate-glan- dular, and commonly bearing some stout broad-based hairs on the margins, occa- sionally a few on the surface as well; basal leaves oblanceolate or spatulate to obovate, rounded at the apex, tapering or more commonly abruptly contracted to the short petiole, mostly 3-8 cm. long and 4-15 mm. wide, generally triple- nerved; cauline leaves several, not much reduced even under the heads, narrowly oblong to ovate, usually rounded at the apex; heads solitary or occasionally 2, the disk 8-15 mm. wide; involuere glandular, 5-7 mm. high; phyllaries close, imbricate, somewhat thickened on the back, green or greenish below, strongly purplish above the middle or at the tip; ligules about 30-60, white or blue, 6-11 mm. long, 1.3-2.0 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 3.0-5.2 mm. long, the clearly marked tube about 0.7-1.0 mm., the lobes about 0.5-0.6 mm., the limzlb usually flaring above; style-appendages ovate, obtuse or merely acutish, about 0.1-0.2 mm. long; pappus double, the inner of about 12-20 fragile bristles, the outer of inconspicuous setae; akenes 2-nerved, somewhat hairy. Dry rocky or sandy soil and cliffs; southwestern Utah and adjacent Nevada.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Arbuscula prostrata, lignosa, ramulis leviter hispidulis, internodis 3.5-8 cm. longis; petioli 0.7-1.5 cm. longi, ad faciem superiorem canaliculati, infra teretes, hispiduli; foliorum laminae 5-7.5 cm. longae, 3-5 cm. latae, chartaceae, ovatae, ad basim obtusae vel subcordatae sed in petiolo decurrentes, ad apicem acuminatae, margine anguste involuto, crasse serrato (utroque latere 7-9 dentibus) apice excepto; ad faciem superiorem costa venisque impressis, crasse salienti-reticulatis infra, venis primariis in paribus tribus prope basim, fortiter arcuatis, ascendentibus, faciebus ambobus scabro-hispidis, infra sparse glandulosis, supra nonnihil rugosis; capitula terminalia, in ramulis lateralibus 15-5 cm. longis sublata, pedunculis 0.3-1.5 cm. longis, gracilibus, subglabris; capitula 9-11-floralibus, homogama, cylindrica, 8 mm. longa, 4 mm. lata; involucri bracteis 4-5-seriatis, ad partem interiorem gradatim maioribus, lanceolatis, ad apices obtusis, scariosis, multinerviis, ad marginem ciliolatis sed alibi glabris, paleis lanceolatis vel ellipticis, membrano-scariosis, valde uninerviis, ad marginem laciniatis, ca. 6 mm. longis, 2 mm. latis; pappi squamae albae, 20-25, subulatae, laciniatae, ca. 4.5 mm. longae, ad basim coalitae; corolla flava, tubo 3 mm. longo, 0.5 mm. lato sed ad staminorum insertionem abrupte turgido, ad 1.2 mm. lato, minute bullato, leviter quinquangulato angulis exceptis membranaceo, glabro, corollae lobi 5, linearo-lanceolati, membranacei sed margine crasso, 1.5 mm. longi, 0.5 mm. lati, ad apicem acuti; antherae 1.7 mm. longae, basifixae, glabrae, basi acuto, apice appendiculato, filamenta glabra, ca. 1.5 mm. longa; stigma bifidum, ramulis ad apicem truncato-plumosis, alibi glabris, 1 mm. longis, stylus ca. 4 mm. longus, nectarium 0.5 mm. altum, carnosum, ovarium linearo-oblanceolatum, glabrum, bi- ad quadrangulatum, 1.7 mm. longum, 0.4 mm. diametro; achenia immatura guttata, in maturitate nigra, glabra, 2.5 mm. longa, 0.6 mm. lata, leviter quadricostata.

description: Plants annual, (40-)50-100 cm high, erect, often robust, with a large main axis (to 7 mm thick), densely short-hirsute to subtomentose, viscous, with spreading, glandular-capitate trichomes; leaves opposite below, alternate upwards, ovate to lanceolate, serrate-dentate, 3.8-9 cm long, 1-4 cm wide, acute at the apex, cuneate to subattenuate at the base, densely short-pilose, viscid, on both surfaces; petioles slender, 0.8-2.5 cm long; heads very broadly campanulate, 1.2-2.5 cm in diameter, solitary on stout peduncles; peduncles 0.8-1.5(-2.2) cm long, densely short hirsute, with dense, glandular-capitate trichomes, especially near the heads; receptacle broadly conical, 5-10 mm wide, 4-9 min high; chaff persistent, scarious, glabrous, oblong to subobovate with laciniate upper margins, 8.5-10(-12) mm long, tapering to an awn-like beak, 1/3 to 1/2 as long as the body; involucre 2(-3)-seriate, the outer bracts 6.5-8(-15) mm long, 1.5-4 mm wide, soinetimes greatly elongated, to 2.5 cm long, green, linear or lanceolate to slightly obovate, alternately narrower, acute at the apex, densely short-hirsute, often with dense short, glandular trichomes, the margins ciliate; inner bracts somewhat membranous, broadly lanceolate or oblong to obovate, 12-14 mm long, 3-5 mm wide, with scarious, usually purple, margins and apex, slightly to densely short-hirsute and with short, glandular trichomes especially near the rounded to obtuse apex; ray flowers 10, pistillate and fertile, tubular at the base for 6-7.5 mm, with conspicuous pinkish to reddish-purple ligules, these 11-14 mm long, 5-11 mm wide, broadly obovate or cuneate, three lobed at the apex; ray corollas with 2 linear inner lobelets, 1-1.5 mm long; pappus of the ray florets like that of the disc; disc corollas yellow, (6.5-)7-8(-8.5) mm long, the tube 1.5-1.8 mm long, short-pilose, the throat narrowly funnelform, 4-4.5(-5.5) mm long, short-pilose near the base, the lobes acute, 1-1.5 mm long, pilose near the reflexed apex; style branches recurved to revolute, slender, slightly flattened, 2.5(-3) mm long, finely pubescent beneath, slightly tapering to the apex, with a short, obscure subulate tip, stigmatic lines obscure, on the inner margins; achenes blackish, 3-3.5(-4) mm long, obscurely ridged, densely pilose, usually with hairs concentrated on the ridges and forming weakly defined rows; pappus of 20 slender, subequal, brownish, plumose bristles, 2.5-3(-4.5) mm long, usually shorter than the achene, the cilia short, delicate (ca 0.5 mm long); anthers 3.5-4(-4.5) mm long, sagittate at the base; chromosome number, n = 10, determined in the population indicated below with an asterisk.

description: Perennial herb with a taproot, and a crown or simple or slightly branched caudex; stems several or numerous, sparsely strigose or essentially glabrous, 3-10 cm. long, spreading, the tips assurgent; basal leaves numerous, rather narrowly oblanceolate, up to 6 cm. long and 5 mm. wide, the blade rounded or subtruneate at the apex, tapering gradually to the petiole, essentially glabrous cauline leaves several, reduced, linear, up to about 1 cm. long; head solitary, the disk 5-10 mm. wide; involuere 4-7 mm. high, finely and sometimes obscurely glandular, usually also sparsely short-hairy; phyllaries imbricate, thin, green, the inner and sometimes to a lesser extent the outer with conspicuous sharply defined purple margins above the middle, tlae slender midrib sometimes also purplish; ligules about 13-25, white or pink, 4-6 mm. long, 1.3-2.5 mm. wide; disk-corollas about 2.8-4.0 mm. long, the tube ill-defined, about 6.5-1.0 mm. long, the lobes about long; style-appendages a little narrower than deltoid, acute, about 0.2-0.3 mm. long; pappus simple, of about 25-35 fragile bristles.; akenes 2-nerved, short-hairy.

description: Suffruticose perennial herbs 2-5 dm high. Stems terete, densely velvety tomentose. Leaves 10-15 cm long, 1.5-2.3 cm wide; petiole 0.8-1.5 cm long, densely tomentose; blade narrowly elliptic, indistinctly trinervate 1-2 cm from the base, glabrous above, tomentulose below, especially along the venation, remotely but indistinctly denticulate to nearly entire. Capitulescence a congested, rounded, umbel-like corymbose-panicle of 30-50 heads, terminal but not much extending beyond the foliage. Heads radiate, turbo-campanulate; involucre biseriate, 5-6 mm long; bracts 13, glabrous, equal, the innermost somewhat keeled below, lanceolate-elliptic; calyculus of 4-8 subulate puberulent bracts, 1-2 mm long, which grade downward into 5-10 similar peduncular bracts. Receptacle planar, ca 1.5 mm across. Ray florets 8, pistillate and fertile; corolla yellow; tube ca 4.5 mm long, glabrous; ligule oval, 4-nervate, ca 4.5 mm long, ca 2 mm wide. Disk florets 9-10; corolla yellow, glabrous; tube ca 2.5 mm long; limb ca 4 mm long, the throat ca 2.5 mm long, the lobes 2-3 times as long as wide. Achenes (immature) columnar, glabrous, 6-8 striate; pappus of numerous, nearly eciliate, white setae, 5-6 mm long.

description: Cormo 1.5-2 cm. crasso; caule humili 3-4 dm. alto, subtus glabro,crasso, foliosissimo; foliis dense hirsutulis, inferioribus lanceolatis vel oblanceolatis, 1-2 cm. longis, 1.5-3 cm. latis; superioribus linearibus, reductis; inflorentia brevi, 5-15 cm. longa, elliptica; capitulis 7-20, pedunculatis; involucro campanulato, circa 15 mm. lato et alto; marginibus bractearum latis, seariosis, atro-purpureis et erosis; bracteis exterioribus rotundis, interioribus oblongis; acheniis 6 mm. longis, hirsutis; pappo purpureo-tincto.

description: Perennial suffruticose herb 10-20 cm high. Stems terete, densely hirsute throughout, arising from a persistent woody base, 3-4 mm in diam. Leaves opposite, 1.5-2.5 cm long, 1-1.8 cm wide, soft-hispid throughout, somewhat glandular-pustulate beneath; petiole 0.5-1.5 cm long; blade 3-nerved from the base, 3-lobed, the lobes irregularly dentate. Heads 1 or 2, hemispheric, terminal, borne on sparsely bracteate peduncles 4-6 cm long. Involucre 8-9 mm high, 10-15 mm wide; outer bracts ca 8, linear-oblanceolate, 4-5 mm long, evenly hispid; inner bracts 2-seriate, not united, narrowly ovate, yellow-scarious along the margin, the outer series pubescent, the inner series glabrous. Chaff lanceolate, sericeous below, ciliate above, ca 7 mm long, attached to and falling with the achenes. Ray florets 8, neuter; ligules yellow, ca 1.5 cm long, ca 6 mm wide, with 10-12 nerves; throat ca 2.5 mm long, pubescent. Disk florets numerous (50-70); corollas yellow, glabrous; tube ca 1.7 mm long; limb tubular, ca 3 mm long, the lobes 5, ca 0.5 mm long. Achene body narrowly obovate, ca 5 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide, ciliate with long sericeous hairs in 3 lines (on both sides and ventrally); pappus of 2, stout, persistent, ciliate awns ca 5 mm long.

description: Paniculately branched annual, 2-8 dm tall. Stems narrowly winged, sparsely pubescent below, moderately pubescent above with short, unbranched, antrorse hairs. Peduncles 2-8 cm long, 1.5-2.0 times as wide at the top as at the base. Leaves glabrous to sparsely pubescent with antrorse hairs, apices acute to narrowly acuminate, midrib prominent but lateral veins obscure; lower leaves variable with most being coarsely or irregularly laciniate; middle and upper leaves linear to linear-lanceolate, 10-20  times as long as wide, entire, broadened at the base before narrowing into a wing along the stem. Heads few to many, globose to slightly ovoid, 6-11(-13) mm in diameter (excluding rays). Receptacle ovoid, 3-4 mm high, 2.0-2.8 mm wide. Involucral bracts not noticeably united at the base, reflexed at anthesis, moderately pubescent. Ray florets 8-9; ligules quite variable, 6.0-12.0 mm long, 3.0-8.0 mm wide, either completely yellow, yellow at the apex and red at the base, or completely red, moderately pubescent on the undersurface. Disc corollas 5-lobed, cylindrical to cylindric-campanulate, 2.5-3.2 mm long, 0.5-1.2 mm wide, yellow-green with yellow or brown to purple lobes. Achenes 1.0-1.2 mm long, 0.5-0.8 mm wide, pubescent with numerous long, soft, straight hairs. Pappus scales 6 (rarely 7), 2.0-2.5 mm long, including the terminal awn which is more than twice the length of the body, 0.5-0.7 mm wide. Chromosome number, n = 14

description: Rhizomes branching, coarse, 10-14 mm. thick because of indument of previous branches; innovations unknown; stems simple or 3-several-branched above the middle, prominently angled and ribbed, glabrous at base, becoming viscid with granular puberulence and stipitate glands, these intermixed upwards with weak septate hairs; scales of the first 6-8 stem nodes 0.5-2.0 cm. long, connate-sheathing, ovate to oblong-lanceolate, dark brown, glabrous, replaced upwards by 6-10 pairs of cauline leaves 1.5-3.2 cm. broad, 4-6 cm. long, broadly sessile, ovate-elliptical to lanceolate, coarsely and irregularly cuspidate-dentate, rigid, strongly 3-5-ribbed from the base, prominently reticulate-veiny beneath, pubescent with intermixed stipitate glands and pilose hairs, especially on the veins on the lower surface, becoming glabrate above; upper leaves reduced, lanceolate, becoming entire, alternate by disjunction of the nodes; peduncles 2-9 cm. long, densely pilose and longstipitate-glandular towards the summit; heads solitary on each branch, turbinate-campanulate, 18-22 mm. high; ray flowers none; disc flowers 20-50, 8.5-13 mm. long, the limb tubular, abruptly enlarged at its junction with the tube, the base of the limb and the tube densely pilose, the limb sparingly pubescent to summit, the corolla lobes triangularly ovate acute, ca. 1.5 mm. long, hispidulous; achenes 6.5-7.5 (8.0) mm. long, cylindrical, somewhat angled, uniformly caneseent and hispid with upwardlv directed double hairs, which are about 1/2 as long as the diam. of the achene; annulus ca. 0.3 mm. long, pappus white, barbellate to subplumose, the setae 0.15-0.25(0.35) mm. long.

description: Plantae fruticosae ca 1.5 m altae, confertim ramosae; caules puberuli, intemodiis ca 0.7-2 cm longis; folia opposita et decussata, petiolo 2-5 mm longo, lamina elliptica vel cordiformi, chartacea, subtriplinervi, 2.5-5.5 x 1.2-2 cm, puberula vel glabra; capitulescentia terminalis, umbelliformis, capitulis solitariis, heterogamis, terminalibus interdum pseudo-axillaribus; pedunculi 1-5 cm longi; involucrum hemisphericum, 3-5-seriatum; flosculi radiati 10-15, corollis 13-18 mm longis, glanduliferis, tubo viridulo, 3-3.5 mm longo, limbo 7-10-nervio, luteolo, 10-1 4.5 mm longo; flosculi disci ca 45-50, corollis 6.7-7.5 mm longis, glanduliferis, praeter tubum viridulum luteis, lobis 1.5-2.1 mm longis; paleae elliptico-lanceolatae, 5.5-6.5 mm longae, trifidae; pappi squamae ca 9-15, ovatae, 0.8-1.2 mm longae; achaenia fuscescentia, 3-4 mm longa, glabra.

description: Densely branched shrubs to 1.5 m tall; stems ascending, branching at angles of 20-35º, subterete, puberulent, striate, internodes mostly 0.7-2 cm long; leaves opposite and decussate, the petiole 2-5 mm long, puberulent, the blade elliptic, chartaceous, smooth or rugose, palmately 3- or 5-nerved, or with the lateral 2 or 4 veins essentially obscure, 2.5-5.5 x 1.2-2.0 cm, at apex obtuse, at base cordate, the margins entire, or serrulate with 3-5 pairs of teeth, upper surface greenishbrown, smooth, glabrous, lower surface paler in color, puberulent to glabrous with scattered glands, moniliform hairs, and a few erect multicellular trichomes; inflorescence terminal, umbelliform with solitary heads terminating each of the ca 3 closely packed branches; peduncles 1-5 cm long, glabrous to puberulent; involucre hemispherical, 11-14 x 12-18 mm, 3-5-seriate, the phyllaries ca 19, imbricate, graduate, the outer ones ovate, acute, 9-13 x 5-7 mm, herbaceous, 3 (5)-nerved, puberulent or glabrous, the inner ones ovate to elliptic, 6-15 mm long, scarious, ca 10-striate, glabrous to abaxially puberulent, at apex obtuse to rounded and becoming membranous; capitula radiate, ca 70-flowered; ray flowers ca 10-15, the corolla 13-18 mm long, the tube green, 3-3.5 mm long, glandular, the ligule yellow (7) 8-10-nerved, 10-14.5 x 3-4.5 mm, often apically 2-toothed, abaxially glandular; disk flowers ca 45-50, the corolla 6.7-7.5 mm long, glandular, the tube green, 2.4-3 mm long, the broad and campanulate throat and the spreading lobes yellow, the lobes 1.5-2.1 mm long, the anthers mostly exserted, yellow, ca 3 mm long, rounded at base, the apical appendage deltoid, abaxially glandular, the style 7-7.7 mm long with truncate branches ca 1.2 mm long; receptacle domeshaped, ca 6 x 5 mm; paleae elliptic-lanceolate, 5.5-6.5 x ca 1.2 mm, conduplicate, often trifid, apically attenuate, branches generally at the middle, pale yellow; pappus of ray and disk florets similar, of ca 9-15 subequal, free, ovate to oblong, apically obtuse, marginally serrulate, stramineous scales, 0.8-1.2 mm long; achenes of ray and disk florets similar, obconic, prismatic, 3-4 mm long, glabrous, carpopodium somewhat sculptured; pollen heliantheous, ca 38-43 µm in diam. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Rhizomate erecto, valido, paleis castaneis, ovatis, acutis, integris, crassis apice tecto. Stipite 20 cm. longo, stricto, tereti, brunneostramineo, niudo, ad basin asperulo (ex paleis delapsis?), subnitido, ut toto folio glaberrimo. Lamina ovata, 40 cm. longa, 30 cm. lata, firmiter herbacea, laete viridi, quinquepinnata, divisione ubique anadromica, divisionibus omnibus e basi inaequalis deltoideis. Pinnis ad 10-jugis, alternis, 8-4 cm. inter se remotis, petiolatis (petiolo 1 cm. longo), ad 15 cm. longis, 10 cm. latis, apice longe acuminato, acute dentato; pinnulis II. ord. 2-1.5 cm. distantibus, petiolatis, ad 6 cm. loingis, 2 cm. vel ultra latis, acuminatis, costulis sursum anguste alatis; pininulis III. ord. 2 x 0.5 cm., petiolo breve alato, ad alam angustam dissectis, ultimis 3-5-jugis, posterioribus plerumque indivisis, vel apice bifidis anterioribus profunde furcatis vel subpinnatis; lobis ultimis 0.6-0.8 mm. latis, uninervatis, sterilibus acutis, linearibus vel cuneato-subellipticis, fertilibus apice dilatato spathulatis. Uno soro pro lobo, in vena terminali, indusio cuneato, pro genere typico, margine libero marginem truncatum vel rotundatum apicis lobi primum attingente, integro vel medio parum producto.

description: Plantae vere rupicolae sive rare terrestres. Rhizomata erecta sive decumbentia. Frondes caespitosae, momomorphae; laminae 1-pinnato-pinnatisectae, membranaceae, 32-40 x 8-15 cm; pinnae medianae 3.5-7 x 1.3 ×-1.9 cm, brevi-acuminatae; rhachides et costae vestitae rubro-articulatis et paleis ovato-acuminatis, 2 × 0.5 mm; segmenta 5-8 paribus nervorum indivisorum; intervenium vestitae pilis brevibus et filiformibus. Sori submarginales. Affinis Ctenitis abyssi (Sehnem) Salino & Morais, sed rhizoma erectum vel decumbenti, intervenio vestita pilis brevibus filiformibus differt.

description: Plants epipetric, rarely terrestrial. Rhizomes erect or decumbent; rhizome scales light-brown, concolorous, sub-clathrate, linear-acuminate to oval-acuminate, margins ciliate, 2-6 mm long. Fronds monomorphic, clumped; fertile blades 38-80 x 8-15 cm; stipes brownish, to 38 x 0.1-0.2 cm, short-pubescent with catenate and unicellular hairs with rounded apices, scales linearlanceolate to ovate-acuminate, subclathrate (cell walls reddish, lumina translucent), slightly ciliate, to 2 x 0.5 mm, sparse; blades 1-pinnate-pinnatisect, lanceolate, membranaceous, light green, 32-40 x 8-15 cm, lamina apex pinnatisect; rachises adaxially sulcate, abaxially with scales similar to those of stipes, catenate hairs present on both sides; pinnae lanceolate, each with apex slightly acuminate, 18-20 pairs, stalked to 1 mm, 3.5-7 x 1.3-1.9cm, basal pair reflexed, a little shorter than the ones above; costae with scales, unicellular filiform hairs and sparse catenate hairs abaxially, adaxially with catenate hairs; segments oblong, often obtuse margins crenate with unicellular filiform hairs; laminae between veins with unicellular filiform hairs on both sides, hairs conspicuous adaxially; costules with catenate hairs adaxially and with sparse unicellular filiform hairs and catenate hairs abaxially; veins unforked, usually reaching the margin, 5 to 8 pairs per segment, lowermost pairs from adjacent segments ending at the margins well above the sinuses, with catenate and unicellular filiform hairs adaxially and with sparse unicellular filiform hairs abaxially; sori submarginal, indusia ciliate, fugacious; spores not seen.

description: Rhizome unknown. Stipe to the lowest auricles 40 cm. long, 1 cm. thick, its base blackish and with few brown, lanceolate scales, upward brown and minutely puberulent. Lamina 180 cm. or more long, 30 cm. broad, herbaceous, narrowed upward into a pinnatifid apex, below rather suddenly contracted with 15-20 pairs of hastate-triangular reduced pinnae, the lowermost ones 1 by 1.5 cm., the uppermost 4 by 2.5 cm.; fully developed pinnae 15 by 3 cm., equally truncate at base without aerophores, the tips acuminate, entire, the margins coarsely serrulate with triangular or oblong lobes 3 mm. long and broad; veins in about 10 pairs, the lower 3 pairs truly united, the following 3 or 4 running to a cartilaginous fold below the sinus. Rachis finely puberulent, the upper surface densely strigose with gray appressed hairs, the underside finely downy, the costa and veins downy as the rachis. Sori medial with a small setose indusium; sporangia glabrous.

description: Thelypteris rhizomate erecto, prolongato, gracili, paleis ovatis, subobtusis, brunneis, integris vestito. Foliis caespitosis, paucis, stipite ad auriculas infimas 15 cm. longo, 1 mm. crasso, stramineo, glabro, sursum tuberculis parvis, i.e., pinnulis abortivis praedito. Lamina oblanceolata, ad 35 cm. longa, supra medium 4-5 cm. lata, caudato-acuminata, versus basin longissime gradatim decreseente, subcoriacea, praeter rachin costasque superne breviter griseo-pubeseente glabra, bipinnatifida. Pinnis infimis paucijugis abortivis, tuberculiformibus, sequentibus auriculiformibus, lobatis, sensim majoribus, supramedialibus maximis, 2-2.5 cm. longis, basi 6-7 mm. latis, alternis, sessilibus, ca 1 cm. inter se remotis, recte patentibus, e basi truncata ad apicem acutum subgradatini attenuatis, fere ad costam pinniatifidis; laciniis faleatis, marginibus integris revolutis triangularibus, acutis, basi ca. 1 mm. latis, basali acroseopica paulo longiore et ineurvata; venis indivisis, 3-4-jugis. Soris suprainedialibus, sat magnis, exinclusiatis, sporangiis glabris.

description: Thelypteris (Lastrea) rhizomate parvo, obliquo, paleis brunneis, opacis, ovatis sparse vestito. description: The type and only collection mentioned by Presl is Cuming 72. As represented in my herbarium, this has the costae and main veins setose beneath with smaller and more sparse hairs or bristles on the veinlets. Presl says, "costis rhachibusque utrinque pubeseentibus," the upper side being so in all species of the group. Mettenius (Aspid, no. 214), Hooker (Sp. Fil. 4: 112) and their successors have reduced this to D. immersa (Bl.) OK. The two are certainly very similar,- "ad costain supra margine rachique subpuberulis in veinis subtus resinoso-punctatis, " quoting Blume. But, as represented here by various collections from Java, D. imnersa, is never setose beneath. Of Philippine collections, we have two from Mount Apo, Elmner 10805, and an unnumbered sheet of my own, bearing very few bristles, which might be D. inmmersa. Merrill, Philippine Plants 1591, col- lected by Ramos in Camarines, is also almost smooth.

description: Leaves up to 2.5 m long; scales of the petiole bases 1.5-2.0x0.05 cm, linear-lance- olate, copiously denticulate, light brown; laminae up to 2 m long, S-pinnate-pinnatisect at base, 2-pinnate-pinnisect medially; basal pinnae ca. 0.5 m long, inequilateral; pinnules short-stalked, 3-12 cm long; pinna rachises abaxially non-glandular, non-pubescent, scaly, the scales 1.5-3 mm long, linear, brown, denticulate, non-bullate, rachises adaxially non-glandular, densely pubescent, the hairs 1.0-1.2 mm long 4-6-celled, scales sparse, like those on the abaxial surface; costules on the abaxial surface eglandular, sparsely pubescent and scaly, the hairs 0.3- 0.5 mm long, 2- or 3-celled, acicular, erect to spreading, the scales like those on the pinna rachises abaxially but smaller, 1.5-2.5x0.1- 0.3 mm, linear to linear-lanceolate, parallel sided, scarcely enlarged basally, the adaxial surface densely pubescent, the hairs 0.5-1 .0 mm long, 4- or 5-celled, substrigose; laminar tissue between veins glabrous on both surfaces, rarely with a few scattered hairs abaxially, the hairs ca. 0.1 mm long; veins visible on both surfaces, abaxially non-glandular, sparsely pubescent, non-scaly, the hairs ca. 0.3-0.5 mm long, 2- or 3-celled, the scales ca. 0.3 mm long, uniseriate, appressed, reddish, adaxially non-glandular, sparsely pubescent, the hairs 0.5-1.0 mm long, 4- or 5-celled; laminar margins ciliate, non- glandular, the hairs 0.3-0.5 mm long, 3- or 4- celled, spreading to substrigose; indusia absent.

description: Plants small, epiphytic; rhizome with a heavily sclerenchymatous inner cortex; rhizome scales 2-3 mm long, linear-lanceolate, rounded, truncate, or subcordate basally, acuminate-subulate or rounded apically, eglandular; cells of rhizome scales generally rectangular or quadrate, 1-3 times as long as broad; fronds 2-10 (mostly 3-7) cm long, erect or arching; xylem of leaf trace in a single arc from origin; foliar trichomes absent or few and scattered, 2-5 celled, glandular; stipes terete or slightly alate at very base, 0.2-0.3 mm in diameter, soon merging with the lamina distally; blades rather coriaceous, linear, deeply crenate or with rounded or obliquely tri- angular lobes, incised to 2/3 the way to the midrib or less, without an obviously differentiated terminal portion of the frond; lobes of the well-developed fronds obliquely deltoid, rounded at apex, their axes forming distally acute angles with the midrib; veins in each lobe generally simple or once-forked, rarely subpinnate in aberrantly enlarged lobes; sori 1-1.5 mm in diameter, usually developed on the upper 1/4-34 of the frond, solitary or very rarely double on each lobe; glandular paraphyses present; sporangia with 10-12 thickened bow cells; spores 40-48 µm in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Bishop, L. Earl. 1974. Earl. Revision of the genus Adenophorus (Grammitidaceae). Brittonia. 26: 217-240.

description: Rhizomes erect, radial, densely scaly; the scales 0.4-0.5 cm long, golden brown, linear-deltate, the margin glabrous or with a few white, glandular cells. Fronds 3.5-8 X 0.6-1.8 cm, closely spaced, erect to slightly curved; stipes 0.3-1 X 0.05 cm, dark brown, densely hirsute, having castaneous setae 0.1-0.2 cm long, and white glandular hairs, with three enlarged global apical cells; laminae pinnatisect, elliptic, subcoriaceous, abruptly tapered to the base and apex; rachises non-visible on either side of the lamina; segments 0.5-0.8 X 0.1-0.2 cm, deltate to linear-deltate, patent or slightly oblique to the rachises, asymmetrical at the base, decurrent basiscopically and cuneate acroscopically, the margins flat or slightly revolute; indument of glandular hairs on both sides of the rachises, veins and laminar tissue; sinuses narrower than the width of the segments; veins furcate, ending at the lamina margin. Sori round, arising at the vein apex, often protruding beyond the lamina margins when mature, with glandular paraphyses, these with enlarged global apical cell, similar to the laminar hairs.
bibliographicCitation: Labiak Evangelista, Paulo H. 2000. New species and new combinations in neotropical Grammitidaceae (Pteridophyta). Brittonia. 52: 246-255.

description: Rhizoiiiate brevirepente, 2 mni. crasso, paleis pallidis ovatis in- tegris 1-1.5 mm. longis obtecto; stipitibus approximatis 10-15 mm. lonigis, ca. 0.6 mm. crassis, setis obseuris 0.1-0.2 mm. longis densissinie obsitis; fronde 4-7 cm. longa, 2.5-3.5 nmmii. lata, subacuta, deorsum longe attenuata, integra, coriacea, pilis sparsis 0.5 mm. longis obseuris plerisque deciduis ornata; venis fureatis ranio superiore breve, im- mersis; soris subeostalibus vel medialibus, deilLum orbicularibus, re- ceptaculo elongato obliquo; sporangiis setis brevibus ornatis.
bibliographicCitation: Copeland, Edwin B. 1931. Philippine ferns collected by R. S. Williams. Brittonia. 1: 67-70. pl. 1-3.

description: Rhizomate repente, valido, breve, paleis fulvis anguste ovatis acntis integris 2 mm. longis vestito; stipite 15-25 mm. alto, 0.5 mm. crasso, pilis brevissimis et aliis usque ad 1 mmn. longis dense obsito; froncde lineare, usque ad 10 cm. longa et 8 mim. lata, sursum angustata obtusa, basi cuneata, integra, coriacea, setis sparsis atropurpureis 1 mm. longis vestita superne demum glabreseente; venis omnino immnersis sterilibus saepe pinnatis, fertilibus cunli ramo fertile breve, sterile furcato, rainulis intra marginem sub hydathodis desinientibus; soris subeostalibus, receptaculis leviter iillnersis, oblongis, 1 mm. longis; sporangiis plerisque nuldis, nonnuLillis setis longis praeditis.

description: Hybrida inculta e Micropolypodio setoso et Terpsichore achilleifolia genita, plantae in saxis vigentes; rhizoma erectum paleis flavescentibus, glabris vestitum; frondes fasciculatae; laminae pinnatisectae vel pinnatisecti-pinnatifidae; segmentis linearibus vel deltato-linearibus, nervis indivisis vel pinnatipartitis; intervenia et marginis setis brevibus, filiformibus vestitae; sori superficiales; sporae abortae.
bibliographicCitation: Labiak Evangelista, Paulo H. & Matos, Fernando B. 2007. A new hybrid and two new combinations in neotropical grammitid ferns. Brittonia. 59 (2): 182-185.

description: Plants rupestrial; rhizomes erect, radially symmetrical, scales deltate, golden to orangish, glabrous, nonclathrate, entire, 0.70-2.05 x 0.15-0.40 mm; fronds clustered, shortly stipitate, monomorphic or nearly so; stipes 0.16-0.45 mm diam., faintly winged, with castaneous setae; laminae deeply pinnatisect, linear to linear-lanceolate, 2.4-9.5 cm long, less than 0.8(-1.2) cm wide, with castaneous setae to 0.9 mm long on the laminae and their margins; segments entire to slightly lobate, varying in shape and size, adnate and decurrent at the base, rounded at the tip, ascending 42º-68º from the costae; costae and veins not visable, covered by the laminar tissue; laminar tissue with dark-brown setae on both surfaces; veins entire to pinnate, 1-5(-6) pairs per segment, ending before the margins as clavate hydathodes, these visible adaxially; sori 1-5(-6) per segment, rounded or slightly oblong, superficial, often overlapping the leaf midrib and/or protruding beyond laminar margins when mature; spores aborted.
bibliographicCitation: Labiak Evangelista, Paulo H. & Matos, Fernando B. 2007. A new hybrid and two new combinations in neotropical grammitid ferns. Brittonia. 59 (2): 182-185.

description: A T. taxifolia lamina feltili abaxialiter setosa, linea-ri-obovata, pinnisque inferioribus reductis auriculatis diversa.

description: Rhizomes short-creeping, dorsiventral, scaly; the scales 0.3-0.4 cm long, castaneous, lustrous, lanceolate, deciduous, the margins glabrous or with only an apical cilium. Fronds 20-35 X 3-4 cm, with deter- minate growth, erect to slightly curved; stipes 5-8 X 0.1 cm, brown, hirsute, having castaneous setae 0.1-0.15 cm long; laminae pectinate, linear-obovate, papyraceous, gradually tapered to the base with 5 or more shorter segments, and abruptly reduced to the apex, often with a flabelliform apical segment; rachises sclerenchymatous or slightly covered by the laminar tissue on the upper third; segments 2 X 0.3 cm, linear, symmetrical at the base, the apex obtuse; indument of simple castaneous setae, ca. 0.1 cm long, on the rachises on both sides and on the costae and laminar tissue only abaxially in the fertile segment; sinuses inconspicuous, narrower than width of the segments; veins free, 1-furcate, ending in the middle of the segment, visible and less so on the adaxial side; hydathodes conspic- uous, lime dots present on the adaxial surface of the laminae. Sori roundish, arising at the tip of the veins; sporangia glabrous.
bibliographicCitation: Labiak Evangelista, Paulo H. 2000. New species and new combinations in neotropical Grammitidaceae (Pteridophyta). Brittonia. 52: 246-255.

description: Leptocionitunm rhizoimate filiformi, lonige repente, tereti, sparsissime piloso. Frondibus pendulis, flaccidis, in sieco brunneis, plus minusve plicato-crispis. Stipite filiformi tereti, exalato, glabro, 3-4 cm. longo. Lamina aut lineari, ad 20 cm. longa, 2 cm. lata, aut lanceolata ad 3-4 cm. lata et sursum rachi ramosa subflabellata, versus basin plerumque valde angustata, bipinnata-pinnatifida; radhi nigrescente, tereti, lobis membranaceis, triangulari-acuminatis-inferioribus separatis superioribus in alas confluentibus-inter pinnas instructa, cum costis venisque setis atropurpureis, cylindricis, plerisque curvatis, subulatis sparse praedita. Pinnis obliquis, sessilibus, 1-0.5 cm. inter se remotis, ad 30-jugis, triangularibus vel oblongis, obtusis, basi postice cuneatis antice truneatis, plerisque 1-1.5 cm. longis, 4 mm. latis, inferioribus plerumque valde reductis, superioribus sensim brevioribus vel iii foliis nonnullis valde prolongatis, habitu et divisione laminae minoris, sub- flabellatimn ordinatis, costis ut rachi superiore alato-dentatis; pinnulis antice 2-3 postice 3-4 (in pinnis prolongatis multijugis), obliquis, plerisque profunde fureatis, basali acroseopica majori, flabellatim dissecta; segmentis vix 0.5 mm. latis, marginibus lobis membranaceis longe acuminatis iis rachidis similibus dense dentato-ciliatis, interdumn planis vel crebriter crispato-plicatis, costulis venisque setis atropurpureis supra descriptis utrinque conspersis. Soris axillaribus, iindusio campanulato, indistincte bivalvato, dorso et margille exteriore lobis membranaceis dense instructo, receptaculo longe (1 cm.) exserto, nigro.
bibliographicCitation: Christensen, Carl F. A. 1937. Botanical Results of the Archbold Expedition No. 8: New and Noteworthy Papuan Ferns. Brittonia. 2 (4): 265-317.

description: Leptocionitum rhizomate filiformi, late inter muscos repente, sparsissime piloso. Stipite filiformi, tereti, exalato, 1-3 cm. longo, sparse rufo-piloso. Lamina lanceolata vel oblanceolata, ad 15 cm. longa, 1.5-2 cm. lata (plerisque minoribus, 4-8 x 1 cm.) pendente, brunnea, ad rachin, costulas venasque pilis rufis subrigidis sat dense hirta, bi-tri- pinnatifida, rachi exalata, nigreseente. Pinnis obliquis, sessilibus, 7-5 mm. inter se remotis (in speciminibus nonnullis imbricatis, condupli- catis), dimidiato-trapezoideis, obtusis, basi postice cuneatis antice truneatis, profunde pinnatifidis, majoribus 1, raro 1.5 cm. longis, 5-6 mm. latis, inferioribus speciminis typicalis sensim brevioribus, ceterum vix reductis; pinnulis obliquis 3-4-jugis, plerisque profunde fureatis, lobis vix 1 mm. latis, apice truneato et marginibus dentatis, dentibus triangulari-acuminatis, vena apicem non attingente. Soris axillaribus, magnis, iindusio oblongo-campanulato, ad medium vel ultra bivalvatis, apice truneatis, dorso pilosis, margine valvarum lacerato-dentato; receptaculo primum incluso, denique 0.5 mm. exserto, nigro.

description: Euhymenophyllum rhizomate filiforme ferrugineo-piloso; stipi- tibus 1-2 cm. longis, filiformibus, teretis, atrocastaneis, rhachibusque pilis ferrugineis plus minus deciduis sparsis; rhachi sursum anguste alata; fronde ca. 5 cm. longfa, 3 cm. lata, olivaceo-viride; pinnis non imbricatis, infimis redcLitis, sequentibus ad costas anguste alatas pin- natifidis; segmentis paucis et remotis, 1 mm. latis, infimis acroseopicis fureatis, aliis plerumque simplicibus; soris in apices segmentorum in- feriorum immersis, involueris 2-3 mm. longis, minusquam 1 mm. latis, ad mediumn fissis, labiis lanceolato-ovatis, integris, plerisque acutis, receptaculo inieluso.

description: "Caudice epigaeo, 30 cm. alto, 10-12 cm. diametro, frondibus 6-8, ad caudicem articulatis, semi-erectis, 2-2.2 m. longis" (ex schedula). Stipulis in sieco coriaceis, nigris, extus paleis brunineis centro nigris, peltatis, orbicularibus vel ovatis, arete adpressis vestitis. Stipite ea. 1 cm. crasso, ad pinnas infimas reductas 8-10 cm. longo, angulato, bisulcato, atro-brunneo, opaco, basi paleis ovato-lanceolatis, acuiniinatis, castaneis, duris, minute dentatis densius vestito sursum parcius et decidue paleaceo. Lamina usque ad 2 m. longa, 50 cm. lata, basi valde reducta, chartacea, in vivo nitida, obseure viridi, glaberrima, bipin- nata; rachibus I.-II. ord. paleis linearibus brunneis sparse (ad bases pinnarum densius)vestitis. Pinnis ad 80-jugis, alternis, 3 cm. inter seremotis, arete sessilibus, subhorizontalibus, linearibus, ad 50 cm. longis et 2 cm. latis, acuminatis, versus basin vix angustatis, inferioribus valde reductis, infimis 3-4 cm. longis; costis ubique interrupte anguste alatis. Pinnulis subpatentibus, usque ad 50-jugis, alternis, 5 mm. inter sereimotis, sessilibus, ad costam articulatis, elliptico-oblongis, 1 cm. longis, 3 mm. latis, basi subaequaliter cuneatis, grosse serratis, dentibus utrinque 4-6, subacutis. Venis 6-7-jugis, simplicibus, curvatim ob- liquis. Synangiis 4-6 pro pinnula, e costula fere ad marginemn extensis, 1-1.4 mm. longis, ovalibus, juvenilibus tomento rufo dense eircumdatis, iaturis nudis, laete brunneis, loculis 9-11 utroque latere. (Fig. 1. a, b.)

description: Rhizome apparently short-creeping, clothed with broad, ovateacuminate, entire, dull and blackish brown, thin and pellucid scales, consisting of narrow, elongate cells with all walls equally thin. Leaves approximate or subtuf ted, not dimorphous, up to 50 cm. long, sublinear, 1.5 cm. wide at the middle and from there narrowed toward both ends, long acuminate and long decurrent nearly to the stipe-base, papyraceous, yellowish brown when dried, glabrous and scaleless, the unwinged stipe nearly none, with the lower portion of the costa rather flat above, round beneath, 4 mm. thick, the veins barely visible, reticulated as in Loxogramme. Sori linear coenosori about 1 mm. from and on each side of the midrib, confined to the upper third of the leaf but ending rather far from its tip. Sporangia mixed with numerous filiform paraphyses.
bibliographicCitation: Christensen, Carl F. A. 1937. Botanical Results of the Archbold Expedition No. 8: New and Noteworthy Papuan Ferns. Brittonia. 2 (4): 265-317.

description: Selliguea rhizomate longe repente, funiforme, 5 mm. crasso, parce ramoso, paleis magnis, 3-4 mm. latis, 1 cm. longis, ovatis, primum acutis denique obtusis, integris, pallide brunneis, tenuissimis densissime imbricatim vestito, sub paleis non glauco, folia conformia, coriacea, glaberrima, ad phyllopodia 3-5 cm. inter se remota articulata ferentibus. Stipite rigido, 8-10 cm. longo, 1.5 mm. crasso, superne applanato, laete brunneo, subtus tereti atrobrunneo, subnitente, sursum anguste marginato. Lamina ovata, 13 cm. longa, 3.5-4.5 cm. lata, breve acuminata, basi abrupte rotundato-cuneata in stipitem brevissime decurrente, brunnea, nitida, marginibus inerassatis, cartilagineis, ineisuris parvis inter venas primarias crenulatis, costa superne brunnea, anguste sulcata, subtus tereti, atrobrunnea; venis omnibus distinctis, praesertim superne prominulis, reticulatis, primariis flexuosis, usque ad marginem distinctis, obliquis, 4-5 mm. inter se remotis. Soris inter venas primarias uniseriatis, ca. 6, superficialibus, plerisque globosis, costalibus transversaliter oblongis, exterioribus et superioribus confluentibus, selligueoidibus; sporangiis brunneis, glabris, paraphysibus nullis.
bibliographicCitation: Christensen, Carl F. A. 1937. Botanical Results of the Archbold Expedition No. 8: New and Noteworthy Papuan Ferns. Brittonia. 2 (4): 265-317.
