description: Prosaptia rhizomate repente, 1.5 mm. crasso, in vivo ex schedula glauco, in sieco brunneo, paleis laete brunneis, lanceolato-acuminatis, remote et decidue ciliatis sat dense vestito, denique denudato. Frondibus approximnatis, numerosis; stipite capillari, tereti, flexuoso, 8 cm. vel ultra longo, brunneo, glabro. Lamina lineari, utrinque angustata, 10 (raro ad 15) cm. longa, 6-8 mm. lata, coriacea, subtus pallide (glaueino?) viridi et ad rachin venisque pilis brunneis, brevibus, mollibus sat sparse pubeseente, superne glabra, pinnata. Pinnis numerosis, obliquis, basi late adnatis, decurrentibus, maximis 4 mm. longis, 2 mm. latis, oblongis vel subrectangularibus apice fertilium truneatis vel interdum retusis, sterilium magis triangularibus, subacutis, vel rotundatis, inferioribus sensim reductis, triangularibus, infimis vix 0.2 mm. longis, majoribus marginibus crassis recurvis leviter undulato-crenatis; venis iminersis, invisibilibus, simplicibus vel in pinnis majoribus fureatis vel interdum subpinnatis. Soris prope apicem pinnarum 1 vel 2 (raro 3 vel 4), in crateribus 1 mm. fere altis, cylindricis, ore rotundo ciliato omnino immersis.

description: Selliguea polypodioidea P. Wecrneri Ros. proxime affinis, differt: rhizomate 3-4 mm. crasso (paleis vix diversis), foliis plus minusve dimorphis, sterilibus iis P. Werneri similibus, minoribus ovato-lanceolatis, brevius acuminatis, marginibus ubique incisuris parvis crenulatis, fertilium lamina lanceolata, ad 20 cm. longa, 3 cm. lata, quam sterili basi magis cuneatis et in stipitem decurrente. Soris crassissimis verticaliter oblongis, usque ad 8-10 mm. longis, 5 mm. latis, 4 vel 5 inter 2 venas primarias, contiguis sed non confluentibus, totam superficiem tegentibus.

description: Calymmodon rhizomate parvo, erecto, subelongato, paleis luteobrunneis, lanceolatis, integris, ad 1 cm. longis, vix 1 mm. latis apice vestito. Foliis caespitosis, subsessilibus, anguste linearibus, ad 25 cm. longis (plerisque brevioribus), 4 mm. latis, versus basin sensim attenuatis, glaberrimis, coriaceis, pinnatifidis, rachi ubique anguste alata; segmentibus 4-8-juois sterilibus, dentiformibus, triangularibus, obliquis, 0.5-2 mm. longis, basi late decurrentibus, subobtusis, ceteris fertilibus ad 40-jugis, 5 mm. inter se remotis, basi decurrentibus, parte contracta brevissima vel nulla, parte sorifera orbiculari, 1.5-2 mm. diametro, primum conduplicata denique plana, sporangiis omnino obtecta.

description: Rhizome elongate, the scales yellowish brown, lanceolate, 5 mm. or more long, 1 mm. wide at base, sparsely ciliate. Leaves tufted, subsessile, lanceolate, up to 12 cm. long, 1 cm. broad, fully pinnate below, the rachis upward very narrowly alate. The lowermost 2 or 3 pairs of segments tooth-like, the following broadly spathulate, to 2 mm. wide above the middle, the fertile ones similar but usually more contracted below the conduplicate or not rarely plane soriferous portion, all with a small tuft of pale thin hairs at the tip; similar few hairs on rachis and veins beneath.
bibliographicCitation: Christensen, Carl F. A. 1937. Botanical Results of the Archbold Expedition No. 8: New and Noteworthy Papuan Ferns. Brittonia. 2 (4): 265-317.

description: Identification sure. Rhizome rather thick, creeping, clothed with pale brown, broadly ovate, obtuse, entire, inmbricated scales. The terete stipe short, at best 2 cm. long, glabrous; lamina entire, spathulate-oblong, 7-10 cm. long, 1 cm. wide just below the rounded obtuse apex, long attenuate and cuneate at base, thickly coriaceous, dark above, brown beneath, both sides glabrous but the margins with some scattered atropurpureous short setae, which are sometimes forked with the branches parallel to the margin. Veins hidden, subpinnate; sori superficial, globose, uniserial at each side near the midrib; sporangia glabrous.
bibliographicCitation: Christensen, Carl F. A. 1937. Botanical Results of the Archbold Expedition No. 8: New and Noteworthy Papuan Ferns. Brittonia. 2 (4): 265-317.

description: Stipe 3-4 cm. long, margined or very narrowly alate nearly to the base, upward cuneately alate, glabrous. Lamina lanceolate, 15-20 by 1-1.5 cm., shortly narrowed below, long attenuate upward, thick coriaceous, glabrous, pinnately cut nearly to the rachis. Segments oblique, oblong or more often triangular, decurrent at base, acute, the largest 1 cm. long by 4 mm. wide at base and with their own breadth between them, both margins with 3 or 4 obtuse or subacute teeth or the lower side sometimes subentire; veins indistinct, very oblique, forked. Sori superficial, globose or oblong to linear, not seldom fused into coenosori, filling the whole underside at maturity.

description: Eupolypodiunt rhizomate breve repente, paleis linearibus, castaneis, ciliatis vestito. Stipite tereti sursum marginato et sinuato-alato, ad 12 cm. longo, brunneo, pilis rufis, patentibus, ad 4 mm. longis dense hirto. Lamina oblanceolata, versus apicem breve versus basin longe attenuata, ad 45 cm. longa, 3-4 cm. lata, papyracea, profunde pinnatifida, radhi utrinque parenchymate concolori, pilis longis, rufis praecipue subtus dense hirta; segmentis ad 50-jugis, horizontalibus, 1 cm. inter se remotis, maximis 2 cm. longis, e basi valde dilatata sensim ad apicem obtusum vel subacutum attenuatis, supra basin ca. 4 mm. latis, integris, sparse et longe ciliatis, subtus sparse hirtis, inifimis minimis, in alas stipites transformantibus; venis indistinctis, simplicibus vel raro furcatis, 12-15-jugis, obliquis. Soris globosis vel paulo oblongis, superficialibus, medialibus, confluentibus, juvenilibus pilis circumdatis, sporangiis nudis.

description: Toxopteris, S. borneensi affinis, frondibus majoribus et integris distineta, rhizomate breve, valido, setis atrocastaneis dense vestito; stipitibus approximatis, 2-4 cm. longis, validis, setis nigris aspersis, sursum angulatis in frondes sensim transeuntibus; fronde sterile 30 cmii. alta, 3 cm. lata, utrinque valde attenuata, integra vel undulata, glabra, coriacea, costa utraque facie prominente; venis approximatis, fureatis, apud marginem connexis; fronde, fertile 40-45 cm. longa, 10-13 mnm. lata.

description: Eupteris tripartita rhizomate breve repente (?), 6 mm. crasso, cum basibus stipitum paleis brunneis lanceolatis integris sat sparse vestito. Stipite 22-24 cm. longo, basi fuseeseente sursum stramineo, stricto, glabro; lamina tripartita, late deltoidea, coriacea, ramis bipinnatifidis vel basi subbipinnatis, apice pinnatis, centrali 12-14 cm. longo (inel. petiolo 3.5 cm.), 8 cm. lata, lateralibus oppositis, paulo minoribus (petiolis 1.5 cm.), latere basiscopico paulo productis, pinnulis earum basalibus basi bipinnatifidis; pinnulis ceteris obliquis 5-6-jugis, alternis 1.5 cm. inter se remotis, obliquis, breve petiolatis, ad 5cm. longis, 1.5 cm.latis, breve caudato-acuminatis, fere ad costam pinnatifidis vel basi subpinnatis; segmientis 7-8-jugis, faleatis, 2.5 mm. latis, acutis, marginibus revolutis, sterilibus leviter crenato-dentatis; costis angularibus costulisque subtus elevatis et squamulis minimis piliformibus persparse praeditis, mox glaberrimis, venis liberis, fureatis, indistinctis; soris apicem laciniarum noll attingentibus, indusio pallido, integro.

description: Rhizomate repente, paleis castaneis nitidis, ovato-acuminatis, pellucidis, integerrimis dense vestito. Stipite gracili, ca. 1 mm. crasso, ad 15 cm. longo, atrobrunneo, nitido, basi paleaceo, glabro. Lamina deltoidea vel ovata, acuminata, ad 20 cm. longa, 8-10 cm. lata, coriacea, in sieco brunnea, tripinnata; rachi flexuosa, paleis nonnullis iis rhizomatis similibus sparse vestita. Pinnis 9- vel 10-jugis, alternis, 3-2 cm. inter se remotis, petiolo ad 1 cm. longo stipitatis, obliquis, trapezioovatis vel inaequaliter deltoideis, longe acuminatis, maximis visis 8 cm. longis, 3 cm. basi latis, costa anguste marginato-alatis; pinnulis ambitu pinnis similibus, 5- vel 6-jugis, obliquis, basalibus maximis ad 3 cm. longis, 1 cm. latis, breve petiolulatis, ad costulam anguste alatam pinnatis, superioribus indivisis, pinnulis III. ord. ambitu similibus, cuneato- spathulatis, apice obtuso dentatis, dentibus ad 1 mm. longis, sublinearibus, acutis; costis colstulisque paleis iis rachidis similibus sat dense sed decidue subtus vestitis. Soris in segmento plerumque 2 vel 3, marginibus parallelis, denique confluentibus, indusiis brunneis, integerrimis.

description: Species nova subgeneri Goniopteridis (C. Presl) Duek, Thelypteride semirii Salino & Melo et T. scabrae (C. Presl) Lellinger affinis sed differt frondibus subdimorphicis, petiolo frondis fertilis quam petiolo frondis sterilis longiore, rachidibus adaxialiter dense pilosis, pilis stellatis vel furcatis vel simplicibus ornatis, facies abaxialis costae pilis simplicibus ornatis, pili longiori 0.25-0.5 mm longi, pili breviores simplicibus 0.02-0.12 mm longi. Sori inframediani indusiati, sporangiis glabris.

description: Stem ascending to erect; caudex narrow (ca. 1 cm diam.); scales lanceolate, castaneous, pubescent; trichomes simple, furcate, and stellate. Leaves several, clustered, 37.7-56.5 cm long, slightly dimorphic, the fertile ones longer petioled. Petioles sulcate adaxially, 16.5-33.5 cm X 0.14-0.24 cm, with scales only at the base, these sparsely to moderately pilose; trichomes furcate and stellate. Laminae 20.8-23.5 cm long, oblong or elliptic or ovate, herbaceous, not verrucose, 1-pinnate-pinnatifid; apex gradually reduced, confluent, and pinnatifid. Buds and aerophores absent. Rachises densely pilose (especially on adaxial side); trichomes simple, furcate, and stellate. Pinnae 9 or 10 pairs per leaf, 8.2-9.8 cm X 1.8-2 cm, perpendicular to ascending (except basal pinnae strongly deflexed), lanceolate to elliptic, incised 2/3 to 3/4 their width, sessile to short-stipitate (to 0.8 mm long), the apex acuminate to long acuminate and the base truncate or oblique in the basal pair; costae lacking scales abaxially; costae, costule, sinus, and laminar tissue pubescent near margin of segments; trichomes adaxially simple; trichomes abaxially moderate-to-dense (especially on costae), with mixture of long (ca. 1 mm) and short (ca. 0.1 mm) mostly simple trichomes, a few stellate, some reddish; laminar tissue on abaxial side with numerous, simple, 2- 4 mm long trichomes. Segments 3.6-4 mm wide, arcuate, entire, rounded to acute; veins 9-12 pairs per segment, unbranched, the basal vein pairs from adjacent segments running to the sinus. Sori inframedial; indusia reniform, entire, the surface pubescent with simple trichomes; sporangia glabrous.
bibliographicCitation: Salino, Alexandre. 2002. New species and combinations in Thelypteris subg. Goniopteris (Thelypteridaceae). Brittonia. 54: 331-339.

description: Stem short- to long-creeping; scales lanceolate, brownish, pubescent; trichomes simple, furcate, and stellate. Leaves several, clustered, 37-91 cm long, monomorphic. Petioles sulcate adaxially, 17-53 cm X 0.15-0.40 cm, glabrescent to short-pubescent, with scales on proximal half. Laminae 20 to 45 cm long, elliptic, chartaceous, not verrucose, 1-pinnate-pinnatifid; apex gradually reduced, confluent, and pinnatifid. Buds and plantlets present in axils of me- dian and distal pinnae and on adaxial side of costae of proximal and median pinnae. Aerophores absent or sometimes present. Rachises pulverulent to pilose, with reddish, simple, furcate and stellate trichomes, especially on adaxial side. Pinnae 12-23 pairs per leaf, perpendicular to ascending (except basal pinnae strongly deflexed), sessile or short stipitate (to 1.3 mm), 6.5- 11 cm X 1.4-2.2 (-3.5) cm, elliptic or lanceolate, incised ca. 1/2 their width; apex acuminate in distil pinnae; base truncate in distal pinnae and oblique or slightly cuneate in proximal pinnae; adaxially pilose with simple or furcate trichomes on the costae, sometimes with simple trichomes on the costules; abaxially pilose with redish simple trichomes on the costae, costules, veins, and segment margins. Segments 3-5 mm wide, entire, the apex rounded; veins 5-9 pairs per segment, unbranched, the basal pairs from adjacent segments running to or below the sinus. Sori medial; indusia perisistent, reniform, entire, pale to brownish, with simple trichomeson the margin; sporangia glabrous.

Presl) Salino affinis sed pinnis abaxialiter et indusiis dense pilosis, pilis pedicelatis furcatis vel stellatis, venis 2-4 paribus basalibus ex segmentis contiguis ad sinum conniventibus differt. Sori mediani indusiati, sporangiis glabris vel pedicellis pilosis.

description: Stem short-creeping, the scales lanceolate, brownish, with numerous stipitate, furcate trichomes. Leaves clustered, 80-160 cm long, monomorphic. Petiole sulcate adaxially, 35-70 cm X 4-7 mm, with stipitate stellate trichomes and lanceolate, pilose scales. Lamina 40-90 cm long, chartaceous, ovate, 1-pinnate-pinnatifid, the apex abruptly reduced and similar (con- form) to lateral pinnae. Buds and sometimes plantlets present in the axils of distal pinnae. Aerophores absent. Rachises with sparse to moderately dense, stipitate, furcate trichomes. Pinnae 8-12 pairs per leaf, sessile to often stalked to 1.7 mm, 12-30 X 1.8-4.0 cm, elliptic, incised ca. 1/3-2/3; apex acuminate; basal pinnae sometimes deflexed; suprabasal pinnae cuneate at the base with several pairs of reduced segments; median pinnae truncate at the base. Segments 5-9 mm wide, entire, obtuse; veins 6-14 pairs per segment, sometimes furcated, often unbranched, the proximal 2-4 pairs from adjacent segments connivent at the sinuses. Indument abaxially: on costae of 3 types (trichomes moderately dense to dense, stipitate, furcate and stellate; trichomes sparse, simple; scales hairlike); on veins and laminar tissue trichomes moderately dense to dense, stipitate, furcate and stellate. Indument adaxially: on costae, segment margins, and sometimes costules trichomes sparse, stipitate, furcate or simple. Sori medial; indusia entire to repand, brownish, densely pilose, the trichomes stipitate, furcate and stellate; sporangia glabrous or with 1-furcate (stipitate) or unbranched trichomes on the sporangial stalks.

description: Rhizomate erecto ( ?), paleis atrofuscis, lineari-lanceolatis, integris apice vestito. Stipite stricto, ad 40 cm. longo, brunneo-stramineo, superne trisuleato, paleis aliis paucis lanceolatis ad 2-3 mm. longis, tenluiter ciliatis, aliis numerosis perparvis brunneis stellato-ciliatis vestito. Lamina ovata, 35 cm. longa, supra basin 23 cm. lata, firme herbacea, laete viridi, bipinnatifida, rachi ut stipite vestita. Pinnis ad 12-jugis, alternis, subpetiolatis, 4-3 cm. inter se rernotis, horizontalibus, basi truneatis, acuminatis, maximis late lanceolatis, ad 11 cm. longis, infra medium 3.5 cm. latis, infimis paulo brevioribus, superioribus oblonlgis, plerisque 2 viae ad costarn pinlllatifidis, parte centrali indivisa ad 7 mm. utrinque lata, superioribus grosse lobato-serrulatis, supremis conflueintibus integris; lobis maximis ad 1.2 cm. longis, 7 mm. latis, oblongis, interdum subfaleatis, sinlubus 1-2 mm. latis separatis, marginibus lateralibus integris, apice late rotundato vel subtruneato leviter dentatis, basalibus plus minusve reductis; pagina superiore glaberrima, inferiore ad costas paleis brunneis, ovatis vel lanceolatis, ciliatus vestita et ubique praesertim ad costas venasque paleis et pilis stellatis minutis instructa; venis simplicibus, curvatim adscendentibus, 6- vel 7-jugis. Soris omnes venas e basi ad apicem occupantibus, exindusiatis, linearibus, sporangiis pilis stellatis mixtis.

description: Plants terrestrial. Rhizomes ca. 2 mm in diam., long-creeping, the internodes spaced 5-15 mm apart, sparsely scaly, the scales 1.5-2.5 x 0.4-0.5 mm, medium brown, thin, shiny, concolorous, spreading, lancea- te, sparsely denticulate along the basal margins. Fronds monomorphic, 24-43 cm long; laminae pinnate, with a single pair of pinnae, one slightly larger and more apical than the other, or sometimes ternate with a terminal segment, lacking laminar idioblasts on both surfaces; stipes 14-28 cm long and ca. 1.0-2.0 mm in diam., black, somewhat lustrous, with a few scales at the base, the scales similar to those of the rhizome, the distal portion of the stipes and rachises adaxially moderately to densely setose, the setae 0.1-0.2 mm long, castaneous; pinnae petiolate, the color of the petiole continuing onto the costae, 6-12 X 3- 7 cm, ovate-lanceate, the bases rounded to obtuse, somewhat inequilateral, the apices acute, the abaxial surfaces glabrous, the adaxial surfaces sparsely setose along the basal costae, the margins entire; venation copiously anastomosing; sori elongate and continuous along both sides of the pinna margins; indusia with entire margins; annuli with 14-16 indurated cells (our count from Thomas et al. 10570) or 18-20 indurated cells (reported and illustrated by Fée in the protologue); spores brown, trilete, tetrahedral.
bibliographicCitation: Sundue, Michael A. & Prado, Jefferson. 2005. Adiantum diphyllum, a rare and endemic species of Bahia State, Brazil, and its close relatives. Brittonia. 57 (2): 123-128.

description: Species insignis, affine A. pulcherrimo , statura graciliore, petiolis rufo-castaneis, lamina oblong-elliptica, minus divisis, pagina frondis texture tenuiter herbacea, in sicco vivo viridi, segmentis ultimis dimorphis, bifidis vel simplicibus, fertilibus late falcatibus, indusiis membranaceis, hyalinis, oblong-ovatis, margine undulatis vel dentatis. Plants slender. Rhizomes erect, the apices densely scaly; scales basifixed, narrowly lanceolate, 2.6-3.5 X 0.3-0.5 mm, black brown, clathrate, concolorous, subentire or with minute glandular hairs, apex hair-pointed. Leaf clustered; petioles 0.7-4 cm long, base 0.2-0.4 mm diam., 1/4-1/3 the length of the laminae, rufo- castaneous, with scattered minute glandular hairs, the base with scattered black brown fibrous scales, adaxial side grooved; laminae oblong-elliptic, widest medially, 3.5-11.5 x 1- 3.2 cm, apex acuminate, finely dissected, 3- pinnate, ultimate pinnule bifid; pinnae 8-17 pairs, ovate or broadly ovate, medial pinnae 0.6- 2 x 0.4-1.3 cm, shortly stalked, 2-pinnate, basal 1 or 2 pairs of pinnae greatly reduced to half the size of upper pinnae, sterile or bearing 1-2 sori; pinnule 2 or 3 pairs, pinnate, anadromous, basal acroscopic pinnule the largest, broadly ovate or elliptic, stalked; secondary pinnule bifid or simple; ultimate segments sterile or fertile,  linear-falcate, 1-2.5 x 0.2-0.5 mm, apex sharply acute, margin entire, each segment with one midvein, ended below the sharp-pointed apex; fertile segments much wider than sterile ones, the base enlarged into a flap, margin of the flap entire or toothed; laminae thin-herbaceous, grass-green when dry; rachis below middle castaneous, distally grass-green, glabrous or with scattered minute glandular hairs, shallowly grooved on adaxial side, abaxial side of pinnule rachis with scattered minute, brown glandular hairs; sori elliptic, 0.6-0.8 mm long, scattered on pinnules, normally on the acroscopic base of the enlarged segment; indusia oblong-ovate, membranous, hyaline, margin undulate or dentate; spores brown, ellipsoidal, monolete, 28.6-40.5 x 22.5-34.5 µm, reticulate.

description: Caules tenues. Flores plerumque 4-divisi circ. 2 mm longi sessiles. Calycis lobi triangulari-ovati subaeuti. Corolla campanulata, lobi triangulari-ovati subaeuti. Scalae ad stamina attingentes fimbriatae circ. caeumen. Styli stigmata aequantes. Capsula depresso-globosa eircumscissilis.
bibliographicCitation: Yuncker, Truman G. 1957. Three new species of Cuscuta from Africa and one variety from Nepal. Brittonia. 9: 133-135.

description: Stems slender, red when dry. Flowers reddish when dry, mostly 4-parted, about 2 mm long, sessile, in dense, few-flowered glomerules. Calyx enclosing the corolla-tube, divided to or below the middle, the lobes triangular-ovate, unequal, bluntly acute, fleshy-thickened at the tip and medianly downward but otherwise membranous, scarcely overlapping at the sinuses. Corolla campanulate, membranous, the lobes triangular-ovate, bluntly acute, about as long as the tube, upright to slightly spreading. Scales reaching the stamens, moderately shortfringed about the apex, bridged below the middle. Stamens about as long as the corolla-lobes, the deltoid-ovoid anthers shorter than the somewhat subulate filaments. Stigmas terete and about equal to the styles, both together longer than the depressed-globose ovary. Capsule depressed-globose, circumscissile with a regular line of cleavage, surrounded by the withered corolla, the seeds 3 or 4, subglobose with two plane sides, the hilum nearly perpendicular, the embryo slender, with scarcely two coils.

description: Caules tenuissimi. Flores sessiles, 4- aut 5-divisi eire. 1.5-2 mm longi ab floris basi ad corollae sinum. Calycis lobi late ovati ad obovati acuti. Corolla urceolata, lobis triangulari-lanceolatis acutis. Scalae truneatae aut bifidae. Capsula depresso-globosa circumscissilis.

description: Stems very slender. Flowers 4- or 5-parted, fleshy and white when young, becoming more membranous and yellowish when dry, 1.5-2 mm long from the pedicel to the corolla sinuses, sessile, in small, comparatively few-flowered glomerules. Calyx loose and about enclosing the corolla, composed of rather large cells and glossy when dry, divided to below the middle, the lobes broadly ovate to obovate, about as broad as long, acute. Corolla urceolate and becoming subglobose about the maturing capsule, the lobes triangular-lanceolate, acute, nearly as long as the tube, erect to spreading. Stamens shorter than the corolla lobes, the oval anthers about equaling the slender but slightly subulate filaments. Scales rather inconspicuous, reaching to about the middle of the tube, bridged low, truncate or bifid and irregularly and rather sparsely fringed about the top. Ovary depressed-globose, the stigmas elongate, terete, about twice as long as the rather short styles. Capsule broadly depressed-globose, quickly eircumscissile, leaving the obcordate septum in the calyx, surrounded by the withered corolla, 3- or 4-seeded, suleate between the seeds. Seeds globose-ovoid, with two plane sides, about 1 mm long, the hilum short, diagonal, the embryo slender, of about two coils.
bibliographicCitation: Yuncker, Truman G. 1957. Three new species of Cuscuta from Africa and one variety from Nepal. Brittonia. 9: 133-135.

description: Stems very slender and red or brown when dry. Flowers 4- or 5-parted, about 3 mm long, yellow when dry, narrowing toward the base into a very short thick pedicel, in dense, several-flowered glomerules. Calyx fleshy, longer than the corolla and entirely enclosing it, divided to below the middle, the lobes ovate, with a protracted, turgid, acute apex, slightly overlapping at the sinuses, shiny-yellow when dry. Corolla campanulate-suburceolate, the lobes shorter than the tube, spreading, somewhat turgid, triangular-ovate, acute, the margins regular or sometimes irregular. Scales about reaching the stamens, strongly bifid, bridged low, the wings dentate above. Stamens shorter than the lobes, the anthers ovoid and shorter than the stoutish, subulate filaments. Ovary ovoid, rostrately pointed, rather deeplv cleft at the apex, the stigmas terete and longer than the short styles. Capsule circumscissile, surrounded by the withered corolla.
bibliographicCitation: Yuncker, Truman G. 1957. Three new species of Cuscuta from Africa and one variety from Nepal. Brittonia. 9: 133-135.

description: These plants form very dense mats; the leaf-blades are orbicular and only 3-5 mm long; the pedicels are much longer than the accompanying petioles, and straight; the sepals are oblong, ca. 1-1.5 mm long, rounded apically; the corolla is glabrous, 2.5-3 mm long (thus much longer than the calyx), tubular for a third the length, the lobes oblong or oblong-obovoid, rounded; the ripe fruit is about as long as the calyx.
bibliographicCitation: Fulford, Margaret H. & Taylor, Jane. 1961. Segregate genera of the Lepidozia complex (Hepaticae) Part 2. Two new genera, Bonneria and Paracromastigum. Brittonia. 13: 334-339.

description: Annual herbaceous vine, trailing or twining, 3-8 m long, glabrous or glabrate. Stems armed at least toward the base with numerous herbaceous spines or warts 2-4 mm long. Juice milky. Petioles 5-24 cm long, smooth or muricate. Leaves glabrous, thin, 7-18 cm long, 6-15 cm wide with 5-6 lateral nerves on each side of midrib, ovate or orbicular, cordate at base, acuminate with excurrent midrib at apex, simple or rarely lobed. Inflorescences axillary, 1-3(-5)-flowered, usually shorter than subtending leaves. Peduncles 3-6 cm long, smooth or muricate. Pedicels 10-20 mm long or longer, smooth, thickening towards apex, greatly thickening in fruit. Bracts 2, fugacious, scarious, oblong, up, to 8 mm long, inserted at base of pedicel. Sepals 5, about equal in length, 2 outer oblong to ovate, more or less plicate at apex and attenuated into a thick awn, 3 inner obtuse or slightly emarginate, distinctly awned, all sepals in flowering stage (excluding awns) 6-8 mm long, 3 mm wide, enlarging in fruiting stage to 12-14 mm long, 6-7 mm wide, awns 3-5 (-7) mm long, deflexed in flower and less so in fruit. Corolla almost salverform but flaring near the limb, without fragrance; tube 3-7 cm long, 3-4 mm wide, straw-colored on outside, purple and pubescent within; limb, glabrous throughout, 3-5 cm in diameter, purple with darker purple plaits. Stamens barely if at all exerted from tube, white, unequal (2 long and 3 short); filaments pubescent near and below fusion with corolla near base of tube; hairs unbranched or arachnoid. Stigma included in tube and below stamens, capitate, 2-lobed. Capsule ovoid-acuminoid, 18-20 mm long, thin-walled, longer than calyx, 2-celled, 4-seeded, on thickened strongly reflexed pedicels. Seeds 8-9.5 mm long, 6-7 mm wide, glabrous, uniformly one-quarter of a circle in cross-section, monochrome medium grayish-brown. Chromosome number: 2n = 30 (Miege, 1960).
bibliographicCitation: Gunn, Charles R. 1972. Moonflowers, Ipomoea section Calonyction, in temperate North America. Brittonia. 24: 150-168.

description: Perennial? Vine of unknown length, puberulent, becoming glabrate with age, lacking herbaceous spines or warts. Nature of juice unknown. Petioles about 8 cm long, pubescent. Leaves glabrous above, pubescent and covered with minute black glands below, 7-12 cm long and about as wide (with 6-7 major lateral veins on each side o,f midrib), thin, orbicular, cordate at base, short- to long-acuminate at apex, entire. Inflorescence axillary, apparently uniflorate. Peduncles about 1-5 cm long, pubescent. Pedicels about 1-2 cm long, pubescent. Bracts 2, fugacious 5, equal, similar, oblong, densely pubescent except along scarious margins, blackglandular dotted below hairs, definitely acuminate at apex with a well-defined, but short excurrent midrib. Corollas salverform, apparently without fragrance-, tube about 6 cm long and 1 cm wide, upper third pubescent on outside; limb glabrous except for marginal cilia at ends of plaits, about 8 cm in diameter. Stamens included in tube, filaments bearing hairs at least near insertion just above base of  corolla tube. Stigmas barely exerted from tube, overtopping anthers, capitate, 2-lobed. Fruits ovoid, about 2 cm long. Seeds densely covered by sericeous, olive-colored hairs. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Species nova Jacquemontiae martii Choisy amms, sed trichomatibus 5- vel 7-radiatis, inflorescentia numer osiore, plus quam 30-flora, sepalis exterioribus oblongis, ad basim crassioribus et quam sepalis interioribus long ioribus, antheris vivide flavis differt.

description: Perennial vine, climbing, with slender stems, somewhat woody at base, much branched, velutinous; trichomes stipitate stellate, 5(-7)-rayed, the rays usually equal; latex white. Internodes 5.7-10.3 cm long. Leaf blades 5.7-8.6x3.4-6.2 cm, papyra ceous, entire to slightly sinuate, ovate, the base subcordate, the apex acuminate to apiculate, velutinous, hoary, yellowish when dried, the trichomes on the abaxial side longer than on the adaxial side, with 9 pairs of secondary veins. Petiole 0.8-2.3 cm long, pubescent. Inflorescences compound dicha sial cymes, umbelliform, usually ca. 30 flowered, rarely 7-12-flowered; peduncles 3.5—5.2 cm long, axillary, velutinous; bracts 5-8 X 1 mm, entire, linear, two at the base of each cyme, pilose. Sepals unequal, the 2 outer 1.0-1.1x0.4-0.45 cm, chartaceous, thick, entire, oblong, the base truncate, the apex acuminate, velutinous, the 3 inner 0.7-0.8x 0.3-0.35 cm, entire, ovate, the base rounded, the apices acuminate, puberulent in the middle region, persistent. Corolla ca. 2 cm long, funnelform, without lobes between episepalic nervures, the apex of episepalic nervure ciliate, blue. Stamens heterandrous, the longer 2 ca. 0.7 cm long, the smaller 3, ca. 0.6 cm long; filaments with short unicellular trichomes at the base; anthers elliptic, ca. 2 mm long, the base subcordate, the apex rounded, bright yellow. Style ca. 1 cm long, exceeding the stamens, each stigmatic lobe ca. 1><0.6 mm, oval, flattened, white; nectary 5-lobate; ovary ca. 1 mm long, globose, glabrous, 2-locular, with 2 ovules per locule. Fruit a capsule, ca. 5 x 4 mm, globose, opening by 8 valves. Seeds 3-3.2 mm long, the dorsal face rounded, the margins with a thin, striate lateral ridge, ca. 0.2—0.4 mm wide, the surface minutely areolate.
bibliographicCitation: Buril, Maria T. & Alves, M. 2011. A new species of Jacquemontia (Convolvulaceae) from northeastern Brazil. Brittonia. 63 (4): 436-441.

description: Plants hemiepiphytic, climbing up to ca. 4 m; roots inserted ventrally; rhizomes dorsiventral, with an elongate ventral meristele, the cortex drying whitish, long-creeping, 6-8 mm wide, dark brown to blackish, lustrous, densely scaly at apex and petiole bases, the scales 1.5-2.2x0.2-0.3 mm, lanceolate, subpeltate, brown to dark brown, clathrate, the lumens translucent but very narrow and not easily seen, the base cordate, the apex acuminate, the margins castaneous, fimbriate; leaves dimorphic; sterile leaves 40x11-13 cm, petiole 6-7 cm long, 3 mm wide, stramineous, articulate to rhizome, glabrous or with a few scales like those of the rhizome, grooved adaxially; lamina 1 -pinnate throughout, with 21-23 pinna pairs, the base truncate, the apex gradually reduced and ending in a terminal segment that is pinnatifid or sub-conform to the lateral pinnae and which is not articulate to the rachis; rachis narrowly alate distally, adaxially grooved, the groove with a central carina, neither the carina or groove continuing onto the pinnae, abaxially rounded, with scattered scales or glabrescent, the scales 1-1.2x0.1- 0.2 mm, linear-lanceolate, dark brown, the margins slightly fimbriate; pinnae 6-7 x 1.4 - 1.7 cm, linear-lanceolate, stalked, the stalks articulate to the rachis, the pinna bases cunéate, the pinna apices attenuate, the margins serrate distally; costae rounded abaxially and adaxially; lamina surfaces glabrous both abaxially and adaxially; veins proximally anastomosing, distally free, with 2(3) aréoles between the pinna costa and the margins, lacking free included veinlets, the costal aréoles measuring about at long as wide, the veins terminating submarginally in elongate hydathodes; fertile leaves essentially the same size as the sterile leaves, and with the same number of pinna pairs, the lamina reduced to only the sporangium bearing tissue; sori acrostichoid; sporangia glabrous; paraphyses absent; spores light brown, aborted.
bibliographicCitation: Moran, Robbin C., et al. 2010. Synopsis of Mickelia, a newly recognized genus of bolbitidoid ferns (Dryopteridaceae). Brittonia. 62 (4): 337-356.

description: Arbuscula 4-5 m. alta. Hamuli teretes, iuniores subfurfuracei. Folia ad apices ramulorum conferta, opposita, setas inter- et intra-petiolares satis rudes includentia; petioli 1-1.2 cm. longi; lamina firme chartacea, obovata, basi cuneata, apice acuminata, integra, glabra, quintuplinervis, 16-22 cm. longa, 8-9 cm. lata. Inflorescentia termi-nalis, trichotome cymosa, multiflora, 5 cm. alta, 8 cm. lata, laxe fur-furaceo-lepidota et in nodis setosa; bracteolae caducae, ovato-navicu-lares, ultimate 4 mm. longae, 2.5 mm. latae; pedicelli 2 mm. longi, graciles; flores pentameri. Receptaculum turbinatum, 5 mm. longum, 3 mm. latum, glabrum, sed minute verruculosum; calyx regulariter 5-dentatus, dentes humiles (0.5 mm. alti, 1-1.5 mm. lati), truncati. Petala alba glabra, ovato-acuminata, 3 mm. longa, 2 mm. lata. Stamina aequalia; filamenta glabra, taeniata, 2 mm. longa; antherae albidae, oblongae, 3 mm. longae, moniliformes vel mesenteriformes, birimosae, glabrae, postice a basi in calcar truncatum, 1 mm. longum desinentes. Stylus 5 mm. longus, glaber; stigma punctiforme. Ovarium 2 mm. altum, receptaculo plane adnatum, glabrum, 5-loculare; placentae liberae, sed paulo supra basin loculorum ortae.
bibliographicCitation: Markgraf, Friedrich. 1936. New Papuan Melastomataceae. Brittonia. 2: 141-144.

description: Shrub 1-2 meters high. Younger stems densely or sparsely substrigose with brownish hairs, glabreseent with age. Petioles slender, 1-5 cm. long, pubescent like the stem, but usually more densely. Leaf blades thin, variable in size and shape even on the same branch, usually ovate-lanceolate to oblong-ovate and 6-10 cm. long by half as wide, acute or subacuminate, often conspicuously and irreg,ularly toothed, acute, obtuse, or rarely subrotund at the base, 3-nerved, softly hirsute above, almost villous beneath. Infloreseences 2-5 cm. long, divaricately trichotomous, loosely flowered, hirsute with spreading or somewhat ascending simple hairs. Hypanthium urceolate or broadly tubular, 3 mm. long, denisely hirsute with spreading or ascending hairs up to 2.5 mm. long, some of them usually glandular. Calyx-tube barely prolonged; sepals thin, erect, broadly ovate, rounded above, nearly 1 mm. long from the torus; exterior teeth erect, essentially free from the sepals, slenderly subulate, 1.5-2.5 mm. long, hirsute like the hypanthium, the hairs decreasing in length distally. Petals obovateoblong, about 4 mm. long. Anthers stoutly subulate, deeply notched at the apex, about 2 mm. long; connective thickened toward the base and minutely prolonged below the thecae. Ovary one-third to onehalf inferior, 5-celled, the summit truneate-conic, glabrous or minutely glandular-pubeseent; style about 4 mum. long, tapering to a barely capitellate stigma.
bibliographicCitation: Gleason, Henry A. 1939. The genus Clidemia in Mexico and Central America. Brittonia. 3 (2): 97-130.

description: Shrub 1-5 meters high. Stems when young apparently glabrous, but actually closely furfuraceous with minute hairs less than 0.1 mm. long. Petioles slender, pubescent like the stem, variable in length from 2 to 8 cm., or nearly half as long as the blade. Leaf-blades thinl, bright green above, purple beneath, broadly ovate, 12-22 cm. long, 6.5-13 cm. wide, acuminate, minutely ciliate-denticulate, cordate or subcordate at the base, 5-7-nerved, glabrous above, or sparsely and minutely furfuraceous when young, minutely furfuraceous on the primary and secondary veins beneath. Infloreseences mostly below the leaves, few-flowered, about 1 cm. long, sparsely branched, the internodes 2-4 mm. long. Hypanthium urceolate, 2-2.5 mm. long, apparently glabrous or punetate, actually beset with minute glandular hairs 0.05 mm. long. Calyx-tube erect, prolonged about 0.5 mm.; sepals depressed-triangular, nearly 1 mm. long from the torus, subscarious, glandular-punctate on both sides; exterior teeth a broad crescentic elevation on each sepal, as wide as the sepal, thickened and more or less pendent at the center, ending in a deflexed tooth about 0.5 mm. long (about 1.5 mm. from the torus). Petals oblong, about 2 mm. long, very slightly inequilateral, barely retuse. Filaments clavate, 1.3 mm. long; anthers obovate, 1 mm. long, slightly retuse, the pore terminal; connective simple. Ovary wholly inferior, 4-celled, its flat summit glabrous; style stout, 3.5-4 mm. long; stigma truncate.
bibliographicCitation: Gleason, Henry A. 1939. The genus Clidemia in Mexico and Central America. Brittonia. 3 (2): 97-130.

description: Frutex interdum epiphyticus. Rami grisei, carnosuli, glabri, bi-anguli. Folia opposita, stipulis binis interpetiolaribus magnis vi-ridibus glabris ovatis, ad 2 cm. longis et 1 cm. latis, ramulum et pulvinar setarum nodalium includentibus munita; petiolus crassiusculus, 1.5 cm. longus, glaber; lamina glabra carnoso-coriacea, basi acuta, apice breviter acuminata, usque ad 21 cm. longa et 11 cm. lata, septuplinervis. Inflorescentiae terminales, glabrae, carnosae, pellucidae, rubrae, minu-tissime bracteatae, in nodis ± setulosae. Pedicelli rubri, 3 mm. longi. Flores tetrameri. Receptaculum albidum, subfurfuraceum, campanulas, 2.5 mm. altum, 2 mm. latum, carnosum. Limbus calycis 1 mm. altus, truncatus, indistincte 4-denticulatus. Petala alba, glabra, ovata, 5 mm. longa, 3 mm. lata. Staminum filamenta glabra, alba, carnosa, 3 mm. longa; antherae ovato-acuminatae, ochroleucae, 3 mm. longae, 1.5 mm. crassae, basi postice recurvo-calcaratae. Stylus glaber, 5 mm. longus, stigma capitatum. Ovarium glabrum, truncatum, apice liberum. Bacca globosa, viridis, 4 mm. crassa. Semina numerosa, nitida, ellipsoidea, 1 mm. longa.
bibliographicCitation: Markgraf, Friedrich. 1936. New Papuan Melastomataceae. Brittonia. 2: 141-144.

description: Rhizomate breve, paleis castaneis lineari-lanceolatis, angustis, acuminatis, integris dense vestito. Stipite ad 25 cm. longo, brunneo, opaco, paleis brunneis basi dilatata lacerata adpressis apice linearibus, deciduis haud dense vestito, cito denudato. Larnina ovata, acuminata, ad 35 em. longa, 15 em. lata, papyracea, in sieco brunnea, tripinnata; rachi paleis parvis, filiformibus, basi fimbriatis persparse vestita. Pinnis ad 20-jugis, alternis, 5-3 cm. inter se remotis, patentibus, petiolo ca. 1 cm. longo stipitatis, lanceolatis vel deltoideis, longe acuminatis (apice tenuo serrato), maximis 12 cm. longis, 4 cm. latis, costis haud alatis; pinnulis alternis, 1.5-1 cm. inter se remotis, petiolulatis, basalibus pinnarum inferiorum paulo abbreviatis ceterum longioribus, maximis 2.5 cm. longis, 1 cm. latis, obtusis, ad costulam anguste marginato- alatam pinnatis, pinnulis ultimis 3- vel 4-jugis, basalibus plerisque profunde trilobatis, cuneatis, ceteris bifidis vel indivisis, cuneatospathulatis, lobis ultimis apice 2-2.5 mm. latis et plerisque recte truncatis dentatisque, dentibus 3 vel 4, brevibus, obtusis; costis costulisque ut rachi subtus sparsissime fibrillosis. Soris plerumque 2 in lobo, marginibus parallelis, indusiis brunneis, integris.

description: Frutex altus. Ramuli teretes glabri. Foliorum petiolus 1-1.5 cm. longus, glaber, infra ipsam laminam lateraliter barbatus; lamina ovata, basi rotundata et minute auriculata, apice breviter acuminata, in mar-ginibus regulariter et distincte denticulata, 6-7 cm. longa, 3.5-4 cm. lata, glabra, subcoriacea, 5-nervis, leviter bullata; costa et venae cras-siores subtus lateraliter barbatae. Inflorescentiae axillares, pauciflorae, usque ad 3 cm. longae et 2 cm. latae, in ramificationibus ultimis cymosae, glabrae; bracteae cuneato-obovatae, glabrae, 5 mm. longae, 2 mm. latae. Pedicelli 2-5 mm. longi, minute bibraeteolati, glabri. Receptaculum turbinatum, glabrum, 5 mm. longum, 3 mm. latum. Calycis lobi late sinuati 1.5 mm. alti, 2 mm. lati, patentim apiculati. Petala obscure rubra, ovata, undulato-denticulata, glabra, 1 cm. longa, 0.5 cm. lata. Filamenta staminum 4 mm. longa, teretia, glabra, antherae lineari-ob-longae, 4 mm. longae, glabrae, luteae, postice a basi in appendicem orbicularem, 1 mm. longam desinentes. Stylus glaber, 1 cm. longus; stigma punctiforme. Ovarium glabrum, 5-loculare, truncatum. Cap-sula 6-8 mm. longa, 4 mm. lata, clavata, loculicida, polysperma. Semina cuneata, 1 mm. longa.
bibliographicCitation: Markgraf, Friedrich. 1936. New Papuan Melastomataceae. Brittonia. 2: 141-144.

description: Frutex altus. Ramuli dense fusco-furfuracei et hirti. Petioli 3-6 cm. longi, eodem modo pilosi. Foliorum lamina suborbicularis, basi cordata, apice breviter acuminata, in marginibus remote et minute denticulata, ad 10 cm. longa et lata, 7-nervis, supra mox glabrata, subtus in nervis fusco-hirta et in facie sparsissime furfuracea. Inflorescentia terminalis, dense fusco-furfuracea et hirta, minute bracteata. Pedi-celli 4 mm. longi, minute bibracteolati, dense fusco-hirti et furfuracei. Receptaculum turbinatum, dense fusco-hirtum et furfuraceum, 4 mm. altum, 3 mm. latum. Limbus calycis sinuato-5-dentatus, 1.5 mm. altus, eodem modo pilosus. Petala rubra, ovata, 8 mm. longa, 4 mm. lata, glabra. Staminum filamenta rubra, glabra, 5 mm. longa, subteretia; antherae luteae, oblongae, 4 mm. longae, basi postice breviter calcaratae. Stylus glaber, 1 cm. longus, apice curvatus; stigma puncti-forme. Ovarium glabrum.
bibliographicCitation: Markgraf, Friedrich. 1936. New Papuan Melastomataceae. Brittonia. 2: 141-144.

description: Frutex erectus, carnosus, 2 m. altus. Ramuli glabri, quadrialati, in nodis incrassati et transversaliter costati, in alis rubro-ciliati, ceterum glabri. Folia eiusdem paris paulo iniqua, laxe rubro-villosa; petiolus 6-10 cm. longus, anguste bialatus; lamina late cordata, obtusa, rubra, praesertim subtus, chartacea, usque ad 22 cm. longa et aequilata, 9-, versus basi 13-nervia. Inflorescentia terminalis, paniculata, sparsissime villosa, bialata, 20 cm. longa, 6 cm. lata, minute bracteata. Pedi-celli 3-4 mm. longi. Receptaculum campanulare, 5 mm. longum, 3 mm. latum, glabrum, rubrum; calycis lobi 5, late triangulares, late rotun-dato-scarioso-auriculati, 1.5 mm. alti, 2.5 mm. lati. Petala glabra, ovata, 7 mm. longa, 5 mm. lata, purpurea, 'Staminum filamenta taeniata, 4 mm. longa; antherae luteae, oblongae, 4 mm. longae, basi postice breviter calcaratae. Stylus 1 cm. longus, curvatus; stigma capitatum. Ovarium glabrum.

description: Miconia shepherdii a speciebus ad sectionem Glossocentrum pertinentibus et ab omnibus aliis speciebus generis adhuc cognitis distincta ramis trichomatibus dendriticis et lineis interpetiolaribus prominentibus instructis, inflorescentiis glomerulatis vel spiciformibus, floribus 4-meris, toris ovariisque flabris, staminibus inappendiculatis et fructibus aurentiacis.

description: Tree 5-12 m high; young branches flettened, with prominent interpetiolar ridges, sometimes projecting and sesembling stipules, along with the petioles densely covered by dendritic trichomes ca. 0.3 mm long. Leaves opposite; petioles 2.5-5 cm; blades 7.5-22 x 4-18 cm, elliptic to oblong, apex acuminate to abruptly acuminate, base rounded to obtuse or seldom cordate, margin minutely denticulate (teeth up to 0.5 mm), chartaceous, longitudinal nerves 5 (seldom 3 with a faint additional pair of marginals), acrodromous, basal to shortly supra-basal (inner pair up to 0.2 mm distant from the base), main and transversal nerves prominent on abaxial surface and impressed on adaxial surface, discolorous, adaxial surface with caducous dendritic trichomes, abaxial with two indument layers, dense and canescent, the first consisting of dendritic trichomes, 0.2-0.3 mm long and 0.3-0.4 mm diam. and the second of sessile, appressed, stellate trichomes ca. 0.1 mm diam. Panicles 8-15 x 6-7 cm, terminal, without accessory branches, with long 1st order paraclades, these glomerulate to spiciform, densely covered by dendritic trichomes 0.5-0.7 mm long, the larger in very dense clusters around the flowers; bracts, bracteoles (at anthesis) and pedicels absent. Flowers 4-merous. Hypanthium 1.5-1.7 mm long, campanulate, inner surface glabrous, outer glabrous on the proximal half, the distal half densely covered by dendritic trichomes ca. 0.5 mm and stellate trichomes ca. 0.1 mm diameter, torus glabrous. Calyx caducous in fruit, inner surface with stellate trichomes, outer with trichomes similar to the ones on the hypanthium, margin stellulate-ciliate; tube 0.3-0.4mm high, lobes 0.5-0.6 mm long, broadly triangular, acute, with minute dorsal teeth. Petals 1.4-1.9 x 1-1.2 mm, white, oblong to slightly obovate, apex rounded or emarginate and asymmetric, when asymmetric with an irregular projection at the right side (in ventral view), margins entire, surface minutely papillose. Stamens white, isomorphic; filaments 2.3-2.8mm long, glabrous, geniculate; connectives dorsally thickened, 0.3-0.4 mm prolonged below the thecae, unappendaged; anthers 1.5-1.8 mm long, oblong with a rounded apex in ventral view, crescent-shaped with a acute apex in lateral view, with a single ventral, moderate pore. Ovary 0.8-0.9mm long, basally 1/3 adherent to the hypanthium, 3-celled, apex glabrous; style 3.3-3.8 mm long, straight, not thickened at the apex, glabrous. Fruits baccate, ca. 2.5 mm diameter, orange when ripe, with 3-5 seeds; seeds ca. 0.7-0.8 mm, hemispheric, testa smooth.

description: Miconia kollmannii ad sectionem Hypoxanthum (priorem sectionem Chaenantheram nominatam) pertinens. A Miconia chrysophylla distincta foliis, inflorescentiis, hypanthiis ex trichomatibus dendriticis ornatis et etiam foliis oppositis, inflorescentiis apicalibus, ramis additis axillaribus et ovariis ex trichomatibus stellato-stipitatis dispersis omatis.

description: Shrub ca. 3 m high; young branches slightly flattened, along with the petioles densely covered by stipitate stellate-lepidote plus stellate trichomes. Leaves opposite; petioles 1-2.5 cm; blades 5.3-12 x 1.35-5 cm, elliptic to lanceate, apex acute to acuminate, base acute, margin entire to repand, chartaceous, longitudinal nerves 3 with a faint additional pair of marginals, acrodromous shortly supra-basal (inner pair up to 5 mm distant from the base), main veins prominent and transversal tenuous on abaxial surface, main veins impressed and transversal imperceptible on adaxial surface, discolorous, adaxial surface glabrous, abaxial densely covered by ochraceous to reddish, short stellate-stipitate and flat-topped trichomes (somewhat resembling a stipitatelepidote one, but presenting branches on the axis, below the top), intermingled by a thick layer of canescent, stellate trichomes. Panicles 6-12 x 2.5-8 cm, terminal with additional axillary branches at the second leaf pair, the terminal ones consisting of three panicles (one central and two lateral, these developing more or less parallel to the leaf pair), each panicle lacking accessory branches, with 3-8 pairs of short paraclades, these with 1-2 pairs of 2nd order paraclades or with a terminal flower and successive dichasial branches and slightly congested (but not forming glomerules) and sometimes somewhat depauperate, suggesting a short scorpioid branching pattern; inflorescence branches densely covered with stellate and short stipitate-stellate trichomes; bracts 1.4-1.9 mm long, lanceate to linear and mostly caducous; bracteoles 0.7-1.4 mm long, linear, persistent. Flowers 4(-5)-merous, with a constriction at the base resembling a very short, 0.15mm long, pedicel. Hypanthium 1.2-1.4 x ca. 1 mm, campanulate, inner surface glabrous, outer with the same trichomes described for the inflorescence, but a little sparser on the proximal half, torus glabrous. Calyx apparently persistent in young fruits, inner surface glabrous, outer with trichomes similar to the ones on the hypanthium, margin entire; tube ca. 0.2 mm high, lobes 0.2-0.3 mm long, triangular, acute, the dorsal teeth 0. 1-0.2 mm long, acute, thick. Petals 1.2-1.3 x 0.6-0.7 mm, white, oblong to obovate, apex retuse, margins entire, eciliate, glabrous. Stamens white, isomorphic; filaments 1.3-1.8 mm long, glabrous; connectives not dorsally thickened, but 0.5-0.8 mm prolonged below the thecae, unappendaged; anthers thecae ca. 0.6 mm long, oblong, with a large ventral opening, resembling a longitudinal slit, that comprises about half of the anther length, with a prominent and thick septum that gives the impression that there are two openings. Ovary 0.9-1 mm long, basally 12-2/3 adherent to the hypanthium, 3-celled and apparently with only 1 ovule in each locule, apex with sparse stipitate-stellate trichomes; style ca. 1.8 mm long, straight, not thickened at the apex and with a slight constriction below it, glabrous. Fruits not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Goldenberg, Renato & Reginato, Mariana. 2007. Three new species of Melastomataceae from the southeastern Atlantic forest of Brazil. Brittonia. 59 (4): 334-342.

description: Shrub b 1-3 m high; branches, petioles, leaf surfaces, inflorescences, bracts and bracteoles glabrous or sparsely covered by sessile glandular bodies, these denser on the nodes. Leaves opposite; petioles 0.9-3 cm long; blades 4.4-14.5 x 1.5-6 cm, elliptic to oboval-elliptic, apex acuminate to shortly caudate, base acute to cuneate or decurrent, margin entire, shortly (0.2-0.3 mm) ciliate, membranaceous, discolorous in dried materials, longitudinal nerves 3, acrodromous, supra-basal with a faint additional pair of marginals, main and transversal veins and reticulation prominent on the abaxial surface and slightly prominent on the adaxial surface. Thyrses 2.3-4.6 x 1.3-3.4 cm, axillary, pauciflorous (4-15-flowered), without accessory branches, with 2-5 pairs of opposite paraclades, these usually dichasial, but sometimes depauperate; bracts 0.85-2.15 mm, lanceolate, entire; bracteoles two, 0.55-0.8 mm long, lanceolate, entire. Flowers 4-5-merous, on pedicels 0.6-1.5 mm long. Hypanthium 2.3-2.9 x 1.8-2.5 mm, campanulate, outside densely covered by very small (up to 0.1 mm), simple, segmented trichomes (mostly inconspicuous in dry material), internal surface glabrous but the torus with very sparse, simple trichomes. Calyx tube ca. 0.5 mm long; lobes 0.4-1.2 mm long, triangular to lanceolate, acute, both tube and lobes outside with the same trichomes described for the hypanthium; external teeth 0.5-1.1 mm long, almost equaling the lobes, lanceolate, acute to shortly subulate. Petals 2-2.5 x 1.1-1.2 mm, white, triangular to lanceolate, acute, entire, eciliate, glabrous. Stamens white, isomorphic, glabrous; filaments 1-1.6 mm long; connectives unappendaged or sometimes dorsally tuberculate, dorsally thickened at the base and ventrally produced just below and continuously to the anthers; anthers 1.5-1.7 mm long, oblong, apex rounded with one dorsal pore. Ovary 1.4-1.7 mm long, basally 0.7-1 mm adherent to the hypanthium, 3-celled, apex with sparse sessile glandular bodies; style 4.4-4.6 mm long, linear, glabrous. Berries 5.8-8.15 x 5.8-8.15 mm, dark violet; seeds ca. 1 x 0.5 mm.

description: Shrub to 3 m tall. Indumentum of minute adpressed scales ca. 0.05 mm long on young leaves, inflorescences, and flowers. Young twigs sub-quadrangular in cross section. Mature branches with a smooth bark. Leaves with petiole 1.9-4.3 cm long, subterete, canaliculate above, glabrous; blades elliptic to narrowly-elliptic, 9-14.5x3.4—6 cm, char taceous, plane, the apex attenuate, the base obtuse to rounded, the margin straight to slightly revolute, entire towards the base but undulate-denticulate towards the apex; adax ial surface appearing minutely papillose after drying due to presence of druse crystals, glabrous; abaxial surface sparsely lepidote. Venation acrodomous, basal, midvein slightly impressed adaxially prominent abaxially, with two pairs of symmetrical secondary veins, first pair slightly impressed adaxially and prominent abaxially, the marginal pair incon spicuous mostly visible above, percurrent tertiary veins oriented ± perpendicularly to the midvein, scarcely visible on both surfa ces, quaternary veins reticulate inconspicu ous. Mite domatia absent. Inflorescence terminal, compact, many-flowered, rounded to subcorymbose cymes of 4 to 6 branch pairs, 4-6.5x7-10 cm, sparsely lepidote; peduncle 1-2 cm long, proximal internodes of lowermost branch 1.6-3.5 cm long, distal internodes shorter, proximal internodes of terminal branches 3-5 mm long; bracts early caducous, obovate to spatulate, 4—6 mm long, the lowermost pairs folióse up to 3.5 cm long. Flowers in dichasia, and appearing as in 3 flowered glomerules, each subtended by a pair of early caducous subspatulate brac teoles, ca. 1.3 mm long. Flowers 5-merous, on a short pedicel ca. 0.2 mm long. Hypanthium turbinate, terete, not ridged, ca. 3 mm long, free portion of the hypanthium ca. 0.6 mm long, external surface sparsely lepidote, internal surface glabrous and strongly ridged. Calyx tube ca. 0.25 mm long; calyx teeth broadly triangular, obtuse, ca. 0.25x0.8 mm, glabrous to sparsely lepidote; sepals broadly obovate, rounded, 0.5-0.7 x 0.6-0.7 mm, internal surface glabrous. Petals oblong, 1.75-1.8 x 0.6-0.8 mm, glabrous, purple to fuchsia, the apex blunt with an asymmetrical notch, reflexed, the base obtuse, not clawed. Stamens 10, isomorphic, genicu late, glabrous, arranged around the style; proximal segment (proximal portion of fila ment) 1—1.2 mm long, white; distal segment (anther, connective and distal portion of fila ment) 1-1.25 mm long, anther 0.7-0.8 mm long, with fertile portion of anther sacs ca. 0.4 0.5 mm long, white, opening by 2 longitudinal slits, the connective with an upward- pointing dorsal projection ca. 0.15 mm long, purple. Ovary partially inferior, 1.5—1.7 mm long, 3-locular, free portion of ovary rounded, ridged with apical projections encircling the base of the style, glabrous. Style terete, glabrous, 2.2— 2.5 mm long; stigma truncate. Immature berries subglobose, sparsely lepidote, the surface appearing minutely roughened after drying due to presence of druse crystals. Mature berries and seeds not seen.

description: Shrubs 0.5-1 m tall. Branches terete, along with leaves, hypanthium, calyx, bracts and bracteoles sparsely to moderately granulose- glandulose, these glands 0.1-0.2 mm long, slender, reddish. Leaves opposite, isophyllous, petioles (2.5-)3.5-11.5 cm long; blade 9-21.5 x Ф-10.5 cm, papyraceous, ovate, elliptic, oblong to oblong-lanceolate, apex acute or acuminate, base obtuse to truncate, seldom subcordate or acute, margins entire to repand, ciliolate, basal- acrodromous nerves 3, plus an additional faint, submarginal pair, adaxial surface covered with white, slightly prominent dots, main nerves slightly prominent at their basal portions turning to impressed from the middle to the apex, transversal ones barely perceptible, abaxial sur- face with main nerves prominent, transversal ones impressed, areoles 2.5-3.5 mm wide. Panicles terminal, 10-15x7-15 cm; bracts 1.2- 1 .5 x 0.2-0.4 mm, persistent, lanceolate to linear- lanceolate, apex subulate-aristate; bracteoles 4 subtending each flower, persistent, consisting of two pairs, the outer ones 1-1.2x0.2-0.3 mm, linear-lanceolate, apex aristate, the inner ones narrower, 0.8-1.2x0.2-0.3 mm, linear-lanceo- late, apex subulate-aristate, sometimes with more than one seta at the tip; pedicels 2- 4.5 mm long, thick. Flowers 4-merous; hypanthium 1.8-2.2x1.5-2 mm, campanulate, costate; torus glabrous; calyx persistent, tube 0.4-0.5 mm long, the lobes 0.6-1 x 0.7-1 .2 mm, broadly triangular, apex acute, external teeth 0.3-0.6x0.2-0.3 mm, vertically compressed, thick and hooked, apex aristate, equaling the calyx lobes; petals 4.5-6.5x1-2 mm, white, erect, broadly lanceolate, apex acute, glabrous; stamens 8, filaments 1.5-3 mm long, white, connective 2.5-3.5 mm long, 0.2-0.3 mm pro- longed below the thecae, unappendaged, anthers 2.5-3.3 mm long, yellow, shortly subulate, dorsally curved at the apex, with a single apical pore; ovary 1.8-2x1-1.2 mm, 1/3 -inferior, 4-locular, apex conical, gla- brous; style 5.8-7.2 mm long, glabrous, stigma punctiform. Fruits oblong, 2.5-2.8 x 1.5-1.8, green when unripe; seeds ca. 0.3 x 0.2 mm (still immature), type VII (following Martin & Michelangeli, 2009), pyramidal, raphe ca. 0.3 mm long, plane.

description: Shrubs 0.5-3m tall. Branches terete, along with the bracts, bracteoles, hypanthia and calyx teeth sparse to moderately granulose - glandulose, the glands 0.1-0.2 mm long, mixed with glandular trichomes 0.3-0.5 mm long, and unbranched, strigose trichomes 0.6-1 mm long. Leaves opposite, isophyllous or slightly anisophyllous; petioles 0.4-1.3 cm long; blades (3.5-)5-10x(1.3-)1.8-3.2 cm, papyraceous, elliptic to seldom ovate, apex acuminate, base acute to cuneate, margins entire and ciliolate, sometimes revolute, acrodromous nerves 3, sometimes with a faint additional submarginal pair, basal to suprabasal (distant up to 3 mm from the base), main nerves prominent, transversal ones slightly prominent below, both main and transversal impressed above, prominent and impressed on both faces, areoles 1-2 mm wide, adaxial surface sparsely strigose (but denser on the nerves), the trichomes 0.6-1 mm long, appressed or slightly curved, with a slightly broadened base, and also sparsely granulose-glandulose, the glands 0.1-0.2 mm long; abaxial surface sparsely strigose, the trichomes 0.3-0.5 mm long, appressed, with a slightly broadened base. Flowers in triads, diads or sometimes solitary, on short peduncles 0.8-1.2 mm long, always terminal, but sometimes overtopped by a young lateral branch; bracts 4-12x1.5-2.5 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, persistent; bracteoles 3-4 x 1-2 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, persistent, not involucral. Flowers 4-5-merous, on pedicels 1.5-2.5 mm long; hypanthium 4-5 x 2.5-4 mm, oblong-campanulate, torus glabrous; calyx persistent, tube 0.3-0.4 mm long, the lobes 2-2.8x1-1.3 mm, oblong to narrowly triangular, acute, margins entire, glabrous; external teeth 4.5-5.8 x 0.7-1 mm, about twice as long as the calyx lobes, oblong-lanceolate, acute, margins entire, ciliate; petals and stamens not seen; ovary 1/2-inferior, 2-3 x 1.5-2 mm, 3-locular, apex conical, glabrous. Fruits globose 6-10 x 5-8 mm, dark purple, with 300-500 seeds, type V (following Martin & Michelangeli, 2009), 0.8-1 x 0.4 -0.7 mm, pyramidal, raphe 0.7 - 1 mm long.

description: Tree up to 25 m high; young branches slightly flattened, with inconspicuous interpetiolar ridges, densely covered by sessile to pedunculate stellate trichomes up to ca. 0.4 x 0.2 mm. Leaves opposite; petioles 5.8-9.6 mm; blades 6.4- 15 x 1.6-4.5 cm, oblong, apex cuspidate, base rounded, margin entire, sometimes slightly revolute, chartaceous, longitudinal nerves 5, acrodromous, basal to shortly suprabasal (inner pair up to 2 mm distant from the base), main and transversal nerves prominent on abaxial surface and impressed on adaxial surface, discolorous, adaxial surface with early caducous stellate trichomes, abaxial with two indûment layers, the first consisting of moderate to dense, ferruginous, sessile stellate trichomes, 0.1-0.2 mm diam., and the second consisting of a dense, granulose-furiuraceous layer. Panicles 6.5-1 1 x4-8 cm, terminal, with- out accessory branches, with long basal branches, the main axis and the pair of basal branches with up to 4 branchlets, each one with one apical glomerule or seldom with an addi- tional pair of sub-apical glomerules, each glomerule composed by several clustered dichasia with sessile flowers, inflorescence covered by sessile stellate trichomes up to 0.2 mm diam; bracts 2.3 - 4.6 x 0.8-4 mm, elliptic to broad ovate, entire, caducous, with a basal constriction, abaxial surface covered by sessile stellate trichomes; bracteoles 1.1 - 2.5 x 0.3 - 0.9 mm linear to lanceolate, entire, caducous, abaxial surface covered by sessile stellate trichomes. Flowers 5-merous. Hypanthium 2.3-2.6 mm long to the torus, terete, inner surface glabrous, outer densely covered by sessile stellate trichomes up to 0.2 mm diameter, torus glabrous. Calyx early caducous, inner surface with sparse simple trichomes of less than 0. 1 mm, outer with trichomes similar to the ones on the hypanthium; tube 0.5-0.7 mm high; inner lobes 0.8-1.3 mm long, triangular, acute, outer lobes 1.1 x 1-1 .4 mm, triangular, acute. Petals 2.8-3.4x1.1-1.6 mm, white, obovate, apex round to slightly emarginate, margins entire, both surfaces minutely papillose. Stamens white, slightly dimorphic in size; longer filaments 2.6-3.2 mm, smaller 1.3-2.5 mm, glabrous; connectives prolonged 0.1-0.3 mm below the thecae, ventrally bilobed and with a small dorsal, obtuse tooth; anthers 1.9-2.6 mm in the longer stamens, 1.3-1.6 mm in the smaller ones, oblong with a rounded apex and a single, small pore. Ovary 1.2-2 mm long, basally 1/2 adherent to the hypanthium, 3- celled, the apex stellate-furfuraceous and sometimes also with unbranched trichomes ca. 0.1 mm long; style 5.3-6.2 mm long, straight, glabrous, stigma truncate to capitate. Fruits baccate, 3^4 mm diameter, longitudinally finely ribbed, glabrescent, dark-purple when ripe, with ca. 50 seeds; seeds ca. 0.9-1.3 mm, pyramidal, the raphe covering 80-90% of the side, testa smooth to slightly rugose, the cells not in lines and of different sizes, the anticlinal walls straight to sinuose.

description: Terrestrial. Rhizomes stout, 1.0-1.5 cm diam., scaly, the scales lanceolate, bicolorous, with a central sclerotic band, brown, margins hyaline, ciliate, the cilia up to 5 mm long. Fronds monomorphic, 0.8 - 1.2 m long; petioles ca. half the frond length, dark brown at base and brown distally, with one vascular bundle shaped like an omega with the open end oriented adaxially, scaly at base, the scales 0.5-3 mm long., similar those from the rhizome, grooved adaxially, the grooves continuous to the rachis; laminae pedate, deltate, chartaceous, 8-12 pinnae per frond, stalked or sessile, the stalk ca. 2 cm long, alternate; proximal pinnae pairs 2- to 3-pinnate-pinnatifid, 30 - 40  cm long, rachises 1-2 mm diam, grooved adaxially, sparsely scaly, the scales lanceolate, margins hyaline, ciliate, the cilia 3-5 celled, sparsely scaly abaxially, the scales like those from the adaxial surface, shorter; middle pinnae pairs 1- or 2 - pinnate-pinnatifid, 10-20 cm long; pinnules 6.0 - 17.0 x 1.5 -6.0 cm, base asymmetric; segment margins conspicuously dentate, apex serrate, obtuse; costules glabrous and awned at base adaxially, sparsely scaly abaxially, the scales like those from the rachis abaxially, shorter; venation free, the veins entire or furcate, visible on the abaxial lamina surface. Sori with unbranched paraphyses, the paraphyses 0.1- 0.5 mm long; pseudoindusia whitish, margins entire to slightly unulate, 0.5-5 X ca. 1 mm; sporangia stalked; spores trilete, tetrahedral, 30-40 µm diam., with an equatorial flange, distal face rugate, with low tubercles fused, proximal face rugate, with low tubercles fused adjacent to the aperture plus a few papillae on their surfaces.

description: Lomtaria e grege B. proceri rhizomate deculmbente erecto, 3 cm. crasso, paleis castaneis, nitidis, ovato-acuminatis, integris, ad 2 cm. longis, basi 5 mm. latis, imbricatis dense vestito. description: Slender monopodial shrub 2 m. tall, glabrous, with suleate, brownish-purple stems, slender, spreading, openly-leaved branches, and thin, pendulous pods. Leaves glabrous, bipinnate, petioles 2-3 cm. long, the rhachis 8-12 cm. long, double-ribbed above; pinnae 4-5 opposite in remote pairs, 7-10 cm. long, the rhachilla quadrangular with 4 thin ribs, the upper pronounced, and a thickened ru'gose base bearing 2 strictly ascending, subulate stipels 1-2 mm. long; leaflets 30-50 pairs, glabrous, 4-5 mm. long, 1-2 mm. wide, oblong, asymmetrically lobed below at base, obtuse, margin whitish above middle; veins prominent, palmately branched below, pinnately above base, the midvein very broad, eccentric, lateral veins 6-9, branched near margin; petiolules 0.5 mm. long, whitish, flaring, gland-like; infloreseence an open compound panicle, terminal, the secondary peduncles 4-8 cm. long alternating with uppermost smaller leaves; tertiary peduncles 1-2 cm. long; pedicels 1-2 mm. long; calyx persistent, cupular, the lobes very low and broadly rounded; corolla unknown; pods stipitate, the stipe 5-8 mm. long, valves 6-8 cm. long, 7-8 mm. wide, glabrous, chartaceous, depressed between the seeds, unarmed, light green to purplish-brown, maturing yellow, beaked; seeds quadrangular-oblong, obliquely depressed at hilum and apically, with clearly marked, prominent lateral keels on both sides, brown with dull greenish spots, 4 x 3 x 2 mm.

description: Tree 2.5-20 m; branches strigose to glabrous. Leaves imparipinnately 3-11-foliolate; stipules lanceolate, (1.8-)3.5-8 X (0.4-)0.6-1 mm, glabrous to strigose, persistent; petioles (0.5-)1.5-5(-10) mm, glabrous to puberulous, narrowly alate to terete, canaliculate, wing ca. 3 mm wide; rachis 2.5-18 cm, alate to marginate, canaliculate, the wing to 2 mm wide, glabrous to strigose; petiolule 1.3-4 mm, glabrous to puberulous-strigose; leaflets 3-11, elliptic to ovate, 4-11(-14) X 1.6-5 cm, chartaceous to coriaceous, the lower pairs smaller, the base asymmetric, acute to cordate, the apex acuminate to obtuse, the upper surface glabrous to pilose, the lower surface pilose, the venation prominent beneath and sulcate above. Inflorescence a simple raceme or a panicle or fascicle of racemes, 3.6-18.4 cm, axillary or arising from leafless branches, the axis glabrous to puberulous; bracts triangular to lanceolate, 0.3-2 X 1 mm, persistent, attached to the pedicel base, gla- brous to puberulous; bracteoles lacking; pedicel 0.3-2.5 cm long, glabrous to pu- berulous. Buds globose to ovoid, 2.9-6.5 X 3.5-5 mm, glabrous. Calyx 3-4-lobed, the lobes heteromorphic, glabrous on the inner surface. Petals lacking. Stamens dimorphic, yellow, the larger ones 2-4, filaments 2.5- 8.5 X 0.3-0.6 mm, glabrous, anthers ob- long-ovate, 0.7-2.5 X 0.3-1.2 mm, the smaller stamens many, filaments 2-8 mm, glabrous, the anthers oblate, 0.6-1 X 0.7-1 mm, glabrous. Gynoecium glabrous, the gynophore 2.6-7.5 mm, ovary elliptic to obovate, 2-5.5 X 0.9-2.3 mm, ca. 7-ovulate, the style 0.3-1.5 mm, lateral, the stigma punctiform. Legume ovoid to globose, 1.5- 3 X 0.7-2 cm, glabrous, verruculose, orange, 1-seeded; the seed black, ca. 2.3 X 1.4 mm, the aril white.

description: Short-lived perennial herbs probably flowering the first season, with several simple or at base weakly branched stems 0.5-2.5 (-3) cm diffusely incurved-ascending from the superficial crown of a slender taproot, floriferous from near or above the middle, except for the bright green glabrous or medially glabrate upper face of the loosely conduplicate leaflets gray-strigulose throughout with fine straight forwardly sub- appressed basifixed hairs up to 0.3-0.55 mm, the young foliage cinereous, the older greenish; stipules submembranous pallid or purplish, deltate-acuminate or -apiculate 1.5-4.5 mm, shortly adnate to or behind the petiole, semiamplexicaul-decurrent, not connate; leaves (4-) 5-9 (-10) cm, the slender petiole (1.2-) 1.5-4 cm, the rachis 2-5 (-6) cm; leaflets (9-) 11-19, shortly petiolulate, narrowly oblong-elliptic obtuse minutely mucronulate, 5-18 x 1.5-4 mm; peduncles slender ascending, in fruit mostly humistrate, 4.5-10.5 (-12.5) cm, about as long as the subtending leaf; racemes subcompactly 8-17-flowered, the flowers widely ascending, the axis scarcely elongating, in fruit 1.5-4 cm; bracts membranous deltate or triangular, 0.5-1.6 mm; pedicels ascending, at anthesis 0.7-1.4 mm, in fruit scarcely thickened, up to 2.4 mm; bracteoles either minute or 0; calyx strigulose with white or mixed black and white hairs, 3.3-4.8 mm, the subsymmetrical hypanthium 0.8-1.2 mm deep, the campanulate unruptured tube 2.5-3.5 X 2.2-2.8 mm, the subulate teeth of nearly equal length 0.8-1.3 mm, separated by wide obtuse sinuses; petals except for whitish wing-tips purple, drying blue; banner recurved through + 50?, obtusely rhombic-obovate emarginate 8.5-9 X 6.6-7 mm; wings 7.5-8.3 mm, the claw 2.7-3.3 mm, the narrowly oblong or oblong-obovate, subtruncately obtuse, scarcely incurved blade 5.2-5.7 x 1.9-2.5 mm; keel almost as long as wings, 7.1-8.2 mm, the claws 2.6-3.3 mm, the lunately semi-elliptic blades 4.9-5.3 x 2.5 mm, incurved through ? 85? to the slightly porrect but obtuse apex; anthers 0.5-0.65 mm; ovary strigulose, pseudo- stipitate; ovules 20-24; pod loosely spreading-ascending, commonly humistrate, sessile but elevated out of calyx on and finally disjointing from a strigulose stipelike gynophore 3-4 mm, subsymmetrically ovoid-ellipsoid, bladdery-inflated, including the broadly triangular compressed slightly incurved beak 1.8-2.6 cm long, about half as (when pressed 1.2-2 cm) broad, the papery-membranous semitransparent finely strigulose valves becoming pallidly stramineous, unmottled, finely reticulate, not inflexed, the funicular flange +/- 1.2 mm wide; dehiscence apical, after falling; seeds obliquely ellipsoid, 2.8-3.1 mm long, brown purple-speckled, dull.

description: Perennial herbs with several simple or weakly branched stems 2-4.5 dm, erect or incurved-ascending from the crown of a taproot or from a shortly forking caudex, except for the glabrous pod and upper face of leaflets strigulose throughout with straight appressed basifixed hairs up to 0.3-0.55 mm, the young stems and unfolding leaves canescent, the adult foliage green, the faintly bicolored leaflets yellowish- green above; leaflets (17-) 23-31, all pairs opposite or the upper scattered, in outline lanceolate or narrowly elliptic obtuse to subacute or shallowly emarginate, minutely callous- mucronulate, up to 11-16 x 2.5-4 mm, conduplicate when young becoming plane or almost so; bracts membranous pallid 1.5-2.5 mm; pedicels widely ascending or in age arched outward, at anthesis 1.5-2.5 mm, in fruit a little thickened 2.2-3.5 mm, 2-bracteolate at apex, persistent; calyx thinly black-strigulose 5.3-7.8 mm, the oblique hypanthium 0.7-1.1 mm, the campanulate tube 3.1-4.3 X 2.5-3.8 mm, subgibbous dorsally at base, the subulate teeth 1.5-3.5 mm, the whole becoming dry, marcescent, ruptured adaxially or not, about base of pod; petals whitish, fading ochroleucous, the keel-tip and sometimes the banner faintly lilac-tinged; banner recurved through + 450, rhombic-oblanceolate emarginate 14.8-17.8 X 6.4-8 mm; wings 2-4 mm shorter than banner, 12.7-14.2 mm, the claw 5-5.8 mm, the narrowly elliptic obtuse nearly straight blade 8.5-9.5 X 2-2.6 mm; keel 9.3-11.5 mm, the claws 5-6 mm, the semi-obovate blades 4.8-5.7 X 2.3-3.2 mm, abruptly incurved through 90? to the bluntly deltate apex; anthers 0.65-0.8 mm; ovary subsessile glabrous; ovules 24-33; pod sessile on and finally disjointing from a minute boss no longer than its diameter, in outline broadly lance-acuminate to semi-ovate, bladdery-inflated, 2.3-3.4 cm, below middle 0.8-1.3 cm diam, at base broadly rounded or obtusely cuneate, at apex contracted into a narrowly deltate-triangular, laterally compressed, tardily dehiscent, incurved beak 4-11 mm, the thin pale green or faintly purplish valves becoming stramineous papery semi-traslucent, not inflexed, the funicular flange very narrow, 0.25-0.5 mm; seeds +/- 2.4-2.7 mm, the testa smooth, dark brown faintly purple-dotted.

description:
Juxta A. arnottianum (Gill.) Reiche quoad stipulas amplexicaules concretas ac legumen sessile vesicario-inflatum similem ponendus sed pube minuta inconspicua, foliolis paucijugis elongatis valde acutis, necnon legumine nigro-striguloso (nec glabro) immaculato distans.

Herbae pluricaules e radice verticali lignosa caudiceque breviramoso, quasi glabrae sed stipulis apicem versus petiolis foliolisque inferne pilis appressis basifixis 0.25-0.5 mm longis albis vel nigellis immixtis parce conspersae, foliis viridibus, inflorescentia sparse nigro-strigulosa. Caules ultra basin decumbentem ramosam incurvo-adscen- dentes 1.2-3 dm longi ad medium sive ultra medium simplices ac floriferi. Stipulae pallide membranaceae nitidae extus glabrae (2-) 3-6 mm longae inter se in vaginam amplexicaulem bidentatam (vetustate raro fissam) connatae. Folia (3-) 4-8 cm longa petiolata, rachi rigidula, foliolis 3-6-jugis dissitis lanceolato- vel anguste elliptico-acuminatis acutissimis plerisque conduplicatis antrorsumque incurvis 7-17 (-20) mm longis. Pedunculi incurvi 3-5.5 cm longi folio paullo superati. Racemi laxe breviter 7-14-flori, floribus mox declinatis, axi fructifero vix elongato 1-2 cm longo. Bracteae lanceolatae submembranaceae 2.5-3 mm longae. Pedicelli ad an- thesin + 1 mm, fructiferi subincrassati recurvi 1.5-2.5 mm longi, subpersistentes. Calycis minute 2-bracteolati nigro-strigulosi 5.6-6 mm longi tubus campanulatus 2.8-3 X 2.3-2.6 mm, dentes lanceolato-subulati inter se ac tubo subaequilongi. Petala violacea in sicco coerulescentia, alis apice et vexillo medio albidis: vexillum per 450 resupinatum ambitu late obovato-cuneatum emarginatum 8.2-8.8 X 5.2-5.4 mm; alarum vexillo sublongiorum 8.7-9 mm longarum unguiculus ? 1.1 mm, lamina oblanceolata leviter incurva apice obtuso cucullata ? 6.4 X 2.5-2.8 mm; carinae +/- 6 mm longae unguiculi 2.9-3.2 mm, laminae oblique obovatae 3.4-3.6 X 2.2-2.3 mm in apicem deltatum subporrectum per 1100 incurvae. Antherae 0.5-0.55 mm longae. Ovarium sessile minute strigulosum 12-14-ovulatum, stylo ac stigmate globoso glabris. Legumen laxe pendulum (verosimiliter saepe humistratum) sessile, maturitate e receptaculo conico deciduum, ovoideo-ellipsoideum vesicario-inflatum 13-23 mm longum, 8-11 (in sicco compressum 15 usque) mm diam., aspectu laterali subsym- metrice ellipsoideum, basi obtusum apice abrupte in rostrum brevissimum obscurumve late deltatum subdeclinatum contractum, longitrorsus secus suturam ventralem alte, dorsalem vix sulcatum, valvulis papyraceis demum semidiaphanis stramineis rubro- punctatis (sed haud maculatis) pilis minutis nigellis adspersis, anguste introflexis, septo partiali ad medium 1.2-1.5 mm lato, rostrum versus obsoleto, ala funiculari ? 0.5 mm lata. Dehiscentia (post lapsum) primum apicalis tunc retrorsus per ambas suturas regressa. Semina fusca nigricantia opaca minute foveolata 2.5-2.8 mm longa.
bibliographicCitation: Barneby, Rupert C. 1974. Draguna Hipponmanicum I. Brittonia. 26: 109-114.

description: Frutex, ca. 1 m altus, ramulis patenti-pilosulis; aculei 2-4 mm longi, recti; stipulae triangulari-acuminatae, striatae, basi margine ciliatae, 2 mm longae; petioli 3-5 mm longi, puberuli; folia 1-juga, rhachillis filiformibus, 6-12 mm longis, puberulis; foliola 16-24, linearia, apice obtusa vel acutata, sessilia, basi oblique rotundata, 4-5 mm longa, 1 mm lata, nervo medio subcentrali, supra obsoleto subtus prominulo, nervis lateralibus subtus pauce irregulariter prominulis, subchartacea, laxe pubescentia, supremum oblanceolatum; inflorescentiae capitulatae solitariae in axillis superioribus, racemum formantes; pedicelli albo-pilosi, ad 15 mm longi; flores sessiles 12-15; calyx glaber, longitudinaliter nervosus, 1.5 mm longus, lobis 5, ovato-lanceolatis, acutis; stamina 12-13, rubra, filamentis ca. 15 mm longis, basim in tubo 4 mm longo connatis; legumen ignotum.

description: Arbor parva inermis; rami teretes lenticellosi, juniores brunneo-pilosi; stipulae non visae; folia petiolis 1.5-2.5 cm longis, brunneo-pilosis, plerumque glandula rotunda sessili suffultis vel eglandulosis; pinnae 1- vel 2-jugae, rhachi inter juga eglandulosa, rhachibus secundariis basi glandulam rotundatam gerentibus, foliola 8-18, sessilia, oblique obovata, basi obtusa, apice breviter unilateralia, latere exteriore quam interiore duplo latiore, nervo medio supra paullo impresso, subtus prominulo, nervis lateralibus obsoletis vel subtus paucis anastomosantibus, utrinque glabra subchartacea; inflorescentiae axillares capitatae, pedunculis filiformibus, 5-7.5 mm longis, puberulis; capitula usque 10-flora; flores sessiles, in alabastro tantum visi; calyx 2.5-3 mm longus, tubo glabro, lobis triangularibus 0.2-0.3 mm longis, ferrugineopilosulis; caetera ignota.

description: Suffrutex gracilis ad 2 m altus, ramis erectis, scandentibus, dense sordide fulvo- velutinis. Folia pinnatim trifoliolata; stipulae late triangulares, acutae, 1 mm latae, dense sericeo-velutinae; petioli 2.5-6 cm longi, dense sericeo-velutini; foliola sub- coriacea vel crassa, elliptica vel ovata, acuta vel obtusa, basi rotundata vel sub- cordata, 6-11 cm longa, 4-5 mm lata, integra vel ad marginem minute incrassata, superne dense velutina, costa elevata venisque primariis prominentibus, subtus dense sericeo-velutina, costa venisque primariis elevatis, venis secundariis et tertiariis valde reticulatis, interdum indumento occultatis; petioluli dense sericeo-velutini, folioli terminalis ad 3 cm longi, foliolorum lateralium 2-3 mm longi; stipellae lanceolatae, 1-2 mm longae, 0.5 mm latae, velutinae. Inflorescentia axillaris, pseudoracemosa, 30-50 cm longa, 40-50-flora, ramulis floriferis brevissimis, 2-4-floris; bracteae tri- angulares, acutae, revolutae, 3 mm longae, 2 mm latae, velutinae; pedicelli 1-2 mm longi, velutini, ad apicem bibracteolati, bracteolis ovatis vel triangularibus, acutis, 2 mm longis, 1-1.5 mm latis, extus dense sericeo-velutinis, intus glabris, striatis. Calyx campanulatus, tubo 18-25 mm longo, extus dense velutino, intus dense sericeo, dentibus 4, inaequalibus, acutis, dente superiore ovato-triangulari, 7-9 mm longo, 5 mm lato, intus dense sericeo, extus ad marginem glabro, subherbaceo, medio dense velutino, dentibus lateralibus falcato-ovatis, 6 mm longis, 2-5 mm latis, intus sericeis, extus ad marginem superiorem dense velutinis, ad marginem inferiorem glabris, dente inferiore ovato-triangulari, 10 mm longo, 2-5 mm lato, intus dense sericeo, extus dense velutino. Corolla coccinea; vexillum ovatum, acutum, basi cuneatum, 2.8-3 cm longum, 1.1-1.3 cm latum, minute auriculatum, extus minute cinereo-sericeum, intus glabrum, ungue 5 mm longo; alae oblongo-lanceolatae, obtusae, basi cuneatae, 2.5-3 cm longae, 4-5 mm latae, auriculatae, ungue 5-8 mm longo; petala carinae oblongo- lanceolata, obtusa, 2.5-3 cm longa, 3.5-4.5 mm lata, glabra, minute auriculata, apicem versus connata, ungue 5-8 mm longo; filamentum staminis vexillari infra medium cum ceteris connatum; antherae ellipticae, 1 mm longae, 0.5 mm latae; ovarium lineare, dense sericeo-villosum; stylus basi pubescens, apicum versus glaber. Legumen ignotum.

description: Foliola ovato-elliptica vel obovata, vulgo 7-9 cm longa, acuminata, acumine 5-7 mm, glabriuscula; pubescentia obscura (vidi 30X), dispersa, alba vel brunnea, nervali, 0.25-0.5 mm. Bracteolae caducae, 1.5-2 mm, obtusae. Pediceli 2 mm. Calyx 20 mm longus, pubescentia minuta, adpressa; labio superiori apiculato, quam tubo longiuri margine superiori valde concava, gibbo nullo, quam inferiori multo longiuri, saepe sinu vel fenestro a labio inferiori separato; dente infimo 4 mm longo, acuto, dentibus lateralibus deltoides, dente infimo paulo brevioribus; tubo 10-12 mm lato, basi leniter truncato. Vexillum 4 cm longum, malvino-caeruleum faucibus pallide albo-lineatis (teste Hunt 6098). Alae torsivae. Legumen 7-10 cm longum, 10-13 mm latum, viride (testa Hunt 6098 & 6282), compressum, paulo pubescens, pilis breviorius, albis, sulco inter costas ca. 2-3 mm lato. Semina non vidi. Species nova subgeneris Wenderothiae (Schlecht.) Sauer, Brittonia 16: 123, 1964. Similis modo Brasilianae speciei C. grandiflorae Benth., sed foliolis glabriusculis, bracteolis brevioribus, obtusis, calycis longioris labio superiori non gibboso, leguminis brevioris sulco inter costas propinquo.
