description: Leaves medium-sized (13-) 15-20 (-31) cm long with (5-) 7 (-9) medium-sized leaflets on relatively short, 3-7 mm petiolules; the terminal blade (4-) 8-12 (-14) cm long, (2-) 4-6 (-8) cm wide, mostly ovate or ovate-elliptic, the lower epidermis papillate, reddish or golden-brown puberulent to pubescent, darker glands thinly scattered and most insignificant; axillary buds mostly obovoid, and golden-brown to often gray pubescence (Fig. 5A-C).

description: Leaves small, 10-18 (-20) cm long, with the 5-9 small, glandular leaflets having strongly revolute margins, especially the upper surface often having scattered, small, 1-2 mm diameter, (? insect) pustules, the lower epidermis papillate; terminal blade 5-7 (-10) cm long, 2-3 (-4) cm wide, the petiolules 3-4 mm long, the lower epidermis papillate, reddish or golden-brown pubescent and conspicuously glandular, particularly on the veins and veinlets; flower buds and subsequent flowers the smallest in size of any Dicorynia, the flower buds mostly 5-7 mm long, 4-5 mm wide, the ovary apices are long tapering; axillary buds golden-brown pubescent, oblong and apices acute (Fig. 5D-F).

description: This variety is characterized by the dark-red or golden-brown to chocolate velutinous indumentum of the inflorescence, and the conspicuously glandular lower epidermis of the leaflets. Leaves variable in size 15-47 cm long; leaflets 9-11 (-13), also variable in size and shape, ovate to ovate-oblong, the larger ones with cordate bases, the smaller ones lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate to elliptic, terminal blade 6-18 cm long, 2-10 cm wide, the lower epidermis papillate and dark-red or golden-brown pubescent with numerous dark-red to chocolate-brown glands, the upper epidermis having both the pubescence and glands, but to a lesser degree and the hairs sometimes whitish (perhaps from bleaching), the margins often revolute, petiolules 3-6 mm long; axillary buds spheroid to short-obovoid, covered with the velutinous indumentum characteristic of the inflorescence (Fig. 5G-K).

description: An easily recognized variety, characterized by the white, sericeous, hairs 1-2 mm long found on the external side or backs of the petals; pistils with the usual dark-brown pubescence outside, but also with some pubescence on the inside walls at the base of the ovary. Leaves (12-) 15-26 (-28) cm long, pubescence and glands very sparse to essentially glabrous, leaflets 5-7, ovate to mostly elliptic and oblong, the terminal blade (7-) 8-12 (-16) cm long, 4-5 (-7) cm wide, petiolules 3-6 mm long, lower epidermis non-papillate; axillary buds ovoid, acute, golden-brown to gray puberulent (Fig. 4D-F).

description: Arboles 8-25 (-35) m de alto, perennifolios, corteza interior con fluido resinoso al corte; ramas jóvenes moderadamente amarillento seríceas, pronto glabras. con arreglo dístico en el tallo; estípulas 2.2 mm de largo, ovadas, ligulares, algo cordadas en la base, caducas; pecíolo 2-(-5) cm de largo, terete, estriado; hojas (9-) 13-15(-17)-folioladas; folíolos(4.5-)6-9 cm de largo, (2-)2. 5-3.1 cm de ancho, lanceolados, angostamente elípticos, la base corto cuneada a redondeada, el ápice acuminado a caudado, brillantes y glabrescentes, excepto esparcidamente canescentes sobre las nerva- duras en el haz, esparcidamente canescente sericeo en el envés, cartáceos a subcoriá- ceos, epunteados; nervadura primaria y secundarias marcadas en el envés, nervadu- ras laterales 8-12. Inflorescencias 5.5-14 cm de largo, simples, axilares, congestifloras, pedunculadas, los pedúnculos 2.5-3.5 cm de largo, floración tardía; pedúnculo floral 2-floros, 1.1-2 mm de largo, robusto; pedi- celos 0.8-1.5 mm de largo; bractéolas 1.2- 1.3 mm de largo, 2 mm de ancho, oblatas, opuestas, cercanas y aplicadas al cáliz y cubriéndolo en un 1/4, caducas. Flores 11- 12 mm de largo; cáliz 3-4 mm de largo, casi truncado, epunteado, con la superficie visible oscura, moderadamente pardo-amarillento sericea; corola lila a violeta, epunteada, la lámina del estandarte 10- 12(- 13) mm de ancho, suborbicular, moderada a densamente canescente sericea adaxialmente, en el cen- tro-base densamente sericea abaxialmente; ovario 5- 6-ovulado, densamente canescente y pardo-amarillento sericeo y corto estri- go so. Legumbre 4.5-6 cm de largo cuando una semilla, 6.5-9.5 cm de largo cuando dos y tres semillas, (2-)2.5-2.8(-3.7) cm de ancho, elíptica a oblonga, indéhiscente, sésil, a algo atenuada en la base, obtusa y frecuentemente rostrada en el ápice, com- presa, recta a constricta entre las semillas sobre los márgenes y valvas, coriácea y subleñosa, esparcidamente canescente sericea en la base y ápice, glabrescente a casi glabra, el margen vexilar y carinal aquilla- dos; semillas l-2(-3), 13-13.5 mm de largo, 7.2-7.5 mm de ancho, color castaño a castaño oscuro. Plántulas con los cotiledones epigeos; eófilos opuestos, secundariamente simples, la primera hoja alterna 1-foliolada.

description: Coarse, tufted, tangled-pubescent perennial with numerous short leafy stems arising from a deep, tough, woody taproot, the stems clothed in the closely imbricate 2-ranked persistent stipules and petioles. Leaves numerous, forming clumps; leaflets 3, sparingly pubescent to glabrous above, appressed or tangled-pubescent below, the blades linear to lanceolate or elliptic, entire, acute to attenuate, mucronate, the central leaflet 1.5-6 cm long, 0.3-1 cm wide, the laterals oblique. Stipules scarious, entire, glabrous below, fused to the petioles by over half their length, the prominent midrib prolonged to form the free green and frequently strigose tips. Inflorescence capituliform, the globose heads of 15-20 flowers borne on stout peduncles 0.2-2.8 dm long usually extending above the leaves, the rachis nodes extremely short, the flowers at first erect, the pedicels soon strongly reflexed, the pale to purple bracts reduced to cupulate scales. Flowers with pale violet-purple standards, the keel and wings light to strong violet-purple, becoming brown in age, 13-19 mm long, the appressed villous pedicels recurved, 1-2 mm long; calyx finely pubescent, whitish green with green veins, 4-4.5 mm long, symmetrical, the lobal veins prominent, the sinal veins evident, the lobes long attenuate and of about equal length, 6-7 mm long. Standard obovate-elliptic, to 7 mm wide, curved up- wards often mucronate; wings 12-13 mm long, the blade 7.5-8 mm long, appressed in the lower third to the slightly shorter keel blade, the wings and keel fused to the staminal sheath for about half the length of their claws. Staminal filaments fused to about the base of the keel, free above, the anthers ca 0.8 mm long. Style 4.5-5.5 mm long, the ovary slender with appressed apically directed pubescence. Legume with silvery appressed pubescence, ca 6 mm long, 1.8 mm wide, flattened with a somewhat thickened green margin, 1-3-seeded, the seeds 1-1.5 mm long. Fig. 1.
bibliographicCitation: Gillett, John M. 1965. Taxonomy of Trifolium: five American species of section Lupinaster (Leguminosae). Brittonia. 17: 121-136.

description: Perennial from branched slender rhizomes bearing terminal rosettes or in older plants forming woody taproots bearing short leafy stems. Plants usually glabrous but the peduncle glabrate or with sparse, spreading hairs. Leaves numerous, clustered, the leaflets always three, glabrous, ovate, oblong-elliptic to elliptic, entire, denticulate to dentate, the veins prominent below especially towards the margins, minutely apiculate, 0.8-(1.9)-3 cm long, 0.4-(1)-1.5 cm wide. Stipules membranaceous, oblong, scarious, the proximal end occasionally purple, the free margins entire, the apex acute to short attenuate, 10-15 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide. Inflorescence loosely elongate capituliform, of 2-3 whorls of 4-5 flowers born on a stout scape 0.6-1.4 dm, rarely 2 dm high, extending above the leaves, the rachis extending well beyond the uppermost strongly reflexed flowers. Involucre absent. Flowers 1.5 cm long, uniformly colored, light purple (magenta) becoming strong purple in age, (strong violet in dried specimens); calyx whitish, 8-9 mm long, the tube pilose, 4 mm long, slightly gibbous, the glabrous lobes attenuate, white with a prominent green midvein, the adaxial pair to 4 mm long, the lateral and abaxial to 5 mm long, the margins entire, the sinus rounded. Standard (when spread) broadly ovate, to 9 mm wide, obtuse to retuse, arched upwards towards the apex; wings 13-14 mm long, the blade 8.5 mm long, appressed in the lower third to the slightly shorter keel (1.5 mm shorter). Staminal filaments fused only at the base to the keel claws, the anthers ca 0.4 mm long. Style ca 8 mm long, the ovary slender oblong with short apically directed pubescence, ovules 4. Legume essentially glabrous, 7 mm long, 2.5 mm wide, oblong, the seeds 1-3, usually 2, flattened, rounded, smooth, 2-2.5 mm long. Fig. 2.

description: Leaflets commonly to 12 cm long, chartaceous, ovate, abruptly acuminate to a moderately long, obtuse tip; pubescence short, white, moderately dense on petiolule, sparse to glabrate on both surfaces of blade. Bracteoles 1.5 mm long, rounded. Pedicel 0.5 mm long. Calyx 14 mm long; pubescence short, white or tan, sparse; upper lip much shorter than tube, not exceeding lower teeth, upper edge nearly straight behind non-apiculate tip; lowest tooth 1.5 mm long, acute, equalling rounded laterals. Standard 4 cm long. Pod commonly to 28 × 2.5 cm, compressed, spirally dehiscent, tan, with dense white pubescence; each valve with sutural ribs and 3 extra ribs, one ea 3 mm from ventral rib, the others more or less median. Seeds to 14 × 12 × 3 mm, elliptic, strongly compressed, dark brown with black specks, not buoyant or impermeable; hilum ca 4 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Sauer, Jonathan D. 1964. Revision of Casaratia. Brittonia. 16: 106-181.

description: Leaflets commonly to 11 cm long, coriaceous, oblong-obovate, acuminate to a medium long, obtuse tip; pubescence short, tan, sparse on petiolule and lower surface of blade; upper surface glabrate. Bracteoles 1 mm long, obtuse. Pedicel 1.5 mm lon(g. description: Tree up to 30 m. high; bark aromatic; twigs subglabrous, somewhat angular or distinctly contorted toward tips; petioles slender, glabrous, 11-20 cm. long; leaves 16-30 cm. long; leaflets 4-6 pairs, alternate or opposite, distinctly in- equilateral, glabrous above and below, minutely farinose, punctate (punctations often obscured or indistinct), narrow-ovate-oblong to widely oblong, 2.5-9 cm. long, 1.3-3.5 cm. wide, conspicuously long-attenuate-falcate-acuminate at apex, obtuse at base (rarely cuneate or flat-obtuse), the costa prominent above and below, glabrous or pubescent above, hirsute-pubescent below, the principal secondary veins spreading from costa at an angle of 550-60?, bifurcating toward the margin, the margin slender-callose, glabrous; flowers not seen; fruit (here inde- hiscent) crassate, drying brown or red-brown, oblong-rotund or obovate-rotund, up to 3.1 cm. long, 2.9 cm. wide, obtuse at apex and base, often wide-cuneate at base, the endocarp drying red-brown, the seeds smooth, obovate-oblong, 1.5 cm. long, 1.1 cm. wide, the arillus drying dull red, scarcely crested, partly enveloping base of seed.

description: Arbor ad 25 m.; ramuli nodosi in siccitate obscuro-brunnei vel argenteo- cinerei cortice saepe fracto glabro; petioli glabri graciles longitudine marcescente- striati, 5-15 cm. longi, folia 10-18 cm. longa; petioluli foliolorumn 2-3.5 mm. longi, glabri; foliola 3-4-juga, subopposita, glabra chartacea vel gracili-coriacea punctata falcata lato-ovato-oblonga, 2.5-7 cm. longa, superioria duo plerumque 4.7-7 cm. longa, (1.5) 2-3.5 cm. lata, plerumque 2.5+ cm. lata, apice gradatim in brevi-falcatum acumen attenuata ultime obtusa rare distincte retusa vix aequila- teralia obtusa vel obtuso-rotunda rare basi subcuneatacosta gracile subprominula vel evanescente prominente infra glabra (?) vel supra infraque pubescente principalibus subparallelibus venis secundariis 20? gracilibus prominulis 1-3 mm. distantibus plerumnque ad margines bifurcatis reticulatis distinctis prominulis subpatentibus marginibus gracili-callosis glanduloso-nitentibus minute sparso- pubescentibus; inflorescentiae paniculatae axillares rhachidibus in siccitate brunneis minuteque pubescentibus crassatis in fructu, 1.7-2.2 mm. latis; flores albi; sepala 4 in essentia extus glabra intus crebro-hirsuta ovato-elliptica ad elliptica circa 4 mm. longa, 2-3 mm. lata, obtusa et apice cristata basi obtusa; stamina ?; ovaria marginibus crebro-hirsuta, 2.5+ cm. longa, 1.8+ cm. lata, stylo 3 mm. longo; legumina laevia vel rugosa in siccitate obscuro-rubro-nigra valvis crassis obliquo-oblongis, 3.3-3.5 (+?) cm. longis, 2.5-3 (+?) cm. latis, apicu- latis endocarpo fibroso vel sublaeve seminibus oblongo-rotundis, 1.5-2+ cm. longis, 1-1.5 cm. latis, laevibus, arillo luteo (in vivo) in parte vel omnino semen involvente.

description: Shrub; twigs glabrous; petiole up to 10 cm. long, glabrous, the leaflets 3 or 4 pairs, the members of each pair usually unequal in size, opposite or subopposite, thin and subcoriaceous, impunctate, glabrous, oval or wide-ovate or oblong, 4-8 cm. long, 2.5-5 cm. wide, obtuse-rotund and slightly retuse (the sinus up to 0.5 mm. deep) at apex, obtuse-rotund to subcordate at base, the costa prominulous to plane or seemingly immersed above, prominent beneath, the principal parallel secondary veins 15?, scarcely ascending, prominulous, slender, the reticulate areas compact, dense, prominulous, the margin thin-callose, glabrous, vaguely involute; inflorescence paniculate, axillary, the rachis glabrous, slender, virgate, shorter than leaves; sepals 4, glabrous within and without, ovate-lanceolate, 4.5 mm. long; stamens 10, the anthers 1.4 mm. long; ovaries glabrous; fruit not seen.

description: Trees 30-45 m. high; bark usually weakly aromatic; petioles rusty-tomentose, the leaves 20-30 cm. long; petiolules 2-3 mm. long, tomentose, the leaflets 8-12 pairs, opposite, the basal pairs often smaller, glabrous above, rusty-tomentose below, subequilateral, impunctate, coriaceous, narrow-oblong-lanceolate, 5-10 cm. long, 1.5-2.5 cm. wide, acuminate at apex, obtuse-rotund at base, the costa immersed above, glabrous above,- prominent and hirsute beneath, the principal parallel veins 20 +-, immersed and evanescent above, prominulous and tomentose beneath, scarcely ascending, the reticulate areas scarcely distinguishable, the margin subinvolute, tomentose; inflorescence paniculate, axillary, the rachises tomentose, 10-30 cm. long; ovaries densely yellow-hispid; legumes subsessile, crassate, glabrous, ovate-elliptic or obovate, 4-5 cm. long, about 3.5 cm. wide, obtuse or subacute at apex, the seeds black, subelliptic, the arillus yellow, subcarnose, about three quarters the length of seed.

description: Trees up to 50 m. high; bark coumarin-scented; twigs smooth, the bark reddish or silver-gray, tight or cracking, essentially pubescent toward tip; petioles slen- der, minutely golden-pubescent to subglabrous, 5-17 cm. long, the leaves up to 25 cm. long, glabrous above and below, the petiolules up to 7 mm. long, the leaflets 3-4 pairs, usually subopposite, punctate, inequilateral or not distinctly so, 2-4.5 cm. apart, oblong, oblong-lanceolate, obovate-oblong (rarely ovate- rotund), 4-12 cm. long, 3-5.5 cm. wide, usually tapering obtusely or acuminately into an attenuate-acuminate tip, the latter falcate, or simply cuneate or obtuse at base, the costa plane or subplane above, prominent beneath, pubescent (usually?) above and below, apparently subglabrous below, the principal parallel secondary veins 15-20+, simple for 3/4 their length, usually bifurcating into unequal branches, each branch usually forming a part of a distinct submarginal and wide- undulate or zig-zag vein, irregular-parallel to margin, the reticulate areas patent, conspicuous, the ultimate veins prominulous, each reticulate area enclosing at least one subpapillate glandular punctation; inflorescence axillary, paniculate; flowers white (in vivo); sepals carnose, glandular-punctate under illumination, glabrous or subpubescent on outside, hirsute within, usually narrow-lanceolate, rarely ovate-rotund, 4.2-5.2 mm. long, 1.2-2.5 mm. wide, acute or vaguely obtuse at apex, tapering slightly at base, the veins 1-5+, evanescent or distinct, the margin usually distinct; stamens 10, the filaments unequal, the anthers smooth, oblong or ovate-oblong, 2.3-2.5 mm. long, 1-1.2 mm. wide, obtuse and usually apiculate at apex, cordate at base; ovaries sparse-pubescent on margins of valves, ovate-oblong, 1.8-2 mm. long, 1-1.5 mm. wide, the style (here immature) about 2.5 mm. long; fruit drying red-black or dull-red, vaguely marcescent, the valves often thick, usually curled, 2.5-3.5 cm. long, 2-3 cm. wide, falcate- mucronate or obtuse-apiculate at apex, the endocarp drying yellow-brown or dull red-brown, the seeds drying a lustrous black, sometimes with an oblique ridge across surface, 1.7-2.4 cm. long, 1-1.5 cm. wide, the arillus red (in vivo), drying red, minutely peaked at apex, 1.8 cm. long, 0.8 cm. wide.

description: Arbor; ramuli in siccitate purpureo-nigri laeves vix minute-hirsuto-pubescentes; folia superiora circa 3 cm. distantia, ad 15 cm. longa, petioli minute hirsuto- pubescentes, irregulariter striati vix hirsuto-pubescentes circa 11 cm. longi; foliola 12 (6-juga) supra nigro-brunnea epunctata vix inaequilateralia alternata supra pubescentia comis minutis crebris prope costam ad margines paucis vel nullis infra minute pubescentia angusto-oblonga ovato-oblonga vel rare elliptico- oblonga, 2.5-5 cm. longa, 2-2.5 cm. lata, apice obtusa retusaque ad basim sic obtusa obtuso-rotundata vel subcordata, costa supra gracile pubescenteque infra prominente pubescenteque venis principibus parallelibus secundariis 10-15+ supra infraque gracilibus prominulisque, marginibus gracilibus nitentibus vix undulatis glabris; inflorescentiae paniculatae axillares patentes rhachidibus tenuibus (-1 mm. latis) apice angularibus subnodosisque, 7-8 cm. longis, pube- scentibus ramulis crebre floriferibus inferioribus circa 1.5 cm. distantibus, circa 2.5 cm. longis; sepala inaequalia rubro-brunnea tenuia semipellucida extus glabra intus hirsuta angusto-lanceolata ad ovato-oblonga vel distincte oblonga, 3.9-4.7 cm. longa, 1.5-2.3 cm. lata, venibus distinctis 3-5+, irregularibus ramosis marginibus angusto-scariosis distinctis; stamina 10 filamentis tenuibus, antheris oblongis, 1-1.5 cm. longis, 0.5+ mm. latis; ovaria in siccitate rubro-brunnea crebre hirsutis ubique comis ad medium styli extendentibus ovulis duobus angusto- rectangulare-oblongis, circa 0.8 mm. longis, stylis crassis, circa 3+ mm. longis; stigmatibus capitatis; legumina non visa.

description: Arbor 9-10 m.; ramuli laeves glabri supra in siccitate nigri lenticellis infra evanescentibus supra punctatis; petioli laeves graciles rigidi glabri, ad 6.5 cm. longa; petioluli praecipue glabri marcescentes, 1-1.5 mm. longi; foliola 4-juga, rigida gracile-coriacea nitentia opposita aut alternata punctata subinaequila- teralia glabra elliptico-oblonga vel oblongo-rotunda, 2-4 cm. longa, 1-2+ cm. lata, inferiora plerumque multo breviora, apice lato-cuneata aut obtusa plerumque distincte retusa et indistincto-falcata basi obtuse aut obtuso-rotunda attenuata (rare subcordata) costa supra infraque in siccitate rubescente supra subplana striataque infra prominente eventualiter evanescente glabra venis principalibus secundariis 15? prominulis ab costa angulo 55º-70º abeuntibus ad margines bifurcatis ramis plerumque evanescentibus reticulatis prominulis conspicuis margine gracili-calloso glabro; inflorescentiae paniculatae axillares patentes plerumque foliis vix longiores rhachidibus glabris; sepala lucido-flava in siccitate carnosa inaequalia glabra extus intusque angusto-oblonga vel ovato-oblonga, 4-4.2 mm. longa, 1.8-3 mm. lata, apice cuneata obtusa aut distincte rotundo- obtusa ad basim obtusa venibus 1-5+ evanescentibus aut conspicuis marginibus vix corporibus disjunctis; stamina 10, filamentis 8? mm., antheris glabris oblongis aut ovatis, 1.8-2 mm. longis, circa 1 mm. latis; ovaria in toto glabra laevia ovato-rotunda, circa 1.5-1.7 mm. longa, 1.2-1.4 mm. lata, stylo glabro praeter basim ciliis paucis distantibus, 3.5-3.7 mm. longo, stiginatibus capitatis; fructus non visi.

description: Arbor magna; ramuli laeves cortice in siccitate subnigro lenticellis plerumque distinctis punctatis vel evanescentibus apicibus (ramulorum) paullum angularibus; petioli graciles granuloso-pubescentes, glandulosi, 6-11 cm. longi; description: Tree ? description: Trees up to 15 m. high; twigs smooth, glabrous, the bark drying silver-purple or silver-black, tight or cracking, the lenticels often evanescent; petioles slender, glabrous or rarely golden-pubescent, longitudinally-striate, 4-9 cm. long, the leaves 8-11 cm. long, the leaflets 3-4 pairs, rarely up to 6 pairs, usually drying deep-brown above, inequilateral, elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 2-7 cm. long, 2-3 cm. wide, narrow toward apex with a wide and obtuse falcate acumination, obtuse at base, glabrous above, essentially glabrous, the costa plane above, prominent beneath, usually glabrous above, pubescent (rarely glabrous) below, the principal parallel secondary veins prominulous, slender, 15-20+ in number, 2-5 mm. apart, spreading from costa at an angle of 650, the reticulate areas prominulous, com- pact, subcrassate, the margins slender-callose, glabrous to minute-appressed-pubescent; inflorescence paniculate, axillary, patent, ovate-oblong in outline, the rachis minute-golden-pubescent, longitudinally marcescent, 10-12 cm. long, the branches multiflowered, patent, usually 0.5-1 cm. apart, 3+ (rarely up to 7) cm. long; flowers white (yellow?), the sepals 4, one wider and distinctly concave, red to brown when dry, the corpus mottled under illumination, glabrous on outside, hirsute within, narrow-oblong to narrow-elliptic (rarely wide-oblong or ovate), 3-4.5 mm. long, 1.2-2.3 mm. wide, acute or obtuse, often hirsute-tufted at apex, the veins visible, 1-3; stamens 10, the filaments 7? description: Trees up to 20 m. in height, the trunk yellow; bark of twigs usually tight and smooth (rarely scurfy), often minutely lenticellate, drying red-brown, dull black- brown or somewhat ashen; petioles slender, glabrous or minutely web-pubescent, 3.5-9 cm. long, the leaflets 4-6 pairs, glabrous or minutely pubescent above and below, punctate (at least toward margins of blade or punctations obscured), wide- ovate-elliptic or ovate-rotund, inequilateral and somewhat falcate, up to 7 cm. long, up to 4 cm. wide, the lowermost pair somewhat smaller, attenuate-acuminate at apex, obtuse (often minute-retuse) at tip of acumination, subcordate or obtuse- rotund at base, the costa pubescent above, rarely minutely pubescent (under lens) only at base, pubescent (at least at base) below, the principal secondary veins 12-20+, well-spaced, subcrassate, arcuate, often branching toward margin, pro- minulous or prominent, spreading from costa at an angle of 600-700, the reticu- late areas well-defined, the margin minutely pubescent, hirsute-pubescent or glabrous; inflorescence paniculate, pyramidal in shape, the rachis hirsute, about 13? cm. in length, about 2 mm. wide at base, the branches pubescent, numerous, the basal ones up to 3.5 cm. long; sepals yellow-brown or red, appressed-short-hirsute on outside 3-4 mm. long, 1-2.7 mm. wide, subacute to short-obtuse-acuminate at apex, the veins indistinct, 1-5; stamens 10, the filaments 5-7 mm. long, the anthers oblong or rarely ovate-oblong, 1.4-2 mm. long, 0.6-0.9 mm. wide, apiculate at apex, cordate at base; ovaries densely short-hirsute on mar- gins, oblong or subrotund, 1.4-2 mm. long, 1.2-1.5 mm. wide, the styles 2-3 mm. long; fruits smooth, pink or red (in vivo), drying red or black-brown, unequal, oblong, 2.5-3 cm. long, 2? cm. wide at dehiscence, the seeds black, smooth, 1.5-1.7 cm. long, 0.8 cm. wide, the arillus white (in vivo), apparently enveloping the entire seed.

description: Large trees 20-30 m.; twigs smooth or often knotty toward apex, the bark tight or cracked, drying silver-gray, brown, or black-brown, glabrous, the lenticels rugose or evanescent; petioles pubescent, slender, 13-15 cm. long, the leaves up to 16 cm. long, the petiolules pubescent, 1-2.5 mm. long, the leaflets 4-6 pairs, usually alternate, adjacent, the pairs as much as 1.5 cm. apart, glabrous (except on costa and margins), glandular-punctate, inequilateral, subfalcate, ovate elliptic or sublanceolate, rarely obovate-elliptic, 3-5 cm. long, 1-3 cm. wide, the lowest pair usually a half (or more) the size of the upper, tapering obtusely or narrowly into a short-(rarely long-)acuminate or falcate tip, cuneate to subrotund at base, the costa pubescent above, pubescent to glabrous beneath, the principal parallel secondary veins 15-20+, prominulous, ascending from costa at an angle of 60º-70º, the reticulate areas prominulous, distinct, patent, the margins slender-callose, pubescent to subglabrous; inflorescence paniculate, axillary, as long as or shorter than leaves, the rachis dense-golden-pubescent, slender or crassate, 0.1-0.2 cm. wide at base, 3-20 cm., usually 10-13 cm. long, angular and contorted, the branches patent, the basal ones up to 4.5 cm. long, 8-12-flowered; flowers white (in vivo), the sepals 4, usually one distinctly concave, drying red-brown, scarcely marcescent on back, frequently mottled (under illumination), glabrous or sparse-hirsute on outside, hirsute within, ovate-lanceolate to oblong, 3.2-4 mm. long, 1.4-2.5 mm. wide, tapering narrowly into an obtuse tip or obviously obtuse at apex, usually tufted-hirsute, obtuse at base, the margin slender-scarious, the veins 1-3, often indistinct; description: Large trees up to 50 m. high, the trunk straight, up to 1.5 m. wide, the bark smooth; twigs drying dull gray-brown, the outer bark scaling off unevenly, the lenticels usually white and rugose; petioles slender, glabrous, 7-9.5 cm. long, the leaves up to 10 cm. long, the leaflets 8 pairs, opposite or somewhat alternate, subsessile, punctate (punctations often obscure), thin-coriaceous, glabrous above, farinose-villose or glabrous below, wide-ovate, wide-elliptic (rarely wide-obovate or oblong), 3-7 cm. long, 2-4.5 cm. wide, tapering unequally and ob- tusely into a conspicuous acuminate tip (often attenuate), obtuse and retuse at tip of acumination, obtuse-rotund and rarely subcuneate at base, the costa gla- brous or pubescent, the secondary veins prominulous, 20?, well-spaced, arcuate-ascending, parallel, spreading from costa at an angle of 65?.-85? in middle of blade, usually forking near margin, enclosing delicate reticulate areas, the margin thin-callose, minutely appressed-pubescent or glabrous; inflorescence paniculate, axillary, oblong, the rachis slender, usually erect, up to 17 cm. long, minutely golden-yellow, appressed-pubescent, the branches subdistichous, at right angles to rachis or scarcely ascending, the basal branches up to 4 cm. long, densely flowered; flowers white, the sepals subequal or equal, yellow-brown or dull red-brown, pubescent on outside, hirsute within, elliptic-oblong or narrow- oblong, 3.8-4 mm. long, 1.3-2.5 mm. wide, subdeltoid to obtuse, often tufted, at apex, obtuse at base, the veins usually visible, 1-3, the margins often wide-scarious; stamens 10, the filaments up to 9 mm. long, the anthers oblong, about 2 mm. long, 1 mm. wide, apiculate at apex, cordate at base; ovaries silky-white-hirsute on margins, 1.7-2 mm. long, 1.5-1.8 mm. wide, the styles 2.5-3.5 mm. long; fruit not seen.

description: Plants to 2 m tall. Leaves unifoliolate, oblong to oblong-elliptic, 3-7.5 x 0.7-2.3 cm, at apex obtuse to mucronulate, at base cuneate or rounded, sparsely seri- ceous above and beneath. Stipules absent. Inflorescences terminal, 2-7 (8) cm long, bearing 1-5 flowers, bracts lanceolate or ovate-lanceolate, 7-10 mm long, usually persistent. Bracteoles on base of calyx. Flowers 12-22 mm long; calyx 12-22 mm long, brown velutinous. Banner yellow, 14-17 x 17-18 mm, bearing two lamelliform appendages at base. Wing petals obovate, 13-15 x 6.5-7.5 mm, claws 2.5-2.8 mm long. Carina 1.5-1.9 x 0.8-1 cm, beak twisted. Stamens dimorphic, elongate anthers 2.1-4 mm long, short ones 0.5-0.8 mm long. Ovary oblong, with a sharply geniculate style, measuring 10.5-12.5 mm from bend. Legume 3-4.4 cm long. Seeds ?26, to 4 mm long, dark brown.

description: Shrub, aphyllous or leafy at anthesis, usually armed with spines; branchlets stout, usually aculeate; petioles 8-36 cm. long, occasionally aculeate, pubescent when young, at length glabrous; petiolules 4.5-12 mm. long, 1.5-2 mm. in diam., pubescent when young, at length gla- brous; leaflet-blades chartaceous, pubescent with soft villous hairs when young, at length glabrous in all parts, usually spineless, not ceriferous beneath; terminal leaflets usually rhombic-ovate, 8.5-26 cm. long, 6.4-19 cm. broad, usually long-acuminate at apex (acumen up to 6 cm. long), rounded or truncate at base; secondaries 7-9 per side; rachis 5.5-30 cm. long, densely pubescent with long rather spreading hairs, at length glabreseent proximally; pedicels 0.4-1 cm. long, about 0.6 mm. in diam., pubeseent as rachis; bracts linear-lanceolate, usually 3.5-6 mm. long and about 0.8 mm. broad; bracteoles similar to bracts, usually 1.6-2.3 mm. long and 0.-0.5 mm. broad; calyx chartaceous, campanulate, 10-20 mm. long on the carinal side (ineluding tooth), 9.5-15.5 mm. long on the vexillar side, 1.5-2.5 mm. broad at base, ampliate to 7-11 mm. toward apex, at margin entire or obscurely den- ticulate, provided with a blunt tooth up to 4.5 mm. long on the upper carinal side, pubescent when young, soon glabreseent or glabrous; standard red, usually narrowly elliptic, 4.4-8.6 cm. long, 0.9-1.8 cm. broad, rounded and often retuse at apex, cuneate or cuneate-clawed at base; wings 9-17 mm. long, 5-7 mm. broad; keel-petals rounded and apiculate dorsally at apex (acumen about 1 mm. long), narrowed or shortly clawed at base, 8-14.5 mm. long, 3.5-6 mm. broad; stamens 5.2-6.6 cm. long, separate for 1.4-2.7 cm.; pistil 4.6-7.2 cm. long, the ovary and gynophore densely pubescent; fruit-pedicels approximately 1 cm. lonig and 1.5 mm. in diam.; pods subligneous, 14-16 cm. long, about 1.3 cm. broad, deeply constricted between seeds, with a stipe 3-4.5 cm. long, with an acumination 1.7-3 cm. long, many-seeded; mature seeds not seen.

description: Small or medium-sized tree, usually leafy at anthesis, armed with spines; branchlets rather stout, usually aculeate; petioles 4.5-23 cm. long, soon glabrous, often aculeate; petiolules 5-11 mm. long, 0.7-2 mm. in diam., soon glabreseent or glabrous; leaflet-blades subcoriace- ous, soon glabreseent (the villous rufous hairs on costa and secondaries often persisting), minutely reticulately ceriferous beneath (occasion- ally indistinctly so on old leaflets), often distinctly paler beneath than above, spineless; terminal leaflets rhombic-ovate or rhombic-orbicular, usually longer than broad, 4.4-13 cm. long, 4.2-12 cm. broad, obtuse or acute at apex, broadly cuneate (or rounded or truncate) at base; secondaries 6-9 per side; radhis 6-23 cm. long, shortly pubescent, soon glabreseent proximally; pedicels 0.2-0.5 cm. long, about 0.7 mm. in diam., puLbeseent as radhis; larger bracts about 2.7 mm. long and 1.3 mm. broad, the smaller ones usually 0.9-1.4 mm. long, 0.4-0.7 mm. broad; bracteoles similar to the smaller bracts; calyx subcoriaceous, campanulate or campaniulate-tubular, 9-21 mm. long on the carinal side, 9-20 mm. long on the vexillar side, 2.5-3 mm. broad at base, ampliate to 5.5-8.5 mm. at apex, at margin usually entire (rarely obscurely denticulate or deeply lobed), calearate (often obscurely so) on the upper carinal side, densely but shortly pubescent with decidu- ous hairs; standard usually bright red, narrowly elliptic, 4.6-8.4 cm. long, 0.7-1.5 cm. broad, obtuse or rounded and often retuse at apex, cuneate or cuneate-clawed at base; wings rounded and often unguici- late toward apex, occasionally hastate on one side, narrowed or clawed at base, usually longer than (occasionally subequal to) keel-petals, 11-19 mm. long, 2-4 mm. broad; keel-petals short- to long-apiculate dorsally at apex, not at all sagittate or hastate (hastate in specimens of a forni from higher elevations in Puebla), narrowed or clawed at base, 10-17.5 mm. long, 3-5 mm. broad; stamens 4.2-6.4 cm. long, sepa- rate for 1-2.6 cm.; pistil 3.6-6.8 cm. long, the ovary and gynophore densely pubescent with rather spreading hairs; fruit-pedicels 0.7-1.1 cm. long, 1.5-3 mm. in diam.; pods subligneous, 14-31 cm. long, 1.5-1.9 cm. broad, shallowly, and between some seeds deeply, constricted (not moniliform), more or less straight (usually neither coiled nor much twisted when mature), gradually tapering below into a stipe 4-6.5 cm. long, with an acumination 2-3.5 cm. long, usually many-seeded; seeds scarlet, with a black line extending from the hilum for 1-2 mm. toward the chalazal end, 10-15 mm. long, 6.5-9 mm. broad.

description: A very large tree with stout trunk, armed with spines, aphyllous or with young leaves at anthesis; branchlets rather slender, aculeate; petioles 8.5-16 cm. long, glabrous, often aculeate; petiolules 5-8 mm. long, 1.2-1.8 mm. in diam., glabrous; leaflet-blades chartaceous to subcoriaceous, glabrous; termlinal leaflet subrotund or rhombic-ovate or broadly ovate, 6.8-12.5 cm. long, 7-11 em. broad, abruptly acute or rounded at apex, truncate to cuneate at base; costa often aculeate above or beneath, the secondaries 6-8 per side; rachis 9.5-23 cm. long, puberulent to glabrous; pedicels 2.2-5.2 cm. long, 0.4-1 mm. in diallI., glabrous; bracts and bracteoles not seen; calyx chartaceous, broadly campanulate, asymmetric, 9-11 mm. long on the carinal side, 8-11 mm. long on the vexillar side, about 1 mm. broad at base, ampliate to 9-15 mm. at apex, the calyx being stretched transversely at anthesis, entire or nearly so at margin, somewhat callose and calearate on the upper carinal side (spur up to 1 mm. long), thickened toward base, glabrous; standard yellowish rosy or rosy, elliptic or broadly elliptic, 3.7-5.1 cm. long (including claw), 2.4-2.9 cm. broad, rounded anid often elliarginate at apex, the claw up to 3 mm. long; wings somewhat deltoid, 5-7 mm. long, 2-3.5 mm. broad; keel-petals falcate, 35-44 mm. long, 6-8 mm. broad; stamiiens 4.4-5.2 cm. long, separate for 0.5-1.2 cm.; pistil 4.1-5 cmii. long, the ovary shortly torneentellous (hairs very fine and not branched), the gynophore glabrous; fruit-pedicels 3.5-4.5 cm. long, about 1.5 mm. in diam.; pods chartaceous, 12-19 cm. long, 1.1-1.4 cm. broad, not at all constricted, with a very slender stipe 2.1-2.5 cm. long, with a very stiff acumination about 0.8 cm. long, 1-3-seeded; seeds umber with sooty markings, at length coffee-brown without nmarkings, 12-14 mm. long and 5-6 mm. broad.

description: Small tree, leafy at anthesis, armed with spines; branchlets rather stout, strongly aculeate; petioles 3.5-19.5 cm. long, usually aculeate, soon glabrescent or glabrous; petiolules 2-7 mm. long, 0.7-3 mm. in diam., puberulent to glabrous; leaflet-blades chartaceous, soon glabrous or nearly so in all parts, usually regularly aculeate (spines usually 1.5-7.5 mm. long) on costa and secondaries above and beneath, not ceriferous beneath; terminal leaflets rhombie-rotund or broadly ovate-rhombic, 3-14.5 cm. long, 3.5-13.5 cm. broad, rounded to acute at apex, usually truineate or subcordate at base; secondaries 5-7 per side; rachis 7-17 cm. long, pubeseent or puberulent with spreading hairs, soon glabreseent; pedicels 0.2-0.4 cm. long, about 0.4 mm. in diam., pubes- cent as radhis; bracts not seen; bracteoles ovate, about 0.8 mm. long and 0.5 mm. broad; calyx chartaceous, campanulate, 9-13 mm. long on the carinal and vexillar sides, 1.3-3 mm. broad at base, ampliate to 5-8.5 mm. at apex, at margin obscurely deniticulate or entire, provided with a small blunt tooth on the upper carinal side, puberulent with deciduous hairs; standard scarlet, narrowly oblanceolate, 4.5-6.5 cm. long, 0.9-1.5 cm. broad, usually retuse at apex, cutneate or cuneate- clawed at base; wings 5-8 mm. long, 2.5-3.5 mm. broad; keel-petals rounded and occasionally shortly apiculate dorsally at apex, narrowed at base, 3.5-6.5 mm. long, 2.5-3.5 mm. broad; stamens 3.5-5.7 cm. long, separate for 0.9-2 cm.; pistil 3.4-5 cm. long, the ovary and gynophore densely pubescent with subappressed hairs; fruit-pedicels 0.6-1 cm. long, 1.5-3 mm. in diam.; pods subligneous, 9-25 cm. long, 1.3-1.7 cm. broad, constricted between seeds (not moniliform), with a stipe 1.5-3.5 cm. long, with an acumination 0.9-2.2 cm. long, usually many-seeded; seeds scarlet with a broad black line extending from the hilum for approximately 1-2 mm. toward the chalazal end, 12-14 mm. long, 8-9.5 mm. broad.

description: Arbuscula 3-6 m. alta; foliis pinnatis 6-8 cm. longis; petiolo 1.5 cm. longo, sparse albi-pubescenti; foliolis 1-2-jugis ovatis, breviter acuminatis vel subacutis, tenuibus, sparse puberulentibus, lateralibus 2-3 cm. longis 1.2-1.4 cm. latis, ter- minali 3.5-4 cm. longo, 2-2.5 cm. lato; infloreseentia terminali paniculata dense sericea; pedicellis ca. 5 mm. longis bifloris; floribus 17-18 mm. longis, bracteolis 2 dense pubeseentibus subtentis; cailyce rubro eineroo sericeo cupulato ca. 5 mm. alto; corolla violacea puberulenta unguibus 7 mm. longis; stylo hispiduloso; ovario dense albo pubeseente; legumine ignoto.

description: Slender shrub or small tree 3-6 m. tall with bark brownish gray to greenish. Branchlets brownish, sparsely white-pubescent, somewhat flexuous; leaves pin- nate, 6-8 cm. long; petiole about 1.5 cm. long, sparsely white-pubescent; leaflets 3 to 5, ovate, shortly acuminate with rounded tips, thin, sparsely, finely white- pubescent above and below, more densely so along the-veins, 2-3 cm. long, 1.2-1.4 cm. wide, the terminal leaflet larger, 3.5-4 cm. long, 2-2.5 cm. broad; mid-vein regularly pinnately branched; lateral veins 5-6 bending upward away from the midvein to 500 or 600 angle, all more prominent below than above; infloreseence terminal, paniculate, with dense, short, dull pubescence; peduncles 7-10 cm. long; pedicels about 5 mm. long, commonly 2-flowered; flowers at anthesis 17-18 mm. long, subtended by 2 grayish, densely pubescent, round bract8 2.5 mm. long; calyx dull reddish, densely grayish-pubescent, cupular, about 5 mm. high, 5-7 mm. broad at rim; banner lavender with a greenish-yellow tinge on the middle, orbicu- lar, 17-18 mm. long, wider than long, emarginate to an apical gland; wing petals pink-lavender, faleately ovate, broadly rounded at apex, broadly lobed on the upper margin near the middle and more acutely lobed at base, pubeseent outside, joined to the keel below the middle of the blade, blade 10 mm. long, claw 7 mm. long; keel petals pink-lavender, blades falcate-oblong, apex rounded, 9 mm. long, claw 7 mm. long, pubescent within and without along the lower margins; style hispidulous within 2 mm. of stigma; ovary densely white-pubescent; legume un- known.

description: Plants perennial, caespitose herbs, to 14 cm tall; stems fistulose, 4-5 mm in diam, completely covered with white lanate, spreading, tangled hairs, becoming tawny in age, 1-1.5 mm long, with a matted undercoat of shorter hairs, lower internodes of the flowering culms 2.5-3 cm long; stipules 5-7 mm long, the sub- ulate free tips 3-4 mm long, densely lanate dorsally; petioles of the larger leaves 5-7 cm long, lanate as stems; leaflets 9-11, oblanceolate, thinly covered with soft curly hairs above, densely lanate below, tips obtuse to rounded, mucronulate, the largest 2.5-3 cm long, 5-7 mm wide, mostly conduplicate; penduncles 5-9 mm long, lanate, racemes 2.5 cm long, flowers scattered; bracts lance-shaped, 3-4 mm long, lanate dorsally; pedicels 2-3 mm long at anthesis, lanate; calyces densely lanate outside, glabrous within, lower lip 5.5-6 mm long, lance-triangular, minutely tridentate, upper lip 4.5-5 mm long, bifid, the notch 3.2 mm deep, lips connate 1.2 mm, bracteoles triangular, 0.5 mm long, attached 0.4 mm below the lips of the lateral sinuses; banner suborbicular, glabrous, 8-8.5 mm long, 8 mm wide, reflexed 3.5-4 mm, appressed 4.5 mm, reflexed/appressed ratio 0.8-0.9; wings 9.5-10 mm long, 4.8 mm wide, the claw 1.9 mm long, lobe above the claw 1.7 mm wide; keel glabrous or with occasional cilia midway along the upper margin, 2-2.5 mm wide in the middle; ovules 4-5; immature legumes densely lanate; seeds not available.

description: Perennial subshrub arising from taproot with numerous laterals bearing round nodules (Venezuelan plants and reported by Allen & Allen, 1981; Burkart, 1957; Barrios & Gonzales, 1971). Main stems 1-20, 2-20 dm tall and up to 2 cm in diameter, with oldest parts bearing grayish-brown bark and youngest green. Young branches, petioles, and rachises bearing numerous appressed silky hairs and scat- tered pustular-based hairs. Stipules acicular, ca 1 cm long. Leaves alternate, imparipinnate, bearing 3-9 leaflets, becoming appressed toward stem at night, 3-10 cm long, petiolate. Leaflets alternate or subopposite, refiexing toward rachis at night, 1-3.5 cm long, 0.5-1.8 cm wide, with terminal larger than laterals, obovate to elliptic, cuneate at base, mucronate at apex, villous on both surfaces, with scattered red pustular-based hairs on upper surface especially towards margins and 1 or 2 similar hairs at base, with red reticulate pattern (upon drying) on lower surface. Inflorescence axillary, 1-3-flowered, subtended by 2 acuminate bracts 8 mm long and 1.2 mm broad at base. Flowers subsessile, maturing acropetally, each subtended by 3 bracteoles. Ventral bracteole 7 mm long, 2 mm broad at base, 3-veined, setulose. Lateral bracteoles slightly shorter and 1/2 as broad, 1-veined, setulose. Hypanthium glabrous, 2-4 mm long, tubular. Calyx bearing mixture of appressed silky and red pustular-based hairs, 5-lobed, tube 3-4 mm long, with upper 2 lobes partially united, with lateral 2 about length of tube, lower lobe 2-3.5 mm longer. Corolla orangish yellow with lighter colored keel. Standard unguiculate, up to 1.5 cm long, with bifid apex, pilose along margins or over entire outer surface. Wings 1.3-1.5 cm long, spreading. Keel 1.2 cm long, open on upper margin. Stamens 10, monadelphous, with filaments subequal and connate (open along dorsal surface) into tube 10-15 mm long and free portion 5 mm long, with basifixed anthers 1 mm long. Ovary 2 mm long, with silky appressed hairs, usually 5-6-ovulate, with glabrous filiform hollow style 12-24 mm long, with minute papillose terminal stigma. Loment erect, subterete, 1.5-3 cm long, 0.4-0.5 cm wide, both sutures straight, osseous, outer surface villous to subgla- brous with 8-9 conspicuous veins and reticulate interstices, with 3-5 (6) segments disarticulating on plants. Seed yellowish-beige, 3-3.5 mm long, 2.5 mm wide, with cotyledons auriculate at junction with radicle. Germination epigeal. 2n = 20.

description: Trees to about 30 m tall, the trunk to 1.5 m diam with buttresses about 1.8 m high; young stems puberulent; stipules not seen; leaves (8) 9-13 (14)-foliolate, the rachis to about 15 cm long, subglabrous; leaflets with puberulent petiolules about 3 mm long, the blades predominantly oblong to lanceolate-oblong, 4.3-13 cm long, 1.8-4.6 cm wide, acuminate, aristate at the apex, the base rounded or subcordate, glabrous or appressed-pubescent on the lower surface; inflorescences with axes, bracts, and bracteoles brown-tomentulose; bracts lanceolate, about 4 mm long, caducous; bracteoles lanceolate or lanceolate-oblong, slightly shorter than the bracts, caducous; flower buds acute; flowers about 10 mm long; calyx 7-7.5 mm long, 3 mm diam; petals dark purple; ovary appressed-pilose, 4-5- ovulate; fruit winged, 1-2-seeded, essentially glabrous at maturity, about (7) 10-12 cm long, the basal seminiferous body 3-4.4 cm long, 2.2-4 cm wide, the terminal wing 7-8.7 cm long, 3.8-4.5 cm wide, rounded at the apex.

description: Trees to about 20 m tall; young stems appressed-pubescent, glabrescent; sti- pules not seen; leaves (3, 4,) 5-foliolate, the rachis about 7 cm long; leaflets with petiolules 3-5 mm long, the blades ovate-elliptic, acuminate, (3) 5-15 cm long, (1.5) 3-7 cm wide, at base rounded to cordate, the surfaces glabrous, nitid; inflorescences with axes, bracts, and bracteoles brown-puberulent to sericeous; bracts and bracteoles lanceolate, 3-4 mm long, 0.75-1 mm wide; flower buds acute at apex and base, somewhat obliquely curved; flowers 10-13 mm long; calyx 6-7 mm long, 3-5 mm diam, sericeous; petals dark purple with greenish-white markings; ovary appressed-pilose along the margin; fruit essentially glabrous at maturity, about 5-6 cm long with a terminal wing slightly cultriform or straight, the basal, seminiferous body 2-2.5 cm long, 3 cm wide, the wing 3-3.5 cm long, usually acute at the apex.

description: Trees to about 12 m tall, the trunk to 3 m diameter; young stems puberulent; stipules linear, attenuate, about 15 mm long, 0.5 mm wide, puberulent, longitudinally striate; leaves 3-5-foliolate, the rachis 2-4.5 cm long, sparsely puberulent; leaflets with petiolules 2-3 mm long, the blades ovate to oblong or the terminal leaflet obovate-oblong, 5-10 cm long, 2-4.5 cm wide, acuminate and apiculate at apex, rounded at base, the upper surface glabrous, nitid, the lower surface puberulent, especially along the midvein, glabrescent; inflorescences with axes, bracts and bracteoles brown-sericeous to tomentulose; bracts ovate, acute, 3 mm long, 2 mm wide at base; bracteoles ovate, acute, 2.5 mm long, 1.5 mm wide; flower buds subacute; flowers about 12-13 mm long; calyx (7.5) 8-10 mm long, 4 mm diam, subsericeous to tomentulose; fruit brown, tomentulose, glabrescent with age, about 2.5-3.5 cm long, 2.5 cm wide, ovate without a conspicuous terminal wing, sometimes slightly alate or crested along one side, the apex acute.

description: Tree 6-24 (-40) m tall, evergreen. Young branchlets puberulous to glabrous. Leaves petiolate, 8-18 mm long; stipules very small, caducous. Leaflets ovate to elliptic or oblong-elliptic, asymmetric, 3.5-12 cm long, 2.0-5.7 cm wide (smaller ones often present with the inflorescence, larger [to 15 X 7.4 cm] on juvenile shoots), coriaceous, glabrous or subglabrous, obtusely pointed to shortly subacuminate. In- florescence paniculate, panicle to 35 X 25 cm but often much smaller, flowers spirally arranged along the ultimate raceme branches; pedicels jointed at base; bracts and bracteoles ovate or orbicular, concave, caducous. Flowers small for the genus; sepals 7-11 mm long, densely appressed-pubescent outside and silvery silky inside; petals 5, either all 3 of the upper ones clawed, suborbicular and subequal, with the 2 lower minute and scale-like, or all clawed and subequal. Large petals ca. 1.5-2.0 cm long; lamina ca. 8-10 mm in diam. Ovary short-stipitate, densely hirsute at the base, more or less glabrous above; ovules 4. Fruits ovoid-oblong, ellipsoid-oblong, or obovoid, 2.5-5.0 cm long, 1.5-3.0 cm wide, coarsely verrucose-rugose. Seeds 1 to 3, ellipsoid, 1.3-1.8 X 0.9-1.2 cm. Chromosome number: 2n = 24.

description: Liana 6-20 m tall, 5-10 cm dbh. Leaves 10-32 cm long; stipules caducous, sometimes forming tendrils provided with thorns, up to 100 cm long; rachis glabrescent, fissured or with sparsely brownish-tomentose; leaflets 5-8, obovate or elliptic, 6-12 x 2-6 cm, membranaceous, glabrous above, sparsely brown-puberulous below, the margin repand, the base rounded to obtuse, the apex cuspidate, 7-9 mm long, sometimes with a mucro 1 mm long; midvein prominent; secondary venation camptodromous; tertiary venation reticulate; petiolule 7-9 mm long. Inflorescence an axillary raceme, 4-9 cm long; bracts ovate, 1.5-3 mm; peduncle dark-brown tomentose. Flowers cream, 8-9 mm long, sessile; bracteoles ovate, 1 mm long; calyx 3-4 mm, ferrugineously tomentose to woolly, truncate; banner 9 x 6-9 mm, tomentose on margins and centrally on abaxial surface; keel petals 6-11 x 3-5 mm, tomentose on the margin and inner central keel; wing petals 9 x 3.2 mm, with lamellate sculpturing; stamens 10, monadelphous, 6-7 mm long, the free part of filaments 1-2 mm long; style curved, 5-7 mm long, hirsute above the middle. Fruit a one-seeded samara, 8-12 x 2.5 cm, glabrescent, with lustrous dark-brown color when dry; seed 2.5-3 cm long.

description: Frutex gracilis ad 1 m altus; rami erecti glabri, apice pube recta albida appressa induti. Folia pinnatim trifoliolata; stipulae setaceae, 3-5 mm longae; petioli 2-5 mm longi, glabri vel parce pubescentes; foliola coriacea, ovato-oblonga vel lanceolata mucronata, basi anguste cuneata, 3.5-10 cm longa, 1.5-3 cm lata, integra, supra glabra vel nitida, subtus elevato-reticulata, glabra vel secus venas puberula, subtus interdum pallida; petioluli glabri vel parce pubescentes, folioli terminalis ad 8 mm longi, foliolorum lateralium ad 5 mm longi; stipellae stipulis conformes. Racemi axillares laxe divergentes 2-4 (-8) -flori, apicum versus ramulorum terminatium et quam folia cingentia multo longiores; pedunculi ascendentes, 4-7 cm longi, glabri vel parce pubescentes; bracteae triangulares acuminatae, + caducae, 1-2 mm longae; pedicelli graciles inaequales 1-2 cm longi, pubescentes; bracteoleae late ovatae acumi- natae integrae striatae, 3-8 mm longae, pubescentes; calyx late campanulatus, bilabiatus, 7-12 mm latus, 8-10 mm longus, pubescens vel puberulus; lobi calycini superiores 3 mm longi, 5 mm lati, dentibus 2 subconnatis; lobi inferiores dentibus 3 late triangularibus, dorsalis 4 mm longus, 2 mm latus, laterales 2 mm longi aequilati; vexillum orbiculatum 2.2-3 cm longum, 2-2.5 cm latum, extus pubescens, sacculo basali 2 mm longo aequilato; alae oblongae, basi auriculatae, ut vexillum albidae vel purpureo-subroseae, carina coeruleo-violacea; stamina 18-25 mm longa, antheris orbicularibus 1-1.5 mm longis; stylus glaber, incurvus; stigma terminale, 1 mm latum; ovarium subsessile, pubescens. Legumen plano-compressum, basi acuminatum, 10-15 cm longum, 0.5-0.8 cm latum, pubescens, suturis conspicue incrassatis; semina compressa parva, 2-3 mm longa.

description: Arbor ad 15 m alta, ramis ferrugineis, sulcatis. Stipulae ignotae; petioli 18-20 cm longi, ad 8 mm lati, dense ferruginei, canaliculati; foliola 7-8-juga, oblonga vel anguste ovata, acuta vel breviter acuminata, basi rotundata vel leviter subcordata, ad marginem revoluta, interdum asymmetrica, 12-25 cm longa, 4.5-8 cm lata, coriacea, superne praeter costam villosam glabra, inferne praeter costam venasque elevatas ferrugineas tomentosa; costa superne apicem versus immersa basin versus prominula, inferne elevata, utroque latere nervos 16-18 valde arcuatos gignente, venulis trans- versalibus numerosis; petioluli 8-10 mm longi, ferruginei; stipellae nullae. Paniculae elongatae, compressae, racemis ad 12 cm longis; pedunculi 15-50 cm longi, ferruginei, canaliculati; flores sessiles; bracteae caducae; bracteolae anguste triangulares, per- sistentes, ad 3 mm longae, 1.5 mm latae, lanosae vel ferrugineae; calyx 4 mm longus, 2.5 mm latus; receptaculum 1.5-2 mm longum, extus lanosum, intus lanoso-villosum; petala linearia vel aristiformia, 4 mm longa, ad 0.25 mm lata, apicem versus dense flavifloccosa; stamina 10, 6-7 mm longa, ad basin pilis deflexis spiniformibus fer- rugineis obtecta; antherae ovatae vel oblongae, 1 mm longae, 0.5 mm latae, glabrae; pistillum sigmoideum; ovarium 4-10 mm longum, longistipitatum, stipite 2-5 mm longo, pilis longis rectis ferrugineis obtectum; stylus 1.5 mm longus, ad basin sparse villosus; stigma glabrum. description: Plants perennial, caespitose herbs, to 17 cm tall, branches mostly basal or from the lower nodes; stems fistulose, angular, 8-10 mm diameter, tawny pubescent in age, appressed or subappressed, sparse, longer hairs 1 mm long, an undercoat of kinky canescence, lower internodes not elongated, lower branch internodes constricted, 2.5-5 mm in diam, the upper portion more inflated, extending through the peduncle and rachis of the raceme; stipules strigose dorsally, 6-10 mm long, free subulate tips 3-5 mm long, 1 mm wide; longest petioles 6-11 cm long, pubescence as stems; leaflets 6-8, oblanceolate, mostly conduplicate, glabrous above, appressed strigose to canescent below, the largest 2-2.5 cm long, 5-7 mm wide, tips rounded and mucronate; peduncles obsolete to 0.5-1 cm long, inflated; racemes 5-9 cm long, immature, flowers scattered, the lower part of the rachis distinctly inflated; bracts persistent or tardily deciduous, subulate, sericeous dor- sally, 3 mm long, 1 mm wide at the base; pedicels 1-1.5 mm long; calyces appressed sericeous to hispidulose outside, glabrous within, the base slightly gibbous above, lower lip ovate, 3.3-5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, tridentate, upper lip 3-4 mm long, bifid, the notch 1.1-1.4 mm deep, the lobes 1 mm wide, lips connate 1.8-2 mm, bracteoles acicular to minutely triangular, 0.2-0.5 mm long, hidden among the hairs, attached 0.4-0.8 mm below the lips of the lateral sinuses; banner glabrous, obovate-oval, 6-8 mm long, 4.5-5 mm wide, appressed 3-3.5 mm, reflexed 3.5-4 mm, r/a ratio 1.1-1.3, the angle ca 120-125?, bent twice; wings 7.5-8 mm long, 3-3.5 mm wide, the claw 2 mm long, lobe above the claw 1.2 mm wide; keel glabrous or with a few cilia distally above, the angle ca 1100; ovules 4-5; legumes 18-22 mm long, 5.5-6 mm wide, ascending-pilose; seeds tan with brown speckles and a brown angle mark at the funicular pit.

description: Liana or tree, 5-16 m tall, 5-35 cm dbh. Leaves 10-20 cm long; stipules persistent, spinescent, triangular, 7-12 x 4-7 mm; rachis dark-brown hirsute or glabrous; leaflets 14-20, elliptic, 1.3-5.8 x 0.5-2.1 cm, glabrous above, sparsely yellow-puberulous below, the margin repand, the base rounded to acute, the apex obtuse with a terminal mucro 1-5 mm long; midvein prominent; secondary venation craspedodromus; tertiary venation reticulate; petiolule 2-3 mm long. description: Liana or scandent shrub 3-30 m tall, 3-8 cm dbh. Leaves 3-16 cm long; stipules persistent, spinescent, 2-3 x 2 mm, sometimes with branches forming tendrils; rachis brown-hirsute; leaflets 25-120, linear to very narrowly elliptic, 4-17 x 1-4 mm, glabrous above, with reticulate nervation above, with granulate yellow texture and sparsely velutinous below, the margin swollen below, the base truncate to oblique, the apex emarginate, only the midvein visible, prominent, sessile. Inflorescence a terminal pseudopanicle, 6-12 cm long, composed of racemes 1.5-2.5 cm long; bract not seen; peduncle brown-hirsute. Flowers pale yellow to pink with purple markings on lip of banner petal, 11 mm long; pedicel 1-1.2 mm long; bracteoles ovate, 1 x 1 mm; calyx 3-3.5 mm, hirsute, truncate; banner 6 x 3 mm, sparsely velutinous on adaxial surface; keel petals 4-6 x 2-3 mm; wing petals 4-5 x 1.8-2 mm, with lamellate sculpturing; stamens monadelphous, 5-7 mm, the free part of filaments 1 mm long; style straight, 6 mm long, thicker and hirsute on the distal half. Fruit a one-seeded samara 3.4-6 cm long, yellowish-brown tomentose; seed 1-1.5 cm long.

description: The essential features are the short, sordidly pubescent foliage, with 2-3 (often 3) pairs of pinnae, the very long racemes, and the narrow, rather depauperate fruit; the leaflets number approximately 11-14 pairs per pinna (Burkart says 6-12).

description: Large trees, up to 46 m high and 77 cm in diameter above the large buttresses; bark ashy-white; leaves up to 33 cm long; leaflets 7-11 (-13), ovate or obovate to elliptic or oblong, those from trees in the western parts of the range frequently more narrow and often lanceolate or linear-oblong, the apices acute or acuminate, often slightly emarginate and mucronate, the bases obtuse to cordate, the larger leaflets (7-) 9-11 (-15) cm long, (2-) 3-4 (-5) cm wide, the upper surface shiny, glabrous to very finely puberulous, the lower surface puberulent, the reticulate veinlets usually slightly raised above both surfaces; inflorescence mostly 22-28 cm long and 22-26 cm wide; flower-buds 15-20 mm long, the tips slightly turned upwards; sepals golden-brown-sericeous on both surfaces; petals 14-20 mm long, the banner 7-11 mm wide, the others 5-7 mm wide; fertile stamens (4-) 5 (-7), the four lateral ones largest, the others reduced in size and frequently distorted; anthers straight, glabrous or only sparingly sericeous, the lower lateral ones 12-15 mm long; staminodes 1-5, usually placed opposite the petals; carpel typically one but the specimens from western Brazil often having two, these basally fused, the upper portion of carpel, styles, and stigmas free; ovary golden-brown-pubeseent; samara purplish-red, oblique at the base, 13-17 cm long, 4-8 cm wide, the centrally situated seed chamber about 4-6 cm long, 2-3 cm wide, the dorsal sutural wing 10-20 mm wide, the ventral sutural wing 5-12 mm wide.

description: Canopy tree 28-33 m tall; trunk unbuttressed but basally swollen, 4-6 dm in diameter, the bole cylindrical, 15-19 m longf (Fanshawe 1954); leaves 10-27 cm long; leaflets 5-6, subcoriaceous, ovate to elliptic to oblong, becoming larger toward the distal end of the leaf, the apices acuminate or acute, often mucronate, the bases cordate, the margins revolute, the larger leaflets (7-) 8-12 (-15) cm long, (3-) 5-7 (-9) cm wide, glabrous or minutely puberulous above, often glaucous beneath, but always with golden-brown puberulence; inflorescence 15-40 cm long, 11-27 cm wide; flower-buds 20-22 mm long, the apices more or less straight; sepals with golden-brown pubescence on both sides; petals 20-30 mm long, the banner 12-15 mm wide, the others 8-12 mm wide; stamens 4-5, the lower lateral ones 14-17 mm long, the abaxial (5th) one the smallest and often staminodal, the mid-portion of the anthers densely pilose, essentially straight; pistil one, the ovary glabrous on the sides, pilose only at the very base and on the lower suture; samara 7-10 cm long, 4-5 cm wide, the seed chamber occupying most of the fruit; wings narrow, 5-7 mm wide on the arching upper suture, and 3-5 mm wide on the lower suture, yellowish-green at maturity.

description: Small to medium sized tree; leaves 13-18 cm long; stipules ovate-lanceolate (fide Benthain, 1870); leaflets 7-9, somewhat subcoriaceous, ovate or oblong to ovate-laneeolate, the apices obtuse to subacuminate, often slightly emarginate and sometimes mucronate, the base cordate, the larger leaflets 5-8 cm long, 2-4 cm wide, the two proximal ones often smaller; upper surface shiny, glabrous or minutely puberulous, nmore or less rugose, the lower surface cinnamon-brown, puberulent, and rugose; infloreseence about 12 cm long and quite open; flowerbuds 19-22 mnm long, the apices straight or slightly curved upward; sepals with golden-brown pubescence on both sides; petals 20-35 mm long, the banner 11-16 mm wide, the others 7-13 mm wide; stamens 4-5, the fifth one abaxial, smaller and often staminodal; anthers glabrous, papillate, essentially straight though somewhat curved upward, the lower lateral ones 15-17 mm long; pistil one, the ovary golden-brown-pubescent; samara (only immature ones examined) purplish, oblique at the base, finely pubescent, the largest examined 11.5 cm long by 4.4 cm wide, the seed chamber centrally located, 5 cm long, 2.5 cm wide; dorsal sutural wing 7-10 mm wide, the ventral sutural wing 4-5 mm wide.

description: A tall tree 30-35 m high, with a dense semiglobular crown anid smooth gray-brown bark, the bole often (if not always) with large, flat, forking buttresses which extend upwards about 5 m; leaves 13-24 cm long; leaflets 5-8, ovate to elliptic to oblong, subeoriaceous, becoming somewhat larger toward the distal end of the leaf, the apices acute or acuminate, often slightly emarginate, sometimes with a smuall mucro, the bases obtuse to cordate, the larger leaflets 7-13 (-15) cm long, 3-6 (-8) cm wide, the upper surfaces shiniy, glabrous or at most minutely puberulous, the veinis and veinlets typically impressed, the lower surfaces puberulent, sometimes rugose, the veins usually somewhat raised; inflorescence 15-25 cm long, 10-18 cm wide; flower buds 10-16 mm long, sharply downward-falcate; sepals golden-brown-sericeous outside but often rather silvery sericeous inside; petals 15-18 mm long, the banner about 10 mm wide, the others about 5 mm wide; stamens 4, with an abaxial staminode, the anthers falcate, the midportion densely pilose, the lower lateral pair 8-11 mm long; pistil one, the ovary goldeni-brown-pubeseent; samara (onily immature material, Boschbeheer 22, examined) quite veiny, oblique at the base, about 12 cm long and 4 cm wide, the centrally located seed chamber 4.5 cm long, 2 cm wide, the dorsal sutural wing 12 mm wide, the ventral sutural wing 7 mm wide. [Amshoff (1939) reports fruits up to 15 cm long and 5 cm wide with wings 2 cm wide dorsally and 1 cm wide ventrally.]

description: These are, on the average, rather large trees with few spines. The herbage, especially the petioles and rhachises of the pinnae, has a considerable amount of dark (anthocyanin?) pigment. The foliage is feathery, the pinnae 1-2 pairs per leaf (Burkart says generally 2 pairs; the material I have seen shows only 1 pair); the leaflets are 13-20 pairs spaced at least 4 mm apart on the pinnae, 1.5-2 (-3) mm wide by (15-) 20-40 mm long (Burkart says 1.1-3 mm wide by 11-35 long); the mature fruit is falcate, flattened, more than 10 mm broad, with a fibrous, flexible outer coat easily broken with the fingernails.

description: Frutex gracilis 2-3 m. altus; spinis geminatis, 2-3 mm. longis; stipulis subu- latis, pubescentibus, 1-2 mm. longis; foliis bipinnatis; pinnis 2-4, 3-6 cm. longis; rhachillis 1-2.5 cm. longis; foliolis 3-5-jugis, glabris, oblongis, mucronatis, plerumque 6-10 mm. longis, 3-4 mm. latis; costa obscura, excentrica; inflores- centia capitata; floribus glabris pubescentibus, breviter pedicellatis; staminibus 10; legumine 4-5 cm. longo, 5-6 mm. lato, tenui, cartaceo, glabro, inermo; semini- bus bruneis, 4 mm. diam.

description: Slender shrub 2-3 m. high with reddish brown, sulcate, glabrous, irregularly pustulate stems, sparsely armed; spines paired below leaf axils, sometimes single or wailting, 2-3 mm. long, straight or descending, with broad, low, oval base bear- ing an anterior branch across leaf base joining stipules; stipules subulate, brown- ish, 1-2 mm. long, slightly pubescent; leaves bipinnate, the rhachis 2-4 cm. long; petioles glabrous 8-15 mm. long, sulcate above, the broadened base gland-like; pinnae 2-4, the rhachilla 1-2.5 cm. long with a gland-like base and 2 gland-like stipules 1 mm. long; leaflets 3-5 pairs, glabrous, oblong, mucronate, round- angulate at base, mostly 6-10 mm. long, 3-4 mm. wide; midvein obscure, eccentric with ascending branch near base; petiolule gland-like, brownish, +- 1 mm. long; infloreseence capitate; peduncles 2.5-3 cm. long, eglandular; flowers short-pedicellate, glabrous, persistent; calyx cupular, serrulate, 0.5 mm. long; corolla 2 mm. long, 5-lobate, the lobes 1.2 mm. long, broadly lanceolate, acute; stamens 10; legume at maturity 4-5 cm. long, 5-6 mm. wide, thin, chartaceous, areuate, mucronate, glabrous, the valves separating at maturity and with exfoliating margins, unsegmented, unarmed; seeds smooth, flat, orbicular, brownish, 4 mm. in diam.

description: Perennial herbs, (1.5-) 2-8 dm tall; stems erect and ascending in clumps from a superficial root crown; herbage glabrous to strigulose with basifixed hairs; stipules 3-10 mm long, triangular- or deltate-acuminate, mostly reflexed, partially or fully amplexicaul-decurrent, none connate; leaves 2-15 cm long; leaflets (7-) 11-19 (- 21), suborbicular, obovate, or oblong, the apex obtuse or emarginate, 5-20 mm long; peduncles erect, 4-11 (-14) mm long; ra- cemes 10-25 flowered, early elongating, flowers ascending, the axis becoming 3-16 (-20) cm long in fruit; calyx 4.7-9 mm long, white-, black-strigulose or mixed, the campanulate or cylindric tube 3-6.5 mm long, the teeth deltate, subulate to lance- acuminate, 0.8-2.5 mm long; petals pink purple, drying violet; banner 12-18 mm long, purple with a white, purple striate spot; keel 8.5-15.5 mm long; wings 10.5- 15 mm long, purple with dark purple tip or purple with a white tip; ovary glabrous or strigulose; ovules (14-) 22-38; fruiting pedicels persistent; pod erect, ascending or spreading, long persistent, in longitudinal section narrowly oblong, narrowly elliptic, to linear, in cross section cordate to terete, straight to incurved, 10-32 x 3.5-8.5 mm, sessile to stipitate, the stipe to 1.0 mm long, contracted at the apex into a uniloculate beak, the ventral suture sometimes prominent, the valves thinly fleshy becoming coriaceous, stramineous, semi-biloculate to biloculate, the septum 1.5-2.5 mm wide; dehiscence apical, through the beak while still attached to the raceme.

description: Arbor alta, ramulis glabris; foliola 3-jugata, coriacea, laminis ovatis vel ellipticis, glabris, reticulato-venosis, basi obtusis, apice abrupte acutis; inflorescentiae 15-18 cm longae, axe dense striguloso; bracteolae ad apicem stipitato-glandulares, glandularum stipite ea 1 mm longo, coriaceae, externe dense strigulosae, intus parce strigulosae; sepala 4, (sepalo adaxiali aliquando manifeste bilobato), glabra, lanceolata, acuminata, 7.5 mm longa, 2-2.5 mm lata; petala 5, plerumque uno petaloideo, aliquando alio etiam, leviter petaloideo, stipite 6-8 mm longo, lamina cordiformi, attenuato ad basim, 8-9 mm longa, 7-8 mm lata, glabra; stamina 8, filamentis glabris, 15-20 mm longis, antheris glabris, oblongis. 1.5 mm longis; stigma peltatum, stylo glabro, ea 7 mm longo; ovarium oblongum, ad suturam abaxialarem strigosum.

description: A tall tree with glabrous branehlets, the stipules caducous; leaves glabrous, with three pairs of coriaceous, ovate to elliptic leaflets, the petioles 2.5-2.8 em long, the rachis 6.5-10 cm long, terete, the petiolules 7-8 mm long; blades of the leaflets 7-11.5 cm long, 4-6 cm wide, obtuse and slightly inequilateral basally, abruptly acute at the apex, reticulate-venose on both the surfaces, the costa plane above, salient below; infloreseences 15-18 cm long, paniculate, oblong, the lateral branchlets racemose, about 3L4 cm long, the axes densely strigulose, the bracts eaducons, the pedicels 6-7 mm long, densely strigulose, the bracteoles coriaceous, adherent to the lower half of the hypanthium, the free part 10 mm long, 5 mm wide, oblanceolate-oblong or elliptic, densely strigulose without, sparingly strigulose within, the apex with a long-stipitate, truncate gland, the stipe about 1 mm long; hypanthium inequilaterally cylindrical (longer on the adaxial side), about 5 mm long, the upper 3 mm free from the bracteoles, glabrous or on the adaxial side strigulose; sepals mostly 4 (the adaxial one wider and sometimes bilobed), 7.5 mm long, 2-2.5 mm wide, lanceolate, acuminate, glabrous; petals 5, glabrous, the adaxial one with a well-developed cordiform blade 8-9 mm long and 7-8 mm wide, and with a claw 6-8 mm long, sometimes one other petal with a claw and partly developed blade, at least three petals linear to subulate, 3-4 mm long; stamens 8, glabrous, the filaments 15-20 mm long; stigma peltate, the style glabrous, about 7 mm long, the ovary oblong, about 5 mm long, 1 mm wide, glabrous except strigose on the abaxial suture, the gynophore glabrous, 1 mm long, arising from the inner surface of the hypanthium at the apex; immature fruit glabrous, oblong, the adaxial suture bialate.

description: Stems erect, differentiated into a leaf-bearing sterile stalk and a naked inflorescence shoot (the latter occasionally bearing 1-several blades). Leaf-bearing stem 5-30 cm. high, glabrate or with a few upwardly directed subvillous hairs. Stipules inconspicuous, to 5 mm. in length, quickly deciduous. Leaves 4-7 in number, borne in a close terminal cluster or slightly scattered down the stem. Petioles 5-9 cm. long, sparsely villous with upwardly appressed hairs; stalk of terminal leaflet to 1.5 cm. in length. Leaflets elliptic-ovate, 1.5-1.75 times longer than broad, gradually or sometimes abruptly pointed at apex, cuneate or subrounded at base; lateral blades usually slightly smaller than terminal one and somewhat basally oblique. Leaves considerably lighter below than above, appearing nearly glabrous, but usually possessing a few scattered, appressed hairs on both surfaces which find their greatest concentration along the veins and near the margin. Very fine, submicroscopic trichomes are usually also present on upper surface. Fertile stems one or several, arising as subterranean branches of the vegetative axis, continuing in a horizontal direction below soil surface for a short distance, then curving and assuming an erect position. Above-ground portion scapose or occasionally bearing 1-3 leaves (f. foliolatum), usually 2-3 times exceeding the sterile stem and up to 7.5 dm. in height. Inflorescence proper racemose or paniculate, mainly restricted to the upper 1/4 of the axis. Flowers borne on nearly glabrous filiform pedicels up to 20 mm. in length. Calyx broadly spreading-campanulate, thin; terminal emarginations rather inevident. Petals 5-8 mm. in length, subequal. Standard broadly ovate to suborbicular, obtusely acuminate-tapering at base. Wings somewhat broader than keel petals, distinctly spurred at base. Keel ovate-lanceolate. Loment stalk 9-10 mm. in length; stamen tube remnants 6-7 mm. long. Loment segments 2-4 in number, 6-8 mm. in length, 4-5 mm. wide, Posterior margin of individual joints straight or concave, nearly continuous through a rounded angle with the straight or concave anterior margin; greatest width of joint usually about 2/3 of the distance towards anterior end.
bibliographicCitation: Isely, Duane. 1951. Desmodium: section Pododcarpium Benth. Brittonia. 7: 185-224.

description: Rootstock rather slender, strohgly knotty or moniliform, stems ascending or somewhat sprawling, branched, rather low, usually not exceeding 3 dm., frequently somewhat zig-zag from node to node. Pubescence of a sparse villous nature, the hairs spreading or downwardly directed. Leaves scattered over entire length of stem. Stipules subulate, early deciduous. Petioles mostly 4-6 cm. long, sparingly pubescent with hairs similar to those on stem; stalk of terminal leaflet approximating 1 cm. in length. Leaflets up to 8 cm. in length, 1-1.4 times longer than wide, or those of lowermost leaves somewhat wider; terminal leaflets obovate to ovate, acute to short-acuminate at apex (rounded on lower leaves), generally cuneate-tapering at base. Lateral leaflets ovate, acute at apex, rounded, and frequently somewhat oblique at base. Veins continuing to margin or weakly incurved. Blades pubescent over entire surface beneath or glabrate, somewhat whitened, greenish above, usually glabrate except along veins and at margin. Trichomes subappressed, about 1 mm. in length; submicroscopic hairs may also be present on lower surface. Stipels not seen, apparently obsolete. Inflorescence terminal on main stem or branches, somewhat exceeding or partially hidden by the leaves, usually racemose. Flowers 5-7 mm. in length, borne on short, ca. 5 mm., frequently recurved pedicels. Calyx only slightly spreading, nearly cylindric-campanulate; apices of dorsal teeth small but distinct. Petals white. Standard suborbicular, basally cuneate, apically entire or sometimes undulate or lacerate. Wing and keel petals almost identical in shape, oblong, not spurred. Keel petals loosely associated. Loments 1-2 jointed, on stalks 4-6 mm. in length. Segments 9-11 mm. long, 6-8 mm. high, greatest width 0.8-0.9 of distance to anterior tip; dorsal margin slightly to strongly concave; posterior border straight or concave; ventral portion obsolete, anterior margin nearly straight, vertical or slightly forwardly directed. Surface of segments sometimes appearing somewhat whitish-scurfy due to a rather dense coating of heavy, hooked and straight hairs.
bibliographicCitation: Isely, Duane. 1951. Desmodium: section Pododcarpium Benth. Brittonia. 7: 185-224.

description: Stems erect, to about 1.8 m tall, long-villous to short-appressed-pubescent. Petioles long, the longer terminal leaflets being 1-2.5 times longer than the combined lengths of the petiole and rachis. Rachises of the longer terminal leaflets equaling or shorter than their petioles. Terminal leaflets elliptic or (ob-) ovate, the longer ones up to 4 cm long and 0.5-0.8 times as wide, glabrous, appressedpubescent or tomentose above; Racemes open, mostly 1.5-4 -times longer than their subtending leaves and bearing 16-44 flowers on the terminal half of the peduncle. Calyces 6-12 mm long, lobed more than three-quarters of their length, about equaling or slightly exceeding the pod. Corolla white or cream-colored.

description: Leaflets commonly to 16 cm long, chartaceous, ovate, acuminate to a long, obtuse tip; pubescence long, white, sparse to moderately dense on petiolule, sparse on both surfaces of blade. Bracteoles 1 mm long, acute. Pedicel 2 mm long. Calyx 10 mm long; pubescence short, white, very sparse, upper lip shorter than or equalling tube, upper edge smoothly convex, not apiculate, slitting at anthesis; lower teeth borne on a common jaw-like base 3 mm long; lowest tooth 1 mm long, acute, exceeding acute laterals. Standard 2 cm long. Pod commonly to 13 × 3 cm, compressed, spirally dehiseent, tan; each valve with a rib along both sutures. Seeds to 18 × 11 × 5 mm, oblong, strongly compressed, black brown, not buoyant or impermeable; hilum about 15 mm long.

description: Leaflets commonly to 11 cm long, coriaceous, nearly circular, emarginate or obtuse and mucronulate; pubescence long, white, extremely dense on petiolule and lower surface of blade, sparse to moderately dense above. Bracteoles 2 mm long, obtuse. Pedicel ca 8 mm long. Calyx 16 mm long; pubescence short, white, sparse to moderately dense; upper lip as long as tube, upper edge constricted behind non-apiculate tip; lowest tooth 2.5 mm long, subulate, slightly exceeding subacute laterals. Standard 4 cm long. Pod commonly to 17 × 3 cm, compressed, indehiscent or tardily dehiscent, tan; each valve with sutural ribs and an extra rib ca 6 mm from ventral rib. Seeds to 17 × 10 × 7 mm, oblong, moderately compressed, dark brown, buoyant and impermeable to water for at least 2 months; hilurn ca 9 mm long.

description: Small or medium-sized tree, armed with spines, usually aphyllous at anthesis; branchlets rather slender, usually armed with spines; petioles 3.5-14.5 cm. long, glabrous or nearly so, spineless; petiolules 2.5-7 mm. long, 0.3-1 mm. in diam., glabrous or puberulent; leaflet-blades chartaceous to subcoriaceous, sparsely pubescent on costa, secondaries and veinlets belneath or nearly glabrous, spineless, minutely farinose-ceriferous beneath, often indistinctly so; terminal leaflets usually rhombic-ovate, 3-8 cm. long, 2-5.2 cm. broad, acute to rounded at apex, cuneate to subcordate at base; secondaries 4-6 per side; rachis 8-20 cm. lolng, delnsely pubescent with very short hairs distally, sparsely so proximially; pedicels 0.5-0.9 cm. long, about 0.7 mm. in diam., pubes- cent as rachis; bracts not seen; bracteoles oblong or lanceolate, about 0.7 mm. long alnd 0.4 mm. broad; calyx chartaceous, broadly campanulate, 8-15 mm. long oln the carinal side, slightly shorter on the vexillar side, about 2 mm. broad at base, ampliate to 6.5-12 mm. at apex, at margin bilobed, provided with a blunt tooth on the upper carinal side, delnsely pubescent with very short hairs, at length glabreseent; stand- ard scarlet, oblong-elliptic or elliptic, 3-5.5 cm. long, 1.3-1.8 cm. broad, obtuse to rounded at apex, cuneate at base; wings subcucullate at apex, shortly clawed or cuneate-clawed at base, 9.5-14 mm. long, 3-6 mm. broad; keel-petals rounded at apex, shortly clawed or clawed at base, 8-13.5 mm. lolng, 3.5-5.5 mm. broad; stamens 2.7-4.5 cm. long, sepa- rate for 0.7-1.3 cm.; pistil 2.1-3.5 cm. long, the ovary and gynophore densely pubeseent with rather short subappressed hairs; fruit-pedicels 0.8-1.4 cm. long, 1-3 mm. in diam.; pods subligneous, 8-18 cm. long, 0.7-1 cm. broad, irregularly and deeply constricted between seeds or moniliforme, with a stipe 2-5.5 cm. long, with an acumination 1-4.5 cm. long, 1-many-seeded; seeds scarlet with a black line extending from the hilum for approximately 0.6 mm. toward the chalazal end, 7.5-9.5 mm. long, 4.5-6.5 mm. broad.

description: Small tree, leafy at anithesis; branchlets not seen; petioles 9.5-22 cm. long, often aculeate, pubeseent with long villous rufous often branched hairs, soon glabrous; petiolules 7-11 mm. long, 1-2 mm. in diam., pubescent as petioles when young, soon glabreseent or glabrous; description: Small tree armed with spines, leafy at anthesis; branchlets rather stout, usually aculeate; petioles (8-)14-26 (-38) cm. long, densely pubescent with villous deciduous hairs, soon glabreseent, often aculeate; petiolules 5-13 mm. long, 1-3.5 mm. in diam., pubeseent as petioles; leaflet-blades chartaceous or subeoriaceous, densely pubescent with vil- lo-Ls hairs, soon glabreseent especially on the upper surface, not ceriferous beneath; terminal leaflets rhomboid or subdeltoid, often broader than long, (5.5-) 14.5-20 cm. long, (5-) 15.5-23 cm. broad, usually acuminate to obtuse at apex, subtruneate to subcordate at base; costa often aculeate above or beneath, the secondaries 7-12 per side, occasionally aculeate; rachis 10-38 cm. long, densely pubeseent with villous hairs, at length glabreseent at least proximally; pedicels 0.3-0.6 cm. long, about 0.4 mm. in diam., pubeseent as rachis; bracts linear-lanceolate, the larger ones about 9 mm. long and 1.5 mm. broad, the smaller ones usually 1.4-2.1 mm. long and about 0.2 mm. broad; brac- teoles similar to the smaller bracts; calyx thin-chartaceous, campanu- late, usually 15-17 mm. long oni the carinal side, 10-15 mm. on the vexillar side, about 2 mm. broad at base, ampliate to 6-8 mm. at apex, at margin entire, calearate on the upper carinal side (spur up to 4 mm. long), densely pubescent with villous hairs in bud, at length glabreseent; standard red, narrowly elliptic, 5-7 cm. long (including claw), 0.8-1.2 cm. broad, acute to rounded at apex, cuneate to obtuse at base, the claw up to 2 mm. long; wings variously shaped, usually auriculate-sagittate toward base, 6-11 mm. long, 1-2.5 mm. broad; keel- petals linear-subfaleate, usually auriculate-sagittate toward base, 23-31 mm. long, 2.5-4.2 mm. broad; stamens 5-6 cm. long, separate for 1-2.3 cm.; pistil 4.2-5.5 cm. long, the ovary densely pubescent with very fine hairs, the gynophore sparsely so distally and often glabrous or puberu- lent proximally; fruit-pedicels about 1 cm. long and 2.5 mm. in diam.; pods subligneous, 18-31 cm. long, 1.2-1.6 cm. broad, not at all or shallowly constricted between seeds, with a stipe about 2 cm. long, with a stiff acumination 1-1.8 cm. long, many-seeded; seeds sooty with tawny markings, 11-13 mm. long and about 6 mm. broad.
