description: An annual, usually 30 cm high or less, with many spreading subordinate branches, the stems and petioles puberulent with short curved hairs, abundantly stipitate-glandular, and also (especially the lower stem) pilose with straight colorless divaricate hairs up to 4 mm long; leaves narrowly to broadly ovate. 1-3 cm broad, 2-5.5 cm lonig, the petioles about as long as the blades (1.5-5.5 cm); blades blunt or acute to gradually acuminate, rounded or very broadly obtuse at base, prolonged at the junction with the petiole into two short rounded auricles; margins crenate-dentate with (7-) 11-15 teeth on each side, the basal portions entire or nearly so; stipules flat, scarious, lanceolate, 0.3-0.7 mm long; blades papillose on both sides, sparingly hairy, somewhat strigose at least above, 3-veined from a point at or just above the base, with 1-2 pairs of smaller veins below this; [male] spike linear, terminal (sometimes with 1 [female] flower near the base of the peduncle), 1-1.5 mm thick, (1-) 2-3.5 cm long, the peduncle (0.6-) 1-2 cm lonig; [female] inflorescence axillary, often compound, consisting of a short sessile spike and usually 2 longer peduncled spikes from the base of the central sessile one; central spike abortive, or up to 5- or 6- bracteate, and 6-7 mm long; lateral spikes pedunculate, up to 1-1.5 cm long, 10- to 12-bracteate, all the spikes rather loosely flowered; [female] bracts 2-3.5 mm long, divided 3/4 their length into 3 blunt triangular or ovate lobes up to 2 mm wide, 3 mm long, the lateral ones sometimes asymmetric and crenate; flowers 1-3 in each bract; calyx lobes elliptic, acute, ciliate; styles laciniate, 2.5 mm long (or in one form 3-4 mm long, simple); [female] spike often terminating in a sterile seta bearing an incompletely developed [female] flower; stamens 8, the anther-cells linear; capsule 3-lobed, 1.5-1.7 mm in diameter, hispid, glandular and near the apex tuberculate; seed ovoid, 1.1 mm long, light reddish brown, finely alveolate-reticulate.

description: Inter congeneras americanas foliis ternatis et angustissimis conspicua, abI. acuminatissima Muell.-Arg. cui foliis angustissimis similior non solum foliis ternatis sed etiam inflorescentia ampliore et calyce quadrilobato faciliter distinguenda. Arbor parva, 2.5-4 m alta. Rami triangulares, novelli 1.5-2.0 mm diam., papillosi, internodiis 4-10 cm longis. Folia ternata, sessilia, linearia, 18-33 cm longa et 2.1-3.3 cm lata, apicem versus sensim contracta, basi cuneata, subcoriacea, sicc. grisea, utrimque glabra, costa supra canaliculata et subtus prominente, nervis patentibus utroque latere costae 18-24 subtus prominulis, reticulatione laxa utrimque distinguenda. Stipulae deltoideae, apice in aristam vix 1 mm longam exeuntes, ca. 5.5 mm longae, dorso carinatae, intus albo-sericeae. Inflorescentia ramum ordinarium terminans, laxe paniculiformis, pedunculo papilloso 3.5-5 cm longo elata; rachis 3.5-7.0 cm longa, papillosa; ramuli ternati, infimi rachide fere dimidio breviores, trichotomi, alii plerumque semel vel bis dichasiales. Bracteae deltoideae, ramulorum infimorum ca. 3 mm longae, aliae gradatim minores. Flores centrales dichasiorum sessiles, laterales pedicellis apice bracteolatis 1.5-2.0 mm longis elati. Bracteolae ovatae ca. 0.7 mm longae. Ovarium glabrum. Calyx urceolaris, margine in lobos late deltoideos tubo paulo breviores productus, glaber. Corolla extus papillosa, tubo coccineo 15 mm longo et 0.6 mm diam., intus glabro, lobis extus viridibus, intus luteis 6 mm longis, acutis. Stamina antheris apiculatis 2.5 mm longis. Stylus glaber 3.5 mm exsertus, stigmata filiformia 1.5 mm longa. Fructus nondum notus.

description: Arbor excelsa glabra ad 50 m. alta; ramis ramulisque teretibus cinereis; foliis digitatim trifoliolatis, petiolis subteretibus 1.5-3 cm. longis basi apiceque incrassatis, foliolis subcoriaceis sessilibus oblongo-obovatis, terminali 6-8 cm. longa et 2-2.5 cm. lata, lateralibus paullo brevioribus, basi attenuatis, apice rotundato-emarginatis, margine cre-natis, supra fuscis, subtus pallidioribus, costa subtus prominente, nervis secundariis utroque 7-9 cum venulis utrinque prominulis; racemis terminalibus ad 12 cm. longis, rhachidibus crassis cum pedicellis calyci-busque cinereo-pulverulentis; floribus apicem versus aggregatis; pedicellis teretibus 3-5 mm. longis; calyce cupuliformi, 1.5 mm. alto, 4 mm. diametro, margine obscure 5-dentato; petalis 5 flavis carnosis imbricatis cohaerentibus ovatis circiter 6 mm. longis; staminibus circiter 200 sub anthesi ad 8 mm. longis; filamentis inaequalibus gracilibus tubercu-latis, in alabastro inflexis in phalanges 5 cohaerentibus; antheris basifixis oblongis 1 mm. longis; disco parvo carnoso piano; ovario glabro subgloboso sub anthesi 1.5 mm. diametro, loculis circiter 12, ovulis 1 in quoque loculo, placenta carnosa; stylis circiter 12 carnosis glabris 1.5-2 mm. longis.

description: Deciduous shrub or small tree 2-5 m high, trunk to 2 dm in diameter, brownish, not peeling; branches greyish-brown, ferruginous-hirsutulous at growing tips, becoming glabrate, terete, and channelled, exuding reddish latex when cut. Leaves alternate; stipules glanduliform, shortly stipitate (ca 0.5 mm long), deciduous; petioles slender, terete, eglandular, hirsutulous, (2) 4-9 cm long; blades membranous, mostly ovate to shallowly and obtusely 3-lobed or -angled (sometimes indistinctly 5-angled), (4) 9-18 (21) cm long, (4) 7-18 (21) cm broad, lobes obtuse and minutely apiculate at tips, base shallowly to distinctly cordate, felty-tomentose on both sides when young, becoming sparsely hirtellous above, persistently but rather lightly flaccid-villose beneath; blades palmately veined with 5-7 major veins from base, lateral veins prominulous, coalescing into an irregular reticulum; margins entire, plane, non- glandular. Dioecious; staminate cymes (Fig. 1) terminal or subterminal, usually paired, peduncle (1) 1.5-8.5 cm long, several times dichotomous, branches copiously hirtellous; bracts lanceolate, entire, non-glandular, hirtellous, ca 0.5-1.0 mm long; pistillate flowers terminal, solitary (rarely paired). Staminate flower (Fig. 2): pedicel very stout, ca 0.8-1 mm long and broad, hirtellous, distinctly articulated at base; calyx lobes 5, narrowly lanceolate, obtuse or subacute, entire, greenish, hirtellous along midstrip, 2.8-4.5 mm long, 0.9-1.5 mm broad; petals 5, creamy white, linear-oblong, glabrous without, sparsely hirsutulous proximally within, firmly coherent into a tube 4.5-6 mm long, the free tips rounded, ca 1.5-2.5 mm long, mid- vein with several sharply ascending laterals (3 or 4 on a side) which dichotomize distally; disk glands 5, subglobose, smooth, glabrous, ca 0.5-0.9 mm across; stamens 10, biverticellate, monadelphous beneath into an angular column ca 2 mm high; outer (lower) stamens with slender filaments 2-3 mm long, the free distal portions 0.7-1 mm long; inner (upper) stamens with filaments 4.5-5 mm long, the free tips 2-3 mm long; anthers blunt, ellipsoidal, flattened, basifixed, glandular at tip of connective, 0.9-1.5 mm long, 0.5-0.8 mm broad. Pistillate flower (Figs. 3 & 4): pedicel stout, densely tomentose, ca 1 mm long at anthesis, becoming 2-6 mm long in fruit; calyx lobes 5, lanceolate, tapering to more or less acute tips, densely tomentose without, entire, 5-7 mm long, 1.8-2 mm broad; petals 5, similar to the staminate, coherent into a tubular corolla 7.5-8.5 mm long, the tube 4.5-6 mm long, glabrous without, hirsutulous within lower half, the lobes 1.8-4 mm long, hirtellous near tip; disk massive, smooth, glabrous, dissected into 3-5 massive lobes; ovary smooth, glabrous, sharply 3-carinate, 2-3 mm high; styles ca 3 mm long, united into a column 1.0-1.2 mm high, bifid, the branches oblong with thickened margins. Capsule some- what fleshy, tardily dehiscent, smooth, oblate, sharply 3-carinate, 3-3.5 cm in diameter; columella ca 2 cm long, narrowly winged; seeds ellipsoidal-cylindric, plump, smooth, finely brownish-mottled, 1.7-2 cm long, 1.3-1.4 cm thick; caruncle dark brown, fluted, ca 1 mm long, 1.8 mm broad.

description: Treelet or shrub, to 5 m tall. Young branches ± densely pubescent. Stipules narrowly lingulate, sparsely to moderately arachnoid or puberulent, 1-1.6 X ca. 0.4 cm; petioles 0.6-1.5 cm long, ± pubescent when young, glabrescent; leaf blades ± chartaceous when dry, 5.5-14 X 2.1-6 cm, elliptic (length/width 2.1-2.7), broadly to narrowly cuneate at base, acuminate at apex, secondary veins 9-15 pairs, level above, prominent beneath, tertiary venation obscure or ± distinct, adaxial surface matte, glabrous or finely puberulous, abaxial surface ± densely arachnoid-villous on midrib and veins, intervenous areas glabrous or ± sparsely puberulous. Inflorescence pedunculate, peduncle 2.5-7 cm long, often leaning to decumbent, ultimate branch systems strongly congested (to subcapitate), few flowered, axes densely hirsute or villous, hairs yellowish to reddish brown. Flowers fragrant (fide Steyermark in sched.), only macrostylous flowers seen; calyx green (at least distally) and ± herbaceous, 6.3-6.7 mm long with the triangular and obtuse lobes narrowly triangular and ca. 3.8-4.9 X 1.8-2.1 mm (tube/lobe ratio 0.6-0.7), ±  densely arachnoid outside, lobes sparsely puberulous within; corolla with white to pale green tube and pink lobes, densely pu- berulous outside with long rigid hairs, this indumentum underlayered by one of short curly hairs, glabrous within, tube 21-28 mm long, lobes 5.4-6.5 mm long, the appendages 3-4 X 4-5 mm; filaments at- tached ca. 4 mm (ca. 20% of tube length) above base of corolla tube in macrostylous flowers, ca. 2 mm long, anthers 4.4-6.3 X 0.8-0.9 mm; ovary densely arachnoid-vil- lous, 3.8-5.6 X 2.2-2.8 mm; style ca. 18 mm long in macrostylous flowers, stigmatic lobes ca. 3.6 mm. Capsules narrowly cylindrical, 21-28 X ca. 5 mm. Seeds ca. 5 X 1.4 mm including wing.

description: Shrub 3-4.5 m tall, branches glabrous to glabrescent. Stipules lanceolate-ligulate, subobtuse at apex, 10 mm long, 3-3.5 mm wide, sparsely to moderately strigillose without. Petioles 6-15 mm long, sparsely strigillose to glabrous. Leaf-blades oblong- elliptic to lanceolate-elliptic, acute to acuminate at apex, acute at base, 6.5-14 cm long, 2.5-6 cm wide, glabrous above, glabrous below except for the subappressed- villosulous midrib and lateral nerves; lateral nerves slightly elevated beneath, tertiary veins transversely reticulate beneath. Inflorescence 5 cm long, 3.5 cm broad, 12- flowered, long-pedunculate, the central and lateral axes each 3-5-flowered, moderately strigose; peduncle solitary, 3-7 cm long, sparsely or moderately strigillose. Hy- panthium 5.5 mm long, 3-3.8 mm wide, densely substrigose-villous. Calyx 6.5-7 mm long, tube 3.5-4 mm wide, moderately subappressed-villous without, lobes oblong- lanceolate to lanceolate-oblong, obtuse or slightly rounded at apex, sparsely substrigose without. Corolla-tube white, 2-2.5 mm wide at the base, 3-3.5 mm wide at orifice, shortly puberulous or tomentose without, glabrous within, lobes roseate with sub- orbicular-ovoid appendages 5.5 mm long and 4 mm wide, the central portion lanceolate- oblong, acute, 6.5 mm long, 3 mm wide. Stamens in the uppermost part of tube, anthers 5.5-6 mm long; filaments 6 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Shrub 3-5 m tall. Young branches glabrous to ± villous hirsute. Stipules ± lingulate, glabrous to ± pubescent outside, with long bristly hairs inside at base, 0.8- 1.4 X 0.3-0.4 cm; petioles 0.5-1.4 cm long, glabrous or ± hirtellous; leaf blades rather thin, papyraceous when dry, 6-14 X 3.3- 5.7 cm, ±elliptic (length/width 1.8-3.5), broadly to narrowly cuneate at base, acuminate at apex, secondary veins 7-13 on each side, prominulous on both sides, tertiary venation distinctly visible on both sides, adaxial surface matte, glabrous or sparsely puberulous with long, thin to coarse hairs, abaxial surface ± sparsely puberulous or hirsute with long, thin to coarse hairs. Inflorescence pedunculate, once or twice pseudodichotomously branched, ultimate branch systems forming monochasial cymes with ca. 3-5 flowers, axes glabrous or sparsely but coarsely hirsute. Flowers fragrant; calyx closed in bud, opening by a longitudinal slit on one side, 11-15 mm long, glabrous outside, or sparsely but coarsely hirsute, glabrous within, without colleters; corolla white, densely and rather coarsely puberulous outside, glabrous with in, tube 11-17 mm long, lobes 4-6 mm long, the appendages 3.5-4.5 X ca. 3 mm; filaments attached 7.5-8.5 mm (40-50% of tube length) above base of corolla tube in brevistylous flowers, near base in macro stylous ones, 2.7-3.5 mm long in brevistylous flowers, ca. 1.5 mm in macrostylous ones, anthers 3.5-3.8 X 0.5 mm; ovary gla- brous or sparsely but coarsely hirsute, ca. 4.5-6 X 0.8-1.5 mm; style 1.6-1.9 mm long in brevistylous flowers, ca. 7 mm in macrostylous ones, stigmatic lobes ca. 4 mm. Capsules narrowly cylindrical, 23-60 X 2-4 mm. Seeds ca. 5.5 X 0.8 mm including wing, wing cleft in both the basi and the acroscopic end.

description: Shrub 3-4 m tall, young branches sparsely appressed-puberulous, older ones glabrous or glabrescent. Stipules ligulate-linear to linear-oblong, rounded to acuminate at apex, 8-9 mm long, 2.5-3.5 mm wide, appressed-puberulent without, glabrous within, with numerous erect setose hairs at the base within. Petioles 3-13 mm long, sparsely appressed-puberulous. Leaf-blades oblong-elliptic to lanceolate-elliptic, acuminate at apex, acute at base, 6-12 cm long, 3-6 cm wide, finely subarachnoid- strigillose to glabrescent beneath, appressed-pilose to glabrescent above, margins ciliate with ascending hairs or these caducous; lateral nerves 11-13 each side, slightly elevated beneath, the tertiary veins transversely reticulate beneath. Inflorescence loosely cymose, 6-9-flowered, 1-2-dichotomous, 5-6 cm long and 5-6 cm broad at anthesis, 7-9 cm long and 12-19 cm broad in fructification, pedunculate; peduncles 1-2, glabrous, 1.5-4 cm long. Flowers 5-merous, pedicellate; pedicels 1-1.5 mm long, sparsely strigillose. Hypanthium 5-6 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, strigillose or appressed- puberulent. Calyx in anthesis spathaceous, ovate-elliptic, abruptly caudate at apex, naviculate, split on one side, 12-13 mm long, 6 mm wide, the acumen 2.5-3.5 mm long, connate 2-3 mm in the basal portion, shortly penicillate, shortly appressed-puberulent without, more or less glabrous within. Corolla white, densely sericeous without, the tube 11 mm long, 2 mm wide at base, 6 mm wide above; lobes with dolabriform- subovate, irregularly undulate-lobate appendages, acute at apex, 4.5 mm long, 3 mm wide, the central portion lanceolate, 4 mm long, 2 mm wide. Stamens inserted at the base of the tube; filaments 1.5 mm long. Style 7 mm long, glabrous; stigmas lanceolate-elliptic, acute, 5 mm long. Capsules linear, 3.5-6 cm long, 2-4 mm wide, the valves bisulcate, straight, glabrous; seeds winged, 5 mm long, 1 mm wide, the appendages erose or lobate, the body elliptic, the wings stramineous or whitish

description: Tree 6-8 m tall, upper part of stems shortly and moderately subappressed hirtellous. Stipules ligulate-oblong, rounded at apex, 10-12 mm long, 5 mm wide, densely strigillose without. Petioles 5-25 mm long, appressed-pubescent. Leaf-blades broadly elliptic or obovate-elliptic, abruptly acuminate at apex, cuneately acuminate at base, 5-15 cm long, 2.5-7 cm wide, upper surface appressed-pubescent to glabrous, lower surface finely appressed-pubescent, the lateral nerves and midrib below with usually denser and longer pubescence, the lateral nerves strigose, the midrib strigose to hirsute; lateral nerves 9-14 each side, lightly elevated below. Inflorescence 2.5-3.5 cm high (long), 3-6.5 cm wide, cymosely umbelliform, pedunculate with usually one (rarely two) spreading to declinate peduncle; peduncle (1.5-)4-6 cm long, subhirsutulous. Flowers crowded in a dense, subdichotomous cyme with usually 8 short axes, the axes 1-2-flowered, 2-4 mm long, densely subhirsute; flowers sessile to 3 mm long- pedicellate, the central flower of a main forking axis pedicellate. Hypanthium 2-8 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, densely brown subhirsutulous. Calyx-tube campanulate-oblong, 5-6 mm long, 3.5-4 mm wide, densely brown-strigose without, nearly subtruncate or shallowly 5-toothed, the teeth broadly suborbicular, rounded to obtuse, 0.5 mm long in anthesis, up to 2 mm long in fruit, 2-2.5 mm wide. Corolla-tube pale green, lobes pink, the tube 16-20 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, densely sericeous without; lobes 5, the central portion ligulate-oblong, 3 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide, the bilobed appendages 3 mm long. Stamens 5, about '/8 way up the tube; anthers 4.5 mm long; filaments 1.5-2 mm long. Style 20 mm long. Capsules linear, (1.5-)2.5-10 cm long, the valves 3.5-5 mm wide, not torulose.

description: Shrub or treelet, to ca. 4 m tall. Young branches lanuginose, soon glabrescent. Stipules ± lingulate or obtusely triangular, rather densely lanuginose, 1.2-2 X 0.4-0.6 cm; petioles 1-2.9 cm long, ± lanuginose in young leaves, glabrescent; leaf blades chartaceous when dry, 15-21 X 5.4-8.5 cm, elliptic to oblong (length/width 2.4- 2.9), rounded or broadly cuneate at base, acuminate at apex, secondary veins 12-17 pairs, prominulous above, prominent be- neath, tertiary venation rather obscure above, prominulous beneath, adaxial surface subnitid, glabrous, abaxial surface rather densely lanuginose in young leaves, sometimes glabrescent and then subglabrous in mature leaves. Inflorescences terminal, pedunculate, paired, peduncle 4-6 cm, axes ± hirsute, first branching dichasial or pseudo-dichotomous, branches monochasial, 3-4 flowered. Flowers known only from young buds (corolla supposedly half its mature length or less); calyx ± herbaceous, rather densely lanuginose outside, rather densely to sparsely puberulous inside, without colleters, 7-11 mm long, tube 0.7-0.9 mm long, lobes narrowly ovate  acuminate, 6.1-10 X 1.8 mm (tube/lobe ratio ca. 0.1); corolla densely puberulous out- side with long rigid hairs, glabrous inside; anther ca. 3 mm; ovary densely shaggy-lanuginose, ca. 4.7 X 1.7 mm, style glabrous. Fruits and seeds not seen.

description: Small tree with glabrous branches. Stipules caducous. Petioles 1-2.5 cm long, glabrous. Leaf-blades obovate-elliptic, abruptly acute at apex, cuneately acuminate at base, 8-14.5 cm long, 3.2-6.7 cm wide, glabrous throughout; lateral nerves 8-10 each side, slightly elevated beneath, tertiary veins prominently transversely reticulate both sides. Inflorescence few-flowered, 1-2-dichotomous, the lateral axes 0.5-3.5 cm long, glabrous; peduncles 2.5-9 cm long, glabrous. Flowers sessile or shortly pedicellate, the pedicels 1-2 mm long, glabrous. Hypanthium 4.5 mm long, 2.5 mm wide, glabrous. Calyx 7.5-9.5 mm long, the tube deeply campanulate, 5.2 mm wide; the two larger calyx-lobes lanceolate-oblong, obtuse, the three smaller ones oblong to ovate-oblong, rounded at the apex, 1.5-1.8 mm wide. Corolla white, 21 mm long; corolla-tube 12-13 mm long, 4-4.5 mm wide, densely antrorsely sericeous without, glabrous within; corolla-lobes with rhomboid-suborbicular appendages rounded- subtruncate at the apex, 3 mm long, 2.5 mm wide, strigose at the base, the central portion ligulate, 5.5 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide. Stamens inserted toward the base of the corolla tube, anthers 2.7 mm long; filaments 0.5 mm long. Capsules linear, the valves torulose at maturity, 1.7-2.7 cm long, 3-3.5 mm wide, glabrous.

description: Small tree. Young branches glabrous. Stipules not seen; petioles 1-2.5 cm long, glabrous; leaf blades subchartaceous when dry, 6.1-15 X 2.5-6.7 cm, elliptic to obovate (length/width 2.1-2.4), ± cuneate at base, abruptly acuminate at apex, secondary veins 6-10 pairs, level above, prominulous beneath, tertiary venation distinctly visible on both sides, adaxial surface matte, glabrous, abaxial surface glabrous throughout. Inflorescences pedunculate, usually 2 arising from seemingly the same point at branch tips, sometimes also solitary from distal leaf axils, peduncles 2.5-9 cm long, once pseudo-dichotomously branched, ultimate branch systems forming elongate monochasial cymes, axes glabrous. Only brevistylous flowers seen; calyx coriaceous throughout, 7.5-9.5 mm long with lobes ca. 3.5 mm (tube/lobe ratio ca. 1.5), glabrous outside and within; corolla white, densely puberulous outside, glabrous within, tube 12-16 mm long, lobes 4.5-5.5 mm long, the appendages ca. 6 X 3 mm; filaments attached ca. 6 mm (ca. 40% of tube length) above base of corolla tube, ca. 2 mm long, anthers ca. 3.6 X 0.7 mm; ovary glabrous, ca. 4-5 X 3-4 mm; style not clearly seen. Capsules narrowly cylindrical, 16-30 X 3- 4 mm, valves spirally coiled in old, opened fruits. Seeds not seen.

description: Small tree. Young branches ± glabrous. Stipules ± lingulate, minutely and sparsely puberulous, 1.2-2.1 X 0.4-0.8 cm; petioles 0.3-3 cm long, sparsely and minutely puberulous when young, soon glabrescent; leaf blades ± papyraceous when dry, 6.9-18 X 2.2-7.3 cm, ovate to elliptic (length/width 2.2-3.1), cuneate or attenuate to rounded at base, acuminate at apex, secondary veins 14- 19 pairs, level to prominulous above, prom- inent beneath, tertiary venation rather obscure above, distinct beneath, adaxial surface matte, ± arachnoid in young leaves but soon glabrescent, abaxial surface with midrib and veins persistently and rather densely puberulous, intervenous areas arachnoid in young leaves, gradually glabrescent. Inflorescence pedunculate, twice dichasially or pseudo-dichotomously branched, ultimate branch systems forming elongate monochasial cymes of 10-20 flowers, axes densely arachnoid when young, gradually glabrescent with age. Calyx ca. 6.3 mm long with the acute, ± lingulate lobes ca. 4.8-5.3 mm (tube/lobe ratio 0.2- 0.3), moderately puberulous outside, glabrous within; corolla of unknown color, the oldest ones seen just barely starting to open, densely puberulous outside, glabrous within, tube ca. 15 mm long, lobes ca. 4 mm long, the appendages not seen unfolded; filaments at- tached ca. 9 mm above base of corolla tube, 2 mm long in brevistylous flowers, anthers ca. 4.8 mm; ovary rather densely arachnoid, ca. 2.4-3.2 X 1.2-1.5 mm; style ca. 2.7 mm in brevistylous flowers, stigmatic lobes ca. 2.8 mm; disk glabrous. Capsules narrowly cylindrical, 12-28 X 2.5-3.5 mm. Seeds 3.5- 5.3 X 0.7-0.8 mm including wing.

description: Shrub, ca. 4 m tall. Young branches ± puberulous, soon glabrescent. Stipules narrowly triangular, rounded at apex, ± arachnoid but soon glabrescent, 0.8-1.5 X 0.3- 0.4 cm; petioles poorly demarcated, 0.2-1 cm long, ± finely arachnoid when young, glabrescent; leaf blades chartaceous when dry, 2.6-15 X 0.6-5 cm, elliptic to vaguely ovate (length/width 2.6-4.3), attenuate at base, acuminate at apex, secondary veins 8- 12 pairs, level above, prominulous beneath, tertiary venation rather obscure on both sides, adaxial surface matte, finely arachnoid when young, soon glabrescent, abaxial surface ± arachnoid when young, soon glabrescent throughout. Inflorescence pedunculate with peduncle 1-4.6 cm long, rather lax, once or twice dichasially branched, further branchings irregular or monochasial, monochasia 3-5-flowered, axes ± densely villosulous, hairs reddish brown. Only brevistylous flowers seen; calyx green (at least distally) and ± herbaceous, 3.1-3.9 mm long with the transversely lingulate lobes 2.1-2.8 X 2.5-3.1 mm (tube/lobe ra- tio ca. 0.4), moderately arachnoid-puberulous outside at base, subglabrous distally, sparsely sericeous-puberulous inside (more densely so around sinuses); corolla pale greenish white, densely puberulous outside with long rigid hairs, glabrous within, tube 9-10 mm long, lobes 3.3-4 mm long, the appendages 2.3-2.7 X 2.4-2.7 mm; filaments attached ca. 4 mm (ca. 40% of tube length) above base of corolla tube, ca. 3 mm long, anthers ca. 3 mm long; ovary densely puberulous, ca. 4.4 X 1.5 mm; style ca. 2 mm long, stigmatic lobes ca. 3.2 mm. Capsules narrowly cylindrical, 14-53 X 2.5 mm. Seeds 2.7-4 X 0.7-0.8 mm including wing.

description: Trees with bitter bark, branches slender. Leaves petiolate, firmly membranaceous. Stipules interpetiolar, free to base, caducous. Inflorescence dichotomously cymose, cincinnate, or verticillately umbellate, few- to many-flowered, mainly terminal or in the uppermost axils. Peduncle usually solitary, sometimes three. Flowers mainly sessile or very shortly pedicellate pentamerous or tetramerous. Calyx usually 4-5- lobed, the lobes equal or unequal, suborbicular to oblong to oblong-lanceolate, or some- times spathaceous and split on one side and becoming naviculate or hood-shaped, when lobed the calyx tube shorter or longer than the lobes, glabrous to sericeous without. Hypanthium elongate, cylindrical or oblong-turbinate, strigillose or subhirtellous to glabrous without. Corolla showy, white to pink or roseate, hypocrateriform, the tube elongate and sericeous to subhirtellous without, glabrous within, 4-5-lobed; lobes valvate and inflexed in aestivation, each lobe with two petaloid bilobate suborbicular, subrhomboid, or subovate, rounded to acute, crispate appendages shorter than or equaling the length of the main body of the lobe. Stamens 4-5, inserted usually at or near the base of the corolla-tube, but sometimes at the summit; anthers linear, obtuse or shortly appendiculate at summit, rounded at base; filaments short, glabrous. Ovary 2-celled; ovules numerous in each cell, vertically imbricate, anatropous, the placenta adnate to the middle of the septum. Capsule loculicidally dehiscent, splitting from above downward, linear, bisulcate, the endocarp at maturity separating from the exocarp producing 4 valves, these sometimes torulose at maturity, many-seeded. Seeds imbricate, tailed at both ends, the tails erose or lacerate.

description: Shrub of unknown height. Young branches ± densely hirsute or villous. Stipules ovate, ? densely hirtellous, ca. 3.3 cm long; petioles 0.7-1.3 cm long, ± hirsute; leaf blades ± papyraceous when dry, 6.1-21 X 2.6-6.6 cm, elliptic to obovate (length/ width 2.3-3.1), cuneate at base, acuminate at apex, secondary veins 9-11 pairs, level above, prominent beneath, tertiary venation rather distinct above, prominulous beneath, adaxial surface matte, coarsely hirsute or puberulous, abaxial surface coarsely and rather densely hirsute or puberulous throughout. Flowers solitary or up to 3 to- gether in terminal, epedunculate clusters, known only from young buds; calyx ± herbaceous, ca. 10 mm long with the lobes ovate-acuminate and ca. 9.7 X 4.6 mm (tube/lobe ratio <0.1), ± densely lanate-puberulous on both sides; corolla densely puberulous outside with long rigid hairs. Capsules narrowly cylindrical, 67-100 X ca. 2 mm, valves of opened capsules not or only slightly curled. Seeds ca. 8 X 0.6 mm including wing.

description: Tree or shrub, to 10 m tall. Young branches ± pubescent. Stipules ± lingulate, densely to sparsely and minutely puberulent, 0.5- 1.6 X 0.2-0.5 cm; petioles 0.5-2.5 cm long, ± pubescent when young, glabrescent; leaf blades papyraceous to ± chartaceous when dry, 3.1-16 X 0.8-7 cm, elliptic to obovate [length/width (1.3)1.9-4.2], broadly to narrowly cuneate at base, acuminate at apex, secondary veins 8-14 pairs, level above, prominent beneath, tertiary venation invisible or obscure above, ± distinct beneath, adaxial surface matte, arachnoid when young, glabrescent, abaxial surface ± densely and rather coarsely puberulous on midrib and veins, intervenous areas ± sparsely and often minutely puberulous or hirsute. Inflorescence pedunculate, peduncle 1.3-6.5 cm long, often leaning to deflexed, ultimate branch systems strongly congested (to subcapitate), few-flowered until fruiting, axes ± densely puberulous, hirsute, or villosulous. Calyx ± scarious throughout, 3.3-7.7 mm long with lobes ca. 0.3-1.9 mm (tube/lobe ratio 1.2-10), densely to sparsely pubescent outside, glabrous within; corolla with pale green tube and pink lobes, densely puberulous outside with long rigid hairs, this in- dumentum underlayered by one of short curly hairs, glabrous within, tube 16-24 mm long, lobes 3-6.1 mm long, the appendages 3-4 X 4-5 mm; filaments attached 6-9 mm (30-50% of tube length) above base of corolla tube, ca. 1-2 mm long in macrostylous flowers, ca. 4 mm in brevistylous ones, anthers 4.5-5.6 X 0.6-0.8 mm; ovary densely puberulous, 5-7.9 X 1.7-2.5 mm; style 13- 17 mm long in macrostylous flowers, ca. 3.6 mm in brevistylous ones, stigmatic lobes 4- 5.5 mm. Capsules narrowly obovoid to narrowly cylindrical, 17-60(100) X 3-5 mm, valves somewhat spirally coiled in long fruits when old and opened. Seeds ca. 6 X 1 mm including wing.

Stipules narrowly lingulate, sparsely to moderately arachnoid or puberulent, 0.8-1.1 X 0.3-0.5 cm; petioles 0.6-1.9 cm long, ? pubescent when young, glabrescent; leaf blades ± chartaceous when dry, 4.9-17 X 2-6 cm, elliptic to obovate (length/width 2.1-3.3), broadly to narrowly cuneate at base, acuminate at apex, secondary veins 6-12 pairs, level above, prominent beneath, tertiary venation obscure, adaxial surface matte, glabrous or finely puberulous, abaxial surface ± densely arachnoid-villous on midrib and veins, intervenous areas glabrous or ± sparsely puberulous, glabrescent. description: Shrub 3-4.5 m tall, branches glabrous. Stipules oblong, obtuse, 7-10 mm long, 2.5- 4 mm wide, strigillose without towards base, scarcely strigillose to glabrous apically and on margins. Petioles 5-20 mm long, sparsely strigillose to subglabrate. Leaf- blades elliptic-obovate to lanceolate-elliptic, acuminate at apex, acute at base, 5-16 cm long, 2-8 cm wide, glabrous above, slightly strigillose below on younger leaves, glabrescent to glabrous on older ones; lateral nerves slightly elevated beneath, tertiary veins transversey prominent beneath. Inflorescence 3.5 cm long, 3.5-9 cm broad, 6-8-flowered; peduncle 1-7 cm long, sparsely to moderately appressed-pubescent. Hypanthium 5-7.5 mm long, 1.8-2 mm wide, densely strigose without. Calyx 5-7 mm long, more or less deeply lobed; tube 3 mm wide, densely stramineous-sericeous without, glabrous within; lobes oblong, obtuse, densely strigose to hirsutulous except towards the margins where shortly appressed-pubescent. Corolla-tube salmon-roseate, 25-30 mm long, 3 mm wide at the base, 5 mm wide at the orifice, densely strigose without, glabrous within; lobes roseate, appendages dolabriform-suborbicular, 9-10 mm long, 4 mm wide, the central portion elliptic-oblong, acute, 10 mm long, 5 mm wide. Stamens in the lower 1/3 of the tube, anthers 7 mm long; filaments 2 mm long. Style 23 mm long, glabrous; stigmas 6.5 mm long. Capsules linear, 12-35 mm long, 3-7 mm wide, glabrescent to glabrous, mostly not torulose at maturity.

description: Shrub 2-3 m tall, branches glabrous. Stipules ligulate-lanceolate, obtuse at apex, 10-13 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, strigillose to glabrescent. Petioles 7-10 mm long, glabrescent. Leaf-blades elliptic to obovate-elliptic, abruptly obtusely acuminate at apex, cuneately acuminate at base, 8-14 cm long, 3-9 cm wide, glabrous above, finely arachnoid-pilose below with appressed hairs; lateral nerves 9-11 each side, impressed beneath. Lateral axes of the inflorescence 3-5-flowered, 9-15 mm long, cinereous- strigillose; peduncles 1-4 cm long, finely strigillose. Hypanthium 3.5-4.5 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, densely strigose-sericeous without. Calyx-tube cupular, 1-1.5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, loosely strigose-sericeous without; lobes ligulate-oblong, sub- orbicular-oblong, or ovate-oblong, rounded or obtuse, substrigose to loosely pilosulous without, glabrous within. Corolla white, tube 17 mm long, 1.5 mm wide at the base, 2.5 mm wide at the orifice, moderately and antrorsely gray-sericeous without, glabrous within; lobes 4, bilobed to the middle, 9 mm long, the central portion ovate- oblong, 4 mm long, 2.5 mm wide. Stamens in upper part of the tube, anthers 2 mm long; filaments 2 mm long. Mature capsules linear, valves mainly straight or only slightly undulate, not torulose, 3.5-4 cm long, 4-5 mm wide, glabrous.

description: Shrub or tree 2-11 m tall, upper part of stems densely to sparsely strigillose to hirsutulous, lower part of stems sparsely strigillose to glabrous. Stipules linear-oblong, rounded or obtuse at apex, 15-28 mm long, 3-7 mm wide, densely strigose to glabrescent. Petioles 4-23 mm long, strigillose or hirsute to glabrescent. Leaf-blades oblong-elliptic to obovate-oblong, acuminate to caudate at the apex, acute to sub- obtuse at the base, 5.5-28 cm long, 2-10.5 cm wide, glabrous to appressed-pilose above, appressed-pilose to glabrous below, margins appressed-ciliolate; lateral nerves 10-18 on each side, lightly elevated beneath. Inflorescence at anthesis 2-6 cm high (long), 4-10 cm wide, pedunculate, the primary axes 2-5; peduncle appressed- pubescent to villous; primary axes umbelliform, 1-2-dichotomous, each with a solitary central flower and secundly-flowered lateral forks, 5-11-flowered, at anthesis 0.4-4 cm long, strigose or villous to glabrescent. Flowers sessile or shortly pedicellate, to 1.5 mm long. Hypanthium 3-4 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, densely cinereous-sericeous. Calyx-tube subcampanulate 0.5-2 mm long, densely strigose to velutinous without; lobes lance-oblong to suborbicular, rounded to acute, the larger ones 1.5-2.5 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, the smaller ones 1.3-1.8 mm long, 1.2-1.3 mm wide, moderately strigose to villous without, glabrous within. Corolla white, tube 10-17.5 mm long, 2-2.5 mm wide at the base, 3 mm wide at the orifice, densely strigose to tomentellose without; lobes with central portion lance-oblong, subacute, 4-6 mm long, 2.2-2.5 mm wide, finely strigose without, the bilobed appendages 3-5 mm long, 2.5-3.5 mm wide, with ruffled suborbicular-dolabriform lobules. Stamens at summit of the tube, anthers 5 mm long; filaments 5 mm long. Style 11 mm long in long-styled flowers, 3 mm long in short-styled flowers. Capsules linear, 0.8-7 (-10) cm long, appressed- pubescent or pilose with spreading hairs to glabrous. Seeds linear-fusiform, 7-9 mm long; body oblong, 1.8-2 mm long; wings 3-4 mm long, erose at extremities.

description: Caespitose fan-shaped epiphytes to 14- 18 cm tall. Leaves 3-6, narrowly lanceolate or oblanceolate, acuminate, apiculate, long tapered to carinate, petiolate base, 14-18.5 x 1.2-1.6 cm, articulated, conduplicate, imbricating sheaths, moderately dark green, the sheaths concolor green or spotted pale red. Inflorescences successive axillary scapes, erect to laxly pendent, the peduncle terete, slender, 5-7.7 cm long, with 1-3 narrow, conduplicate, acuminate, approximate bracts on the basal half, pale green blotched red, the floral bracts 2, subopposite, blotched pale red. Flower color variable, the sepals and petals dark yellow or green, heavily marked with intense orangish or dark purplish red, the labellum pale tan-yellow heavily overlaid with very dark red blotches and spots, center with a few patches of appressed intertwined white trichomes interspersed with more or less erect, aciform dark red trichomes, the callus ground color pale yellow or red, with spiculate dark red spots, between spots the indumentum short-pilose, hyaline, underneath densely covered with a mixture of short and long, hyaline, thin, pointed trichomes, the column dark yellow with sparse hyaline pubescence dorsally, thickly pilose underneath, spotted and  blotched intense brown-red, the anther straw-yellow with rose-red spots, the ovary green with reddish brown spots. Sepals and petals subsimilar and subequal, the dorsal sepal elliptic, apiculate, 12 x 6.2 mm, the lateral sepals obliquely oblong-elliptic, acute, concave at the base, thickened along the midveins, 15.5 x 6.6 mm, the petals obliquely elliptic, shortly acuminate, margins lightly revolute, 12 x 6.3 mm. Labellum obovate, 13 x 15 mm, the apex with a deeply undulate fold, the margin lacerate- fimbriate, the callus quadrangular, deeply bilobed-emarginate, auricular, with a central oblong, sulcate, broadly thickened rib. Column fleshy, winged, 8.6 mm long, 5 mm broad across the transverse, broadly semiel- liptic wings, the abaxial keel short, 3-3.5 mm long, the column foot with a prominent claw, the anther 1.9 x 1.5 mm, the pollinia 2 in very unequal pairs, larger pair 1.3 x 0.5 mm, smaller pair 1.0 x 0.3 mm, the stipe short, continuous with the rhombic, thick viscidium. Ovary sulcate, obtusely angled, the pedicel terete. Fragrance diurnal, musty.

description: Caespitose fan-shaped epiphytes. Leaves 4-5, linear-lanceolate, acute, articulated to imbricating sheaths, 7-14 x 1.2 cm. Inflorescences slender axillary scapes, semierect, the peduncle with a solitary loose bract below the middle, the floral bracts 2, dissimilar, subopposite. Flowers campanulate, small for the genus, the sepals and petals greenish-white, the labellum white with purple spots and flecks, the column greenis -white with purple spots and flecks, the anther yellowish white, the viscidium and stipe translucent, the pollinia pale yellow. Sepals and petals subsimilar and subequal, 1 1-12 x 5 mm, the dorsal sepal lanceolate, apiculate, concave-galeate, the lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate, curved forward, parallel, decurrent on the foot, the petals obliquely elliptic-oblong, acute, apiculate, parallel. Labellum obovate-suborbicular, concave subsaccate, with a transverse folded ridge near the middle, 11 x 10 mm when expanded, the margins erose above the abruptly subcordate base, the callus elliptic in outline, 0.5 x 0.3 mm, apically with 2 oblique, divergent, complanate teeth and with lateral flaps just below the middle. Column stout, slightly arcuate, with semielliptic wings at the middle, with a short, inconspicuous abaxial keel and below the middle with a thick, raised, oblong rib extending on to the foot, sparsely pubescent dorsally and on wings, 11 x 6 mm, the anther obovoid, 2.8 x 3 mm, the pollina ium 2.6 x 1.2 mm, the viscidium ovate triangular, 1 x 0.6 mm, the pollinia claviform, compressed, larger pair 1.5 x 0.6 mm.

description: Caespitose epiphytes with elongate fanshaped growths. Leaves oblanceolate, acute, articulated to imbricating sheaths, 7-12 x 1.2-2.0 cm, the petioles conduplicate. Inflorescences slender axillary scapes, with a single clasping bract near the middle and a solitary floral bract. Flowers campanulate, the sepals yellowish, translucent, the petals similar but with purple spots, the labellum dark purple with a paler, darker spotted picotee, the callus dark purple, the column pale yellow, the anther pale yellow with several purple spots, the stipe and viscidium hyaline, the pollinia very pale yellow. Dorsal sepal obliquely oblong-lanceolate, acute, 11 x 4 mm, with small basal auricles. Lateral sepals strongly oblique, ovate-oblong, subfalcate, acute, adnate to the column foot, 12 x 4 mm. Petals obliquely oblong-lan- ceolate, acute, 11 x 4 mm, with small basal auricles. Labellum obovate, obtuse, 9.5 x 7.4 mm, deeply concave at the base, constricted at the middle, the proximal lateral margins tightly revolute, the distal lateral margins strongly crisped-undulate, plicate, erose, with a sparsely spiculate surface, the callus free, very fleshy throughout, with 2 basal, lateral teeth, 2-ridged in the center, with the apex rounded with 2 short, blunt, downward projecting teeth. Column cla- vate, adaxially sparsely short-spiculate, the abaxially keel diminishing gradually to the base, 9.5 x 3 mm including the foot, the anther 2 x 2 mm, the pollinarium 0.35 x 0.18 mm, the pollinia 4 in two dissimilar pairs, obliquely oblong-claviform, convex- concave, recurved, complanate, larger pair 0.18 x 0.05 mm, the stipe broadly elliptic, truncate, the viscidium sessile, elliptic.

description: Fan-shaped caespitose epiphytes to 17 cm tall. Leaves lanceolate, acute, conduplicate at the base, 1 1-17 x 1.0-1.5 cm, articulated to basal sheaths. Inflorescences axillary scapes, laxly pendent, the peduncle terete with 2 close basal bracts, the flower with 2 subopposite floral bracts. Flowers pure white. Sepals subsimilar and subequal, 1.3- 1.5 x 0.6-0.64 cm, the dorsal sepal elliptic lanceolate, acute, lightly concave, distal margins lightly involute, the lateral sepals ovate-oblong, obtuse or abruptly acute. Petals obliquely ovate, abruptly acuminate, 1.3 x 0.81 cm. Labellum suborbicular when expanded, crisped-undulate, margins erosedenticulate, joint of claw and foot of column sharply angled, 1.3 x 1.5 cm; callus rhombiform, 2-ridged in the center, distal margins repand. Column elliptic in outline, winged, abaxial central keel extends only to base of wings, descending below, sparsely pubescent in the middle on both surfaces, the anther granulate distally, the anther dor- sally tuberculate, 2.2 x 1.8 mm, the polli- narium 2.8 x 1.3 mm, the pollinia 4 in two dissimilar pairs, larger pair 1.6 x 0.6 mm, the viscidium, ovate, 1.2 x 0.6 mm. description: Caespitose, acaulous epiphytes to 14 cm tall, producing fan-shaped growths. Stems completely covered by distichous, imbricating, articulated, conduplicate, foliar sheaths. Leaves lanceolate, acute, mid-vein carinate, thin, 12-14 x 1.6 cm, pale green. Inflorescences multiple scapes from basal leaf axils; peduncle terete, subtended by 2 remote ovate, acute, loose bracts; floral bract subsimilar, smaller. Flowers light green with dark purple to brownish red spots, more dense on the dorsal sepal and petals, the labellum white tinged green with sparsely occurring brownish spots near the middle along the inner margin, the column very pale green, the anther pale cream to nearly white. Dorsal sepal ovate, obtuse to shortly acute, 1.7 x 0.8 cm. Lateral sepals oblique, ovate, basally concave, 2.2 x 0.8 cm. Petals ovate, acute, oblique, 2.2 x 1.2 cm. Labellum shortly clawed, the blade when expanded broadly oval, 1.5 x 1.2 cm, in natural position sides strongly incurved, concave, distal margin strongly reflexed, pleated, the callus extending from the base to beyond the middle of the labellum, consisting of a central, low, rounded, elongate rib, thicker through the basal half, flanked by two nearly erect, compressed, semiovate lobes, attenuate toward the apex. Column arcuate, with obtuse triangular wings and a prominent ventral keel below the stigma, 1.4 x 0.67 cm, with a prominent foot. description: Small fan-shaped caespitose epiphytes. Leaves narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, the mid-vein carinate, 10-13 x 1.2-1.4 cm, articulated to imbricate bases. Inflorescences axillary scapes, erect or arching, the peduncle flexuous, 4.0 cm long, 0.05 cm in diam., clear green. Flowers white, the column white with yellow wings and sparse dark rose-red spots. Column fleshy, the wings semielliptic, pubes- cent, the low abaxial keel diminishing toward the foot, the anther transversely elliptic with a rhombic base, 1.75 x 1.8 mm, the pollinarium 1.9 x 1.0 mm, the pollinia 4, hard, in 2 unequal oblanceolate, complanate pairs, larger pair only slightly convex, the viscidium elliptic, acute.

description: Caespitose, acaulous epiphytes to 9.5 cm tall, producing fan-shaped growths. Leaves several, lanceolate, mid-vein carinate, acuminate, articulated to conduplicate sheaths imbricating at base, to 8.0 x 1.4 cm, pale dull green. Inflorescences multiple axillary slender scapes. Flowers pale green-yellow with red-brown markings towards the base; labellum exterior whitish, interior with dark purplish red markings intensifying towards the center, the dark red colored areas consisting of short, small tuberculiform cells; column base clear green-yellow, foot white with dark red-brown markings; anther pale yellow mottled red-brown; pollinia yellowish white. Column without wings, dorsal lower half sparsely pubescent, with a prominent, longitudinal, abaxial keel, 0.25 cm long, below stigma descending to become a low ridge dividing the concave base and foot, with 8- 10 small blisters on each thickened margin, keel thicker and much wider on the foot. description: Acaulous epiphytes to 17.5 cm tall, producing fan-shaped growths, with promi- nent, more or less ascending rhizome. Leaves several, grading into bracts, oblanceolate to narrowly elliptic, elongate, conduplicate, distichous, petiolate, acuminate, acute to minutely apiculate, 16-17.5 x 1.8 5 cm, dark green. Inflorescences multiple axillary scapes, laxly erect, terete, to 6.0 cm long, subtended by 2 floral bracts, larger bract nearly surrounding peduncle, transverse, ovate-reniform, 0.43 x 0.9 cm. Flowers pale yellowish green, the labellum clear yellow with reddish brown spots and blotches on the basal half of the concave involute sides of labellum; callus yellow with scattered small reddish spots; column same color as the sepals with small red spots dispersed over ventral surface; anther dull yellow suffused reddish brown; pollinia wax-white. Sepals subsimilar, ovate-elliptic, acute apiculate, spreading, 1.5-1.8 x 0.9-1.0 cm; the lateral sepals larger, slightly oblique, concave and shortly connate at the base, adnate to column foot. Petals oblique, ovate- elliptic, acute to apiculate, mid-vein thick- ened, 1.67 x 0.9 cm. Labellum concave to subsaccate, obscurely 3-lobed, shortly clawed, 1.1 x 1.25 cm; lateral lobes rounded, concave; midlobe transversely reniform, erose, reflexed; callus of 3 longitudinal ridg- es to midpoint, 4-dentate apically, minutely tuberculate, 0.72 x 0.4 cm. Column convex above, more or less flat to lightly convex below, sparsely short pubescent, with a small, short keel extending below the stigma, 1.3 cm long, 0.52 cm broad across wide spreading wings, the foot pronounced; anther 0.15 x 0.175 cm; pollinia 4 in 2 unequal pairs, clavate, concave, larger pair 0.18 x 0.55 cm, smaller pair 0.14 x 0.5 cm; stipe oblong, acute.

description: Diminutive fan-shaped epiphytes with very short rhizomes. Leaves lanceolate, acute, tapered to the slender, articulated, conduplicate, petiolate base, 8.0-11.2 x 1.0- 1.2 cm. Inflorescences successive axillary scapes, lax, the peduncle to 4.0 cm long pedicellate ovary to 1.0 cm long, the 2 floral bracts, unequal, subopposite, ovate, acute. Sepals very pale greenish yellow with faint purplish red dots, the spots paler on distal half, darker and more defined on basal half, the petals more densely spotted, the labellum very pale tan with dark red spots, the column pale yellowish green with abaxial brownish red spots, the anther pale cream yellow. Sepals subequal, 1.5-1.7 x 0.5 cm, the dorsal sepal narrowly elliptic lanceolate, apiculate, nearly flat, the lateral sepals obliquely oblong-lanceolate, apiculate, basally concave. Petals lanceolate, apiculate, 1.45 x 0.55 cm, recurved at the apex. Labellum obovate, 1.2 x 0.9 cm, margins erose-dentate, the callus subrhombic, ar- cuate, bilobed. Column fleshy, winged, 7.9 x 3.5 mm, distal portion of abaxial keel highest below stigma, semioblong-elliptic, below low carinate, the wings below the middle of column, obliquely semiovate, directed back and slightly downward, sparsely pubescent, the anther 1.3 x 1.4 mm, broader than long across the apex, the pollinarium 1.8 mm long, the pollinia in two very unequal pairs, the viscidium hastiform-lanceolate, viscid pad more or less narrowly elliptic occupying a little more than half the length of the viscidium. Pedicellate ovary to 1.0 cm long.

description: Fruit ovoid, 10 mm diam., 22 mm long, with pericarp 1 mm thick, stigmatic remains apical-similar to the preceding only in its vascular bundles, which lack sheaths and constitute a single series in the inner 1/3 of the pericarp, otherwise remarkably different: characterized by a unique continuous layer of short columnar sclereids pressed against the locular epidermis, and resembling it, giving the appearance of a double locular epidermis, the outer short fibrous bundles much larger and the mantle of brachysclereids more diffuse, and with numerous tanniniferous cells in the inner 1/2 of the pericarp.

description: Fruit ovoid, 9 mm diam., 20 mm long, with pericarp 1.6 mm thick, stigmatic remains apical-remarkable for the two concentric rings of very flat fibrous bundles adjacent to the locular epidermis, with vascular bundles lacking fibrous sheaths in the inner 1/3 of the pericarp; further characterized by a thin subepidermal mantle of brachysclereids with embedded narrow, short fibrous bundles, a lack of tanniniferous cells, and a moderately thick locular epidermis.

description:
A Pinckneya et a Pogonopo calyce tetramero, corolla hepta- vel octomera, staminibus a apice corollae tubi secedentibus, antheris quasi 300 locellis, capsula septicidali, seminibus duabus alis irregularibus absimilis.

Arbores 6-18 m altae, trunci diametro 10-20 cm; stipula caduca bilobata 4.5-5 cm longa; petiolus folii 10-19 cm longus, folii lamina obovata, anguste obovata vel anguste elliptica, 50-100 x 19-50 cm, nervis secundariis arcuatis 20-40; inflorescentia floribus 50-160, ramis secundariis flore terminali calycis uno lobo foliaceo 16-24 cm longo subtenta duobus ramis tertiariis scorpioideis 5.5-8 cm longis.
bibliographicCitation: Kirkbride, Joseph H., Jr. 1985. Manipulus Rubiacearum IV Kerianthera (Rubiaceae), a new genus from Amazonian Brazil. Brittonia. 37: 109-116.

description: Trees 6-18 m tall with the trunk 10-20 cm in diam, densely to sparsely velutinous with the hairs incompletely septate, with crystal sand in various tissues; branchlets terete; stipules interpetiolar, bilobate, the lobes narrowly triangular, narrowly acute at the apex, 4.5-5 x 1 cm, caducous, the inner surface glabrous; leaves opposite, very large, petiolate, the petiole terete, 10-19 cm long; leaf blade entire, obovate to narrowly so or narrowly elliptic, acuminate at the apex, long attenuate at the base, 50-100 x 19-50 cm, 1.9-3.3 times longer than wide, with 20-40 arcuate secondary veins on each side of the midrib, anastomosing near the margin, these sulcate to weakly so above and prominent below, and sparsely velutinous and the intervenium glabrate above and these velutinous and the intervenium sparsely velutinous below; inflorescences terminal, red with 50-160 flowers, 35-40 x 25-30 cm, modified thyrsoid with 2-6 opposite, decussate, secondary branches, the secondary branches 5.5-8 cm long, with a terminal flower with 1 calyx lobe expanded into a large colored foliar organ, subtended by 2 scorpioid cymous branches, the tertiary branches 3.5-10 cm long, with 5-11 flowers without a foliar calyx lobe, with 1 bract subtending each branch and flower, the bracts triangular to rarely broadly so, narrowly acute to rarely acute at the apex, 6-24 x 4-12 mm, glabrous on the inner surface; flowers sessile, red, the ovary inferior; hypanthium cylindrical, 16-19 mm tall, 4-6 mm in diam; calyx tubular with 4 distinct lobes, glabrous within with 10-11 colleters subtending each sinus, the colleters 0.4-1 mm long, the tube 7 mm tall, the lobes broadly oblong, broadly acuminate at the apex, 5-7 x 3.5-5 mm, sometimes with 1 lobe expanded into a red foliar organ, the pseudopetiole 5-9 cm long, the pseudoblade elliptic to obovate, acute at the apex, attenuate at the base, 11-15.5 x 5-6 cm, 2.2-2.6 times longer than wide, with 6 or 7 basal acrodromous primary veins, abaxially sparsely velutinous, adaxially moderately velutinous; corolla tubular with 7 or 8 erect lobes forming an extension of the tube, valvate with the apices of the lobes overlapping slightly, the tube 50 mm long, glabrous within, the apical orifice 9 mm in diam, the basal orifice 5 mm in diam, the lobes narrowly oblong, obtuse at the apex, ca 18 x 6 mm, densely lanate with non-septate hairs within with the apex glabrous; stamens separating from the tube at its apex, partially exserted from the tube proper but included within the pseudotube of erect lobes, filaments tangentially compressed, ca 1.5 mm long, ca 1 mm wide, glabrous; anthers dorsifixed slightly below the middle, 10 mm long, ca 1 mm thick, with ca 300 locelli 0.2-0.8 mm long, with the introrse dehiscence by 2 longitudinal slits; circular disc completely filling the apex of the ovary between the corolla and the style; style simple, terete, 70 mm long, glabrous, the exserted stigma bilobate with the lobes broadly oblong, 1.5 x 1.5 mm, very minutely papillate; ovary bilocular with 1 placenta in each locule, the locules very narrowly spindle-shaped, 15-16 mm tall, ca 1 mm in diam, with a septal ridge 0.1 mm tall extending the full height of the locule, the placenta terete, divided in the middle almost its full length, 10-11 mm long, 0. 3-0.4 mm in diam, with 4 irregular rows of horizontally attached ovules from base to apex, the more than 500 ovules crescent-shaped, with the funicular attachment in the center of the concave edge, 0.3-0.4 mm long, 0.1 mm tall, oriented at right-angles to the axis of the placenta; fruit capsular, septicidal beginning at the apex of the ovary and going to the base, with the outer locule wall splitting later and the persistent, unruptured calyx linking the locule walls at the apex, weakly turbinate, 3-4.5 cm tall including the calyx, 1-1.5 cm in diam; seeds numerous, unequally biwinged, with the wings irregular in shape, 3-4 mm long, 1-1.8 mm tall, the testa cells rectangular with straight lateral walls, 169-273 x 44-113 µm, the outer wall thin and smooth, the internal walls with 19-26 large pits, the pits 7-15 µm in diam.
bibliographicCitation: Kirkbride, Joseph H., Jr. 1985. Manipulus Rubiacearum IV Kerianthera (Rubiaceae), a new genus from Amazonian Brazil. Brittonia. 37: 109-116.

description: Caespitose epiphytes, 12-15 cm tall. Leaves several, linear, long-tapered, acute, articulated to conduplicate sheathing bases, 15 x 0.6-0.9 cm. Inflorescences 1-2 per growth, axillary few-flowered racemes, occasionally branched. Flowers campanulate, segments pale yellow suffused with red towards the base, dorsal sepal with 3 inconspicuous reddish longitudinal stripes, lateral sepals and petals transversely reddish brown barred basally, basal half of labellum striped with intense purple and brown red, column pale green, anther pale yellow. Dorsal sepal ovate-lanceolate, acute, concave, 0.85 x 0.48 cm. Lateral sepals obliquely ovate-oblong, acute, concave, lightly carinate, margins involute, 0.7 x 0.38 cm. Pet- als oblong, acute, 0.7 x 0.3 cm. Labellum 4-lobulate, 0.6 x 0.57 cm, articulate to column foot; lateral lobes rounded, obtuse, in- curved, erect; midlobe emarginate, concave, the lobules subquadrate; callus basal, erect, 2-lobed. Column short, stout, with a prominent foot. Pollinia 4, in 2 equal pairs, obovate, compressed, viscidium ovate.
bibliographicCitation: Bennett, David E. & Christenson, Eric A. 1994. New Species and New Combinations in Peruvian Orchidaceae. Brittonia. 46 (1): 24-53.

description: Fruit 3.2 cm diam., with pericarp extremely thick (to nearly 6 mm), seed laterally compressed and irregularly indentedresembling the preceding 4 genera, but distinctive for its unusual branching and twisting vascular bundles that permeate much of the fruit, and which are sheathed with small tanniniferous cells rather than fibers, and for its extremely thick mantle of brachysclereids in the outer pericarp.
bibliographicCitation: Essig, Frederick B., et al. 1999. Systematic Histological Study of Palm Fruits. III. Subtribe Iguanurinae (Arecaceae). Brittonia. 51 (3): 307-325.

description: Herbae epiphyticae, caespitosae, parvae, usque ad 2.1 cm altae. Folia elliptica, 0.6-1.4 cm longa, 0.3-0.6 cm lata, apice minutissime tridenticulata. Caules secundarii erecti, 4-7 vaginati. Inflorescentiae 3-5 mm longae. Sepalum dorsale late-ovatum, acutum, 3-nervium, 0.17-0.21 mm longum, 0.14-0.17 mm latum, sepalis lateralibus 0.06 mm connatum; sepala lateralia ovata, acuta, 0.16-0.18 mm longa, 0.12-0.14 mm lata, inter se 0.09 mm connata. Petala transverse bilobata, flava basin versus rubra. Labellum trilobatum, lobis lateralibus apicem versus flavis, ad basin rubris, circa 0.06 mm longis, lobo intermedio brevi, apice sparsim pubescente. Columna circa 0.08 mm longa.

description: Herbae parvae, caespitosae, epiphyticae, usque ad 3.8 cm altae. Caules secundarii prostrati vel erecti, 3-7 vaginati, vaginis infundibuliformibus. Folia anguste-obovata vel oblanceolata, 9-24 mm longa, 4-9 mm lata, apice minutissime tridenticulata. Sepala anguste-triangularia, ciliata acuta; sepalum dorsale 3.2-3.8 mm longum, 1.2- 2.0 mm latum, 3-nervium, cum sepalis lateralibus 1/3-1/4 connatum; sepala lateralia 3 mm longa, 1.0-1.6 mm lata ad basin, 2-nervia, inter se 1/5-l/6 connata. Petala trans- verse bilobata, 1-nervia, rubra; lobis posterioribus quam anterioribus aliquantum longioribus et latioribus. Labellum trilobatum, lobis lateralibus lineari-ovatis, circa 1.0 mm longis, circa 0.25 mm latis, lobo intermedio puberulo, retuso. Columna 1.3-1.6 mm longa.

description: Herbae epiphyticae, caespitosae, usque ad 14.0 cm altae. Folia ovata, 1.6-3.4 cm longa, 0.6-1.8 cm lata, apice minutissime tridenticulata. Caules secundarii erecti, 4-11 vaginati. Inflorescentiae ad superficiem inferiorem foliorum adpressae. Sepala ovata, acuta; sepalum dorsale 2.6-3.6 mm longum, 1.6-2.5 mm latum, 3-nervium, cum sepalis lateralibus 0.7-1.3 mm connatum; sepala lateralia 2.3-3.1 mm longa, 1.5-2.1 mm lata, 2-nervia, inter se 0.75-1.3 mm connata. Petala transverse bilobata, atrosanguinea, lobis posterioribus quam lobis anterioribus fere 2-ploi longioribus, lobis posterioribus plerumque superpositis sese tangentibus; lobi angusti, usque ad 0.47 mm lati. Labellum trilobatum, lobis lateralibus 1.0-1.3 mm longis, 0.26-0.47 mm latis, lobo intermedio pusillo, 0.13-0.17 mm longo, pubescente. Columna 0.87-1.3 mm longa.

description: Herbae epiphyticae, caespitosae, usque ad 14.4 cm altae. Folia ovata, acuta vel acuminata, apice minutissime tridenticulata, 1.3-4.3 cm longa, 0.5-1.9 cm lata. Caules secundarii erecti, 5-14 vaginati. Inflorescentiae ad superficiem superiorem foliorum adpressae, usque ad 2.7 cm longae. Sepala flava, diaphana; sepalum dorsale late ovati-triangulare, acutum, 3-nervium, 2.5-3.1 mm longum, 1.6-2.8 mm latum, aliquando cum area rubra ad basin, cum sepalis lateralibus 0.8-1.4 mm connatum; sepala lateralia 2.0-2.7 mm longa, 1.3-2.2 mm lata, ovata, acuta, 2-nervia, inter se 0.8-1.4 mm connata. Petala flava, marginibus basalibus apicalisque rubri-striatis, transverse bilobata, lobis posterioribus quam lobis anterioribus majoribus. Labellum trilobatum; lobis lateralibus usque ad 1.1 mm longis, lobo intermedio pusillo, usque ad 0.2 mm longo, dense pubescente. Columna usque ad 1.1 mm longa.

description: Plant epiphytic, caespitose, 1.1-3.5 cm tall. Secondary stems generally decumbent or drooping, monophyllous, 3-12 mm long, bearing 3-5 sheaths; sheaths with an ovate, cuspidate, infundibuliform mouth, ciliate along margins, muricate along nerves. Leaves narrowly obovate, tridenticulate apically, 5-9 mm wide, 1.1-2.3 cm- long. Inflorescences usually 1 per growth, racemes 0.9-2.3 cm long, sometimes exceeding leaf in length, not appressed to leaf but bent away from it, flowers alternate. Bracts infundibuliform, about 1.2 mm long, often ciliate. Fruit (only immature fruit measured) about 3 mm long, about 2 mm wide. Flowers mostly reddish. Sepals ciliate; dorsal sepal deltoid-ovate, slightly accuminate, 3-veined, 3.5-4.2 mm long, 2.5-3.2 mm wide, connate with lateral sepals for 1.0-1.6 mm; lateral sepals ovate, acute to slightly acuminate, 2-veined, 2.8-3.9 mm long, 2.0-2.6 mm wide, connate for 1.2-2.0 mm. Petals bilobed, the lobes subequal, often minutely ciliate, posterior lobe 1.7-2.1 mm long, 0.63-0.95 mm wide, anterior lobe 1.7-2.2 mm long, 0.47-0.84 mm wide. Middle lobe of lip a retuse, short stemmed, hairy apiculus, about 0.16 mm long, lateral lobes of lip 1.3-1.8 mm long, 0.4-0.9 mm wide. Column about 1.1-1.2 mm long, about 0.3-0.4 mm wide at tip.

description: Plant epiphytic, caespitose, mature plants 1.9-12.7 cm tall. Secondary stems erect, monophyllous, 0.6-9.5 cm long (mature plants), bearing 3-12 sheaths, each with an ovate, acute, infundibuliform mouth; sheaths puberulent along nerves and margin. Mature leaves short petiolate, ovate to lanceolate or elliptic, tridenticulate apically, 0.35-1.3 cm wide, 1.1-3.7 cm long. Inflorescences usually appressed to top side of leaves, 1-8 per leaf, peduncle 0.3-2.8 cm long, never equalling the leaf. Flowers alternate. Bracts infundibuliform, about 1 mm long, acute, carinate, ciliate along keel (sterile bracts usually not ciliate along keel). Sepals ciliate along margins, greenish to tan with reddish tinges in places. Dorsal sepal ovate, acute, 1.5-2.2 mm wide, 2.7-3.4 mm long, 3-veined. Lateral sepals 2-veined, connate for 0.6-1.1 mm, obliquely ovate, acute, 1.3-1.7 mm wide, 2.3-2.9 mm long. Petals usually deep orange-yellow with a band of red to dark reddish orange along margins, bilobed, falcate (semi-lunar), posterior lobe larger than the anterior lobe; posterior lobe 1.3-1.95 mm long, 0.5-0.9 mm wide; anterior lobe 0.9-1.6 mm long, 0.3-0.6 mm wide. Middle lobe of lip puberulent, retuse, 0.1-0.2 mm long; lateral lobes of lip from almost completely deep blood-red to deepest red along inner basal part and lighter red toward outer apical margins, 1.2-1.7 mm long, 0.4-0.5 mm wide. Column 1.0-1.5 mm long.

description: Herbae epiphyticae, caespitosae, 4.1-11.3 cm altae. Folia ovata, acuta vel acuminata, 1.3-3.5 cm longa, 6-17 mm lata, apice minutissime tridenticulata. Caules secundarii erecti, 5-13 vaginati. Infloresceintiae ad superficiem inferiorem foliorum adpressae, 5-16 mm longae. Sepala ovata, acuta; sepalum dorsale plerumque omnino flavum autem aliquando basin versus rubrum notatum, 3-nervium, 2.7-3.7 mm longum, 1.4-2.4 mm latum, cum sepalis lateralibus 0.6-1.1 mm connatum; sepala lateralia flava, 2-nervia, 2.1-3.2 mm longa, 1.1-2.4 mm lata, inter se 0.9-1.8 mm connata. Petala transverse bilobata, flava ad basin rubrinotata, lobis posterioribus quam lobis anterioribus aliquando majoribus. Labellum trilobatum, lobis lateralibus flavis ad basin rubris, recurvatis, 0.9-1.6 mm longis, 0.3-0.5 mm latis, lobo intermedio filiformi pusillo, 0.2-0.3 mm longo, tenui, glabro. Columna 1.0-1.5 mm longa, apice acuto cum apiculo tenui ad apicem.

description: Herbae epiphyticae, caespitosae, usque ad 18.2 cm altae. Folia ovata, acuta vel acuminata, 1.0-3.9 cm longa, 0.6-2.6 cm lata, apice minutissime tridenticulata. Caules secundarii erecti, 4-13 vaginati. Inflorescentiae infra folia, usque ad 2.9 cm longae. Sepala lateralia flava diaphana, ovata, acuta, 2-nervia, 2.1-3.3 mm longa, 1.3-2.2 mm lata, inter se 0.9-1.5 mm connata; sepalum dorsale flavum diaphanum plerumque rubrum, ovatum, acutum, 3-nervium, 2.6-3.9 mm longum, 1.4-2.7 mm latum, sepalis lateralibus 0.7-1.2 mm connatum. Petala transverse bilobata, flava ad basin rubra, lobis posterioribus quam lobis anterioribus majoribus. Labellum trilobatum, lobis lateralibus plerumque omnino rubris, interdum apicem versus flavis, 0.9-1.3 mm longis, 0.2-0.4 mm latis, lobo intermedio pusillo, panduriformi, apice retuso vel applanato, minute puberulo, 0.1-0.3 mm longo. Columna rubra, 0.7-1.3 mm longa.

description: Suffrutex ut videtur caulibus superne villosulis, internodiis foliisque subaequilongis; foliorum laminis 4-5 cm longis ovatis aeutis in basi rotundato-cordatis, marginibus irregulariter serratis, pagina superiore appresso-hirsuta, inferiore villosa, petiolis ad 15 mm longis elatis; floribus in paniculis 10-15 cm longis elatis, ad apices ramulorum 2-3 cm longorum confertis; calycum florentium tubo 2 mm longo, dentibus ovatis, brevissime acuminatis, in maturitate vix 3 mm longis et paulo auctis; corollarum albarum tubo vix 2 mm longo; nuculis dorsaliter ad basim sulco tenue depressis.

description: Shrubs 1-2 m tall, their branchlets densely pubescent with branched hairs; leaves oblong or ovate-oblong, 6-12 cm long, 3.5-6 cm broad, generally obtuse at the apex, cordate or cordate-truncate at the base and some- times abruptly and shortly narrowed to the petiole, the upper surface bullate, glabrate but sprinkled with branched hairs, the lower rather densely ashy- pubescent with branched hairs, margins serrulate-crenate, petioles 1-12 mm long, rather stout; flowering calyces 2.5-3 mm long, pubescent with mostly simple hairs, the teeth deltoid, blunt, hairy on the inner surfaces, the teeth about 1 mm long, mature calyces 6-7 mm long, membranous, but rather flaccid and not tumid, the teeth scarcely enlarged; corolla tubes 2.5-3 mm long; nutlets oval, fuscous, nearly 2 mm long.

description: Shrubs or small trees 2-5 m tall, upper stems densely tomentose; leaves generally 12-20 cm long, 4-10 cm broad, ovate-lanceolate, generally acute at the apex or shortly acuminate, mostly narrowed below the middle or toward the base and attenuate along an indefinitely margined petiole, 1.5-3 cm long, upper surface bullate, sparingly pubescent with branched hairs, the lower tomentose and often velvety with tangled branched hairs, rufous when dry, said to be gray buff when fresh, margins serrulate-crenate; flower- ing calyces 3.5-5 mm long, the teeth 1-1.5 mm long, mature calyces 5.5-7 mm long, membranous, tumid, mostly clothed with simple hairs, the teeth 1-2 mm long, deltoid-acuminate, slender and sharp, more or less connivent; corolla tubes 1.5-4 mm long, bearing a patch of longish hairs on the lower lip between the stamen pair; nutlets oval, fuscous, about 1.5 mm long.

description: Suiffrutex altitudine ad 2 m., caulibus pilis extensis sparse villosis; foliorum laminis plerumque 7-10 cm. (12.5 cm.) longis, ad 7.5 cm. latis, cordatis vel hastato-cordatis, in apice obtusiusculis, in basi cordatis, utrimque sparse villosis, marginibus dentatis; petiolis 1.5-2.5 cm. longis; floribus oppositis in paniculis amplis ad.50 cm. longis dispositis, bracteis sessilibus amplexicaulibus subrotundis; pedicellis 1.5-3.5 cm. longis; corollarum lilacinarum tubo 20-32 mm. longo, intus ad basim annulato; calycum maturorum tubo campanulato saepius 10-12 mm. longo, extus sparse glanduloso, dentibus deltoideis, 5-10 mm. lonlgis, in apice acuminatis, quam tubus brevioribus; nuculis glabris, 3-4 mm. kongis. Typus: Indian Canyon Trail, Santa Ana Mountains, Epling (UCLA).

description: Shrubs or small trees as much as 8 m tall; branchlets densely pubescent, even lanate with branched hairs; leaf blades 7-20 cm long, 4-11 cm broad, generally ovate-lanceolate, sometimes, as in the type, oblong-lanceolate, mostly acute at the apex, rounded, truncate, cordate or even subsagittate at the base, not at all decurrent onto the petiole, finely serrulate-crenate, the upper surfaces bullate and glabrate with scattered branched hairs, the lower surfaces pubescent, even velvety with branched hairs, petioles 1-4 cm long; flowering calyces 3-5.5 (rarely 6-7) mm long, the teeth deltoid-lanceolate, acute, even acuminate, rarely obtuse but sometimes thus on the same branch, 1.5-2.5 mm long, rarely less, pubescent with mostly simple hairs, 6-8 mm long at maturity and not tumid; corolla tubes 2.5-5 mm long; nutlets 1.5 mm long, ovoid.

description: Suffrutex altitudine ad 1 m. et ultra, caulibus minute hirtellis saepius ( ? semper) roseis; foliorum laminis oblongo-ovatis plerumque 5-6 cm. longis, ad 3.5 cm. latis, in apice obtusiusculis, in basi cuneato-angustatis, rarius subhastatis, pagina superiore glabra viride, inferiore puberula, marginibus obscure dentatis, petiolis obscuris ad 1 cm. longis; floribus oppositis in paniculis gracilibus ad 60 cm. longis bracteis laneeolatis pro rata parvis.; pedicellis 1-3 cm. longis; corollarum lilacinarum tubo 20-30 mm. longo, intus ad basim annulato; calycum maturorum tubo campanulato saepius 8-10 mm. longo, extus sparse glanduloso, dentibus 6-11 mm. longis acicularibus rigidis, tubum subaequantibus; nuculis glabris, 2-3.5 mm. longis. Typus: Otay Mountain, 3000 feet, Epling, Robison & Gander (UCLA).
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Suffrutex ad 1.5 cm. altus caulibus pilis simplicibus extensis villosis; foliorum laminis mediis sessllibus, 15 cm. longis et ultra, 6-7 cm. latis, ellipticis, in apice acuminatis, ad basim dilatatis et amplexicaulibus, utrimque breviter et sparse villosis marginibus obscure serratis; fioribus paucis sessilibus in glomerulis in axillis foliorum superiorum deminutorum ample paniculate dispositis; calycum membranaceorum maturorum tubo 4 mm. longo, dentibus duobus inferioribus 6-7 mm, longis, liberis, superioribus tribus aequilongis, ad medium connatis, omnibus deltoideo-lanceolatis, acutis; corollarum lilacinarum tubo 7-8 m. longo; staminibus e tubo 5 mm. exsertis; nuculis 3 mm. longis, solitariis.

description: Frutex vel suffrutex altitudine ignotus verisimiliter plus quam 1 m atque plus minusve lignosus; foliis et ramulis pilis minutis ramosis ubique et sparse tectis; floribus plerumque in foliorum diminutorum axillis sessilibus frequenter ut videtur solitariis; calycum tubo florentium 2.5-3 mm longo, in maturitate paulo aucto, dentibus subaequalibus in maturitate plus minusve 3 mm longis; corollarum tubo cylindrato, plus minusve 5 mm longis, itaque in calycibus vel inclusis vel paulo exsertis et lobis ex calycum lobis (praesertim inferiore)-breviter exsertis, etiam areolis duobus trigonalibus sub labiarum superiorem ornatis; staminibus inclusis; nuculis maturis nigris 2 mm longis.

description: Shrubs about a meter tall, branchlets ashy-tomentulous with small branched hairs; leaf blades generally 5-8 cm long, 2-5 cm broad, obtuse at the apex, obtusely narrowed at the base, oval or oblong, sub-membranous, ashy and concolorous on both surfaces and puberulent with finely branched hairs, crenulate, not attenuate along the petioles, the petioles 5-10 mm long; flowering calyces 2.5-3.5 mm long, finely pubescent with branched hairs even on the inside of the teeth, teeth deltoid acute, scarcely 1 mm long, tending to be apiculate, mature calyces about 5 mm long, the teeth then somewhat increased; corolla tubes 2-3 mm long; nutlets ovoid, about 1 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Jativa, Carlos D. 1968. Supplementary notes on American Labiatae X. Brittonia. 20: 295-313.

description: Shrubs or small trees 2-5 m, branchlets white tomentulose with small branched hairs; leaf blades generally 6-10 cm long, 1.5-2.5 cm broad, oblong-elliptical, obtuse at the apex, narrowed toward the base but not attenu- ate along the petioles which are 5-10 cm long, weakly bullate and thinly pubescent, whitish pubescent beneath with small branched hairs, margins finely serrulate-crenate; flowering calyces 2-3.5 mm long, finely pubescent with branched hairs, even on the inside of the teeth, teeth deltoid, acute, scarcely 1 mm long, 4-6 mm long at maturity, tumid, the teeth then somewhat increased, erect or flaring; corolla tubes 2-3 mm long; nutlets obovate, fuscous 1.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Jativa, Carlos D. 1968. Supplementary notes on American Labiatae X. Brittonia. 20: 295-313.

description: Herba suffruticosa caulibus procumbentibus ramoso-hirsutis internodiis quam folia plerumque brevioribus; foliorum laminis ovatis 1.5-3 cm longis, in apice rotundatis vel obtusis, in basi modo late cuneatis modo cordatis, irregulariter crenulatis, pagina superiore valde bullata, plus minusve pubescente, inferiore subtomentosa, petiolis 1-1.5 .cm longis; floribus in spicis confertis 1.5-3 cm longis 1-1.5 cm diametro, modo terminalibus modo in foliorum supremorum axillis positis; calycibus florentibus subsessilibus 3.5 mm longis, in maturitate paulo auctis labia superiore quam inferior duplo longiore, dentibus deltoideis acutis 1-1.5 mm longis postice maximo; corollarum albarum tubo 4 mm longo; nuculis 1 mm longis.

description: Shrubs 1-3 m tall, more or less pubescent in the inflorescence with often branched hairs; leaves to 20 cm long, elliptical lanceolate, acute, narrowed (sometimes rounded) at the base to petioles 1-1.5 cm long, crenulate, glabrate on both surfaces or pubescent beneath, bullulate above; flowers in terminal panicles, 3 or more in each axil, bracts small, ovate; flowering calyces 2.5-4 mm long, glabrate or pubescent, the teeth 1-2 mm long, mature calyces campanulate, usually crowded, 12-15 mm long, the teeth increasing to as much as 4 mm; corolla tubes 2.5-4 mm long, annulate within or bearing a small p.atch of hairs.

description: Fruit 14 mm diam., pericarp 1.3-2.2 mm thick, stigmatic remains lateral-similar to Cyphophoenix, but with the seed and locular epidermis round and smooth, a very thick layer of tannin/pigment tissue adjacent to the epidermis, small tanniniferous cells scattered in the inner pericarp, brachysclereids in scattered patches amongst the oblique fibrous bundles, and raphidebearing cells lacking.
bibliographicCitation: Essig, Frederick B., et al. 1999. Systematic Histological Study of Palm Fruits. III. Subtribe Iguanurinae (Arecaceae). Brittonia. 51 (3): 307-325.

description: Arbuscula palmarae solitaria, laminis divisis in 19-21 segmentia, inflorescentia erecta, exposita supra folia, inflorescentis partialibus 7-9, rachillis sinuatis adscendis rigidis, flores illis L. b-rcteatae similes, a qua imprimis differt absentia bractearum florum distinctarum, calyce crassiore, triquetro, caespitibus trichomatis, corolla et androeio per trientem longitudinis connatis, stylo duplo longiore quam ovario.

description: Solitary understory palm, 2-3 m tall. Stem slender, ca. 3 cm diam. Leaves 8-10; leaf sheath 50-60 cm long, tubular basally and covered by minute ramenta on the thickened side in continuation of the petiole, distally partly resolved in fibrous mesh, often extended on side opposite to the petiole into chartaceous, long-acuminate apex; petiole 60-100 cm long, minutely speckled along the abaxial side, proximal portion 7-9 mm wide, yellow to brown, with slightly curved, marginal spines, to 5 mm long and 1-2 cm apart, middle portion 5-6 mm wide, green to yellowish green, with few short spines 5-10 cm apart, distal portion spineless; lamina glabrous, shiny, dark green above, dull green below, divided along abaxial ribs into 19-21 segments; mid-segment with ca. 5-6 adaxial ribs, 57 cm long, truncate; the remaining segments with 2-3 adaxial ribs; basal segment 45-50 cm long, rounded apically; indention of individual segments mixed long and short, those leading to abaxial ribs to 5 mm long, those lead-ing to adaxial ribs to 3 cm long; subapical segments with deeper indentions than the basal and apical segments. Inflorescences and infructescences to 5 in a single palm, interfoliar, to 250 cm long, erect, exposed above the crown, partial inflorescences 7- 9, gradually decreasing in size toward the distal end; prophyll 40-50 cm long, distinctly bicarinate, slightly disintegrated apically, light brown to grayish brown, exposed portion covered by brown ramenta variable in density and length; peduncle 70-80 cm, flattened, ca. 1 cm wide; pedun- cular bracts lacking; proximal subtending bract ca. 25 cm long, tubular, bicarinate, beige to olive-green distally, partly covered by ramenta, especially along the lateral keels; first partial inflorescence sometimes branched to third order basally, rachis ca. 20 cm long; flower-bearing rachillae 7-9, to 17 cm long, zig-zagged, ascending, rigid and covered by ferruginous tomentum. Flowers to 30 on longest rachillae, inserted in pairs proximally to solitary distally, ses- sile on tubercles, lanceolate to narrowly ovate, 8-11 X 3-4 mm, basally truncate, apically obtuse in bud; calyx 5-7 mm long, triquetrous, fused with receptacle in basal 1-2 mm (to level of insertion of the corolla), covered by tomentum, this being ferruginous, short and evenly distributed ba- sally to lighter, tufted, to 1 mm long apically, particularly near the rounded calyx lobes; corolla 3-lobed, 7-9 mm long, fused basally, glabrous to minutely tomentose apically, whitish green, moderately reflexed at anthesis; androecium 4.5-6 mm long, tubular, whitish, fused with corolla in basal 1-2 mm; filaments 6, equal, ca. 0.5 mm long, deltoid, with black margins, erect and closely aligned, thus forming a narrow passage; anthers elongate, ca. 2 mm long; ovary 1-1.5 mm long, turbinate, glabrous; style slender, 3.5-4 mm long. Flowering sequence apparently erratic. Mature fruits unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Barfod, Anders S. & Borchsenius, Finn. 2000. A New Species of Licuala (Arecaeae; Coryphoideae) from the Central Highlands of Vietnam. Brittonia. 52 (4): 354-357.

description: Fruit subglobose, 7 mm diam., 8 mm long, with pericarp 1 mm thick, stigmatic remains apical. The species is similar to L. monostachya but with the outer pericarp greatly expanded, with raphide-bearing cells widely scattered but mostly near the epidermis, and the single series of radially distended fibrous bundles confined to the inner pericarp; vascular bundles without fibrous sheaths, in a narrow band along with numerous flattened tanniniferous cells in the innermost pericarp next to the indistinct locular epidermis.
bibliographicCitation: Essig, Frederick B. 2002. A systematic histological study of palm fruits. VI. Subtribe Linospadicinae (Arecaceae). Brittonia. 54: 196-201.

description: Fruit narrowly ovoid, 4 mm diam., 9 mm long, with pericarp 0.5 mm thick, stigmatic remains apical. Fibrous bundles large, subterete, in a single series occupying much of the outer half of the endocarp, with a series of small raphide-bearing cells just below the epidermis; vascular bundles few, widely spaced in the inner half of the pericarp, with sparse fibrous sheaths; locular epidermis indistinguishable.
bibliographicCitation: Essig, Frederick B. 2002. A systematic histological study of palm fruits. VI. Subtribe Linospadicinae (Arecaceae). Brittonia. 54: 196-201.

description: Caespitose epiphytes. Stems to 25 cm long, wholly concealed by imbricating leaf bases. Leaves distichous, bilaterally com- pressed, sigmoid in side view, acute, to 2 cm long, with hyaline edge. Inflorescences subsessile, axillary, solitary flowers near the stem apex, the floral bract tubular, ovate, acute, to 2 mm long. Flowers yellow, campanulate. Sepals subsimilar, subequal, ovate, acute, concave, 3.3 x 1.2 mm. Petals elliptic-obovate, apiculate, 5 x 1.8 mm. Label- lum suborbicular, cuneate, emarginate, convex, 4 x 4 mm, the margin minutely irregular, the callus of 3 tuberculate, longitudinal ridges, converging to form an el- evated, retrorse, tuberculate hook, to 1.4 mm above the disc. Column stout, to 2.4 mm long, with large corniform wings. Pollinia 2, clavate, 1 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Bennett, D. & Christenson, E. A. 1994. New species of Peruvian Orchidaceae II. Brittonia. 46: 228-259.
