description: Caespitose terrestrials with scapose paniculate inflorescences to 1 10 cm tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid, lightly compressed, 7.5 x 3.5 cm. Leaves 3, linear-oblong to linear- oblanceolate, petiolate base conduplicate, acute, stiff, 40 x 2 cm. Inflorescence stiffly erect, with 8 or more lightly flexuous branches bearing 8-10 flowers each. Sepals and petals yellow with muddy-brown bars and large markings, the labellum brilliant clear yellow, callus pale tan-white with pale brown and dark brown spots, surrounded by a large, pale brown area, the column and the anther green. Dorsal sepal oblong, cuneate above and below, clawed, tip obtuse, 7.5 x 3.5 mm. Lateral sepals lanceolate, oblique, falcate, 8 mm long. Petals oblique, ovate-oblong, basally concave clawed, obtuse, 8 x 6 mm expanded. Labellum 3-lobed, basal lobes with spreading, oblanceolate auricles, a broad median claw, midlobe subreniform, 1.25 x 1.6 cm, the callus with several spreading lamina and teeth basally, continued in front with 3 lobulate, toothed lamellae. Column stout, wings large, 3-lobed, tabula infrastigmatica geniculate, the anther ovate, with a central adaxial keel, 1.6 x 1.2 mm, the pollinarium 1.6 x 0.8 mm, the pollinia 2, obovate, cleft, 0.6 x 0.4 mm, the stipe linear, I x 0.2 mm, the vis- cidium minute, orbicular.
bibliographicCitation: Bennett, D. & Christenson, E. A. 1994. New species of Peruvian Orchidaceae II. Brittonia. 46: 228-259.

description: Medium-sized epiphytes. Pseudobulbs approximate, ellipsoid, compressed, bifoliate, 5.5 x 3.5 cm. Leaves narrowly oblanceolate, acute, 20-23 x 4.3 cm, the petiolate base conduplicate. Inflorescence paniculate, long pedunculate, subfractiflex to 77 cm or more tall, the short lateral branches laxly 4-5-flowered the peduncle with 8 or more distant, small, ovate, acute bracts. Flowers showy, the sepals and petals brilliant yellow with purple markings on the outer surface, the labellum brilliant yellow, the callus purplish with yellowish white teeth, the column similarly colored to the callus, the anther marked yellow and purple, the pollinia shiny yellow, the stipe semitranslucent white, the viscidium purple. Dorsal sepal and petals subsimilar, elliptic-lanceolate, clawed, acute, 13 x 5.5-6.5 mm, the petals broader. Lat- eral sepals subspathulate, clawed, shortly connate basally, 14 x 4.5 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, transverse, 1.5 x 1.8 cm, the lateral lobes much smaller, revolute, basally subcordate, the mid-lobe suborbicular, emarginate with overlapping lobules. Column bent upward from the more or less terete base, abruptly expanded above, the antrorse wings large, irregularly crenulate, tabula infrastigmatica thick, transverse, with 2 diverging geniculate-rounded margins separated by a low central ridge; anther 3 x 1.5 mm; pollinarium 2.6 x 1 mm, the pollinia 2, hard, obpyriform, obliquely obpyriform when viewed from the side, the stipe convex-concave, margins lightly recurved, the viscidium minute, oval-shaped.
bibliographicCitation: Bennett, D. & Christenson, E. A. 1994. New species of Peruvian Orchidaceae II. Brittonia. 46: 228-259.

description: Fruit globose, 20 mm diam., with pericarp 1.9 mm thick and stigmatic remains lateral or subapical similar to Acantho- phoenix but with the mantle of brachysclereids and short oblique fibrous bundles close to the epidermis, and with the subepidermal pigmented zone much thicker; further characterized by the vascular bundles scattered throughout the inner to middle pericarp, and a very thick zone of sclerified parenchyma and small tanniniferous cells adjacent to the very thick locular epidermis.

description: Suffrutex erectus, ramosus, 30-40 cm. altus, caulibus lignosis, deorsum, eirciter 3 mm. diametro, teretibus, glabris; ramulis ultimis eirciter 1 mm. diametro, plus minusve breviter curvato-hirsutis; foliis in paribus subaequalibus, lanceolatis, 5-9 cm. longis, 1-1.5 cm. latis, utrinque subaequaliter angustatis, basi longe cuneatis, apice acuminatis, chartaceis vel submembranaceis, in sieco supra subolivaceis, subtus pallidioribus, glabris vel utrinque, prasertim ad costam nervosque, conspersissime breviter pubescentibus, nervis primariis utrinque eirciter 9, curvatis, eirciter marginem anastomosantibus; petiolo 6-20 mm. longo, breviter consperse curvato-pubescenti; stipulis eaducis; infloreseentiis eymosis, pedunculatis, 3-4.5 cm. longis, submultifloris, breviter subferrugineo-pubeseentibus, peduneulo 1-1.8 cm. longo; fioribus ut videtur albidis, eirciter 16 mm. longis, pedicellis puberulis, 1-2 mm. longis; bracteis linearibus vel lineari-lanceolatis, acuminatis, 6-10 mm. longis, 0.8 mm. latis, obscure consperse pubeseentibus, bracteolis simillimis, brevioribus, eirciter 3 mm. longis; receptaculo leviter compresso, puberulo, eirciter 1 mm. longo et 2 mm. lato, sepalis 5, oblongo-ovatis vel oblongo-lanceolatis, acutis, 0.6 mm. longis; corollae tubo 11 mm. longo, sursum leviter ampliato, extus glabro, intus breviter dense papilloso, lobis 5, oblongo-ovatis, obtusis, 3.5-4 mm. longis, 2-2.5 mm. latis, intus breviter dense papillosis; antheris oblongis, 2.5 mm. longis; stylus gracilibus, 1 cm. longis, obscurissime hirsutis, stigmatibus applanatis, oblongis, 1.5 mm. longis, 0.6 mm. latis, obtusis.

description: Solitary, erect, pleonanthic, monoecious palm; stem to ca 20 m high, 31-53 cm in diam, leaf sheaths persistent just below crown, internodes inconspicuous. Leaves 13-20, fewer in younger or senescent plants, spirally arranged in a broad, erect-arching crown; sheath 100-125 cm long, split opposite the petiole, thick, coriaceous, adaxial surface smooth and brown, abaxial surface rarely with yellow, longitudinal surface striations that may extend to base of rachis, densely white-lepidote; petiole lacking or to 10 cm long; rachis 6.25-7.50 cm long, base trough-shaped in cross-section, center more or less 4-sided, becoming triangular toward apex, adaxial surface smooth, abaxial and lateral surfaces (at middle of rachis) densely white-lepidote; pinnae 156-186 per side, 2-3 basal pinnae grouped, oth- erwise regularly spaced and in a single plane, very rigid, acute, basally reflexed at attachment, 1-ribbed with prominent intermediate veins, adaxially dark green and smooth, abaxially glaucous; basal pinnae 152-182 x 1.5-2.5 cm; middle pinnae 140-168 x 4.5-6 cm; apical pinnae 49-69 x 0.5-1.5 cm. Inflorescences interfoliar; yellowish at anthesis, prophyll ca 75 cm long; peduncular bract 95- 240 x 28-41 cm, woody, longitudinally ribbed, brown, opening longitudinally along a more or less distinct invagination, persistent, with acumen 28-52 cm long, interior surface tan to light orange at anthesis; all axes of inflorescences white- to yellow-lepidote at anthesis, peduncle 94-122 cm long; rachis 1-1.7 m long; rachillae of staminate inflorescence simple, up to 365 in number, 13-32 cm long, linear, erect, attenuate, arranged spirally around the rachis and subtended by a membranous bract ca 4 mm long, bearing 69-138 staminate flowers arranged in 2 or 3 (4) longitudinal rows on abaxial side only; rachillae of androgynous (but functionally pistillate?) inflorescence simple, ca 277 in number, 2-3 x 3-4 mm, arranged spirally around the rachis, each rachilla subtended by a contorted bract 5-6 cm long and generally bearing 1-2 pistillate flowers at base to middle and 2- 3 aborted staminate flowers at middle to apex, or more rarely bearing staminate flowers only. Flowers unisexual; staminate flowers yellowish, fragrant, asymmetrical, subtended by 1 or 2 bracteoles, 1-2 mm long on staminate inflorescences, up to 1.5 cm long on androgynous inflorescences; sepals 3, free or basally connate, deltate, ca 1.5 x 1.2 mm, membranous to coriaceous, margins smooth; petals 2 (3), free, incurved, 10-12 mm long, 1 petal 6-7 mm wide and obovate with apex dentate or lobed, the other petal 4 mm wide and narrowly elliptic with apex acute with smooth margins coriaceous; stamens free, 28-32 (37); filaments slender, ca 2 mm long; thecae united, irregularly coiled and twisted; pistillode present. Pis- tillate flowers yellowish, subtended by a straight to curved or occasionally contorted bracteole 0.8-3.0 cm long; sepals 3-6, imbricate, triangular to deltate, 1-3 cm long at anthesis, coriaceous, margins smooth; petals 3 (5), imbricate, triangular to deltate, ca 2 cm long at anthesis, coriaceous, margins smooth, apex cuspidate; staminodial cupule leaving a ring around the pistil; stigmas typically 3-6, apical, erect. Fruits broadly ellipsoid to oblong, 13-14 x 7.5-8 cm, 152-404 g each (dry weight), brown-yellow-lepidote throughout; staminodial ring strongly defined; stigmatic residue persistent; fruiting perianth indurate, 7-7.5 cm long, containing a ca 1.4 cm long staminodial tube; epicarp 1-2 mm thick, fibrous; mesocarp 2-3 mm thick, mealy, dry, tan-white at maturity; endocarp 5.1-7.6 cm in diam, woody and very hard; seeds generally 4-6, ovate to ellipsoid, 4.3-6 cm long; endosperm white, oily, homogeneous; embryo basal.
bibliographicCitation: Balick, Michael J., et al. 1987. Hybridization in the babassu palm complex. II. Attalea compta x Orbignya oleífera (Palmae). Brittonia. 39: 26-36.

description: Arbor; foliis simplicibus, petiolis crassis ad 50 cm. longis, arete ferrugineo-tomentellis glabreseentibus, laminis coriaceis siiborbiculari bus, ad 45 cm. diametro, basi truneatis vel obtusis, profunde 5-9-lobatis (lobis oblongis vel ellipticis, 4-8 cm. latis, distaliter angustatis, apice acuminatis, margine saepe sinuatis), supra glabris, subtus dense et arete ferrugineo-stellato-tomelntosis (pilis sessilibus multo-ramosis), nervis primariis prominentissimis, nervis seeundariis numerosis patulis, venulis copiose reticulatis subtus prominulis; infloreseentia terminali paniculata inulto-ramosa, ad 40 cm. longa et lata, ramulis pedunculisque arete stellato-tomentosis, bracteis parvis ovatis, pedunculis racemosis 10-15 mm. longis; capitulis (male) 5-6 mm. diametro, bracteolis exterioribus paucis ovato-deltoideis acutis, 1-1.5 mm. longis, extus tomentellis, bracteolis interioribus submembranaceis obovato-spatulatis; floribus glabris 4- vel 5-meris, calyce earnoso obeonico eireiter 1 mm. longo; petalis oblongo-deltoideis eireiter 1 mm. longis, subacutis; filamentis ad 2 mm. longis, antheris globoso-oblongis parvis; ovario ad summum plano, disco parvo, stylis 5 gracilibus erectis, e basi liberis, eirciter 0.5 mm. longis, loculis 5, ovulis 5.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Albert C. 1936. Notes on North American Araliaceae. Brittonia. 2: 247-261.

description: Arbor ad 10 m. alta; ramulis crassis, juventute ferrugineo-tomentosis (pilis cauliculatis multo-ramosis) mox glabris rugosis; foliis simplicibus, petiolis ad 17 cm. longis, striatis, subglabris, laminis tenuiter coriaceis, ex ovatis ellipticis, 13-30 cm. longis, 6-20 cm. latis, basi rotundatis vel cuneatis, apice abrupte acuminatis, margine integris et anguste revolutis, supra glabris vel parce stellato-pilosis, subtus stellato-tomen- tellis (pilis 4-7-ramosis, cauliculis longis gracilibus), demum glabres- centibus, nervis primariis 3 vel 5 prominentibus e basi adscendentibus, nervis secundariis paucis adscendentibus, venulis reticulatis incon- spicuis; inflorescentia terminali patula, ad 25 cm. longa et lata, ramulis, bracteis pedunculisque stellato-tomentellis, bracteis parvis mox deciduis, pedunculis 10-30 mm. longis; capitulis (male) globoso-ovoideis 3-6 mm. diametro, bracteolis parvis late ovatis extus puberulis, floribus 15-20 per capitulum, glabris; calyce parvo, liiiibo illconspicuo truneato; petalis oblongis eirciter 1.5 mmnn. longis, subaeutis; filamentis carnosis ad 3 mm. longis, antheris oblongis parvis; stylo carnoso brevi; capitulis Q quam eis e paullo iliajoribus, floribus 8-14 flores (male) aequalitibus, stylis 9-12 carnosis e basi liberis erectis, loculis 9-12; fructibus plerumque 6-14 per capitulum, subglobosis, 2-3 mm. diametro, stylis crassis recurvatis eirciter 1 mm. longis, seiminibus quam stylis interdum paucioribus.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Albert C. 1936. Notes on North American Araliaceae. Brittonia. 2: 247-261.

description: Fruit globose, 11 mm diam., with pericarp 1-1.2 mm thick, stigmatic remains apical differing sharply from the preceding two genera by the presence of only a single series of short fibrous bundles embedded in a dense mantle of brachysclereids variably positioned in the subepidermal to mid-pericarp regions; further characterized by a series of raphide-bearing cells between the mantle and the outer epidermis, by flattened vascular bundles with extensive fibrous sheaths occupying the inner 1/3 of the pericarp, by tanniniferous cells forming continuous sheets over the large vascular bundles and scattered between the bundles, and by a very thin locular epidermis.
bibliographicCitation: Essig, Frederick B. & Hernandez, N. 2002. A systematic histological study of palm fruits. V. Subtribe Archontophoenicinae (Arecaceae). Brittonia. 54: 65-71.

description: Small, psygmoid twig epiphyte, 40-90 mm tall and broad. Roots terete, flexuous, lanuginose, silvery-white, to ca. 90 mm long and 0.5-1 mm diam. Leaf sheaths oblong, partly imbricating, with the inner margins hyaline, erose, 3.5-6 X 2-3.5 mm. Leaves distichous, bilaterally strongly compressed, narrowly linear-elliptic (ensiform), slightly falcate, attenuate to acuminate, articulate at base with the leaf sheaths, 24-80 X 2.5-4.5 mm. Inflorescences 1-3 racemes produced one at a time, shortly pedunculate, with a flexuous rachis, 30-70 mm long; both peduncle and rachis provided with prominent, irregularly denticulate to smooth keels continuous with the keels of the bracts. Bracts of the peduncle 3, indistinguishable from the floral bracts. Floral bracts spreading, semiclasping, conduplicate, ovate, obtuse to long-acute, keeled dorsally, margins conspicuously denticulate, pale green, translucent, 1.5-6 mm long. Flowers inconspicuous, membranaceous, subglobose, barely opening, greenish yellow, with dispersed crystalline idioblasts on all the floral segments and the column, ca. 3 mm diam. Ovary slender, straight but slightly arcuate near the apex, glabrous, with 6 longitudinal, repand keels, 2.3-4.5 mm long. Dorsal sepal semiorbicular, concave and hardly spreada- ble, rounded, prominently keeled and aris- tate, 1-nerved, 1.5 X 1.3 mm; arista to 0.3 mm long. Lateral sepals obliquely semiorbicular-ovate, concave and hardly spreadable, rounded, prominently keeled and aristate, margins sparsely papillose, 1-nerved, 1.5 X 1.3 mm; arista to 0.4 mm long. Petals flabellate, slightly concave, broadly rounded, margins irregularly dentate-lacerate, 3- nerved, 2 x 2.5 mm. Lip deeply concave, cymbiform, incurved, more or less oblong elliptic in outline, unspreadable, broadly ob- tuse, with a subflabellate, irregularly dentate- lacerate lobule at each side of the base and a fleshy, slightly prominent transverse thickening between the lobules, 2.7 X ca. 1 mm; lobules ca. 0.35 X 0.7 mm. Column very short, ca. 5 mm long, with a prominent rostellum; clinandrium concave, elliptic in outline, 0.75 mm long; rostellum narrowly triangular, slightly deflexed at the base and recurved at the apex, its sides revolute, 1.8 mm long. Anther subclavate, arcuate, imperfectly 4-celled, 2.5 mm long. Pollinarium complex, formed by pollinia, stipe and viscidium, ca. 2.5 mm long. Pollinia 4, waxy, yellow, obovoid. Stipe linear, broadened at the pollinia end. Viscidium orbicular. Stigma a small, narrow cavity on the ventral surface of the column body. Capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Salazar Chávez, Gerardo A. & Soto Arenas, Miguel Á. 1996. A new species of Ornithocephalus (Orchidaceae) from Oaxaca, Mexico. Brittonia. 48: 209-212.

description: Frutex 2-metralis, ramulis glabris; stipulae vagina 8-9 mm longa minute sparsimque puberula in dentes paucos lineari-lanceolatos 1-1.5 mm longos glabros desinenti; foliis petiolatis, petiolis 3-5 mm longis; laminis subcoriaceis elliptico-lanceolatis apice acutis basi cuneatim acutis longidecurrentibus 2.7-4.5 x 1-1.8 cm ubique glabris; nervis lateralibus manifestis utrinque 5-7 supra impressis subtus vix elevatis; inflorescentia 3-4 cm longa pedunculata, pedunculo 2-2.5 cm longo ancipite sursum dilatato 1.5 mm lato minute puberulo angulis ciliolatis; inflorescentiae rhachide sparsim vel moderate puberula; floribus aggregatis sessilibus in seriebus tribus vel quattuor separatis 3-5 mm remotis; inflorescentiae bracteis lanceolatis 1-1.1 mm longis minute puberulis; calyce 2-2.5 mm longo glabro, tubo turbinato-campanulato 1-1.5 mm longo 1.5 mm lato, lobis lanceolatis acutis 1 mm longis glabris; corolla non visa; fructibus obovoideis glabris 3.5-4 mm longis 3-3.5 mm latis.

description: Arbor ad 25 m alta, partibus juvenilibus pilis fulvis 2-armatis subsessilibus 0.3-0.5 mm longis strigillosis; ramulis teretibus infra folia 6-8 mm diametro mox glabratis, gemma terminali 3-8 mm longa, squamis chartaceis acutis pilis ad 0.8 mm longis strigosis; petiolis 20-35 mm longis basi teretibus superne canaliculatis 2-3.5 mm latis pilis ad 0.2 mm longis strigillosis mox glabratis; foliorum laminis coriaceis glabris integris obovatis, 10-21 cm longis, 4-10 cm latis, in sicco rubiginosis, basi obtusis vel attenuatis et in petiolum decurrentibus, apice rotundatis vel emarginatis, costa supra leviter canaliculata et medio acute elevata subtus prominenti, nervis secundariis utrin- secus 7-11 subpatentibus utrinque elevatis marginem versus curvatis et inconspicue anastomosantibus, nervis tertiariis et rete venularum supra immersis subtus sub- prominulis; inflorescentiis e ramulis infra folia enatis fasciculatis 1-4-floris, bracteis minutis persistentibus; pedicellis teretibus sub anthesi 10-25 mm sub fructu ad 35 mm longis pilis ad 0.3 mm longis subtiliter strigillosis; sepalis 4-5.5 mm longis dorso strigillosis, 3 exterioribus subcoriaceis ovato-deltoideis 3.5-6 mm latis apice subacutis, 3 interioribus subcarnosis orbicularibus vel ellipticis 3-5 mm latis apice rotundatis vel obtusis; corolla infundibulari mox caduca, tubo circiter 5 mm longo pilis ad 0.4 mm longis extus strigoso intus glabro, lobis 6 primo dextrorsum contortis ellipticis 5-7 mm longis ad 4 mm latis extus basim versus strigosis intus medio pilis ad 0.3 mm longis strigillosis; staminibus 12-18, filamentis teretibus 2-3 mm longis glabris, antheris subfusiformibus 2.5-4 mm longis ad 1 mm latis versatilibus apice peracutis dorso et ventre pilis ad 0.5 mm longis strigosis; ovario subgloboso sub anthesi 1.5-2 mm diametro pilis ad 0.4 mm longis copiose strigoso demum glabrato, loculis 6, ovulis solitariis pendulis, stylo tereti 13-18 mm longo glabro; fructibus coriaceis glabris rubiginosis ellipsoideis 40-42 x 18-20 mm styli basi apiculatis, sepalis persistentibus.

description: Inter congeneras bracteis e basi ramulorum usque ad nodum sequentem ascendentibus instructas foliis majoribus distinguenda. Arbor parva, ca. 2 m alta. Rami novelli complanati, ca. 4.5 mm diam. densius ferrugineo-puberuli, veteriores subteretes; internodia 6.0-9.5 cm longa. Folia opposita, petiolo ferrugineo-tomentello 0.7-1.4 cm longo instructa; lamina elliptica, 18-23 cm longa et 8.5-11.5 cm lata, acuminata, basi acuta, supra nitida, subtus opaca, sicc. supra olivaceo-brunnea, subtus olivacea, supra costa et parte inferiore nervorum densius puberulis exceptis glabra, subtus costa nervis venulisque dense pubescens, inter venulos vix notabile puberula, costa nervisque supra paulum impressis, subtus prominentibus, venulis laxe reticulatis subtus prominulis, nervis utroque latere costae 13 vel 14. Stipulae e vagina circ., 4.5 mm alta utroque latere rami in lobos duos anguste deltoideos ca. 7.5 mm longos productae, extus ferrugineo-tomentellae, intus ad basin glabrae, ad marginem vaginae annulo colletorum subulatorum usque ad 1.5 mm longorum instrfctae, lobis puberulae. Inflorescentia basi jugo foliorum ca. 5 cm longorum instructa, pedunculo chryseo-tomentello 3 cm longo elata, trichotome corymbosa, ca. 8 cm diam. et 5. cm alta; rachis ramulique etiam chryseo-tomentelli; bracteae ramulorum usque ad ramificationem proximam ascendentes, deltoideae, puberulae, sicc. brunneae, infimae ca. 7 mm longae, superiores gradatim breviores, supremae ovato-lanceolatae circ. 2.5 mm longae; flores ad apicem ramulorum congesti, sessiles; bracteolae florum lateralium subulatae, 1.5-2.5 mm longae. Flores 5-meri, probabiliter homostyli. Ovarium chryseo-tomentellum 2-loculare. Calyx cupularis, ovario paulo brevior, puberulus, margine in dentes 5 tubo dimidio breviores productus, intus glaber et glandulis 5 cum segmentis alternatibus instructus. Corolla coccinea, extus hirtello-tomentosa et apicem versus verruculosa, tubo 12 mm longo et 4 mm diam., intus annulo pilorum basali excepto glabro, lobis 4 mm longis intus glabris. Stamina filamentis glabris instructa; antherae dorsifixae filamentis bis longiores 3.5 mm longae, apice mucronato incisuras corollae fere attingentes, thecis basi acutis. Granula pollinis globosa 115 A diam. Discus annularis glaber, bipartitus. Stylus glaber 8 mm. longus, stigmata filiformia 3 mm longa. Drupa nondum visa.

description: Stem to 16 m tall, to 27(-45) cm diam but wider at the base, smooth, brown. Leaves 20-30, arched and forming a graceful crown, somewhat persistent; sheath and petiole to 2 m long; rachis 2.2-2.8 long; pinnae 61-71 per side, regularly arranged; proximal pinnae ca 56 x 0.8 cm; middle pinnae ca 70 x 3 cm; apical pinna ca 46 x 1 cm. Inflorescence ca 2 m long; peduncle 1-1.5 m long; prophyll to 40 cm long; peduncular bract 1.6-1.9 m long, sometimes a third incomplete bract to 25 cm long present; rachis 70-95 cm long with stellate, villous tomentum; rachillae 55-63, from 30 cm long proximally to 13 cm long distally, each subtended by a basal apiculate bract 6 mm wide basally, the rachillae often with small side branches 1.5-4 cm long and with a zig-zag shape and congested with staminate flowers, side branches also with a small apiculate bract 3-4 mm wide basally; triads 3-4 at base of rachillae, each surrounded by apiculate bracts, 2 bracts less than 1 mm high, sometimes one external bract 5-7.8 mm wide at the base and 4-5 mm high (in fruit 1.5 cm wide and 1 cm high); staminate flowers orange colored, sessile or occasionally on a 2-3 mm long pedicel; sepals connate at the base, cymbiform at apex, 1 mm wide, 3 mm high; petals 4-5 mm wide at base, 7 mm high, deltate; stamens (14) 15-17 (18), 17 in most proximal flowers on a rachillae, 15 in the most distal, 10 mm long; filaments 4 mm long; anthers 6 mm long, sagittate at both ends to 2 mm deep, with a longitudinal violet shadow between thecae; pistillode 2-3 (5)-fid; pistillate flowers purple to violet, sessile; sepals 0.9-1.8 cm wide at base, 5-8 mm high, shallowly triangular; petals 0.7- 1.5 cm wide basally, 5-8 mm high, shallowly triangular; staminodial ring irregular covering ovary with 3 main finger-like projections 3-4 mm high and short teeth; ovary surface granulate, pilose in area covered by staminodial ring, with 3 closely spaced stigmas; fruit developing from one carpel, 4-5.5 cm long, 2.8-4 cm diam, thinner at the apex, the ridges not prominent; epicarp greenish-brown; mesocarp 3-10 mm thick, fibrous; endocarp 6-7 mm thick, black, with no obvious ridges; seed single, 1.4 cm diam.

description: Stem to 14 m tall, 25-35 cm diam, rough, dark brown. Leaves 18-25, erect but curved distally; sheath and petiole 1.5-1.7 m long, sheathing part with farinose indumentum abaxially; rachis 2.4-2.5 m long; pinnae 77-79 per side, irregularly spaced, with brown scales on veins abaxially; proximal pinnae 45-80 x 0.4-1.1 cm, middle pinnae 65-70 x 2.5-3 cm, apical pinna 40-52 x 0.5-0.8 cm. Inforescences ca 1.8 m long; peduncle to 80 cm long; prophyll inserted near base of peduncle, to 47 cm long, flattened; peduncular bract inserted just above prophyll, 1.1-1.6 m long, densely brown-tomentose on outer surface; rachis 38 cm long; rachillae 33-38, spreading at anthesis, from 21 cm long proximally to 18 cm long distally, densely brown-tomentose, each subtended by an apiculate bract 4 mm long; triads subtended by bracts 1-1.5 mm high; staminate flowers crowded on the rachillae, pedicellate, the pedicel 2-6 mm long, 1 mm diam; sepals free, briefly connate basally, 2 mm high; petals broadly triangular, 10 mm long, 6 mm wide valvate; stamens 13-14, 6 mm long; filaments 2 mm long; anthers 4 mm long, medifixed, scarcely sagittate; pistillode 3 (4)-fid; pistillate flowers 4 or 5 per rachillae, 8.5 mm long, 10 mm wide; sepals broadly triangular, 13 mm wide basally, 10 mm high; petals similar to sepals but slightly smaller; staminodial ring 2 mm tall, annulate, with 6 short teeth, 3 of them minute; ovary brownish-beige tomentose, without tomentum on the surface directly covered by the ring; stigmas close together at anthesis; ovule basal, 1.6 mm, white. Fruit ovoid, 3-7.5 cm long, 2-5 cm diam, with 3 prominent ridges; epicarp green; mesocarp 2 mm thick laterally, 7 mm thick near apex, very fibrous; endocarp with 3 prominent apical ridges; seeds 2, 2-2.5 cm long, 1-1.8 cm diam, with basal embryo opposite one of the pores; endosperm with central cavity.

description: Frutex scandens lactescens gracillimus; rami teretes glabri; folia opposita glabra integerrima carnosula opaca indistincte nervosa, peti-olus 0.5 cm. longus vix 0.5 mm. crassus, lamina lineari-lanceolata sub-falcata, basi angustata, apice longissime acuminata, ad 7 cm. longa, 0.5 cm. lata, inflorescentia axillaris glabra gracillima laxi- et pauciflora, pedunculus communis 6 cm. longus, cyma trichotoma bracteis subu-latis minimis ornata, pedicelli 6 mm. longi; lobi calycis triangulares acuti, 1 mm. longi, eglandulosi; tubus corollae ruber cylindricus, 5 mm. longus, 0.5 mm. latus, extus velutinus, lobi luteo-virides, 5 mm. longi, 1.5 mm. lati, carnosuli, extus velutini, intus glabri, patentes, ob-longo-acuti, marginibus dilutioribus limbati, faux pulvinulis 5 inter-staminalibus, e setis erectis compositis clausa; antherae glabrae acutae dimidio superiore lanceolato exsertae, dimidio inferiore longe arcuato-bicaudato immersae, stigmati arete adhaerentes, filamentis liberis, supra ipsam tubi corollae basim ortis insertae; stigma tripartitum: e basi obconico-annulata constrictum, supra cyathiformi-5-dentato-am-pliatum, apice obtuse ellipsoideo-incrassatum; ovarium globosum glabrum, squamis 5 lanceolatis glabris paulo longioribus cinctum.

description: Fruit 45-53 mm diam., pericarp very thick (specimen examined was immature and incomplete), stigmatic remains basaldistinctive for the corky outer region, the numerous vascular bundles with thick fibrous sheaths intermixed with numerous tanniniferous cells throughout much of the pericarp, and a lack of raphide-bearing cells and brachysclereids. From the immature specimen it appears that there are many large vascular bundles with thicker fibrous sheaths in the inner pericarp and a thickened locular epidermis. This is a specialized fruit with respect to its corky outer region and its numerous vascular bundles, but histologically unspecialized. According to Pintaud (1999) the gynoecium displays a relictual trimerous (trilocular) condition.

description: Perennial herb erect, up to 32 cm tall, the leafless stem either absent or morpholgically indistinguishable from axes of the inflorescence. Inflorescences modified thyrsiform with the indeterminate primary axis giving rise to several indeterminate secondary axes both terete, 0.3-1 mm in diam, with the internodes 1-3.5 cm long, with the bracts paired at each node, sessile, with the bases joined by a fine ridge, with the blade subcoriaceous, subrevolute, linear- or subulate-triangular, narrowly acute at apex, 2-4 X 0.3-0.5 mm, 4.4-9.3 times longer than wide, sparsely strigose, with no venation externally evident, with the short lateral axes terete, 1-12 mm long, 0.2-0.4 mm in diam, with the terminal capitula 2-5-flowered, with all of the axes sparsely strigose. Flowers sessile, ebracteate; hypanthium obovate to broadly so, ca. 0.5 X 0.3-0.4 mm, abaxial surface strigose, adaxial surface glabrous; calyx lobes triangular, narrowly acute at apex, 1.5-1.7 x 0.6-0.7 mm, glabrous or glabrate and ciliate with strigose hairs; corolla pale pink, salverform with a slight constriction below the point of stamen separation, the tube 2.3-2.5 mm long, exterior sparsely strigose, interior glabrous with a puberulous band subtending the stamens, the lobes 4, ovate, narrowly papillate with a few short erect hairs inside; stamens included, attached ca. 34 up the tube from the base, the filaments ca. 0.1 mm long, glabrous, the anthers ca. 0.6 X 0.2-0.3 mm, with the base short lanate, with an extended connective, the connective oblong or broadly triangular, obtuse at the apex, ca. 0.3 X 0.1-0.2 mm, minutely puberulous; style 2.3-2.6 mm long, glabrous, with 3 'glands' surrounding the base, the 'glands' glabrous, consisting of a disc with a tab on the abaxial edge, the disc portion 0.1-0.2 mm in diam, ca. 0.05 mm thick, the tab 0.1-0.2 mm wide, ca. 0.15 mm tall, the stigma exserted, clavate, 0.7-0.8 mm long, ca. 0.15 mm in diam, minutely papillate. Fruit persistent until dehiscence, sessile, abaxial surface strigose, adaxial surface glabrous, 0.5-0.6 mm long, 1.3-2 mm in diam, the calyx persistent; seeds hemilenticular with the commissural face oval, ca. 0.6 X 0.4 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. & Kirkbride, Joseph H., Jr. 1977. Review of the genus Perama (Rubiaceae). Brittonia. 29: 191-198.

description: Annual herbs up to 70 cm tall, the terete slender moderately strigose stems weakly branched above the middle, the internodes 0.8-4 cm long. Leaves opposite or rarely ternate at 8-13 nodes, subsessile or shortly petiolate, the petiole 1-2 mm long strigose; blades chartaceous, ovate or elliptic, acute or apiculate at the apex, rotund or obtuse at the base, 7-13 X 3-7 mm, trinervate with the lateral nerves sub-basal, adpressed strigose above, the veins densely adpressed strigose and the intercostal areas sparsely adpressed strigose below. Inflorescences axillary in upper axils one per node, pedunculate, capitate with 3-8 flowers, the peduncle 7-30 mm long, strigose. Flowers sessile arranged in capitula 2-5 mm tall, 3-5 mm wide, ebracteate; hypanthium subglobose, 0.75-0.8 mm long, densely setose, with two calyx lobes lanceolate, acuminate, 3-3.75 x 0.75 mm, sparsely strigose-setose without, more densely strigose-setose to erect pilose within; corolla pale pink, hypocrateriform, 7.5-8 mm long, sparsely strigose without, the tube 5-5.5 mm long with the base 1 mm and the orifice 3 mm wide, with the orifice villose within elsewhere glabrous, the lobes 4, suborbicular-ovate, somewhat obtusely subacute, 2-2.5 X 1.75-2 mm, densely papillate within; stamens included, affixed at the orifice of the tube, with the filaments ca. 0.3 mm long, glabrous, with the base of the thecae setose-barbate; style ca. 6.5 mm long, papillate towards the apex but elsewhere glabrous, with 3 conical glands at the base 0.25 mm tall, with the stigma ca. 0.75 mm long. Fruit sessile, glabrous, with the seeds suborbicular 0.7-0.8 mm in diam.

description: Annual herbs erect, up to 27 cm tall with terete strigose stems 0.3-0.7 mm in diam, moderately to rarely branched, the internodes 1-4.5 cm long. Leaves opposite or rarely ternate at 1 or 2 lower nodes, shortly petiolate, the petiole 0.5-1.5 mm long, strigose; blades subchartaceous, narrowly ovate, acute at the apex, obtuse at the base, 2.7-5.5 X 1.2-3.1 mm, 2.3-5.6 times longer than wide, trinervate with the lateral nerves basal, the midrib and nerves not evident above, evident and plane below, the tertiary nerves obscure, strigose above, with the nerves strigose and the intercostal areas glabrous to sparsely strigose beneath. Inflorescences axillary at apical nodes of slender branchlets, one per node, pedunculate, capitate with (2) 4-6 flowers, the peduncle 2-15 (25) mm long, strigose. Flowers sessile arranged in capitula 2-5 mm tall, 3-7 mm wide, ebracteate; hypanthium subglobose, 0.5-0.6 mm long, densely strigose; calyx bilobate with the lobes narrowly ovate, acute, 1.3-1.8 X 0.6-0.8 mm, strigose to sparsely so without, sparsely strigose to glabrous within; corolla white, hypocrateriform with a slight constriction below the point of stamen separation, the tube 3.1-3.5 mm long, exterior with the upper half very sparsely strigose and the lower half glabrous, interior glabrous except for a puberulous ring below the stamens, the lobes 4, ovate, acute, 1.1-1.3 X 0.7-0.8 mm, sparsely strigose without, minutely papillate within; stamens included, attached in the upper half of the tube, the filaments 0.1-0.2 mm long, glabrous, the anthers 0.4-0.7 X 0.3-0.4 mm, glabrous with the base lanate, with an extended connective, the connective broadly ovate, obtuse at the apex, ca. 0.2 X 0.1-0.2 mm, minutely puberulous; style ca. 3.5-4 mm long, with 3 conical 'glands' ca. 0.2 mm tall surrounding the base, the stigma clavate, 0.4-0.6 mm long, glabrous. Fruit persisting until dehiscence, sessile, 0.9-1.1 mm tall, 1.1-1.3 mm in diam, with the abaxial face densely strigo,se, with the adaxial face sparsely strigose, the calyx persistent; seeds hemilenticular with the commissural face oval, ca. 0.6 X 0.5 mm.

description: Perennial herb erect, up to 10 cm tall with terete strigose stems, the internodes 0.5-1.7 cm long. Leaves opposite, petiolate with the petiole 1-1.5 mm long, strigose; blades subcoriaceous, subrevolute, ovate, acute at the apex, obtuse at the base, 4-10 x 2.5-7 mm, 1.2-1.6 times longer than wide, with 1-2 arcuate, suprabasal pairs of lateral veins or none evident, the prominulous or plane midrib, plane lateral veins, and intercostal areas sparsely strigose above, the subprominent midrib and plane lateral veins strigose and the intercostal areas glabrate beneath, the tertiary venation obscure. Inflorescences short spikes with 4-6 flowers axillary in upper axils with one per node, sessile, with the axis densely pilose up to 3 mm long. Flowers sessile, ebracteate; hypanthium depressed obovate, ca. 0.2 X 0.3 mm, glabrous with strigose hairs around the apex; calyx bilobate with the lobes narrowly oblong, narrowly acute, 1.6-1.8 X 0.5 mm, sparsely strigose, persistent in fruit; corolla hypocrateriform with a constriction below the point of stamen separation, the tube 3 mm long, exterior glabrate, interior glabrous with a sericeous band at the base of the stamens, the lobes 4, triangular to narrowly so, ca. 1.1 X 0.4-0.6 mm, sparsely strigose without, minutely papillate within; stamens included, attached ca. 2/3 up the tube from the base, the filaments ca. 0.2 mm long, glabrous, the anthers ca. 0.75 x 0.25 mm, with the thecae ca. 0.5 mm long,glabrous with the base lanate, with an extended connective ca. 0.25 mm long, minutely puberulous; style 4 mm long with 3 conical 'glands' surrounding the base, ca. 0.2 mm tall, ca. 0.1 mm in diam, the stigma ca. 0.3 mm long. Fruit persistent, sessile, glabrous, ca. 1 mm tall, ca. 1.5 mm in diam, loculicidally dehiscent with the outer walls shed leaving the central column and freeing the 3 seeds; seeds hemilenticular with the commissural face oval, ca. 0.9 X 0.6 mm.

description: Monoecious shrub to 1.2 m tall, the younger branches with appressed mal- pighiaceous hairs; leaves narrowly elliptic to elliptic, 3-6.5 cm long, 1-2.5 cm wide, acuminate, the base acute or obtuse, pilose with malpighiaceous hairs on both sides, especially when young, the older leaves becoming glabrous above, essentially entire with an occasional marginal gland; petioles 2-3 mm long; stipules narrowly triangular to triangular, ca 2 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide; inflorescences racemose, 1.5-2 cm long; staminate flowers: sepals 4, elliptic, 2 mm long, 1 mm wide, acuminate, glabrous above except at tip, pilose below with malpighiaceous hairs; petals 4, obtrullate, 2 mm long, 1 mm wide, the apex acute to obtuse, pilose on both sides; glands 4, glabrous; stamens 4, the filaments ca 2 mm long, arching upward, hairy; pistillate flowers: sepals 5, elliptic to ovate, 3.5-4 mm lonI, 1.5-2 mm wide, acuminate, pilose on both sides with malpighiaceous hairs; petals absent; glands 5, rectangular in radial outline; ovary densely pilose to woolly, the styles trifid, the primary divisions bifid for ca 34 their length, pilose, the stigmas slightly flattened; seeds globose, 2 mm in diameter, apiculate, weakly ridged.

description: Fruit ovoid, 7.5 mm diam., 8 mm long, with pericarp 1.5 mm thick, stigmatic remains subbasal unusual among the pseudomonomerous Arecoid palms (but similar to Nephrosperma) in the very distinctive, large, somewhat elongate and sometimes obliquely oriented sclereids in the outer pericarp; further characterized by the thick layer of tanniniferous cells and occasional raphide cells below the epidermis, the very thick fibrous sheaths around the nearly terete vascular bundles, and the thin layer of tanniniferous cells in the inner pericarp.

description: Description (based on 175 collections): erect or somewhat procumbent annual herbs 1-5 dm high; main stems smooth or scabridulous, terete, sometimes lignescent (plants then appearing to be perennial), cataphylls spirally arranged; stipules of cataphylls ovate or deltoid, acute, not auriculate, usually red-stained, ca. 0.6-1.5 mm long; deciduous branchlets 3-6 (-17) cm long, subterete, smooth or scabridulous, with ca. 15-30 leaves; leaf blades elliptic to oblong, obtuse to emarginate at tip, cuneate to subcordate at base, ca. 3-10 mm long, 1-4 mm broad, smooth or scabridulous, with lateral veins inconspicuous or obscure beneath; stipules ovate- to linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 0.6-1.5 mm long. Monoecious; proximal cymules of branchlet with paired 0 flowers, distal cymules each with 1 0 and 1 9 flower. Staminate flowers with pedicels 0.7-1.5 mm long; calyx lobes 4 (5 or 6 in the larger flowers at first few proximal axils), ovate or elliptic, acute or obtuse, entire, 1-veined, yellowish or reddish tinged, 0.5-1.0 mm long; disk segments 4 (5, 6), roundish, ca. 0.2 mm across; stamens 2 (3 in the larger flowers of proximal axils), filaments completely connate into a column, 0.2-0.3 mm high; anthers connivent, dehiscing horizontally, ca. 0.3 mm across. Pistillate flowers with smooth or scabridulous pedicels becoming 1.5-3 (1-3.5) mm long; calyx lobes 5 or 6, ovate or elliptic to oblovate, rounded or obtuse, entire, herbaceous with broad pale margins, 1-veined, (0.5-) 0.7-1.1 mm long; disk of 3 unequal segments, these sometimes again bifid or divided; ovary smooth; styles free spreading, or ascending, ca. 0.2 mm long, bifid about halfway, style branches unthickened.

Description (based on 50 collections): annual herbs, erect, 1-5 dm high; main stems smooth, terete, cataphylls spirally arranged; stipules of cataphylls linear- lanceolate, acuminate, not auriculate, 1-1.5 mm long; deciduous branchlets 6-12 cm long, subterete, with (10-) 15-30 leaves; leaf blades membranous, elliptic, obtusely pointed, inequilateral at base, 11-20 mm long, 4.5-9 mm broad, paler beneath and with a fine veinlet reticulum; stipules linear-lanceolate, attenuate-acuminate, unequal, the longer ca. 1.0-1.8 mm long. Monoecious; proximal cymules with 3-7 d flowers, distal with solitary 9 flowers. Staminate flowers with pedicels 1.2-1.8 mm long; calyx lobes 5 (rarely 6), obovate, rounded, entire, 1-veined, 1.5-3 mm long; disk segments 5 (6), cuneate, fleshy, papillose, 0.2-0.4 mm across; stamens 3, filaments ca. 0.5-0.8 mm long, connate halfway into a column; anthers dehiscing obliquely, 0.2-0.4 mm long. Pistillate flowers with pedicels becoming 4-7 mm long; calyx lobes 5, elliptic to obovate, green, entire, clearly to obscurely pinnately veined, 3.0-3.5 mm long; disk patelliform, fleshy, subentire; ovary smooth; styles free, ascending, 0.5-0.6 mm long, bifid; style branches capitate. Capsules ca. 3.5 mm broad; seeds dark brown, densely verruculose, 1.5-1.8 mm long.

Chromosome number: 2n = 36 (Miller & Webster, 1967)

description: Suffrutex; ramulis deciduis, axibus monopodialibus; laminis parvis, obfalcatis, apicibus late obtusis, glandis sessilibus, basibus acutis, marginibus costatis, revolutis, petiolis brevibus, stipulis brevibus, lanceolatis, acutis, persistentibus; foliis conferte recteque distichis, subimbricatis; floribus parvis, paucis, axillaribus, bibracteatis, perianthiis biserialibus, segmentis lanceolatis; floribus pistillatis sine staminibus vel staminodiis, discis conspicuis, luteis, lobatis; ovariis trilocularibus; stylis connatis, stigmatibus crateriformibus, trilobatis; capsulis trilobatis, globosis; seminibus sine carunculis; floribus staminatis non visis.

description: Shrub to 1 m. high; branches terete, very dark grayish-black, roughened by branchlet scars, the axis monopodial, the lateral leaf-bearing branchlets decidu- ous; branchlets slender, angled, scabrous, 5-10 cm. long, the leaves very closely distichous, vertically oriented, subimbricate, the shoot thus dorsi-ventral with the aspect of a flat spray, leaves 4-7 mm. long, 1-2 mm. wide, obfalcate, the apex rounded, minutely retuse, with a conspicuous sessile gland ventrally im- mediately below the notch, acute at the base, pale green and glaucous on the upper surface, cream-colored and glaucous on the lower surface, with mid-rib only, the margins revolute and costate; petioles 0.5 mm. long, or the blade sub- sessile, the stipules 1-2 mm. long, lanceolate, acute, reddish, persistent; sparsely flowering, the flowers axillary, bibracteate, the bracts lanceolate nearly 2 mm. long, pedicel about 1 mm. long; perianth segments in two sets of three each, yellowish, the margins, apex and mid-rib reddish, the outer, narrowly lance-olate 3-4 mm. long, obtuse, the apex somewhat thickened, the inner ovate-lanceolate, the pistillate flower with no vestige of stamens, the disc conspicuous, yellowish, lobed; ovary 3-celled, styles completely united, the stiggma crateriform, shallowly 3-lobed; perianth persistent; capsule globose, shallowly 3-lobed, 4-5 mm. long, 6-8 mm. broad, the style 1.5-2.0 mm. long, 0.5 mm. thick, terete, shallowly 3-sulcate; seed 3, about 2.75 mm. long, 2 mm. thick, 3-sided, the outer convex, the lateral faces plane, caruncle lacking, but with a small white callosity at the acutish apex, the testa light brown, irregular reddish-brown striate; stami- nate flowers not seen.

description:
Description (based on 25 U.S. collections): perennial herbs 0.2-3 dm high; main stems erect or spreading, wiry, clustered on a thickened caudex; stipules of cataphylls ovate-triangular acute to acuminate, entire to indurate, mostly 0.8-1.3 mm long; deciduous branchlets 1-6 (0.5-14) cm long, terete, smooth or rarely scabridulous, with ca. 5-35 (-75) leaves; leaf blades membranous to subcoriaceous, elliptic or obovate or suborbicular, obtuse or rounded and apiculate at tip, acute to rounded at base, mostly 2-8 mm long, 1-5 mm broad, smooth or scabridulous beneath, veinlet reticulum prominent to invisible beneath; stipules lanceolate, acuminate, 0.4-1 mm long. Mostly dioecious, or if monoecious then male and female flowers on separate branchlets (rarely a few female flowers present at tips of elongated male branchlets); cymules unisexual, male flowers in bracteolate monochasia up to 1-1.5 mm long, with (10-) 15-20 flowers, male flowers solitary at each axil. Staminate flowers with pedicels 0.3-0.8 mm long; calyx lobes 5, obovate, obtuse or rounded at tip, entire to crenulate, yellowish, 1- veined, 0.7-0.8 mm long; disk segments 5, subentire, ca. 0.1-0.15 mm across; stamens 2, filaments connate over halfway into a column ca. 0.2-0.3 mm high; anthers subsessile atop the column, dehiscing horizontally. Pistillate flowers with pedicels becoming 1.2-1.8 (1-2.1) mm long; calyx lobes 5, elliptic-oblong or obovate, rounded at tip, entire or obscurely crenulate, herbaceous with broad whitish margins, (0.7-) 0.9-1.2 mm long; disk deeply 5-lobed; ovary smooth; styles free, spreading or somewhat ascending, 0.15-0.2 mm long, bifid nearly or quite halfway, style branches slender and recurving. Capsules ca. 1.7-1.9 mm broad; seeds light brown, with 6-8 delicate slightly raised longitudinal striae on back, 0.8-0.9 mm long.

Chromosome number: 2n = 52 (Webster & Ellis, 1962)

description:
Description (based on 325 U.S. collections): Glabrous perennial herbs, becoming +/- suffruticose, 1-5 dm high; branches ascending, whiplike; leaves spirally arranged, not markedly imbricate; blades narrowly oblong to obovate, acute or mucronulate at the tip, obtusish at the base, glaucous beneath and smooth or minutely scabridulous, with 5-10 obscure to distinctly visible lateral veins, mostly 5-10 mm long, 1.5-5 mm broad; stipules reddish or pinkish with hyaline margins, becoming darker, acute to acuminate, auriculate at the base, entire or denticulate, mostly 1-2 mm long (0.5-1 mm on reduced branches). Mostly monoecious, but unisexual plants not uncommon; cymules axillary on all orders of branching, unisexual or bisexual, with 1 (rarely 2) female flower and/or several male flowers. Staminate flowers with pedicels 1.5-3.5 mm long; calyx lobes 6 (rarely 5), oblong to obovate, obtuse to acute, 1-veined, greenish yellow or sometimes reddish tinged, 0.7-1.3 mm long; disk segments 6, orbicular or cuneate, 0.2-0.3 mm across; stamens 3, filaments 0.6-0.8 mm long, connate into a column ca. 0.4-0.5 mm high; anthers dehiscing vertically, ca. 0.3 mm long. Pistillate flowers with pedicels becoming 2.5-7 mm long, smooth or scabridulous; calyx lobes 6 (rarely 5), ovate to obovate, acute, green and herbaceous, pinnately veined, becoming ca. 1.5-2.5 mm long in fruit; disk segments 6, obcuneate, flat, ca. 0.2-0.3 mm across; ovary smooth or somewhat scabridulous; styles spreading or ascending, 0.25-0.3 mm long, bifid; style branches mostly 0.1-0.15 mm long, subcapitate. Capsules 2.7-3.2 mm broad; seeds usually dark brown, irregularly verruculose, 1.2-1.4(1.1-1.5) mm long.

Chromosome number: 2n = 16 (Webster & Ellis, 1962).

description: Description (based on 25 collections): annual herbs 1-5 dm high; stems erect, simple or sparsely branched, subterete at basal, distally compressed and with narrow lateral wings 0.1-0.2 mm broad, scabridulous; leaves distichous; blades elliptic or oblong, acute or obtuse at tip, obtuse to rounded at base, paler beneath with veinlets inconspicuous or obscure, 8-20 mm long, 2.5-10 mm broad; stipules herbaceous at center with pale brown margins, ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, denticulate, cordate auriculate, 1.1-2 mm long; monoecious; cymules axillary, with 1-3 8 flowers and 1 or 2 (rarely 3) 9 flowers. Staminate flowers with pedicels ca. 0.5-0.8 mm long; calyx lobes 5 or 6, ovate or suborbicular, acute or obtuse, entire, 1-veined, pale, 0.5-0.7 mm long; disk segments 5 or 6, roundish or cuneate; stamens 3, filaments 0.2-0.3 mm long, united into a column or nearly free; anthers subsessile on the column, dehiscing horizontally, ca. 0.2 mm long. Pistillate flowers with sharply reflexed smooth angled pedicels 1.4-1.8 (1-2.2) mm long; calyx lobes 6 (rarely 5), ? oblong, obtuse or acute, entire, becoming 0.7-1.2 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm broad; disk patelliform, entire (? angled); ovary smooth; styles spreading, ca. 0.25-0.3 mm long, basally fused, shallowly bifid with thickened style branches. Capsules some- times reddish tinged, 2.8-3.2 mm broad; seeds pale to greyish brown, irregularly or closely verruculose, 1.3-1.5 mm long.

description:
Description (based on 40 U.S. collections): annual herbs, ca. 2-5 dm high; main stems smooth, subterete, with spirally arranged cataphylls; stipules of cataphylls lanceolate, acuminate, not auriculate, 0.7-1 mm long; lateral deciduous branchlets ca. 5-15 cm long, with ca. 10-25 leaves; leaf blades membranous, elliptic to obovate, acute or obtuse at tip, acute to rounded at base, 6-25 mm long, 4-11 mm broad, pale and finely reticulate beneath; stipules lanceolate, acuminate, entire, 0.7-1.1 mm long. Monoecious; cymules axillary on deciduous branchlets; proximal cymules with 2 or 3 male flowers and 1 or 2 female flowers, distal cymules with solitary female flowers. Staminate flowers with pedicels 0.5-1.5 mm long; calyx lobes 5, elliptic or obovate, acute to rounded, entire, 1-veined, whitish, 0.4-0.7 mm long; disk segments 5, cuneate, entire, ca. 0.2 mm across; stamens 5, filaments ca. 0.2-0.3 mm long, free, distally bent; anthers dehiscing ? horizontally, 0.15-0.25 mm across. Pistillate flowers with smooth flexuous capillary pedicels becoming (2.5-) 3-8 mm long, basally dilated into a pulvinus; calyx lobes 5, ovate, acute or obtuse, whitish except for the unbranched midrib, in fruit reflexed and ca. 0.6-0.8 mm long; disk patelliform, entire; ovary smooth; styles free, spreading, ca. 0.25 mm long, bifid 1/2 to 2/3 their length; style branches subcapitate. Capsules greenish, 1.7-1.9 mm broad; seeds pale brown, densely papillose, 0.8-0.9 mm long

description: Description (based on 100 U.S. and foreign collections): annual herbs, erect or procumbent, mostly 1.5-5 dm high; main stems smooth, subterete with narrow angles, cataphylls spirally arranged; stipules of cataphylls ovate-lanceolate, attenuate- acuminate, conspicuously auriculate, ca. 2-3 mm long; deciduous branchlets (3-) 5-10 cm long, compressed-winged, hirsutulous, with ca. 20-35 leaves; leaf blades membranous to somewhat firm, oblong or oblong-obovate to sometimes linear, oc- casionally falcate, acute or obtuse and mucronulate at tip, obtuse and + asymmetrical at base, 6-25 mm long, 2-9 mm broad, with veinlets raised above and delicate beneath, minutely scabridulous on lower face and hispidulous marginally and sub- marginally; stipules attenuate-acuminate, unequal, the longer ca. 0.8-1.5 mm long. Monoecious; proximal nodes of branchlet with solitary 9 flowers, distal nodes with monochasia of ca. 5-7 d flowers. Staminate flowers with pedicels less than 0.5 mm long; calyx lobes 6, elliptic to oblong-obovate, obtuse, entire, 1-veined, 0.3-0.5 mm long; disk segments 6, very small (ca. 0.1 mm across), obscurely crenulate; stamens 3, filaments connate into a slender column ca. 0.1-0.15 mm high; anthers discrete, dehiscing vertically, 0.1-0.15 mm long. Pistillate flowers subsessile, the thickened pedicel not over 0.5 mm in fruit; calyx lobes 6, linear-oblong to lanceolate, obtuse or rounded, hispidulous dorsally, serrulate or entire, yellowish and sometimes reddish tinged, 0.6-0.9 mm long in fruit; disk patelliform, subentire; ovary conspicuously bullate-papillate; styles flattened, basally fused into a triangular plate ca. 0.4 mm across, bifid ca. 1/3 their lengths, style branches slender. Capsules tuberculate to nearly smooth, ca. 2-2.2 mm broad; seeds light brown, with 12-15 sharp transverse ridges on back and sides, and often with 1-3 lateral pits, 1.1-1.2 mm long. Chromosome number: 2n = 52 (Raghavan & Arora, 1958; Webster & Ellis, 1962).

description: Multi-stemmed shrubs, 3-8 m tall, with leaves clustered at the ends of the terminal branchlets; bark smooth, light gray; wood white; young leafy branchlets 1-2 mm thick, terete. Stipules sheathing at base, connected to petioles, pilose outside and on the margins, basally pilose inside, the free portion 1-1.5 mm long, broadly ovate, acute at apex; stipules long-persistent with two petiole scars on the sides, remaining on stem as a tight series of cup-shaped units. Blades 2.5-7 X 1-2.5 cm, length:width ra- tio 2:1 to 4:1, obovate to oblanceolate, decurrent at base, rounded to acute at apex, dark green above and pale green below, chartaceous, drying reddish brown above and olive-green below; glabrous above and below; primary and secondary veins glabrous or with sparse sericeous hairs; primary veins prominent below, secondary veins 4-6 each side, tertiary veins sparse and reticulate; petioles 1-4 mm long, 0.5-0.8 mm thick, terete. Inflorescences axillary, cymose, 9-20-flowered, pendulous, (1-)2 per node, 1.5-5.5 cm long; rachis and branches filiform, glabrous to sparsely short-pubescent; flowers in 2-3-florous cymules; distal bracts oblanceolate, 1-2 mm long; bracteoles subtending the flowers absent or reduced to microscopic lanceolate scales. Flowers short-pedicellate; pedicels filiform, 0.5-1.5 mm long, elongating in mature capsules. Calyx rotate, membranaceous, entire or with 2-4 round lobes (Fig. 2), 1-3 mm long in flowers, expanding in mature capsules, with a basal ring of pilose hairs inside. Corolla funnelform, deeply lobed, 3.5-4 mm long, white; tube funnelform, ca. 1.5 mm long, 0.6 mm wide at base and 1.5-1.7 mm wide at orifice, glabrous outside and inside; lobes 4-5(-6), imbricate in bud, ca. 2 X 1 mm, oblong, rounded at apex, glabrous throughout. Stamens 4-5 (-6), half-exserted, of equal length, subsessile, attached on the tube near the mouth; filaments 0.3-0.5 mm long; anthers narrowly oblong, 1.1-1.4 x 0.2-0.3 mm, dorsifix- ed near the base. Style exserted, 4-5 mm long, terete, glabrous; style branches ovate, 0.5-0.8 mm long. Capsules narrowly-obconical, multicostate, decurrent at base, 3- 6 x 1.5-2.6 num, reddish brown, glabrous (or very sparsely puberulent), bilocular and with solitary seeds, indehiscent; disk black, glabrous; persistent calyx membranous, entire or with round lobes, 4-9 mm long, expanded in mature capsule, functioning as a rotate pterophyll. Seeds basally inserted, ellipsoid-ovoid, fleshy, smooth, ca. 1.5 X 0.5 mm, with apical hilum.

description: Planta fruticosa scandensque, usque ad 6 m alta; eaulibus ramisque tetragonis atro-purpuraseentibus, primum albido-hispidis pilis arcuatis tenerrimis patentibus vel conspicue retrorsis apicaliter acribus, demum plus minusve glabrescentibus. Folio opposita longe tenuiterque petiolata, petiolis 2-6.5 cm longis, subdense pilosis; lamina foliorum principalium ovata vel oblongo-ovata, mem- branacea, 8-12 cm longa et 4.5-7.5 cm lata, supra sparsissime adpresseque infra dense adpresseque albido-setosa, apice acuta vel subacuminata, basi rotundata vel saepius truneata etiam subeordata, margine acriter inaequaliterque serrata dentibus usque ad ?20-22 utroque latere. Verticillastra cire. 5 vel 6 in utraque infloreseentia, in fructu cire. 5-8 cm lata, varie 4-16-flora; pedicellis elongatis tenuibusque, late patentibus, 1.5-3 cm longis, rectis vel aegre arcuatis, dense albo-hispidis pilis arcuatis saepe antrorsis, 2-8 e pedunculo inchoato vel etiam 2-3 mm longo ortis. Calyx campanulatus 8-12 mm longus, subadpresse retror- sumque hispidus, lobis triangulato-ovatis, apice acutis, quam tubo dimidia brevioribus. Corolla alba, 2.5-3 cm longa, pubeseens, tubo -+ 1.3 cm longa, labia inferiori 3-lobata lobo mediano -+9 mm lato, lobis lateralibus multo minoribus. Staminum filamenta puberula. Styli rami paulum inaequales, flabelliformes. Fructus maturi (nuculae) atri, plani, circuumambitu orbiculati, apice acuti, 7-10 mm alti.

ramulis juvenilibus distalibus complanatis mox teretibus apicem versus 1-2 mm latis fuscis, pilis ad 0.3 mm longis sericeis, demum glabratis; foliis alternis, sessilibus vel subsessilibus, foliorum laminis coriaceis integris oblongis vel ellipticis vel obovatis, (2-)3-8 cm longis, 1.5-3.5 cm latis, interdum in ramulis flori- feris haud 3 x 3 mm, basi obtusis vel subcordatis in ramulos aliquantum decurrentibus, apice rotundatis vel subacutis, juventute pilis ad 0.6 mm longis utrinque sericeis, maturitate supra glabris subtus dispersim hispidulis, costa tereti supra elevata subtus prominenti, nervis secundariis utrinsecus 7-15 patentibus utrinque elevatis marginem versus anastomosantibus, rete venularum utrinque prominulo nervos secundarios con- jungenti et interdum eis parallelo; inflorescentiis axillaribus fasciculatis 2-10-floris, bracteis minutis acutis strigillosis mox caducis subtentis, pedicellis teretibus sub anthesi 2.5-4 mm sub fructu ad 5 mm longis, pilis ad 0.2 mm longis strigillosis vel pilis patenti- bus hispidulis, aliquando bracteolatis, bracteola infra medium solitaria acuta strigil- losa ad 1 mm longa, floribus sub anthesi 3-4 mm diametro; staminibus 5 glabris corol- lae lobis oppositis tubi apice insertis, filamentis ad 0.2 mm liberis teretibus, antheris ovoideis basifixis ad 0.7 X 0.5 mm longitudinaliter dehiscentibus; staminodiis 5 corol- lae lobis alternatis ovatis acuminatis circiter 0.8 x 0.5 mm; fructibus immaturis coriaceis glabris in sicco sepiaceis subellipsoideis, apice obtusis stigmate 3-lobato apiculatis, sepalis persistentibus.

description: Fruit globose, 10 mm diam., with pericarp 1.5 mm thick, and stigmatic remains lateral to subapical most distinctive for its dense zone of brachysclereids with embedded short, obliquely to radially oriented fibrous bundles in the middle pericarp; further characterized by a thick pigmented zone below the epidermis, abundant tanniniferous cells in the outer third of the pericarp, followed by scattered and sometimes densely clustered tanniniferous cells in the inner half of the pericarp, by the vascular bundles few, small and with thin or no fibrous sheaths, and by the very thick locular epidermis.

description: Caespitose terrestrials to 5 5 cm tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid-pyriform, 4-6 angled, lightly sulcate, 4-6 cm long, 3 cm in diam. Leaf 1, broadly elliptic, acuminate, 47 x 24.5 cm, with a petiole to 5 cm long, 0.6 cm in diam. Inflorescence suberect-arching racemes, 55 cm long, 2 mm in diam., the peduncle, rachis and ovaries spiculate, the 4-5 peduncular bracts tubular, 2.5-3.0 cm long, the floral bracts ovate-triangular, 1.4 cm long, much shorter than the ovary. Flowers 15- 18, appearing limp, the sepals and petals cream yellow with red dots and spots, the labellum hypochile pale greenish cream-yellow moderately spotted with purplish-red, the center of the claw white with similar spots, the callus white dorsally, otherwise purplish-red, pubescence hyaline, the epi- chile white with reddish-purple spots along basal margins and on the distal half, the column green heavily overlain with reddish-purple spots, the anther cream-yellow, the stipe and viscidium semitranslucent white and the pollinia cream-yellow. Sepals subsimilar, spreading, lanceolate, acuminate, to 39 x 9 mm, the lateral sepals oblique. Petals subfiliform, pendulous, 42 x 3 mm. Labellum 3.3 x 1.1 cm, the hypochile with two basal incurved, thickened auricles, more or less triangular, in front with a short thick claw expanding gradually in two large convex-concave, incurved, obliquely tapered lobes with suboblong, acute apices, with a central ridge dilated api- cally into a large, laterally compressed, se- mielliptic free callus, the epichile trullate, apically complicate-concave with a lightly upturned apex, the claw, base of lateral lobes, callus, and epichile hispid. Column slender, arcuate, gradually clavate above, 28 mm long, the anther oblong-ovate, constricted slightly below the apex, 4.5 x 1.6 mm, the pollinarium 4.6 x 1 mm, the pollinia linear- oblanceolate, parallel, 2.2 x 0.5 mm, the stipe linear-oblanceolate, 2.2 x 0.5 mm, viscidium minute.

description: Plants epiphytic, rarely lithophytic, rhizomatous, to 18 cm tall. Roots many, slender, velamentous. Primary stem or rhizome short, stout, creeping, enclosed by imbricating scarious sheaths. Secondary stem modified into pseudobulbs, erect or ascending, clustered, ovate to oblong, to 1.4 cm long, 5 mm wide, basally enclosed by scarious sheaths, 1-3-leaved at apex. Leaves thinly coriaceous, keeled, linear-oblong to linear-lanceolate, articulate with leaf sheaths, acute, to 14 cm long, 8 mm wide. Inflorescence terminal, to 12 cm long, racemose or rarely paniculate, the peduncle slender, elongate, compressed, completely enclosed by scarious linear-lanceolate, attenuate sheaths, racemose above or rarely with 1-3 spicate lateral branches; flowers fleshy, yellow to greenish-yellow, non-resupinate. Floral bracts minute, membranous, ovate, acute, concave, to 1 mm long, 0.7 mm wide. Ovary pedicellate, slender, to 4 mm long. Sepals glossy, rigid; dorsal sepal ovate, acute to subacuminate, concave, to 3 mm long, 2 mm wide; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, acute, concave, adnate to the column foot forming a saccate mentum, to 4 mm long, 4 mm wide. Petals glossy, rigid, oblanceolate to spatulate, subobtuse to acute, con- cave, to 2.5 mm long, 1.0 mm wide. Labellum free, attached to a short column foot, arcuate, 3-lobed, cuneate in outline, to 4 mm long, 3 mm wide; lateral lobes falcate to triangular, subobtuse to acute, incurved; midlobe oblong, the apex trun- cate, emarginate, recurved, basally provided with an orbicular central fleshy ridge covered with glandular hairs. Column greenish-white, short, cylindric, to 2.5 mm long, 1.8 mm wide, with a short foot to 1-2 mm long; anthers 3, the central an- ther with 2 bipartite pollinia, the 2 lateral anthers with 1 or 2 bipartite pollinia and with or without anther cap. Capsule erect, to 5 mm long, 2.3 mm wide.

description: Pyramidal treelets (or rarely few-branched shrubs), to 3 m tall, erect; bark lightly fissured, cream-colored to pale brown. Stipules free or narrowly connate at base, triangular, or ovate to broadly ovate, 4-7 mm long, acute or round at apex. Leaves sessile or shortly petiolate; petioles to 7 mm long; blades narrowly elliptic, elliptic, ovate to broadly ovate, or rarely obovate, 6-13 X 2.5-9.8 cm, apex acute or obtuse, base acute (rarely decurrent) or obtuse to cordate, subcoriaceous to coriaceous; margin sometimes revolute. Inflorescences reduced cymes, axillary in last nodes, 1-3-flowered. Flowers with pedicels 0.9-2.2 cm long. Calyx lobes narrowly el- liptic to narrowly lanceolate, rarely linear, 9-25 X (1-)2-6 mm, chartaceous. Corolla obconical, gradually expanding towards the mouth (Fig. 1), 6-8.5 cm long (including lobes), dark pink, red to deep crimson, of- ten with 5 white lines along angles inside; tube 4-5 mm wide at base, 28-37 mm wide at mouth; lobes 5, broadly ovate or broadly triangular, 5-7 X 13-15 mm, round at apex. Filaments 4.7-5.7 cm long, pubescent at basal portion, free at base; anthers mostly included, with tips projecting just beyond the corolla mouth, linear, twisting at anthesis, 15-20 X 0.5-0.7 mm, base and apex round. Style partially exserted beyond the corolla mouth, glabrous; with two stigmatic lines 7-13 mm long. Capsules ellipsoid to obovoid, angular, strongly 5-costate, 14-24 X 11-15 mm. Seeds concavo-convex, round to broadly obovoid, 1.8-2.2 X 1.6- 2.2 mm.

description: Stem solitary, erect, 2.5 m tall, 10 cm diam, covered with persistent remains of sheaths. Leaves 6, erect; sheaths not forming a crownshaft; petiole 80 cm long, rounded below, channeled above with central ridge, reddish-brown, glabrous; rachis 165 cm long, rounded below, ridged above, reddish, with scattered brown deciduous membranous scales above, glabrous below; pinnae 29 per side, stiff and horizontally spreading, evenly spaced ca 5 cm apart and opposite basally to sub-opposite from middle upwards, at base of rachis 48 cm long and 1 cm wide, at middle 75 cm long and 5 cm wide, at apex 44 cm long and 4.5 cm wide, with scattered scales similar to those of rachis on veins below. Inflorescence erect, interfoliar; peduncle 75 cm long, terete, covered with membranous scales; prophyll inserted near base of peduncle, 60 cm long, 4 cm wide, dorsoventrally compressed, bicarinate, woody, splitting apically; peduncular bract inserted 23 cm above base of peduncle, 223 cm long, 2.5 cm diam, terete, rostrate, splitting abaxially longitudinally; rachis 80-135 cm long, terete, reddish, covered with scales similar to those of peduncle; rachillae ca 60, spreading at anthesis and in fruit, spirally arranged and 7 cm apart basally to 2 cm apart apically, 72 cm long and 2-3 mm diam at base (thickening up to 3 mm diam in fruit), 45 cm long at apex, slightly tomentose with very short, scattered hairs, swollen at junction with rachis and with ca 8 cm long sterile part above this, basal one subtended by acute bract 4 cm long. Flowers in triads proximally to paired or solitary staminate distally, subtended by a low membranous bract: staminate flowers inserted laterally to pistillate with one slightly larger and inserted above the other, ebracteolate, glabrous; sepals distinct, imbricate, 1 mm high, 2 equal in size and wider than the third; petals distinct, valvate, 3-4 mm high, 2 equal in size and larger than the third; pistillode columnar, 1 mm high, trifid at apex; filaments erect and scarcely inflexed at apex in bud; pistillate flowers glabrous, surrounded by 2 low, membranous bracteoles; sepals distinct, imbricate, 2 mm high, broadly triangular, keeled; petals distinct, imbricate below, valvate above, 2 mm high; staminodes very small, dentiform; pistil with small whitish projections. Fruit 8 mm diam, dark purple; seed 7 mm diam, endosperm ruminate.

description: Stems cespitose, erect, with 1 or 2 well-developed, these up to 1 m tall and 10 cm diam, covered with persistent decaying leaf sheaths. Leaves 4 or 5, spreading; sheath 50-60 cm long, open (at least on outer leaves) and not forming a crownshaft, persistent; petiole 90-105 cm long, 1.5 cm diam, subterete, densely covered with deciduous, appressed, brown, membranous scales; rachis 240 cm long, rounded below, ridged above, with similar scales as petiole; pinnae 34-36 per side, 1-veined, horizontally spreading, evenly spaced, sub-opposite, deep green above, dull green below, with long acuminate tip, at base of rachis 60 cm long and 1 cm wide at mid-point, at middle 70 cm long and 4.5 cm wide at mid-point, at apex 35 cm long and 1 cm wide at mid-point, with scattered brown scales on mid-veins below. Inflorescence interfoliar, arching, protandrous; peduncle up to 120 cm long and 1 cm wide, densely brown-tomentose; prophyll erect and persistent in leaf sheath, inserted at base of peduncle, 50 cm long, 4 cm diam, bicarinate, dorsoventrally compressed, reddish-brown outside and with scattered brown scales; peduncular bract falling away from inflorescence during anthesis, 160 cm long, with 6 cm long acute apex, inserted 15-18 cm from base of peduncle, outside covered with similar scales as prophyll, splitting abaxially longitudinally, at anthesis red outside and white inside, becoming brown; vestigial bracts 3, small, acute, inserted near apex of peduncle; rachis up to 35 cm long, densely covered with scales; rachillae 35-50, spirally arranged on rachis, at base of rachis 25 cm long, at apex 10 cm long, flexuose, each subtended by a very small acute bract, with scales similar to those of rachis; peduncle, rachis, and rachillae cream-colored where exposed at staminate anthesis, becoming reddish at pistillate anthesis and in fruit; flowers in triads proximally to paired or solitary staminate distally; triads borne from base of rachillae, surrounded by a prominent bract; staminate flowers cream-colored at anthesis; sepals 3, free, imbricate, keeled, 1.5 mm long, minutely ciliate; petals 3, free, valvate, 4 mm long; stamens 6; filaments 4 mm long, inflexed at apex; anthers 2 mm long; pistillode 1 mm, trifid at apex; pistillate flowers reddish at anthesis, subtended by 2 low bracteoles; sepals fleshy, imbricate, 2 mm high; petals fleshy, imbricate 3.5 mm high; staminodes dentiform; stigmas very short, reflexed at anthesis; fruit dark purple, 8 mm diam, with stigmatic remains lateral; endosperm ruminate.

description: Solitary. Stem 2-7 m high, ca 7 cm diam, brown; internodes 9-11 cm long. Leaves 4-9, erect; sheath 60 cm long, open, with fibrous margins, not forming a distinct crownshaft, light brown when fresh, covered with reddish-brown fibrous scales; petiole 7-8 cm long, 1.7 cm wide at apex, green when fresh and young, violet when mature, adaxial surface slightly concave, deciduously scaly, abaxial surface convex, covered toward the margins with a scaly indumentum like that of the sheath; rachis 140-176 cm long, green when fresh, adaxial surface flat at base, acute distally and produced at apex into a slender thread to 20 cm long, abaxial surface convex, scaly toward the margins like the sheath; blade simple, oblong in outline, 192-250 cm long, 66-90 cm wide at the middle, with 36-42 primary veins on each side, forming an angle of 10-30º with the rachis, ca 1.5-2 cm apart, prominent and acute on the adaxial surface, less prominent and with thick, fasciculate, whitish hairs on the abaxial surface; secondary veins as prominent abaxially as the primary ones, only one between each two primary veins; tertiary veins inconspicuous on the adaxial surface, prominent and yellowish abaxially. Inflorescence interfoliar to infrafoliar, once branched, 171 cm long, reddish in fruit when fresh; prophyll 34 cm long, ca 7 cm wide, oblong, acute, fibrous; peduncular bract inserted 7 cm above the prophyll, one seen ca 160 cm long, 7 cm wide, oblong, acute, fibrous; peduncle 64-75 cm long, 1.5 cm diam, subterete, provided near the apex with a bract 4-5 cm long, 1.5 cm wide, longtriangular, acute, rigid; rachis 63-69 cm long, densely covered with an indumentum of very small, light brown crusty trichomes; rachillae 45-46, each subtended by a bract that in the basal rachillae is triangular, to 3 cm long, ca 1 cm wide; rachillae pendulous but rigid, ca 3 mm diam, with an indumentum like that of the rachis, the basal ones 69-74 cm long, the apical 43-44 cm long. Staminate flowers at anthesis 4-5 mm long; sepals 1-1.5 mm long, broadly ovate, acute, with ciliate margins; petals 4-5 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide, triangular to oblong, acute; stamens 6, the filaments ca 3 mm long, tapering toward the apex; pistillode deeply trifid, ca 1 mm long, shorter than the stamens. Pistillate flowers before anthesis 3-4 mm long, 2.5-3 mm diam, apparently recently fertilized ovoid, 5-6 mm long, 4 mm diam; sepals broadly ovate; petals broadly imbricate, ovate, acute; gynoecium ellipsoid; stigmas recurved; staminodes 6, deltoid. Fruits (nearly mature) globose, 7-9 mm diam; stigmatic residue lateral; endosperm ruminate. Eophylls bifid.

description: Plants epiphytic. Pseudobulbs oblong-elliptic, angular-obovate, usually ridged or furrowed, flattened on one side and convex on the other. Pseudobulbs stalked, the stalk hidden by the sheathing bracts when young, the bracts usually falling with age, the uppermost of the bracts leaf-like. Pseudobulbs 5-12 cm long, 2-4 cm wide, com- pressed. Terminal leaves usually two. Leaves lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, acumi- nate, 13-30 cm long, 2.0-4.1 cm wide. Floral bracts broadly triangular, 0.6-1.0 cm  long, 0.4-0.8 cm wide, the margins papery. Pedicel 2.2-4.0 cm long. Sepals 1.5-2.5 cm long, 0.4-1.0 cm wide, elliptic-obovate, the apex emarginate with a fleshy apiculate keel on the outside of the sepals, yellow or yellow-green with transverse brown or maroon-brown markings. Dorsal sepal inserted on the back of the column, often hooding the column, or slightly reflexed; lateral sepals spreading or reflexed. Petals 1.5-2.4 cm long, 0.4-1.0 cm wide, broadly elliptic-obovate to almost spatulate, basally adnate to the column, often almost clasping the column, the apex emarginate to apiculate, the outside of the petals with a fleshy keel, usually uniformly brown or yellow-brown with transverse markings usually absent. Lip 1.2-1.9 cm long, 1.7-2.1 cm wide, basally adnate to the column for 0.5-0.9 cm, then perpendicular to the column, obscurely lobed or broadly pandurate, subquadrate, the apex emarginate, often fimbriate or crenulate, often with a fleshy keel on the underside, the distal half of the lip almost always curved upwards, the lip white with purple markings towards apex, the base often yellow near the union with the column, callus usually white or yellow, of two distinct diverging longitudinal ridges, often with a small ridge to the outside of each callus. Column 0.9-1.0 cm long beyond the union with the lip, cylindrical to semiterete, with a wide channel below the stigma, the margins of the column with a small tubercle or auricle just below the stigma. Anther cap 0.4 cm tall, 0.6 cm long, smooth to slightly papillose, triangular from front view, not noticeably overhanging the stigma from side view, the top with a keel. Viscidium visible from front view, facing outward, narrowly elliptic; stipe 2.5 mm long, 0.8 mm wide, some- what constricted basally, narrowly angular-obovate, the lateral margins recurved ventrally and almost meeting basally; pollinia 2.5 mm long, 1.4 mm wide, asym- metrically reniform, the ventral groove very prominent, the surface smooth, yellow. Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, cultivated in Guatemala.
bibliographicCitation: Williams, Norris H. 1974. Taxonomy of the genus Aspasia Lindley (Orchidaceae:Oncidieae). Brittonia. 26: 333-346.

description: Plants epiphytic. Pseudobulbs oval, elliptic-ovate, laterally compressed, smooth or slightly furrowed. Sheathing bracts 2--6, the upper ones leaf-like. Terminal leaves one or two. Leaves linear-lanceolate, usually thin, 14-22 cm long, 1.3-1.7 cm wide, the apex asymmetrical, acute, the base slightly ligulate. Floral bracts long-triangular, somewhat papery, 1.0-1.7 cm long, 0.4-0.6 cm wide. Pedicel 3.0-6.5 cm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, 2.4-4.5 cm long, 0.3-0.8 cm wide, yellow-brown with darker maroon spots, the dorsal sepal erect, the lateral sepals recurved. Petals shorter and wider than sepals, lanceolate, 2.4-3.5 cm long, 0.3-0.5 cm wide. Lip adnate to the column for 0.4-0.8 cm, then perpendicular to the column, pandurate, 2.0-4.0 cm long, 1.7-4.0 cm wide, apically wider than the base, the basal lobes spreading and hiding the base of the column, the apex entire, apiculate, often fimbriate or crenulate, often apically reflexed and appearing emarginate, rarely emarginate. Column 0.2-0.5 cm high beyond union with the lip, semiterete, not greatly inflated at the base, the clinandrium entire or slightly fringed, not hooding the anther cap. Anther cap papillose, 0.3 cm tall, 0.4 cm long, semicircular from front view, slightly overhanging but not obscuring the viscidium. Viscidium ovate or obovate; stipe oblong or angular-oblong to almost rectangular, the lateral margins not recurved in the material examined; pollinia obovoid, the ventral groove well developed. Brazil.

description: Plants epiphytic. Pseudobulbs oblong-elliptic to angularly obovate, laterally com- pressed, often flat or concave on one side and convex on the other, smooth to fur- rowed, about 10 cm long, 1.8 cm wide, usually bifoliate. Sheathing bracts 2-6, the upper ones leafy, falling with age. Leaves lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, 10-30 cm long, 2-4 cm wide, slightly coriaceous. Floral bracts 0.7-1.1 cm long, 0.3-0.4 cm wide. Pedicel 2.4-2.7 cm long. Sepals elliptic-obovate to lanceolate, the dorsal sepal inserted on the back of the column, 2.8-3.2 cm long, 0.8-1.0 cm wide, the lateral margins often inrolled, the dorsal sepal often reflexed; lateral sepals reflexed, often falcate or asymmetrical, 2.8-3.5 cm long, 0.7-1.1 cm wide, with a fleshy keel, the apex apiculate sepals yellow-green or yellow-brown with longitudinal brown-maroon stripes, often with thick horizontal brown bars. Petals lanceolate to elliptic-lanceolate, 2.5-2.8 cm long, 0.7-1.1 cm wide, with fleshy apiculate keel on the back of the petals, yellow-green with thin longitudinal stripes, inserted on the base of the column, spreading or clasping the column. Lii) pandurate, white becoming yellow near union with the column, more or less planar, 2.5-3.1 cm long, 2.5-2.8 cm wide, with a callus of two parallel fleshy lamellae (additional lamellae almost never present), adnate to the column for 0.8-1.2 cm, the lobes of the lip about equal, the apex emarginate wvith a small fleshy apiculate keel on the underside, not curved upwards. Column 1.0-1.4 cm high beyond the union with the lip, noticeably inflated at the base, semiterete, with a long, thin, fairly deep channel beneath the stigma: stigma oblong, the auricles of the column small or lacking. Anther cap overhanging the stigma and obscuring the viscidium in front and side views, fleshy, smooth to slightly papillose, the margin of clinandrium smooth. Viscidium narrowly elliptic: stipe 2.8 mm long, 0.9 mm wide, slightly constricted basally, narrowly angular-obovate, the lateral margins recurved ventrally and almost meeting basally; pollinia asymmetrically obovoid to reniform, 2.8 mm lona, 1.4 mm wvide, the ventral groove very prominent, the surface smooth, yellow.

description: Plants epiphytic. Pseudobulbs elliptic-oblong, obovate, or ovoid, laterally flattened, 4.5-10.0 cm long, 1.2-2.0 cm wide. Sheathing bracts 2-6, the upper ones leaf-like. Terminal leaves usually two, rarely one. Leaves lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, acute, 10-22 cm long, 1.5-3.2 cm wide. Floral bracts broadly triangular, 1.1-1.3 cm long, 0.4-0.6 cm wide. Pedicel 2.6-3.5 cm long. Sepals lanceolate, green-brown with transverse maroon-brown bars, 1.8-2.3 cm long, 0.3-0.6 cm wide, the apex asymmetri- cal, the lateral sepals slightly falcate, the backs of sepals often with a slightly fleshy keel. Petals elliptic-obovate, slightly asymmetrical, rarely appearing spatulate, 1.6- 1.9 cm long, 0.6-0.7 cm wide, yellow-green to yellow-brown, with vertical maroon stripes superposed over transverse brown bars. Lip adnate to the column for 0.8-1.1 cm, then rigidly perpendicular to the column, 1.5-1.8 cm long, 1.3-1.5 cm wide, distinctly lobed, the basal lobes distinctly wider than the apical lobes, the apex emarginate, the margins crenulate, those of the basal lobes often deeply incised, white with radiating purple streaks, yellow near the union with the column, the callus of two ridges, pubescent at the base. Column 0.7-0.9 cm high beyond the union with the lip, semiterete, the channel beneath the stigma wide and shallow, the margins of column lightly pubescent, the auricles of column small or lacking. Anther cap overhanging the viscidium in side view, papillose. Pollinaria adequate for complete description are lacking in all material examined; pollinia triangular obovoid.

description: Frutex, ca. 2 m altus; rami teretes cortice griseo striato; ramuli teretes brunnei, glabri; folia 3-4 mm longe petiolata, ovata, basi truncata vel subcordata, apice cuspidata, acuta, 4-6 cm longa, 3.5-5.5 cm lata, nervo medio supra applanato vel inferne leviter impresso, subtus praesertim inferne prominulo, nervis lateralibus utroque latere 6-8 arcuatis, non prominulis, vel obsoletis, utrinque densissime et minute glanduloso-punctata, punctis pellucidis, chartacea, margine plana integra; pedunculi 1-2 axillares, 1-flori, 3-4 cm longi; prophylla linearia 2 mm longa, decidua; calyx in fructo tantum visus, glaber, glanduloso-punctatus, lobis ovatis, apice rotundatis, 5 mm longis, 3-4 mm latis, extus glanduloso-punctatis; discus ferrugineotomentosus; fructus 3-locularis, juvenilis tantum visus, obovoideus, 8-10 mm longus, 6-7 mm latus; semina 2 vel 3 in quoque loculo, laevia, nitida flavidula, subreniformia, 2.5 mm longa.
