description: Frutex; rami brunnei, cortice striato et subalato; ramuli 4-alati, hirsuti; folia petiolo 1-2 mm longo, supra canaliculato, orbicularia vel transverse elliptica, 12-24 mm longa, 12-21 mm lata, basi obtusa vel breviter cuneata, apice obtusa vel brevissime cuspidata, nervo medio, supra applanato vel inferne parum impresso, subtus prominente, nervis lateralibus utroque latere 3-4 plerumque obsoletis, utrinque glanduloso-punctata, punctis pellucidis, margine plano vel paullo recurvo, chartacea; pedicelli solitarii axillares, 6-10 mm longi, piloso-hirsuti; prophylla linearia, 1-1.5 mm longa, ciliata; alabastra verosimiliter clausa (in statu clauso plane non visa); calycis tubus semiovalis extus piloso-hirsutus et glandulosus, limbo in anthesi irregulariter disrupto reflexo, intus villoso; petala oblongo-obovata, 7-8 mm longa, 2.5-3 mm lata, sessilia, antice rotundata glanduloso-punctata; stamina numerosa, filamentis 4 mm longis, antheris subquadratis; stylus 6 mm longus, rectus; stigma capitatum apice applanatum; ovarium calyci usque ad stamina adnatum, 3-loculare; semina numerosa; fructus non visus.

description: Frutex vel arbor parva, 1-3 m altus; ramis junioribus viridibus, posterius albo-cineraseentibus, per causa epidermis suberificationis; stipulae deltoideae, deciduae, caeteris usque 1/3 basi fissae, 0.8-1 mm longae; petiolus 3-5 mm longus; folia elliptico-ovata vel oblanceolata, obtusa vel apice rotundata, basi cuneata vel longe e-meata, ad petiolum usque circa basim decurrentia, glabra, nervo medio supra impresso, quamquam in sulco prominenti, costula vel laevis carina form anti, 3-6.5 cm longa, 7-18 mm lata; infloreseentiae foliis breviorae, 2-3 florae; bracteae deltoideae margine 2- vel plures dentatae; flores pedicellatae, calyx et pedicelli verrucosi, lobi 5 inaequales, deltoidei; corolla 3-5 mm longa, collo brevi, lobis 2 mm longis; antherae lineares, 1.5 mm longae; bacca oblongo-ovata, costato-verrucosa, matura 8-10 mm longa. Hab. prope Cayo de la Sabina, Sierra de Nipe, Oriente, 17 Jul 1960, Acun-a (E.E.A. 21379) (Holotypus, SV, Isotypus, LS); Playa Vaca, Moa, Baracoa, Aug 1948, Cleitente 6155 (LS). Haec species mea sponsa Agustina Ovies Rodriguez cujus affectus et stimulus valde in scientiae laboribus mihi influit, dedico. Species P. nutantis Sw. affinis, sed frnctibus costatis, foliis chartaceis obtusis differt.

description: Frutex glaber, 2-3 m altus, ramis suleatis; stipulae triangulari-ovatae, deciduae, nondum evolutae 1-1.5 cm longae; folia 3-5 mm longe petiolata, oblaneo- lata, elliptico-obovalia vel obovata, glaberrima, basi angustata vel cuneata, apice acuta, obtusa vel abrupte acuminata, 4-5.6 cm longa, 1.5-3.3 cm supra medium lata; nervo medio supra impresso, subtus prominente, lateralibus utroque latere 5-7, supra leviter impressis, subtus vix prominulis; inflorescentiae terminiales 2.5-4.8 cm longae; bracteae triangulares, acuminatae, denticulatae vel integrae, 1-1.5 cm longae; calycis limbus tubulosus, vix 1 mm altus, glaber; corolla non visa; pedicelli fructiferi 1-2 mm longi, glabri; bacca globosa, 4-4.5 mm diametro. Hab. prope Sabanilla, Km 22 ad viam Baracoa, Oriente, 11 Jan 1960, Alain & Acutta 7494 (Holotypus, SV; Isotypus, LS). Ex affinitate P. lopezii Acujia & Roig, quae foliis ellipticis brevioribus, peduniculis 1-1.5 cm longis, calycis tubo supra ovarium non producto, discrepat. In honiorem Fr. Alainii collectoris et botanici eminenitis et amici dilecti, dicata.

description: Inflorescentia terminalis subumbellatim cymoso-paniculata subhemispherica latior quam longior 2.5-3 x 3.5-4 cm conspicue bracteata, epedunculata vel breviter pedunculata, pedunculo dense strigoso; bracteis foliosis, extimis majoribus rhombico-spathulatis utrinque tomentellis; calyce hypanthioque extus dense hirsutulis; corolla hypocraterimorpha praeter infimam glabram modice pilosula, lobis quinque patenti-recurvatis ligulatis 4-4.5 mm longis; pyrenis extus dense tomentoso-villosulis.

description: Shrub 1-1.5 m tall; stems densely retrorsely strigose in upper portion, glabrescent below; stipules with a sheath 4-5 mm long, the lobes ligulate-lanceolate, obtuse, 3-4 x 1 mm, densely strigillose; leaf-blades subcoriaceous, oblong-elliptic, abruptly acuminate at apex, acute at base, 11-19 x 4-9.5 cm, glabrescent or sparsely appressed-pubescent above, upper midrib appressed-pubescent, the lower surface sparsely to moderately appressed-pubescent, the lower midrib and lateral nerves densely strigillose, with 10-15 lateral nerves on each side, the tertiary venation prominently reticulate on lower surface; inflorescence many-flowered, terminal, subhemispheric, cymose-paniculate, broader than high, 2.5-3 cm long, 3.5-4 cm broad, epedunculate to shortly pedunculate, conspicuously bracteate, with 7-10 or more crowded axes 3-5 mm long; peduncle none or up to 7 mm long, densely strigose; bracts near apex of axes of inflorescence, the larger outermost ones 10-12, rhombic-spathulate, rounded to acute at apex, abruptly narrowed to an unguiculate base, 15-19 x 10-1 5 mm, pinnately veined, tomentellose on both sides, the smaller ones rhombic to broadly obovate, abruptly acute or mucronate at apex, abruptly narrowed at base, 13-16 x 6-11 mm, pilosulous on both sides; calyx and hypanthium 2.5 mm long, densely hirsutulous with ascending hairs; calyx lobes broadly triangular, acute, 0.8 mm long, 1 mm wide, densely hirsutulous without, long-ciliate, the sinus within bearing a single subuliform squamella between the base of each lobe; corolla salverform, 20-21 mm long, the tube white, 16 x 0.7-1 mm, moderately pilosulous within between the insertion of the stamens to the orifice, the lobes yellow, ligulate, terminating in a short acute appendage, 4-4.5 x 0.9-1 mm, pilosulous without, papillate within; anthers linear, 2 mm long; filaments inserted 11 mm above base of tube; style 20 mm long, glabrous; disk equalling length of calyx tube; fruit blue, ovoid, a 2-seeded pyrene; seeds concave-convex, 5-5.5 x 4 mm, densely tomentose-villosulous.

description: Suffrutex 0.5-metralis, ramulis juvenilibus puberulis; stipulis terminalibus tantum persistentibus oblongo-ligulatis apice rotundato-subtruncatis 2-7 x 4 mm inferne sparsim puberulis superne glabratis; foliis petiolatis, petiolis 7-8 mm longis sparsim puberulis; laminis membranaceis oblanceolatis oblongo-ellipticis vel elliptico-lanceolatis apice acutis basi longi-attenuatis 7-14 x 2-5 cm supra glabris subtus costa media nervis lateralibusque ceterum glabris; nervis lateralibus in quoque latere 6- 7 arcuato-adscendentibus supra impressis subtus leviter manifestis intra marginem 2-4 mm anastomosantibus; inflorescentia cymosa hemisphaerica 2-5 x 2-5 cm axibus quinque usque decem tenuibus praedita pedunculata, pedunculo terminali tenui 6.2 cm longo puberulento; axibus duobus infimis 7- 15 mm ceteris 3-10 mm longis; bracteis duobus sub basi axium infimorum patentibus lanceolatis 2 mm longis sparsim puberulis; axibus secundariis 1-2-ramosis 2-5 mm longis in ramulos laterales duos desinentibus; floribus pedicellatis ad apicem ramulorum dispositis, axi centrali 1-flora, axibus late- ralibus 1-3-floris, pedicellis 1.5-2.5 mm longis puberulis; calyce cum hypanthio 1.5 mm longo, hypan- thio turbinato 0.8 x 0.8 mm puberulo; calyce 0.8 mm longo 1.5 mm lato extus minute puberulo, lobis quinque inaequalibus late breviterque suborbiculari-triangularibus apice rotundatis vel obtusis 0.1-1.5 mm longis 0.2-0.8 mm latis ciliolatis; disco tubo calycis breviore; corolla viridescenti-alba doleiformi 3 mm longa, tubo basi 1 mm lato ceterum 1.5-2 mm lato infra lobos corollae obtuse 5-angulato extus praeter costas longitudinales papillosas plerumque glabro intus prope medium piloso ceterum glabro, lobis quinque lanceolato-oblongis carinatis appendiculatis in alabastro 0.7-1.5 mm longis sub fructu 1.8 mm longis, apice inflexo-cucullatis dorso appendice carnosa corniculata 0.6-0.7 mm longa; antheris lineari-oblongis 1.1 mm longis; filamentis 0.5 mm longis 0.5 mm supra basin tubi corollae affixis.

description: Frutex ramosus gracilis glaberrimus, ramis in sieco brunnescentibus subteretibus, internodiis superioribus brevibus 1.5-2.5 cm. longis; stipulae persistentes basi in vaginam 1-1.5 mm. longam trunicatam coalitae, vagina in lobos 2 erectos rigidos acuminatos aequilongos desinente; folia parva, petiolo crassiuseulo vix ad 2 miim. longo; lamina lanceolato-oblonga 3.5-6 cm. longa 1-2 cm. lata longe anguste attenuata, basi anguste rotundata, subcoriacea, supra in sieco viridis, costa prominente, nervis prominulis, subopaca, subtus lucida, costa gracili brunneseente elevata, nervis lateralibus utroque latere ca. 10 arcuatis prominentibus angulo semirecto adscendentibus in marginem desinentibus, nervulis prominentibus subarete reticulatis; infloreseentia parva terminalis cymoso-paniculata, ca. 2 cm. longa atque aequilata vel latior, ramis plusminusve refractis vel late patentibus basi non bracteatis, floribus in cymulas plerumque trifloras dispositis, pedicellis fructiferis subrectis plerumque 3-4 mm. longis; fructus subglobosus 4 mm. diam., pyrenis dorso grosse obtuse costatis.

description: Frutex 1-2 m altus, glaber, ramis hornotinis paullo striatis; stipulae triaingulari-ovatae, 1-15 mm longae; petiolus 3-8 mm longus; folia elliptica vel lanceolato-elliptica, utrinque acuta, 6-7 cm longa, 1.7-2.3 cm lata; nervo medio supra impresso, lateralibus utroque latere 11, supra leviter impressis; lamina supra viridissima, subtus pallidiora; infloreseentiae terminales, 4-5.7 cm longe pedunculatae; bracteae lanceolato-ovatae, longe acuminatae, minute pubescentes, 0.7-2 mm longae; pedicelli 1-2 mm longi; calyx tubulosus, 5-dentatus, parte libera 1 mm alta; corolla extrinsecus tomentosa, saltem in alabastra, 4 mm longa, lobis tubo aequantibus; bacca oblonga, 5-6 mm longa, calycis parte libera coronata, leviter striata. description: Subshrub; stems minutely granular-glabrescent; stipules 5-6 mm long, the sheath 1.5-3 mm long, 3 mm wide, 2-setose on each side with subulate teeth 3.5-4 mm long bearing a few scattered trichomes; leaves with petioles 5-13 mm long, glabrous, the leaf blades firmly membranous, lance-elliptic, acuminate at apex, acute at base, 12-16.5 x 3-5.5 cm, glabrous above, glabrous below except sparsely puberulent on midrib and lateral nerves, with 12 or 13 lateral nerves, slightly elevated beneath, the tertiary venation finely prominulous beneath; inflorescence terminal, solitary, spherical-campanulate, 11-12 mm long, 9-11 mm wide, with about 10 bracts surrounded at base by a larger pair, the outermost bracts broadly suborbicular, narrowed to a subacute apex, the inner bracts ligulate-oblong, rounded at apex, 13 x 3-3.5 mm, within at base bearing 2 setiform squamellae 1 mm long; bracteoles subtending flowers spathulate-oblanceolate, acute to mucronate, cucullate, 9-11 x 3 mm, glabrous except for upper ciliate margins; calyx and hypanthium 2.5-3 mm long, glabrous, the lobes 5, somewhat unequal, triangular-lanceolate, acute, 1-2 mm long, subentire or the margins and apex slightly irregular; corolla bud glabrous except for a few setose apical hairs, the mature corolla not seen; fruit unknown.

description: A shrub with subsessile, very strongly bullate-reticulate leaves, very small, erect, pubescent thyrses, small puberulent corollas, sliohtly bearded within; drupes obovoid.

description: Frutex, ramulis glabris; stipulis conspicuis late lanceolatis obtuse acutis basi dilatatis 21-22 x 5-6 mm integerrimis glabris tenuiter multistriatis; foliis petiolatis, petiolis 2 cm longis glabris vel sparsim minuteque papillato-puberulis; laminis firme membranaceis anguste elliptico-oblanceolatis sensim apice longiacuminatis basi sensim anguste longiattenuatis decurrentibusque 27-30 x 4-4.3 cm supra glabris subtus praesertim costa media nervis lateralibusque sparsim minuteque papillato-puberulis; inflorescentia terminali monocephala pedunculata, pedunculo 3.8 cm longo 3.5 mm diam. glabro; capitulo cum bracteis extimis 1.5 cm longis 1.8 cm latis; involucri bracteis extimis duobus basi 4 mm conjunctis ovato-lanceolatis apice acutis basi rotundatis dilatatisque 3 cm longis basi 2.3 cm latis glabris; bracteis ceteris inter bracteas extimas involucrales et flores in seriebus duobus dispositis, seriei exterioris majoribus suborbiculari-ovatis acutis 2.2 x 1.1 cm, seriei interioris minoribus elliptico-oblanceolatis acutis 9 x 3 mm; floribus sessilibus numerosis bracteolatis; bracteolis duobus sub floribus 10 mm longis unguiculatis, laminis elliptico-spathulatis subacutis 4.5 x 2 mm glabris, unguibus 3 mm longis basi pilis plurimis filamentosis fasciculatis 4-5 mm longis adnatis subtentisque; calyce cum hypanthio 2.5 mm longo, hypanthio cylindrico 1.5 x 0.9 mm minute adpresso-puberulo; calyce 0.6 mm longo 1.4 mm lato margine truncato vel paullo 5-undulato glabro; corolla in alabastro cylindrica glabra 5 x 1.5 mm.

description: Arbor, ramulis hirsutis pilis 1.5-2 mm longis vestitis; stipulis in vaginam 5 mm longam 6 mm latam dense hirsutam connatis, in dentes duos lineari-aciculares 5 x 1 mm hirsutulos desinentibus; foliis oppositis petiolatis, petiolis 12-15 mm longis hirsutis; laminis membranaceo-chartaceis oblongo-ellip- ticis apice abrupte acuminatis basi subacutis vel acutis 11-12.5 x 3.5-5 cm supra praeter costam mediam dense hirsutulam glabris nitidisque subtus costa media nervis lateralibusque hirsutis pilis patentibus praeditis ceterum glabris; nervis lateralibus in quoque latere 8 adscendentibus; venulis tertiariis supra manifestis impressis subtus tenuiter paullo manifestis elevatisque; inflorescentia ter- minali monocephala sessili vel brevissime pedunculata ca 7-8-flora in vaginam supremam stipulae involucralis immersa; vagina suprema suborbiculari apice truncata 7 mm longa 12 mm lata hirsuta pilis usque 1.5 mm longis vestita, in dentes aciculares quattuor 3 x 0.8 mm desinenti; involucri bracteis insigniter conspicuis cinnabarinis sex basi liberis; bracteis magnis extimis duobus lanceolatis acutis 4-4.5 x 1.2-1.3 cm ubique nisi basi intus glabras dense hirsutulis; bracteis ceteris magnis quattuor similibus 2.7-3.7 x 1.1-1.2 cm; capitulo (sine bracteis magnis) sub-hemisphaerico 1.7 cm longo 2.8 cm lato; floribus sessilibus sine bracteis bracteolisque; bracteis minoribus paucis inter flores et bracteas magnas lanceolato-linearibus vel subulatis acuminatis 10-16 x 1.5-3 mm extus hirsutulis ciliatisque pilis 1.5 mm longis praeditis; calyce hypanthioque post anthesin 13-14 mm longo extus dense hirsutulo pilis usque 2 mm longis vestito, hypanthio basi dense hirsuto pilis cincto; calycis tubo cylindrico 10-11 x 4-6 mm intus supra medium dense strigoso ceterum glabro, lobis quinque vel sex triangulari-lanceolatis acutis 3-5 x 1.5-2.5 mm intus strigosis; corolla non visa; fructibus juvenilibus subglobosis 10 x 10 mm dense hirsutis calyce persistenti coronatis.

description: Frutex 1.5-1.8-metralis, ramis glabris; stipulis in vaginam deltoideam vel late triangularem apice acutam vel obtusam 4-6 mm altam basi 3-5 mm latam supra medium striolatam margine glabram vel eroso-fimbriatam connatis; description: Frutex vel arbor parva, 1-3 m altus, glaber, ramis striatis, internodiis brevibus; stipulae eircumeirea tubuloso-connatae, apice rotundatae, membranaceae, deciduae, 1-1.5 mm longae; folia lanceolato-elliptica, 2-3 mm longa petiolata, coriacea, acuta sed apice ipso obtusiuscula, utrinque glaberrima, nervo inedio suLpra impresso, subtus patenti, lateralibus utrinque fere obsoletis, 2-3.5 cm longa, 7-11 mm lata; inflorescentiae fere folii longitudinem aequanites; pedunculi 1-1.5 cm longi, erecti; bracteae breves, deltoideae, acutae, 0.7 mm longae; flores iolni visi, calyx vix ovarium aequans, brevissime 5-dentatus; bacca globosa, 3-4 mm diametro; pyrenae dorso 4-suleatae. Hab. prope Loma Mensura, Sierra de Nipe, Orieinte, 25 Feb 1956, Lopez Fignteiras 2524 (Holotypus, LS).
bibliographicCitation: Acuña Gale, Julián B. & Reig, J. T. 1962. Psychotriae cubensee novae (Rubiaceae). Brittonia. 14: 224-229.

description: Leaves stiff, cuneate at base, not abruptly contracted, domatia usually promi- nlent, petiole well developed; thyrse stiff, usually straight, robust; corolla tube very short, lobes narrowly ovate, acute, tending to be erect, with a patch of hair within at base of each lobe.
bibliographicCitation: Carlquist, Sherwin. 1964. Pollen morphology and evolution of Sarcolaenaceae (Chlaenaceae). Brittonia. 16: 231-254.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Frutex glaber, 2 m altus vel altior, ramis teretibus; stipulae lanceolato-ovatae, 6.7 mm usque infra medio fissae, laciniae tenuiter et longe acuminatae, glabrae; petiolus gracilis, 1.5-2.5 cm longus, glaber; folia lanceolato-ovata vel elliptica, membranacea, plaina, nervo medio supra impresso, subtus prominelite, lateralibus utroque latere 5-9, arcuatis et anastomosantibus; limbus 7-15 cm. longus, 2.5-6 cm latus, domatiatus; infloreseentiae terminales paullo foliis lon- giorae, 3-3.5 cm longe pedunculatae; bracteae inferiores ovatae 5-fissae, laciniis acutis, caeterae 3-fissae vel integrae, ovatae, 1-4 mm longae; pedicelli 0.8-3 mm longi pubeseentes; calyx cupuliformis pars libera fere 1 mm alta, 5-dentata, dentibus triangularibus vel deltoideis plus minus acutis; bacca no10 bene evoluta 9.5 mm longa, oblongo-ovata.
bibliographicCitation: Acuña Gale, Julián B. & Reig, J. T. 1962. Psychotriae cubensee novae (Rubiaceae). Brittonia. 14: 224-229.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Planta herbacea, caulibus 30-60 cm altis glabris; stipulis inconspicuis membranaceis semilunatis 0.6-0.8 mm altis 3.5 mm latis, marginibus paullo scariosis integerrimis; foliis petiolatis, petiolis 1.5-2.7 cm longis glabris; laminis membranaceis lanceolato-ellipticis apice abrupte breviacuminatis basi cuneatim longiattenuatis 10-16 x 3.5 cm ubique glabris, marginibus saepe undulatis, nervis lateralibus utroque latere 10-12 arcuato-divaricatis prope marginem leviter anastomosantibus; inflorescentia axillari pedunculata glabra cymoso-dichasiali 1.5-2 cm longa 2-3 cm lata, pedunculo 1.7-7 cm longo 1 mm lato; inflorescentiae axibus divaricatis in seriebus tribus vel quattuor verticillatis, axibus primariis dichotome ramosis 4-6 mm longis plerumque in florem centralem solitarium vel interdum in flores duos vel tres atque in ramos laterales duos 2-3 mm longos desinentibus, ramis lateralibus ad apicem in flores duos vel tres sessiles desinentibus; inflorescentiae bracteis sub axibus oblongis subobtusis vel subacutis 1-1.5 x 1 mm patentibus, marginibus scariosis pallidis; calyce cum hypanthio 1.5-2 mm longo glabro; bracteis sub fasciculis florum minutis suborbicularibus 0.9-1 x 0.8-0.9 mm glabris scariosis; hypanthio 1 x 0.8-0.9 mm, calyce 1 mm alto 1.8 mm lato, lobis quinque sub-orbiculari-deltoideis ad apicem rotundatam angustatis 0.4 mm altis 0.6 mm latis glabris circum apicem papillatis; disco umbonato 0.6 x 0.6 mm lobos calycis aequanti vel paullo breviore; corolla viridi-alba campanulato-infundibuliformi 6-6.5 mm longa, tubo 4.5-5 mm longo basi 1-1.5 mm lato fauce 2-2.5 mm lato extus glabro intus superne dense villoso ceterum glabro, lobis quinque ovatis acutis 1.5- 2 x 0.8-1.5 mm extus glabris intus papillatis; antheris lineari-oblongis 1 x 0.3 mm ad faucem affixis; fructibus maturis albis elliptico-oblongis 6-7 x 4.5-5 mm, pyrenis dorso 3-costatis plano-convexis.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1981. New species of Rubiaceae from French Guiana, Brazil, and Colombia. Brittonia. 33: 385-400.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description:
Frutex valde ramosus et tortuosus, usque 2-3 m altus, ramis bialatis glaberrimis; stipulae valde parvae, truneatae, integrae, vel interpetiolus leviter bidentatus vix 0.5 mm longae, paullo persistentes; petiolus brevis, 2-4 mm longus; folia obovata vel elliptico-obovata, margine revoluta, nitida, chartacea, apice rotundata, cuneata et parum in petiolo decurrentes, 1-3 cm longa, 6-12 mm lata, glaberrima; inflorescentiae terminales, foliis breviores, pedunculis 3-4 mm longis, 2-3-floris; bracteae late triangulares, 0.5 mm longae vel breviores; pedicelli fructiferi 1.5-1.8 mm longi; baccae oblongae, 4 mm longae, brevi calycis annulo coronatae; calyx 5-dentatus fere laevis.

Hab. in Cuba prope Playa de Moa, Baracoa, Oriente, 4 Nov 1945, Acutna (E.E.A. 13360) (Holotypus, SV). A P. odorata Wright stipulis bidentatis non bilaceratis et foliis totis glabris et nitidis differt.

In honorem Ing. Luis A. Morales Mustelier viliter in 1958 necati dedicalus.
bibliographicCitation: Acuña Gale, Julián B. & Reig, J. T. 1962. Psychotriae cubensee novae (Rubiaceae). Brittonia. 14: 224-229.

description: Arbuscula 1.4-metralis, ramulis glabris angulatis; foliis petiolatis, petiolis 0.5-1.5 cm longis glabris; laminis oblongo-ellipticis apice acuminatis basi acutis 9-14.5 x 3-5 cm ubique glabris; stipula ter- minali in lacinias duas lineari-lanceolatas acuminatas 3.5-5 mm longas principaliter ferrugineo-hirtellas basi glabras profunde fissa, cicatricibus stipularibus inferioribus basi annulo pilorum ferrugineorum fimbrillatorum manifeste elongatorum usque 2 mm longorum munitis; nervis lateralibus in quoque latere 5-7 adscendentibus supra impressis subtus leviter elevatis prope marginem tenuiter conjunctis; inflorescentia pedunculata 2.5-3 cm alta 4-5 cm lata ramulis quinque constanti, axibus dichasialibus in seriebus duobus divaricatis dispositis, infimis 1-2 cm longis superioribus 0.8-1 cm longis glabris, pedunculo terminali 3.8-4 cm longo glabro; floribus sessilibus vel breviter pedicellatis ad apicem ramulorum lateralium quinque vel sex aggregatis, flore centrali solitario ramulo laterali breviore, pedicellis 0.5-1 mm longis; bracteis sub basi ramulorum inflorescentiae ferrugineo-ciliolatis, supremis ovatis 1.7 mm longis; calyce cum hypanthio 2 mm longo extus glabro, hypanthio 1 mm longo 1.5 mm lato; calycis lobis quinque breviter deltoideis subacutis 0.5 mm altis 1 mm latis ciliolatis; disco tubo calycis breviore; corolla subcylindrica 4-5 mm longa, tubo 3 x 1.5-2 mm extus glabro intus fauce dense villoso, lobis quinque oblongo-lanceolatis subacutis.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1981. New species of Rubiaceae from French Guiana, Brazil, and Colombia. Brittonia. 33: 385-400.

description: Frutex paullo ramosus, 2-3 m altus, glaber vel ad interinodiis junioribus minute pilosus; stipulae lanceolato-ovatae, apice obtusae, dorso tomentosae, 3-4 mm longae, deciduae; stipulae delapsae annulum rufum pilosum relinquelntes; petiolus brevis, 1-2 mm longus; folia lanceolato-angustata, subtus pubesceiltia, 2.3-4.8 cm longa, 3-6 mm lata, revoluta, supra viridia-nitelntia, subtus griseo-olivacea; infloreseentiae terminales foliis breviores vel aequalntes, 1.3-2.5 cm longe pedulleulatae; pedicelli fructiferi 1.5-2 mm lonlgi; bacca globoso-obloniga, striata, 5 mm longa, calycis parte libera coronata, 5-denitata, vix 0.5 mm alta. Hab. prope Loma Bandera, Sierra de Nipe, Oriente, 11 Jun 1954, Acuina & Maza (E.E.A. 19254) (Holotypus, SV.) P. eveniae Wr. prope ipso loco lectae affinis, quae foliis anogustioribus, calyce dentato, infloreseentiis foliis brevioribus discrepat.
bibliographicCitation: Acuña Gale, Julián B. & Reig, J. T. 1962. Psychotriae cubensee novae (Rubiaceae). Brittonia. 14: 224-229.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Branches somewhat quadrangular, leaves stiff chartaceous, hirtellous beneath, elliptic to oblong ovate, domatia very small, petioles 1 cm or less long, thyrses somewhat hirtellous, with 2-3 whorls of 3 branches each, the lower branches with 2 shortly pedicellate flowers, the upper with one flower each, somewhat lolnger pedicellate, corolla very large, 10 mm long, the tube very short (ace. Heller and Skottsberg), the fruits slightly pyriform, 7-8 mm long, 6 mm wide, disk very prominent, 3-4 mm across, surrounded by fragmented calyx ring.
bibliographicCitation: Carlquist, Sherwin. 1964. Pollen morphology and evolution of Sarcolaenaceae (Chlaenaceae). Brittonia. 16: 231-254.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Frutex 2-metralis glaber; stipulis cupulatis scarioso-membranaceis apice truncatis 6 mm altis 8 mm latis; foliis petiolatis, petiolis 3-5.5 cm longis; laminis subcoriaceis anguste oblanceolatis apice acuminatis, acumine 7-15 mm longo, basi longiattenuatis 23-25 cm longis supra medium 4.5-6 cm latis, nervis lateralibus numerosis supra vix manifestis subtus obsoletis vel nuilis; inflorescentia terminali cymoso-paniculata pedunculata sub anthesi 5 x 4 cm multiflora, pedunculo 9-12.5 cm longo 2 mm lato, rhachidi 2.5 cm longa; inflorescentiae ramulis primariis albis 10-13 sub anthesi 8-12 mm subfructu 20-23 mm longis; bracteis inferioribus sub ramulis primariis lanceolatis 4-5 mm longis; floribus subsessilibus vel pedicellatis, pedicellis 0.5-4 mm longis; calyce cum hypanthio 1.5 mm longo, hypanthio subcampanulato 0.7-0.8 mm longo 0.8-1.2 mm; calyce subcupulato-campanulato 0.8 mm longo 5-dentato, dentibus aliquantum inaequalibus late deltoideis apice acutis 0.3-0.4 mm longis 0.5- 0.7 mm latis, marginibus irregulariter inaequalibus; disco calyce breviore; corolla alba anguste cylindrica ante anthesin apice subtruncata 4.5-5 x 1-2 mm, lobis dorso obtusiuscule breviterque nodosis; antheris linearibus 2 mm longis; baccis ovoideis aurantiacis subcomplanatis 8 x 6 mm, pyrenis 3-costatis.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1981. New species of Rubiaceae from French Guiana, Brazil, and Colombia. Brittonia. 33: 385-400.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Planta herbacea 0.25-0.5-metralis, caulibus basi prostratis ad nodos radicantibus; stipulis membranaceis breviter suborbicularibus 3 mm altis 8 mm latis extremitatibus lateralibus 2-3 mm longicorniculatis paullo recurvatis incrassatisque glabris cystolithis valde manifestis instructis; foliis petiolatis, petiolis 3.5-5 cm longis 1-1.5 mm crassis glabris; laminis membranaceis late ellipticis vel ovato-ellipticis apice abrupte acuminatis basi abrupte cuneatim longiattenuatis 20-22 x 7-9 cm supra pilis 1-1.5 mm longis sparsim vel modice pilosulis subtus glabris, marginibus pilis 1-1.5 longis ciliatis; nervis lateralibus utroque latere 9-10 arcuato-adscendentibus secus marginem desinentibus; inflores- centia axillari brevipedunculata, pedunculo gracili 7-11 x 1 mm; inflorescentia cymoso-paniculata latiore quam altiore 1.5 cm alta 2-2.5 cm lata, axibus primariis gracilibus plerumque tribus vel quattuor 5-7 mm longis; bracteis sub axibus primariis late deltoideis obtusis 3.5 x 2 mm carinatis glabris vel prope marginem sparsim puberulis; bracteis axium inflorescentiae lanceolato-ovatis 2 mm longis glabris; floribus sessilibus ad apices axium secundariorum binis vel ternatis ebracteatis dispositis; calyce cum hypanthio 1.3 mm alto 1.5 mm lato, hypanthio 0.8 mm alto; calyce 0.5 mm alto margine leviter 5-undulato; disco calyce paullo breviore; corolla albida cylindrico-campanulata, tubo 1.5-2 x 1.8 mm extus superne sparsim puberulo ceterum glabro cystolithis manifestis, lobis quattuor vel quinque patentibus lanceolatis apice attenuatis curvatisque 1.5 x 0.7 mm; antheris quinque linearibus 1 mm longis; bacca subovoidea 6.5 x 5 mm, pyrenis concavo-convexis.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1981. New species of Rubiaceae from French Guiana, Brazil, and Colombia. Brittonia. 33: 385-400.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Inflorescentia terminalis solitaria monocephala involucrata pedunculata, bracteis extimis obovatosuborbicularibus ad basim liberis vel paullo connatis; bracteolis manifeste curvatis lineari-ligulatis 11 x 1-1.2 mm; squamellis subulatis plurimis 1 mm longis et pilis numerosis 1.5-2 mm longis mixtis receptaculo insidentibus.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1984. New Rubiaceae from French Guiana. Brittonia. 36: 154-160.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Shrub 1.5 m tall, completely glabrous; stems green suffused gray; stipules foliaceous, free to the base, the terminal ones prominently striate, linear-lanceolate, narrowed to a subobtuse entire or slightly bilobed apex, 6-8 x 2-2.5 mm, the lower ones ovate-lanceolate, rounded or subobtuse at apex, 7-10 x 4-5 mm; leaves with petioles 5-11 mm long, the leaf-blades subcoriaceous, oblanceolate to elliptic-oblanceolate, acuminate at apex, cuneately acute at base, 11-18 x 3-6 cm, with 6-8 lateral nerves on each side, slightly elevated beneath; inflorescence terminal, solitary, subhemispheric-campanulate, 15-17 x 15-17 mm, involucrate, pedunculate; peduncle 5.5-6 cm long, enlarged to 3-5 mm wide below head; outer 2 bracts orange, subcoriaceous, obovate-suborbicular, rounded or broadly obtuse at apex, free to the base or only slightly connate, 15-17 mm long and broad; flowers surrounded by about 20 bracteoles; bracteoles curved, coriaceous, linear-ligulate, 11 x 1-1.2 mm; receptacle with numerous, subulate squamellae 1 mm long mixed with numerous hairs 1.5-2 mm long; calyx and hypanthium cupular-campanulate, 2.8-3 mm long; calyx 1-1.2 mm long, 1.1-1.4 mm wide, subtruncate at the obsoletely denticulate margin; disk shorter than the calyx-tube; corolla not seen; pyrenes oblong, 14 x 7 mm, glabrous, the inner face smooth with longitudinal, narrow ventral suture.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1984. New Rubiaceae from French Guiana. Brittonia. 36: 154-160.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Frutex 2-3 m altus, glauceseens rami hornotini in sieco striati; stipulae ovatae basi parce connatae, apice obtusae, 2-2.5 mm longae; petiolus 4-7 mm longus, folia oblaineeolata vel elliptico-lanceolata supra viridissima, subtus olivacea, in sieco glauco-nigreseentes, 4.7-5 cm longa, 7-17 mm lata, basi cuneata acuta vel apice versus acuminata, apice ipso obtusiuscula, nervo medio supra impresso, subtus prominulo; lateralibus utroque latere 7-8 parum conspicuis, margine plus minns revoluta; infloreseentiae terminales plerumque pauciflorae, 2.5-5.5 cm longe pedunculatae; bracteae triangulares abrupte acuminatae, valde breves, primarii mox decidui; pedicelli florales 1-1.2 mm longi, fructiferi 1.5 mm longi; calyx eupuliformis, discrete 5-denticulatus; corolla tubulosa, 5 mm longa, lobis 1/2 tubi brevioribus; bacea sphaeroidea, 4 mm diametro, longistrorsis striata. Hab. prope Jauco, Oriente, 17 Jul-4 Aug, 1924, Leon 11787 (Holotypus, LS; Isotypus, SV); ibidem, León 11784 (LS). Haec species a nonnulis extremis formnis P. shaferi Urb. accedat, sed ramis et pedunculis robustioribus differt. In honorem clarissimi Dr. Carlos de la Torre insignis cubanae naturae eruditus et Professor, qui in amori zoologicae scientiae varias cubanas generationes instruxit dicata.
bibliographicCitation: Acuña Gale, Julián B. & Reig, J. T. 1962. Psychotriae cubensee novae (Rubiaceae). Brittonia. 14: 224-229.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Frutex 1.5-2.5-metralis omnino glaber; stipulis 4-fidis in vaginam vix evolutam connatis in lacinias lanceolato-lineares 5-6 x 1-1.5 mm profunde fissis; foliis petiolatis, petiolis 3-8 mm longis; laminis oblongo-elipticis apice acuminatis, acumine 1-2 cm longo, basi cuneatim acutis 9.5-18 x 4-7.5 cm; nervis lateralibus principalibus utrinque 7-9 arcuato-adscendentibus secus marginem curvatis supra impressis subtus paullo elevatis; inflorescentia terminali monocephala intra involucrum late urceolato-cyathiformem disposita, pedunculata; pedunculo solitario erecto 3-3.5 cm longo 1 mm lato infra basin inflorescentiae dilatato; involucro purpureo 2.5-3 x 2.2-2.5 cm ex bracteis duobus usque summum connatis constanti; floribus sessilibus capitatis intra involucrum a bracteis I-seriatis cinctis; bracteis extimis quinque flores extimos tantum cingentibus inaequalibus lanceolatis vel oblongis apice rotun- datis 13-20 x 5-8 mm secus margines involutis; bracteolis duobus flores individuales basi cingentibus venosis scariosis oblanceolatis subacutis vel subacuminatis 9-11 x 1.5-2.5 mm; floribus ca 10 orifi- cium involucri 5-7 mm excedentibus; calyce cum hypanthio 5 mm longo, hypanthio 1.5 x 1.2 mm; calyce 3 x 3 mm, lobis quinque subaequalibus membranaceo-scariosis lanceolato-ligulatis apice su- bacutis vel obtuse acuminatis 1.5-2 x 0.3-0.6 mm sub sinu inter lobos 1-2 glandulas conspicuas 1 mm longas gerentibus; corollis albis anguste infundibuliformibus 2.2-2.7 mm longis, tubo parte in- feriore angustioreque 1-2 mm lato parte superiore latioreque 3-3.5 mm lato intus paullo infra medium tubi corollae supra basin 8-9 mm pilosulo ceterum glabro; antheris linearibus 2.5 x 0.3 mm, filamentis 8-9 mm longis in medio tubi insertis; stylo 10 mm longo; disco tubo floris breviore.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1981. New species of Rubiaceae from French Guiana, Brazil, and Colombia. Brittonia. 33: 385-400.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Frutex 1-2 m altus, glaber, ramis hornotinis fere teretibus vel teretibus; stipulae laneeolato-ovatae, usque 1/3 longitudinis ex apice bifureatae, glabrae, deciduae, 1 cm longae; stipulae delapsae annulum rufum pilosum relinquentes; petiolus 5-8 mm longus; folia oblonga vel elliptico-oblonga parum chartacea, parce revoluta, apice breve acuminata, basi paullo cuneata, 6-12 cm longa, 2-5 cm lata, nervis lateralibus utroque latere 10-15 sub anoulo 850 abeuntibus; inflorescentiae terminales 5-6 mm longe pedunculatae, rachis brevis, 3-5-divisus; bracteae inferiores ovatae, leviter sinuatae et paullo ciliatae, caeterae triangcu- lares, 1.5-3 mm longae; flores sessiles vel subsessiles; calyx campanulatus 5-dentatus, dentibus triangularibus, acutis, 1 mm longis, in fructu persistentibus; corolla extrinsecus glabra in sieco 5 mm longa; bacca globoso-oblonga, 6-7 mm longa, calycis parte libera coronata. Hab. prope Sierra de Nipe, Mayari, Oriente, Mai 1940, Carabica 3669 (Holo- typus, LS); prope Palenquito, Yateras, 20 Jul 1953, Alain 3114 (LS); prope Pico Galano, Sierra del Frijol, Baracoa, 1 Jan 1954, Alain 3722 (LS), 3779 (LS). In honorem notabilis horticultoris H. A. Van Hermann, per magna labore sua in Cuba, dedicata.
bibliographicCitation: Acuña Gale, Julián B. & Reig, J. T. 1962. Psychotriae cubensee novae (Rubiaceae). Brittonia. 14: 224-229.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: A P. prunifolia (H.B.K.) Steyermark imprimis differt laminis lanceolato-ellipticis, costa media supra patenti-hirsutulo, nervis lateralibus principalibus tantum usque 3/4-7/8 longitudinem adscendentibus, nervis ultimis minus manifestis brevioribus subhorizontalibus; inflorescentia bracteis involucralibus usque ad basim liberis oblongo-subpanduratis exterioribus non unguiculatis circumdata.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1984. New Rubiaceae from French Guiana. Brittonia. 36: 154-160.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Densely branched shrub with quadrangular stems, the younger stems densely hirsute with spreading hairs 1-1.5 mm long on the angles, the older ones less pubescent to glabrous; stipules 7-8 mm long, densely hirsute, the 2 acicular teeth on each side 3-4.5 mm long, 0.5 mm wide at base, setose-ciliate with hairs 1-1.5 mm long; leaves with petioles 4-5 mm long, densely hirsute, the leaf blades lanceolate-elliptic, acuminate at apex, acute at base, 6.5-1 1 x 2.3-4.2 cm, the upper and lower midrib spreading-hirsutulous, ciliate on margins, elsewhere glabrous, with 9 or 10 lateral nerves on each side, prominently ascending 3/4-7/8 length of blade, the less conspicuous shorter nerves of the uppermost 1/4-1/8 more horizontally spreading, the main nerves sulcate above, elevated below; inflorescence terminal, solitary, short-pedunculate, subcapitate, broadly oblong, 15-17 x 4-7 mm; peduncle 2-4 mm long, densely hirsute; bracts surrounding inflorescence 4, pale green with purple midrib, slightly unequal, free to the base, subchartaceous, oblong-subpandurate, subobtuse at apex, slightly narrower at the middle, 19 x 7 mm, the midrib strongly hirsute without, ciliate on margins, glabrous within; inner bracts 4, free to the base, linear-ligulate, subacute at apex, 13 x 2 mm, densely ciliate, the outer midrib thickened, hirsute; flowers apparently 3 in a head, each one subtended by 4 setulose-subulate bracts 6-8 x 0.5-0.8 mm, the margins densely ciliate, densely pilose without, the hairs ascending, 1-2 mm long; calyx and hypanthium (immature) cylindric, 1-2 mm long; hypanthium glabrous; calyxlobes 5, triangular, the margins erose, densely ciliate with erect hairs 0.5 mm long; corolla (immature) setulose-pubescent at apex; pyrenes and seeds not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1984. New Rubiaceae from French Guiana. Brittonia. 36: 154-160.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Caulis griseus glaber vix quadrangularis, folia parva gracilo-petiolata, thyrsus gracilis ereetus, corolla 3 mm longa glabra lobis non inerassatis.

description: Living material of one collection of this species was available for study. Several cells in prometaphase of meiosis were observed in dividingf pollen mother cells. Reduction division appeared to be quite regular, showing 19 bivalents in all cases. On a greenhouse-grown plant, one head, composed of approximately 112 flowers, was bagged when the first flowers opened, and the bag was left intact until the last corollas had withered. Only 12 good nutlets were obtained, the remaining fruits being completely undeveloped. A higher percentage of good fruits was found in unbagged heads; one head with 75 flowers yielded 62 good nutlets. Flowers pollinated by another plant from the same collection yielded a still higher percentage of good fruits. In P. albescens the evidence indicates that fertility increases with outcrossing, yet the species is at least partly self-compatible.

description: Shrubs or rarely trees to 8 m tall, the trunk to 25 cm in diameter, bark dark, checked; twigs 1-1.5 mm in diameter, gray-pubes- cent, variously glabrescent and reddish brown or the darkening tomentulum persistent; buds 3-4 mm long, narrowly ovoid, dark brown to dark reddish-brown, whitish puberulent toward tip, bud scales glabrous or glabrate, the margins whitish-ciliate; stipules membranous-ligulate, 5-6 mm long, rarely persistent around buds. Leaves evergreen, persisting less than 2 annual growing seasons; leaf blades (1.5-)3-4.5(-6) cm long, (1-)1.5-3 cm broad, narrowly elliptic to oblong, or sometimes obovate, leaf margin flat to moderately revolute, with (O-)2- 4(-5) spinescent teeth on each side particularly in the distal 1/3 of the blade, leaf teeth antrorsely oriented, spines 1-2 mm long, leaf apices acute or rounded, the tip spinescent, leaf bases rounded to usually markedly cordate, adaxial leaf surfaces yellowish or grayish, glossy or grayish-puberulent becoming variously glabrescent or persistently puberulent along the midribs, the minute, crisped, multi-radiate trichomes leaving a translucent punctation (visible under mag- nification) at point of attachment, abaxial leaf surfaces densely tawny-tomentose with crisped, entangled hairs detachable at ma- turity or rarely deciduous, the surface beneath the tomentum markedly flat-bullate, the midvein often pinkish with age; second- ary veins 5-7 on each side, irregular and unequal, sometimes branching and passing into adjacent pairs of teeth, impressed on the adaxial surfaces, prominent (even beneath the tomentum); petioles 3-5(-7) mm long, persistently gray-tomentose or dark- ening with age. Staminate inflorescences ca. 2 cm long, the young anthers red-purple, fading to yellow, well-exserted, staminate calyces sparsely villous. Pistillate inflores- cences 1- or rarely 2-flowered on tomentose peduncles 1-4 mm long, styles nearly 1 mm long and markedly spatulate by abrupt dilation of the stigmas. Fruit biennial, solitary or rarely paired, subsessile or on stalks 3-4 mm long; cups hemispheric or saucer shaped, 9-1 1 mm broad, cup scales thin and closely appressed, glabrous and light brown, grayish ciliate along margins, the tips irregbrown, densely puberulent, included at the bases only. description: Shrub 3-4 m tall, rarely a tree. First-season twigs 1-2.5(-3) mm diam., glabrescent, some retaining scattered minute stellate or multiradiate trichomes. Terminal buds 1-3 mm long, 0.7-1.6 mm diam., ovoid; bud scales ovate with ciliate margin. Stipules deciduous. Young leaves unknown. Mature leaves coriaceous, ovate-lanceolate, lanceolate or elliptical, 2.1-8.7 X 0.8-3.6 cm; apex acute or acuminate, aristate; base rounded or obtuse, decurrent; margin with 1-7 aristate teeth; teeth to 2 mm long, located on the distal half of the leaf or near the leaf base. Secondary veins 3-11, slightly raised or nearly level with the epidermal surface, straight or slightly curved, usually ending directly in teeth when present. Adaxial leaf surface glabrous, occasionally with stellate trichomes at the base of the midvein. Abaxial leaf surface glabrous but with fasciculate trichomes in the axils of the secondary veins; glandular trichomes absent; epidermis smooth. Petioles 2-16 X 0.5-2 mm, glabrescent to glabrous with few minute stellate trichomes. Male catkins 2.5- 4.5 cm long, the rachis sparingly pubescent; male flower with a cupuliform perianth, glabrous, the lobes ciliate; stamen number unknown; anthers elliptical, glabrous, exserted. Female flowers unknown. Fruit biennial, at the end of a peduncle 8-14 mm long, 1-2 mm thick; fruits 1-2; cupule hemispheric or slightly turbinate, 10-14 mm diam., 8-11.5 mm tall, the scales deltoid or ovate with narrow apex, slightly pubescent; acorn ovoid, globose or globose-ovoid, 9-13 mm long, 7-10 mm diam. Cotyledons free; position of abortive ovules unknown.

description: Shrubs or small trees to 5 m tall or at higher elevations a low rhizomatous shrub, bark dark gray, smooth; twigs 0.75-1 mm in diameter, sparsely puberulent, becoming glabrous, reddish brown; buds ca. 2 mm long, narrowly ovoid, dark brown, rusty-puberulent toward the tips; bud scales glabrous, with rusty-ciliate margins, stipules linear, light brown, scarious, ca. 5 mm long. description: Trees 8-21 m tall; trunk cylindric; latex white; branchlets moderately stout, gray to nigrescent, with lenticels. Leaves alternate, congested at the apex of branches; petiole (1-)3-4 cm long; blade obovate, spatulate or oblanceolate, chartaceous, apex acute to rounded, base acute, cuneate, decurrent to petiole; (13-)19-21(-30) X (5-)5.5-7(-9) cm; dark shiny green above, glabrous, rarely puberulous along the midrib; glaucous green beneath, glabrous to sparsely puberulous; veins prominent on adaxial and abaxial surfaces, rusty or light brown; margins entire to slightly sinuate, sometimes revolute at the base. Corolla yellowish, puberulous, inside velutinous below the insertion of the stamens; tube ca. 3.5 mm, lobes ca. 2 mm. Stamens inserted above middle of the tube, anthers ovate, acute, ca. 1.1 mm long. Pistil ca. 2.5 mm, ovary puberulous, style + stigma ca. 1.1 mm long. Follicle biconvex, dolabriform, stipitate, woody, brown with lenticels, ca. 8-9 X 4-5 cm. description: Stem solitary, erect, 2-4(-8) m tall, 4-7 cm diam., brown, occasionally with basal vegetative branches; internodes 0.5 cm long; aerial roots forming a short basal cone; pneumatodes very short. Leaves 15-19(-25), sometimes reddish brown when young, green when mature, the older ones not persistent; sheath 10-15 X 9 cm, reddish brown tomentose, the margins slightly fibrous; petiole 35-40 X 0.7-1.5 cm, channeled adaxially, rounded to angled abaxially, brown tomentose, slightly fibrous at margins toward base; midvein 68-84 X 0.5-0.7 cm, green, with same indumentum as on petiole, ridged adaxially, flat abaxially; rachis with a filiform extension of 1.5- 5 X 0.1 cm; blade 0.7-1 X 0.2-0.3 m, dull green adaxially, silver green abaxially, deeply bifid at apex for ca. 45 cm; primary veins 25-27 per side, emerging at 25-30º angle at midvein, prominent abaxially, yellowish, slightly brown tomentose. Inflorescence spicate; peduncle 40-50 cm long, 0.5-0.6 cm diam., dorsiventrally compressed; prophyll 14-15(-25) cm long, 1.5 cm diam., fibrous, inserted at base of peduncle; peduncular bract 1, chartaceous, brown tomentose, 22-40 X 1.3-2 cm, in- serted 1.4 cm above base of peduncle; inflorescence rachis 23-40 cm long, 1-1.5 cm diam., terete, pale brown at anthesis, brown in fruit, with same indumentum as on peduncle, the sterile apex acute, ca. 0.6-3 cm long; flower pits spirally arranged, ca. 2-4 mm apart from each other, covered with an inflexed lower lip, 3 X 2-4 mm. Staminate flowers obovoid, 0.8-1.3 cm long, 0.4-0.5 cm diam., fragrant, the pedicel almost absent; sepals oblong-obovoid, 5-6 X 1.4-2 mm; petals obovoid, 7-8 X 2-3 mm; sta- mens 21-26, occasionally 1 or 2 partially or totally sterile; filaments united into a tube to 6-7 mm long, conspicuously yellow orange, not remarkably thinner at apex, the epidermis papillate, the free parts 3-4 mm long, 0.4 mm diam.; connective 1.2-1.5 mm long; thecae 0.5-1.2 mm long; pistillode 4-5 mm long. Pistillate flowers oblong in bud, 8 mm long, 4 mm diam., the pedicel to 1 mm long; sepals oblong, 5-7 X 2-3 mm; petals oblong, 7-8 mm X 2-3 mm; ovary 0.9 mm long, 1-1.2 mm diam.; style 2.5-3 mm long; stigmatic branches 1-1.5 mm long; staminodial tube 2 mm long, the lobes 15-21, 2-2.2 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid-ovoid, 1.5-1.8 cm long, 0.5-0.8 cm diam.; epicarp purplish red in young fruits, purplish black at maturity; seed ellipsoid, 0.8-1 cm long, 0.5 cm diam.

description: Stems cespitose, 1 or 2 well-developed, these up to 8 m tall and 8 cm diam, with internodes 2.5 cm long, procumbent for first ca 50 cm and with numerous adventitious roots, then erect, occasionally with small lateral vegetative branches. Leaves 20-30, arching; sheath open, not or scarcely encircling stem (at least on outer leaves), 15-25 cm long, 10 cm wide at base, 1.5 cm wide at apex, with slightly fibrous margins, outer surface densely brown-tomentose; petiole 30-35 cm long, 1-1.5 cm wide, flat above, rounded below, glabrous; rachis 70-90 cm long; blade entire (splitting with age), 120 cm long, 30 cm wide, deeply bifid at apex for ca 40 cm, with 35-40 primary veins prominent above and below, deep green above, paler green below, red when first expanded. Inflorescence interfoliar, erect at anthesis, becoming pendulous in fruit; peduncle 90 cm long, 2 cm wide, dorsiventrally compressed, densely brown-tomentose; prophyll 30 cm long, 5 cm wide, flattened, covered on outside with deciduous, dense, brown tomentum, inserted 1 cm above base of peduncle; first peduncular bract 55 cm long, 4 cm wide, flattened, with similar tomentum to that of prophyll, inserted 3 cm above base of peduncle; second peduncular bract 58 cm long, 3.5 cm wide, flattened, with similar tomentum to that of prophyll, inserted 4 cm above base of peduncle; incomplete peduncular bracts 0-1, up to 3 cm long, inserted at mid-point of peduncle; rachis 6-9 cm long; rachillae 11-15, up to 32 cm long, 8 mm diam, glabrous, with a ca 1 cm long acute sterile apex, reddish-brown at anthesis; triads borne in pits arranged in 6 vertical series along the rachillae; pits covered by a bract in bud, this recurved at anthesis; flower bracteoles 3, the outer one prominent and ca 3 mm long, the inner ones smaller; staminate flowers ca 4 mm long in bud; sepals 3, 4 mm long, 2 equal and wider than the third, glumaceous, slightly keeled, imbricate; petals connate below for half their length into a tube, this briefly adnate to stamen tube below, lobes 3, 2 mm long, unequally wide, glumaceous, valvate; stamens 9 (10), filaments connate below into a 1.5 mm tube, free above; anthers 1.5 mm long, inflexed in bud, thecae separate, terminal on arms of the bifid connective; pistillode short, slightly 3-lobed at the apex; pistillate flowers ca 3 mm long in bud; sepals 3, 3 mm long, 2 equal and wider than the third, glumaceous, keeled, imbricate; petals connate below for 2/3 their length into a tube, this briefly adnate to receptacle below, lobes 3, ca 1 mm long; staminodial tube 1 mm long with 7 lobes, 2 mm long; ovary 3-locular; style terminal, 1.5 mm long; stigmas 3; fruit not seen.

description: Stem solitary, erect, sometimes basally decumbent, 3-6 m tall, 5-8 cm diam., brown, occasionally with basal and lateral vegetative branches; internodes 2-3 cm long; aerial roots forming a short basal cone; pneumatodes very short. Leaves 18- 25(-31), reddish brown when young, green when mature, the older ones briefly persistent; sheath 12-30 X 7-9 cm, reddish brown tomentose, the margins slightly fi- brous; petiole (18-)25-35 X 1-1.5 cm, flat to channeled adaxially, angled to rounded abaxially, the indumentum same as on sheath, the margin slightly fibrous near base; midvein 56-95 cm X 0.3-0.6 cm, loosely brownish gray tomentose, flat to channeled adaxially, rounded to flat abaxially; blade 0.70-1.20 X 0.23-0.30 m, dull green adaxially, grayish green and covered with a whitish farinose indumentum abaxially, deeply bifid at apex for ca. 42 cm; primary veins 40-70 per side, emerging at 25-30º angle at midvein, mostly prominent abaxially, loosely brown tomentose. Infiorescence branched to 1 order; peduncle 85-95 cm long, 1.5-2 cm diam., dorsiventrally compressed; prophyll 27-35 cm long, 2-3.5(-5) cm diam., chartaceous, inserted at base of peduncle or 1 cm above it; peduncular bracts 2, with indumentum same as on prophyll, chartaceous, brown; first peduncular bract 45-58 X 2-2.5(-4) cm, inserted 3 cm above base of peduncle, second peduncular bract 58-60 X 2.5-3.5 cm, inserted 4 cm above base of peduncle; inflorescence rachis 5-10 cm long, 0.5 cm diam., dorsiventrally to irregularly compressed, pale green at anthesis, almost glabrous; rachillae 9-16, slightly pendent, the same color as inflorescence rachis, glabrous; basal rachillae 28-32 cm long, 0.5 cm diam.; middle rachillae 27-29 cm long, 0.5 cm diam.; apical rachillae 24-28 cm long, 0.5 cm diam., the sterile apex acute, 0.2-0.6 cm; flower pits spirally arranged, 2-3 mm apart from each other, covered with an inflexed lower lip, 2.5-3 X 2-5 mm. Staminate flowers obovoid, 6-8 mm long, 2 mm diam., slightly fragrant, white at anthesis, the pedicel to 1 mm long; sepals oblong-obovoid, 4 x 1-2 mm; petals oblong-obovoid, 6-7 x 1.5-2 mm; stamens 8-10; filaments united into a tube to 4 mm long, the free parts 3-3.5 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., white, conspicuously thinner at apex, lacking a papillate epidermis; connective 1 mm long; thecae 1.1-1.2 mm long; pistillode 2 mm long. Pistillate flowers oblong-ovoid in bud, 4 mm long, 3 mm diam., the pedicel to 1 mm long; sepals oblong-ovate, 3 x 2- 2.5 mm; petals oblong, 3 X 2 mm; ovary I mm long, 1.2 mim diam.; style 1.5 mm long; stigmatic branches 1 mm long; staminodial tube 2 mm long, the lobes 7-8 or sometimes fewer by congenital union of 2 of them, 2 mm long. Fruits not known.

description: Frutex 4-metralis, ramulis glabris ad apices spinosis, spinis 3.5-7 mm longis; stipulis ad apices ram- orum ovatis aristatis 3 x 1.5 mm glabris; foliis ad apices ramorum congestis petiolatis, petiolis 3-7 mm longis moderatim pilosis; laminis membranaceis elliptico-ovatis apice abrupte acuminatis basi cuneatim acutis 5-9 x 3-5 cm supra minute scabrellis subtus molliterpilosulis costa media nervisque pilis patentibus 0.5-0.8 mm longis praeditis; nervis lateralibus utroque latere 4-5 rectis adscendentibus supra paullo impressis subtus paulo elevatis ante marginem 8-10 mm conjunctis; floribus masculinis ad apices ramorum brevium lateralium 2-4-fasciculatis; calycis tubo cylindrico 3.5 x 1 mm extus pilis 0.5 mm longis dense hirsuto, lobis quinque lineari-subulatis inaequalibus 6-12 x 0.5-0.8 mm dense hispidulis pilis albis 0.5 mm longis vestitis; corolla hypocrateriformi 26 mm longa plerumque 0.8 mm lata praeter faucem ubi 2 mm latam extus pilis patentibus 0.4-0.5 mm longis dense hirsutula intus glabra, lobis quinque ovato-oblongis apice rotundatis vel obtusis 4.5 x 2.8 mm extus secus medium hirsutulis intus glabris; staminibus quinque paullo exsertis; stylo rudimentario filiformi 35 mm longo glabro; fructu subhemisphaerico-ovoideo 19 x 15 mm minute puberulo, calycis lobis persistentibus.

description: Liana dioica, spinis geminatis reflexis secus virgas dispersis armata; folia, inflorescentia, calyx, corolla extus trichomatibus flavidis patentibus, 1-2 mm longis hirsuta. Petiolus 1-3 cm longus; lamina elliptica vel obovato-elliptica, 7.5-22.5 cm longa, 3-10 cm lata, margine ciliata. Inflorescentia staminata cymoso-corymbosa, candelabriformis; flores 7-20; pedunculus 3-10 mm, ramis 2-3; pedicellus 3-8 mm longus; hypanthium 2-3 mm longum, 1.5-2 mm latum; calycis cupula 2-2.5 mm longa, 3-4 mm lata, lobi 5 (6), lineares subulati vel oblanceolati, 1-8 (12) mm longi, 0.3-1 mm lati, inaequales; corolla alba, tubo 4-5 cm longo extus patule-hirsutus, lobi 5, anguste elliptici vel ovato-elliptici, 1.5-4 cm longi, 0.5-1 cm lati; stamina inclusa; antherae sessiles, lineares, 1-1.2 cm longae; stylus glaber, inclusus, 2.5-3.5 cm longus. Inflorescentia pistillata subcapitata, subsessilis; flores 2-6, sessiles; calycis lobi 12 mm usque longi, 4 mm lati; corollae tubus 3-3.5 cm longus; stylus 2-2.5 cm longus. Fructus solitarius terminalis, subgloboso-obovoideus, 7 cm usque longus, 6 cm diam, umbonatus; pericarpium 2-10 mm crassum; semina discoidea, 8-10 mm longa.

description: Plants armed, dioecious, woody, sometimes at first shrubby with scrambling branches, eventually vines, high-climbing to the canopy, sometimes forming large tangled masses, 8-13 m or more high, the stems to 7 cm in diam, the bark smooth, greenish, the slash pale, creamy, with little odor; twigs opposite, divaricate, to 25 cm long and 2-5 mm in diameter, the bark thin, exfoliating, reddish- or grayish-brown, lenticellate, the new growth golden- or reddish-hirsute with spreading trichomes 1-2 mm long, the stout spines paired, axillary, recurved and reflexed or rarely straight, 5-10 mm long, 2-4 mm thick basally, the internodes 1-5 cm long; stipules persistent or eventually deciduous, free or slightly connate basally, broadly triangular to ovate, acuminate, 6-10 mm long, 3-5 mm wide basally, the acumen 1/2 the length of or equalling the body, externally densely appressed-hirsute, internally densely white villous, the hairs mixed with slender brown colleters 0.5- 0.7 mm long, the margins scarious. Leaves opposite, those of a pair equal or subequal; petioles (0.3) 1-3 cm long, 1-2 mm thick, densely spreading-hirsute; lamina elliptic to obovate-elliptic, (2) 7.5-22.5 cm long, (1) 3-12.5 cm wide, the apex acute, shortly acuminate or obtuse, the acumen 3-12 mm long, the base narrowly cuneate to obtuse or rounded, the sides often unequal, the costa prominent abaxially, hirsutulous, the secondary veins 6-9 pairs, festooned- brochidodromous or camptodromous, making a 40-45o angle with the costa, prominent abaxially, the venation visible to tertiary adaxially and to quaternary abaxially, the lamina membranous in shade forms, to slightly fleshy and chartaceous when growing in full sun, slightly discolorous, dark green above, lighter green below, somewhat shiny, drying green, both surfaces appressed-hirsutulous, the trichomes whitish to golden, unicellular, often slightly bulbous basally, denser along the costa and veins, the margin plane, ciliate. Staminate inflorescence ter- minal, cymose-corymbose, candelabra-like, to 9 cm long and 20 cm wide (in- cluding the corollas), (3) 7-20-flowered, terminated by 2-3 short branches each bearing 3-6 flowers, all parts densely spreading-hirsute, the peduncle 3-10 mm long or sessile; staminate flowers with slender pedicels 3-10 mm long, the hypanthium narrowly obconical, 2-3 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, the calyx cup 2- 2.5 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, internally sericeous, the lobes 5 (6), filiform, linear-subulate, often unequal, 1-8 (10) mm long, 0.3-1 mm wide; corolla white, the tube 4-5 cm long, 3 mm wide medially, dilated to 4-5 mm wide distally, externally spreading-hirsute, internally glabrous or with scattered hairs distally, the lobes 5, narrowly elliptic or ovate-elliptic, 1.5-4 cm long, 0.5-1 cm wide, acute to acuminate, externally hirsute-ciliate along one side, internally glabrous; stamens 5, included, the anthers sessile, linear, 1-1.2 cm long, affixed 8 mm below the faux; style included, glabrous, 2.5-3.5 cm long including the ellipsoid stigmas 2-3 mm long, the disc flat, 0.5 mm long. Pistillate inflorescence subcapitate, subsessile, hirsute, the peduncle 3-5 mm long, the flowers 2-6, like the staminate flowers but the hypanthium larger, 3-6 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, the calyx lobes often oblanceolate, foliaceous, to 12 mm long and 4 mm wide, the corolla tube shorter, 3-3.5 cm long, the style shorter, 2-2.5 cm long, the stigma ovoid-capitate, 2 mm long, the ovary unilocular, with 2 intrusive bilobed parietal placentas. Fruit terminal, solitary, subglobose to obovoid-depressed, to 7 cm long and 6 cm in diam, umbonate, the umbo to 10 mm long and 7 mm in diam, the surface at first long-hirsute, glabrescent, smooth or slightly reticulate, the pericarp hard, brownish or blackish, 2-10 mm thick; seeds numerous, embedded in a blackish pulp, subcircular-discoid, 8-10 mm in diam, 1.5-3 mm thick, brown.

description: Shrub or small tree 1-6.5 m tall with the stem compressed parallel to the petiole bases, biangular or triangular, the younger branches strigose to densely strigose glabrescent in age, 2.5-7 mm in diam. Stipules narrowly ovate or narrowly triangular, narrowly acute at apex, 7-24 x 2.5-7 mm, strigose to densely strigose on both faces, the hairs on the adaxial face towards the base mixed with few to numerous colleters. Leaves: the petiole adaxially canaliculate, 0.5-3 cm long, sparsely strigose to densely strigose; leaf-blades narrowly elliptic to rarely elliptic, attenuate to rarely subobtuse at the base, acuminate at the apex, 12-37.5 x (3) 4-14.5 cm, 2.2-4 times longer than wide, the venation pinnate, of 10-17 pairs of arcuate veins anastomosing near the margin, beneath prominent and strigose to glabrate or hispid, above weakly sulcate and sparsely strigose to glabrous, the intervenium sparsely striLose on both faces or glabrous to sparsely hispid beneath. Inflorescences sparsely strigose to densely strigose or hispid, the peduncle compressed, 1.5-7.5 cm long; panicle 2.5-18 x 3-20 cm, usually slightly wider than long, the branches compressed, the basal branches opposite or ternate, the next branches sometimes opposite or ternate, occasionally the third and fourth branches also oppo- site or ternate, the upper branches alternate; bracteole subtending the lower branches narrowly oblong to linear or rarely triangular, narrowly acute, 1.2-5.3 x 0.1-0.5 (1) mm, an interbracteolar structure resembling the stipules between the opposite and ternate branches. Flowers: the pedicels terete, 1-8 mm long, strigose or hispid, all subtended by 1 bractlet but the ultimate pedicel of each cymose branch, the bractlets 0.1-0.2 mm long, densely strigose or densely hispid; hypanthium (0.9) 1.6-2.2 mm long, (1) 1.8-3.2 (3.7) mm diam, wider than long, strigulose or hispidulous, the septum complete or rarely incompletely fused in the center; calyx tube 1-1.7 mm tall, sparsely strigulose or sparsely hispidulous outside, puberulous inside at base, the calyx lobes very shallowly triangular to triangular, broadly acute at apex, 0.1-0.4 x 0.6-1.3 mm, sparsely strigulose or sparsely hisnidulose outside, glabrous inside; corolla tube (5) 6-9.5 mm long, at base and orifice 0.9-1.4 mm diam, either sparsely strigulose or rarely sparsely hispidulose, sparsely and minutely retrorse or scabrous externally, apically papillate and basally glabrous internally, the corolla lobes linear to narrowly oblong or rarely ovate, narrowly acute at apex, (3) 4.5-7.9 x 0.5-1.2 mm, glabrous or sparsely hispidulose externally, with glabrous keel and flat proximal area papillate internally; filaments 0.3-1.6 mm long; anthers 2.2-4.4 x 0.2-0.5 mm; style 2-2.4 or 3.8-6.5 mm long, the stigma 0.9-2.3 mm long. Fruit globular, 4-6 mm diam; seeds 0.2-0.6 mm diam, the seed coat cells (M. C. G. Kirkbride, 1976) 66-119 x 39-77 µm, with more than 50 pits per cell each less than 1.3 µm diam and the internal walls 15-18 µm thick.

description: Slender, tree-like, erect, unarmed palm with naked, light tan-gray, solitary stem 6-12 m tall, to ca 14 cm in diameter (at 1 m above ground). Leaves regularly pinnate, equally segmented, the apex obliquely bifid, blade 2.5-3 m long; sheath ca 40-50 cm long, lacking a tubular ligule, the apical-opening descending to the lowest point (U-form) opposite the petiole insertion, densely lepidote before ex- posure, with pale silky or velutinous scales abaxially, becoming tan to dark brown with aging, adaxially glabrous and conspicuously fibrous, the fibers becoming stretched and net-like as the inner bud expands, becoming glabrate, loosely fibrous and cloth-like in appearance with weathering; petiole 10-20 cm long between the sheath and lowermost pinna, not wing-margined, concave adaxially above the sheath, sometimes with a slightly raised midportion, densely pale velutinous- lepidote continuous with the sheath abaxially, extending onto the rachis, adaxially extending into the sheath region for a short distance; rachis 2.5-3 m long, rounded to flattened abaxially, irregularly concave adaxially with a median ridge, the pinnae inserted in shoulder-like lateral grooves, the median ridge becoming broader toward midblade with the lateral grooves broadening as the pinna insertions become larger, the median ridge then narrowing to triangular in cross section (above the middle of the blade) with the pinnae inserted on the adaxial angles, continuing as a filament between the apical pinnae pair or adnate to one of the apical segments, densely pale-velutinous, both surfaces with dark brown, less matted scales in the lateral grooves and margin where pinnae are inserted, all parts scabrous with age; pinnae ca 55-57 on each side of the rachis at intervals of 1-5 cm, linear-lanceolate, subopposite to alternate, those toward the base of the blade very narrow, broadest at midblade, and narrowing gradually apically, each with several secondary plications in vernation, the apical pair not much broader than those nearby; adaxially appearing glabrous but with widely dispersed minute scales, being more plentiful and conspicuous in the axil of insertion (ob- scure or lacking with age) and the midnerve densely appressed tan-brown lepidote, abaxially with numerous punctiform dark colored scales across the entire surface, a series of larger evanescent light colored scales along the margin, and with greatly enlarged ferrugineous winged-T-bar peltate scales persistent on the midnerve, blade drying dark above paler beneath, basal pinnae much reduced, to 15 cm long, 0.2-0.6 cm wide, median pinnae ca 50-60 (73) cm long, 2-3.5 cm wide and multiplicate with the principal midnerve paralleled by slender secondary nerves interspersed with very fine tertiary nerves, apically irregularly toothed with one usually long-attenuate, the others short and sharp, apical pinnae 0.9-1 (1.5) cm long, 0.2-1.5 cm wide, variously free or united, sometimes simple with a single principal midnerve but normally at least one half of the apical pair having more than one principal nerve with several strong plications, an irregular apex and often with a "window" at the point of insertion; inflorescence interfoliar; prophyll included within the leaf-sheath, flattened-ancipitous, ca 30 cm long, opening through the loosely netted abaxial face; peduncular bract exserted and only slightly greater than half the length of the peduncle at anthesis; peduncle arcuate, persis- tently ferrugineous-lepidote, ca 1 or more m long, at first enclosed by 2 persistently densely brown-lepidote tubular bracts inserted close together at the base and with 1-3 small bracts (like those subtending the branches) widely spaced in the upper 1/3 of the peduncle; panicle with 4-10 simple branches, each ca 10-20 cm long including a distinct sterile basal portion 2-5 cm long and bearing 20-30 flowering nodes, rachis 2-10 cm long, all parts densely ferrugineous-lepidote and subtended by conspicuous, sharply acute to attenuate bracts, becoming orange at maturity of fruit; flowers white to creamy-white at anthesis in triads of 2 staminate and 1 pistillate or paired staminate toward the apex of the branches; pistillate flowers reaching maturity well after staminate anthesis; triads in shallow depressions subtended by a sharply acute to attenuate, glabrate and ciliate bractlet; staminate flowers 7-10 mm long, subtended by a rigid, strongly nerved, carinate, acute to attenuate bracteole and a rigid quadricarinate, deeply biconcave, ciliate bracteole successively; sepals imbricate, irregular in form with strong nervation and thin margins, somewhat rounded in outline, deeply concave, ca 2.5-4 mm long; petals deeply concave, heavy-textured, triangular-acute, completely valvate, not sculp- tured inside, ca 7 mm long; stamens ca 75-80 in number, filaments ca 2 mm long, connate in a tuft, adnate basally to the petals, free and distinct above, not inflexed apically, anthers versatile, ca 3 mm long, basifixed within the deeply sagittate base, bifid to truncate apically; pistillode absent; pistillate flower ca 10 mm high, subtended by a rigid, quadricarinate, deeply biconcave bracteole which clasps both the pistillate and the next lower staminate flower; sepals ca 7 mm high, strongly imbricate, rather strongly striate, much like those of the staminate flowers; petals ca twice the length of the sepals, strongly imbricate over the lower 2/3 of their length with the upper 1/3 valvate; staminodia connate-cupular basally and adnate to the petals for ca 4 mm, the numerous lobes short and blunt becoming obscure with maturation, often with 1 or more elongate attenuate lobes; pistil conic-ovoid, the 3 stigmatic lobes more or less trigonous; ovary trilocular, triovulate. Fruit blackish-purple at maturity, ca 22 mm long, 20-22 mm in diameter, 1-seeded, ovoid to subglobose with a short, apiculate, apical stylar cap, and per- sistent, enlarged perianth; exocarp smooth, thin; mesocarp of 1-2 layers of elon- gate, flattish fibers in a very thin pulp; endocarp very thin, fragile, not adherent to seed; seed irregularly depressed-globose, 15 mm high, 8 mm wide, attached laterally along an impressed raphe extending the length of the seed from an irregularly impressed oblique base, the pale testa rugulose between elongate length-wise impressions when dry; endosperm deeply and densely ruminate; embryo basal. First seedling leaf bifid.

description: Frutex 2-metralis, ramulis minute granuloso-puberulis; foliis petiolatis, petiolis 0.8-1.5 cm longis minute granuloso-puberulis; laminis anguste oblanceolatis apice acutis basi attenuato-acuminatis 10.5-12 x 2.3-2.6 cm supra glabris subtus puberulis; floribus pedicellatis binis vel solitariis, pedicellis clavatis 5 mm longis glabris minute verruculosis; involucello patelliformi concavo; calyce cum hypanthio 3 mm longo, hypanthio subcylindrico 2.5 x 1.8 mm; calyce 2 mm lato leviter 5-denticulato; corolla rubella, lobis tubo multo brevioribus; tubo subinfundibuliformi 33 mm longo basi 2 mm lato parte suprema 5 mm lato extus minute cano-puberulo intus supra basin tubi 5 mm 1/6 longitudinem annulo piloso munito, supra annulum usque faucem minute puberulo, lobis quinque ligulatis apice rotundatis 8-9 x 2.5 mm extus canopulverulentibus intus prope basin sparsim puberulis ceterum glabris; antheris 3.2 mm longis apice caudatis, filamentis 5 mm longis; stylo filiformi 42 mm longo glabro.

description: Frutex 0.5-0.7-metralis, ramulis tenuibus pilis brevissimis patentibus moderatim rigido-hirtellis; foliis brevipetiolatis, petiolis 2-4 mm longis moderatim hirtellis; laminis subcoriaceis obovato-oblongis vel oblanceolatis apice rotundatis basi subacutis vel obtusis 2.7-3.5 x 1-2.5 cm faciebus utrinque glabris, marginibus dense hirtello-ciliolatis paullo incrassatis subrevolutis; nervis lateralibus inconspicuis in quoque latere 6-7; inflorescentia spicata, floribus sessilibus; rhachidi dense minuteque crispo-hirtella; involucello patelliformi concavo 0.3-0.5 mm alto 2 mm lato; calyce hypanthioque cylindrico 4.2 x 2.5 mm, calyce apice truncato extus dense adpresso-puberulo; corolla cremosa, lobis tubum aequantibus vel fere, tubo 7.5-8 x 1.5 mm extus supra medium antrorsus sericeo ceterum glabro, intus in medio usque sursum 5/8 annulo piloso munito, supra annulum usque faucem dense sericeo, lobis quinque linearibus obtusis 8-9 x 1.5-2 mm utrinque sericeis; antheris 2.1 mm longis, connectivo apicali caudato 0.5 mm longo, filamentis 6.5 mm longis adpresso-pilosulis.

description: Notulis morphologicis plurimis inter Orbignyam oleiferam Burret et Attaleam comptam Martius intermedia et solum inter parentes obvia. Palma 7-11 m alta, trunco solitario 35-40 cm diam. Folia pinnata, pinnis ad racheos basin fasciculatis distaliter ordinatim dispositis; pinnae medianae ±98- 110 cm longae, ad medium 4-7 cm latae. Inflorescentia androgyna, rachillis 9-12 cm longis; florum petala anguste elliptica vel ovata; stamina 11-20, thecis rectiusculis vel subtortis vel subcurvatis. Fructus elliptici 9.2-10 x 4.3-6.7 cm; semina saepissime 3-4.

description: Solitary, erect, pleonanthic, monoecious palm; stem 2-6 m high, 35-40 cm in diam, with pronounced, closely spaced internodes. Leaves 14-22, fewer in younger or senescent plants, spirally arranged in a broad, arching crown; sheath 70-74 x 31-33 cm, partially clasping, split opposite the petiole, thick, coriaceous, adaxial surface smooth and greenish, abaxial surface weakly gray-lepidote with yellow, longitudinal striations that may extend to the rachis; petiole 5-10 cm long, adaxial surface channelled and smooth, abaxial surface convex and glaucous; rachis 5.37- 5.5 m long, base trough-shaped in cross-section, center more or less 4-sided, becoming triangular toward apex, abaxial surface glaucous; pinnae 181-191 per side, in groups of 2-5 at base of rachis, otherwise regularly spaced and in a single plane, rigid to pliant, linear-lanceolate at center of rachis, acute, plicate, basally reflexed at attachment, 1-ribbed with prominent intermediate veins, adaxially green and smooth, abaxially dull-glaucous; basal pinnae 135-152 x 1.2-2.1 cm; middle pinnae 98-110 x 4-7 cm; apical pinnae 14-22 x 0.9-1.4 cm. Inflores- cences interfoliar, yellowish at anthesis, bearing a prophyll; peduncular bract 128- 140 x 22-27 cm, woody, longitudinally ribbed, brown, swollen in middle, per- sistent, with acumen 17-20 cm long; peduncle ca 50 cm long; rachis 50-150 cm long; rachillae of staminate inflorescence simple or occasionally much branched, ca 300 in number, 14-30 cm long, linear to slightly undulate, slender, attenuate, arranged spirally around the rachis and subtended by 1 or 2 membranous bracts 0.6-1.4 cm long, bearing staminate flowers arranged in 2 longitudinal rows on abaxial side only; rachillae of androgynous inflorescence simple, frequently curved or contorted, 9-12 cm long, arranged spirally around the rachis, each rachilla subtended by a bract 4-8 mm long and generally bearing 1 pistillate flower at middle (2.5-4 cm above insertion on rachis) and 2 rows of 25-38 staminate flowers on the abaxial side extending to the apex, or bearing exclusively staminate flowers. Flowers unisexual. Staminate flowers yellowish, slightly fragrant, subtended by a bracteole ca 0.5 mm long; sepals 3, free or basally connate, triangular to deltate, 1.2-3 x 0.8-1 mm, membranous to slightly coriaceous; petals (2) 3, free, more or less straight to inrolled, 0.9-1.8 x 2.5-5 mm, narrowly elliptic to ovate, acute at apex, coriaceous with smooth margins; stamens free, 11-20; filaments straight, linear; thecae united, longitudinally dehiscent, linear to loosely coiled and twisted; pollen grains free; pistillode reduced. Pistillate flowers not seen. Fruit ellipsoid, 9.2-10 x 4.3-6.7 cm, 110-176 g (dry weight), brown-lepi- dote throughout, occasionally channelled on sides, mature fruits with an indistinct ring left by staminodial cupule; stigmatic residue persistent, apical or sometimes slightly eccentric; fruiting perianth indurate, consisting of 3 sepals 3.8-4.4 cm long, 3 petals 5.2-7.2 cm long, and a staminodial ring; epicarp 2-3 mm thick, fibrous; mesocarp 2-5 mm thick, yellow at maturity; endocarp 4-5.2 cm in diam, woody and very hard; seeds generally (2) 3-4, ellipsoid, ca 3-4 cm long; endosperm white, oily, homogeneous; embryo basal.

description: Stem solitary, erect, columnar or slightly swollen at or below the middle, to 30 m tall, 30-50 cm diam, gray, smooth, the base with a thick mass of brown, spinulose adventitious roots 1 m x 5 mm, internodes to 20 cm long and leaf scars 7-10 cm long, these appearing as unevenly wide and oblique rings around the stem. Leaves 15-25, erect in young trees, arching and spreading in mature trees with rachis twisted so pinnae appear in a vertical plane, abscising and leaving a clean stem; sheath open to base, not distinguishable from petiole; sheath and petiole 2.5-2.8 m long, 30 cm wide at base and tapering to 8 cm at apex, channelled adaxially, rounded abaxially, margins covered with conspicuous fibers to 1 m x 3 mm; rachis 5-6 m long, 8-10 cm wide at base and tapering toward apex, flat becoming ridged adaxially, rounded to flat abaxially with whitish or brownish tomentum, smooth, green, margins flat to 3 cm wide; pinnae 130-170 per side, strongly reduplicate, opposite to subopposite, evenly spaced, 4-5 cm apart, ar- ranged in one plane, dark green adaxially, lighter green abaxially; basal pinnae 70-80 x 1 cm; middle pinnae 140-160 x 7-10 cm; apical pinnae 70-80 x 2-3 cm. Inflorescences interfoliar, erect at anthesis, becoming pendulous in fruit, either predominantly staminate or predominantly pistillate and both types occurring on the same tree; peduncle dorsiventrally flattened, 80-130 x 5-7 cm; prophyll per- sistent, to 1 m x 20 cm, dorsiventrally flattened, round at the apex, bicarinate, brown, woody, becoming fibrous with age; peduncular bract persistent, inserted near base of peduncle, 2.8-3.3 m long, brown without and cream-colored within, sheathing peduncle for ca 1 m then open to 50 cm wide along rachis, the apical 50 cm forming an acuminate solid tip, outer 5 mm of expanded portion woody, deeply sulcate, inner 8 mm spongy, smooth; rachis to 1.5 m long, tapering to a 40 cm long flower-bearing apex; rachillae 600-1000, spirally arranged, ascending, 25-40 cm long, each subtended by a 4 mm long apiculate bract, basal 5-10 cm sterile, covered with white, mealy tomentum; predominantly staminate inflores- cences with staminate flowers arranged in 2 rows of dyads along the abaxial side of the rachillae, with 0-6 pistillate flowers, also in 2 rows, borne at the base of the proximal few rachillae; dyads subtended by an acute, erect, 2 mm long bract; staminateflowers to 12 mm long, each subtended by a small bracteole, yellowish; sepals 3, free, triangular, slightly carinate, ca 2 mm long; petals 3, 1 free to the base, the 2 others more or less connate, fused to the short receptacle at base, 10-12 mm long, lanceolate to sigmoid, acuminate and sometimes with more or less bifid apices, flat, coriaceous, with smooth margins; stamens 10 or 1 1, borne around edge of receptacle; filaments 2-3 mm long, attached abaxially 2 mm from the base of the anthers; anthers bithecate, more or less straight and not coiled or twisted, ca 5 mm long, apically rounded, the base sagittate; pistillode ca 1 mm long, 3 or 4-fid at apex; predominantly pistillate inflorescences with pistillate flowers arranged in 2 rows along the abaxial side of the rachillae, to 19 pistillate flowers borne from base to middle of rachillae, above staminate flowers; pistillate flowers 3000-7000 per inflorescence, to 15 mm long, subtended by an acute, erect, 2 mm long, bract and 2 low bracteoles, yellowish, occasionally with vestigial lateral staminate flowers; sepals 3, free, imbricate, triangular, concave, coriaceous, 10 x 12 mm; petals similar to sepals, 12 x 14 mm; staminodial tube 7 mm high, thin, coriaceous, closely appressed to gynoecium; gynoecium subglobose, rostrate, 10 x 13 mm; styles 3, sessile, conical, 3 mm long, smooth abaxially, papillose adaxially; ovary trilocular, 1-seeded; fruit oblong, 6 x 3.5 cm, acute, orange with brown scale-like tomentum; fruiting perianth ca 17 mm long, hard, woody; exo- carp fibrous, ca 1 mm thick; mesocarp fleshy, 2-3 mm thick, with odor of apricots; endocarp 2-3 mm thick, hard, bony, triporate basally; seed 3 x 1.5 cm; embryo basal; endosperm homogenous.
bibliographicCitation: Balslev, Henrik & Henderson, Andrew. 1987. The identity of Ynesa colenda (Palmae). Brittonia. 39: 1-- 6.
