description: Frutex; rami tetragoni, angulis subcarinatis, stellato-pilosi et glandulosi, brunnei; folia petiolo 0.7-1.2 mm longo, obovata vel suborbicularia, 4-5 mm longa, 2-2.5 mm lata, basi acuta vel cuneata, apice obtusa vel rotundata, nervo medio et nervis lateralibus (2- vel 3-jugis) supra impressis subtus prominulis, supra glabra impressoglandulosa, subtus dense albide stellato-pubescentia, margine integra chartacea; flores axillares solitarii; bracteae ovatae 1 mm longae; pedicelli cum pedunculo 1-2 mm longi vel breviores, glandulosi et parce stellato-pilosi; calyx tubulosus ad apicem versus parum ampliatus, 2 mm longus, 13-nervus, 5-dentatus, dentibus omnibus aequalibus, deltoideis, 0.5 mm longis, erectis, intus fauce dense pilosis; corolla alba (ex Holdridge) 4.5 mm longa, extrinsecus patenti-pilosa, tubo recto a basi angusto sensim ampliato, superne in statu compresso 1.5 mm lato, intus dense piloso, lobis erectis, rotundatis, 0.6-0.8 mm longis et latis, labio postico emarginato, antico trilobo; stamina tubo corollae sub fauce affixa, filamentis liberis, brevibus, subaequilongis, antheris ellipticis; staminodium non observatum; stylus 4 mm longus glaber, apice inaequaliter bifidus, ramis subulatis.
bibliographicCitation: Liogier, Alain H. 1968. Novitates Antillanae. III. Brittonia. 20: 148-161.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Frútice de 1-1,5 m; ramitas rojizas y glabrosas; laminas foliares 1.5-5 cm de long., glabrosas, la mayor parte ovado-obtusadas y mas o menos estrechadas en la base hacia el peciolo de 2-5 mm de lorng., mas o menos serruladas arriba de la mitad, obtusadas en el 'apiee, enves verde claro; 3-15 flores en las axilas de las reducidas hojas superiores, peduneulos de hasta 10 mm de long., bracteolos subfoliares, pedicelos 3-7 mm de long.; tubo del cáliz 5-8 mm de long. levemente hirsuto, labios 3-4 mm de long., dientes superiores 1-2,5 mm de long., lanceolado-deltoides, inferiores similares; tubo de la corola 25-30 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Suifrutex parvula ramulis pubeseentibus; foliorum sat erebrorum laminis deltoideo-flabelliformibus 7-10 mm longis, crenatis, paginis ambabus molliter einereo-pubeseentibus etiam subargenteis, venis subtus prominulis, petiolis 2-4 mm longis; floribus in foliorum supremorum crebris solitariis, pedicellis 1.5 mm longis, bracteolis foliosis integris; calycum tubo 4 mm longo extus molliter cinereo-hirtello, labia superiore 3 mm longo, dentibus ovatis obtusis circiter 2 mm longis; corollarum tubo 19 mm longo, labia superiore 3 mm alta. Sufrútice parvo con ramitas pubescentes; laminas foliares 7-10 mm de long., redondeado-flabeladas crenadas ambas supperficies con pubescencia suave, cenicientas o aun subargenteas, enves con venas algo elevadas, peciolos 2-4 mm de long.; flores solitarias en las axilas de las hojas superiores, pedicelo 1.5 mm de long., bracteolos foliados enteros; tubo del ealiz 4 mm de long. eon pubescencia suave y cenicienta, labio superior 3 mm de long.; tubo de la corola 19 mm de long., labio superior 3 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Sufrútice aromatico ramitas con puberulencia pequeñita; laminas foliares 5-12 mm de long., sesiles planas oblanceoladas, el apice redondeado, margenes enteras, ambas superficies glabras; 1-3 flores en las axilas de las hojas superiores; peciolos 1 mm de long.; tubo del ealiz 4-5.5 mm de long. casi glabro, labios igualmente glabros 2.5-4 mm de long.; dientes superiores deltoideo-subulados muy agudos 1.5 mm de long., inferiores mas agudos de hasta 4 mm de long.; tubo de la corola 9-14 mm de long., labio superior 2-3 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Hierba muy aromatica postrada hirtula en todas partes ramitas procumbentes de 15-20 cm de long., laminas foliares 9-14 mm de long., anchamente ovadas obseuramente crenado-serradas obtusas en el apice, redondeado-truncadas en la base, peeiolos casi 3 mm de long., 3-6 flores solitarias en las axilas; tubo del cáliz casi 2 mm de long., dientes agudo-lanceolados casi 1,5 mm de long.; tubo de la corola 5 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Herba peraromatica versimiliter perennis prostrata repens ramulis ascendentibus utrimque pilis extensis villosis internodiis plerumque quam folia brevioribus; foliorum laminis ovatis 9-14 mm. longis, obtusiusculis in basi rotundato- angustatis, obscure crenato-serratis, utrimque villosis pagina inferiore pallidiore, petiolis circiter 3 mm. longis elatis; floribus 3-6 in cymulis axillaribus bracteo- latis dispositis; calycibus florentibus circiter 3.5 mm. longis villosulis, dentibus anguste deltoideo-acuminatis, acutis vix tamen rigidis; corollarum albarum tubo 5 mm. longo.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. 1951. Supplementary notes on American Labiate--V. Brittonia. 7: 129-142.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Sufriútice o frútice de hasta 1 m, ramitas con pubescencia diminuta; laminas foliares 5-10 mm de long., sesiles, planas, obovadas o oblanceoladas, el apice redondeado, ambas superficies glabras, margenes enteras; flores solitarias pedicelos 1 mm de long.; tubo del cáliz glabro 4-5 mm de long.; labio superior 1.5-2.2 mm de long., dientes agudos, el central un poco mas largo, los inferiores 1-1.5 mm de long.; tubo de la corola 18-20 mm de long., labio superior de hasta 5 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Frútices de hasta 3 m, adelgazados, ramitas puberulas; laminas foliares 12-25 mm de long. y 5-10 mm de aneho, enteras, planas, elipticas y ovales, obtusas en el apiee, estrechas debajo de la mitad hacia el peciolo de 2-4 mm de long., haz finamente puberula, verde-cenicienta, enves densamente farinaceo con pubeseencia diminuta; 1-3 flores en las axilas de las hojas superiores, pedieclos 2-3 mm de long.; tubo del ealiz farinaceo 4.5-6 mm de long., labio superior 1.5-3 mnm de long., dientes deltoideo-agudos, los inferiores estreehamente deltoides 1.5-2.5 mm de long.; el tubo de la corola 20-30 mm de long., labio superior 2.5-6 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: Frutex reclinatus, 2-3-metralis, puberulens vel glabratus, nodis praecipue juvenili- bus puberulentibus, ramulis tenuibus, rufis, valde divaricatis; folia oblonga vel elliptica, (0.5-) 1.2-1.9 (-2.6) cm longa, apice acuta, basi attenuata in petiolos pubescentes 1-2 mm longos, margine revoluta, serrata vel basi integra; foliorum paginae subglabrae, costa puberulenti; flores axillares solitarii, pedicellis basi bibracteolatis tenuibus 5-10 mm longis suffulti; calyx subcampanulatus 4-5 mm longus, extus minute puberulens, intus pilis pallidis dense annulatus, bilabiatus, labiis inaequalibus; labium superiore paullo longiore, patente, 3-dentatum, dentibus triangularibus ca 0.5 mm longis; labium inferiore erectum bifidum, lobis acuminatis ca 1.5 mm longis; corolla aurantiaca (in siccitate violacea vel purpurea), 26-32 mm longa, extus hirtella, intus abaxiale pilis rigidis bilineata, tubo supra medium pilis retrorsis dense annulato; corollae tubus 19-24 mm longus, rectus, basin versus attenuatus; labium superiore 8-9 mm longum, erectum, bilobatum, inferiore de- clinatum trilobatum, lobis subaequalibus; stamina fertilia 2, abaxialia, exserta (labium superiorem excedentia), filamentis 17-20 mm longis, e corollae tubo parte mediana oriundis, antheris purpureis, thecis valde divergentibus 2.5 mm longis; stamina lateralia (posteriora) vestigialia subsessilia, antheris purpureis sagittatis 1 mm longis vel minus, filamentis aequilongis; stylus 4 cm longus apice bifidus.
bibliographicCitation: McVaugh, Rogers & Schmid, Rudolf. 1967. Novelties in Satursia sect. Gardoquis (Labistae). Brittonia. 45: 261-267.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: A sprawling vinelike shrub with the slender or almost wirelike small lateral branchlets very widely spreading from the main stems; leaves often with 3-5 serrations above the middle and entire toward base; leaves sometimes finely scabrous near the margins on the upper surface; fresh flowers orange-red, almost yellow within; stamens and anthers purple.
bibliographicCitation: McVaugh, Rogers & Schmid, Rudolf. 1967. Novelties in Satursia sect. Gardoquis (Labistae). Brittonia. 45: 261-267.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Sufrútice de 30-75 cm, ericoide, densamente foliado evidentemente procumbente; ramitas con puberulencia rizada; laminas foliares 2-3 mm de long., ovalado-ovadas, subsesiles, enteras, planas y glabrescentes; flores solitarias, pedicelos 1-2 mm de largo; ealiz glabrescente tubo, 3,5-5 mm de long., dientes ovado-obtusos, labio superior 2-3 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: Suffrutex parvus glabratus ramulis minutissime et sparsissime hirtellis; foliorum laminis plerumque ovatis 6-10 mm longis, in apice obtusis in basi ad petiolos 1-2 mm longis plus minusve angustatis, utrimque glabris, obscure et inaequaliter crenatis; floribus nune tribus lnune solitariis in foliorum supremorum axillis, pedunculis subnullis, pedicellis 1-2 mm longis, bracteolis lineari-foliolosis 2-3 mm longis; calycum tubo 4.5 mm longo, extus glabro, dentibus ovatis superioribus 0.5 mm longis, inferioribus 1 mnm longis; corollarum tubo 20 mm longo, labia superiore 7 mm alta. Sufru'tice pequenio ramitas escasas y menudamente hirtulas; laminas foliares 6-10 mm de long. la mayor parte ovadas, obtusadas en el apice, estrechas en la base hacia los peeiolos de 1-2 mm de long., ambas superficies glabras, margenes obscuramente desiguales y crenadas; 1-3 flores en las axilas de las hojas superiores pedicelos 1-2 mm de long., bracteolos 2-3 mm de long.; tubo del ealiz 4.5 mm de long. glabro, diente s ovado-obtusados, superiores 0,5 mm de long., inferiores 1 mm de long.; tubo de la corola 20 mm de long., labio superior 7 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: An erect shrub up to 2.5 m high, with ascending branches (usually diverging from the stem at angles less than 50?); nodes hirsute or the older ones glabrate; leaves ovate or lanceolate to oblong-ovate or elliptic, (1.3-) 2-5 (-6+) cm long, acute and usually acuminate at apex, obtuse to cuneate at base, the margins revolute, serrate or serrulate nearly their whole length or sometimes subentire; petioles 2-5 (-7) mm long; adaxial leaf-surface glabrous or sparsely scabrous especially at the margins; flowers slender-pedicellate, 1-6 together in irregularly cymose clusters terminating stiff axillary branchlets 3-10 mm long, these branchlets and the pedicels often long-persistent after the flowers fall (Fig. 1, B); calyx 8-13 mm long, the campanulate tube a little longer than the lobes, puberulent or sparingly hirtellous or villous without, nearly glabrous within except for a villous annulus 1-2 mm below the bases of the ciliate lobes; calyx-limb unequally 2-lipped, the upper (adaxial) lip shorter, somewhat recurved, with three triangular teeth 1-1.5 mm long, the lower nearly straight, its two triangular or acuminate teeth 3-5 mm long; corolla red-orange (the color usually noted as "orange" in the field), often drying rose-purple, usually pubescent without, glabrous within, 22-34 mm long, the tube 20-24 mm long, adaxially saccate and reflexed near base, the upper lip 2-lobed, straight, the lower 3-lobed, the lateral lobes somewhat wavy-margined; fertile stamens 4, didynamous, attached near the middle of the corolla-tube, the posterior (adaxial) filaments (11-) 15-21 mm long, about as long as the upper lip of the corolla, the anterior (abaxial) pair (13-) 16-26 mm long, usually much exceeding the lip; anthers rich purple, the anther-sacs strongly divergent, 1.25-1.75 mm long; style longer than the stamens, unequally bifid.
bibliographicCitation: McVaugh, Rogers & Schmid, Rudolf. 1967. Novelties in Satursia sect. Gardoquis (Labistae). Brittonia. 45: 261-267.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Herbae perennes aromaticae rhizomatosae dense hirtellae glandulosae. Petioli 3-5 (9) mm longi; laminae foliorum late vel anguste ovatae 12-20 (39) mm longae 6-14 (30) mm latae apice obtusae vel rotundatae integrae bicolores. Nodi superi foliati biflori, floribus pedicellatis; calyx cylindricus 13-nervatus, fauce annulata; corolla rubro-purpurea 26-35 mm longa, lobis 4 mm longis apice rotundatis suberectis inaequalibus; stamina 4, supera exserta, antherarum connectivo lato.
bibliographicCitation: Henrickson, James. 1981. A new species of Satureja [S. maderensis] (Lamiaceae) from the Chihuahuan Desert region. Brittonia. 33: 211-213.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Aromatic perennial herbs 1-2 (3) dm high from an underground rhizomiferous rootstock; rhizomes bearing conspicuous pinkish buds; stems many from base, unbranched above, the internodes 8-25 (45) mm long, closely decurved-hirtellous with hairs 0.05-0.2 mm long, light green to purplish. Leaves with caniculate petioles 3-5 (9) mm long; leaf-blades broadly to narrowly ovate, 12-20 (39) mm long, 6-14 (30) mm wide, obtuse to rounded at tip, broadly cuneate to rounded at base, entire, slightly revolute upon drying, sparsely puberulent-hirtellous with usually upcurved hairs 0.05-0.2 mm long and with scattered subpunctate glands on both faces, bicolored, green above, more grayish beneath with whitish veins. Flowers paired at upper leaf nodes; peduncles 0-2 mm long; bractlets subulate but rounded at tip, 1-1.5 mm long, pedicels 3-6.5 mm long, all decurved-hirtellous as stems; calyx cylindrical, 7-10 mm long, usually purplish to green, puberulenthirtellous with erect-ascending hairs and with sessile glands, the tube with dense ring of white, ascending, exserted hairs 0.6-1 mm long at inner throat, otherwise glabrous inside, 13-nerved, teeth 5, 1.1-2 mm long, the abaxial ones longer, more acuminate-attenuate; corolla ascending, 26-35 mm long, lavender-rose to redpurple, with white area in abaxial throat marked with lavender-purple spots, tube gradually ampliate, slightly curved, lobes 5, all rounded at tip, abaxial one ca 4 mm long and wide, lateral ones 3-4 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, adaxial pair united to within 1.5 mm of tip, villous, sometimes gland-dotted outside and pilosulous with hairs 0.2-0.3 mm long, pilose through 3-6 mm near base within with coarse, antrorse, white hairs 0.2-0.5 mm long; style 33-40 mm long, exserted 2-6 mm, lobes ca 1 mm long, coiling with age; stamens 4, abaxial pair with filaments 4-4.5 mm long and anthers usually included, abaxial pair with filaments 6.5-8 mm long and anthers usually exserted, ca 1-1.3 mm wide, connective ca 0.5 mm broad, sacs nearly parallel to divaricate, 0.7-0.8 mm long. Mature fruit unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Henrickson, James. 1981. A new species of Satureja [S. maderensis] (Lamiaceae) from the Chihuahuan Desert region. Brittonia. 33: 211-213.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Sufrútice de probablemente 1 m, ramitas glabras o eseasamente hirtulas; laminas foliares 8-15 mm de long., enteras, la mayor parte redondeadas, algunas veces anchamente ovaladas y redondeadas en el 'pice, estrechas en la base hacia los peciolos de 3-5 mm de long., ambas superficies glabras o eseasamente hirtula, enves verde claro; 1-3 flores en las axilas de las hojas superiores; tubo del ealiz 5-6 mm de long., hirtulo, labio superior 3-3.5 mm de long., pedicelos 2.5-3 mm de long., dientes deltoideo-subulados muy agudos, 1,5 mm de long., inferiores subulados mas agudos 2-2.5 mm de long.; tubo de la corola 18-22 mm de long., labio superior 3 lunm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: Sufrútice de hasta 1 m, erecto o procumbente, pubeseente en todas partes; laminas foliares 0,5-2 cm de long., algunas veces redondeadas otras veces elipticas, margenes mas o menos crenadas, estrechadas en la base hacia el peciolo 1-3 mm de long., haz hirtula, enves ceniciento-tomentuloso o pubeseente; 6-21 flores o mas, apretadas en axilas de las hojas mas o menos diminutas dispuestas generalmente en interrumpidas espigas; ealiz 3.5-4 mm de long., dientes deltoideo-lanceolados, agudos sub-iguales 1.2-1.5 mm de long.; tubo de la corola 4-4.5 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: Hierba postrada intrincada, aromátiea, hirtula en todas partes, ramitas de 30-50 cm de long.; láminas foliares 2-4 mm de long., por la mayor parte redondeado-ovadas y sub-enteras, pecíolos casi 1 mm de long.; flores solitarias; tubo del cáliz 2-2,5 mm de long., dientes 0,6-1 mm de long. deltoideos; tubo de la corola 3-4 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: Frútice glabro de hasta 2 m; láminas foliares 1,5-4,5 cm de long., glabriuseulas, ovadas sub-enteras o serruladas, estreehadas en la base hacia peeiolos de hasta 7 mm de long.; hasta 21 flores en axilas, pedicelos delgados 2-4 mm de long.; cáliz 2 mm de long., dientes 1 mm de long., sub-iguales y recurvados; corola casi 2.5 mm de long., tubo y limbo sub-iguales, labio superior entero.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: Sufrútice de probablemente 1 m; ramitas glabras; laminas foliares 1-1.5 mm de long., enteras, redondeado-ovaladas, ambas superficies glabras y por la mayor parte glaucas, redondeadas en el apice y mas o menos estrechas en la base hacia los peciolos de 1-2 mm de long.; flores 1-3 en las axilas de las hojas superiores; tubo del ealiz 6-7 mm de long., puberulo, labio superior 1.5-2 mm de long.; dientes apenas 1 mm de long., subulados, inferiores 1.5 mm de long., subulado-agudos,pedicelos 3-4 mm de long.; tubo de la corola aproximadamente 20-22 mm de long., labio superior 4 mm de long.; nuculas negras.

description: Sufrútice de hasta 2 m, con pelos muy diminutos y rizados distribuidos en todas partes; láminas foliares 3-12 mm de long., oblongas, ambos extremos obtusados estrechándose en la base hacia peciolos 1 mm de long.; 1-3 flores en las axilas, pedicelos 1 mm de long.; caliz casi 2 mm de long., dientes divergentes sub-iguales agudo-deltoideos, iguales en lonzgitud a la mitad del tubo; corola 2.5 mm de long.; limbo igual en longitud a la mitad del tubo.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: Sufrútice densamente foliado ericoide procumbente; ramitas hirtulas con pelos aseendentes; laminas foliares 3-5 mm de long., sesiles, planas, ovado-agudas, margenes pequenamente serruladas, ambas superficies argenteas con pelos muy diminutos enves con venas plegadas paralelas, elevadas, margenes de ningin modo revolutas; flores solitarias pedicelos 2-2,5 mm de long.; tubo del cáliz hirtulo 4 mm de long., labio superior 2 mm de long., dientes deltoideos 0,5 mm de long., inferiores 1.5 mm de long., deltoideo-agudos, 1.2 mm de long.; tubo de la corola 20-22 mm de long., labio superior 4-4.5 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: Sufrútice de 20-50 cm, densamente foliado ericoide procumbente; ramitas coln puberulencia rizada; laminas foliares 2-4 mm de long., constantemente revolutas, haz muy diminutamente hirtula, envés con densa puberulencia blanea rizada; flores solitarias, pedicelos 1-2 mm de long; tubo del cáliz 3-4 mm de lonig. hirtulo, dientes subiguales 0.5-1 mmn de long., deltoideos, obtusos; tubo de la corola 20-25 mm de long., labio superior 2.5-3 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: Sufrútice aromatieo de hasta 1.5 m; ramitas pubescentes; laminas foliares 2-3 cm de long romboidal-redondeadas, anchamente obtusadas en el ápice, estrechadas en la base hacia el pecíolo de 2-6 mm de long., pero algunas veces truneadas, márgenes regularmente erenadas, haz hlrtula enves pubeseente-ceniciento o tomentoso-blanco, por la mayor parte 3-6 mm de long.; tubo del ecliz 4.5-5 mm de long., hirtulo o pubeseente, labio superior 3-3.5 mm de long., dientes estrechamente deltoideo-agudos 2 mm de long., inferiores similares 2.5-3 mm de long. subulados; tubo de la corola 20-27 mm de long., labio superior 4-6 mm de long.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. & Játiva, Carlos D. 1964. Revisión del género Satureja on América del Sur. Brittonia. 16: 393-416.

description: Roots clustered, fleshy. Stem 56-60 cm high, delicate, sparsely glandular in upper half. Leaves 2-3, clustered at base, petiolate; petiole 10-18 cm long, narrow; blade 15- 18 cm long, 1.5-2 cm wide, linear-lanceo late to lanceolate, acute at apex. Cauline bracts 7-8, more or less cup-like, acuminate, herbaceous, the lower glabrous, the middle and upper sparsely glandular, all shorter than internodes, not reaching inflorescence base. Inflorescence 14-17 cm long, 15-25-flowered, lax. Flowers rather small, with shallow sac-like spur at base, subsessile. Floral bract 1 1-12 mm long, longer than ovary, lanceolate, acute, herbaceous, thin, in basal part sparsely glandular, 3-nerved. Pedicel ca. 1.3 mm long, twisted. Ovary ca. 7 mm long, densely glandular, strongly arched apically. Sepals densely glandular on outer surface, glabrous at apices. Dorsal sepal ca. 9 mm long, ca. 4 mm wide, obovate- lanceolate, subacute, 3-nerved, concave in upper part. Lateral sepals ca. 10 mm long, ca. 3 mm wide, oblong-falcate, subacute, 3-nerved. Petals ca. 8.5 mm long, ca. 2.2 mm wide, falcate, linear in basal part, widened in upper half, obtuse, thin, 1-nerved. Lip sessile, divided into the hypochile and epichile; hypochile 8 mm long, 3.5 mm wide near the base, 5.5 mm wide at apex, strongly concave-almost cochleate-in basal and apical portions, with a thick and fleshy crest along the midvein, minutely plicate near the apex, in anterior part 2 fleshy knobs near the margins; epichile 2.3 mm long, 6 mm wide, more or less transversally elliptic, dissected into wing-like lobules with thickened completely adnate to the ovary; stigma bi- lobed, both lobes separated from one another; rostellum very short; viscidium small, rounded; the rostellum remnant obtuse; an- other ca. 1.8 mm long, cordate-ovate.
bibliographicCitation: Szlachetko, Dariusz L. 1995. Two new species of Sauroglossum (Orchidaceae) from Peru and Brazil. Brittonia. 47: 143-146.

description: Stem 42-57 cm high, 3-6 mm in diam. at base, 1.5-2 mm in diam. below inflorescence, delicate to relatively stout, sparsely glandular in upper half or below inflorescence, densely glandular along inflorescence. Leaves 3, gathered in basal rosette, petiolate; petiole up to 8 cm long, narrow; blade up to 13 cm long and 5 cm wide, oblanceolate or broad to elliptic-lanceolate, acute at apex. Cauline bracts 5, acute, herbaceous, glabrous, remote from one another or the lower shorter and the upper longer than internodes. Inflorescence 12-16 cm long, 15-22-flowered, lax, subsecund. Flowers tubular, with shallow, sac-like spur at base, subsessile. Floral bracts ca. 16 mm long, longer than ovary, ovate-lanceolate, acute, herbaceous with hyaline margins, almost glabrous. Pedicel ca. 1.5 mm long, twisted. Ovary 8-9 mm long, sparsely glandular. Sepals almost glabrous, rather fleshy. Dorsal sepal ca. 9 mm long, ca. 2.5 mm wide, obovate-lanceolate, obtuse, 1-nerved, concave at base. Lateral sepals ca. 9 mm long, ca. 2.5 mm wide, linear-falcate, obtuse, 1-nerved, hooded at apex, saccate at base. Petals ca. 8.5 mm long, ca. 1.5 mm wide, spatulate, widest and papillate at apex, obtuse, rather fleshy, 1 -nerved. Lip set on short claw, arcuate, concave at base and apex, fleshy with thin margins, firmly adnate to the column, the basal lobules thickened at apices and thin at bases. Gynostemium ca. 6 mm long, erect, relatively stout, dilated near the stigma; column foot ca. 2.5 mm long, oblique, adnate to the ovary; stigma bilobed, both lobes distinctly separated; rostellum very short; viscidium small, oval; the rostellum remnant notched at apex; an- ther ca. 1.5 mm long, ovate.

description: Small caespitose twig epiphyte. Pseudobulb ellipsoid, complanate, unifoliate, 14 x 6 mm. Leaf elliptic-lanceolate, acuminate, basally conduplicate, mid-vein keeled, to 7 x 2.5 cm, shortly petiolate. Inflorescences basal, more or less erect, laxly paniculate, with few-flowered lateral branches. Flowers with sepals pale green marked pale violet, the petals whitish, mid-vein greenish, with dark purple small spots and broken lines, the labellum cream-white, calli teeth and disc yellow, the column pale green tinted cream-yellow, the anther dark violet-purple, the pollinia pale yellow, the stipe cream- yellow, the viscidium ochre. Dorsal sepal oblong-obovate, concave, subacute, 7.3 x 3.3 mm. Lateral sepals concave, connate for 3/4 their length, elliptic in outline, the two apical lobes overlapping, basally bisaccate, 12 x 4 mm when expanded, with two lateral swellings. Petals obliquely elliptic-obovate, obtuse, subacute, 8.9 x 4.0 mm. Labellum 12 x 6 mm, basal half semiterete, oblong, glabrous below, sparsely hirsute above, extended into a pair of pointed spurs, the lamina broadening near the middle, the midlobe with basal margins laciniate-fimbriate, with two strongly compressed, vertical lamellate keels ascending close to the lateral margins which form two antrorse, conical lobules whose forward edges descend to the disc, in front with two parallel, subapproximate, antrorse, lightly complanate, obtuse teeth, the mid-margins with a deep fold, the lamina broadly rounded apically, minutely papillose. Column joined to the labellum by a common keel, gradually dilated above, ventrally concave, from the middle a thin, high, continuous border around the stigma forming a membraneous, cucullate hood around anther bed, 7.5 x 2.5 mm; the pollinia 2, hard, subglobose-napiform, 0.7 x 0.6 mm; the stipe obovate, acuminate, 1.1 x 0.5 mm; the viscidium elliptic, relatively thick, 0.3 x 0.2 mm.

description: Caespitose epiphytes to 11 cm tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid, lightly complanate, 3 X 0.8 cm. Leaf 1, ovate-lanceolate, petiolate, acuminate, carinate, purple on the undersurface, to 9.2 X 2.9 cm, the petiole thickened, channeled, elliptic in cross section. Inforescences suberect, scapose racemes to 15 cm long, 5-7-flowered, the rachis fractiflex, subsequently producing 1-3 secondary 3-5-flowered branches, the floral bracts ovate, acuminate, concave, 1.5 mm long. Flowers obliquely conic, yellow, the sepals with pale purple mottling, the petals with broken lines of small purple spots, the labellum whitish yellow, the lateral lobes and callus apices marked with purple, the column pale yellow, the anther reddish purple. Dorsal sepal elliptic-obovate, subacute, deeply concave, 9 X 4 mm. Lateral sepals fused for most of their length, collectively oblong-oblanceolate, emarginate, concave, 12 X 3.8 mm, the base a bilobed scrotiform sac. Petals elliptic-obovate, broadly obtuserounded, abruptly constricted at the apex, 8 X 4 mm. Labellum obscurely 3-lobed, longclawed, obovate in outline, 2.7 cm long, the base a pair of retrorse pubescent horns with hooked apices, the claw oblong, pubescent, the lateral lobes erect-infolded, denticulate, broadly obtuse-rounded, the midlobe 3-lobulate, denticulate, with the apex conduplicate, shallowly emarginate, the callus biseriate, the posterior calli a pair of introrse falcate teeth, the anterior calli a pair of suberect teeth. Column nearly straight, dilated at the apex, finely pubescent along the basal ventral margins and the base of the dorsal surface, 7 X 2 mm, the stigmatic cavity large, transverse, the clinandrium with a high, finely serrulate-subcrenulate membra- nous margin. Anther 2-celled, globose, 1.8 X 1.8 mm, the pollinarium 1.8 X 1 mm, the viscidium minute, the stipe oblanceolate, 1 X 0.6 mm, the pollinia 2, hard, obliquely obovoid, 0.5 X 0.3 mm.

description:
Bactris acanthocarpa var. exscapa is a solitary (or rarely clustered), understory palm. The stem is generally short and subterranean but can become aerial and then reach 30 cm long and 6 cm diameter. Plants flower in the early rainy season (Fig. 1). Inflorescences are often covered by dead leaves and other debris. At maturity and before anthesis the visible part of the spiny peduncular bract is 22-32 cm long. The mean number of rachillae is 25 (n = 25), and these are covered with easily removed, brown, moniliform trichomes. Flowers are ivory-colored and are borne in regularly arranged triads at the base of the rachillae, with paired or solitary staminate flowers distally.

Inflorescence buds become exserted vertically in the subtending leaf sheath. The peduncular bract splits longitudinally and abaxially between 16:00 and 18:00 (Fig. 2A). Inflorescence temperature elevation for this and other species is given in Table II. A weak, sweet scent is given off after bract opening. Pistillate flowers are at anthesis immediately; stigmas are glistening and remain so for up to 24 hours. At this time a few staminate flowers adjacent to the most proximal pistillate flowers have their stamens exserted from the petals. For the first few hours following bract opening the rachillae remain bunched within the bract, but during staminate anthesis they tend to become somewhat pendulous and exserted from the bract, at least distally. Staminate anthesis in a few flowers begins on day two, but the main opening time of anthers seems to be during the night of day two. On the morning of day three all staminate flowers have their stamens exserted, and the flowers begin slowly to fall. By the afternoon of day three all staminate flowers have fallen from the inflorescence. Over the next few days the peduncular bract begins to close slowly around the rachillae and developing fruits.

description: Herba terrestris; caulis erectus, usque 0.5 m longus, 3 cm crassus, internodiis 1.5-2.5 cm longis. Folia ad apicem caulis aggregata. Foliorum lamina late ovata vel deltoideoovata (cuspide usque 1.5 cm longa inclusa), usque ad 28.5 cm longa, 22.5 cm lata, basi cordata sinu basali apertissimo usque ad 4 cm profundo, superne breve acuminata, apice ipso cuspidato, in vivo supra laete viridia, in statu sicco olivacea, subtus viridigrisea, costa canaliculata ca. 8 mm lata, nervis lateralibus primariis utrinque ca. 12, supra profunde sulcatis. Petiolus usque 52 cm longus in parte distali subteres, in parte inferiore 2/5-1/3 vaginatus. Pedunculi ut videtur bini, usque ad 22 cm longi, lilacini sub anthesi. Spatha (cuspide 9 mm longa inclusa) usque ad 12 cm longa (in speciminibus), tubo ca. 4 cm longo extus sordide rubro-violaceo, lamina extus pallide viridi in aetate circumscissa. Spadix quam spatha ca. 2.5 cm longior, parte pistillata albida ca. 3.3 cm longa, parte staminata luteola ca. 5.7 cm longa. Ovarium ellipsoideum vel in aetate cylindricum, 3-3.5 mm longum, 1 mm crassum, uniloculare placentis 2 parietalibus; ovula in quamque placentam 1 vel 2. Semen ellipsoideum vel ovoideum, 1 mm longum et fere 1 mm latum ubique longitudinaliter sulcatum.

description: Arbor parva ( ?), ramulis crassis teretibus rugosis einereo-puberulis glabreseentibus; petiolis crassis teretibus ad 55 cm. longis, glabreseenti- bus, conspicue lenticellatis, basi dilatatis, ligula coriacea oblongo- lanceolata 5-9 cm. longa, foliolis 12-15, petiolulis subteretibus striatis canaliculatis 4-14 cm. longis, laminis tenuiter coriaceis glabris elongato oblongis, 15-30 cm. longis, 4-8 cm. latis, basi obtusis vel rotundatis, apice caudato-acuminatis (acumine 2-3 cm. longo), margine integris et leviter revolutis, costa utrinque prominente, nervis secundariis utroque 15-20 patulis, utrinque elevatis, venulis prominulis; inflorescentia terminali robusta composito-paniculata, ad 50 cm. longa, rhachide et ramulis cinereo-puberulis glabrescentibus, ramulis numerosis 30-40 cm. longis, pedunculis numerosis patulis 3-7 mm. longis subglabris; floribus sessilibus, capitulis compactis 4-6 mm. diametro, 15-20-floris; floribus 5-mneris glabris, calyce cupuliformi, sub anthesi eirciter 1.5 mm. longo et diametro, limbo minuto, truncato vel undulato; petalis mem- branaceis valvatis connatis deltoideis, circiter 1.5 mm. longis et 1 mm. latis; filamentis gracilibus circiter 1.5 mm. longis, antheris globoso- oblongis circiter 0.7 mm. diametro; disco carnoso annulari undulato; stylis 5, circiter 1.5 mm. longis, columnain carnosam cohaerentibus, apice liberis, loculis et ovulis 5.

description: Frutex 1-2 m altus; rami vetustiores grisei, striati, juniores dense pilosuli, apice in spinas 1-3 excurrentes; spinae terminales rectae, 5-10 mm longae glabrae, ad vel supra medium squamulas 2 oppositas floriferas gerentes; stipulae intrapetiolares late triangulares 1 mm longae, basi inter sese connatae; folia ca. 1 mm longe petiolata elliptica vel anguste elliptica, 8-12 mm longa, 3-6 mm lata, basi acuta vel attenuata, apice breviter acuminata et mucronata, nervo medio supra applanato vel inferne interdum paullo impresso, subtus prominente, nervis lateralibus obsoletis vel 3 vel 4 utroque latere utrinque prominulis, supra pilis rigidis minutissimis scabra, subtus pilosula, margine integra plana, rigide coriacea; flores 2-5 glomerati ad spinassessiles vel 1 mm longe pedicellati; calyx 2-2.3 mm longus, hirsutus, tubo subtereti 1 mm longo, lobis inferne connatis, ca. 1 mm longis, triangularibus, acutis, margine ciliatis; corolla non visa; bacca globosa hirsuta 3-4 mm diam., alba.
bibliographicCitation: Liogier, Alain H. 1968. Novitates Antillanae. III. Brittonia. 20: 148-161.

description: Herba perennis bella altitudine ad 20-30 cm, rhizomis ut videtur late repentibus, 1-2 mm diametro; caulibus erectis nisi in inflorescentia nullomodo ramosis, pilis extensis brevibus sparse ornatis; foliis sat remotis, 1-18 mm longis, ovatis, sessilibus, obtusis, ad margines sat integris, pagina superiore glabra, inferiore praesertim ad venas et margines hirtella; floribus in racemis brevibus, in foliorum deminutis oppositis; calycibus atro-cyaneis hirtellis, 5 mm longis, in maturitate non visis; corollarum tubo cyanearum, 14-15 mm longo, intus nudo, labia inferiore albostriata; nuculis non visis.

description: Herba perennis in silvis humidis sub Fraxinum et Quercum repens; caulibus praesertim ad angulos pilis brevibus ascendentibus hirtellis; foliorum laminis ovatis 2.5-3.5 cm. longis, paucicrenatis, pagina superiore sparse hirtella et inferiore solum ad venas, petiolis 1-1.5 cm. longis; floribus in foliorum supre- morum axillis dispositis; calycibus florentibus vix 2 mm. longis extus hirtellis, in maturitate 4-4.5 mm. longis, scutello aequilongo; corollarum tubo et galea 8 mm. longa, labia inferiore quam galea duplo longiore; nuculis atris papillosis.

description: Herba perennis modesta in querceto-pinetis sub frutices repens caulibus paucis gracilibus procumbentibus pilis extensis 1 mm. longis conspersis; foliorum laminis ovatis etiam rotundato-ovatis 1-2.5 cm. longis superne gradatim deminutis, petiolis 2-4 mm. longis elatis paucicrenatis utrimque pilis strictis longioribus sparse conspersis; floribus in foliorum supremorum deminutorum axillis dispositis; calycibus florentibus 4 mm. longis pilis longioribus conspersis; corollarum caerulearum tubo et galea fere ad 20 mm. longa, labia inferiore quam galea duplo longiore; nuculis non visis.

description: Herba perennis e rhizomate tuberoso-incrassato, caulibus prostratis 1-2 dm longis laxe et breviter glanduloso-pubescentibus, foliis sessilibus vel subsessilibus, integris, ellipticis, 15-22 mm longis, 7- 12 mm latis; flores solitarii ex axillis, corolla albida 19-21 mm longa, palato longe pubescenti.

description: Perennial from deep-seated, tuberous-thickened rhizomes; stems 1-several, often branched at ground level, slender, prostrate, 1-2 dm long, loosely and softly spreading-hairy with short hairs of uneven length up to about 0.3 mm long, many of the hairs gland-tipped; leaves elliptic, entire, tapering to a sessile or subsessile base, mostly 15-22 mm long and 7-12 mm wide, few-veined, densely spreading-glandular-hairy, the hairs up to about 0.5 mm long; flowers solitary in the upper axils; calyx 5 mm long; corolla pale, whitish, the lower lip somewhat creamy and the upper washed with dull pale purple, as in S. nana var. nana, 19-21 mm long overall, the throat open (?), the palate provided with more or less numerous long, flattened, white hairs; lower stamens seated a little above the middle of the co- rolla-tube.

description: Herba perennis suifruticosa ramosa altitudine ad 2 m. ramulis minute appresso-hirtellis, superne inter flores pilis parvis extensis indutis; foliorum laminis ovatis interdum anguste ovatis 8-9 cm. longis (? et ultra), 3.5-5 cm. latis, gradatim acuminatis in basi magnam partem rotundatis, marginibus leniter sinuatis subintegris, pagina superiore glabra, inferiore ad venas minute hirtella, petiolis 1-2 cm. longis; floribus in racemis 15 cm. longis, suboppositis, bracteis caducis; calycum florentium labiis 4 mm. longis, extus glabris, inferiore in maturitate 7 mm. longa, scutello 6 mm. alto; galea rosea et tubo albo 25 mm. longo, tubo leniter sigmoideo gracile superne ampliato faucibus 6-7 mm. diametro; staminibus inferioribus ad tubi medium positis; nuculis atris minute papillosis.
bibliographicCitation: Epling, Carl C. 1951. Supplementary notes on American Labiate--V. Brittonia. 7: 129-142.

description: A B. militaris fructuumn endocarpii fibris numerosis cum sacculis succiferis connexis differt.

description: Stems cespitose, 1-2 m tall, 2.5-3 cm diam. Leaves 5-8 per stem, coriaceous, strongly plicate; leaf spines widely scattered, black, terete, to 7 cm long, few on lateral surfaces of petiole, abaxial surface of rachis, and margins of blade; sheath and ocrea not seen; petiole 28-43 cm long; rachis 78-146 cm long; blade simple, elongate cuneate-oblanceolate in outline, gradually expanded from a narrowly cuneate base to the bifid apex, with 18 main veins per side, without evident cross-veins; blade to 1.5 m long, to 18-27 cm wide at apex of rachis. Inflorescences interfoliar; peduncle to 14 cm long, straight, not spiny; prophyll 7-9 X 1.2-1.8 cm; peduncular bract to 17.5 cm long, tomentose; rachis 1-2 cm long; rachillae 5-8, to 4 cm long, at anthesis covered with brown, moniliform trichomes; tliads irregularly arranged among paired or solitary staminate flowers; staminate flowers 4-5 mm long; sepal lobes 1-1.5 mm long; petals 4 mm long, the lobes valvate; stamens 6; pistillode very small; pistillate flowers 3-4 mm long; calyx annular, to 1 mm long; corolla tubular, 3-4 mm long; staminodes absent; ovary cylindric; stigma broadly truncate; fruits broadly obovoid, indistinctly rostrate, 1.4-1.6 cm diam., orange; mesocarp juicy; endocarp not pitted, turbinate, the sterile pores displaced longitudinally; endocarp fibers numerous, free, terete, with juice sacs attached; fruiting perianth with minute calyx and longer corolla, without staminodial ring; eophyll bifid.
bibliographicCitation: Nevers, Greg C. de & Henderson, A. 1999. A new Bactris (Palmae) from Central America. Brittonia. 51: 77-78.

description: Arbor glabra usque ad 8 m alta, foliis novellis petiolisque saepe rubrotinctis; folia longepetiolata, subtus insigniter pallida, elliptico-ovata vel ovata-lanecolata, 1.5-4.5 cm lata, 5-13 cm longa, serrulata, caudato-acuminata, base acuta vel rotundata; petiolus eglandulosus, 1.5-5.5 cm longus; dentium laminae pares 1-2 infimi dilatati, glandulosi, glandulae depressae vel brevi-eylindricae; stipulae cito deciduae, 2-3 mm longae, anguste triangulae, basi glandulosae; costa subtus prominens, supra in siccitate convexa; nervi laterales iiicoiispicui, utroque latere 7-10, arcuati; spica terminalis, subpendula, androgyna, 4.5-6 cm longa, basi [female] ; bracteae & appressae, ovatae, acutae, integrae vel paulum dentatae, 2 mm longrae, basi calcare obtuso et glandulis 2 lateralibus 3-5-lobatis instructae; flores a [male] 1-2 evolventes, stipitati; calycis a lobi suborbiculares, fere 1 mm longi, 2 abaxiales connati, inter se incisi, lobus tertius distinctus; stamina 2-3, filameiitis calycis lobisque aequilongis; filamenta 2 divaricata (aantheris vix exsertis), tertium sub lobam duplicatum calycis erectum; flos [female] 1 (-2), brevipedicellatus; calyx 1.5 mm longus, ei lobi valde inaequales 4-5, imbricati, ovati, acuti, eroso-denticulati, paullo scariosi; styli ca. 2 mm longi, carnosi, valde recurvati, usque ad medium fere connati; ovula 1, pendula; capsula valde 3-lobata, inermis, ca. 1 cm lata; semina carunculata, laevia, nitida, fusca, depressa, 6.5 mm longa.
bibliographicCitation: McVaugh, Rogers. 1961. Euphorbiaceae novae-galicianae. Brittonia. 13: 145-205.

description: Stems cespitose, 1.5-3.0 m tall, 2.5-5.0 cm diam.; internodes (0.5)2-6(15) cm long, with rings of black, flattened spines 1-4 cm long. Leaves 6-12, erect, 2-4.5 m long; sheath brownish-green, 15-80 cm long, sheath and petiole with a few black, somewhat flattened spines 0.5-7 cm long; petiole cylindrical, canaliculate adaxially, yellowish-green, 0.2-1.0 m long; rachis 0.8-2.5 m long; pinnae 12-30 per side, irregularly arranged in 7-10 clusters of 2-7 pinnae, spreading in different planes, oblanceolate to sigmoid, long acuminate, the middle ones 35-60 cm long, 2.5-7 cm wide, apical ones to 16 cm wide. Inflorescences interfoliar; peduncle 9-25 cm long, recurved, laterally flattened, brown-velvety to hairy at the top;prophyll 8-15 cm long; peduncular bract 20-38 cm long in total, with a fusiform part densely covered with dark brown, soft hairs 0.2-1 cm long, somewhat spiny toward the apex, intermixed, particularly on the lower half, with yellowish hairs; rachis 2.5-8 cm long, hardly visible, bearing 20-60 very slender, flexuous rachillae, 5-15 cm long, brown spinulose basally; flowers in triads at base of rachillae, these interspersed with solitary staminate flowers, distally with paired or solitary staminate flowers; staminate flowers 2-2.5 mm long (pre-anthesis); sepals connate into a 3-lobed calyx, the lobes deltate, ca. 0.5 mm long; petals connate below for ca. half their length, free and valvate above, fleshy, obovate, 2-2.5 mm long; stamens 6; pistillode absent; pistillate flowers (post-anthesis) 3-5 mm long; sepals connate into a cupular, glabrous calyx, ca. 1 mm long, 2-3 mm diam.; petals connate into a tubular, densely brownish-black spinulose corolla, 3-5 mm long staminodes absent; fruits globose to widely obovoid, ca. 2 cm diam. (1.5 cm when dry), yellowish green becoming bright orange when ripe, densely spinulose; mesocarp starchy; fruiting perianth 7-12 mm diam. with glabrous, lobed calyx smaller than the spinulose, lobed co- rolla; seedling with a bifid eophyll.
bibliographicCitation: De Graanville, J. J. & Henderson, A. 1994. A new species of Bactris (Palmae) from the Amazon region. Brittonia. 46: 147-150.

description: Caespitose epiphyte to 15 cm tall. Pseudobulbs oblong, strongly complanate, 2-3 x 1.5-1.8 cm, subtended by foliaceous bracts subequal to the leaves. Leaves 1-2, linear oblanceolate, acute, to 13 x 1.4 cm. Inflo- rescence a complex panicle with successively 1-flowered branches, arcuate, to 27 cm or longer. Flowers with sepals and petals pale cream-yellow apically becoming greenish yellow to yellowish green basally, marked with 4-6 transverse pale brown bars, the labellum bright cream-yellow, basally with clear brown markings, the callus yellow with small reddish brown markings, the column dull cream-yellow, the anther pale yellow, the pollinia golden yellow on a pale tan stipe. Sepals and petals subsimilar, elliptic-lanceolate, acute, with the margins revolute, the dorsal sepal 9.3 x 3 mm, the lateral sepals 8.3 x 3 mm, the petals curved forward, 9.6 x 3 mm. Labellum unlobed, obovate, cuneate, rounded, 1.2 x 6 mm, parallel to the column, the margin irregularly, minutely toothed, the callus prominent at junction of labellum and column. Column clavate, terete-filiform toward base, 10 mm long, the rostellum beaked. Anther long acuminate, 3 mm long, the pollinarium 3 mm long, the pollinia 2, the stipe narrowly oblanceolate, the viscidium minute, orbicular.
bibliographicCitation: Bennett, David E. & Christenson, Eric A. 1995. New species of Peruvian Orchidaceae III. Brittonia. 47: 182-209.

description: Trees to 26 m tall, 55 cm dbh; wood hard, white when freshly cut and rapidly turning reddish when exposed to air; bark light-brown to grayish. Leafy branchlets decussately compressed, glabrous, with ob- long to linear lenticels. Stipules free at base, contorted in bud, narrowly triangular, gla- brous or sparsely pubescent outside, 20-25 X 4.5-6 mm at base, readily caducous, leaving a white scar encircling the stem. Blades 20-45(-60) X 14-31(-40) cm, obovate, pandurate to widely pandurate, rounded at base, obtuse at apex, the margins undulate, dark green above and pale green below, thick-chartaceous, drying rust- brown above and olive-green below, glabrous or sparsely pubescent above and below; primary and secondary veins glabrous or sparsely pubescent and prominent below; secondary veins 15-18 each side; tertiary veins subparallel; petioles 0.9-3.1 cm long, 2.8-5.1 mm thick, adaxially flattened to concave, glabrous; domatia absent. Infiores- cences terminal, corymbose and laxly branched, with opposite decussate branch- es, the lax cymules at distal end of each branchlet 16-22(-35) cm long, the lateral branches 4-6 pairs; distal bracts absent, the bracteoles subtending the flowers narrowly triangular to narrowly ovate, 1-2 X 0.5-1 mm at base. Flowers protandrous; pedicels 1.5-9 mm long, glabrous; some flowers aborted and becoming only vestigial or- gans. Calyx cupular and 4(-5)-lobed, 4-12 mm long, glabrous; the lobes ovate, 0.5-4.5 mm long, glabrous and with many minute colleters inside; in some flowers one lobe of the calyx expanded into a calycophyll, these flowers usually not fully developed. Calycophylls ovate to elliptic, with palmate or pinnate venation; blades 5.5-12.5 X 2.5- 6(-8) cm; stalks 3-5 cm long. Corolla nar- rowly urceolate, pale yellow, 3-6 X 1.5- 2.5 mm at mouth in early stage of anthesis (Fig. 1C); 7-11 mm long with limb ex- panding and becoming campanulate 6-8 mm wide at mouth in later stage of anthesis (Fig. 1D); tube long-urceolate, glabrous outside, densely pilose at base inside; lobes 4(-5), imbricate in bud, 1-1.5 X 1-1.5 mm in early stage and 3.5-4 mm wide at base in later stage of anthesis. Stamens 4(-5), fully exserted at later stages of anthesis, equal in length; filaments attached near the base of the corolla tube, 11-14 mm long when fully expanded, terete, filiform, densely pilose in basal portion; anthers reddish, narrowly ellipsoid, 2.5-3 X 0.6-1.1 mm, dorsifixed near the base, rounded at both ends. Pollen reddish. Style fully ex- serted in last stage of anthesis, terete; style branches narrowly oblong, 2.5-3 X ca. 0.5 mm; stigmatic surface microscopically (40X) papillose. Ovary bilocular, 2-3 mm long, multi-ovulate, with ovules inserted on a central placenta. Capsules subspherical (faintly bi-globular), woody, 1.8-2.5 cm diam., light-brown, with many lenticels, 2- locular, with loculicidal dehiscence. Seeds horizontally inserted, numerous, lunate, 15- 24 X 7-9 mm, with lateral membranous wing.

description: Shrubs to trees up to 20 m tall, and 20 cm (or more) diam.; wood very hard, white when freshly cut and rapidly turning reddish on cut edges when exposed to air; bark light-brown to grayish, also becoming reddish shortly after cut. Young leafy branchlets decussately compressed, glabrous, with oblong to linear lenticels. Stipules free at base and contorted in bud, narrowly triangular and acuminate, glabrous outside and inside, with sparse small colleters at base inside, 35-50 mm long, 5-11 mm wide at base, with many parallel veins departing from base, reddish green, readily caducous, leaving a white scar encircling the stem. Blades 27762 X 18-32 cm, obovate to pandurate (rarely widely ovate), acute to rounded at base, obtuse at apex, acute at the very tip (but not acuminate), the margins undulate, dark green above and pale green-yellowish below, subcoriaceous, drying rust brown above and olive - green below, glabrous above and glabrous to puberulent below. Primary and secondary veins glabrous to minute puberulent and prominent below; secondary veins 8-19 each side; tertiary veins starting subparallel and reticulate in the middle. Petioles 1-4 cm long, 3-6 mm thick, terete or adaxially flattened to concave, glabrous. Domatia absent. Inflorescences terminal, sometimes frondose, corymbose and laxly branched, with opposite decussate branches, the cymules fairly clustered at distal end of each branchlet, 15-27 cm long, the lateral branches 2-4 pairs. Distal bracts ovate, 4-7 X to 6 mm, the bracteoles subtending the flowers narrowly triangular, 2-3 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide at base. Flowers protandrous, odor a pungent mix of jasmine and chlorine; pedicels 5-17 mm long, glabrous to minutely puberulent. Calyx cupular and lobed, 4-12 mm long, glabrous, the lobes ovate, 0.5-4.5 mm long, glabrous; calyx caducous. Corolla tubular, up to 2.5 cm long, and light green, in early stage of anthesis; narrowly campanulate and short lobed, 3.5- 4(-5) cm long and 9-14(-20) mm wide at mouth, light-yellow when fully expanded; tube cylindrical at base and gradually expanding toward the mouth (Fig. iB, C), glabrous outside and inside; corolla lobes 5(- 6), imbricate in bud, 2-4 mm long, 2-3 mm wide at base, rounded to ovate. Stamens 5(-6), fully exserted, equal in length; filaments attached near the base of the corolla tube, 4.5-6.3 cm long when fully expanded, terete, filiform, with a basal tuft of short pilose hairs; anthers yellow, linear, 14-19 X 0.6-1.1 mm, dorsifixed near the base, acute at both ends. Style fully exserted, terete; style branches ovate, 1.1-1.4 mm wide; stigmatic surface microscopically (40X) papillose. Capsules oblong ovoid, very thick and woody, with very thick pedicel, 5.5- 7.5 X 3-3.5 cm, light brown, 2 locular with loculicidal dehiscence. Seeds horizontally inserted, numerous, lunate, 25-32 X 7-9 mm, with lateral membranous wing.

description: Planta herbacea, caulibus 3.5-4 dm longis inferne 2 mm diam superne 1.5 mm diam inter angulos adpresso-pilosis; foliis petiolatis, petiolis 3-5 mm longis dense crispo-pilosis; laminis membranaceis ovatis apice subacuminatis basi abrupte cuneatim angustatis obtusis vel subacutis 2-4 x 1-2 cm utrinque secus costam mediam nervosque pilis 0.7-1 mm longis vestitis; inflorescentia terminali laxe cymosa in dichasia ramificata, ramulis monochasialibus disposita, 5-10-floris tenuibus sparsim adpresso-pilosis; floribus sessilibus; hypanthio sub anthesi campanulato 1.5 mm longo 1 mm lato dense setoso-sericeo; calycis lobis setaceis 2.5-3 x 0.2 mm, marginibus adpresso-ciliatis; corolla rosacea hypocrateriformi 11 mm longa, tubo 8 mm longo basi 0.7 mm lato in medio 0.5 mm lato supra medium 1.2 mm lato extus praeter partem supremam 3 mm sparsim adpresso-pilosulam glabro intus parte suprema 3.5 mm papillato-puberulo, annulo faucis incrassato glabro, lobis anguste obovato-ligulatis apice rotundatis 3.5 x 1.5 mm extus glabris intus papillatis; antheris linearibus 1.2 x 0.1 mm; fila- mentis 0.5 mm longis 6 mm supra basin tubi insertis; stylo filiformi 5 mm longo; capsulis suborbi-cularibus 3 x 3 mm pilis 0.9-1 mm longis dense setuloso-strigosis munitis, seminibus pallido-brunneis subrhomboideo-suborbicularibus foveolatis 0.3-5 mm altis 0.5-0.7 mm latis.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1981. New species of Rubiaceae from French Guiana, Brazil, and Colombia. Brittonia. 33: 385-400.

description: Herba, ramulis teretibus, adpresso-puberulis; stipulae 4 mm. longae, subulatae; petiolis 0.8-1.2 cm. longis, adpresso-puberulis; laminis 3.5-5.5 cm. longis, 1-2 cm. latis , membranaceis, ellipticis vel elliptico-lanceolatis, ad basim decurrenti- bus, ad apicem acuminatis; ad faciem superiorem venis planis adpresso-sub- puberulis, infra venis primariis leviter salientibus et adpresso-puberulis; dichasia terminalia 4-8 cm. longa, pedunculis 2.5-3 cm. longis, adpresso-puberulentibus; axibus 1-3.5 cm. longis, adpresso-puberulis; pedicellis ca. 1 mm. longis, adpresso- puberulis; ovarium turbinatum, valde adpresso-puberulens, 1.5 mm. longum, 1.5 mm. latum, cellis duobus ovula numerosa gignentibus, sepala 5, 5-6 mm. longa, 0.5-1 mm. lata, marginibus exceptis glabra, corolla quinquelobata, alba, 1.5-2 cm. longa, tubo 12-15 mm. longo, ad fauces ca. 2 mm. lato, intus et pro parte superiore extus puberulens, lobis ellipticis vel oblanceolatis, 4.5-8 mm. longis, 2.5-4 mm. latis, glabris, ad apicem mucronulatis, in alabastro contortis; stamina 5, inclusa, in medio tubo inserta, antheris linearibus, 2 mm. longis, filamentis ligulatis ca. 1 mm. longis; stigma bifidum, 1.5 mm. longum, stylus 3-5 mm. longus, discus cupulatus, 0.5 mm. altus; fructus maturus capsularis, ovoideus, pilosus, seminibus ca. 45, alveolatis.

description: Ab omnibus speciebus generis floribus foemineis secus rachillas crassissimas crebre dispositis differt. Caudex 15-23 m altus, 17 cm diametro, radicibus epigeis 3-5 m altis sustentatus. Folia 5-8; vagina 200-260 cm longa, viridis; petiolus 25-35 cm longus; rachis 250-314 cm longa; pinnae utrinque 17-24, usque ad basin in segmentos (2) 4-7 (10) longitudinaliter fissae, segmenta 70-127 utrinque; pinnae mediae 116-135 cm longae. Inflorescentiae bracteae pedunculares 3; rachillae 7-9, usque ad 82 cm longae, fructiferae 15-17 mm diametro; florum foemineorum cicatrices valde approximatae. Stamina 84-139. Fructus ellipsoidei, apice rostrati, 3.5-3.6 cm longi, 2.4 cm diametro, maturi longitudinaliter fissi, mesocarpium album, spongiosum extrudente. Semina ellipsoidea, 2.3-2.5 cm longa, 1.8-1.9 cm diametro. Embryo apicalis.

description: Trunk 15-23 m high, 17 cm diam at base, grayish, with inconspicuous nodes, supported by a loose cone of stilt roots 3-5 m high, 2-2.5 m diam at base, with individual roots 5-8 cm diam and covered with spines to 1 cm long. Leaves 5-8; sheath 200-260 cm long, the crownshaft grass-green, with a conspicuous yellow area marking the former position of the inflorescence bud, sparsely covered toward apex with a yellowish, easily removed, loosely wooly indumentum, when dry with whitish, flexuous, strongly appressed hairs; petiole 25-35 cm long, 6-7 cm diam, subterete, with a thin indumentum of whitish, scaly, strongly appressed hairs, the surface smooth to the touch; rachis 250-314 cm long, adaxially acute, striate, with a whitish tomentum of soft hairs, abaxial indumentum like that of petiole; pinnae 17-24 on each side, longitudinally divided into (2) 4-7 (10) multifarious, arcuate segments, a total of 70-127 segments on each side, the inner segments of each pinna linear, to 3.3 cm wide, the outer long cuneate to lanceolate in profile, obliquely praemorse toward apex, to 17 cm wide, with very short and scattered hairs above when young, glabrescent, pubescent below with loose and rather persistent, whitish, usually somewhat erect hairs not covering entire surface; basal pinnae 70-100 cm long, middle pinnae 116-135 cm, subapical pinnae 23-50 cm, apical pinnae connate into a flabellum to 23 cm wide at apex. Inflorescence infrafoliar, erect before anthesis; peduncle 28-40 cm long, 7-10 cm wide, dorso- ventrally compressed, green when fresh, brown when dry, with a dense caducous indumentum of yellowish-white, appressed, flexuous hairs; prophyll 20-22 cm long, 12 cm wide, ancipitous, adaxially bifid at apex, abaxially acuminate, with a caducous indumentum similar to that of the peduncle; peduncular bracts 3, 35-60 cm long, with a caducous indumentum similar to that of the prophyll, the peduncle with a fourth rudimentary bract above to 1.5 cm long; rachis 15-20 cm long; rachillae 7-9, to 82 cm long, slightly compressed, light-brown when dry, 11-13 mm diam at middle at anthesis, 15-17 mm diam in fruit, with pistillate scars usually obovate, sometimes almost rectangular, 10-14 mm long, 5-9 mm broad, the areas between them conspicuously wrinkled when dry. Flowers densely arranged, the staminate diversely shaped by mutual pressure, 11-15 mm long; sepals 3-5 mm long, glabrous; petals to 15 mm long, irregularly shaped and angled, thick, glabrous; stamens 84-139 (x = 118, N = 17); filaments 1 mm long, anthers 5-8 mm long, briefly apiculate; pistillode 2 mm long, globose, bicomuate. Pistillate flowers 9-10 mm long, subtended by a rounded, long-acuminate bract to 10 mm long, bearing long, yellowish hairs at apex; sepals 7-8 mm long, broadly rounded, ciliate toward base, carinate, glabrous; petals similar to sepals in shape and size, but ecarinate; ovary 9 mm long, ovoid, glabrous; stigmas erect when fresh. Fruits ellipsoid, obtuse and conspicuously rostrate, 3.5-3.6 cm long, 2.4 cm diam, light brown when ripe and eventually splitting longitudinally and exposing the thick, spongy, protruding, yellowish mesocarp; endocarp thin; fruiting perianth to 15 mm long, the petals longer than the sepals; seed ellipsoid, brown, 2.3-2.5 cm long, 1.8-1.9 cm diam, without constrictions; endosperm homogeneous; embryo apical.
bibliographicCitation: Bernal-González, Rodrigo & Henderson, Andrew. 1986. A new species of Socratea (Palmae) from Colombia with notes on the genus. Brittonia. 38: 55-59.

description: Caespitose epiphytes to 9.5 cm tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid, complanate, furrowed, subtended by bracts with the upper pair foliaceous. Leaves 3, oblong or narrowly lanceolate, attenuate below to conduplicate petiolate base, apex retuse, 7.5 x 1.0 cm. Inflorescences racemes, upright, 14-17 cm long, the floral bracts small, ovate, acute. Flowers pale orange-brown with two broad chestnut-brown transverse bars, the label- lum pure white with pale greenish-yellow callus base and a green median rib bordered by a bright orange rhombiform marking, the column pale green with two apical, brown blotches. Sepals and petals subsimilar, spatulate, rounded with shortly acuminate apices, the sepals 0.75-0.83 x 0.15-0.16 cm, the petals smaller to 0.61 cm long. Labellum 3-lobed, clawed, 0.6 x 0.4 cm, the lateral lobes obliquely rhombic, the midlobe much smaller, bilobed or retuse, the callus with two exterior, divergent keels and a thickened center with ascending margins, centrally rhombic descending in front to an oblong, convex rib with a slightly raised midnerve extending to the center of the midlobe. Column lightly arcuate, subclavate, 0.46-0.22 cm, with porrect, incurved, acute column wings.
bibliographicCitation: Bennett, David E. & Christenson, Eric A. 1994. New Species and New Combinations in Peruvian Orchidaceae. Brittonia. 46 (1): 24-53.

description: Fruit 8.3-9 mm diam., pericarp 1.6 mm thick, stigmatic remains basal-like Heterospathe, but distinctive for the large, corky, pyramidal warts that form through cracking of the outer pericarp as it matures, fibrous bundles mostly in the corky regions, these short and irregularly oriented, tanniniferous cells in a thick band adjacent to the locular epidermis and scattered elsewhere, with the vascular bundles with scant fibrous sheaths, and with brachysclereids and raphide cell lacking.
bibliographicCitation: Essig, Frederick B., et al. 1999. Systematic Histological Study of Palm Fruits. III. Subtribe Iguanurinae (Arecaceae). Brittonia. 51 (3): 307-325.

description: Herba ramis rigide ascendentibus e basi, vix ramosis; foliis ovatis vel ellipticis sessilibus acutis vel vix acuminatis, nervis lateralibus utroque 3-4 obscuris; stipulis aliquantum vaginantibus trifidis; floribus dense capitato-verticillatis, verticillis bracteatis, hypanthiis turbinatis glabris, lobis calycis infra connatis, limbis ovatis vel lanceolatis valde acuminatis, corolla alba tubulosa lobis ovato-oblongis tubo breviore, tarde reflexis, staminibus styloque exsertis, capsula cylindro-turbinata tenui septicida vestigio septi libero, semine elliptica brunnea, 1.7-1.8 longa, dorso transverse tessellato.

description: Low herb, branched at base with rather stiffly ascending, scarcely branched, square stems with prominent cord-like angles, usually glabrous; a strong deep taproot; leaves ovate or elliptic, sometimes narrowed to base, but sessile, apex acute or slightly acuminate, usually glabrous (ciliate toward base in Stoddart 4059, Buckley 3701), midrib strong, but 3 or 4 lateral veins on a side faint to obscure; stipules somewhat sheathing, limb somewhat ovate-triangular with usually 3 strong processes, center one longest, lateral ones variably developed, glabrous or with a few long hairs; inflorescence of dense capitate verticels, these 1-2 cm across, 1- 6 or more on a stem, crowded to usually well separated, subtended by 2-4 ovate foliose bracts, glabrous or ciliate at least at base in Stoddart 4059, Buckley 3701, bracts usually smaller, heads usually larger upward, flowers mixed in heads with setiform bracts perhaps of stipular nature; flowers very slightly pedicellate; hy- panthium turbinate, glabrous; calyx lobes united at base, narrowly ovate to lan- ceolate, strongly and sharply acuminate, margins glabrous to basally somewhat hispid-ciliate, this varying in Stoddart 4956 even on same plant, acumen straight to curved; corolla white, tubular, slightly dilated upward, lobes ovate-oblong, shorter than tube, becoming reflexed; stamens becoming well-exserted, anthers narrowly oblong, about 1 mm long, pale yellowish; style well-exserted, bifid at apex, branches spreading; capsule cylindric-turbinate, thin-walled, well-dehisced ones not available, but so far as can be determined, dehiscence septicidal with remnant of septum free; seeds brown, elliptic, rounded on ends, about 1.7-1.8 mm long, transversely coarsely tessellate dorsally, ventral groove wide.

description: Planta herbacea, erecta, foliis ovatis, stipulis tridentatis hirsutis, loba centrala elongata; floribus congestis verticillatis, brevi-pedicellatis, lobis calycis lineari-lanceolatis, subspinescentibus, corolla alba vix infundibuliformi lobis patentibus vel reflexis; staminibus valde exsertis, stylo stamina su- perantibus, apice breve bifido; capsula turbinata tenui septicida tum loculicida tum in 2 valvi dehiscentibus; semine ovato, 1-4 x 0.8-0.9 mm, subnitido tesselato-reticulato fusco dorso valde convexo.
bibliographicCitation: Fosberg. 1988. New and Noteworthy Plants from Great Barrier Reef Sand Cays, Australia. Brittonia. 40 (1): 52-65.

description: Small herb; stems square, glabrous or very sparsely hirsute, apparently erect; leaves broadly ovate, to 2 cm long, apex acute, base obtuse to usually cordate, margins strongly hirsute- or hispid-ciliate, hairs on under surface of some leaves; stipules short, slightly sheathing, with one elongate central process, and 2 subsid- iary ones, notably hirsute; inflorescence of capitate verticels in upper part of plant, these subtended by 2 broadly ovate-cordate, foliaceous, ciliate bracts, abundant setiform bracts congested with the flowers in the heads; flowers very shortly pedicellate; hypanthium hispidulous, turbinate; calyx lobes scarcely united at base, linear-lanceolate, strongly acuminate, almost aristate or spinescent, midrib apparent, margins strongly hispid-ciliate; corolla white, slightly funnelform, about 4 mm long, lobes ovate, spreading to reflexed; stamens strongly exserted, anthers linear, about 1 mm long; style exceeding stamens, shortly bifid, branches spreading; capsule turbinate, thin-walled, dehiscing across top septicidally, then at right angles loculicidally, finally separating septicidally, crowned by persistent calyx lobes until dehiscence is completed; seeds subglossy, dark brown, ovate in outline, 1.4 x 0.8-0.9 mm, dorsal side very convex, coarsely tessellate-reticulate, ventral side flattish, with a rather wide groove.

description: Frutex; rami teretes; ramuli patente pilosuli, internodiis ad 8 mm longis; stipulae lanceolatae, ca. 2 mm longae, basi glandula elliptica suffultae, extus pilosulae; petiolus 1-2 mm longus; folia forma et magnitudine valde varia, oblonga vel lanceolata, oblonga 1-2 cm longa, apice rotundata, lanceolata 3-4.5 cm longa, 7-14 mm lata, apice acuminata, nervo medio supra parum vel vix prominulo, nervis lateralibus utroque latere 4-6, subtus prominulis, ad marginem anastomosantibus, utroque latere parce pilosula et setis urentibus praesertim ad marginem versus armata, margine integra; flores masculi in ramulis abbreviatis 1-3; pedicelli 3-5 mm longi breviter pilosi; alabastra ellipsoidea, 3 mm longa, 2 mm lata, pilosula; sepala 3, viridia elliptica apice brevissime apiculata 3 mm longa enervia, anthesi reflexa; petala nulla; stamina ca. 24, erecta, filamentis liberis inaequilongis antheris suborbicularibus glabris; caetera ignota.
bibliographicCitation: Liogier, Alain H. 1968. Novitates Antillanae. III. Brittonia. 20: 148-161.

description: Frutex 2-metralis, ramulis juvenilibus dense antrorsusque strigosis; stipulis ovatis cuspidatis 8 x 3 mm striatis extus dense minuteque strigillosis; foliis petiolatis; petiolis 8-15 mm longis dense minuteque strigillosis; laminis lanceolato-oblongis apice gradatim obtuse acuminatis basi cuneatis decur- rentibusque 14-19 x 3-7.5 cm supra moderatim minuteque adpresso-pubescentibus subtus praesertim costa media nervisque magis dense adpresso-pubescentibus; floribus terminalibus solitariis vel duobus sessilibus; calycis tubo cylindrico 14-17 x 2.5 mm dense antrorsus strigoso, lobis quinque lineari- setaceis 12-14 x 1-1.5 mm extus dense intus minus strigosis; corolla alba hypocrateriformi-infundi- buliformi usque 9 cm longa, tubo 4-4.5 cm longo prope faucem 10 mm lato ceterum 5 mm lato extus praeter partem inferiorem 10-20 mm glabram vel sparsim puberulam moderate minuteque adpresso- puberulo intus sine annulo sed orificio dense villoso atque parte suprema 10 mm dense adpresso deinde deorsum glabro; lobis quinque late lanceolatis caudatis 25-42 x 8-12 mm, caudis 8-15 mm longis, extus modice adpresso-pubescentibus intus praeter basin villosum glabris; antheris linearibus 5.5 mm longis; stylo 32 mm longo glabro, stigmatibus spathulatis 4-6 mm longis.

description: Herba perennis erecta 10-20 cm alta, gracilis simplex glabra, pallide vinoso-ferruginea, radicibus solitariis tuberoso-incrassatis 20-27 mm longis et 4-7 mm diam. descendentibus, foliis radicalibus fugacibus hysteranthis, caulibus gracilibus usque ad 1 mm diam. bracteis (5) 7-8 vaginantibus scariosis instructis, spicis laxis 25-50 mm longis, 6-8 mm diam., bracteis floriferis scariosis acuminatis 5-7 mm longis. Flores (3) 4-8 (9), inter se distantes (ad 9 mm) secundi vel in spiram laxam contorti, ovario erecto 2-4 mm longo, 1.5-2.0 mm diam., perianthio horizontali vel leviter ascendenti, sepalis et petalis pallide vinoso-ferrugineis, nervis virido-luteis ferruginescentibus labello albo, in centro viridi-lutescenti nervis viridio-luteis instructo, ferruginascentibus, sepalis lateralibus 4 mm longis, 1 mm latis, lanceolatis acutis uninerviis, sepalo dorsali 5 mm longo 1.5 mm lato lanceolato acuto uninervi, petalis 4 mm longis 1 mm latis lanceolatis subacutis uninerviis, labello 4 mm longo 2.5 mm lato membranaceo vel in centro laminae succulento ovato obtuso prope basin dilatato, nervis lateralibus patenti-ramosis, tuberculis basalibus humilibus rotundatis obscuris, rostelli rostro brevi, seminibus ellipsoideis vel fusiformibus saepe tortilibus, monoembryonatis. Folia matura ignota.

description: Slender erect perennial herb, wholly glabrous, 10-20 cm tall. Root solitary, tuberously thickened, 20-27 mm long, 4-7 mm thick, descending. Leaves appearing after anthesis, fugaceous, wholly basal. Stem and inflorescence pale vinaceous-rust. Stem slender, to 1 mm thick, bearing (5) 7-8 loosely sheathing scarious bracts 8-18 mm long. Spike lax, 25-50 mm long, 6-8 mm in diameter. Floral bracts scarious, ovate, acuminate, 5-7 mm long. Flowers (3) 4-8 (9), spaced to 9 mm apart, in a loose spiral to nearly secund; ovary erect, 2-4 mm long, 1.5-2 mm in diameter; perianth horizontal to slightly ascending; sepals and petals pale vinaceous-rust, striped with vinaceous-rust; lip white, becoming green-yellow centrally, veined with green-yellow, the veins becoming rust. Lateral sepals 4 mm long, 1 mm wide, lanceolate, acute, 1-nerved; dorsal sepal 5 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, lanceolate, acute, 1-nerved. Petals 4 mm long, 1 mm wide, lanceolate, acutish, but with the very tip blunt, 1-nerved. Lip 4 mm long, 2.5 mm wide, membranaceous to fleshy centrally, ovate, obtuse, somewhat dilated basally, with dendritic venation; basal calli low, rounded, obscure. Rostellum with a short beak. Seeds ellipsoidal to fusiform, often spiralled or contorted, monoembryonic. Mature leaves unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Sheviak, Charles J. & Bye, R. A. 1980. Spiranthes dendroneura (Orchidaceae), a new species from Chihuahua. Brittonia. 32: 368-371.

description: Herba erecta, inferne glabra, supeme trichomatibus capitatis copiose obsita. Radices tuberosoincrassatae. Folia basalia lineari-lanceolata, in fructuum maturitatem persistentia. Flores 7.5-15 mm longi, leviter cumarino-aromatici, albi vel ebumei, labelli parte centrali saepe flava. Sepala libera vel ad basim connata, lateralia late patentia vel laxe incurva vel appressa, lineari-lanceolata acuminata. Labellum ovatum, lanceolatum vel oblongum 7-12 x 2.5-6.8 mm, ad medium constrictum et interdum subpanduratum.
bibliographicCitation: Sheviak, Charles J. 1984. Spiranthes diluvialis (Orchidaceae), a new species from the western United States. Brittonia. 36: 8-14.

description: Herb, erect, slender to stout, 20-50 cm tall, glabrous below, pubescent above with numerous capitate trichomes. Roots tuberously thickened, up to 1 cm in diam. Leaves linear-lanceolate, the larger to 28 x 1.5 cm, basal, usually restricted to the very base of the stem and rapidly reduced upward to sheathing bracts, persisting past anthesis. Spike dense, 3-15 x 1.2-2.5 cm. Floral bracts ovate, attenuate or acuminate, the lower 9-33 mm long. Flowers 7.5-15 mm long, faintly fragrant with the scent of coumarin, white or ivory, the lip often yellow centrally. Sepals free or connate at the base, the dorsal lanceolate, acute, the lateral broadly spreading to loosely incurved or appressed, linear-lanceolate, acuminate. Petals connivent with the dorsal sepal, linear, acuminate. Lip 7-12 x 2.5-6.8 mm, ovate, lanceolate, or oblong, with a median constriction and occasionally subpandurate, the margin entire or dentate toward the apex, crisped, the basal calli prominent, pubescent. Seeds ellipsoidal, monoembryonic.
bibliographicCitation: Sheviak, Charles J. 1984. Spiranthes diluvialis (Orchidaceae), a new species from the western United States. Brittonia. 36: 8-14.

description: Planta annua, 18-28 cm. alta, saepe ramosa; foliis ovatis, circiter 1.2-2.2 cm. longis, obtusis vel subacutis, ad basim cordatis, sessilibus, glabris exceptis mar- ginibus ciliatis; infloreseentia terminali paniculis sparsifloris; pedicellis gracil- limis, 2 mim. longis, pubescentibus, calyce fructifero hirsuto lineato, 4.5 mm. longo, lobis 2.5 mm. longis, lanceolato-acuminatis, subglabris exceptis marginibus ciliatis; perianthii tubo 7 mm. longo; seminibus 1.5 mm. longis, 0.6 mm. latis.

description: Annual, stems 18-28 cm. tall, pubescent, unbranched or with a few branches above; leaves ovate, often broadly so, 1.2-2.2 cm. long, 0.5-1.2 cm. broad, obtuse to subacute, subentire to entire, cordate at base, sessile, glandular-punctate, gla- brous except the margin sparsely long hirsute-ciliate; flowers in terminal inter- rupted spikelike panicles, 5-10 cm. long, pubescent, the subtending leaves broadly ovate, obtuse at apex, cordate to obtuse at base, glabrous except the margin con- spicuously sparsely long hirsute-ciliate, usually conspicuously purplish; bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 5 ? mm. long, glabrous, purple, the margin conspicuously sparsely long hirsute-ciliate; pedicel 2 mm. long, slender, pubescent; calyx yellow- ish-green at base, purple above, becoming 7 mm. long, the tube glandular-punctate, finely puberulent and with five sparsely loncr-hirsute lines, 4.5 mm. long, the lobes about equal, 2.5 mm. long, lance-acuminate, subglabrous except the densely ciliate margin; corolla two-lipped, light lavender, the tube equaling the calyx, puberulent without, the lobes puberulent within, the throat hirsute, the upper lip obcordate, the lower lip 3-lobed; nutlets 0.6 mm. broad, 1.5 mm. long.

description: Planta annua, 1.5-2 dm. alta; ramis divaricatis ad basim, dense retrorsis- hirsutulis; foliis lanceolatis-ovatis, circa 1.7 cm. longis, 6 mm. latis, glabris, punctatis inconspicuis, subintegris vel sinuatis, crassis sparsis ciliatis ad basim, minimis ad apicem ramulorum; florum bracteis lineatis-lanceolatis, integris, glabris nisi crasse ciliatis, 5-7 mm. longis; bracteolis lineatis, 5-6 mm. longis, hispidulis, crasse ciliatis; infloreseentia terminali paniculis sparsifloris; pedicellis circa 2 mm. longis, dense retrorsis-hispidulis; calyce fructifero 6-7 mm. longo, constricto in medio, hispidulo, quinque eminentibus et decem paullo minus conspicuis costis munitie, glandulari inconspicue, costis crasse hirsutis; perianthii tubo 10 mm. longo; seminibus glaucis, 1.3 mm. longis, 0.7 mm. latis.

description: Annual, 1.5-2 dm. tall, widely branched from the base, densely retrorse-hir- sutulous; leaves broadly lanceolate, about 1.7 cm. long, 6 mm. broad or less, gla- brous, inconspicuously punctate, subentire to undulate, sparsely coarse ciliate especially toward the base, reduced in size toward the infloreseence; floral bracts narrowly lanceolate, entire, glabrous, coarse-ciliate entirely around the margin, 5-7 mm. long; bracteoles linear, 5-6 mm. long, hispidulous, coarse-ciliate; pedicel abQut 2 mm. long, densely retrorse-hispidulous; calyx 6-7 mm. long, centrally constricted, prominently 5-ribbed with 10 ribs only slightly less prominent, all the ribs coarsely hirsute below the constriction, the calyx otherwise finely his- pidulous, inconspicuously glandular, the lobes subequal, hispidulous, densely short-ciliate, about 2.5 mm. long, pale purplish; corolla pink-purple, about 10 mm. long, puberulent without, the tube and throat about 4.5 mm. long, the lower 3-lobed lip 5.5 mm. long, the upper notched lip somewhat shorter; nutlets plump, pointed below, rounded above, pale brown with a decided bloom, about 1.3 mm. long, 0.7 mm. broad.

description: Perennis, tenuis, 3-6 dim. alta; caule saepe rubello, et lateribus et angulis molliter pilosis, pilis longis; foliis lineari-lanceolatis, subsessilibus, crenato-serratis, 5-10 cm. longis, 1-2 cm. latis, molliter pubes- centibus, pilis appressis, apice acuto, basi cuneata; bracteis lineari- lanceolatis, folia fere superantibus; calyce molliter longipilosa, dense viscida, tubo 3 mm. longo; dentibus lanceolato-subulatis; corolla pur- purea, circa 1 cm. longa.

description: Stachys nuttallii auctores permulti, non Shuttlew. ex Bentham. Herba perennia, caulibus florentibus 50-150 cm altis, erectis aut decumbentibus, superne glanduloso-pubescentibus vel hispidis; caulium nodi ± barbati. Folia 4-12 cm longa atro-virentia, viva graveolentia, petiolo brevi vel subnullo, lamina ovata vel elliptic 4 cm lata, margine serrulata vel crenata. Inflorescentia racemosa interrupta 4-28 cm longa, verticillastris axillaribus 4-25, unoquoque 8-plurifloro. Calyx actinomorphus 3-4 mm longus, lobis 5 deltoideis vel acutis 0.8-2 mm longis. Corolla bilabiata 1-1.3 cm longa, labio superiori galeato inferiori trilobo lilacino- vel violaceo-lineato vel -maculato 5-6.5 mm longo. Mericarpia obovoidea 1.7-2 mm longa, 1.8 mm lata.

description: Perennial herb, the flowering stems (56) 85-147 cm tall, erect or sprawling, unbranched or branched towards base; lower stems generally glabrous or pusticulate with crusty, swollen hairs, the upper stems glandular-pubescent to hispid; stem angles often reddish, generally hispid with retrorse, jointed trichomes; stem nodes somewhat bearded. Leaves 6.5-12.5 cm long, 3.6 cm wide, dark green, short- petioled to nearly sessile, rank-smelling when fresh; blade ovate to elliptical, the apex acuminate, the margins finely serrulate or crenate with rounded teeth, 5-8 per cm, the base rounded to slightly cordate, the upper surface canescent to distinctly scabrous, the lower surface nearly always copiously glandular-pubescent, the veins bristly. Inflorescence an interrupted raceme 12 (4-28) cm long, with 12 (4-25) axillary verticils, each usually 8- or more flowered, each verticil subtended by two pubescent, foliose bracts. Calyx actinomorphic, 3.5-4.5 mm long, the five deltoid to acute lobes 0.8-2 mm long, each with a short, glabrous, terminal awn, often with ciliate margins; calyx surface sometimes reddish, glandular to hispid; each calyx subtended by a pair of minute, bristly bracteoles. Corolla 1.1-1.3 cm long, two- lipped, the upper lip galeate and pubescent, the lower lip glabrous, 5-6.5 mm long, three-lobed, white with purple or lavender spots and lines. Mericarps 1.7-2 mm wide, dark brown, widely obovoid, the entire surface finely reticulate to irregularly bumpy, the outer surface sometimes scarified.
