description: Liana, or shrub with scandent branches; branchlets einereous, slender, often lenticellate; leaves opposite or subopposite, the petioles stout, rugose, 7-14 mm. long, the leaf-blades coriaceous or thin-cori- aceous, dark brown when dried, elliptic- or obovate-oblong, 7-14 em. long, 4-7.5 cm. broad, rounded to obtuse at base, cuspidate or abruptly short-acuminate at apex (acumen up to 7 mm. long, often callose and obtuse at apex), entire and slightly thickened at margins, the costa raised above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves 5-9 per side, spreading, ascending toward margins and inconspicuously anastomos- ing, faintly prominulous or essentially plane above, conspicuously elevated beneath, the veinlets reticulate, immersed above, prominulous or essentially plane beneath; infloreseence 1.5-5 cm. long at anthesis, thyrsoid-paniculate, often divided to base, the branchlets slender, alternate or subopposite, each subtended by a papyraceous ovate acute bract about 1 mm. long; flowers congested or loosely arranged in clusters of 3-6, each subtended by 2 or 3 minute inconspicuous brac- teoles, 1.5-2 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the pedicels slender, 0.7-1.5 mm. long; sepals thin-coriaceous, ovate-deltoid, 0.5-0.8 mm. long, 0.8- 1.2 mm. broad, obtuse at apex, seariose and obscurely erosulous at margins; petals erect, thin-carnose, obovate-oblong, 1.5-2 mm. long, 1-1.3 mm. broad, seariose and subentire or faintly erosulous at mar- gins; disk membranous, 0.3-0.4 mm. high, 1-1.3 mm. in diameter, undulate at margin; filaments 0.5-0.6 mm. long; anther-locules about 0.3 mm. long, dehiscing by vertical extrorse-lateral clefts, the connective acute, conspicuously produced about 0.2 mm. beyond locules; ovary about 0.6 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the style 0.2-0.3 mm. long; ovules 2 per locule, collateral.

description: Liana, the branches stout, the branchlets slender, often pale-setulose when young, at length glabrous, papillose or scabrous, usually obseurely so; petioles subterete, flattened above, resemblinlg branchlets in pubescence (usually glabrous) and scabrous, 4-10 mm. long, the leaf-blades chartaceous or thin-coriaceous, minutely papillose and scabrous on both surfaces, glabrous, greenish or olivaceous when dried, ovate-oblong or elliptic-oblong, (4-)7-14(-20) cm. long (2-)4-7(-8.5) cm. broad, rounded or lightly cordate at base, bluntly short-acuminate or cuspidate at apex (acumen 3-8 mm. long), entire and often nar- rowly revolute at margins, the costa sharply elevated above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves 5-7 per side, aseendinig or arcuate-ascending, prominulous above, prominent beneath, the veinlets copiously reticulate, prominulous on both surfaces or nearly plane above; inflorescence 4-10 cm. long, pseudodichotomously 4-6-times branched, the peduncle 2.5-6 cm. long, the bracts papyraceous, oblong-deltoid, 1-2 mm. long, acute, the branchlets often closely pale-puberulent when young, at length glabrous and obscurely scabrous; flowers 9-12 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the pedicels puberulent when young, 3-7 mm. long, often bibracteolate near base; sepals and petals minutely and closely puberulent oni both surfaces, the sepals thin-coriaceous or carnose, 1.7-3 mm. long and broad, subacute to rounded at apex, irregularly erosulous toward apical margins, occasionally up to 5 mm. long and broad and conspicuously erose at anthesis; petals membranous, broadly spatulate, 4-5 mm. long and broad, rounded at apex, sharply reduced to a short claw at base, deeply and irregularly pectinate-erose at margins; disk 6-6.5 mm. in diameter, extending about 1 mm. beyond the petal-bases, about 0.5 mm. thick; embryoniferous portion of seed ovoid, at maturity to 14 mm. long and 8 mm. broad, the wing elliptic or obovate, slightly falcate, often glandular-variegated, at maturity to 6 cm. long and 3 cm. broad.

description: Liana, glabrous, branches terete, lenticellate, smooth, with seasonal growth marked by scale-like cataphylls. Leaves opposite or some subopposite, stipules 0.3-0.9 mm long, caducous, triangular, apiculate, minutely erose, basally toothed; petiole 0.2-0.5 cm, canaliculate; blade (0.9-)2.4-4.9(-8.7) X (0.3-)1.1-3.1(-4.5) cm, elliptic, ovate or broadly obovate, coriaceous, the base rounded or cuneate, the apex acute (rarely rounded), the margin entire or dentate along the distal one-half or one-quarter, thickened, the venation brochidodromous with veins prominent on both sides. Inflorescence paniculate-corymbose, (1.6-)2.8-4.8 X (0.5-)1.6-3.5(-4.1) cm, with 31-62 flowers, axillary, often aggregated at leafless nodes; bracts 0.7-1.5 mm long, opposite or subopposite at nodes, triangular, the margin minutely erose, basally toothed; peduncle (1-)1.3-1.8(-2.5) cm long, flattened; branches opposite or subopposite; pedicels 1.3-3 mm long, cylindric; bracteoles 2, at base of pedicel, triangular, ca. 0.3 mm long. Flowers yellowish, scentless (J. S. Sobrinho 323), actinomorphic, 2.1-2.3(-3.5) mm wide at anthesis; sepals 5, 0.9-1.1 X 0.9-1.3 mm, triangular, membranous, hyaline, the margin minutely denticulate; petals 5, 1.5-1.8 X 1.4-1.6 mm, elliptic, ovate or subrhombic, obtuse, basally carnose, spreading at anthesis, the margin minutely erose; disc 0.15-0.2 X 0.3 mm, carnose, annular, flattened, pentagonal, angles slightly projecting and alternating with petals; stamens (2-)3, 0.6-1 mm long, in newly opened flowers appressed to gynoecium, in older ones the apex deflexed, filaments flattened, enlarged at base, the anthers oblong, 0.2-0.3 X 0.3-0.4 mm, dorsifixed, extrorse, the locules dehiscing transversely by confluent slits; ovary 3-lobed, 3-locular, with 6 axillary ovules in each locule; style ca. 0.3 mm long, central, cylindric; stigmas obscure or inconspicuously 3-lobed. Fruit and seeds not seen.

description: Arbor. Ramuli foliosi 3-7 mm crassi, appresse puberuli. Lamina integra, elliptica vel obovata vel suboblonga vel subobovata, 5-19 cm longa, 3-14.5 cm lata, coriacea, breviter acuminata vel rotundata, basi acuta vel obtusa, subtus substrigosa vel ad venas majores appresse puberula, ad areolas et venas minores pilis albis arachnoideis instructa; venae laterales pro latere 6-10, par basale vel paria basalia ramosa; petiolus 1-6.5 cm longus; stipulae 2-8 cm longae, caducae, appresse pallide flavo-puberulae. description: Trees up to 15 m tall. Leafy twigs 3-7 mm thick, sparsely puberulous with minute appressed pale yellow to whitish hairs. Lamina entire, elliptic to obovate, sometimes to oblong or subobovate, 5-19 cm long, 3-14.5 cm wide, coriaceous, apex shortly acuminate to rounded, base acute to rounded, margin entire; upper surface smooth, with sparse appressed hairs on the midrib, lower surface with sparse to rather dense pale yellow appressed hairs on the main veins, sparsely appressed-puberulous on the smaller veins, in the areoles white arachnoid hairs; above midrib prominent, lateral veins plane to slightly impressed, beneath midrib and lateral veins prominent, the other veins almost plane; lateral veins 6-10, basal pair branched, often also the next pairs; petiole 1-6.5 cm long, with sparse appressed hairs; stipules 2-8 cm long, caducous, outside pale yellow-appressed puberulous, inside glabrous. Pistillate inflorescences branched; peduncle 3-7 cm long, like the branches and pedicels pale yellow-appressed-puberulous to subsericeous; flowers 7-12, fruiting pedicel 2-10 (20) mm long; perianth ca 3 mm long, pale yellow-subsericeous; stigma peltate, 3-4 mm diameter, lobed. Fruiting perianth oblongoid to subovoid, ca 1.8 cm long, with sparse appressed hairs, at maturity maroon.

description: Herba 3 m usque alta, fere glabra. Folia parva, foliolis 3-5; laminae oblanceolato-ellipticae, illae foliolorum mediorum 4-8 X 1-3 cm. Racemi 6-16 cm longi; flores zygomorphi rubri (unde nomen specificutn), pedicellis angulo fere recto divergentibus (fructu demum pendulo); bracteae paucae folliis caulinis similes vel multae minimae per rhachim dispersae. Sepala libera late ovata vel ovato-oblonga, 6-10 mm longa. Petala obovato-elliptica vel oblonga, (7) 9-12 mm longa. Flores d: stamina exserta ad apicem androgynophori 14-17 mm longi affixa, filamentis 9-18 mm longis. Flores 9: ovarium a latere compressum, 10-15 mm longum, gynophoro 6-11 mm longo. description: Erect herbs to 3 m tall, glabrous throughout except for minute papillate puberulence on leaves, youngest shoots, and pedicels; stems slender, simple or few-branched, usually suffrutescent, faintly longitudinally striate, green. Leaves 3- to 5-foliolate, comparatively small; petioles slender, 3-12 cm long, glabrous; leaflets uniform in size and shape, membranous, oblanceolate-elliptic, acuminate to subcaudate-acuminate at apex, cuneate, tapering into a short (1-4 mm) petiolule, the central blades 4.1-8.5 x 1.1-2.6 cm; midrib and 7-10 pairs of lateral nerves prominent beneath, very sparsely and (under strong lens) minutely glandular-papillate; blade glabrous beneath, minutely papillate-puberulent above. Racemes erect, 6.3-16.3 cm long, loosely 24-82-flowered; floriferous portion (rhachis) to 14.1 cm long, the lower sterile portion (peduncle) 1.1-5.6 cm long. Pedicels 9-16 mm long, glandular-papillate and glabrescent, in flower spreading at ?90? from the axis, downcurved in ripe fruit. Bracts unifoliolate or the lowermost 1 or 2 usually 3-foliolate, elliptic or if reduced lanceolate-elliptic, few (1-4) and leafy, similar to the upper cauline leaves but smaller and short-petiolate (Mori & Bolten 7420), or numerous (ca 10-27), and the uppermost rudimentary, sometimes borne irregularly scattered or at intervals along the axis (Pittier 880). Sepals free to base, firmly herbaceous, bright red, ovate to ovate-lanceolate or ovate-oblong, 6-10 X 2-5 mm, acute, the lower (abaxial) longer than the others, the upper with a + auriculate base, minutely glandular-papillate in region of midrib. Petals red, obovate-elliptic to oblong, (7) 9-12 X (2) 3-6 mm, obtuse at apex, sessile, almost equal in size and shape, the upper (adaxial) slightly smaller than the lateral (abaxial) pair, the margins (at least in fresh flowers) undulate. Nectary a massive fleshy adaxial gland, 3.9-4.3 mm high, 4.8-5.4 mm wide, 2.4 mm thick, broadly to transversely depressed-trulloid, with 3 low rounded lobes alternating with the petals. Staminate flowers: stamens exserted, normally all fertile and equal in length, the median or lateral pair occasionally markedly smaller (or even aborted?); filaments upcurved in the expanded flower, 9-18 mm long; anthers 3.4-4.2 mm long; androgynophore 14-17 mm long. Pistillate flowers: ovary narrowly oblong-cylindric, laterally compressed, 10-15 mm long, 1-2 (3) mm wide, glabrous; stigma capitellate, inconspicuously bilobed, ca 1 mm in diameter, sessile; gynophore 6-11 mm long; androgynophore 9-19 mm long. Fruits (only half-ripened ones seen) slenderly cylindric, often slightly curved, 5-9 cm long, 3-5 mm thick, attenuate at both ends, at first spreading, finally drooping; valves glabrous, longitudinally striate by several anastomosing nerves; stigma barely differentiated from the style; gynophore 7-11 mm long; androgynophore 12-15 mm long; pedicel 13-19 mm long. Mature seeds unknown. Chromosome number, n = 29.

description: Branched, rather strict annuals, (8-) 15-30 (-40) cm tall, densely glandular-viscid throughout; petioles 1-17 mm long; leaflets linear to linear-elliptic, 5-40 mm long, 0.5-4.0 mm wide, somewhat fleshy, conduplicate, acute, mucronulate; racemes open, 3-10 (-18) cm long, few-flowered (each with 5-9 open flowers and buds) ; bracts 3-foliolate; sepals lanceolate, entire, acute to obtuse, 1.5-2.5 (-3.0) mm long, erect at anthesis; petals spatulate with slender claw, white to yellowish-white, strongly dimorphic, the larger pair 4-5 mm long, emarginate and shallowly laciniate with 3-6 lobes, the smaller 2-3 mm long, more deeply laciniate; stamens 6-9, pink, the filaments 3-5 mm long; anthers 0.5-1.0 mm long, apiculate; nectary tubular, irregularly toothed and somewhat flaring at the apex, with a deep cleft on the abaxial side, 2.0-3.5 mm long, 0.5 mm in diameter, yellow, drying pink-purple; siliques linear-fusiform, slightly inflated, 10-25 (-32) mm long, 3-4 mm wide, the valves dehiscing nearly to the base; style 0.5-2.0 mm long, persistent in fruit, the stigma minute; gynophore 2.0-4.5 mm long; pedicel 8-9 mm long; seeds 4-18 in each silique, subspherical, 1.7-1.8 mm long, bright reddish-brown, evenly pebbled with shiny, inflated cells, the internal invagination of the testa rather deep (half of the seed diameter).

description: Slender to robust annual herbs from a slender tap root, or (in Mexico and adjoiniing U. description: Shrubs or small trees, to 8 m tall, the younger twigs striate when dried. Leaf blades narrowly ovate or elliptic to narrowly elliptic, 4.5-10.5 X 1.5-4 cm, chartaceous, with 7-11 pairs of lateral veins, the midrib salient below, canaliculate above, the lower orders of venation more or less salient on both sides; apex long acuminate to attenuate, the acumen 1-2 cm long, infrequently articulate with the blade; base acute to obtuse, narrowly decurrent onto the petiole; margins mostly entire, less commonly serrate on the upper one-half, with up to 9 teeth per side. Petioles 5-12 mm long, canaliculate above. Stipules triangular, 0.8 X 0.5 mm. Inflorescences usually branched, arising at the base of the acumen to 2 cm below the base of the acumen, the flowers frequently in cymose clusters at the ends of naked stalks, the rachis (3) 5-20 mm long, the bracts not imbricate, the pedicels 1-2.2 (9) mm long. Flowers 2-3 mm diam.; sepals triangular, ca. 0.3 X 0.3 mm; petals triangular, 0.8-1.1 X 0.7-0.8 mm, greenish-yellow; filaments 0.3 mm long, the anthers + globose, 0.2 mm long; ovary with 6-8 ovules, the hypanthium longer than broad, the style 0.2 mm long. Berry globose, 5 mm diam. Seeds 6-8 per fruit, oblong, 1.5-2 X 1 mm.

description: Shrubs or small trees to 6 m tall, frequently epiphytic, the younger twigs sulcate when living, appearing narrowly winged when dried. Leaf bpades mostly elliptic, 3.2-7.7 X 1.1-2.9 cm, glabrous, cl coriaceous, with 7-14 pairs of lateral veins, the midrib salient below, canaliculate above, the lower orders of venation salient below, impressed above; apex narrowly acuminate to very long attenuate, the acumen 0.5-2.5 cm long, never articulate with the blade; base acute to cuneate or obtuse, narrowly decurrent onto the petiole; margins distinctly serrate, with 2-11 mucronate teeth on each side. Petioles 9-18 mm long, narrowly and deeply canaliculate. Stipules triangular, 1.5 X 1 mm. Inflorescences racemose, arising from near the middle of the blade to the base of or on the acumen, with 1-2 separate rachises in a cluster, the rachis squamose, 2-5 mm long, with the flowers tightly congested, the pedicels 0.4-2.0 mm long, subtended by a very broadly ovate bract with fimbriate margins, the fimbriae obscured with age. Berry globose to depressed-globose, 3-4.5 X 3.5-5 mm. Seeds ca. 6 per fruit, oblong, 1.8-2.7 X 0.8-1.0 mm.

description: Shrubs or small trees, to 15 m tall, the younger twigs striate when dried. description: Epiphyte or terrestrial scandent subshrub, rooted in thick moss layer; stems terete, striate, glabrous; bark cracking longitudinally, rooting apparently where in contact with soil substrate. Leaves coriaceous, bullate when fresh, elliptic-lanceolate, 11-15 X 3.5-4.5 cm, basally cuneate, apically short-acuminate, marginally entire, glabrous; 3-plinerved from ca. 1 cm above base, lateral nerves running close to margin for entire length, therefore leaves nearly appearing pinnate, midrib raised proximal 3/4 the length then plane to weakly impressed distally above, raised and conspicuous beneath, lateral nerves plane to slightly impressed above but conspicuously raised beneath, reticulate veinlets raised on both surfaces and conspicuous beneath; petiole subterete, rugose, 6-10 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescence axillary, short-racemose, 2-3- flowered; rachis terete, glabrous, thin, ca. 5 mm long; floral bract and bracteoles (nearly basal) ovate, sharply acuminate, ca. 1 mm long, marginally glandular fimbriate proximally, the fimbriae often fused in the bracteoles; pedicel terete to subterete, striate, 13 mm long when fresh but 7-8 mm long when dry, glabrous, dark red when fresh. Flowers glabrous, calyx when fresh: rose-red to dark red, ca. 10.5 mm long, the hypanthium ca. 8 mm long, the limb ca. 2.5 mm long, the lobes ca. 1 mm long; calyx when dry: ca. 5 mm long, the hypanthium obconic, ca. 3.5-4 mm long, the limb campanulate, ca. 1-1.5 mm long, the lobes broadly triangular, ca. 0.5 mm long; calyx lobes marginally with 2-3 glandular fimbriae per side; sinuses broadly rounded; corolla cylindric-turbinate, cylindric-patent from the base then greatly engorged (gibbous) just below the middle then distally narrowing to throat; corolla when fresh: 13-15 mm long and 12-13 mm diam. at broadest point narrowing to ca. 5 mm diam. at throat, dark pink to violet in lower half and white distally, the lobes oblong-triangular, acute, ca. 1.5 mm long, spreading and reflexed; corolla when dry: 8-9 mm long and 6-7 mm diam. at broadest part, black; stamens 10, ca. 6.5 mm long; filaments marginally short-pilose, ca. 1.5 mm long, without spurs; anthers 5.5 mm long, strongly incurved at base; thecae ca. 3.5 mm long; tubules dehiscing more or less latrorsely by oval slits ca. 1.5 mm long that do not extend to tip of tubule; style about as long as corolla, glabrous, inserted. Leaves (1) 2-3-jugate, large, (25.6) 30.8-37 (40.5) cm long; petiole 6.2-10.6 (13.2) cm x 2.5-3.7 (4.4) mm; interjuga (2.5) 3.8-6 cm long, petiole and rachis glabrous, black when dry, with exfoliating epi- dermis; petiolules long, lateral ones 0.5-1.2 (1.5) cm long, terminal one 1.5-2.9 cm long; leaflets markedly coriaceous, broadly to narrowly elliptic, basal pair 12-16.5 (20) x 3.8-6.3 cm, ultimate pair (13) 16.6-19 (22.7) x (3.9) 4.9-6.3 cm, terminal (13) 15-19 x (4.1) 5.3-6.8 cm, base of lateral leaflets oblique, proximal side acute to obtuse, dis- tal side obtuse to truncate, all with apex broadly acuminate, acumen 0.5-0.9 cm; secondary veins 20-30; abaxial surface gla- brous, midvein acutely prominent and secondary veins broadly prominulous, adaxial surface glabrous or with scattered appressed hairs to 0.1 mm long along midvein, mid- vein broad and obtusely prominulous and secondary veins flat but broad and pallid when dry. Panicles subterminal on short shoots, long, 4.5-12 cm x 0.7-2.3 mm, of ten exceeding the petiole; secondary axes well-developed, 0.4-6.2 cm long, tertiary axes often developed, all axes with dense to sparse, erect to ascending hairs 0.05 mm long; bracts on primary axis ovate to broadly lanceolate, fleshy, acute, 0.75-1.15 mm long, those on secondary and tertiary axes ovate to lanceolate, membranous, 0.35-0.6 (0.75) mm long; pedicel terete, 2-3 cm x 0.3-0.4 mm, glabrous on the distal 2/3 of its length. Flowers functionally unisexual, dimorphic, 4-merous, small, 2-3 mm long overall; calyx shallowly cupular, the lobes broadly depressed-deltate and obtusely apiculate or calyx often undulate and lobes indistinct, glabrous except margin with erect translucent hairs to 0.05 mm long and lobes short-papillate apically; petals broadly lanceolate to ovate, slightly carinate, apex acute with strongly inflexed apiculum up to 0.3 mm long, abaxial surface with scattered ap- pressed hairs to 0.05 mm long, papillate apically, adaxial surface short-papillate, the margin long-papillate and provided with spreading acute translucent hairs to 0.15 mm long; stamens 8; staminateflowers with ca- lyx 0.5 x 1.3-1.5 mm overall, lobes to 0.2 mm long; petals 2.9-3.2 x 1.2-1.5 mm; an- tepetalous stamens 1.55 mm long and antesepalous ones 1.8 mm long, filaments narrowly triangular in dorsiventral view, anthers basifixed, the dorsiventral view narrow-lanceolate with lobulate base and acute apex, the lateral profile obliquely lanceolate, 0.75 mm long; disk level with base of stylode, 0.15-0.2 mm high x 0.2-0.25 mm thick; pistillode globose, 0.7 x 0.5 mm overall, glabrous, provided with locules and reduced ovules, abruptly contracted to a stylode 0.35 mm long, sharply 5-winged at the capitate, truncate apex; pistillate flowers with calyx 0.7 x 1.5-1.7 mm overall, lobes 0.3 mm long; petals 2.7 x 1.1-1.2 mm; staminodes reaching base of style, 1-1. 1 and 1.1-1.25 mm long, rudimentary anthers in dorsiventral view broadly lanceolate to oblong with lobulate base, the lateral profile narrowly lanceolate with apex often mucronate due to prolongation of connective, 0.45 mm long; disk low and broad, 0.2-0.25 mm high x 0.25-0.3 mm thick; pistil 1.5-1.55 x 0.65-0.7 mm overall, substipitate, ovoid, glabrous, contracted to a long style 0.75 mm long, stigmatal region 0.2-0.25 mm high, stigmas lateral, globose, sessile. In fruit in- florescence 3-3.3 mm diam. at base, pedicel 2.1-3.5 x 0.8-1 mm; maturing fruits red to reddish-black or purplish, ovary substipi- tate, globose, 1-1.1 x 1-1.2 cm, apex broadly short-acuminate and slightly excentric, surface glabrous, glossy, smooth (wrinkled when dry); arillate structure on pyrene not observed; pyrene thickly cartilaginous, the dorsiventral view broadly obovate to orbicular with obtuse base and abruptly short-acuminate apex, the lateral profile on dorsal side semi-obovate with acute base and obtuse apex, on ventral side semi-ovate with obtuse base and acuminate apex, apex  trigonous due to two lateral subapical depressions on ventral surface, surface with dense layer of suberect fibers to 0.3 mm long except for a broadly rounded-obtriangular area on central 1/2 of ventral surface; testa with some irregular thickening but not infolded with cotyledons and for the most part easily removed from the embryo; cotyle- dons with some lobing but not contortuplicate, in lateral longitudinal section slightly incurved distally, ventral cotyledon larger and distally thickened.

description: Large trees 15-35 m tall; tabular buttresses to ca. 1.5-2 m tall, 40 cm wide (Fig. 3); trunk above buttresses straight, 0.4-0.8 m diam.; crown open, spreading, and rather flat-topped (Williams & Standley, 1952: 142; Allen, 1956: 288). Bark gray or whitish, exfoliating in irregular plates or with scales or quadrangular cracks to 10 X 1.5 cm (Hammel & Grayum 17697); sapwood and heartwood hard and light brown in color (Allen, 1956: 291). Leaf blades 6-14 X 2.5-7.5 cm, ovate, ovate-lanceolate, or slightly obovate, the apices acute, shortly acuminate, or long acuminate, the margin entire or slightly undulate, the bases cordate, asymmetrical, glabrescent above (at maturity?) or obscurely pubescent with scattered, minute stellate hairs, pubescent below with simple, bifurcate and 4-8-rayed stellate hairs with the rays ascending or ap- pressed (immature leaves?), or 8-rayed stel- late hairs with the rays appressed (mature leaves?), soft to the touch, 3-5-nerved at the base, coriaceous; petioles 1.5-3.5 cm long, pubescent with erect simple or stellate hairs with appressed rays, slightly thick- ened at both ends; stipular sheaths more or less falcate, ca. 6-7 X 2 mm, the margin more or less entire to erose, extrorsely densely pubescent with long, simple, ap- pressed hairs. Inflorescences terminal or subterminal on leafy branches, paniculate, densely pubescent with appressed stellate hairs. Flower buds gray to pink (Hammel & Grayum 17697), obovoid to pyriform. Epi- calyx minutely pubescent with stellate hairs with either short spreading rays or long antrorse rays. Calyx campanulate (known only in young bud). Mature petals not seen. Staminal tube divided into 5 alternisepalous phalanges, each of ca. 12-15 stamens, mature filaments not seen. Ovary more or less ovoid, glabrous (?); style distally pubescent; stigma obscurely bipartite (appearing 5-lobed in bud, at least, from impressions created by other floral parts). Calyx in fruit 3-3.5 cm long, pinkish to reddish brown, stellate-pubescent with a surface of minute stellate hairs with spreading and appressed rays and larger stellate hairs with 0.5-1 mm long clustered and appressed, antrorse rays, free sepal lobes narrowly oblanceolate or spatulate, 1.5-2.5 cm long, 4-6 mm broad; fruit ca. 8-10 X 4-5 mm, pericarp ellipsoidal, with appressed hairs; seeds light brown, with darker raphe and chalazal region; testa thin; endosperm evidently fleshy, copious, adjacent to thin, folded cotyledons.

description: Small evergreen herb to 30 cm, rhizome to 15 mm diameter, white to purple internally. Leafy shoots producing a dense clump, (1)-2-(3)-leaved, with deep maroon, glabrous basal sheaths ca. 2.5 X 6 cm; plane of distichy parallel to rhizome. Leaves to 40 cm in length, glabrous; petiole to 14-23 X 0.6 cm, maroon at base from distinct red pigmented cells, transitioning to green at apex, scattered with minute white spots, canaliculate, maroon throughout groove, margin membranous; ligule small, 3-4 mm in length, bilobed, becoming papery; blade 18- 20 X 9-12 cm, broadly elliptic, midrib prominent below, base subattenuate to slightly truncate, equal or subequal, apex apiculate and often papery, adaxial surface slightly darker green than abaxial. Infiores- cence terminal on leafy shoots, erect to 5.5 cm; peduncle 4-6 cm, glabrous, translucent with scattered maroon pigmented cells (appearing pink) at base fading to translucent green by first fertile bract; rachis inclined slightly at first fertile bract, continuing straight; inflorescence bracts 22-24 X 17-20 mm, distichous and densely imbricate, opening only to one side of rachis, deviating approximately 10-30º from vertical axis, glabrous, light green with maroon pigmented dots clustered near veins, apices acute; cincinni 7-8, containing 2-3 flowers of which 1-2 do not develop; flowers mature sequentially in waves from base to apex of inflorescence; bracteoles tubular, 19-25 X 8-17 mm, membranous, glabrous and transparent with maroon veins. Flowers conspicuous; calyx tubular, 11-13 mm long, trilobed and deeply cleft to ca. 7 mm abaxially, colorless with maroon pigmented dots; corolla tube 20-30 mm, translucent yellow, glabrous, trilobed with lobes 15-17 mm, reflexed, the two lobes nearest labellum often overlapping at anthesis; lateral staminodes 17-22 X 10 mm, obovate, spreading, glandular hairy throughout, lemon yellow with a linear dark red mark extending 1/3 to 1/2 the length of the lobe, following main veins; labellum 16-18 X 13- 16 mm, obovate, bilobed, cleft extending 7 mm, lemon yellow with darker yellow regions extending down lobes, glandular hairy along margins and down throat, lobes abaxially flared and slightly overlapping at the tips; fertile stamen with filament 4 mm long, yellow, glabrous, anther 5 X 3 mm, thecae parallel and encircling style, fertile throughout, densely glandular hairy throughout, crest extended less than 1 mm beyond thecae; ovary trilocular, 2-3 X 2 mm, glabrous, pale green, placentation axile; stigma cup-shaped, fringed with hairs; epigynous (stylodial) nectaries two, linear, 7 mm long, pale yellow. Fruits unknown.

description: Small tree, 4-6 m tall; trunk simple, cylindrical to 30 cm diam., unarmed or nearly so when old, the bark longitudinally fissured, rusty-brown; main branches cylin- drical, suberect to subhorizontally diverging, then arching, with a sooty dark brownish or rusty bark and areoles 2-5 mm in diam. and 2-4.5 cm apart, these provided with 10-30 sooty brown or blackish spreading spines to 3 cm long, often forming naked knob-like spur shoots 3-7 mm long on the oldest branches; branchlets with a grayish- brown to sooty brownish bark and 5-12 spines per areole; twigs 2-7(-1 0) mm thick, bright green when fresh, grayish or grayish- brown after periderm formation, with are- oles 1.5-3 mm in diam. and 4-15 mm apart, these semilunar to rounded, tufted when young with a cream-colored to dilute tawny  tomentum and provided with (1-)2(-6) acicular spines 6-21 mm long and 0.2-0.4 mm thick, grayish or dull reddish-brown to lusterless black, conically thickened at the base. Leaves subsessile, oblanceolate to lanceolate, (2-)3.5-7(-12) cm long, 0.7-2.8 cm broad, acuminate at apex, attenuate to narrowly cuneate at base, nearly flat with the margins straight or somewhat undulate, the blade bright green, rather thin and not very fleshy, the midrib slightly impressed above and very round-prominent for the whole length on the lower side, the lateral nerves 0-3(-5), scarcely evident on both surfaces, more often inconspicuous, departing at angle of about 40º-60º from the midrib, the longer ones finally ascending, sometimes forked and somewhat reticulate at end; the petiole nearly absent or scarcely 1 mm long. Flowers imperfectly unisexual, occurring on separate, functionally dioecious plants, solitary on branches and twigs and from lateral areoles and spur shoots, bright purplish  pink, perigon in bud spherical. Staminate flowers 2.5-5 cm in diam., the pedicels 3- 9 mm long, with 1 or 2 leaf-like bracts 2- 4.8 cm long and 1-2 cm broad; receptacle turbinate, 6-12 mm long, 8-12 mm in diam., bearing 3 or 4 leaf-like bracts, these obovoid or oblanceolate to lanceolate or narrowly elliptic, 1.3-3.7 cm long and 5-12 mm broad, acute to acuminate at apex, cuneate more or less narrowed at base, with the central nerve very conspicuous below and withvery small naked areoles at the axils, the areoles rarely bearing 1 or 2 spines to 8 mm long; perigon leaves 14-15, the sepaloids 3- 5, oblong to obovate, more or less fleshy, 8-22 mm long and 6-14 mm broad, 5-8 mm wide at base, obtuse to rounded at apex, greenish but often with the margins pink, to entirely purplish-pink and transitional to the petaloids, the petaloids 9-11, obovate to narrowly obovate, little exceeding the sepaloids in length, 14-24 mm long and 5-15 mm broad, attenuate to a certain degree and 2-4 mm wide at base, rounded to broadly emarginate or truncate at apex, the blade thin and delicate of a bright purplish-pink color; stamens numerous, almost two or three times shorter than the inner petaloids, 5-8.5 mm long, with the filaments pink and thread-like 3.5-7 mm long, the anthers oblong and translucent-pink (pollen creamy yellow), 1.2-1.8 mm long, 0.7-1 mm broad; style vestigial, shorter than the stamens and completely masked by them, scarcely 3-5 mm long and 0.6-1 mm thick, somewhat narrowed towards the tip and ending in several erect filiform "stigma lobes" lacking papillae. Pistillate flowers 2-3.7 cm in diam., the pedicels 3-7 mm long, with 1-4 leaf- like bracts 2-4 cm long and 0.7-1.5 cm broad; receptacle spheroidal to depressed spheroidal, 11-18 mm in diam., rather smooth, with 3-7 bracts similar in size and shape to the bracts of the staminate flowers; receptacular areoles very small and naked; receptacular rim 5-8 mm in diam., naked, without areoles and upper bracts; perigon leaves 12-20, the sepaloids 3-5, similar in shape, texture and color to the staminate sepaloids, but 7-12 mm long and 5-10 mm broad, the petaloids 9-15, very much like the staminate petaloids but also a little shorter, 11-17 mm long and 4-13 mm broad; stamens dwarfed, 1-2 mm long, sterile, inserted on the short-cylindrical receptacular rim which forms an open nectarial pit delimited by the flat ovary roof at the bottom; ovary inferior, the locule large, depressed, 6-10 mm in diam., with nearly flat bottom and ovary roof, the latter with conspicuous septal ridges below which the pa- rietal placentae are disposed; style short, 3- 4 mm long and 1.3-1.6 mm diam., cylindrical (circular in transverse section) and longitudinally striate, the striae thin and parallel; stigma lobes 8-12, 4-5 mm long, fingerlike, spreading or more often asymmetrically recurved, sometimes grouped in 2 or 3 irregular clusters. Floral parts above the ovary deciduous in early postfloral stage, exposing a characteristic umbilicus in fruits. Fruits pulpy, pendulous, depressed globose, 2-4.5 cm long and 2.5-5.5 cm broad, the pedicel 2-6 mm long and 2-3 mm in diam.; young fruits apically folded into pleats (um- bilicus rounded polygonal), bright green and 2- or 3-bracteate; bracts leaf-like, 1-3 cm long and 0.5-1.7 cm broad, dropping off at maturity; mature fruits smooth (umbilicus circular, more or less depressed and 0.7-1.6 cm in diam.), pale green, naked, the areoles inconspicuous; fruit wall 4-6 mm thick; loc- ule filled by the seeds and pulp formed by juicy hyaline gelatinous funicles. Seeds numerous, ca. 105-220 per fruit, obovate to subcircular, flattened, 3.5-4 mm long, 2.5- 3.2 mm broad and 1-1.2 mm thick, black, glossy (Fig. 1).

description: Vine; branchlets terete, conspicuously lenticellate, densely tomentose when young, puberulous or glabrescent when mature. Leaves imparipinnate, the leaflets 2- or 3-jugate; petiole 3.5-6.5 cm long, tomentose; rachis 4-6.8 cm long, tomentose; petiolule 2-4 mm long, appressed-ferruginous; leaflets coriaceous, ovate-elliptic, 3.5-7 cm long, 2.8-3.5 cm wide, rounded at the base, acuminate at the apex, the acumen 0.8-1 cm long and the tip itself emarginate, the upper surface glabrous except for the slightly pilose midrib, the lower surface strigose with scattered appressed trichomes arising from a dark, glandular, bulbous base, the midrib more densely strigose; venation strongly reticulate on both sides, the midrib impressed above, prominent below; lateral veins 12-18 pairs, anastomosing near the margin. Inflorescence racemose or paniculate, pseudoterminal, the rachis 6-7 cm long, densely ferruginous-tomentose; bracts on the base of the rachis lanceolate, 2.5-3 mm long, densely ferruginous-tomen- tose. Pedicels articulate, 3-4 mm long above the articulation, densely ferruginous- tomentose, the bract below the articulation lanceolate, 0.5 mm long. Sepals ovate, 3-4 mm long, 2-2.7 mm wide, densely ferru- ginous-tomentose on both surfaces, the apex acute, the margin ciliate; petals free, ovate, 2-3 mm long, 1 mm wide, sparsely pilose on both surfaces; stamens 10, connate at base, the shorter five 0.3-0.4 mm long, the longer five 0.5-0.7 mm long, the staminal tube 0.3 mm long, the filaments glabrous, the anthers globose; ovary hispidulous, with ferruginous hairs 0.7 mm long. Fruit not seen.

description: Shrub 1 m tall, branched from a sublig- neous base. Stem erect, quadrangular, branching, glabrous. Leaf blades elliptic, 15- 16 x 4.5-5 cm, firm, the upper surface smooth, glabrous, and drying olive green, the lower surface densely pilose and purplish, acuminate apically, attenuate basally, midvein sulcate above, convex below, lateral veins ca. 8 pairs or more, convex on both surfaces, the margins faintly and irregularly crenate; petiole 5-15 mm long, canaliculate, puberulous. Inflorescence cymose, terminal and axillary, once- or twice- dichasially branched, peduncles 1.5-6 cm long, conspicuously glandular pilose, the trichomes yellowish; basal bract linear, to 10 mm long, the others smaller, glandular pilose; pedicels of central flower 3 mm long, glandular pilose; bracteoles subulate, 2.5-3 x 0.4-0.5 mm, glandular pilose. Calyx deeply 5-lobed, the lobes linear, 10-14 x 0.5 mm, conspicuously glandular pilose, the trichomes yellowish; corolla white, 35-45 mm long, glabrous except upper part of corolla tube minutely pilose, limb suberect, lobes obovate, 7-8 x 6-8 mm, retuse apically; stamens included; anthers 3 mm long; pollen spheroidal, 63 µm diam., the reticulum homobrochate; ovary and style puberulent. Capsule narrowly ovate, 15 x 4 x 3 mm, pubescent, apiculate and tinged with red apically, the stipe 5 mm long. Seeds  2.5 x 2 mm, dark brown, glabrous, margin ringed by hygroscopic trichomes.

description: Suffruticose herb to 50 cm high; stems erect, markedly quadrangular. Leaves ovate, 2.5-3.3 cm long, 1.5 cm wide, acute or acuminate, cuneate to attenuate, puberulous. Flowers subsessile, solitary, sometimes in sessile or pedunculate dichasia reduced to 3 flowers, in the axils of the upper leaves; bractlets obovate, foliaceous, less than 1 cm long and 3-4 mm broad. Calyx ca 1 cm long with linear segments 7-8 mm long and 1 mm broad, puberulous. Corolla white, 1.5- 2 cm long, the basal tube 6-7 mm long, the throat obconic, 6 mm long, 5 mm diam, the lobes suberect, 4 mm long and 3 mm broad. Stamens included, shorter pair of filaments 3 mm long, longer pair 4 mm, the anthers ca 1.5 mm long. Capsule stipitate, approx- imately 1 cm long, few-seeded.

description: Frutex usque ad 2 m altus. Caules juniores quadrati, internodis plus minusve uniformiter pubescentibus trichomatibus flexuosis eglandulosis 0. 1-0.5(-0.7) mm longis. Folia petiolata, laminae ovatae vel ovato-ellipticae, 25-40 X 12-28 mm, 1.4-2.1-plo longiores quam latiores. Dichasia axillaria pedunculata alterna multi(7-15 vel pluri)-flora. Bracteolae caducae. Calyx 11-15 mm longus, glandulosus. Corolla flavovirens, 28-35 mm longa, extus glandulosa. Capsula 9.5-13 mm longa, apice parce pubescens trichomnatibus eglandulosis. Semina 2 (vel 4?).
bibliographicCitation: Weigend, Maximilian & Förther, Harald. 1999. Two new species of Sisymbrium (Brassicaceae) from coastal Peru. Brittonia. 51: 119-123.

description: Shrubs to 2 m tall. Young stems quadrate, ± evenly pubescent with flexuose eglandular trichomes 0.1-0.5(-0.7) mm long. Leaves petiolate, petioles to 6 mm long, blades ovate to ovate-elliptic, 25-40 X 12-28 mm, 1.4-2.1 times longer than wide, acute at apex, acute at base, surfaces densely pubescent with flexuose to flexuose-antrorse eglandular trichomes 0.3-1.2 mm long, margin entire. Inflorescence of pedunculate compound dichasia in axils of distal leaves; dichasia opposite or alternate, many (i.e., 7-15 or more)-flowered, 1 per axil, peduncles 4.5-13 mm long, subquadrate to quadrate, pubescent with flexuose to antrorse eglandular trichomes 0.1-0.5 mm long (sometimes with a few scattered erect to flexuose glandular trichomes to 0.3 mm long as well). Bracteoles and secondary bracteoles caducous (bracteoles not seen), secondary bracteoles linear to lance-linear, 7-12 X 0.7-1 mm, abaxial surface pubescent with conspicuous glandular and less conspicuous eglandular trichomes 0.1-0.4 mm long. Flowers subsessile to pedicellate, pedicels to 8 mm long, pubescent like peduncles. Calyx 11-15 mm long, tube 1.1-2 mm long, lobes linear to linear-lanceolate, 10.3-13 mm long, equal in length, 6-10 times longer than tube, 0.8-1.1 mm wide, abaxially and marginally pubescent like secondary bracteoles. Corolla yellowish green, 28-35 mm long, externally pubescent with flexuose to retrorse eglandular and glandular trichomes 0.05-0.5 mm long, tube cylindric-funnelform, 26-30 mm long, narrow proximal portion 11-16 mm long, ± gradually expanded into a throat, throat 12-15 mm long, ± equal to narrow proximal portion in length, 5-6 mm diam., limb 6-7 mm diam., lobes 3-3.3 X 2.3-2.7 mm. Stamens 4, paired, exserted from corolla tube, pairs ? equal in length, 18-23 mm long, thecae 3.5-4.3 mm long, dorsally glabrous. Style 30-35 mm long, pubescent throughout with eglandular trichomes, stigma 0.4-0.8 mm long, only 1 lobe evident, often curved or coiled. Capsule 9.5-13 mm long, pubescent at apex only with a few flexuose eglandular trichomes to 0.6 mm long, stipe 3-4 mm long, head ovoid to obovoid. Seeds 2(-4?), 3.4 X 2.6 mm, surfaces and margin pubescent with appressed trichomes.

description: Arbor ad 20 m. alta; ramulis cinereis teretibus novellis pilosis mox glabris; petiolis 5-10 mm. longis canaliculatis; laminis simplicibus subcoriaceis glabris elliptico-oblongis, 9-20 cm. longis, 4-7 cm. latis, basi cuneato-attenuatis, apice breviter acuminatis et mucronulatis, margine subintegris vel acute serratis, costa supra subplanis subtus prominente, nervis secundariis utroque 6-10 patulis prope margines anastomosantibus subtus elevatis, venulis paucis subtus prominulis; racemis axillaribus sub anthesi 6 cm. demum ad 16 cm. longis; rhachide breviter ferrugineo-pilosa; floribus ferrugineo-puberulis saepe binis, bracteis minutis subtentis; pedicellis sub anthesi 1-2 mm. longis; peri-anthio gracili 6-9 mm. longo apice conspicue incrassato; antheris 1.5 mm. longis; ovario densissime ferrugineo-setoso, stylo perianthium aequante; pedicellis in fructu 4-5 mm. longis; folliculis glabris ovatis 2-43 cm. longis basi angustatis apice acuminatis.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Albert C. 1936. Plantae Krukovianae. V. Brittonia. 2: 145-164.

description: Plant apparently 2-10 dm high, branched above, subglabrous below, glandu- lar-pubeseent above; petioles 1-3.5 cm long, somewhat winged; leaf-blades 3-10 cm long, 1.5-4.5 cm wide, bright green; floral bracts 1-2 cm long, 0.2-0.4 cm wide; pedicels about 1 cm long, divergent, filiform; floral tube 4-5 mm long, very slender, greenish; sepals 2.5-3.5 mm long, green with purplish or pinkish tinge; petals purple to pink, 3-4 mm long; capsule about 1 cm long, 2.5 mm thick; seeds about 0.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Munz, Philip A. 1961. The Lopezieae (Onagraceae). Brittonia. 13 (1): 73-90.

description: Herba perennis rhizomate breve saepe oblique ascendente. Culmi graciles, (6) 10-25 (40) cm alti, 0.3-0.6 mm lati, subquadranguli, sulcati in sicco, glauco-virides. Vaginae 2 vel 3, membranaceae, culmum spisse cingentes, pallide fulvescentes et rufo-brunneo-tinctae vel ex toto rufo-purpureo-brunneae, ore oblique sectae tenuiter membranaceae, apice deltoideo-acutae; vagina summa 3-5 (8) cm longa. Spicula ellipsoidea vel ovoideo-ellipsoidea, 4-10 mm longa, 2-3.5 mm lata, apice obtusa, dense multiflora; gluma infima (bractea) oblonga, 2-2.5 mm longa, 1.2-1.5 mm lata, apice obtusa vel leviter emarginata, vacua, pallida, costa late viridi. Glumae floriferae suberectae vel erecto-patentes, ellipticae vel oblongo-ellipticae, 1.6-1.8 mm longae, ca. 1 mm latae, naviculares, apice emarginatae, membranaceae, pallidae et latere utrinque rufo-brunneo-suffusae, sursum brunneo-lineolatae, margine late albo hyalinae, costa late glauco-viridi trinervi apicem glumae haud attingente. Achaenia obovato-orbicularia, ad apicem rotundum subito contracta, 0.6-0.8 mm longa atque lata, compresso-trigona cum angulis prominentibus, maturitate pallide flavescentia vel sordide albida, fere laevia vel raro cellulis oblongis obscurissime cancellata; stylopodium depresso-conicum, 0.2-0.3 mm longum, achaenio paullo angustius, pallide brunneum; stylus ca. 2 mm longus, sursum (ca. 34) profunde trifidus stigmatibus 3 papulosis. Stamina 3; antherae 0.5 mm longae. Setae hypogynae 3 vel 4, 0.3-0.7 mm longae, stylopodium numquam superantes, albescentes, retrorsim spinuloso- scabrae vel sublaeves.
bibliographicCitation: Koyama, Tetsuo M. 1977. A new species of Eleoch'aris [E. liogieri] (Cyperaceae) from the West Indies. Brittonia. 29: 237-239.

description: Herba perennis; rhizoma suberectum, crassiusculum 2-6 cm longum, 3-5 mm crassum, fuscum, stolones graciles 10-20 cm longos apice tuberiferos emittens. Culmi plures dense caespitosi, 17-30 cm alti, 1-2 mm crassi, teretes, rigiduli, remotiuscule transversim septati, interseptis 5-20 mm longis vacuis. Vaginae basilares 2 vel 3, culmum spisse circumdantes, tenuiter membranaceae, albidae vel pallide stramineae, ore hyalinae oblique truncatae dorso acutae. Spicula lineari-lanceolata, erecta, 12-20 mm longa, 2.5-3 mm lata, teres, apice sensim acuta, basin versus leviter angustata, pallide straminescens, 6-12-flora; bracteae duae, ovato- deltoideae, 4-5 mm longae, acutiusculae. Glumae suberectae, appressae, ovato-ellipticae vel ovato-lanceolatae, 6-7.2 mm longae, 2.25-3 mm latae, ecarinatae, apice scariosae acutac acutiusculaeve, dorso late herbaceae glauco-straminescentes, inconspicue plurinervulosae, mar- ginibus late pallide scariosae, costa 1-nervia. Achaenia elliptica, 2 mm longa, 1.3-1.5 mn lata, crasse biconvexa, maturitate fulvo-olivacea, laevia, basi cuneata, apice truncata numquam constricta, haud annulata, tantum marginata; stylus 3.7-4.5 mm longus, stigmatibus 2 vel 3 ca 2 mm longis, stylopodio conico-elongato ca 1.5 mm longo 1 mm lato. Setae hypogynae 6 vel 7, 2.2-3 mm longae, achaenio sesquilongiores, rigidulae, retrorsim spinuloso-scabrae. Stamina 2 vel 3; antherae lineares, 3 mm longae, connectivo ca 0.3 mm longo subulato.

description: Frutex, caulibus vix ramosis, 2.5-5 mm diam., deorsum laevibus nitentibus, apicem versus dense albo-lanatis, eglandulosis, internodiis brevibus; folia alterna, subconferta, subsessilia (petiolo vix 2 mm longo, lanato), lamina elliptico-lanceo- lata, bene evoluta 12 cm longa et 4 cm lata, vel saepe minoribus et solum 5 cm longa et 1.5 cm lata, gradatim acuminata, basi longe angustata et in petioluni decurrenti, herbacea, supra perspicue bullata, dense hirtella, pilis albis sub- conicis rigidis 2-cellularibus, venis et venulis impressis, subtus reticulato-venosa, dense albo-lanata, pilis elongatis flaccidis multicellularibus, pilis minutis tenuibus capitato-glandulosis intermixtis, margine perspicue et regulariter serrato- dentata; folia minuta orbicularia stipuliformia saepe obvia; infloreseentiae axillares, numerosae, pedunculis 5-10 cm longis, albo-lanosis, apice bibracteatis, bracteis lineari-subulatis, integris, lanatis, simpliciter umbellatae, floribus 3 vel 4, longe pedicellatis, pedicellis non fureatis, 10-15 mm longis, albo-lanatis eglandulosis curvatis; hypanthium late subsphaerico-obconicum, in anthesin ca. 3 mm longuLs, apice 3 mm latum, externe densissime lanatum, pilis albis elongatis eglandulosis; calycis lobi fere liberi, basi solum ca. 0.5 mm connati, erecti, lanceolati, ca. 8 mm longi, 2.5 mm basi lati, gradatim et acriter acuminati integri inconspi- cue trinervii externe dense albo-lanati, intus virides vel interdum rubro-tincti, evidenter stipitato-glandulosi; corolla in calyce erecta flaveseenti-viridis, intus tubo purpureo-maculata, ca. 18 mm longa, tubo basi vix gibboso, 4.5 mm lato, apice ampliata et ca. 10 mm lato, externe glanduloso-pilosulo, limbo bilabiato, ca. 11 mm lato, lobis 2 superioribus erectis, in galea emarginata ca. 7 mm lata alte connatis, lobis 3 inferioribus latissimis, ca. 4 mm latis, rotundatis, intus -glabris, margine recurvatis; filamenta basi corollae 5 mm adnata, in parte libera basi albo-barbata, sursum glabra recta; staminodium bene evolutum, barbatumr; antherae albae ex tubo exsertae, per paria connatae, ca. 2.6 mm longae et 1.6 mm latae, loculis oblongis, discretis; ovarium apice valde albo-tomentosum; stylus ruber 2 cm longus glaber; stigma exsertum viride stomatomorphum; discus annularis albus crassus angulosus glaber; capsulae nutantes, pedicellis fructiferis curvatis 1.5-2 cm longis, subhemisphaericae, ca. 6 mm longae et apice latae, persistenter albo-tomentosae, apice transverse dehiseentes.

description: Perennial herb; roots coarse, fibrous, graybrown; rhizomes elongated, (1.3-)1.5-3.5(-4) mm thick, scales to 9 mm (rarely seen in herbarium specimens), tubers absent; Culms obscurely 3 angled to terete or rarely distinctly trigonous distally, (45.5-)50-82(-90.2) cm x (1.8-)2.4-5 (-6.2) mm, soft, internally spongy, with incomplete transverse septa, smooth, olive-gray (when dry); leavesreduced to sheaths, sheaths 2, apically notched, membranous, loose, friable, proximally dark maroon, distally cinnamon to orange-rufous, apex acute; spikelet cylindric, narrowly-lanceolate, (19-)22.8-39 (-42) x (3.7-)4-4.7 (-5) mm, acute, proximal 2-3 scales empty, the lowest obtuse, amplexicaul, appearing as a continuation of the culm, sometimes subtended by an annular swelling; floral scales appressed to weakly spreading, ovate-oblong, (4.7-)4.8-5.2 (-5.3) x (2-)2.2-2.9 (-3.1) mm, cartilaginous, olive-gray centrally with a sub-apical dark splotch, stramineous marginally, abaxially and adaxially sparsely red-maculate, apex acute (rounded), the distal 0.2-0.3 mm, hyaline erose, central area nearly flat, coarsely many-veined, midvein not distinguishable abaxially, conspicuous in adaxial view; perianth bristles 6-8, sub-equal, mostly exceeding tubercle, ascending, broad and strap-shaped proximally, coarsely retrorsely spinulose nearly to the base, stramineous; stamens 3; anthers 1.7-2.2 (-2.4) mm, reddish brown; style trifid or sometimes bifid; achene biconvex, more or less obpyriform to widely obovate, 1.7-2 (-2.1) (not including tubercle) x 1.3-1.5 (-1.6) mm, with (11-)12-16 (-18) longitudinal rows of concave, transversely oblong polygonal cells that are (at least the most centrally located) transversely reniform, visible through transparent periclinal layer on each achene face, dull-buff, maturing to shiny dark green blotched with (or else entirely) amber, apex constricted to about 0.4 times the width of the achene to a distinct neck (this sometimes obscured by the style base); tubercle dorsoventrally compressed, deltate, (0.5-)0.6-0.9 (-1.1) x (0.6-)0.7-0.9 (-1) mm, light to dark brown.

description: Arbores dioicae procerae. Ramuli angulati indumen to aureo praediti cito glabrescentes. Folia alterna dissita; petiolus in sectione transversali hemisphaericus vel parum canaliculatus; lamina membranacea, anguste elliptica vel elliptica vel oblanceolata, margine ad bas- em recurvata, apice acuto vel acuminato, nervis se- cundariis (3)4-5(6)-jugis, ad basem breviter margini- bus confluentibus, statu vivo roseis; pagina supra gla- bra, subtus puberula, in sicco brunnea. Inflorescentiae dissitae, thyrsoideae; rami inflorescentiarum stamina- tarum (6)7-9(10) et 3(4)-furcati, bracteis et bracteolis deciduis; rami inflorescentiarum pistillatarum 6-8 et 1(2)-furcati. Florum receptaculum obconicum; tepala sub anthesi recurvata, rosea; stamina verticillorum I et II sessilia, antheris laminaribus, imbricatis, locellis 4 introrsis apicem versus insertis, ea verticilli III col- umnaria, basi glandulis geminatis minutis, locellis 4 extrorsis et latrorsis, verticilli IV nulla; pistillodium florum staminatorum nullum vel minutum. Fructus cupula hemisphaerica crassa margine integra.

description: Dioecious trees (15)25-30(42) m X (28)34(40) cm, buttresses lacking or small; outer bark gray, smooth, with hoops and prominent lenticels; inner bark 6 mm thick, creamy orange, granular; wood bright yellow. Axes orthotropic, extensions rhythmic; branching sylleptic, basitonic in axils of cataphylls, flowering on sylleptic branches upon their inception. Branchlets initially angular soon becoming terete, innovations (7.5)10(19) cm long, twigs (2.8)3.5(4.4) mm diam., densely to sparsely covered with straight, appressed, ascending, up to 0.2 mm long, yellow-brown to golden hairs, soon glabrescent; epidermis drying black; cataphylls soon deciduous; terminal buds conical, ca. 5 X 2.5 mm, hairs as on branchlets. Leaves alternate; petioles half-terete to slightly channelled in cross section, (1.5)2- 2.7(3.2) cm X (1.4)2-2.4 mm, indument as on branchlets, becoming sparser apically; lamina membranaceous, flat, narrow-elliptic to elliptic (oblanceolate), (9.7)14-17(21) X (2.8)4.2-6.5(7) cm, base decurrent, symmetric, apex attenuate to acute, or acuminate, acumen 0-2.5 cm long, margin flat throughout (basally slightly recurved); pri- mary vein above flat, below prominent; secondary veins (3)4-5(6) pairs, the basal most pair arising from the petiole and shortly concurrent with the margin, equally spaced, alternating on both sides of the midvein to subopposite, above flat, below prominent, diverging from primary vein at angle of (35)45-50(55)?, abruptly arching to chordal angle of (9)13-17(22)?, orientation uniform throughout lamina length (except basalmost pair, which generally has more acute angle), weakly brochidodromous, loops 0.5 mm from margin, tertiary veins perpendicular to primary vein through- out; higher order veins random-reticulate, above flat, below slightly raised, areoles polygonal, up to 0.5 mm broad, highest order veins 50, irregularly branched; surface above glabrous, below sparingly hairy, hairs as on branchlets; both sides dark brown to black, below sometimes slightly glaucous; veins distinctly reddish when fresh. Staminate plant: inflorescences along the whole length of innovation, erect, thyrsoid, peduncle (5)6.6-10(11) cm X 0.8-1.2 mm, hypopodium (2.1)3.5-5(6) cm long; second order branches (6)7-9(10) below terminal cyme, up to 2 cm long, decreasing in length toward apex, highest order branches 3(4)º; indument as on branchlets, axes drying black; bracts and bracteoles deciduous; flowers: pedicels 2.5-4 X 0.8 mm, gradually enlarging to form conical receptacle, ca. 1.9 X 2.4 mm; indument as on inflorescence branches; tepals 6, red with whitish margin, drying red to salmon; chartaceous, recurved at anthesis, transverseovate, ca. 2 X 2 mm (inner and outer tepals equal), apex obtuse, on both sides sparsely covered with short (up to 0.1 mm long), straight to crisped, yellowish hairs; inside of receptacle densely hairy, the hairs up to 0.2 mm long; stamens 9, those of whorls I and II subequal (whorl I larger than whorl II, overlapping), sessile, anther oblong, laminar, up to 1.2 X 1.2 mm, glabrous, locelli 4 (sometimes median ones vestigial), apical, introrse; stamens of whorl III columnar, partially fused to free, thick, ca. 1.3 X 0.9 mm, adaxially with longitudinal callus on lower half, glabrous, locelli 4, apical, upper pair latrorse, lower pair extrorse, with pair of minute (ca. 0.15 mm broad) glands at base; whorl IV completely absent; pistillode absent or hairy linear appendage ca. 0.3 mm long. Pistillate plant: inflorescences along whole length of flush, thyrses, peduncle (3.5)5-7.8(9) cm X 0.8 mm, hypopodium 2-4.7 cm long; second order branches 6-8 below terminal cyme, up to 1.5 cm long, highest order branches 2(3)º; indument and color when dry as on staminate inflorescences; bracts deciduous; flowers like staminate ones; pistil teardrop shaped, ca. 2 X 1 mm, style ca. 2/5 of total length of pistil, 0.3 mm diam., stigma 3- pointed, spreading, locule located in middle of ovary. Fruits: infructescences bearing up to 3 fruits; pedicels thickened, up to 1 cm X 7 mm, gradually enlarging to form thick, hemispherical cupule up to 1.5 X 2.2 cm, smooth to wrinkled, red, tepals deciduous; berry elliptic, ca. 3 X 1.5 cm, yellow-orange.
bibliographicCitation: Madriñán, Santiago R. 1996. New species of Rhodostemonodaphne (Lauraceae) from north-eastern South America. Brittonia. 48: 45-66.

description: Liana (or slender tree with scandent branches); branehlets slender, terete; leaves opposite (rarely subopposite), the petioles slender, 6-14 mm. long, the leaf-blades thin-coriaceous or chartaceous, brownish or dark green when dried, narrowly elliptic or elliptic-oblong, 7-18 cm. lonig, 2.5-6.5 cm. broad, acute or attenuate at base and decurrent on the petiole, gradually acuminate at apex (acumen 8-15 mm. long, obtuse), entire and lnarrowly revolute at margins, usually sparsely black-punctate beneath, the costa prominent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 7-10 per side, arcuate-aseending, often prominulous on both surfaces, sometimes subimmersed, the veinlets obscurely reticu- late, usually immersed, sometimes faintly prominulous; infloreseence 1.5-3 cm. long, thyrsoid-paniculate, copiously branched from base, the branchlets alternate or pseudodichotomous, slender, usually blackish, the bracts and bracteoles alternate or subopposite, papyraceous, obtuse, less than 1 mm. long, occasionally fimbriate; flowers subsessile or short- pedicellate; sepals papyraceous or submembranous, semiorbicular-deltoid or deltoid-ovate, 0.5-1 mm. lolng, 0.8-1.3 mm. broad, obtuse or roulnded at apex, seariose and erose or fimbriolate at margins; petals thin-coriaceous or submembranous, elliptic-oblong or obovate, 1.7-2.2 mm. lolng, 1-1.6 mm. broad, rounded at apex, scariose and entire at margins; disk thin-carnose or submembranous, erecto-patent, 0.2-0.3 mnm. high, 1-1.2 mm. in diameter, minutely undulate or crenulate at margin; stamiens suberect, the filaments submenibranous, 0.4-0.5 mm. long, broadened at base, the ailthers about 0.2 by 0.5 mm.; ovary depressed- subglobose or trigonous, about 0.7 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the style 0.2-0.3 mm. long, the stigmas deltoid, spreading, subacute, alternate with stamens; ovules 2 per locule, collateral-superposed; inflorescence-branchlets greatly thickened in fruit, the pedicels up to 0.4 mm. in diameter, obseurely ringed by transverse scars; fruits subglobose or ellipsoid, up to 1 cm. in diameter (probably larger at maturity), the pericarp very thick, essentially smooth or minutely rugulose.

description: Liania; braniehlets slender, subterete, often Conspicuously lenticellate; leaves opposite, the petioles rugose, slender, 4-8 mm. long, the leaf-blades chartaceous, olivaceous when dried, elliptic-oblong, 8-16 cm. long, 3.5-6.5 cm. broad, obtuse at base, obtuse or obtusely cuspidate at apex, entire at margins, sometimes sparsely black-punctate on either surface, the costa prominent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 7-9 per side, spreading, anastomosinig near margins, prominulous on both surfaces, the veinlets copiously reticulate, prominulous on both surfaces; infloreseence 3-5 cm. long at anthesis, thyrsoid-paniculate, divided from base, copiously branching, the branchlets very slender, alternate or pseudodichotonious, the bracts alterinate or subopposite, papyraceous, ovate, obtuse, less than 0.8 mm. long; flowers subtended by minute bracteoles, 2.5-4.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the pedicels very slender, 3-8 mm. long at anthesis; sepals papyraceous or membranaceous, broadly ovate-deltoid, 0.4-0.5 mm. long, 0.6-1 mm. broad, subacute or obtuse, subentire; petals membranaceous or papyraceous, oblong-obovate, 2-2.2 mm. long, 1-1.7 mm. broad, rounded at apex, entire or minutely erosulous-fimbriolate at margins, sometimes farinose-puberulent distally without; disk membrainous, erect, 0.3-0.4 mm. high, 0.8-1 mm. in diameter, crenulate at margin; stamens erect, the filaments slender, 0.7-1.1 mm. long, the anthers about 0.15 by 0.4 mm.; ovary depressed-globose, about 0.7 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the style 0.4-0.6 mm. long, the stigmas spreadinig, 0.2-0.3 mm. long, conspicuously bilobed, alternate with stamens, the lobes obtuse, often sharply recurved, clearly united in pairs; ovules 2 per locule, collateral.

description: Pendent, epiphytic shrub with branches to 0.5 m long. Stems terete, minutely striate, tan to reddish-brown when dry, hispidulous with reddish-brown hairs 0.6-0.8 mm long becoming glabrous with age. Leaves distichous, flat or concave, ovate, (1.6) 2-2.5 X (0.8) 1-2 cm, basally rounded or subcordate, apically acute or short acuminate, marginally entire, hispidulous on upper surface especially near margins, glabrous beneath, brown above and olive-green or light brown beneath when dry; obscurely 5-plinerved, the midrib slightly impressed proximally and raised distally above and slightly impressed but inconspicuous beneath, lateral nerves and veinlets slightly raised but inconspicuous above and totally obscure beneath. Petiole sub- terete, densely hispidulous, 1-1.5 mm long. Flowers axillary, solitary with 4 tiny inflorescence bracts at base. Floral bract ovate, marginally ciliate, 1.5 mm long. Pedicel terete, glabrous, 1-2 mm long, completely concealed by the 2, ovate to hemi- spheric distally hispidulous bracteoles. Calyx somewhat glaucous, copiously hispidu- lous with translucent or reddish-tinged hairs 1-1.2 mm long; tube obconic, bluntly 5-angled, 3 mm long; limb 1-1.5 mm long including apiculate lobes. Corolla cylindric, narrowed at the throat, 5-6 X 2.2 mm, hispidulous throughout, white; lobes 1 mm long. Stamens 10, 5 mm long; filaments alternately slightly unequal, 2.8-3 mm and 3-3.2 mm long, hispidulous over entire length; anther 2.5 mm long, the tubules slightly longer than the thecae; thecae with a minute (0.1 mm long) finger-like appendage protruding from the base. Style 5-6 mm long, glabrous. Berry not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Luteyn, James L. & Wilbur, Robert L. 1977. New genera and species of Ericaceae (Vaccinieae) from Costa Rica and Panama. Brittonia. 29: 255-276.

description: Pendent, epiphytic shrub to 2 m. Mature branches terete, glabrous, gray; bark cracking longitudinally; immature branches and twigs of new growth subterete, flexuous, hispidulous becoming glabrate, reddish-brown. Petioles terete, rugose, 1.5-2 (4) mm long, hirtellous. Leaves distichous, ovate, (2.5) 4-4.5 X 1.5-2.5 cm, basally rounded or obtuse, apically acuminate, mucronulate, somewhat rugulose on both sur- faces, weakly scattered pilose on both surfaces; obscurely 3 (5) plinerved, midrib slightly impressed above and raised beneath, entire lamina somewhat concave-revolute and "hiding" the inflorescence. Inflorescence axillary, short racemose, 1-3 flowered; rachis terete, hispidulous, to 5 mm long. Floral bracts minute, subulate, 1 mm long. Pedicels terete, slightly thickened distally, hispidulous, 6.5-9 mm long. Bracteoles subulate, hispidulous, 1 mm long. Calyx pilose, 4 mm long; tube hemispheric, bluntly 5-angled basally, 2.5 mm long; limb including the inconspicuous lobes slightly spread- ing, 1.5 mm long and 5 mm diam; sinus flat; disc annular, pulvinate, glabrous. Corolla cylindric, slightly inflated basally, 8-10 mm long and 4 mm in basal diam, glabrous; lobes oblong, obtuse, 1.5 mm long, pilose, reflexed at anthesis to expose stamens and style. Stamens 10, equal; filaments 4-5 mm long, marginally pilose; anthers including tubules 5 mm long; thecae 2 mm long. Style terete, 9 mm long. Fruit not seen.

description: Epiphytic shrub about 5 dm tall. Stems subterete or bluntly angled, minutely striate becoming smooth, glaucous, pale reddish-brown when dry, hispidulous with translucent hairs 0.2-0.3 mm long becoming glabrous with age. Leaves distichous, ovate, (2.5) 3-4.5 x 1.5-2.5 cm, basally broadly rounded or subtruncate, apically short acuminate, apiculate, marginally entire, obscurely short-pilose above especially near margins and glabrous beneath, pale green above and brown beneath when dry but with a pale greenish-brown area 1 mm broad along the entire margin beneath; 3 (5)-plinerved with the nerves obscure but slightly impressed above and only the midrib slightly raised beneath. Petiole subterete, flattened above, hispidulous as branchlets, 2-3 mm long and 1 mm diam. Flowers axillary, solitary with 2-4 minute inflorescence bracts at base. Floral bract ovate, marginally ciliate, 0.3-0.5 mm long. Pedicel angled, striate, glaucous, hispidulus, 1.5-2.5 mm long. Bracteoles awl- shaped, ciliate, 0.5 mm long, located above the middle. Calyx glaucous, sparsely hispidulous with translucent hairs 0.2 mm long; tube obconic, bluntly 5-angled, 2-3 mm long; limb 1.5-1.75 mm long including the apiculate lobes. Corolla urceolate, strongly constricted at throat, 5-5.5 x 2.2 mm, glabrous beneath but upper part of throat and lobes hispidulous; lobes +/- 0.5 mm long. Stamens 10, 2.5 mm long; filaments slightly but distinctly alternating 1.5 and 2 mm long, glabrous, attached near base of anther; anther 1-1.2 mm long with tubules equaling thecae. Style 3.5 mm long, glabrous. Berry +/- 5 mm diam.

description: Tree 11-25 m high, the trunk to 1 m in diameter, the young parts minutely golden- sericeous, the branchlets and foliage soon glabrate, the branchlets 3-5 mm in diameter toward apex and copiously cicatricose below the distally crowded leaves; petioles semiterete, (1-) 1.5-3 cm long, the leaf-blades chartaceous or subcoriaceous, obovate to elliptic, (5-) 7-13 (-16) cm long, (2.5-) 4-8 (-8.5) cm broad, acute to obtuse at base and short-decurrent on the petiole, often slightly asymmetrical, rounded to short-acuminate at apex and sometimes slightly retuse, shallowly crenulate and slightly recurved at margin, minutely glandular-pustulate above when young, the costa plane or slightly elevated above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves (6-) 7-10 per side, subspreading, plane or slightly impressed above and raised beneath, the veinlet-reticulation faintly reticulate to somewhat obscure; domatia prominent, the raised oval aperture without associated indument; inflorescences axillary, spicate, 8-14 cm long, with (30-) 40-70 flowers, the peduncle (2-4 cm long) and rachis slender, scattered-sericeous but soon glabrate, the bracts oblong-elliptic, 1-2.5 mm long, about 1 mm broad, essentially glabrous, early caducous; flowers 5-merous, the lower receptacle 2-6 mm long at anthesis, copiously sericeous with brown hairs about 0.2 mm long, the calyx-limb shallowly cupuliform, at length rotate, 1-2 mm long, 4-5 mm in diameter, glabrous to sparsely sericeous without, laxly villose within, the lobes broadly deltoid, 1-1.5 X 1.5-2 mm; disk pulvinate, 5-lobed, densely villose with hairs 0.8-1 mm long; stamens 10, the filaments 3-5 mm long, the anthers oblong, 0.5- 0.7 mm long, apiculate or obtuse at apex, the style 3.5-4 mm long; fruits circumalate, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 4-5.5 cm long, 1.5-3 cm broad, copiously sericeous when young but soon glabrate, the wings 3-10 mm broad at middle of fruit and 15-20 mm broad at base and apex, the fruit-body rounded or obscurely trigonal in cross-section.

description: Tree (or shrub) 2-15 m high, the young parts copiously sericeous with golden hairs 0.4-0.7 mm long, the branchlets 3-8 mm in diameter toward apex, inconspicu- ously cicatricose, often subpersistently sericeous or spreading-pilose, the leaves distally disposed but not congested; petioles semiterete, (5-) 15-40 mm long, pilose like the young branchlets; leaf-blades chartaceous or papyraceous, broadly obovate-elliptic, 8-21.5 cm long, 5-15 cm broad, broadly rounded to cuneate or obtuse at base, rounded or faintly emarginate to broadly obtuse at apex and sometimes with a tuft of hairs about 0.5 mm long simulating a mucro, entire or faintly undulate and slightly thickened at margin, obscurely biglandular near base, glandular-pustulate above, with subpersistent scattered indument on both surfaces and especially on costa beneath but at length glabrate, the costa plane or slightly elevated above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves 6-10 per side, spreading, curved and anastomosing toward margin, plane or prominulous above, often conspicuously raised beneath, the veinlet-reticulation lax, plane or slightly impressed above, prominulous beneath; description: Tree 15-25 m high, the trunk to 1 m in diameter, the young parts copiously sericeous with hairs 0.3-0.6 (-1) mm long, the branchlets distally angled, becoming subterete, 2-4 mm in diameter toward apex, subpersistently sericeous or spreading- pilose, copiously cicatricose, the leaves distally disposed but not congested; domatia usually present, consisting of an axillary membrane with a broad distal aperture and a few associated hairs; inflorescences axillary, spicate, 10-2 0 cm long, the flowers numerous, 60-80, the peduncle (1.5-2.5 cm long) and rachis slender, persistently sericeous with hairs 0.2-0.4 mm long; flowers 5-merous, the bracts very early caducous; lower receptacle becoming compressed-ovoid in hermaphrodite flowers, 1.5-2.5 mm long at anthesis, copiously and persistently sericeous, the calyx-limb shallowly cupuliform, becoming subrotate, 1-2 mm long, 3.5-5 mm in diameter, sparsely sericeous without and proximally within, the lobes deltoid-lanceolate, 1.3-2 mm long, 1-1.5 mm broad, acute, glabrate; description: Tree 8-12 m high, the young parts sparsely sericeous with hairs 0.2-0.8 mm long, the vegetative and inflorescence parts soon glabrate, the branchlets slender, 1.5-3 mm in diameter toward apex, the leaves distally disposed but not congested; petioles slender, semiterete, narrowly winged distally, 8-20 mm long, the leaf-blades chartace- ous, obovate- to oblanceolate-elliptic, 4-11 cm long, 1.5-5.5 cm broad, attenuate at base and decurrent on the petiole, obtuse to rounded and slightly emarginate at apex, entire or undulate at margin, glandular-pustulate on both surfaces, the costa slightly elevated above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves 4-7 per side, curved, slightly elevated or plane above, prominulous beneath, the veinlet-reticulation lax, slightly prominulous or plane on both surfaces, the domatia none or infrequent, then inconspicuous and without associated hairs; inflorescences axillary, spicate, 6-16 cm long, the flowers numerous, about 40-50, the peduncle (1.5-3 cm long) and rachis slender, the latter rarely sparsely strigillose distally; flowers usually 5(rarely 4-)-merous, the bracts linear-lanceolate, recurved, 1-2 mm long and 0.2-0.3 mm broad, obscurely tufted-strigillose at apex, early caducous; lower receptacle terete or becoming slightly flattened, 2-5 mm long at anthesis, the calyx-limb infundibular or narrowly campanulate, 3-5 mm long, 4-6 mm in diameter, glabrous without, pale tomentellous within (hairs weak, 0.5-0.8 mm long), the lobes deltoid or deltoid- lanceolate, 1.5-3 X 1.5-2 mm, acute or acuminate; disk hirtellous or tomentellous; stamens 10 (rarely 8), the filaments 7-12 mm long, the anthers oblong, 0.8-1 mm long, obtuse at apex, the style 4-11 mm long; fruits not known.

description: Tree 3-12 (or to 18?) m high, the young parts copiously sericeous, the branchlets (2-) 3-6 mm in diameter toward apex, cicatricose below the leaves crowded distally; petioles semiterete, often slender, (4-) 6-20 mm long, the leaf-blades chartaceous or submembranaceous, obovate or broadly elliptic-obovate, (5-) 7-20 cm long, (4-) 5-15 cm broad, obtuse to rounded or faintly subcordate at base, obtuse to rounded or shallowly emarginate at apex, entire or undulate and slightly thickened at margin and obscurely biglandular near base, glandular-pustulate above, the costa plane or slightly elevated above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves 7-12 per side, spreading, curved and anastomosing toward margin, plane or prominulous above, sharply elevated beneath, the veinlet-reticulation copiously reticulate, plane or prominulous on both surfaces; description: Tree 8-11 m high, the young parts copiously hispidulous-sericeous with golden hairs 0.4-1 mm long, the branchlets stout, 5-8 mm in diameter toward apex, at length glabrate, copiously cicatricose below the leaves densely congested at apex; petioles semiterete, 7-20 mm long, copiously pilose, the leaf-blades chartaceous, broadly obovate, 7-12 cm long, 4-8 cm broad, obtuse at base and decurrent on the petiole, rounded or slightly emarginate at apex, entire or obscurely crenulate at margin, thickened and slightly recurved, inconspicuously glandular-pustulate and spreading pilose on both surfaces with hairs 0.4-1 mm long, at length subglabrate but with indument on the costa and secondaries beneath, the costa slightly elevated above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves 7-10 per side, spreading, curved toward margin, plane or slightly elevated above, prominulous or strongly raised beneath, the veinlet-reticulation lax, prominulous on both surfaces; domatia frequent, the apertures narrowly oval or subcircular, with associated hairs; inflorescences axillary, spicate, 6-11 cm long, the flowers usually 25-45, the peduncle (to 3 cm long) and rachis copiously tomentellous with hairs 0.3-0.6 mm long; flowers usually 5-merous, the bracts oblong-linear, reflexed, 2.5-5 mm long and 0.3-0.5 mm broad, copiously tomentellous on both sides, persistent to anthesis; lower receptacle 2-3.5 mm long at anthesis, copiously soft-tomentellous, becoming flattened, the calyx-limb infundibu- lar, 4-5 mm long, pale-pilose within with hairs 1-1.3 mm long, the lobes deltoid- lanceolate, acute, about 2 mm long; disk 5-lobed, copiously hirtellous; stamens usually 10 (perhaps sometimes 8 or 12), the filaments filiform, 7-9 mm long, the anthers oblong-ellipsoid, about 1 mm long, the style 8-11 mm long in hermaphrodite flowers, rudimentary in staminate flowers; description: Small to medium-sized trees, 3-25 m tall, to 100 cm diam., shallowly buttressed or unbuttressed. Bark gray-brown, thin, hard, very shallowly fissured, inner bark dark red- dish-orange. Trichomes ferrugineous to purple-brown, to 0.5 mm long. Leaves 24- 83.5 cm long, 7-1 5-foliolate; petiole sparsely to densely pubescent, especially basally, 4-17.5 cm long; rachis sparsely to densely pubescent, 10-52.8 cm long; petiolules densely pubescent, the lateral ones 3-15 mm long, the terminal one 18-38 mm long; leaflet blades narrowly oblong, lanceolate or occasionally narrowly elliptic, ovate, obovate or oblanceolate, 9-25.5 x 3.3-9.3 cm, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, sometimes shiny adaxially, the apex short- to long-acuminate, the base obtuse, rounded, truncate, cordate, sometimes oblique, the margin sometimes revolute, also sometimes sparsely ciliate; both surfaces sparsely to densely pubescent, sometimes glabrous; midrib prominent abaxially, impressed adaxially; secondary veins in 9-19 pairs, prominent abaxially, often impressed adaxially; higher order venation prominulous to prominent abaxially, impressed to prominulous adaxially. Inflorescences 12.5-64 cm long, sparsely to densely pubescent; peduncle 1.5- 8 cm long; pedicels 2-4 mm. Flowers calyx lobes (narrowly) ovate or deltate, 2.1-3.5 x 0.9-2.2 mm, densely pubescent abaxially; petals cream-colored to pale yellow when fresh, narrowly ovate, 2.6-3.8 x 1.3-2 mm, pubescent abaxially, sparsely to densely pubescent adaxially. Staminateflowers hypanthium cupular; filaments 0.8-1.3 mm long, sparsely pubescent; anthers oblong, 0.9-1.3 mm long, glabrous; pistillode cylindric, 2.5- 4 mm long, sparsely to densely pubescent, rudimentary stigmas 2-3-lobed or subcapitate. Pistillate flowers hypanthium mmore shallowly cupular; rudimentary anthers sagittate, 1 mm long; ovary globose, 2.4-5 x 2.3-4.2 mm, densely pubescent; style 1 mm long, crowned by a capitate or bilobed stigma. Maturefruit green to bluish green when ripe, ovoid, ellipsoid, or oblong, 1.7-2.5 x 2-3 cm when dry, densely pubescent.
bibliographicCitation: Mitchell, J. I. & Daly, Douglas C. 1993. A revision of Thyrsodium (Anacardiaceae). Brittonia. 45: 115-129.

description: Planta volubilis vel procumbens, partium juvenilium pilis pallide brunneis 0.1-0.3 mm longis, caulibus mox glabratis; petiolis 5-15 mm longis breviter crispato-pilosis glabratis; foliorum laminis papyraceis vel subcarnosis oblongo- vel ovato-lanceolatis, (3-) 5-8 cm longis, (1-) 1.5-2.7 cm latis, in sicco viridi-brunneis subtus pallidioribus, utrinque glabris vel secus costam nervosque parce crispato-pilosulis, basi obtusis vel rotundatis et glandulis paucis ellipsoideis ad 0.2 mm longis supra ornatis, apice calloso- acutis vel apiculatis, margine integris vel subundulatis et paullo incrassatis, costa supra canaliculata vel subplana subtus prominenti, nervis secundariis utrinsecus 4-7 curvato- adscendentibus supra prominulis subtus elevatis; description: Vine, the stems glabrous except for a few sparse hairs at nodes; petioles 10-30 mm long, sparsely crispate-pilose with hairs 0.2-0.5 mm long, subglabrate; leaf-blades ovate or ovate-elliptic, (2.5-)4-9 cm long, (2-)2.5-6 cm broad, glabrate on both sides or crispate-pilose beneath on costa and nerves, broadly obtuse to rounded or subcordate at base and with 2-4 minute rostrate glands on the upper surface at apex of petiole, mucronulate-acuminate at apex (acumen 1-3 mm long) or rounded or subretuse and mucronulate-apiculate, narrowly recurved at margin, the costa plane or slightly ele- vated above, raised beneath, the secondary nerves 5-7 per side, spreading, anasto- mosing toward margin, prominulous on both surfaces; inflorescences umbelliform- cymose, 2-9 cm long, composed of 2-4 congested-racemiform umbels born laterally on a fractiflex axis, the peduncle slender, usually 1-2 cm long, like the secondary peduncles (to 4 mm long), rachis, and pedicels sparsely crispate-pilosulous, glabrate; flowers 5-8(-20) per umbel (lower ones caducous, leaving conspicuous scars), sub- tended by membranaceous ovate bracts, these 0.7-1 X 0.4-0.7 mm, sparsely fimbrillate and pilosulous, the pedicels slender, 4-10 mm long at anthesis; calyx 2.5-4 mm in diameter at anthesis, the lobes ovate, 1-1.3 mm long, 1.2-1.5 mm broad, acute at apex, ciliolate, pilosulous without, conspicuously nerved, bearing minute ovoid glands in the sinuses; corolla 9-13 mm in diameter at anthesis, the lobes elliptic-ovate, 5-6 mm long, 3-3.5 mm broad, acute at apex, conspicuously nerved; filament-tube 0.5-0.8 mm long, the anthers carnose, oblong, laterally free except distally, about 2 mm long to fusion with stigma, each with a pronounced carnose dorsal swelling in the proximal half, dorsally angled distally but not spurred, the appendages about 0.5 mm long and broad, the thickening apically truncate, the translators ellipsoid, about 0.3 mm long, each bearing basal caudicles 0.1-0.15 mm long, the pollinia ellipsoid, about 0.3 mm long, laterally attached to caudicles; ovaries falcate-ovoid, the styles carnose, 0.7-1 mm long, the stigma about 1.5 mm in diameter; fruit with a single follicle developing, this ovoid-fusiform, 30-95 mm long, 5-12 mm broad, obtusely callose-acute; seeds 6-7 mm long, 4-5 mm broad.

description: Vine, the young parts sparsely puberulent with pale brown hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long, the stems glabrous; petioles (10-) 15-23 mm long, obscurely puberulent, soon glabrate; leaf-blades drying dull green, ovate, (3-)4-8 cm long, (1.5-)2.5-5 cm broad, rounded Or broadly obtuse at base and with a few obscure glands on the upper surface at apex of petiole (these ovoid,' about 0.3 mm long), subacute or obtuse and callose-apiculate at apex, the costa plane above, subprominent beneath, the secondary nerves S-8 per side, spreading, obscurely anastomosing toward margin, slightly elevated on both sur- faces; inflorescences umbelliform-cymose, (2-) 5-1 1 cm long at anthesis, composed of 2 or 3 compound racemiform umbels borne laterally on a fractiflex axis, the peduncle slender, 5-50 mm long, glabrous like the rachis at anthesis, the umbels 2-7-times divided from base, the secondary peduncles 1-12 mm long, like the pedicels puberulent with crispate hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long, glabrate; flowers 20 50 per compound umbel, subtended by deltoid-ovate bracts, these 0.4-0.8 mm long and broad, obtuse at apex, ciliolate, dorsally strigillose, the pedicels slender, terete, 6-25 mm long at anthesis; calyx at first puberulent but soon glabrate, 3.5-4.3 mm in diameter at anthesis, the lobes broadly ovate, 1-2 mm long and broad, rounded at apex, obviously ciliolate, with several apparent nerves, the glands compound, each composed of 3-6 lobes 0.3-0.6 mm long;
