description: Liana (or slender shrub with scandent branches), the branchlets slender, subterete or faintly quadrangular distally, often conspicuously lenticellate; leaves opposite, the petioles rugose, 4-8 mllm. lonig, the leaf-blades chartaceous, olivaceous when dried, elliptic-oblong, 10-20 cm. long, 4-6.5 cm. broad, acute at base and decurrent on the petiole, caudate-acuminate or conspicuously cuspidate at apex (acumen 7-15 mnl. long, obtuse), crenulate-serrulate at margins (crenations 1 or 2 per centimeter, often minutely apiculate, sometimes essentially obseure), the costa prominent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 9-12 per side, arcuate-ascending, anastomosing toward margins, prominulous on both surfaces, the veinlets copiously reticulate, prominuilous on both surfaces; inflorescence 2-3.5 cm. long at anthesis, thyrsoidpaniculate (branchlets and bracts usually alternate, frequently subopposite), divided from base, the branchlets slender, the bracts ovate, obtuse, less than 1 mm. long, sometimes fimbriolate; flowers 2.5-2.8 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the pedicels less than 1 mm. long; sepals papyraceous, deltoid-ovate, 0.4-0.5 mm. long, 0.5-0.7 mm. broad, obtuse or subacute, entire; petals submembranous, obovate, 1.3-1.5 mm. long, 0.9-1.2 mm. broad, rounded at apex, distally erosulous or fimbriolate at margins, obseurely glandular-punetate, obscurely and minutely puberulent distally within; disk membranous, erect, 0.2-0.8 mm. high, 0.7-0.8 mm. in diameter, crenate-undulate at margin; stamens erect, the filaments very slender, filiform-ligulate, 0.5-0.7 mm. long, hardly broadened at base, the anthers about 0.2 by 0.4 mm.; ovary depressed-trigonous, 0.4-0.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, sharply angled, the style 0.2-0.3 mm. long, the stigmas conspicuously divaricate, alternate with stamens, faintly emarginate at apices; ovules apparently 2 per locule.

description: Liana, the branehes and branehlets stout, subterete; leaves opposite, the petioles stout, rugose, 12-17 mm. long, the leaf-blades coriaceous or thin-coriaceous, olivaceous or dark brown when dried, 9-20 cm. long, 4-10 cm. broad, essentially rounded at base or obtuse and decurrent on the petiole, cuspidate or short-acuminate at apex (acumen 5-8 mm. long), entire and slightly recurved at margins, the costa stout, prominent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 6-9 per side, spreading, sharply raised on both surfaces, the veinlets usually faintly prominu- lous on both surfaces; infloreseence axillary, 3-4.5 cm. long, thyrsoid-paniculate or pseudoeymose, the peduncle 3-10 mm. long, the branch- lets alternate or subopposite, the bracts and bracteoles alternate or subopposite, ovate, appressed, about 1 mm. long; flowers 4-5.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the pedicels about 1 mm. long; sepals 5 (rarely 4), papyraceous, semiorbicular, 0.7-1.3 mm. long, 1-1.5 mm. broad, rounded, entire; petals thin-carnose, elliptic- or subspatulate-obovate, 1.7-2.5 mm. long, 1.3-2.2 mm. broad; disk submembranous, erect, about 0.3 mm. high, 1-1.3 mm. in diameter, subentire or undulate at margin; stamens erect, the filaments 0.4-0.6 mm. long, slightly expanded toward base, the anthers 0.3-0.5 mm. long, 0.6-0.9 mm. broad; ovary trigonous-conical, the style 0.2-0.4 mm. long, the stigmas spreading, deltoid, sub- acute, alternate with stamens; ovules 2 per locule, superposed; fruiting inflorescence greatly swollen, the peduncles woody, up to 1 cm. in diameter, the fruits often paired at apices of peduncles, subglobose or somewhat obovoid, up to 11 cm. in diameter, slightly contracted at base, rounded at apex, the pericarp woody, 9-12 mm. thick, finely rugulose without, the dissepiments persistent and coriaceous, the seeds few (6?), oblong-ovoid, angled, 3-4 cm. long.

description: Liana; branches stout, terete, einereous, the branehlets comparatively slender, often lenticellate; leaves opposite, the petioles thick, rugose, 15-25 mm. long, the leaf-blades coriaceous, olivaceous or brown when dried, elliptic-oblong, 16-25 cm. long, 6-12 cm. broad, obtuse at base, acute or short-cuspidate at apex, entire and narrowly recurved at margins, sparsely black-punctate and closely ceriferous beneath, the costa very prominent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 7-10 per side, arcuate-ascending, anastomosing near margins, raised or con- spicuously prominulous on both surfaces, the veinlets usually inm- mersed; inflorescence 2-3 cm. long, dichotomously 3- or 4-timnes branched, the peduncle 6-10 mm. long, the branchlets often minutely farinose-ceriferous, the bracts subopposite, deltoid, obtuse, less than 1 mm. long; flowers subsessile in ultimate dichotomies or paired at apices of ultimate branchlets, minutely puberulous on exterior surfaces; sepals deltoid, subacute, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.8 mm. broad, erose-ciliate; petals thin-carnose, obovate-oblong, about 1.5 mm. long and 1 mm. broad, erose-fimbriate at margins; disk erect, about 0.4 mm. high, entire at margin; stamens erect, the filaments slender, about 0.8 mm. long, the anthers about 0.4 mm. broad; ovary trigonous-subglobose, the style stout, about 0.2 mm. long, the stigmas oblong, obtuse, recurved, bilobed at apices, alternate with stamens; ovules 2 per locule, super- posed; infloreseence-branches greatly thickened and lenticellate in fruit, the pedicels up to 4 mm. in diameter, somewhat flexuose; fruits ovoid or ellipsoid, at maturity 3-4 cm. long, and 2-2.5 cm. broad, the pericarp woody, 2-4 mm. thick, conspicuously rugose, the seeds few, blackish.

description: Liana; branchlets slenlder, eloingate, terete, striate, einereous, often conspicuously lenticellate; leaves opposite, the petioles stout, 3-4 mm. long, flattened or shallowly canaliculate above, the leaf-blades chartaceous or papyraceous, olivaceous when dried, elliptic-oblong, 11-18 cm. long, 3.5-6.5 cm. broad, obtuse at base, short-acuminate at apex (adumeil 7-15 mm. long, obtuse), entire at margins, the costa prominent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 8-10 per side, spreading, conspicuously anastomosing, sharply prominulous on both surfaces, the veinlets reticulate, faintly prominulous on both surfaces; infloreseence axillary, lax, 4-6 cm. long, thyrsoid-paniculate, usually divided from base, the branchlets very slender, alternate or pseudodichotomous, the bracts alternate or subopposite, ovate, obtuse, 0.6-0.9 mm. long; flowers in dichotomies or subtended by 2 minute bracteoles, the pedicels very slender, 4-7 mm. long; sepals ovate-deltoid, obtuse, 0.5-0.8 mm. long, 0.9-1.3 mm. broad, seariose and entire at margins; petals submem- branous, spatulate-obovate, 1.7-2.2 mm. long, 1.3-1.5 mm. broad, narrowed at base, rounded at apex, entire at margins; disk submembra- nous, erect, about 0.4 mm. high, about 1.5 mm. in diameter, entire at margin; stamens suberect, the filaments 0.5-0.9 mm. long, the ailthers about 0.2 by 0.4 mm.; ovarv depressed-globose, the style about 4 mm. long, the stigmas spreading, deeply lobed, alternate with stamens (the 6 parts essentially subequal) ; ovules apparently 2 per locule, collateral.

description: Liana; branchlets slender, elongate, terete, often lenticellate; leaves opposite or subopposite, the petioles slender, rugose, 7-16 mm. long, the leaf-blades chartaceous, greenish or olivaceous when dried, ellipticoblong, often narrowly so, 13-23 cm. long, 4-7 cm. broad, obtuse to attenuate at base and decurrent on the petiole, short-acuminate at apex (acumen stout, 5-20 mm. long, obtuse or apiculate), entire and often slightly revolute at margins, the costa prominent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 4-7 per side, arcuate-aseending, conspicuously prominulous on both surfaces, the veinlets copiously and conspicuously reticulate and prominulous on both surfaces; inflorescence lax, 7-20 cm. long, thyrsoid-paniculate, the peduncle and branchlets very slender, the peduncle up to 13 cm. long, the branchlets spreading, alternate or subopposite, towards the apices pseudo dichotomously branching, the bracts and bracteoles submembranous, oblong-deltoid, less than 1 mm. long, often erosulous; flowers 5-7 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the pedicels very slender, 6-10 mm. long at anthesis; sepals submembranous, broadly deltoid to semiorbicular, 0.6-1.2 mm. long, 1-1.8 mm. broad, rounded at apex, seariose and erosulous or short-fimbriate at margins; petals yellowish green, membranous to thin-carnose, obovate or suborbicular, 2.8-3.7 mm. long and broad, rounded at apex, conspicuously narrowed toward base, narrowly revolute and subentire or minutely erosulous at margins, obscurely flabellate-nerved; disk thin-carnose, suberect or slightly spreading, 0.2-0.3 mm. high, 1-1.4 mm. in diameter, subentire or faintly undulate at apex; stamens erectopatent, the filaments membranous, 0.5-0.7 mm. long, the anthers 0.15-0.2 mm. long, about 0.3 mm. broad, dehiscing by confluent horizontal (or oblique) apical clefts; ovary depressed-conical, smooth, about 0.6 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the style 0.2-0.3 mm. long, the stigmas obscure; ovules 6 or 8 per locule, superposed in 2 ranks; fruits (in our specimens) paired at apices of woody thickened inflorescence-branches (pedicels stout, cylindric, about 18 mm. long and in diameter, similar to fruit in texture), large, indehiseent, elongate-cylindric, faintly trigonous, up to 11 cm. long and 4.5 cm. in diameter, rounded at base, obtusely short-cuspidate at apex, 3-locular, the dissepiments soon evanescent, the pericarp coriaceous, 2.5-3 mm. thick, minutely rugose, the seeds usually 12-20, congested, ovate, angled, imbedded in pulp, up to 25 mm. long and 18 mm. broad, the testa thin-coriaceous, the cotyledons up to 17 mm. long and 10 mm. broad.

description: Liana; branehlets terete, slender; leaves opposite, the petioles rugose, 9-14 mm. long, the leaf-blades chartaceous or thin-coriaceous, olivaceous or brownish when dried, elliptic-oblong, 10-16 cm. long, 3.5-8 em. broad, obtuse to subattenuate at base and decurrent on the petiole, short-cuspidate at apex, entire and slightly recurved at margins, the costa prominent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 9-13 per side, spreading, prominulous on both surfaces, the veinlets reticulate, prominulous on both surfaces; infloreseence 1-2.5 cm. long at anthesis, divided from base, pseudodichotomously several times branched, the branchlets stout, often farinose-ceriferous, the bracts and bracteoles ovate-deltoid, less than 0.5 mm. long; flowers 3-3.7 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the pedicels 0.5-1.5 mm. long; sepals deltoid, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.7 mm. broad, obtuse or subacute, entire or erosulous; petals thin-carnose, oblong, 1.4-1.8 mm. long, 0.8-1.3 mm. broad, rounded or obtuse at apex, erosulous at margins, sometimes minutely tuberculate within; disk thin-earnose, 0.15-0.3 mm. high, subentire at margin; filaments suberect, 0.4-0.8 mm. long, the anthers about 0.2 by 0.5 mm.; ovary depressed-subglobose, about 0.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, connate to disk at angles, the style about 0.2 mm. long, the stigmas deltoid, entire, subacute, opposite the staniens; ovules 2 or 4 per locule, collateral or in superposed pairs.

description: Liana; branchlets terete, einereous, often Conspicuously lenticellate; leaves opposite, the petioles stout (2-3.5 mm. in diameter), rugose, 9-17 mm. long, the leaf-blades thick-coriaceous, opaque, brownish when dried, elliptic-oblong, (7-)10-25 cm. long, 4-10.5 cm. broad, obtuse to acute at base, obtusely cuspidate at apex, entire or obsoletely crenate and conspicuously revolute at margins, sometimes black-punetate beneath, the costa stout, prominent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 6-12 per side, spreading, faintly prominulous above, elevated beneath, the veinlets immersed, rarely faintly prominulous; infloreseence 1-3.5 cm. long, pseudodichotomously branched essentially from base, the branchlets usually minutely farinose-ceriferous, the bracts and bracteoles thin-coriaceous, ovate, obtuse, less than 1 mm. long; flowers sub-sessile, congested, 2.2-3 mm. in diameter; sepals papyraceous or thin- coriaceous, ovate-deltoid, 0.5-1 mm. long and broad, subacute, entire or seariose and obscurely fimbriolate at margins, minutely puberulent distally without; petals thin-carnose, obovate-oblong, 1.3-2.2 mm. long, 1-1.5 mm. broad, rounded at apex, subentire or minutely erosulous at margins, puberulent on both sides distally; disk thin-carnose, erect, 0.2-0.4 mm. high, 1-1.3 mm. in diameter, undulate at margin; stamens suberect, the filaments membranous, 0.5-0.8 mm. long, the anthers often sharply reflexed, 0.2-0.3 mm. long, 0.4-0.6 mm. broad; ovary depressed- globose-trigonous, 0.6-1 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the style 0.2-0.5 mm. long, the stigmas spreading, oblong, deeply emarginate or bilobed, alternate with stamens; ovules 2 per locule, collateral-superposed; fruiting inflorescences much thickened, the branchlets up to 3 mm. in diameter, the immature fruits ellipsoid, rounded at apex, the pericarp coriaceous, obscurely rugulose, blackish when dried.

description: Rhizomes coarse, the aerial portion sometimes exceeding 5 dm. in length, the dark brown fibrose-reticulate leaf-sheaths persistently marcescent; leaves erect, 3.0-4.5 dm. long, 5-11 mm. wide, scabrid-serrulate, flat, finally becoming involute, moderately to densely pilose at the base, the margins and prominent mid-rib pubescent, otherwise subglabrous; flowering culms strongly compressed sharp- margined, 2-3 mm. wide, 2.0-4.5 dm. long including the 1-3 dm. long inflores- cence, basal sheath about 2.5 cm. long, sheaths of the inflorescence minutely puberulent on the prominent veins; inflorescence predominately either staminate or pistillate; staminate spikelets numerous, 4-5 mm. long, sterile glumes 5-6, broadly lanceolate to oblong, the lower attenuate-awned, the upper short. mucronate, mrinutely puberulent towards the apex, staminiferous glumes 2-3, ob- long, emucronate, subscarious, stamens 6; pistillate spikelets 4 mm. long, sterile glumes 5-6, similar to the staminate but somewhat narrower, fertile glumes ap- parently 1, 0.8-1.0 mm. thick, emucronate, subscarious; achenes 3.2-3.5 mm. long, the body about 2 mm. long, obovoid-trigonal, densely puberulent towards the abruptly constricted apex, the tricarpellary sutures prominent, beak 1.0-1.5 mm. long, terete, obtuse, puberulent only at the base; perianth scales about 0.3 mm. long, scarious, fimbriate essentially to the base.

description: Woody vine, villous, monoecious, with functionally unisexual flowers. Young branches, inflorescence axes and petioles densely covered with short, erect, whitish or light brown hairs, intermixed with minute, orange, glandular trichomes. Flowering branchlets 1.3 mm diam, terete; older ones 2.5 mm diam, with 3 or 5 rounded ribs, minutely ferruginous, lenticellate; cross section of stems with a single stele. Leaves 3-foliolate; stipules subulate, caducous, 3-5 x 0.5 mm, abaxially pubescent, adaxially glandular pubescent; petiole furrowed along adaxial surface, 0.7-4 cm long; petiolules up to 10 mm long on distal leaflet, 1-4 mm long on lateral ones; leaflets chartaceous, ovate, 2.5-9.5 x 1-5.5 cm, acute or obtuse at apex, mucronate, the margin dentate-serrate with 6-30 obtuse glandular teeth, the lower surface greenish brown, pubescent, with inflexed hairs, the upper surface drying blackish, densely to sparsely covered with short hairs, the midrib villous, and minute glandular hairs on both surfaces; terminal leaflets cuneate-decurrent at the base, the lateral leaflets asymmetric with a narrower acroscopic side, obtuse or obtuse-decurrent at base. Thyrses axillary, spicate, simple, solitary or paired, or double, the axis nearly terete in cross section, 0.6-2 cm long, the rachis slightly angular and striate, 0.6-7.5 cm long, with two caducous tendrils at its base or these absent; peduncle of cincinni 0.5-2.25 mm long, the cincinni curved, 4-5-flowered; pedicels (1.5-)2.5-3 mm long, somewhat hispid, articulated at base; bracts triangular-subulate, caducous, 1-2.25 mm long, abaxially villous, with sparsely glandular hairs adaxially; bracteoles similar to the bracts but smaller. Flowers 3-3.5 mm long; sepals 5, the outer two cucullate, ovate, 1.5 x 1 mm, adaxially minutely pubescent, the inner one ovate or obovate, the third and fifth connate at base, 2-2.75 x 1.25-1.75 mm; all minutely glandular at margins, all or only the outer ones somewhat hispid; petals white, oblong or obovate, clawed, 1.75-2.5 x 0.75-1 (-1.5) mm, abaxially sparsely glandular, adaxially densely glandular; appendages of the central petals with an insignificant earshaped crest; disc glands 4, prominent, the central two circular in outline, the lateral ones ovoid, obtuse at the apex; torus glabrous, except for a ring of hairs at the androecium base. Staminate flowers with stamens 2-2.75 mm long, the filaments puberulent near the base, the anthers with an inconspicuous appendage at apex; pistillode 0.8 mm long, with few glandular hairs. Pollen grains heteropolar, hemitrisyncolporate, peroblate or oblate, polar axis (13.1-)15.7(-19.6) mm, equatorial diam (26.2-)32.3(-43.2) mm, proximal polar side perforate-microreticulate, distal polar side perforate-microreticulate or perforatefossulate. Pistillate flowers with staminodia 1.75 mm long, anthers indehiscent; gynoecium 2.75 mm long, the ovary trigonous, ellipsoid in outline, villous, with sparsely glandular hairs, the style shorter than or as long as the stigmas. Capsules septifragal, chartaceous, 1-seeded (2 ovules aborted), obovate or oblong in outline, light brown, apex truncate-emarginate, 2.4-3.1 x 1.5-1.8 cm, the stipe 0.5-2.5 mm long, the locules compressed, 9-10 x 2-3 mm, the wings 4-6 mm wide; epicarp villous on the seed-bearing portion, the wings with simple and glandular hairs; endocarp pubescent, the hairs curly. Seeds ellipsoid in lateral view, trigonous in transverse section, 4.8-5.3 x 3.5-3.9 mm, inserted near the base of the locule; aril dry, yellowish and crescent-shaped; embryo with the outer cotyledon curved and the inner one biplicate.

description: Large tree, the branchlets robust, densely and persistently tomentose, the hairs ferruginous, branching from base or irregularly, 0.5-1 mm. long; petioles canaliculate, stout, 3-4 mm. in diameter, 5-8 mm. long, tomentose as the branchlets; leaf blades thin coriaceous, oblong, 14-18 cm. long, 4.5-7 cm. broad, subcordate at base, subacute or cuspidate at apex, glabrous above except on the tomentellous costa, beneath densely tomentose (hairs stalked, irregularly branched, about 0.5 mm. long), the costa plane or slightly depressed above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves 25-30 per side, straight, slightly impressed above, raised beneath, those near the base very short and slightly recurved, the veinlets reticulate, nearly plane and obscure; 'staminate inflorescences broadly paniculate, freely branching, many-flowered, up to 15 cm. long and broad, the peduncle 3-5 cm. long, with the branchlets densely tomentose with hairs similar to those of the foliage branchlets; flowers densely aggregated on short ultimate peduncles, probably about 15-30 per cluster, associated with membranous puberulent orbicular somewhat persistent bracts 5-7 mm. long and broad; pedicels very short or none; perianth submembranous, 1.7-1.9 mm. long, densely tomentelous without (hairs branched from base, about 0.2 mm. long), 3-lobed nearly to base, the lobes oblong, obtuse; androecium 1.2-1.6 mm. long, the filament column slender, 0.4-0.6 mm. long, the anthers 3, 0.8-1 mm. long, free and conspieuously divergent in the apical one-half or two- thirds, oblong, obtuse or minutely apieulate at apex; pistillate inflorescences and fruits not known.

description: Tree: branchlets slender, when young densely tomentose (hairs ferruginous, few-branched, up to 0.5 mm. long), soon glabrous; petioles canaliculate, slender, 1.5-2 mm. in diameter, 5-11 mm. long, tomentose as the branchlets; leaf blades chartaceous or thin coriaceous, oblong or narrowly obovate-elliptic, 8-16 cm. long, 2.5-5 cm. broad, truncate or shallowly cordate at base, subacute or cuspidate at apex, ferruginous tomentellous beneath (hairs usually sessile but sometimes short-stalked, 3-5-branched, 0.2-0.4 mm. ill diameter), the costa shallowly grooved above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves 18-30 per side, straight, slightly impressed above, raised beneath, the veinlets obscure; staminate inflorescences narrow, once-branched, 3-7 cm. long, the pedicel 1-2 cm. long, conspicuously flattened, with the branchlets and flowers dark brown tomentellous (hairs irregularly 3-8-branched, 0.2-0.3 mm. in diameter), the branchlets few, short, the flower clusters 3-9, those toward the apex sessile; bracts oblong, acute, 5-8 mm. long, puberulent, soon deciduous; flowers arranged in clusters of 8-20, the pedicels slender, up to 2 mm. long; perianth thin carnose, 2-2.3 mm. long, 3- lobed nearly to base, the lobes obtuse; androecium 1.4-1.6 mm. long, the filament column slender, 0.7-1 mm. long, the anthers 3, 0.5-0.7 mm. long, obtuse at apex, tapering at base; pistillate and fruiting inflorescences not seen.

description: Tree up to 40 m. high, often buttressed, the trunk above buttresses up to 1.3 m. in diameter; branches conspicuously whorled and spreading; branchlets often rugose, at first densely tomentose (hairs stellate from base or irregularly branched, about 0.2 mm. long), at length puberulent or glabrescent; petioles shallowly canaliculate, 2-5 mm. in diameter, 10-25 mm. long, tomentose as the branchlets; leaf blades coriaceous, often shining above, oblong, ovate, or elliptic or deltoid  oblong, or narrowly oblong, 15-47 cm. long, 6-15 cm. broad (leaves occasionally smaller on flowering branchlets), cordate, rounded, truncate, or broadly obtuse at base (often subacute toward periphery of geographic range), acuminate, acute, or cuspidate at apex, glabrous above, uniformly tomentose beneath (hairs stalked, stellate, or irregularly stellate, 3-6-branched, 0.2-0.3 mm. long, the stalk sometimes obscurely jointed), often somewhat glabrescent with age, the costa prominent on both surfaces, very strong beneath, the secondary nerves 10-28 per side, straight or arcuate, slightly impressed or raised above, prominent beneath, the veinlets plane or slightly impressed above and prominulous beneath; androecium 0.9-2 mm. long, the filament column carnose, usually swollen at base, 0.2-0.6 mm. long, the anthers usually 3 (sometimes 4 or 5), 0.7-1.5 mm. long, connate to apex or more or less divergent distally but rarely conspicuously so, apiculate at apex, the apiculum single or divided, 0.1-0.2 mm. long; pistillate inflorescences 3-7 cm. long, nearly as broad, tomentellous as the staminate inflorescences, the peduncle 0.5-4 cm. long; flowers single or in small clusters of 2-5, the pedicels stout, 1-2 mm. long, the ovary subglobose, often somewhat acute at apex, densely tomentose (hairs 0.2-0.3 mm. long, with numerous short crowded lateral spurs), the stigma small, sessile; fruiting inflorescences up to 6 en. long, at length glabrescent, the mature fruits 5-10 per inflorescence, pedicellate (pedicels slender, 2-3 mm. long), subglobose, faintly carinate, 10-14l mm. in diameter, densely tomentose as the ovary, glabrescent, the pericarp brittle, 0.2-0.7 min. thick, the aril membranous, laciniate nearly to base.

description: Perennis; caulis repens, ramosus, minute pubescens; folia elliptica, obtusa, crenato-dentata, glabra, majora 0.9-1.4 cm. longa; racemi usque ad 18 cm. longi; pedicelli 4-5 mm. longi; sepala 4-6 mm. longa, elliptico-oblonga, obtusa, ciliata; corolla 4-5 mm. longa, laete purpurea, lineata; capsula obcordata, glabra.

description: Stems branched, repent, pubescent with minute ascending incurved hairs. Leaves opposite, the blades elliptic or narrowly so, obtuse, crenate-dentate, glabrous, the larger 0.9-1.4 cm. long, 4-8 mm. wide, on petioles 2-3 mm. long. Flowering shoots erect, forming racemes up to 18 cm. long. Bracts sessile, oblong-lanceolate, 5-10 mm. long, obtuse, finely pubescent (especially on margins). Pedicels becoming 4-5 mm. long, erect or slightly spreading, finely pubescent with ascending-incurved hairs. Sepals becoming 4-6 mm. long, elliptic-oblong, obtuse, hirtous (especially ciliate). Corolla 4-5 mm. long, glabrous, the posterior and antero-lateral lobes oval (3 mm. wide), the mid-anterior oblong (1 mm. wide); corolla "pale purple, darker veined"9 with wide stripes. Filaments 2 mm. long. Style 1-1.5 mm. long. Capsule flattened, wider than long, obcordate, glabrous, at least 4 mm. wide (not seen mature), the 2 lobes rounded.
bibliographicCitation: Pennell, Francis W. 1936. New and noteworthy Papuan Scrophulariaceae. Brittonia. 2: 177-188.

description: Species V. Mullahca Ham. affinis, differt foliis multo angustioribus, oblongo-lanceolatis vel late oblongo-lanceolatis, graciliter caudato-acuminatis, nervis utrinque paucioribus, utrinque 3 vel 4, subtus in axillis barbatis, dentibus paucis, utrinque 2-3 vel foliis integris. Frutex suberectus, partibus junioribus breviter stellato-pubeseentibus, vetustioribus glabris vel subglabris; ramis teretibus, glabris, haud vel parcissime lenticellatis, rubrobrunneis vel subeinereis, ramulis ultimis breviter stellato-pubeseentibus, 1.5 mm. diametro; foliis chartaceis, oblongo-lanceolatis vel late oblongo-lanceolatis, 7-12 cm. longis, 2-3.5 cm. latis, basi late acutis vel subobtusis, apice graciliter caudato- vel subeaudato-acuminatis, acuminibus 1-1.5 cm. longis, faleatis vel subrectis, acutis, aliquando integris, plerumque in parte superiore utrinque dentes 2-3 breves acutos distantes gerentibus, in sieco supra subolivaceis, nitidis, glabris, subtus paullo pallidioribus, axillis barbatis, costa nervisque elevatis parcissime subadpresse hirsutis, ceteroquin glabris; nervis primariis utrinque 3-4, adscendentibus, marginem attingentibus, plerumque in dentibus exeuentibus, reticulis laxis, elevatis; petiolo eirciter 1 cm. longo, breviter pubeseenti; infloreseentiis umbellatis, sub fructu eirciter 7 cm. diametro, radiis primariis 6-7, patulis, eirciter 2 cm. longis, teretibus vel obscure angulatis, leviter breviterque stellato-pubeseentibus, secundariis paucioribus, patulis, 1-1.5 cm. longis; fructibus subcompressis, ovoideis vel oblongo-ovoideis, eirciter 7 mm. longis, pericarpio pellucidococeineo, seminibus compressis, obscure suleatis.

description: Terrestrial shrub to 1.5 m tall; mature stems terete, striate, glabrate; bark gray when dry, cracking longitudinally; twigs subterete, bluntly angled, striate, short-pilose, drying reddish-brown. Leaves coriaceous, "whitened below," ovate, broadly ovate-elliptic, to semiorbicular, 0.8-1.9 x 0.5-1.8 cm, basally rounded, sometimes subcordate, sometimes very short-decurrent, apically obtuse, retuse, marginally entire, essentially glabrous but usually tufted pilose at the apical notch, midrib slightly impressed above and raised beneath, lateral nerves raised above, anastomosing, slightly raised but usually inconspicuous beneath, veinlets slightly raised or obscure on both surfaces; petiole terete, rugose, densely short-pilose, ca 2 mm long. Inflorescence seemingly terminal, solitary, racemose, 10-20-flowered, the lowest flowers sometimes subtended by leaf-like bracts or scattered flowers even appearing solitary in normal upper-leaf axils; rachis angled, sparsely pilose basally as it grades into the twig but glabrous distally, ca 1.5-3 cm long at anthesis but lengthening to 5 cm later; floral bracts elliptic, obtuse, 3-4 mm long, basally ciliate along margins; pedicels subterete, angled, 3-4 mm long at anthesis but lengthening to 10 mm later, glabrous; bracteoles basal to medial, ovate-lanceolate, 1(-3) mm long, marginally ciliate. Flowers: calyx glabrous, glaucous, ca 3 mm long, articulate with the pedicel, stipitate; hypanthium globose and constricted into the stipe at the very base, purple when fresh, 1.5-2 mm long; limb campanulate, ca 1-1.5 mm long including the lobes; lobes green when fresh, broadly triangular, acuminate, ca 0.75-1 mm long; sinuses rounded; corolla cylindric, glabrous, white when fresh, 4-4.2 mm long; lobes triangular, obtuse, ca 1-1.2 mm long, reflexed; stamens 10, equal, 3 mm long; filaments distinct, marginally ciliate distally, 1.5-1.8 mm long; anthers 1.5 mm long including tubules; thecae ca 0.7 mm long; ovary 5-locular, style 3 mm long; disc pulvinate, glabrous. Berry purple, "edible," 6-8 mm diam; seeds ovoid, ca 2.2 mm long, the testa with thinwalled cells that do not become mucilaginous on wetting, the embryo drying whitish.
bibliographicCitation: Luteyn, James L. 1986. A new Vaccinium (Ericaceae) from Guayanan Brazil. Brittonia. 38: 101-103.

description: Probabiliter annua, laxe vel vix caespitosa, radicibus fibrosis. Culmi graciles, erecti, 6-20 cm alti, 0.2-0.5 mm crassi, obtuse trigoni, laeves, basi pauci-foliati. Folia dimidium culmi haud attingentia; laminae graciliter lineares, 2-10 cm longae, 0.5-1 mm latae, planiusculae, flaccidae, praeter margines apicales spinuloso-scabridos laeves, ad apicem breviter acuminatum abrupte contractae; vaginae 0.5-1 cm longae, pallidae vel dilute cinnamomeae; ligula deest. Inflorescentia spiculis 2-9 subdigitatim dispositis constructa, raro tantum unispiculata, 1-3 cm longa, 2-4 cm lata; bracteae involucrantes 2 vel 3, squamiformes, costa in mucronem setaceum ca. 3 mm longum excurrente. Spiculae sessiles vel breviter (ca. 1-6 mm) pedunculatae, lineares vel lineari-oblongae, teretes, 5-12 mm longae, 1-1.2 mm crassae, apice subito acutae, 6-24-florae, brunneo-castaneae, eae laterales plerumque divergentes vel leviter re- flexae. Glumae spiraliter dispositae, suberectae, ovatae vel ovato-deltoideae, semper muticae, 2.5-3 mm longae, 1.6-2 mm latae, apice obtusiusculae, latere utrinque tenuiter chartaceae glabrae nitidulae castaneo-brunneae, margine late albescenti- hyalinae, costa 3-nervia haud prominente leviter naviculares. Achaenia late obovata, apice rotunda non umbonulata, 0.75-0.9 mm longa, 0.5-0.6 mm lata, biconvexa, maturitate brunnescentia, ex toto sparse albo-verruculosa, obsolete lineolata, cellulis extimis transverse oblongis vix impressis; stylus 2-2.2 mm longus, glaber, basin versus leviter dilatatus, apice bifidus stigmatibus 2 ca. 0.5 mm longis. Stamina 2 vel 3; antherae 0.5 mm longae.
bibliographicCitation: Koyama, Tetsuo M. 1978. Studies in the Cyperaceae of Thailand I. New and otherwise noteworthy species of Fimbristylis. Brittonia. 30: 102-108.

description: Frutex parvus, ramulis juventute angulatis et pubescentis; petiolis circiter 1 mm. longis; laminis coriaceis utrinque glabris eglandulosis juventute glaucis, late ellipticis 1.5-2 cm. longis, 1-1.5 cm. latis, basi late obtusis, apice late obtusis, margine integris et anguste revolutis; inflorescentiis terminalibus vel axillaribus vel 2.5 cm. longis, ramulis sparse puberulis glaucis, bracteis angustatis puberulis, circiter 3-4 mm. longis; pedicel. lis glabris sub anthesi 3-4 mm. longis ad medium bibracteolatis, bracteolis subulatis eglandulosis glabris circiter 2 mm. longis; calyce et margine glabro, lobis 5 acuminatis circiter 2 mm. longis; corolla glabra tenuiter carnosa, anguste campanulata circiter 4 mm. longa, lobis 5 subacutis circiter 1.2 mm. longis apice reflexis; staminibus 10 subsimilibus in corollam inclusis, filamentis puberulis, antheris quam filamentis paullo brevioribus, tubulis quam loculis brevioribus per poros lateralis vel introrsos dehiscentibus; ovario glabro et glauco (sp?).
bibliographicCitation: Lasser, Tobias & Maguire, Bassett. 1950. A report on the plant of the Phelps Cerro Yaví expedition of 1947. Brittonia. 7: 75-90.

description: Shrubs 5-120 cm high, rhizomatous, forming open colonies. Twigs green, conspicuously 3-angled, glabrous or minutely puberulent along the grooves. Leaves broadly elliptical or ovate, 19-27 X 7-11 mm, green, laxly glandular beneath; margin serrate. Calyx green and glabrous; lobes very small or absent then the margin of the calyx tube merely sinuate. Corolla thin, globose, pink, cream, or greenish white, 3-5 mm long, 5-7 mm diam., 3-5 mm deep; lobes very small. Stamen filaments glabrous; staminal awns at base of tubules; pollen tetrads 34-38 pim diam. Berries purple black, bluish black, rarely reddish or red, 7-9 mm diam.; seeds ca. 1 mm long. Chromosome numbers 2n = 24, 48 (Rousi, 1967; Schultz, 1944; Hagerup, 1941; Rutland, 1941; Love & Love, 1956; Hedberg & Hedberg 1961; Sorsa, 1962).
bibliographicCitation: Vander Kloet, S. P. & Dickinson, T. A. 1999. The taxonomy of Vaccinium section Myrtillus (Ericaceae). Brittonia. 51: 231-254.

description: Frutex parvus ut videtur expansus; ramulis teretibus juventute cano-tomentellis demum glabris; petiolis semiteretibus basi inlerassatis 1-3 mm. longis, decidue tomeintellis; laminis coriaceis juventute ut videtur glaucis mox fusco-viridibus et subtus pallidioribus, late obovatis vel suborbicularibus, 20-45 nmm. longis, 11-28 mm. latis, basi obtusis vel late cuneatis, apice rotundatis vel obscure retusis (raro obscure crenulatis), margine subintegris et obscure revolutis, eglandulosis, juventute subtus et costa supra breviter cano-pilosis, pilis interdum subtus ad nervos persistentibus interdum evanidis; infloreseentiis terminalibus vel axillaribus paniculatis 2-4 (-6) cm. longis, ramulis bracteis et petiolis dense cailo-tomentellis; bracteis oblongis acutis circiter 2 mm. longis; petiolis eglandulosis sub anthesi 2-4 mm. longis basin versus bibracteolatis, bracteolis subulatis tomentellis eglandulosis; calyce piloso, lobis 5 deltoideis acutis eirciter 1 mm. longis; corolla tenuiter carnosa globoso-urceolata eirciter 4 mm. longa, extra lineis lobos oppositis praecipue apicem versus cano-puberula intra glabra, lobis 5 acutis reflexis eirciter 1 mm. longis; staminibus 10 subsimilibus eirciter 3 mm. longis, filamentis ubique puberulis eirciter 2 mm. longis, antheris quam filamentis paullo brevioribus, loculis rugulosis, tubulis quam loculis longioribus per poros laterales eirciter 0.5 mm. longos dehiseentibus; ovario plerumque glabro (interdum plus minusve persistenter puberulo); fructibus immaturis globosis glaucis.

description: Frutex mediocris, ramulis juventute angulatis et cano-puberulis demumn teretibus nigrescentibus glabris; petiolis semiteretibus mox glabris 3-4.5 mm. longis superne anguste alatis; laminis coriaceis utrinque glabris eglandulosis j uventute glaucis demum fusco-viridibus, anguste obovatis vel spathuilatis, 30-45 (-60) mnm. longis, 8-15 (-20) mm. latis, basi anguste cuneatis vel attenuatis et petiolo decurrentibus, apice rotundatis vel obscure retusis, margine integris et anguste revolutis; inflorescentiis terminalibus vel axillaribus interdum subpaniculatis 4-6 (-10) cm. longis, ramulis dense et persistenter cano-puberulis saepe basi bracteis foliorum laminis similibus sed minoribus subtentis (bracteis saepe subtus puberulis et apice mucronulatis, interdum ad 1-2 mm. longis reductis) ; pedicellis puberulis eglandulosis sub anthesi 4-5 min. sub fructu 5-6 mm. longis basin versus vel infra medium bibracteolatis, bracteolis subulatis eglandulosis puberulis circiter 1 mm. longis; calyce praeter lobos apicem versus parce et minute puberulos et margine subeiliatos glabro, lobis 5 deltoideis acutis circiter 1 mm. longis; corolla teiiuiter carnosa globoso-urceolata eirciter 4 mm. longa praeter lobos extra parce puberulos glabra, lobis 5 acutis eirciter 1 mm. longis apice reflexis; stamilnibus 10 subsimilibus eirciter 3 mm. longis, filamentis ubique puberulis eirciter 2 mm. longis, antheris quam filamentis paullo brevioribus, loculis rugulosis, tubulis quam loculis brevioribus per poros laterales vel introrsos eirciter 0.5 mm. longos dehiscentibus; ovario glabro; fructibus cariosis globosis maturitate ult videtur 6-8 mm. diametro juventute glaucis demum fuscescentibus.

description: Accedit prope Fimbristylidem bisumbellatam atque F. merrillii a quibus differt planta perennis breviter rhizomatosa et achaenio tantum leviter cancellato cellulis extimis non impressis. Caespitosa, rhizomate breve oblique adscendente 1-2 mm longo 1.5-2 mm crasso. Culmi graciles, 25-45 cm alti, 0.3-0.6 mm crassi, trigoni, laeves, glabri. Folia 2-5, 1/4-3/4 culmi aequantia; laminae anguste lineares, canaliculatae, 5-20 cm longae, 0.5-1 mm latae, glabrae, apice abrupte acutae, margine plus minus involutae; vaginae 1-6 cm latae, leviter dilatatae et laminis latiores, ventraliter scariosae stramineo-brunnescentes sursum pubescentes, ore oblique truncatae, pube ca 0.25 mm longa ligulatae. Anthela semi-composita vel composita, 3-6 cm longa, 1.5-3.5 cm lata, laxe 7-15 (raro usque 23) spiculosa; radii usque 5, valde inaequales, erecto-patentes, filiformes, glabri laeves, imus 2-4 cm longus; cladoprophylla brunneo-mem- branacea, sursum pubescentia; bracteae duae inferiores subfoliaceae, basi marginibus brunneo- scariosis pubescentibus dilatatae, ima 1-7 cm longa quam anthela multo brevior vel longior. Spiculae ovoideo-ellipsoideae vel oblongo-ellipsoideae, 4-8 mm longae, 1.5-2 mm latae, teretes, apice acutae, ferruginescentes, 20-40-florae. Glumae spiraliter dense imbricatae, erecto-patentes, late ovatae vel late ovato-ellipticae, apice acutae, 1.5-1.8 mm longae, 1.2-1.3 mm latae, medio membranaceae laete brunneae 3- vel 5-nerviae ecarinatae, marginibus latissime albo-scariosae, costa trinervia apicem haud attingente. Achaenia obovata vel late obovato-obdeltoidea, 0.6-0.7 mm longa, 0.5-0.6 mm lata, biconvexa, non marginata, basi cuneata, apice rotunda vel sub- truncata, minutissime umbonulata, ad angulos sparse verruculosa, faciebus seriebus longi- tudinalibus 14-17 cellulae oblongo-hexagonalium non impressae leviter cancellata, maturitate fulvescentia vel glauco-fulva; gynophorum depresso-obdeltoideum, vix 0.1 mm longum; stylus ca 2.5 mm longus, valde compressus, marginibus hyalino-alulatus supra medium copiose fimbriatus, stigmatibus 2, ca 1 mm longis. Stamina 2 vel 3; antherae lineares, 1-1.2 mm longae.

description: Arbuscula epiphytica vel terrestris, 1-3 m alta. Folia obscure 3-5-plinervia, coriacea, ovata vel lanceolata vel elliptica, apice acuta vel acuminata et basi cuneata vel rotundata, (2.5) 4-8 (11) X (1.5) 2.5-4.5 (6.2) cm; petioli 1-2 mm longi, glabri. Inflorescentia axillaris, umbellato-racemosa, 2-4 (5) cm longa; bracteae ovato-lanceolatae vel lanceolatae, 1-3 mm longae; pedicelli 1-3 mm longi, glabri vel puberuli; bracteolae 0.8-1.5 (2) mm longae. Hypanthia cum pedicello articulata, campanulata, 2.5-3 mm diam, glabra vel puberulenta; lobi calycis 5, triangulares, 0.5-0.8 mm longi, acuti. description: Annua, omnibus partibus glabra, subdense caespitosa, radicibus fibrosis. Culmi plures, filiformes, erecti, 8-20 cm alti, 0.25-0.5 mm crassi, acute 3- vel 4-quetri, laeves sed sub inflorescentia plerumque hispiduloso-scaberuli. Folia basilaria, pluria; laminae anguste lineares, suberectae, 2-7 cm longae, 0.8-1.2 mm latae, canaliculato-planae, tenuiter 5-vel 6-nerviae, crassiuscule herbaceae, laevissimae, apice obtusae rotundaeve; ligula non evoluta; vaginae 5-10 mm longae, dilatatae, brunneo-cinnamomeae, ventre hyalinae, ore truncatae. Inflorescentia monostachya. Spicula elliptica vel lanceolato- elliptica, erecta, apice basique acuta, 1-2 cm longa, 2.5-4 mm lata, valde compressa, interdum medio torta, spisse 10-28-flora, straminea vel fulva; rhachilla alata. Glumae regulariter distiche dispositae, erecto-patentes, lanceolatae, apice acutae vel acutius- culae, 4-6.2 mm longae, 2-2.2 mm latae, costa 1-nervia virente acute carinatae, chartaceae, stramineae, marginibus angustissime albo-hyalinae. description: Rhizoma breve, oblique adscendens. Culmus erectus, rigidus, 45-50 cm altus, compressotrigonus, 2-2.5 mm crassus, laevis. Folia pluria, ad basin culmi dense aggregata, subdistiche disposita; laminae lineares, valde obcompressae, 5-20 cm longae, 3-4 mm latae, planiusculae, coriaceae, ad apicem obtusum vel breviter acutum subito contractae, margine utrinque subdense ciliatae, basin versus pubescentes, interdum fere glabrescentes, basi pube transversali ca 0.5 mm longa ligulatae; vaginae 15-40 mm longae, brunnescentes, antice hyalinae brunneae mox solutae, ore oblique sectae dense albo-ciliatae. Inflorescentia anthelata, subdensa, 3- vel 4-capitata, 4-5 cm longa ac lata; capita globosa, 18-30 mm in diametro, dense multi-spiculosa, ferruginescentia; radii 2 vel 3, 5-30 mm longi; bractea unica suberecta, 20-35 mm longa, apice abrupte acuta, inflorescentia brevior. Spiculae sessiles, lanceolatae, 9-13 mm longae, 3-4 mm latae. apice acutae, sub-compressae, subdense 15-25-florae. Achaenia obovata vel ± obovato-pyriformia, 2.5 mm longa, 1.8 mm lata, vere trigona, basi cuneato contracta gynophoro depresso, apice rotundo contracta urmbontulata, facie alba seriebus longitudinalibus 6-8 cellulae transverse oblongae impressae trabeculata; stylus 3-3.2 mm longus, gracilis, basi anguste pyramidalis, stigmatibus 3, 1.5 mm longis. description: Shrub, 2-2.5 m tall, with a strict habit, profusely branched and pilosulus on the upper leafy branches, becoming leafless and glabrous in the lower portion, the internodes 5-9 mm, with a thin cylinder of white spongy pith, the upper thinner branches with swollen, solid nodes; leaves ascending, spatulate, (1.3) 2-3.5 (4.7) cm long, 0.8-1.2 cm wide, the blades shallowly crenate-serrate nearly to the petiole, glabrous on the upper surface except the minutely pilosulous impressed veins, the margins and sinuses occasionally pilosulous, the lower surface punctate, often minutely pilosulous on the raised veins, the petioles 5-8 mm long; inflorescence an aggregate dichasium, terminal on leafy branches, capitate, 10-30 mm long, 18-21 mm wide, becoming ellipsoidal and slightly diffuse at maturity, 30-50 mm long, the internodes densely pilose, the nodes tufted-pilose, leafy-bracteate, the bracts 10-12 mm long, 5-8 mm wide, becoming much narrower above; corolla infundibuliform, gibbous, ascending pilose inside the tube, whitish, gynodioecious, the hermaphrodite flower 5.5-7 mm long, the tube 4-5 mm long, the limb spreading, ca 2 mm long, the stamens long-exserted, the anthers 4-lobed, the pistillate flower 4.5-5 mm long, the tube 2.5-3 mm long, the limb spreading, 1.5-1.75 mm long, with 3 abortive stamens, the style and 3-lobed stigma exserted well beyond the tube; achenes ovate to elliptic, 3-3.25 mm long, 1.9-2 mm wide, flattened dorso-ventrally, with a thin peripheral rim, glabrous; calyx-limb short-cupuliform, open on one side.

description: This species, ranging from Bahia to Rio de Janeiro, is marked by the large, long petioled leaves, bearing 3-5 pairs of ovateoblong leaflets with serrate margins. Although I have been unable to trace any isotype of Engler's species, I came upon a collection from the type locality (Rio de Janeiro, Copacabana, Mar 1872, Glaziou 2119, K, P, photo of B sheet in F and SPF) that had been annotated by Engler. Besides this, the beautiful plate in Flora Brasiliensis (Engler, 1874) allows no doubt of the identity of the species.

description: Evergreen shrubs or small trees. Prickles present. Leaves imparipinnate. Leaflets 5-13, opposite to subopposite, obovate to broadly elliptic, to 29 mm long, to 19 mm wide, acute, rounded, or retuse apically, cuneate or rarely rounded basally, margin crenulate, pellucid-punctate marginally, glabrous to rarely puberulent basally. Inflorescences axillary, spicate, to 1.5 cm long, minutely puberulent. Sepals 4, distinct,. persistent. Petals 4, glabrous. Stamens 4 (absent in carpellate flowers). Ovaries 2,, connate basally, stipitate. Follicles 1-2 (per flower), connate basally, stipitate,. glabrous.

description: Stem hypogeous, 9-16 cm long, 4-10.5 cm in diam. Cataphylls chartaceous, base trian- gular, apex aristate, 4.6-7.1 x 2. 1-2.4 at base, yellowish tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 1-2(3), 40-291x24-44 cm, ascending; petiole 35-177 cm long, dark-green with characteristic yellow variegation; petiole subterete, heavily armed with prickles up to 5 mm long; rachis subterete, up to 105 cm long, with few prickles along the proximal third. Leaflets 3- 10 pairs, sessile, papyraceous, elliptic, opposite to subopposite, dark-green with yellow or cream variegation, apex acute, base attenuate; margins dentate along distal third, subrevolute; articulations brown in young leaflets turning green at maturity, 0.4-0.8 cm wide; the median leaflets 12-22x3.1-8.8 cm. Pollen strobili up to 6, erect, long-cylindrical, 7-11 cm long, 1.9-2.5 cm in diam, yellowish-beige, apex acute; peduncle densely light- brown tomentose, 3-6 cm long, 0.7-0.9 cm in diam. Ovulate strobili 1-2 ovoid to cylindrical, 12 cm long, 4.5 cm in diam, gray-greenish tomentulose; megasporangio- phores peltate, distal face hexagonal-truncate, 0.8-1.3 cm high, 1.7-2.1 cm wide. Seeds ovoid, red at maturity, 1.1-1.5 cm long, 0.7- 1 cm in diam, sclerotesta smooth. Chromosome number. - 2n=21, 22 (Moretti et al., 1991).

description: Stern epigeal, erect to decumbent in adult plants, branching dichotomously with age, 30-65 cm long, 10-31.5 cm in diam. Cataphylls chartaceous, persistent, base triangular, apex aristate, 7.1x2.6 cm at base, reddish- brown tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed to erect. Leaves 3-15 or more per apex, 120-190x 45 - 62 cm, ascending, distal portion descending to spreading, brown when emerging turning green at maturity; petiole 38-72 cm long, green-yellowish in young leaves, terete, armed with prickles up to 5 mm long; rachis subterete, up to 84 cm long, with few prickles  along the proximal third. Leaflets 41-52 pairs, sessile, coriaceous, linear-lanceolate, alternate to subopposite, subfalcate, apex acute, base attenuate; margins entire, subrevolute; articulations brown in young leaflets, 0.4-0.8 cm wide; the median leaflets 12-35 x 0.6-1.5 cm. Pollen strobili usually 1-3 per apex, erect, cylindrical to conical, 9-15 cm long, 1.2-2.4 cm in diam, dark-brown tomentulose, apex apiculate; peduncle light-brown tomentose, up 7.2 cm long, 1.2 cm in diam; pollen sporangiophores cuneiform, distal face hexagonal-truncate, 0.45 cm long, fertile abaxial surface with 5 bisporangiate synangia per lobe. Ovulate strobili usually solitary, erect, cylindrical, 12-15 cm long, 6.1-7.3 cm in diam, dark-brown to reddish, tomentulose, apex aristate; peduncle brown puberulent, 2.1 cm long, 1.2 cm in diam; megasporangiophores peltate, distal face hexagonal- truncate, 0.7-0.9 cm high, 1.6-1.8 cm wide. Seeds ovoid to angular, sarcotesta white when immature turning salmon-pink when mature, sclerotesta light-beige, smooth with 6-8 light furrows running longitudinally and sometimes dichotomizing, 2.1-2.6 cm long, 1.4 - 1.9 cm diam.  Chromosome number.  2n=16 (Schutzman et al., 1988).

description: Stem hypogeous, branching dichotomously with age, 5-40 cm long, 5-8 cm in diam. Cataphylls chartaceous, persistent, base triangular, apex aristate, 6x1.4 cm at base, yellowish tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 2-5(8) per crown, 35-60x38-52 cm, ascend- ing to gracile, reddish-brown when emerging, turning green at maturity; petiole 12-21 cm long, green-yellowish in young leaves, subterete, heavily armed with straight to sometimes bifurcate prickles up to 4 mm long; rachis subterete, up to 42 cm long, with few prickles along the proximal third. Leaflets 15-27 pairs sessile, coriaceous, linear, alternate to subopposite, apex acute, base attenuate; margins serrulate along extreme distal portion, subrevolute; articulations light orange when young, turning yellowish with age, 0.3-0.4 cm wide; the median leaflets 20- 35x0.3-0.6 cm. Pollen strobili usually 2-3, erect, cylindrical, 6.5-8.5 cm long, 1.4- 1.9 cm in diam, yellowish-beige tomentulose, apex acute; peduncle densely light-brown tomentose, 6-8 cm long, 0.9-1.1 cm in diam; pollen sporangiophores cuneiform, distal face hexagonal-truncate, 0.3 cm long, fertile abaxial surface with 10-14 bisporangiate syn- angia per lobe. Ovulate strobili usually solitary, erect, cylindrical to oval-cylindrical, 9-12 cm long, 4.2-4.8 cm in diam, brown tomentulose, apex acute; peduncle densely brown tomentose, 3.4-3.8 cm long, 0.8- 1.1 cm in diam; megasporangiophores peltate, distal face hexagonal-truncate, 0.8-1.1 cm high, 1-1.3 cm wide. Seeds ovoid, sarcotesta pink when immature, red at maturity, 1.2- 1.6 cm long, 0.7-0.9 cm in diam, sclerotesta smooth. Chromosome number.  2n= 1 8 (Vovides, 1983; Moretti, 1990a)

description: Stem epigeal, rarely branched with age, up to 100 cm long, 10-12 cm in diam. Cataphylls chartaceous, persistent, base triangular, apex aristate, 8.3 x 2.7 cm at base, light brown-greenish tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed to erect. Leaves 8-15, 100-200 x 20-45 cm, ascending, distal portion descending to spreading, green when emerging; petiole 30- 50 cm long, green in young leaves, terete, armed with minute prickles to unarmed; rachis subterete, up to 150 cm long, unarmed. Leaflets 8-15 pairs, sessile, papyraceous, oblong-lanceolate, glossy, iridescent blue- green, alternate to subopposite, apex abruptly acuminate, base attenuate; margins entire, subrevolute; articulations green, 0.4-0.6 cm the median leaflets 14-18x4-6 cm x. Pollen strobili usually solitary, erect, cylindrical, 12- 15 cm long, 2-4 cm in diam, gray-brown at maturity, apex acute; peduncle light-brown tomentose, up 6.5 cm long, 1.4 cm in diam. Oválate strobili usually solitary, erect, cylindrical, 12-18 cm long, 4-8 cm in diam, brownish when young, iridescent blue-green at maturity, apex aristate; peduncle light brown puberulent, 3.4 cm long, 1.5 cm in diam; megasporangiophores peltate, distal face hexagonal-truncate, 1 .4-2 cm high, 3-3.6 cm wide. description: Stem hypogeous and tuberous, 6-14 cm long, 5-9 cm in diam. Cataphylls chartaceous, persistent, base triangular, apex long-aristate, to 12 cm x 1.5 cm at base, reddish-brown tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 1-5, 20 - 100 x to 55 cm, slightly to slightly recurved, tomentulose when emerging; petiole 35-60 cm long, terete, sparsely to heavily armed with prickles; rachis terete, up to 70 cm long, with few prickles along proximal third. Leaflets 10-15 pairs, sessile, subcoriaceous-coriaceous, long-lanceolate, opposite to subopposite, recurved, apex acute, base attenuate, margins dentate along distal third, subrevolute; articu- lations dark brown when young, 0.3-0.5 cm wide; median leaflets 20-45 x 1-4 cm. description: Stem arborescent, to 2.5 m tall. Leaves 3-6, 1-2 m long; petiole 0.5-1 m long, sparsely to densely prickled; rachis with 6- 10 pairs of leaflets, occasionally with a few prickles in the lower third. Leaflets elliptic, grooved between the veins on the adaxial surface, cuneate basally, acuminate apically, margins serrate in upper third, the median ones 30-50 cm long, 12-15 cm wide. Polleniferous strobili cream to tan, cylin- drical to elongate-cylindrical, 8-12 cm long, 1-2 cm diam. Ovulate strobili brown, short pedunculate, cylindrical to ovoid-cylindrical, 20-40 (50) cm long, 8-12 cm diam. Seeds red, ovoid, 1.5-2.5 cm diam. (2n= 18.)

description: Stem arborescent, to 2 m tall and 15 cm diam., wrinkled in appearance. Polleniferous strobili cream to light yellow, cylindrical, 10-20 cm long, 2-3 cm diam. Ovulate strobili tan to light brown, narrowly ovoid to cylindrical, 20-30 cm long, 8-12 cm diam. Seeds ovoid, red. (2n= 16.)

description: Stem subterranean, subglobose to cylindrical, to 5 cm diam. Leaves 1-3, to 1 m long; petiole to 60 cm, densely prickled; ra- chis with 6-15 pairs of leaflets, some prickles in lower third. Leaflets elliptic-lanceolate, subcoriaceous, cuneate basally, very long acuminate apically, margins entire, the larger median ones 20-30 cm long, 1-3 cm wide. description: Stem subterranean, globose to subcylindric, 2-5 cm diam. Leaves 3-10, 0.5-2 m long; petiole 0.2-1 m long, slightly to dense- ly prickled; rachis often with prickles in low- er third, with 10-30 pairs of leaflets. Leaflets with distinct petiolule and abaxial glandlike collar at the juncture of the lamina, oblong to long-elliptic, margins serrate in upper third, cuneate basally, acute to acuminate apically, the larger median ones 15- 3 5 cm long, 3-7 cm wide. Polleniferous strobili cream to tan, cylindrical, 4-6 cm long, 1-1.5 cm diam.; peduncle 15-30 cm long. description: Stem epigeal, up to 30 cm tall, 18-20 cm in diam. Cataphylls base triangular, apex linear- lanceolate, 3-6 x 1-2 cm wide at base. Leaves 5-20, 100-200 cm long, erect to slightly curved; petiole 50-75 cm long, terete, armed with stout prickles in lower half; rachis terete, up to 100 cm long, with few prickles along the lower half. Leaflets 30-40 pairs, sessile, chartaceous to papyraceous, linear-lanceolate opposite to subopposite, subfalcate near the base, apex long-acuminate and oftern strongly curved, base attenuate, margins serrulate only near the base, subrevolute; articulations 0.4-0.7 cm wide; the median leaflets 25-30 x 4-6 cm. Pollen strobili usually 2-6, erect, cylindrical to oblong, 12-20 cm long and 2-4 cm in diam, cream to light brown, apex acute; peduncle light brown tomentose, 10-20 cm long; pollen sporangiophores cuneiform, distal face hexagonal, 0.4 cm long, fertile abaxial surface 2-lobed with 10-16 bisporangiate synangia per lobe. Ovulate strobili unknown.

description: Stem arborescent, to 60 cm tall, 6-12 cm diam. Leaves 3-10, 0.5-1 m long; petiole with numerous prickles, to 30 cm long; rachis with few prickles in lower third, with 5-8 (10) pairs of leaflets. Leaflets elliptic, grooved between the veins on the adaxial surface, cuneate basally, acuminate apically, margins serrulate in upper third, the larg- er median ones 12-20 cm long, 6-10 cm wide. description: Stem epigeous, globose to cylindrical, to 4 m tall and 10—30 cm wide, erect or prostrate, typically solitary but occasionally branching. Cataphylls chartaceous, narrowly triangular, tomentellous, to 14 cm long and 3 cm wide at base. Leaves pinnately com pound, up to 30 per stem, erect to arching, to 3 m long; petiole to 80 cm long, rachis to 220 cm long; petiole and rachis densely tomentellous on young leaves, gradually becoming glabrous with some trichomes persisting on abaxial side of rachis, moder ately to strongly armed with prickles to 4 mm long throughout petiole and extending to the distal half of rachis or beyond. Leaflets subopposite to subaltérnate, to 44 pairs per leaf, broadly lanceolate with a distinct longi tudinal furrow, typically straight but occa sionally moderately falcate, margins dentate with 22—60 teeth to 3 mm long on distal 3/4 1/2 of leaflet, light green and densely tomen tellous when emerging, glossy bright green at maturity; median leaflets 22-42 x(2.1-)3.6 4.8 cm. Pollen strobili one to many per stem, to 38x4 cm wide, dark brown tomentellous throughout all stages of maturity, peduncle to 23x1.5-2.2 cm, brown tomentellous at all stages of maturity; microsporophylls arranged in 18-26 orthostichies of 32-36 sporophylls each, obtrullate, 11-12 x 6-7 mm at pollen shedding; peltate sterile portions strongly protuberant, 4-5 mm long, encompassing 1/3 to 1/2 of total length of sporophyll, dark brown tomentellous; face hexagonal, 6-7 mm tall, 6-7 mm wide, distal facet shallowly indented, microsporangia 24-32 per microsporophyll, limited to the abaxial surface and separated into two separate groups aggregated along the margin of the spor ophyll blade. Ovulate strobili one to several per stem, pendent at maturity, dark-brown tomentellous, when young, light brown to grey at maturity, 35-50x 10-15 cm, peduncle to 25x2-2.5 cm, extending beyond cataphylls, dark-brown tomentellous when young, gradually progressing to green and glabrous at maturity; strobilus axis and megasporophyll stalks densely tomentellous; megasporophylls arranged in 8-14 orthosti chies of 6—25 sporophylls each, 4—5 x 2—3 cm with stalks 3-3.5 cm long, faces of sterile peltate distal portions hexagonal to oblong hexagonal, 2-3x2.5-3 cm, 1—1.5 cm thick, protruding to small, depressed terminal facet 0.5 X1 cm. Seeds with sarcotesta ovoid pyr amidal to oblong pyramidal, often somewhat flattened longitudinally, red at maturity, 2.8 3.5 X1.4—2.1 cm wide, and sclerotesta 2.5-3.2 x 1.2-1.9 cm wide. 2/7= 16 (Norstog, 1980).

description: Stem hypogeous, branching dichotomously with age, 10-45 cm long, 8-15 cm in diam. Cataphylls chartaceous, persistent, base triangular, apex aristate, 8.4 x 3.7 cm at base, yellowish tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 2-3 (4) ascending to spreading, 45- 96 x 30- 41 cm, light-green when emerging, green to dark-green when mature; petiole 15-25 cm long, green in young leaves, subterete, armed with prickles up to 4 mm long; rachis subterete, up to 57 cm long, with few prickles on the proximal third. Leaflets 12-23 pairs, sessile, coriaceous, linear-lanceolate, opposite to subopposite, apex acute, base attenuate, margins serrulate along distal third, subrevo- lute; articulations 0.4-0.7 cm wide; median leaflets 16-26x 1.8-3.1 cm. Pollen strobili 1- 2 per crown, up to 6 (7) when multiple crowned, erect, cylindrical, 8-14 cm long, 1.8-3.5 cm in diam, light brown tomentulose, apex acute; peduncle light-brown tomentose, 6 cm long, 1 .2 cm in diam; pollen sporangio- phores cuneiform, distal face hexagonal- truncate, 0.3 cm long, fertile abaxial surface with 6-8 bisporangiate synangia per lobe. Ovulate strobili usually 1-2 per crown, erect, ellipsoid to conical, up to 16 cm long, up to 6 cm in diam, beige-tomentulose, apex acute; peduncle brown-tomentose, up to 6 cm long, 1.6 cm in diam; megasporangiophores peltate, distal face hexagonal-truncate, 0.7-1 cm high, 1.9-2.6 cm wide. Seeds ovoid, sarcotesta pink when immature, red at maturity, 1.4-1.8 cm long, 0.8-1 cm in diam, sclerotesta smooth. Chromosome number. - 2n=18 (Norstog, 1980; Moretti, 1990a.b).

description: Stem arborescent, 0.5-5 m tall, 5-12 cm diam. Leaves 5-20, 1-2.5 m long; petiole with numerous small prickles, 30-70 cm long; rachis with prickles in lower third, 10- 20 pairs of leaflets. Leaflets elliptic to ob- ovate, obliquely cuneate basally, acuminate apically, margins serrulate in upper third, the median ones 5-10 cm long, 3-6 cm wide. Polleniferous strobili cream to tan, cylindrical to ovoid-cylindrical, 4-6 cm long, 1- 1.5 cm diam.; peduncle 2-4 cm long. Microsporophylls with sterile tip composed of six steeply inclined facets surrounding a centrally depressed terminal facet, sporangia present on both the adaxial and abaxial surfaces of the fertile region. Ovulate strobili cream to tan, cylindrical to ovoid-cylindrical, 15-25 cm long, 5-8 cm diam. Seeds red, 1-1.5 cm long, 0.5-0.8 cm diam. (2n= 18.)

description: Stem hypogeous, dichotomously branching with age, up to 30 cm long, 4-6 cm in diam. Cataphylls membranaceous, deciduous, base triangular, apex acuminate, 5.x 1.8 cm at base, reddish-brown tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 1-6, ascending to spreading, 34-90x32-38 cm, reddish-brown when emerging, turning green to dark-green at maturity; petiole 16-29 cm long, blackish in young leaves, subterete, armed with simple prickles up to 4 mm long; rachis subterete, 17-45 cm long, with few prickles along the proximal third. Leaflets 3-4(6) pairs, sessile, coriaceous, elliptic to lanceolate, opposite to subopposite, veins highly prominent on adaxial surface, though relatively inconspicuous veins have been reported on some individuals, apex acute, base attenuate, margins dentate along upper third, subrevolute; articulations brown in young leaflets, 0.4-0.8 cm wide; the median leaflets 6-27x2-8.1 cm. Pollen strobili usually 1-2, erect, conical, 2- 4.3 cm long, 0.5-1.1 cm in diam, light-brown tomentulose, apex acute; peduncle light- brown tomentose, 2-3.5 cm long, 0.7- 0.9 cm in diam; pollen sporangiophores cuneiform peltate, distal hexagonal face and truncate to scutiform, 0.25 cm long, fertile abaxial surface with 2 bisporangiate synangia per lobe. Ovulate strobili usually solitary, erect, conical, 6-9 cm long, 3-4. 5 cm in diam, purplish-brown tomentulose when immature turning dark-purple glabrescent when mature, apex acute; peduncle densely dark- brown tomentose, 2.9 cm long, 1.6 cm in diam, distal face hexagonal-scutiform, 0.9- 1.2 cm high, 1.6-2 .1 cm wide. Seeds ovoid, sarcotesta pink when immature, red at maturity, 0.8-1.1 cm long, 0.6-0.8 cm in diam, sclerotesta smooth.

description: Stem hypogeous, branching dichotomously with age, up to 32 cm long, up to 14 cm in diam. Cataphylls chartaceous, persistent, base triangular, apex aristate, 3-6.4x1.3-2.6 cm at base, brown tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 2-3(4), ascending, 30-105 x 29- 45 cm, brown when emerging, green when mature; petiole 10.2-95.3 cm long, greenish in young leaves, subterete, armed with prickles up to 4 mm long; rachis subterete, up to 67 cm long, with few prickles along the proximal third. Leaflets 3-12 pairs, sessile, coriaceous, lanceolate to oblanceolate, opposite to subopposite, apex acute, base attenuate, margins serrulate along upper third, subrevolute; articulations brown when young, green when mature, 0.4-0.8 cm wide; the median leaflets 17-35x2-3.5 cm. Pollen strobili usually 1-2, erect, conical, 6.5-7.3 cm long, 1.1-1.4 cm in diam, light to dark-brown tomentulose, apex acute; peduncle light brown tomentose, 6.8 cm long, 1.2 cm in diam; pollen sporangiophores cuneiform, distal face hexagonal-truncate, 0.4 cm long, fertile abaxial surface with 4-5 bisporangiate synangia per lobe. Ovulate strobili usually solitary, erect, cylindrical to ovoid, 8.7-16.3 cm long, 5-8.3 cm in diam, dark-brown tomentulose, apex acute; peduncle brown tomentose, 4-7.5 cm long, 1.1 cm in diam; megasporangiophores peltate, distal face hexagonal-truncate, 0.8 cm high, 1.8-2.1 cm wide. Seeds ovoid, sarcotesta pink when immature, red at maturity, 1.4-2.1 cm long, 0.5-0.9 cm in diam, sclerotesta smooth. description: Stem epigeous, globose to cylindrical, to 3 m tall and 10-30 cm wide, erect or prostrate, typically solitary but occasionally branching. Cataphylls chartaceous, narrowly triangular, grey-tan tomentellous, to 13 x 3 cm at base. Leaves pinnately compound, up to 35 per stem, erect to arching, to 3 m long, petiole to 90 cm long, rachis to 210 cm long; petiole and rachis glabrous, moderately to strongly armed with prickles to 4 mm long throughout the petiole and extending to the distal half of rachis or beyond. Leaflets subopposite to subaltérnate, to 49 pairs per leaf, narrowly lanceolate with a distinct longitudinal furrow, typically falcate but occasionally straight, margins dentate with 20-42 teeth on distal 3/ 4-1/2 of leaflet, light green and glabrous when emerging, dark green at maturity; median leaflets lets 32 - 45 X 2.5—3.8 cm. Pollen strobili one to many per stem apex, to 27 x 2.5-4 cm, peduncle to 15 x 1.5-2 cm; microsporophylls arranged in 18-22 orthostichies of 40-50 sporophylls each, obtrullate, 8.2-8.6x6.4-7.3 mm at pollen shedding; distal peltate sterile portions strongly protuberant, 2.6-3.2 mm long, encompassing 1/3 to 2/5 of total length of sporophyll; face hexagonal 4-5x4-5 mm, distal facet shallowly indented; microspor angia 24-36 per microsporophyll, limited to the abaxial surface and separated into two separate groups aggregated along the spor ophyll blade margin. Ovulate strobili one to several per crown, leaning at maturity, reddish-brown tomentellous when young, dark brown at maturity, 35-50x10-12 cm, peduncle to 15 cm long, 2-3 cm diameter, extending beyond cataphylls, light to dark brown tomentellous, strobilus axis densely tomentellous; megasporophylls arranged in 8-14 orthostichies of 8-30 sporophylls each, 4-5x2.2-3 cm with glabrous stalks 3.4 4 cm long, faces of sterile peltate distal portions hexagonal to oblong-hexagonal, 2— 3x2.2-3 cm, 1—1.5 cm thick, protruding to a small, depressed terminal facet, to 1 x0.5 cm. Seeds with sarcotesta ovoid pyramidal to oblong pyramidal, often somewhat flattened longitudinally, red at maturity, 3—4 x 1.1— 1.6 cm, sclerotesta 2.5-3.2x 1-1.5 cm.

description: Stem hypogeous to epigeous, rarely branching. Cataphylls chartaceous, persistent, base triangular, apex aristate, 3-4.5x1.2- 2.7 cm at base, brown tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 2-4(6), 57-100x25-35 cm, ascending to spreading, brown when emerging; petiole 12-30 cm long, brown-greenish young leaves, subterete, sparsely to densely armed with prickles up to 4 mm long; rachis subterete, up to 70 cm long, with few prickles along the proximal third. Leaflets 12-18 pairs, sessile, coriaceous, oblong to oblanceolate, opposite to subopposite, apex acute to acuminate, base cunéate, margins serrate to denticulate in the upper two third, subrevo- lute; articulations brown-yellowish in young leaflets, 0.3-0.6 cm wide; the median leaflets 15-20x4-6 cm. Pollen strobili usually 1-2, erect, cylindrical to ovoid, up to 6-10 cm long and 2-4 cm in diam, light brown, apex acute; peduncle densely light brown tomentose, 2-4 cm long, 1.5 cm in diam. Ovulate strobili usually solitary, erect, cylindrical, 10- 15 cm long, 5-7 cm in diam, green, glabrous when mature, apex acute; peduncle brown- greenish tomentose, 3.5 cm long, 1.5 cm in diam; megasporangiophores distal face hexagonal-truncate, 1-1.4 cm high, 1.1-1.8 cm wide. Seeds ovoid, sarcotesta light red when immature, red at maturity, 1.5-2 cm long, 0.5-0.8 cm in diam, sclerotesta smooth.

description: Plants epiphytic. Stem arborescent, to 1 m long and 15 cm diam. Leaves 3-10, 1-3 m long; petiole inermis, 0.3-1 m long; rachis inermis, with 20-50 pairs of leaflets. Leaflets gray-green, oblanceolate, sufalcate basally, acute apically, margins entire, the median ones 30-50 cm long, 2-4 cm wide. Polleniferous strobili cream to tan, cylindrical, 25-50 cm long, 2-4 cm diam. Ovulate strobili yellow-green to tan, cylindrical to ovoid-cylindrical, 25-50 cm long, 8-12 cm diam. Seeds yellow, sarcotesta becoming mucilaginous, 1.5-2.5 cm long, 1-1.5 diam. (2n= 16.)

description: Stem hypogeous, becoming epigeous with age, often dichotomously branched, up to 60 cm long, 20 cm in diam. Cataphylls coriaceous, persistent, base triangular, apex long aristate, up to 10x3-4.5 cm at base, yellowish tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 3 to many, 45-190x10-30 cm, diffuse, brown-yellowish when emerging; petiole 17-50 cm long, brown-yellowish when young, subterete, armed with small prickles up to 3 mm long; rachis terete, up to 120 cm long, with few prickles along the proximal third. Leaflets 8-18 pairs, sessile, coriaceous, obovate to oblanceolate, opposite to subop- posite, imbricate, keeled, apex rounded to sub-acute, base attenuate, margins slightly serrulate along the 1/2 distal portion, sub- revolute; articulations yellow in young and juvenile leaflets, 0.4-0.7 cm wide; median leaflets 14-20 x 4-7.5 cm. Pollen strobili usually 2-4, erect, cylindrical, up to 17cm long, 1.8 cm in diam, yellowish to brown tomentose, 12 cm long, 1.1 cm in diam; pollen sporangiophores cuneiform, distal face hexagonal-truncate, 0.45-0.55 cm long, fer- tile abaxial surface with 8-9 bisporangiate synangia per lobe. Ovulate strobili usually 1 per crown, erect, cylindrical, up to 25 cm long, up to 10.5 cm in diam, yellowish-green tomentulose when immature, light brown upon maturity, apex apiculate; peduncle yel- lowish tomentose, up to 8 cm long, up to 1.3 cm in diam; megasporangiophores pel- tate, distal end hexagonal-truncate, 0.9 cm high, 1.3 cm wide. Seeds ovoid, sarcotesta yellowish-green when immature turning red at maturity, 1.6 cm long, 1.2 cm in diam, sclerotesta smooth. Chromosome number. - 2n=18 (Moretti, 1990a, b).

description: Stem hypogeous, generally unbranched, 5- 34 cm long, 4-11.3 cm in diam. Cataphylls chartaceous, persistent, base triangular, apex aristate, 5.4 cm long, 2.9 cm at base, reddish- brown tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 2-3 (4), 57.5-179x40.2-76.1 cm, descending, red- dish-brown when emerging; petiole 10.2- 95.3 cm long, blackish in young leaves, subterete, heavily armed with straight or bifur- cate prickles up to 6 mm long; rachis subterete, up to 84 cm long, with few prickles along the proximal third. Leaflets 5-28 pairs, sessile, coriaceous, lanceolate, opposite to subopposite, imbricate, apex acute, base attenuate, margins dentate along distal third, subrevolute; articula- tions dark brown in young leaflets, 0.8-1.2 cm; the median leaflets 22.7-38*3.1^.4 cm wide. description: Stem subterranean, subglobose, to 10 cm diam. Cataphylls of two forms either ovate and 3-4 cm long and 4-5 cm wide, or acicular and 7-10 cm long and 2-3 cm wide. Leaves 1(3), 0.5-1.5 m long; petiole 15-50 cm long, sparsely to densely prickled; rachis with 3-12 pairs of leaflets. Leaflets oblong or oblanceolate, cuneate basally, acuminate apically, margins serrate in upper third, the larger median ones 20-40 cm long, 5-8 cm wide. Polleniferous strobili cream to tan, cylindrical to ovoid-cylindrical, 4-6 cm long, 1-1.5 cm diam.; peduncle 2-4 cm long. Microsporophylls with sterile tip composed of six steeply inclined facets surrounding a centrally depressed terminal facet, sporangia present on both the adaxial and abaxial surfaces of the fertile region. Ovulate strobili wine-red to dark red-brown, cylindrical to ovoid-cylindrical, 15-20 cm long, 5-7 cm diam. Seeds pink to light red, 1. 5-2 cm long, 0.5-0.8 cm diam.

description: Stem epigeal, erect, dichotomously branching in mature plants, 15-43 cm long, 8.6- 26.4 cm in diam. description: Stem hypogeous, unbranching, 6-14 cm long, 5-9 cm in diam. Cataphylls coriaceous, persistent, base triangular, apex long-aristate, 8.3x3.6 cm at base, reddish-brown tomentose. Leaves usually solitary, up to 3 under cultivation, 46- 171x32-75 cm, ascending, reddish-brown when emerging; petiole 14-95.3 cm long with bulbous base, blackish in young leaves, subterete, proximal section strongly channeled, armed with prickles up to 5 mm long; rachis subterete, 31-76 cm long, with few prickles along proximal third. description: Trees. Leaves simple, glabrous; stipules narrow-falcate, 11 X 1.6 mm, glabrous; petiole 3.7 mm; blade elliptic, 10-15.3 X 4.9- 5.2 cm, the base cuneate, the apex acuminate, the venation prominent beneath, the venules ascending, straight. Racemes terminally fasciculate, 21-25.5 cm, incurved, with >30 flowers, the axis 2.5 mm diam., puberulous; bracts subulate, 1.7 X 0.6 mm, attached to the pedicel base, apically pilose; bracteoles attached to the pedicel halfway up from the base, subulate, 1.4 X 0.5 mm, apically pilose; pedicels 6.7 X 0.7 mm, puberulous; buds asymmetric-elliptic, acuminate, 11.2 X 3.5 mm, the base acute, puberulous. Calyx 1-lobed, glabrous internally. Petals 5, little graduated (the vexillum larger than wings and keel), the claw 1.7 X 0.8 mm, the blade ca. 10 X 4.3 mm. Sta- mens 10, filaments 2 x 0.3 mm, anthers 5.5 X 0.5 mm, sparsely pilose. Gynophore 1.8 mm, tomentose; ovary 4.2 X 1.8 mm, tomentose, ca. 8-ovulate, style 3.9 mm, straight, glabrous, stigma punctiform, glabrous. Drupe green 2 X 1.6 cm, oblong, aril absent.

description: Stem hypogeous, unbranched, up to 25 cm long, up to 7 cm in diam. Cataphylls chartaceous, semidecidious, base triangular, apex aristate, 5.3x1.4 cm at base, yellowish tomentose. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 1-2 (3), 49-220x35-58 cm, ascending to descending, bright reddish-pink with lustrous cuticle when emerging, dark green when mature; petiole 20-130 cm long, terete, armed with few simple prickles; rachis subterete, up to 84 cm long, unarmed. Leaflets 3-7 pairs sessile, coriaceous, oblong-lanceolate, opposite to subopposite, adaxial surface with brilliantly shining cuticle throughout life of leaflet, apex acute, base attenuate; margins dentate along distal third, subrevolute; articulations brown in young leaflets turning green with age 0.6-1.6 cm wide; median leaflets 18-35x3.5-12 cm. Pollen strobili 1-5, conical, light-brown tomentulose, erect upon emergence becoming prostrate to decumbent upon maturity, up to 3.9 cm long, 1.1 cm in diam, apex acute; peduncle light-brown tomentose, up to 5.8 cm long, 1.2 cm in diam; pollen sporangiophores cuneiform, distal face hexagonal scutiform, 0.35 cm long, fertile abaxial surface with 5-6 bisporangiate synangia per lobe. Ovulate strobili usually solitary, decumbent to erect, elliptic, 8- 12 cm long, 4.5-6 cm in diam, brown to yellowish tomentose, apex aristate; peduncle brown tomentose, 2.1-4.3 cm long, 1 . 1-1 .3 cm in diam; megasporangiophores peltate, distal face hexagonal-truncate to scutiform, 1-1.2 cm high, 1.1-1.3 cm wide. Seeds ovoid, sarcotesta pink when immature, red at maturity, 1.1- 1.4 cm long, 1.6-1.8 cm in diam, sclerotesta smooth. Chromosome number. - 2n= 16 (Schutzman, 1984; Moretti, 1990a).

description: Dioecious plant up to 1.6 m tall; trunk subterranean up to 25 cm long, 7 cm in diam- eter. description: Herbaceous plant, seasonally dormant. Stem tuberous, depressed-globose, to ca. 15 cm diam., ca. 10 cm high, producing occasional, globose propagules. Leaf solitary; petiole 36 cm long, 0.4-0.5 cm diam.; lamina bipinnatifid, 29 X 22 cm, lobes with cuspidate apices and reddish margins. Inflorescence appearing before the leaf; peduncle 5-36 cm long, to ca. 1.5-2 cm diam. at apex, smooth, usually underground on flowering; spathe ovate, cymbiform, convolute at base, slightly nodding forward, 16-20 X 11-15 cm, coriaceous, apex acuminate, outside olive green to dark purplish with small clear spots arranged in longitudinal rows, inside purple with yellowish or whitish stripes; spadix shorter than the spathe, 9-14 cm long, stipitate, stipe oblique 1.5 cm long at the longer side, 0.5 cm at the shorter side; male part 6-10 cm long, 3-3.2 cm diam.; female part cylindrical 3.4-4 cm long, 2.5-3 cm diam.; synandria 4-7-androus; filaments fused to the thecae, 4-7 mm long, ca. 3 mm diam., slightly compressed laterally, reddish; connectives free, grayish; thecae yellowish, elliptic ca. 1.5 X 1 mm, dehiscing by a slit; female flowers surrounded at base by 4-8 elongate-clavate staminodes, these 5-7 mm long, ca. 0.8 mm diam., sometimes short-connate at the base; pistils 8-11 mm long; ovaries ovate, 4-5 X ca. 3 mm, yellowish, 3-4 locules, each locule 1-ovuled; ovules orthotropous, funicles densely covered with short trichomes; styles elongate, green, 4-6 mm long, ca. 1 mm diam.; stigma only slightly 3-4 lobed, ca. 1 mm diam. Fruits unknown.

description: Epiphyte, at least 1 m tall. Leaves 50-80 cm long, the sheaths 12-16 cm long by 9-10 cm wide, castaneous, the blades 24-35 mm wide, ligulate, the apex acute to attenuate. Inflorescence bipinnate, pink, ca 55 cm long by 10 cm broad, the branches 4-6 cm apart, secund, 5-6 cm long by 2.5-3 cm wide, 4-6-flowered. Primary bracts as long as branches below, 2-6 cm long by 2 cm wide, with narrow triangular apex, the rachis floccose, the sterile base of branches ebrac- teate, 7-12 mm long. Floral bracts 11-13 mm long by 11 mm wide, pink, nerved, ecarinate. Sepals 25 mm long by 5 mm wide, strongly coriaceous, nerved, ecar- inate, connate for 5-7 mm. Distance between flowers 7-9 mm. Capsule 33 mm long by 6 mm wide; coma of seeds brown.

description: Plant terrestrial, 60-100 cm tall in flower; stolons ascending 15 cm X 2-4 mm. Leaves 10-12, rosulate, subspreading, thin-coriaceous, nerved, 40-60 cm long. Leaf sheaths elliptic, 6-10 X 2-3 cm, dark cas- taneous toward the base abaxially, punctate-lepidote, the scales subdense and brown. Leaf blades subligulate, acute to long-attenuate, 8-15 mm wide, punctate-lepidote, throughout but much more so abaxially. Scape stiffly erect, 50-70 cm X 2-3 mm, glabrous; scape bracts erect, imbricate, narrowly elliptic, acute to attenuate, exceeding internodes of scape but not concealing them, brown-lepidote especially abaxially. Infiorescence erect, simple, polystichously 45-60-flowered, 22-25 X 4-5 cm; floral bracts elliptic, 9-18 X 4-6 mm, thin, nerved, ecarinate, reddish, sparsely brown- lepidote, the apex acute and cucullate. Flowers: pedicel 1-3 mm long, stout, erect and imbricate pre-anthesis, spreading ca. 90º from axis at anthesis, becoming reflexed in fruit; sepals narrowly elliptic, acute, 10-13 mm long, connate for 1-2 mm, the adaxial pair obtusely carinate; corolla erect, slightly spreading; petals ligulate, broadly acute, 10-15 mm long, conglutinated into a tube for ca. 1/2 their length, orange yellow. Fruit a dry capsule to 23 mm long; seed coma brown.

description: Plant acaulescent, flowering 30-50 cm tall, propagating by stolons 2-5 cm X 5 mm. Leaves densely rosulate, erect to spreading, 30-50 cm long, inconspicuously and densely pale punctate-lepidote throughout. Leaf sheaths elliptic, 60-70 X 35-40 mm, castaneous toward the base abaxially, reddish striate toward the blade especially abaxially. Leaf blades linear, attenuate, 10- 20 mm wide, rather thin, green or tinged lilac, somewhat reddish striate toward the base abaxially. Scape erect, 20-30 cm X 5 mm, glabrous. Scape bracts erect, densely imbricate, the lowest subfoliaceous, green, the upper elliptic, attenuate, green, tinged reddish or purple. Inflorescence erect, sim- ple, 10-18 cm long; flowers 10-15. Floral bracts elliptic, acute, 33-52 X 10-18 mm, the lowest slightly exceeding the flowers, the upper shorter than the flowers, thin-coriaceous, tightly enfolding the flowers, red, dark lilac, or dark purple. Pedicel stout, 5- 10 mm long, spreading 15-45º from the axis at anthesis. Sepals 35-43 mm long, connate 20-30 mm, the free lobes erect, oblong, obtuse, green to yellow. Corolla tubular with erect to slightly spreading lobes. Petals narrowly oblanceolate, obtuse, 40-48 mm long, more than 2/3 conglutinated, yellow to green. Stigma of the convolute-blade type.

description: Epiphytic shrubs with strangler habit or trees 20-30 m derived from such, with aculeate trunk and branches. Leaves 3-7-foliolate, petioles 30-60 mm, leaflets 30-80 x 18- 30, elliptic-oblong to elliptic-obovate, obtuse and usually emarginate at apex, cuneate at base, glabrous, subsessile or briefly (3 mm) petiolulate. Flowers borne singly towards the tips of branches, with three caducous bracts. Pedicels stout, 12-24 mm. Calyx ca. 6 mm long, cupuliform, glabrous externally, villous within, apex truncate. Petals 40-55 x 5-8 mm, linear-oblong, puberulous externally, reflexed at anthesis (sometimes markedly so), bright red. Staminal tube 30-40 mm long, with or without an articulation 2-6 mm from the base, usually densely tomentose at the base, becoming sparsely so above, with five short apical filamentous lobes 8-10 mm, bearing anthers with upper thecae 6-8 mm and lower thecae 7-11 mm. Ovary and lower portion of style densely hairy. Fruit an elliptic capsule ca. 9.0 x 5.5 cm.
