description: Shrub to 1.5 m high, branched, the branches 3-6 mm in diameter, hirsute, becoming glabrescent, striate; leaves elliptic-lanceolate, 48-110 mm long, 15-45 mm wide, more or less coriaceous, usually slightly acuminate, sometimes acute, rarely more or less obtuse, mucronate, glabrous above, hirsute beneath, becoming glabrescent, entire, slightly revolute, attenuate at base, the costa prominulous beneath, with 6-8 pairs of lateral veins; petioles 3-7 mm long, almost concave above, convex beneath, hirsute; racemes more or less conical, acute, 8-10 mm wide, simple, terminal or axillary, pedunculate (the peduncle 9-11 mm long), the axis 4.5-7.5 cm long, finely pubescent, striate, bracteate, the bracts linear- lanceolate, 3-3.8 mm long, 0.9-1 mm wide, deciduous, ciliate, 1-nerved, slightly pubescent beneath; flowers 5-5.5 mm long, the pedicels 1.8-2.2 mm long, finely pubescent; outer sepals triangular, acute, ciliate, slightly pubescent beneath, becoming glabrescent, the two lower 1.8-2.5 mm loug, 1-1.2 mm wide, one-half- united, 3-nerved, sometimes 1-nerved, the upper sepal 2.2-3.2 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, 5-nerved, rarely 3-nerved; wings blue, 5.2-5.8 mm long, 4-4.8 mm wide, obovate, more or less acute at base, 3-nerved, glabrous; keel 6-6.2 mm long, 3.8-4.5 mm wide, orbicular, plicate, glabrous within, obtuse at base, 3- nerved, 3-lobed, the middle lobe obtuse-subemarginate; upper petals elongate- spatulate, pubescent; stamens 8, the filaments 4.2-4.8 mm long, almost entirely united, the free part 0.6-1.2 mm long, glabrous; ovary ovoid, 1.8-2.5 mm long, 0.9-1.5 mm wide, glabrous; style 2.5-3.2 mm long, geniculate above the base, glabrous, thicker toward the apex; stigma with 2 lobes, the lower acute, the upper 1-tubercled, the tubercle papillose; drupe ellipsoid, 6-7.5 mm long, 3-3.6 mm wide, glabrous, reticulate.

description: Tree to 6 m tall, the indument on petioles and peduncles not visible to the naked eye, composed of erect, usually curved trichomes (the longest 0.1 mm). Leaflet-blade acuminate at apex, essentially glabrous (with scattered trichomes to 0.1 mm long on midrib and margin), with domatia in axils of secondary veins, these with circular or elongate openings, visible to the naked eye, the terminal blade elliptic or oblanceolate, 9.8-28 X 3.6-10 cm, cuneate or short-acuminate at base, with 8-10 secondary veins per side, its petiolule 1-3.8 cm long, the lateral baldes elliptic or oblanceolate, 12-24.5 X 4.6-8.2 cm, asymmetric at base (usually unequally acute or short-acuminate both basiscopically and acroscopically), with 6-8 secondary veins per side, their petiolules 0.5-1.2 cm long; petiole 5.5-16 cm long. Inflorescence 11-25 cm long including a peduncle 7.5-16.8 cm long, the internodes of primary rachis developed, the partial inflorescences alternate on primary rachis, stalked, dichasial at first node, dichasial or monochasial at higher nodes, the secondary axis 10-30 mm long; pedicels 1-2 mm long. Calyx subentire or shallowly dentate, ca. 1.5 mm long, sparsely or densely pubescent with short, ± erect trichomes without, glabrous within. Corolla apiculate or acute in bud, 5-merous, 48.2-58 mm long at anthesis, densely mealy appressed-pubescent without, white or green, the tube formed by coherent petals 36-45 mm long, 1.8-2.1 mm wide just above the calyx, 3-3.7 times longer than the lobes, these 11-15 X 1.5-1.8 mm, acute and not inflexed at apex. Androecium of 2 fertile stamens and 3 staminodes; filaments 40-55 mm long, strongly coherent for ±the length of the corolla tube, sparsely pubescent adaxially within the tube, the free part of fertile stamens 4.2-11 mm long, that of staminodes 7-13 mm long; anther lacking an appendage, and, therefore, a sterile base not identifiable, the fertile portion 2.8-4 X 0.7-0.8 mm. Disc ca. 0.7 mm high, slightly shorter than the ovary. Carpels 1-1.2 mm high, glabrous but becoming pubescent with short, erect hairs soon after anthesis; style 41-50 mm long. Fruiting mericarps ca. 14 X 10 mm, pubescent with short, erect hairs. Seed not known.

description: Description: Woody vine; older branchlets grav, obscurely pulverulent-puberulent, glabreseent in age; younger branchlets only slightly more slender, very conspicuously lenticellate with narrow and elongate corky lenticels; description: Arbuscula 1-1.5 m alta, ramulis fulvo-velutinis. Stipulae persistentes, 1-1.5 mm longae, 0.3 mm latae, subulatae, strigulosae; folia oblanceolata, chartacea ad rigiduloso-chartacea, petiolis 8-15 mm longis, strigulosis, 2-3 pares glandularum discoidearum ferentibus, laminis 15-27 cm longis, 3.5-6.5 cm latis, ad basim longo-attenuatis, decurrentibus, ad apicem gradatim longo-acuminatis, ad marginem irregulariter undulatis vel sinuato-dentatis, supra pilosulis ad costam, infra fulvo-velutinis, costa venisque supra planis, infra plus minusve salientibus, venis 6-9 jugatis. Flores in axillis euphyllorum solitarii et ad apicem ramulorum in capitulum bracteosum collecti, bracteis oblanceolatis, strigulosis, acuminatis, 4-6 cm longis, 0.5-1 cm latis; pedicelli 2-3 mm longi, strigulosi, bracteolis 8-10 mm longis, 1-1.5 mm latis, anguste ellipticis, acutis, strigulosis; calyx et corolla in speciminibus deficientes; antherae anguste oblongae, 4 mm longae, 0.7 mm latae, glabrae; styli 3, sericei, ca. 6 mm longi, ovario verruculoso, oblongo-ovato, glabro. Fructus maturus albus, 15 mm longus, 10 mm latus, tuberculatus, oblongo-ovoideus; semina oblanceoloidea, valde curvata contortaque, ca. 5 mm longa, 2 mm lata, villosula, minute reticulata, arillo ca. 3.5 mm longo et lato.
bibliographicCitation: Cowan, Richard S. 1957. New species and new records of plants in Guiana. Brittonia. 8: 231-245.

description: Arbor ad 20 m. alta, 3 dm. diametro, ramulis nitidis, glabris, teretibus; folia glabra, (2-)4-6-jugata, petiolis ad basim valde incrassis, teretibus, 3-7 cm. longis; rachibus teretibus, 3-10.5 cm. longis; petiolulis ad basim incrassis, 4-7 mm. longis, foliola opposita ad alterna, oblonga vel oblongo-elliptica, 5.5- 11.5(-16) cm. longa, 2-4(-6.5) cm. lata, coriacea, rotunda retusaque ad apicem, ad basim attenuata et in petiolulis decurrentia; utrinque costa manifeste.reticu- lata sed vix saliens; inflorescentiae terminales vel subterminales, paniculatae, valde patentes, 1-4 dm. longae; pedunculis 2-10 cm. longis, axibus puberulis sulcatisque, pedicellis circa 1 mm. longis; flores inaequaliter aggregati, sepalis infra connatis, leviter utrinque sericeis, ovatis vel rotundo-ovatis, obtusis, marginibus ciliolatis, 1.5-2 mm. longis latisque; petalis albis, breviter unguicu- latis, glabris marginibus ciliatis exceptis, oblongis, ad apicem rotundis, 4.5-5 mm. longis, 1.5-2.5 mm. latis, squamis laminis aequantes sed angustiores ha- bentibus, extus glabra basibus ?xceptis, intus villoso-sericea; discus cupulatus, niger, glaber, crenatus, inaequaliter lobatus, 1 mm. altus, circa 1.5 mm. diametro; stamina in floribus verisimiliter femineis 7, in floribus masculis 8, erecta, filamentis filiformibus, glabris, 1.5-3.3 mm. longis, antheris lanceolatis, apiculatis, glabris, 1-1.5 mm. longis; stigma oblongum, glanduloso-puberulens, 1 mm. longum, stylus glabrum, columnare, 1.5 mm. longum, ovarium obovoideum, glabrum, 3 loculos uniovulatos continens; fructus ignotus.

description: Frutex 4-5 m. altus; ramulis teretibus cinereis glabris; foliis glabris 35-45 cm. longis 2-jugis, petiolis teretibus basi incrassatis 10-13 cm. longis, foliolis oppositis, petiolulis incrassatis rugosis 7-10 mm. longis, laminis coriaceis fuscis obovatis vel oblongo-obovatis, 12-25 cm. longis, 7-12 cm. latis, basi acutis vel subattenuatis, apice subito acu-minatis, margine integris, costa utrinque prominente, nervis secundariis 8-11 subrectis prope margines anastomosantibns supra prominulis subtus elevatis, venulis copiose reticulatis utrinque prominulis; paniculis axillaribus prope apices ramulorum quam foliis paullo brevioribus, ramulis numerosis patulis subsimplicibus rhachidibusque cinereo-puberulis; fioribus 1-3-fasciculatis, bracteolis ovatis acutis 1 mm. longis mox deciduis cum pedicellis calycibusque hispidulis; pedicellis 1-2 mm. longis; calyce profunde partito, lobis 5 ovatis obtusis, 1.5 mm. longis, 1.2 mm. latis; petalis 5 submembranaceis praeter squamas glabris, laminis lanceolato-oblongis obtusis, 4.5 mm. longis, 1.3 mm. latis, squamas integras lanceolatas intus dense villosas (pilis circiter 0.7 mm. longis) 3.5 mm. longas gerentibus; disco glabro carnoso 5-angulato 5-lobato; staminibus intra discum 5 glabris, filamentis 1 mm. longis, antheris lineari-oblongis apiculatis 2 mm. longis; ovario parce puberulo subgloboso, stylo ovarium aequante.

description: Frutex vel arbor, ramulis fasciculatis vel verticillatis; foliis oblanceolatis vel obovatis (27) 48-63 x (13) 16-22 mm, aliquantum asymmetricis, apice acutis vel rotundatis interdum retusis basi acutis vel acuminatis, petiolo 2-9 mm longo, costa supeme caniculata infra caniculata vel prominula, venis utrinque obscuris, margine planis vel aliquantum revolutis atroglandimarginatis infra visis, versus apices crenulatis; floribus 1 -6-fasciculatis pedunculo 4-14 mm longo pendulo, bracteolis 2 suboppositis cymbiformibus 2-2.5 x 1.5 mm, apice rotundatis atroglandulosis, margine atroglanduloso-serrulatis; calycis lobis 4-6 liberis cymbiformis 4.5-5 x 3-3.5 mm apice acutis, duobus exterioribus margine atroglanduloso-serrulatis et tribus intimis eglandulosis integris; corollae lobis 5 basaliter connatis; staminibus ca 15-24 basi connatis; ovario bilocularibus ca 1 x 1 mm, ovulis 4; fructibus biloculari ca 10 x 9 mm, stylo persistenti ca 5 mm longo; seminibus 4 vel paucioribus abortibus.

description: Shrub or small tree 1-6 m tall; branchlets opposite or fasciculate, terete or angled, grayish. Leaves subcoriaceous, dull, glabrous, oblanceolate to obovate, (27) 48-63 x (13) 16-32 mm, slightly asymmetrical, the base acute to acuminate, the petiole 2-9 mm long, the apex acute to round, sometimes retuse, the midrib caniculate above, caniculate or prominulous below, the veins obscure on both surfaces, the margins planar to slightly revolute, dark gland-dotted along margin as seen from below, crenulate apically. Flowers 1-6-fasciculate, axillary among leaf bases; peduncles 4-14 mm long, pendulous; bracteoles 2, cymbiform, subop- posite, unequal in size, 2-2.5 x 1.5 mm, the apex rounded, black-gland-tipped, the margin black-glandular; calyx lobes 4-6, free, cymbiform, 4.5-5 x 3-3.5 mm, the apex acute, the margin black-glandular-serrulate on outer 2 lobes, eglandular on inner 3; corolla of 5 lobes, fused basally into a tube for ca 3 mm, the lobes ca 2 mm long, the apex acute; androecium of ca 15-24 stamens, weakly fused to corolla tube basally, the filaments ca 0.2 mm long, the anthers basifixed, 1.5-2 mm long, the thecae subparallel, the connective extending 1 mm, subparallel, dehiscence introrse; gynoecium with terete stigma and style, 2 mm long, the ovary very widely ovoid, 1 x 1 mm, 2-locular with 2 ovules per locule. Fruits with persistent style 5 mm long, ovoid to widely ovoid, ca 10 x 9 mm, 2-locular, 4-seeded or fewer by abortion; seeds ovoid, 7 x 5 mm.

description: Frutex 1-1.5 m. altus; ramulis brunneis; foliis petiolatis, coriaceis, 5-10 cm. longis, 2.5-4 cm. latis, anguste ovatis vel lanceolatis, acuminatis, glabris vel pubeseentibus, integris; petiolis 1 cm. longis, nervis validis, pinnatis, 8-11-jugis; floribus solitaribus vel geminatis; pedicellis puberulentibus, 5-8 mm. longis; fructu globoso, 6 mam. longo, 7 mm. diam., sparse puberulenti vel glabrato.

description: Spreading, leafy, sclerophyllous shrub 1-1.5 m. high, colonial; branches choco- late-brown, glabrous or pubescent, wrinkled; leaves alternate, sparsely or densely pubescent, blades narrowly ovate or lanceolate, acuminate, base obtuse sometimes slightly decurrent, 5-10 cm. long, 2.5-4 cm. wide, entire or rarely remotely ser- rulate, selerophyllous, venation pinnate, midvein strong, laterals 8-11 on each side; petioles mostly 1 cm. long, sparsely or densely pubescent; flowers single or geminate in the leaf axils, apparently apetalous; pedicels 5 to 8 mm. long, glabrous or pubescent; calyx lobes connate to near the tips, forming a cap over the ovary, 1-2 mm. long, densely strigillose; ovary pilose below around the base, glabrous apically; stigma 0.5 to 1 mm. long; fruit tricoccus, sparsely pubescent or glabrate, globose, 6 mm. high, 7 mm. diam. transversely near apex.

description: Shrub or tree, densely tomentose throughout, at least when young, with branched hairs. Upper parts of the branches stout, the internodes 3-10 (rarely 20) mm. long. Leaves opposite. Petioles stout, 3-6 mm. long. Leaf-blades coriaceous, oblong, 3-5 cm. long, 1.5-2 cm. wide, obtuse, revolute (at least when dried), entire, obtuse to rounded at base, permanently einereous-tomentose beneath, eventually glabrescent above. Spikes lateral, usually spreading, 3-5 cm. long, the crowded flowers nearly sessile, separated by internodes 2 mm. long. Outer sepals ovate-lanceolate, 9 mm. long, 2.5 mm. wide; anterior sepal linear, 6.5 mm. long; posterior sepals linear, 7 mm. long. Corolla-tube slender, slightly curved, 11-12 mm. long, 3 mm. in diameter at its summit, finely tomentulose. Corolla-lobes 4.5-5 mm., slightly unequal, 3 oblong-lanceolate, acute, 2 mm. wide, 2 quadrate, 3 mm. wide, their tips broadly rounded, slightly thickened, and somewhat involute. Filaments united into a tube 10-11 mm. long, 5-nerved, hyaline, adnate to corolla only at base, slightly enlarged above in conformity with the corolla, finely tomentulose distally. Staminodia 3, subulate, the median 1 mm. long, straight, the lateral curved-divergent, 1.5 mm. long. Anthers 2, oblong, 2.5 mm. long, acute, laterally connate for half their length, saccately prolonged on the inner side at base, on stipes 0.3 mm. long. Disk funnelform, as long as the ovaries, the margin very obscurely 5-lobed. Ovaries 5, pubescent. Style slender, glabrous, 7 mm. long, with 5 short (0.2 mm.), radiate, oblique, stigmatic lobes. Immature fruit subspheric, pubescent, splitting longitudinally across the top and down the axial side, exposing the chartaceous endocarp. Ovules 2, collateral near the middle of the axial suture. Testa (immature) crustaceous, dark-brown.

description: Folia elliptica vel oblanceolata apice obtusa vel rotundata praeter costam supeme strigillosam, secus marginem hispidulum et interdum infeme secus costam sparsim strigillosam fere glabra; calyx extus pubescens pilis sparsis adpressis instructus, 2.1-5.2 mm longus, lobis inter se inaequalibus, brevioribus 4 oblongo-ovatis obtusis vel acutis 0.8-3.2 mm longis 0.7-1.5 mm latis, 1 longissimo ligulato rotundato 1.3-4 mm longo 0.7-1.3 mm lato; corolla alba vel roseo-suffusa 7.6-11.1 mm longa extus minute strigosa pilis simplicibus praedita, tubo curvato subinfundibuliformi 4.8-6.1 mm longo apice 1.5-2 mm lato, lobis ligulato-oblongis apice rotundatis, superiore 2.8-5 mm longo ceteris 2.2-3.5 mm longis 1.1-2 mm latis; antherae connectivum in mucronem brevem 0.2 mm longo productum; fructuum cocci glabri, costati, apice acuti.
bibliographicCitation: Kallunki, Jacquelyn A. & Steyermark, Julian A. 1987. A new species of Raveniopsis (Rutaceae), a genus new to Brazil. Brittonia. 39: 409-411.

description: Shrub 0.5-1 m tall, stems substrigose with simple hairs when young, glabrescent. Leaves opposite, simple, petiolate; petioles 0.5-1.3 cm long, densely hispidulous above; leaf-blades elliptic to oblanceolate, acute at base, obtuse to rounded at apex, often retuse, 3.5-12.4 cm long, 1.2-4.2 cm wide, upper surface glabrous except for the hispidulous marginal areas and sometimes strigillose midrib, lower surface glabrous except for scattered hairs on midrib or a few isolated hairs on surface of some leaves; midvein impressed above, raised below, lateral nerves 15-30 on each side, manifest above, obsolete below. Inflorescence terminal, dichasial, each branch unilaterally racemose, 1.2-8 cm long, moderately hispidulous; peduncle 2.8-5.8 cm long, hispidulous or nearly glabrous. Calyx 2.1-5.2 mm long, externally pubescent with sparse appressed hairs; tube 0.8-1.2 mm long; lobes unequal, shorter lobes oblong-ovate, obtuse to acute, 0.8-3.2 mm long, 0.7-1.5 mm wide, longest lobe ligulate, rounded at apex, 1.3-4 mm long, 0.7-1.3 mm wide. Corolla white, sometimes tinted pink, 7.6-1 1.1 mm long, minutely strigose externally and internally with simple hairs; tube curved, subinfundibuliform, 4.8-6.1 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide at apex; lobes ligulate-oblong, rounded at apex, upper lobe 2.8-5 mm long, 1.5-1.6 mm wide, others 2.2-3.5 mm long, 1.1-2 mm wide. Fertile stamens 2, anthers linear-oblong, 1.9-2.4 mm long, hispidulous, anther connective with a short mucro 0.2 mm long and a bilobed basal appendage ca 0.4 mm long; staminodia 5, subulate, 2.2-3.5 mm long, hispidulous; filaments joined into a tube, tube equalling the length of the corolla tube and adherent to it, hispidulous without and subtomentose within. Disc cupular, 0.5-1.1 mm high, the margins subentire; ovary of 5 separate, 2-ovuled carpels, glabrous, included within the disc; style 2.8-5 mm long, glabrous. Fruit of up to 5 dehiscent cocci, cocci ovoid, acute at apex, 3.8-4 mm long, 2.5-2.6 mm wide, glabrous, costate, 1-seeded; seeds blackish-brown, subreniform, 2.2-2.5 mm long, 1.5-1.8 mm wide, mtinutely muricate, glabrous.
bibliographicCitation: Kallunki, Jacquelyn A. & Steyermark, Julian A. 1987. A new species of Raveniopsis (Rutaceae), a genus new to Brazil. Brittonia. 39: 409-411.

description: Arbuscula 1-2-metralis; foliis simplicibus, laminis ovato- vel elliptico-oblongis apice subobtusis vel rotundatis basi obtusis vel subobtusis 2.2-3 cm longis subtus dense stellato-lepidotis pilis brunneis instructis, nervis lateralibus utroque latere 10-20; inflorescentiis racemosis 3-7-floris; pedunculis 0.3- 2 cm longis stellato-lepidotis; sepalis extus dense stellato-lepidotis, sepalis brevioribus 3 mm longis, longioribus 3.5-8 mm longis; corolla alba 14-18 mm longa, tubo extus stellato-lepidoto, lobis oblongo- obovatis vel obovatis apice rotundatis 3-5 mm longis; antheris fertilibus elliptico-oblongis; stylo glabro.
bibliographicCitation: De Luca, Paolo, et al. 1980. Dioon caputoi (Zamiaceae), a new species from Mexico. Brittonia. 32: 43-46.

description: Shrublet 1-2 m tall, branches naked below, the younger and apical portions densely stellate-lepidote. Leaves simple, petiolate; petioles 3-5 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, densely stellate-lepidote; leaf-blades rigidly subcoriaceous, dark green above, brown below, subrevolute, ovate or elliptic-oblong, subobtuse or rounded at apex, obtuse or subobtuse at base, 2.2-3 x 1-1.3 cm, glabrous and strongly sulcate along the midrib above, densely covered on the lower surface by a brown stellate-lepidote indument; lateral nerves 10-20 each side, divaricately spreading, slightly sulcate above, slightly elevated below. Inflorescence terminal, or in the uppermost axils of the leaves, racemosely 3-7-flowered; peduncle 0.3-2 cm long, densely stellate-lepidote; rachis 2.3 cm long, densely stellate-lepidote; pedicels 1-1.5 x 1-1.5 mm, densely stellate-lepidote; calyx unequally 5-lobed, sepals fleshy, densely stellate-lepidote without, glabrous within; 3 shorter sepals lan- ceolate, subobtuse, 3 x 0.5-0.6 mm, longer sepals 2, elliptic- or ligulate-lanceo- late or oblanceolate, subobtuse, 3.5-8 x 0.7-2 mm; corolla white, tubular-infun- dibuliform, 14-18 mm long, tube 9.5-11 x 1.8-1.9 mm, stellate-lepidote without, glabrous within, puberulous at orifice within; lobes 5, unequal, oblong-obovate or obovate, rounded at apex, 3-5 x 2-3 mm, glabrous within, one lobe entirely densely stellate-lepidote without, three lobes stellate-lepidote without on only one side, one lobe stellate-lepidote without in the middle. Fertile stamens 2, slightly exserted; anthers elliptic-oblong, 1.5 mm long, subglobose-bulbose at base; staminodes 3, the free part subulate, 1.5 mm long, papillate apically, pi- losulous below where joining the staminal tube; staminal tube 9.5-10 mm long, pilosulous in the middle 5 mm above the base and also pilosulous on the upper- most margins below the base of the staminodes, otherwise glabrous. Style 5.5- 6.5 mm long, glabrous, obliquely 5-lobed; ovary 5-lobed, included within the cupular disk. Carpels oblong, 0.5 mm long, minutely papillate; fruiting cocci subovoid, somewhat narrowed at the apex, 5 x 3 mm, densely covered without with pale brown stellate hairs; seeds black, oval, 3 x 1.8 mm, echinate-papillate.
bibliographicCitation: De Luca, Paolo, et al. 1980. Dioon caputoi (Zamiaceae), a new species from Mexico. Brittonia. 32: 43-46.

description: Shrub or tree 2-5 m tall, the indument of vegetative buds, young twigs and petioles, and inflorescences strigulose. Leaves 1 -foliolate; leaflet blade narrow-elliptic, acuminate at apex, acute at base, 7-16 cm long, 2.4-4.8 cm wide, subcoriaceous, shiny above, glabrous, the secondary and parallel intersecondary veins evident, straight, coalescing into a +/- straight intramarginal vein, 27-36 per side, the tertiary veins evident and slightly raised on both surfaces; petiole 0.4-1.2 cm long. Inflorescence 5-8-flowered, 0.8-2 cm long including a peduncle 0.25-0.6 cm long; pedicels 1.3-2 mm long in flower and 3-4 mm long in fruit. Sepals wide-ovate, rounded at apex, 1.8-2.5 mm long, 1.5-1.8 mm wide, sparsely strigulose without, glabrous within. Corolla in bud ca. 6 mm long, glabrous without, green, the tube 0.6-1.3 mm to division of innermost lobe, 1. 5-2 mm to division of other lobes, ca. 2.5 mm wide, the innermost lobe narrow-obovate, ca. 5 mm long, ca. 2 mm wide, the other 4 lobes wide-obovate, 3-3.2 mm long, ca. 2.2 mm wide. Filaments of fertile stamens adherent to corolla, ca. 1.5 mm long; staminodes adnate to corolla at very base, adherent above, lance-subulate, ca. 3.5 mm long; anthers ca. 3.2 mm long, ca. 1.5 mm wide, glabrous, the connective glabrous, the appendages ca. 0.5 mm long, ca. 1.5 mm wide. Disc shorter than ovary. Carpels ca. 1 mm high, glabrous; style not seen. Fruiting mericarps 1-4, 10-1 1 mm long, ca. 6 mm wide, glabrous. Seed ca. 6.2 mm long, ca. 4.5 mm wide, brown.
bibliographicCitation: Kallunki, Jacquelyn A. 1994. Revision of Raputia Aubl. (Cuspariinae, Rutaceae). Brittonia. 46: 279-295.

description: Tree ca. 5 m tall, the indument of vegetative buds, young twigs and petioles, and inflorescences strigulose. Leaves 3-foliolate; leaflet blade elliptic, acuminate at apex, decurrent and in lateral leaflets asymmetric at base, chartaceous, dull above, glabrous, the secondary veins evident, curved, looping at margin, 14-18 per side, the tertiary veins evident and slightly raised on both surfaces, the abaxial surface drying dull green, the terminal blade 15-23 cm long, 5.5-7.5 cm wide, the lateral blade 16.3-22.5 cm long, 6.5-7.5 cm wide; petiole 5.3-6 cm long; petiolule 0.6-1.2 cm long. Inflorescence 17-24- flowered, 8.5-10.5 cm long including a peduncle 4-6.8 cm long; pedicels 3-4 mm long in flower. Sepals wide-ovate, rounded at apex, 2.3-3 mm long, 2-2.5 mm wide, appressed-strigulose without, glabrous within. Corolla (in very young bud) densely pubescent without, greenish. Filaments and stam- inodes observed in very young bud and not clearly seen; anthers (in very young bud) ca 2.8 mm long, ca. 1.3 mm wide, glabrous, the connective glabrous, the appendages ca. 0.3 mm long, ca. 1.3 mm wide. Disc (in bud) shorter than ovary. Carpels (in bud) glabrous. Fruiting mericarps (immature) ca. 4, ca. 10 mm long, ca. 7 mm wide, densely strigulose. Seed (immature) brown.
bibliographicCitation: Kallunki, Jacquelyn A. 1994. Revision of Raputia Aubl. (Cuspariinae, Rutaceae). Brittonia. 46: 279-295.

description: Tree 4-5 m tall, the indument of vegetative buds, young twigs, and inflorescences strigulose, that of young petioles often of ascending, once-curved hairs. Leaves 3-foliolate; leaflet blade oblanceolate or narrow elliptic, rarely elliptic, acuminate at apex, decurrent and in lateral leaflets asymmetric at base, chartaceous, dull above, glabrous, the secondary veins obscure, curved, looping at margin, 7-12 per side, the tertiary veins obscure on both surfaces but slightly raised on the abaxial surface, the abaxial surface drying dull green, the terminal blade 6.3-12 cm long, 1.7-3.9 cm wide, the lateral blade 4-11 cm long, 1.3-3.9 cm wide; pet- iole 1.8-5.8 cm long; petiolule 0-1 mm long. Inflorescence 7-3 1-flowered, 6.2-15 cm long including a peduncle 1.5-6 cm long; pedi- cels 1-1.5 mm long in flower, 3-5 mm long in fruit. Sepals very wide-ovate, rounded at apex, 1.8-2.5 mm long, 1.8-2.5 mm wide, strigulose without, glabrous within. Corolla 8.5-10.5 mm long at anthesis, densely stri- gulose without (even at anthesis), white or greenish, the tube 2.5-3 mm to division of innermost lobe, 4-4.5 mm to division of other lobes, ca. 2.3 mm wide, the innermost lobe lanceolate, 6-7 mm long, 1.5-1.7 mm wide, the other 4 lobes wide-ovate, 2.5-3 mm long, ca. 2 mm wide. Filaments of fer- tile stamens adherent to corolla, ca. 5 mm long; staminodes adnate to corolla, arising at throat, linear, ca. 1 mm long; anthers ca. 3.3 mm long, ca. 1.5 mm wide, glabrous, the connective glabrous, the appendages ca. 0.5 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide. Disc shorter than ovary. Carpels ca. 1 mm high, glabrous at anthesis but soon densely strigulose; style ca. 6 mm long, gland-dotted, glabrous. Fruiting mericarps 1-5, 12-13 mm long, 5- 8 mm wide, densely strigulose. Seed (im- mature) ca. 8.2 mm long, ca. 5 mm wide, brown.

description: Shrub or tree 2-6 m tall, the indument of vegetative buds, young petioles, and inflorescences strigulose. Leaves 3-foliolate; leaf let blade usually oblanceolate, sometimes narrow-elliptic, rarely wide-elliptic (NY isotype), acuminate or rarely obtuse at apex, long-decurrent and in lateral leaflets asymmetric at base, chartaceous, dull above, glabrous, the secondary veins evident, straight or curved, looping at margin, 16-32 per side, the tertiary veins evident and slightly raised on both surfaces, the abaxial surface (at least the midvein) drying yellow-brown, the terminal blade (26.7) 34.2-54 cm long, (6) 8.6- 12.6 (14) cm wide, the lateral blade 23.7- 52 cm long, 8-12.3 cm wide; petiole 5.5- 12 cm long; petiolule absent or rarely to 0.4 cm long. Inflorescence 5-10-flowered, 2.5- 4 cm long including a peduncle 1.5-2.7 cm long; pedicels 4-6 mm long in flower and in fruit. Sepals wide-ovate or very wide- ovate, rounded at apex, 2.5-3.5 mm long, 2-3.5 mm wide, densely strigulose without and within. Corolla ca. 15 mm long at anthesis, densely strigulose on lobes and glabrous on tube without, cream to pale green, the tube 3-4 mm to division of innermost lobe, 8-10 mm to division of other lobes, ca. 4 mm wide, the innermost lobe linear, 14-15 mm long, ca. 2 mm wide, the other 4 lobes oblong, 6-8.5 mm long, ca. 3 mm wide. Filaments of fertile stamens adherent to corolla, 11-12 mm long, the staminodes adherent to corolla, linear, ca. 13 mm long; anthers ca. 4.5 mm long, 1.8-1.9 mm wide, glabrous, the connective glabrous, the appendages 1.2-2.1 mm long, ca. 2 mm wide. Disc +/- equal to ovary, not enveloping it. Carpels 0.8-1 mm tall, glabrous; style 9.8- 12 mm long, gland-dotted, glabrous. Fruit- ing mericarps 1-5 (usually only 2 maturing), 12-17 mm long, 8-10 mm wide, glabrous. Seed 11-12 mm long, 7-8 mm wide, dark brown.

description: Shrub 2.5-4 m tall, the indument of veg- etative buds, young twigs and petioles, and inflorescences strigulose. Leaves 1 -foliolate; leaflet blade lanceolate, acuminate at apex, acute or very short-decurrent at base, 4.7- 16.5 cm long, 1.8-5.3 cm wide, chartaceous, dull above, glabrous, the secondary veins evident, curved-ascending, looping at mar- gin, 7-12 per side, the tertiary veins obscure on adaxial surface, evident and slightly raised on abaxial surface; petiole 0.6-3.2 cm long. Inflorescence 18-75-flowered, 26-84 cm long including a peduncle 15-27 cm long; pedicels ca. 2 mm long in flower, 5-6 mm long in fruit. Sepals wide-ovate or suborbicular, rounded at apex, 3.5-4 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide, densely strigulose without, glabrous within. Corolla in bud ca. 8 mm long, densely strigulose without, green or white, the tube ca. 3-4 mm long, the innermost lobe oblong, ca. 4 mm long. Filaments of fertile stamens adherent to corolla, ca. 3.5 mm long; staminodes adherent to corolla, lance-subulate, ca. 4.7 mm long; anthers in bud ca. 3.3 mm long, ca. 1.3 mm wide, glabrous, the connective glabrous, the appendages in bud ca. 0.9 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm wide. Disc in bud enclosing ovary. Carpels in bud ca. 1 mm high, minutely puberulent at apex; style in bud ca. 3.5 mm long, glabrous. Fruiting mericarps 1-5, 10- 12 mm long, 7-8 mm wide, densely strigulose. Seed 6-8.5 mm long, 3-5 mm wide, brown.

description: Tree 5-6 m tall, branches glabrous; leaves petiolate, the petioles 4-7.5 mm long, the blades coriaceous, subovate, obtusely acuminate at apex, acute at base, 8-12 cm long, 2.2-4.5 cm wide, remotely and minutely serrulate or subentire, glabrous both sides, the secondary nerves 8-9 each side; panicles axillary or terminal, 6-14 cm long, the rachis puberulent, the flowers pedicellate, pedicels 1.5-3 mm long, puberulent; sepals 5, broadly suborbicular-ovate, obtuse, 1 mm long, 1.2 mm wide, ciliate; petals 5, lanceolate-oblong, rounded at apex, 3 mm long, 1 mm wide, glabrous without, margins ciliate; stamens 5, the terminal appendage conspicuous, ovate-oblong, rounded and irregularly erose at apex, 1.5-1.7 mm long, 0.5 mm wide, the anthers 1 mm long, glabrous; ovary subovoid, 1 mm long, glabrous, the style curved, 1 mm long, glabrous.

description: Annual to 50 cm long with lax, elongate, flowering and fruiting scapes, the latter up to 30 cm long. Stems hirsute below with spreading stiff hairs, the upper portions less so but now with interspersed short, glandular, hairs. Leaves petiolate, remote along the stem, 5-8 cm long, 3-4 cm wide, 3-5-parted, the terminal segment largest and with 3-5 dentate lobes, sparsely pubescent on both surfaces. Inflorescence lax with 10-30 remote flowers, glandular-pubescent throughout. Pedicels 0.8-1.5 cm long, recurving in fruit. Sepals lanceolate, 5-7 mm long, 1-1.8 mm wide, hirsute, reflexing with age. Corollas rotate-campanulate, ca 5 mm long, 8-10 mm wide, white with purplish venation. Anthers purple. Ovary globose, ca 5 mm long, 5 mm wide, moderately pubescent with spreading stiff hairs 1-1.5 mm long; seeds 4 per capsule, or by abortion 2 or 3, ca 3 cm long, ca 2 mm wide, alveolate-pitted throughout.

description: Arbuscula lactescens. Folia opposita, subsessilia; lamina 5-12 X 1.5-4 cm, oblonge elliptica vel elliptica apice breviter caudata vel acuminata basi cuneata, coriacea vel subcoriacea, glabra, in sicco rubra subtus pallidiora ad nervorum axillas domatiis instructa nervis tertiariis reticulatis conspicuis. Inflorescentiae fasciculis parvifloris. Corolla hypocraterimorpha tubo 14-20 mm longo, leviter arcuato stomate quinque lobis constricto, lobis ovatis 9.5-10 X 4-5 mm, intus prope basin granulate papillatis. Antherae fere per 3/4 longitudinis exsertae, dorso barbellatae. Ovarium dense puberulum. Folliculi lineares teretes 20-23 cm X 3-4 mm glabri, seminibus 4.5 cm longis dorso sparse pilosis.

description: Shrub or small tree, 3-5(-8) m tall, latex abundant, white; branches terete, a slightly dark reddish brown or blackish sheen on younger parts, becoming grey and lenticillate with age. Leaves opposite, subsessile, the blades (5-)7-9(-12) cm long, 1.5-2.5(- 4) cm wide, oblong-elliptic to elliptic, apex short-caudate to acuminate, base cuneate, coriaceous to subcoriaceous, glabrous on both surfaces, margin revolute, upper surface glossy, lower surface opaque and somewhat paler with well-developed domatia present in at least some of the axils where the secondary veins meet the mid- vein, generally drying with a reddish tinge on both surfaces; secondary veins 9-10 on each side, spreading, only slightly ascending, anastomosing before the margin, slightly impressed on the upper surface, prominulent and often drying dark reddish brown on the lower surface; tertiary veins rather obscure on the upper surface, reticulate and often well demarcated by their darker red-brown color on the lower surface. Infiorescences 2-5-flowered, in axillary and ter- minal fascicles; peduncle 1-2 mm long, glabrous, fuscous to black-varnished; bracteoles glabrous, coriaceous, broadly ovate, minutely ciliolate at the margin, ca. 1 mm long. Flowers fragrant, pedicellate, pedicels (10-)17-25(-30) mm long, relatively slender, glabrous. Calyx 2-3 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, glabrous on both surfaces, the lobes 2 mm long, ovate, somewhat blunt at the apex, with five small, flattened colleters al- ternating with the lobes on the inner sur- face. Corolla salverform, the tube greenish white to white, the lower cylindrical part (13-)15-19 mm long, 1.5 mm wide just be- low the upper cupular part, gradually en- larging to 2.5-3 mm wide at the base, slightly arcuate, the outer surface complete- ly glabrous, the inner surface on the upper 3/4 densely pilose, the lower 1/4 glabrous; the inflated base sometimes with enlarged staminal ribs, the upper cupular part ca. 1- 2 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide, the outer sur- face glabrous to granular, the inner surface granular-pubescent, constricted at the mouth by five bilobed rudimentary coronal lobes alternating with the anthers; lobes pure white, 9.5-10(-13) mm long, 4-5 mm wide, ovate, obliquely tapered, apex acute, lower surface glabrous, the upper surface glabrous at the apex, becoming densely pa- pillose-puberulent toward the base. Stamens inserted near the mouth of the corolla tube; anthers about 3/4 exserted, 3.8-4 mm long, very narrowly sagittate, the dorsal side bar- bellate, the basal appendages slender, acu- minate, curved inward and forward. Style- head cylindric-fusiform; ovary apocarpous, bilocular, ca. 1 mm high, ovoid, densely puberulent, surrounded at the base by a nectary disc ca. 0.5 mm high composed of five lobes cleft almost to the base; ovules 6 in each carpel, biserially arranged. Fruit apocarpous, glabrous, reddish brown, composed of two slender, terete follicles 20-23 cm long, 3-4 mm wide. Seeds 4.5 cm long, 2 mm diam., linear, longitudinally sulcate, the convex surface covered with a somewhat sparse indument of simple, pale golden hairs ca. 8 mm long; embryo straight, 3.5 cm long, the cotyledons flat, six times as long as the radicle.

description: Liana or small shrub with scandent branches, the branchlets sub-terete-or distally faintly angled, usually brownish; petioles 3-8 mm. long, the leaf-blades papyraceous, narrowly elliptic, 9-14 cm. long, 2.5-5 cm. broad, acute or obtuse at base, long-acuminate at apex (acumen 10-20 mm. long, slender, obtuse), obsoletely crenulate at margins (crenations about 2 per centimeter) or undulate, the costa slightly raised above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves 6-8 per side, ascending, prominulous above, sharply raised beneath; infloreseeicee 1-2.5 cm. long, dichotomously 3-5-times branched, the peduncle up to 15 m. long, slender, with the branchlets often faintly quadrangular, the bracts ovate, acute, about 1 mm. long; flowers 2-2.7 mm. in diameter at anthesis, subsessile or minutely pedicellate; sepals mnembranous, ovate or suborbicular, 0.6-0.8 mm. long, about 1 mm. broad, scariose and minutely erosulous at margins, sometimes glandular-punetate proximally within; petals erecto-patent, submembranous or thin-car- inose, elliptic, 1.5-2 mm. long, 1-1.3 mm. broad, seariose and subentire or erosulous at marginis, often glandular-punetate; disk about 0.6 mm. in diameter, 0.1-0.2 mm. thick, slightly elevated and free at upper margin; stamens suberect or spreading, the filamenits ligulate, about 0.4 mmri. long, slightly broadened toward base, the anthers about 0.2 by 0.4 mm.; ovary about 0.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the style about 0.3 mum. long; ovules 4 per locule (5 ex Peyritsch).
bibliographicCitation: Smith, A. C. 1940. Hippocrateaceae. Brittonia. 3 (3): 356-367.

description: Arbor lactescens ad 25 m alta. Folia decussata, lam- ina elliptica apice breviter caudata basi attenuata 8-9 X 3.5-4 cm, glabra coriacea vel subcoriacea, subtus ad nervorum axillas domatiis conspicuis instructa nervis in utroque latere lateralibus (6-)7-8. Inflorescentiae fasciculis ex 30-45-floris compositae. Calyx lobis ovatis recurvatis. Corolla hypocraterimorpha tubo 2.5-3.5 mm longo stomate quinque lobis constricto, lobis ovatis intus dense tomentosulis prope basin villosulis. Antherae exsertae, apice dorsali barbellatae. Ovarium dense puberulum. Folliculi lineares teretes.

description: Large trees, to 25 m tall. Branches terete, but angled and flattened at the nodes, purplish black-varnished in the younger parts, becoming grayish black and lenticillate with age. Leaves decussate, the blades 8-9 cm long, 3.5-4 cm wide, coriaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic, apex shortly and bluntly caudate, the cauda 0.5-1.0 cm long, base attenuate, margin revolute, glabrous and drying tan on both surfaces, slightly paler on the lower surface with a few small domatia present in some of the axils where the secondary veins meet the midvein; secondary veins 6-7(8) on each side, rather sharply ascending, anastomosing before the margin, impressed on the upper surface, prominulent and drying red-brown on the lower surface; tertiary venation obscure to faintly reticulate on the upper surface, obscure to densely netted reticulate and drying red- brown on the lower surface; petioles 3-5 mm long, canaliculate, glabrous. Inflorescences terminal, 30-45-flowered, peduncle 2 mm long, glabrous, black-varnished; bracteoles 0.5-0.8 mm long, ovate, glabrous to glabrate, minutely ciliolate at the margin. Flowers pedicellate, pedicels 5-6 mm long, glabrous. Calyx 1.5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm in diameter, sparsely puberulent down the middle of the lobes on the outside, otherwise glabrous, the lobes ca. 1 mm long, ovate, obtuse to bluntly acute, the very tips gently recurved and puberulent within, with five small, flattened colleters alternating with the lobes on the inner sur- face. Corolla salverform, cream, very fra- grant, the tube to 3.5 mm long, composed of a lower cylindrical part 2-2.5 mm and an upper expanded cupular part 0.8-1 mm, constricted at the mouth by five rudimentary corona lobes; lobes ca. 4.5 long, 2 mm wide, upper surface densely tomentulose becoming sparsely villosulous at the base, lower surface sparsely tomentulose to gla- brate. Stamens inserted near the mouth of the corolla tube; anthers 2 mm long, apex dorsally barbellate, base sagittate with slender basal appendages. Style-head cylindric-fusiform; ovary apocarpous, bilocular, cylindrical, 1 mm high, above the nectary densely puberulent, surrounded at the base by a 5-lobed disc nectary ca. 0.4 mm high with the lobes fused at the base for slightly more than half their length; ovules ca. 14 per carpel. Fruit apocarpous, glabrous, composed of two slender terete follicles (only immature fruit seen). Seeds unknown.

description: Liana or small tree, the branehlets elongate, einereous or brownish, subterete or distally faintly quadrangular; petioles 8-15 mm. long, the leaf-blades papyraceous or chartaceous, elliptic or broadly ovate-elliptic, (7 -) 10-18 (- 20) cm. long, (3 -) 5-9 cm. broad, obtuse or acute at base, obtusely acumllinate at apex (acumen 5-10 mm. long), undulate or crenate at margins (crenations 1 or 2 per centimeter), the costa strongly elevated above, prominent beneath, the secondary nerves 7-9 per side, areuate-aseending, prominulous above, often conspicuously elevated beneath; infloreseence (1-)2.5-7 cm. lonig, usually 5-8-times branched, the pedunele slender, usually quadrangular, up to 2.5 en1. long, sometimes contilnued into a similar rachis, sometimes dichoto- mously branehed at apex, the primary branches dichotomously ar- ranged or opposite at 2 or 3 nodes along rachis, spreading, repeatedly dichotomously branched, the bracts ovate, 1-2 mm. long, subacute, erosulous, persistent, the distal nodes contracted at base and appearing articulate; flowers 1.7-3.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the bracteoles often imbricate, ovate or suborbicular, about 0.5 mm. long, erosulous or ciliolate, the pedicels slender, less than 1 nmn. long; sepals submem- branous or papyraceous, ovate-deltoid or semiorbicular, 0.5-0.7 mm. long, 0.7-1.3 mm. broad, erosulous or conspicuously ciliolate at mllar- gins; petals suberect or erecto-patent, thin-carnose, elliptic-oblong, 1.2-1.8 mm. long, 1-1.3 mm. broad, entire; disk pelitagonous, 1-1.3 nmn1. in diameter, 0.1-0.3 imm. high; stamens suberect, the filanments deltoid-ligulate, 0.3-0.5 mnm. long, conspicuously broadened toward base, the anthers about 0.2 by 0.3 mnm.; style carnose, 0.1-0.2 mm. long, the ovules 4-8 per locule.

description: Frutex lactescens ad 1 m alta. Folia opposita sessilia; lamina 7-10.5 x 4-5 cm, ovata coriacea glabra, apice acuminata basi rotunda subamplexicaulis subtus opaca pallidior ad nervorum axillas domatiis instructa nervis tertiariis obscuris. Inflorescentiae fasciculis 5-10-floris. Corolla hypocraterimorpha tubo ca. 11 mm longo stomate quinque lobis constricto, lobis lanceo-latis 6 X 2 mm, intus prope basin villosulis. description: Shrub, to 1 m, latex white. Branches black-varnished becoming brown and conspicuously fissured with age. Leaves opposite, sessile (7-)10.5 cm long, 4-5 cm wide, the blades coriaceous, ovate, apex acuminate, base rounded, glabrous on both surfaces, upper surface glossy and drying brownish, lower surface opaque and paler with domatia in at least some of the axils where the secondary veins meet the mid-vein; secondary veins ca. 8 on each side, arcuate-ascending, anastomosing before the margin, impressed on the upper surface, prominulent on the lower surface; tertiary venation obscure on both surfaces. Inflorescences 5-10-flowered, in axillary and terminal cymes; peduncle 4-9 mm long; bracteoles ca. 1 mm long, varnished-resinous. Flowers pedicellate, pedicels robust, 4-6 mm long, varnished-resinous. Calyx lobes ca. 4 mm long, lanceolate, acuminate, tight- ly imbricate, the outer surface varnished- resinous, glabrate, margin ciliolate. Corolla salverform, white, outer surface glabrous, the lower cylindrical part of the tube 6 mm long, ca. 2 mm diam. at the base, constrict- ed at the level of stamen insertion, the ex- panded upper cupular part 5 mm long, 2.5 mm diam., the mouth occluded by five bi- lobed rudimentary corona lobes; corolla lobes obliquely lanceolate, acuminate, 6 mm long, ca. 2 mm wide at the broadest point, villosulous at the base within, oth- erwise glabrous to glabrate. Stamens in- serted at the base of the upper cupular part of the corolla tube, completely included; anthers ca. 3 mm long, narrowly sagittate, the dorsal side barbellate. Style-head cylindrical, ca. 1 mm long; ovary round, ca. 1 mm high, sparsely and minutely puberulent at the apex, surrounded at the base by a shallowly and irregularly lobed disc nectary ca. 0.5 mm high; ovules ca. 6 per carpel, biserially arranged. Fruit apocarpous, glabrous, dark brown striate, composed of two terete, thinly woody follicles ca. 5 cm long, 0.5 cm diam. (immature). Seeds unknown.

description: Erect annuals 10-25 cm high. Stems slender, moderately pubescent with hispid hairs interspersed among short glandular trichomes, arising from slender tap roots. Leaves 3-5 cm long, crenulate with 5-9 lobes, these in turn with 3-5 lobes, pubescent on both surfaces with both glandular trichomes and bullate-based hispid hairs. Scorpioid branches of the inflorescence 3-7 cm long, with both long acicular stiff hairs and short glandular trichomes. Calyx lobes 4, free, 3.4-4 mm long, elliptic-oblanceolate to somewhat spatulate, pubescent like the stem. Corollas purple, glabrous, campanulo-funnelform, ca 3.5 mm long, 3.5-4.5 mm wide, the lobes ca 1.5 mm long, 2-2.5 mm wide, the margins distinctly denticulate. Anthers yellow, projecting out of the corollas ca 1.5 mm. Ovary globose, 2.5-3 mm high, 2.5-3 mm wide, sparsely pubescent only on the upper portion. Style branches 4-5 mm long, glabrous or nearly so except for well-defined, short, glandular trichomes along the base of the shaft. Seeds brown, 2-2.2 mm long, alveolate in the manner of P. alba, the ventral surface not corrugate.

description: Shrub with scandent branches or liana, glabrous throughout (juve- nile infloreseence sometimes obscurely puberulent), the branches and branchlets usually einereous; petioles 4-10 (- 15) mm. long, the leaf- blades papyraceous or chartaceous, elliptic or obovate-elliptic, often narrowly so, 6-13 (occasionally 4-19) cm. long, 1.5-6 (-8.5) cm. broad, obtuse to attenuate at base, rounded to obtusely cuspidate at apex, serrate to subentire at margins (serrations usually 2-4 per centimeter), the costa conspicuously elevated above, prominent beneath, the secon- dary nerves 6-10 per side, ascending or erecto-patent, conspicuously prominulous on both surfaces; infloreseence 2.5-11 em. long, dichoto- mously or pseudodichotomously branched (usually 5-8-times, some- times reduced and only 3-times branched), the peduncle slender, terete, up to 6 cm. long, the branehes opposite or subopposite, slender, the bracts ovate, about 1 mm1. long, obtuse, erosulous; flowers 2.2-4.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the pedicels slender, 0.5-1.5 1m1. long; sepals submembranous, ovate to deltoid, 0.6-1.1 mm. long, 0.7-1.3 mm. broad, minutely erosulous at margins; petals thin-carnose or submembrainous, elliptic or elliptic-oblong, 1.3-2.2 mm. long, 0.9-1.8 mm. broad, entire and seariose at nmargins; disk 1-1.5 mm. in diameter, 0.15-0.2 mm. thick; stamens suberect, the filaments elliptic, 0.3-0.6 mm. long, con- spicuously broadest at middle, reduced at base and apex, the anthers 0.2-0.4 mm. long, 0.3-0.6 mm. broad; ovary about 0.8 ium. in diameter at anthesis, the style slender, 0.2-0.4 mm. long, the ovules 4 or 6 per locule; fruiting pedicels 1-2 mm. in diameter, the fruits 2-6 per in- florescence, the capsules obovate-elliptic or inarrowly elliptic-oblong, (3 -) 3.5-7.5 cm. long, 1.5-4 cm. broad, 2-4 mm. thick before dehiseence, rounded or faintly emarginate at apex, the pericarp flabellate-costate without (nerves usually faintly or sometimes conspicuously prominu- lous), smooth within, 0.2-0.3 mm. thick distally, 0.5-1 mm. thick toward base; seeds 4-6, the embryoniferous portion obliquely ellipsoid, subacute at apex, 10-15 mm. long, 4-6 mm. broad, the wing sometimes variegated, elliptic-oblong, slightly falcate, at maturity 25-35 mIm,. long and 12-15 mm. broad.

description: Plantae maximae, ramis dichotomis, intemodiis usque 14 cm longis; nodi tumidi, circa inflores- centias grosse callosi. Folia bina, pendula, crasse coriacea, lanceolata, saepe 50-80 cm longa, nonnulla 1 m longa, 15-20 cm lata; venatio pinnata, costae parte superiori 8 mm lata vel ultra. Inflorescentiae omnes laterales, ad nodos tumidos aggregatae, ut videtur endogenae, quaque triadibus binis constans. Pedunculi triadium usque 5 mm longi, bractea obtusa, pallide marginata terminati; pedicelli cupula haud profunda terminati. Petala 3.5-4 cm longa, ad apicem obtusum angustata, non constricta, basi ? 2 mm lata. Pars media petalorum appendiculis vermiculiformibus intus omata; ligula magna, trans- versalis. Flos fere infra medium laete rubidus, ceterum aureo-flavus sicut antherae stylusque. Antherae dorsifixae, 3 mm longae; pili longi, rufescentes, retrorsi versus parti superiori filamenti affixi 1 cm longi, filamento ipso medium alabastrum affixo. Stamina dimorpha; stigma clavatum, stylus rectus.

description: Very large plants, branches dichotomizing, stout, the youngest flower-bearing ones 8 mm, internodes to 14 cm long, nodes swollen and coarsely callused around inflorescences. Leaves paired, pendent, very leathery, dark dull green, lanceolate, mostly 50-80 cm long, some 1 m long, width 15-20 cm; margin callused but otherwise smooth; venation evident, pinnate, the upper portion of the midrib 8 mm wide or more. Petiole massive, canaliculate, about 5 mm long and wide. Inflorescences lateral only, crowded on the swollen nodes, apparently endogenous, each being made up of a peduncle 1 cm long bearing two triads; triad peduncles to 5 mm long, terminating in blunt bract with light-colored margin; pedicels 4-5 mm, terminating in shallow cupule 3 mm wide investing 1/3 Of the ovary. Ovary maroon-green, 3 x 2 mm, smooth; both cupule and calyculus with conspicuous, light-colored margin, that of the calyculus prominently and irregularly scalloped. Petals 3.5-4 cm long, the bud broadest below, slowly tapering to a blunt apex, without constriction, base about 2 mm wide, tip slightly less. Inner surface of the mid-portion of petals with vermiform appendages; ligule large, bracket-like, trans- verse. Slightly less than the lower half of the flower bright red, the remainder golden yellow, including anthers and style, base of style reddish. Stamens dimorphic, the 2 anther series not overlapping, anthers dorsifixed, 3 mm long, connective prominent but rather blunt, and with long, reddish, retrorse hairs attached to the upper portion of the 1 cm long filament, this attached at the middle of the bud. Stigma clavate, finely papillate, placed beyond the anthers, the straight style nearly as long as the petals. Fruits unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Kuijt, Job. 1987. Miscellaneous mistletoe notes, 10-19. Brittonia. 39: 447-459.

description: Epiphytic or lithophytic herbs, cespitose or short-creeping, 5-18 cm tall. Rhizome short, clothed by scarious sheaths. Roots slender, occasionally branched, 1 mm diam.; pseudobulbs 10-35 X 5-10 mm, oblong-ovoid to cylindrical and laterally compressed, young shoots subtended by 1-2 scarious bracts. Leaves solitary, apical; pseudopetiole 5-15 mm long, blades oblong, acute, coriaceous, 5-12 cm X 5-17 mm. Inflorescences usually solitary; peduncle 20-30 mm long. Floral bract 7-10 mm long, scarious, linear, sheathing the ovary but not exceeding it. Flowers yellow-green or brownish yellow, the lip yellow-green with reddish spots; column-foot inconspicuous. Pedicellate ovary ca. 11 mm long. Sepals 5-nerved, with 3 thick nerves and 2 faint ones and a few reticulated cross-veins between major longitudinal veins; dorsal sepal 10-13 X 5-6 mm, elliptic-oblanceolate, obtuse; lateral sepals 10-12 X 4-5 mm, free, attached to column foot, elliptic, acute; petals 9-10.5 X 2-4.5 mm, elliptic, acute. Lip 8-10 X 6-7 mm, 3-lobed; midlobe 5 mm long, oblong to subquadrate, rounded to emarginate; lateral lobes small, 1 mm long, 1.2 mm wide at base, toothlike, triangular ovate, acute, emerging from the lower 1/3 of the blade of the labellum; disk with a thickened midrib or callus. Column 7-9 mm long, arched, semiterete, clavate; thickened in cleistogamous genotypes; column foot 1.5-2.5 mm long. Anther 1.7-2 mm long; pollinarium typical of the Maxillaria rufescens complex.

description: Epiphytic herbs, cespitose or short-creeping, 15-20 cm tall. Rhizome abbreviated, clothed by scarious sheaths; pseudobulbs 1-leaved apically, 25-40 mm long, 15-20 mm wide and 10-18 mm thick when turgid, subspheroid or ovoid, tetragonal in cross section, clustered, partially clothed by 2 sheaths which are 20-35 mm long and bladeless. Leaves 10-18 cm X 26-33 mm, elliptic, acute, basally attenuated into a 5-12 mm long, conduplicate pseudopetiole, blade abaxially with a strongly keeled midnerve, particularly so toward the pseudopetiole. Inflorescences emerging from the base of, and shorter than, the pseudobulbs or from the rhizome, more commonly originating from the second-newest pseudobulb, 1-flowered, nodding, peduncle 22-26 mm long, slightly compressed laterally, clothed by 2 sheaths, the uppermost 12-18 mm long, apex oblique to the peduncle. Floral bract 11-12 X 6-7 mm, tubular, elliptic and acute when forcefully spread. Flowers with dull ochre sepals, petals and ventral face of column green-yellowish; lip dull yellow with red-magenta spots, callus dull creamyellow with an orange, thin margin. Sepals 5-nerved, with 3 thick nerves and 2 faint ones and a few reticulate cross-veins between major longitudinal veins; dorsal sepal 14-16 X 6.5-8 mm, elliptic, broadly obtuse or rounded, apically mucronulate; strongly hooded over column and lip; lateral sepals 13-15 X 6.5-7 mm, ovate-elliptic, broadly obtuse, apiculate, patent or slightly convex; petals 13.5-14 X 6.0-6.2 mm, elliptic-oblong, apex broadly obtuse, apiculate, subparallel to column in natural position. Lip 11-12 mm long, reaching 12.5 mm when spread, 8-8.5 mm wide across the forcefully expanded apices of the lateral lobes; mid-lobe 6 mm long, rectangular, shallowly emarginate at apex where it is 4 mm wide; lateral lobes 2 mm long, 1.8 mm wide at base, triangular ovate, acute, erectuncinate in natural position, emerging from the lower 1/3 of the blade of the lip; disk bearing an oblong mid-longitudinal farinose callus which thickens about the point of insertion of the lateral lobes, 1 mm wide at base, 1.2 mm at widest point, tapering toward apex in the second 1/3 of the blade. Column 7.5-8.5 mm long, 3.2 mm tall near apex, 3.5 mm wide on ventral face, hemiterete, shallowly concave on ventral face, slightly arcuate; column foot 2.5-3 mm long. Anther 2.1-2.3 mm thick and long, surface smooth; pollinarium typical of the Maxillaria rufescens complex.

description: Folia vulgo imparipinnata trifoliolata, raro 2-juga vel unifoliolate vel simplicia vel paripinnata 2-juga; lamina elliptica vel lanceolata, apice retuso; petiolus atque rhachis alati; foliola opposita, sessilia. Flores virides, breviter pedicellati (pedicelis ca. 1 mm longis); filamenta staminea paulo subulata, apice obtuso; stigma capitatum dilatatum. Pilocarpo microphyllo simillima, sed ab eo foliis paucifoliolatis, foliolis multo maioribus plerumque retusis 20-40 nervis lateralibus ornatis, atque floribus maioribus differt.

description: Small trees; distal branchlets pubescent or glabrescent; terrninal buds protected by cataphylls, the cataphyll 5-7 mm long, triangular, pubescent. Leaves alternate or subopposite, imparipinnate, less frequently paripinnate with (1-)3(-5) leaflets, seldom simple; petiole 0.5-4 X 1-2 mm, glabrous, canaliculate by incurved wings, the wings to 1 mm broad and auriculate near leaflet base, inserted at ca. 450; rachis 1-1.5 cm long, glabrous, winged, the wings 0.5-0.8 mm broad, broader toward leaflets base; lateral leaflets sessile, opposite, the blade 4-5.5(-14.5) X 1.5-2(-5) cm, elliptic to lanceolate, the apex acute, subacuminate or obtuse, the very tip emarginate or retuse, the base conspicuously asymmetric, shining above, paler beneath, chartaceous, slightly bulate, glabrous, the margin revolute; venation brochidodromous, the midvein prominent on both sides, the secondary veins 10-20 pairs; terminal leaflet 6.5-12.5 X 2-4.5 cm, narrowly elliptic to lanceolate, subacuminate at apex with very tip retuse, the base acute or attenuate, usually symmetric; petiolule 0-10 X 1 mm, winged, the wings 0.3-0.8 mm, frequently auriculate near apex, glabrous. Raceme solitaire, subterminal, erect or slightly arched, to 40 cm long and 9 mm wide at anthesis, the rachis ca. 2 mm thick at base, greenish, puberulent to glabrescent; bracts at base narrowly triangular, ca. 0.5 X 1 mm, pubescent at margin and apex; pedicels ca. 1 mm long at anthesis, slightly inclined toward apex of the raceme, glabrous; floral bract 1, ca. 0.5 X 0.6 mm, triangular with acute apex, ciliolate; bractlets 2, basal, ca. 0.5 X 0.6 mm, triangular with acute apex, ciliolate. Calyx (4)5- lobed, the lobes valvate or subvalvate, unequal, rounded, 0.5-0.6 X 0.7-0.9 mm, glabrous, ciliolate; corolla ca. 6 mm diam., aestivation subquincuncial; petals (4)5, 2.5-2.8 X 1.5-1.8 mm, ovate to lanceolate, greenish, glabrous, inflexed through 0.3 mm at apex, venation subactinodromous; stamens (4)5, filaments ca. 2 X 0.5 mm, flattened, slightly subulate with obtuse apex, glabrous, pale brown, anthers 0.9-1 X 0.7-0.8 mm, ovate, with a dorsal narrowly elliptic gland ca. 0.2 X 0.1 mm; disk ca. 0.6 mm high and 1.8-2 mm diam., glabrous; carpels (4)5, the ovary ca. 0.7 mm high, 5-plicate, protruding ca. 0.3 mm beyond disk, pale brown, glabrous; ovule 1 per carpel; style ca. 0.5 mm long; stigma dilated, ca. 0.3 X 0.8 mm, (4)5-lobed. Mericarps and seeds not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Skorupa, L. A. & Pirani, José R. 2004. A new species of Pilocarpus (Rutaceae) from northern Brazil. Brittonia. 56 (2): 147-150.

description: Stems about 2 cm. in diameter, to 1 m. or more in height; leaves narrowly linear, 1-5 cm. long, 2.5-3 cm. broad at the base, more or less minutely serrate on the margins; flowering culms, including the infloreseence, 16-40 cm. tall; staminate spikelets 5-8 mm. long; pistillate spikelets 4-5 mm. long; achene body 5-6 mm. long, 0.5 mm. in diameter, the beak-like apex of style-base tissue (when persistent) 4-5 mm. long; scales of the perianth about 1.5 mm. long.

description: Stems at maturity becoming generally woody; internodes 17-50 mm long (mean 35 mm), 1-3 mm wide (mean 1.8 mm), moderately to lightly pubeseent; leaves variable, obovate-elliptic to oblanceolate-linear, often appearing rather varnished, and sometimes having a narrow (0.5 mm wide) yellowish margin, 21-70 mm long (mean 40 mm), 8-15 mm wide (mean 10.5 mm); apex rounded- obtuse; base attenuate-acute; 3-5 veins sometimes noticeable on the lower surface; blades essentially glabrous, sometimes lightly pubescent; petioles 2-5 mm long, 1 mm wide, often possessing a few scattered hairs even when the blade is essentially glabrous; inflorescences lightly yellowish pubescent, the bracts often ciliate; anthesis approximately from December through February; staminate inflorescence with 2-5 segments (mean 3.1), individual segments with 9-45 flowers (mean 23.0) ; pistillate inflorescence with 2-3 segments (mean 2.3), individual segments with 6-15 flowers (mean 10.3) ; fruit white, 4 mm in diameter, glabrous; n = 14.

description: Stems at maturity becoming generally woody; internodes 15-30 mmli long (mean 20 mm), 1.5-2.5 mm wide (mean 1.9 mm), becoming somewhat flattened and dilated at the nodes, yellowish hirtellous or subglabrous; leaves oblanceolate-linear, 22-37 mm long (mean 29 mm), 4-9 mm wide (mean 5.9 mm); apex obtuse-acute; base attenuate-subpetiolate; venation inconspicuous; blades lightly stellate-pubescent to subglabrous in age, the younger foliage often with conspicuous whitish stellate clusters of hairs superimposed on a yellowish scabrous background; infloreseences densely yellowish-stellate; anthesis approximately from July through September; staminate infloreseence with 2-4 segments (mean 2.7); individual segments with 19-29 flowers (mean 24.6) ; pistillate infloreseence with 1-2 segments (mean 1.7); individual segments with 7-10 flowers (mean 8.3); fruit yellow-brown, 3-4 mm in diameter, densely long-yellow-villous; n = 14.

description: Ad sectionem Monsteram pertinens. Herba scandens plerumque hemiepiphytica. Caulis teres vel leviter compressus, internodiis 5-49 X 5-11 mm. Petiolus 6.2-38 X 0.2-1 cm, ad pulvinum usque vaginatus, vagina decidua. Lamina ovata vel elliptica, 12-34 x 6-22 cm, papyracea, leviter inaequilatera, fenestrata, apice cuspidato vel acuminato, basi cuneata vel obtusa, nervis lateralibus primariis 3-7; fenestrae 2.5-5 x 1-1.6 cm. Pedunculus 6.9-15 X 0.4-0.7 cm. Spatha aurantiaca 3-9 X 1.5-3 cm. Spadix florifer eburneus vel aureus, 4-6.5 X 1.2-1.5 cm, omnino fertilis. Spadix fructifer erectus, aurantiacus, 3.6-7.2 X 1.1-1.4 cm. Baccae prismaticae vel rotundatae, 7-9.5 X 2-8 mm. Semina ovoidea, 5.5-7 X 4.5-5.5 mm.

description: Herb; scandent or hemiepiphytic. Stem creeping, terete or slightly flattened against substrate, the internodes 5-49 X 5-11 mm bearing roots near nodes; roots dimorphic, the anchor roots 0.5-2.5 mm diam., the feeding roots 3-4 mm diam. Leaves numerous; petioles 6.2-38 X 0.2-1 cm, adaxially sulcate, sheathed up to pulvinus, the sheath deciduous; lamina ovate to elliptic, slightly oblique, drying blackish adaxially and ochre to blackish abaxially, chartaceous, 12-34 X 6-22 cm; adult leaf with 0-5 perforations per side, the perforations 2.5-15 X 1-1.6 cm, only rarely reaching margins and lacerating leaves; venation essentially reticulate, the primary lateral veins 3-7 per side; base cuneate to obtuse; apex shortly cuspidate to acuminate; leaf tip to 2 cm long. Inflorescences 1-4 per floral sym- podium, each inflorescence subtended by a prophyll 7-13 X 1-3 cm; peduncles 6.9-15 X 0.4-0.7 cm, erect at anthesis; spathe orange on both surfaces, 3-9 X 1.5-3 cm, acuminate, obliquely inserted on peduncle, soon deciduous. Spadix with oblique inser- tion, 4-6.5 cm long, 1.2-1.5 cm diam., cream colored to orange yellow, with 6-8 flowers in main spiral and 6-7 flowers in transverse spiral. Flowers (all fertile): gynoecium prismatic, 2-4 X 4-6 mm, white to cream colored, the stigma slit-like, 1.5- 2 X 0.8-1 mm wide, orange; stamens 4 per flower, 2-4 X 0.5-1 mm, the filament lat- erally flattened, shorter than anthers, the anthers sagittate 1.5 X 1 mm. Infructescence erect, 3.6-7.2 X 1.1-1.4 cm. Berries prismatic to rounded, 7-9.5 X 2-8 mm, with an apical cusp of trichosclereids, orange. Seeds green, ovoid, 5.5-7 X 4.5-5.5 mm, 1 to 3 per berry.
bibliographicCitation: Berg, Cornelius C. 2004. A new species of Ficus (Moraceae) of uncertain provenance. Brittonia. 56 (1): 54-57.

description: Plants at maturity becoming generally woody; internodes 15-30 mm lonog (mean 26 mm), 1.5-3 mm wide (mean 2.1 mm), lightly canescent; leaves linear-lanceolate, 32-84 mm long (mean 52 mm), 6-9 mm wide (mean 7.7 mm); apex rounded to acute; base obtuse-acute; venation inconspicuous or the blades sometimes 5-veined oni lower surface; blades subpetiolate, with whitish clusters of hairs superimposed on a canescent background, especially in youllger leaves; inflorescences yellowish canescent; anthesis approximately from December through February; staminate infloreseence with 2-4 segments (mean 3.0); individual segments with 29-42 flowers (mean 36.8) ; pistillate inflorescence with 1-3 segments (mean 2.0); individual segments with 16-25 flowers (mean 20.5); only immature fruit known, this greenish yellow, 3-4 mm in diameter, lightly puberulent.

description: Plants at maturity becoming generally woody, generally yellow-velutinous, especially on the younger parts; internodes 25-70 mm long (mean 47 mm), 2-5 mm wide (mean 3.4 mm); leaves elliptic to obovate-oblanceolate, 42-71 mm long (mean 57 mm), 14-35 mm wide (mean 24.8 mm); apex rounded to obtuse; base attenuate to obtuse; venation variable, sometimes 5 veins apparent on the lower surface; blades often velvety to the touch, the apex sometilmes becoming glabrous; petioles 5-8 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, often more densely pubescent than the leaves; infloreseences densely yellow-pubescent; anthesis approximately from December through February; staminate inflorescence with 2-8 segments (mean 5.3); individual segments with 37-120 flowers (mean 69.6); pistillate inflorescence with 2-8 segmellts (mean 4.5); individual segments with 12-38 flowers (mean 23.4); fruit yellow, 3-4 mm in diameter, densely yellow villous; n = 14.

description: Stems at maturity becoming woody, densely covered with a yellowish-tinged white tomentum; internodes 15-29 mm long (mean 22 mm), 1-2.5 mm wide (mean 2.0 mm); nodes often having extra-long hairs; leaves oblong-oblanceolate, sessile, 11-30 mm long (mean 22 mm), 4-9 mm wide (mean 5.8 mm); apex rounded-obtuse; base attenuate; venation inconspicuous; anthesis approximately from December through February; staminate infloreseence with 2-4 segments (mean 3.3), individual segments with 21-29 flowers (mean 24.3) ; pistillate inflo- reseence with 2-4 segments (mean 3.0), individual segments with 11-16 flowers (mean 13.0) ; fruit white, 3-4 mm in diameter, essentially glabrous or with a few short trichomes especially below the sepals; n = 14.

description: Rather stout, divaricate, sparsely branched, nearly leafless plants with rigid, terete internodes to 4 cm long, silvery green when young. Basal cataphylls one conspicuous pair, to 7 mm above the axil, fused, the tips broad and brownish, sometimes with a second pair to 20 mm above the axil. All lowest foliar organs on laterals median in position (both on vegetative growth and inflorescences). Leaves to 5 X 3 mm, fleshy, caducous, acute. Dioecious; both collections seen female. Inflorescences in both primary and secondary positions, to 3.5 cm long in fruit; peduncle of 1 or 2 internodes, followed by 3-6 fertile internodes; flower 1 per fertile bract, deeply sunken in the axis. Fruit globose, 4 X 5 mm, red, the petals closed.
bibliographicCitation: Kuijt, Job. 1997. Phoradendron olae Kuijt, a new species from Mexico pivotal in the taxonomy of the genus, with comments on P. californicum Nutt. Brittonia. 49: 181-188.

description: Frutex vel arbor 2.5-10 m alta, ramulis junioribus sericeis, ramis vetustioribus sericeis vel glabratis, lenticelliferis, ad nodos cicatricibus elevatis instructis. Folii lamina 3-7 cm longa, 1.5-3.5 cm lata elliptica vel parum ovata obovatave, basi cuneata, margine plana vel parum revoluta, apice obtusa vel acuta vel parum acuminata et saepe apiculata, supra novella laxe sericea adulta praeter costam nervosque et marginem glabrata, costa et utrinque 5-7 nervis prominulis vel impressis, subtus viridis, brunneo- vel albido-sericea pilis sessilibus vel brevistipitatis, directis vel leviter serpentinis, usque ad 1.3 mm longis, costa nervisque prominentibus, venis tertiariis parallelis prominulis, eglandulosa (sensu usitato malpighiaceo), multis punctis translucidis angulatisque instructa; petiolus 4-10 mm longus, sericeus, eglandulosus; stipulae 2.5-3 mm longae, intra- et epipetiolares, omnino connatae vel apice liberae, abaxialiter sericeae, adaxialiter atrorubrohirsutae. Fasciculi florum 3-6 foliis hornotinis axillares, bracteis bracteolisque inter se similibus, 1.5-2.5 mm longis, usque ad 0.8 mm latis, anguste triangularibus vel linearibus, abaxialiter carinatis et sericeis vel glabratis, adaxialiter glabris, persistentibus vel tarde deciduis. Pedicellus 8-14 mm longus, 0.8 mm diametro, laxe sericeus, sessilis. Sepala 3-3.5 mm longa, 2.5-3 mm lata, triangularia, apice obtusa vel acuta, parum vel non revoluta, abaxialiter dense sericea, adaxialiter glabra, omnia eglandulosa vel omnia biglandulifera, glandulis usque ad 2 mm longis, planis, circularibus vel ellipticis, non compressis. Petala alba vel flavida, abaxialiter ungue costaque sericea, adaxialiter glabra, ungue 1-2 mm longo, limbo 3-4.5 mm longo, 2.5-3.5 mm lato, rotundo vel spathulato, plano vel revoluto, basi decurrenti, margine eroso, in centro punctis translucidis instructo. Receptaculum caespites pilorum basifixorum gerens. Staminum 10 filamenta 1.5-3 mm longa, 5 exteriora (petalis opposita) quam 5 interiora (sepalis opposita) longiora, libera, plana, adaxialiter hirsuta pilis basifixis. Antherae aequales, ca. 1 mm longae, reflexae, deciduae, 4-loculares, connectivo glanduloso et apice parum amplifacto, loculis exterioribus alis introrsis rubris (?) ca. 0.2 mm latis instructis. Pollen tricolporatum. Ovarium 1 mm altum, hirsutum pilis basifixis, ex 3 carpellis liberis uniovulatis constans. Styli 3, basiventrifixi, 3-4 mm longi, praeter basim hirsutam glabri, apice minute stigmatici, in gemma inflexi, in fructu persistentes. Fructus hirsutus, ex 3 (vel abortu 2-1) coccis indehiscentibus siccisque in toro plano gestis constans, coccis immaturis 3 mm altis, ovoideis, basi gibbosis.

description: Large or moderate-sized tree; twigs somewhat wrinkled; leaflets about 5-13, mostly 5-13 cm. long and 2-5 cm. wide, elliptic or elliptic-ovate, acute or shortacuminate at the apex, the terminal distinctly acute at the base (and sometimes obovate in shape), the lateral usually acute or acutish, but sometimes, especially the lower ones, obtuse or rounded at the base, all nearly or quite glabrous, somnetimes finely puberulent along the midrib on either or both sides; inflorescence more or less puberulent with short curled yellowish hairs; sepals puberulent like the pedicels, about 1 mm. long in the staminate flowers, smaller in the perfect flowers; petals yellowish or greenish, mostly 2-3 mm. long, in the staminate flowers, and 3-4 mm. in the perfect flowers; filaments hairy near the base; fruiting gynophore well developed, mostly 2.5 mm. long or more and longer than broad, often lobed; fruit black, about 5-8 mm. in diameter.

description: Small tree; leaflets about 7-9, elliptic or sometimes narrowly ovate, acute at both ends, mostly 4-8 cm. long, 1.5-3 cm. wide, the lower ones not reduced, all crenulate to near the base, strongly reticulate-veiny beneath, but the veins not much raised, glabrous above, when mature, the lower side glabrous, or hispidulous along the midrib and main veins; infloreseenee reddish-puberulent or -hispidulous; staminate infloreseence open and few-flowered (circa 6-15 flowers in my specimens), the sepals reddish-puberulent, narrow, and fully 2 mm. long, the petals slightly reddish-puberulent on the back and 3-4 mm. long, the filaments very sparsely spreading-hairy at the base; hermaphrodite infloreseence of very few flowers (4 in my specimen), with slightly broader sepals and shorter petals; immature fruit about 7 mm. in diameter. (Description partly from two collections seen, partly abstracted from original.)

description: Small or medium-sized tree; twigs somewhat wrinkled; leaflets about 9-13, elliptic or elliptic-ovate, acute or 'short-acuminate at the apex, rounded or obtuse at the base, 5-17 cm. long, 2-6.5 cm. wide, averaging larger than in P. excelsa, the lower ones evidently smaller than the upper ones, all essentially glabrous, or sometimes with a few short hairs along the midrib and main veins; inflorescence and floral structures about like those of P. excelsa; fruiting gynophore averaging a little longer than in P. excelsa, often reaching 5-6 mm.; fruit about 9-11 mm. in diameter, blue or bluish.

description: Erect, vegetatively glabrous, unbranched or few-branched treelet, 2-6.5 m tall, the branches (when present) erect. Leaves imparipinnate with 3-5 leaflets; rachis (including petiole) 22-31 cm long, terete to broadly elliptic in cross section, the diameter below basal leaflet ca. 3 mm, 1.5-2 mm below terminal leaflet; petiole 5-15 cm long; leaf lets subcoriaceous, abaxially shiny, drying black, the petiolule 4-5 mm long, the mid vein sunken adaxially and raised abaxially, the secondary veins evenly spaced, weakly arched, and raised abaxially, the tertiary veins evident and usually raised; terminal leaflet elliptic to slightly obovate, 20-30 X 8.5-11 cm, the apex acute to slightly attenuate, the base cuneate; lateral leaflets decreasing in size along rachis toward base, distal ones 17-29 X 7-10 cm, basal ones 13-16 X 4-8 cm, the apex acute to slightly attenuate, the base cuneate and barely oblique. Inflorescence a subterminal raceme like thyrse, arching, then pendent, 12-31 cm long, the primary axis 1.4-1.7 mm diam. in flower, 3-4.5 mm diam. in fruit; staminate inflorescence 12-13 cm long, the condensed dichasia spaced ca. 4 per cm distally decreasing to 2 per cm basally, each dichasium producing ca. 10-25 flowers with 1-9 open at a given time; pis- tillate inflorescences 31 cm long, the dichasia ca. 2 per cm, more crowded distally. Staminate flowers deep scarlet; pedicels 3- 4 mm long, 0.3-0.4 mm diam., glabrous; tepals 6-7 [probably representing (4)5 sepals and a variable number of petals], 0.5- 0.8 X 0.2-0.6 mm, deltate to triangular, sparsely puberulent, acute to rounded apically; stamens (4)5, the filaments 0.5-3 mm long, the anthers ca. 0.3-0.4 mm long, the locules separated by the connective; pistil vestigial, 0.1-0.3 mm long, covered with a tuft of hairs. Pistillate flowers not seen (characters of the persistent calyx can be observed in the fruit). Fruit a berry; pedicel 1.5-2 mm long, 1-1.2 mm diam.; calyx and corolla 5-merous, the two whorls distinct; sepals ca. 1 X 1 mm, triangular, sparsely puberulent; petals ca. 1-1.2 X 0.5-0.7 mm, triangular, glabrous to very sparsely puberulent; immature berry 4-5 X 3.5-4.5 mm, ellipsoid; style 0.05-0.2 mm long, the stigmas 2, virtually sessile on fruit, divergent and recurved.
bibliographicCitation: Thomas, Wm. Wayt. 1997. A new species of Picramnia (Picramniaceae) from the Atlantic coastal forest of southern Bahia, Brazil. Brittonia. 49: 380-383.

description: Shrubs to 3 m (not sarmentose as mentioned by Liogier, 1980). Leaves imparipinnate, the petiole 3-7 cm, the rachis to 16 cm; leaflets 3-9, 3.2-15.5 x 2.0-8.0 cm, the terminal leaflet the largest, the apices acuminate (rarely elliptical-oblanceolate), the base rounded. Fruit large, to 7.2 x 4.5 cm, ovoid-pyriform to pyriform, green with a red blush, only one developing per inflorescence. Seeds to 3, imbedded in a firm flesh, to 3.5 x 2.5 cm (one side curved and two sides flattened when 3 seeds per fruit), tan, marked with several medium-brown crisscrossing lines.

description: Shrub about 1-4 m. high; leaflets about 4-9 pairs, mostly 8-18 em. long and 3-7 mm. wide, varying from narrowly elliptic-oblong to ovate or broadly elliptic, usually rounded or obtuse at the base, abruptly contracted near the apex into a linear tip mostly 1 cm. long or more; leaf-rachis with two ridges or narrow and inconspicuous wings; infloreseence large and open, the staminate 15-30 cm. long, the pistillate a little smaller; calyx about 1 mm. long or a little less, the teeth longer than the tube; petals about 2.5-5 mm. long; filaments several times as long as the small anthers; staminodia short and broad, about 0.5 mm. long or less; fruit brown or reddish, 2-3 cm. long.

description: Herba perennis, caulibus paulum puberulentibus, internlodis longis; foliis rhomboideis vel ellipticis vel fere lanceolatis, marginibus ad basin integris, supra medias folioruni serratis; pedunculis elongatis; sepalis lanceolatis integris; corollis inflatis, ventricosis; antheris naviculatis; staminodiis glabris.

description: An apparently perennial herb with erect, fine, terete stems obscurely puberulent below the inflorescence, and with widely spaced leaves giving a bare aspect (ecological modification?). The leaves are rhombic to elliptic to somewhat lance- olate, acute at both base aild apex, glabrous or slightly ciliate, entire basally, but distally (from the widest parts upward) strongly serrate with attenuate and sometimes incurved teeth; the blades are highly variable in size, the largest leaves from 45 mm long and 8 mm wide on one collection to 90 mm long and 30 mm wide on another. The bracts are lanceolate to nearly filiform upward, at least the lowest minutely serrate, the uppermost entire, sparingly glandular-pubescent. The peduncles are elongate, to 45 mm long on the type, and 2-3 times the length of the pedicels, 1- to 3-flowered, with rather conspicuous bracteoles subtendilog the pedicels, all lightly glandular. The sepals are lanceolate, entire, to 8 mm lonlg, and similarly glandular. The corolla is abruptly inflated from a tube shorter than the calyx, ventricose, about 30 mm longr, with rounded anld slightly spreadinog lobes, the lowermost of which are strongly villose within; the color is apparelntly violet or purplish to nearly white, although olne collection (number 9751) is said on the label to have red flowers. The anthers are divaricate, naviculate, glabrous, and with entire margins. The staminode is slightly dilated distally and glabrous.

description: Perennial herb, 1-2 dm tall; stems arising from a loosely branched, woody rhizome, which in turn surmounts a thick, woody taproot, the aerial stems ascending, solitary or in a cluster of few to several, becoming much branched and floriferous with all branches terminating in inflorescences; herbage finely puberulent, the hairs 1-1.5 mm long, non-glandular; leaves petiolate, all cauline, the petiole 0.5-2 cm long, winged to the base where connate with base of opposing leaf, the blade 1.5-5 cm long, 7-24 mm wide, ovate or ovate-spatulate to broadly lanceolate, cuneate basally, entire, obtuse to rounded apically; thyrse of 3-4(-7) verticillasters, the cymes (1-)2-5-flowered, the bracts leaflike below, reduced in size upwards, the peduncles and pedicels glandular- pubescent; calyx glandular-pubescent, (4-)4.8-6.5 mm long, the lobes lanceolate, sometimes broadly so, entire, narrowly scarious in the lower half, the sharply acute to acuminate apex flaring outward; corolla 15-20 mm long, gradually expanding from the tubular base to moderately ampliate, the short upper lip projecting, the lower lobes spreading, violet, sometimes darkly so, glandular-pubescent externally, the palate with 2 pale violet to white ridges, glabrous; staminode exserted, slightly dilated apical-ly, glabrous, white to sometimes yellowish; fertile stamens reaching the orifice or included, the anthers remaining horseshoe-shaped, the cells 1.1-1.6 mm long, dehiscing only across the confluent apices, dark violet above, pale violet to tan below, the sutures ciliate-fringed, glabrous on the sides; capsule 6-8 mm long, ovoid, acuminate; seeds 1.4-1.8 mm long, dull tan, finely pitted, variable in shape depending on position in the capsule, with angular edges and flat to concave surfaces, or rounded on one side; In = 8 (Vincent 4421, 4422, 4325).

description: Perennial herb, 0.8-2(-2.8) dm tall; stems ascending, arising in clusters from a loosely branched, woody rhizome, which in turn surmounts a thick woody taproot; herbage finely puberulent with short, white hairs (0.05 mm long) on the stems and upper leaf surfaces, the lower leaf surface glabrous; leaves short-petiolate, all cauline, 1.7-3.5 cm long (including the short petiole), 3-6(-7) mm wide, oblanceolate or the upper sometimes lanceolate, gradually tapering to the winged petiole, entire, obtuse apically, the lowermost sometimes spatulate and much smaller; thyrse of 3-5(-7) verticillasters, the cymes 1-2(-3)-flowered, the lowermost bracts leaflike in size and shape, reduced in size upwards, the peduncles and pedicels glandular-pubescent; calyx glandular-pubescent, 3.5-5.5(-6.5) mm long, lanceolate to ovate, the margins entire, narrowly scarious in the lower half, the apex acute, somewhat thickened and flaring outward; corolla 14-18 mm long, gradually expanding from the tubular base to moderately ampliate, the short upper lip projecting, the lower lobes spreading, violet to reddish violet, glandular-pubescent externally, the palate with 2 pale violet to white ridges, glabrous; staminode exserted, slightly dilated apically, glabrous; fertile stamens reaching the orifice or included, the anthers remaining horseshoe-shaped, the cells 0.9-1.2 mm long, dehiscing only across the confluent apices, usually purple-black, the sutures ciliate-fringed, glabrous on the sides; capsule 6-9 mm long, ovoid; seeds 1.8-2.3 mm long, dull tan, finely pitted, variable in shape depending on the position in the capsule, with angled edges and flat to concave surfaces or rounded on one side; In = 8 (Vincent 4468).
