description: Relatively constant in appearance, strict or densely branched from the base, the branches prostrate, 1.5-32 cm long; covered with weak glassy trichomes, more densely so above, and with an admixture of glandular pubescence in inflorescence; leaves not crowded, linear to very narrowly elliptic, 15-46 mm long, 1-5 mm wide, sharply serrulate, withering by the time the capsules mature. Inflorescence not elongating much. Hypanthium 0.45-0.9 mm long, 0.4-0.8 mm across at summit; ring 0.15-0.3 mm above the base. Sepals 2-2.8 mm long, 0.6-2.8 mm long, 0.6-1 mm wide at base. Petals 2-5 mm long, 1.2-1.8 mm wide, very pale pink or white, notched about a quarter of their length. Filaments of episepalous stamens 0.6-1 mm long, those of the epipetalous ones 0.5-0.6 mm long. Anthers 0.4-0.5 mm long. Style and stigma together 1.9-3.2 mm long. Capsules curving and nearly erect from the prostrate branches, 8-12 mm long, 1.2-1.5 mm thick, not torulose, with strong brown ribs along the lines of dehiscence permanently fusing the capsule about 3/4 of its length, the capsule very tardily splitting-about 1/4 of its length. Seeds closely packed between the rigid walls and more angular than those of other species, held at an angle of about 60º from vertical, 1 mm long, 0.4-0.5 mm thick.
bibliographicCitation: Raven, Peter H. & Moore, David M. 1965. A revision of Boisduvalia (Onagraceae). Brittonia. 17: 238-254.

description: Extremely variable; stout or slender, 4-150 cm tall, villous or strigulose; leaves scattered or dense, 12-85 mm long, 2.5-12 mm wide, narrowly lanceolate, more rarely lanceolate or linear, remotely serrulate or serrate. Inflorescence more or less crowded, its bracts broader than the foliage leaves, lanceolate to broadly ovate, 5-22 mm long, 3-13 imm wide, sometimes long-acuminate. Hypanthium 1.3-3.8 mm long, 1.3-2 mm across at the summit, the ring 0.6-2 mm above its base. Sepals 2-9 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide at the base. Petals 2-9 mm long, 1.2-5 mm wide, rose-purple, magenta, pinkish, or white. Filaments of episepalous stamens 1-3 mm long, their anthers shedding pollen directly on the stigma. Epipetalous stamens inserted on ring, their filaments 0.5-1.5 mm long. Anthers 0.5-1 mm long. Style 2.5-7.5(-9?) mm long; stigma more or less irregularly 4-lobed. Capsule 4-11 mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm thick, the central column persisting. Seeds 1.2-1.9 mm long, 0.4-0.9 mm thick.
bibliographicCitation: Raven, Peter H. & Moore, David M. 1965. A revision of Boisduvalia (Onagraceae). Brittonia. 17: 238-254.

description: Decumbent and matted or suberect, but usually well branched from the base, the stems 1.5-52 cm long; glabrous below, with fine strigulose pubescence above and on the leaves, at least along their veins and margins, or more rarely loosely villous above or entirely glabrous; leaves somewhat crowded, lanceolate or narrowly lanceolate, 8- 35 mm long, 2-6(-9) mm wide, evenly serrulate. Inflorescence crowded, scarcely elongating. Hypanthium 0.3-1.1 mm long, 0.2-0.8 mm across at summit; ring 0.15-0.5 mm above the base. Sepals 0.7-1.9 mm long, 0.6-1.2 mm wide at base. Petals 0.9-3.2 mm long, 0.7-1.9 mm wide, pale pink, fading purplish-rose, notched about a third of their length. Filaments of episepalous stamens 0.3-1.1 mm long, those of the epipetalous ones 0.2-0.8 mm long. Anthers 0.4-0.8 mm long. Style and stigma together 1-2.9 mm long. Capsule 5-8 mm long, 1.5-2 mm thick, often hidden by subtending bract, slightly torulose, with a strong brown rib on the back of each valve and thin lines of dehiscence between adjacent valves; capsule readily and promptly dehiscing only in upper third but structurally capable of splitting to base. Seeds crowded and about 200 inclined from vertical, 1.0-1.3 mm long, 0.3-0.45 mm thick.

description: Stout, 8-55 cm tall, villous or strigulose, often densely so; leaves usually longer than internodes they subtend, 12-50 mm long, 2-12 mm wide, narrowly elliptic, entire or very sparsely serrulate. Inflorescence more or less crowded, its bracts similar to the foliage leaves. Hypanthium 1.3-2.4 mm long, 1.3-3 mm across at the summit, the ring 0.6-1.4 mm above its base, Sepals (1.5-)2-6 mm long, (0.5-) 1.2-2 mm wide at the base. Petals (2.8-)4.2-11 mm long, (2.2-)3.5-5.5 mm wide, bright rose-purple. Filaments of episepalous stamens 1.9-6.5 mm long, their anthers usually held below the level of the stigma but in small-flowered plants shedding pollen directly on it. Epipetalous stamens in large-flowered plants inserted above the ring, in small-flowered plants on it, their filaments 0.7-4.3 mm long. Anthers (0.3-)1.1-1.6 mm long. Style (3.3-)3.5-10 mm long; stigma 4-lobed, irregularly so in smaller-flowered plants. Capsule 14719 mm long, 1-1.7 mm thick, the ribs usually broad and prominent; both the partitions between locules and the central column thin and pushed aside before maturity, the seeds then crowded into two rows near the base of the capsule and a single overlapping row above. Seeds 1.8-2 mm long, 0.7-0.8 mm thick. Gametic chromosome number, n = 10.

description: Slender, 1-62 cm tall, villous; leaves usually longer than internodes they subtend, 3-45 mm long, 1-4(-6) mm wide, very narrowly elliptic, entire or sparsely serrulate. Inflorescence not crowded, its bracts similar to the foliage leaves. Often cleisto- gamous. Hypanthium 0.4-1 mm long, 0.6-1.2 mm across at the summit, the ring 0.2-0.4 mm above the base. Sepals 0.7-2 mm long, 0.4-0.8 mm wide at the base. Petals 1-2.9 mm long, 0.9-1.8 mm wide, rose-pink to white. Filaments of episepalous stamens 0.4-1 mm long, their anthers shedding pollen directly on the stigma. Epipetalous stamens inserted on the ring, their filaments 0.2-0.8 mm long. Anthers 0.2-0.6 mm long. Style 1.2-3 mm long; stigma asymmetrical, subelavate or ob- scurely 4-lobed. Capsule (6-)8-13 mm long, 1.1-1.5 mm thick, the central column readily disintegrating. Seeds 0.9-1.5 mm long, 0.4-0.9 mm thick. Gametic chromo- some number, n = 9.

description: Erect to decumbent, 2.5-60 cm tall; leaves crowded to rather sparse, to 85 mm long and 13 mm wide, linear to narrowly ovate. Hypanthium 5-17 mm long, 2-6 mm wide at summit. Sepals 3-13 mm long, 1-3 mm wide at base. Petals 6-27 mm long, 4-15 mm wide. Filaments 3-14 mm long. Anthers 0.7-4 mm long. Style 12-40 mm long. Capsule 2.5-16 mm long, 2-2.6 mm thick. Gametic chromosome number, n = 19.

description: Arbor ramosa foliis sessilibus oblanceolatis obtusis basi cuneatis, venis secundariis prope marginem anastomosantibus, floribus solitariis axillaribus, sepalis rotundatis vel late ellipticis, usque 17 mm. longis, staminibus ad basin distinctis, stylo integro, stigmatibus 3.

description: A branching tree, glabrous throughout. Stems stout, purple-brown when young, becoming gray in age, the internodes 5-10 mm. long. Leaves coriaceous, sessile, elliptic-oblanceolate, 7-9 cm. long, 2-3 cm. wide, obtuse or obscurely retuse, entire, cuneate to a broad base; secondary veins lightly elevated on the upper side, curved-ascending, anastomosing near margin into a conspicuous connecting vein, with 1 or 2 additional marginal veins also present; upper leaves smaller, 3-4 cm. long, 1.5-2 cm. wide. Flowers solitary in the upper axils, the pedicels very stout, purple-red, about 1 cm. long. Sepals coriaceous, purple-red, the outer rotund, 10-11 mm. long and wide, the second broadly elliptic, 11-12 mm. long, 10-11 mm. wide, the third broadly elliptic, 17 mm. long, 11 mm. wide, the inner two round-obovate, 16-17 mm. long, 14 mm. wide. Petals pink, broadly triangularobovate, conspicuously retuse, 35 mm. long and nearly as wide, freely flabellately veined. Stamens very numerous, the filanments 8-11 mm. long, distinct to base. Anthers 1.8-2 mm. long. Pistil 16 mm. long, the conic ovary tapering gradually into the slender uLinbranched style; stigmas 3, sessile.

description: Frutex plus quam 1 m alta. Caulis strictus, erectus, teres, purpurascens; in caule inferiori moderate pubescens (praeter infra cicatrices foliorum dense barbatum), pube molli arachnoidea quae stellata et 0.5-1.0 mm longa est; in parte caulis foliata dense molli-pubescens, pilis 1.0-1.5 mm longis, patentibus; sursum in caule superiori et inflorescentia pube gradatim magis sparsa et abbreviata, pilis stellatis 2-3-brachiatis, antrorsis, 0.2-0.3 mm longis. Folia usque ad 10 cm longa, 9 cm lata, ovata vel leniter 3-lobata, profunde cordata sinu aperto, acuminata, margine omni crenata, palmatim 7-9-nervata, nervis supra purpurascentibus, discoloria, supra sparse pubescentia (praesertim in nervis) et viridia, infra dense et molliter albo-tomentosa. Petioli foliorum infimorum usque ad 8 cm longi, purpurascentes, ubique dense pubescentes, pilis 1.0-1.5 mm longis; folia summa sessilia atque amplexicaulia. Stipulae filiformes, 7-10 mm longae, dense albo-pubescentes, caducae cicatrices proprios elevatos facientibus. Inflorescentia paniculam termi- nalem apertam aphyllam efformans in axe principali et ramis paniculae pigmento purpurascenti bene evoluto tincta. Pedicelli (fructiferi) 1.0-2.5 cm longi, supra medium articulati; unumquidque alabastrum bractea florali trifida caduca 2-4 mm longa subtentum. Involucrum nullum. Calyces 6-7 mm longi, ad basim late rotundati vel plani (ubi fructificantes), sine nervatione prominenti, ca. semi-divisi; lobi calycis 5, ovati, adpresso-pubescentes pilis minutis stellatis (2-3 brachiis antrorse dispositis), praecipue in apicibus purpurascentes. Petala flavida, 8-10 mm longa, in marginibus unguium manifeste stellato-pubescentia, extus prope basim minute et non manifeste stellato-pubescentia, cetera glabra. Columna staminalis 2 mm longa, pallida, ad apicem antherifera; antherae numerosae, pallidae; pollen globosum, spinosum, flavum. Styli 12-14, purpurascentes, glabri; stigmata capitata, pallida, stamina paullo excedentia. Fructus ex 12-14 mericarpiis compositus, antrorse brevi-strigosus, pilis in pariete dorsali adpressis, in apice erectiusculis; mericarpia ad apicem rotundata, in 2 cellulis per constrictionem (extus manifestam) et per endoglossum divisa; endoglossum simplex, ex 2 linguis parallelis compositum qui extremum apicale cellulae inferioris obtegunt; cellula inferior 1-spermo, indehiscens, pariete dorsali et parietibus lateralibus per costas distinctas limitatis; cellula superior 2-sperma, seminibus non collateralibus sed inter se superpositis, dehiscens, parietibus dorsalibus et lateralibus non manifeste distinctis. Semina (immatura) glabra.

description: Herba usque ad 1 m alta. Caules cortice subtiliter striato longistrorsum; caules foliiferi subtiliter pubescentes, pilis stellatis et pilis simplicibus usque ad 1 mm longis, pilis albidis, sparsis. Axis inflorescentiae glaber. Folia ovato-cordata, interdum leniter trilobata, aliquantum grosse crenata, palmatim 7-nervata, usque ad 8.5 cm longa, 7 cm lata, acuta vel acuminata, supra glabrata praeter in venis aliquantum pubescentes, infra moderate stellato-pubescentia. Petioli foliorum infimorum usque ad 5.5 cm longi, pubescentes, pilis albidis 1-1.5 mm longis; folia summa sessilia atque amplexicaulia. Inflorescentia paniculam terminalem apertam aphyllam efformans. Involucrum nullum. Flores (ex descriptione collectoris) flavi. Calyces 5-6 mm longi, sparse stellato-pubescentes, lobis calycis 2.5 mm latis, 3.5 mm longis, reticulato-venosis. Fructus schizocarpium ca. 8 mericarpiorum, 8-10 mm diametro, 4-5 mm altitudine, glabratus praeter pilos stellatos paucibrachiatos secus suturas dorsales dehiscentiae dispersos; mericarpia bicellularia, cellula inferiori reticulata, indehiscenti, 1-sperma, in angulo inferiori 2 spinis brevibus et obtusis armata, cellula superiori laevi, dehiscenti, 1-sperma, protuberatione prominenti dorsali, semine superiore valde brevi-pubescenti, semine inferiore minus perspicue pubescenti; 2 cellulae mericarpii per endoglossum simplex albidum perfecte separatae.

description: Herbs, 3-4 cm high, hyaline. Tuber ovoid, 4-7 mm long, 2-4 mm wide, bearing 28-34 roots to 15 mm long. Stems 5, white, leafless except for a rosette of bract-like leaves just below the flower, 1-1.5 mm diam. Leaves 4, white, appressed, navicular, ovate, 3-4 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, apex obtuse. Flower upright. Flora tube white (with carmine to purple stripes) to carmine-purple, urceolate, zygomorphic, 7-9 mm long, largest diam 7 mm; base of floral tube bearing on its outside 12 oblong swellings of ca 2 mm long; gibbous part of tube with 2(?) longitudinal slits; throat hexagonal, 1.5 mm diam; inside of tube pilose, hairs 0.3 mm long. Shortest tepals white, inserted 1.5 mm below the annulus, reflexed, triangular-ovate, 4-6 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide, apex acute. Largest tepals white, tinged with purple, inserted just below the annulus, erect, almost closing the throat, swollen, fleshy, papillate, ovate, cucullate, 2-6 mm long (the longest one opposite the gibbous part of the floral tube), 2.5-3 mm wide, apex rounded, bearing a filiform appendage inserted 1-2.5 mm below the apex of the tepal; appendage basally purple, white at the top, to 65 mm long and basally 0.7 mm wide, tapering towards the top. Annulus purple, 1 mm wide (extending from the insertion of the tepals to the throat), ornamented by 2 rows of 3 erect, transversely narrowly oblong lobes alternating with the shortest tepals, each lobe 0.1-0.2 mm high, 1.5-2 mm wide, the inner row narrowing the throat. Filaments inserted 1 mm below the throat, 0.6 mm long, 0.8 mm wide. Connectives dilated, ovate, 1.7 mm long including the lobes, 1 mm wide, 2-lobed at the apex with triangular, acute, 0.6-0.8 mm long lobes, sagittate at the base with linear, 0.7-0.8 mm long lobes. Thecae attached to the middle of the connective, broadly ovate, 0.9 mm long and wide taken together. Interstaminal lobes present, inserted 0.8 mm below the filaments, linear, 0.3 mm long. Style cylindric, 0.5 mm long, stigmas patent, deltoid, ca 1 mm long, their apical part tufted with 0.4 mm long hairs. Ovary broadly depressed obovoid, 3 x 4 mm. Placentas 3, inserted parietally in the upper part of the ovary wall. Ovules narrowly ellipsoid, 0.2-0.3 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Folia solitaria ad 160 x 1.5 cm petiolata, basi cataphyllis aliquot subhirsutis 3-35 cm longis amplexo, apice pulvino ca. 4 cm longo suffulto; lamina ad 64 x 18 cm usque oblonga, basi rotundata et breviter attenuata, apice obtusa, nervo medio sulcato et nervis secundariis ad 33 usque paria ca. 1 cm inter se distantia instructa. Pedunculus ad 40 x 0.8 cm. Totus ramulus inflorescentiae bracteis distichis caducis; bractea inferior (abaxialis) ad 9.5 x 2.5 cm longa, bractea superior (adaxialis) tenuior ad 5 x 0.8 cm; unaquaeque bractea superior pedunculum hirsutum ad 7 mm longum apice bracteolam parvam ovatam persistentem et 2 pedicellos 2-3 mm longos ferentem includens. Ovarium tuberculis parvis rotundatis truncatis dense in fructu acutescentibus instructum. Sepala ad 3 x 0.6 cm, glabra. Staminis filamentum ca. 0.5 cm longum. Stylus liber, tubo 1-2 cm, stigmate flexo foveolato. Semina subdiscoidea, arillo laterali, 2-lobato.

description: Trees to 8 m high. Branchlets with scattered T-shaped trichomes (0.35-0.77 mm long). Older branches glabrous and lenticellate. Leaf blades 6.5-13.5 cm long, 3.5-8 cm broad, elliptic to obovate, the apex shortly acuminate, frequently glandular, the base shortly attenuate, the blades with (2) 4-6 abaxial circular glands next to the midvein or near the lateral nerves on the lower 1/3, with widely scattered trichomes and 4-6 pairs of evident lateral nerves above, scattered trichomes on the lamina and the midvein beneath. Petioles appressed-pilose, 4-8 mm long, the stipules inconspicuous, up to 1.2 mm long. Inflorescences simple racemose, appressed-pilose or with scattered trichomes, terminal on 2-4-leaved lateral axes, 10-24-flowered, the lateral axes 1-6.5 cm long, the primary bracteoles usually absent or, if present, up to 2 mm long at the base of the 4-8 cm long inflorescence axis, the secondary bracteoles 1-2 mm long, the peduncles 6-15 mm long and articulated 2-6 mm above the base, the tertiary bracteoles up to 1 mm long at the articulation, one of the pair glandular. Sepals ovate, glabrous, ciliate, 3.5-5 mm long, with 8 glands 2.5-4 mm long. Petals, stamens and pistil not seen. Fruits red, glabrous, 3-locular, (10) 11-13 mm long, (9) 10-12 mm diam., the bases of 3 persistent styles at the apex. Seeds 3 or 2 by abortion.

description: Epiphyte with basal rosette of leaves forming water and detritus-impounding tank, 60-126 cm high including inflorescence. Leaves with distinct sheath and blade; light green, spotted with purple pigments, especially at base of blade and apex and margins of sheath; sheaths 11-20 X 7- 12 cm, ovate to elliptic, creamy white to light green with dense purple spotting around top and margins, less at base and center, moderately to densely covered with peltate, multicellular, radially symmetric, foliar scales with concentric rings of cells and a peripheral wing of 32 cells with dis- tinctly thickened radial walls; blade 26-58 cm long, 3.2-9.5 cm wide at base, narrowly triangular, light green and spotted with pur- ple, especially at base and apex, not plicate, sparsely to moderately covered with peltate scales on both surfaces, the margins entire, the apex acute to acuminate. Inflorescence a many-flowered panicle with 1 order of branching and 5-15 primary branches; scape terete, 0.9-1.6 cm thick at base, the lower half completely covered by imbricate scape-bracts, the upper half partially exposed due to reduction in size of scape- bracts and increase in internode length lower scape-bracts differentiated into sheath and blade, the upper scape-bracts not differentiated; lower scape-bract sheaths 2.2- 7.3 X 2.8-4.4 cm, ovate, clasping the scape, moderately to densely covered with peltate scales on both surfaces; lower scape-bract blades 6.8-25 X 0.8-3 cm, ovate, erect, sparsely to moderately covered with peltate scales on both surfaces, the margins entire, the apex attenuate, spreading to recurved; upper scape-bracts 2.9-4.5 X 2.2-2.7 cm, ovate to elliptic, sparsely to moderately covered with peltate scales on both surfaces, the margins entire, the apex attenuate, the base clasping the scape; primary branches 5-23 cm long, 0.5-0.8 cm thick, erect, with 4-8 sterile bracts below the fer- tile segment of each branch; rachis, i.e., the fertile segment of the primary branch, 2.1- 9.3 cm long, square in cross section, 2-4 mm thick, with 4-13 flowers arranged in 2 ranks; internode between the lowest two floral bracts 6-13 mm, the distal internodes becoming increasingly shorter; primary bracts 2.5-6.6 X 2.3-4.4 cm, subtending and loosely clasping primary branches, ovate, glabrous on abaxial surface, moderately to densely covered with peltate scales on adaxial surface, the margins entire, the apex obtuse, occasionally mucronate, the base slightly decurrent; floral bracts subtending the flowers and overlapping the bract directly above by 1/2 (thus concealing the rachis on the sides where the flowers are borne), 34-47 X 14-27 mm, obovate to ovate, sparsely to moderately covered with peltate scales on adaxial surface, the abaxial surface glaucous, the margins entire, the apex obtuse to rounded, occasionally retuse, the base decurrent on the visible part of the rachis. Flowers sessile, arcuate and slightly zygomorphic; hypanthium completely fused to ovary, 4-6 mm long; sepals 34- 49 X 11-16 mm, keeled (sharply in the lower half), fused at the base for 2.5-5 mm, obovate, sparsely to densely covered on adaxial surface with peltate scales, the abaxial surface glabrous, the apex obtuse; petals 76-87 X 10-12 mm, obovate, eligulate, greenish yellow, coiling abaxially after elongation, then fading quickly to white and becoming flaccid following anthesis, the apex rounded; stamens exserted; filaments terete, ca. 10 cm long, 1 mm thick; anthers 10-15 X 1.1-1.4 mm, the anther sacs opening by longitudinal slits, the anther attachment versatile but appearing basifixed, attaching 2-3.2 mm from base, the base usually splitting 1-1.8 mm; stigma lobes 3, 3-5 mm long, erect to spreading, if erect then spiraling only slightly or not at all; style 9-11 cm long; ovary 14-16 X 3.9-4.2 mm, cryptically ?/2-inferior, the ovules borne on axile placentae in apical portion of ovary, 5-16 mm up from ovary base, the basal portion sterile, 4.8-5.2 mm long, composed of soft, brain-like tissue traversed by a multitude of convoluted longitudinal fissures, possibly secretory. Capsules 45-56 X ca. 12 mm. Ovules with a short apical appendage ca. 0.3 mm long. Seed body 2-5 X 0.7-0.9 mm, the basal coma 18-30 mm long, coherent at the distal end, the apical appendage up to 3 mm long, not divided into a coma.

description: Shrubs or trees 2-7 m high. Branchlets with scattered T-shaped trichomes (0.35- 0.7 mm long). Older branches glabrous and lenticellate. Leaf blades 10-22 cm long, 4-12 cm broad, ovate to elliptic, the apex acuminate, the base obtuse to shortly attenuate, the blades with 2-10 abaxial glands next to the midvein or removed toward the margin on the lower 1/3, glabrescent, with 4-7 pairs of evident lateral veins above, with widely scattered trichomes beneath, these denser along the lateral veins. Petioles glabrescent, 9-20 mm long, the stipules to 1.6 mm long. Inflorescences ternate-racemose or with 3 racemose eglandular axes radiating from a thickened, per- sistent common peduncle 0.2-4.7 cm long, arising from one or both axils at a node on the main axes, appressed-pilose, the primary bracteoles 1-6 mm long, rarely green bracteate up to 3.5 cm long, paired at the apex of the common peduncle or approxi- mate, the 3 lax racemose inflorescence axes 4-10) cm long, 8-14-flowered, the 2 lateral racemose inflorescence axes opposite or approximate, the secondary bracteoles 1-3 mm long, the peduncles 6-16 mm long, articulated 0.5-3 mm above the base, the tertiary bracteoles paired, eglandular, 1-1.5 mm long at the articulation. Mature flowers 14-21 mm diam. Sepals ovate or sometimes subtruncate at the apex, 4-5 mm long, glabrous, ciliate, the glands 8-9, 2.5-3 mm long. Petals, all 5 with erose limb margins, the outermost 4 petals 7-9.5 mm long, the claws 3-4.5 mm long, the limbs 4-5 mm long, 4.5-7 mm diam., the innermost 8-9 mm long, the claws 4-4.5 mm long, the limb, 4-5 mm long, 4-5 mm diam. Stamens 4-5 mm long, connate for 1/3 to 1/2 their length, the anthers 1.2-1.4 mm long, the connective yellow. Pistil 4-5.5 mm long, the ovary 3-loculate, glabrous, 1.5-2 mm long, 1-1.5 mm diam., the styles connate. Fruits orange, 11-12 mm long, 13-15 mm diam. Seeds 3, or 2 by abortion.

description: Trees 2-3 m high. Branchlets appressed-pilose (T-shaped trichomes 0.3 5-0.7 mm long, barely visible at 10 X magnification). Older branches glabrescent and the lenticels inconspicuous. Leaf blades elliptic, 2.5-9.5 cm long, 1.2-3 cm broad, the apex acute to shortly acuminate, the base shortly attenuate, the blades with 4-12 abaxial glands on or near the lateral and submarginal veins from the base up to 4/5 of the lamina, glabrescent and with 2-3 pairs of evident lateral veins above, with scattered trichomes beneath, the margins barely revolute. Petioles appressed-pilose to glabrescent, 7-11 mm long, the stipules less than 1 mm long, inconspicuous. In- florescences, axillary, simple-racemose, leafless, eglandular, appressed-pilose or with scattered trichomes, the primary bracteoles absent, the axes 2.5-5 cm long, 6-7- flowered, the secondary bracteoles 1-1.5 mm long, the peduncles basally articulated, 12-13 mm long, the tertiary bracteoles paired, eglandular, 1-1.2 mm long from the articulation. Sepals ovate, 4-4.5 mm long, glabrescent, ciliate, the glands 8, 3-3.5 mm long. Petals, stamens and pistil not seen. Fruits 12 mm long, 9 mm diam., reddish-orange, 3-locular, glabrescent to glabrous.

description: Arbor ad 20 m.; folia imparipinnata, bijugata, petiolis 9-9.5 cm. longis, teretibus; rachibus 7-8.5 cm. longis, teretibus, sparse pilosulis; petiolulis 1-2 mm. longis, foliolorum laminis 8-12 cm. longis, 4-6.5 cm. latis, tenui- chartaceis, oblongo-ovalibus, ad basim obtusis et paullo obliquis, ad apicem subito breviter acuminatis, extremitate obtusa, margine integro; supra sparse velutinis, infra densissime velutinis, pallidioribus; costa et venis leviter utrinque salientibus, nervis in paribus 6-7; inflorescentiae racemosae, ad apicem ramu- lorum defoliatorum congestae, axi sparse pilosulo; flores masculi glabri, sub- sessiles, calyces 5-meri, lobis 0.8-1 mm. longis, 0.5-0.7 mm. latis, carnosis, liberis, imbricatis, ovatis, ad apicem obtusis; corolla 5-mera, lobis 1.7 mm. longis, 0.7-1 mm. latis, liberis, in alabastro imbricatis, petalis lanceo-ovatis, ad apicem obtusis; stamina 10, aequalia, sub disco glabro decemlobato inserta, fila- mentis subulatis, glabris, circa 1.5 mm. longis, antheris ovali-oblongis, 0.6 mm. longis, 0.4 mm. latis, discus 1.7 mm. diametro, convexus; pistilli rudimentarii stigmate trilobato; flores feminei fructusque ignotus.

description: Woody vines, climbing to 3 m, the stems terete, hollow, to 5 m long, very sparsely and minutely pubescent to glabrescent, and beset with widely scattered spines, these retrorse, stout, 2-3 mm long, compressed laterally. Leaf blades elliptic, basally rounded, entire, apically long-acuminate, almost glabrous (except with tufts of hairs in the axils of the secondary nerves abaxially), 8-12 X 2.5-5 cm, 3-nerved from the base, the nerves raised beneath, with a single flat, yellowish nectary near base of midrib abaxially; petioles 5-15 mm long, minutely bearded adaxially, otherwise glabrous; stipules subulate, pubescent, caducous. Flowers whitish or yellowish in 2-5-flowered, subumbellate groups borne on slender axillary peduncles 5-6 mm long, the peduncles 1-4 per axil; pedicels 2-4 mm, slender, the umbel subtended by 2 or more minute bracts; sepals 5, oblong-apiculate, ca. 3 mm X 1.5 mm, glabrous [other details of flower structure not observable in available material]. Fruits green, solitary on pedicels ca. 8 mm long, woody, indehiscent, 2-3 cm diam., 5-carpelled, each carpel with 1-3 stout woody spines, the largest 12-15 mm long, almost glabrous.

description: Arbor. Folia elliptica vel obovata, (12) 13.5-30.5 cm longa, (2.5) 4.5-12 cm lata, apice acuminata vel longe acuminata, basi cuneata vel anguste cuneata, margine integra, superne glabra, subtus glabra sed costa parce pubescenti et lamina glandulosa. Nectarium foliorum multiaperturatum. Petalarum unguis ca 1.5 mm longus, cucullo e duobus dentibus adaxialibus et duabus ails abaxialibus constanti, lamina cylindrica, anguste elliptica, pubescenti. Antherae sessiles ad apicem columnae staminalis, connectivo non expanso. Capsula globosa ca 2 cm diametro, spinosa.

description: Small trees, 2-10 m tall; trunk 5-10 cm d.b.h. Young stems sparingly pubescent with scattered, stellate hairs; older stems glabrate. Leaves elliptic to obovate, (12) 13.5-30.5 cm long, (2.5) 4.5-12 cm wide, apex acuminate to long acuminate, base cuneate to narrowly cuneate, margin entire, very slightly revolute, glabrous above, essentially glabrous below except for scattered, bifurcate or 3-armed hairs on the midvein and widely scattered, brownish-red, glandular excrescences on the blade; primary, secondary, and tertiary veins slightly raised above and below; midvein below with an inconspicuous, multiaperturate foliar nectary centered ca 2-5 mm from the leaf base, foliar nectary ca 3-5 mm long; petiole 5-15 mm long, sparingly pubescent with bifurcate and 3-armed hairs; stipules acicular to linear, ca 2-3 mm long, apiculate, sparingly pubescent with simple and bifurcate hairs, especially toward the apex, caducous. Inflorescences glomerate, axillary (seemingly cauliflo- rous when in the axils of fallen leaves); peduncles 2-6 mm long, articulate, densely pubescent with stellate hairs, subtended by 3 triangulate bracts at the very base, the bracts ca 0.5 mm long, caducous. Calyx 5-lobed, the lobes triangular to narrowly triangular, 4-5 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, united ca 0.5-1 mm at the base, reflexed at anthesis, abaxial surface densely pubescent with stellate hairs, adaxial surface pubescent with multicellular hairs. Petals 5, unguiculate, cucullate, and ligulate; claw ca 1.5 mm long, maroon, lower portion curved away from the axis, glabrous, apical portion forming a hood composed of 2 adaxial teeth and 2 abaxial wings (one each on either side of the lamina), teeth ca 0.5 mm long, wings ca 1 mm long, both teeth and wings rounded distally, glabrous adaxially, and pubescent abaxially with simple, attenuate hairs to ca 0.5 mm long, the hood and especially the teeth defining a cavity that encloses the stamens; lamina cylindric, very narrowly elliptic, ca 3-4 mm long, ca 0.5-0.7 mm wide, pubescent with simple, attenuate hairs to ca 0.5 mm long, maroon at the base, cream-colored above. Staminal column ca 1.5 mm tall, maroon, composed of 5 stamens alternating with 5 staminodes; each stamen tucked under a petal hood; anthers 2-locular, sessile at the apex of the staminal column, connective not expanded; staminodes each expanded on either side into a minute, lateral lobe upon which the adaxial face of the petal hood rests, apex of staminodes papillate. Ovary globose, ca 0.7 mm tall, 5-locular, locules biovulate, outer surface with scattered acicular hairs and globose protuberances; style 5-costulate, ca 0.3 mm long; stigma capitate, shallowly 5-lobed. Mature fruit not seen, evidently a woody, globose capsule to ca 2 cm long, adorned with short spines (fide de Granville et al. 7856, 7889), immature fruit densely spiny, spines apiculate with several simple hairs clustered at the apex; seeds not seen.

description: Epiphyte, with basal rosette of leaves forming water and detritus-impounding tank, to 3.5 m high including inflorescence. Leaves with distinct sheath and blade; sheaths 18-32 X 17-22 cm, elliptic to ovate, stramineous to dark ferruginous due to dense covering of peltate, multicellular, radially symmetric, foliar scales with concentric rings of cells and a peripheral wing of 32 or 64 cells with distinct radial walls; blade 42-87 cm long, 16 cm wide at base, narrowly triangular, green, plicate, the margins entire, the apex acuminate to cuspidate. Inflorescence a terminal, many-flow- ered, broad panicle, with one order of branching and 4-25 primary branches, ca 1.5-3 m long, 1-1.5 m across; scape terete, ca. 3.5 cm thick at base, completely covered by imbricate scape-bracts; lower scape-bracts ascending to spreading, much like the upper leaves, divided into distinct sheath and blade; upper scape-bracts spreading to reflexed, articulated between sheath and blade; scape-bract sheaths 4.2- 6.5 X 3.8-6.1 cm, ovate, clasping the scape, decurrent along the margins, stramineous due to dense covering of peltate scales; scape-bract blades 11.3-24.5 cm long, 2.2- 4 cm wide at base, narrowly triangular, the margins entire, the apex acuminate to attenuate, sparsely to densely covered with peltate scales on both surfaces; primary branches 22-66 cm long, 0.8-1.4 cm thick, spreading but curved-ascending to erect in distal 2/3, with 5-11 sterile bracts below the fertile segment of each branch; rachis 14.5- 32 cm long, elliptic in cross section, 0.5- 1.2 cm thick, with 11-27 flowers arranged in 2 ranks; internode between the lowest floral bracts 1.2-2 cm, the distal internodes becoming increasingly shorter; primary bracts 4-9 X 2.5-5 cm, subtending and loosely clasping the primary branches, ovate, sparsely to moderately covered with peltate scales on adaxial surface, the abaxial surface glabrous, the margins entire, the apex rounded, often mucronate, the base slightly decurrent; floral bracts subtending the flowers and overlapping the bract directly above by 1/2 (thus concealing through anthesis the rachis on the sides where the flowers are borne, becoming more spreading as the fruit develops), 35-58 X 22-36 mm, ovate to elliptic, moderately to densely covered with peltate scales on adaxial surface, the abaxial surface glabrous, the margins entire, the apex retuse to rounded, the base decurrent on the visible part of the ra- chis. Flowers sessile, slightly zygomorphic; hypanthium completely fused to ovary, 8- 11 mm long; sepals 35-55 X 19-34 mm, not keeled, connate at the base for 2-6 mm, obovate, sparsely to densely covered on ad- axial surface with peltate scales, the abaxial surface glabrous, the apex +/- obtuse; petals 95-132 X 10-12 mm, obovate, eligulate, yellow-green with deep maroon pigments extending 2-3 mm in from each margin, fading quickly to creamy white following anthesis, the apex acute to rounded; stamens exserted; filaments terete, 106-113 mm long, 1.5-2 mm thick; anthers 16-18 X 2-3 mm, the anther sacs opening by longitudinal slits, the anther attachment versatile, attaching 4-5 mm from base, the base sagittate, usually splitting 2-3.5 mm; stigma lobes 3, 5-6 mm long, erect, spiraling slightly; style 104-116 mm long; ovary 17-19 X 8-10.2 mm, cryptically ½ -inferior, the ovules borne on axile placentae in apical portion of the ovary, 9-19 mm up from ovary base, the basal portion sterile, 8-10 mm long, composed of soft, brain-like tissue traversed by a multitude of convoluted longitudinal fissures, possibly secretory. Capsules 50-65 X 6.5-8.5 mm. Ovules with an elongate apical appendage ca. 1 mm long. Seed body 2.5-4 X 1-2.8 mm, basal coma 17-23 mm long, apical append- age up to 3 mm long, not divided into a coma.

description: Glaber, verisimiliter erectus. Caulis fuscus acute 4-angulatus. Folia subearnosa, oblonga vel oblongo-oblanceolata, acuminata, subavenia, basi longe cuneata in petiolum brevem anguste alatum. Infloreseentia cormybiformis pauciflora, axibus fuscis rugosis, bracteis bracteolisque subulatis. Calyx infra medium 5-fidus, lobis ovato-oblongis obtusis apiculatis. Corolla infundibuliformis, lobis late ovatis. Antherae vix exsertae. Capsula anguste ovoidea, stylo persistente complanato, indurato; stigmatis lobi oblolngi apice rotundati.

description: Apparently erect and scarcely branched, glabrous. Stem fuscous, sharply 4-angled or narrowly 4-winged, becoming rugose above, the internodes 2-5 cm. long. Leaves rather fleshy, fuscous when dry, oblong to oblong-oblanceolate, to 10 cm. long and 3.5 cm. wide, acuminate to a very sharp tip, long-cuneate at the base into a short margined petiole connected by a narrow ridge around the stem with that of the opposite leaf, inconspicuously veined; upper leaves scarcely smaller. Infloreseence 8-15 mm. long, corymbiform, few-flowered, rugose; bracts and bracteoles subulate, 10-3 mm. long. Calyx-tube hemispheric, 3 mm. high; calyx-lobes ovate-oblong, 7.5-9 mm. long, obtuse. Corolla funnel-shaped, about 35 mm. long; corolla-lobes broadly ovate, 10-11 mm. long, minutely erose-denticulate. Stamens and style scarcely exserted; lobes of the stigma broadly oblong, rounded at apex; pollen-grains 0.05 mm. in diameter. Capsule slenderly ovoid, tipped by the persistent, indurated, flattened style and stigmas.

description: Epiphyte with basal rosette of leaves forming water and detritus-impounding tank, to 4.5 m high with inflorescence. Leaves with distinct sheath and blade; sheaths 17-29 X 14-20 cm wide, elliptic, stramineous to ferruginous due to dense covering of peltate, multicellular, radially symmetric, foliar scales with concentric rings of cells and a peripheral wing of 64 cells having indistinct radial walls; blade 39-91 cm long, 9.6-16.5 cm wide at base, narrowly triangular, plicate, green, the mar- gins entire, the apex acuminate to attenuate. Inflorescence a many-flowered, broad, terminal panicle, with 3-4 orders of branching and 12-36 primary branches, 2.5-4 m long (as measured from terminal flower to point at which lowest lateral branch emerges from axis), 1.5-3 m across; scape terete, 3- 4 cm thick at base, completely covered by imbricate scape-bracts; lower scape-bracts ascending to spreading, grading into upper leaves; upper scape-bracts spreading to reflexed, +/- articulated between sheath and blade; scape-bract sheaths 4-11.2 X 7.5-10 cm, elliptic to ovate, clasping the scape, stramineous to ferruginous due to dense covering of peltate scales; scape-bract blades 9.5-38.5 X 4-6.5 cm, triangular, sparsely to densely covered by peltate scales on both surfaces, the margins entire, the apex acuminate to attenuate; primary bracts 2.5-10.5 X 2-4.7 cm, loosely clasping primary branches, ovate, the apex atten- uate to cuspidate; primary branches decumbent, 30-78 cm long, pinnately branched with 1-7 secondary branches, 4-13 mm diam., with 3-8 sterile bracts and internodes 4.5-7 cm long below the first secondary branch; secondary branches 9-37 cm long, 2-4 mm diam., occasionally with 1-2 tertiary branches; 5-13 cm long; flow- ers arranged +/- in 2 ranks on secondary and tertiary branches, subtended by floral bracts distal to 2-5 sterile bracts at base of secondary branches; internode between lowest two floral bracts on secondary branches 29- 45 mm, the distal internodes of secondary and tertiary inflorescence branches increasingly shorter; floral bracts 20-28 X 5-8 mm, ovate to obovate, sparsely to moder- ately covered on adaxial surface with peltate scales, the abaxial surface glabrous, the apex attenuate. Flowers sessile, slightly zygomorphic; hypanthium completely fused to ovary, 5-6.5 mm long; sepals 25-33 X 7-9 mm, not keeled, fused at the base for 2-6 mm, obovate, sparsely to densely covered on adaxial surface with peltate scales, the abaxial surface glabrous, the apex +/- obtuse; petals 57-124 X 7-9 mm, obovate, eligulate, yellow-green with deep maroon pigments extending 2-3 mm in from each margin, fading quickly to pale creamy white following anthesis, the apex rounded; stamens exserted; filaments terete, 75-79 mm long and ca. 1 mm diam.; anthers 12- 13 X ca. 1.2 mm, the anther sacs opening by longitudinal slits, the anther attachment versatile, attaching 2-2.5 mm from base, the base often slightly sagittate, usually splitting 0.5-1.5 mm; stigma lobes 3, 2.5- 3 mm long, ? erect, spiraling slightly; style 68-73 mm long; ovary 14-16 X 3-4.5 mm, cryptically half-inferior, the ovules borne on axile placentae in apical portion of ovary, 5-14 mm up from ovary base, the basal portion sterile, ca. 5-6 mm long, composed of soft, brain-like tissue traversed by a multitude of convoluted longitudinal fissures, possibly secretory. Capsules 50-65 X 6.5- 8.5 mm. Ovules with an elongate apical appendage ca. 1 mm long. Seed body 2.5-4 X 0.7-0.9 mm, basal coma 25-35 mm long, coherent at the distal end, the apical appendage 2-9 mm long, not divided into a coma.

description: Leaflets commonly to 15 cm long, coriaceous, ovate, acuminate to a long, acute tip; pubescence medium to long, white to tan, sparse to moderately dense on petiolule and lower surface of blade; upper surface glabrate. Bracteoles 1 mm long, obtuse. Pedicel 3 mm long. Calyx 14 mm longr; pubescence long, tanl, sparse to moderately dense; upper lip shorter than tube, upper edge convex, not apiculate, sitting at anthesis; lower teeth borne on a comiimon jaw-like base 6 mm long; lowest tooth 2 mm long, subulate, exceedino acute laterals. Only immature corollas seen, in which standard is 1.5 cm long. Only immature pods seen, 15 × 2.5 cm, compressed; each valve with a single rib along ventral suture.

description: Leaflets commonly to 14 cm long, chartaceous, broadly ovate, acuminate to a short or medium long, obtuse tip; pubescence long, white, sparse on petiolule, sparse to nearly glabrous on both surfaces of blade. Bracteoles 1.5 mm long, obtuse. Pedicel 3 mm long. Calyx 14 mm long, nearly glabrous; upper lip nearly as long as tube, upper edge constricted behind non-apiculate tip; lowest tooth 2 mm long, slightly subulate, equalling obtuse laterals. Standard 4.5 cm long. Pod commonly to 20 × 5 cm, compressed, indehiseent or tardily dehiseent, tan; each valve with sutural ribs and an extra rib ea 2 mm from ventral rib. Seeds to 27 × 18 × 6 mm, oblong-elliptic, strongly compressed, light reddish brown, not buoyant or impermeable; hilum ca 17 mm long.

description: Trees 4-10(-18) m tall, to 30 cm or more dbh, or rarely much-branched shrubs to 5 m tall, with dark-brown smooth bark (at least when young). Leaves evergreen, alternate-spiral, elliptic to oblong or lanceolate, mostly 9-28 X 3-9 cm, the apex acute to obtuse or rounded, minutely short-apiculate to filiform-apiculate, the base mostly rounded to cuneate, glabrous or puberulent with short simple hairs beneath, the midrib prominent with (10-)13-24 main lateral veins on each side; petioles (1-)3-6 cm long, glabrous or minutely puberulent, the pulvinus 4-6 mm long, prominent at the leaf juncture. Inflorescences erect, terminal racemes, solitary or paired; peduncle relatively short, 6-10(-16) cm long and few to many-flowered, eventually when fully matured with a total of (3-)8-15(rarely-40) flowers and old pedicel scars, but only 3-15 in bud and 1-8 flowers at any time; pedicels 2-4 cm long, strongly ascending. Flowers showy, fragrant; sepals with open aestivation, green, triangular, acute to obtuse or rounded, 3-5 x 3-4 mm, much shorter than the petals, delicately erose-denticulate on the margin, each sharply reflexed by a large, fleshy, bulbous, ovoid episepalous gland that sits adaxially on its base; petals maroon in bud, turning white or partly white and violet abaxially, white to purple adaxially, ovate, (11-)15-22 x 8-11 mm, rounded at the apex, truncate and sessile at base, ascending and then diverging; stamens 30-40, the filaments 4-7 cm long (apparently 8-10 cm when fresh, fide Vasquez & Coimbra, 1996, 2002), light violet to deep purple, the anthers 4-5 mm, white; gynophore 7-8 cm long; ovary oblongoid, (3-)6-8 mm long. Fruits fleshy, baccate, 1-3 or more pendent from the ends of branches, oblongoid to subcylindric, 6-10 x 2.5-4(-5) cm, smooth, turning bright yellow to orange when ripe, often with 4 strong longitudinal placental lines or ribs alternating with 4 weak ones (visible especially when dry); mature gynophore (6-)7-11 cm long, 3-4 mm thick; receptacle and androgynophore 5-7 mm long; mature pedicels 2-5 cm long. Seeds 25-40(-60), ovate to oblongoid or subspherical, variously beveled, 10-15 x 9-11 X 8-9 mm, the fleshy, spongy, fiber-infiltrated sarcotesta and fruit pulp white or ivory, fragrant, aromatic and with a sweet taste, but with pericarp bitter; embryo white, basically reniform-cochleate, but testa intrusion wide and shallow, with the cotyledons incumbent yet variously conduplicated and folded into and around each other and around the radicle.

description: Acaulis, florifera 60-80 cm vel ultra alta. Folia rigidula, rosulata, cretacea; vaginae suborbiculatae, ad 6 cm longae; laminae lanceolato-subulatae, 50 cm vel ultra longae, basi 5-6 cm latae, regulariter revolutae, densissime subappresse lepidotae. Scapus erectus, validus, glaber, basi foliis imbricatis indutus. Inflorescentia bipinnatim paniculata, ad 50 cm longa, spicis 25-30 vel ultra; bracteae primariae pallide erubescentes, ovatae, inflatae, subappresse lepidotae, inferiores lamina subulata praeditae, superiores acuminatae; spicae 10-12 cm vel ultra longae, erectae vel suberectae, lanceolatae, 1.5 cm latae, 2-3-florae, rachi glabro et 4-5 prophyllis breviter mucronatis carinatisque praeditae; bracteae florigerae 3-4 cm longae, lanceolatae, erectae, mucronatae, carinatae, rigidae, glabrae, margine hyalinae, virides vel levissime erubescentes, rachim obtegentes, sepala superantes. Flores erecti, 5 cm longi; sepala 2-3 cm longa, lineari-lanceolata, acuta, glabra, pallide viridia, postica carinata atque longe connata; petala violacea, erecta, tubum angustum formantia, quam stamina stylusque breviora.

description: Epiphyte with basal rosette of leaves forming water and detritus-impounding tank, 0.8-1.2 m high including inflorescence. Leaves with distinct sheath and blade; sheaths 7-20 X 2.9-11.5 cm, elliptic to ovate, green, occasionally purple-spotted, sparsely to densely covered with peltate, multicellular, radially symmetric, foliar scales with concentric rings of cells and a peripheral wing of 32 cells with distinctly thickened radial walls; blade 33.5-51 cm long, 3.3-10 cm wide at base, narrowly triangular, green, occasionally purple-spotted, the margins entire, the apex acuminate to slightly cuspidate. Inflorescence a many- flowered simple spike or panicle with 1 or der of branching and 1-4 primary branches; scape terete, 0.9-1.5 cm thick at base, the lower half completely covered by imbricate scape-bracts, the upper half partially exposed due to reduction in size of scape- bracts and increase in internode length; lower scape-bracts differentiated into sheath and blade, the upper scape-bracts not differentiated; lower scape-bract sheaths 2.5- 8 X 1.8-3.5 cm, elliptic to obovate, sparsely to moderately covered with peltate scales on both surfaces, clasping the scape; lower scape-bract blades 7.4-26 X 1.6-5.8 cm, ovate, erect, sparsely to moderately covered with peltate scales on both surfaces, the margins entire, the apex attenuate, spread- ing to recurved; upper scape-bracts 2.9-5.5 X 1.8-2.9 cm, ovate to elliptic, sparsely to moderately covered with peltate scales on both surfaces, the margins entire, the apex acute, the base clasping the scape; primary branches 9-14 cm long, curved-ascending to erect, with 3-8 sterile bracts below the fertile segment of each branch; rachis, i.e., the fertile segment of the primary branch, 7-15 cm long, square in cross section, 2-4 mm thick, with 6-22 flowers arranged in 2 ranks; internode between the two lowest floral bracts 8-19 mm, the distal internodes becoming increasingly shorter; primary bracts subtending and loosely clasping the lateral branches, 3.2-5.6 X 1.7-2.6 cm, ovate to elliptic, sparsely to moderately covered with peltate scales on adaxial surface, the abaxial surface glabrous, the margins entire, the apex acute to rounded, the base slightly decurrent; floral bracts subtending the flowers, spreading and not over lapping (thus the rachis not concealed completely between floral bracts on the same side of the rachis), 25-51 X 9-26 mm, ovate, sparsely to moderately covered with peltate scales on adaxial surface, the abaxial surface glabrous, the margins entire, the apex rounded, the base decurrent on the sides of the rachis 90º from the sides on which the flowers are borne. Flowers sessile, slightly zygomorphic; hypanthium completely fused to ovary, 4.5-6 mm long; sepals 30-40 X 19-34 mm, obovate, not keeled, connate at the base for 1.5-5 mm, sparsely to densely covered on adaxial surface with peltate scales, the abaxial surface glabrous, the apex +/- obtuse; petals 71-95 X 10-11 mm, obovate, eligulate, yellowish green, becoming flaccid following anthesis, the apex rounded; stamens exserted; filaments terete, 80-105 mm long, ca. 1.2 mm thick; anthers 9-10.5 X ca. 1.2 mm, often curved, the anther sacs opening by longitudinal slits, the anther attachment versatile, filaments attaching 2-3.2 mm from base, the base usually splitting 0.9-1.2 mm up toward the point of attachment, not sagittate; stigma lobes 3, 4-6 mm long, erect to spreading, if erect then spiraling only slightly or not at all; style 9-11 cm long; ovary 12.8-15 X 4.8-5.9 mm, cryptically ½ inferior, the ovules borne on axile placentae in apical portion of the ovary, 8-11 mm up from the ovary base, the basal portion sterile, 3.7-5.5 mm long, composed of soft, brain-like tissue traversed by a multitude of convoluted longitudinal fissures, possibly secretory. Capsules 63-69 X ca. 10 mm. Ovules with a minute apical appendage. Seed body 3-4 X 0.5-0.8 mm, the basal coma 22-31 mm long, the apical appendage up to 0.3 mm long, not divided into a coma.

description: Frutex usque ad 1.2 m altus. Caules juniores teretes vel subquadrati, trichomatibus glandulosis et eglandulosis pubescentes. Folia sessilia vel subsessilia, linearia vel lanceolato-linearia vel lanceolato- ovata, 1 1-27 mm longa, 2-8 mm lata, 2.7-6.5-plo longiora quam latiora. Dichasia redacta plerumque 1-flora, in axillis foliorum vel bractearum foliacearum sessilia; bracteolae lineares vel oblanceolatae, 2.5-7 (10) mm longae. Flores brevipedicellati; calyx 5-6.5 mm longus, extus glandulosus; corolla lutea, 15-20 mm longa. Capsula 15 mm longa, glabra; semina 2, 4.5 mm longa, complanata, laevia.

description: Densely branched shrub to 1.2 m tall. Young stems terete to subquadrate, pubescent with a sparse, inconspicuous understory of glandular trichomes 0.05- 0.1 mm long and a conspicuous overstory of flexuose, eglandular trichomes 0.2- 0.7 mm long (hirsute); older stems glabrate and with the epidermis exfoliating in thin strips. Leaves sessile to subsessile, linear to lance-linear to lance-ovate, 11- 27 mm long, 2-8 mm wide, 2.7-6.5 times longer than wide, pubescent like young stems. Flowers borne in sessile dichasia (often reduced to a single flower) in the axils of leaves (or reduced leaflike bracts at upper nodes), pedicellate with pedicels 1-2 mm long; bractlets linear to oblanceolate, 2.5-7 (10) mm long, 0.5-1.1 (1.5) mm wide, pubescent like leaves except with glands more numerous. Calyx 5- lobed, 5-6.5 mm long, the lobes lance-subulate, sparsely hirsute and pubescent with minute, slender glands 0.05-0.1 mm long and conspicuous tack-shaped glands 0.1 mm long; corolla "bright yellow," 15-20 mm long, externally hirsute, the tube 5-7.5 mm long, the upper lip oblanceolate, 8.5-10.5 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide, bifid at apex, the lower lip 9.5-12 mm long, the lobes oblanceolate, 9-12 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide, the lower lobe partially conduplicate; stamens 9-10.5 mm long, the thecae 2.7-3 mm long, the pollen (observed subsequent to mounting in aniline blue in lactophenol) prolate, 68.6-73.5 µm long (polar diam), 31.9-36.8 µm wide (equatorial diam), 1.9-2.3 times longer than wide; style 13-15 mm long, glabrous. Capsule 14-15 mm long, glabrous, the stipe 7 mm long, the head 7-8 mm long, the retinacula 2.5 mm long; seeds 2, 4.5 mm in diam, glabrous, the surfaces smooth, the margin entire.

description: Suffrutex usque ad 5 dm altus. Caules juniores quadrati, glabri vel inconspicue pubescentes. Folia sessilia, linearia, 8-53 mm longa, 0.9-2.2 mm lata, (6.5) 14-38-plo longiora quam latiora. Dichasia redacta 1-3-flora, sessilia vel in axillis bractearum brevipedunculata; bracteae et bracteolae subulatae, 1.5-10 mm longae. description: Erect to reclined perennial herb to 5 dm tall from woody caudex. Stems quadrate, the angles often with a wing-like ridge; younger stems with internodes glabrous or inconspicuously puberulent in 2 decussate lines on opposite sides of the stem, the trichomes eglandular, retrorse, 0.05-0.1 mm long, the nodes usually sparsely puberulent; older stems glabrous or becoming glabrate as the epidermis exfoliates. Leaves sessile, linear, 8-53 mm long, 0.9-2.2 mm wide, (6.5) 14-38 times longer than wide (intergrading with bracts toward shoot apex), acute at apex, subcuneate at base, midvein and lateral veins parallel, the surfaces and margin glabrous (or with a few marginal, antrorse trichomes 0.05 mm long near the apex), the margin flat. Inflorescence of axillary or terminal thyrses; dichasia sessile or borne on peduncles to 5 mm long, reduced to 1 or more sessile to pedicellate flowers, the pedicels to 1.5 mm long; rachis glabrous or conspicuously pubescent in 2 lines with trichomes as on the stems; bracts subulate, 2-4 (10) mm long, 0.5- 0.7 mm wide, the abaxial surface and margin pubescent with straight to retrorse, eglandular trichomes 0.05-0.1 mm long; bractlets (and secondary bractlets, if present) subulate, 1.5-3 mm long, 0.3-0.6 mm wide, pubescent like bracts and occasionally with a few, scattered glandular trichomes up to 0.1 mm long. Calyx 2.7-4 mm long, the lobes subulate, 2-3 mm long, pubescent like bractlets except with the glandular trichomes more numerous; corolla blue with purplish lines on the upper lip, subactinomorphic, 7-10.7 mm long, pubescent on external surface, the tube 1.5-2.5 mm long, 1.2-1.4 mm in diam, the upper lip elliptic, 5-8 mm long, 2-4 mm wide, emarginate at apex, the lobes of the lower lip homomorphic, elliptic to obovate-elliptic, 5.5-8.5 mm long, 2-3.5 mm wide; stamens 5-7 mm long, the filaments blue, pubescent, the thecae yellow, 1-1.2 mm long, the pollen (observed subsequent to mounting in aniline blue in lactophenol) subprolate, 44.1- 51.5 µm long (polar diam), 39.2-41.7 µm wide (equatorial diam), 1.1-1.3 times longer than wide; style 7.5-8.5 mm long. Capsule 8.5-9 mm long, glabrous, the stipe 3.5 mm long, the head partially flattened, 5.5 mm long; seeds (immature) 3.5 mm long, concavoconvex, the convex surface papillate, the concave surface with prominent conical tubercules.

description: Erect perennial herbs to 4 dm tall. Young stems quadrate to terete, pubescent in 2 decussate lines on opposite sides of the internodes, the trichomes eglandular, antrorse, 0.2-0.9 mm long. Leaves petiolate, the petioles to 24 mm long, the blades ovate to ovate-elliptic to suborbiculate, 14-48 mm long, 8-35 mm wide, mostly 1.2-2.1 times longer than wide, rounded to acute at base, acute at apex, the surfaces sparsely pubescent (especially along veins), the margin flat, ciliate with antrorse trichomes. Inflorescence of axillary to terminal thyrses, these often forming panicles of numerous spicate axes; dichasia sessile, reduced to 1 or more sessile flowers; rachis, bracts, bractlets, and calyx pubescent with a mixture of eglandular and glandular trichomes, the eglandular trichomes straight, 0.05-0.1 mm long, the glands 0.1-0.2 mm long; bracts subulate, 2-4 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide; bractlets (and secondary bractlets, if present) subulate, 1.5-2.5 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm wide. Calyx 3-5 mm long, the lobes subulate, 2.5-4.5 mm long; corolla white (to very pale purple) with purple veins (especially prominent on upper lip), 10-12.5 mm long, glabrous on external surface, the tube 5-5.5 mm long, 1-1.2 mm in diam, the upper lip 4-6 mm long, 1-1.8 mm wide, bilobed at apex with lobes up to 1 mm long, the lobes of the lower lip appearing hetero- morphic, the lateral lobes elliptic, 5-7 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, the lower-central lobe conduplicate, 4.5-7 mm long, 2-3.2 mm wide; stamens 3.5-5.5 mm long, the filaments whitish, sparsely pubescent near base, the thecae 0.7-1 mm long, the pollen (observed subsequent to mounting in aniline blue in lactophenol) spherical, 53.9 µm in diam; style 7-9 mm long. Capsule 7-9 mm long, glabrous below, sparsely pubescent (sometimes only a few trichomes present) at apex; seeds apparently 2 per capsule, 2-3 mm long, 2-2.5 mm wide, the surfaces subtuberculate, the margin entire.

description: Suffrutex, caulibus albidis, subquadrangularibus, glabris vel subtiliter pubescentibus; laminis foliorum ovato-lanceolatis, acuminatis, ad basim rotundatis vel truneatis, tenuibus, supra parce pilosulis, subtus minute caneseenti-pubescentibus; petiolis tenuibus, pubeseentibus; infloreseentia paniculata, spicis laxis plus ininusve curvatis, rachidibus glanduloso-puberulentibus; bracteis et bracteolis siibulatis, parce puberulentibus; calycis segmentis subulatis, subglabris; corolla alba, parva, parce pubeseenti; capsula fortasse abnormali, clavata, bifureata, stipite exili.

description: Suffruteseent herb up to 1 m. high; stems whitish, subquadrangular, glabrous or sparingly and finely pubescent, the hairs white, up to 0.5 mm. long, the lower internodes about 8 cm. long, the uppermost 2-3 cm. long; leaf blades ovate- lanceolate, up to 8 cm. long and 4 cm. wide, acuminate, obtuse or rounded at base, thin, drying green above and grayish-green beneath, the upper surface sparingly pilosulous, the hairs segmented, appressed or ascending, up to 0.5 mm. long, beneath softly and rather densely pubescent, the hairs minute and mostly spread- ing, the margin ciliate, the eystoliths minute and inconspicuous; petioles slender, up to 2.5 cm. long, finely and rather densely pubescent, the hairs spreading, up to 0.5 mm. long or a few of them as much as 1 mm. long; flowers borne in lax, more or less curved spikes up to 5 cm. long, these forming leafy terminal panicles up to 15 cm. long, the rachises puberulous, the hairs straight, the longer ones gland-tipped, the smaller submicroscopic and prickle-like, the lower portions of the infloreseence in addition to the above types of hairs bearing also longer, eglandular hairs, the lower internodes of the spikes 10 mm. long, the internodes successively shorter toward tip, bracts suiulate, 2-3 mm. long, each bearing a few minute glanduular hairs and subtending 1-several flowers, these flanked by a pair of subulate bractlets 1.5-2 mm. long; calyx 3 mm. long, the segments subulate, 2-2.5 mm. long, sparingly and minutely pubescent; corolla (immature or possibly cleistogamous) white, up to 5 mm. long, sparingly and finely pubes- ttent, the anthers 1.5 mm. long and 0.5 mm. broad; capsule (abnormal?) 13 mm. long, glabrous or sparingly pubeseent at tip, clavate, bifurcate, the lobes short and rounided, the stipe slender, 10 mm. long; seed not seen.

description: Herba perennis, laxe caespitosa, rhizomate breve recto fibris fusco-brunneis leviter vestito, radicibus rigidulis. Culmus erectus, rigidus, trigonus, 20-30 cm altus, supra basin ca. 3 mm crassus. Folia radicalia, pluria; laminae late lineares, 15-25 cm longae, 5-8 mm latae, coriaceae, glauco-virides, planiusculae, 1-costatae, praeter margines apicales scabriusculas laeves, apicem versus sensim attenuantes; vaginae 6-10 cm longae, rufo-purpureae vel fusco-brunneae, demum in fibras fuscas plus minus solutae. Inflorescentia umbelliformis, simplex, congesta, hemisphaerica, 3-4 cm alta, 4-7 cm lata, 6-8-spicata; radii abbreviati, pauci evoluti, 0.5-2 cm longi, patentes; bracteae 3 vel 4 foliaceae, inflorescentiam multo superantes, ima 11-18 cm longa, 7 mm lata, secunda 5-8 cm longa, omnes deflexae. Spicae ovoideo-ellipsoideae, 2-3 cm longae, 1.5-2 cm crassae, dense 8-25-spiculosae, lateraliter moderate compressae, 5-12-florae, rufo- vel brunneo- purpureae; rhachilla spongioso-incrassata, in quoque nodo articulata, internodiis 0.5-0.7 mm longis 1-1.3 mm latis, alis latiuscule ovatis spongioso-incrassatis. Glumae ovato-orbiculares, 2.5-3 mm longae, 1.8-2 mm latae, naviculares, ad apicem mucronatum subito contractae, chartaceae, fusco-rubentes vel rufo-purpureae, utrinque 3- vel 4-nerviae; costa obtusa, lata, glauco-virens, subtrinervia. Achaenia late ovato-elliptica, 1.5-1.8 mm longa, 1-1.25 mm lata, compresso-trigona, obtusangula, nigricantia, cellulis extimis subhexagonis minutis; styli 3-3.5 mm longi, profunde trifidi, stigmatibus 2-2.5 mm longis. Stamina 3.

description: Rhizomatous shrub or vine with branches to 30 m climbing in trees, young branches somewhat angular, glabrous; leaves with petioles 8-10 mm long, glabrate, lamina broadly lanceolate to elliptic, 8-20 x 3-10 cm, apex obtuse to acuminate, base nearly acute or rounded, midrib and veins prominent below. Inflorescence axillary or terminal, strigose. Flowers with calyx patelliform, lobes 1.3-1.6 mm long, lanceolate, densely hairy, petals ovate-lanceolate to ovate, 3.5-4.3 x 1.4-2.0 mm, almost equal, strigose outside, villose or tomentose or rarely crispate within, apex inflexed, glabrous; filaments 2-3 mm, anther sacs globose, connective tapering to an extended apex, 0.6-0.8 mm; ovary glabrous, 1 mm diam.; hirsute; style 0.7 mm long, glabrous, slightly incurved. Fruit globose to oblongoid, 7.5-8 x 3.8-4.0 cm, strigose inside endocarp.

description: Shrub to 2 m tall; branchlets terete, sparsely fulvo-stellate or pilose. Leaves with petioles 5-7 mm; lamina elliptic, orbicular to ovate-oblong, 9-18 x 6-9 cm, apex obtuse to rarely acute, base rounded to sub- cordate, membranous, sparsely pilose or hirsute below, veins 4 or 5 pairs, prominent below. Inflorescences axillary and terminal cymes, sparsely hirsute and stellate. Flowers with campanulate calyx, 4 mm diam., lobes oblong, abruptly acuminate, 1.4-1.8 x 0. 8- 1 mm, densely hirsute; petals lanceolate or ovate, 4 x 1.1-1.4 mm, inside crispate-pilose; stamens 2.5-3.2 mm, anthers ovate to oblong, apex extended for 0.5 mm; ovary ovoid, densely hirsute. Fruit oblongoid, flat- tened in drying, 3.5 x 3 cm, outside densely short hirsute, inside sparsely hirsute with clusters of straight hairs.

description: Stems 0.3-1.5 m long from stout woody caudex, angled and sulcate, hirsute at base or glabrate above. Leaves small and crowded at base of stems, more distant above; petioles 0.1-0.3 cm, lower leaves ovate 1.5- 3 x 0.6-1 cm, apex acuminate, base rounded, sparingly strigose and ciliate becoming glabrate; upper stem leaves ovate to ovate- oblong to lanceolate, 5-8 x 2.5-4.5 cm, apex acute to acuminate, base rounded, membranous to subcoriaceous, glabrous, veins 5 pairs, ultimate ventation finely reticulate. Inflorescence extra-axillary, all parts golden hirsute, bracts linear-filiform, 3-5 mm long. Flowers with calyx lobes ovate-lanceolate, 3.5 x 1 mm, loosely hirsute; petals lanceo- late, 4.5-6 x 1-1.5 mm, hirsute both surfaces; stamens with filaments 3 mm long, anthers 1 mm long, connective extended 0.5 mm; pistil ovoid, 1.5 mm diam., hirsute, style 2 mm long, glabrous. Fruit unknown.

description: Shrub; stems angular, sulcate, hirsute with pubescence spreading and appressed. Leaves with petioles 1-2 mm long, hirsute; lamina ovate, ovate-orbicular, to elliptic, 7-9 x 6.5- 8 cm, apex obtuse or broadly acute, base rounded to subcordate, entire, veins 5 or 6 pairs, mostly straight ascending, lower surface of lamina densely and completely covered with white lanate and crispate pu- bescence. Inflorescence supra-axillary, paniculate. Flowers in cymes, all parts densely hirsute and lanate; bracts linear, 2 mm long; calyx lobes narrowly triangular, 2-2.5 mm long; petals oblong, 2-3 x 1.5 mm, densely pubescent both surfaces, filaments 2.5 mm long, glabrous, anther connective apiculate and reflexed; pistil globose, densely hirsute, style 1-2 mm long, glabrous. Fruit a globose drupe, 2 x 1.8 cm, densely short tomentose pubescent outside, and densely pilose inside.

description: Scandent shrub, caudex large, starchy tuber; stems angular, densely red brown stellate pubescent. Leaves with petioles 6-9 mm long, stellate pubescent; lamina rhomboid to ovate, 10-15 x 6-8 cm, apex acuminate, base rounded, stellate pubescent above on midrib and veins. Inflorescence axis sparingly stellate or tomentose. Flowers with calyx 4 mm diam., lobes triangular-acute, 1.3 mm long, hirsute pubescent outside; petals ovate-oblong, 4.1-4.3 x 1.6-1.9 mm, hirsute without, villose within, with a glabrate base, apex inflexed; filaments glabrous, 2.5- 2.6 mm long; ovary globose, 1.2 mm diam., hirsute. Fruit a broadly ovoid to globose drupe, 5 cm long, 4 cm diam., densely stel- late-pubescent, endocarp woody, smooth, to 0.7 mm thick, pubescent inside.

description: Annual herb; stems 1-8 dm tall, simple or sometimes sparingly branched above, often with fleshy tubercle-like leaves at the base; herbage villous to hirsute, usually with viscid and gland-tipped hairs intermixed; leaves 3-6 (10) cm long, 5-15 (22) mm broad, entire, oblanceolate or narrow-lanceolate to elliptic or obovate, usually tapering to a petiolar base, the midvein and usually the 2 lateral veins prominent, the larger leaves pinnately veined; inflorescence a dense, many-flowered, continuous spike, glandular-villous; bracts lanceolate to oblanceolate, entire, tipped with red to orange or occasionally yellow; flowers sessile, small, inconspicuous, mostly concealed by the bracts; calyx 9-12 mm long, the tube viscid-villous, the median clefts subequal, 3-5 mm deep, the primary lobes rigid, entire, truncate or rounded, densely glandular-puberulent, red to orange or occasionally yellow; corolla included in the calyx, usually about 1 mm shorter to as long, rarely exserted, the galea shorter than the tube, 2.5-5 mm long, the lower lip much reduced with 3 lanceolate lobes, the tube 6-8.5 mm long; capsule 5-7 mm long, obovoid-spherical, often blackish brown; seeds numerous, elongate, truncate at the summit (Fig. 2).

description: Plants low-growing perennials with a thick, woody caudex. Stems few to many, 15-35 cm long, ascending, usually branched from near the base and occasionally branched above, basal portions occasionally short-decumbent, weakly rhizomatous, often persistent, glabrous below the inflorescence to very sparsely arachnoid-silky in the inflorescence. Leaves reduced, scale-like and entire on extreme basal and underground portion of stem; fully developed cauline leaves 2-4 X 1.5-3.5(-4.5) cm, adaxially cupulate when fresh, usually obovate, basally slightly auriculate; blade strongly veined, the veins clearly depressed on the adaxial and raised on the abaxial surfaces, the distal portion strongly divided into 5-9(-11) widely spreading, lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, acute to occasionally acuminate-tipped lobes, these lobes often unequally divided on either side of the central axis and/or occasionally divided into secondary, sometimes irregular segments, greenish, but often with dull brownish purple apices, glabrous to sometimes sparsely silky-hairy along veins of abaxial surfaces. Mature inflorescence a showy, densely flowered spike, 3-15 cm long. Bracts 2-3.5 X 1.5-3.5 cm, broadly obovate, veined as in leaves, usually cleft only at or above the mid-point into 5-9(-11) upright to ascending, narrowly to broadly lanceolate or tri- angular, acute-tipped lobes, these often un- equally divided on either side of the central axis and/or occasionally divided into sec- ondary, sometimes irregular segments, pale green basally, bright scarlet-red to pale red- dish orange on the distal two-thirds, often fading to pale yellowish orange with age, glabrous to finely villous-silky, mostly along the prominent veins., Calyx 20-28 mm long, greenish basally, scarlet red to pale reddish orange on the distal one-third to one-half, glabrous to short villous-silky, divided about one-third in front and back, lobes 7-11 mm long, secondary segments 2-4 mm and acute to obtuse. Corolla 30-45 mm long, beak 18-24 mm long, equal to or usually greater than the length of the tube, strongly exserted byond calyx, dorsally greenish to yellow-green, and glabrous to minutely puberulent, with narrow, shiny, glabrous, reddish pink margins; lower lip 1-2 mm long, usually included within the calyx and strongly reduced to 3 greenish to dull purplish, incurved teeth; stigma exserted 1-4 mm beyond corolla, purplish, bilobed, exserted portion of style usually down-curved. Mature capsule ovate, 8-14 X 4-10 mm. Seeds oblong-ovoid, 2-3.2 mm long. Seed coat deeply reticulate, radial walls of reticulations with scalariform thickenings, inner tangential walls ruptured at maturity and fibrous-textured. Chromosome number: n = 12.

description: C. macrostigmati B. L. Rob. similis sed differt statione ad substrata arida calcarea lirnitata; statura multo breviore, magis compacta: toliis plerumque integris; indumento albido puberulo vel hirsutulo; bracteis omnino viridibus imbricatis brevilanceolatis, celeriter in bases relative latas angustatis, aIpicibus anguste rotundatis vel acutis; inflorescentiis brevioribus magis compactis et floribus paucioribus; rostris corollarum vix labia abaxialia excedentibus, magis brevioribus quam tubis; per anthesin et rostris corollarum et labiis abaxialibus et partibus distalibus tuborum omnino exsertis e calycibus.

description: Plants tufted, herbaceous perennials with slender, weakly branching, tuberculate roots and an often branching, slightly woody caudex. Stems slender, mostly herbaceous, one to several, 2-15 cm long in flower, ascending to occasionally spreading and somewhat decumbent, often persistent, usually unbranched above caudex but occasionally with 1 or 2 short ascending lateral branches, the pubescence whitish, eglandular, and moderately to densely puberulent to hirsutulous. Leaves alternate, ascending above to spreading and often recurved below, becoming reduced, scale-like, and unpigmented near the base, closely spaced and usually imbricate, the internodes rarely exceeding 10 mm in length. Leaf blade 8-30 mm long, 1-4(-6) mm wide, linear to linear-lanceolate, flat to more often moderately involute, entire or sometimes with a pair of short, ascending, linear to lanceolate, usually acute-tipped lobes; 1-3 nerved, the primary veins somewhat sunken on abaxial side and raised on adaxial side; margins smooth to often undulate or weakly crisped, moderately ciliate; base narrowing, sessile and often partially clasping, obscurely decurrent as ribs along the stem; indument moderately to sparsely white puberulent to hirsutulous with eglandular hairs occasionally mixed with a few short, stipitate-glandular hairs; coloration greenish, often with dark purplish outer edges. Inflorescence an inconspicuous spike 1.5-3 cm long, the flowers and their subtending bracts relatively few, mostly imbricate. Bracts gradually and weakly differentiated from leaves, entire or occasionally with a pair of short, spreading to ascending, linear-Ilanceolate, acute-tipped lobes, usually imbricate, the internodes <10 mm; main blade 5-17 mm long, 2-7 mm wide near base, mostly ovate-lanceolate, the base wide, rapidly tapering to a narrower, acute apex; margins ciliate with slightly papillose, hispidulous hairs; coloration entirely green, becoming darker green distally. Flowers sessile, upper half usually exserted from calyx at full anthesis. Calyx 15-23 mm long, tubular, somewhat ampliate distally, subequally divided 5-8 mm in front and in back, the lobes rounded and entire or more often emarginate, with 2 very short obtuse or rounded segments; indument sparsely puberulent; coloration pale greenish basally, gradually becoming lemon yellow to pale yellow on distal one-half to two-thirds, occasionally with a pale reddish-orange wash on upper 2-3 mm. Corolla 20-28 mm long, the lower 2/3 tube pale white, the upper tube, beak, and lower lip pale lemon yellow or occasionally pale greenish yellow. Corolla beak 5-7 mm long, much shorter than tube in length, strongly exserted beyond calyx, glabrescent to sparsely puberulent. Lower corolla lip petaloid, 2-5 mm long, strongly exserted from calyx, with 3 equal segments upright to slightly recurved above, usually yellowish. Style partially exserted from corolla beak, upright but curving sharply outward just below its attachment to stigma, so stigma is suspended over lower corolla lip. Stigma exserted 1-2 mm beyond corolla, yellowish, deeply cleft into 2 vertically-arranged, divaricate, recurved lobes, each lobe 1.0-2.5 mm in length, with lower lobe often slightly longer than upper lobe. Stamens included within corolla beak. Pollen grains ovate. Mature capsule 8-10 mm long, 5-6 mm wide, broadly ovate, apiculate-tipped, often persistent. Seeds 1.0-1.5 mm long, ovate-elliptic to triangular. Seed coat loose fitting, very shallowly to moderately deeply reticulate; shape of reticulation cells generally ovate to more or less rectangular; radial walls of reticulations weakly striated, inner tangential walls smooth, membranous, and ruptured at maturity.

description: Inter affines notulis sequentibus praestans: inflorescentia secundo-racemosa; caules et folia utrinque pilis patulis stipitato-glandulosis induti; folia caulina majuscula late elliptica vel (ob)lanceolata secus caulem dissita; calyx multo anterius quam posterius fissus, lobulis duobus inter se inaequalibus; insuper corollae rostrum tubo subaequilongum.

description: Plants herbaceous perennials with a slen- der and often somewhat tuberculate woody caudex. Stems slender, herbaceous to slightly woody below, 1 to several, 25-50 cm long, ascending to spreading and decumbent, often branching from near the base and/or often divaricately long-branched above and/or with short, leafy axillary branches; basal portions of main stems often short-decumbent, weakly rhizomatous, and/or often weakly persistent; distal portions at times becoming decumbent and then often becoming rhizome-like when in contact with soil or leaf litter and producing ascending lateral branches; densely pilosulous and viscid throughout with spreading, stipitate-glandular, multicellular, flattened, vitreous to whitish hairs. Internodes of main stem leaves 0.5-5 cm. Leaves relatively few, mostly alternate to sometimes nearly opposite, widely spreading to less often somewhat reflexed on lower stem. Leaf blade flat, entire, greenish, (15-)20-50 X 2-18 mm, moderately to more often broadly elliptic, lanceolate or oblanceolate, auriculate at base (not clasping or decurrent), acute, obtuse or narrowly rounded at apex, (1-)3-nerved, the primary veins somewhat sunken adaxially and raised abaxially, surfaces often somewhat viscid, the upper and lower surfaces and margins invested with short, spreading to occasionally retrorse, stipitate-glandular to occasionally nonglandular hairs, relatively densely so above and more sparsely to sometimes subglabrous below. Infiorescence a showy, relatively few-flowered, secund raceme, 3-15 cm long, often with a small cluster of sterile apical bracts, usually bearing a sparse coating of a salt-like crystalline excrescence on the hairs and surfaces of the bracts and calyces. Flowers pedicellate, the pedicels 1-7 mm long. Bracts entire, similar to leaves but gradually reduced in size above, 10-35 X 3-17 mm, mostly elliptic to oblanceolate with rounded apices, pilosulous and viscid as in leaves, entirely green to less common- ly pale red to red-orange on the distal half. Calyx 16-25 mm long, tubular and often distally ampliate, greenish basally, scarlet red to pale reddish-orange on the distal 1/2 to 2/3, sparsely pilosulous and viscid, divided about 2/3 in front and 1/6 in back, lobes rounded and entire or more often emarginate, with 2 short, unequal, acute- to obtuse-tipped segments, the rear segment exceeding the front segment by 1-2 mm in length. Corolla 25-38 mm long; corolla beak (12-)14-20 mm long, approximately equal to the tube in length, strongly exsert- ed beyond the calyx, glabrescent to sparsely glandular-puberulent, dorsal surface greenish to yellow-green, ventral surface with thin, shiny, glabrous margins, usually yellow to yellow-green throughout to very oc- casionally deep reddish distally; lower co- rolla lip ca. 1-2 mm long, barely exserted from the calyx and strongly reduced to 3 incurved, dark greenish to occasionally red-tipped, lanceolate and acute-tipped teeth. Stigma exserted 1-5 mm beyond corolla, dark green, unlobed, and only slightly capitate-expanded, with exserted portion of style usually down-curved near base of stigma. Stamens about equalling the corolla in length, with anthers 3-4 mm long, orange or red, and often pendulously exserted from the lower surface of the corolla beak. Pollen grains ovate. Capsule ovate to elliptic, apiculate, 10-12 X 4-6 mm. Seeds ovate-elliptic to triangular, 1.3-1.8 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide at base; seed coat loose-fitting, very shallowly reticulate, reticulation cells generally ovate, radial walls of reticulations smooth, inner tangential walls smooth, membranous and not ruptured at maturity.

description: Unarmed tree to 30 m, 60-70 cm in diameter at breast height. Bark rough, dark brown, corky, to 1 cm thick; inner bark with prominent cream-colored fibers and anastomosing, vertical red/pink streaks interspersed with whitish, more porous tissue; sap thin, orange. Wood very hard. Twigs stout, greyish-brown, glabrous, with small brown lenticels; axillary buds obovate; terminal buds oblong, 0.8-1.2 cm long, with scales ridged abaxially. Stipules caducous, lanceolate, 3-5 mm long, 1 mm wide, slightly keeled, with short-ciliate margin, a few bifid hairs near the base and longer sericeous hairs toward the apex. Leaves alternate, palmately compound with 3-5 leaflets (Fig. 1A); petioles rounded, averaging 12 cm (range 6-21 cm) long, thickened at base when old; leaflets articulate; petiolules stout, 5 mm (2-20 mm) long, roughened, leathery, sparsely pilose; blades chartaceous, lanceolate, 23 cm (9-40 cm) long, 6 cm (2-10 cm) wide, acute at base, longcaudate at apex, especially on seedling leaves (Fig. IC), often apiculate or mucronulate on leaves of mature tree, glabrous or with a few scattered hairs mainly along the midvein toward the base on both surfaces, the midvein protruding above and below, lateral veins 10-16 protruding distinctly beneath and slightly above; seedling leaves long-petiolate, short-petiolulate, farinose when young. Flowers unknown. Fruit (Fig. IB, G) a woody capsule, 12 cm long, 6 cm in diam, covered with dense bundles of short, rust-colored hairs without and glabrous within, partially splitting into 5 subequal sections and sometimes falling with the seed permanently enclosed. Seed solitary, attached basally, 6 (5-7) cm x 3 (2-4) cm, 15.5 gm (air dried); testa 0.6 mm thick, dark brown, covered with raised, anastomosing, cream-colored fibrous bands (Fig. IF), reportedly also covered with mucilage (J. Denslow, pers. comm.); cotyledons prominently unequal, the smaller 3 mm long, soon deciduous, the larger thick, fleshy, with a petiole up to 28 mm long, both remaining enclosed within the testa following germination at the soil surface, and often permanently enclosed in the pericarp; embryo straight, with well-developed, cylindrical radicle and inconspicuous plumule, enveloped by the folded large cotyledon (Fig. 1E); seedlings slender (Fig. ID), with 3-4 leaf (cataphyll?) scars below the first persistent leaves.

description: Plants perennial, glabrous and glaucous; stems one to several, not hollow, stout, erect but usually arising laterally from near apex of a buried or slightly emergent tough woody root-crown, simple or sometimes branched above, often crooked, the lowermost portion usually purplish, 5-10 dm tall; leaves fleshy, petiolate, separated by substantial internodes, the lower not rosulate; juvenile and lower leaves similar, usually coarsely dentate, broadly obovate with a flattened and slightly wing-margined petiole; blade 4-9 (15) cm long, 3-7 (11.5) cm wide, the petiole 3-6 cm long; middle cauline leaves larger, broadly obovate to ovate, obtuse, usually entire, the blade to 15 cm long and 9 cm wide; upper cauline leaves becoming narrower and acute upward but retaining a definite petiole; inflorescence elongated, ebracteate, the flowering pedicels slender, divaricately ascending to more widely spreading; sepals erect at anthesis, reddish purple, not saccate, linearly oblong, 11-13 mm long, 3-4 mm wide; petals spatulate to broadly linear, erect, flaring to slightly recurved just below apex but not unguiculate, 15-19 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, the veins prominent, dark reddish brown to purple on a cream-colored ground; stamens erect, the filaments slender, nearly equal, 3.5-4.5 mm long, the anthers straight, slightly apiculate, 3.5-5.0 mm long; glandular tissue prominent, surrounding petal bases and subtending to nearly surrounding filament bases; fruiting pedicels stout, straight, divaricately ascending, 8-15 mm long, markedly expanded at summit; infructescences 2-4 dm long; siliques terete, divaricately ascending to more widely spreading, straight to somewhat arcuate, 7-12 cm long, 1.5-2.0 mm diam, not stipitate; style obsolete, the stigma capitate, mound-shaped, not lobed; seed oblong, wingless, slightly compressed, 1.5-2.0 mm long, 1.0-1.2 mm wide, brownish; cotyledons accumbent or sometimes obliquely incumbent.
