description: Terrestrial or epiphytic shrub with branches to 1.5 m long; stems terete, weakly striate, glabrous or weakly puberulent, yellowish-brown when dry, provided with few scattered, black globular, sessile glands ca 0.3 mm in diam (Fig. 1). Leaves coriaceous, lanceolate, (3) 4.5-8 x (0.8) 1.3-2 cm, basally tapering and acute or obtuse, apically long acuminate, the margins revolute, glabrous above, weakly hirsute along the midrib beneath with hairs 0.5-0.7 mm long and with glandular fimbriae (Fig. 2), upper surface provided with glands similar to those on the stems except these ca 0.2 mm in diam; 5-plinerved from near the base with the inner pair of lateral nerves reaching only 2/3 to the tip, the midrib, lateral nerves and reticulate veinlets impressed and conspicuous above but only the midrib obviously raised beneath; petioles terete, rugose, puberulent, to 5 mm long and 1.5 mm in diam, with scattered glands as the stems and leaves. Inflorescence axillary, solitary, racemose, 20-30-flowered; rachis subterete, bluntly angled, 12 cm long and 1.5 mm in basal diam (but still elongating), glabrous but with translucent globular glands to 0.3 mm in diam near the base, rachis itself encircled at the base by numerous oblong-oblanceolate sterile bracts similar to the floral bracts; floral bracts membranaceous, at anthesis spreading at an angle of nearly 900 from the rachis and with the tips reflexed, substriate, lanceolate, 20-25 x 5-6 mm, pink to red when fresh, marginally bearing 8-10 green, scattered spherical to oblong subsessile glands ca 0.1-0.2 mm in diam, apically with a tuft of hairs with each hair ca 0.3 mm long; pedicels immature, 3-4 mm long, glabrous; bracteoles mem- branaceous, ovate-oblong, obtuse, 3-4 mm long, marginally with spherical to oblong glands similar to those of the floral bracts (Fig. 10). Flowers immature but with the calyx glabrous, 5-6 mm long; hypanthium cylindric and seemingly ba- sally apophysate, ca 1-1.5 mm long, reddish to yellowish-green with a mauve hue when fresh, provided with numerous spherical glands ca 0.2-0.3 mm in diam (these also present at the junction with the calyx and pedicel) (Figs. 3-4); limb subcampanulate, smooth, ca 5 mm long including the lobes; lobes ovate-triangular, acute, ca 1.5-2 mm long, each side flanked by an oblong callose-thickened gland ca 1.5-1.75 mm long, these glands contiguous or slightly connate at the distal tip of the lobe (Fig. 18); sinus acute but often partially obscured by two spherical to short oblong glands 0.1-0.3 mm in diam; corolla immature but at least 15 mm long, glabrous, red to deep wine-red in bud when fresh; stamens immature, but the filaments and anthers alternately long and short, the filaments densely puberulent medially, the thecae granular. Berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial shrub to 2 m tall; mature stems terete, striate, glabrous, reddish-brown when dry; immature twigs subterete, striate, densely pilose with white hairs 1-1.5 mm long or glabrate. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, lanceolate or somewhat ovate-lanceolate, (7) 9-12 x 1.5-4.5 cm, basally obtuse or broadly cuneate, apically caudate-acuminate, essentially glabrous above but densely appressed pilose (hairs to 0.8 mm long) beneath; 3-5-plinerved with the lateral nerves arising near the base, midrib and lateral nerves impressed above and raised beneath, reticulate veinlets obscure; petioles subterete, rugose, 5-7 mm long, 2-3 mm in diam, densely appressed pilose as leaves. Inforescence solitary, axillary, race- mose, 3-5-flowered; rachis subterete with the nodes congested, glabrous, ca 1- 2 cm long and 4 mm in basal diam; floral bracts subcoriaceous, oblong-elliptic but tightly involute around and concealing the pedicel, calyx and lower half of the corolla, 22-25 mm long and ca 15 mm broad, glabrous, pink to red when fresh; pedicels terete, swollen distally, glabrous ca 3-4 mm long and in diam; bracteoles subcoriaceous, oblong-elliptic, appressed to flowers, apically rounded and slightly emarginate, 15-18 mm long and ca 10 mm broad, glabrous, attached at the base of the pedicel and completely concealing the pedicel and calyx. Flow- ers with the calyx glabrous, 10-11 mm long, translucent green to whitish-green when fresh; hypanthium cylindric, basally truncate, smooth, 4-5 mm long; limb cylindric, 6-7 mm long including the lobes; lobes oblong, oblong-ovate, 3.8-4 mm long and 2.5-3 mm broad at base, apically rounded and apiculate, marginally imbricate in the basal half, distal half with thin, somewhat scarious-looking glan- dular border; corolla tubular, glabrous, 18-19 mm long, rose-red basal 3/4 and white distal 1/4 when fresh, lobes triangular, ca 1 mm long; stamens slightly un- equal, 15.5-16 mm long; filaments distinct, essentially glabrous, alternately 5.5- 6 mm and 2.5-3 mm long; anthers alternately 11-12 mm and 15 mm long including the tubules; thecae granular, 6.5-7 mm long; tubules dehiscing by clefts nearly the length of the tubule; style glabrous, 22 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial or epiphytic shrub to 3 m tall; mature branches and twigs terete, weakly striate, glabrous, somewhat glaucous; bark thin, dark reddish brown. Leaves stiff-coriaceous when dry, ovate, 12-17 X 6.5-10.5 cm, basally broadly rounded, sometimes subcordate, apically abruptly short-acumi- nate, marginally entire and slightly revolute near base, glabrous on both surfaces, but with glandular fimbriae beneath; 5-9-plinerved from the base, the midrib, lateral nerves, and reticulate veinlets conspicuously raised on both surfaces; petioles terete, conspicuously rugose, 8-11 mm long and ca. 3 mm diam., glabrous. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 8-13-flowered; rachis strongly angled, 6-7 cm long and 2-3 mm diam. at base, glabrous, pink when fresh; floral bract chartaceous, ovate to elliptic-ovate, 30-45 X 20-30 mm, apically obtuse to rounded, glabrous, dark scarlet when fresh; pedicel subterete, ribbed to bluntly angled, 9-10 mm long, glabrous; bracteoles nearly basal, oblong-lanceolate, acute, ca. 1.5 mm long, glandular-callose the distal 1/2, glabrous. Flowers with calyx glabrous, green to suffused with pink when fresh, 10- 15 mm long; hypanthium cylindric, coarsely 10-ribbed, 4-5 mm long, basally apophysate and deeply lobed with lobes pointing back; limb cylindric to distally slightly spreading, conspicuously striate, 6-10 mm long; lobes triangular, 2-3 mm long, erect after anthesis, completely glandular-callose in distal 1/2, green and viscid when fresh; corolla cylindric, slightly constricted at throat, somewhat translucent when dry, 32- 36 mm long and ca. 8 mm diam., glabrous, pearl-white and nitid when fresh, the lobes triangular, obtuse, ca. 1-2 mm long, white with the margins purple; stamens 29 mm long; filaments ventrally moderately short-pilose, alternately 6 mm and 10 mm long; anthers alternately 27 mm and 21 mm long; thecae 9-12 mm long; style ca. 30-34 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic shrub 1-3 m tall. Petioles often flattened adaxially, (4-)6-15 mm long, glabrous. Leaves lanceolate to lance-elliptic, rarely oblanceolate or ovate, (3-)8-12 (-18) cm long and 1-4(-6) cm broad, basally rounded, obtuse, cuneate or rarely sub- truncate, apically acuminate, glabrous or rarely with a few hairs at base of midrib on upper surface, (3-)5(-7) plinerved. Inflorescence (7-)11-16(-20) flowered, cy- lindric to fusiform in bud; rachis bluntly angled, viscid, glabrous, 3-6(-9) cm long. Floral bracts rarely translucent when dry, glabrous, smooth or reddish-papillate abax- ially, oblong to oblanceolate, rarely obovate or somewhat spatulate, basally narrowed and truncate, apically rounded to acute, (2-)2.5-4(-5) cm long and 1-2 cm broad, deep violet or maroonish-purple, often appearing black. Pedicels glabrous, (6-)9-13 (-16) mm long. Bracteoles lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, rarely ovate, 2-4 (-5.5) mm long and 0.6-1(-2) mm broad, basally slightly auriculate, apically acuminate and glandular callose-thickened distal third, purplish-pink when fresh. Calyx glabrous, (6-)7-11(-13.5) mm long; tube coarsely ribbed, (2-)2.5-4(-5.5) mm long and (2.5-)3-6(-6.5) mm in diameter across base, basally apophysate and deeply lobed with lobes straight or flaring outward and extending well below articulation; limb cylindric or somewhat spreading, (3.5-) 5-8 mm long including lobes; lobes triangular, 1-2 (-2.5) mm long and 2-2.5 mm broad, erect after anthesis, glandular callose-thick- ened without; sinus obtuse to broadly rounded. Corolla slightly constricted basally, narrowed to throat, sometimes translucent when dry, (25-)30-38(-45) mm long and 5-8 mm in diameter, pilose with short, white trichomes, tube whitish-purple at con- stricted base, purple to dark purple above, limb and lobes pale purple; lobes oblong, obtuse, 1.5-2 mm long, strongly reflexed at anthesis. Stamens 24-39 mm long; fila- ments moderately pilose distally, alternately either 3.5-6 mm or 7.5-14.5 mm long; anthers including tubules alternately either 16.5-27.5 mm or 22.5-35.5 mm long; thecae 6-13.5 mm long. Style 35-46 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial shrub with branches to 1.5 m long; mature stems terete, striate, glabrous or puberulent, dull reddish-brown when dry; immature twigs subterete to bluntly angled, striate, puberulent. Leaves subcoriaceous, ovate to ovate-elliptic, (3.5) 5.5-11 x (1.5) 3-4.5 cm, basally rounded or somewhat truncate to obtuse, apically long acuminate, glabrous except for midrib which is pubescent above and lamina with tiny glandular-fimbriae beneath; pinnately veined, the midrib elevated above and beneath and conspicuously thickened the proximal 1/2-1/3, lateral veins 6-8 per side, arising at an angle of 30-55? from the midrib, slightly impressed above and elevated beneath, anastomosing near the margins, the re- ticulate veinlets elevated above but obscure beneath; petioles terete, slightly rugose, 3-6 mm long and 1.5 mm in diam, puberulent. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 9-13-flowered; rachis subterete, bluntly angled, muricate, glabrous, 3.5-5 cm long and 2-3.5 mm in basal diam, pale green but suffused with orange when living, drying orangish-brown; floral bracts membranaceous, oblanceolate, 17-30 x 10-15 mm, glabrous, deep reddish-orange when fresh but drying dark wine-red; pedicels terete when fresh but drying flat, glabrous, 6-13 mm long and 1 mm in diam, pale green but suffused with orange when fresh, distally (at the junction with the calyx) provided with angular (sometimes partially atrophied) flesh-col- ored glands which secrete a white, sticky latex; bracteoles ovate-lanceolate, ca 0.5 mm long, glabrous, the margin and upper 1/3 glandular callose-thickened (Fig. 11). Flowers with the calyx glabrous, 4-5 mm long; hypanthium cylindric but weakly 5-10-ribbed, 1.5-1.8 mm long, basally apophysate with the apophysis margin shallowly to deeply undulate; limb cylindric to somewhat spreading, 2.7- 3.2 mm long including the lobes; lobes (but not entire limb) turning inwards after anthesis, 0.8-1 mm long and 1.5 mm broad at base, the margins glandular callose- thickened over their length with glands contiguous at the apex (Fig. 12E) or the glands almost completely covering the lobe (Fig. 19); sinus broadly rounded; corolla basically cylindric becoming swollen distally then abruptly constricting into the short throat and lobes, glabrous, 15.5 mm long and 4.5-5.5 mm in diam (the upper 1/3 constricted to 2.5 mm in diam), light to bright orange below and white at the constricted apex when fresh, the lobes ca 1 mm long, slightly spread- ing at anthesis; stamens equal, slightly shorter than the corolla, 12.5 mm long; filaments distinct, short pilose medially on the inner surface, alternately 3.5 mm and 1.5 mm long; anthers including tubules alternately 10 mm and 11.5 mm long; thecae granular, alternately 3 mm and 2 mm long, basally drawn-out into a short appendix (prognathous) 0.5 mm long; tubules dehiscing through clefts 2-4 mm long; style glabrous, 16 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Thin-stemmed, epiphytic shrub with branches to 1 m long; mature stems terete, glabrate, bark grayish and cracking into thin longitudinal strips; immature stems and twigs of new growth terete or subterete, smooth, reddish-brown, densely pilose with spreading hairs to 0.8 mm long. Leaves slightly concave, ovate to elliptic-ovate, (0.8) 1-1.8 x (0.3) 0.5-1 (1.3) cm, basally rounded or broadly obtuse, apically acute or shortly blunt-acuminate, margins slightly revolute, pilose on both surfaces (glabrate above) with white spreading hairs to 0.8 mm long; weakly 5-plinerved, midrib conspicuous, plane to slightly impressed above and raised beneath, lateral nerves inconspicuous and with reticulate veinlets raised above but obscure beneath; petioles terete, rugose, pilose, 1-2 mm long and 0.8 mm diam. Inflorescence 4-6 (12)-flowered; rachis flexuous, subterete, glabrous, 1.2-2.5 (4.5) cm long and 0.7-1 mm in diam, green suffused with violet when fresh; floral bracts caducous, membranaceous, broadly oblong-ovate, 3.5 x 4 mm, apically rounded, glabrous, purplish-violet; pedicels terete, smooth, glabrous, when fresh 5 mm long and 0.6 mm diam (drying 0.3 mm), green suffused with violet, provided with spherical glands 0.2 mm in diam at distal tip; bracteoles located at base of pedicel caducous, membranaceous, oblong, 0.5 mm long, distal one-third glandular callose-thickened. Flowers: calyx glabrous, 3 mm long, dark violet when fresh; hypanthium cylindric, smooth, weakly 5-ribbed, basally narrowly apophysate, 1-1.2 mm long; limb campanulate, 1.8-2 mm long; lobes broadly triangular, acute, connivent after anthesis, ca 1.2 mm long, each margin provided with an oblong somewhat crescent-shaped callose-thickened gland, these not contiguous at lobe tip; sinus acute; corolla cylindric, somewhat bottleshaped, narrowed at throat, glabrous, 10-11 mm long and 5-6 mm in diam at broadest point, pale violet when fresh, lobes deltoid, ca 0.5 mm long, spreading to reflexed at anthesis; stamens subequal, 4.2-4.4 mm long, slightly less than half the corolla length; filaments distinct, essentially glabrous, alternately 1.8 mm and 1.2 mm long; anthers alternately 2.7 mm and 3.2 mm long including tubules; thecae slightly granular, 1.2 mm long; tubules dehiscing by clefts 0.5-0.7 mm long; style glabrous, 8 mm long. Berry blue-black.

description: Terrestrial and epiphytic shrubs to 1 m tall. Petioles 3-6 mm long, weakly to densely pilose. Leaves elliptic to oblong-elliptic, or rarely lance-elliptic, (5-)11-15 (-19) cm long and (2-)4-7.5 cm broad, basally obtuse to rounded, rarely subacute, apically acuminate sometimes abruptly, glabrous above, hirsute along the nerves and lamina beneath, also with scattered, reddish globular glands, 0.1-0.2 mm in diameter along the upper surface, 3 (-5) plinerved. Inflorescence 18-29 flowered; rachis viscid, densely spreading hirsute, 6-8 cm long, with dark pink, globular glands scattered along the length. Floral bracts marginally short-ciliate and glandular fimbriate, ob- long to obovate, basally narrowed and slightly auriculate, apically obtuse to rounded, (11-) 18-26 mm long and (4.5-)8-12 mm broad, dark pink, rarely with few to many minute, peltate, globular glands marginally and on lamina. Pedicels densely spreading hirsute, (7-)12-16 mm long, distally covered with globular- to disc-shaped glands. Bracteoles ovate, 1-1.5 mm long and 0.5-1 mm broad, slightly pubescent along lam- ina, especially along midrib abaxially, apically and marginally with globular- to disc- shaped callose-thickenings. Calyx 4.5-5.5(-7.5) mm long; tube 1.5-2.5 mm long and 4-5.5 mm in diameter across apophysate base, with numerous, globular- to disc- shaped, peltate glands at base of apophysis; limb cylindric-campanulate, basally pi- lose, 2.5-3.5 (-5) mm long including lobes; lobes triangular, glabrous, 1 mm long and 2 mm wide at base, erect after anthesis, completely callose-thickened; sinus flat. Corolla slightly swollen at base, sharply constricted at. limb, very fleshy when fresh, (18-) 20-21.5 mm long and 6-7.5 mm in diameter, 3.5 mm at constricted limb, pilose distally, pinkish-purple, whitened at base and limb; lobes reflexed at anthesis, 1.5 mm long. Stamens 14-15.5 mm long; filaments distally strigose, alternately either 2.5-3 mm or 4-5.5 mm long; anthers including tubules alternately either 10.5-11.5 mm or 12.5-13.5 mm long; thecae 5-5.5 mm long. Style 20-21 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial or epiphytic shrub with branches to 3 m long; mature stems terete, smooth, somewhat nitid, glabrous, reddish-brown when dry; immature twigs terete or subterete and bluntly angled and ribbed, glabrous, reddish-brown; vegetative bracts (subtending current season's growth) coriaceous, persistent often for several years. Leaves elliptic, oblong-elliptic, 12-20.5 x 5.5-10 (12.5) cm, basally rounded or obtuse, often short bluntly-attenuate, apically obtuse or round- ed and rather abruptly short caudate-acuminate, glabrous; 3-5 (7)-plinerved from near base, midrib thickened and raised through proximal 0.5-1.5 cm otherwise impressed above and raised beneath, lateral nerves impressed above and raised beneath, reticulate veinlets impressed or plane above and raised beneath; petiole terete, sometimes flattened and slightly broadened distally, minutely rugose, 8- 12 (15) mm long and 2.5-3.5 (5) mm diam. Inflorescence 3-12-flowered, its bracts subcoriaceous, ovate to obovate and broadly rounded at apex, to 4 x 3 cm, erect and appressed to flowers at anthesis, green when fresh; rachis obscured by bracts, glabrous, congested, 10-17 mm long and 2.5-3.5 mm diam; floral bracts mem- branaceous, erect and appressed, oblong to obovate, 28-46 x 23-30 mm, apically rounded and emarginate, glabrous but dorsally provided with glandular fimbriae, red at anthesis; pedicels subterete, striate, glabrous, 8-15 mm long; bracteoles membranaceous, oblong, 4.5-9 x 2-3 mm, marginally glandular-fimbriate, the fimbriae sometimes fusing distally. Flowers: calyx glabrous, 10.5-13 mm long, translucent green when fresh; hypanthium cylindric, rugose, 4-6 mm long, basally apophysate with a rim 1-2 mm long which is produced below articulation (thus enveloping distal portion of pedicel); limb erecto-patent to campanulate at anthesis but somewhat connivent thereafter, 6.5-7 mm long, tinged with red when fresh; lobes deltoid, 1.5-2 x 3.5 mm, charged with thin supramarginal undulate or irregularly oblong glands to 1.8 mm long, subconnivent and twisting around style base after anthesis; sinus rounded; corolla cylindric, glabrous, when fresh 33-38 mm long and 10-11 mm diam and waxy-red, lobes oblong-deltoid, ca 1 mm long; stamens subequal, 24.5-31.5 mm long; filaments glabrous or weakly short pilose ventrally, alternately 2.7-4.8 mm and 8.2-9 mm long; anthers alternately 22-29 mm and 17.7-23.5 mm long; thecae slightly granular, alternately 7.5-10.5 mm and 6.5-9.5 mm long; tubules dehiscing by clefts ca 8 mm long; style glabrous, 33-38 mm long. Mature berry not seen.

description: Frutex epiphyticus et terrestris; petioli dense puberuli sed adulti glabri 4-6 mm longi; foliablonga vel oblongo-elliptica, bullata, 5.5-10 cm X 2.5-4.5 cm, basi emarginata vel subcordata, apice obtusa; inflorescentia 26-28-flora omnibus partibus dense brevi-pilosa; rhachides 8.5-9.5 cm longae; bracteae florales striatae, lanceolatae, (14.5-)18.5-23 mm X 6-9 mm, basi cuneatae, apice acuminatae; pedicelli 1-2.5 mm longi; bracteolae striatae, lanceolatae, (8-)13-16 mm X 3.5-4.5 (-6.5) mm, calycis basem amplectentes; calycis 7-9.5 mm longi, tubus subglobosus, nonapophysatus 2-2.5 mm longus, limbus cylindricus vel erecto-patens lobis 2-4 mm longis eglandulosis inclusis 5.5- 7 mm longus; corolla 11.5 mm longa; stamina 8.5-9 mm longa, filamentis alternatim 2-2.5 mm et 3.5-4 mm longis, antheris tubulis inclusis alternatim 6-6.2 mm et 6.5-7 mm longis; stylus 9.5-10.5 mm longus.

description: Terrestrial and epiphytic shrubs. Petioles 4-6 mm long, densely puberulent becom- ing glabrous. Leaves oblong to oblong-elliptic, 5.5-10 cm long and 2.5-4.5 cm broad, basally subcordate, apically obtuse, often bullate, with scattered, short hairs along base of midrib and lateral nerves, margins of young leaves short pilose soon caducous, 5 plinerved. Inflorescence 26-28 flowered with lowest few (up to 5) nodes sterile; rachis densely short pilose, 8.5-9.5 cm long. Floral bracts prominently striate on both surfaces with conspicuous midrib, lanceolate, (14.5-) 18.5-23 mm long and 6-9 mm broad, basally cuneate and strongly concave, apically long acuminate, marginally glandular fimbriate, densely short hirsute on both surfaces with white trichomes 0.2- 0.4 mm long, pink (according to label data). Pedicels 1-2.5 mm long, short white pilose. Bracteoles lanceolate, apically long acuminate, striate, (8-)13-16 mm long and 3.5-4.5(-6.5) mm broad, marginally glandular fimbriate, densely short pilose, clasping base of calyx, slightly spreading distally. Calyx 7-9.5 mm long, short pilose; tube subglobose, 2-2.5 mm long; limb cylindric to slightly spreading, conspicuously striate, 5.5-7 mm long including lobes; lobes long-triangular, 2-4 mm long and 2-2.5 mm broad, erect after anthesis, marginally eglandular, pubescent within; sinus obtuse. Corolla bluntly 5-angled, densely short pilose, 11.5 mm long and 3-3.5 mm in diam- eter, with scattered, short, red, clavate fimbriae on corolla surface; lobes obtuse, erect. Stamens alternately either 8-8.5 mm or 8.5-9 mm long; filaments weakly pubescent distally, alternately either 2-2.5 mm or 3.5-4 mm long; anthers alternately either 6-6.2 mm or 6.5-7 mm long; thecae 2-2.5 mm long. Style 9.5-10.5 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic shrub; stem terete, striate to ribbed, glabrate; twigs terete to subterete, complanate, striate to ribbed, densely shortpilose with white hairs, glabrate. Leaves co- riaceous, somewhat bullate, elliptic-ovate, elliptic, to oblong-elliptic, rarely ovate, (2) 4-6 X 1.5-2.5 cm, base rounded, cordate to subcordate, sometimes somewhat clasping, apex acute, obtuse, to narrowly rounded, margin entire and slightly revolute, glabrous to short-hirsute at base of nerves above, moderately and persistently short hirsute beneath, also with scattered, minute, glandular fimbriae on both surfaces; 5-plinerved from above the base, midrib raised and thickened in the proximal 2-10 mm, then impressed distally above, conspicuously raised beneath, lateral nerves impressed above (the inner pair joined with midrib for 2-10 mm) and conspicuously raised beneath, reticulate veinlets slightly impressed above but conspicuously raised beneath; petiole subterete, broadly flattened and canaliculate above, rugose, 3-5 mm long, densely short-hirsute, glabrate. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 8-32-flowered, surrounded at base by a series of ovate, acute bracts to 2 mm long; rachis subterete, angled, slender, striate, 3-9 cm long, densely short-pilose with white hairs; floral bract flat not ribbed, elliptic, sometimes some- what oblanceolate, base tapering, apex acute, 18-25 X 5-6 mm, moderately short- pilose on upper surface, margin minutely glandular-fimbriate distally, pink to red (fide labels); pedicel subterete, striate, 9-10 mm long, densely short-pilose; bracteoles basal, elliptic-oblong, obtuse, 2-3 mm long, short-pilose, margin glandular-fimbriate. Flowers with calyx 4-5.5 mm long, moderately short-hirsute, red (fide labels); hypanthium cylindric, ribbed, 1.5-2.5 mm long, base strongly apophysate with the margin undulate to lobed; limb cylindriccampanulate, 2.5-3 mm long; lobes deltate, acute, ca. 1.3 mm long, eglandular, erect after anthesis; sinuses rounded; corolla cylindric, 11-13 mm long and ca. 4 mm diam., dark violet to purple (fide labels), short-pilose all over, the lobes erect, ovate-deltate, acute, to 1 mm long, white (fide labels); stamens equal overall, 11-12 mm long; filaments distinct, alternately ca. 3 mm and 5.2 mm long, glabrous to weakly short-pilose; anthers alternately ca. 9 mm and 8 mm long; thecae alternately ca. 3 mm and 4.5 mm long; tubules alternately ca. 6 mm and 4 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphyte, totally glabrous. Stems subterete or flattened, smooth or ribbed; bark yellowish- to grayish-brown when dry, cracking longitudinally. Petioles terete, smooth (4) 7-8 mm long and (1.5) 2-3 mm diam, reddish-brown when dry. Leaves elliptic to oblanceolate, (6) 10-17.5 x (2) 3-5 cm, basally rounded when young to broadly cuneate at maturity, apically acuminate to abruptly short acuminate; 3-5 plinerved from the base, midrib and innermost pair of lateral nerves slightly impressed above and raised beneath, outer pair of lateral nerves obscure and slightly raised on both surfaces, veinlets raised on both surfaces. Inflorescence short racemose, ca. 9 flow- ered; rachis ca. 1 cm long and 5 mm diam at base. Inflorescence bracts ovate to oblong, apically rounded, marginally minutely ciliate, to 30 X 20 mm. Floral bracts membranaceous, oblanceolate, apically rounded, 45 x 10-20 mm, pink (fide label data). Pedicels terete, 12 mm long and 1-1.5 mm diam, covered with numerous globular, peltate glands. Bracteoles linear, 8-11 x 1.5 mm, with 3-5 spherical glands scattered along the margins, and one large apical callose-thickened gland. Calyx 8-9 mm long; tube cylindric, 10-ribbed, 2-2.5 mm long, basally apophysate with the apophysis margin undulate; limb erect but slightly spreading, 5.5-7 mm long including lobes; lobes triangular, acute, 3-3.5 mm long, flanked along each side by an oblong callose-thickened gland 2.5-3 mm long, the glands nearly contiguous at the apex of the lobe; sinus obtuse. Corolla (immature) cylindric, ca. 25 mm long and 4 mm diam, white the basal half and bluish the apical half (fide label data). Stamens (immature) subequal with the corolla, ca. 20 mm long; filaments alternately either 3 mm or 6.5 mm long, pilose; anthers including tubules alternately either 18 mm or 15 mm long; thecae smooth, alternately either 11 mm or 8 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial shrub from a single arching stem to 4 m tall; seedlings with stems flexuous, finely short white pilose, the leaves elliptic, finely short white pilose on both surfaces; mature stems conspicuously and persistently 5-winged (wings to 3 mm broad), smooth, glabrous, reddish-brown. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic to ovate-elliptic, (8) 11-20 (23) x (4) 7-16 (19) cm, basally cordate and clasping, apically rounded, dark green above, paler green beneath when living, glabrous but with minute glandular fimbriae beneath; 5 (9)-plinerved, the nerves arising from the base, red beneath when living, the midrib and inner 1 (2) pairs of lateral nerves conspicuously impressed above and raised beneath, the outer 1-2 pairs of lateral nerves inconspicuously and slightly impressed to plane above but raised beneath, veinlets inconspicuous on both surfaces; petioles subterete, ovoid, ru- gose, 4-5 mm long, 5 mm in diam, glabrous, red when living. Inflorescence ax- illary at the tips of the branches, paniculate with up to 850 flowers per inflores- cence; rachis and rachis branches subterete, glabrous, green when living, the main axis to 53 cm long and 6 mm in basal diam, the secondary branches 20-28 cm long and the tertiary branches ca 13 cm long; floral bracts caducous, mem- branaceous, cucullate, ovate, ca 6 mm long and 8-9 mm broad, basally clasping, apically rounded, glabrous, green tinged with red when living; pedicels terete, striate, 6-7 mm long at anthesis (elongating to 11-12 mm in fruit), ca 1 mm in diam but swollen to 1.5 mm at the base, green when living, glabrous; bracteoles caducous, similar to the floral bracts but ca 3 mm long and 4 mm broad. Flowers with calyx glabrous, 4 mm long, green when living; hypanthium cylindric, basally slightly apophysate, ca 1.5 mm long and 4 mm in diam; limb slightly spreading, ca 2-2.5 mm long including the lobes; lobes ovate to hemispheric, apiculate, connivent after anthesis, ca 0.75 mm long, marginally thin without fimbriae; sinus acute; corolla bottle-shaped, glabrous, 13-14 mm long and 7 mm in diam at the broadest point, purplish-green with the purple pigment being restricted to the inner (morphologically lower) epidermal surfaces (Fig. 13F), the lobes triangular, acute, 1.5 mm long, flaring at anthesis, white; stamens nearly equal in length, 10- 11 mm long; filaments distinct, very sparsely pilose along the margins distally, alternately 2 mm and 2.8-3 mm long; anthers including the tubules subequal, 8.5- 9 mm long; thecae slightly granular, ca 3 mm long; tubules dehiscent by clefts 3 mm long; style glabrous, 12 mm long. Berry spherical, glabrous, ca 13 mm ih diam, dark blue-black, sweet-tasting.

description: Shrub; stems terete, nearly smooth, glabrous, reddish-brown when dry; vegetative bracts ensheathing the twigs lanceolate, conspicuously striate, to 4 cm long, persisting at least 2 years then decomposing and becoming fibrous. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic or weakly ovate-elliptic, 8-14 x 3-8 cm, basally rounded, apically abruptly short acuminate, marginally scarious the margins themselves crisped (see Fig. 5A inset), glabrous but densely and minutely glandular-fimbriate beneath; 5 (7)-plinerved from the base, all nerves (including the midrib, lateral nerves and reticulate veinlets) slightly impressed above and conspicuous, midrib and lateral nerves slightly raised but obscure beneath; petioles terete, rugose, glabrous, 5-12 mm long and 2-4 mm in diam. Inflorescence axillary, solitary, racemose, 20-30-flowered, the lowest bracts sterile; rachis subterete, bluntly angled, glabrous, 11-13 cm long and 2-2.5 mm in basal diam, encircled at the base by numerous persistent, ovate-lanceolate, conspicuously striate bracts; floral bracts coriaceous, smooth except lowermost (sterile) conspicuously striate, ob- long, elliptic to oblanceolate, basally truncate somewhat clasping, apically round- ed although lowermost often keeled and then appearing acute, uppermost (fertile) bracts 15-20 x 8-9 mm, lowermost (sterile) 22-25 x 8-10 mm, light green when fresh (fide Forero et al. 2195), tan when dry, glabrous but distally provided abaxially with numerous elliptic, slightly concave (Figs. 24-25), reddish (when dry) glands; pedicels subterete, striate, glabrous, 3-4 mm long and 1.5 mm in diam; bracteoles none. Flowers with calyx glabrous, 7-8 mm long; hypanthium cylindric to pentagonal, slightly rugose, 2.5-3.5 mm long, basally with a shallow rim; limb cylindric, ca 4-5 mm long including the lobes; lobes deltoid, 0.8 mm long, eglandular, erect after anthesis; sinus broadly rounded; corolla cylindric, glabrous, 30- 31 mm long and 4-5 mm in diam, red with pink apex when fresh (fide Forero et al. 2842), lobes oblong, obtuse, 3.5 x 2 mm; stamens equal, 27-28 mm long; filaments distinct, alternately 4.2 mm and 6-7 mm long, the longer one short pilose the distal half; anthers alternately 25 mm and 22 mm long including the tubules; thecae 5-6 mm long; style glabrous, ca 30 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Frutex epiphyticus; petioli 4-7 mm longi; folia elliptica vel oblongo-elliptica, (4.5-)9-14 cm X (1-) 2-4(-6) cm, basi obtusa, apice acuminata; inflorescentia 20-flora, rhachides 3-8 cm longae, valde fusiformes; bracteae florales oblongae vel obovatae, 25-35 mm X 13-18 mm; pedicelli 1 mm longi; bracteolae oblongae vel oblanceolatae, 25-30 mm X 10 mm; calycis 11-15 mm longi, tubus nonapophysatus 2.5-4 mm longus, limbus lobis lineari-oblongis 3-6 mm longis inclusis 9-12 mm lon- gus; corolla 35 mm longa; stamina alternatim 10-11.5 mm et 12-13.5 mm longa, filamentis alternatim 1-2 mm et 3.5-4.5 mm longis, antheris tubulis inclusis alternatim 8-9 mm et 9-10.5 mm longis; stylus 33-37 mm longus.

description: Epiphytic shrubs. Petioles 4-7 mm long, hirsute. Leaves elliptic or oblong-elliptic, (4.5-) 9-14 cm long and (1-) 2-4 (-6) cm broad, basally narrowing and obtuse, apically acuminate, sparsely short pilose along nerves above, moderately pilose or glabrate beneath, 3(-5) plinerved. Inflorescences obconic or fusiform-shaped at anthesis, 20 flowered, lowest nodes sterile, circumscribed at base by striate bracts; rachis glabrous, fusiform, 3-8 cm long. Floral bracts glabrous, striate, oblong-obovate, basally nar- rowing and rounded, apically rounded and emarginate, 25-35 mm long and 13-18 mm broad, red to rose-pink (fide label data), with subsessile, capitate, red glands at base. Pedicels glabrous, 1 mm long. Bracteoles oblong or oblanceolate, basally clasping calyx and imbricate, apically rounded and shallowly emarginate, 25-30 mm long and about 10 mm broad, with subsessile, capitate, red glands at base. Calyx glabrous, 11-15 mm long; tube barrel-shaped, 2.5-4 mm long, nonapophysate; limb erect or spreading, submembranaceous, striate, 9-12 mm long including lobes; lobes linear- oblong, acute, 3-6 mm long, erect after anthesis, marginally with stout, glandular fim- briae; sinus obtuse to broadly rounded. Corolla glabrous, membranaceous basally and subcoriaceous apically, 34-35 mm long and 6-7 mm in diameter, white with green tips (fide label data). Stamens alternately either 10-11.5 mm or 12-13.5 mm long about one-third length of corolla; filaments distinct or slightly coherent basally, gla- brous, alternately either 1-2 mm or 3.5-4.5 mm long, long filaments conspicuously narrowed and thin distally; anthers including tubules alternately either 8-9 mm or 9-10.5 mm long; thecae 2.5-3 mm long; tubules dehiscing by short, oblique pores or oval clefts 1-1.5 mm long. Style 33-37 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic shrub. Mature branckes terete, smooth, glabrate, brown; immature branches and twigs of new growth terete, smooth, reddish-brown, densely pilose with white hairs to 4 mm. Petioles terete, rugose, 5 mm long and 2 mm diameter, densely pilose with tan hairs to 3 mm. Leaves elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 8-13 X 3.5-5.5 cm, basally rounded, apically abruptly acuminate, brownish-green when dry, densely pilose beneath with hairs to 2 mm, scattered pilose above; 3(5) plinerved, midrib, lateral nerves and primary veins impressed and conspicuous above, elevated beneath, veinlets slightly elevated above, obscure beneath. Inflorescence short racemose, 6 flowered; rachis terete, striate, densely pilose, about 2.5 cm. Floral bracts lanceolate,:acuminate, 16-23 X 4-6 mm, densely pilose marginally, scattered pilose on lamina, -hairs to 2 mm. Pedicels swollen distally, striate, densely pilose, 8-12 mm. Bracteoles not seen. Calyx densely pilose, 13-13.5 mm, pink (fide label data); tube spherical, 3.5-4.5 mm long and broad, non-apophysate; limb short-cylindric or spreading, 9-9.5 mm including lobes; lobes linear-lanceolate, acute, 8 mm long and 2 mm broad at base, erect after anthesis, marginally with 3-4 gland tipped fimbriae on each side; sinus acute. Corolla (past anthesis) cylindric, about 20 mm, scattered pilose with hairs densest at lobe tips. Stamens 16 mm; filaments alternately either 1 or 3 mm; anthers including tubules alternately either 15 or 13 mm; thecae 3-4 mm. Style 21 mm. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic shrub; stem terete to subterete, sometimes bluntly angled, striate, short-pilose, glabrate; twigs subterete, complanate, bluntly to sharply angled, striate, moderately short-pilose with white hairs. Leaves coriaceous, ovate, ovate-elliptic, rarely oblong-ovate, 2-3.5 X 1-1.7 cm, base rounded, subcordate, apex acute, obtuse, or narrowly rounded, margin entire, slightly thickened, and slightly revolute, sparsely but conspicuously short-pilose along edge of lamina and onto the margin on both surfaces and also at base of midrib beneath, glabrate, also bearing deciduous, minute, glandular fimbriae on both surfaces; 3(5)- plinerved from the base, midrib plane or usually raised above and conspicuously raised beneath, lateral nerves and reticulate veinlets conspicuously raised above and slightly raised but inconspicuous beneath, sometimes only midrib noticeable beneath; petiole subterete, flattened above, rugose, 1.7-3.3 mm long, densely short-pilose, glabrate. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 7- 20-flowered; rachis subterete, sharply an- gled, 1-2.5 cm long, glabrous; floral bract flat not ribbed, oblong to oblanceolate, rounded, 12-15 X 3-7 mm, eglandular, ciliate distally, red (fide label); pedicel subter- ete, ribbed, 6-8 mm long, eglandular, gla- brous; bracteoles basal, oblong-elliptic, rounded to acute, 2-3(5) mm long, margin densely and deciduously glandular-fimbriate. Flowers with calyx 4-5 mm long; hypanthium cylindric, ribbed, 1.5-1.6 mm long, base broadly apophysate with the margin flaring, undulate to lobed, and short- pilose; limb campanulate-spreading, 2.4- 2.5 mm long, glabrous; lobes oblong-ovate, apiculate, ca. 1 mm long, margin lacerate- glandular, erect after anthesis; sinuses acute; corolla cylindric, 9-10 mm long and ca. 3.5 mm diam., red to vermillion (fide label), glabrous, the lobes ovate, acute, ca. 1 mm long, white; stamens equal overall, 8-8.5 mm long; filaments distinct, alternately ca. 3.5 mm and 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers alternately ca. 6.3 mm and 7.5 mm long; thecae alternately ca. 3 mm and 2.5 mm long; tubules alternately ca. 3.5 mm and 5 mm long; style slightly exserted, glabrous. Berry not seen.

description: Pendent, epiphytic shrub; stem subterete, bluntly angled, striate, moderately short hirsute, glabrate, also provided with few, scattered, globular glands ca. 0.2-0.3 mm diam.; twigs subterete, complanate, sparsely hirsute with white hairs 0.7-0.9 mm long. Leaves coriaceous, stiff, lanceolate or elliptic lanceolate, 8-18 X 1.2-3.5 cm, base cuneate or obtuse, apex gradually acuminate, glabrous above, very sparsely hirsute along midnerve beneath, glabrate, also with few, minute, globular glands (0.1-0.2 mm diam.) along the margin and onto the lamina above; conspicuously 3(5)-plinerved, midrib and inner pair of lateral nerves strongly impressed and conspicuous above, raised and conspicuous beneath, reticulate veinlets slightly impressed on both surfaces; petiole subterete, rugose, 4-6 (7) mm long and 1.2-2 mm diam., sparsely short- hirsute, glabrate. Inflorescence racemose, ca. 14-flowered; rachis subterete, striate, ribbed, ca. 10-11 cm long and 1.2-2 mm diam., moderately hirsute, also bearing few, globular, sessile glands along the length; floral bract oblong or oblong-obovate, 17- 21 X 5-8 mm, base narrowed and obtuse, apex obtuse or acute, margin ciliolate and also bearing few, tiny, sessile, globular glands on margin and dorsal surface of lamina, pinkish lilac; pedicel striate, rugose, 11-14 mm long and ca. 1 mm diam., densely hirsute, also with few, scattered, globular glands; bracteoles basal, striate, oblong- ovate, 4-6 X 1.5-3 mm, marginally ciliolate, also bearing along margin few, sessile, globular glands and the tip callose glandular. Flowers with calyx ca. 9 mm long; hypanthium ca. 2 mm long and 2.5-3 mm diam., moderately hirsute, the base apophysate, moderately undulate, and bearing few, globular or disc-shaped glands, pink; limb spreading campanulate, ca. 7 mm long including the lobes, hirsute proximally, pink; lobes triangular, ca. 2 X 1.8-2 mm, erect after anthesis, each margin provided with an oblong to crescent shaped callose gland, these contiguous at the apex; sinuses acute to obtuse; corolla lilac (fide label). Berry not seen.

description: Both collections are from the southern most locality of the species in Ecuador and vary from the typical form in having very small leaves 1.3-2.2 x 0.7-0.9 cm vs nor- mal (2.5-) 5-7.5 (-11) x (1-) 1.5-3 (-4.5) cm in more typical forms, short petioles 1- 3 mm long vs 4-8 mm long, inflorescences of 4-16 flowers vs (11-) 16-30 (-40), floral bracts 3-4 x 2 mm vs 5-8 x 3.5-4 mm, and bracteoles 0.2 mm long vs 0.4-0.5 mm. On first impression, the collections appear to be a distinct species because the features mentioned above represent extremes in the morphological variation of var. isernii. However, upon closer examination, all the essential characters that circumscribe var. isernii are present. Therefore, I do not feel that these extremes necessitate taxonomic recognition since they are normally variable characters in Cavendishia (see Luteyn, 1983).

description: Terrestrial or epiphytic shrubs. Petioles flattened adaxially, (4-)6-7(-10) mm long, hirsute when young, glabrate at maturity. Leaves bullate, elliptic to lance-ellip- tic, 4-9 cm long and 1-3 cm broad, basally cuneate, apically long caudate-acuminate often abruptly, acumen 1.5-2 cm long, base of midrib adaxially short hirsute but soon glabrate, adaxial surface and margins of mature leaves with scattered, reddish globular glands, 0.1-0.2 mm in diameter, these soon caducous leaving a reddish or blackish papillate scar, 5 plinerved. Inflorescence 4-7 (-10) flowered with lowest several nodes sterile; rachis bluntly angled, glabrous, 4-9(-15) cm long, with scattered, globular glands proximally. Floral bracts foliaceous, 5 plinerved, muricate, ciliate-margined, lance-elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, basally narrowed and clasping, apically acuminate, 7-11(-16) mm long and 2-5 mm broad, pale green, marginally with numerous, red, sessile, globular glands to 0.2 mm in diameter. Pedicels glabrous, (14-)19-25 mm long, with globular glands distally. Bracteoles foliaceous, broadly oval to semiorbicu- lar, strongly reflexed and revolute, 1-4 mm long and broad, basally clasping, apically broadly rounded, ciliate- and glandular-margined. Calyx glabrous, 4-6 mm long; tube short-cylindric, 10-ribbed, 1.5-2 mm long and 3-4.5 mm irn diameter at apophysate base, margins of apophysis turned upwards and provided along edge with globular glands which secrete a milky, viscid latex especially when young; limb erect, or spreading to campanulate, eglandular, 2.5-4 mm long; lobes broadly triangular, (0.5-) 1 (-1.5) mm long, erect after anthesis, marginally with oblong, callose-thickened glands nearly contiguous or contiguous at the apex; sinus broadly rounded to flat. Corolla slightly constricted basally, constricted to a short throat distally, when imma- ture apically broadly shouldered and nippled prior to anthesis, at maturity corolla thick and fleshy, but drying thin, membranaceous, 19-29 mm long and 9.5 mm in diameter, glabrous, greenish-red at maturity; lobes about 0.5 mm long. Stamens 15- 20 mm long; filaments alternately either 3.5-4.5 mm or 6.5-7.5 mm long; anthers including tubules alternately either 10-14 mm or 12.5-17 mm long; thecae 2.5-5 mm long. Style 21.5-26 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphyte or terrestrial shrub to 3 m tall; mature stems subterete, striate, glabrous, reddish-brown when dry, the bark thin and reticulately exfoliating into strips; immature twigs terete or bluntly angled, densely cinerous puberulent, reddish-brown when dry. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to oblong-ovate, or elliptic, (2) 3.5-5 (6) x (1) 1.5-2.5 (3) cm, basally rounded often subcordate, apically short acuminate, sparsely short pilose above (more apparent towards the base) and glabrous beneath, with scattered reddish short glandular fimbriae beneath, weakly 3-5-plinerved often appearing pinnate, the lateral nerves often much thinner than the midvein, the midvein and lateral nerves slightly but conspicuously raised at the base becoming plane or slightly impressed distally above, all veins raised beneath; petioles terete, somewhat rugose, 2-3 mm long, 1.2-1.5 mm in diam, densely cinerous puberulent becoming glabrate. Inflorescence axillary, panicu- lately branched, 20-100-flowered; rachis and rachis branches subterete, striate, glabrous, the main axis 5-10 cm long and 1 mm in basal diam, the secondary branches 1.5-5 cm long and 0.75 mm in diam; floral bracts caducous, membrana- ceous, somewhat cucullate, ovate to oblong-ovate, ca 7 x 4.5 mm, basally trun- cate and auriculate, clasping, apically rounded, ciliate and marginally glandular- fimbriate, dorsally glandular-fimbriate also, glabrous, translucent white but tinged with green when living; pedicels terete, striate, 6-8 mm long at anthesis, ca 0.2- 0.3 mm in diam, with angular glands at distal tip; bracteoles oblong to ovate, 0.75 mm long, apically obtuse and ciliate, marginally glandular-fimbriate (Figs. 6-7) becoming especially dense near the distal tip. description: Epiphytic shrub; stem terete, striate, glabrous; twigs subterete, bluntly angled, striate, densely white puberulent, glabrate. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to ovate-elliptic, 3.5-5.6 X 1.2-1.8 cm, base rounded to broadly obtuse, apex long-acuminate, mar- gin entire and slightly revolute, glabrous on both surfaces, lacking glandular fimbriae; 3(5)-plinerved, midrib weakly impressed in the proximal 1/2-3/4 becoming plane to slight- ly raised in the distal 1/2-1/4 above, lateral nerves and reticulate veinlets slightly raised above, all nerves slightly raised beneath; petiole subterete, strongly canaliculate above, 4-6 mm long, densely puberulent, glabrate. Inflorescence axillary, solitary, racemose, 6-9-flowered, surrounded at the base by a series of broadly ovate bracts to 2 mm long; rachis subterete, sharply angled, 1.5-2.5 cm long, glabrous, eglandular; lowest 3-4 floral bracts sterile (without flowers), the more distal fertile ones conduplicate or concave, oblong-obovate, rounded, 7-16 X 4-7 mm, glabrous, eglandular, surrounding the buds and then spreading and becoming strongly reflexed through and post-anthesis; pedicel subtere te, striate, 7-10 mm long, glabrous; brac- teoles basal, oblong, rounded, 1.5-2 mm long, glabrous, but marginally conspicuously glandular-fimbriate in the distal 1/3. description: Pendent, epiphytic shrub; stem terete or subterete, striate, glabrous; twigs terete, glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, linear, (6) 7.5-15 x 0.3-0.7 cm, base cuneate, apex acute, margin strongly revolute, glabrous, but somewhat punctate on both surfaces from deciduous fimbriae borne in slight depressions; apparently pinnately nerved, midrib impressed above, raised and conspicuous beneath, lateral nerves obscure (if present), reticulate veinlets obscure to inconspicuous but slightly raised when present; petiole te- rete or subterete, rugose, 1-3 mm long and ca. 1 mm diam., glabrous. description: Terrestrial shrub to 3 m tall; stems subterete, bluntly angled, striate, glabrous but black glandular-punctate. Leaves coriaceous, oblong-elliptic to lanceolate, (7.5) 12-18 (27) x (3) 5-7 (12) cm, basally rounded, obtuse or short attenuate, apically acuminate often abruptly short acuminate, glabrous but densely glan- dular-fimbriate beneath (appearing reddish-punctate after fimbriae break off); 5 (7)-plinerved, the inner pair of nerves arising 2-3 cm above the base, midrib conspicuously thickened basal 2-3 cm but thin and impressed distally above and raised beneath, lateral nerves impressed above and raised beneath, reticulate veinlets raised on both surfaces but inconspicuous beneath; petioles terete, ru- gose, 7-12 (19) mm long and 2.5-3 (4.5) mm in diam, glabrous, reddish-brown when dry. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, potentially being 125-140-flowered but with seemingly only 1-2 flowers open at any given time, frequently two inflorescences per axil with the inflorescence basally encircled by numerous ovate to obovate bracts to 25 mm long and broad; rachis subterete, bluntly angled, congested, glabrous, ca 7 cm long when first flowering but elongating to 35 cm and still flowering towards the tip, old rachises found as long as 52 cm, average diam 4-5 mm; floral bracts subcoriaceous, subpersistent, appressed to the flow- ers, oblong to ovate, 25 mm long and broad, basally truncate, apically rounded, marginally eglandular, glabrous, punctate with minute spherical glands (Figs. 21- 23), bright red when fresh; pedicels subterete, 4 mm long and in diam, glabrous but densely glandular with nearly spherical minute fimbriae; bracteoles similar to floral bracts except ca 17 mm long and broad, marginally weakly glandular-fim- briate, tightly enclosing the hypanthium and thus imbricate. Flowers with the calyx glabrous, 25-27 mm long; hypanthium cylindric, smooth, 7-8 mm long and 9-10 mm in diam, basally truncate; limb cylindric ca 19-20 mm long including the lobes; lobes oblong, obtuse, imbricate, 18-19 mm long, erect and tightly imbricate after anthesis, marginally scarious and seemingly glandular over the entire length (see Fig. 26B inset), also punctate as bracts; corolla cylindric but slightly swollen basally, glabrous, 21-22 mm long and ca 8 mm in diam, white, nearly completely enclosed by the calyx lobes with only the distal few millimeters showing, lobes oblong, acute, 2 mm long and broad, flaring at anthesis; stamens equal, 15-16.5 mm long; filaments distinct, densely short pilose the distal 1/2-l/3, alternately 5-6 mm and 3-3.7 mm long; anthers including tubules alternately 12- 12.5 mm and 14-14.5 mm long; thecae slightly granular, 6.5-7 mm long, the tubules dehiscing by elongate clefts 5-6 mm long; style ca 20-21 mm long, in- serted. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic shrub; stems subterete to bluntly angled, smooth to somewhat striate, glabrous to glabrate, with scattered, globular glands ca. 0.1 mm diam.; twigs subterete, glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, strongly bul- late, lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, 2.4- 6.8 X 1.3-4.2 cm, base clasping to nearly amplexicaul, apex acute to scarcely mucro- nate, glabrous above and glabrate beneath, with few and scattered glandular fimbriae 0.2-0.3 mm long; 5-7-plinerved, midrib and lateral nerves strongly and conspicuously impressed above and raised and conspicuous beneath, reticulate veinlets con- spicuously impressed on both surfaces; petiole inconspicuous, subterete, rugose, <1.5 mm long and 2 mm diam., glabrous. Inflorescence racemose, 9-18-flowered; rachis subterete to somewhat angled, striate, ribbed, 3-6 mm long and 1.7-2.1 mm diam., glabrous, without glands; floral bract oblong to oblong-elliptic, 15-18 X 3.5-4.5 mm, base obtuse, apex gradually acumi- nate, margin ciliolate, the tip callose glandular, pinkish red to red; pedicel striate, rugose, 3-4.5 mm long and ca. 1 mm diam., glabrous to glabrate; bracteoles located ca. 1 mm above base of pedicel, linear-oblong, 3.5-4.5 X 1.5-2 mm, margin ciliolate. Flowers with calyx glabrous, ca. 5.2-6.2 mm long; hypanthium ca. 2.2-2.5 mm long and 2-2.5 mm diam., basally strongly apophysate with a conspicuous collar or rim, without glands, reddish; limb narrowly campanulate, ca. 2.5-3.5 mm long including the lobes, reddish; lobes triangular, 0.8 X 1.7 mm, erect after anthesis; sinuses acute to obtuse; corolla cylindric, 7.5-8 mm long and ca. 2 mm diam. when dry, green- ish white to greenish yellow, the lobes erect, triangular to ovate-triangular, acute, ca. 0.8 mm long; stamens 6-7 mm long; filaments alternately ca. 1 mm and 2-2.3 mm long, glabrous to weakly short-pilose; anthers alternately ca. 5.8-6 mm and 4.5-5 mm long; thecae alternately ca. 1.8 mm and 2.7 mm long; tubules alternately ca. 4 mm and 2.3 mm long, dehiscing by clefts alternately ca. 2.5 mm and 1.6 mm long; style 8.5-9 mm long, glabrous. Mature berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial or epiphytic shrub with branches to 2 m tall; mature stems terete, minutely striate, glabrous, tan when dry; twigs subterete, complanate, minutely striate, cinereous. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic, oblong-elliptic, ovate-elliptic, 6-16 x 2.5-6 cm, basally rounded, apically abruptly caudate-acuminate (acumen to 3 cm long and averaging 0.8 mm broad), when dry olive-green above and brown beneath, glandular-fimbriate and short-pilose (especially along the nerves) on both surfaces; from base 5-7 (9)-plinerved, the nerves slightly impressed above and conspicuously raised beneath, reticulate veinlets inconspicuous but raised on both surfaces; petioles terete, rugose, short-pilose or hispid, 5-8 mm long and 1-2.5 mm in diam. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 15-flowered, the flowers restricted to distal one-fifth of inflorescence; rachis subterete, somewhat fusiform, 5-7 cm long and 1.5 mm in basal diam becoming 3 mm in diam distally, densely short- pilose with white hairs 0.2-0.3 mm long; floral bracts: those of proximal three- fifths of inflorescence caducous causing it to appear pedunculate, those of next distal one-fifth usually reflexed at anthesis, sterile, subcoriaceous, striate, oblong to ovate-lanceolate, apically acute, 2-4 x 0.5-1.4 cm, densely short-pilose on both surfaces, deep scarlet when fresh, the distal (one-fifth) bracts subtending flowers, appressed, membranaceous, striate, oblong, apically rounded and usually emarginate, 2.5-3.5 x 0.7-1.3 cm, densely short-pilose on both surfaces, when fresh grass-green becoming pink at base and red distally; pedicels ca 0.5 mm long, densely short-pilose; bracteoles none. Flowers: calyx densely short-pilose, ca 9-9.5 mm long; hypanthium cylindric to obconic, 2.5-3 mm long, basally truncate and with a fringe of glandular fimbriae; limb cylindric or slightly spread- ing, weakly striate, 6-6.5 mm long including lobes; lobes triangular, acute, 2.5 mm long, marginally glandular-fimbriate, cream-colored when fresh; sinus rounded; corolla cylindric, 30-35 mm long and 6-7 mm in diam, short-pilose in distal three-fourths, nearly glabrous proximal one-fourth, inconspicuously glandular- fimbriate, white lower three-fourths and pale yellowish-green distal one-fourth when fresh, lobes triangular, ca 1 mm long, pale yellowish-green; stamens unequal, alternately 13.8 mm and 15.6 mm long; filaments distinct (lightly coherent prior to anthesis), alternately 3 mm and 5.6 mm long, glabrous; anthers alternately 11.5 mm and 10.4 mm long including tubules; thecae slightly granular, 4 mm long; tubules dehiscing by clefts 2.5 mm long; style glabrous, 30-36 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Frutex epiphyticus et terrestris 2.5 m altus; petioli glabri vel adaxialiter dense puberuli, adulti glabri, 4-10(-13) mm longi; folia ovata, lanceolata, lanceolato-elliptica vel oblonga, (4-)8-12(-15) cm X (1-)2.5-7 cm, basi obtusa rotunda vel truncata, apice saepe abrupte acuminata; inflorescentia (2-)5-9(-12)-flora, ante anthesis obconica vel sphaerica; rhachides (0.6-)0.8-2(-3.5) cm longae; bracteae florales pallidae purpureae vel atroroseae, oblongae vel obovatae raro subrotundae, (2-) 3-6(-7) cm X (1-)1.5-2(-4.5) cm, apice rotundatae et plerumque profunde emarginatae; pedicelli (8-)10-16(-19) mm longi; bracteolae ovatae, lanceolatae, lanceolato-ellipticae vel sublineares, 1.5- 2(-5) mm longae; calycis glabri, 7-11(-13) mm longi, tubus 2-5 mm longus basaliter apophysatus et profunde lobatus, limbus cylindricus vel erecto-patens lobis calloso-incrassatis et glandulosis inclusis (4-)5-7.5(-9) mm longus; corolla alba, subrosea vel pallida violacea, 31-40(-43) mm longa, glabra vel raro distaliter brevi-pilosa; stamina 24.5-36 mm longa, filamentis alternatim 2.5-7.5 et 7.5-13.5 mm longis, antheris tubulis inclusis alternatim 16-26.5 mm et 21.5-32.5 mm longis; stylis 32-41 mm longus.

description: Terrestrial or epiphytic shrubs to 2.5 m tall. Petioles flattened adaxially, 4-10 (-13) mm long, glabrous to densely puberulent adaxially when young often glabrate at maturity. Leaves ovate, lanceolate, lance-elliptic or oblong, (4-)8-12(-15) cm long and (1-) 2.5-7 cm broad, basally obtuse, rounded to truncate, apically acuminate and often abruptly so, usually puberulous at base of midrib and lateral nerves on upper surface, 5-7 plinerved. Inflorescence (2-)5-9(-12) flowered with often lowest one or two nodes sterile, obconic to spherical in bud; rachis glabrous, (0.6-)0.8-2 (-3.5) cm long, rarely with clavate glands or cartilaginous teeth at base. Floral bracts often translucent when dry, glabrous with minute, red, clavate, glandular fimbriae abaxially, oblong, obovate or rarely subrotund, basally narrowed and somewhat clasp- ing, apically rounded, usually deeply emarginate, (2-) 3-6 (-7) cm long and (1-) 1.5- 2.5 (-4.5) cm broad, pale purplish to bright rose or dark pink when fresh. Pedicels glabrous, (8-)10-16(-19) mm long, rarely glandular distally. Bracteoles ovate, lan- ceolate, lance-elliptic, or nearly linear, 1.5-2 (-5) mm long and 0.5-1.5 (-4) mm broad, apically callose-thickened. Calyx glabrous, 7-11(-13) mm long; tube ribbed, 2-5 mm long and 3-5 mm in diameter across base, basally apophysate and deeply lobed with lobes straight to flaring outward and extending well below articulation; limb cylindric to slightly spreading, (4-) 5-7.5 (-9) mm long including lobes; lobes triangular, (1-) 1.5-2 (-2.5) mm long, erect after anthesis, tips completely glandular callose-thickened or callose-thickened apically, centrally or only marginally; sinus subacute when fresh, but drying obtuse to broadly rounded, rarely flat. Corolla slightly constricted basally and at throat, often translucent when dry, 31-40(-43) mm long and 7-9 mm in diameter, glabrous or rarely pilose distally, tube dull or glossy white, often basally pink to pinkish below grading through violet to pale purple above, limb white; lobes oblong, obtuse, 1.5-2 mm long, reflexed at anthesis, white sometimes marginally purple. Stamens 24.5-36 mm long; filaments densely puberu- lous distally, alternately either 2.5-7.5 mm or 7.5-13.5 mm long; anthers including tubules alternately either 16-26.5 mm or 21.5-32.5 mm long; thecae 6-13 mm long. Style 32-41 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic shrub. Mature branches and twigs terete, striate, glabrous, tan to reddish- brown when dry, sometimes glaucous. Petioles terete, striate, (4-) 7-10(-14) mm long and 2-2.5 mm diameter, sparsely pilose when young, glabrous at maturity, dark reddish-brown. Leaves oblong, elliptic, ovate-elliptic, (7-)10-14(-16) X (3-)4-6 cm, basally rounded, obtuse or subtruncate, apically long acuminate or abruptly short acuminate, brown or olive-brown when dry, glabrous; 5(-7) plinerved, midrib and lateral nerves slightly impressed above, raised and prominent beneath, veinlets slightly raised but obscure on both surfaces. Inflorescence 15-25 flowered; rachis bluntly angled, smooth or slightly striate, glabrous, (2.5-) 7-9 cm long and 2-4 mm diameter at base. Floral bracts smooth, glabrous, elliptic, 15-20 X 8-10 mm, basally obtuse, apically rounded to obtuse, reddish. Pedicels swollen distally, striate, glabrous, 8-10 mm long and 1 mm diameter at anthesis, lengthening to 17 mm after anthesis. Bracteoles ovate-lanceolate, 1.5 X 0.75 mm, apically acute, glandular callose-thickened marginally and distal half. Calyx glabrous, 5 mm; tube short cylindric, coarsely ribbed, 1.5 mm, strongly apophysate basally; limb erecto-patent to slightly campanulate, rugose, 3.5 mm including lobes; lobes broadly triangular to somewhat ovate-apiculate, 1 mm, erect after anthesis, completely glandular callose-thickened; sinus obtuse. Corolla slightly narrowed at base and throat, 18-20 mm long and 4.5 mm diameter, glabrous; lobes triangular or oblong, obtuse, 1 mm, tips callose-thickened. Stamens 18.5-19 mm; filaments pilose distal half, alternately either 2 or 4 mm; anthers including tubules alternately either 18 or 16 mm; thecae 5.5-6.5 mm. Style 19 mm. Berry spherical, glabrous, 11-12 mm diameter.

description: Terrestrial shrub 2 m tall; mature stems terete, striate, glabrous, reddish-brown; bark cracking longitudinally; twigs subterete, bluntly angled, striate, glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, oblong-elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 5-9.5 x 1.5-3 cm, basally rounded or obtuse, apically acuminate, marginally entire, glabrous on both surfaces, minutely fimbriate beneath, 5 (7)-plinerved with inner pair of lateral nerves arising up to 2 cm above base, midrib thickened and raised in the proximal 2 cm, then impressed rest of length above, raised beneath, lateral nerves plane to slightly raised above, raised beneath, reticulate veinlets raised on both surfaces; petiole thin, subterete, +/- flattened above, rugose, 5-9 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescence axillary, short- to long-racemose, sometimes appearing fasciculate, (4) 10-15-flowered; rachis subterete, bluntly angled, glabrous, 0.3-1.6 cm long and 1.2 mm diam; floral bracts caducous in bud, concave, elliptic, ca 7 x 4.5 mm, apically obtuse to rounded, glabrous, apex and margins curling outward before falling, dark reddish-orange when fresh; pedicel terete, striate, 9 mm long, glabrous, glandular-fimbriate at articulation; bracteoles basal, caducous, elliptic, 2 x 1.5 mm, apically obtuse, marginally glandular-fimbriate. Flowers with calyx glabrous, 5.3 mm long, dark orange when fresh, hypanthium cylindric-campan- ulate, 1.3 mm long, lobes broadly triangular, 1 mm long, eglandular, sinus broadly rounded; corolla cylindric to bottle-shaped, but abruptly and narrowly constricted at throat, very thick carnose with walls to 2 mm thick at middle when fresh, 15.5 mm long, 8.5 mm diam at middle and 3 mm diam at throat, glabrous, bright orange when fresh but constricted limb and lobes white, lobes erect, triangular, ca 2 mm long, bistratose; stamens 11.6 mm long, filaments alternately 2.5 mm and 4.5 mm long, ventrally weakly puberulent, anthers alternately 10.2 mm and 7.6 mm long, thecae 3.5-4.5 mm long; style 13-14 mm long, glabrous. description: Epiphytic shrub; stem subterete, bluntly angled, smooth or minutely striate, nitid, glabrous; twigs subterete, slightly angled, smooth, glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, narrowly ovate or ovate-elliptic, 7-11.5 X 1.3- 3.2 cm, base obtuse or rounded, apex gradually tapering and acuminate, glabrous, also with deciduous, minute, glandular-fimbriae beneath; 3(5)-plinerved, midrib impressed above, raised and conspicuous beneath, lat- eral nerves slightly raised but relatively inconspicuous above, slightly raised beneath, reticulate veinlets slightly raised and con- spicuous above, slightly raised but obscure beneath; petioles terete or subterete, rugose, 2-4 mm long and 1 mm diam., weakly short-pilose, glabrate. Inflorescence subspherical, racemose, 4-11-flowered, surrounded at the base by a series of ovate to oblong, glabrous bracts; floral bract smooth, but venation well-marked on both surfaces, obovate or oblong-elliptic, 16-24 X 8-15 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse or rounded, glabrous, pinkish lilac when fresh; pedicel terete or subterete, sometimes ribbed, 5.5- 7 mm long and ca. 1 mm diam., glabrous; bracteoles basal, ovate, ca. 1 mm long, mar- ginally with thick cartilaginous teeth. Flowers with calyx 5-7 mm long, glabrous; hypanthium cylindric, slightly rugose, 1.5-2 mm long and 2-2.5 mm diam., the base apophysate with a relatively smooth margin; limb spreading-campanulate, 3.5-5 mm long including the lobes; lobes slightly striate, long-triangular, 2.5-3 X 1.5-2 mm, erect after anthesis, the margin scarious and bearing ca. 3 or 4 oblong to fimbriate glands proximally, these becoming thickened cartilaginous teeth distally; sinuses obtuse; corolla cylindric but narrowed at the throat, 1.8-2.2 cm long and 3-4.5 mm diam. when dry, basal 2/3 red and distal 1/3 white, the lobes erect, somewhat ovate-triangular, acute, 0.7-1 mm long, white; stamens of overall equal length, ca. 1.8 cm long; filaments alternately 2-3 mm and ca. 4 mm long, glabrous or very weakly puberulent distally; anthers alternately ca. 17 mm and ca. 14.5 mm long; thecae ca. 4-5 mm long; tubules alternately ca. 13 mm and 11 mm long; style ca. 2 cm long, glabrous. description: Frutex terrestris 2.5-3 m altus; petioli glabri vel raro puberuli, (2.5-)6-8(-10) mm longi; folia elliptica, lanceolato-elliptica vel ovato-lanceolata, 9-16 cm X 3-6 cm, basi acuta vel anguste obtusa raro rotundata, apice acuminata vel aliquantum caudato-acuminata; inflorescentia 11-21(-26)-flora; rhachides (3-)8-15 cm longae; bracteae florales roseae, oblongae vel oblanceolatae raro obovatae, 3-5 cm X 1-2 cm, marginibus glandulosae; pedicelli (11-) 15-19 mm longi, leviter glandulosi; bracte- olae ovatae vel lanceolatae, 1.5-2(-4) mm longae, marginibus et apicibus glandulosae; calycis glabri 4-6 mm longi, tubus 1.5-2 mm longus nonapophysatus, dense glandulosus, limbus cylindrico-cam- panulatus lobis calloso-incrassatis et glandulosis secus margines inclusis 2.5-3.5 mm longus; corolla alba, 2.5-3.5 cm longa, glabra vel pilosa; stamina subaequalia, 27-30 mm longa, filamentis alternatim 4-6 mm et 10-13.5 mm longis, antheris tubulis inclusis alternatim 17-20.5 mm et 25-27 mm longis; stylus 25-31 mm longus.

description: Erect, often arching, terrestrial shrub, 2.5-3 m tall. Petioles flattened adaxially, (2.5-)6-8(-10) mm long, glabrous or puberulent. Leaves elliptic, lance-elliptic to ovate-lanceolate, 9-16 cm long and 3-6 cm broad, basally acute to narrowly obtuse, rarely rounded, apically acuminate to somewhat caudate-acuminate, glabrous, but with reddish-globular glands, 0.1-0.2 mm in diameter along upper leaf surface, these often caducous leaving a reddish or blackish papillate scar, 5(-7) plinerved. Inflorescence viscid, 11-21 (-26) flowered (often with lowest several nodes sterile); rachis flexuous distally, glabrous or rarely puberulent, (3-)8-15 cm long, provided along its length and especially at base with tiny, peltate, globular reddish glands. Floral bracts gla- brous, oblong to oblanceolate, rarely obovate, basally narrowed to a slightly clasping base, apically rounded to narrowly obtuse, 3-5 cm long and 1-2 cm broad, pink marginally with 7-23 dark red, globular, peltate or sessile glands about 0.7 mm in diameter. Pedicels glabrous, (11-) 15-19 mm long and 1-1.5 mm in diameter, with scattered, globular, reddish glands. Bracteoles ovate to lanceolate, 1.5-2(-4) mm long and 1-2 mm broad, pink, with scattered, dark red, globular glands both along margins and apically. Calyx glabrous, 4-6 mm long; tube cylindric or spreading, rugose to strongly ribbed, 1.5-2 mm long and 2.5 mm in diameter, nonapophysate, usually so densely covered by dark red, globular to disc-shaped, peltate glands as to obscure surface; limb cylindric-campanulate, (2.5-)3-3.5 mm long including lobes, with scattered, globular to disc-shaped, peltate glands; lobes triangular, obtuse, 1-1.5 mm long and 1.5 mm broad, erect after anthesis, marginally glandular callose- thickened with glands contiguous at lobe apices; sinus broadly rounded. Corolla constricted basally, narrowed to throat, 2.5-3.5 cm long and 8-10 mm in diameter, glabrous or pilose (then glabrous at constricted base), white; lobes triangular, obtuse, 1-2 mm long. Stamens 27-30 mm long; filaments slightly coherent basally, strigose distally, alternately either 4-6 mm or 10-13.5 mm long; anthers including tubules alternately either 17-20.5 mm or 25-27 mm long; thecae 7.5-11 mm long. Style 25-31 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphyte or terrestrial shrub with branches arching to 2 m long; mature stems terete, smooth, glabrous, tan when dry, with odor of anise when freshly cut; immature twigs subterete, striate, glabrous, tan when dry. Leaves coriaceous, ovate-lanceolate, (4) 9-16 (20) x (1.5) 4-7 (9) cm, basally rounded and subcordate, apically acuminate, the apex itself obtuse, light brown when dry, glabrous, pinnately veined (or weakly plinerved) with 4-5 pairs of opposite lateral veins, the midrib thick and raised the proximal ?2 to 2/3 becoming thin and slightly impressed distally, the lateral nerves impressed above causing the leaves to be bullate, anastomosing near the margins and raised and conspicuous beneath, reticulate veins slightly raised on both surfaces; petioles terete, rugose, 4-7 (10) mm long, 1.5-2 (4) mm in diam, reddish-brown when dry. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 16-25 (35)-flowered; rachis bluntly angled, striate, glabrous, 10-20 cm long, 3 mm in basal diam, green but heavily suffused with purple when fresh, drying purple; floral bracts membranaceous, conspicuously striate, ovate to oblong-ovate, 13- 20 x 6-11 mm, basally clasping, glabrous, dark wine-red when fresh; pedicels subterete, weakly striate, glabrous, 4-4.5 (6) cm long, ca 1 mm in diam at anthesis, green but heavily suffused with purple when fresh; bracteoles coriaceous, op- posite to subopposite, conspicuously striate, broadly ovate, somewhat cucullate, basally clasping, 3-4 mm long and 4-5 mm broad, glabrous but the margins glandular callose-thickened the distal 3/4, dark wine-red when fresh. Flowers with the calyx glabrous, 10-11 mm long, ca 7 mm in diam at the middle; hypanthium cylindrical, 4-5 mm long, strongly apophysate, the margin of the apophysis smooth; limb cylindric slightly swollen at the middle, 5-6 mm long including the lobes; lobes erect after anthesis, broadly ovate, apiculate, 2 mm long and 4 mm broad, entire upper half glandular callose-thickened, the young lobes secreting a white viscid latex when fresh; sinus acute, corolla cylindric but sharply constrict- ed and narrowed at the throat, glabrous, ca 35 mm long and 9 mm in diam, the tube dark wine-red, the lobes erect at anthesis, triangular, acute, about 2 mm long, whitish-red when fresh; stamens equal, ca 28-30 mm long; filaments distinct, alternating 9-11 mm and 4-5 mm long, the short one essentially glabrous, the long one puberulent medially; anthers including tubules alternately 8 mm and 10-11 mm long; tubules dehiscent by clefts 5-7 mm long; style glabrous, 35 mm long. Berry purple.

description: Frutex 1.5 m., ramulis cinereo- pubescentibus; petiolis ad 2 mm. longis; laminis coriaceis in sicco, oblongis, 3-5 cm. longis, 1.5-2.5 cm. latis, basi subcordatis, apice obtusis vel abrupte apiculatis, supra glabris subtus pubescentibus, quintuplinerviis, margine integris; inflorescentia ad apicem ramulorum racemosa 20-flora 6 cm. longa, bracteis glabris membranaceis, maximis circiter 2 cm. longis, 1 cm. latis apice rotundatis; rha- chidibus glabris sub anthesi 5.5 cm. longis; pedicellis glabris circiter 5 mm. longis, bracteolis late lanceolatis 2-3 mm. longis; floribus extus glabris; calyce circiter 3 mm. longo, limbo circiter 1 mm. longo; lobis 5 deltoideis acutis, sinibus rotundatis; corolla tenuiter carnosa, glabra cylindrica, sub anthesi 18-20 mm. longa et 4-5 mm. lata, apice paullo contracta, lobis deltoideis acutis circiter 1.5 mm. longis; staminibus 10, filamentis glabris alternatim circiter 1.5 et 4 mm. longis, antheis alternatim circiter 12.5 et 15 mm. longis, tubulis quam thecis paullo longioribus per rimas elongatas dehiscentibus; stylo filiformi corollam subaequante subtruncato.

description: Terrestrial shrub with branches to 2 m long; stems terete, minutely striate, hispid with hairs to 1.5 mm long. Leaves coriaceous, ovate or oblong-ovate, 7-16 x 2.5-5.5 cm, basally subcordate, apically acuminate, olive-green on both surfaces, glandular-fimbriate, glabrous above and short-hispid beneath; 5-7 (9)-plinerved, midrib and lateral nerves impressed proximally and plane distally above but raised beneath causing leaves to be somewhat bullate basally, reticulate veinlets slightly raised but inconspicuous on both surfaces; petioles terete, ru- gose, hispid, 2-7 mm long and 1-2 mm in diam. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, ca 25-flowered, proximal one-fourth with sterile bracts and nodes, distal three- fourths floriferous; rachis subterete, narrowly fusiform, densely hispid, 3.5-4.5 cm long and 2 mm in basal diam becoming 3.5 mm in diam distally; floral bracts subcoriaceous, conspicuously striate, appressed to flowers, ovate, acute, ca 3.5 x 1.7 cm, densely short-pilose on both surfaces, red at anthesis, proximal bracts sterile and spreading to reflexed, persistent; pedicels ca 0.5 mm long, short- pilose; bracteoles none. Flowers: calyx densely short-pilose, 12 mm long; hy- panthium cylindric, 2.5-3 mm long; limb 9.5-10 mm long including the lobes, these triangular, acuminate, eglandular, 5-6 mm long; sinus obtuse; corolla cylindric, densely short-pilose over entire length, when fresh white in lower two-thirds and pale green in upper one-third, lobes deltoid, 1-2 mm long; stamens unequal, alternately ca 12 mm and 13.5 mm long; filaments distinct, glabrous, alternately 2.5 mm and 4.5 mm long; anthers alternately 11.2-12 mm and 9.5-10.5 mm long including tubules; thecae alternately 3.5-4 mm and 4-4.5 mm long; dehiscence through clefts 2-3 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial shrub to 3 m tall; mature stems terete, the epidermis shedding in longitudinal strips to expose an inner reddish-brown bark; immature stems and twigs of new growth terete to subterete and bluntly angled, densely white pilose with trichomes to 1 mm long. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to oblong-ovate, (2.5) 4- 6 (8) x (1.5) 2.5-4 (4.5) cm, basally rounded and cordate, apically rounded or rarely obtuse, densely short pilose on both surfaces becoming glabrous above with age, the lower surface also with scattered glandular fimbriae; 5 (7)-plinerved from the base, the midrib and lateral nerves impressed above and conspicuously elevated beneath making the leaves bullate, the reticulate veinlets slightly raised but inconspicuous on both surfaces; petioles subterete, flattened dorsally, densely pilose, 3-5 mm long and 2-3 mm in diam. Inflorescence axillary, short racemose, ca 10-12-flowered; rachis subterete, congested by the overlapping nodes, densely short pilose, 1-2 cm long; floral bracts membranaceous, obovate, 9 mm long and 8 mm broad, tightly appressed to the flower, apically retuse, red when fresh, concealing the calyx and lower half of the corolla; pedicels terete and swollen distally, pilose, 2 mm long and 2-3 mm in diam; bracteoles oblong, mucronate, keeled, clasping the calyx, 6-8 mm long and 3 mm broad when flattened. Flowers with the calyx 4.8-6 mm long, pilose especially on the limb and lobes; hypanthium subcylindric-subpentagonal, 1.5-2 mm long, basally truncate; limb cylindric, 3- 4 mm long including the lobes; lobes connivent after anthesis, triangular, acute- acuminate, 1-1.2 mm long, marginally glandular-fimbriate (see Fig. 26D inset); sinus rounded; corolla tubular, slightly broadened towards the base, pilose the upper 3/4 but glabrous the lower 1/4, 11-12 mm long and 5-6 mm in diam, white when fresh, lobes deltoid, 0.8 mm long, slightly spreading at anthesis; stamens equal, 7.7-9 mm long; filaments distinct, pilose distally along the margins and on the dorsal surface, alternately 3-3.8 mm and 1.7-2 mm long; anthers including tubules alternately 6-6.5 mm and 6.3-7.8 mm long; thecae slightly granular, 3 mm long; style glabrous, 11 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphyte or terrestrial shrub with branches to 2 m long, totally glabrous (except filaments of stamens); stems terete or subterete and complanate, striate, reddish- brown when dry. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic or oblong-elliptic, 7-15 x 2.5-4.5 (5.5) cm, basally rounded or obtuse, apically long-acuminate or somewhat caudate-acuminate (acumen then 1.5-2 cm long), olive-green above and brown be- neath when dry; (3) 5-7 (9)-plinerved from base with midrib, lateral nerves, and reticulate veinlets impressed above and raised beneath; petioles terete, rugose, 5-8 mm long and 1-2 mm in diam. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, ca 20-flowered, the flowers restricted to distal one-fourth of inflorescence; rachis fusiform, subterete, 4-5 cm long, 2.5 mm in basal diam and ca 4-5 mm in diam distally; floral bracts: those of proximal three-fourths of inflorescence subcoriaceous, striate, oblong-lanceolate, apically obtuse or subacute, to 2.5 x 1 cm, caducous so that at anthesis inflorescence appears pedunculate, the next few sterile and wide-spreading to reflexed, the distal floriferous ones subcoriaceous, striate, ap- pressed, oblong, apically rounded or obtuse, 3.5 x 1.5 cm, glandular-fimbriate near midrib, red at anthesis when fresh; pedicels obconic, 2 mm long, bibracteo- late at distal tip; bracteoles similar to distal floral bracts but ca 3 x 1 cm. Flowers: calyx 8.5 mm long, white when fresh; hypanthium campanulate, truncate basally, 3.5 mm long; limb spreading, striate, 5 mm long including lobes, those triangular, eglandular, 3 mm long; sinus obtuse; corolla tubular but tapering distally, 34 mm long and 8 mm in diam, when fresh white in lower two-thirds and pale green in upper one-third, lobes triangular, 1 mm long; stamens unequal, alternately ca 15.8 mm and 14.2 mm long; filaments connate into a tube 4 mm long, individual fila- ments alternately 5.7 mm and 4 mm long, the long one basally 1.1 mm broad tapering distally to 0.3-0.4 mm and short-hirtellous medially, the short one 1.1 mm broad throughout its length and short-hirtellous distally; anthers alternately 9.3 mm and 10.5 mm long including tubules; thecae granular, rigid, 3.5 mm long; tubules dehiscing by clefts 3-4.5 mm long; style ca 33.5 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic liana (according to label data). Petiole subterete, 2-3.5 mm long, densely puberulent. Leaves linear-lanceolate to linear-elliptic, 9-14 cm long and 1-1.5 cm broad, basally broadly obtuse or rounded, slightly cordate, apically long-attenuate, acute, glabrous, margins strongly revolute, 3 (-5) plinerved. Inflorescence 12-14 flow- ered with lowest nodes sterile; rachis bluntly angled, glabrous, 5-10 cm long, with globular glands scattered along the rachis. Floral bracts somewhat ribbed, short cili- ate apically, oblong or oval-elliptic, basally narrowed and rounded, apically obtuse or acute, 13-19 mm long and 5-7 mm broad, pink (fide label data), margins with sessile, globular glands to 0.2 mm in diameter, 3-7 per side. Pedicels subterete, 1 mm long (but immature), glabrous, provided with few, globular glands. Bracteoles oblong, oblong-elliptic or oval, 8-10 mm long and 4-5.5 mm broad, basally rounded, apically broadly rounded, glabrous, completely enveloping floral buds, marginally with few, sessile, globular glands. Calyx immature, glabrous; tube one-fifth total length of calyx, appearing non-apophysate, surface obscured from view by peltate subsessile, globular glands; limb appearing campanulate; lobes triangular, margins conspicuously glandu- lar callose-thickened, the thickenings nearly contiguous at lobe apex; sinus obtuse. Corolla immature. Berry not seen.

description: Frutex terrestris, omnino glaber; petioli 4-10 mm longi; folia crassissima, coriacea, lanceolata vel lanceolato-ovata, 11-16 cm X 5-9 cm, basi breviter attenuata, apice acuta vel cuspidata, marginibus arcte revolutis; inflorescentia 9-15-flora; rhachides 3-4 cm longae; bracteae florales ellipticae, con- cavae, 14-20 mm X 11-12 mm; pedicelli 3.5-7.5 mm longi; bracteolae oblongae, 2-3 mm X 2 mm; calycis 9-11 mm longi, tubus 4-5 mm longus, nonapophysatus, limbus cylindricus lobis junioribus glanduloso-fimbriatis secus margines inclusis 5-6.5 mm longus; corolla immature; stylus maturus 10-11 mm longus.
