description: Terrestrial shrub, glabrous throughout. Petioles flattened adaxially, 4-10 mm long. Leaves very thickly coriaceous, lanceolate to lance-ovate, 11-16 cm long and 5-9 cm broad, basally short attenuate, somewhat decurrent, apically acute, somewhat cus- pidate, margins entire and extremely tightly revolute, 5-7 plinerved. Inflorescences 9-15 flowered; rachis coarsely angled, 3-4 cm long. Floral bracts marginally glandu- lar fimbriate, elliptic, concave, 14-20 mm long and 11-12 mm broad, basally cuneate and truncate, apically rounded. Pedicels striate, 3.5-7.5 mm long. Bracteoles oblong, marginally glandular fimbriate, 2-3 mm long and 2 mm broad. Calyx 9-11 mm long, with reddish, glandular fimbriae on tube when immature; tube cylindric to barrel shaped, 4-5 mm long and 4.5-5.5 mm in diameter, non-apophysate; limb cylindric, 5-6.5 mm long including lobes; lobes oblong to broadly triangular, marginally densely glandular fimbriate when young, soon caducous, 2-2.5 mm long and 2.5-3 mm broad; sinus acute. Corolla immature. Style persistent, 10-11 mm long. Mature berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial or epiphytic shrub with mature stems to 5 cm in diam and 4 m tall; immature stems somewhat soft-wooded, subterete or complanate, striate, gla- brous, drying dark reddish-brown. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, (2.5) 4-6.5 x (1) 1.5-3 cm, basally rounded to slightly subcordate, apically round- ed to broadly acute, the uppermost leaves sometimes apiculate, glabrous but with a few scattered fimbriae on lower surface; 5-plinerved often appearing pinnately veined, the midrib impressed above and conspicuously raised beneath, the lateral nerves impressed above and raised beneath with the inner pair arising ca 1 cm above the base and extending nearly to the distal tip, the outer pair arising from the base but extending only l3-?2 way up the lamina, the reticulate veinlets slightly raised on both surfaces but inconspicuous; petioles terete, rugose, 3-7 mm long and 1-2 mm in diam, glabrous, dark reddish-brown. Inflorescence ax- illary, racemose, 15-20 (30)-flowered; rachis subterete, bluntly to sharply angled, conspicuously striate, glabrous, 6-8 (13) cm long and 2.5-3 (4) mm in basal diam; floral bracts membranaceous, oblong to elliptic, slightly concave, (18) 20-22 x (8) 12-14 mm, basally slightly auriculate, apically rounded, the margins thinner than the main body of the bract, glabrous, dark red when fresh; pedicels subte- rete, striate and angular, glabrous, 18-20 (24) mm long and 1 mm in diam; brac- teoles ovate, acute, 1.5 mm long, apically with a tuft of short hairs, marginally glandular-fimbriate. Flowers with the calyx glabrous, 8-9.5 mm long, dark waxy red when living; hypanthium cylindric, basally strongly apophysate (especially after drying), slightly 10-ribbed, 4-5 mm long; limb cylindric or slightly spreading, 5-6 mm long including the lobes; lobes triangular, acute, apex itself blunt, erect after anthesis, 1.5 mm long and ca 3 mm broad at the base, marginally provided with minute oblong glands (usually two/side) which are easily broken off upon drying (Fig. 16); sinus rounded or obtuse; corolla cylindric, slightly wider towards the base and constricted distally, glabrous, (20) 24-25 mm long and ca 8 mm in diam, lower 3/4 bright dark waxy red, upper 1/4 plus lobes yellowish-white when fresh, the lobes triangular, 2 mm long, spreading to reflexed at anthesis; stamens equal, 20-21 mm long; filaments distinct to lightly coherent the basal half, puberulent the distal half, alternately 7 mm and 5-6 mm long; anthers including the tubules alternately 15 mm and 17 mm long; thecae slightly granular, alternately 6-6.5 mm and 5.5-6 mm long, dehiscing through clefts alternately 8-9 mm and 7 mm long; style 23-25 mm long. Berry immature, 14 mm in diam.

description: Frutex epiphyticus, ubique glaber; petioli 7-10 mm longi; folia lanceolato-elliptica vel oblongo- lanceolata, 10.5-17.5 cm X 2.5-6 cm, basi rotundata vel obtusa, apice brevia acuminata; inflores- centia 9-12-flora; rhachides 1.5-2.5 cm longae; bracteae florales spathulatae, apice rotundatae et profunde emarginatae, 33-45 mm longae, apice 15-20 mm et basi 2-6 mm latae; pedicelli 8-10 mm longi; bracteolae spathulatae, 36-44 mm longae, apice 10-12 mm et basi 1 mm latae; calycis 8-8.5 mm longi, tubus 3-3.5 mm longus apophysatus, limbus cylindricus lobis calloso-incrassatis et glan- dulosis secus margines 3-3.5 mm longis inclusis 5 mm longus; corolla immatura; styli persistentes 33-35 mm longi.

description: Epiphytic shrub, glabrous throughout. Petioles 7-10 mm long. Leaves lance-elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, 10.5-17.5 cm long and 2.5-6 cm broad, basally rounded or nar- rowly obtuse, apically short acuminate, 3-5 plinerved. Inflorescence 9-12 flowered, with lowest few nodes sterile; rachis 1.5-2.5 cm long. Floral bracts translucent when dry, spatulate, apically rounded and deeply emarginate, 33-45 mm long and 15-30 mm broad at top, narrowing sharply to 2-6 mm at base, pale reddish-violet, lamina with tiny, red, clavate glands abaxially. Pedicels 8-10 mm long. Bracteoles similar to floral bracts, but 36-44 mm long and 10-12 mm broad at top, narrowing to about 1 mm at base, conspicuously imbricate distally when in bud, margins without glandu- lar fimbriae or callose-thickenings. Calyx 8-8.5 mm long; tube bluntly 5-angled, 3- 3.5 mm long, shallowly apophysate basally, with apophysis undulate not lobed; limb cylindric, 5 mm long including lobes; lobes narrowly triangular, acute, 3-3.5 mm long, erect-after anthesis, marginally glandular callose-thickened, glands oblong and running length of each side of lobe; sinus obtuse. Corolla immature, but judging from per- sistent styles, probably about 35 mm long. Style 33-35 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial or epiphytic shrub with stems to 3 m long; mature branches terete, striate, glabrous, reddish brown; twigs bluntly angled, smooth or striate, glabrous, reddish brown. Leaves coriaceous, lance-elliptic or lanceolate-ovate, 3-13 X 1.5-4.8 cm, basally narrowly attenuate, somewhat short- decurrent onto petiole, apically obtuse to short-acuminate, glabrous, sparsely brown-punctate beneath, young leaves densely covered with brown exudate; 3-plinerved, midrib and lateral nerves slightly impressed above, very conspicuous beneath, some- what reddish toward the base, veinlets obscurely reticulate; petioles terete or subterete, rugose, (0.3-)1-1.5 cm long and 1-2 mm diam., glabrous, red. Inflorescence fasciculate, (1-)3-5-flowered; floral bracts membranous, triangular, ca. 3-5 X 2 mm, basally truncate, apically obtuse or sub- acute, glabrous, marginally glandular-fimbriate; pedicels terete, smooth, short-pilose with white hairs, 3.5-4 mm long and ca. 1 mm diam.; bracteoles basal, submembranous, subrugose, ovate, ca. 2.8 X 2 mm, with persistent white hairs on midrib, marginally glandular-fimbriate. Flowers: calyx gla- brous to pubescent with spreading hairs, 5-8 mm long, reddish green to rose or reddish orange; hypanthium cylindric, subrugose, 2.2-2.7 X 2.5-2.8 mm, basally slightly apophysate with a narrow rim or collar; limb subcylindric, slightly spreading or campanulate, 2.2-2.8 mm long; lobes triangular, subacute, 1-2 X ca. 2 mm, pilose to glabrous; sinuses obtuse; corolla bottle- shaped and bluntly 5-angled when fresh, slightly constricted basally and narrowing to throat, 9-12 mm long and 3-6 mm diam. at widest point, pilose with spreading hairs, white at very base and reddish orange above, the lobes triangular, subacute, erect to slightly flaring, ca. 1 mm long; stamens alternately 7-8.8 mm and 8-9 mm long; filaments alternately 3-5 mm and 2-2.8 mm long, nigrescent, glabrous, or sparsely puberulous distally; anthers alternately 6-6.2 mm and 7-7.2 mm; thecae slightly granular, 2-3 mm long; tubules ca. 3-5.2 mm long; style glabrous; stigma truncate, disk-like. Berry suboblong, red to dark purple.

description: Lianoid shrub to 2 m tall or high-climbing epiphytic vine. Mature stems terete or somewhat flattened, smooth, glaucous, glabrous, reddish-brown to tan when dry; twigs with scattered, tiny, subsphaerical glands. Petioles terete or flattened dorsally, slightly rugose, glabrous or distally puberulent, (4) 8-12 mm long and (1) 2-2.5 mm in diam, reddish-brown. Leaves coriaceous, alternate, oblong or oblong-elliptic, (8) 12-17 cm X (3) 4-6 cm, basally obtuse, rounded or rarely truncate, apically abruptly long or short caudate-acuminate, entire, short-pilose along nerves above, glabrous beneath, both surfaces with caducous glandular fimbriae; pinnatinerved with 4-6 lateral veins per side, rarely appearing plinerved, midrib noticeably thickened in the proximal half, impressed above and conspicuously raised beneath, lateral veins impressed above and raised beneath, arching from the midrib at 450 and anastomosing near the margin to form a collective nerve, veinlets slightly raised on both surfaces. Inflorescence axillary, solitary, racemose, 13-19-flowered, somewhat fusiform in bud; rachis subterete, bluntly angled, glabrous, 6-8.5 cm long and 2.5-3.5 mm in basal diam. Floral bracts membranaceous, oblong or oblanceolate, apically obtuse or rounded, 3.5-5 cm X 1.5-2.5 cm, pink to deep red when fresh (fide label data).Pedicels subterete, glabrous, ca 8 x 1-1.2 mm at anthesis elongating to 15 mm. Bracteoles oblong-lanceolate, cucullate, 2.5-3.5 x 1 mm, with a conspicuous midrib, and glandular callose-thickened marginally for the distal one-third. Calyx glabrous, 7.5-9 mm long; tube subcylindric, rugose, 2-3.5 mm long, basally apophysate and lobed; limb erect, cylindric, striate, 5-5.5 mm long including the lobes; lobes triangular or ovate, acute, 1.5-2.5 mm long, completely or only the distal two-thirds glandular-callose; sinus acute. Corolla cylindric, in bud soft puberulent or glabrous, glabrous at anthesis, 25-31 mm long and 5-7 mm diam, whitish- to violet-blue or grayish- to purplish-pink (fide label data); lobes triangular, obtuse, 2 mm long with an oblanceolate callose-thickened area in the middle. Stamens 10, 26-28 mm long; filaments distinct, the short one (2-5 mm) glabrous, the long (9-10 mm) sparsely pilose; anthers alternately 22 mm and 25-26 mm long including the tubules; thecae 10-12 mm long. Style glabrous, 23-29 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Frutex epiphyticus 7-10 dm altus vel terrestris 1-3 m altus; petioli glabri vel juniores adaxialiter leviter pilosi, 7-13 mm longi; folia lanceolata vel lanceolato-elliptica, (3-)5-9(-11) cm X (1-)2-4 cm, basi aut obtusa aut rotundata et tunc saepe breviter decurrentia, apice acuminata; inflorescentia (2-)3-6(-9)-flora, ante anthesis obconica vel sphaerica; rhachides (0.3-)0.6-1.2(-3.2) cm longae; bracteae florales pallide virides, oblongae vel oblanceolatae, (1.5-) 2-3 (-4) cm X 0.5-1(-2) cm, apice rotundatae vel obtusae et plerumque emarginatae; pedicelli (6-) 8-13 (-15) mm longi; bracte- olae lineari-lanceolatae, 1-2.5(-3) mm longae; calycis glabri, 5-7(-10) mm longi, tubus (1.5-)2-3 (-4) mm longus, basaliter apophysatus et profunde lobatus, limbus campanulatus vel cylindricus lobis calloso-incrassatis et glandulosis inclusis (2.5-)3.5-4.5(-6) mm longus; corolla glabra vel raro pilosa, violacea vel rosea 20-24(-30) mm longa; stamina 19-24.5 mm longa, filamentis alternatim 2.5-5 mm et 5-10 mm longis, antheris tubulis inclusis alternatim 13-20 mm et 17-22 mm longis; stylus 22-29 mm longus.

description: Epiphytic shrub 7-10 dm tall or terrestrial and 1-3 m tall. Petioles usually flat- tened adaxially, 7-13 mm long, glabrous to weakly pilose adaxially when young then persistent or glabrate when mature. Leaves lanceolate to lance-elliptic, (3-) 5-9 (-11 ) cm long and (1-) 2-4 cm broad, basally obtuse or rounded, lamina often short decur- rent along petiole, apically short acuminate and often abruptly so, glabrous or often with numerous short hairs at base of midrib adaxially, 5(-7) plinerved. Inflorescence (2-)3-6(-9) flowered, obconic to spherical in bud; rachis viscid, glabrous, (0.3-) 0.6-1.2 (-3.2) cm long, usually with minute cartilaginous teeth at base. Floral bracts usually translucent when dry, glabrous, usually with minute, red, glandular fimbriae abaxially, oblong to oblanceolate, or oblong-lanceolate, basally narrowed and some- what auriculate, apically rounded or obtuse, usually emarginate, or when young notched apically with notch almost completely filled with callose tissue, (1.5-)2-3 (-4) cm long and 0.5-1(-2) cm broad, pale green, but suffused with pink along margins and at base when fresh, but drying green. Pedicels linear-lanceolate, 1-2 (-3 ) mm long and 0.5-1 mm broad, apically acuminate and glandular callose-thickened distal half to two-thirds. Calyx glabrous, 5-7(-10) mm long; tube strongly ribbed, (1.5-)2-3(-4) mm long, basally apophysate and deeply lobed with lobes straight, extending to or just below articulation; limb campanulate to cylindric, (2.5-)3.5-4.5 (-6) mm long including lobes; lobes triangular, (0.7-)1-1.5(-2) mm long and 2-3 mm broad, erect after anthesis, completely glandular callose-thickened or only distal two thirds callose-thickened; sinus obtuse, broadly rounded or flat. Corolla slightly constricted basally, narrowed to throat, often translucent when dry, 20-24(-30) mm long and 5-7 mm in diameter, glabrous or rarely pilose, whitish at base and apex, otherwise pinkish-violet to rose-red; lobes triangular or oblong, acute, about 1 mm long, reflexed at anthesis, tips often callose-thickened, white with pinkish or violet margins. Stamens 19-24.5 mm long; filaments densely pilose, alternately either 2.5- 5 mm or 5-10 mm long; anthers including tubules alternately either 13-20 mm or 17-22 mm long; thecae 4.5-7 mm long. Style 22-29 mm long. Berry about 9 mm in diameter.

description: Frutex terrestris; petioli 3-4(-6) mm longi; folia bullata, oblonga vel oblongo-ovata, (2-)3.5- 5.5(-7) cm X (1.5-)2-4(-4.5) cm, basi rotundata et subcordata, apice rotundata vel obtusa; inflorescentia 10-14-flora; rhachides 1-2 (-4) cm longae, pilis crispis dense obtectae; bractae florales oblongae vel oblongo-ellipticae, 8-10 mm longae; pedicelli (1.5-)4.5-7 mm longi; bracteolae ovatae vel subulatae (0.5-)1-2 mm longae; calycis 6-9 mm longi, tubus 2-3 (-3.5) mm longus subapo- physatus, limbus lobis eglandulosis inclusis 3.5-6 mm longus; corolla pilose, 11.5-14 mm longa; stamina 8.5-10.5 mm longa, filamentis alternatim 2.5-3.5 mm et 3.5-5.5 mm longis, antheris tubulis inclusis alternatim 5-7.5 mm et 6.5-8.5 mm longis; stylus 10-13 mm longus.

description: Terrestrial and epiphytic shrubs, 0.5-2 m tall. Petioles 3-4(-6) mm long, densely white puberulent. Leaves bullate, oblong, or oblong-ovate, (2-)3.5-5.5(-7) cm long and (1.5-)2-4(-4.5) cm broad, basally rounded and subcordate, apically rounded or obtuse, densely short pilose along nerves and margins when young, usually persisting along nerves of upper surface, 3-5 (-7) plinerved. Inflorescence 10-14 flowered; rachis 1-2(-4) cm long, densely pilose with white, curly trichomes. Floral bracts glabrous or densely short pubescent with white, curly trichomes, marginally ciliate and glandular fimbriate, oblong or oblong-elliptic, basally rounded and somewhat clasping, apically rounded and often shallowly emarginate, 8-10 mm long and 5(-8) mm broad, purplish. Pedicels densely pilose with white, curly trichomes, rarely gla- brate, (1.5-)4.5-7 mm long, usually with tiny black, clavate glands distally. Bracte- oles ovate or subulate, (0.5-)1-2 mm long and to 1 mm broad, densely glandular fimbriate marginally, usually densely short pilose. Calyx 6-9 mm long, usually densely pilose with white, curly trichomes (rarely glabrate); tube barrel-shaped, 2-3(-3.5) mm long, basally with an inconspicuous rim or collar; limb cylindric or somewhat spreading, 3.5-6 mm long including lobes; lobes oblong-ovate or ovate, 1.5-2 mm long and 3 mm broad, usually somewhat connivent after anthesis, eglandular; sinus acute. Corolla pilose distally, rarely glabrate, 11.5-14 mm long and 4-5 mm in diameter, pink, pinkish-white, or purplish. Stamens 8.5-10.5 mm long; filaments pilose distally, alternately either 2.5-3.5 mm or 3.5-5.5 mm long; anthers including tubules alter- nately either 5-7.5 mm or 6.5-8.5 mm long; thecae 1-3 mm long. Style 10-13 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial shrub 1-1.5 m tall; mature stems subterete, smooth, nitid, glabrous, bark gray; immature twigs subterete, bluntly angled, striate, reddish-brown when dry, densely short pilose with white hairs. Leaves coriaceous, succulent when fresh, imbricate, somewhat clasping, ovate to oblong-ovate, 2-3 x 1.5-2 cm, basally rounded and cordate, apically narrowly rounded or obtuse, marginally thickened, ciliate, dark green with red margins when fresh, drying brownish- green, weakly 5 (7)-plinerved with the lateral nerves arising from the base, the midrib slightly impressed above, raised beneath, the lateral nerves slightly raised on both surfaces, the reticulate veinlets obscure above but very conspicuous beneath when dry; petiole subterete, channeled above, 1.5-2 mm long and in diam, densely short pilose, reddish-brown. Inflorescence axillary, composed of a single flower enveloped by a series of ca 23 persistent bracts; rachis none; the first 10 inflorescence bracts broadly ovate, 1-5 x 2-5 mm, the second 10-11 bracts (floral bracts) oblong, 11-26 x 9-12 mm, the inner two bracts located at the base of the pedicel (the bracteoles) also oblong ca 28 x 9-10 mm, all bracts marginally glandular-fimbriate, dull red when fresh; pedicel ca 0.5 mm long and 3 mm in diam, glabrous. Flowers with the calyx glabrous, 5-6 mm long; hypan- thium campanulate, smooth, 4-4.5 mm long, basally truncate, pale yellowish- green when fresh; limb campanulate, smooth, 2-2.5 mm long including the lobes, yellowish-green but suffused with pink when fresh; lobes triangular, acute, some- what connivent after anthesis, 1.5 mm long, marginally densely glandular-fim- briate these fimbriae sometimes partially fused at their bases (Figs. 14-15); sinus acute; corolla cylindric, slightly zygomorphic being curved distally, glabrous, 30 mm long and 6-7 mm in diam, dull red, the lobes oblong, acute, 2 mm long, yellowish-white when fresh; stamens equal, 22-23 mm long; filaments distinct, alternately 5 mm and 3 mm long, pilose along the margins and ventrally the distal half; anthers alternately 18 mm and 20 mm long including the tubules; thecae 6 mm and 7 mm long, slightly granular; dehiscence by clefts 9-10 mm long; style glabrous, 29 mm long. Mature berry not seen.

description: Terrestrial or epiphytic shrub to 2 m tall; mature stems terete, minutely striate, short-hirsute with yellowish to tan, flat, acicular hairs to ca. 1 mm long; bark reddish brown, apparently glaucous; twigs similar to mature stems, also provided with tiny red glands which break off leaving dark red papillae. Leaves chartacaeous when dry, ovate-elliptic, 7.5-12 X 3-5.2 cm, basally rounded, apically long-caudate-acuminate (the tip 2-3 cm long), marginally entire, persistently hirsute beneath, and also provided with tiny, red, capitate-glandular hairs (or fimbriae), somewhat glabrate above but persistently short-hirsute along veins; 5-7-plinerved from near the base, the midrib and lateral nerves impressed above and raised beneath, the reticulate veinlets slightly raised on both surfaces; petiole subterete, canaliculate above, rugose, glaucous, 5-6 mm long, moderately to densely hirsute especially at junction with blade above. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 9-11-flowered; rachis complanate, bluntly angled, thin, (4-)5.5-7 cm long and 1-1.3 mm diam. at base, hirsute, and also provided with short, stout, red, glandular hairs with minute capitate heads; floral bract charta- ceous, easily deciduous (caducous?), elliptic, 10-18 X 6-8 mm, apically rounded, marginally ciliolate, provided with tiny, capitate, glandular hairs dorsally, dark red when fresh; pedicels terete, rugose, 10-13 mm long, hirsute, minutely red glandular as rachis; bracteoles located near base, broadly ovate, acute, ca. 1.5 X 1 mm, the apex glan- dular callose and marginally with several stout glandular fimbriae which fuse distally, glabrous. Flowers with calyx green when fresh, ca. 6 mm long; hypanthium cylindric, ca. 2 mm long, basally apophysate and un- dulate, densely hirsute and provided with red glandular hairs with minute capitate heads as rachis; limb erect to slightly spreading, ca. 4 mm long, glabrous, with scattered red glandular hairs proximally as hypanthium; lobes broadly deltate, acute, ca. 2 mm long, completely glandular-callose, dark maroon when fresh; sinuses acute; corolla cylindric, bluntly pentagonal, viscid (when fresh), 17-19 mm long and 6- 8 mm diam., glabrous, translucent pale green, the lobes reflexed at anthesis, deltate, ca. 2 mm long, whitish; stamens 16.3-17 mm long; filaments alternately 2.7-3 mm and 5-6.3 mm long; anthers alternately 15.3-16 mm and 13-14 mm long; thecae alternately 4.6-5.5 and 5.6-5.8 mm long; style about equalling corolla, glabrous. Berry not seen.

description: Arbor circa 4 m alta ramis terminalibus nodosis internodiis 15-18 mm longis (in specimine) asperis, pilis rigidis hamatis dense tectis. Folia subcoriacea peltata. Lamina palmata in 9 lobis usque prope basim fissa; lobo maximo ab insertione petioli usque ad apicem 17-22 cm longo et 8.5-10.5 cm lato, minimo 10-12 cm longo et 4.5-6 cm lato, parte centrali integra 3-2 cm radii; lobis obovato-oblongis apice subrotundatis ad basim paulo contractis et plicatis margine in majoribus saepe prope basim 1-lobatis (aspectu lyrato) lobis secundariis late oblongis obtusissimis ad 2 cm longis; supra viridis leviter asperula pilis rigidis acutis basi tuberculatis sparsis et minute tuberculato- granulosa nervis principalibus conspicuis reticulo paulo visibili; subtus alba dense lanuginoso-arachnoidea costis elevatis arachnoideis et basim versus plus minusve villosis, nervis secundariis aseendentibus prominentibus etiam indutis 10-15 mm inter se distantibus, nervis tertiis parallelis prominulis reticulo velato. Petiolus 28-34 cm longus striatus parce tenuiterque arachnoideus et basim plus minusve puberulus; pulvinulo badio hirsuto-velutino. Stipula oblonga acuta extus sparse puberula et albo-arachnoidea, intus glabra vel marginem versus puberula; circa 11 cm longa. Infloreseentiae masculae axillares geminatae; pedunculi graciles sed rigidi complanati 5-7 cm longi, 3 X 2 mm crassi valde hispidulo-hirsuti. Spatha ovato-oblonga apice attenuata breviter apiculata, 6-6.5 cm longa submembranacea, sparse villosa et albido-arachnoidea, intus glabra. Amenta mascula sessilia praecipue 8, interdum bifida, 3.5-5.5 cm longa, 4-5 mm crassa, receptaculo mi- nute hispido, perigonio oblongo laevi sparsissimis pilis arachnoideis munito.

description: Culmi rhizomati multiramosi ad 25 cm. alti; folia 3.5-7 cm. longa, 1-2 mm. vel minus lata ad basim, glabra praeter margines sparse pubeseentes; culmi floriferi cum infloreseentiis 7-9 cm. alti; spicae brunneae vel stramineae, 3-5 mm. longae; achaenia straminea vel brunnea, 4 mm. longa, ad 0.5 mm. diam., glabra praeter margines superiores scabridulas; pili hypogyni ad 1 mm. longi.

description: Stem much-branched, to at least 25 cm. tall. Leaf sheaths stramineous, striate; ligules narrowly triangular, 4-5 mm. long; leaf blades 3.5-7 cm. long, 1-2 mm. broad or less at the base, stramineous above and beneath, glabrous except for scattered minute marginal pubeseence near the base of the- blades. Flowering culms, including infloreseence, 7-9 cm. tall, the infloreseence composing one-third of the total length; sheath of lowermost infloreseence bract 3-6 mm. long, the blade 3-5 times longer than the sheath; upper bracts similar but smaller. Spikes stramineous, brownish or somewhat reddish tinged, 3-5 mm. long, composed of 10-20 or more spikelets. Staminate spikelets 2-3.5 mm. long; glumes narrowly ovate or lanceolate, acute or mucronulate; anthers 1.5-2 mm. long. Pistillate spikelets slightly larger than the staminate; glumes lanceolate to narrowly lanceolate. Achenes stramineous or brownish, 4 mm. long and about 0.5 mm. in diam. at base, obscurelS triangular toward the apex, glabrous except for the minutely scabridulous apical angles; perianthial bristles scanty, about 1 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Gilly, Charles L. 1943. An Afro-South-American Cyperaceous complex. Brittonia. 5: 1-20. f. 1.

description: Stems stout, up to 8 cm. tall. Leaf sheaths dark reddish-purple, obscurely striate; ligules obtuse or emarginate, prolonged 2-3 mm. beyond base of blade; leaf blades 4-8 mm. wide at base, 10-30 cm. long, olivaceous or reddish-brown above, reddish or stramineous beneath, glabrous except for scattered appressed pubescence along margins and midrib beneath. Flowering culms, including inflorescence, 20-45 cm. tall, the infloreseence comprising about three-fifths of the total height; sheath of lowest infloreseence bract 2-3.5 cm. long, the blade 3-4 times longer than the sheath. Spikes reddish or purple-brown, 5-10 mm. long, 1-1.5 mm. in diam., composed of 15-50 spikelets. Staminate spikelets 2-2.5 mm. long; glumes narrowly ovate to lanceolate, obtuse, erose or more or less bifid at the hyaline apices; anthers 1 mm. long. Pistillate spikelets approximating the staminate in size; glumes ovate to broadly lanceolate, the apices obtuse or erose or rarely mucronulate. Achenes 4-5.5 mm. long, about 0.75 mm. in diam., essentially terete below, scarcely ridged or striate, obscurely triangular toward the apex, glabrous; perianthial hairs dense, 1-1.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Gilly, Charles L. 1943. An Afro-South-American Cyperaceous complex. Brittonia. 5: 1-20. f. 1.

description: Culmi rhizomati ad 5 cm. alti; folia 5-7 cm. longa, 4-5 mm. lata ad basim, marginibus glandulosis serrulatis, glabra praeter crines minutos denticuli cujusque in axillae; culmi floriferi cum infloreseentiis ad 14 cm. alti; spicae rubrae vel purpureo-brunneae, 4-8 mm. longae, 1-1.5 mm. diam.; achaenia rubra, 5 mm. longa, ad 0.75 mm. diam. ad basim, teretia vel subteretia; pili hypogyni 1-1.5 mm. longi.

description: Stem branched, to at least 5 cm. tall. Leaf sheaths reddish-striate; ligules narrowly triangular, 4-7 mm. long; leaf blades 5-7 cm. long, 4-5 mm. broad at base, coriaceous, striate, glauceseent and olivaceous above, stramineous beneath, the margins minutely glandular serrate, glabrous except for minute tufts of white hairs in the axils of the marginal teeth. Flowering culms, including infloreseence, to at least 14 cm. tall, the infloreseence comprising about one-half this height; sheath of lowermost infloreseence bract olivaceous or brownish, 8-12 mm. long, the blade approximate or slightly longer. Spikes reddish or purple-brown, 4-8 mm. long, 1-1.5 mm. in diam., composed of 5-15 spikelets. Staminate spikelets 2-2.5 mm. long; glumes lanceolate, acute or mucronate; anthers 1-1.25 mm. long. Pistillate spikelets 3-4 mm. long; glumes ovate or lanceolate, mucronate. Achenes reddish, 5 mm. long, 0.75 mm. in diam. at the nearly terete base, obscurely triangular toward the apex, glabrous except for the minutely scabridulous apical angles; perianthial hairs dense, 1-1.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Gilly, Charles L. 1943. An Afro-South-American Cyperaceous complex. Brittonia. 5: 1-20. f. 1.

description: Densely tufted; stems very slender, up to at least 6 cm. tall. Leaf sheaths reddish-striate or completely red; ligule firm, obtuse, rounded or emarginate, 1 mm. or less in length; leaf blades 3-7 (or rarely to 10) cm. long, less than 3 mm. in width at base, revolute for most of their length, glaucous or stramineous or -more or less red-dotted above, stramineous or reddish-striate beneath, more or less pubescent on margins and upper surfaces, or nearly glabrous. Flowering culms, including infloreseence, 5-15 cm. tall, the infloreseence composing one-half to two-thirds of the total length; sheaths of lowermost infloreseence bracts 8-12 mm. long, the blade about twice the length of the sheath; upper bracts similar but smaller. Spikes reddish-purple, 4-6 mm. long, 1-2 mm. in diam., composed dof 6-40 spikelets, the completely staminate spikes usually longer and more slender than the pistillate or bisexual ones. Staminate spikelets 1-1.75 mm. long; glumes broadly lanceolate to lanceolate, acute; anthers 0.75-1 mm. long. Pistillate spikelets slightly larger than the staminate; glumes ovate to broadly lanceolate, acute or mucronate. Achenes 3.5-4 mm. long, about 0.75 mm. in diam. near the base, numerously ridged and nearly terete below, obscurely triangular toward the apex, varying from sparsely pubescent along the ridges to nearly glabrous; perianthial hairs dense, 1-1.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Gilly, Charles L. 1943. An Afro-South-American Cyperaceous complex. Brittonia. 5: 1-20. f. 1.

description: Stem branched, to at least 10 cm. tall. Leaf sheaths stramineous or obscurely reddish striate; ligules narrowly triangular, 5-7 mm. long, hyaline; leaf blades 2-3.5 cm. long, 1-2 mm. broad at the base, olivaceous or brownish above, stramineous beneath, glabrous except for the appressed pubescent margins. Flowering culms, including inflorescence, 6-10 cm. tall, the infloreseence composing twothirds of the total length; sheath of lowermost infloreseence bract 5-12 mm. long, the blade about as long or slightly longer; other bracts similar but with shorter sheaths and blades. Spikes dark red or purple-black, 1.5-3 mm. long, about 1.5 mm. in diam., composed of 2-8 spikelets. Staminate spikelets about 1.5 mm. long; glumes narrowly ovate to lanceolate, acute; anthers 0.75 mm. long. Pistillate spikelets approximating the staminate in size; glumes ovate to narrowly ovate, mucronulate; styles slender. Mature achenes unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Gilly, Charles L. 1943. An Afro-South-American Cyperaceous complex. Brittonia. 5: 1-20. f. 1.

description: Stem much branched, to 30 or more cm. in length. Leaf sheaths 2-5 cm. long; ligule firm or hyaline, prolonged 1-2 mm. beyond base of blade, rounded or emarginate at apex; leaf blades 10-30 cm. long, 5-6 mm. wide at the base, more or less glaucous on both surfaces, pilose on margins and midrib, and sometimes with scattered pubescence on the upper surface. Flowering culms, ineluding infloreseence, 4-8 dm. tall, the infloreseence composing about one-third of the total length; sheath of lowermost infloreseenee bract 2-3.5 cm. long, the blade 3-5 times as long as the sheath. Spikes stramineous, greenish yellow or red-purple, 3-6 mm. long and broad, composed of 6-40 spikelets. Spikelets 1.5-2 mm. long; glumes ovate to lanceolate, acute or mucronate, hyaline-margined; anthers 1.5-2 mm. long. Achenes stramineous or reddish, 2.5-3 mm. long, about 0.75 mm. in diam. at the obscurely trigonous base, sharply triangular toward the slightly falcate apex, smooth and glabrous except for the scabridulous apical angles; perianth hairs dense, 1-1.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Gilly, Charles L. 1943. An Afro-South-American Cyperaceous complex. Brittonia. 5: 1-20. f. 1.

description: Shrubs or trees, to 12 m tall, often with arching branches, sometimes ± scandent; thorns solitary or paired, mostly straight, sometimes recurved, to 1(-2.5) cm long. Leafy twigs 1-2.5 mm thick, densely brownish- (to whitish-) tomentose, the lenticels numerous, initially often hidden by dense indumentum. Lamina chartaceous, elliptic to oblong to ovate or to subobovate, 1.5-10 X 1-5.5 cm, inequilateral, the apex acute to acuminate or to rounded, the base rounded to subcordate; margin serrate to dentate to subcrenate, the upper surface hispidulous and also puberulous to subtomentose mainly on the veins, scabrous (or scabridulous), often becoming ± bullate (venation ± impressed above), the lower surface brownish- to whitish-tomentose to patent-puberulous; domatia usually present, often most conspicuously in the axils of one of the first branches of the basal lateral veins and in the axils of the second pair of lateral veins, (always?) lacking in the axils of the basal lateral veins; lateral veins 3-5 pairs; tertiary venation scalariform; petiole 0.2-0.7 cm long, tomentose; stipules 0.3-0.6 cm long, hairy. Inflorescences branched, the bisexual ones to 0.6 cm long, the staminate ones to 1.8 cm long; peduncle to 0.6 cm long; bisexual flowers 1-2 per inflorescence; pedicel 0-2 mm long; tepals ca. 1.5 mm long, ciliolate and appressedpuberulous outside; filaments to ca. 1.5 mm long; anthers ca. 0.8-1.2 mm long; ovary ellipsoid to ovoid, ca. 3 mm long, pilose; style 0-2 mm long; stigmas ca. 3-5 mm long, furcate, the stigma branches 1.5-2 mm long; staminate flowers: pedicel 0-0.5 mm long; tepals ca. 1.5-2 mm long, ciliolate and appressed-puberulous outside; filaments ca. 1.5-2 mm long; anthers ca. 0.8-1.2 cm long. Fruits ellipsoid to subovoid, ca. 0.6-1 cm long when dry (and often ± clearly ribbed), sparsely to densely hairy, at full maturity pale yellow to whitish or to orange.

description: Shrubs or trees, to 8 m tall; thorns paired or solitary, mostly straight, somtimes slightly recurved, to 1.5(-2) cm long. Leafy twigs 0.5-2.5 mm thick, sparsely to densely white appressed-puberulous or sometimes to subtomentose, the lenticels minute, usually inconspicuous. Lamina chartaceous, ovate to subovate to elliptic to oblong or to subrotundate, 1-3.5 X 0.5-2.5 cm, the apex rounded to obtuse, often apiculate, sometimes retuse, the base (sub)cordate to rounded, the margin crenate to subentire (or to subdentate), the upper surface evenly white, mostly ± appressed-puberulous, smooth, the lower surface white or sometimes slightly brownish, densely ± appressed-puberulous to subsericeous; domatia lacking; lateral veins 1-4 pairs; tertiary venation scalariform to subreticulate; petiole 0.2-0.5 cm long, white-puberulous; stipules ca. 0.1-0.2 cm long, hairy. Inflorescences branched, bisexual or staminate, to 0.5(-0.8) cm long; peduncle 0-1 mm long; bisexual flowers 1 per inflorescence; tepals ca. 2 mm long, ciliolate and puberulous outside: filaments to 2 mm long; anthers ca. 1 mm long; ovary ellipsoid to ovoid, ca. 3 mm long, glabrous or sparsely hairy at the apex; style 0-1 mm long; stigmas ca. 2-3 mm long, furcate, the stigma branches 0.5-1 mm long; staminate flowers: pedicel 0.5-1.2 mm long; tepals ca. 1-1.2 mm long, ciliolate and appressed-puberulous outside; filaments ca. 1-1.5 mm long; anthers ca. 0.5-0.8 mm long. Fruits ellipsoid to globose, ca. 0.5-0.6 cm long when dry, (sub)glabrous, at full maturity orange to red.

description: Plant caespitose, perennial. Stems terete, delicate, slender, glabrous, 8-10 cm high, ca. 1 mm diam., not forming a caudex. Leaves distributed along the stem, not basally aggregated; blades linear, 1.5-2.5 cm X 0.5 mm, membranous, sparsely ciliolate along margins, with trichomes to 0.3 mm, scabrous at apex; leaf sheaths with vinaceous striae; contraligules lanceolate, 3-3.5 mm, membranous, not hyaline, ciliolate, stramineous, vinaceous and generally cleft at base. Inflorescences axillary, paniculate, slender, 5-8 cm X 0.4 mm, striate, glabrous, with 2-3 nodes; 1-2 upper nodes with female spikelets, the lower ones with male spikelets. Sheath of the lowermost inflorescence bract ca. 5 mm, ochraceous. Spikelets clustered in spike-like structures, 2-2.5 mm long, with 5-7 spikelets, subdistichously disposed. Male and female spikelets similar, ca. 1.5 mm long; glumes ovate 1 X 0.6 mm, reddish, hyaline at margins, apiculate. Fructifications (utricles) 3-3.5 mm long, exceeding the uppermost glume, obscurely trigonous, stramineous; hypogynous squamellae densely pilose, the trichomes to 1.2 mm long, white.

description: Shrubs or trees, to 8(-15) m tall, often with arching branches, occasionally climbing (?); thorns solitary (or paired), straight or slightly recurved, to 1(-4) cm long, often absent. Leafy twigs 1-2.5 mm thick, sparsely to densely whitish- (or brownish-) puberulous, mostly with ± curved hairs, the lenticels minute and usually inconspicuous. Lamina chartaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic to oblong to ovate or to obovate (to lanceolate or to subrotundate), 1-5(-10) X 0.5-3(-7) cm, slightly inequilateral to equilateral, the apex obtuse to rounded to acute or to subacuminate, the base rounded to truncate to subcordate or to obtuse, the margin crenate to dentate to serrate or subentire, both surfaces usually distinctly punctate, the upper surface sparsely appressed-puberulous on the veins to subglabrous or somtimes sparsely (sub)tomentose, smooth, the lower surface sparsely appressed-puberulous, mainly on the veins, or sometimes sparsely to rather densely (sub)tomentose; domatia usually conspicuous in the axils of the lateral veins, in particular the basal and the second pairs; lateral veins 2-5 pairs; tertiary venation scalariform to subreticulate, usually obscure; petiole 0.2-0.8 cm long, glabrous or puberulous; stipules 0.2-0.4 cm long. Infiorescences branched, the bisexual ones to ca. 0.5 cm long, the staminate ones to ca. 1.5 cm long; peduncle ca. 6 mm or 0.5-2 mm long respectively; bisexual flowers 1-3 per inflorescence; pedicel ca. 6 mm long; tepals ca. 1.2-1.8 mm long, ciliolate; filaments to ca. 1.5 mm long; anthers ca. 0.8-1 mm long; stigmas ca. 2-3 mm long, furcate, the stigma branches ca. 1-1.5 mm long; staminate flowers: pedicel 0.5-1 mm long; tepals ca. 1.2-2 mm long, ciliolate; filaments 1.2-2 long; anthers ca. 0.8-1 mm long. Fruits globose to subovoid, 0.4-0.6(-1) cm long when dry, subglabrous, at full maturity orange to red to purple.

description: Shrubs or trees, to 12 m tall, often ± scandent, mostly lianescent, and then to 30 m (or more?) long; thorns mostly solitary, sometimes paired, usually ? recurved; branches drying brownish to purplish. Leafy twigs 1-5 mm thick, puberulous to subglabrous, rarely densely tomentose, the lenticels numerous and mostly conspicuous. Lamina chartaceous (to subcoriaceous), elliptic to oblong to subovate, 2-15 X 1-8.5 cm, ± inequilateral, the apex acuminate, the base rounded to subcordate (or to obtuse), the margin entire to serTate (or crenate) or subentire, the upper surface glabrous, puberulous to strigillose to subtomentose, smooth, sometimes puberulous to hispidulous and ± scabrous, sometimes ± bullate, the lower surface glabrous or mainly on the veins (rather) sparsely, whitish to brownish, appressed-puberulous to strigillose to pilose, sometimes densely tomentose to pubescent; domatia absent or inconspicuous or small, with or without hairs (barbate); lateral veins 3-5 pairs; tertiary venation scalariform (to subreticulate); petiole 0.4-1.5 cm long, puberulous; stipules ca. 0.2-0.4 cm long. Inflorescences branched, bisexual or staminate, to 3(-5.5) cm long; peduncle to 0.4 cm long; bisexual flowers 1-3 per inflorescence; pedicel 1-2 mm long; tepals ca. 1.2-2 mm long, ciliolate or also (sparsely to densely) appressed-puberulous outside; filaments to ca. 1.5 mm long; anthers 0.5-1 mm long; ovary ovoid to obovoid, sparsely to densely appressed-puberulous; style 0-1 mm long; stigmas ca. 4-6 (or to 10) mm long, furcate, the stigma branches 2-4(-5) mm long; staminate flowers: pedicel 0-1 mm long; tepals ca. 1.5 mm long, ciliolate or also (sparsely to densely) appressed- puberulous outside; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long; anthers 0.7-1 mm long. Fruits ellipsoid to globose (to ovoid), ca. 1.2-1.7 cm long when dry, sparsely appressed- puberulous, at full maturity pale yellow to orange (or reddish?).

description: Trees, to 7(-12) m tall; thorns lacking; older branches grayish to brown. Leafy twigs 1-2.5 mm thick, minutely appressedpuberulous, the lenticels minute and usually inconspicuous; axillary buds well-developed, to 3.5 mm long. Lamina subcoriaceous to chartaceous, elliptic to oblong to (sub)obovate (to subrotundate), (1-)2.5-5(-10) X (0.5-)1-3.5(-5) cm, the apex shortly acuminate to acute (to obtuse), the base rounded to subacute or to subcordate (but the very base shortly attentuate), the margin entire to crenate-dentate, both surfaces usually distinctly punctate, the upper surface sparsely and minutely appressed-puberulous, the lower surface sparsely and minutely appressed-puberulous; domatia present, at least in the axils of the lateral veins in the middle of the lamina, often also minute ones in the axils of the basal ones; lateral veins (3-)4-5(-6); tertiary venation subscalariform to reticulate; petiole 0.3-0.7(-1) cm long, minutely appressed-puberulous; stipules 0.2-0.3 cm long. Inflorescences branched, bisexual or staminate, to 1 cm long; peduncle to 0.2-0.3 cm long, to 1.2 cm long in fruit; bisexual flowers 1 per inflorescence; pedicel 0.5-1 mm long; tepals ca. 1.5-2 mm long, ciliolate and sparsely appressed-puberulous outside; filaments to ca. 1.5 mm long; anthers ca. 1 mm long; ovary ellipsoid; style ca. 0.1-0.2 mm long; stigmas 0.5-2 mm long, furcate, with stigma branches to 0.5 mm long, broadly spathulate, 1-1.5 mm broad and usually (weakly) 2-lobate, or semidisciform, ca. 1.5 mm broad and 4-lobate; staminate flowers: pedicel 0-0.5 mm long; tepals ca. 1.5 mm long, ciliolate and sparsely puberulous outside; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long; anthers ca. 0.8-1 mm long; staminate flowers: pedicel 0-1 mm long; tepals ca. 1 mm long, ciliolate and sparsely appressed-puberulous outside; filaments ca. 1-1.2 mm long; anthers 0.8 mm long. description: Trees, to 30 m tall; thorns paired, sometimes solitary, straight, to 1 cm long, ± spreading. Leafy twigs 1-2 mm thick, (sub)glabrous (only sparsely hairy on and near the nodes and at the bases of the thorns, partly with brownish, oblongoid- to ellipsoid-capitate pluricellular hairs), (dark) purplish(-brown), the lenticels numerous, small, white, conspicuous. Lamina subcoriaceous to chartaceous, subovate to ovate to elliptic to oblong, 3-9.5 X 1.2-4 cm, (sub)equilateral, the apex acuminate to subacute, the base obtuse to rounded, the margin crenate to dentate, the upper surface very sparsely appressed-puberulous on the midrib, the lower surface very sparsely appressed-puberulous to strigillose on the main veins; lateral veins 3-5 pairs; tertiary venation loosely scalariform to subreticulate, smaller veins ± obscure; domatia in the axils of the basal pair of lateral veins, well-developed to almost absent, sometimes also present in axils of other lateral veins; petiole 0.2-0.5 cm long, very sparsely appressed-puberulous; stipules ca. 0.4 cm long. Inflorescences branched, bisexual or staminate, the bisexual ones 0.4 cm long, the staminate ones to 0.8 cm long; peduncle to 0.2 cm long, to 0.5 cm long in fruit; bisexual flowers 1 per inflorescence; pedicel 0.2 mm long; tepals ca. 2 mm long, ciliolate; filaments to ca. 1.5 mm long; anthers ca. 1 mm long; ovary ca. 2-3 mm long, glabrous or sparsely appressed-puberulous; style 0-1 mm long; stigmas ca. 2.5-6 mm long, furcate, the stigma branches 2-4 mm long; staminate flowers: pedicel 0-0.5 mm long; tepals ca. 1.5 mm long, ciliolate; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long; anthers ca. 1 mm long. Fruits subglobose, ca. 1 cm diam. when dry, (sub)glabrous.

description: Plants erect, uniaxial annuals, (3.5-) 15-35 cm tall with the stems sparingly and strictly branched; roots shallow and fibrous. Leaves cauline, more abundant below the middle of the stem because of the shortened lower internodes, grass-green, slightly thickened but not leathery, oblanceolate or sometimes obovate, the lowermost small, 3-12 mm X 1-3.5 mm, becoming longer and narrower upwards, to 11-22 mm X 2.7-4 mm, the midvein rather prominent but lateral veins obscure. Inflorescence a simple racemose cyme with the lower flowering branches alternate on axis, strict, typically monochasial except for a terminal simple dichasium at the apex of the main axis. Pedicels longer than the flowers, 7.5-19, mm. Flowers pentamerous, only about 1-30 per plant. Calyx 3.7-5.6 mm long; lobes 2.5-3 mm long, lance-acuminate to triangular, usually much shorter than the corolla-tube. Corolla rose-pink without a white "eye," (8.2-) 9-14 mm long; outer corolla-tube often viscid to the touch, 4.5-8.5 mm long, equalling the ovary; corolla-lobes lance-ovate to oblong, sometimes bicolored beneath, (3.7-) 4.5-8.5 mm long, 1.8-3.3 mm wide, the tips broadly acute or obtuse. Stamens equalling the style; anthers oblong before dehiscence, 1-2 mm long when coiled; pollen 22.8-32.3 nm diam. Ovary (4.5-) 6-7 mm long at anthesis; style 2.1-3 mm long; stigma subcapitate with only a crease demarcating the lobes. Capsule oval in outline, 4-8.2 mm long, 2.7-3.4 mm wide, thick-walled and resinous; seeds 0.3-0.5 mm long, 500-600 per capsule. Chromosome number, n = ca. 36. Flowering Oct to Jan.
bibliographicCitation: Broome, Carmen R. 1977. The Central American species of Centaurium (Gentianaceae). Brittonia. 28: 413-426.

description: Plants short-lived, erect, uniaxial annuals 8.5-20 (-36) cm tall, unbranched in lower half. Leaves cauline, only about 5-8 pairs on main axis, much shorter than the internodes, the lowermost scale-like, about 1 mm X 0.3-1 mm, the upper linear- setaceous, 7-17 mm x 1 mm, appressed to the stem, reduced to small appressed bracts in the inflorescence. Inflorescence a simple paniculate cyme with both dichasial and monochasial branching, the flowering branches diverging from the main axis at angles of 10?-300 (-50?) and ascending, branched once or twice and several-flowered or uniflorous. Pedicels 1-33 mm long. Flowers pentamerous, 4-24 per plant. Calyx 4-7 (-9) mm long with lanceolate to subulate lobes 3.5-7.5 mm long. Corolla rose-pink, 6.7-11.5 mm long; corolla-tube 3.5-6.3 mm long and rarely exceeding the ovary; corolla-lobes oblong-elliptic, 3.2-5.3 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, rounded at the tips. Stamens 2-4 mm long, exceeding the style; anthers 0.7-1.8 mm long; pollen 19-23.8 nm diam. Ovary 3.7-5 mm long; style 2-3 mm long; stigma bilobed, the lobes cuneate to flabelliform. Capsule ovoid, 3.8-7 mm long, 1.6-3 mm wide; seeds ca. 0.15 mm long. Chromosome number, n = 21. Flowering Nov to Feb.

description: Plants erect biennials to 60 cm tall with one to several stems arising from a tap- rooted crown. Main stem simple with several leafy unbranched nodes below the inflorescence. Leaves of the basal rosette oblong-ovate or oblong-lanceolate, strongly 3-nerved, to 5.5 cm X 2 cm, the cauline leaves generally smaller than the basal ones, (ob-)lanceolate to (ob-)ovate, shorter than the nearest internode. Inflorescence a compact umbelliform or corymbiform cyme terminating each stem, the larger plants often bearing several hundred flowers. Pedicels less than 1 mm long and subtended by a pair of small bracts, the central flower of each dichasium subsessile with the  lateral ones on bracted peduncles up to 1 cm long. Flowers (4-) 5 (-6) -merous. Calyx 5-6 mm long; lobes linear-acuminate, about 1/2 to 34 as long as the corolla-tube at anthesis. Corolla up to 12 mm long, pink; corolla-tube 6-10 mm long; corolla-lobes 5-6.5 mm long, obtuse at tips. Stamens slightly exserted, about equalling the style; anthers about 1.5 mm long. Ovary about as long as corolla-tube at anthesis; stigma strongly bilamellate; lobes oval or ligulate. Capsule cylindrical, papery-walled, about twice as long as the persistent calyx at maturity.

description: Plants diffusely branched uniaxial annuals 5-19 cm tall with the spreading lateral branches arising from the basal and upper nodes, the roots shallow and fibrous. Leaves all cauline, the lowermost oblanceolate to narrowly spathulate, 5-20 mm x 3-6 mm, the upper tending to become narrower, 6.5-23 mm x 1.5-3.8 mm, and becoming reduced to inconspicuous bracts in the inflorescence; foliage green, often suffused with blue (drying to black), especially along margins of leaves and stem-wings. Inflorescence a loose compound cyme with long, ascending floriferous branches which typically diverge from the main axis at angles of 40-70, uniflorous at the end or each divaricately branched two or three times in a simple, few flowered monochasial or dichasial cyme. Pedicels of central flowers of a dichasium 5.5-20 mm long. Flowers pentamerous, often hexamerous, 1-35 per plant. Calyx 3.7-6.5 mm long; lobes 3-5 mm long, narrowly lanceolate to triangular. Corolla light pink fading gradually to white toward the center, without a demarcated "eye," 10-18 mm long; corolla-tube 5-7 mm long; corolla-lobes broadly lance-ovate, 5-12.5 mm long, 2.5-5 mm wide, the tips barely acute to obtuse. Stamens 3-4.6 mm long, shorter than the style; anthers 2.2-3.6 mm long at anthesis; pollen 22.8-28 nm diam. Ovary 4.5-7 mm -long at anthesis; style 2.6-4.5 mm long; stigma subcapitate with only a crease indicating the two lobes. Capsule oval in outline, 6-9 mm long, 2.2-3.6 mm wide, thickwalled and dark brown, not resinous; seeds 0.3-0.4 mm long, 400-600 per capsule. Chromosome number: n = 36. Flowering year-round, but mostly Dec to May.

description: Plants uniaxial, short-lived annuals (4-) 9-32 cm tall with profuse and divaricate branches from the base or above the middle, arising from shallow, fibrous roots. Leaves cauline, not markedly dimorphic, the lowermost ovate or obovate, 2-7 mm X 2-3.5 mm, those of the middle nodes elliptic to lance-ovate, 9-22 mm X 2.5-8 mm; floral bracts reduced and much smaller than the cauline leaves, becoming linear and appressed to the stem. Inflorescence a broad open panicle or compound mono- chasial cyme with the longest lateral branches up to six times compoundly branched; dichasial branching common at all levels, but ultimate branches of inflorescence usually monochasial. Pedicels of central flower in dichasium 11.5-20 (-28) mm long, the lateral pedicels shorter. Flowers tetramerous, occasionally with pentamerous ones intermixed on the same plant, 2-100 or more per plant. Calyx (2.7-) 3.5-6.5 mm long; calyx-lobes (2-) 3-5.5 mm long, subulate-attenuate and moderately keeled, shorter than or equalling the corolla-tube. Corolla dusty pink without a prominent white "eye," occasionally white, (6-) 7-10 mm long; corolla-tube 4.5-6 mm long, about as long as the ovary, constricted slightly or not at all above ovary; corolla-lobes 2.4-4.5 mm long, 1.5-2.3 mm wide, oblong to elliptic, the tips bluntly truncate or rounded. Stamens 2.4-3.4 mm long, inserted just below summit of ovary and exceeding the style; anthers 0.5-1.5 mm long after anthesis; pollen 20.9-24.7 nm diam. Ovary 4.4-6 mm long at anthesis; style 1.5-2.6 mm long; stigma subcapitate or definitely bilobed, the lobes in the latter case hemispheric or flabellate in outline. Capsule fusiform, 5-7 (-8.5) mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm wide, thick-walled but not resinous, reddish-brown; seeds 0.2-0.3 mm long, 150-350 per capsule. Chromosome numbers: n = 21, 22. Flowering Nov to Mar.

description: Plants erect, short-lived annuals, (5-) 10-21 cm tall, uniaxial, usually unbranched in the lower half, with 3-6 internodes between the basal leaves and the lowermost branches. Leaves dimorphic, the lower 2-3 pairs clustered in a little pseudorosette obovate to oblanceolate, 4-11 cm X 2-5 mm, the cauline leaves linear-subulate or linear and falcately curved, 9-21 mm X 0.5-0.7 mm, shorter than or equalling the internodes they subtend, and divergent from the stem unless very short, when appressed reduced in the inflorescence to tiny appressed bracts. Inflorescence a lax divaricately branched, compound monochasium, with the branches very thin and flexible, the main branches diverging from each other at angles of 60º-120º, uniflorous or branched 1-4 times and several-flowered; dichasia rare, but when present the pedicel of the central flower 22-30 mm long, pedicels in the monochasia 10-25 mm long. Flowers pentam- erous, 1-20 per plant. Calyx 4.3-6.1 mm long; lobes 4-4.5 mm long, subulate to narrowly lance-acuminate, usually exceeding the corolla-tube. Corolla rose-pink, pale pink, or white, without an "eye," 6-10 mm long; corolla-tube 3.3-5 mm long, about equalling the ovary; corolla-lobes 2.7-5 mm long, 1.1-1.5 mm wide, lanceolate to oblong or ovate, with acuminate to obtuse tips. Stamens 2-3 mm long, equalling or exceeding the style; anthers linear, sagittate, or oblong before anthesis, 0.5-1.2 mm long when coiled; pollen 18-23.8 nm diam. Ovary 3.5-4.5 mm long; style 1.5-2.5 mm long; stigma definitely bilobed. Capsule oval in outline, thick-walled, 4-5.7 mm long, 1.5-2.2 mm wide; seeds 0.2-0.3 mm long, 200-500 per capsule. Chromosome number, n = 21. Flowering Nov to Feb.

description: Terrestrial or epiphytic shrub to 3 m tall with single stems up to 5 cm in diam. Mature stems and twigs terete to subterete, somewhat striate, densely short-pilose with white to gray trichomes. Petiole subterete, densely short-pilose, up to 5 mm long and 3 mm in diam. Leaves coriaceous, amplexicaul, ovate, ovate-lanceolate or elliptic, broadest at the base or in the middle, then noticeably constricted below the middle with a shallow sinus on each side, (5) 8.5-15 x (2.5) 5-8 cm, basally cordate-auriculate with rounded lobes, apically acuminate with the apex itself acute, entire, yellowish- or brownish-green when dry, sparsely short-pilose along the nerves above and densely soft-pilose with both solitary hairs and fascicles of 4-6 hairs beneath; pinnately veined or weakly plinerved with 3-5 lateral nerves per side, midrib, lateral nerves and reticulate veinlets impressed above, midrib and lateral nerves conspicuously elevated beneath; pseudostipuls lanceolate, (12) 22-25 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, pendent, 10-ca 25-flowered. Rachis bluntly angled, ca 5-9 cm long, pale yellowish-green when fresh, densely woolly with white or cream-colored trichomes. Floral bracts persistent, lanceolate, (4.5) 6-7 x 1.5-2 cm, membranaceous, noticeably reticulate veined, pale yel- lowish-green suffused with red at the base when fresh, densely softly short-pilose. Pedicel subterete, expanded distally, densely woolly as rachis, 10-12 (17) mm long and 3-4 mm in diam, pale yellowish-green. Bracteoles similar to floral bracts but 3.5-4.5 x 1 cm, inserted ca midway up the pedicel. Calyx (22) 25-35 mm long; tube cylindrical, coarsely 10-ribbed, densely woolly, 5-7 mm long, dark green when fresh; limb erect, sparsely pilose, 16-30 mm long including the lobes, pale yel- lowish-green suffused with red when fresh; lobes lanceolate, 15-25 x 4-5 mm, erect after anthesis; sinus acute. Corolla cylindrical and very fleshy (2 mm thick at the base) when fresh, slightly swollen basally, densely short-pilose with white trichomes, 45-50 mm long and 10-12 mm diam at the middle (ca 15 mm at the base), dark pinkish-red when fresh; lobes lanceolate, spreading at anthesis, (15) 17-20 mm long, purplish-black within. Stamens 10, equal, 42-43 mm long; filaments distinct, glabrous, 7-8 mm long, golden-yellow when fresh; anthers 37-38 mm long including the tubules, golden-yellow when fresh; thecae coarsely granular, 15-16 mm long; tubules slender, ca half the diameter of the thecae, ca 22 mm long, dehiscent by oblique oval pores 1-1.2 mm long. Berry green turning purple.

description: Upper branches often purplish-red; leaves finely rugose-reticulate, the upper ones elliptic to oblong or sometimes obovate, 3-4 (-6) times as long as wide, blunt (usually) or acute at tips, gradually narrowed to stout margined petiolar bases 1 cm. long or less; upper surface green, vestite especially on the midrib and near the margins with flaccid hyaline simple hairs up to 1 mm. long; the lower surface with a prominent network of raised veinis, these obscured like the young stems, pedicels and calyces with dense matted grayish-brown or yellowish-brown short hairs, many of which appear stellate; margins often revolute, denticulate with 5-8 dark callosities per cm., the callosities up to 1 mm. long, inserted intramarginally on the upper surface; flowers 6.5-8 cm. long; corolla-tube 12-19 mm. long, narrowest at the middle (where 6-8 mm. wide when pressed) or nearly cylindrical; dorsal lobes 5-7 mm. wide just above base, 3.5-4.5 cm. long; lateral and ventral lobes similar, not divided to the base of the lower lip, 2.5-4 mm. wide at base, 2-3 cm. long; anther-tube 14-17 mm. long, 4-5 mm. in diameter; fruit ovoid, about 2-2.5 cm. in diameter, 2.5-3 cm. long; calyx-lobes appressed in flower and fruit, with 6-10 callose teeth on each edge.

description: Truncus semihypogaeus, humilis, ad 20 cm altus; cataphylla lanata, triangularia, 5 cm longa, basi 3.5 cm lata; folia pauca, usque 10, glabra; petiolus subteres teresve, 60-90 cm longus, parte infima dilatatus, validis spinis armatus; rachis semiteres, in dimidio inferiore paucis spinis armata, supra fere inermis vel inermis, in cuspidem 2-7 cm longam excurrens; foliola subopposita vel alterna, 6-13-juga, remota, oblanceolata vel late obovata, 18-31 cm longa, 9-16 cm lata, translucida, tenuia, basi cuneata, apicem versus subito asymmetrice caudato-acuminata, acumine fere 4 cm longo, margine integerrima, prope apicem repanda vel undulata, 40-66 nervis praedita; strobilus 6 lineari-cylindricus, 28 cm longus, 3 cm latus; pedunculus tomentosus, 6-8 cm longus, 1.5-2 cm latus; strobilus Q cylindricus, 20 cm longus, 5 cm latus; pedunculus tomentosus, 12 cm longus, 1.4 cm latus; semina 2.3-2.7 cm longa, 2 cm lata.

description: Stem semihypogeous, short (less than 20 cm), cylindric, covered by persistent leaf and cataphyll bases; cataphylls pubescent, stipulate, triangular, 5 cm long, 3.5 cm wide, winged at the margins; leaves 2-3.2 m long, stipulate, few (less than 10), sparsely pubescent when young, glabrous when fully expanded; petiole 60-90 cm long, subterete to terete with an expanded base, armed with robust prickles; rachis straight, semiterete, sparsely armed with prickles in the lower half and nearly smooth to smooth above, ending in a conical-linear apex 2-7 cm long; leaflets subopposite to alternate, 6-13 on each side, pairs widely spaced, oblanceolate to widely obovate, inequilateral, 18-31 cm long, 9-16 cm wide, membranaceous to translucent, thin, 0.3-0.4 mm thick, sessile, attenuate at base (5- 10 mm wide) and abruptly acuminate at the strongly asymmetric apex (2-4 cm long), the veins 40-70, dichotomous, prominent and rigid, especially when dry, margins entire, undulate in the distal portion, dark cupric when young, dark green when fully expanded, glaucous on the adaxial surface; microsporangiate strobilus greenish-red when young, light gray when mature, usually solitary, long-cylindric to elongate-conical, 28 cm long just prior to shedding pollen, 3 cm in diam; peduncle tomentose to woolly, 6-8 cm long, 1.5-2 cm in diam, unarmed; microsporophylls deltoid to cuneate, 7-10 mm long, 6-9 mm wide, basally stalked, apex slightly peltate with 2 horns 1-2 mm long; microsporangia covering the unexposed abaxial surface (from 2/3-3/4 the total length), in clusters of (2) 3 (4-5), dehiscing longitudinally; megasporangiate strobilus wine red when young, brown to dark brown when mature, usually solitary, cylindric or slightly conical, 20 cm long including the peduncle, 5 cm in diam, the apex mucronate; peduncle tomentose, grayish, elongate, 12 cm long, 1.4 cm in diam, unarmed; megasporophylls peltate with a narrow basal stalk and transversely hexagonal tips bearing 2 stout horns with many fine ridges between them, 1.5-3 cm long including the stalk, 1.5-2 cm wide; ovules 2 per megasporophyll, projecting inward toward the stro- bilus axis, red-pubescent when young, a prominent white-pubescent collar at the base of each ovule through maturity; seeds smooth, 2.3-2.7 cm long, 2 cm in diam.

description: Truncus ovoideus vel subcylindricus, 9-15 cm altus, 8-12 cm diametro; folia 5-20, stipulata 1-1.5 m longa, basi tomentosa; petiolus armatus; foliola lanceolata vel recurvata, fasciculata in rachi, 7-22 cm longa, 1-5 cm lata, 8-30-nervia, apice acuta; strobilus d pedunculatus fulvus, elongatus, subcylindricus, apice mucronatus, 18-25 cm longa, ca 3 cm diam.; pedunculus inermis, 3.5 cm longus, basi tomentosus; microsporophylla bicornuata, cornubus 3.0 mm longis; strobilus 9 pedunculatus, olivaceus, subcylindricus, mucronatus, 10-14 cm longus, 3-5 cm diam.; pedunculus inermis 6-9 cm longus, 0.7 cm diam., basi tomentosus; megasporophylla peltata vel transverse hexagona ca 15 mm alta, 10-15 lata, cornubus magnis bicornuta cristaque prominente inter cornua, praedita.

description: Trunk ovoid to subcylindric; leaves stipulate, tomentose at base; petiole armed with spines; leaflets lanceolate to recurved, clustered along rachis, acute at apex; strobilis c tawny-brown, mucronate; peduncle unarmed, tomentose at base; microsporophylls with two horns 3.0 mm long; strobilis 9 olive-green, mucronate; peduncle unarmed, tomentose at base; megasporophylls with two large horns and a prominent ridge between them.

description: Palm-like plants; trunks epigeous, globose becoming cylindrical with age, 1-2 dm tall when mature, 9-13 cm diam. Leaves 1-20, typically 6-10 in a, spirally arranged crown, pinnate, 8-15 dm long, 5-6 dm wide; leaflets 30-50 pairs, opposite to subopposite, linear-lanceolate, falcate to subfalcate, 1-3 dm long, 6-12 (15) mm wide, apex acuminate, base attenuate, margin entire, revolute; nerves 7-10, distance between nerves 0.60-1.15 mm; petiole and rachis ascending, unarmed, tomentose at base. Microstrobili cylindrical to narrowly conical, light green when immature, brown to dark brown at dehiscence, 9-15 cm long, 2.5-3 cm diam; peduncle 9-13 cm long, 9-10 mm diam, tomentose; microsporophylls numerous, cuneiform, bicornate at distal end, fertile portion covering 1/2 /3 of abaxial surface excluding horns and stalk, sterile portion nearly plane, 9-11 mm long, 6-9 mm wide; microsporangia numerous, 0.85-1.0 mm diam, dehiscence by longitudinal slit. Megastrobili cylindrical or barrel-shaped, light reddish brown to green when immature depending on exposure to light, turning green to dark green at maturity, 13.5-19.5 cm long, 6.5-8 cm diam; peduncle 12.5-15.0 cm long, 1.0-1.8 cm diam, tomentose; megasporophylls spirally arranged forming apparently vertical rows, cuneiform-peltate, distal ends hexagonal, thickened, bicomate, tomentose at margins, 2.8-3.2 cm long, 2.5-3.2 cm wide. Seeds ovate variably angulate, fleshy layer creamy-white when immature turning brownish-green to brown at maturity, stony layer light beige, smooth, 1.6-2.1 cm long, 1.2- 1.6 cm diam. Chromosome number 2n = 16.

description: Stem short (less than 50 cm), subcylindric to cylindric, covered by persistent leaf bases; leaves 1-2 m long, stipulate, densely pubescent when young, glabrous when fully expanded; petiole 20-30 cm long, armed with spines especially below, terete to subterete; rachis 0.8-1.7 m long, straight, sometimes armed with spines in the lower half and nearly smooth or smooth above; leaflets opposite to subopposite (rarely alternate), 50-80 on each side, linear, 20-50 cm long, 3-7 (10) mm wide, sessile, attenuate at base and apex, 5-6 veined, the venation dichotomous, the blade strongly rolled parallel to the longitudinal plane and almost completely tubular when dry; microsporangiate cone tawny brown when fresh, usually solitary, long-cylindric, tapering slightly towards the mucronate apex, 20-25 cm long just prior to the shedding of pollen, 5-8 cm in diameter; peduncle tomentose, elongate, 2-5 cm long, 1-2 cm in diameter, unarmed; microsporophylls broadly cuneate, 12-15 mm long, 5-8 mm wide, tapering to a narrow basal stalk, the apex slightly peltate with 2 horns 1-3 mm long; microsporangia covering the unexposed abaxial surface (from 2/3-3/4 the total length), mostly in clusters of three, dehiscing longitudinally; ovulate cone olive-green when fresh, usually solitary, cylindric, 20-40 cm long, 9-12 cm in diameter, the apex mucronate; megasporophylls peltate with a narrow stalk and with transversely hexagonal tips bearing 2 stout horns, 2-4 cm long including stalk, 1.5-3.5 cm wide; ovules two per sporophyll, projecting in towards cone axis, slightly pubescent when young, glabrous when mature; seeds white when ripe, smooth, 2-3.5 cm long, 1.2-1.5 cm in diameter.

description: Arbor ad 8 m alta; ramificationis ordinatione valde sympodiali, apicibus foliorum basibus occultis; ramis viridibus demum fuscis, apices versus 3-5 mm latis; foliorum cicatricibus prominentibus 4-6 mm latis; internodiis ad 3 mm longis, vel foliis arcte positis et internodiis subnullis; apicibus et foliorum primordiis tomento rufo-brunneo indutis; petiolis plerumque 4-7 cm longis, foliorum laminis membranaceis vel sub- coriaceis, ellipticis vel subobovatis, 10-22 cm longis et 5.5-9 cm latis, basi acutis, apice obtusis vel acuminatis, margine integris cum costis marginalibus debilibus vel nihil evolutis, supra atroviridibus nitidis et glabris, subtus hebetato-viridibus pallidior- ibus et glabris, nervis saepe rubris, costa ad 2 mm lata, supra subprominente, subtus valde prominente, nervis secundariis utrinsecus circiter 20, nervis tertiariis reticulum facientibus; paniculis 15-25 cm longis simplicibus, ramis 7-10 primariis 4-8 cm longis, axe et ramis immaturis tomento rufo-brunneo deciduo denso indutis, pedunculo 4-8 cm longo; ramis paniculae cum bractea unica basali 1-2 mm longa late ovata acuta, margine minute crenulata; floribus in quoque ramulo 15-40 coarctatis, inter- nodiis subnullis vel plerumque ad 2 mm; florum bracteis 1.5-2 mm longis late ovatis, bracteolis et floribus amplectentibus, bractearum marginibus integris vel minute crenulatis; bracteolis circiter 1.5 mm longis, late ovatis, basi subobliquis vel truncatis, apice obtusis vel acutis, margine integris, flores ad basim amplectentibus; sepalis 2.5-3 mm longis ovatis apice obtusis, nervis manifestis 3-7; staminibus et pistillis maturis ignotis.
bibliographicCitation: Sohmer, Seymour Hans. 1972. Revision of the genus Carpentiera (Amaranthaceae). Brittonia. 24: 283-312.

description: Arbor ad 12 m alta, habitu valde sympodiali, ramorum apicibus foliorum basibus occultis; ramulis prasinis demum subfuscis apicem versus 4-9 mm diametro, foliorum cicatricibus prominentibus 2-8 mm latis; internodiis ad 2 mm longis, partibus juvenilibus tomento brunneo primo indutis; petiolis 3-18.5 cm longis; foliorum laminis coriaceis vel subcoriaceis, ellipticis vel subovatis, 13-40 cm longis, 5.5-9.5 cm latis, basi acutis, apice obtusis, margine integris costis marginalibus evolutis, utrinque nitidis aeruginosis glabris, costa ad 2 mm lata supra subimpressa subtus valde prominente, nervis secondariis utrinsecus circiter 20, nervis tertiariis inconspicuis; paniculis 22-48 cm longis ubique glabris vel basi pedunculi et ramulorum tomentellis vel interdum ubique paullo puberulis, pedunculo 2-15 cm longo, ramulis lateralibus 9-32 alternis simplicibus vel interdum divisis; paniculae ramulis primariis 3.5-15 cm longis bractea triangulata acuminata ad 1.5 mm longa et 2 bracteolis lateralibus similaribus sed minoribus basi subtentis; floribus 20-100 in quoque ramulo arcte appressis internodiis subnullis vel plerumque ad 2 mm; florum bracteis ad 1.25 mm longis ovatis acuminatis margine integris vel minute crenulatis puberulis; florum bracteolis ad 1 mm longis ovatis basi obliquis apice longe acuminatis margine integris vel parce puberulis; sepalis 1.75-2.1 mm longis anguste ovatis 3-5-nerviis apice acutis glabris, raro pilis atris brevibus indutis; staminum fungentium filamentis sub anthesi 1 mm longis ad 2-3 mm accrescentibus, antheris circiter 1 mm longis; staminodiis ad 1 mm longis antherarum rudimento minuto; ovario globoso vel urceolato circiter 1.5 mm longo, stylo ad 0.5 mm longo, stigmatibus ad 0.5 mm longis interdum in floribus hermaphroditis non expansis; ovulo maturitate ad 1 mm longo.

description: Tree to 4.5 m, rarely to 6 m, often shrubby; branching pattern sympodial but superficially monopodial, the apices visible, not obscured by leaf bases; branches green, becoming light brown, 0.6-1.8 (rarely to 2.5) mm broad near the apices; leaf scars 1-3 mm wide; leaf internodes 0.7-16 (usually 3-10) mm long; apices and leaf primordia invested with a light brown tomentum; petioles 0.2-5.5 (usually 1-3) mm long, the petiolar wings sometimes lacking, the leaf-blades subcoriaceous to coriaceous, obovate to somewhat elliptic, 3-12.5 cm long, and 1-5.5 cm broad, acute or obtuse at base, acute to obtuse or round at apex, entire at margin and with marginal ribs usually well developed, both surfaces dull green, usually glabrous, except for occasional tufts of hair present in the lower vein axils, the costa to 1.5 mm broad, somewhat raised above, prominently ridged beneath, the secondary veins 10-15 to a side, the tertiary veins, when visible, forming a reticulum; panicles 10-40 cm long, with 5-20 alternate primary branches, glabrous or more usually tomentulose in the axils of the branches and bracts, the peduncle 1-5 cm, the branching pattern simple or compound, the primary branches 2-20 cm long, with 1 basal, acute to acuminate, triangular bract with entire margins, often puberulent, the bract 0.8- 1.8 mm long; flowers 5-20 on each branch, the floral internodes 1.1-9 mm long; floral bracts 0.6-1.25 mm long, triangular, almost deltoid, with acute to acuminate apices and entire margins often minutely puberulent; floral bracteoles 0.6-1 mm long, ovate, with oblique bases, acute to acuminate apices and entire margins often slightly puberulent; sepals 1.5-2.25 mm long, ovate, with acute to obtuse apices and 3-5 veins, glabrous; filaments of functional stamens about 1 mm long before anthesis, enlarging to 2-3 mm at anthesis, the anthers about 0.7 mm long, the staminodes about 0.75 mm long with rudimentary anthers; ovary 1.2-2 mm long, with a short style about 0.5 mm long and 2 stigmas about 0.5 mm long; pistils often rudimentary in the perfect flowers; seed about 1.5 mm long.

description: Tree to 6 m high; branching pattern sympodial; branches green, often suffused with red, becoming light brown, 1.5-2.75 mm broad near the apices; leaf scars 1.5-3 mm broad; internodes 1-14 (usually more than 4) mm long; apices and leaf primordia invested with a light yellow-brown tomentum; petioles 1.5-6.5 (rarely to 18) cm long; leaf-blades subcoriaceous to stiffly coriaceous, rarely membranaceous, elliptic to lanceolate, 5-15.5 (rarely to 21) cm long and 2-6 (rarely to 9) cm wide, acute or obtuse to rounded at base, acute to obtuse at apex, entire margin and with marginal ribs strongly or sometimes not at all developed, dark-green and shining above, paler green beneath, the costa to 1.5 mm broad, somewhat raised above, prominently ridged beneath, the secondary veins 10-15 to a side, the tertiary veins when visible forming a reticulum; panicles 10-63 cm long, with 12-20 alternate primary branches glabrous throughout to puberulent at the branch bases, the peduncle 3-15 cm long, the branching pattern simple or compound, the primary branches 4-20 cm long, each with 1 basal, scarious, narrowly triangular bract with a few minute marginal teeth or hairs; flowers 8-20 on each branch, the internodes between the flowers 0.3-12 mm; floral bracts about 1.25 mm long, ovate to deltoid, acuminate, with puberulent margins; bracteoles about 1.25 mm long, ovate with oblique base, acute to acuminate apex, and entire (often puberulent) margins; sepals 1.75-2.5 mm long, ovate, with acute apices and 3-7 discernible veins; filaments of functional stamens about 1 mm long before anthesis, expanding to 2-3 mm long at anthesis, the anthers about 1 mm long, the staminodes about 1 mm long with rudimentary anthers; ovary about 1.5 mm long, the style none or very short, the stigmas about 1 mm long, the gynoecia often rudimentary in the perfect flowers; ovule about 1.5 mm long at maturity.

description: Tree to 6 m high, slender or shrubby; branching pattern sympodial; branches green becoming light brown, 0.5-5 mm broad near the apices; leaf scars to 6 mm broad; internodes to 14 mm long; apices and leaf primordia invested with a light brown tomentum; petioles 1-17 cm long; the blades membranaceous, sometimes sub- coriaceous, ovate, 5-27 cm long, 3-13 cm wide, usually round at base, acute to obtuse (rarely acuminate) at apex, entire at margin and usually without developed marginal ribs, the upper surface deep green and shining, the lower surface paler and duller, glabrous, the costa to 2 mm broad, somewhat raised above, prominently ridged beneath, the secondary veins 10-20 to a side, the tertiary veins forming a reticulum; panicles 12-50 cm long, simple or compound, with 5-20 alternate primary branches with 1, acute to acuminate, triangular or deltoid bract about 1 mm long with entire to slightly crenulate margins; flowers several to many on each branch, the internodal distance between the flowers 1-5 mm; floral bracts about 1 mm long, ovate to triangular, with acute to acuminate or aristate apices and with entire to slightly crenulate margins; bracteoles about 0.8 mm long, ovate, with acute to acuminate apices, oblique bases, and entire to slightly crenulate margins; sepals 1.5-2.25 mm long, ovate, with acute to obtuse apices and 3-7 discernible veins; filaments of functional stamens about 1 mm long before anthesis, enlarging to 2-3 mm at anthesis, the anthers about 1 mm long, the staminodes about 1 mm long, with rudimentary anthers; ovary about 1.5 mm long, with short style about 0.3 mm long, and stigmas about 0.4 mm long; pistils of the perfect flowers frequently rudimentary or failing to mature seed; seed about 1.5 mm long at maturity.

flowers in dichotomies or paired at ends of ultimate branchlets, the pedicels slender, up to 2.5 mm. long, the bracteoles about 0.5 mm. long; expanded flowers at anthesis 2.5-4 mm. in diameter; sepals papyraceous, ovate-deltoid, 0.6-0.9 mm. long and broad, obtuse, entire or faintly erosulous at margins; description: Erect herb, branching above, to 8 dm. high, glabrous throughout. Stem subterete, with 2 pairs of approximate angles; lower internodes 1 cm. long or less, the upper progressively elongate to 15 cm. in the infloreseence. Petioles 4-6 mm. long, flattened at base, connected by a narrow wing across the stem. Blades rather fleshy, yellowish-green when dry, oblong-lanceolate, 50-80 mm. long, 18-25 mm. wide, or the lower smaller and proportionately wider, sharply acute, acute or obtuse at base, inconspicuously few-veined; leaves of the branches greatly reduced or none. Infloreseence freely branched, occupying half or more of the length of the plant, many-flowered; pedicels ascending, 5-20 mm. long; bracteoles (when present) ovate, minute. Calyx 10-11 mm. long, its lobes ovate-oblong, 5.5-6 mm. long, obtuse, finely erose-denticulate. Corolla salverform, blue, the' tube 10 mm. long, the lobes oblong-triangular, 7 mm. long, apiculate. Filaments exserted 2-5 mm.; anthers involute, polleen-grains muricate, nearly 0.1 mm. in diameter. Capsule slender, 12 mm. long, tipped by the persistent style and stigma.

description: Scandent woody plant with paired tendrils on axillary peduncles; stems striato sulcate, glabrescent, exudate milky, crosssection with one central vascular stele and three peripheral steles. Leaves biternate, 15- 20 cm long; leaflets ovate-subrotund, 6-11 cm long, 4-9 cm wide, the apices obtuse or acuminate, the bases attenuate, the petiolules to 1 cm, shortly contracted or subsessile, the margins entire or rarely denticulate, the texture chartaceous-coriaceous, the ve- nation brochidodromous, the upper and lower surfaces of leaflets usually glabrous and glossy, sometimes finely pubescent, the petiole and rachis wingless; stipules minute, to 1 mm, deltoid-ovate. Thyrses robust, sol- itary, 8-20 cm long, pedunculate, some- times borne on tendrillate branches, the pu- bescence dense, yellow; bracts filiform- subulate, 1.5-2 mm long; cincinni sessile or shortly stipitate and moderately contracted, loosely spaced along peduncle, the pedicels 4-6 mm. Flowers white-greenish white; calyx pentamerous, the sepals free, thin, papery, 3.5-4 mm by 3 mm, slightly concave; corolla tetramerous, the lateral petals 3 mm x 2 mm with obliquely reflexed scale, the central petals 3 mm x 2.5 mm with hood shaped scale, the scale apex 2-lobed; extrastaminal disk glands 4, ovate, glabrous; stamens 8, the filaments complanate, unequal, the anthers glabrous; pistil tricarpellate, sessile, tomentose, the stigma 3-branched, papillate. Fruit a trigonous, wingless schizocarp, 1-1.5 cm long, 1.5-2.5 cm wide, tomentose, the cocci 3, the carpophore disintegrating and not persistently attached to pedicel; locule monospermous, the dissepimentum broad, the inner wall tomentose. Seed exalbuminous, basally attached, the testa crustaceous, brown, smooth, glabrous; hilum broad; embryo curvate, oily-fleshy; cotyledons folded, the abaxial one incurvate, the adaxial one biplicate.

description: Description: Staminate flowers: pedicels short, inerassate; bractlets 2, tiny, ovate, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.25 mm. wide, acute, villous- pubescent with long antrorse yellow hairs outside; outer sepals 3, ovate, about 1.25 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, acute at apex, concave within, villous outside as the bractlets; inner sepals 3, broadly elliptic, 1.5-2.2 mm. long, 1.25-1.5 mm. wide, obtuse and often subeucullate at apex, concave within, densely strigose-tomentellous with short ap- pressed yellowish hairs outside; petals 6, broadly obovate, about 1.25 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, spatulate and truncate or more or less 3-lobed at apex, often cordate and clawed at base, glabrous, the mar- gins slightly involute; stamens 6, separate to the base, 1.2-1.5 mm. long; filaments glabrous, gradually ampliate from the narrow base to the broad apex; anther-connective slightly prolonged and short-beaked at apex, not humped or keeled; anthers 2-celled, not immersed in the connective, opening by longitudinal slits.

description: Description: Staminate flowers: pedicels very short or obsolete, in- crassate; bractlets obsolete; outer sepals 3, lanceolate-ovate, 0.5-0.6 mm. long, 0.25-0.3 mm. wide, acute, densely tomentose with long, spreading, yellow or brownish hairs outside; inner sepals 3, broadly elliptic, about 1.25 mm. long and wide, rounded at apex, usually re- flexed in anthesis, not eucullate, densely tomentose with tangled hairs outside; petals rhomboid, obtuse, rounded, or sub-3-lobed at apex, 0.7- 0.8 mm. long, about 0.5 mm. wide, not noticeably clawed or cordate at base, glabrous, slightly concave within; stamens 6, separate to base, about 0.75 mm. long; filaments glabrous, club-shaped, conspicuously 2-humped at apex (one hump usually slightly larger than the other); anther-connective not beaked; anthers small, not immersed, opening by longitudinal slits.
