description: Biennial or short-lived perennial with a taproot; stems erect, 1 to several or occasionally as many as 15, the central stem longer than the lateral ones, 0.6-2.3 dm tall, with spreading bristly-hairs and a soft under-pubescence; leaves densely gray-hairy with short soft hairs and longer generally appressed bristles, those on the lower surface often evidently pustulate at the base, those of the upper surface only occasionally pustulate and then only in the basal leaves; basal leaves numerous, tufted, oblanceolate to occasionally somewhat spatulate, mostly 1.5-4 cm long and up to 0.8 cm wide; cauline leaves few, reduced upwards, not as densely pubescent as the basal leaves, the bristles tending to spread especially along the petiole and leaf-margins; inflorescence capitate, tending to be somewhat open in fruit;flowers homostylic; calyx segments 2-4 mm long in flower, elongating to 5-7 mm in fruit; corolla tube short, about equaling the calyx, the flat spreading limb white, 3-6 mm wide, with evident yellowish fornices; nutlets in profile lanceolate to ovate, 2.2-3.2 mm long, smooth and shiny to slightly roughened or occasionally roughened on both sides but not tuberculate, usually all 4 maturing, the scar elongate, closed, the margins not raised; style surpassing the mature nutlets by 0.3-1.1 mm.

description: Plants: Herbs; monoecious. Stems sparsely hispid (hair bases enlarged on older stems). Stem hairs 0.3-0.7(1.1) mm long. Leaves: Petioles cylindrical; sulcate in cross- section; 2-2.5(3) cm long; pubescence a single type on each petiole; antrorse-strigose. Leaf blades pentalobate or heptalobate (rarely); very broadly ovate in outline; broadly cordate at the base; with a basal sinus; acute or broadly acute (rarely) at the apex; 2-3(3.5) x 2.5-4(4.5) cm; 0.7-0.8 times longer than wide; antrorse-strigose on the upper surface; antrorse-strigose on the veins below; sparsely antrorse-strigose on the intervenium below; antrorse-ciliate on the margins. Central leaf-blade lobe symmetrical; narrowly obovate to obovate in outline; acute or broadly acute (rarely) at the apex; 1.1-1.8(2.1) x 0.4-0.9(1.1) cm. Lateral leaf-blade lobes entire; narrowly ob- ovate to obovate in outline; acute at the apex; 0.4-1.8 x 0.2-0.8(1) cm. Tendrils: 2.5-5.5 cm long. Male inflorescences: A sol- itary flower; sessile. Male flowers: Pedicel terete in cross-section; 6-17 mm long (at anthesis); antrorse-strigose. Hypanthium infundibular; 4.2-4.4 mm long; hispidulous or antrorse-strigose. Calyx lobes narrowly oblong in outline; 1.1-1.6 mm long. Corolla hispidulous outside; sparsely puberulent inside. Corolla lobes elliptic in outline; obtuse and mucronate at the apex; 4.4-4.8 x 3.2- 3.4 mm; sparsely hispidulous outside. Sta- mens separating from the hypanthium ca. 2.4 mm from the base of the hypanthium. Filaments ca. 0.2 mm long. Anther thecae straight, without bends; 2.1-2.4 mm long; puberulent (on the edges). Anther connec- tive not extended. Disc trilobate. Female inflorescences: A solitary flower. Female flowers: Pedicel terete in outline; 2.4-4 mm long. Hypanthium obturbinate; not distinctly ridged. The lower 3/4 of hypanthium fused to the ovary. Fused portion of hypan- thium obturbinate; ca. 10.4 mm long; ca. 1.6 mm in diam.; aculeate. Free portion of hypanthium ca. 3.6 mm long; ca. 1.6 mm in diam. Calyx lobes linear in outline; ca. 2.1 mm long. Corolla lobes elliptic in outline; obtuse and mucronate at the apex. Fruit: Monochromous; yellow; ellipsoid; 1.6-1.8 cm long; 0.8-0.9 cm in diam.; with the pericarp moderately to very thick; aculeate; glabrous; rostrate at the apex. Beak 0.6-0.8 cm long. Aculei 0.5-1 mm long. Seeds: Ovate; 3.1-3.8 x 2-2.3 mm; glabrous; smooth without evident surface sculpturing; emarginate.

description: Plants: Vines, herbs, or subshrubs; monoecious. Stems hispidulous or retrorse-stri- gose. Stem hairs 0.1-1 mm long (sometimes with hairs of 2 lengths, the longer ones on the ridges and the shorter in the grooves). Leaves: Petioles cylindrical; sulcate in cross section; 1.5-5(5.5) cm long; pubescence a single type on each petiole; hispidulous or retrorse-strigose. Leaf blades pentalobate to 5-palmately lobed (rarely); broadly ovate to shallowly ovate (rarely) in outline; cordate at the base; with a basal sinus; acute to broadly acute or obtuse at the apex; 1.8-6.5 x 1.5-6 cm; 0.7-1.2 times longer than wide; hispidulous on the upper surface; hispidulous on the veins below; hispidulous on the intervenium below; not ciliate on the margins. Central leaf-blade lobe symmetrical; very broadly triangular or shallowly ovate in outline; acute to broadly acute or obtuse at the apex; 0.7-2 x 0.9-4 cm. Lateral leaf- blade lobes entire; shallowly triangular or shallowly ovate in outline; acute to broadly acute or obtuse at the apex; 0.3-1.2 x 0.5- 2.2 cm. Tendrils: 4-5 cm long. Male inflorescences: Racemose; 5-19-flowered; sessile. Maleflowers: Pedicel terete in cross-section; 2-10.5 mm long; hispidulous. Hypanthium campanulate; 2.8-4 mm long; hispidulous. Calyx lobes narrowly oblong, linear, or triangular in outline; 0.7-2.4 mm long. Corolla puberulent outside; sparsely puberu- lent inside. Corolla lobes elliptic to broadly elliptic or obovate in outline; acute to broadly acute at the apex; 2.6-5.6 x 2-5.6 mm; puberulent outside. Stamens separat- ing from the hypanthium 1.3-1.6 mm from the base of the hypanthium. Filaments 0.3- 0.4 mm long. Anther thecae straight, without bends; 1.6-1.8 mm long; puberulous (on margins). Anther connective extended. Disc cylindrical or fungiform. Female inflorescences: A solitary flower. Female flowers: Pedicel terete in outline; 2.8-14 mm long. Hypanthium hour-glass shaped; distinctly ridged. Ridges on hypanthium 6. The lower 2/3 to 3/4 of hypanthium fused to the ovary. Fused portion of hypanthium ovoid; 3.6- 5.2 mm long; 1.2-1.4 mm in diam.; not aculeate. Free portion of hypanthium 1.6- 2 mm long; 1.6-2 mm in diam. Calyx lobes narrowly oblong or narrowly triangular in outline; 1-1.3 mm long. Corolla lobes obovate in outline; abruptly acuminate at the apex. Stigma 1.1-1.2 mm long; with 3 finger-like projections on the margin. Fruit: Monochromous; orange; ovoid; 1.5-2.5 cm long; 0.6-1 cm in diam.; with the pericarp thin; not aculeate; hispidulous; rostrate at the apex (with hypanthium, calyx, and corolla persistent). Beak 0.7-1 cm long. Seeds: Ovate; 4.2-5.2 x 2.4-3 mm; glabrous; with a band of punctations around the edge on both faces; emarginate.

description: Plants: Herbs; monoecious. Stems hispid and hispidulous. Stem hairs 0.2-0.4 or 0.7- 1 mm long. Leaves: Petioles cylindrical; sul- cate in cross-section; 0.8-2.5 cm long; pu- bescence 2 different types uniformly intermixed on each petiole; hispid and hispidulous. Leaf blades entire; broadly ovate in outline; cordate at the base; with a basal sinus; obtuse at the apex; 1. 5-3 x 1. 5- 3 cm; ca. as long as wide; hispid on the upper surface; hispid on the veins below; hispidulous on the intervenium below; not ciliate on the margins. Stamens separating from the hypanthium 1.5-2.2 mm from the base of the hypanthium. Filaments 0. 5-0.6 mm long. Anther thecae straight, without bends; 1.8-1.9 mm long; puberulent. Free portion of hypanthium 1.8-2.4 mm long; 2-2.2 mm in diam. Calyx lobes narrowly triangular in outline; 0.8-1.6 mm long. Corolla lobes broadly elliptic or broadly ovate in outline; broadly acute to acute at the apex. Stigma 1.5-2 mm long; with 4 finger-like projections on the margin. Fruit: Bicolored with longitudinal stripes from base to apex; ellipsoid; 1.5-4 cm long; 1-2 cm in diam.; with the pericarp thin; not aculeate; hispid- ulous and hispid; short rostrate at the apex. Beak ca. 0.2 cm long. Seeds: Elliptic; ca. 5.5 x ca. 3 mm; glabrous; with a band of punctations around the edge on both faces; emarginate.

description: Plants: Vines or herbs; monoecious. Stems hispid and hispidulous. Stem hairs 0.2-0.3 or 0.6-1.3 mm long. Leaf blades pentalobate; broadly ovate to very broadly ovate in outline; cor- date at the base; with a basal sinus; narrowly acute to acute to broadly acute at the apex; (2.5)3.5-7(9) x (2)3-7 cm; 0.9-1.1 times longer than wide; hispid on the upper sur- face; hispid on the veins below; hispid or hispidulous on the intervenium below; not ciliate on the margins. Central leaf-blade lobe symmetrical; shallowly triangular to broadly triangular (rarely) or shallowly ovate in outline; narrowly acute or broadly acute at the apex; 1.5-3 x 3-4 cm. Lateral leaf blade lobes entire; shallowly triangular to very broadly triangular or shallowly ovate in outline; acute or broadly acute at the apex; 0.5-1.5 x 1-2.5 cm. Tendrils: 3.5-5.5 cm long. Male inflorescences: Shortly racemose or fasciculate; 5-14-flowered; pedunculate or sessile. Male flowers: Pedicel terete in cross-section; 5-17(25) mm long; hispidu- lous. Hypanthium campanulate; 4.2-5 mm long; hispidulous. Calyx lobes linear or narrowly triangular in outline; (1.3)1.6-2.5 mm long. Corolla hispidulous (over veins) out- side; puberulent inside. Corolla lobes broadly elliptic in outline; broadly acute and mucronate at the apex; (2.7)5-5.5 x (1.9)3.9-4.2 mm; hispidulous (over veins) outside. Stamens separating from the hypanthium 2.2-3 mm from the base of the hypanthium. Filaments 0.6-0.9 mm long. Anther thecae straight, without bends; 2.3-3.1 mm long; puberulent. Anther connec- tive extended. Disc cylindrical. Female in- florescences: A solitary flower. Female flowers: Pedicel terete in outline; 9-23 mm long. Hypanthium hour-glass shaped; distinctly ridged. Ridges on hypanthium 6. The lower 5/6 of hypanthium fused to the ovary. Fused portion of hypanthium ellipsoid; ca. 12 mm long; ca. 2 mm in diam.; not aculeate. Free portion of hypanthium ca. 2 mm long; ca. 1.8 mm in diam. Calyx lobes narrowly obovate or narrowly triangular in outline; 1.6- 3.2 mm long. Corolla lobes elliptic or obovate in outline; broadly acute at the apex. Stigma 1.6-2.4 mm long; with 6 or 3 finger like projections on the margin. Fruit: Monochromous (with 8-9 distinct ribs, 0.3- 0.8 mm wide); red (to orange-red); narrowly spindle-shaped to spindle-shaped; 2.5-4 cm long; (0.8)1-1.5 cm in diam.; with the pericarp moderately to very thick; not aculeate; hispid to sparsely so (especially when ma- ture); rostrate at the apex. Beak 0.4-0.8 cm long. Seeds: Elliptic; 4.5-4.9 x 2.3-3.1 mm; glabrous; with a band of punctations around the edge on both faces; emarginate.

description: Plants: Herbs; dioecious. Stems villous. Stem hairs 0.5-1 mm long. Leaf blades entire; ovate to broadly ovate in outline; cordate at the base; with a basal sinus; narrowly acute to broadly acute or obtuse at the apex; 3.5-6.5 x 1.5- 4.5 cm; 1.2-1.5 times longer than wide; villous on the upper surface; villous on the veins below; glabrate on the intervenium below; not ciliate on the margins. description: Plants: Herbs; monoecious. Stems shortly, sparsely pilose. Leaves: Petioles cylindrical; 4-7 cm long; pubescence a single type on each petiole; shortly villous. Leaf blades pentalobate; broadly ovate in outline; cordate at the base; with a basal sinus; acute at the apex; 2-4 x 2-4 cm; as long as wide; villous-hirsute on the upper surface; villous-hirsute on the intervenium below. Central leaf-blade lobe symmetrical; very broadly triangular in outline; acute at the apex; ca. 1.7 x ca. 2.3 cm. Lateral leaf-blade lobes entire; shallowly triangular in outline; acute to broadly acute at the apex; 0.6-0.9 x 1.5-1.9 cm. Tendrils: Ca. 4 cm long. Male inflorescences: Fasciculate; 4-flowered; pedunculate. Maleflowers: Pedicel 13-26 mm long; densely hirsute. Hypanthium campanulate; ca. 2 mm long; shortly, sparsely villous. Calyx lobes narrowly triangular in out- line; ca. 0.5 mm long. Corolla sparsely villous outside. Corolla lobes oblong-ovate in outline; acute at the apex; ca. 3 mm long; sparsely villous outside. Filaments ca. 0.5 mm long. Anther thecae straight, without bends; ca. 1 mm long. Anther connective extended. Female inflorescences: A solitary flower or fascicles; 1-4-flowered. Female flowers: Hypanthium hour-glass shaped; not distinctly ridged. The lower 2/3 of hypanthi- um fused to the ovary. Fused portion of hypanthium ellipsoid; ca. 2.2 mm long; not aculeate. Free portion of hypanthium ca. 1. 1 mm long. Calyx lobes narrowly triangular in outline; ca. 0.4 mm long. Stigma ca. 0.9 mm long; with 3 finger-like projections on the margin. Fruit: Not aculeate; rostrate at the apex. Seeds: Oblong-ovate; 2-3 x ca. 1 mm; glabrous.

description: Plants: Vines; monoecious. Stems short pilose. Stem hairs 0.5-0.8 mm long. Leaf blades pentalobate; very broadly ovate in outline; cordate at the base; with a basal sinus; broadly acute or obtuse at the apex; 3.5-4.5 x 3.5-5.5 cm; 0.8-1 times longer than wide; sparsely hirsute on the upper surface; sparsely hirsute on the veins below; sparsely hirsute on the intervenium below; not ciliate on the margins. Central leaf-blade lobe symmetrical; triangular in outline; broadly acute or obtuse at the apex; 1-1.5 x 2-3 cm. Lateral leaf-blade lobes entire; very shallowly triangular in outline; broadly acute or obtuse at the apex; 0.3-0.6 x 1-2 cm. Tendrils: 2.5-5 cm long. Male inflorescences: Racemose or fasciculate; 3-6-flowered; sessile. Maleflowers: Pedicel terete in cross-section; 5-15 mm long [Manilal et al. (1985) described the pedicels as up to 30 mm long]; hirsute. Hypanthium campanulate; 2.5-5 mm long; hirsute. Calyx lobes linear or narrowly triangular in outline; 1-2 mm long. Corolla glabrous and hirsute (sparsely, over the central vein) outside; glabrous inside. Corolla lobes ovate to broadly ovate in outline; acute at the apex; 4-5 x ca. 2.5 mm; glabrous and hirsute (sparsely, over the central vein) outside. Stamens separating from the hypanthium ca. 1.5 mm from the base of the hypanthium. Filaments ca. 0.4 mm long [Manilal et al. (1985) described the filaments as 2 mm long]. Anther thecae straight, without bends; ca. 1.4 mm long; puberulent. Anther connective extended. Disc cylindrical. Female inflorescences: A solitary flower. Female flowers: Pedicel up to 20 mm long. Hypanthium hour-glass shaped; not distinctly ridged. The lower 2/3 of hypanthium fused to the ovary. Fused portion of hypanthium ellipsoid; 6.5-8 mm long; ca. 2.5 mm in diam.; not aculeate. Seeds: Ovate; 3.1-3.8 x 1.7-2.2 mm; puberulent with hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long (frequently lost after collection); smooth without evident surface sculpturing; marginate with the broad mar- gin delineated by a furrow.

description: Vines, annual, without a woody root-stock, lacking tubers. Monoecious. Stems procumbent or climbing, sulcate, not aculeate, pilose, with non-breakaway hairs. Stem hairs 1-3 mm long. Nodes not geniculate. Internodes 12-18 cm long. Leaves: Petioles cylindrical, sulcate 6-13 cm long, not aculeate, pubescence a single type on each petiole: pilose, with non-breakaway hairs. Leaf blades 5-lobate, with the margins serrate, broadly to very broadly ovate, base cordate, 2-4 cm deep, apex narrowly acute to acute, 14-20 X 14-18 cm, 0.9-1.1 times longer than wide, pilose on the upper surface, not aculeate on the veins below, pilose on the veins below, pilose between the veins below, antrorse-ciliate on the margins, with non-breakaway hairs. Central leaf-blade lobe symmetrical, entire or weakly pinnatifid, broadly to very broadly or rarely shallowly triangular in outline, apex narrowly acute, 7-11 X 6.5-10 cm. Lateral leaf-blade lobes symmetrical or rarely asymmetrical, entire or weakly pinnatifid, broadly triangular, apex acute to narrowly acute, 4-5 X 3-5 cm. Tendrils solitary, simple, 16-20 cm long, not aculeate, short pilose. Inflorescences unisexual. Male inflo- rescences fasciculate, 4-7-flowered, sessile. Male flowers pedicellate. Pedicel terete in cross section, 3-11 mm long (longest on flowers at anthesis), pilose, without bracteoles. Hypanthium campanulate, 4-5 mm long, 3-3.5 mm diam., pilose. Calyx lobes 5 or 6, linear apex narrowly acute; 4.8-6 X 0.4-0.6 mm, pilose. Corolla infundibular, pilose outside, puberulent inside. Corolla tube 1.5-2.5 mm long, ca. 6 mm diam., pilose outside. Corolla lobes broadly ovate, apex broadly acute and mucronate (mucro ca. 0.5 mm long, hyaline), 5.5-6.5 X 5-6 mm, pilose outside, puberulent inside. Sta- mens separating from the hypanthium ca. 3 mm from the base of the hypanthium. Filaments slightly, radially compressed, ca. 1 X ca. 0.5 mm, glabrous. Anther thecae free, sigmoid, 3.5-3.8 mm long, glabrous (ciliate on margins). Anther connective extended, oblong, unilobate, obtuse at apex, papillate at the apex, 1.5-2 X 0.5-0.8 mm, glabrous. Disc weakly fungiform, ca. 0.8 mm long, ca. 2.3 mm diam.; glabrous. Female inflorescences a solitary flower or fascicles (sometimes, multiple fruit set per node), 1- 3-flowered, sessile. Female flowers pedicel- late. Pedicel terete, ca. 12 mm long, pilose, with non-breakaway hairs, cylindrical. Hy- panthium hourglass shaped, not distinctly ridged. The lower 3/4 of hypanthium fused to the ovary. Fused portion of hypanthium ovoid, ca. 12 mm long, ca. 3.5 mm diam., not tuberculate, aculeate, glabrous. Aculei soft, 2-2.2 mm long. Hyaline bristle at apex of aculeus 1.7-1.9 mm long, 5.7-7.3 times as long as the opaque base. The upper 1/4 of hypanthium free from the ovary. Free portion of hypanthium campanulate, ca. 5 mm long, ca. S mm diam., not aculeate out- side, pilose outside, sparsely puberulent in- side. Calyx lobes 5, narrowly elliptic in out- line, apex narrowly acute, 6.5-9 X 1-2 mm, sparsely antrorse-strigose. Corolla infundib- ular, pilose outside, sparsely puberulent in- side. Corolla tube, ca. 3 mm long, ca. 6 mm diam., pilose outside. Corolla lobes trans- versely broadly ovate, apex obtuse and mu- cronate, the mucro 0.5-0.7 mm long and hyaline, 8.5-9 X 9-10 mm, pilose outside; sparsely puberulent inside. Staminodes 5, separating from the free portion of the hy- panthium ca. 3 mm above the ovary, papilliform, ca. 0.5 mm long, 0.3-0.4 mm diam., glabrous. Style terete in cross section, ca. 2 mm long, ca. 1 mm diam., glabrous, subtended by a circular disc, ca. 1.5 mm long, ca. 4.5 mm diam., glabrous. Stigma cupular, ca. 4.5 mm long, ca. 5 mm diam, lobate, with 4 finger-like projections on the margin, 2.5-4 mm long, 1-2 mm diam., papillate. Fruit not geocarpic, maturing above ground and readily visible. Pedicel sulcate, 1-2 cm long, sparsely pilose, with non-breakaway hairs, cylindrical. Fruit monochromous, green (immature) or yellow at maturity, ellipsoid to cylindrical, 9-12 cm long, 3.5- 4.2 cm diam., pericarp moderately to very thick, not tuberculate, aculeate, glabrous, apex blunt. Aculei terete, with hyaline bristle lost, 2.5-4.5 mm long, 3-5 mm in diam. Seeds yellowish white, ovate, 6.5-7 X 3.3- 3.5 mm, 1.5-1.6 mm thick, glabrous, smooth, weakly marginate with the broad margin delineated by a furrow or emarginate, unwinged. Chromosome number: 2n= 4x= 38.

description: Shrub or slender tree with eventually scandent branches or liana, the braniehes strongly rugose, the branchlets opposite, brownish or einereous; petioles 3-7 mm. long, the leaf-blades thin-coriaceous or chartaceous, narrowly elliptic to ovate- or elliptic-oblong, 4.5-12 cm. long, (1.5-)2-7 cm. broad, subattenuate to rounded or faintly cordate at base, sharply acute or cuspidate or abruptly short-acuminate at apex, entire and often conspicuously reflexed at margins, the costa prominent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 5-9 per side, erecto- patent or ascending, arcuate and anastomosing toward margins, con- spicuously elevated on both surfaces, the veinlets copiously reticulate, sharply prominulous on both surfaces; infloreseence (1.5-)3.5-8 cm. long, few-flowered, 2-4-times branched, the peduncle slender, up to 6 cm. long, continued into a similar short rachis, the lateral branches few, alternate or opposite, the bracts papyraceous, lanceolate-ovate, 1-1.5 mm. long, acute; flowers 8-11 mm. in diameter at anthesis, lateral or terminal oni elongate ultimate branchlets, the pedicels 0.5-2.5 mm. long (articulation conspicuous below terminal flowers); sepals ovate-deltoid or suborbicular, 1.5-2.2 mm. long, 2-2.5 mm. broad, erosulous; petals elliptic- or obovate-oblong, 4.5-5.6 nmm. long, 3.5-4 mm. broad, rounded, minutely erosulous; disk membranous, 1-2 mm. in diameter, 0.4-0.5 mm. high, minutely crenulate at margin; filaments 0.8-1.1 mm. long, the anthers about 0.4 by 0.8 mm.; ovary about 0.8 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the style about 0.5 mm. long, subtruncate, the stigmas obscure; ovules 6 per locule; capsules suborbicular or broadly obovate, 5-7.5 cm. long, 4.5-6 cm. broad, stipitate (stipe 2-5 mm. long), the pericarp about 0.3 mm. thick; seeds usually reduced to about 3 in number, the embryoniferous portion about 3 cm. long and 1.5 cm. broad, the wing papyraceous, narrowly oblonig, about 15 mm. long anid 3.5 mm. broad distally.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Albert C. 1940. The American species of Hippocrateaceae. Brittonia. 3: 341-555. f. 1-12.

description: Liana, the branchlets usually opposite, often rtugose, einereous or brownish; petioles 8-13 mm. long, the leaf-blades chartaceous, elliptic-oblong or ovate-oblong, 8-19 cm. long, 4-10 cm. broad, subattenuate to rounded at base, gradually acuminate at apex (acumen 5-10 mm. long, subacute), entire or obscurely crenlulate at margins, the costa promi- nent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 6-9 per side, ascending or arcuate-ascending, conspicuously elevated above, promiinent beneath, the veinlets conspicuously reticulate, sharply prominulous on both surfaces; infloreseence 5-12 cm. long, pedunculate or branching near base, the peduncle slender, subterete or faintly angled, up to 7 cm. long, sometimes continued into a definite rachis, the lateral branches subopposite or alternate, slender, few-flowered, several times alternately or pseudodichotomously branched, the bracts papyraceous, ovate, 1-1.5 mm. long, subacute, erosulous; flowers 10-17 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the pedicels slender, 1.5-3 mm. long; sepals usually obviously flabellate-nerved, broadly ovate or ovate-deltoid, 1.3-2.5 mm. long, 1.7-3.5 imm. broad, subentire or faintly erosulous at miiargins; petals often strongly concave, obovate-elliptic, 5.5-9 mm. long, 3.5-7.5 mm. broad, rounded at apex, entire or faintly undulate-crenulate and often inflexed at margins; disk membranous, 1.5-3 mnm. in diameter, 0.4-0.7 mm. high; filaments 1.2-1.7 mm. long, the anthers 0.4-0.5 mm. long, 0.8-1 mm. broad, at length flattened into one plane; ovary 0.8- 1.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the style stout, 0.5-0.7 mm. long, the stigmas usually coilspicuous, spreading, oblong, obtuse, 0.2-0.6 mm. long, sometimes obscure; seeds 4-6 (frequently fewer, sometimes undeveloped), the embryoniferous portion 2-2.5 cm. lonig, 1.5-2 cm. broad, the wing thin-coriaceous, about 20 mm. long anld 5 mm. broad distally.

description: Shrub to 3 m. high (ex Mitchell), probably becoming scandent, the branchlets cinereous; petioles often rugose, 8-20 mm. long, the leaf- blades chartaceous, elliptic-oblong, 8-17 cm. long, 4.5-9 cm. broad, rounded or broadly obtuse at base, obtusely short-acuminate at apex, entire or obscurely crenulate at margins, the costa promninent on both surfaces, the secondary nerves 5-7 per side, areuate-aseending, con- spicuously prominulous on both surfaces, the veinlets copiously reticulate, prominulous oni both surfaces; description: Shrubby herbaceous perennials 1 m tall, sparsely branched; stem and branches brittle, brownish red, lower stems with thin, gray, exfoliating bark, upper stems glabrous or very sparingly pubescent; internodes shorter than the subtending leaves. Leaves sessile or subsessile, petioles to 0.5 mm long; blades 10-33 mm long, 4-10 mm wide, coriaceous, ascending, somewhat appressed especially to- ward the stem apex, narrowly lanceolate, base acute on lower leaves, rounded on leaves of the inflorescence, apex acute; surfaces completely glabrous, shining; upper leaves gradually diminishing in size to become the crowded, narrowly lanceolate-oblong bracts of the inflorescence. Inflorescences leafy, indistinct ter- minal racemes; flowers solitary at the nodes; pedicels 2-3.5 mm long; bracteoles 0.7-1 mm long, ovate-lanceolate, apex long-acuminate. Hypanthia 22-26 mm long, 4-5 mm wide at the base including a rounded, distinctly descending spur 1.5-2 mm long, widest at the base in lateral view; neck 2-3 mm wide, slender, elongated, constricted at anthesis, base convex dorsally, mouth not flaring, slightly wider than the neck, oblique by extension of the ventral side; outer surface red with yellow apex, shining-glabrous except for occasional erect, colorless, glandular  hairs 0.5 mm long; inner surface neither bialate nor vesiculate, lightly villous above the stamens, glabrous from the base of the stamens to the ovary, ringed at the base around the ovary by a 5-7 mm wide area of flattened, scarious, hyaline hairs less than 1 mm long, inner surface of the spur glabrous; calyx lobes equal, ca 0.5 mm long, broadly triangular; appendages 1 mm long, about as long as the calyx lobes, triangular, terminating in an erect seta. Petals 0. Stamens 11, the 2 dorsalmost shortest, inserted slightly below the ventral 9, 5 antisepalous stamens long-exserted, 4 antipetalous ones subexserted; filaments of the antipetalous sta- mens villous, the rest glabrous. Pollen diporate. Style long-exserted, glabrous; stigma punctiform to slightly capitate; ovary at anthesis 1/3 as long as the style, glabrous, non-gibbous; ovules 5. Seeds 3.5 x 3 mm, dark brown with a lighter, narrow margin, cordate, apex distinctly retuse. Disc 0.5 mm long, bilaterally flattened, subdeflexed with slightly deflexed apex, concave around the base of the ovary.
bibliographicCitation: Graham, Shirley A. 1990. New species of Cuphea section Melvilla (Lythraceae) and an annotated key to the section. Brittonia. 42: 12-32.

description: Shrubby herbaceous perennials, 0.37-1 m tall, with multiple, ascending, simple stems or the stems sparsely branched at or near the stem apex, the branches to 20 cm long; stems and branches brownish red, sparsely to moderately minutely hirsute, the hairs white, antrorsely oriented; internodes 1/2 as long as the subtending leaves at mid-stem, to 1/3 as long at the stem apex. Leaves opposite, sessile or subsessile, appressed and strongly imbricate along the stem on thick, broad petioles < 1 mm long, con- gested toward the stem apex; blades 15-32 X 2-10 mm, narrowly ovate to elliptic or oblong, thickly membranous to coriaceous, the midvein prominently raised below, the secondary and intramarginal veins obscure, on the upper surface the midvein furrowed and secondary veins slightly apparent, the base acute to especially truncate or subcordate at midstem, the apex acute; blade sur- faces glabrous or occasionally sparsely and minutely hirsute near the margin and along the midvein on the lower surface, the mar- gin of larger leaves bearing well-separated, broad-based resin-producing hairs 0.5 mm long; leaves very gradually diminishing in size toward the stem apex to form the im- bricate, ovate to oblong bracts of the inflo- rescence. Inflorescence an indistinct, leafy, terminal raceme; flowers alternate, interpe- tiolar, mostly clustered at or near the stem apices as a result of the shortened distal in- ternodes; pedicels 5-6 mm long, sturdy, persistent; bracteoles 2, broadly ovate, 1 mm long, leaf-like, paired at midpoint on the pedicel or higher. Floral tubes 18-21 X 3-4 mm at anthesis, including a conspicu- ous, descending, slightly inflated spur with rounded base, the spur extending 2-3 mm beyond the attachment of the pedicel, the pedicel ventral; floral tube dorsally convex, ventrally concave, the neck not contracted at anthesis or in fruit, the mouth to 5 mm wide in lateral view, slightly oblique with a small ventral pouch; outer surface yellow, the ribs glandular-hirsute, bearing moder- ately dense, erect, resin-producing, broad- based hairs to 0.5 mm long, the distal 3 mm of the floral tube non-glandular, minutely hirsute or glabrous; inner surface villous above the stamens, pilose below, vesicles 0; sepals equal, 1.3 X 1.5 mm, triangular, the apex acute to acuminate; appendages flat- tened, subtriangular to oblong with a free margin, 1 X 0.5 mm, extending to 1/2 the length of the sepals. Petals 6, equal, 2.5-3 X 1 mm, narrowly obovate, pale yellow. Stamens 11, the 2 dorsalmost shortest and inserted deepest, the filaments glabrous, the other 9 gathered toward the ventral side of the tube, the filaments densely villous, the antesepalous stamens extending to the apices of the sepals, the antepetalous ones slightly shorter. Pollen oval-triangular, tri-colporate, syncolpate, the pores slightly protruding, the exine psilate at 500X, the interaperturate walls thickened; diameter 32-35 [im in lactic acid. Style glabrous, included to slightly exserted at anthesis, long-exserted in fruit; stigma capitate; ovules 3. Seeds 3 X 2.3-2.6 mm, oblong, dark brown, slightly retuse at the apex, the margin thick, rounded, not paler than the seed body. Nectariferous disc 1 X 1.3 mm, semi-circular in dorsal view, curved-deflexed, forming a concavity on the lower side.

description: Herba annua erecta, 30-60 cm alta; caulis simplex vel ramosus, viridis, glanduloso-viscosus, dense pilis purpureis obtectus. Folia anguste lanceolata, 35-90 mm longa, 8-15 mm lata, infima petiolis 10-27 mm longis et summa petiolis 3-10 mm longis insidentia, basi attenuata, apice obtusa, utrinque pilis brevibus longisque sparse adspersa, subtus pilis longis praesertim in nervis; folia floralia gradatim minora, linearia, bracteiformia, sessilia vel brevipetiolata. Inflorescentia foliata, racemosa; flores geminati, alius interaxillaris, alius axillaris; pedicelli 2-3 mm longi, bracteolis minutis ovatis, pilis rubris glandulosis instructis, praediti. Calyx initio horizontalis sed postea declinatus, totus 16-17 mm longus, 4-5 mm latus, calcare 1.5-2 mm longo descendente munitus, isthmo vix constrictus, fauce dilatatus. Calyx extus pilis purpureis glandulosis 0.1-3 mm longis obtectus, dorso purpureus, purpureo-nervatus, ventra-liter pallescens et viridi-nervatus; calyx intus nec bialatus nec vesiculatus, supra stamina villosus, infra stamina glaber; lobus dorsalis maximus productus, linguiformis vel deltoideus, 1.75-2 mm longus, 2 mm latus, ceteri late deltoidei, 1 mm longi, 2 mm lati; appendices inter lobos ca. 0.25 mm longae pilis 3-5 gerentes. Petala 6, purpurea, duo dorsalia erecta, obovata, 12-15 mm longa unguiculo tenuissimo 2-4 mm longo, squamulis non suffulta, 4 ventralia horizontalia, linearia vel anguste spathulata, 4-6 mm longa. Stamina 11, subexserta, duo dorsalia brevissima profundissimaque inserta, duo longissima filamentis complanatis, 0.5 mm latis, dense villosis usque ad antheram. Pollinis grana oblata, ovato-triangulata a polis visa, tricolporata, poris aequatorialibus, aequidistantibus, protrudentibus, 7 µ longis, 6 µ latis, syncolpata, colpis ad medium inter margines et polos abrupte contractis, exiniotectato, striato, utroque latere pororum 3 vel 4 striis crassis ornato et a polis striis tenuibus radiantibus, diametro 35 µ. Gynoecium stigmate capitato, stylo exserto glabro vel parce villoso; ovula 7-10; semina suborbicularia, 2.5 mm longa, 2 mm lata. Discus obliquus, 1 mm longus. n = 12.
bibliographicCitation: Graham, Shirley A. 1968. New species of Cuphea (Lythraceae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 20: 1-10.

description: Fruticulus 80 cm altus, ramis ascendentibus, puberulis. Folia subsessilia, 10-40 mm longa, 5-15 mm lata, ovata vel oblonga, basi rotundata vel obtusa, supra nitida glaberrima, margine scaberrima, subtus pubescentia, ad apicem ramorum congesta. Inflorescentia foliata terminalis indistincta; flores solitarii; pedicelli 4-5 mm longi; bracteolae ovato-lanceolatae apice acuminato. Hypanthium 19-20 mm longum, 4 mm latum, crassum, cylindraceum, flavovirens, minutim puberulum, calcare leviter incurvato, intus infra stamina parce pilosum et ad basim dorsaliter pilis densis hyalinis obtectum; appendices digitiformes lobis saepe longiores. Ovula 5. Discus 1 mm longus, crassus, semicupularis, deflexus.

description: Shrubby herbaceous perennials 80 cm tall, with ascending branches to 20 cm long; stems and branches brownish red, lower stems with thin, gray-brown, exfoliating bark, upper stems and branches sparsely to moderately pubescent, the hairs minute, white, erect; internodes mostly equal to or shorter than the subtending leaves. Leaves subsessile, petioles 1-3 mm long; blades 10-40 mm long, 5-15 mm wide, coriaceous, ovate to oblong, base rounded to obtuse, apex acute; upper surface glabrous, shining, the margin minutely scabrous, the lower surface distinctly paler yellow-green than the upper, bearing minute, white, erect hairs; upper leaves crowded on the stem, gradually diminishing in size to become the overlapping, ovate to oblong bracts of the inflorescence. Inflorescences leafy, indistinct racemes; flowers solitary at the nodes; pedicels 2-3 mm long; bracteoles 1 mm long, ovate-lanceolate, apex long-acuminate. Hypanthia 19-20 mm long, 4 mm wide in lateral view, including a descending spur 1-1.5 mm long; neck of the tube at anthesis not constricted, mouth not flaring, blunt or slightly oblique by extension of the ventral side; outer surface yellow-green, minutely puberulent to pubescent; inner surface neither bialate nor vesiculate, sparsely villous above the stamens, subglabrous from the base of the stamens to the ovary, dorsally above the ovary bearing a dense area of flattened, hyaline hairs ca 1 mm long, inner surface of the spur glabrous; calyx lobes equal, ca 0.5 mm long, broadly triangular; appendages 1 mm long, oblong, green, minutely pubescent, generally extending slightly beyond the calyx lobes. Petals 6, equal, 1 mm long, red, cuneate- oblong. Stamens 11, the 2 dorsalmost shortest, inserted at nearly the same level as the ventral 9, ca 15 mm from the base, 5 antisepalous stamens long-exserted, 4 antipetalous ones included to subexserted; filaments of the antipetalous stamens lightly villous, the others villous to glabrous. Pollen diporate. Style exserted, sparsely pilose; stigma punctiform; ovary at anthesis 1/3 as long as the style, glabrous, non-gibbous; ovules 5. Seeds with a broad retuse apex, mature size unknown. Disc 1 mm long, thick, deflexed, concave around the base of the ovary.

description: Herba robusta suffrutescens perennis, caulibus pilis densis minutis transversalibus dibrachiatis et pilis longis simplicibus in una serie verticali praeditis. Folia anguste elliptica, 45-90 mm longa, 17-35 mm lata, membranacea, supra atro-viridia, subtus griseo-viridia, utrinque pilis brevibus rigidis obtecta, subtus venis maxime prominenti- bus, apice acuminata, basi attenuata, petiolis 4-7 mm longis; folia floralia gradatim minora. Inflorescentia foliata, racemosa, pauciflora; flores 1 per nodum, ut videtur axillares vel in internodii, pedicelli 11-17 mm longi, bracteolis linearibus, viridibus, 2-3 mm longis praediti. Calyx totus 30 mm longus, ore obliquo, latere ventrali aliquantum producto, calcare incurvo, rotundato, 2 mm longo, basi gracilis ruber, expansus versus orem, area intercostali flavovirens, extus pilis brevibus adpressis, intus glaber, nec bialatus vel vesiculatus. Calyces lobi parvi, plus minusve aequales; appendices rubrae, lineares, lobis 2-3-plo longiores. Petala 6, duo dorsalia orbiculata, atro-rubra, 6-7 mm longa, a squamula parva, incrassata, margine rotundata subtenta, 4 ventralia flavida, late obovata, 2.5 mm longa. Stamina 11, 9 exserta, duo dorsalia brevissima profundissime inserta. Pollinii grana oblata, ovato-triangulata a polis visa, tricolporata, poris aequatorialibus, aequidistantibus, non protrudentibus, syn- colpata, exinio tectato, striis multis tenuibus a margine versus polum extensis, diametro 33 u. Gynoecium stigmate punctato, stylo exserto, glabro; ovula 13; semina ignota. Discus horizontalis in calcare.
bibliographicCitation: Graham, Shirley A. 1971. Three new species of Cuphea (Lythraceae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 23: 227-230.

description: Frutex perennis, ad 1 m altus; rami 14-2 7 cm longi, pilis densis, minutis, incoloribus, rigidis et pilis sparsis longioribus, praesertim in caulibus junioribus, indutis; internodiis quam foliis 2-3-plo brevioribus. Folia sessilia vel subsessilia, anguste ovata usque elliptica vel lanceolata, 35-55 mm longa, 13-25 mm lata, basi attenuata, apice acuta, laminis membranaceis vel subcoriaceis, scabris, pilis minutis rigidis et pilis dispersis, longis, infirmis, utrinque indutis; folia floralia gradatim minora, bracteiformia. Inflorescentia foliata, racemosa; flores 1 per nodum, interaxillares; pedicelli 3-4 mm longi, bracteolis spathulatis, ciliatis, 1 mm longis, praediti. Calyx flavovirens, totus 22-26 mm longus, calcare rotundato, 1 mm longo, fauce exigue dilatatus, extus pilis densis brevibus rigidis et longis, infirmis obtectus, intus nec bialatus nec vesiculatus, supra stamina sparse villosus, infra stamina glaber; lobus dorsalis semiorbicularis, 2 mm longus, 3 mm latus, apice mucronato, ceteri angusti deltoidei, 1 mm longi, 1 mm lati; appendicibus inter lobos bulbosis, setosis, praesertim prominentibus dorsaliter. Petala 2, dorsalia, erecta vel reflexa, orbiculata vel obovata, 10 mm longa, erecta vel reflexa, sanguinea, macula parva nigra inferne terminata, unguiculo 1 mm longo, a crista incrassata subtenta. Stamina 11, 5 exserta, duo dorsalia profundissime inserta, filamentis glabris vel leviter villosis praeter apices glabros. Pollinii grana oblata, ovato-triangulata a polis visa, tricolporata, poris aequatorialibus, aequidistantibus, protrudentibus, 4 mm longis, syncolpata, colpis facientibus triangulum magnum ad polos, exinio tectato, omnino grosse uniformiterque striato, diametro 23 ᴗ Gynoecium stigmate punctato, stylo exserto, glabro; ovula 12-14; semina circa 10, fere orbicularia, 2.5 mm longa, 2.5 mm lata. Discus crassus, erectus, ovarii basin ex parte amplectens.

description: Herbae perennes e xylopodio crasso globoso; caules 20-25 cm longi, simplices, erecti, pubescentes et hirsuti. Folia ascendentia, decussata, sessilia, linearia, 25-35 X 1-3 mm, uninervia. Inflorescentiae racemosae foliosae. Flores 8-9 mm longi, calcare brevissime recto, tubo luteolo, intus infra stamina omnino pilosi; vesiculae 0; petala 6, subaequalia vel dorsalia 2 ceteris minora, 5-5.5 X 2-3 mm, luteola; discus basalis nectarifer crassus, subtriangularis, semi-deflexus, subtus non excavatus. Ovula 3; semina margine retusa.

description: Perennial herbs 20-25 cm tall; stems slender, erect, 1 or 2 from a globose xylopodium ca. 1 X 0.5-1 cm, the stems unbranched or with 1 or 2 branches arising near the base; outer bark gray, exfoliating in narrow strips, the inner bark golden brown; stems densely fine-hirsute to pubescent, the hairs erect, thin, transparent, of various lengths to 0.4 mm, sometimes interspersed with coarser, reddish, bulbous-based hairs to 0.5 mm long; internodes 1/2 as long as the subtending leaves. Leaves decussate, sessile, ascending, held at a 450 angle or less to the stem, each leaf overlapping 1/3-1/2 the length of the next successive leaf, the leaves becoming more crowded and more closely appressed toward the stem apex; blades 25-35 X 1-3 mm, narrowly lanceolate to linear, thickly membranous to dry-coriaceous, semi-rigid, appearing uninerved, the midvein prominent below, the margin plane, the base acute, the apex acuminate; blade surfaces glabrous except sparsely setose on young leaves; leaves very gradually diminishing in size toward the apex of the stem to become the lance- olate-linear bracts of the inflorescence. In- florescence a leafy terminal raceme of ca. 10 flowers; flowers alternate, interpetiolar; pedicels 7 mm long, persistent; bracteoles 2, opposite, leaf-like, ovate, 0.6-0.7 mm long, persistent near the apex of the pedicel. Floral tubes 8-9 mm long, 1-2 mm wide at anthesis, including a rounded horizontal spur extending 0.5 mm beyond the attach- ment of the pedicel, the pedicel ventral, the neck slightly contracted, the mouth flared, 3.5 mm wide in lateral view, blunt, up- turned; outer surface yellow-green, hirsute, bearing on the ribs erect coarse, red-purple hairs to 0.2 mm long, these mixed on young flowers with sparse, fine, erect, translucent hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long; inner surface vil- lous above the stamens, pilose below, ves- icles 0; sepals equal, 1 X 1-1.3 mm, tri- angular, the apex acuminate; appendages (epicalyx) represented by thickenings at the sinuses of the sepals, the margins scarcely free. Petals 6, subequal or the dorsal 2 slightly smaller than the ventral 4, 5-5.5 x 2-3 mm, obovate to spathulate, yellow. Sta- mens 11, the 2 dorsalmost shortest and in- serted deepest, the filaments glabrous, the other 9 barely reaching the sinuses of the sepals, the filaments villous, the antesepalous ones longer than the antepetalous ones. Pollen oval-triangular, tricolporate, syncolpate, the pores protruding 2.5-3 pm, the exine moderately and coarsely striate at the equator, the striae extending toward the poles, diam. 25 pm in lactic acid. Style densely villous at the base and on to the upper part of the ovary, glabrous toward the stigma, included in fruit; stigma small, capitate; ovules 3. Seeds unknown in mature state, immature seeds broadly obovate, brown, the margin retuse at the apex. Nectariferous disc 0.5-0.7 X 1 mm, subtriangular in dorsal view, slightly curved-deflexed, the base thick, not concave or excavated on the underside. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Herba gracilis repens, verisimiliter perennis; rami plerumque erecti, ad 1.5 cm longi, pilis densis, minutis, rigidis obtecti et pilis longis infirmis in una serie verticali praediti. Folia sessilia vel subsessilia, lanceolata vel ovata, 10-20 mm longa, 3-9 mm lata, crassa, coriacea, supra glabra, subtus pilis densis, minutis, rigidis, apice acuta vel acuminata, basi rotundata; folia floralia gradatim minora. Inflorescentia ter minalis, foliata, racemosa; flores 1 per nodum, interaxillares, interdum in internodiis; pedicelli 4-5 mm longi, bracteolis scariosis, lanceolatis, 1.5 mm longis praediti. Calyx gracilis, totus 20 mm longus, longissime calcaratus, calcare 4 mm longo, gracili, acuto, descendente, lobis plus minusve aequalibus, ore non obliquo, appendicibus lobos aequantibus, 1-aristatis, extus flavovirens, costis purpureis et pilis minutis rigidis obtectus, intus bialatus, alis glabris. Petala 6, atropurpurea, duo dorsalia obovata, 6 mm longa, macula parva nigra inferne terminata, a squamula elongata incrassata, 0.5 mm longa subtenta, 4 ventralia lanceolata vel oblonga, 1.5-2 mm longa. Stamina 11, plerumque 3 exserta, filamentis glabris. Pollinii grana oblata, ovato-triangulata a polis visa, tricolporata, poris aequatorialibus, aequidistantibus, leviter protrudentibus, syncolpata, exinio tectato, omnino striato, striis numerosis, dilutis, diametro 20 u. Gynoecium stigmate punctato, stylo exserto, glabro; ovula 10; semina ignota. Discus 1 mm longus, deflexus, projectus sed non adnatus in calcare.

description: Herba annua erecta, 25-70 cm alta, plerumque ramosa; caulis pilis minutis nonglandulosis et pilis longis glandulosis obtectus. Folia late ovata usque elliptica, 35-75 mm longa, 20-40 mm lata, petiolis 5-35 mm longis, basi acuta usque obtusa, apice acuminata, utrinque dense pilis brevibus sparse longisque adspersa; folia floralia gradatim minora, lanceolata usque linearia, bracteiformia, 4-15 mm longa, 0.25-4 mm lata, sessilia vel brevipetiolata. Inflorescentia racemosa vel brevi- vel longipaniculata; flores 1-3 per nodum, unus interaxillaris, ceteri axillares in ramis brevibus; pedicelli 1 mm longi, bracteolis pilis usque ad 0.5 mm longis compositis, praediti. Calyx totus 8-11 mm longus, 1-1.5 mm latus, vix calcaratus. Calyx extus pilis purpureis glandulosis 0.1-1 mm longis obtectus, dorso rubro-purpureus viridinervatus, ventraliter stramineus, viridi-nervatus; calyx intus bialatus, alis glabris, non vesiculatus, supra stamina villosus, infra stamina glaber; lobus dorsalis maximus productus, late deltoideus, 0.75-1.25 mm longus, 1-1.5 mm latus, post anthesin deflexus, ceteri deltoidei, 0.25-0.5 mm longi, 0.25-0.5 mm lati; appendices inter lobos virides, 0.25 mm longae pilis albis gerentes. Petala 2 vel 6, purpureo-nigra, duo dorsalia oblonga usque obovata, 2.5-5 mm longa, fere horizontalia, squamulis non suffulta, 4 ventralia linearia vel oblonga, usque ad 0.5 (-2) mm longa, horizontalia, saepe rudimentalia vel nulla. Stamina 11, inclusa, parce villosa, duo dorsalia brevissima profundissimaque inserta. Pollinis grana oblata, ovato-triangulata a polis visa, tricolporata, poris aequatorialibus, aequidistantibus, protrudentibus, 3 µ longis, 4 µ latis, syncolpata colpis angustis rectis, exinio tectato, omnino striato, diametro 24 µ. Gynoecium stigmate capitato, stylo exserto, parce villoso; ovula 3; semina suborbicularia, 2.5 mm longa, 2 mm lata. Discus oblongus, 0.5 mm longus, erectus vel parce obliquus, apice ampliato vel deflexo. n = 10.

description: Sessile, oblong leaves with rounded base and an abbreviated acute-acuminate apex and the terminal, hypsophylloid inflorescence serve to identify C. pulchra. Koehne stressed the unusual morphology of this species by separating it as the sole member of series 4 of subsection Pachycalyx. On the basis of the hypsophylloid inflorescence and low ovule number (4-7) the species resembles C. paradoxa in subsection Melvilla series 3, but otherwise the species are not similar. Pollen of C. pulchra, unlike all other pollen known in section Melvilla, has interaperturate thickenings characteristic of pollen of section Trispermum, suggesting possible early derivation from that line. The pollen differences in section Melvilla, which include: triporate, triangular, finely-striated grains; triporate, oval triangular grains; triporate, thick-interaperturate grains; and diporate grains, proviide a major argument for the polyphyletic nature of the section and for the convergent development of the thick, red-tubed, bird-pollinated flower form.

description: Frutex perennis glaber, ad 1 m altus; rami fusci vel fusci-purpurei, cortice maturo exfoliato, internodiis plerumque foliis 2-3-plo brevioribus. Folia decurrentia, petiolis 1-5 mm longis, anguste lanceolata ad 105 mm longa et 20 mm lata, saepe 50 mm longa et 6 mm lata, basi apiceque acuta; folia floralia gradatim minora, bracteiformia, saepe 20 mm longa et 4 mm lata. Inflorescentia foliata, racemosa vel paniculata; flores saepe 1 per nodum, alterni, interaxillares; pedicelli 4-7 mm longi, bracteolis 0.5 mm longis pilis 3-paucis bulbosis compositis, praediti. Calyx 18-22 mm longus, 5-6 mm latus, adaxiale convexus, postice gibbosus, ore obliquo, latere ventrali aliquantum producto. Calyx totus roseo-purpureus, extus intusque glaber, intus nec bialatus vel vesiculatus; lobi late triangulares, lobus dorsalis 1.5 mm longus, ceteri 1 mm longi; appendices lobos aequantes vel paullo breviores, 1-2 setis brevibus praediti. Petala 6, roseo-purpurea, duo dorsalia orbiculata usque obovata, 5-6 mm longa, unguiculo tenuissimo 1-1.5 mm longo, fere erecta, a crista incrassata subtenta, 4 ventralia subulata, ad 1 mm longa, horizontalia. Stamina 11, saepe 9 exserta, 2 inclusa, filamentis leviter villosis praeter apices glabros, duo dorsalia brevissima profundissime inserta. Pollinis grana oblata, triangulata a polis visa, tricolporata, poris aequatorialibus, aequidistantibus, non protrudentibus, syncolpata, exinio tectato, striis multis tenuibus a margine versus polum extensis, diametro 35 µ. Gynoecium stigmate punctato vel vix bifido, stylo exserto sub anthesi, tempore gradatim producto; ovarium sine apice gibbere dorsali auctum; ovula 35-40; semina 20-30, obovata, 2 mm longa, 1.5 mm lata. Discus crassus, erectus, 1-1.5 mm longus, 2-2.5 mm latus, ovarii basin ex parte amplectens sed ventraliter interruptus.

description: Fruticulus 40 cm altus ramis glaberrimis. Petioli 1 mm longi, complanati. Folia 5-12 mm longa, 5-8 mm lata, ovato-oblonga vel suborbiculata, glaberrima nitida. Inflorescentia foliata terminalis indistincta; flores solitarii usque terni; pedicelli 1-2.5 mm longi; bracteolae ovato-lanceolatae, apice acuto. Hypanthium 11-13 mm longum, 3-4 mm latum, flavum, glabrum praeter costas sparse glanduloso-setosas, calcare 1 mm longo, subincurvato; intus supra stamina glabrum infra staminum glabrum nisi ad basim annulo villoso cinctum. Petala 0. Pollen diporatum. Ovula 3. Semina 3 x 2.5 mm, cordata, retusa. Discus semicupularis, 0.5 mm longus, complanatus, subdeflexus apice deflexo.

description: Subshrubs to 40 cm tall, glabrous, sparsely branched, stems brownish red with brownish red bark; internodes 1/2 as long as to equal the length of the subtending leaves. Leaves subsessile, petioles to 1 mm long, flattened, 1 mm wide, broadly attached at the node; blades 5-12 mm long, 5-8 mm wide, subfleshy, ovate-oblong to suborbicular, base rounded to obtuse, rarely acute, briefly attenuate, apex rounded; surfaces shining, glabrous; upper leaves scarcely diminishing in size in the inflorescence, densely clustered and overlapping. Inflorescences leafy, indistinct terminal racemes; flowers 1-3 at a node, one interaxillary, the others on a much reduced axillary branchlet; pedicels 1-2.5 mm long; bracteoles ovate to oblong, ca 0.5 mm long, apex acute. Hypanthia 1 1-13 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, including a dorsally convex, slightly descending spur 1 mm long; neck 2 mm wide, thick, short, scarcely constricted at anthesis, mouth not flaring, about as wide as the neck in lateral view, blunt to very slightly oblique by extension of the ventral side; outer surface yellow, glabrous except for sparse, colorless, glandular  viscous setae 0.5-0.7 mm long on the ribs; inner surface glabrous above the stamens, glabrous from the base of the stamens to the ovary, ringed at the base around the ovary by a 3 mm wide band of slightly flattened hyaline hairs less than 1 mm long, inner surface of the spur glabrous; calyx lobes equal, ca 0.5 mm long, triangular; appendages ca 0.5 mm long, shorter than to equal the calyx lobes, oblong, terminating in a single seta. Petals 0. Stamens 11, the 2 dorsalmost short- est, inserted immediately below the ventral 9, 5 antisepalous stamens slightly exceeding the hypanthium, 4 antipetalous ones included; filaments glabrous to lightly villous. Pollen diporate. Style long-exserted, glabrous; stigma punctiform to slightly capitate; ovary at anthesis as long as the style, glabrous, non-gibbous; ovules 3. Seeds 3 x 2.5 mm, dark brown with a lighter narrow margin, cordate, apex distinctly retuse. Disc 0.5 mm long, flattened, subdeflexed with deflexed apex, concave around the base of the ovary.

description: Frutex perennis, 1-2.5 m altus; caules maturitate glabri, ferruginei, rami juniores virides, glanduloso-hirtelli; internodia plerumque quam folia 2-3-plo breviora. Folia sessilia vel subsessilia, anguste ovata usque lanceolata, 25-50 mm longa, 5-17 mm lata, glabra, basi obtusa, apice acuta vel acuminata; folia floralia abrupte minora, bracteiformia, lanceolata. Inflorescentia distincta, terminalis, racemosa vel paniculata; flores 1 per nodum, interaxillares; pedicelli 3-4 mm longi, bracteolis anguste ovatis ad 1.5 mm longis vel bracteolis 3 pilis bulbosis compositis, praediti. Calyx totus 22-30 mm longus, 3.5-5 mm latus, calcare truncato vel rotundato, descendente, 2.5 mm longo, ore dilatato, obliquo, latere ventrali aliquantum producto. Calyx extus pilis brevibus glandulosis instructus, basi et a basi ad orem secus costas intense vinosus, area intercostali flavovirens; costae dorsales divergentes, 1.5-2.5 mm distantes, ceterae 0.5-1.5 mm distantes; calyx intus bialatus, non vesiculatus, basim versus dense villosus, alis glabris, ceterum glaber. Calyces lobi late triangulares, 3 lobi superiores 4 mm longi, 3 lobi inferiores 1.5 mm longi; appendices lobis breviores, orbiculatae, glabrae. Petala 6, vinosa, duo dorsalia obovata, 9-11 mm longa, unguiculo tenuissimo ad 2 mm longo, erecta vel leviter reflexa, a crista incrassata subtenta, 4 ventralia anguste lanceolata vel linearia, 1-2 mm longa, horizontalia. Stamina 11, saepe 9 exserta, 2 inclusa, filamentis glabris, antheris purpureis, duo dorsalia brevissima profundissime inserta. Gynoecium stigmate punctato vel vix capitato, stylo incluso sub anthesi, tempore gradatim producto; ovula 12; semina plerumque 6-8, obovata, 3 mm longa, 2.5 mm lata. Discus crassus, horizontalis, 1.5 mm longus, 1.5 mm latus.
bibliographicCitation: Graham, Shirley A. 1968. New species of Cuphea (Lythraceae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 20: 1-10.

description: Herba annua, 10-70 cm alta; caulis ramique graciles, virides vel spadicei, pilis albis brevibus usque ad 0.1 mm longis et dense pilis rubro-purpureis, 0.25-1 mm longis obsiti, nodorum pilis purpureis, 1 mm longis. Folia ovata, 15-40 mm longa, 8-20 mm lata, petiolis 5-20 mm longis, basi obtusa usque cordata, apice acuta usque acuminata, utrinque dense pilis brevibus sparse longisque adspersa; folia floralia gradatim minora, bracteiformia, sessilia, in pare inaequalia, pilis minutis albis obtecta. Inflorescentia racemosa vel brevipaniculata; flores 1-5 per nodum, unus interaxillaris, ceteri axillares in ramis brevibus; pedicelli 1-7 mm longi, bracteolis pilis minutis paucis compositis, praediti. Calyx totus 4-8 mm longus, 1-2 mm latus, calcare conico horizontali vel leviter ascendente, 1-3 mm longo. Calyx extus pilis minutis purpureis glandulosis instructus, dorso purpureus, ventraliter pallescens, ore lobisque viridibus; calyx intus nec bialatus nec vesiculatus, parce villosus; lobus dorsalis maximus productus, late deltoideus, 0.5-1 mm longus, 1-1.75 mm latus, post anthesin deflexus, ceteri deltoidei, 0.5 mm longi, 0.5 mm lati; appendices inter lobos virides, suborbiculares, usque ad 0.25 mm longae, duo dorsales pilis 2 vel 3 purpureis gerentes, ceteri pilis singularis gerentes. Petala 6, subaequalia vel dorsalia quam ventralia longiora, duo dorsalia purpurea, oblonga, usque obovata, 1-3 mm longa, squamulis parvis triangularibus suffulta, 4 ventralia pallida purpurea, oblanceolata, 1.5-3 mm longa, horizontalia. Stamina 11, inclusa vel subexserta, duo dorsalia brevissima profundissimaque inserta, duo longissima filamentis dense villosis praeter apices glabros. Pollinis grana oblata, ovato-triangulata a polis visa, tricolporata, poris aequatorialibus, aequidistantibus, protrudentibus, 3 µ longis, 4 µ latis, syncolpata colpis angustis, exinio tectato, utroque latere pororum 3 vel 4 striis crassis ornato, ceterum laevi, diametro 21 ft. Gynoecium stigmate capitato, stylo incluso vel exserto, glabro; ovula 6; semina suborbicularia, 1.5 mm longa, 1.25 mm lata. Discus anguste triangularis, deflexus in calcare, 1-1.25 mm longus. n = 10.
bibliographicCitation: Graham, Shirley A. 1968. New species of Cuphea (Lythraceae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 20: 1-10.

description: Slender perennial herbs 16-20 cm tall with 1 to a few stems arising from an eventually enlarged, elongated to slightly globose, woody root, the stems erect, unbranched, minutely hispid, bearing a mix of eglandular, minute, erect, white hairs and glandular-viscous, bulbous-based hairs to 1 mm long; internodes ca. 2/3 the length of the subtending leaves. Leaves decussate, ses- sile, slightly ascending, imbricate or nearly so; blades 15-35 X 4-8 mm, narrowly lanceolate, thickly membranous, the midvein prominently raised below, the secondary and intramarginal veins conspicuous in the dry state, the base obtuse to rounded, the apex acuminate; blade surfaces glabrous ex- cept for sparsely scattered, lax, white, glandular setae to 0.5 mm long; leaves abruptly reduced toward stem apex to form lanceolate-linear bracts of the inflorescence. Inflorescence a distinct, small-bracted, sparsely-flowered, terminal raceme; flowers alter- nate, interpetiolar; pedicels 5-10 mm long; bracteoles 2, lanceolate, 0.5 mm long, sub-opposite near the apex of the pedicel. Floral tubes 7-8 mm long, 1.5 mm wide at anthe- sis, including a rounded, horizontal spur extending 1 mm or less beyond the attachment of the pedicel, the pedicel ventral, the neck of the floral tube contracted at anthesis, broad in fruit, the mouth flaring, ca. 3 mm wide in lateral view, upturned with a small ventral pouch; outer surface yellow-green, bearing abundant eglandular and glandular hairs as on the stems; inner surface lightly villous, denser on the dorsalmost ribs at the base of the ovary, vesicles 0 to weakly developed; sepals equal, 1 X 1 mm, triangular; appendages minute thickenings at the sinuses between the sepals, the margin scarcely free. Petals 6, subequal, 3.5-5 X 1.5-2 mm, the ventrals slightly longer than the dorsals, oblong-obovate, yellow. Sta- mens 11, the 2 dorsalmost shortest and in- serted deepest, the 5 antesepalous stamens reaching the apex of the sepals, the 4 an- tepetalous ones reaching the sinuses of the sepals or shorter, the filaments villous. Pol- len oval-triangular, tricolporate, syncolpate, the pores strongly protruding, the exine coarsely striate, especially at the pores; diam. (18-)20-25 µm in lactic acid. Style villous, included to barely exserted at anthesis, long-exserted in fruit, the apex curving upward; stigma small-capitate to punctiform; ovules 3. Seeds 2.5 X 2 mm, oblong-orbicular, brown, obtuse at the apex, marginate, the margin narrow, rounded, not thinned or paler than the seed body. Nec- tariferous disc 0.5 X ca. 1 mm, thick, in the plane of the ovary, horizontal-deflexed.

description: Robust liana flowering in forest canopy or draping forest margins, the young stems and newly expanding leaves densely sordid- tomentulose with hairs <0.4 mm, the adult leaves firmly chartaceous discolorous, glabrous or almost so and lustrous on upper face, densely pallid-tomentulose beneath with short matted hairs, the indumentum concealing the epidermis. Petiole of leaves associated with inflorescence 2-4 cm, that of some shade-leaves attaining 9 cm; leaf blades basifixed, ovate from widely cuneate base, shortly or obscurely acuminate, that of leaves associated with inflorescence ±7- 10 X 4.5-6.5 cm, that of shade-leaves at- taining 17 X 10.5 cm; primary nerves 5(7), shallowly depressed ventrally, slenderly raised dorsally, the midrib simple or sometimes once forked distally on each side, the scalariform secondary nerves and reticular venules shallowly or scarcely depressed ventrally. Staminate inflorescence compactly cymose-paniculate, gray-tomentulose throughout, the primary axes to 6 cm, the pedicels at and after anthesis 2-3 X 0.8-1 mm, the flowers caducous. Staminate flower: sepals 3-seriate, the 3 outermost ones linear-elliptic ±0.8 X 0.25 mm, the 3 median ones similar but 1.2 X 0.3 mm, the 3 innermost rhombic-obovate ±1 X 0.9 mm; petals 3, rhombic-obovate ?0.8 X 0.4 mm, glabrate; androecium 6-merous, the free filaments linear 1.6-1.8 mm, the erect anthers 0.2 mm; pistillode 0. Pistillate inflorescence simply racemose, few-flowered, the pri- mary axis to 1.5 cm, the fruiting pedicels 9-13 mm, the three carpophores ± 1.5 X 5 mm. Drupes plumply obovoid from oblique base, ±4 X 3.3 X 3 cm, the densely velutinous-tomentulose exocarp scarcely 0.2 mm thick, the papery endocarp scarcely thicker, the lignescent mesocarp 8-9 mm thick; embryo horny ±23 X 18 mm.

description: Quoad folia alterna, ramulos novellos dense ferrugineo glandulari-granulosos, corolla intus omino glandulari-papillosa, antherasque elongatas triangulares curvatas et longitudinaliter dehiscentes, subgeneri Iteoides Agostini pertinet. Affinis C. iteoideo (Bentham) Agostini sed lamina margine plana (nec revoluta), dorso squamis lepidotis margine liberis (nec in fovea superpositus) induta, floribus [male] 2.8-3.0 (nec 3.4-4.0) mm longis, sepalorum lobis triangulari-attenuatis (nec ovato-triangularibus), corollaeque lobis secus marginem glanduloso-ciliatis (nec glandulari-granulosis) basi usque 13 (nec 3/4 connatis differt.

description: Tree, 4-5 m tall; branchiets slender, furrowed, densely glandular-granulose and ferrugineous-lepidote when young. Leaves with petioles canaliculate, 1.2-2.0 cm long, densely lepidote, the blades chartaceous, narrowly elliptic, 9-20 x 3.4-6.0 cm, apically long- or subabruptly-acuminate, basally cuneate, the margins flat and entire, glabrous or bearing a few ferrugineous-lepidote scales above, pustu- late, manifestly orange-lepidote and drying pallid below. Inflorescence a simple, axillary raceme, 1.5-4.5 cm long; rachis manifestly orange glandular-granulose and lepidote; pedicels 3.0-4.0 mm long, densely glandular-granulose. Staminate flowers 4- or 5-merous, 2.8-3.0 mm long, white or pinkish-white; calyx shallowly cupuliform, glabrous, orange-punctate, the sepals connate ca 14 their length, calyx tube 0.28-0.30 mm long, the lobes triangular-attenuate, 1.2-1.4 mm long with glandular-ciliate margins; petals connate basally to 1/3 their length, the corolla tube 0.73-0.80 mm long, the lobes reflexed at anthesis, ovate-triangular, 2.1- 2.2 x ca. 1.1 mm, narrowly ovate at apex, with glandular-ciliolate margins, or- ange-punctate above the middle and along the margin without, glandular-papillose throughout within, orange schizogenous glands of the lobes mostly prominent within; stamens 1.1-1.3 mm long, the filaments connate into a tube, ca 0.7 mm long, the anthers erect, elongate-triangular, curved, cordate at base, dorsifixed below the middle, longitudinally dehiscent by narrow slits; pistillode globose, 0.9 mm long, lepidote; stigma truncate. Fruiting pedicels 1.2-1.3 mm long, the calyx broadly ovate-triangular, 0.9-1.1 mm long, orange-punctate above the middle without, the margins glandular-ciliolate; corolla, staminodes and pistil not seen. Fruit black, drying to ca 6 mm in diam.

description: Quoad folia altema, ramulos novellos dense ferrugineo-tomentosos, perianthii glandulasque haud prominentes, subgeneri Laxifloro Agostini pertinet. Valde affinis C. duidae (Gleason et Mold.) Agostini sed inflorescentiarum rachi atro-punctato (nec epunctato), bracteis 1.5-1.7 (nec 0.8-1.5) mm longis, calycisque lobis deltatis subacuminatis integerrimis 1.3-1.7 mm longis atro-punctatis inter se aequilatis (nec late triangularibus erosis 0.7-1.2 mm longis pellucide aurantiaco-punctatis inter se inaequilatis) differt.

description: Shrub to 3 m tall. Branchlets thin, 2-4 mm diam, appressed-stellate and dendroid-ferrugineous tomentose when young, glabrescent. Petioles marginate, 0.6-1.5 cm long, stellate-ferrugineous tomentulose, soon glabrescent. Leaf blades coriaceous, narrowly obovate-spathulate, 3.2-4.4 X 1.7-2.8 cm, apically obtuse, emarginate, rounded or acute, basally attenuate, marginally entire, somewhat glaucous, pitted and bearing a few stellate ferrugineous trichomes above, prom- inently pitted with superimposed lepidote scales below, the costa and secondary veins prominent above and below, the tertiary veins not visible above. Staminate plant not seen. Pistillate inflorescence erect, 1-2.8 (4.2) cm long, 2-9-flowered, the rachis thin, opaque, black-punctate, ferrugineous glandular-granulose with a few scattered ferrugineous trichomes; bracts linear-lanceolate, 1.5-1.7 mm long, densely ferrugineous tomentose, usually caducous; pedicels (1.9) 2.5-3.2 mm long, ferrugineous glandular-granulose, glabrescent. Pistillate flowers not seen. Fruiting calyx cotyliform, divided equally, the tube ca 1/4-1/3 calyx length, 0.4-0.5 mm long, glandular-granulose, the lobes deltate, 1.3-1.7 X 1.3-1.7 mm, subacuminate api- cally, coriaceous, somewhat rugose basally, black-punctate, the margins undulate, entire, glandular-ciliate. Fruit globose, bearing a few scattered lepidote scales at base, green, then black, 3-4 mm in diam when dried.
bibliographicCitation: Pipoly III, John J. 1983. Contributions toward a monograph of Cybianthus (Myrsinaceae): III. A revision of subgenus Laxiflorus. Brittonia. 35: 61--80.

description: Shrub or small tree to 3 m tall. Branchlets thin to moderately thick, 3.5-8 mm in diam, appressed-stellate and dendroid-ferrugineous tomentose, at times appearing furfuraceous when dried, glabrescent. Petioles marginate, 0.6-2.4 cm long, stellate-ferrugineous tomentulose, glabrescent. Leaf blades coriaceous, widely obovate to oblanceolate, 3.2-8 X 1.7-3.9 cm, apically obtuse, emarginate or acute, basally acute, the margins entire and revolute toward base, nitid, prominently pitted and glabrous or bearing a few stellate trichomes above, sparsely stellate-ferrugineous puberulent at first, glabrescent, pitted with superimposed lepidote scales below, the costa and secondary veins not prominent above, raised below. Staminate inflorescence lax, 1.5-4.9 cm long, the rachis opaque, green, ferrugineous glandular-granulose with a few scattered dendroid trichomes; bracts linear- lanceolate, 0.6-2.1 mm long, densely ferrugineous tomentose, caducous; pedicels 0.5-1.8 mm long, densely translucent glandular-granulose, with scattered stellate trichomes, glabrescent. Flowers 4- or 5-merous, yellow or greenish-yellow; calyx shallowly cotyliform, 1.3-1.8 mm long, unequally divided, the tube 1/4-1/3 calyx length, 0.5-0.6 mm long, densely glandular-granulose with scattered ferrugineous stellate trichomes, often glabrescent, the lobes widely triangular, 0.7-1.2 X 0.7-1.5 mm, acute to prominently acuminate apically, membranaceous or slightly thickened medially, pellucid- or orange-punctate, the margins minutely erose, glandular-ciliate, with scattered translucent lepidote scales; corolla campanulate, (3.1) 3.4-4.4 mm long, the tube ca 1/4 corolla length, (0.8) 1-1.3 mm long, the lobes slightly reflexed at anthesis, ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 2.3-3.3 X 1. 1-2 mm, acute to somewhat rounded apically, prominently orange-lineate and often bearing a few black-punctate glands apically; stamens 2.4-2.8 mm long, the filaments connate into a tube, 1-1. 1 mm long, their free portions 1-1 .3 mm long, the anthers elongate-triangular, 1.1-1.2 mm long, dorsifixed ca 1/3 from base; pistillode 2.2- 3.2 mm long, the ovary 0.4-0.7 (1) X 0.4-0.9 (1. 1) mm, prominently translucent- lepidote, the scales often short-stipitate, the style elongate, erect or twisted, 1.6- 2.1 mm long, the stigma 0.2-0.3 mm long. Pistillate inflorescence erect, (1.4) 2- 5.8 cm long, (3) 7-1 3-flowered, the rachis opaque, maroon, ferrugineous glandular- granulose with a few scattered trichomes, glabrescent; bracts linear-lanceolate, 0.8-1.5 mm long, densely ferrugineous tomentose, early caducous; pedicels 0.9- 2.3 mm long, glandular-granulose with a few scattered stellate ferrugineous tri- chomes, glabrescent. Flowers 4-merous, yellow or greenish-yellow; calyx cotyli- form, divided unequally, the tube ca 1/4-1/3 calyx length, 0.6-0.7 mm long, glan- dular-granulose, with scattered lepidote scales, early glabrescent, the lobes widely triangular, 0.7-1.2 X 1.1-1.8 mm, acute apically, thickened medially, somewhat rugose, orange-punctate, the margins minutely erose, sparsely glandular-ciliate with a few translucent lepidote scales; corolla campanulate, 2.6-2.8 mm long, the tube ca 1/4 corolla length, 0.7-0.8 mm long, the lobes strongly reflexed at anthesis, ovate-triangular, 1.8-2.1 X 1-1.6 mm, acuminate and sparsely black-punctate apically; staminodes 1.7-2 mm long, the filaments connate into a tube 0.8-0.9 mm long, the free portion 0.5-0.6 mm long, the sterile anthers 0.6-0.7 mm long, dorsifixed ca 1/3 from base; pistil ca 3 mm long, the ovary 1.1-1.3 X 0.8-1 mm, prominently translucent stipitate-lepidote, with 3-4 ovules partially imbedded in placenta, the style thick, ca 1.6 mm long, the stigma ca 0.1 mm long. Fruit globose, bearing a few translucent lepidote scales apically below the often persistent style base, red, then purple, 4-6 mm in diam when dried.

description: Shrub or tree to 10 m tall. Branchlets mostly thick, (3) 5.2-12 mm diam, glabrate or densely stellate- and dendroid-ferrugineous tomentose and glandular-granulose, at times glabrescent. Petioles marginate, (1.3) 1.6-4.2 (4.6) cm long, ferrugineous tomentose, glabrescent or persistent. Staminate inflorescence often tortuous, sometimes lax (3.6) 4.5-15 cm long, the rachis maroon, opaque, densely ferrugineous tomentose and glandular-granulose, often glabrescent; bracts linear- lanceolate, 0.8-3.6 mm long, densely ferrugineous tomentose, caducous; pedicels (0.2) 2.9-3.6 mm long, densely ferrugineous tomentose and glandular-granulose, glabrescent. description: Plant arborescent; stem usually unbranched, erect or decumbent, to 10 m tall, 12-25 cm diam. at narrowest point, bark almost smooth, pale grey. description: Plant arborescent; stem erect, un- branched, to 3 (rarely to 10) m tall, 11-20 cm diam. at narrowest point, bark lightly fissured, grey to brown. Leaves numerous, bright green, glossy, 1.5-2.5 m long, flat (not keeled) in section, with 100-200 pinnae, opposing pinnae inserted at 180º on rachis, rachis consistently terminated by paired pinnae. Petiole 35-60 cm long (20-35% of total leaf), glabrous, spinescent for 80-100% of length. Basal pinnae not gradually reducing to spines, pinnae to 19 cm long. Median pinnae simple, glabrous, strongly discolorous, inserted at 70-850 to rachis, 22-32 cm X 12-16 mm, section flat, margins slightly recurved, decurrent for 5-8 mm, narrowed to 4.5-7 mm at base (to 35-50% of maximum width), 15-19 mm apart on rachis; apex acute, not spinescent; midrib flat above, raised below. Tomentum loose and shed early. Cataphylls broadly triangular; soft, 4-7 cm long, with short, grey to pale yellow-brown indumentum. Microsporangiate cones ovoid, orange, 16-40 cm long, 9-12 cm diam. Microsporophyll lamina 35-40 X 18-22 mm, fertile zone 30-35 mm long, sterile zone 5-6 mm long, level to slightly deflexed, apical spine, prominent, sharply upturned, 9-17 mm long. Megasporophylls 18-32 cm long, white-tomentose or yellow-tomentose; ovules 6, glabrous; lamina lanceolate, 50-75 X 25- 35 mm, obscurely dentate, with up to 12 soft, indistinct lateral spines 0-1 mm long; apical spine distinct from lateral spines, 15- 25 mm long. Seeds flattened-ovoid, 45 X 30 mm; sarcotesta orange-brown, not pruinose; fibrous layer absent; sclerotesta apically crested; spongy layer present.

description: Plant arborescent; stem erect, usually unbranched, to 2, sometimes 5 m tall, 10-18 cm diam. at narrowest point, bark thick, hard, corky, with regular polygonal fracturing, dark grey. description: Stems arborescent, to 6 m tall, 15-20 cm diam. at narrowest point; lower part more or less smooth. Leaves 50-100, bright green, highly glossy, 130-200 cm long, flat (not keeled) in cross section (opposing pinnae inserted at 180º on rachis), with 140- 230 pinnae, the white or orange tomentum shedding as leaf expands; rachis usually ter- minated by paired pinnae; petiole 25-40 cm long (15-20% of total leaf), glabrous, unarmed or spinescent to 50% of length; basal pinnae not reducing in size or becoming spinescent toward leaf base, 100-120 mm long; median pinnae simple, strongly discolorous, 230-290 mm long, 10-13 mm wide, inserted at 50-70º to rachis, decurrent for 3-6 mm, narrowed to 2-3 mm at base (to 15-30% of maximum width), spaced 13-17 mm apart on rachis, flat in cross section; margins flat; apex acute, not spinescent; midrib raised above and below. Cataphylls narrowly triangular, soft, pilose, 60-80 mm long. Male (pollen) cones ovoid or narrowly ovoid, orange or brown, 30-40 cm long, 14-18 cm diam.; microsporophylls: lamina firm, not dorsiventrally thickened, 40-50 mm long, 7-11 mm wide, the margins slightly recurved; fertile zone 32-40 mm long; sterile apex 5-7 mm long, level; apical spine prominent, sharply upturned or gradually raised, 12-20 mm long. Megasporophylls 18-22 cm long, gray-to- mentose or brown-tomentose; lamina orbicular or ovate, 100-170 mm long, 45-90 mm wide, deeply pectinate; lateral spines 20-28, soft, 20-40 mm long, 3-4 mm wide; apical spine distinct from lateral spines, 55-85 mm long, 6-9 mm wide at base; ovules 2-6, glabrous. Seeds flattened-ovoid; sarcotesta yellow, not pruinose; fi- brous layer present; sclerotesta smooth; spongy layer absent.

description: Plant arborescent; stems erect to decum- bent, frequently branched, to 3 m tall, 8-10 cm diam. at narrowest point, bark smooth, pale yellowish. Leaves 10-25, highly glossy, bright green, above, pale green below, 0.45-1.2 m long, slightly keeled in section, with 30-106 pinnae, opposing pinnae inserted at 120-140º on rachis, rachis frequently terminated by a spine 1-3 mm long. Petiole 8-30 cm long (10-30% of to- tal leaf length), glabrous, unarmed (rarely with a few distal spines). Basal pinnae not gradually reducing to spines. Median pinnae simple, glabrous, coriaceous, 12-24 cm X 8.5-16 mm, inserted at 45-60º to rachis, narrowed to 2-4 mm at base, (to 15-25% of maximum width), 10-20 mm apart on rachis, margins flat, midrib raised above and below. Tomentum loose and shed early. Cataphylls narrowly triangular, soft, 2.5-8 cm long, 0.9-1.2 cm wide at the base, with short, closely appressed grey to pale yellowish brown indumentum mostly shedding before maturity. Male cones ovoid, orange, 9-28 cm long, 5-10 cm diam.; microsporophyll lamina 30-70 X 12-18 mm, fertile zone 13-24 mm long, sterile zone 15-25 mm long, level to slightly deflexed, apical spine broadened, prominent, gradually raised, 10-45 mm long. Megasporophylls 10-24 cm long, white-, grey- or yellow-to- mentose; ovules 2-4, glabrous. Lamina lanceolate, 22-90 X 12-27 mm, regularly dentate, with up to 12-24 distinct somewhat pungent lateral spines 2-3 mm long; apical spine distinct from lateral spines, 22-40 mm long, 4-5 mm wide at base. Seeds flattened-ovoid, 25-45 X 21-32 mm. Sarcotesta orange, not pruinose; fibrous layer present, sclerotesta not strongly apically crested; spongy layer absent.

description: Trunk 60-300 cm tall, 20 cm diam. at base, 8-10 cm diam. at narrowest point; frequently branched. Pinnae 15-53 pairs, bright green and glossy above, pale green below; basal pinnae not gradually reducing to spines; median pinnae simple, glabrous, coriaceous, 12-24 cm X 8.5-16 mm, narrowed to 2-4 mm at base (to 15-25% of maximum width), 10-20 mm apart on rachis, inserted at 45-60º to rachis, margins flat, midrib raised above and below. Cataphylls 2.5-8 cm long, 0.9-1.2 cm wide at the base, narrowly triangular, soft, with short, closely appressed grey to pale yellowish brown indumentum mostly shedding before maturity. description: Slender, mesophytic, nearly glabrous herb with cordate, angular leaves, the petioles long and flat, long-pedunculate male. panicles, and orbicular fruits setaceously prickled. description: Acaulescent or caulescent herbaceous perennial 3-18 cm tall; primary root 3-1 1(- 20) cm or more long, 0.4-2 cm diam., enlarged to varying degrees in lower half, crown with 1-3 usually conspicuous pseudoscapes, each arising (1-)2-10 cm below ground, among remnants of old leaf sheaths and bases with 1-3 enlarged, bladeless, scarious sheaths and 1 or 2 leaves. Leaves somewhat fleshy, often minutely wrinkled on drying, glabrous, gray-green, petiole U-shaped, blade bipinnate-pinnatifid to tripinnate, narrowly to broadly ovate in outline, primary leaf divisions in 3-5 usually opposite pairs, the terminal one deeply pinnatifid, leaflets and lobes oblong to oblanceolate or obovate, closely overlapping to spreading, apices round to obtuse, margins sometimes scaberulous; basal leaves 7-16 X 1.5-3 cm, petiole 5-10 cm long, blade 2.5-8 cm long; cauline leaves generally 1 pair, 4.5-7.5 x 1.5-3.5 cm, petioles 2-4(- 7) cm long, blades 2.5-4(-7) cm long; leaves of axillary branches reduced in size. Inflorescence a subcompact compound umbel 1.5-3.5 cm diam.; peduncle terminal, often also lateral, ascending to erect, 1-12 cm long, shorter than to much exceeding the leaves, especially in fruit; involucre of 1-8 bracts, bracts oblong to obovate, often variously lobed, white, scarious with 1-4 purple veins; rays 3-6, 3-5 mm long, or to 30 mm in fruit, terete to somewhat flat- tened, unequal, erect to spreading; umbel- lets mostly andromonoecious, the flowers 9-12, 2-8 staminate and 3-9 perfect; involucel symmetrical, bractlets 4-6, obovate to spatulate, the free portion gradually expanded distally, broadly rounded to truncate, entire or irregularly toothed or lobed, sometimes cleft, 4.5-7 mm long and about equalling the flowers, connate to 1/3 of length, white, scarious with (1-)3(-5) dark green to purple veins arising from base, parallel below, gradually flaring distally, equal or nearly so or the lateral pair rarely to 1/2 as long, occasionally one or more veins with a reduced lateral branch; pedicels 1-3 mm long, or to 12 mm long in fruit. Flowers white or cream to purple; sepals broadly triangular to ovate, 0.2-0.7 mm long or obsolete, often unequal, not en- larging in fruit, white, scarious with a green to purple midrib; petals 1.7-2.2 mm long, obovate in lower 2/3 with a narrow, in- curved, plicate apex; anthers purplish, 6-8 mm long; filaments 1.8-2.2 mm long; style filiform, subterete, 2-2.5 mm long or to 3 mm long in fruit, arcuate-spreading; stylo-podium none; disk present; ovary glabrous; carpophore well-developed, bipartite, per- sistent, 8-14 mm long. Fruit flattened somewhat dorsally, broadly elliptic to suborbicular, not constricted at commissure, 7- 14 X 2-4 mm, tan to purplish, wings uniformly developed (2-)3-4 mm wide, 0.1- 0.3 mm or less thick, chartaceous to carti- laginous, or the dorsal wing or one or both intermediate wings poorly or not developed; oil tubes flat, reddish brown, (2-)3 in the intervals, 4-7 on the concave commissural face; seed face concave. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Plantae humiles perennes acaulescentes vel brevicaulescentes ramis paucis vel nullis e caudice vaginis papyraceis obtecto; folia petiolata herbacea lanceolata vel oblonga glabra pinnato-pinnatifida vel 2-pinnata, divisionibus lineari-lanceolatis vel ellipticis; inflorescentia ex umbellis compositis subcom- pactis constans pedunculis quam foliis brevioribus vel multo longioribus; involucrum deficiens; radii pauci subteretes vel complanati; umbellulae andromonoeciae e floribus staminatis pedicellatis 1 -pluribus et floribus perfectis subsessilibus 1 -paucis constantes; involucellum dimidiatum bracteolis linearibus vel lanceolatis, distinctis vel basin versus connatis; flores flavi, sepalis late rotundatis vel triangulatis vel obsoletis, petalis obovatis vel obcordatis, antheris flavis, stylis filiformibus; stylopo- dium nullum, disco praesenti; carpophorum bipartitum persistens; fructus subteres vel aliquantum lateraliter complanatus late ellipticus vel suborbiculatus, costi prominenter alatis; vittae parvae, in intervallis 5-9 in commissura 8-10; seminum superficies involuta.
