description: Scandent perennial (?); stems 1 to several; leaves biternately decompound, most of the ultimate leaflets tendriliform; leaflets ovate to lanceolate, membranaceous, glabrous, (8-)35-45(-50) mm long, (5-)21-23(-25) mm broad, with (5-)6-7(-8) veins running lengthwise from the base, the margin entire; racemes of 2-7 pendent flowers; bracts scarious, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 7-15 mm long, ca. 1 mm broad, the margin entire; sepals ovate-acuminate to cordate-acuminate, 2-3 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm broad, the margin entire; corolla yellow, cordate in outline; outer petals 16-20 mm long, 2-4 mm broad, the reflexed or carinate portion ca. 4 mm long, the spur 2-3 mm long; inner petals 12-20 mm long, the blade ca. 3 mm broad, the claw 8-12 mm long; crest 1 mm or less in diameter, exceeding the inner petal apices by 1-2 mm or less; filaments of each phalange united from the base throughout ca. 2/3 of their length; nectariferous spur short, blunt; pollen grains 4- to 6-rugate, the exine finely verrucate; stigma quadrangular, a papilla at each of the basal angles, a minute papilla at each of the distal angles; capsule red (ex collector), not seen, apparently linear-elongate.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Scandent annual (?); stems 1 to several, usually attaininog lengths of 2-4 m; leaves biternately decompound, the ultimate leaflets frequently tendriliform; leaflets ovate to lanceolate, often oblique at base, membranaceous, glabrous, (3-) 7-11 (-17) mm long, (2-) 3-5 (-8) mm broad, ca. 7- to 10-nerved, the margin entire; corymbs of 2-6 pendent flowers; bracts searious, linear-lanceolate, 4-8 mm long, ca. 1 mm broad, the margins sparsely barbulate-denticulate; sepals subeordate-oblong, the apex acuminate, the margin fimbriate; corolla lemonyellow, elongate-cordate; outer petals (10-)11-13 (-14) mm long, 1.5-3 mm broad, the reflexed or carinate portion ca. 2 mm long, the spur ca. 2 mm long; ininer petals (9-)10-11(-12) mm long, the blade ca. 2 mm broad, the claw 7-9 mm long; crest less than 1 mm in diameter, exceeding the inner petal apices by 1-2 mm; filaments of each phalange uniited from the base to shortly below the anthers; nectariferous spur 2 mm or less long, usually sigmoid in shape; pollen grains 4- to 6-rugate, the rugae obscure, the exine finely reticulate; stigma quadrangular, with a papilla at each of the basal angles; capsule linear-oblong, 3-6 cm long, 0.2-0.3 cm broad; seeds reniform-orbicular in outline, the testa exclusive of the papillae brown, dull, the papillae distributed over the surface in patches of irregular size, black, lustrous, an elaiosome present.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Stems (4-)6-9(-12) dm tall, 5-13 mm in diameter at the base, 2-7 mm in diameter at the first node; lowermost leaves appearing ca. half way up the stem; leaflets glabrous, glauceseent beneath, ovate to oblong-lanceolate, (1-)4-7(-10) cm long, (0.6-)2-3(-3.6) cm broad, the margins with 4-8(-10) mucronulate teeth on each side, the apex acuminate-mucronulate, the base acuminate to cuneate, often oblique, the costa slightly prominent beneath, the main lateral veins 4-18 on each side, the petiolulate leaflet-laminae usually partially decurrent on the short petiolule; petioles 4-14 cm long, the rachis segments of the secondary portions of the leaf 3.1-14.3 cm long, the rachis segments of the tertiary portions of the leaf 2.2-9.5 cm long; racemes 3- to 14-flowered; bracts linear-lanceolate, the apices acuminate, 5-25 mm long, ca. 1 mm broad; pedicels filiform, 3-35 mm long; pedicel bracteoles 1-2, linear-lanceolate, 5-15 mm long, ca. 1 mm broad; sepals oblong-lanceolate to obovate, 14-23 mm long, 2-5 mm broad; outer petals eymbiform, pandurate when spread out, 3.5-4.5 cm long, 0.8-1.5 cm broad, with ca. 10 nerves running vertically from the base in the lower portion and fanning out and anastomosing in the upper portion, the reflexed portion 15-18 mm long, the spur very shallow; inner petals linear-oblong, slightly expanded and with slightly convex inner faces in the upper one-third, 3.5-4.5 cm long, the blade ca. 3 mm broad, the claw 14-18 mm long, filiform to 1 mm broad; crest large, 3-4 mm in diameter, not crisped; pollen grains tricolpate, the exine obscurely verrucate; stigma pandurate in outline, shallowly bilabiate at the apex; style 7-10 mm long; capsule oblong in outline, 3-4 cm long, 5-7 mm broad; seeds suborbicular in outline, ca. 1 mm in diameter, black, lustrous, the testa very minutely reticulate, an elaiosome present.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Scandent perennial from a stout rootstock; stems 1 to several, usually attaining lengths of up to 3-4 m or more; leaves biternately decompound, the ultimate leaflets often tendriliform; leaflets ovate to nearly orbicular, acute to oblique at base, membranaceous, glabrous, (3-) 20-25 (-35) mm long, (2-)12-17(-25) mm broad, the larger leaflets with 9-13 veins running lengthwise from the base, the veins not prominent beneath, the margin entire; racemes of (2-)7-10(-14) pendent flowers; bracts searious, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, ca. 3-6 mm long, ca. 1 mm broad or less, the margin entire; corolla yellow, cordate in outline; outer petals (15-) 16-19 (-21) mm long, 3-5 mm broad, the reflexed portion 2-4 mm long, the spur ca. 3 mm long; inner petals 14-17 mm long, the blade 3-4 mm broad, the claw 9-13 mm long; crest ca. 1 mm in diameter, exceeding the ininer petal apices by ca. 2 mm; filaments of each phalange united from the base to shortly below the anthers; nectariferous spur acuminate, lunate, often with a minute peg-like proliferation on the proximal side ca. half way from the point of attachment; pollen grains 4- to 6-rugate, the exine finely verrucate; stigma quadrangular in outline, notched at the apex; capsule lanceolate in outline, acute at both ends, membranaceous, 22-29 mm long, 5-6 mm broad; seeds somewhat variable in shape, usually comma-shaped, black, lustrous, the testa papillate, the papillae often larger on the broader end, an elaiosome present.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Scapose perennial from a stout horizontal rhizome; leaves variably glaucous, broadly triangular in outline, ternately compound, (10-) 15-25 (-30) cm long, (5-) 8-12 (-18) cm broad; petioles (4-) 8-14 (-20) cm long; ultimate leaf segments oblong, incised-pinnatifid, the distal segments usually with 3 coarse teeth or lobes at the apices, (1.5-)2-3(-4) cm long, (3-)6-12(-20) mm broad; scapes naked, of variable length, shorter than to exceeding the leaves, (7-) 10-25 (-28) cm long; panicle of 2-20 pendent flowers; bracts linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 4-7 (-10) mm long, 1-1.5 mm broad, the margin entire to obscurely serrulate; pedicels ebracteolate, rarely 1- to 2-bracteolate; sepals ovate to lanceolate-acuminate, (3-)6-7(-12) mm long, 1-3 mm broad, the margin entire to obscurely serrulate; corolla cordate-ovate to cordate-oblong in outline, the outer petals white to ochroleucous or rose-tinted, (12-)13-16(-18) mm long, 2-4 mm broad, the reflexed portion 3-5 mm long, turning dark on drying, the spur 1-2 mm long; inner petals white, pale yellow-tipped, (11-)13-15(-17) mm long, 2.5-3.5 mm broad, the claw linear-ellipsoid to linear-lanceolate, (6-)7-8(-9) mm long, 1-2 mm broad; crest 1-2 mm in diameter, exceeding the inner petal apices by 1-2 mm; filaments of each phalange united from shortly below the anthers to the base except for 2-6 mm just above the base where the median filament bends out in an angular loop which lies within the saccate outer petal base; nectariferous spur wanting, but nectariferous tissue present throughout the loops of the median filaments; pollen grains 6-rugate, the exine finely reticulate; stigma rhomboidal in outline, 2-horned at the apex, with two lateral papillae; style 4-7 mm long; capsule oblong in outline, (10-) 13-16(-20) mm long, 4-5 mm broad, surrounded at the base by the persistent corolla; seeds reniform, ca. 2 mm in diameter, black, lustrous, the testa finely reticulate, an elaiosome present.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Rigidly erect, glaucous perennial, arisinig from a stout taproot; stems 1 or more, 1-2 (-4) m tall, stout, 2-3 cm or more in diameter at the base, the pith hollow at maturity; leaves sparsely scattered aloiic the stem, more nlumerous towards the base, tripinnately compound, (12-) 25-35 (-50) cm long, (6-) 10-20(-35) em broad; ultimate leaf segments pinnllatifid, (10-) 20-30 (-60) mm long, (5-) 8-15 (-30) mm broad, the lobes linear-laneeolate; paniiele terminal, of onle to several somewhat spheroidal, dense clusters of erect flowers, each cluster containilg several to 100 flowers or more; bracts suborbicular to ovate, 4-8 mm long, 3-7 mm broad, the margin entire; pedicels rigid, 2-10 mm long, ebracteolate; sepals suborbicular to ovate, (5-)7-10(-12) mm long, (3-)4-7(-9) mm broad, the ulargin entire; corolla ochroleucous, subcordate in outline; outer petals purple-tipped, (15-) 22-26 (-30) mm long, 2.5-4 mm broad, the reflexed portion (5-) 7-10 (-12) mm long, the spurs very shallow, ca. 1 mm long; inner petals (15-)20-22(-24) mm long, 2-4 mm broad, the blade 2-3 mm broad, tipped with deep purple, the claw 6-9 mm long and 2/3 as broad as the blade; crest large, 3-5 mm in diameter, crisped, exceeding the inner petal apices by 2-4 mm; filaments of each phalange usually united from the base to shortly below the anthers, occasionally distinct nearly to the base; nectariferous spur wanting, but a small amount of nectariferous tissue present externally at the base of the median stamen; pollen grains usually tricolpate, occasionally 6-rugate, the membranes of the colpi or rugae conspicuously verrucate, the exine obscurely sculptured to psilate; stigma ca. 3 times as broad as long, 2-horned at the apex; style (7-)9-11(-14) mm long; capsule ovoid, tapering at both ends, (10-)20-30(-35) mm long, 5-8 mm broad; seeds subreniform, ca. 1.3 mm rarely to 2 mm in diameter, black, dull, the testa densely papillate, an elaiosome wanting.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Scapose perennial from a horizolntal rhizome or fascicle of fusiform tubers, small bulblets often present at the proximal end of the tubers or alona the rhizome; leaves usually 1-2 in number, occasionally more, biternately to triternately compound, (7-)9-13(-16) cm long, (3-)4-7(-10) cm broad; petioles terete, not expanded at the base, (2-)4-7(-10) cm long; ultimate leaf seogments linear-lanceolate, occasionally irregularly shaped, minutely apiculate, (2-)7-13 (-18) mm long, 1.5-3 mm broad; scapes 1- to 3-flowered, barely exceedilng the leaves; bracts ovate, 4-5 mm long, 2-3 mm broad; pedicels 5-25 mm long, ebracteolate; sepals ovate to lanceolate, 5-8 mm long, 2-4 mm broad, the margin entire; flowers erect to nodding; corolla white to pink, cordate to oblong in outline with a cordate base; outer petals (15-)18-22(-25) mm long, (3-) 4-5(-6) mm broad, thle reflexed petals (15-)18-22(-24) mm long, the blade spatulate, 2-3 mm broad, purple, exceeding the reflexed outer petals by 7-10 mm, the claw obovate-elliptic, ca. 10 mm long, 3-4 mm broad; crest wanting; filaments of each phalange united near the anthers and at the base, the median filament bending to form a loop which almost doubles back on itself at its proxinlal end, a small amount of nectariferous tisue present at this point and extending to the base; pollen grains 6-rugate, the membranes of the rugae distinctly and irregularly verrucate, the exine minutely verrucate; stigma much reduced, ca. twice as broad as the style, 2-horned at the apex; style 7-11 mm long; capsule fusiform-ovoid, surrounded by the persistent corolla, 10-15 mm long, 4-6 mm broad; seeds reniform, ca. 2 mm in diameter, black, lustrouLs, the testa essentially smooth, an elaiosome present.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Herbae scandentes, caulibus ca. 1 mm diametro; foliis biternatis, petiolis teretis, 1-3 cm longis, plerumque eirrhiferis; foliolis subcoriaceis, ovatis lanceolatisve, plerumque 2.5-3.5 cm longis, ca. 2-2.5 cm latis, aliquot minoribus, glabris, supra in sieco fusco-viridibus, subtus pallide viridibus, plerumque 3-6-nerviis; nerviis subtus prominentibus; petiolulis brevibus, eirrhis ramosis, saltem 5 cm longis; inflorescentibus 6-10-floribus ca. 7 cm longis, (6-) 7-10 (-14)-floribus, pedicellis 8-20 mm longis, bracteis linearibus, integerrimis; floribus flavidis, ca. 2 cm longis, ca. 6 mm latis, base cordatis; sepalis lanceolatis usque ad cordato-lanceolatis, acuminatis, (1.5-)2-3(-4) mmn longis; petalis exterioribus base saccatis, apice cucullatis supra cucullos late apiculatis, petalis interioribus (10-)13-17(-24) mm longis, lamina ca. 4-5 mm longa, ca. 3-4 mm lata, unquibus filiformibus; filamentis 6, parte libera 4 mm longa, nectariis apice non curvatis; ovario lineari-lanceolato, cum style 16 mm longo; stigmate inaequaliter 4-lobulato; capsula fortasse succulento-baccata, rubra (ex collectore), ovoidea vel oblongo-lineare; seminibus globoso-reniformibus, nigris, nitidissimis, aspere granulatis, hilis cristatis.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Perennial from a stout rootstock; stems 1 to several, ca. 3-4 m long at the close of the growing season; lower leaflets alternate or opposite, the upper alternate, the ultimate ones tendriliform; leaflets entire, (15-)25-35(-60) mm long, (10-)20-25(-35) mm broad, with 3-6 veins running lengthwise from the base; racemes of (6-)7-10(-14) pendent flowers, leaf-opposed; bracts scarious, acuminate, ca. 5-7 mm long, ca. 1 mm or less broad at the base, the margin entire; sepals orbicular- to ovate- or lanceolate-acuminate, (1.5-)2-3(-4) mm long, 0.5-3 mm broad, entire; corolla yellow to orange, cordate in outline; outer petals (16-) 18-22 (-24) mm long, (3-)4-5 (-6) mm broad, the reflexed portion 2-3 mm long, the spur 3-4 mm long; inner petals (10-) 13-17 (-24) mm long, the claw delicately filiform, 10-15 mm long; crest ca. 1 mm in diameter, exceeding the inner petal apex by 1-2 mm; filaments of each phalange united from the base to shortly below the anthers; nectariferous spur somewhat variable in shape but never distinctly curved upward at the apex, the apex more or less blunt, partially surrounded by a wax-like secretion; pollen grain apertures obscure, the exine finely to obscurely verrucate; style filiform, rigid, 6-9 mm long; capsule 12-20 mm long, 4-8 mm broad; seeds somewhat variable in shape, usually reniform with a protuberance towards one end, occasionally the protuberance much reduced, the testa papillate, the papillae all of the same size or frequently larger towards one end, an elaiosomne present.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Seapose perennial from a short rootstock bearinli well-developed fibrous roots; leaves glaucous, broadly triangular in outline, ternately compound, (4-) 7-9 (-16) cm long, (1-) 2-3 (-4) cm broad; petioles (3-) 5-7 (-12) cm long, ultimate leaf segments deeply and finely dissected into linear lobes less than 1 mm wide; scapes naked, exceeding the leaves, simpfe or rarely branched, (7-) 10-15 (-25) cm long; flowers (1-) 2-3 (-8), nearly erect to nodding on filiform ebracteolate pedicels; corolla white to purple, cordate in outline; outer petals strongly reflexed, (15-)18-21(-25) mm long, 3-7 mm broad, the reflexed portions 7-10 mm long, the spurs 2-3 mm long; inner petals (15-) 18-22 (-25) mm long, the blades oblong with a slightly expanded purple-tipped apex, 2-3 mm broad, the claw elliptic to obovate-elliptic, 5-8 mm long, ca. 2 mm broad; crest not crisped, 1-2 mm in diameter; filaments of each phalange united from shortly below the anthers to the base except for the mediall filament which is free for a few mm of its length just above its base where it forms a loop that bends out into the saccate outer petal base and dips below the point of attachment; nectariferous spur wanting, but nectariferous tissue present throughout the basal 1-2 mm of the free portion of the median filamenit; pollen grains tricolpate, the exine reticulate; stigma ca. twice as broad as long, 2-horned at the apex, with two lateral papillae; style (8-)10-12(-14) mm long; capsule oblong in outline, ca. 10-12 mm long, 3-4 mm broad, surrounded at the base by the persistent corolla; seeds reniform, ca. 2 mm in diameter, black, lustrous, the testa finely reticulate, an elaiosome present.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Scandent annual (?); stems 1 to several, usually attaining lengths of 2-3 m; leaves biternately decompound, the ultimate leaflets frequently tendriliform; leaflets ovate to lanceolate, membranaceous, glabrous, (4-)12-20(-26) mm long, (2-)4-8(-11) mm broad, ca. 8- to 11-nerved, the margin entire, the base acute, often oblique;; corymbs of 2-3 pendent flowers; bracts searious, linear-lanceolate, 5-8 mm long, ca. 1 mm broad, the margins fimbriate; sepals subcordate in the lowermost 1/4 to 1/3, the upper portion linear-oblong, the apex acuminate, the margin of the basal portion fimbriate, the margin of the upper portion entire to sparsely denticulate; corolla yellow, cordate; outer petals (15-)17-19(-20) mm long, (3-)3.5-4.5(-5) mm broad, the reflexed or carinate portion ca. 2 mm long, the spur ca. 2 mm long; inner petals (13-)14-16(-17) mm long, the blade 2 mm broad or more, the claw 10-14 mm long; crest 1 mim in diameter or less, exceeding the inner petal apices by 1 mm or less; filaments of each phalange united from the base to shortly below the anthers; nectariferous spur 2-3 mm long, terminally reduced to a fine, hair-like process; pollein grains 4- to 6-rugate, the exine finely verrucate; stigma quadrangular, ca. 1.5 times as broad as long, with a papilla at each of the basal angles, entire to notched at the apex; capsule linear-oblong in outline, tapering towards the apex, 4-5 cm long, 4-5 mm broad; seeds reniform, black, lustrous, the testa finely reticulate, an elaiosome present.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Scandent perennial from a stout rootstock; stems 1 to several, usually 3-4 m long at the close of the growing season; leaves bi- or triternately decompound, the ultimate leaflets tendrilform; leaflets ovate to lanceolate, acute to strongly oblique at base, membranaceous, glabrous, (3-)20-25(-35) mm long, (2-)12-17(-25) mm broad, typically with 7-8 veins running lengthwise from the base, the veins not prominent beneath; margin entire; racemes of (2-) 7-10 (-14) pendent flowers; bracts searious, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, usually 3-6 mm long, ca. 1 mm or less broad, the margin entire; sepals variable in shape, usually ovate-acuminate, 2-3 mm long, 0.5-3 mm broad, the margin entire; corolla yellow to white tipped with pink or light purple, cordate; outer petals (13-)17-20(-22) mm long, 2-4 mm broad, the reflexed portion 3-4 mm long, the spur (1-)2-3(-5) mm long; inner petals 13-18 mm long, the blade ca. 3 mm broad, the claw 9-13 mm long; crest ca. 1 mm or less in diameter, exceeding the inner petal apices by ca. 2 mm; filaments of each phalange united from the base to shortly below the anthers; nectariferous spur with a distinct terminal hook; pollen grains 4- to 8-rugate, the exine finely verrucate; stigma quadrangular, notched at the apex; capsule ovate to oblong in outline, fleshy, red at maturity, 12-25 mm long, 3-9 mm broad; seeds somewhat variable in shape, usually comma-shaped to reniform, black, lustrous, the testa papillate, the papillae all of the same size or frequently larger towards one end, an elaiosome present.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Stems usually 6-10 dm in length, occasionally to 14 dm; leaves (15-)20-30(-40) cm long, (10-) 14-17(-20) cm broad, the ultimate leaf segments deeply lobed or cleft, 4-10 cm long, 2-7 cm broad the lobes lanceolate-apiculate; racemes of (3-)8-11(-15) pendent flowers; bracts linear-oblong, the apex acuminate, 4-10 mm long, ca. 1 mm broad very early caducous; outer petals rose-purple to pink, rarely white, (20-)22-27(-30) mm long, the blade 3-4 mm broad, the claw oblong to oblaleeolate, 10-14 mm long, 2-5 mm broad, crest 1-3 mm in diameter; stigma oblong-pandurate in outline, shallowly bilabiate; style 7-11 mm long; capsule unknown to me; seeds ca. 3 mm in diameter, an elaiosome present, rarely wanting (?).
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Scandent annual (?) ; stems 1 to several, usually attaining lengths of 2-4 m; leaves biternately decompound, the ultimate leaflets frequently tendriliform; leaflets ovate to lanceolate, membranaceous, glabrous, (3-)7-18(-22) mm long, (2-)3-8(-10) mm broad, ca. 7- to 10-nerved, the margin entire, the base often oblique; corymbs of 2-6 pendent flowers; bracts searious, linear-lanceolate, 5-12 mm long, ca. 1 mm broad, the margin fimbriate; sepals subcordate-oblong, the apex acuminate, the margin fimbriate; corolla lemon-yellow, elongate-cordate; outer petals (10-)11-13(-14) mm long, 1.5-3 mm broad, the reflexed or carinate portion ca. 2 mm long, the spur ca. 2 mm long; inner petals (9-)10-11(-12) mm long, the blade ca. 2 mm broad, the claw 7-9 mm long; crest less than 1 mm in diameter, exceeding the inner petal apices by 1-2 mm; filaments of each phalange united from the base to shortly below the anthers; nectariferous spur 2 mm long or less, usually sigmoid; pollen grains 4- to 6-rugate, the exine finely verrucate; stigma quadrangular with a papilla at each of the basal angles, notched at the apex; capsule torulose, 4-6 cm long, ca. 3 mm broad; seeds subreniform in outline, black, dull, the testa distinctly reticulate, an elaiosome present.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Scapose perennial from a fascicle of obelavate to fusiform tubers; small bulblets often present at the proximal enids of the tubers; leaves usually 1-2, occasionally more, pubescent near the base, rarely the entire leaf sparsely pubescent, bi- to triternately decompound, 4-7 (-10) em lonig, (1-) 3-4 cm broad; petioles terete, not expanded at the base, 2-5(-8) cm long; ultimate leaf segments variable in shape, usually oblong to spatulate, (2-)6-12(-18) mm long, 1.5-6 mm broad, the apices minutely apiculate, occasiolnally retuse; scapes barely exceeding the leaves (or shorter than the leaves by 1-3 cm), one-flowered; bracts 1 per scape, rarely 2, lanceolate, 4-6 mm long, 2-3 mm broad; pedicels slender, 2-7 nmm long, ebracteolate; flowers noddinig to erect; corolla pink to white, suffused with light brown, cordate in outline; outer petals strongly reflexed, (7-)12--16(-20) mm long; inner petals (11-)13-15(-17) mm long, the blade deltoid-spatulate to shallowly sagittate-spatulate, 4-8 mm broad, purple-tipped, the claw linear-oblong, 4-6 mm long; crest wantinig; filaments of each phalange usually distinct above the base, occasionally united just below the anthers, the median filament bending to form a loop with a slight indentation at its proximal end, the loop bearing nectariferous tissue externally at its base; pollen grains tricolpate, the exine reticulate; stigma much reduced, slightly broader than the style, bilobed; style 3-5 mm long; capsule ovoid, tapering apically into the persistent style, 9-14 mm long, 5-9 mm broad, surrounded bv the persistent corolla; seeds reniform, ca. 1.5 mm in diameter, black, lustrous, the testa finely and obscurely reticulate, an elaiosome wanting.
bibliographicCitation: Stern, Kingsley R. 1961. Revision of Diccutra (Fumariaceae). Brittonia. 18: 1-57.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Liana, the young branches densely tomentellous. Leaf lamina chartaceous, oblong to elliptic, 9-12 x 4.5-6 cm, subcordate and slightly unequal at base, acu- minate at apex, the acumen 4-7 mm long, with scattered sparse appressed hairs above, hirsute beneath, midrib plane and tomentose above, prominent and hirsute beneath; primary veins 7-9 pairs, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath, secondary venation slightly impressed above; petiole 0-2 mm long, tomentellous. Stipules 10-13 mm long, lanceolate, persistent, tomentose, the margins fimbriate. Inflorescences of terminal and subterminal panicles of cymules 2-6 cm long, the rachis and branches densely yellow-brown-tomentose; peduncles 1-2 cm long. Only male flowers seen, ca 2.5 mm long; pedicels 1-2 mm long. Bracts and bracteoles lanceolate, persistent, with numerous bracteoles 1-2 mm long, tomentose. Calyx ca 1 mm long, tomentose on exterior, the lobes equal, glabrous on interior. Corolla of 5 equal lobes free to base, glabrous, the lobes cucullate, bifid at apex. Fertile stamens 5, alternating with and slightly exceeding petals in length. Disc of 5 rounded glands at bases of petals. Male flowers with a mass of lanate pubescence in center. Fruit not seen.

description: Liana, the young branches tomentose becoming glabrous with age. Leaves oblong- elliptic, coriaceous, bullate on both surfaces, 5-10 cm long, 1.8-4.7 cm broad, broadest well above middle, acuminate to apiculate at apex, the acumen 4-10 mm long, rounded to subcordate and slightly unequal at base, densely hispid-ferrugineous- tomentose on both surfaces when young, soon becoming almost glabrous above with a few appressed hispid hairs at maturity and sparsely hirsute beneath, the pubescence confined to veins; midrib impressed and pubescent above; primary veins 8-11 pairs, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath; secondary venation slightly impressed above, distinctly prominent and reticulate beneath; petioles 3-7 mm long, terete, hispid tomentose. Stipules persistent, appressed pubescent, 6-8 mm long, the mar- gins fimbriate. Flowers hermaphrodite; pedicels 1-3 mm long. Inflorescences of terminal and subterminal panicles, 3-5 cm long; peduncles ca. 1 cm long; the rhachis and branches brown tomentose. Bracts and bracteoles linear, villous-pubescent on exterior, glabrous within, 2-3 mm long, persistent. Calyx 1.5-2 mm long, brown, villous-tomentose on exterior, the lobes almost equal. Corolla of 5 equal lobes, the lobes deeply bifid and slightly bicucullate, free to base, glabrous. Fertile stamens 5, alternating with and exceeding the corolla lobes. Disc of 5 ellipsoid glands inserted at base of corolla lobes. Ovary trilocular with 2 ovules in each loculus, lanate on exterior. Styles 3. Fruit trilocular with only 1 or 2 locules developing seeds; epicarp with dense compact hispid spinous pubescence, the hairs ca. 4 mm long; pericarp hard, thin, glabrous within.

description: Small tree to 7 m, the young branches hispid pubescent. Leaf lamina chartaceous, oblong, 14-17.5 x 3.8-6.5 cm, rounded and markedly unequal at base, apex ?rounded (damaged on all leaves), with sparse appressed hirsute pubescence above, hirsute on all venation beneath, midrib plane above, prominent and hirsute beneath; primary veins 8-10 pairs, plane above, prominent beneath; petiole 4-6 mm long, hispid. Stipules 5-10 mm long, lanceolate, persistent, hispid, the margins fimbriate. Infiorescences of terminal or subterminal (in axils of apical leaves) panicles of cymules 4-6 cm long, the rachis and branches densely brown-hispid; peduncles 1.3-1.8 cm long. Flowers hermaphrodite, ca 3 mm long; pedicels 1- 1.5 mm long. Bracts and bracteoles lanceolate, persistent, 2-5 mm long, hispid. Calyx ca 1 mm long, gray-tomentose on exterior, the lobes equal, glabrous within. Corolla of 5 equal lobes free to base, glabrous, the lobes deeply bifid almost to base, each half cucullate at apex. Fertile stamens 5, alternating with and equalling petals in length. Disc of 5 bi-lobed glands at bases of petals. Ovary densely lanate on exterior, trilocular. Style lanate at base, glabrous above, the apex trifid. Ovules 2 per locule. Fruit not seen (field notes mention brown-pubescent fruits).

description: Herba perennis (vel annua?) omnis glabra; radix primaria fusi-formis ramosa fibrosa; caulis primarius erectus a basi ramosus; rami inferiores adscendentes vel etiam stoloniformes (foliis squamiformi-bus), superiores gradatim breviores magisque erecti, omnes parce sympodialiter ramosi (umbellas foliis oppositas ferentes), plantam semiglobosam ad 10 cm. altam formantes; folia sparsa, in caulium partibus inferioribus remota, versus apices magis minusve in rosulas conferta, subspathulata, parte inferiore petioliformi canaliculata alata basi vaginante c. 2-12 mm. longa, 1-3 mm. lata, parte basali raro parce ciliata persistente denique cartilaginea albida, parte superiore ellip-tica vel cuneiformi vel oblonga vel rarius lanceolata, 8-18 mm. longa, 3-9 mm. lata, apice dentibus grandis 3 obtusiusculis vel acutiusculis, nervatura utrinque distincta pennata subflabellata reticulata; inflores-centiae umbellae simplices, foliis oppositae, floriferae folia paulum superantes, fructiferae inter folia absconditae; pedunculus subteres denique striatus, 5-12 mm. longus, apice paulum dilatatus; bracteae involucrantes numerosae (c. 12), lanceolatae vel spathulato-lanceo-latae, 6-9 mm. longae, foliis similes sed angustiores et plerumque eden-tatae; pedicelli 10-20 tenues teretes, exteriores involucro paulo breviores, 4-7 mm. longi, interiores multo breviores, fructiferi paulum aucti; calycis tubus (ovarium inferum) breve campanulatus lateraliter compressus, 0.75-1.25 mm. longus et latus, jugis dorsalibus et inter-mediis distinctis, lateralibus utrinque in unum conjunctis, carinalibus semper suturalibus paulo distinctioribus; calycis dentes subulati c. 0.5 mm. longi raro paulo longiores, mox paulum aucti; petala 5 ellip-tica obtusiuscula c. 1.5 mm. longa penni nervia; stamina 5 filamentis filiformibus acutis, ad 2 mm. longis, antheris dorsifixis rotundato-ellipsoides; styli 2 subfiliformes apicem versus attenuati c. 1.25 mm. longi uncinati; fructus omnis glaber valde applanatus reniformis, mericarpiis ad 3 mm. latis 3.5 mm. altis, jugis obtusiusculis, lateralibus indistinctis, intermediis distinctis 0.75-1.25 mm. a commissura remotis, carinalibus paulo distinctioribus quam saturalibus, calycis dentibus et stylis panlum auctis coronatus; carpophorum indivisum, 2-2.5 mm. longum, apicibus 2 brevissimis.

description: Folia lanceolato-elliptica vel ovata, (4.5) 6-9 X (1.5) 2-5 cm, basi rotundata vel obtusa, breviter attenuata, apice acuminata. Pedicelli 15-18 cm longi. Bracteae florales ovatae, 1 mm longae. Calyx 10-12 mm longus, glaber; tubus obconicus, 3.5-5 mm longus; limbus 6.5-7 mm longus lobis inclusis; lobi ovati 2.5 mm longi. Corolla 22 mm longa, glabra. Stamina 12 mm longa; filamenta 4.5 mm longa; antherae 10 mm longae tubulis inclusis; tubuli 3-3.2 mm longi. Stylus 16-18 mm longus, glaber.

description: Epiphytic shrub, 0.75-1 m tall. Mature stems subterete, smooth or minutely striate, glabrous or puberulent, dark blackish-red when dry. Immature stems and twigs of new growth subterete, striate, glabrous or puberulent, brown or gray when dry. Leaves lance-elliptic or ovate, (4.5) 6-9 X (1.5) 2-5 cm, glabrous, basally rounded or obtuse, short attenuate, apically short or long acuminate, marginally entire, green to olive-green when dry, glandular-fimbriate beneath but fimbriae soon deciduous; 5 (7)-plinerved, midrib impressed above (although thickened and raised proximal  1-1.5 cm) and raised beneath, lateral nerves and veinlets slightly raised on both surfaces; pseudostipules 2 mm long. Petiole subterete, rugose, glabrous, laterally slightly winged, 5-10 mm long and 1.5-2 mm diam, dark reddish-brown when dry. Rachis 1.5 mm long. Pedicel terete, minutely ribbed, glabrous, 15-18 cm long and 0.3-0.5 mm diam. Floral bract ovate, 1 mm long, marginally glandular-fimbriate. Bracteoles located near the base of the pedicel, aristate, 1.5 mm long, marginally glandular-fimbriate. Calyx glabrous, 10-12 mm long; tube obconical, muricate, 3.5- 5 mm long; limb campanulate, conspicuously nerved, 6.5-7 mm long including the lobes; lobes broadly ovate, apiculate, 2.5 X 5 mm; sinus acute. Corolla campanulate-cylindric, glabrous, +/-22 mm long, pink when living (fide Dressler 5170), thin and membranaceous when dry; lobes broadly ovate, 2.5 mm X 6 mm. Stamens 12 mm long; filaments ciliate, 4.5 mm long, 2 mm broad at the base and narrowing to the connective which itself extends to the base of the tubules; anther including tubules 10 mm long; thecae 6.8-7.5 mm long, minutely granular; tubules slightly spreading, 3-3.2 mm long, pilose on inner surfaces, dehiscing by oval, latrorse clefts 1.5-2 mm long but not extending to the apex. Style glabrous, 16-18 mm long; stigma peltate. Fruits not seen.

description: Antherarum thecis haud fimbriatis seminibusque tumidis tribu Melothrieis Endl. juxta Ibervilleam Greene et Tumamocam Rose referendum, ab ambabus caulibus perennibus, floribus multo majoribus albis nocturnis, antheris inter se connatis, placentis 4-5, stigmatibus bilobis 4-5, staminodiis 5 diversum, et his signis a Cucurbitaceis omnibus abstans.

description: Perennial, high-climbing vines with simple tendrils, apparently dioecious; rootstocks very large, tuberous, fleshy, pale brown; stems coarse, pale grayish-brown, sometimes lenticellate, glabrous. Leaf blades orbicular to broadly ovate in outline, mostly 6-15 cm long, 7-17 cm wide, deeply 3-5-lobate, the lobes obtuse to acute, sometimes lobulate, apiculate, with a deep, broad basal sinus, 3-nerved from the base, green and scabrid to scabrous above, the trichomes usually with conspicuous cystolithic bases, lighter green and hispid below, the margins remotely denticulate to entire; petioles 1.5-5 cm long, with a few scattered hairs. Staminate flowers: in (3) 10-20-flowered racemes (3) 8-15 cm long, glabrous, long-pedunculate, the flowers borne near the tip (on the upper 1/6 or less); pedicels persistent, thickish, 4-5 mm long, the bracteoles acicular, 0.5-1 mm long, borne about midway on the pedicel, the calyx tube 3-4.5 cm long, narrowly cylindrical, glabrous outside, densely villous inside at the apex with multicellular trichomes to 1.5 mm long; sepals 5, narrowly triangular, 1-1.5 mm long, green; petals 5 (in outer surface of bud densely yellowish-lanate), hastate, somewhat clawed at base, acute, (1.5) 2-2.5 cm long, 1-1.5 cm wide, free, white, glandular-puberulent, the margins ruffled, conspicuously 3-veined from the base; stamens 3, inserted at the mouth of the calyx tube, the filaments 3, free, 1 mm long, pilose; anthers 3, connate, inserted just within throat of corolla, 1 monothecous and the other 2 dithecous, 4-7.5 mm long, the thecae oblong, straight, dehiscing extrorsely, the connective narrow, apically produced in pubescent obtuse tips ca 1 mm long; pollen spherical, 58-71.5 Am diam, 4-colporate, tectate; pori circular, 9 Am diam. Pistillate flowers: solitary in the axils, 9-10 cm long; pedicel stout, 4-20 mm long; ovary 3-4.5 cm long, ca 6 mm thick, glabrous, green with white blotches and stripes, narrowly fusiform; calyx tube ca 5 cm long, 1 cm diam at the apex, narrowly cylindrical, glabrous outside, villous inside in the throat with multicellular trichomes; sepals as in staminate flowers; corolla similar to that of staminate flowers but larger, the corolla lobes 5, ca 3 cm long, free; staminodes 5, linear, 1-2 mm long, inserted 12-15 mm below the mouth of the tube; style 1, columnar, slender, ca 4 cm long, the stigmata 4 or 5, deeply bifid, the branches linear, acute, papillose, 8-10 mm long; placentae 4 or 5. Fruit on pedicel 1.5-3 cm long and 3-5 mm thick, fusiform, rostrate, 9-12 cm long, 3-4.5 cm wide, dark green with silver-white spots, bright yellow to usually orange-red at maturity, glabrous, longitudinally 10- or 1 1-ribbed, indehiscent, the pericarp soft, thick, the locules 4 or 5; seeds numerous, horizontal, each encased in a red aril-like pulp, brownish-black, obovate in outline; mature seeds tumid (somewhat compressed but turgid), marginate, rugulose on the paler margin, 7-9 mm long, 4.5-5 mm wide.
bibliographicCitation: Lott, Emily J. 1986. Dieterlea, a new genus of Cucurbitaceae from Mexico. Brittonia. 38: 407-410.

description: Truncus cylindricus usque ad 3 m vel ultra altus, 20-30 cm diam. Cataphylla dense lanata, 9-10 cm longa, basi 2 cm lata. Folia carinata, recto angulo supra-concava, numerosa, rigide coriacea, adscendentia, in statu juvenili tomentosa, deinde glabra, 75-85 cm longa et ultra. Rachis semiteres, prope apicem spiraliter torta. Petiolus semiteres, 10-12 cm longus. Foliola 80-100 ca utroque latere, subopposita, lineari-lanceolata, acute pungentia, supra rachidem oblique inserta, 5 mm ca paribus intervallis separata. Foliola infima 2.5-3 cm longa, 3 mm lata, margine integerrima; foliola inferiora 20-30-juga, sensim crescentia, usque ad 6-7 cm longa et 7-8 mm lata, margine superiore integerrima vel dentibus 1, raro 2, spinosis 2-3 mm longis praedita, margine inferiore integerrima vel 1-spinosa; foliola mediana et superiora 50-70-juga, 6-7 cm longa, 7-8 mm lata, ad apicem decrescentia, utroque margine integerrima vel superiore 1-spinosa, nervis 12 ca, supra basin angustata, insertione basali 9-10 mm lata; foliola suprema 1 cm tantum longa, 1-2 mm lata, margine integerrima. Strobilus femineus ovoideo-cylindricus, 50 cm ca longus, 25 cm ca diam., squamae deltoideo-ovatae ca 8-10 cm longae et 4-5 cm latae, extus dense lanosae; semina ovoideo-subglobosa, 3-4 cm longa, 2-2.5 cm diam. Strobilus masculinus elongato-cylindricus, apice obtusus, ca 40 cm longus et 10 cm latus.

description: Truncus cylindricus usque ad 1 m vel ultra altus. 20-25 cm diam. Cataphylla lanata. 12-14 cm longa. basi 2 cm lata. Folia plana. numerosa. coriacea. adscendentia. glabra. 75-90 cm longa et ultra. Rachis semiteres, recta aut leviter torta. Petiolus semiteres, 12-15 cm longus. Foliola 50-70 et ultra utroque latere. subopposita. lineari-lanceolata. acute pungentia. margine revoluta. 4-5 mm lata. 5-7 mm ca paribus intervallis separata. supra rachim acuto angulo inserta. Foliola inferiora primum 1.5- 2.5 cm longa. 2 mm ca lata. deinde sensim crescentia, margine integerrima; foliola mediana. 6-8 usque ad 10 cm longa. 4-5 mm lata. nervis 6-8, margine superiore integerrima vel superiore dentibus 1. rarissime 2. spinosis 2-3 mm longis praedita. margine inferiore integerrima; foliola superiora sensim decrescentia usque ad 1-2 cm longa. 1-2 mm lata. margine integerrima. Strobilus femineus ovoideo- cylindricus. 30-40 cm longus. 20-25 cm diam. squamae deltoideo-ovatae 12-14 cm longae. 5 cm latae. extus dense lanosae: semina subglobosa. 3-4 cm diam. Strobilus masculinus elongato-cylindricus. ca 40 cm longus. 9-10 cm latus. microsporophylla basi angustata. 3-4 cm longa. parte fertili biloba. parte sterili sursum arrecta atque acute pungentia.

description: Truncus cylindricus, erectus vel reclinatus, 5 m vel ultra altus, 25-40 cm diam. Cataphylla dense lanata, 16-18 cm longa, basi 2 cm lata. Folia plana, numerosa, coriacea, adscendentia, in statujuvenili pubescentia, deinde glabra, 160 cm longa et ultra. Rachis semiteres, recta: petiolus semiteres, 10-15 cm longus, basi 3-4 cm latus. Strobilus ? ovoideo- cylindricus, 60-75 x 20-25 cm, apice obtusus; squamae deltoideo-ovatae 10 x 5 cm, extus dense lanosae; semina ovoideo-cylindrica, 5-6 x 3 cm. description: Truncus cylindricus, plerumque supra terram erectus interdum subterraneus. description: Stem short (less than 100 cm), cylindric, covered by persistent leaf bases, aerial or raised only slightly above the ground, rarely with buds at base; leaves in crown, mostly numerous, 1-2 m long, tomentose when young, glabrous or pubescent at maturity, flat, rigid, ascending; petiole (6) 10-24 (35) cm long, unarmed, semiterete to subterete; rachis semiterete to subterete, straight; leaflets subopposite, 70 or more on each side, lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, falcate to subfalcate (rarely straight), inserted at right angles (rarely at an acute angle), 10-18 cm long and 4.5-12 mm wide in the middle portion of the leaf, spinulose or entire, light green or glaucous, horizontal (rarely deflexed); microsporangiate cone solitary, long- cylindric, 25-50 cm long, 6-10 cm in diameter; microsporophylls 2.5-4 cm long, exposed tip pointed above and rounded below; megasporangiate cone ovoid, solitary, 20-30 cm long, 15-20 cm in diameter; megasporophylls lanceolate, densely woolly, 4-5 cm long, 7-8 cm wide at the base, the outer part mostly reflexed; seeds cream or red, 2-2.5 x 2.5-3.5 cm, 6-10 cc in volume.

description: Arbor 10-15 m. alta; ramulis teretibus juvenilibus leviter flexuosis cum petiolis arete brunneo-strigosis; petiolis canaliculatis 5-8 mm. longis; laminis coriaceis ovato-oblongis, 11-15 cm. longis, 4-5.5 cm. latis, basi rotundato-cuneatis, apice obtuse acuminatis, supra praeter costam strigulosam glabris, subtus regulariter dense strigosis (pilis 0.50.8 mm. longis), costa supra impressa subtus prominente, nervis secun-dariis 11 vel 12 leviter curvatis supra leviter impressis subtus prominu-lis, venulis inconspicuis; inflorescentiis male axillaribus cymosis 1-2 cm. longis 5-10-floris, ubique praeter corollam dense ferrugineo- vel brun-neo-strigulosis vel sericeis, bracteis 4-5 mm. longis caducis; pedicellis 2-6 mm. longis; calyce obconico, sub anthesi circiter 5 mm. longo, lobis 5 vel 6 lanceolato-deltoideis acutis, 2-2.5 mm. longis, circiter 1.5 mm. latis; corolla tenuiter carnosa rotata 7-8 mm. longa, prope ad basin 5-lobata, lobis oblongis obtusis circiter 3.5 mm. latis, in alabastro imbri-catis, sub anthesi patulis, praeter pilorum ad 1 mm. longorum lineam dorsalem medianam glabris; staminibus circiter 50 subaequalibus cir-citer 4 mm. longis dorsaliter hispidis, pilis 1-2 mm. longis, filamentis 0.5-1 mm. longis; gynaecio subnullo.

description: Arbor ad 30 m. alta; ramis ramulisque teretibus juventute hispidulis mox glabris nigrescentibus; petiolis teretibus hispidulis 1-2 mm. longis; laminis coriaceis fuscis elliptico-oblongis, 5-6 cm. longis, 1.52.2 cm. latis, basi cuneato-attenuatis, apice obtusis, margine integris et recurvatis, supra praeter costam depressam hispidulam glabris, sub-tus brevissime sericeis, costa subtus prominente et pilis ad 1 mm. longis hispida, nervis secundariis utroque 6-10 utrinque obscuris copiose anastomosantibus; inflorescentiis $ axillaribus cymosis ad 12 mm. longis, plerumque 4-fLoris, ramulis pedicellisque densissime strigosis, bracteis caducis; pedicellis 1-2 mm. longis; calyce coriaceo rugoso cupuliformi, 4 mm. longo, 3-4 mm. diametro, parce puberulo, lobis 4 ovatis apiculatis circiter 1 mm. longis, margine incrassatis; corolla car-nosa cylindrica, 7-9 mm. longa, media 3 mm. diametro utrinque angus-tata, extra pilis argenteis ad 1 mm. longis sericea, intus glabra, lobis 4 oblongis obtusis 1 mm. longis; staminibus circiter 20 subaequalibus parce hispidis, 6-7 mm. longis, filamentis circiter 1.5 mm. longis, antheris linearibus acutis; ovario rudimentario breviter setoso.

description: Arbor ad 20 m. alta; ramulis crassis subteretibus arcte et dense brunneo-tomentosis; petiolis crassis rugosis tomentosis canaliculatis 10-15 mm. longis; laminis coriaceis elliptico-oblongis, 20-24 cm. longis, 9-10 cm. latis, basi rotundatis et petiolo abrupte decurrentibus, apice breviter acuminatis, margine arcte revolutis, supra praeter costam puberulam glabris, subtus densissime molliter ferrugineo-tomentosis (pilis circiter 0.5 mm. longis), costa validis supra plana subtus promi-nentissima, nervis secondariis utroque 9-11 adscendentibus prope mar-gines anastomosantibus supra leviter impressis subtus prominentibus, venulis reticulatis subtus prominulis; inflorescentiis female axillaribus cymo-sis 2-4 cm. longis 10-14-floris, ramulis pedicellisque densissime ferrugineo-tomentosis, bracteis oblongis 3-4 mm. longis caducis; pedicellis 6-12 mm. longis; calyce tenniter coriaceo obconico, snb anthesi 10-12 mm. longo, ntrinqne tomentello, lobis 5 lanceolato-oblongis acutis, 5-6 mm. longis, 3-4 mm. latis; corolla carnosa 12-14 mm. longa, profnnde 5-lobata, lobis oblongis circiter 6 mm. latis, apice rotnndatis, in alabas-tro imbricatissimis, snb anthesi patulis, praeter pilorum adpressorum 1- 2 mm. longorum lineam dorsalem medianam glabris; staminodiis circiter 15 linearibus, 3-4 mm. longis, apice parce setosis; ovario sub-globoso leviter sulcato, sub anthesi circiter 3 mm. diametro, dense brevi-ter setoso, loculis 10 (vel 8?) 1-ovulatis, stylis 4 vel 5 carnosis patulis hispidulosis, 6-7 mm. longis, basi in columna brevi connatis, apice bifidis; calyce fructifero accrescente.

description: Plant 1-3 in high, the branches slender, wandlike; prinicipal leaves 3-10 cm long, 1-3 cm wide, acute, with about 15-20 veins on each side of the midrib; upper leaves muostly 1.5-2.5 cm long, with about 8-10 veins on each side of the midrib; flowers rather numerous; pedicels 2-3 cm long at anthesis, somewhat longer in fruit; floral tube about 4 mm long; sepals about 8 mm long; petals 4-5 mm long; anthers about 2.5 mm long; capsule 6-7 mm in diameter; seeds 3-4 mm in diameter.

description: Frutex glaber, ramis teretibus, pallidis, ramulis ultimis eirciter 1.5 mm. diametro, plus minusve, abrupte flexuosis, internodiis plerumque 2-3 cm. longis; foliis coriaceis, ellipticis vel ovato-ellipticis, 7-10 cm. longis, 3-5.5 cm. latis, utrinque laevibus, in sieco supra viridibus, subnitidis, subtus subalbidis, glaucis, apice breviter acuminatis, basi rotundatis, 3-plinerviis, nervis longitudinalibus apicem attingentibus, cum reticulis primariis supra impressis, subtus plus minusve elevatis horizontalibus utrinque eirciter 9, margine serrulatis, dentibus atro-apiculatis, aliquis superioribus basi valde inerassatis; infloreseentiis axillaribus, solitariis, 6-10-floris, fasciculatis vel depauperato-racemosis, rhachibus aliquando ad 1 cm. longis, glabris; bracteolis binis, basalibus, ovatis, acuminatis, plus minusve carinatis, margine irregulariter breviter ciliatis, 2 mm. longis, pedicellis glabris, 6 mm. longis; fructibus depresso-globosis, maturis atris, eirciter 3 mm. longis et 3 mm. diametro, valvis parcissime consperseque hirsutis; sepalis persistentibus ovatis vel oblongo-ovatis, coriaceis, glabris, acuminatis, 2-3 mm. longis, 1.5-2 mm. latis.

description: Frutex ut videtur erectus, subtus foliis breviter consperseque setulosis exceptis glaber, ramis ramulisque in sieco rubro-brunneis vel pallidis, teretibus, ultimis eirciter 1.5 mm. diametro, internodiis 2-3 cm. longis, reetis; foliis coriaceis, oblongo-ellipticis, ellipticis vel ovatis, in sieco supra pallidis vel pallide viridibus, laevibus subtus pallide brunneis, asperulis, brevissime consperseque setulosis, 7-11 cm. longis, plerumque 3-4.5 (rariter ad 6) cm. latis, perspicue acuminatis, basi late acutis vel rotundatis, 3-nerviis, nervis lateralibus longitudinalibus apice attingentibus, nervis horizontalibus utrinque 6-10, cum reticulis supra vix vel leviter impressis, subtus leviter elevatis, margine serrulatis, dentibus brevissime glanduloso-apiculatis; petiolo crasso, 2-3 mm. longo; infloreseentiis axillaribus, 10-18-floris, solitariis vel binis, fasciculatis vel depauperato-racemosis, rhachibus aliquando ad 8 mm. longis, glabris, pedicellis glabris, sub fructu ad 7 mm. longis, bracteis ovatis, acuminatis, ad 3 mm. longis, bracteolis binis similis sed minoribus, eirciter 2 mm. longis et 1.8 mm. latis, margine breviter ciliatis; sepalis persistentibus oblongo-ovatis vel ovato-lanceolatis, acuminatis, subearnosis, glabris, ad 4 mm. longis et 2.5 mm. latis; capsulis in fundo tubi liberis vel subliberis, subglobosis, eirciter 2 mm. diametro, valvis distincte hirsutis; stylis subpersistentibus ad 3 mm. longis, glabris.

description: Slender vine twining on shrubs in closed understory of Tropical Moist Forest, the annotinous and older trunks unknown, the sinuous hornotinous stems with ventral face and margin of membranous leaf-blades charged with scattered stiff setiform hairs up to 1-2 mm, the foliage dull olivaceous concolorous; petioles 6-10 cm; blades varying from broadly hastate to symmetrically pentagonal or asymmetrically 3-4-gonal, 8-15 x 5.5-14 cm, each angle abruptly short-acuminate, the basal sinus narrow but open and 1-2 cm deep; primary venation of 5 veins radiating from the petiole, the outer pair retrorsely directed, the inner pair incurved ascending, either one or both veins of each pair either incurved within the margin of the blade or excurrent into a deltate-acuminate angle, the midrib giving rise at and beyond middle to 2-3 pairs of secondary veins, the tertiary and subsequent venulation finely prominulous on both faces but the reticulation open, the ultimate areoles up to 2-5 mm diam; inflorescence d and flower [female] unknown; raceme [female] pendulous, laxly 20-25-flowered, the axis together with very slender pliant peduncle ±3 dm; drupe compressed-ellipsoid +1.2-1.3 x 0.8 x 0.5 cm, when fresh lustrous black-purple, black when dry, the endocarp immersed in gelatinous pulp, in broad profile 11 x 8 mm, the membranous external wing entire ±2 mm wide.
bibliographicCitation: Lasseigne, Alex A. 1981. Senna barnebyana (Leguminosae: Caesalpinioideae), a new 'cassia' from Peru. Brittonia. 33: 512-514.

description: Tree 3-12 m tall, with DBH of up to 50 cm; bark smooth, gray to dark gray. Leafy portion of twigs 0.8-3.4 mm thick, thinly sericeous at first, soon glabrate, yellowish, reddish, or olive-brown to gray or brown with epidermis exfoliating in patches, finely longitudinally striate or wrinkled. Lamina of larger leaves 1 1.3- 16.4 cm long, 4-5.4 cm wide, chartaceous to membranous, oblong to oblong- oblanceolate, base cuneate and decurrent on petiole, apex acuminate, the acumen 8-13 mm long, glabrous adaxially, sericeous abaxially when young, soon glabrate; midrib impressed adaxially, raised and keeled abaxially; secondary veins 9-14 per side, these and higher-order veins indistinct or slightly prominent on both leaf surfaces. Petiole 6-9 mm long, 1.2-1.5 mm wide, sparsely pubescent to glabrate. Inflorescence terminal or leaf-opposed, 1- or 2-flowered; pedicels 3.9- 5.1 cm long, 0.6-1.2 mm thick at midpoint, rusty sericeous at first, then sparsely pubescent. Sepals 2, 6.5-9 mm long, 5-6 mm wide, chartaceous, broadly ovate, acute at apex, with tiny dense erect hairs adaxially, sparsely appressed-pubescent abaxially. Petals connate, subcoriaceous; tube 2-5 mm long, adnate to torus, sparsely appressed-pubescent on abaxial surface; lobes 4, 4-5 mm long, 0.5-0.6 mm wide at widest point, narrowed near middle with portion distal to this point lanceolate and often with a longitudinal furrow, glabrate adaxially, sparsely ap- pressed-pubescent abaxially, Stamens 1.2-1.4 mm long; connectives depressed- globose, densely erect-puberulent. Carpels ca 100-150; ovaries 0.6-0.9 mm long, densely sericeous; styles 0.5-0.6 mm long, with crisped hairs at apex; ovules 2. Torus 5 mm in diam. Pedicel in fruiting stage 4.5-5 cm long, 1.7-2.3 mm thick at midpoint, glabrate. Torus in fruiting stage 1.5-2.2 cm in diam, calyx and corolla persistent; carpophores 3.5-6.5 cm long, 0.7-0.9 mm thick at midpoint, obliquely clavate and 2.0-2.7 mm thick at apex. Monocarps 36-110+, concolorous with carpophores, 8.5-13 mm long, 6.5-7.5 mm wide, ellipsoid, apex rounded or apiculate, base attenuate, glabrate; monocarp wall 0.2 mm thick. Seeds 2, rarely only 1, 7-7.5 mm long, 6-6.7 mm wide, irregularly ellipsoid to globose.
bibliographicCitation: Johnson, D. M. 1989. Revision of Disepalum (Annonaceae). Brittonia. 41 (4): 356-378.

description: Leafy portion of twigs 1.2-1.6 mm thick, dark reddish to yellowish-brown, nearly smooth. Lamina of larger leaves 14.4-14.7 cm long, 3.9-5 cm wide, oblanceolate, membranous, base cuneate, decurrent, apex long-acuminate, the acumen 15-18 mm long, glabrous adaxially, sparsely pubescent abaxially; midrib slightly impressed adaxially, raised and keeled abaxially; secondary veins 8-10 per side, these and higher-order veins slightly raised on both surfaces. Petiole 7- 11 mm long, 0.8-1.3 mm wide, glabrous. Pedicel up to 6.3 cm long, 0.7 mm thick at midpoint. Sepals 2, 8 mm long, ca 6 mm wide, 3.5 mm deep, ovate and somewhat concave, acute at apex, subcoriaceous, densely pubescent adaxially. Petals connate, subcoriaceous; tube 4.5 mm long, adnate at base to torus, with appressed and erect hairs adaxially, appressed-pubescent abaxially; lobes 4, 12.5 mm long, 4.5 mm wide at base, linear, tapering to an acute apex, with both appressed and short erect hairs adaxially, appressed-pubescent abaxially. Stamens 1.5-1.8 mm long; connectives cushion-shaped, erect-pubescent. Carpels ca 1.3 mm long [immature]; ovaries obscured by their long appressed hairs; style apex hispidulous. Fruit unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Johnson, D. M. 1989. Revision of Disepalum (Annonaceae). Brittonia. 41 (4): 356-378.

description: Small tree 1.5-3 m tall. Leafy portion of twigs 0.7-4 mm thick, reddish-brown to pale yellowish-gray, soon becoming light gray with epidermis exfoliating, slight- ly longitudinally wrinkled, glabrous. Leaf lamina 7.5-15.2 cm long, 2.4-5.6 cm wide, chartaceous to subcoriaceous (rarely membranous-chartaceous), elliptic to oblong, occasionally oblanceolate to obovate, base cuneate and short decurrent, apex acuminate with a blunt acumen 4-13 mm long, glabrous adaxially, at first sericeous abaxially, soon sparsely pubescent; midrib impressed adaxially, raised and keeled abaxially; secondary veins (5) 8-12 per side, these and higher-order veins slightly raised on both surfaces. Petiole 4-11 mm long, 0.8-1.7 mm wid glabrous. Inflorescence leaf-opposed or sometimes terminal, 1- or 2 (3)-flowered; pedicels (2.7) 3.7-6.5 cm long, (0.4) 0.7-1.2 mm thick at midpoint, glabrous to sparsely pubescent. Sepals 2, 5-12 mm long, (3.5) 6.5-11 mm wide, chartaceous, orbicular or broadly ovate, rounded or acute at apex, with fine erect pubescence adaxially, glabrous or glabrescent abaxially. Petals connate, subcoriaceous; tube 1.5-11 mm long, broadly obconic to narrow and abruptly flaring, adnate to torus, densely pubescent abaxially; lobes 4, 3-8 mm long, 0.6-2 mm wide at narrowest point, 1.6-2.3 mm wide at widest point, spatulate, apex blunt, hairy adaxially except on spatulate or rhombic apical portion, uniformly pubescent abaxially. Stamens 1. 5-2. 1 mm long; connectives cushion-shaped, densely erect-puberulent. Carpels ca 30; ovaries 0.8-1 mm long, densely sericeous; styles 0.9-1.4 mm long, short-pubescent to hispidulous at apex; ovules 2, rarely 1. Torus 2.5-6.5 mm in diam. Pedicel in fruiting stage 1.9-5.2 cm long, 0.7-1.6 mm thick at midpoint, glabrous. Torus in fruiting stage 5.5-12 mm in diam, calyx and corolla persistent; carpophores 0.6-2.5 cm long, 0.7-1.2 mm thick at midpoint, truncate and 1.1- 1.5 mm thick at apex. Monocarps 7-26 (53), concolorous with carpophores, 9- 12 mm long, 7-9 mm wide, ellipsoid, apex rounded, sometimes apiculate, base rounded, glabrate; monocarp wall 0.1 mm thick. Seeds 2, rarely 1, 7-8.5 mm long, 6-6.5 mm wide, ellipsoid.
bibliographicCitation: Johnson, D. M. 1989. Revision of Disepalum (Annonaceae). Brittonia. 41 (4): 356-378.

description: Tree or shrub 1.5-9 m tall with a DBH of 5-30 cm; bark smooth, gray to black, sometimes mottled, inner bark pale yellow or gray, sapwood white or yellowish. Leafy portion of twigs 0.7-4.3 mm thick, glabrous or sparsely pubescent and soon glabrate, dark reddish or yellowish-brown, with age dark gray or gray-brown, often with frosty exfoliating epidermal patches, longitudinally wrinkled, sometimes slightly verrucose. Lamina of larger leaves 7.8-18.4 cm long, 3.1-6.3 cm wide, subcoriaceous, occasionally coriaceous or chartaceous, oblanceolate, oblanceolate- obovate or elliptic, base cuneate and short-decurrent on petiole, apex with an acumen 4-10 mm long, glabrous adaxially, initially sparsely appressed pubescent or glabrous abaxially, soon glabrate; midrib slightly impressed adaxially, raised and keeled abaxially; secondary veins 6-15 per side, commonly 9-1 1, these and higher-order veins raised or indistinct on both surfaces. Petiole 4-13 mm long, 0.8-2.2 mm wide, glabrous. Inflorescence terminal, with the opposing leaves often reduced in size, 1- or 2-flowered; pedicels 1.4-4.6 cm long, 0.6-1.3 mm wide at midpoint, glabrous or with a few appressed hairs. Sepals 2, (5) 7-11 mm long, 6.5-11 mm wide, 3-5 mm deep, coriaceous to subcoriaceous, orbicular to ovate, often boat-shaped, rounded to obtuse at apex, densely short-pubescent adaxially,  glabrous or sparsely pubescent abaxially. Petals connate, coriaceous to subcor- iaceous; tube (0.5) 2-6.5 (7.5) mm long, broadly funnelform, adnate to torus at base, glabrous; lobes 4-9, (5) 7-12.5 (14) mm long, 1.7-5.5 mm wide at widest point, linear, evenly tapering to an acute or obtuse apex, sparsely appressed- pubescent only on ultimate 1-2 mm of lobes, otherwise glabrous. Stamens (1.2) 1.5-2 mm long; connectives cushionlike, erect-pubescent. Carpels ca 60-120; ovary 0.7-1.5 mm long, appressed-pubescent; style 0.5-1.6 mm long, setulose or hispidulous at apex; ovules (1) 2 (3). Torus 5-8 mm in diam. Pedicel in fruiting stage 2.2-5.4 cm long, 1-2.5 mm thick at midpoint, glabrate. Torus in fruiting stage 6-20 mm in diam, calyx and corolla usually persistent; carpophores (0.6) 1.9-4.0 cm long, 0.6-1.5 mm thick at midpoint, evenly to obliquely truncate and 1.1-2.2 mm thick at apex. Monocarps (8) 17-76, concolorous with carpophores, 6-11 mm long, 5.5-8 mm wide, ellipsoid, apex rounded to apiculate, base broadly cuneate to rounded, glabrate; monocarp wall 0.2 mm thick. Seeds 2, less com- monly 1, 5.5-12 (15) mm long, 4.5-7 mm wide, irregularly ellipsoid to globose.
bibliographicCitation: Johnson, D. M. 1989. Revision of Disepalum (Annonaceae). Brittonia. 41 (4): 356-378.

description: Shrub or small tree 2-5 m tall. Leafy portion of twigs 1.3-3 mm thick, glabrate, reddish-brown to dark gray, longitudinally wrinkled. Lamina of larger leaves 14.6- 17.5 cm long, 3.3-4.6 cm wide, chartaceous, oblanceolate to narrowly elliptic or oblong, base cuneate and short decurrent on petiole, apex acuminate, the acumen 9-20 mm long, glabrous adaxially, initially golden to rusty-sericeous abaxially, at length glabrate or with scattered appressed hairs; midrib impressed adaxially, prominent and keeled abaxially, secondary veins 8-13 per side, these and higher order veins slightly raised on both surfaces. Petiole 4-7 mm long, 1.2-1.6 mm wide, pubescent. Inflorescence terminal, 1-flowered; pedicel 1-1.7 cm long, 1.3 mm thick at midpoint, ferruginous-pubescent. Sepals 3, 10-11 mm long, 8-9.5 mm wide, chartaceous, ovate, acute at apex, appressed-pubescent on both surfaces, eventually glabrate abaxially. Petals free, in 2 whorls of 3, coriaceous, oblong or oblanceolate, acute at apex, glabrous to sparsely puberulent adaxially, sparsely sericeous abaxially; outer petals 14-26 mm long, 6.5-11 mm wide; inner petals 13-23 mm long, 7-11 mm wide. Stamens 2.2-2.7 mm long; connectives de- pressed-globose, short-pubescent. Carpels 18-35; ovary 0.5-1.2 mm long, ap- pressed pubescent; style 1.2-1.5 mm long, hispidulous at apex; ovules 1 or 2. Torus 4-10 mm in diam. Pedicel in fruiting stage 1.3-2.2 cm long, 1-2.3 mm thick at midpoint, ferruginous-pubescent. Torus in fruiting stage 4.5-6 mm in diam, perianth not persistent; carpophores 0.7-1.3 cm long, 0.9-2 mm thick at midpoint, obliquely clavate to truncate, 1.5-2.3 mm thick at apex. Monocarps 4-15, concolorous with carpophores or darker, 13-14 mm long, 7-9 mm wide, ellipsoid to oblong-ellipsoid, apex rounded, base rounded or slightly attenuate, glabrate; monocarp wall ca 0.1 mm thick. Seeds 1 or 2, 10-12.5 mm long, 6-8 mm wide, flattened-ellipsoid.
bibliographicCitation: Johnson, D. M. 1989. Revision of Disepalum (Annonaceae). Brittonia. 41 (4): 356-378.

description: Shrub or tree 3-18 m tall with a DBH of at least 2-3 cm. Leafy portion of twigs 1.5-5.2 mm thick, sparsely pubescent at first, soon glabrate, brown to dark gray or purplish-gray, longitudinally wrinkled. Lamina of larger leaves 10.6-18 cm long, 3-7.1 cm wide, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic, less commonly oblong, oblanceolate, or lanceolate, base cuneate and decurrent, apex acute or short- acuminate, the acumen 3-9 mm long, glabrous adaxially, at first densely rusty sericeous abaxially, soon sparsely appressed-pubescent; midrib slightly impressed adaxially, raised and keeled abaxially; secondary veins 8-12 per side, these and higher-order veins prominent on both surfaces. Petiole 6-10 mm long, 1.5-2.3 mm wide, pubescent to glabrate. Inflorescence terminal, 1-flowered; pedicel 2.2- 4.3 cm long, 1.5-2 mm thick at midpoint, rusty-pubescent. Sepals 3, 14-18 mm long, 13-17 mm wide, chartaceous, broadly ovate, obtuse to apiculate at apex, pubescent to sparsely pubescent. Petals free, in 2 whorls of 3, chartaceous, ob- lanceolate, acute at apex, adaxially with dense erect hairs and petal surface bumpy creating an appearance of stellate hairs, uniformly appressed-pubescent abaxially; outer petals 22-32 mm long, 9-19 mm wide; inner petals 23-34 mm long, 12- 24 mm wide. Stamens 2.2-2.6 mm long; connectives cushion-shaped, puberulent. Carpels 60-200; ovary ca 1 mm long, rusty appressed-pubescent; style 1.4-1.8 mm long, pubescent at apex; ovules 1 or 2. Torus 7-9 mm in diam. Pedicel in fruiting stage 2.8-5.4 cm long, 1.7-4 mm thick at midpoint, pubescent. Torus in fruiting stage 11-21 mm in diam; perianth not persistent; carpophores 3-4.7 cm long, 1.5-1.7 mm thick at midpoint, truncate and 3-5 mm thick at apex. Mono- carps (3) 10-98, darker than carpophores and slightly glaucous, 11.5-16 mm long and 8-11 mm wide, ellipsoid, apex rounded, base broadly cuneate to rounded, glabrate; monocarp wall 0.5-0.6 mm thick. Seeds 1 or 2, 11-11.5 mm long, 8 mm wide, ellipsoid.
bibliographicCitation: Johnson, D. M. 1989. Revision of Disepalum (Annonaceae). Brittonia. 41 (4): 356-378.

description: Tree 3-14 m tall with a DBH of 15-30 cm. Leafy portions of twigs 1.3-4.6 mm thick, appressed-pubescent to glabrescent, reddish to grayish-brown, longitudinally striated to wrinkled, occasionally with oblique longitudinal ridges decurrent from petiole base. Lamina of larger leaves 12.7-21.5 cm long, 4.5-8.1 cm wide, chartaceous, obovate to broadly oblanceolate, occasionally elliptic to oblong, base cuneate and short-decurrent, apex short-acuminate, with a blunt acumen 4-11 mm long, glabrous adaxially, appressed-pubescent abaxially, eventually very sparsely pubescent to glabrescent; midrib slightly impressed adaxially, raised and keeled abaxially; secondary veins 8-12 (15) per side, these and higher-order veins slightly raised on both surfaces. Petiole 4-12 mm long, 1.5-2.1 mm wide, pu- bescent. Inflorescence terminal, 1-flowered; pedicel 3.6-5.3 mm long, 1.2-1.7 mm thick at midpoint, appressed-pubescent. Sepals 3, 10-21 mm long, 7.5-15 mm wide, chartaceous, ovate, acute at apex, appressed pubescent on both surfaces. Petals free, in 2 whorls of 3, subcoriaceous, oblanceolate or panduriform, acute to cuspidate at apex, erect-pubescent to glabrous adaxially, appressed-pubescent abaxially, 21-44 mm long, 8-25 mm wide. Stamens 2.8-3.8 mm long; connective cushion-shaped, erect-pubescent. Carpels 120-200; ovaries 2.1-2.9 mm long, densely pubescent; styles 1.2-4.5 mm long, slightly setulose at apex; ovules 2, rarely 3. Torus 7-8.5 mm in diam. Pedicel in fruiting stage 5.3-6.7 cm long, 2.5- 4.3 mm thick at midpoint, sparsely appressed-pubescent. Torus in fruiting stage 11-25 mm in diam; perianth not persistent; carpophores 3.1-4.4 cm long, 1.3- 2.1 mm thick at midpoint, clavate and 2.2-3.5 mm thick at apex. Monocarps 13- 102, concolorous with carpophores, 14-21 mm long and 7-10 mm wide, ellipsoid, apex rounded or apiculate, base attenuate, glabrescent; monocarp wall 0.1-0.2 mm thick. Seeds 2, less commonly 1 or 3, 10-13 mm long, 7.5-8.5 mm wide, flattened-ellipsoid.

description: Bushy shrub ca. 1 m tall. description:
Epiphytic or terredstrial, bushy shrubs 0.5-1.5 (2) m tall. Branchlets sharply ridged and grooved and rather indistinctly 3-angled to very irregularly 4-angled, glabrous or very sparingly strigillose or minutely puberulent; mature branches becoming terete, grayish to blackish, conspicuously fissured. Internodes from about 1/5-3/4 as long as the surrounding leaves. Petioles 3-5 mm long, glabrous, flattened above. Leaves coriaceous, broadly elliptic to somewhat obovate or even spatulate, (0.8) 1.2-1.8 cm X (4) 6-12 mm, basally cuneate, apically obtuse to broadly rounded, entire to very obscurely and microscopically serrulate, dark green above and pale green beneath when fresh, glabrous above, beneath evenly but sparingly beset with appressed, amber-colored (when dry) trichomes 0.2-0.3 mm long; 3-5- plinerved, midrib and lateral veins slightly elevated to nearly plane on both surfaces.

Flowers solitary, axillary, subsessile. Pedicel disarticulating just beneath base of calyx, 2-3 mm long, with 1-3 deltoid to acutely oblong bracts near the base. Bracteoles subopposite, semiorbicular, +/- 1.5 X 1.8-2 mm, broadly clasping, ciliate, located + 1.5-1.8 mm below and scarcely overlapping the base of the calyx. Hypanthium terete, shortly cylindric, glabrous, +/- 3.5 X 2-2.2 mm; calyx lobes 3, not very pronounced, erect, broadly deltoid, acute, +/- 0.5 mm long, marginally entire, non-ciliate, glabrous. Corolla deep red, thinly fleshy; corolla tube + cylindric, abruptly tapering into a basal portion 2-2.3 X about 1-1.4 mm, the longer portion of tube 5-5.5 X about 2.5 mm with a few ascendent trichomes 0.1-0.2 mm long; corolla lobes 3, erect, oblong-deltoid, acute, 1.5-2 X 1-1.2 mm. Stamens 6, +/- 1 mm shorter than the corolla-tube; filaments 2.5 mm long, flattened, glabrous; anthers granular, 2.5- 2.8 mm long, each theca tapering into a slender tubule + 2.5-2.8 mm long with an introrse elongate-oval slit 1.5 mm long. Style glabrous, slender, extending +/-1.0-1.2 mm beyond the closely enveloping stamens or about to the top of the corolla tube. Berry reportedly at first greenish-white turning dark blue.

description: Arbor alta ramulis glabratis, novellis dense stellato-pubescentibus; foliis breviter petiolatis, ovato-lanceolatis, remote denticulatis vel subintegris, ad basim asymmetricis rotundatis brevissime peltatis, subtus subsparse minuteque stellato- lepidotis, infloreseentiis axillaribus interdum cum petiolis coalitis, racemosis, 2-3.5 cm. longis, dense stellato-pubeseentibus; perianthio rotato, lobis 1.5-2 cm. longis; capsula dense pilis longis stellatis pubeseenti, late ovoidea, ad apicem depressa; stigmatibus 2-3, glabris, 2-3 mm. longis.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Slender tree up to 15 or 20 m. high with gray bark. Branchlets sturdy, grayish, tuberculate with prominent nodes about 1 cm. apart, glabrate, pustulate, young twigs brownish with dense, stellate pubescence; leaves with petioles mostly 1 cm. long, densely lepidote-pubescent, the blades ovate-laneeolate, acute to obtuse, distally somewhat unevenly marginate or slightly denticulate, asymmetrically decurrent and usually subpeltate at rounded bases, mrostly 8-10 cm. long, 4-5 cm. wide, selerophyllous, glaucus and glabrous above, with sparse, minute, lepidote, silvery scales below; veins prominent below, lepidotely pubescent, glabrate, laterals 4 or 5, tertiaries scalariform, reticulately anastomosing; infloreseence axil- lary or petiolar, racemose, 2-3.5 cm. long, densely stellate-pubescent; peduncles stout, with lanceolate, deciduous, pubescent bracts 2 mm. long subtending the short, stout pedicels 1-2 mm. long; corolla rotate, the lobes 1.5-2 mm. long, ovate-cucullate, densely stellate-pubescent; stamens 5, conspicuous, purple, glabrate, 2 mm. long, emarginate, 2-celled, 4-lobed, persistent, on filaments 2 mm. or more long; fruit (immature) yellow, densely long-stellate-pubeseent, broadly ovoid, 7-8 mm. in diameter, 8-10 mm. high, depressed apically and bearing 2 or 3 per- sistent, glabrous stigmas 2-3 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Cronquist, Arthur J. 1947. Revision of the North American species of Erigeron, north of Mexico. Brittonia. 6: 121-302.

description: Frutex, ramulis tenuibus, cano-hirsutulis, basibus petiolorum persistentibus, foliis numerosis, disjuncte verticillatis vel verticillatis, internodis indistinctis vel 1.5 mm. longis; foliis linearibus, acerosis, triquetris, supra late v-formibus apicibus mucronatis, petiolis tenuis decurrentibus; cymis axillaribus vel disjunctis paucifloribus; floribus minutis, sepalis lanceolatis, basibus connatis, petalis lanceolatis subter mediis connatis; coronis duplicibus, lobis exterioribus linearibus, basibus connatis; lobis interioribus minutis; squamis exterioribus anthearum ovato-orbiculatis, membranaceis, stigma excedentibus; polliniis pendulis; folliculis tenuibus.
bibliographicCitation: Lasser, Tobias & Maguire, Bassett. 1950. A report on the plant of the Phelps Cerro Yaví expedition of 1947. Brittonia. 7: 75-90.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Apparently a shrub; branches slender, gray-hirsutulous, rough with persistent petiole bases; leaves very numerous, of high but indefinite phyllotaxy complex, disjunctly verticillate, toward the base of the shoot the verticils more distinct, with 8-10 leaves per whorl, internodes less than 0.5 mm. to 1.5 mm. long; leaves 8-12 mm. long, 0.5 mm. diam. linear, acerose, triquetrous in cross-section, the upper surface broadly V-shaped, the apex mucronate, the petioles slender, about 2 mm. long, decurrent; cymes axillary or disjunct, 1-3-flowered, 3-5 mm. long, brac- teoles less than 1 mm. long; flowers minute, sepals 1.0-1.5 mm. long, connate at the base, lanceolate, acute, somewhat fleshy, petals 2.0-2.5 mm. long, lanceolate, acute somewhat fleshy, lower 1/3 connate; corona double, the outer lobes linear, 1 mm. long, exceeding the gynostegium, connate at the base, the inner scale-like, 0.3-0.5 mn. long; anthers 0.75 mm. long with an external ovate-orbicular mem- branous hood surpassing the stigma; the pollinia pendent 0.2 mm. long, translator arms horizontal, 0.1 mm. long, corpusculae 0.15 mm. long, amber-colored; follicle slender, about 2 cm. long; seed not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Lasser, Tobias & Maguire, Bassett. 1950. A report on the plant of the Phelps Cerro Yaví expedition of 1947. Brittonia. 7: 75-90.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Plants 1.5-4 dm tall; leaves with a petiole 3-12 (16) cm long, the blade 4-9 (14) cm long, (2) 2.5-6 (7) cm wide; scape 1-3.7 dm long; umbel (1) 2-5 (1 1)-flowered, the longer pedicels 1.5-5 (7) cm long; calyx 4-6.5 mm long, the segments 2.2-4 mm long; corolla with the reflexed limb 8-18 mm long, white with a yellow base and red band; stamens with the filament tube concealed or exposed to 0.5 mm length, the anthers (4.6) 5-7.2 mm long, with blunt tips, the connective dark purple to maroon; capsule 8-11 mm long; 2n = 44 (Beamish, 1955; Thompson, 1953).
bibliographicCitation: Holmgren, Noel H. 1994. Redefinition of Dodecatheon dentatum (Primulaceae) and rationale for use of varietal rank. Brittonia. 46: 87-94.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Perennial herb from a short, erect root stock, 1-3 (4) dm tall; herbage glabrous; leaves abruptly contracted into a distinct petiole (3) 4-13 (16) cm long, the blade thin in cross section, ovate, (2) 3.5-7.5 (18) cm long, (1.5) 2-5 (7) cm wide, rounded to cordate basally, obtuse or rounded apically, coarsely shallowly dentate to irregularly sinuate or crenate, rarely subentire; scape 0.8- 3.7 dm long; umbel glabrous, (1) 2-4 (1 1)- flowered, the longer pedicels 0.8-4.5 (7) cm long in flower, slightly longer in fruit, the flowers 5-merous, nodding; calyx 4.5-6 (7) mm long, the segments lanceolate, 2.2-3.7 (4) mm long, acute, acuminate, or caudate; corolla with the reflexed limb (8) 10-17 (20) mm long, with a narrow ring of purple or reddish-brown arcs at the ridge, then white throughout or in var. utahense (rarely also in var. ellisiae) with a yellow basal band and pale violet or pink lobes; stamens with a short, connate filament tube with 0-1.3 (1.8) mm length visible, the anthers (4.6) 5-7.5 (7.9) mm long, the connective smooth, dark purple or in var. ellisiae yellow; stigma not conspicuously enlarged, 0.2-0.3 mm thick; capsule narrowly ovoid, 8-13 mm long, 5-valvate at the apex; 2n = 44 (var. dentatum).
bibliographicCitation: Holmgren, Noel H. 1994. Redefinition of Dodecatheon dentatum (Primulaceae) and rationale for use of varietal rank. Brittonia. 46: 87-94.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Plants 1-3 (4) dm tall; leaves with a petiole 3-9 (13) cm long, the blade (2) 4-7 (18) cm long, 1.5-4 (6.3) cm wide; scape 1-3 (3.7) dm long; umbel 1-5-flowered, the longer pedicels 1.5-4.5 (5.5) cm long; calyx 5- 7 mm long, the segments 2.5-4 mm long; corolla with the reflexed limb 13-20 mm long, white to cream with a yellow base and red band, the lobes rarely purplish in the Graham Mts.; stamens with the visible part of the filament tube 0.6-1 mm long, and anthers 6.3-8 mm long, with acute tips, the connective yellow; capsule 9-13 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Holmgren, Noel H. 1994. Redefinition of Dodecatheon dentatum (Primulaceae) and rationale for use of varietal rank. Brittonia. 46: 87-94.

description: Filamentis cum connectivo atropurpureis vel nigris var. dentato similis, ab ea corollae lobis pallide vio- laceis vel roseis (nec albis) necnon filamentorum tubo per 0.4-1.8 (nec 0-0.5) mm exposito diversa.
bibliographicCitation: Holmgren, Noel H. 1994. Redefinition of Dodecatheon dentatum (Primulaceae) and rationale for use of varietal rank. Brittonia. 46: 87-94.

description: Plants 1-2.5 dm tall; leaves with a petiole 4-8.5 (12) cm long, the blade 2.5-7 (9) cm long, 2-3.2 (4.2) cm wide; scape 0.8-1.8 dm long; umbel (1) 2-4 (9)-flowered, the longer pedicels 0.8-3.5 (4.5) cm long; calyx 4.5-6 mm long, the segments 2.2-3 mm long; corolla with the reflexed limb 10- 16 mm long, pale violet to pink with a white band at the base becoming yellowish proximally and rimmed with reddish brown arcs; stamens with the visible part of the filament tube 0.5-1.8 mm long, the anthers (5) 6-7 mm long, with acute to blunt tips, the connective dark purple to maroon; capsule not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Holmgren, Noel H. 1994. Redefinition of Dodecatheon dentatum (Primulaceae) and rationale for use of varietal rank. Brittonia. 46: 87-94.

description: Affinis D. magnifico Sleumer sed ramulis junioribus dense appresse pubescentibus, petiolis dense appresse pubescentibus 1.5-3 cm, foliorum lamina haud verrucoso-papillata, pedunculis 0.7-2 cm, sepalis 3-4 X 3-5 mm, antheris ca. 0.5 mm glabris, necnon fructu 5-11 mm diam absimilis.
bibliographicCitation: Aymard Corredor, Gerardo A. 2000. Dilleniaceae novae neotropicae: XI. A new subandean species of Doliocarpus. Brittonia. 52: 196-199.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Liana; branches and branchlets densely appressed-pubescent, glabrate at maturity. Leaves subcoriaceous, obovate, obovate-elliptic to elliptic, 17-34 X 5-16 cm, the base cuneate-attenuate, apex obtuse, rarely shortly acuminate, margins not revolute, entire, sinuate-dentate mostly in the upper half; lamina glabrous, midrib and secondary veins shortly appressed pubescent above, lamina sparsely pilose below, except along the midrib and secondary veins where densely pilose, smooth on both surfaces (not verrucose-papillate); tertiary venation more evident on lower surface than on the upper surface; secondary veins 10-16 each side, convergent and linking with the margin; petioles 15-30 X 3-6 mm, exalate, canaliculate, densely appressed-pubescent, becoming glabrous when mature. Inflorescence axillary, fasciculate, uniflorous or racemose, peduncles 0.7-2 cm long, pilose; bracts triangular, appressed-sericeous externally, glabrous internally; sepals 3-6, unequal, 3-5 mm long, ovate, appressed-sericeous externally, glabrous internally; petals not seen; stamens 30-50; filaments glabrous, ca. 4 mm long; anthers 0.4-0.5 mm long, oblong, glabrous. Carpel ca. 1.5 mm long, densely hispid-sericeous. Fruit a berry, 5-11 mm diam., sparsely pilose; seed 1, reniform, glabrous, black, 8-10 X 5-6 mm, completely covered by an aril.
bibliographicCitation: Aymard Corredor, Gerardo A. 2000. Dilleniaceae novae neotropicae: XI. A new subandean species of Doliocarpus. Brittonia. 52: 196-199.
