description: Shrub to 1 m tall, densely and stiffly branched. Leafy twigs 1-3 mm thick, sparsely to densely minutely puberulous. Lamina subcoriaceous, lanceolate to (rarely) linear, 3-7.5 X 0.3-1.5 cm; apex obtuse to (rarely) acute; base cuneate to subcrenate; margin slightly revolute; upper surface glabrous to sparsely and minutely puberulous on the midrib; lower surface glabrous; midib prominulous, flat toward the apex; lateral veins flat to slightly impressed (these and the other smaller veins rather obscure above), (10-)12-15(-18) pairs, the basal pair rather distinct, longer and departing in more acute angles than the others; tertiary venation largely parallel to the lateral veins. Petiole 0.4-1.2 mm long, 0.5-1 mm thick, minutely puberulous; stipules 0.5-1 cm long, minutely puberulous to subglabrous, persistent to subpersistent. description: Monoecious, tendriled vine; stems 5- to 10-sulcate, tomentellous at least at nodes, glabrescent in age. Leaves simple, blade 10-20 cm long and wide, suborbicular in outline, apex acuminate, base deeply cordate, shallowly 3- to 5-lobate, margin glandularly dentate, chartaceous, upper surface minutely pustulate, puberulent, pubescent on veins, lower surface pubescent, 3-veined, 2 lateral veins divided at base and redivided near base; petioles 4-10 cm long, slender, puberulent or tomentellous, especially toward base, sulcate; tendrils 5-branched, puberulent to glabrate, branched well above base. Staminate inflorescences axillary, racemose- paniculate, flowered in upper two-thirds, flowers in umbelliform clusters, rachis 15-30 cm long, slender, puberulent to glabrate; pedicels filiform, 1.0-1.5 cm long, glabrate. Staminate flowers greenish-yellow, calyx depressed-urceolate, glabrous, 1.5-2.0 mm long, 3-4 mm in diameter, lobes 5, triangular-lanceolate, 0.5-1.0 mm long; corolla lobes 5, lanceolate, 6-8 mm long, 2-3 mm wide at base, apex acute, spreading, 7-nerved for most their length, outer surface glabrous, inner surface with short-stalked glands; nectaries 10, pouch-like, sunk into bottom of hypanthium and protruding from the underside, each opening by a pore near periphery on top, upper surface of nectaries tomentose, openings to pores obscured; stamens 5, fila- ments united into a slender column ca. 3 mm long, anthers sessile, connate, thecae flexuous, forming an irregular head ca. 3 mm in diameter. Pistillate flowers 1-3 in same axils as staminate inflorescences, sessile on peduncle 2-5 cm long, peduncle tomentellous at base, otherwise glabrate; calyx and corolla as in staminate; nectaries 10, cup-like, sunk into bottom of hypanthium and protruding from the underside, inner surface with short-stalked glands, tomentellous near style base; style ca. 4 mm long, thick, glabrous, stigma subpeltate, 3-lobate, 2 lobes obscurely 2-lobate, surface papillate, ovary fusiform, 12-15 mm long, ca. 4 mm thick, hirsute-tomentellous on lower half, 5-angled, sparsely aculeate towards base. Fruit green or purplish- tinged, broadly fusiform, slightly compressed, 4.0-5.5 cm long, 2.5-3.0 cm wide at middle, sparsely aculeate at base or rarely spineless, surface sparsely short-hirsute, glabrescent at maturity, slightly roughened, slightly 5-angled, indehiscent, flesh greenish, firm, becoming woody and fibrous at maturity, 1-seeded; seed suborbicular to broadly ovate, firmly attached to flesh.

description: Monoecious, tendriled vine; stems 5- to 10-sulcate, villous, becoming glabrous in age. Leaves simple, blade 22-25 cm long and wide, suborbicular in outline, apex acuminate, base deeply cordate, shallowly 5-lobate, margin glandularly dentate, chartaceous, upper surface minutely pustulate, sparsely villous, lower surface sparsely  villous, especially on veins, 3-veined, 2 lateral veins divided at base and redivided near base; petiole ca. 9 cm long, slender, villous, sulcate; tendrils apparently 5- branched with 2-4 branches well developed, sparsely villous, branched well above base. Staminate inflorescences axillary, racemose-paniculate, flowered nearly its full length, flowers in umbelliform clusters, rachis 20-25 cm long, slender, villous; pedicels filiform, 5-20 mm long, villous. Staminate flowers green; calyx broadly campanulate, villous, ca. 1 mm long, 5-7 mm in diameter, lobes 5, linear-lanceolate, 6-8 mm long, 1 mm wide at base, spreading, 3-nerved for most their length; corolla lobes 5, broadly lanceolate, 8-10 mm long, 4-5 mm wide at base, apex acute, spread- ing, 7-nerved for most their length, outer surface villous, inner surface glabrous; nectaries 10, forming a depressed spherical cushion at base of staminal column, each opening by a pore on periphery; stamens 5, filaments united their length into a slender column ca. 3 mm long, anthers sessile, connate, thecae flexuous, forming an irregular head ca. 3 mm in diameter. Pistillate flowers not seen, apparently solitary or few in same axils as staminate inflorescences. Fruit narrowly ovoid to broadly fusiform, ca. 4.5 cm long, 2.5 cm wide, aculeate at base, surface villous, shallowly pitted, shallowly sulcate, apparently indehiscent, woody and fibrous, 1-seeded; seed not in suitable condition for accurate description.

description: Decumbent shrub 0.3-1.3 m high, 0.8-5.5 m broad, with many branches fron the base; younger twigs and branchlets stellate-tomentose; leaves elliptic-ovate to ovate, subentire to shallowly or deeply palmately 5-7-lobed, 22-37 (-54) mm wide, 19-29 (-50) mm long, the upper surface dark green and stellate-pubescent (1-6 hairs per mm2, these 350-775 µ long), the lower surface light green to whitishgreen, much more densely stellate pubescent (9-18 hairs, each 0.3-1 mm long, per mm2), on petioles 16-40 mm long; flowers 28-36 (-55) mm broad, light-orange to reddish brown in both bud and mature state, on pedicels 9-25 mm long, their 2-3 bractlets 3-12 mm long, each sepal 9-15 (-22) mm wide, 11-22 mm long, slightly pubescent above near the margins and the base, moderately pubescent on the back, the basal gland densely pubescent; styles 12-19 mm long; capsules densely pubescent, ovoid to conical, acute, 19-34 mm long, 10-15 mm broad; seeds dark brown, pubescet, carunculate, ellipsoid-ovoid, 3-5 mm long; pollen grains 32.5-40 µ in diamneter at polar view (mean = 34.8 µ), lumina ca 1.1 µ broad; micro sporogenesis of sporocytes showed ca 49 bivalents at diakinesis; flowering period, late April to early July.

description: Shrub or small tree 4-8 m tall; trunk up to 10 cm diam. Stipules 5.5-6.5 cm long, densely brown-sericeous. Leaves 70-140 cm long, the leaflets (11-) 13-15, the rachis tomentose; petiole 18-35 cm long, 0.7-1 cm diam; petiolules rufous-tomentose, the lateral petiolules 0.6-3 cm long, the apical petiolule 4.5-9.5 cm long; lamina of leaf- lets narrowly oblong or oblong-lanceolate, abruptly caudate-acuminate at apex, obtuse to subrotund at base, 12.7-45 cm long, (4.9-)6-14 cm wide, 6-7.8 cm distant (aver- aging 7.2 cm distant); basal leaflets 12.7-15.5(-43) cm long, 4.9-6(-13.5) cm wide, second pair 18.8-21.5 cm long, 7.2 cm wide, third and fourth pairs 23-34.5 cm long, 7-9.5 cm wide, fifth to seventh pairs 20-33.7 cm long, 7.6-9.2 cm wide, the apical leaflet 20.7-35 cm long, 8.1-12.1 cm wide; upper surface glabrous except for pubescent midrib and lateral nerves, the lower surface pilosulous to subglabrescent and papillate with brown-pilose midrib and lateral nerves, the margins entire or obscurely sub- appressed-denticulate above the middle; primary nerves 19-59 on each side, those of the basal leaflets 19-27 on each side, those of the median leaflets 36-38 on each side, those of the apical leaflet 35-59 on each side (averaging 46), 3-6 mm (averaging 4.2 mm) distant, the midrib and lateral nerves prominent on both surfaces. Inflorescence 15-50 cm long, minutely brown-tomentose, the verticillate primary axes up to 22 cm long. Flowers in congested clusters of 3-7, pedicellate, the pedicels 1-13 mm long. Bracts oblong, up to 5 mm long, early caducous. Sepals unequal, the outer 5-7 mm long, 4-7 mm wide, the inner 6-7 mm long, minutely appressed-velutinous. Petals roseate to orange-yellow, 10 mm long, 6 mm wide, glabrous. Anthers 1 mm long, 0.3 mm wide. Carpels densely pilose, ovary 1 mm long; style 6 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Shrub 2-4 m tall; trunk 2-4 cm diam. Stipules 1.5-5 cm long, minutely puberulent. Leaves 50-100 cm long, leaflets 11-15, rachis minutely puberulent especially above, commonly glabrescent below; petiolules minutely puberulent, the lateral ones 1-4 cm long, the apical one 3-8 cm long; lamina coriaceous, oblong, elliptic- or ovate-oblong abruptly acuminate to caudate at apex, subacute, obtuse, or rounded at the base, 10.8- 27.5 cm long, 5.3-9.6 cm wide; basal leaflets 10.8-18.2 cm long, 5.3-7.5 cm wide, second pair 13.4-27.5 cm long, 6.4-7.5 cm wide, third to fifth pairs (15-)16.8-26.5 cm long, 6.4-8.7 cm wide, sixth pair 19.8 cm long, 6.5 cm wide, apical leaflet 19-24 cm long, 6.5-9.6 cm wide; upper and lower surfaces glabrous or glabrate, the midrib and lateral nerves below appressed-pilosulous to glabrescent; primary nerves 12-36 on each side, those of the apical leaflet 21-36 on each side (averaging 28), 4-9 mm distant (averaging 6.3 mm), the midrib and lateral nerves prominent on both sides. Inflorescence 20-55 cm long with opposite to verticillate primary axes 20-40 cm long, shortly rufous brown-tomentose or in age puberulent to glabrescent below. Flowers in fascicles of 3, pedicellate, the pedicels 2-12 mm long, brown-tomentellose. Bracts unequal, the larger one oblong-lanceolate, obtuse, 7-10 mm long, 2-4 mm wide, tomentellose, subpersistent to deciduous, the other 2-4 mm long, 1-2 mm wide. Outer sepals 2.5-4.5 mm long, 2.5-3.5 mm wide, the inner ones 4.5-6 mm long, 4-6 mm wide, sericeous on both sides. Petals yellow or golden, obovate, rounded at the apex. Fila- ments 4-5.5 mm long. Ovary 0.3-3.7 mm long; styles 3.5-4.5 mm long. Fruiting follicles at maturity 1.5-2 cm long, 1-1.2 cm wide; seeds 1.3 cm long, 0.8 cm wide, glabrous.

description: Folia 104-133 cm longa, 13-21-foliolata plerumque 1 7-19-foliolata, petiolata; petiolis 33-54 cm longis; laminis (3.8-)4-7(-7.7) cm remotis, subtus costa media nervis lateralibusque sparse adpresso-pubescentibus ceterum glabris, marginibus supra medium manifeste crenulatis; nervis lateralibus utroque latere 21-38, eis foliorum basalium utroque latere 21-27, eis foliorum mediorum (quartis vel sextis) 27-38, eis foliorum apicalium 24-31. description: Tree 5-10 m tall. Apical stipules 5-laciniate, the segments subulate-aristate, 2.5-3.5 cm long, slightly appressed-pubescent. Petioles glabrous; apical petiolules (2-)5-7.5 cm long, the others 1.7-3 cm long, glabrous. Leaflets coriaceous, the basal ones oblong lanceolate, abruptly acuminate-caudate at apex, obtuse to subacute at base, 18-25 cm long, (6.5-) 7.1-9.6 cm wide, second and third pairs 23-30 cm long, 7.2-10.4 cm wide, fourth to sixth pairs 30-36 cm long, 8.3-10.5 cm wide, eighth and ninth pairs 27.5-31.5 cm long, 7.1-11.2 cm wide, tenth pair 29-30 cm long, 9.2-9.5 cm wide, apical leaflet 24-29 cm long, 7.1-10.1 cm wide; median and upper leaflets (fourth to ninth pairs) broadly lanceolate, long-acuminate to caudate at apex, obtuse to acute at base, margins crenulate above the middle with low, depressed, obtuse projections, repand to subentire below the middle; lateral nerves 4-8 (-9) mm apart. Inflorescence up to 42 cm long, the lateral axes 20-24, appressed-pubescent, the lower axes 17-33 cm long. Bracts subtending flower fascicles finally deciduous, the outermost largest one entire, lanceo- late, acute to subacute, 8-18 mm long, 1.5-4 mm wide, densely subsericeous without; smaller subtending bracts 3-5 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide. Bracts subtending the lower axes persistent, trifid, often cleft on each side, triangular-lanceolate, 25-30 mm long, 7-10 mm wide, sparsely appressed-pubescent without. Pedicels 6-8 mm long, appressed-tomentellose. Sepals suborbicular, rounded at apex, sericeous both sides, the outer two 6-8 mm long, 6-10 mm wide, the inner three 5.5-8 mm long, 6.5-8 mm wide. Petals obovate, rounded at apex, unequally crenulate-denticulate in upper half; styles 2.5-2.7 mm long. Fruiting valves reflexed at maturity, suborbicular, rounded at apex, 3 cm long, 3.5 cm wide; pericarp 1.5 cm thick; fruiting pedicel 7-10 mm long. Seeds castaneous-black, shining, 1.7-2 cm long, 2.2 cm broad, glabrous.

description: Caespitose, rosulate, mostly stellate-pubescent herbs with one or two growing points that may be moderately swollen or branched ca. 5 cm below the surface. Leaf blades up to 37 mm long, 20 mm broad, ovate to oblong or oblong-lanceolate, unlobed, the apex obtuse to acute, the margin serrate to crenate-serrate, the base subcordate to obtuse, the major veins palmate, impressed above, raised below; petioles mostly 15-25 mm long, shorter than the blades; stipules filiform to linear, to 8 mm long. Flowers solitary in the leaf axils, exceeded by the leaves; pedicels 10-20 mm long, not articulated. Calyx apparently inflated, subrotate, at anthesis ca. 12 mm long, with broadly triangular, acute lobes to ca. 7 mm long, 8 mm broad, in fruit to 17 mm long with lobes to 10 mm or more broad, the lobes papery, veined with several parallel nerves, folded and slightly keeled along the commissural nerve, puberulent within; nectaries poorly developed. Petals apparently yellowish, to 15 mm long, ca. 8 mm broad, obovate, the claw slender, marginally puberulent. Staminal column included, to ca. 4 mm long, terminated by ca. 30 anthers on filaments to 1.5 mm long. Stigmas not exceeding the anthers. Fruit 9-10 mm in diam., closely in- vested by the calyx tube; mericarps pale brown, up to 3 mm high, 5 mm broad (exclusive of the dorsal spines), differentiated into a smooth-walled, stellate-pubescent, loculicidally dehiscent upper portion bearing a pair of suberect, dorsal spines up to 2 mm long, and a glabrous, reticulate-fenestrate, indehiscent lower portion; within  divided into a barren upper cell and a seed bearing lower cell by an endoglossum extending from the dorsal wall nearly to the ventral wall. Seeds reniform-orbicular, ca. 2 mm long and broad, puberulent about the raphe. (Fig. IA)

description: Frutex 1.5 m altus; ramulis ultimis subviridibus, patente pubescentibus; foliis oppositis, ellipticis, in extremis Iambis aentis vel subaeuminatis; laminis 7.5-13.5 cm longis, 2.5-7 cm latis, breve pubescentibus, remote denticulatis; petiolis 2.5-5 cm longis; inflorescentia terminale, conferta; bracteis viridibus, pubescentibus, lanceo-linearibus vel lanceolatis, 5-15 mm longis; pedicellis tenuibus, 7-12 mm longis; hypanthio coceineo-aurantiaco, ca 4 cm longo, base 2-2.5 mm diam., supra 9 mm, externe subpubeseente, interne basale pubeseente, sepalis 13-14 mm longis, 5-6 mm latis, apice subapiculatis; petalis coceineis, oblongis, 14-16 mm longis; staminibns inclusis, ca 5 et 8 mm longis; antheris 2 mm longis; stylo super oram hypanthii 10-11 mm longo; stigmate 2 mm longo; bacca oblongo-ellipsoidea, 13-15 mm longa, subglabra.

description: Shrub 1.5 m tall, the ultimate branchlets greenish and with a short, white, spreading pubescence; leaves opposite, elliptic, acute to subacuminate at both ends, the blades 7.5-13.5 cm long, 2.5-7 cm wide, rather thin, with ea 6-9 pairs of principal veins from the midrib, short-pubescent on both surfaces, remotely and inconspicuously denticulate; petioles 2.5-5 cm long; infloreseence terminal, compact, with somewhat reduced leaves near its base; bracts subtending the flowers green, pubescent, lance-linea to lanceolate, 5-15 mm long; pedicels very slender, 7-12 mm long; hypanthium red-orange, about 4 cm long, 2-2.5 mm in diameter at very base, then narrowed and then gradually expanded to ca 9 mm at the summit in pressed specimens, scattered-pubescent on the outside with somewhat reddish hairs, white-pubescent within the basal half; sepals red-orange, ascending-divaricate, lance-oblong, externally pubeseent, internally glabrous, 13-14 mmlong, 5-6 mm wide, narrowed slightly to a somewhat rounded slightly apiculate tip; petals red with somewhat paler base, slightly longer than sepals, rounded at apex, oblong, ca twice as long as wide; stamens included, ca 5 and 8 mm long; anthers 2 mm long; style 10-11 mm long above the summit of the hypanthium; stigma 2 mm long; berry oblong-ellipsoid, dark, when somewhat immature 13-15 mm long and 6-7 mm wide in pressed specimens, almost glabrous.

description: Trees (rarely shrubs), (1)3-15(25) m tall, (1)5-25(30) cm diam. Young twigs, petiole, and lower side of lamina and primary vein densely to totally covered with yellowish brown, appressed to erect hairs to 1.2 mm long, the shorter ones curly. Petioles 3-10 mm long, 2-4.5 mm diam. Lamina of larger leaves (elliptic-)oblong-obovate, narrowly obovate to obovate, 10-35 x 3-12 cm, length/width ratio 2.5-4, chartaceous to slightly coriaceous, acumen 5-30(-40) mm long, 10-22 secondary veins on either side of primary vein, angles with primary vein 60-85º, smallest distance between loops and margin 2-5 mm, number of percurrent tertiary veins (0-)6-9(-13). Inflorescences 1-5(-10)-flowered. Indument: peduncles, pedicels, bracts, and outer side of sepals sparsely to totally covered with yellowish brown, appressed to erect, sometimes curly hairs to 1 mm long, inner side of sepals glabrous, outer side of petals totally covered with white to (yellowish) brown, appressed hairs to 1.4 mm long, inner side of petals, except for extreme base, totally covered with whitish silvery to (yellowish) brown, appressed hairs to 1.4 mm long. Peduncles 1-3 mm long, 3-4 mm diam., fruiting peduncles 2-4 mm long, 3-5.5 mm diam. Pedicels 15-20 mm long, 2.5-3.5 mm diam., fruiting pedicels 12-20 mm long, 5-8 mm diam. Upper bract depressed- ovate, 3-5 mm long. Flower buds ovoid to broadly ovoid, to 20 mm diam. Flowers creamy to yellowish brown, tinged reddish-purplish on inner side (in vivo). Sepals (triangular-)ovate to broadly (triangular-)ovate, 10-22 x 10-22 mm, apex acute. Petals free, outer petals oblong-obovate, rhombic-obovate to obtrullate, 30-50(-60) x 15-25 mm, apex acute, inner petals oblong-obovate, obtrullate to broadly obtrullate, 35-60 x 15-30 mm, apex acute. Torus convex with concave center. Staminodes 30-60, yellowish brown, orange to salmon (in vivo), narrowly triangular-obovate to obtrullate, 3-8 x 0.8-3 mm, apex acute to nearly rounded. Stamens ca. 300, yellowish, orange to salmon (in vivo), 2.5-4 mm long, prolonged connective 0.4-0.7 x 0.8-1.6 mm. Carpels 30-100, ovary 2.5 mm long, style 3 mm long, stigma densely covered with whitish hairs to 1.1 mm long. Fruit yellowish green to dark purplish outside, yellowish, orange to pink inside (in vivo), 3-8 cm diam., fertile carpels 40-100, areoles smooth, rarely slightly tuberculate, tubercles to 2 mm high, glabrous or sparsely to densely covered with yellowish hairs to 0.2 mm long on tubercles. Seeds obovoid to obtrulloid, 12-20 mm long, 7-11 mm diam., reddish brown to dark brown, aril 2-5 mm high.

description: Trees, 5-15 m tall, 2-15 cm diam. Young twigs, petioles, and lower side of lamina and primary vein sparsely to densely covered with yellowish, appressed to erect hairs to 0.8 mm long, the shorter ones curly. Petioles 3-8 mm long, 2-4.5 mm diam. Lamina of larger leaves oblong-obovate, narrowly obovate to obovate, 10-40 X 3- 14 cm, length/width ratio 2.5-4, chartaceous, acumen 5-50 mm long, 10-20 sec- ondary veins on either side of primary vein, angles with primary vein 50-75º, smallest distance between loops and margin 1-3 mm, number of percurrent tertiary veins (12-)14-16(-19). Inflorescences 1-3-flow- ered. Indument: peduncles, pedicels, bracts, and outer side of sepals sparsely to densely covered with whitish to yellowish, ap- pressed to erect, sometimes curly hairs to 0.7 mm long, inner side of sepals glabrous, outer side of petals totally covered with whitish-silvery to yellowish, appressed hairs to 1.2 mm long, inner side of petals totally covered with whitish to yellowish, appressed hairs to 0.5 mm long, basal 1/4-1/3 glabrous. Peduncles 1-5 mm long, 3-4 mm diam., fruiting peduncles 2-5 mm long, 3- 6 mm diam. Pedicels 14-22 mm long, 2-3 mm diam., fruiting pedicels 18-22 mm long, 5-7 mm diam. Upper bract depressed ovate, 3-4 mm long. Flower buds com- pressed ovoid, to 18 mm diam. Flowers creamy to yellowish white (in vivo). Sepals ovate to broadly triangular-ovate, 10-13 X 13-16 mm, apex acute to right-angled. Pet- als connate for basal 1/3, outer petals rhom- bic-obovate to obtrullate, 24-35 X 8-13 mm, apex acute to obtuse, inner petals ob- trullate to broadly obtrullate, 20-40 X 15- 20 mm, apex acute to obtuse. Torus flat to slightly convex, with concave center. Stam- inodes ca. 40, pale yellow (in vivo), ob- long-obovate, narrowly triangular-obovate to obtrullate, 3.5-5 x 1.5-2 mm, apex acute to nearly rounded. Stamens 200-300, pale yellow (in vivo), 2.5-3.5 mm long, pro- longed connective 0.4-0.6 X 0.8-1.4 mm. Carpels 30-100, immersed into concave part of floral receptacle, ovary 2-2.5 mm long, style 2-2.5 mm long, stigma densely to totally covered with hairs to 0.4 mm long. Fruit green to whitish (in vivo), 5-8 cm diam., fertile carpels 30-60, areoles hexagonal, strongly tuberculate to nearly smooth, tubercles 2-5 mm high, glabrous or sparsely to densely covered with whitish to yellowish hairs to 0.2 mm long on tubercles. Seeds (narrowly) obovoid, 14-22 mm long, 7-8 mm diam., reddish brown, aril 2-3.5 mm high.

description: Tree or shrub 2-12 m; young shoots densely and minutely pubescent, early glabrescent. Leaves alternate, trifoliolate; petiole flattened or canaliculate adaxi- ally, 3.3-20.5 cm long, glabrous; petiolules 0-1 (2) cm long, sometimes remaining minutely pubescent at maturity; leaflets entire, glabrous, chartaceous, terminal ones mostly narrow obovate but ranging from oblanceolate to narrow ovate, apically acuminate with an acute (or rarely blunt) tip, basally short-decurrent or -cuneate, 12.2-34 cm long, 4.3-16 cm wide, with 8-15 secondary veins per side, lateral ones mostly narrow ovate, sometimes elliptic to narrow obovate, apically acuminate, basally usually oblique but sometimes equal and cuneate, 10.5-28.2 cm long, 3.4-11 cm wide, with 5-11 secondary veins per side; venation raised on both surfaces. Inflorescence a narrow, apparently terminal panicle, densely and minutely pubescent throughout; peduncle 3.7-16 cm long, ridged; flowering rachis 8.2-49 cm long with sessile or subsessile cyrnose lateral branches subtended by lanceolate bracts, these 2.2-3.2 mm long, 0.7-0.8 mm wide, bracts at base of pedicels smaller but otherwise similar; pedicels 2-3 (5) mm in flower, 1.5-7 mm in fruit. Calyx cupulate, 2.3-2.6 mm long with 5 triangular lobes 0.5-0.7 mm long, densely and minutely pubescent without and apically short sericeous within, in fruit persistent, with lobes 1.8-2.5 mm long, 1.4-2.5 mm wide at base. Corolla 5-lobed, densely and minutely pubescent without, white; tube 14.5-19 mm long, 1.3-2 mm wide, with a retrorse shaggy pubescence within except for basal 2.5 mm; lobes imbricate in bud (1 with 2 outer margins, 1 with 2 inner margins, and 3 with 1 outer and 1 inner margin), oblanceolate, round at apex, densely and minutely pubescent within, 8.3-8.5 mm long, 2-2.7 mm wide, innermost slightly narrower than others. Fertile stamens 2, flanking the innermost corolla lobe inserted near apex of tube, filaments 2.5 mm long, anthers oblong, 3-4 mm long, with basal appendage 0.5 mm long; staminodes 5, inserted near apex of tube or on base of lobes, 4.5-6.6 mm long, puberulent, each with a spherical, apical gland. Disc cupulate, sinuate in conformity with the carpels, shallowly 5-dentate, 0.7 mm high, +/- equalling the ovary, glabrous. Ovary of 5 free carpels 0.7 mm high, glabrous in bud and in flower, densely pubescent soon after anthesis, each with 2 superposed ovules; style 1, 18-22 mm long, glabrous; stigma capitate. Fruiting mericarps usually 5 (occasionally some aborting), free, 8.2-11 mm high, 6-8 mm wide measured laterally, each with a terminal dorsal beak 1.8-3.5 mm long, frequently tuberculate and/or transversely ridged, densely and minutely pubescent, glandular-punctate, "green" when fresh, greenish-brown to brown when dry. Seeds 1 per mericarp, broadly elliptic in lateral view, ovate in dorsal view, 5.4- 7.5 mm high, 3.7-4.9 mm wide measured laterally, glabrous, brown.

description: Plants large, reproducing vegetatively by buds from axils of leaves in the parent rosette or by buds from the rhizome; roots fleshy, rhizome globose; remnants of leaf base membranous, not separating into fibers. Leaves succulent, brittle, spreading, channelled and undulate, or flat, ovate-lanceolate and long-attenuate toward the tip, with acute apex and medium point, (14.0)25.0-39.0 cm long, 2.2-4.8 cm broad, light green, spotted, glaucous except over spots, the spots darker green or brown, large, round to oval, usually confluent, the larger spots ca 1.0 X 0.5 cm; margins with a narrow cartilaginous band, minutely denticulate, the teeth of several sizes, irregularly spaced, often retrorse. Inflorescence 2.42-2.59 m tall, rachis thick, glaucous, densely flowered, the flowering portion 28.0-39.5 cm long, bearing 27-46(81) flowers; bracts of scape fleshy, many, abruptly smaller than the leaves, deltoid-acuminate; floral bracts pale, deltoid, shorter than the ovary; bracteoles pale, deltoid. Flowers sessile; buds abruptly expanded above ovary into an ellipsoid to oblong lobe portion, the apex obtuse, without knobs; mature flowers nearly erect, glaucous-green on the outside, golden-green inside, streaked with brown below stamen insertion if the filaments are brown; ovary ellipsoid, (1.0) 1.2-2.0 cm long; tube broadly funnelform- campanulate, constricted at the top of the ovary, ridged where stamens are adnate, inserted at a slight angle to the ovary, longer or shorter than the ovary, (0.7)0.9-1.5 (2.2) cm long; lobes revolute, oblong, usually longer than the tube, (0.7)1.0-2.1 cm long, the apex slightly swollen, acute, the outer lobes more strongly revolute than the inner, inner lobes keeled on the back; apical tuft small, slightly decurrent; filaments bent near middle in bud, inserted at 0.2-0.3 cm into the top of the tube, exserted by 4.0-6.6(9.7) cm, straight, pale yellow-green; anthers attached about equally between the ends, reddish-brown, 0.9-1.3 cm long; style straight, at first short, at maturity elongate, exserted by 4.4-6.6(9.5) cm; stigma clavate-capitate, trigonous, papillate over the top, the stigmatic furrows broad, short, not extending down the sides of the stigma; nectar viscid. Capsule oblong, 2.3-3.1 cm long, 1.6-1.9 cm in diameter with beak ca 0.2 cm long, sometimes short-stipitate; seeds 0.5-0.6 and 0.5 cm on their radial margins.

description: Plants large; reproducing vegetatively by stoloniferous rhizomes from the base of the parent rhizome; roots wiry; rhizome globose, to 5 cm in diameter; remnant leaf bases coarse-fibrous, to 6 cm long. Leaves to 14 in a rosette, herbaceous, brittle, erect-spreading, broadly channeled, sometimes undulate, linear-lanceolate to lanceo- laete, 2 1.0-39.0 cm long, 1.5-3.5(4.3) cm broad, with obtuse apex and very short point, smooth, bright green, rarely with magenta spots beneath the basal fifth; margins entire, slightly revolute. Inflorescence to 1.24 m tall, the flowering portion open, bearing 15-21 flowers, lower internodes ca 3 cm long; bracts of scape many, becoming successively gradually smaller than the leaves; floral bracts large, narrowly triangular, second floral bract 1.7-4.0 cm long; bracteoles narrow. Flowers all sessile, or those at the first few nodes pedicellate, greenish gray outside, sometimes flushed with brown or darker green above, golden-green within, mature flowers spreading outward from the stalk; ovary oblong, protruding into tube, 1.2-1.5 cm long, 0.4-0.5 cm in diameter; tube narrowly funnelform, slightly curved, 1.5-2.0 cm long; lobes oblong, equalling the ovary, the upper lobes erect-spreading, lower lobes reflexed, 1.2-1.5 cm long, 0.6-0.7 cm broad, the inner tepals keeled, the apex swollen at the point; apical hair tuft decurrent on interior of lobe; filaments flattened, stout, abruptly tapered near the anther, bent near tip in bud, inserted ca 1/4 of the tube length into tube, exceeding tube by 2.2-2.4 cm, slightly spreading, anther attached near midpoint, 1.3-1.4 cm long; style at first bent slightly toward lower tepals, at maturity straight and equal to or longer than the stamens, exserted by 2.2-2.5(3.2) cm; stigma small, hardly of larger diameter than the style, trigonous; odor strong, similar to citronella. Capsule ellipsoid, 2.0-2.6 cm long, 1.0 cm in diameter, beaked; seeds 0.3-0.4 and 0.3-0.45 cm on the radial margins.

description: Plants very large, reproducing vegetatively by lateral shoots from the storage rhizome; rhizome 7 cm in diameter. Leaves somewhat coriaceous, arching, shallowly channeled, linear-lanceolate with acute apex and long, pungent point, (35)48.7-76.6 (92) cm long, 4-10.5 cm broad, green, slightly glaucous beneath; margin cartilaginous, hyaline, sometimes streaked with dark green or purple, irregularly denticulate to denticulate-erose, the teeth small and simple to large and bifid or trifid. Inflorescence 2-3.5(3.8) m tall, the flowering portion elongate, dense, rachis 0.7-0.8 cm in diameter, (22.5)41.5 cm or more long, bearing 23-40 or more flowers; lower nodes rarely (i.e., in cultivation) with 2-3 flowers; lower bracts of scape leaflike, bracts becoming successively gradually smaller upward along scape; floral bracts ovate, long-acuminate, 1.7-2.6 cm long, 0.4-0.8 cm broad at base, rarely interspersed with linear sterile bracts; bracteoles deltoid, to 1.2 cm long. Flowers sessile; buds narrow in ovary and tube portion, oblong in lobe portion, the apex acute, without knobs; mature flowers erect-spreading, fleshy; ovary ellipsoid to ovoid, without neck, not protruding into tube, 1.2-2.2 cm long, 0.4-0.8 cm in diameter; tube funnelform, nearly straight, not constricted above the ovary, longer or shorter than the ovary, 1.4-2.0 cm long; lobes spreading, oblong, 2.0-2.7 cm long in field specimens, 3.5-4.6 cm long in cultivated specimens, cucullate, outer lobes yellowish-green on both surfaces, or dark red within, inner lobes keeled, yellowish-green, or dark red within and on outer margins; filaments bent nearly double in bud, inserted in the top 1/3 of the perianth tube, exceeding tube by (6.3) 7.6-8.9 cm in field specimens and 9.0-10.5 cm in cultivated specimens, spreading, reddish; anthers attached at a point ca 1/3 from the upper end, 2.2-2.9 cm long, at least sometimes reddish; style longer or shorter than the stamens, exserted from the tube by 7.2-10.8 cm, reddish-brown; stigma clavate, trigonous, deeply furrowed. Capsule ovoid to oblong, rounded below, ca 3 cm long, 1.2-2.0 cm in diameter.

description: Subshrub; stems erect, 1.5-2 m tall, single stems usually unbranched, glabrous; internodes 10-15 cm long, 5-10 mm diam., terete, sea-green; leaves of a pair equal; petiole 8-15 cm long, glabrous, the lamina elliptic, 21-26 X 12-14 cm, the base oblique, unequal-sided, insertion on main vein up to 3 cm from each other, acute at apex, the margin slightly serrulate, chartaceous, glabrous on both sides, primary veins 17-19 pairs, verdigris-green above, sea-green beneath; inflorescence pseudoterminal, subumbellate, a cyme of 15-20 flowers; peduncles 2 per node, 16-20 cm long, glabrous, green; pedicels 1-2 cm long, glabrous; calyx lobes subequal, thick, roundish, the base connate for 2 mm, the margin subentire to slightly crenate, glabrous on both sides, rosy to crimson, basally pink, with purple warts at the rim, the dorsal lobe 15 X 14 mm, bent downward and folded like a cup surrounding the spur, the lateral lobes 15 X 12 mm, the ventral lobes 13 X 12 mm, all lobes widest in the center; corolla horizontal in the calyx, tubular, ventrally slightly inflated, carmine to pinkish, paler toward the base, dark-spotted ventrally, glabrous externally, glandular internally close to entrance, total length 32 mm, the spur obtuse, glabrous, 8-10 mm long, the opening 5 X 7 mm, the limb 8 X 10 mm, with a conspicuous keel dorsally on entire length of tube, 2 mm high near limb, 1 mm near spur, pointed toward limb, the lobes subequal, entire, triangular, reflexed, the ventral and lateral 4 X 4 mm, the dorsal 5 X 3 mm; fertile stamens 4, included, inserted about 6-8 mm above base of the corolla, the free part 7-8 mm, glabrous; staminode 3 mm; anthers connate, 3.5 X 2.5 mm; ovary ovoid, laterally compressed, glabrous, 5 mm long, 5 mm high, 3 mm wide; style included, 7 mm long, glabrous; stigma bilobed, the lobes 1 mm wide, 2.5 mm long; nectary annular, laterally and ventrally reduced, glabrous, dorsally 2 mm high, 4.5 mm wide, 2.5 mm long; fruit and seeds not seen.

description: Herb; stems erect, 1-1.5 m tall, usually unbranched, glabrous; internodes 4-7 cm long, 5-8 mm diam., terete, dark olive-green; leaves of a pair equal; petiole 3-4.5 cm long, glabrous, the lamina elliptic, 17- 20 X 5-9 cm, cuneate at base, acute at apex, serrulate, chartaceous, glabrous above and beneath, green; primary veins 7-8 pairs; inflorescence axillary, subumbellate, a cyme with 11-15 flowers, only 1 or 2 open at a time; peduncles usually 2 per node, 10-12 cm, glabrous, blood-red; ped- icels 5-8 mm, glabrous; calyx lobes sube- qual, thick, round, obtuse, the base connate for 1.5-2 mm, the margin subentire, gla- brous on both sides, blood-red, the dorsal lobe 15 X 15 mm, the lateral lobes 12 X 12 mm, the ventral 12 X 13 mm, all lobes widest in center; corolla horizontal in the calyx, tubular, fleshy, slightly inflated to- ward the apex, wine- to blood-red, pale yel- low toward the base, glabrous internally and externally, total length 21-23 mm, the dorsal spur straight, obtuse, 4-5 mm long, the tube basally 6 mm diam., at widest part 10 mm diam., dorsally keeled for 15 mm, the keel 0.5-0.8 mm high, throat opening round, 4 mm diam., the limb terminal, very dark wine-red appearing black, 8 mm diam., the lobes subequal, roundish, entire, 3 mm wide, 2 mm high; fertile stamens 4, included, flat, inserted ca. 5 mm above base of the corolla, the free part 6 mm, glabrous; staminode 3 mm; anthers connate, 2 X 1 mm; ovary ovoid, laterally compressed, glabrous, greenish, 5 mm long, 4-5 mm high, 3 mm wide; style included, glabrous, 8 mm long; stigma bilobed, the lobes 1 X 1 mm; nectary dorsal, semi-annular, tomen- tose, laterally and ventrally reduced, 1.5 mm high, 3.5 mm wide, 2.5 mm long; fruit a bivalved, fleshy capsule; seeds dark brown tuberculate, ca. 0.5 X 0.2 mm.

description: Herb; stems erect, 20-50 cm tall, mostly unbranched; internodes densely hirsute, green, terete; leaves of a pair subequal; petiole 20-45 mm, hispid, the lamina elliptic, 5-10 cm long, 2-4 cm wide in the center, cuneate at base, acute at apex, serrate, hispid above and beneath, verdigris-green above, grey-green beneath; primary veins 9-12 pairs; inflorescence an axillary cyme reduced to a few, mostly 2 flowers; peduncle 4-8 cm, usually 1 per node, hispid, grass-green, the pedicels 4-6 mm, slightly hispid; calyx lobes membranaceous, subequal, ovate, acute, the base connate for 2 mm, the margin crenate, hispid externally, especially at the base, glabrous internally, yellowish green, the dorsal lobe 11 X 7 mm, the lateral lobes 12 X 7 mm, the ventral lobes 11 X 6 mm, all lobes widest just above the base; corolla horizontal in calyx, funnelform, bright orange, pale yellow at base, with spur 25-32 mm long, sparsely hispid externally, glabrous at base and internally, the spur obtuse, 3 mm long, the tube 11-13 mm long and 5 mm diam. at base, then widened and 10-12 mm diam. near the limb, the limb 2-2.5 cm diam.; corolla lobes subequal, entire, rounded, the ventral lobe and the lateral lobes 12 X 12 mm, the dorsal lobes 9 X 12 mm; fertile stamens 4, included, inserted ca. 2 mm above the base of the corolla, the free part 6-8 mm, slightly papillose, flat; staminode 3 mm, glabrous, inserted at the base of the spur; anthers connate, 1.5 X 2 mm; ovary ovoid, laterally compressed, tomentose, 4 mm long, 3 mm high, 2 mm wide; style included, 6-8 mm, tomentose; stigma bilobed; nectary semi-annular, laterally reduced, dorsally 0.7 mm high, 2 mm wide, slightly tomentose; fruits and seeds not seen.

description:
A Gasterantho corallino (Fritsch) Wiehler inflorescentiis 1-5-floris, corollis urceolatis sed (calcare incluso) 3-3.5 cm longis, calcaribus recurvatis corollaque extra dense glanduloso-puberula differt

Terrestrial herbs; stems 1-2 m tall, quadrangular, apparently rarely branched, puberulent, diam. to 8 mm, the internodes 1.5- 4.5 cm long. Leaves opposite, isomorphic, petiolate; blades ovate, elliptic to obovate, 10-28 x 4.9-12.4 cm, the base oblique, cuneate-acute, the apex acute-acuminate, the margin serrate, the upper surface flat, dark green, glabrous but puberulent when young, the lower surface lighter green, glabrous or weakly puberulent, with puberulent to to- mentose veins, the secondary veins 8-10 per side; petioles 1-4 cm long. Inflorescences in upper leaf axils, of cymes of 1-5 flowers, puberulent-tomentose; peduncles 6-16 cm long; ebracteate; pedicels 2-5 cm long. Calyx green, lobes unequal, basally connate for 3-5 mm, glabrous to sparsely puberulent externally, glandular-puberulent to glandular-tomentose internally, with ca. 8 parallel veins which reticulate near the denticulate-subentire and glandular-puberulent margin, the ventral lobes lanceolate to ovate, ca. 10 mm long, 8 mm wide at base, the lateral lobes ovate, ca. 12 mm long and 12 mm wide at base, the dorsal lobe ovate, ca. 15 mm long, ca. 12 mm wide at base, dorsally keeled along primary vein; corolla urceolate, 2-2.5 cm long (including spur), tube 3-3.5 cm long, pink-red and densely glandular-puberulent externally, glabrous internally, diam. 1-1.5 cm and gradually expanding, the pouch ventral, the throat apical and dorsal, diam. 3-4 mm, the lobes subequal, rotund, 1-2 mm long and 2-3 mm wide at base, the spur ca. 1 cm long, bent upward, apex blunt; stamens included, the filaments ca. 10 mm long, glabrous, the anthers ca. 2.5 x 1.5 mm; nectary irregular but to 2-3 mm high dorsally at both sides of the ovary; ovary glabrous-puberulent, the style 10-12 mm long, the stigma weakly bilobed stomatomorphic. Berry flattened, ca. 8 mm long, ca. 10 mm wide and ca. 4 mm thick, dehiscence not observed; seeds subellipsoid, ca. 0.2 mm long, somewhat striate, with surface crystals.

description: Planta minuta, prostrata, dense conferta, ramis gracilibus, glabris, prostratis, radicantibus, intertextis, vix 0.5 mm. diametro, ad 5 cm. longis, ramulis minute puberulis, consperse ciliatis; foliis parvis, crasse coriaceis, evenosis, supra viridibus, subtus atropurpureis, ellipticis vel elliptico-ovatis, 4-5 mm. longis, eirciter 2.5 mm. latis, acutis vel obscurissime acuminatis, breviter (ad 1 mm.) petiolatis, basi acutis, margine minute crenulatis, dentibus in setis plus minusve caducis gracilibus ad 0.8 mm. longis productis; floribus axillaribus, solitariis, breviter (ad 1 mm.) pedicellatis, bracteolis binis coriaceis, late ovatis vel orbiculari-ovatis, glabris, obtusis, ad 1.3 mm. longis; sepalis 5, oblongo-ovatis, obtusis, fere 2 mm. longis; corolla rosea (una valde immatura visa), lobis ovatis, eirciter 1 mm. longis, tubo paullo longioribus; staminibus eirciter 1 mm. longis, filamentis glabris, deorsum incrassatis, antheris minute bicorniculatis; ovario globoso, glabro, 5-loculari; stylis 1 mm. longis; fructibus ignotis, ex collectore caeruleis.

description: Terrestrial shrub 0.2-1 m tall; mature stems subterete, bluntly ridged, glabrous; bark thin, cracking longitudinally, grayish- to reddish-brown; twigs subterete, striate, ridged, glabrous to puberulent, or densely spreading- to ascending-hirsute with hairs to 3 mm long, sometimes also bearing scattered gland-tipped setae to 0.5 mm long, reddish-brown. Leaves thick-coriaceous, narrowly ovate, or elliptic to oblong, (2) 3.5-5 (6.5) x (1) 1.4-2.5 (3.4) cm, basally rounded, rarely truncate, apically short-acuminate and sometimes bluntly mucronate, marginally conspic- uously bluntly serrate, each tooth terminated by a tiny (0.2-1 mm long) or elongate (to 2 mm long), often deciduous, gland-tipped seta, nitid, essentially glabrous or somewhat punctate beneath from persistent bases oftiny (0.2-0.8 mm long), gland tipped setae scattered only along the midrib and veins, or also hirsute with hairs to 2 mm long, the lamina usually +/- bullate and concave to revolute, discolorous (i.e., leaves drying darker above than beneath); midrib, lateral nerves (3 or 4 per side), and reticulate veinlets of a lighter color than lamina when dry, plane or more commonly slightly raised above, rarely impressed, conspicuously raised beneath; petiole subterete, shallowly canaliculate above, 2-3 mm long, glabrous or with few gland-tipped setae, reddish-brown. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, congested and barely exceeding the leaves at anthesis, ca (11) 15-20-flowered; rachis subterete, complanate, angled, 3-5 cm long, surrounded at the base by a series of ovate, keeled, striate, mucronulate, glabrous but ciliolate bracts to 4.3 mm long, densely white-puberulent to short-pilose and sometimes also with few to many, scattered, gland-tipped setae to 0.4 mm long; pedicels terete, striate, 4- 8 mm long to 10 mm after anthesis, pubescent as rachis; bracteoles located at base or along lower 1/3 of pedicel, striate, lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 3-4.5 x 0.7-1 mm, +/- glabrous but marginally ciliolate and glandular-fimbriate; floral bract coriaceous, conspicuously striate, +/- cochleariform, often caducous, ovate to oblanceolate, acute, 5-7 (9) x 2.5-4.5 mm, +/- glabrous but marginally ciliolate and short-glandular-fimbriate. Calyx (4) 4.5-5 mm long, the lobes broadly ovate, acuminate, (2.7) 3.5-4 x 2.2-2.5 mm, glabrous or puberulent at tips within, marginally only ciliolate, or glandular-fimbriate proximally and ciliolate distally; corolla urceolate, terete or bluntly 5-angled, 5-7 x ca 4 mm, glabrous or rarely short-pilose at base, red, the lobes ovate, obtuse, 1-1.5 (2) mm long; stamens 4.7- 5 mm long; filaments 3-4 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.1-1.7 mm long, the awns short to very short; ovary densely short-pilose; style ca 3-4 mm long, glabrous or puberulent. Fruiting calyx terete, ca 1 cm diam, blue-black.

description: Terrestrial shrub 1-1.5 m tall; stems subterete, somewhat ribbed, glabrous; bark thin, exfoliating in strips; twigs subterete, angled, striate, deciduously puberulent and strigose; buds complanate or angled, the bracts ovate, striate, ciliate. Leaves coriaceous, flat or slightly concave, elliptic, (1) 1.3-2 x (0.6) 0.7-1.2 cm, basally rounded or broadly obtuse, apically acute, apex itself a sessile, blunt, terminal gland, marginally conspicuously and regularly crenate, each tooth blunt and tipped by a tiny, deciduous, glandular seta, nitid and essentially glabrous above or minutely and deciduously puberulent along midrib, essentially glabrous beneath but the lamina and midrib reddish-black punctate, these punctae sometimes producing basally swollen, short-glandular-setose hairs ca 0.2-0.3 mm long or eglandular setae to 1 mm long, pinnately nerved, midrib impressed above and conspicuously raised beneath, lateral nerves 4 or 5 per side, these impressed, flat or raised above and raised beneath, reticulate veinlets impressed to slightly raised above and conspicuously raised beneath; petiole subterete, rugose, striate, shallowly but broadly canaliculate above, 1.5-2 mm long, punctate. Inflorescence axillary, flow- ers nodding, solitary in axils of normal upper leaves or slightly reduced leaves near branch tips; pedicel terete, striate, 5-8 mm long but lengthening to 1 cm after anthesis, short-pilose with white hairs and also moderately to densely strigose with short, crisped, ferrugineous, basally slightly swollen, eglandular hairs to 0.5- 0.75 mm long; bracteoles numerous (ca 4-9), basal or scattered along proximal half of pedicel, mostly deciduous, ovate to ovate-elliptic, carinate, striate, acute, to ca 3.5 mm long, densely ciliolate; floral bract similar to bracteoles. Calyx ca 5 mm long, sparsely and deciduously short-setose as pedicels, the lobes ovate, acuminate, ca 4 mm long, ciliolate, glabrous or only sparsely short-pilose at tips without, densely short-pilose within; corolla urceolate to cylindric-urceolate, apparently 5-angled, 5-8 x 4-5 mm, sparsely short-white-pilose proximally, weakly strigose along angles in proximal half, pilose within, "white with pinkish lobes" (fide Steyermark 62595), the lobes ovate, obtuse, ca 1 mm long; stamens 10, ca 5 mm long; filaments ca 3.5 mm long, densely pilose; anthers ca 2 mm long, conspicuously short-awned distally; ovary densely short-pilose, canescent; style ca 4 mm long, sparsely short-pilose basally. Fruiting calyx apparently globose, ca 6 mm diam.

description: Erect, or the lowest branches decumbent, as much as 50 cm tall, repeatedly but not profusely branched throughout, usually with 2-8 nodes between branches, the branching mostly not dichotomous; stems glabrous or pubeseent with spreading or appressed hairs; leaves glabrate or pubescent like the stem, 10-30 mm long, 1-4 mm broad, usually somewhat smaller above, sessile or narrowed to petioles as much as 5 mm long; flowers subsessile or on pedicels as much as 2 mm long, at anthesis usually not exceeding the shoot apex, the first flower 1-5 (-10) nodes from the base; calyx sparsely to densely pubeseent with short appressed or spreading hairs; petals 1.1-1.8 mm long; larger stamens 0.8-1.5 mm long; anthers ca 0.2 mm long, usually touching the stigma and shedding pollen directly on it; pollen 55-68 µ in diameter, more than 90 per cent of the grains filled; stigma subglobose, 0.4-0.7 mm broad; style ca 1 mm long, not expanded below the stigma; ovary pubescent with short appressed or spreading hairs; capsules ascending, rarely reflexed, 6-15 mm long, 0.6-0.8 (-1) mm broad, not conspicuously flattened, somewhat constricted between the seeds, the margins undulate, at maturity splitting into 4 subequal valves free from the septum; pedicels 0.3-3 (-6) mm long; seeds all developing, (8-) 10-25, vertical, not conspicuously staggered, the rows usually not overlapping, glabrous or densely puLbeseent, light brown, sometimes with darker blotches, or uniformly dark brown, 0.8-1.8 mm long, 0.3-0.7 mm broad.

description: Erect, as much as 60 cm tall, branched or unbranched near the base, dichotomously branched above or the lateral branches much shortened; branches usually separated by 1-2 nodes; stems glabrous or pubescent with short appressed or spreading hairs; leaves glabrous or pubescent like the stems, 10-60 mm long, 1-5 mm broad, usually smaller above, sessile or narrowed to petioles as much as 10 mm long; flowers subsessile to conspicuously pedicellate, the first flower 1-20 nodes from the base; calyx sparsely to densely pubescent with short appressed or spreading hairs; petals (1.2-) 1.5-7 mm long; larger stamens 1-6 mm long; anthers 0.2-0.8 mm long, free from the stigma or adhering to it and shedding pollen directly on it; pollen 70-98 µ in diameter, more than 90 per cent of the grains filled; stigma hemispherical to subglobose, 0.2-0.5 mm broad; style 0.7-7 mm long, shorter than, equal to, or longer than the stamens; ovary pubescent with short appressed or spreading hairs; capsules ascending to reflexed, 3-15 mm long, 1-1.5 mm broad; constricted between the seeds and appearing lumpy, or the margins smooth and at most undulate, at maturity splitting into 4 subequal valves free from the septum; pedicels obscure or as much as 10 (-15) nim long, slender, usually shorter than the capsules; seeds may or may not all develop, 3-18, vertical, staggered or in 2 even rows, or the seeds crowded and overlapping, glabrous or pubescent, uniformly brown or mottled, 1-1.6 mm long, 0.5-0.8 mm broad.

description: Erect, as much as 1 m tall, usually unbranched near the base, dichotomously or subdichotomously branched above, branching at each of several nodes below the first flower, less branched above; stems glabrous or pubescent with short appressed or spreading hairs; leaves glabrate or pubescent like the stems, 20-75 mm long, 1-6 mm broad, much reduced above, sessile or narrowed to petioles as much as 10 mm long; flowers conspicuously pedicellate, at anthesis not exceeding the shoot apex, the first flower usually 10-20 nodes from the base; calyx sparsely to densely pubescent with short appressed or spreading hairs; petals 4-8 mm long; larger stamens 3-7 mm long; anthers 0.4-0.7 mm long, not touching the stigma; pollen 80-90 iu in diameter, more than 90 per cent of the grains filled; stigma hemispherical, ca 0.4 mm broad; style 3.5-8 mm long, somewhat longer than the stamens, expanded at the tip to the breadth of the stigma; ovary pubescent with short appressed or spreading hairs; capsules ascending to reflexed, 4-16 mm long, ca 1 mm broad, constricted between the seeds and appearing lumpy or the margins merely undulate, at maturity splitting into 4 subequal valves free from the septum; pedicels slender, 3-12 mm long, shorter than the capsules; seeds may or may not all develop, 4-10 (-13), vertical, usually staggered, those in one cell alternating with those in the other, glabrous or pubescent, uniformly brown or gray mottled with brown, 1.2-2.3 mm long, 0.6-1 mm broad.

description: Erect, as much as 80 cm tall, usually unbranched near the base, dichotomously or subdichotomously branched above, branching at each of several nodes below the first flower, less branched above; stems glabrous or pubescent with short appressed or spreading hairs; leaves glabrate or pubescent like the stems, 15-60 mm long, 1-5 mm broad, much reduced above, sessile or narrowed to petioles as much as 10 mm long; flowers conspicuously pedicellate, at anthesis not exceeding the shoot apex, the first flower usually 10-20 nodes from the base; calyx sparsely to densely pubescent with short appressed or spreading hairs; petals (1.5-) 2-3 (-4) mm long; larger stamens 2-4 mim long; anthers 0.2-04 mm long, some usually touching the stigma and shedding pollen directly on it; pollen 68-77 y in diameter, 20-70 per cent of the grains filled; stigma hemispherical to subglobose, 0.5-0.6 mm broad; style 1-3.5 mm long, shorter than the larger stamens, often somewhat expanded below the stigma; ovary pubescent with appressed or spreading hairs; capsules ascending to reflexed, 6-15 mm long, ca 1 mm broad, constricted between the seeds, very irregular and lumpy, at maturity splitting into 4 subequal valves free from the septum; pedicels filiform, (2-) 3-12 mm long, usually shorter than the capsules; seeds not all developing, 10-80 per cent in each capsule abortive, the undeveloped ovules usually evident on the septum after dehiscence; good seeds 2-10, vertical, irregularly staggered, those in one cell more or less alternating with those in the other, glabrous or pubeseent, uniformly brown or gray mottled with brown, 1.4-2 mm long, 0.6-0.8 mm broad.

description: Erect, compact, as much as 30 cm tall, branched near the base or sometimes throughout the lower half, often with several branches from the cotyledonary node, the branching not dichotomous; secondary branches few or none; stems glabrous or sparsely and minutely glandular near the tips; leaves glabrous, 10-25 mm long, 1-3 mm broad, not greatly reduced above, sessile or narrowed to petioles as much as 10 mm long; flowers sessile or essentially so, at anthesis usually exceeding the shoot apex, the first flower 1-3 nodes from the base; calyx glabrous or minutely glandular; petals 0.8-1.5 mm long; larger stamens 0.6-0.8 mm long; anthers 0.2-0.3 mm long, touching the stigma and shedding pollen directly on it; pollen 50-55 ,u in diameter, more than 90 per cent of the grains filled; stigma subglobose, ca 0.3 mm broad; style 0.3-0.4 mm long, not expanded below the stigma; ovary glabrous or minutely glandular; capsules ascending, 8-17 mm long, 1-2 mm broad, resembling the leaves, much flattened, depressed along the midline, the margins straight or minutely undulate, at maturity splitting along 4 loculicidal sutures, the dorsal and ventral valves twice as broad as the lateral and remaining attached by the narrow septum; pedicels stout, obscure, less than 0.5 mm long; seeds all developing, 24-50, oblique, not stag- gered, the 2 rows not overlapping, glabrous, light brown, 0.7-1.1 mm long, 0.3-4 mnm broad.

description: Prostrate, decumbent, or erect, as much as 40 cm tall, usually branched at the base and throughout, the lowest branches often as long as the primary stem; branching mostly not dichotomous; stems glabrous or sparsely pubescent with short appressed hairs; leaves glabrate, 5-30 mm long, 1-3 mm broad, somewhat reduced above, sessile or narrowed to petioles as much as 5 mm long; flowers subsessile, the first flower 5-15 nodes from the base; calyx glabrous or sparsely pubescent with short appressed hairs; petals 1.2-2 mm long; larger stamens 0.5-1 mm long; anthers 0.2-0.3 mm long, adhering to the stigma and shedding pollen directly on it; pollen 65-68 ju in diameter, more than 90 per cent of the grains filled; stigma subglobose, 0.3-0.5 mm broad; style 0.4-0.7 mm long, shorter than the larger stamens; ovary glabrous to sparsely pubescent with appressed hairs; capsules ascending, 4-10 mm long, ca 1 mm broad, more or less constricted between the seeds, at maturity splitting into 4 subequal valves free from the septum; pedicels obscure to as much as 2.5 (-3) mm long; seeds usually all developing, 3-10, vertical, more or less staggered, glabrous or rarely pubescent, uniformly brown or mottled, 1.2-1.8 mm long, 0.4-0.7 mm broad.

description: Erect, as much as 70 cm tall, usually unbranched near the base, dichotomously or subdichotomously branched above, branching at each of several nodes below the first flower, less branched above; stems glabrous or nearly so except for a few hairs at the upper nodes; leaves glabrate, 15-60 mm long, 1-4 mm broad, much reduced above, sessile or narrowed to petioles as much as 10 mm long; flowers conspicuously pedicellate, at anthesis not exceeding the shoot apex, the first flower usually 10-20 nodes from the base; calyx pubescent with short appressed hairs; petals 1.5-2.5 mm long; larger stamens 1.2-1.5 mm long; anthers ca 0.2 mm long, usually touching the stigma and shedding pollen directly on it; pollen 68-76 µ in diameter, more than 90 per cent of the grains filled; stigma subglobose, ca 0.3 mm broad; style 1-1.5 mm long, not expanded below the stigma; ovary pubescent with appressed hairs; capsules ascending to strongly reflexed, 4-9 mm long, ca 1 mm broad, constricted between the seeds and appearing lumpy, at maturity splitting into 4 subequal valves free from the septum; pedicels filiform, 3-11 mm long, usually about the length of the capsules; seeds all developing, (1-) 3-5 (-6), vertical, staggered, those in one cell alternating with those in the other, glabrous, uniformly brown or mottled with brown, 1.3-1.7 mm long, 0.6-0.8 mm broad.

description: Erect, as much as 40 cm tall, branching mostly in the lower half, unbranched above, the branches strict; secondary branches few or none; stems glabrous or pubescent with short appressed or spreading hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long; leaves glabrous or pubescent like the stem, 10-25 mm long, 1-3 mm broad, not greatly reduced above, sessile or narrowed to petioles as much as 5 mm long; flowers subsessile or on pedicels as much as 1.7 mm long, at anthesis more or less equalling the shoot apex, the first flower usually 1-3 nodes from the base; calyx glabrous or pubescent like the stems; petals 1.3-1.8 mm long; larger stamens 0.8-1.5 mm long; anthers 0.2-0.3 mm long, touching the stigma and shedding pollen directly on it; pollen 60-65 µ in diameter, more than 90 per cent of the grains filled; stigma subglobose, 0.5-0.9 mm broad; style 0.7-1 mm long, not expanded below the stigma; ovary glabrous or pubescent like the stems; capsules ascending, 10-15 mm long, 0.8-1.4 mm broad, flattened, somewhat depressed along the midline, scarcely constricted between the seeds, the margins straight or slightly undulate, at maturity splitting into 4 valves free from the septum, the dorsal and ventral valves somewhat broader than the lateral; pedicels 0.4-2 mm long; seeds all developing, (10-) 14-34, vertical or oblique, not staggered, the 2 rows not overlapping, glabrous or pubescent, light to dark brown, 0.8-1 mm long, 0.3-0.5 mm broad.

description: Erect, as much as 50 cm tall, profusely branched throughout, usually at every other node, the branching dichotomous except near the base; stems glabrous or with a few short appressed hairs at the upper nodes; leaves glabrous, 10-40 mm long, 1-5 mm broad, much reduced above, sessile or narrowed to petioles as much as 10 mm long; flowers conspicuously pedicellate, more or less alternating with the branches, at anthesis not exceeding the shoot apex, the first flower usually 5-15 nodes from the base; calyx glabrous or pubescent with short appressed hairs; petals 0.7-1.2 (-1.5) mm long; larger stamens ca 0.5 mm long; anthers more or less equalling the filaments, touching the stigma and shedding pollen directly on it; pollen 48-58 ju in diameter, more than 90 per cent of the grains filled; stigma subglobose, ca 0.3 mm broad; style ca 0.3 mm long, not expanded below the stigma; ovary glabrous or pubescent with short appressed hairs; capsules ascending to strongly reflexed, 3-9 mm long, ca 1 mm broad, terete, scarcely constricted between the seeds, at maturity splitting into 4 subequal valves free from the septum; pedicels filiform (3-) 5-12 mm long, usually longer than the capsules; seeds all developing, (5-) 10-30, vertical, usually crowded in two overlapping rows in each locule, glabrous, uniformly brown or gray mottled with brown, 1-1.5 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm broad.

description: Stems 1-10, 3-10 dm high, erect, unbranched, glabrous. Leaves light yellowish-green, in 10-20 pairs, with the upper internodes (1-) 2.5-10 cm long, with eciliate but minutely denticulate margins. Larger leaves lanceolate to ovate, acuminate, 5.5-15 cm long, 1.5-5 cm wide, 3-7-nerved. Lower leaves smaller, but all above the litter usually with a distinct lamina. Flowers in terminal clusters of 1-20, the clusters often very large and hemispherical. Smaller flower clusters frequent in the upper 1 or 2 axils, sessile. Terminal inflorescences subtended by 2 or 3 pairs of involucral leaves; axillary inflorescences sometimes also subtended by a pair of involucral leaves in addition to the cauline leaves. Bracts often present in the inflorescences but not regularly subtending each flower. Calyx tube 7-15 mm long, glabrous. Intracalycular membrane with a minute sharp point in front of each calyx lobe; sinuses usually truncate, occasionally acute. Calyx lobes deltoid-ovate to ovate-lanceolate or occasionally lanceolate, 3.5-15 mm long, 2-7 mm wide, with bracket-like keels decurrent on the tube. Margins of the calyx lobes minutely denticulate but not ciliate. Corolla slightly open, 3-5.5 cm long. Corolla lobes 4-6 (-8) mm long, 4-7 (-10) mm wide, rounded, mucronate, with the outer margins somewhat involute. Free portions of the appendages each consisting of a small deflexed portion continuous with the involute inner margin of the adjacent corolla lobe, and an erect, truncate to obliquely triangular portion 0.5-4 mm high, 3-7 mm wide, erose to shallowly laciniate at the summit. Sinuses conspicuously unequal. Corolla white with the veins, including some of the smaller veinlets, outlined in green. Outer edges of the lobes sometimes tinged with red-violet. A series of gray-green to purple streaks on the interior surface extending from slightly below the level of stamen attachment about halfway to the bases of the lobes. Filaments becoming free slightly higher than one fourth the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 8-12 mm long. Anthers connate or occasionally separating. Seeds winged.

description: Stems 1-20, 1-12 dm high, erect or occasionally somewhat decumbent. Leaves medium green, with ciliate margins, in 10-20 pairs, with the upper internodes (.5-) 1-8 cm long. Involucral and upper leaves lanceolate to ovate, (1-) 3-5-nerved, 3-16 cm long, 1-5 cm wide. Leaves near the middle of the stem often proportionately narrower, lanceolate to lance-elliptic; lower leaves usually oblong, much smaller than those above; lowest leaves reduced to scales. Flowers in terminal clusters of 1-25, also frequently sessile in the upper 1-6 axils or on branches 1-4 internodes in length. Terminal inflorescences usually subtended by 2 pairs of involucral leaves. Each flower subtended by a pair of bracts, these usually linear to oblanceolate, some often foliaceous in large clusters. Calyx tube 7.5-14 mm long, glabrous. Calyx lobes usually lanceolate, occasionally ovate to broadly elliptic or oblanceolate to obovate, 2-15 mm long, 0.75-6.5 mm wide, with ciliate margins. Corolla completely closed, tapering, 3-4.5 cm long. Free portions of the appendages suberect, symmetrical, 0.75-4 mm high, 2.5-7 mm wide, about as wide at the summit as at the base, shallowly bifid, the segments truncate with jagged margins. Corolla tube whitish up to a level slightly above that of stamen attachment, above this level the petals (exclusive of appendages) usually increasingly suffused with blue (changing to blue-violet in age). Deep blue stripes on the interior surface present between the lateral and central petal traces, extending from 1/4 to 4/5 the distance from the receptacle to the summits of the appendages. Fused portions of the appendages usually pale blue, except in the center remainder of the appendages white or nearly so, conspicuous at anthesis. Corollas sometimes rose-purple or white. Filaments becoming free a little higher than one third the distance from the receptacle to the summits of the appendages, 8-12 mm long. Anthers connate. Seeds winged.

description: Stems 1-15, 0.7-5 dm high, erect, puberulent. Leaves medium green, somewhat glossy, with ciliate margins, in 5-15 pairs, with the upper internodes 1-12 cm long.Upper leaves ovate or ovate-elliptic to lanceolate, 3-11 cm long, 1-3 (-4) cm wide; lower leaves smaller, the lowest mere scales. Flowers in terminal clusters of 1-15, also often sessile in the upper axils or terminating short, peduncle-like branches. Terminal inflorescences usually subtended by 2 pairs of involucral leaves, those on branches by 1 or 2 pairs. Each flower subtended by a pair of bracts, these highly variable in size and shape. Calyx tube 7-13 mm long, puberulent. Calyx lobes deltoid-ovate to elliptic, lanceolate or occasionally obovate, 1.5-12 mm long, 1-6 mm wide, acuminate, with ciliate margins. Corolla completely closed, 3-5 cm long, tapering to a rather acute summit. Corolla lobes deltoid, 1.5-3 mm long, about as wide as long, mucronate. Free portions of the appendages about as long as the lobes, 3.5-6 mm wide, each divided into two approximately equal deltoid to oblong segments with minutely jagged edges. Appendages conspicuous at the summit of the intact corolla. Corolla tube whitish up to the level of stamen attachment; the petals (exclusive of appendages) above this level increasingly suffused with blue-violet. Appendages less deeply colored, with one segment of each free portion, along with the inner edge of the lobe to which it is adjacent, nearly white, except sometimes at the tip. Deeply colored stripes on the inner surface nearly filling the areas between the lateral and central petal traces from a level about 5 mm below that of stamen attachment to a level about 8 mm below the tips of the lobes. Pigmentation variable in intensity, often very dark. Filaments becoming free about 5/8 the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 7-12 mm long. Anthers connate. Seeds winged.

description: Stems usually solitary, occasionally 2-3, simple or occasionally with 1 or 2 branches, (0.5-) 1.5-5 dm high, more or less erect, glabrous. Leaves linear to linear-spatulate or narrowly oblanceolate, 1-nerved, 0.5-5 (-9) mm wide, with smooth margins. Leaves larger and more closely spaced below, obtuse to rounded at the apex, smaller, more distant, and acute upward. Flowers generally solitary. Involucre none. Calyx tube 6.5-15 mm long, glabrous. Calyx lobes linear, 10-25 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide, with smooth margins. Corolla opening widely, 30-55 mm long. Lobes spreading, broadly ovate, (7-) 10-20 mm long, 5-10 mm wide, with th'e margins minutely erose, especially basally, and with slightly mucronate apices. Free portions of the appendages 4-6 mm long, more or less equally bifid, both segments laciniate, the divisions attenuate. Lateral petal traces first branching about halfway between the level of stamen attachment and the bases of the lobes. Lowest one fourth of the corolla tube pale yellow or greenish-yellow, green along the veins. Upper portion of corolla generally blue, the lobes very deeply colored, the exterior of the petals (exclusive of appendages) suffused with golden-green except along the inner edges of the lobes. Golden-green spots present on the interior surfaces of the petals (exclusive of appendages) in the upper two thirds of the corolla tube and on the lower 1/3-2/3 of the lobes. Deep blue stripes on the interior surface extending from the deeply colored upper portion of the corolla approximately to the level of stamen attachment. Blue pigment rarely replaced by rose-purple, or wholly or partially absent from corollas which are otherwise white, except for the green pigment present in all color forms. Filaments becoming free about three eighths the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 13-25 mm long. Anthers well separated at anthesis. Seeds winged.

description: Stems 1-5, taller ones usually branched, 1-7 dm high, erect or nearly so, usually puberulent. Leaves bright medium green, variously spaced, usually ovate, occasionally lanceolate, elliptic, or obovate, acute but seldom acuminate, 1- or 3-nerved, the margins ciliate throughout; the larger leaves (1-) 1.5-7.5 cm long, 4-30 mm wide; those below smaller, the lowest mere scales. Flowers in terminal clusters of 1-10; larger plants usually with flowers also in axillary clusters and/or clusters terminating branches 1-4 internodes long. Inflorescences subtended by 1 or 2 pairs of involucral leaves. Each flower subtended by a pair of linear-lanceolate to obovate bracts. Calyx tube 7-20 mm long, glabrous or puberulent in lines below the margins of the lobes. Calyx lobes generally oblanceolate, often somewhat foliaceous, 10-35 mm long, 1.5-7 mm wide, with ciliate margins. Corolla nearly closed to distinctly open, 3.5-5.5 cm long. Corolla lobes erect to recurved, ovate-deltoid, 5-10 mm long, 4.5-8 mm wide, entire, mucronate. Free portions of the appendages 2.0-6.5 mm long, subequally bifid, with both segments erect, laciniate, attenuate. Sinus on the outer side of each lobe slightly lower than that on the inner side. Corolla tube greenish white up to a level slightly below stamen attachment, with the veins outlined with green; blue (changing to blue-violet with age), or occasionally rose to rose-purple pigment present above this level, deeper toward the summit. Corolla lobes and free portions of the appendages nearly uniform in color throughout. Dark stripes present on the interior surface from 2-4 mm below the level of stamen attachment to 3-5 mm below the bases of the lobes, between the lateral and central petal traces; a shorter and narrower stripe also present in the center of the fused portion of each appendage. Filaments becoming free about one third the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 12-17 mm long. Anthers connate. Seeds winged.

description: Stems 1-10, 2-8 dm high, erect or nearly so, glabrous. Leaves medium green, somewhat glossy, with ciliate margins, in 12-20 pairs, with the upper internodes (1-) 2.5-12 cm long. Upper leaves ovate to ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 4.5-15 cm long, 1-5.5 cm wide; lower leaves smaller, the lowest very small or reduced to scales. Flowers in terminal clusters of 1-20, also often sessile in the upper axils, rarely on branches. Terminal inflorescences usually subtended by 2 pairs of involucral leaves. Each flower subtended by a pair of bracts, these highly variable in size and shape. Calyx tube 6-12 mm long, glabrous. Calyx lobes obovate to orbicular, 2-10 mm long, 0.75-8 mm wide, mucronate to attenuate. Corolla completely closed, rounded at the summit, 2.5-4 cm long. Corolla lobes incurved, 0.75-2 mm long, 2-4.5 mm wide, the tip rounded or slightly mucronate. Free portions of the appendages 1-2 times as wide as long, unequally bifid, with the sides nearly parallel, the ends jaggedly truncate. Appendages folded under the lobes so that only the latter are visible in the intact corolla. Corolla up to the level of stamen attachment whitish, above this level increasingly suffused with blue (changing to blue-violet with age), the appendages and inner edges of the lobes lighter than the rest of the upper part of the corolla. Deep blue stripes on the interior surface extending between the lateral and central petal traces from the level of stamen attachment until they merge with the deep blue of the upper part of the corolla. White-flowered forms occasional. Filaments becoming free 1/4-1/3 the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 10-15 mm long. Anthers connate. Seeds winged.

description: Stems usually solitary, occasionally 2-4, 1.5-6 dm high, erect or somewhat decumbent, puberulent. Leaves dark green, with ciliate margins, usually 3-nerved, in 4-15 pairs, with the upper internodes usually 3-10 cm long. Upper leaves lance-elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 3-10 cm long, 0.75-4 cm wide, acute to acuminate, tapering to a narrow base. Leaves at the second or third node below the involucre usually largest. Lower leaves smaller, often oblanceolate to obovate and rather blunt, the lowest mere scales. Flowers in terminal clusters of 1-15, often also in the upper axils, sessile or on peduncle-like branches. Involucral leaves in 1 or 2 pairs. Each flower subtended by a pair of subulate to oblanceolate bracts. Calyx tube 8-12 mm long, puberulent. Calyx lobes 2-8 (-12) mm long, usually subulate, occasionally oblanceolate, their margins ciliate. Corollas obconic-funnelform, slightly to widely open, 25-45 mm long. Corolla lobes erect to spreading, triangular-ovate, 3-6 mm long, 3.5-6 mm wide, mucronate. Free portions of the appendages 2-4.5 mm long, 2-4 mm wide, unequally bifid, the segments shallowly toothed, the narrower ones (counterclockwise as viewed from within) generally bent inward, the wider ones erect. Sinuses unequal as in G. catesbaei. Corolla tube generally white, the upper 1/3-2/3 of the petals (exclusive of appendages) usually suffused with pale to medium blue, except along the inner edges of the lobes. Appendages white except for faint blotches of pigment in their fused portions. Deeply pigmented stripes present on the interior surface between the lateral and central petal traces from just below the level of stamen attachment to just below the level of the bases of the lobes. Blue pigment occasionally replaced by violet. Filaments becoming free 1/3-1/2 the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 10-15 mm long. Anthers connate. Seeds winged.

description: Stems 1-15, 1-9 dm high, erect, glabrous. Leaves dark green, in 6-20 pairs, with the upper internodes 0.5-15 cm long, linear to lanceolate, acute, 1-nerved, the margins nearly entire to minutely denticulate, not ciliate. Larger leaves 4-9 cm long, 3.5-14 (-20) mm wide. Most of the leaves similar in size, only the lowermost reduced, all above the litter usually with a definite lamina. Flowers in relatively loose terminal clusters of 1-7, often also sessile in the upper 1-8 axils or on peduncle-like branches. Terminal inflorescences subtended by 1 or 2 pairs of involucral leaves. Flowers usually each subtended by a pair of bracts; bracteation sometimes irregular. Calyx tube 6-16 mm long, glabrous. Calyx lobes linear to oblong or oblanceolate, 1.5-12 (-15) mm long, 0.5-3 (-4) mm wide, the margins entire or minutely denticulate below. Corolla slightly open, 2.5-5 cm long. Corolla lobes incurving, 2.5-5 mm long, 4-6 mm wide, entire, rounded, slightly mucronate, asymmetrical, the outer side larger and strongly cucullate, the inner side slightly inrolled. Free portions of the appendages each consisting of a minute deflexed projection appearing as a continuation of the involute inner margin of the adjacent lobe, and an obliquely triangular portion about 1 mm long, 2.5-4 mm wide, with slightly erose margins. Sinus on the outer side of each lobe conspicuously lower than that on the inner side. Lower 1/3 of the corolla whitish. Corolla tube, especially the petals exclusive of the appendages, increasingly suffused with blue upward. Pigment darkest along the outer edges of the lobes, nearly absent from the inner half. Narrow deep blue lines on the interior surface between the lateral and central petal traces extending from the level of stamen attachment nearly to the bases of the lobes. Appendages irregularly blotched with pale blue. Corollas occasionally violet or white. Corolla lobes of all color forms frequently suffused with green. Filaments becoming free about 1/3 the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 8-13 mm long. Anthers connate. Seeds winged.

description: Stems solitary, generally unbranched, 0.75-3.5 dm long, more or less decumbent, glabrous. Leaves linear to linear-spatulate or occasionally narrowly oblanceolate, acute to obtuse, smooth-margined, 1-nerved; the lower leaves sometimes broader and blunter, with the lower internodes shorter. Flowers solitary. Involucre none. Calyx tube 8-15 mm long, glabrous. Calyx lobes linear, 10-30 mm long, 1-3 mm wide, with smooth margins. Corolla opening widely, 35-65 mm long. Corolla lobes spreading, ovate, 15-25 mm long, 5-9 mm wide, with minutely jagged edges and mucronate apices. Free portions of the appendages 5-10 mm long, more or less equally bifid, both portions laciniate, the divisions attenuate. Petals with a secondary vein arising from each lateral vein about the level of stamen attachment, continuing between the lateral vein and the central vein, the petals thus appearing 5-nerved. Lower 1/3-2/3 of the corolla white except for narrow green zones along the veins and small purplishgreen spots on the inner surface in rows between the veins of each petal. Petals (exclusive of appendages) increasingly suffused with greenish-purple externally in the upper portion of the corolla tube, darker along the lateral veins; exterior surfaces of the lobes paler, dull greenish-blue or greenish-purple, lighter or nearly white toward the inner edges, with numerous short, darker streaks. Interior surfaces of the petals white. Appendages white in both their united and free portions. Filaments becoming free about one third the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 7-12 mm long. Anthers well separated at anthesis. Seeds winged.

description: Stems 1-5 (-20 according to Curtis 1959), 1-6 dm high, erect or slightly decumbent, minutely but copiously puberulent. Leaves rather light green, in 7-20 pairs, with the upper internodes 0.5-4.5 (-6) cm long, oblong-lanceolate or occasionally nearly linear, widest near the base, acute to obtuse, 1-nerved; the margins entire except for minute cilia at the base, often revolute; the midrib puberulent below. The larger leaves 1.5-7 (-10.5) cm long, 4-18 (-30) mm wide; leaves gradually smaller below, the lowest mere scales. Flowers in terminal clusters of 1-6, also often sessile in the upper axils or terminating short branches. Clusters usually subtended by one pair of involucral leaves. Each flower subtended by two linear bracts. Calyx tube 7-18 mm long, glabrous except along the principal veins. Calyx lobes linear or rarely oblanceolate, 4-18 (-25) mm long, 1-3 (-4) mm wide, with minutely denticulate margins and puberulent midribs. Corolla vase-shaped, opening fully, 3-6 cm long. Corolla lobes 6-14 mm long, 4-10 mm wide, widely spreading, ovate, with the margins often shallowly erose, the tips mucronate. Free portions of the appendages 2.5-6 mm long, shallowly bifid, laciniate, the divisions attenuate. Corolla tube colorless up to the level of stamen adnation except for green zones along the veins; above this level with deep blue stripes on the interior surface between the lateral and central petal traces; the entire corolla tube becoming increasingly suffused with blue upward, the upper portion of the tube, the free portions of appendages, and the lobes usually deep blue throughout. Upper parts of the petals (exclusive of appendages) in the corolla tube and the outer sides of the lobes suffused with greenish-purple externally. Blue pigment rarely replaced by violet or rose-purple. Filaments becoming free about one third the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 10-16 mm long. Anthers free at anthesis. Seeds winged.
