description: Stems 1-5, 1-8 dm high, erect, usually more or less purple, glabrous. Leaves comparatively succulent, rather pale green, in 7-20 pairs, with the upper internodes 5-15 cm long, the lower ones much shorter. Upper leaves lanceolate to ovate, obtuse to acute, 3-5-nerved, 3-9 cm long, 0.8-3 cm wide. Lower leaves transitional to lanceoblong or nearly linear, 1-3-nerved; the lowest mere scales. Leaf margins minutely denticulate but not ciliate. Flowers in terminal clusters of 1-15, rarely also sessile in the axils of the first pair of leaves below the involucre, or on peduncle-like branches. Involucral leaves ovate-lanceolate to ovate, in 2 or 3 pairs, somewhat folded, enveloping the lower portions of the flowers, beneath large clusters often intergrading with smaller, irregularly positioned bracts. Calyx tube 7-12 mm long, hyaline, glabrous, usually concealed by the involucre. Calyx lobes oblong, glabrous, 2-14 mm long, 1-5 mm wide, entire, hyaline except occasionally at the tips (some rarely longer and foliaceous). Corolla loosely closed or slightly open, 3-4.5 cm long. Corolla lobes erect to spreading, ovate-triangular, nearly symmetrical, 4-8 mm long, 3-6 mm wide. Free portions of the appendages each consisting of a minute deflexed portion continuous with the somewhat involute margin of the adjacent lobe, and an erect, obliquely triangular, irregularly erose portion 0.5-2.5 mm high, 4-6 mm wide. Sinus on the outer side of each lobe slightly lower than that on the inner side. Lower half of the corolla yellowish-white to white, with the veins often outlined in pale green. Corolla usually suffused above with blue in the petals, violet in the appendages or about as often blue-violet or pale grayish-violet throughout, or rarely rose-pink; pigment darkest along the outer edges of the lobes. Inner edges of the petals (both lobes and fused portions) and adjacent portions of the appendages colorless; remainder of the appendages variously streaked and mottled. Deeply pigmented stripes on the interior surface extending between the lateral and central petal traces from the middle of the corolla to the bases of the lobes. Petals often suffused with green externally. Anthocyanins sometimes largely absent, the corolla then pale greenish-yellow to white, slightly mottled with violet above. Filaments becoming free slightly higher than 1/3 the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 7-12 mm long. Anthers connate. Seeds winged.

description: Stems 1-7, the flowering ones 0.75-6.5 dm high, erect or somewhat decumbent, glabrous or puberulent. Leaves dark green, in 7-15 pairs, with the upper internodes 2-7 cm long (except in depauperate specimens), highly variable in shape, ranging from linear to broadly elliptical or obovate, but generally widest near or above the middle, obtuse to acute but usually not acuminate, 1- or 3-, rarely 5-nerved, the margins ciliate; the larger leaves 1.5-12 cm long, 3-30 mm wide, the lower leaves smaller, the lowest mere scales. Flowers in terminal clusters of 1-8, on larger stems often also in clusters terminating short, peduncle-like branches from the upper 1-10 nodes. Inflorescences usually subtended by one pair of involucral leaves. Each flower subtended by a pair of oblanceolate to linear bracts. Calyx tube 5-15 mm long, glabrous. Calyx lobes usually narrowly oblanceolate, acute, 4-17 mm long, 0.8-4 (-6) mm wide, with ciliate margins. Corolla ventricose, slightly open, 3-5 cm long. Corolla lobes usually incurving, rounded, widest at the base, 2.8-7.0 (-9) mm long, 3.5-6 mm wide, mucronate. Free portions of the appendages similar in size and shape to those of G. catesbaei. Corolla tube up to the level of stamen attachment greenishwhite, the veins outlined in green; the tube above this level increasingly suffused with blue. Upper portion of the corolla blue throughout. Deep blue stripes present on the inner surface between the lateral and central petal traces from the level of stamen attachment to a level 3-5 mm below the bases of the lobes. A similar but narrower stripe present in the center of the fused portion of each appendage. Blue pigment occasionally replaced by pale violet. Filaments becoming free about one fourth the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 10-15 mm long. Anthers connate. Seeds winged.

description: Stems 1-5, 0.75-6 dm high, erect, glabrous. Leaves dark green, glossy, with entire margins, in 5-12 pairs, with the upper internodes 0.5-12 cm long. Upper leaves elliptic-lanceolate to obovate, acute, 2.5-10 cm long, 1-4 cm wide, 3-5-nerved. Leaves smaller, proportionately wider, and blunter below, those near the middle of the stem usually obovate and obtuse, the lower ones obovate to spatulate or orbicular, often truncate, occasionally retuse, the lowest mere scales. Flowers in terminal clusters of 1-10, occasionally also sessile or terminal on short branches of 1-4 internodes in the upper 1-6 axils. Terminal inflorescences subtended by 2 or 3 pairs of involucral leaves. Each flower usually subtended by a pair of small, oblanceolate bracts. Calyx tube 6-18 mm long, glabrous. Calyx lobes linear to oblanceolate, acute, 5-35 mm long, 0.5-12 mm wide, with entire margins. Corolla slightly open, 3-5.5 cm long. Corolla lobes erect, ovate-triangular, entire, mucronate, 4-10 mm long, 3-6 mm wide. Free portions of the appendages obliquely triangular, 1-2 mm high, 2-5 mm wide, often shallowly bifid with both segments erect. Sinus on the outer side of each lobe conspicuously lower than that on the inner side. Corolla greenish- to yellowish-white, the appendages paler, the veins outlined in green. Corollas of some plants more or less suffused with blue-violet. Filaments becoming free from the corolla tube 1/4-3/8 the distance from the receptacle to the tips of the lobes, 7-10 mm long. Anthers either connate or separate. Seeds wingless.

description: Herba erecta, basaliter ramosa, 6-20 (-30) cm alta. Planta griseo-viridis, purpurascens, hirsuta glandulosaque. Folia anguste triangularia vel anguste lanceolata, 1.5-2.5 cm longa. Bracteae sessiles, lanceolatae vel lanceolato-ovatae. Pedicelli breves (1-2 mm longi) sub anthesi, in fructu usque ad 12 mm longi. Calyx ca. 7 mm longus, in fructu medio distentus, demum ruptus. Corolla lutea, 10-12 mm longa, valde cucullata, galea 2.5-3 mm longa, labio infero trilobato, ca. 0.5 mm longo. Ovarium oblongo-ellipticum, leviter asymmetricum, aliquantulum complanatum, ca. 2.5 mm longum.

description: Herbs 6-20 (-30) cm tall, erect and usually basally branched with 2 to several lateral ascending stems. Herbage grayish green and often deeply purplish-tinged, hirsute on stem and leaf veins, hirsutulous-strigose on the leaf surfaces, and with scattered glandular trichomes throughout, these becoming increasingly abundant in the inflorescence. Leaves narrowly triangular to narrowly lanceolate, entire or the upper leaves with a pair of narrowly triangular lobes diverging above the mid-point, 1.5-2.5 cm long, 3-nerved from base, progressively reduced upwards and grading imperceptibly into the shorter and broader bracts. Inflorescence narrow and elon- gate in age, 5-15 cm long, the flowers few (usually fewer than 15) and discrete. Bracts with a sessile, clasping base, lanceolate to lance-ovate, sometimes with a pair of narrow lobes above the mid-point, 6-8 mm long in upper inflorescence to 15 mm below. Pedicels short (1-2 mm) at anthesis, elongating in fruit up to 12 mm. Calyx shorter than corolla tube, ca. 7 mm long, somewhat 4-sided with the anterior side rounded, posterior side sulcate, laterally flattish, strongly glandular-pilose, shallowly 4-cleft, 2-2.5 mm in front, 1.5-2 mm in back and a little less laterally, distended in fruit and eventually rupturing, the lobes deep purplish green, fading to lavender along the tube, lighter in the membranous area below the anterior and posterior sinuses. Corolla yellow, glabrous or occasionally with a few scattered hairs on tube, 10-12 mm long with a strongly hooded galea 2.5-3 mm long and a 3-lobed lower lip, ca. 0.5 mm long, the tube narrow, 8-9 mm long. Anthers glabrous, unequal, the upper pair ca. 1.8-2 mm long, the lower ca. 1.5-1.8 mm long. Ovary oblong-ellipsoid and slightly asymmetrical, somewhat flattened, ca. 2.5 mm long, forming a dark brown capsule ca. 7 mm long. Seeds mostly cuneiform, light brown, surrounded with a loose, brownish reticulate net, ca. 0.8-1 mm long.

description: Rhizome slender, elongate, probably from a deep-seated woody root, 2 mm in diameter, terminating in a rosette of 5-7 or more leaves and an upright stem ca. 40 cm high, 2 mm in diameter at base; basal leaves with brown, acute, puberulent to hirsutulous and ciliate stipules; petiole ca. 8-15 cm long, very sparsely hirsute, but hirsutulous and minutely glandular throughout or at the apex; blade divided 3/4 to 9/10 of the distance to the base into 5 principal lobes, the lobes again deeply divided into m-ucronulate lobelets, the surface above with appressed longer and erect shorter hairs, strigose and minutely glandular on the nerves below, the surface somewhat glandular below, the midlobe about 3.5 cm long, the lateral lobes 2.8-3.8 cm long: cauline leaves similar at lower nodes or progressively smaller, reduced to 3 lobes and often glandular in the infloreseence, the castaneous stipules puberulent abaxially, ca. 5 mm long; peduncles 2-flowered, axillary at lower nodes or mostly aggregated in a loose terminal infloreseence, 2.5-7 cm long, densely and minutely glandular and loosely pilose to hirsute as are the pedicels, these 1-2.5 cm long; sepals 5-6 mm long including short awns 0.5-1 mm, 2-3 mm wide, ovate, glandular-puberulent, the outer often with a few more or less appressed or curved hairs on the 3 principal nerves; petals carmine, salmon, brick-red or rarely white veined with red, obovate, 9-12 mm long, 5-6 mm wide, rounded or slightly emarginate at the apex, glabrous; stamen-filaments glabrous, red-tipped, about equalling the base of the stigmas, shorter than the sepals, the anthers elliptic, 1.5 mm long; immature fruit ca. 28 mm long, the stigmas red, 5 mm long, the column puberulent and glandular, ca. 1.9 mm long, sessile-glandular, puberulent, and sparsely strigose.

description: Subshrub with sprawling or repent repeatedly branching woody stems to 10 cm long or more, 2 mm in diameter, the short branches and most of the stems densely clothed with imbricate persistent stipules and petioles below the leaves to a diameter of 4 mm; leaves alternate, the stipules to 6.5 mm long, red becom- ing brown or gray-black in age, adnate to the petiole about half their length, linear-acuminate above, glabrous except for short stiff pale marginal cilia 0.2-0.3 mm long and a pair of similar terminal bristles; petioles shorter than the stipules, red when young, glabrous; blades articulate with the petioles and even- tually caducous, deep green often tipped and sometimes margined or flushed with red, entire, 8-8.5 mm long, 2-2.5 mm wide, narrowly oblanceolate in out- line, glabrous except for short stiff pale marginal cilia, glossy and coriaceous, acute, 3-nerved but only the central nerve apparent when dry, cupped upward from the center and drying with the margins appressed against each other; inflorescences solitary and terminal on the stems, 1 flowered; peduncle bibracteate, densely retrorse-strigose, 2-12 mm long, bracts glabrous and ciliate, 3-nerved, acute, pale reddish-brown, ca. 5 mm long, pedicel 6-10 mm long, densely retrorse-strigose; flowers pale to deep pink with rose-magenta veins; sepals ovate, 9-9.5 mm long, to 4 mm wide, 3-nerved, abruptly mucronulate, short-hirsute on the veins, margins and at the base; petals obovate, rounded at the apex, glabrous except for a few marginal hairs at the base, 10-12 mm long, ca. 6 mm wide; stamen-filaments ciliate, 4 mm long; fruit at maturity densely and minutely hispid, the column 13 mm long; carpels smooth, strigose-hispid; stigmas 2 mm long; seed brown, 2.5 mm long, the coat minutely reticulate.

description: Spreading scandent shrub, usually less than 0.5 m but up to 1.5 m in height, with branches prostrate, lower woody stems dark brown, ringed with petiole scars; herbaceous stems red- to pinkish-brown, sericeous. Stipules 5-1 1 mm long with broad sheathing base narrowing to an acuminate tip, young stipules bright red to pink with scant long-silky pubescence, older stipules persistent, becoming brown and curling. Leaf blade obovate to elliptic, (1. 1) 2.7-4 (5) cm long, (0.8) 1-2 (3) cm wide, both faces as well as petiole densely long-silky strigose, lower surface pubescence denser than above, blade with 5-8 subparallel veins, the central ones joined in the lower 1/3 of the blade, apex rounded to obtuse with (3) 5 (19) shallow teeth in apical 1/3, base acuminate, tapering to slender petiole (7) 15 (20) mm long. Inflorescence a (3) 6 (10)-flowered cyme, extending just beyond foliage; peduncles and pedicels densely white sericeous; flowers 23-31 mm in diameter (in living material). Sepals 5, ovate to elliptic, 5-9 mm long, 2-3.5 mm wide, mucronate, densely long-strigose outside, mostly olive-green and glabrous within, abruptly narrowed at tip, base broad. Petals 5, obovate, 9.5-14 mm long, 5-10 mm wide, either white or white with purple-magenta lines radiating from the base. Stamens 10, 4-6.5 mm long; anthers and filaments purple-magenta; pollen pale yellow. Carpels 5, carpel bodies and lower style column densely long-silky strigose, free section of stigmatic branches purple-magenta, 2-3 mm long. Seeds brown, oblong, ca 2.5 mm long, 1 per carpel.

description: Perennial herbs, 19-60(-100) cm tall. Rootstock 2.1-6.4 mm diam., ± vertical. Stem 0.05-0.2(-0.24) cm diam., decumbent or climbing, with vegetative stems 5-10 cm long (± horizontal, covered with imbricate stipules, usually without petiole remains), leafy, herbaceous, with patent, eglandular hairs 0.2-2.2 mm long and patent, glandular (only on the inflorescence) hairs 0.3-1 mm long. Basal leaves in a persistent rosette; lamina 2.9 x .2(-5) x 3.2-5.2(-6) cm, polygonal in outline, cordate, palmatifid (ratio main-sinus length/ middle-segment length = (0.75-)0.82-0.89), pilose, with eglandular, appressed hairs, nervation not projected; segments 5, rhombic (ratio maximum width/ middle-segment length = 0.58-0.71), 3- 9.5 mm wide at the base, 5-10(-15)-lobed in distal half (ratio second-sinus length/ middle-segment length = 0.12-0.32); cauline leaves opposite; petioles to 25 cm long, with eglandular, patent hairs 0.2-2.1 mm long, and rarely patent, glandular hairs 0.2-0.3 mm long; stipules 7-17.7x2.2-5.1 mm, lanceolate (with a setaceous apex 1-3.2 mm long), with eglandular hairs on abaxial surface and on the margin, glabrous adaxially. Inflorescence in a dichasial cyme; cymules 2-flowered, solitary; peduncles (18-)30-100(-130) mm long, with patent to retrorse, eglandular hairs 0.15-2.5 mm long and patent, glandular hairs 0.3-1.3 mm long; bracteoles 4-9 x 0.8 -1.5 mm, lanceolate to subulate, with eglandular hairs on both sides and on the margin; pedicels 9.5-36 mm long, with patent to retrorse, eglandular hairs 0.15- 1.6 mm long and patent, glandular hairs 0.2-1.7 mm long. Sepals 6-7.9(-9) x 2.8- 4.5 mm, not accrescent, 3-5-nerved, with muero 0.4-0.8 mm long, with scarious margins 0.2-0.58 mm wide, with ± patent, eglandular hairs 0.3-1.5 mm long on the abaxial side and patent, glandular hairs 0.3-1.4 mm long, almost glabrous adaxially. Petals 10-13. 3(-14.6) x 6.2- 11.7 mm (ratio petal width/petal length = 0.49-0.88), erect-patent, entire or slightly notched (notch ca. 1 mm deep), glabrous on the adaxial side, hairy on the base of abaxial side, ciliate on the basal margin, purplish. Staminal filaments 4-6.3 mm long, lanceolate, pilose on the abaxial side, ciliate on all of its length, with eglandular hairs 0.3-1 mm long; anthers 1-1.7x0.7-1 mm. Nectaries 5, hemispheric, glabrous. Gynoecium 4.7-8.2 mm long. description: Perennial plant; thick tap root 10-20 mm diam., >20 cm long, rough reddish brown bark; stems densely branched, sub-woody. Each apex carries a rosette of 3-4 leaves, 2(-6) X 2(-6) mm, orbicular, digitately lobed for 0.25-0.85 of its length into 5-7(-9-11) subequal segments, central lobe typically larger; segments broadly rhombic-triangular, obtuse, simple and in a vertical position when alive, venation within lobes parallel-reticulate; leaf lamina, petiole, petiole base, pedicel, calyx, mericarps and beak (rostrum) densely covered in short felt of ad- pressed acropetalous somewhat yellowish hydrophobic eglandular pubescence; hairs uniformly conical, smooth, ca. 3 m diam. at base, length 0.1-0.2 mm (leaf lamina, petiole) to 0.2-0.4 mm (petiole base, mericarps); petioles 2(-4) mm long, widening to sheathing flat leaf base 3.5 X 2.5 mm, with (1-)3 veins, pubescent on abaxial sur- face, reddish brown. Stipules narrow-triangular, (1.2-)3-5 X 0.3-2 mm, reddish to black, together with dead leaf bases forming a dense stypochaetium below live leaves. Flowers solitary, pedicel short (1-2 mm), calyx persistent, sepals obtuse triangular, 4.1 X 1.6 mm, 3-5 veins prominent on outer surface, margins distinctly paler in dried material. Corolla white. description: Low, densely and intricately branched, rounded, spinescent shrub or subshrub, from almost matted to 2 m high; herbage glabrous or finely puberulent, the leaves somewhat glaucous or grayish-green; stems ribbed from decurrent petiolar mar- gins, the young stems green, the older stems becoming light orangish-tan, devel- oping a gray or tannish-orange bark, bearing the petiolar bases for a few years; stipules connate with the base of the petiole, their free tips lanceolate to linear or filiform, 0-1.4 (1.7) mm long; leaves short-petiolate, the petiole 0.6-2 (2.8) mm long, the blade 3-13 (17) mm long, 1.2-4.3 (6) mm wide, narrowly oblanceolate to oblanceolate, cuneate basally, acute or mucronate apically, entire; flowers solitary at a node, subtended by a fascicle of bracts, the outer bracts small and the inner ones resembling small leaves, the pedicel 1.2-5 (6) mm long; hypanthium lined inside with a fleshy disk; sepals (3-) 5, broadly rounded, (0.5) 1-2 (3) mm long, hyaline-margined; petals (3-) 5, narrowly oblanceolate, narrowly spatulate to linear, (2) 2.8-6.5 mm long, white; stamens 6-10, with short filaments and anthers 0.3-0.5 mm long; pistil(s) 1 (2), apocarpous; follicle(s) 3-5.5 mm long, longitudinally ribbed, beaked, green to brown, the stigma discoid, oblique, opening along the ventral surface; seeds 1 or 2, 2-3 mm long, subglobose, white, cream, or brown, smooth and shiny, with a fimbriate aril.

description: Epiphytic shrub to 1 m. Mature branckes coarsely and bluntly angled, glabrous, reddish-brown when dry; immature branches and twigs of new growth terete to sub- terete, puberulent, greyish- to reddish-brown when dry; epidermis thin, cracking longitudinally. Petioles subterete, 1.5-2.5 mm, puberulent adaxially. Leaves cori- aceous, glabrous, ovate to pyriform, 1-2 X 0.5-1 cm, basally rounded or obtuse, apically bluntly obtuse, marginally crenate each tooth gland tipped; obscurely 5 plinerved, only midrib prominent; axillary buds with awl-shaped, stipule-like perulae 1.5-2 mm. Inflorescence axillary, flowers solitary. Pedicels terete, glabrous, 1 mm. Bracteoles ovate, acuminate, 1-2 mm, marginally glandular-fimbriate, concealing pedicel. Calyx puberulent, 5-7 mm, 5-winged opposite the sinus; tube nonapophysate, 2.5-4 mm; limb erecto-patent, sometimes striate, 2.5-3 mm including the lobes; lobes triangular, acute, 1.5-2 mm; sinus rounded. Corolla tubular, terete, 26 mm long and 3-5 mm in diameter, puberulent, bright red; lobes triangular, obtuse, reflexed at anthesis, 2 mm. Stamens subequal, 23-24 mm; filaments connate into a tube 6.5 mm, glabrous; anthers including tubules 18-19 mm, dehiscing by oblique, terminal pores 1 mm long; thecae 3.5 mm. Style exserted, glabrous, 24-27 mm. Berry not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Luteyn, James L. 1977. Notes on neotropical Vaccinieae (Ericaceae). III. New and noteworthy species from Mexico. Brittonia. 28: 400-406.

description: Frutex epiphyticus; petioli 2 mm longi; folia ovato-lanceolata vel elliptico-lanceolata, 2.5-6 cm longa et 1-1.5 cm lata, basi rotundata vel obtusa, apica longa acuminata; inflorescentia 8-10-flora; rhachides 1-1.5 cm longae; bracteae florales lineari-lanceolatae vel aristatae, 1 mm longae et 0.5 mm latae; pedicelli 4-10 mm longi; bracteolae aristatae, 1 mm longae; calyx glaber 5-9 mm longus, tubo striato 1.5-3.5 mm longo, limbo striato lobis 1-2 mm longis inclusis 4-5.5 mm longo; corolla 12-17 mm longa; stamina 11-13 mm longa, filamentis 2-3 mm, antheris tubulis inclusis 9.5-11 mm, poris subterminalibus 0.5-1.5 mm longis; stylus 14-19 mm longus.

description: Epiphytic shrub. Mature branches terete, striate, glabrous, reddish when dry; immature branches and twigs of new growth terete to subterete, often flattened with blunt angles, smooth to minutely striate, glabrous, reddish-brown when dry; bark thin, cracking in a reticulate pattern, reddish. Petioles subterete, flattened adaxially, rugose, 2 mm long and 1 mm in diameter, glabrous or puberulent. Leaves coriaceous, ovate-lanceolate or elliptic-lanceolate, 2.5-6 cm long and 1-1.5 cm broad, basally rounded or obtuse, apically long acuminate, tip ultimately blunt, pale grayish-green when dry, glabrous, obscurely 3 (-5) -plinerved, midrib and lateral nerves plane to slightly raised on both surfaces, veinlets raised slightly on both sides but conspicuous only beneath. Inflorescences solitary, axillary, racemose, 8-10-flowered; rachis subterete, smooth, glabrous, 1-1.5 cm long; floral bracts persistent, linear-lanceolate or aristate, 1 mm long and 0.5 mm broad, glandular-fimbriate basally, ciliate distally. Pedicels cylindric, gradually thickening distally, striate, glabrous, 4-10 mm long and 0.5-1 mm in diameter, sometimes with cartilaginous teeth distally. Bracteoles aristate, 1 mm long, ciliate distally. Calyx glabrous, 5-9 mm long; tube cylindric or spreading distally, slightly expanded as a rim basally but not conspicuously apophysate, striate, 1.5-3.5 mm long; limb spreading, striate, 4.5-5 mm long including the lobes; lobes broadly triangular, acute, striate, 1-2 mm long; sinus obtuse. Corolla cylindric, mem- branaceous when dry, glabrous, 12-17 mm long and 4-5 mm in diameter; lobes tri- angular, obtuse, 1-2 mm long. Stamens equal, 11-13 mm long; filaments distinct at anthesis, marginally pilose, 2-3 mm long; anthers including tubules 9.5-11 mm long dehiscing by oval, subterminal pores, 0.5-1.5 mm long; thecae conspicuously granular, 2-3 mm long. Style thin, glabrous, 14-19 mm long, strongly exserted at anthesis; stigma truncate. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic shrub, without lignotuber; stem and twigs subterete, conspicuously and bluntly to narrowly ridged and grooved, striate, glabrous or nearly so, scattered glandular-fimbriate, the proximal portion of the stem of each year's growth conspicuously surrounded by a series of tightly clasping, imbricate, ovate to elliptic, acute to rounded, striate, glabrous bracts 5-20 mm long; bark not exfoliating. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, (5-)7-10(-12.5) X (2.7-)3-4(-5.7) cm, basally rounded or broadly tapering, apically acute or more typically acuminate with the tip 1 cm or more long, marginally entire and slightly revolute, glabrous above or sparing- ly to moderately spreading short-pilose or puberulent along the proximal raised portion of the midrib, glabrate beneath, especially the younger leaves with minute, reddish brown, appressed, glandular fimbriae 0.1- 0.2 mm long which leave punctate depres- sions when deciduous, the lower surface without circular, basal glands, 5-7-plinerved with lateral veins arising at or near the base, the midrib very much thickened and prom- inently raised in proximal 1 cm then becom- ing impressed distally, raised beneath, lateral nerves slightly raised proximally then im- pressed distally above and slightly raised be- neath, reticulate veinlets obscure above and slightly raised but obscure beneath; petiole stout, rugose, 3-6 mm long, densely short- pilose, or puberulous to glabrate. Inflores- cence axillary, borne near the end of the branches, sessile, racemose, 4-7-flowered, the rachis, pedicels, bracts, calyces, and co- rollas weakly to moderately provided with reddish brown, appressed, glandular fimbriae 0.1-0.2 mm long; rachis striate or irregularly angled, 3-7 cm long, the lower 1.5-2 cm enveloped by ovate to oblong bracts 5-8 mm long; floral bract oblong to spatulate, 9- 13 mm long, entire, apically rounded; pedi- cel striate, 5-11 mm long, markedly broad- ened just below articulation; bracteoles 2, lo- cated apically, either at the pedicel/calyx ar- ticulation and then immediately subtending the calyx or to 10 mm below apex of pedi- cel, elliptic, acute, striate, 13-16 X ca. 5 mm, dorsal circular glands none. Flowers with the calyx articulate with pedicel, 10- 12.5 mm long, moderately to densely glandular-fimbriate with reddish brown fimbriae; hypanthium ± pentagonal but basally strongly ribbed or narrowly winged in the lower half with the rib or wing disappearing distally onto the limb (appearing winged when dry), 4-6 mm long, shorter then limb; limb campanulate-spreading, 6-8 mm long, conspicuously lobed; lobes deltate, 3-4 mm long and basally 3.2-4 mm wide, apically acute; sinuses acute; corolla apparently membranaceous, not carnose, broadly cylindric (probably cylindric-campanulate, but difficult to say from pressed material), terete, 12-15 mm long and 7-9 mm apical diam., glabrous but provided with scattered glandular fimbriae, the lobes triangular-deltoid, acute, 2-3 mm long, seemingly bicolorous with the tube roseate and the lobes reportedly pale greenish; stamens 10, nearly equal to corolla, ca. 10-11 mm long; filaments distinct, 3-4 mm long, spreading long-pilose with slender trichomes 0.2-0.4 mm long; connectives smooth; anthers ca. (7-)8-9.2 mm long, curving slightly inward; thecae granular, ca. 3-3.5 mm long, the base incurved and shortly and bluntly apiculate; tubules 2, separate to base, cylindrical, (3.5-) 5-6 mm long, dehiscing by an apically oblique, introrse, oval cleft ca. 0.8 mm long; style glabrous; stigma punctiftrm. Berry unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Luteyn, James L. 2001. Two new species and two new combinations in mesoamerican Ericaceae. Brittonia. 53: 437-446.

description: Epiphytic shrub with branches to 3 m. Mature branches terete to subterete, short puberulent or glabrate, striate, reddish- to blackish-brown when dry; bark thin, cracking longitudinally; immature branches and twigs of new growth subterete, bluntly angled, densely puberulent. Petioles subterete, channeled adaxially, somewhat winged, 1-3 mm long, densely short puberulent. Leaves coriaceous, obovate, oblong-elliptic, or elliptic, 1-2 (-3) cm long and 0.5-1.5 cm broad, basally cuneate and attenuate, apically rounded and slightly emarginate, marginally entire or remotely crenate dis- tally, scattered hairs on midrib adaxially, obscurely 5-plinerved, all nerves slightly raised on both surfaces. Inflorescences axillary, 1-2-flowered, subtended by 3-5, ovate, ciliate and fimbriate margined bracts, 1-1.5 mm long and 0.5-1 mm broad, not clearly differentiated into inflorescence bracts, floral bracts, or bracteoles. Pedicels subterete to bluntly angled, slightly thickening and oblique distally, glabrous 5-9 (-13) mm long and 1 mm in diameter, with few cartilaginous teeth distally. Calyx glabrous, 3- 4.5 mm long, constricted at the base of the limb, obprismatic, 5-winged opposite the sinuses; tube nonapophysate, 1.5-2.5 mm long; limb campanulate, 1.5-2 mm long including the lobes; lobes triangular, acute, 0.5 mm long; sinus rounded to flat. Corolla cylindric, narrowed to the throat, carnose when fresh, slightly 5-angled, (14-) 16-20(-25) mm long and 3-6 mm in diameter, glabrous without but with scattered, short, glandular-fimbriae, crimson when fresh; lobes triangular or oblong, obtuse, to 3 mm long, throat and lobes densely white pubescent within. Stamens equal, 14-19 mm long; filaments distinct, 3-5 mm long, glabrous, white; anthers including tubules 11-16.5 mm long, yellow, dehiscing by lateral slits 3.5-4 mm long; thecae 2.5-4 mm long. Style thin, glabrous, 19-23 mm long, exserted prior to anthesis; stigma trun- cate. Berries spherical, 8-10 mm in diameter, dark blue-black.

description: Plants annual, prostrate, with several stems at the base arising from a thin taproot; leaves basal and cauline, laminar proximally and becoming acerose distally, paired and opposite, exstipulate, narrowly petiolate, the leaf-blade broadly elliptic or rounded to reniform proximally, linear and awn-tipped distally, tomentose on the lower surface, glabrate above; flowering branches slender, yellowish-green, thinly pubescent with slightly curled eglandular hairs; inflorescence cymose, dichotomously branched throughout (except rarely at the first node) with a cluster of bracted flowers at each node; bracts acerose, paired and opposite, thinly pubescent to glabrate on both surfaces; peduncles lacking; involucral bracts composed of 5 unequal, linear-lanceolate, awned segments united only at the base, not tubular; flowers yellow, on short, peg-like pedicels, not stipitate, woolly-tomentose without, the 6 tepals petaloid, united more than half their length, the short, ovate lobes spreading at the orifice; stamens 9, about as long as the tepals at anthesis, the filaments glabrous, the anthers yellow, oval; pistil 3-carpellary, the ovary 1-celled, 1-ovulate, the style 3-branched with a small capitate stigma at the tip of each branch; fruits 3-angled achenes, dull brownish, glabrous, with a short, stout beak; embryo curved, with abundant meally endosperm.

description: Arbor parva (6-8 m alta); ramuli juniores laeves glaberrimi; internodia 1.5-3 cm longa. Foliorum petiolus incrassatus, saepe curvatus, 5-7 mm longus; lamina membranacea, glaberrima, oblanceolata vel oblongo-lanceolata, basin versus longe angustata et in petiolum longe decurrens, apice in cuspidem latam obtusam 1-2 cm longam subsensim contracta, 12-20 cm longa et 4-7 cm lata; costa supra impressa, subtus valde prominens, teres glaber et laevis; nervi laterales I. supra parum conspicui, in utroque latere 15-18, sub angulo fere 900 exeuntes, sursum curvati et 4-5 mm intra marginem regulariter conjuncti, supra parum conspicui, subtus valde prominentes. (Flores ignoti.) Fructus 10-12 mm longe stipitatus, pedunculo rigido glaberrimo et prope basin articulato sustentus; monocarpia insigniter parva, nigra, glaberrima, ovoidea, apice rotundata et interdum apiculo minuto instructa, 6-7 mm longa et ca. 4 mm crassa. Semina monocarpii forma, testacea.

description: Arbor parva; ramuli novelli pilis ferrugineis erectopatentibus circ. 1 mm. longis vestiti, mox glabrescentes et nigricantes. Foliorum petiolus circ. 5 mm. longus; lamina coriacea, supra laevis et costa impressa ferrugineo-tomentosa excepta glaberrima, subtus primo dense, deinde laxe pilis ferrugineis decum- bentibus vestita, oblonga vel oblongo-elliptica, basin versus acutata et breviter decurrens, apicem versus in cuspidem circ. 1 cm. longam obtusam modice abrupte contracta, 9-13 cm. longa et 3-5 cm. lata; nervi laterales I. arcuato-adscendentes, 1-2 mm. intra marginem sat irregulariter arcuato-conjuncti, supra plani vel paulo impressi, subtus cum venulis valde elevatis reticulum densum formantes. Flores solitarii; pedicelli 12-18 mm. longi, pilis erectis ferrugineis vestiti, plus minus glabrescentes, 5-8 mm. supra basin articulati. Sepala late ovata, acutiuscula, extra longe sericea, intus fere glabra et nigra, circ. 5 mm. longa. Petala oblongo-oblanceolata, 10-12 mm. longa et 6-8 mm. lata, extra pilis longis adpressis aureo-ferrugineis densissime sericea, intus tomentosa sed basin versus glaberrima. Stamina 0.8-1 mm. longa, disco conspicue umbonato. Fructus ignotus.

description: Arbor circ. 15 m. alta; ramuli et pedicelli pilis 1.5-2 mm. longis flavidis patentissimis dense vestiti, demum plus minus glabrescentes. Foliorum petiolus circ. 2 mm. longus; lamina papyracea, supra primo hirsuta, mox glabrescens et lucida, in costa persistenter denseque ferrugineo-pilosa, subtus pilis longis pallidis decumbentibus, in costa magis patentibus et diutius persistentibus obsita, lanceolata, circ. ad medium latissima, basi breviter acuta vel rotundata, apicem obtusiusculum versus sensim angustata, 6-12 cm. longa et 1.8-2.5 cm. lata; costa subtus rubra; nervi laterales graciles, angulo circ. 80? exeuntes, subrecti et circ. 2 mm. intra marginem conjuncti. Flores solitarii; pedicelli tenues sed rigidi, 3-4 cm. longi, circ. ad quartam partem inferiorem articulati, infra articulationem bracteis 2 (-3) membranaceis rotundato-ovatis et apice obtusis iox deciduis ornati. Sepala ovata, acuta, 6-8 mm. longa, extra adpresse longo-hirsuta, intus tomentella. Petala oblonga, obtusa, exteriora circ. 12 mm. longa, interiora 15-17 mm. longa, omnia 5-6 mm. lata, ad basin dense sericeo- villosa, ceterum tomentella. Stamina 1-1.2 mm. longa, disco plano glabro. Fructus ignotus.

description: This dioecious herbaceous vine flowers throughout the year. It has pedicellate male flowers with thecae replicate at base, urceolate-cylindrical hypanthia, and lanceolate calyx lobes usually 5-14 mm long (Jeffrey, 1984). It has simple crispate-pubescent leaves that vary greatly in shape, from mildly trilobed to deeply palmatifid. The leaf shape does not correlate well with sexual condition. Gurania lobata occurs occasionally in Trinidad-Tobago and is wide-spread in parts of tropical South America.

description: Herba, caulibus erectis vel ascendentibus, subquadrangularibus, bifariam pilosis; foliorum lamina ovata vel oblongo-ovata, apice subobtusa vel breviter acuminata, basi angustata vel superiorum obtusa, supra glabra vel parce hirsuta, subtus glabra vel costa parce hirtella; paniculae longae, angustae, laxae, bracteis ultimis triangulari-subulatis, pedunculis, rhachibus et pedicellis purpurascentibus, glanduloso- pilosis; bracteae flores subtendentes lineari-subulatae; calycis segmenta linearia, glabra; corolla glabra, tubo carenti, basi abrupte dilatata, in fauce leviter angustata, labio superiore erecto, ovato, rotundato, labio inferiore patulo, trilobato, lobis ovatis, obtusis; stamina exserta, antheris linearibus, utrinque muticis; ovarium glabrum.

description: Erect herb to 3 dm tall; stems subquadrangular, bifariously pilose, the trichomes recurved, spreading, 0.5 mm long; leaf blades ovate to oblong-ovate, 4.5- 9.5 cm long and 3.5-5.5 cm wide, subobtuse to short-acuminate with a blunt tip, narrowed at base or the uppermost rounded or obtuse, all rather thin, entire or undulate, the upper surface drying green, glabrous to sparingly hirsute, the trichomes mostly curved, ascending, rigid, 0.6 mm long, the lower surface gray- green, glabrous or nearly so or the costa sparingly hirtellous, the trichomes to 0.5  mm long, ascending, costa, lateral veins (4-7 pairs) and veinlets not noticeably conspicuous but more so above than beneath, cystoliths conspicuous under mag- nification; petiole 0.5-4 cm long, glabrous to sparingly and bifariously pilose, the trichomes ascending, sordid, 0.6 mm long; flowers borne in axils and terminally in long narrow lax panicles, 5-13 cm long and 3-7 cm broad, the small triangular- subulate bracts 3 mm long, 1 mm wide at base, gradually integrating into the stem leaves; peduncles, rachis and pedicels purplish, moderately glandular pilose, pedicels 10 mm long, purplish, glandular puberulous; bracts subtending flowers linear-subulate, 1.5 mm long, 0.5 mm wide, glabrous, cystoliths minute, con- spicuous; calyx accrescent, 5.5-10 mm long, the segments linear, at anthesis 5 mm long and 0.75 mm wide at base, often 9 mm long in fruit, the tips blunt, glabrous without and bearing numerous minute cystoliths, conspicuous under a lens, glandular-punctate within; corolla 1.3-1.5 cm long, glabrous, 1.2 mm in diam at base, abruptly enlarged to 3 mm at 2 mm above base, thence enlarged to 6 mm at middle and again narrowed to 3.5-4 mm at mouth, the lips subequal, 2.5 mm long, upper lip erect, ovate 1.75 mm broad, rounded, lower lip 3-lobed, lobes spreading, ovate, 1.5 mm long and broad, obtuse; stamens exserted 5 mm beyond mouth of corolla, glabrous; anthers linear, 3 mm long, 1 mm thick, muticous at both ends; pollen 2-porate, subspheroidal, 47 x 44 gm, exine spinulose, spinulae widely spaced (Fig. 2); style exserted 7 mm beyond mouth of corolla, stigma minute; ovary glabrous; capsule clavate, glabrous, 14 mm long, 3 mm wide, 2 mm thick; retinacula 1.5 mm long, linear-cucullate at tip, inconspicuously erose; seeds whitish (immature), suborbicular, about 2.25 mm long and 2 mm wide, minutely tuberculate.

description: Suffrutex, caulibus subquadrangularibus, hirtellis; foliorum lamina ovata, apice graciliter acuminata, basi rotundata in petiolum decurrens, tenuis, hirtella; paniculae densae, longae et magnae, terminales, bracteis ultimis linearibus, hirtellis, rhachidi et rhachillis hirtellis; pedicelli hirtelli; calycis segmenta lineari-lanceolata, parce vel aliquanto dense hirtella, pilis patulis; corolla lutea deorsum rubro-maculata, glabra, tubo basi angusto, supra abrupte dilatato, labio superiore anguste obovato, erecto, plus minusve recurvato, apice acuto, labio inferiore brevi, trilobato, lobis suborbicularibus; stamina exserta, glabra, antheris linearibus, utrinque muticis; capsulae clavatae, subtiliter pubescentes; semina brunnea, ovoidea, basi obliqua, minute tuberculata.

description: Shrub or undershrub 1-2 m high; stems subquadrangular, rather densely hirtellous, the hairs appressed, yellowish-brown; leaf blades ovate, 13-18.5 cm long and 6.5-10.5 cm wide, slenderly acuminate, short-cuneate (5 mm long) from a rounded base, thin, entire, yellowish-green above, pale green beneath, hirtellous, the hairs to 1 mm long, septate, ascending or subappressed, the margins sparingly ciliate, the costa and lateral veins (about 11 pairs) moderately prominent beneath, less so above, the cystoliths minute, 0.25 mm long, obscure; petioles 3-7.5 cm long and 2 mm thick, densely hirtellous; panicles terminal and axillary, forming a large, dense, complex inflorescence 35-40 cm long and 7 cm broad, the ultimate bracts linear, 7 mm long and 0.5 mm wide, hirtellous, the hairs erect and ascending; rachis and rachilla densely brown-hirtellous, the hairs more or less ascending, septate, 0.4 mm long; pedicels 1-2 mm long, hirtellous; calyx green, 10 mm long becoming about 14 mm in fruit, moderately hirtellous, the hairs spreading, the segments 9 mm long, linear-lanceolate, 0.8-1 mm wide near base, sometimes bearing a few hairs tipped by conical elongated brownish glands; corolla 2.3 cm long, glabrous, yellow with red spots on the lower half, 1 mm broad at base, abruptly enlarged at 3 mm above base to 7.5 mm, thence narrowed to 4 mm at throat, the upper lip narrowly obovate, erect, more or less recurved, 4 mm long, about 1.75 mm wide, acute and entire at tip, ciliate, the lower lip broadly ovate, about 3 mm long and 6 mm wide, the lobes suborbicular, the middle one 1 mm long, the lateral ones 2 mm long, all 2 mm wide, the margins ciliate; stamens exserted 6-7 mm beyond the lips of the corolla, glabrous; anthers linear, 5 mm long, 0.75 mm broad, rounded at both ends; pollen 2-porate, bilateral, subspheroidal, 54 x 48 µm, the nexine densely granular, sexine tectate (Fig. 3); pistil 2.8 cm long, exceeding stamens, glabrous, the stigma minute; ovary glabrous; capsule clavate, 13-14 mm long, 3-4 mm broad, 3 mm thick, finely pubescent, the solid stipe 6 mm long; seeds 4, brown, ovoid, 3 mm long, 2.5 mm broad, 1 mm thick, oblique at base, smooth or slightly tuberculate.

description: Shrub or undershrub 1-2 m high; stems subquadrangular, rather densely hirtellous, the hairs appressed, yellowish-brown, the lower portions of the stem glabrate; leaf blades ovate, 13-16 cm long and 5.5-7.5 cm wide, short-acuminate, decurrent on the petiole from a rounded base, moderately firm, entire or undulate, yellowish-green, hirtellous, the hairs to 1 mm long, septate, ascending or subappressed, the margins sparingly ciliate, the costa and lateral veins (about 10 pairs) moderately prominent beneath, less so above, the cystoliths minute, 0.25 mm long, obscure; petioles 4-5 cm long and 1.5 mm thick, densely hirtellous; panicles terminal and axillary, forming a large complex inflorescence to 30 cm long and 9 cm broad, the ultimate bracts subulate, 4 mm long and 0.5 mm wide, hirtellous, the hairs more or less spreading; rachis and rachilla hirtellous, the hairs spreading; pedicels 1-3 mm long, hirtellous; calyx 6-8 mm long, sparingly to moderately hirtellous, the hairs spreading, the segments 7 mm long, linear-lanceolate, 0.8-1 mm wide near base, sometimes bearing a few hairs tipped by conical elongated brownish glands; corolla 1.5-2 cm long, glabrous, reddish-orange, 3 mm broad at base, abruptly enlarged at 4 mm above base to 6 mm, thence narrowed to 3.5 mm at throat, the upper lip narrowly obovate, erect, more or less recurved, 3-4 mm long, about 1.75 mm wide, acute and entire at tip, ciliate, the lower lip broadly ovate, about 3 mm long and 7 mm wide, the lobes suborbicular, about 2 mm long and 2.5 mm wide, the margins ciliate; stamens exserted 10-12 mm beyond the lips of the corolla, glabrous; anthers linear, 4 mm long, 0.75 mm broad, slightly curved; pollen 2-porate, bilateral, subspheroidal, 52 x 42 µm, the nexine densely granular, sexine tectate (Fig. 3); pistil 2.3 cm long, exceeding stamens, glabrous, the stigma minute; ovary glabrous; capsules not seen.

description: Herba glabra, foliis ut videtur numerosis, longissime (ad 70 cm.) petio- latis, lamina lanceolata, chartacea, olivaceo-viridia, ad 40 em. longa et 6 cm. lata, acuminata, basi longe cuneata, perspicue longitudinaliter eirciter 20- nervia, nervulis transversalibus obsoletis. Racemis eirciter 70 cm. longis, partibus floriferis pedunculo subaequantibus; bracteis linearis vel lineari- lanceolatis, acuminatis, inferioribus ad 4 cm. longis, superioribus gradatim brevioribus, ultimis 1-1.5 cm. longis, eirciter 1-1.5 cm. distantibus, rmajoribus vix 1.5 mm. latis, bracteolis ut videtur solitariis, eaducis, lineari-lanceolatis, 2-3.5 mm. longis; floribus in axillis bracteorum solitariis, pedicellis curvatis vel recurvatis, 3-4 mm. longis, infra calycem articulatis; floribus purpureis, eirciter 6 mm. longis, apertis 1 cm. diametro, calycis tubo late obconico, eir- citer 2 mm. longo. lobis 6, subaequalibus, elliptico-ovatis, obtusis vel rotun- datis, Girciter 4 mm. longis et 3 mm. latis, coronis eirciter 1.5 mm. altis, deor- sum 3-3.5 mm. diametro, sursum plus minusve angustatis, obscure 6-lobatis vel subintegris; antheris 6, oblongis, 1.5 mm. longis, sessilibus, apicibus leviter exsertis; ovario late ovoideo, semi-infero, 3-loculari, loculis 2-ovulatis; stylis subnullis, crassissimis, stigmatibus 3, sessilibus; fructibus (haud visis), ex collectore bacciformibus, eyaneo-azureis.

description: Large shrub or small to moderate sized tree, to ca. 18 m tall, in wet forest. Bark dark brown, roughened; wood creamy gray. Twigs densely puberulent, rusty brown. Leaves entire, truncate or slightly cuneate, ovate to elliptic, acute to acuminate, 5-7-nerved, usually 15-20 cm long (1 1/2-2 times as long as broad, rarely narrower), punctate, discolorous, sparsely and obscurely lepidote to glabrate above, minutely puberulent below (so densely so that the lamina is usually concealed by interlocking stellate hairs ~ 0.1 mm diam.), with characteristic auriculate appendages at base of lamina 1-5 mm wide. Foliar nectaries 3-5 (rarely 7), small (1-2 mm) but prominent because glabrous against puberulent lamina, the central one 1/2-2/3 distance from leaf base, the lateral ones progressively nearer base. Petioles 1/3-1/2 length of lamina (rarely shorter), sparsely to densely brown-puberulent, with adaxial ridge emerging from between appendages. Stipules inconspicuous, brown-puberulent, early caducous. Pedicels 0.5-2 cm long (in flower), 1-5 cm (in fruit), slender (0.75-2 mm diam.), brown-puberulent. Involucral nectaries sometimes present. Involucral bractlets 3, subulate, 1-3 mm (rarely 6-10 mm) long, rusty-puberulent, deciduous, leaving scars in fruit. Calyx truncate, brown-puberulent, 4-12 mm long, expanded and torn in flower and fruit to pseudo-lobate condition. Petals densely yellowish lepidote without where exposed in bud, glabrous within, reflexed, ca. 1 cm long, white (or sometimes yellow). Flowers "with fragrance like linden" (Hoim & litis 413). Filaments (of staminate flowers) numerous, 4-1 1 mm, glabrous; staminal column fused with petals to form short stipe (2 mm) below point of fusion; pubescence on claws of petals and on staminal column. Pistillate flowers not seen. Fruits 3-celled, brown-puberulent, trigonally globular or ellipsoid to slightly obovoid-slightly beaked, 1-2.5 cm broad, glabrous within except sparsely to freely pubescent (hairs 1.5 mm) along suture; carpel wall 0.5-0.75 mm thick, creamy white within. Seeds dark, shiny glabrous with vasculature of seed coat prominent, 5-9 mm long, arillate, rounded; aril approximately equaling seed, snow-white (when fresh-brownish in sicco).
bibliographicCitation: Wilbur, Robert L. 1970. A new Costa Rican species of Centrapogon [C. talamancensis] (Campanualaceae-Lubelioideae). Brittonia. 21: 353-358.

description: Leaves truncate, lanceolate to ovate, symmetrical. Stipules 3-9 mm long. Involucral nectaries lacking. Involucral bractlets inserted on the calyx. Calyx hemispheric in bud, 4-8 mm (usually 5-6 mm) long. Flowers 1-1.5 cm diameter. Petals punctate. Filaments 4-5 mm long. Fruits 1-2.5 cm long.

description: Arbor vel arbuscula (3 usque ad 10 m alta), raro frutex, dioecia, sylvarum pluvialum tropicalum. Meristemata puberula dense. Caules glabrati vel puberuli infuscati minute et dense. Folia discoloria, truncata (raro cordata paululum), ovata (raro elliptica), acuta vel acuminata, 5-7-nervia, punctata minute, glabrata supra, glabrata vel puberula sparse et minute infra (praesertim in nervis); folia maxima 15-28 cm longa, 1/2-3/4 latiores quam longa. Domatia nulla. Nectaria foliorum 5-7, inconspicua (1-3 mm longa), nectario centrali distali disposito (ca. 3/4 e basi semotus), nectariis lateralibus basalibus vel sub-basalibus dispositus. Petioli punctati, glabrati vel puberuli infuscati minute, 1/4-1/2 longiori quam laminae (raro longiori). Stipulae lineares, puberulae, 2-4 mm longae, caducae. Pedicelli plures in axillis foliorum dispositi, stramini-puberuli, 0.5-1.5 cm longi ubi florens, ad 1-2.5 cm longi (raro ad 4 cm) ubi fructificans, gracilis (1 mm diametro). Nectaria involucralium nulla. Bracteolae involucralium 3, minutae (1-2 mm longae), lineares, puberulae dense, saepe caducae. Calyces stramini-puberuli dense et minute (praeter in margine plerumque glabros), 3-5 mm longi, campanulati angulatae, truncati, laceratescens et reflexescens in florem. Corollae flavi-lepidotae et nitidae extus ubi alabastrens, 10-13 mm diametro ubi florens, glabrae intus praeter ad basem ubi adnatas ad columnas androeciales; petala 5-8 mm longa, reflexa, epunctata vel punctatis petalorum paucissimis, alba vel eburnea. Flores staminati gynoeciis nullis, filamentis 5-6 mm longis et antheris fertilibus. Flores pistillati filamentis brevioribus (3 mm) et antheris sterilibus, stylis recurvatis, stigmatibus decurrentibus, 1-2 mm diametro, omnibus vix androecia excedentibus. Capsulae globosae (raro exiguae trigonae in sicco), 10-14 mm diametro, puberulentis subtiliter granulatis et flavo-virentibus dense obtectae extus, praeter pilos paucos (0.5 mm longos) ad suturas affixas glabrae intus, 3-loculares, stipitatae; paginae interior parietum carpelliorum albae, cum maculis irregularibus fuscatis. Semina arillata, glabra, nigra, 7-8 mm longa, in loculo solitaria.

description: Large shrub (5 m) or small to moderate sized tree (5-20 m tall), in wet lowland forest. Bark grayish. Twigs densely hoary (brownish puberulent). Leaves truncate or slightly cuneate, ovate (or sometimes elliptic), acute to acuminate, 5-7-nerved, glabrate above (except puberulent on main veins), brown-tomentose below, punctate, 13-26 cm long, about half as broad. Foliar nectaries 3-5 (sometimes 7), inconspicuous (1-2 mm long, rarely to 5 mm), the central one 1/2-3/4 distance from base of leaf, the lateral ones progressively nearer base. Petioles densely hoary (if tomentum worn off, punctate), 1/4-1/2 length of lamina. Stipules linear, 2-5 mm long, densely puberulent, caducous. Pedicels 0.5-1 cm long (in flower; rarely longer) to 1-3 cm long (in fruit), 1-3 mm diam., densely brownish yellow-puberulent, angular in flower, distally incrassate. Involucral nectaries lacking (or rarely weakly developed). Involucral bractlets linear, 1-3 mm long, inserted at base of calyx, puberulent, often persistent in fruit. Calyx globose to ovoid in bud, densely yellow-puberulent except usually glabrate and punctate along margin, 4-7 mm long, truncate usually becoming torn and reflexed in flower and fruit. Flowers 1.5-2 cm diam. Petals 1 cm long, shiny lepidote (pale yellow) without where exposed in bud, glabrous within, white, sparsely punctate, reflexed. Stamens (of staminate flowers) numerous; filaments 3-7 mm long, glabrous, punctate; anthers yellow. Stigma (of pistillate flowers) con- torted, approximately equaling petals; androecium reduced; anthers non-dehiscent. Capsules stipitate, densely and coarsely yellow-puberulent, 3-celled, globose to slightly elongate, 1.5-3.5 cm long (usually 2.5-3 cm), diam. the same or slightly less, glabrous within except suture usually fringed with simple hairs 1 mm long; carpel wall 1 mm thick. Seeds 2-4 per locule, angularly turbinate, arillate, dark brown, shiny glabrous, 6-10 mm long; aril approximately equaling (and partially enclosing) seed.

description: Moderate sized tree of dense forests. Bark grayish. Stems finely and densely brown-puberulent. Leaves with small basal auriculate appendages, truncate to cordate, ovate, acute to acuminate, markedly discolorous, 5-7-nerved, glabrate above (except puberulence retained on main veins), very densely and finely tan-puberulent below, 12-22 cm long, 1/2-2/3 as broad as long (rarely broader). Foliar nectaries 3-5, small (1-3 mm) but prominent because glabrous in contrast to lamina, the central one ca. 1/2 distance from leaf base, the lateral ones progressively nearer base, sometimes asymmetrically placed. Petioles densely puberulent, 1/3-2/3 length of lamina. Stipules linear, 5-8 mm. Pedicels 1-2 cm long (in flower) to 2-4.5 cm (in fruit), brown-puberulent, angular. Involucral nectaries sometimes present, often well developed in fruit. Involucral bractlets 3, linear, 1-5 mm long, brownish puberulent. Calyx 5-8 mm long, densely tan-puberulent, truncate becoming torn in flower and fruit. Petals 1-1.5 cm long, white, punctate, reflexed, densely yellow-lepidote without where exposed in bud, glabrous within except at base where a dense cushion of white hairs occurs at the juncture of the corolla and the androecial column. Staminate flowers with filaments 5-7 mm; anthers dehiscent; pistil lacking. Stamens (of pistillate flowers) reduced; filaments short, punctate; anthers non-dehiscent. Stigma clavate, recurved, pubescent, slightly exceeding androecium. Capsules 3- (rarely 4-) loculed, stipitate, woody, globose to slightly elongated, 2.5-3.5 cm long, densely yellowpuberulent without, glabrous within except for dense white pubescence on suture (hairs to 2 cm, directed inwards). Seeds 2-4 per locule, glabrous, arillate, ca. 8 mm long.

description: Large shrub or small tree with stellate-pubescent twigs, becoming glabrate stems. Leaves cordate or sometimes truncate, weakly 3-lobed, 7-9-nerved, acute to acuminate (or the lateral lobes rounded apically), discolorous, minutely and sparsely strigose above, densely pallid-tomentose below (hairs stellate below, typically with 8-10 arms, those above with 2 or 3 arms), punctate (especially on main veins below), with well developed domatia, up to 16 cm long, usually broader than long. Foliar nectary single, 1-3 mm, located near base of midvein, glabrous. Petioles 1/2 length of lamina to equaling lamina, tomentose, punctate. Stipules linear, 5 mm long, caducous. Pedicels 0.5-1.5 cm long (in flower), 1.5-2 mm diam., angular, densely yellow-brown- puberulent. Involucral nectaries 3, prominent, bordered (borders glabrous), 1.5-2 mm wide. Involucral bractlets often lacking (very early caducous?); when present, 7-10 mm long, puberulent. Calyx ovoid in bud, 7-12 mm long, densely yellow- puberulent, subtruncate or obscurely 5-lobed, becoming torn in flower. Petals white, 1.5-2 cm long, densely punctate, reflexed, puberulent without where exposed in bud, glabrate within except densely pubescent on claw. Stamens (of staminate flowers) numerous; filaments 5-7 mm, punctate; gynoecium lacking. Staminal column (of pistillate flowers) reduced; filaments 2-3 mm, punctate; anthers non-dehiscent; stigma exceeding androecium by 5 mm, recurved. Capsules 3-loculed, ovoid, greenish puberulent, 3.5 cm long, very woody; carpel wall 5 mm thick. Seeds arillate; aril much reduced.

description: Caulibus puberulis; foliorum lamina utrinque modice puberula, pilis supra rectis vel ascendentibus subtus appressis; petioli dense puberuli; paniculae 9-15 cm longae 3-4 cm latae; rhachides dense puberuli, rhachillis et pedicellis dense pilosis, bracteis ultimis lineari-lanceolatis, 3-3.5 mm longis, 0.8 mm latis, parce pilosis; calycis 5-5.5 mm longis, pilosis; corolla 1.4 cm longa, 7 mm lata ad medium, in fauce sensim angustato ad 5 mm; stamina orificium corollae 0.8-1.6 cm superantes, antheris 3 mm longis, 1.2 mm crassis.

description: Low, much branched shrub, erect or diffuse. Stem closely pubescent with ascending-incurved yellowish-brown hairs. Leaves numerous and close-set (the internodes 4-8 mm. long), the blades narrowly elliptic, obtuse, dentate with 3 or 4 pairs of rather low rounded teeth, coriaceous, above glabrous, beneath finely pubescent on the midrib, somewhat glutinous on both surfaces, the larger 0.8-1 cm. long, 3-4 mm. wide, on petioles 1.5-2 mm. long, which are ciliate laterally and pubescent medianly beneath. Racemes axillary, about 5-flowered, exceeding the leaves; rachis and pedicels closely pubescent with incurved or appressed yellowish-brown hairs; bractlets 4-6 mm. long, oblanceolate-linear, the pedicels 2-3 mm. long. Sepals 5 mm. long, elliptic-ovate, ciliate (and midrib pubescent) especially proximally. Corolla 8-10 mm. long, "red," rotate (lobes widely spreading, and tube flaring), externally and internally glabrous; posterior lobes wholly united, all lobes rounded, the antero-lateral orbicular-ovate, the mid-anterior slightly narrower. Stamens glabrous, the anthers less than half the length of the filaments. Style 5 mm. long. Capsule 4 mm. long. Seeds 0.5 mm. long, flattened, smooth, brown.

description: Lax, much branched shrub, 4-6 dm. tall. Stem densely pubescent with ascending-incurved brown hairs. Leaves numerous but relatively loosely set (the internodes mostly 5-15 mm. long), the blades elliptic or narrowly so, acute to obtusish, serrate with 5-7 pairs of acute or acutish teeth, coriaceous, pale beneath, glabrous on both surfaces (except for fine pubescence on midribs); the larger 1.5-2 cm. long, 8-10 mm. wide on petioles 1-2 mm. long, which are ciliate laterally and pubescent medianly beneath. Racemes axillary, 5-10-flowered, exceeding the leaves; rachis and pedicels densely pubescent with incurved or appressed brown hairs; bractlets 4 -7 mm. long, oblanceolate-linear, the pedicels 3-9 mm. long. Sepals 5-6 mm. long, elliptic-ovate, pubescent or at least ciliate. Corolla 8-12 mm. long, "red" (or "very dark red"), campanulate (lobes not spreading, but tube wide and cup-like), externally glabrous or slightly pilose with short hairs, internally glabrous; posterior lobes united nearly or quite to apex, the 3 anterior lobes alike, obovate-semicircular, retuse to emarginate. Stamens glabrous, the white anther less than half the length of the filament. Style 5 mm. long. Capsule 5 mm. long. Seeds 0.5 mm. long, flattened, smooth, brown.

description: Low, much branched, diffuse shrub. Stem pubescent with ascending-incurved brown hairs. Leaves numerous and close-set (the internodes 2-6 mm. long), the blades elliptic-lanceolate, obtuse, dentate with 2-5 pairs of rounded low (but somewhat projecting) teeth, coriaceous, above glabrous, beneath pubescent on the conspicuous midrib, the larger 0.5-1 cm. long, 2-4 mm. wide, on petioles 1.5-2 mm. long, which are ciliate laterally and pubescent medianly beneath. Racemes axillary, 2-4-flowered, exceeding the leaves; rachis and pedicels pubescent with spreading or ascending-incurved brown to grayish hairs; bractlets 4-6 mm. long, linear, obtuse, the pedicels 2-3 mm. long. Sepals 5-6 mm. long, elliptic-lanceolate, ciliate (and midrib pubescent) at least proximally. Corolla 9-12 mm. long, "pale pink," campanulate (lobes somewhat spreading and tube somewhat flaring and darker), externally and internally glabrous; posterior lobes wholly united, all lobes elliptic or oval, the anterior somewhat emarginate, the mid-anterior slightly the narrowest. Stamens glabrous, the anthers less than half the length of the filaments. Style 4-5 mm. long. Capsule 4 mm. long. Seeds 0.5 mm. long, flattened, smooth, brown.

description: Leaves all basal, 7-12 cm. long, slightly dilated at the mniddle, widely dilated distally, ciliate around the margin, glabrous within, the appendage cartilaginous, nearly eireular, eucullate, 5-10 mm. long. Pedicels elongating after (? and during) anthesis, eventually 4 cm. long, densely villous with short hairs. Sepals narrowly lanceolate or narrowly triangular-ovate, 2 cm. long, acuminate, thin and obscurely veined, elongating after anthesis to as much as 32 mm.

description: Treelet or tree 2-15(-22) m; shoots reddish-brown to grayish, sparsely puberulent to glabrous, somewhat smooth to longitudinally striate, with numerous pale lenticels. Leaves initially puberulent with short, white, appressed trichomes, but soon glabrescent or some trichomes persisting on petiole apex and leaflet bases; petiole (1-) 1.5-3.5(-4) cm long, slender, semiterete, adaxially flat to slightly or deeply canaliculate; leaflets brown-punctate on both surfaces, more conspicuously so abaxially, membranous to chartaceous, pale green to pale olive to pale brown, dull on both surfaces, sessile, lorate to narrow-oblong to narrow-elliptic or sometimes oblanceolate, margin slightly revolute, the apex apiculate by the involution of margin (the apiculum 1-4 mm long, straight to curled, somewhat rigid), base attenuate to cuneate and sym- metric, sometimes obtuse or slightly asymmetric on lateral leaflets, seldom the whole blade asymmetric; terminal leaflet (3.5-)6- 8.5(-9.5) x 1-1.7(-2.5) cm; lateral leaflets (3-)5-8.3(-9.5) X 0.5-1.5(-2.5) cm; mid- vein prominent on both surfaces (except distally); secondary veins (5-)8-11 per side, inconspicuous to prominulous abaxially. Inflorescence a diplothyrse 7-11(-14) cm long, much longer than the leaves, sparsely puberulent to subglabrous; peduncle 0-3 cm long; coflorescences 6-8(-16), opposite, proximal ones 5-8(-14) cm long and sometimes subopposite; bracts deltoid, acute, ca. 0.8 mm long, puberulent. Flowers (4-)5-merous; pedicel puberulent to sub-glabrous, 1-3 mm long; bractlets deltoid, puberulent. Sepals semiorbicular, rounded to obtuse, subglabrous and ciliolate, ca. 1 mm long, greenish. Petals cream-colored, oblong to elliptic, obtuse, 2-3 X ca. 1 mm, glabrous but adaxially minutely papillose, entire. Stamens ca. 2 mm long; anthers ovoid, yellow. Disk (4-)5-lobed, slightly shorter than the ovary, yellow. Ovary (4- )5-lobed, conspicuously glandular-verrucose, glabrous; style ca. 0.7 mm long; stigma (4-)5-lobed. Fruit of 4-5 mericarps, glabrous; seed locule ellipsoid, 5-9 mm long; wing oblong, 8-12 X 5-9 mm, membranous, veiny.

description: Tree(-let); shoots pale brown, glabrous, suberose, longitudinally fissured and ridged, with no evident lenticels, when young conspicuously brown-punctate (when dry). Leaves pubescent when very young, soon glabrescent or the petiole minutely puberulent; petiole (1.4-)2-4(-6) cm long, semiterete to canaliculate and sometimes narrowly winged (Ekman 15269), pale cream with many brown glandular dots; leaflets glaucous and conspicu- ously brown-punctate on both surfaces, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, shiny above, dull beneath, sessile, oblanceolate to narrow-obovate, margin flat to revolute, the apex obtuse to rounded, or sometimes truncate to emarginate, base decurrent to sometimes cuneate, in lateral leaflets slightly asymmetric; terminal leaflet (3-)5-8(-11) X (1.2-)1.8-3.8 cm; lateral leaflets 2.8- 6.5(-8) X (0.9-)1.4-3.5 cm; midvein flat adaxially (may be slightly raised only on the proximal portion), slightly raised and pale cream on abaxial surface, fading distally, secondary veins 5-7 per side, inconspicuous on both surfaces or sometimes slightly prominent abaxially. Inflorescence a diplothyrse 3-11.5 cm long, shorter or sometimes longer than the subjacent leaves, sparsely and minutely puberulous to generally glabrous, brown-punctate; peduncle 1-2 cm long; coflorescences 2-10, opposite, the proximal ones 1-8 cm long; bracts deltate, ca. 0.7 mm long, puberulous to ciliolate abaxially. Flowers 4-merous; pedicel minutely puberulous to glabrous, 1-2 mm long; bractlets deltoid, puberulous to ciliolate. Sepals suborbicular, puberulous, ca. 0.8 mm long, conspicuously punctate. Petals cream-colored, oblong, obtuse, ca. 2- 2.3 X 1.2 mm, glandular-punctate, entire. Stamens ca. 1.3 mm long; anthers ovoid. Disk 4-lobed. Ovary 4-lobed, glandular-tuberculate; style punctate, ca. 0.4 mm long; stigma subcapitate, 4-lobed. Fruit of 4 samaroid mericarps, glabrous; seed locule ellipsoid, ca. 0.9 mm long; wing obovate, to 15 X 0.9 mm, chartaceous, with raised veins and black punctations.

description: Treelet 1.5-4(-7) m; shoots pale gray to pale brown, glabrous, suberose, longitudinally fissured and rough, with many white lenticels. Leaves pubescent when very young, soon glabrescent or sparsely and minutely puberulous mainly on the petiole; petiole 0.5-2(-3) cm long, semiterete, slightly to deeply canaliculate adaxially; leaflets conspicuously punctate on both surfaces, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, greenish to olivaceous and shiny above, dull-green beneath, short-petiolulate to sessile, narrow-obovate to oblanceolate, margin flat to slightly revolute, apex obtuse and retuse to emarginate, base decurrent in the terminal leaflet, acute to decurrent but always asymmetric in the lateral leaflets; terminal leaflet 3.8-8(-9) X 1.8-3.4(-4.2) cm; lateral leaflets 3-7.8 X 1.4-2.5(-3.2) cm; midvein raised on both surfaces except distally, secondary veins 6-8 per side, prominulous to prominent on both surfaces. Inflorescence a diplothyrse 8-12 cm long, longer than the leaves, minutely pubescent to glabrous; peduncle 0-1.2 cm long; coflorescences ca. 6, opposite, the proximal ones 5-8 cm long; bracts ovate, acute, ca. 1 mm long, abaxially pubescent to ciliolate. Flowers (4-)5-merous; pedicel puberulous to glabrous, 1-2 mm long; bractlets ovate, puberulous to ciliolate. Sepals suborbicular, glabrous with ciliolate margin, 0.9 mm long, greenish. Petals white to cream-colored, oblong, obtuse, ca. 3.2 X 1.8 mm, ciliolate. Stamens ca. 1.8 mm long; anthers ovoid, rounded at apex, yellow. Disk (4-)5-lobed, shorter than the ovary, yellow. Ovary (4-)5-lobed, greenish, glabrous; style punctate, ca. 0.7 mm long; stigma slightly (4- )5-lobed. Fruit of 4 or 5 mericarps, glabrous; seed locule ellipsoid, ca. 10 mm long; wing oblong, 15-17 X 9-11 mm, chartaceous, veiny, glandular-punctate.

description: Shrub or treelet 2-3 m tall; shoots dark-brown to dark-grayish, longitudinally fis- sured, with many white lenticels. Leaves short-pubescent with cream-colored, erect to curved trichomes, soon glabrescent except persistently pubescent to sparsely so on main veins and on the petiole; petiole 1.5-4.2 cm long, cream-colored to yellowish, semiterete, flat adaxially to slightly canaliculate; leaflets punctate on both surfaces (brown dots), chartaceous to subcoriaceous, olivaceous, shiny above, dull beneath, short-petiolulate or sessile, narrow-elliptic to narrow-oblong to lanceolate, margin flat to slightly revolute, apex obtuse to retuse, base cuneate to acute in the terminal leaflet, acute and strongly asymmetric in the lateral leaflets; terminal leaflet 5.2-11.5 X 1.8-5.5 cm; lateral leaflets 3.5-9 X 1-3.8 cm; mid- vein raised on both surfaces, yellowish, the secondary veins 7-11 per side, prominent on both surfaces. description: Shrub or treelet 2-7 m tall, rarely a tree to 12 m (Pittier 9207); shoots pale gray to pale brownish, with many white lenticels. Leaves pubescent only when very young, soon completely glabrous or with scattered trichomes remaining on the distal portion of petiole; petiole (1-)2-3 cm long, deeply canaliculate adaxially; leaflets dark-punctate on both surfaces, chartaceous, sessile to seldom short-petiolulate, greenish to olive- brownish, shiny above, dull beneath, narrow-elliptic to narrow-obovate, margin slightly revolute, apex obtuse and often retuse to emarginate, seldom subacute, base cuneate to decurrent in the terminal leaflet, strongly asymmetric and acute to obtuse in the lateral leaflets; terminal leaflet 5-8(-9) X 2-3(-3.5) cm, lateral leaflets 3.5-7.2(-8) X 1.6-2.5(-3.2) cm; midvein raised on the proximal 3/4 of the blade on both surfaces, the secondary veins 5-8 per side, incon- spicuous. Fruit of (3-)4(-5) mericarps, glabrous; seed locule ellipsoid, 5-10 mm long; wing oblong, 10-14 X 9-11 mm, chartaceous, with slightly prominent veins, glandular-punctate.

description: Shrub to treelet 1-6 m; shoots pale brown and densely velutinous with white, slender, soft, straight, erect trichomes, glabrescent, turning grayish or brownish, longitudinally striate, with pale lenticels. Leaves velutinous mainly on the veins and petiole on both surfaces and more densely so on abaxial surface with white, soft, straight trichomes; petiole 1.2-2.5 cm long, semiterete, flat to slightly concave adaxially at its distal end, persistently velutinous; leaflets brown-punctate on both surfaces but more conspicuously adaxially, membranous, pale olive to pale brownish, dull on both surfaces, sessile, narrow-obovate to oblanceolate, margin slightly revolute and densely ciliate, apex rounded and emarginate, the base cuneate to decurrent on the terminal leaflet, acute and strongly asym- metric on the lateral ones; terminal leaflet 3.7-7.7(-9.5) X 1.6-2.7(-3.2) cm; lateral leaflets 2.8-5.5(-7.7) X 1.2-2.5 cm; mid- vein prominent on both surfaces except dis- tally; secondary veins 5-8 per side, prom- inulous on both surfaces. Inflorescence a di- plothyrse 5-9.5 cm long, shorter than the leaves, densely velutinous with white, soft, straight trichomes; peduncle 0-7 mm long; coflorescences 2-4, opposite, the proximal ones 4.5-8 cm long; bracts lanceolate, acute, 2-3 mm long, puberulous. Flowers 5-merous; pedicel velutinous, ca. 1 mm long; bractlets ovate, pubescent. Sepals sub-orbicular, ciliolate, 0.7 mm long. Petals cream-colored, oblong, obtuse, ca. 2.2 X 1 mm, margin ciliolate. Ovary 5-lobed, glandular-tuberculate, puberulous; style ca. 0.8 mm long; stigma slightly 5-lobed. Fruit of 5 mericarps, puberulous; seed locule ellipsoid, ca. 9 mm long; wing oblong-rounded, obtuse, 8-10 X 5-6 mm.

flowers (5.5-)7-10 mm. in diameter at anthesis, each subtended by 2 or 3 caducous bracteoles about 0.5 mm. long, the pedicels puberulent or glabrous, (1-)3-5 mm. long (above articulation); sepals submembranous to thin-carnose, often pale-puberulenit without, ovate-deltoid to semiorbicular, 0.9-1.5 mm. long, 0.9-2 (-2.8) mm. broad, sometimes glandular-punetate or -lineolate, subacute to rounded at apex, entire or erosulous and often seariose at margiins; description: Plants herbaceous to suffrutescent, usually less than 1 m in height, erect to procumbent, glabrous to somewhat pubescent; leaf blades narrowed at base to frequently not clearly distinguishable petioles, blades 2.2-8.5 cm, membranaceous, narrowly ovate to lanceolate, usually long acute at apex, widest below the middle; flowers bisexual, disposed in 1-several cymules clustered in the leaf axils, the ovate to lanceolate, acuminate floral bracts about 2 mm long, and ovate to deltoid-ovate bracteoles 1-2 mm long; sepals ovate to lanceolate, acute to acuminate at apex, 2-2.9 mm long; stamens with filaments 1-1.5 mm long at anthesis and with anthers about 0.2 mm; ovary lenticular-ovate, about 1.5 mm long at anthesis; style 0.5-0.8 mm and 2 stigmas 0.1-0.2 mm long; fruit about 2 mm long, indehiscent, infrequently irregularly dehiscent at base where the pericarp may be thinner; seed 1-1.8 mm long, without an aril, the testa black, shining, minutely reticulate.

description: Liania, climbing to 5-20 m; stems at base 2-6 cm diam., the cross-section cylindrical, irregularly sulcate, or rarely slightly flattened, twisted, glabrate, developing small scattered lenticels. Leaves mostly plane, opposite or rarely subopposite on the same stem, spreading; petiole 16-35 mm long, initially sericeous and soon glabrate, bearing a pair of glands at base, each gland 2-3 mm diam.; stipules present on petiole, above base, as minute protuberances 0.1-0.3 mm long, apparently absent from old leaves; lamina of larger leaves (8.5-)1 0.2-23.8(-25) x (6.5-)7-16.8(-17) cm, membranous, ovate, oblong, elliptic, subrotund, ovate-lanceolate, or cordate-orbicular, rarely oblong-lanceolate or widely lanceolate, often asymmetrical, obtuse, rounded or cordate, rarely slightly cuneate at base, acute, cuspidate, retuse to obtuse-rounded, rarely acuminate at apex, the margins bearing toothlike extensions with many small glands or short cilia on borders, especially in young leaves, glabrous or initially sparsely sericeous (with short, appressed, medifixed hairs) and soon glabrescent, the lateral veins slightly prominent below, reticulum very fine and more visible below than above. Inflorescence paniculate, spreading, 20-38 cm long, pri- mary branches 10-22, 0.5-15.5 cm long, secondary branches 6-18 or absent, 0.5-2 cm long, tertiary branches if present ca. 0.5 cm long, accessory branches evident; terminal or axillary, densely and persistently brown-sericeous, pendulous, with the flowers borne ultimately in congested and dense 4-6-flowered umbels; inflorescence bracts like leaves, gradually or abruptly reduced to 5-6 X ca. 3.6 mm, the margins entire, biglandular at base or eglandular, the glands ca. 1.5 mm diam., bright green; peduncle absent; bracts 1.9- 2.2 X 2.4-2.5 mm, broadly ovate, eglandular or bearing 1-2 small glands at base, abaxially densely sericeous, adaxially gla- brous; bracteoles like bracts but smaller, eglandular; pedicel (3.5-)4-7.3 X 1.2-5 mm, straight, densely brown-sericeous, abruptly thickened distally. Sepals 3-3.5 X 2.5-3 mm, brown, rounded at apex, strongly appressed against filaments in anthesis, abaxially densely sericeous, adaxially glabrous, the anterior sepal eglandular, the lateral 4 biglandular, the glands 3.5-4.7 mm long, elliptic. Petals exposed in the enlarging bud, pale yellow suffused with red principally near the claw, glabrous, thickened in center of limb but not carinate; lateral petals spreading, margins proximally strongly erose and revolute in anthesis (principally 2 posterior-lateral petals), claw 3.2-3.5 mm long, limb 4-5 X 4.5-5 mm, orbicular and deeply concave; posterior petal sub-erect, glandular-thickened at margins, claw 3.5-3.7 mm long, limb ca. 3.5 X 4.2 mm, triangular and nearly flat. Stamens glabrous; filaments strongly heteromorphic, 3.7-5.2 X 0.3-0.9 mm, connate l/3-l/2 their length, the 2 stamens op- posite posterior-lateral petals much thicker than others and straight, ca. 5 mm long, longest stamen opposite anterior sepal coherent with adjacent filaments and bent inward, ca. 5.2 mm long, shortest stamen opposite posterior petal, ca. 3.7 mm long, other stamens 4-4.5 mm long; anthers (1.8-)2-2.5(-2.8) mm long, strongly unequal, reflexed in anthesis, connective distally widened so as to displace the locules laterally and sometimes elongated so as to exceed the locules, the proximal 2/3-4/5 dark red, the distal 1/5-1/3 pale yellow. Ovary 1.5-1.7 mm high, densely sericeous; styles 3.5-4.2 mm long, equalling or slightly exceeding the anthers, glabrous or proximally sericeous, all 3 with a flattened elliptic top and internal stigma; anterior style nearly straight, dorsally strongly apiculate at apex; posterior styles somewhat lyrate, usually dorsally slightly apiculate at apex. Samara brown at maturity, (38-)46-50 mm long, borne obliquely, thinly sericeous to glabrate; dorsal wing almost as long as samara, 30-40 X 15-20 mm, the abaxial edge nearly straight; nut 8-9 mm diam., subspheroidal, smooth-sided, without lat- eral crests or winglets.

description: Liana vel frutex, ramis glabratis. Folia opposita; petiolus 3-6 mm longus, eglandulosus; lamina foliorum majorum 4.7-15.2 cm longa, 1.8-6.4 cm lata, oblonga, oblongo-lanceolata, obovato-oblonga vel lanceolata, margine integra vel sinuata, abaxialiter pertinaciter metallosericea, subtus basi 2 glandulis magnis. Inflorescentia in paniculam erectam disposita, axillaris et terminalis, sericea, floribus in umbellis vel corymbis 3-6-floris, pedunculis 5.5-7.7 mm longis, complanatis, pedicellis 5.7-7 mm longis. Petala flava, patentia, in alabastro exposita, 4 lateralia obtusa, basi truncata, petalum posticum limbo proximaliter glanduloso-dentato. Filamenta abaxialiter sericea. Samarae 31-47 mm longae, 15-20 mm latae, nuce laevi.

description: Liana climbing to 5-10 m, or shrub to 1-1.8 m tall when nothing is available to climb on; stems 1-1.5 cm diam. at base, cylindrical in cross-section, glabrate, developing scattered lenticels. Leaves mostly plane, opposite; petiole 3-6 mm long, initially sericeous to glabrate, eglandular; stipules present on petiole, above the base as minute protuberances 0.1-0.2 mm long, often hidden by hairs, very soon deciduous; lamina of larger leaves (4.7-)6.7-11.7(-15.2) X (1.8-)3.5-6.4 cm, membranous to chartaceous, oblong, oblong-lanceolate, obovate-oblong to widely lanceolate, the base obtuse or slightly cuneate, the apex of- ten acute, obtuse, rounded or sometimes acuminate, the margins entire or sometimes slightly sinuate (principally in young leaves), flat; lamina bearing 2 large glands abaxially at base, one each abaxially below on either side of midrib, and a row of small submarginal glands from base to apex (sometimes in sinuses), glabrous above, with densely and persistently silvery or me- tallic-sericeous indument below, the hairs sessile, straight and appressed, the lateral veins more prominent below, the reticulum more visible below than above. Inflores- cence a much-branched panicle, terminal or axillary, erect, persistently brown-seri- ceous, with flowers borne ultimately in um- bels or corymbs of (3-)4-6 or more flow- ers; inflorescence bracts like the leaves, gradually reduced to 1-10 X 0.5-5 mm, ob- long to lanceolate, the margins entire; pe- duncle 5.5-7.7 X 1-1.5 mm, uniformly slender, slightly flattened laterally, straight, densely brown-sericeous; bracts 1.3-1.5 X 0.8-0.9 mm, ovate, eglandular, abaxially densely sericeous, adaxially glabrous; brac- teoles like the bracts but smaller; pedicel 5.7-7 X 1-1.8 mm, (6.8-8 X 1-2 mm in fruit), curved upward in flower, densely brown-sericeous, uniformly thicker distally. Sepals 1.5-1.7 X 1.2-1.3 mm, brown, rounded at apex, appressed against fila- ments in anthesis, abaxially densely seri- ceous, adaxially glabrous; lateral 4 sepals biglandular, the glands 2.8-3.5 mm long, green, turning yellow with age, free at apex, elliptic (in some plants the glands adjacent to anterior sepal form a U, showing that all sepals are biglandular). Petals exposed in the enlarging bud, yellow turning orange with age, glabrous, thickened in claw and center of limb but not carinate, narrowly flat; lateral petals spreading, the margin erose, the claw 2.4-2.7 mm long, the limb 3.5 X 2.6-2.8 mm, obtuse, truncate at base; posterior petal suberect, glandular-dentate on the proximal 1/2-2/3, the claw ca. 2.7 mm long, the limb 3-3.5 X 2.2-2.4 mm, triangular or obtuse, truncate at base. Filaments 2-2.4 X 0.3-0.7 mm, abaxially sparsely sericeous, connate 1/3-1/2 their length, distally curved sideways or backward; anthers 1.1-1.3 mm long, subequal, reflexed at anthesis, the connective dark red. Ovary 1.2-1.5 mm high, densely sericeous; styles 1.7-1.8 mm long, as long as the anthers, glabrous, straight or slightly divergent distally, all 3 dorsally apiculate at apex, with stigma internal and vertically elliptical. Samara cream-colored at maturity, (31-)40-47 mm long, borne suberect, thinly sericeous to glabrate; dorsal wing almost as long as the samara, 27-41 X 15-20 mm, the abaxial edge nearly straight; nut 12-14 mm diam., subspheroidal, smooth-sided, without lateral wings or crests.

description: Liana, ramis glabrescentibus. Lamina foliorum majorum 7.9-14.2 cm longa, 3.2-9.5 cm lata, oblonga, cordato-oblonga vel elliptica, bullata, basi cordata, glabrescens, petiolis 22-48 mm longis, confluentibus no- dis, basi biglandulosis. Panicula 9.5-35 cm longa, deflexa, umbellis 4-floris, pedunculo florifero nullo, ped- icellis 4.8-6.6 mm longis. Petala lutea, in alabastro exposita, patentia, abaxialiter laevia, marginibus integris; stylis posticis arcuatis, in apice dorsaliter rotundato vel truncato. Samarae 29-52 mm longae, nuce lateraliter laevi.
