description: Herb 60-75 cm tall; roots tuberous at apex; rhizomes slender, with long internodes; vegetative stems foliose, 20-65 cm long, ca. 5 mm diam., with a reddish purple tinge when young, the leaves aggregated at the apex; flowering stems appearing before the vegetative, purple when young, 65-75 cm x 4-5 mm; vegetative leaves 10-12, aggregated at stem apex, resupinate, broadly oblanceolate, 6.5-18.5 X 2.5-7 cm, dark green abaxially (above due to resupination), glaucous and prominently ribbed adaxially, obtuse apically, abruptly narrowing at the base to a nonsheathing pseudopetiole; leaves of the flowering stems reduced to membranous, linear-lanceolate bracts that are soon scarious, 1.2-2.2 cm X 1-2 mm, sessile, acute at the apex. Inflorescence of 8-12 cymes (rays), each 1-2-flowered, subtended by 8-12 linear-lanceolate bracts variably (among populations) 3-4 cm X 2-3 mm or ca. 2 cm X 1-1.5 mm; pedicels slender, subtended by a small scarious bracteole, 2-7 mm long. Flowers 13-15, 4-4.5 cm long; perianth zygomorphic, funnelform-campanulate, 4-4.5 mm wide at base, spreading to 2 cm distally; tepals of outer whorl 3.5-4 cm long, ca. 8 mm wide at middle, obtrullate, abruptly acuminate at apex, attenuate to slightly unguiculate at base, 3-nerved, the margins serrulate above the middle, abaxial surface yellowish white, suffused with reddish brown at base, ad- axial surface whitish green with 3 maroon striations the length of the tepal; inner tepals 3.5-3.6 (two lateral) or 3.9-4.1 (ventral) cm long, 4.7-5.4 mm wide at middle, narrowly obtrullate, acute at apex, attenuate-unguiculate at base, the margins coarsely serrate to crenate in upper half, abaxial surface light yellowish green, maroon at base, with elongated purple-brown spots, adaxial surface light yellowish green with median purple-brown striation and elongate spots on either side; stamens with filaments 30-32 mm long; anthers ca. 4 X 1.7 mm, purple, latrorse; pollen yellow; style filiform, ca. 3 cm long; stigma 3.4-3.7 mm wide; ovary obconic, ca. 3 mm diam., prominently 6-ribbed. Fruit slightly woody, ellipsoidal, ca. 10 X 8-9 mm, slightly umbonate at apex; seeds 4-6 per locule, globose, ca. 3.4 mm diam., with a tan, verrucose testa. 2n = 16.

description: Beaucarnea compacta sp. nov. B. gracilis Lem. siinilis, sed differt habitu generali rosulis sessilibus, inflorescentiae ramis simplicibus et fructibus apiculatis.

description: Dioecious shrubs with subglobose base, 40-60 cm high, 0.8-1.0 m diam.; bark fissured into a polyhedral pattern, reddishgray to reddish-brown; leafy rosettes sessile, obconical, with very reduced branches. Leaves linear, erect, long acuminate, 50-75 cm long, 10-12 mm wide at the middle, glaucous green, papillate, margins pale-green to yellow-green, denticulate, leaf base deltoid; teeth translucent, persistent. Info- rescences paniculate, ovoid to ellipsoid, 1.5-2.0 m long, 1.0-1.2 cm diam. at the base; scape ca. 20 cm long, bracts linear, occasionally undulate, long-acuminate with deltoid bases, pale-green to whitish; branching starting at 0.8-1.0 m high above base of scape, main axis green at the base, branches usually simple, reddish to pale-yellow, ascending, the larger branches 29- 32 cm long, the shorter branches 11-15 cm long; fertile nodes 80-100, each one forming terminal cymes (rhipidia); bracts sub- tending inflorescence branches lanceolate to triangular, 1.2-3.5 mm long, veins 3 to 9; bracts subtending cymes deltoid, 1.0-2.0 mm long with one central vein; bracteoles 1 mm long. Staminate flowers 5-7(-8) per node, creamy yellow tinged with purple, fragrant; pedicels 0.5-1.5 mm long articu- lated below the flower, flowers appearing almost sessile; perianth segments ovate to oblong, concave, 1.5-1.7 mm long, not reflexing at anthesis, with the stamens slightly exserted; anthers dorsifixed; ovary aborted or reduced. Pistillate flowers 2 to 4 per node, creamy yellow, pedicels 1.5-3.0 mm long, articulate at or above the middle; perianth segments ovate to lanceolate, 1.5-2.0 mm long; ovary 3-carpellate, two ovules per carpel, unilocular, ellipsoid, trigonous, apically winged, with nectaries basally septal; style ca. 0.5 mm long, stigmatic lobes round; rudimentary stamens present, translucent. Fruit pedicels enlarged at maturity, 2.5-4.0 mm long, articulated at or above the middle. Fruit an indehiscent capsule, 3-winged, pyriform to ovoid, 8-9 X 4-5 mm, immature fruit pale-green tinged with purple, yellow at maturity, apices apiculate; perianth segments persistent, appressed; stigmatic branches persistent, dark brown. Seeds one per fruit, 3-lobate, one lobe larger than the other two ovoid, 4 X 3 mm; testa rugose, red-brown.

description: Calibainus glassianus sp. nov. C. hookerii (Rose) Trel. similis, a quo differt habitu conico ramis apicalibus, inflorescentia longiore ex rosulis eminenti, et fructibus minoribus costis rubellis.
bibliographicCitation: Hernández, Lionel & Zamudio Ruiz, Sergio. 2003. Two new remarkable Nolinaceae from Central Mexico. Brittonia. 55: 226-232.

description: Dioecious shrub, conical, 60-80 X 40- 60 cm, bark fissured into a polyhedral pattern below and rugose above, dark gray; branches >4 at maturity, sessile or reduced, grouped at the apex of the plant. Leaves erect, recurved and reflexed from above the base, linear, long acuminate, 1.1-1.2 m long, 7-9 mm wide at the middle, glaucous green, scarcely papillate, margins denticulate, teeth translucent, some double teeth present, persistent, leaf base deltate. Inflorescences paniculate, ovoid, 1.5-1.7 m long, 1.0-1.2 cm diam. at the base, the bracts of scape linear, long-acuminate with triangular bases, yellow, the branching starts at 20-25 cm above base of scape, main axis green at the base, branches compound, reddish to pale-yellow; the larger branches 28-30 cm long, the shorter branches 16-18 cm long; fertile nodes 80 to 110, each node forming terminal cymes (rhipidia); secondary branches basal, bracts subtending branches linear, the larger bracts 23-29 cm long, the shorter bracts 3-4 cm long; bracts subtending the cymes lanceolate, 2.5-3.0 mm long with one central vein, margins membranous; bracteoles to 2 mm long, with tiny purple spots. Staminate flowers 3 to 4 per node, creamy yellow, fragrant; pedicels 1.0-2.5 mm long, articulated at or above the middle; perianth segments oblong, elliptic to orbicular, concave, 1.8-2.75 X 1.5-2.0 mm, the outer series slightly smaller than the inner series; stamens exerted, 2-3 mm long, anther dorsi-fixed; ovary reduced. Pistillate flowers 2 to 4 per node, creamy yellow, almost translucent; pedicels 1.0-2.5 mm long, articulate at or above the middle; perianth segments elliptic, orbicular to oblate, concave 1.2-2.0 mm long, the external series smaller; ovary 3-carpellate, two ovules per carpel, unilocular, ellipsoid, six-angled at the base, apically winged, nectaries basally septal; style ca. 0.7 mm, stigmatic lobes tuberculate; rudimentary stamens present, translucent. Pedicels enlarged at maturity of fruits, 2.5- 4.0 mm long, articulate at or above the mid- dle. Fruit a depressed globose nut, 3-ribbed, 4.5-5.0 mm long, 4.0-4.5 wide, yellow with purple spots when mature, the costae reddish; perianth segments persistent, appressed; stigmatic branches persistent. Seed one per fruit, 2.5-4.5 mm diam., testa rugose, red-brown.
bibliographicCitation: Hernández, Lionel & Zamudio Ruiz, Sergio. 2003. Two new remarkable Nolinaceae from Central Mexico. Brittonia. 55: 226-232.

description: Caulis altus, striatus. Folia 6-7, oblonga vel oblongo-lanceolata, apice subito attenuata, sensim ad basim in petiolum attenuata, quinquenervia; lamina 17.5-26 cm long, 5.5-10 cm lata, petiolus ad 4.5 cm longus. Pedunculus 10-13 cm longus. Sepala 6-7, lanceolata, basi in unguem brevem angustata, apice longe et tenuiter acutata, 8-13 cm longa et 1.7-4 cm lata. Petala obscure purpurea, 7.5-11 cm longa, in dimidio superiore leviter dilatata (ad 4.5 mm), calice breviora. Stamina 15-20, petalis multo breviora, 1.5-2.5 cm longa; antherae 1-2 cm longae; connectivum ultra antherae apicem in appen- diculum (1.5-2 mm, interdum 2.5 mm) productum. Ovarium pyramidato-angulatum, truncatum, apicem cum plica transversa; styli 6 ad basim ± coaliti; stigmata incrassata, recurva.

description: Herb, about 15-40 (45) cm high. Rhizome short, about 1-1.5 cm in diam. Stems slender. Leaves (5) 6-10; blade membranaceous, oblong-lanceolate or lan- ceolate, 3-nerved, (4.5) 7-8 (13) cm long and (0.5) 2-3 (5.3) cm wide; petiole 0.3- 1 (1.3) cm long. Peduncle usually shorter than leaves, occasionally slightly longer, 4-8.5 (20) cm long. Sepals (3) 5-6 (9), lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, acuminate, (1.5) 1.7-2.5 (7) cm long, 0.4-1.3 cm wide. Petals usually much longer than sepals, up to 5-7 cm long, thread-like. Stamens 10-12; anthers longer than filaments, 6- 8 (10) mm long, but sometimes only 2.5 mm long. Ovary angular; styles 4-5, united to above the middle.
bibliographicCitation: Takhtajan, Armen Leonovich. 1983. A revision of Daiswa (Trilliaceae). Brittonia. 35: 255-270.

description: Herba ad 50-55 cm alta. Rhizoma ad 10 cm longum ad 2 cm diametro. Caulis tenuis. Folia 5, petiolata; lamina ovata, basi cordata, apice attenuata, quinquenervia, 11-13 cm longa, 8-9 cm lata, variegata; petiolus 4.5 cm longus. Pedunculus 20 cm longus. Sepala 5, ovato-lanceolata, basi angustata, apice attenuata, 5.5 cm longa et 2 cm lata. Petala filiformia, sepalis breviora, ad 4.2 cm longa. Stamina 20, 2 cm longa; antherae 1.5 cm longae; connectivum ultra antherae apicem in appendiculum breve (1.5-2 mm longum) productum. Ovarium ovato-globosum; styli 5, plusminusve liben. Capsula ignota.

description: Herb, about 40-65 cm high. Rhizome short, about 1.5-2 cm in diam. Leaves 6-8; blade membranous, with 1 lateral vein on each side of the midrib, oblong- lanceolate, apically acuminate, basally gradually narrowed, 10-16 cm long, 3.5- 5 cm wide; petiole (0.7) 1.5-2.5 (4) cm long. Petals usually dark purple, much shorter than sepals. Stamens (8) 10-12, about 1-1.5 cm long; free portion of the connective brownish, (0.5) 2-3 mm long. Ovary ovate or ovate-cylindrical, angular and 6-winged, truncate, the upper side together with styles brown, with crenulate transverse rim; styles 6, united at base.
bibliographicCitation: Takhtajan, Armen Leonovich. 1983. A revision of Daiswa (Trilliaceae). Brittonia. 35: 255-270.

description: A robust herb about 0.8-1 m tall. Rhizome thick and very short. Stems thick, striate. Leaves 5-6, very large; blade oblong, slightly cordate at the base, with 2 or 3 lateral veins on each side of the midrib, 22-25 cm long and (7.5) 11-15 cm wide; petiole 4-7 cm long. Peduncle up to 70 cm long. Sepals 5, lanceolate, sessile, more or less gradually attenuate, 3.5-4.2 (7) cm long. Petals much shorter than sepals and only slightly longer than stamens, 1. 5-3 cm long and about 1 mm wide. Stamens 10-12, with short filaments and anthers about 1 cm long; free portion of connective no more than 1 mm long. Ovary pyramidal, truncate, with 5-6 ribs (almost winged); styles 5-6, thick, united at the very base, 8 mm long. Capsule about 3 cm diam. Seeds numerous, large.
bibliographicCitation: Takhtajan, Armen Leonovich. 1983. A revision of Daiswa (Trilliaceae). Brittonia. 35: 255-270.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Herb up to 100 cm high. Rhizome short, about 2-2.5 cm in diameter. Leaves 4-6 (7); blade membranous, ovate or wide-ovate, basally rounded or cordate, with 2 or sometimes 3 lateral veins on each side of the midrib, (7.5) 9-15 (20) cm long and 5-10 (at the later stages about 15) cm wide, abruptly acuminate; petiole 1.5-7 (at the later stages about 1 1) cm long. Peduncle 8-60 cm long. Sepals 4-6, short-clawed, lanceolate, more or less gradually acuminate, membranous, yellowish-green, at the later stages of development leaf-like, (3.8) 8-10 (at the later stages about 11) cm long and 1-3 (4) cm wide. Petals filiform, longer than sepals. Stamens 6-12; anthers short (4-6 mm long), oblong, usually almost equal to filaments or slightly longer; free portion of connective roundish, 0.8-1 mm long, brown, carnose, with the apex markedly notched (emarginate). Ovary ovate- pyramidal; styles usually 5, almost free or more or less united. Capsule angular, ovoid or ovoid-spheroidal.
bibliographicCitation: Takhtajan, Armen Leonovich. 1983. A revision of Daiswa (Trilliaceae). Brittonia. 35: 255-270.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Herba ad 75 cm alta. Rhizoma breve, ad 1.5 cm diametro. Caulis tenuis. Folia (4) 5-6 (7), petiolata; lamina ovato-oblonga vel oblonga, basi plusminusve cordata, apice subito attenuata, trinervis, (5) 7-13 cm longa, 3.5-4.8 cm lata; petiolus (0.8) 1-2 (2.5) cm longus. Pedunculus (2) 4.5-8.5 (12.5) cm longus. Sepala 5-6 (7), ovata vel lanceolata, basi angustata, apice attenuata, (1.2) 2-3.5 cm longa et (0.6) 1.2-1.9 cm lata. Petala filiformia, ad normam sepalis multo longiora, ad 6.5 (interdum 9) cm longa. Stamina (10) 12-14, brevia (0.8-1.4 cm longa); antherae aurantiae, longitudine filamentum aequantes vel paulo superantes; connectivum ultra antherae apicem in appendiculum breviusculum (ad 0.3 mm longum) productum. Ovarium pyramidatum, plusminusve truncatum, apice cum margine collariformi transversa; styli 5 vel 4, plusminusve connata. Capsula subglobosa, circa 1.4 cm diametro.
bibliographicCitation: Takhtajan, Armen Leonovich. 1983. A revision of Daiswa (Trilliaceae). Brittonia. 35: 255-270.

description: Herba usque 1.5 m alta. Rhizoma ad 3.5 cm crassum. Folia 6-7, membranacea, nitida, obovata vel oblongo-obovata, apice breviter abrupte acuminata, basi subacuta, quinquenervia; lamina (18) 23-24 cm longa (11) 14-15.5 cm lata, petiolus 5-6 (6.5) cm longus. Pedunculus 45-75 cm longus. Sepala 6, lanceolata, acuminata, membranacea, circiter 7-8 cm longa. Petala 6, in dimidio superiore leviter dilatata et flavovirentia, calice longiores (8-9 cm longa). Stamina 12, petalis multo breviora, 3-6 cm longa; antherae 2.2 cm longae; connectivum ultra antherae apicem in appendiculum (3.5-4 mm longum) productum. Ovarium pyramidatum, truncatum, apice cum plica transversa. Styli 6, ad basim ± coaliti; stigmata incrassata, recurva. Ovarium et styli violacei.
bibliographicCitation: Takhtajan, Armen Leonovich. 1983. A revision of Daiswa (Trilliaceae). Brittonia. 35: 255-270.

description: Plants (15) 40-65 cm high. Rhizome short. Leaves (8) 11-22, linear or lanceo- late, acuminate and gradually narrowed at the base, with a very short petiole or sessile, with a prominent midrib, (5.5) 10-12 (19) cm long and 0.6-1 (3) cm wide. Peduncle (1.5) 3-18 cm long. Sepals 4-10, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, abruptly narrowed at base, (2) 3-6.5 cm long and (0.5) 0.6-0.9 (1.3) cm wide. Petals 4-8, filiform or subulate, usually longer than sepals, 3.5-7.5 (9) cm long. Stamens (8) 12-20, about 1 cm long with anthers somewhat longer than the filaments; free portion of the connective very short, usually no more than 0.5 mm long, rarely up to 2 mm long. Ovary angular, more or less truncate; styles 4-10, usually shortly united at the base.
bibliographicCitation: Takhtajan, Armen Leonovich. 1983. A revision of Daiswa (Trilliaceae). Brittonia. 35: 255-270.
rights: Content licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License

description: Herb about 30-60 cm high, rarely only 10-15 or up to 120 cm high. Rhizome about 1.5 cm in diam. Leaves 6-9; blade lanceolate to oblong, acuminate, nar- rowed at the base, 3-nerved (with 1 lateral vein on each side of the midrib), 7- 15 (22) cm long and 1.5-3 cm wide; petiole usually 1-2.5 (5) cm long, frequently more or less purple. Peduncle usually much shorter than leaves. Sepals (3-4) 5 (6-7), oblong-lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, sessile, acuminate, (2) 2.5-8 (up to 12.5, Lace 877) cm long. Petals usually yellow or yellowish-green, rarely purple, thread-like, usually flat in the lower part, awl-shaped in the upper part, frequently somewhat widened toward the tip, usually shorter than sepals. Stamens usually 10, rarely 4, 6, 8 or 12-16, free portion of connective usually very short and not longer than 1 mm. Ovary angular; styles usually 4-5, more or less united at the base, usually golden-yellow.

description: Herb, about 25-45 cm high. Rhizome short. Stems slender, reddish, the upper part covered with transparent papillose hairs. Leaves 6-7 (10), oblong, narrowed at the base, abruptly acuminate, with papilla-like hairs along the margins; blade 5-9.5 cm long and 1.5-3.5 cm wide; petiole 2-6 mm long, densely covered with very short papillose hairs, which are scattered also on the lower side of the blades and sepals, mainly along the nerves. Peduncle 2.5-6.5 cm long, the upper part with transparent papillose hairs. Sepals (4) 5-6, oblong-lanceolate, narrowed at the base, acuminate, 2.5-4.8 cm long and 7-12 mm wide. Petals filiform, equal to or longer than sepals. Stamens 10-12, about 8.5-10 mm long; anthers longer than the filaments, with a very short free portion of the connective. Ovary ovate- pyramidal, 5-angular, truncate, crowned by rounded teeth; styles 5, more or less united.

description: Herb about 10-90 cm high. Stems slender, striate. Leaves 7-9 (11), membranaceous, lanceolate or narrow lanceolate, acuminate, at base narrowed, three-nerved, sessile or rarely with a short petiole up to 1 cm long; blade 5-7 (up to 16.5) cm long and 0.9-1.5 (up to 5.4) cm wide. Sepals 5, sometimes 4 or 6, rarely 3, lanceolate, acuminate, sessile, (2.5) 3-4 (up to 7.5) cm long. Petals linear-awl-shaped, equal to the sepals or shorter, about 0.5 mm wide, sometimes absent. Stamens usually 10, sometimes 8 or 12 (when 4 or 6 sepals), rarely 6; filaments 3-6 mm long, narrow, anthers (4) 6-9 (15) mm long; the free portion of connective long, equal to anther or longer (6) 11-12 (17.5) mm long, rarely 3.5-5 mm long (var. appendiculata). Ovary ovate-roundish, truncate; styles 5, sometimes 6, rarely 3, thick, short, at base slightly united, recurved.

description: Herb, to 20 cm high. Rhizome short, thick, about 0.8 cm in diam. Stems slender. Leaves 4-6, lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate or sometimes obovate, acuminate, narrowed at base into a very short petiole or almost sessile, 3.2-6.5 cm long and 1.4-3.7 cm wide, with short papillose hairs along the margins, with prominent midrib, dark green with whitish-variegated veins above, dark purplish below. Peduncle short, about 0.7-2 (5) cm long. Sepals 3-4 (5), sessile, narrow lanceolate to ovate, acuminate, 20-30 mm long and 5-10 mm wide (seldom smaller, 8-9 X 4-4.5 mm), with short papillose hairs along the margins, with variegated veins. Petals filiform, from somewhat shorter to much longer than sepals, about 17-25 mm long and 0.5 mm wide, purplish in upper part, greenish in lower part. Stamens 6-8 (10), about 5-7 mm long; anthers 1.5-4 mm long, almost without a free portion of the connective. Ovary almost spheroidal, green (purple); styles 3, about 1-1.5 mm long, dark purplish, slightly united at the base. Capsule very fleshy, red.

description: Herb (12) 20-80 cm high. Rhizome short, about 2 cm diam. Stems thick, striate. Leaves (5) 6-8 (14) thickish; blade ovate-oblong to lanceolate, apically abruptly acuminate, basally cuneate, more or less undulate along the margins with 2 lateral veins on each side of the midrib, (4.5) 7-11 cm long, (1.5) 2.5-4 (4.5) cm wide; petiole (0.5) 1.5-2 (2.5) cm. Peduncle (1.5) 5-10 (13.5) cm. Sepals (4) 6-8 (10), lanceolate, (2.5) 4-7.5 cm long and 1-2 (2.5) cm wide, similar to leaves in venation and texture. Petals golden-yellow, usually longer than sepals, (3.3) 5-10 cm long, (0.5) 1.5-3 mm wide, rarely 10 mm wide (Delavay 3020, P). Stamens (12) 20- 24, (1.5) 2-3 cm long; anthers somewhat longer than filaments, 7-15 mm long; free portion of the connective 1-2 mm long. Ovary ovate-roundish, angulate, with narrow longitudinal wings; styles 4-10, recurved, 4-5 mm long, united only at the base. Capsule roundish.

description: Perennials with short woody trunks. Leaves long and somewhat drooping; leaf bases spoon-shaped; blade 75-135 cm long, 1-2.5 cm at base, the surface bright green or tinged with purple, smooth, shiny, glabrous, not waxy-glaucous; prickles curved forward, to 2 mm long. Inflorescences 2-4 m, often tinged with pink; fertile bracts lanceolate, ca. 6 X ca. 2.2 cm, often purple.Staminate plants not seen. Pistillate flower fascicles with 5-7 branches; central axis to 2.5 cm; side branches 8-12 cm, spreading. Pistillate flowers with laciniate bract ca. 2.5 X 3 mm; receptacle 0.4-1 mm; tepals ca. 2 X ca. 1 mm, denticulate, tinged with purple; styles 0.2-0.4 mm; stigma 0.2-0.6 mm. Fruits tinged with purple, broadly obovate to obcordate, 9-11.5 X 8-10 mm; pedicel 2-2.2 mm in fruit; apical lobes 4-4.5 mm, widely divergent, rounded or indented; notch formed by apical wing lobes 3 mm deep, open; style included deep within notch; lateral wings 2.5-3 mm. Seeds 1 or rarely 2 per fruit, trigonous, turbinate, 3-3.5 X ca. 2.5 mm, rugose or with a yellowish crust.

description: Woody perennials with upright or partially reclining trunks to 2(-4) m tall, skirted with old leaves. Leaves long and arching, brittle; leaf bases spoon-shaped, 10-12 X 4.5-6 cm, gradually narrowing above, usually with small prickles at apex of leaf base, auriculate flaps lacking; leaf blades 80-140 cm long, 1-1.2 cm wide at base, flattened and quadrangulately thickened below, narrowing to 4-5 mm above, the surface minutely papillose, dull or occasionally shiny; prickles present only near leaf base, these small and rudimentary; margins minutely and weakly serrulate; tips long-attenuate, weathering entire. Inflorescences 3-4 m tall, elongate, the apex acuminate; bracts of peduncle not densely overlapping. Staminate fascicles with 5-7 branches; central axis to 2 cm; side branches 5-9 cm long. Staminate flowers on short pedicels; tepals spatulate, arched, denticulate, ca. 2.4 X 2 mm. Pistillate fascicles with 5-9 branches; central axis 1-1.5 cm; side branches 6-9(-14) cm long. Pistillate flowers on short pedicel to 1 mm in fruit; receptacles ca. 0.4 mm; tepals 1.6-1.8 X 1.4 mm, denticulate-laciniate, membranous; styles 0.2 mm long; stigma lobes ca. 0.4 mm, united or sometimes separate. Fruits tan-colored, broadly obovate, 4-6 X 3.5-5 mm; apical lobe ca. 1.4 mm long, rounded; notch formed by apical wing lobes ca. 0.5 mm deep; style ca. equal to depth of notch. Seeds single in fruit, trigonous, turbinate, 3-3.5 X ca. 2.5 mm, smooth.

description: Perennials with trunks to 2 m tall, similar to var. longissimum in habit. Leaves arching, brittle, quadrangulately thickened; leaf bases thin, ca. 5.0 cm at base, gradually narrowing to blade; apex of leaf base with prickles; blades 70-80 cm long, flattened at base, becoming quadrangulately thickened above; margins with small prickles at base. Inflorescences 3-4 m tall, very narrow and tapering, the apex long-attenuate; bracts of peduncle separated, not closely overlapping. Flower fascicles with 5-7 branches. Pistillate flowers with tepals 1.5 X 1 mm, laciniate, membranous; style 0.2 mm; stigma 0.4 mm, united. Fruits 4 X 3.5 mm; style and stigma included in notch formed by apical wing lobes.

description: Perennials with erect woody trunks 0.2-2 m tall. Leaves numerous in dense rosettes; leaf bases spoon-shaped, ca. 10 X 5.5-7 cm; blades narrow, rigidly upright, not twisting, long-linear, 70-100 X 0.8-1(-1.5) cm, quadrangulately thickened near base, the surface smooth, glossy, dark green; prickles curved forward, yellow, evenly and often widely spaced, 1-2 cm apart; tips narrow, elongate and brushy when young, weathering entire at maturity. Inflorescences 2-3 m tall; bracts olive-tan, not overlapping; lower bracts of peduncle long-attenuate, prickly; upper bracts lanceolate with scarious margins, smooth. Staminate fascicles with 7-8 branches; central axis to 3.5 cm long; side branches 4-7(-10) cm long. Staminate flowers with tepals ca. 2.4 x 1.4-1.6 mm, arched. Pistillate fascicles with 5-7(-12) branches; central axis to 5 cm; side branches 4-10 cm long, often branched. Pistillate flowers subtended by a laciniate, tripartite, membranous bract ca. 3 X ca. 2.5 mm; pedicels short, 1-2 mm long in fruit; receptacle ca. 0.2 mm long; tepals spatulate, denticulate, ca. 2 x 1 mm; styles ca. 0.1-0.2 mm; stigma lobes 0.2-0.4 long. Fruits tan-colored, broadly elliptical to obovate, 6-7 X (4-)5-6.5 mm; notch formed by apical wing lobes ca. 1 mm; style included within the notch. Seeds single in fruit, trigonous, turbinate, ca. 3 x ca. 2.5 mm, smooth.

description: Perennials with woody upright trunks to 3 m tall, surrounded by dense layers of old leaves. Leaves in dense rosettes, narrow, brittle, quadrangulate, arching; leaf bases spoon-shaped, 13-14 X 5-6 cm, more or less rectangular, sharply constricting to narrow blade, entire, with small membranous auriculate flaps near apex; blades 80-90 cm long, 8-9 mm wide at base quickly narrowing to 4-5 mm wide, quadrangulately thickened, cross section rhombate at base becoming square toward tip; leaf surfaces smooth, minutely papillate, not shiny, not waxy-glaucous; prickles completely absent, the margins minutely serrulate; tips thin, weathering entire at maturity. Inflorescences 3-6 m tall; peduncle 5-7 cm diam. at base, massive, the apex blunt; bracts of peduncle densely overlapping 7-16 X 3-4.5 cm, stramineous, papillate-roughened, lanceolate. Staminate fascicles with 3-4 branches; central axis 1-3 cm long; side branches 7-12 cm long. Staminate flowers with laciniate bracts 2.5 X 4-6 mm; tepals ca. 2.4 X 1.5-2 mm, obovate, weakly laciniate. Pistillate fascicles with 3 branches, 10-24 cm long; central axis short, ca. 1 cm. Pistillate flowers with laciniate, roughly tripartite bracts, ca. 2.5 X 3-3.5 mm; pedicels 2-2.5 mm long; receptacles 0.4-1 mm; tepals 2-2.5(-3) X ca. 1.5 mm, oblanceolate, weakly denticulate, membranous; styles ca. 0.2 mm; stigma lobes 0.8-1 mm, weakly united or separate. Fruits purple-red-colored, elliptical-ovate, 7.5-8 X 5-6 mm; notch formed by apical wing lobes ca. 1 mm; style slightly exserted above notch. Seeds single or occasionally double in fruit, trigonous, turbinate, ca. 2.5 X ca. 2 mm, smooth.

description: Perennials with short woody trunks. Leaves narrow, erect; leaf bases not seen; blades 70-90 X 1-1.4 cm, the surface waxy-glaucous, smooth, often tinged with purple; prickles curved forward, yellow with brown tips; leaf tips long-tapering, narrow, weathering entire. Inflorescences 2-4 m tall, often tinged with purple; lower bracts of peduncle not seen. Staminate fascicles sometimes compact, spaced 2-3 cm apart, with 3-5 branches; central axis short, to 1.5 cm; side branches 2.5-6(-8) cm, densely packed. Staminate flowers subtended by membranous, laciniate bracts 2-3 X ca. 2.5 mm; pedicels short; tepals ellipticalobovate, 3-3.2 X 1.6-1.8 mm, tinged with dark purple. Pistillate fascicles with 3-7 branches; central axis 2-2.5 cm; side branches 7-9 cm long. Pistillate flowers with short receptacle to 0.3 mm long; tepals elliptical-obovate, ca. 2 X ca. 1.4 mm. Fruits purple-colored, thick-walled, roundish-elliptical, ca. 7.5 X ca. 7 mm; apical wing lobes ca. 2.4 mm; lateral wing ca. 1.5 mm; notch formed by apical wing lobes ca. 2 mm; style ca. 1 mm long, greatly swollen in fruit, golden brown, included in notch. Seeds single, trigonous, turbinate, ca. 3.5 X ca. 2.5 mm, rugose.

description: Amphiphytes. Plants glabrous. Leaves rosulate, numerous. Petiole of varying length, mostly not longer than the lamina, but up to 3-4 times the length of the lamina in aerial leaves. Lamina of submersed leaves and leaves of terrestrial forms normally 3 times as long as broad, up to 3 cm long. Lamina of aerial leaves 4 times longer than broad or even narrower, up to 6 cm long. Leaves oblong-lanceolate, acute, the base tapering gradually into the petiole. Primary veins 3, the 2 outer ones close to the leaf margin. Secondary veins about 10 pairs, departing at about 450 angles. Lamina with short pellucid lines. Inflorescence compound, always exserted beyond the leaves, to 15 (30) cm high. Flowers in 1-4 whorls, each whorl with many flowers from the axils of sessile, broadly ovate, acute bracts. Pedicels filiform, prolonged up to 2-3 cm after anthesis. Flower to 1.5 cm diameter, truncate at the base. Sepals coriaceous, broadly ovate, acute, 2 mm long. Petals white, broadly obovate, somewhat emarginate, very thin, withering, 6 mm long. Stamens (6) 9, the anthers 3 mm long. Achenes clavate, 1-1.5 mm long, 1 mm wide, the beak nearly straight, short, the facial ribs 3, very obscure or not present, normally without glands.

description: Herbae annuae, glabrae. Folia emersa, petiolata; lamina 2-12 cm longa, lineis pellucidis parallelis ad venas primarias percursa. Achaenia lato-clavata, teretia, eglandulosa.

description: Annual or short-lived perennial herbs from short, erect rhizomes, glabrous, to 60 cm tall; rhizomes to 1 cm long, to 1 cm diam. Leaves emersed; blade lanceolate to oval, greenish-brown, unlobed, 2-12 cm long, 1-4 cm wide, with 3-5 veins, the pellucid markings evident as lines more or less parallel to primary veins, the apex acute, the base attenuate; petiole triangular in cross section, winged, twice as long as blade, 5-20 cm long. Inflorescence a simple scape of up to 8 whorls, erect to decumbent, overtopping the leaves, often proliferating, 30-60 cm long, to 1.5 cm wide, the whorls with 3-6 flowers, the rachis triangular between whorls; peduncle 10-15 cm long, terete; bracts long-acuminate, to 10 mm long, ca equal to pedicel subtended, membranous, the apex acuminate to subulate; pedicels spreading in flower, recurved in fruit, cylindric, to 10 mm long, ca 0.5 mm diam. Flowers ca 1 cm across, the sepals spreading to reflexed, 7-8-veined, without papillae on veins, ca 3 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, the petals not clawed, spreading, ca 4 mm long, ca 3 mm wide, the stamens 12, the anthers versatile, to 1.5 mm long, ca 0.5 mm wide, the filaments to 1.5 mm long, the carpels numerous. Fruit broad-clavate, to 2.5 mm long, to 0.5 mm wide, terete, with 6-8 inconspicuous ribs, beaked, eglandular, winged, separating when mature, the beak terminal, erect, to 0.3 mm long.

description: Glabrous, perennial herb from short rhizomes, to 125 cm tall. Leaves emersed; blade lance-ovate, greenish-brown, unlobed, 30-54 cm long, 8.2-12.5 cm wide, with 3 or 5 veins, the pellucid markings forming a network independent of the veins, the apex acute, the base attenuate; petiole terete, slightly winged, slightly longer than blade, ca 7 mm thick, the base with a sheath to 15 cm long. Inflorescence a simple scape of ca 7 whorls, erect, without proliferations, to 53 cm long, to 7 cm wide, the whorls with 10-1 8 flowers, the rachis internodes triangular in cross section between whorls; peduncles triangular in cross section; bracts lanceolate, to 1.5 cm long, shorter than pedicels subtended, coarse throughout, the apex long acuminate; pedicels spreading in flower, recurved in fruit, cylindric, to 4.5 cm long, to 2.5 mm diam. Flowers ca 25 mm wide; sepals erect, surrounding the mature fruiting aggregate, to 20-veined, without papillae along veins, to 1.5 cm long, to ca 8 mm wide; petals without claws, spreading, ca 10.5 mm long, ca 8 mm wide; stamens ca 25, the anthers versatile, to 1.5 mm long, the filaments to 2 mm long. Fruit clavate, flattened, 4-5-ribbed, beaked, without glands, slightly dorsally winged, 3-3.5 mm long, 1.2-1.5 mm wide, the beak lateral, horizontal, 1-1.5 mm long.

description: Bulbous perennial herb, 50-60 cm tall. Bulb sub-globose, 5-6 x 4 cm, with a papery brown tunica. Leaves 3-4 at anthesis, petiolate; petiole slightly concave adaxially, concave abaxially, 25-35 cm long; lamina widely elliptic to slightly ovate, 15-20 cm long, 7-12 cm wide, short acuminate at apex, very shortly attenuate to the petiole, thin in texture, lustrous dark green adaxially, silvery-green abaxially. Inflorescence scapose, umbellate, 9-10-flowered, terminated by two valvate, ovate-lanceolate, greenish-white, marcescent bracts, 29-30 mm long; bracteoles successively shorter and narrower. Flowers pendulous via curving of the tube, not noticeably fragrant; pedicel sub-erect, 10-15 mm long; perianth tube white, curved abruptly above the ovary, 25-28 mm long, cylindrical and 2.5-3 mm wide throughout most of its length, abruptly dilated to 6 mm just below the throat; limb of 6 white segments spreading widely to ca 30 mm; segments in two whorls, ovate, recurved at the apex, sub-equal; outer segments ca 23 mm long, 14 mm wide, terminating in a 4 mm long apiculum; inner segments 20-21 mm long, 14.5 mm wide, apically acute. Stamens 6, connate into a campanulate staminal cup ca 12 mm long and wide, apically white, basally pale greenish-yellow, plicately folded on either side of the filamental trace; free portion ca 5 mm long, 4.5 mm wide, the anther-bearing part subulate, apically obtuse, 3.5 mm long, inserted between two irregular, coarsely serrulate teeth each 4-5 mm long, 1.5 mm wide at the base, adjacent pairs somewhat imbricate and appearing as one; anthers oblong-linear, sub-basifixed, versatile, grayish-brown, 3.5-4 mm long; pollen (Fig. 2) off-white, monosulcate, elliptic, average polar axis 67.9 µm, average equatorial axis 83.3 µm, exine reticulate with open system of muri and lumina, 100% fertile. Style filiform, white, ca 36 mm long, reaching to 1/2 the length of the cup; stigma 3-lobed, the lobes globose, surface glandular-pubescent, 2.5 mm wide. Ovary inferior, elliptic-globose, trilocular, ca 5 mm long, 3.4 mm wide; ovules 7-8 per locule, globose, superposed. Fruit a sub-globose, leathery, 3-loculicidal capsule, ca 1 x 2 cm, bright orange in color. Seeds 1-2 per locule, fleshy, ellipsoidal, ca 50 mm x 1 cm, with a lustrous black testa. Somatic chromosome number 2n = 44.

description: Bulbous geophyte to 50 cm tall. Bulb subglobose, surrounded by a brown tunica, 40 mm long, 30 mm wide, apically articulated into a 20 mm long neck. Leaves mostly 1, deciduous, petiolate; petiole 12-13 cm long, 3.5-5 mm diam; lamina elliptic, 21-23 cm long, ca 11 cm wide, shortly acuminate at the apex, shortly attenuate to the petiole at the base, abaxial epidermis with cuticular striation (Fig. 3). Inflorescence scapose, umbellate; scape 40-45 cm long, terminated by two valvate lanceolate bracts each 19-21 mm long which enclose the flowers before anthesis. Flowers 6-7, 3-4 cm long, perpendicular to the scape or slightly cernuous at anthesis, pedicellate, each subtended by a linear-lanceolate bracteole; pedicels 9-10 mm long and thin. Perianth funnelform-tubular, red; perianth tube subcylindrical, 10-11 mm long, 2.5-3 mm wide, constricted at the base; perianth limb spreading only slightly at the apex to 7-8 mm, segments lanceolate-spatulate, 16 mm long, 4 mm wide, the outer series apiculate, the inner series obtuse. Stamens 6, connate below into a subcylindrical, edentate, staminal cup which is irregularly cleft between each free filament; cup 9-10 mm long, 4.5 mm wide with a ridge of 6 globose, callose glands at the base, each ca 1 mm diam; free filaments straight, varying in length from 15-18 mm, subulate, exserted 3-5 mm beyond the perianth; anthers oblong, 3.5 mm long, dorsifixed and versatile; pollen grain (Fig. 7) boat-shaped-ellipsoid, polar diam averaging 30.0-30.2 ,im, equatorial diam averaging 45.2-49.8 ,um, the exine reticulate. Style filiform, 28 mm long, exserted 8-10 mm beyond the limb; stigma capitate, 0.3-0.5 mm wide. Ovary inferior, ellipsoid, ca 2.5 mm long, 2.0 mm wide; ovules numerous in each locule, axile in placentation, biseriate, somewhat flattened. Fruit a 3-lobed, loculicidal, blue-green, turbinate capsule, ca 11 mm long, 20-25 mm wide, rostellate at the apex, turning brown at dehiscence; seeds numerous, blackish-brown, flattened, obliquely winged, 10 mm long, and 5 mm wide.

description: Bulbous geophyte to 80 cm tall. Bulb surrounded by a brown tunica, 25-50 cm diam, apically articulated into a 15-35 mm long neck. Leaves 1-2 (3), mostly deciduous, petiolate; petiole 20-25 cm long, 5-7 mm diam, adaxially compressed proximal to the lamina, otherwise cylindrical; lamina ovate, 17-21 cm long, 8- 12 cm wide, apically acute, subcordate at the base and abruptly attenuate to the petiole, thin, non-lustrous, conspicuously plicate, adaxial surface grass-green, abaxial surface whitish-green and devoid of cuticular ornamentation (Fig. 2), midrib narrow and upraised, margins coarsely undulate. Inflorescence scapose, umbellate; scape ca 60 cm long, ca 5 mm diam, terete, terminated by 2 valvate, ovate-lanceolate, marcescent bracts each ca 28 mm long and 8-10 mm wide (Figs. 2-5) which enclose the flowers before anthesis. Flowers 5-7, each ca 10 cm long, at anthesis perpendicular to the scape axis or slightly cernuous, pedicellate, each subtended by a linear-lanceolate bracteole 15-17 mm long; pedicels 16-20 mm long, 1.7 mm diam. Perianth yellow (tawny-brown at the base of the tube), in- fundibular; perianth tube funnelform, straight, 22-24 mm long, 4 mm wide at the base, 10-11 mm wide at the throat; perianth limb spreading to 30-3 5 mm, consisting of 6 subequal, lanceolate-spatulate segments in 2 series; outer segments ca 28.3 mm long, 7 mm wide, acute-apiculate; inner segments ca 26 mm long, 7.5-8 mm wide, obtuse. Stamens 6, greenish-yellow, long-exserted, declinate for most of their length, ascendent in their distal 10 mm; filaments 7-8 cm long, filiform, free, lacking callose glands at their base, affixed to the perianth tube 6-6.5 mm below the throat, dilated to 1 mm at their base and articulated between adjacent filaments into a narrow appendage 6-6.5 mm long which is adnate to the perianth tube; anthers green, oblong-linear, 5-6 mm long, dorsifixed and versatile; pollen grain (Fig. 6) boat-shaped-ellipsoid, monosulcate with reticulate exine, becoming almost tectate-perforate at the equatorial facies, average polar diam 44.1 µm, average equatorial diam 74.5 µm. Style filiform, greenish-yellow, ca 7.5-8 cm long, declinate below stamens at first, ascendent when receptive; stigma capitate, 0.7-0.8 mm wide. Ovary inferior, ellipsoid, ca 11 mmlong, 5 mm wide; ovules 9-10 per locule, axile in placentation, biseriate and ± globose. Mature fruit and seed unknown. Somatic chromosome number 2n = 46 (Figs. 8 & 9).

description: Bulbous perennial herb. Bulb globose with a grayish-brown tunica, 2.5 cm diam, apically articulated into a neck 3.4 cm long and 7 mm thick. Leaves hysteranthous, not seen. Inflorescence scapose, umbellate; scape slender, 33-35 cm long, 2.5 mm thick, terminated by 2 lanceolate bracts 20.5 mm long; inner bracteoles reduced to minute linear scales less than 1 mm long. Flowers 4-7, orange-red and salmon, funnelform-tubular, slightly zygomorphic by curving of the perianth tube, 8-9 cm long, pedicellate; pedicels 28-35 mm long, ca 0.8 mm thick; perianth ca 4 cm long, tube 31 mm long, slightly arcuate, 3.7 mm wide proximally, dilated in distal half to ca 1 cm; limb short, straight, 12-14 mm wide, consisting of 2 series of subequal ovate segments, 8.5-9 mm long, the outer series 3.5-4 mm wide and minutely apiculate, the inner series 4.5-5 mm wide and apically obtuse. Stamens entirely free, declinate; filaments 49-51 mm long, inserted ca 2.5 mm below perianth throat, filiform; anthers oblong, 2.7 mm long, versatile; pollen grain (Fig. 2) boat-shaped elliptic, monosulcate, polar diam 43.10 ,um, longest equatorial diam 63.45 ,um; exine reticulate, becoming tectate-perforate near the sulcus and at the meridional ends of the grain. Style 8.5-9 cm long; stigma capitate, minute, less than 1 mm wide. Ovary ellipsoid, 5 mm long, 3.2 mm wide; ovules numerous in each locule, axile, biseriate.

description: Liana robusta alte scandens, caulibus ad 2 cm vel ultra crassis, internodiis ad 1 cm vel ultra longis. Folia basi imbricata erecto-patentia coriacea ad 100 cm longa (probabiliter ad 120 cm) et 2-3.5 cm lata, lineari-ensiformia apice acuto, parte basilari vaginantia ad 9-10 cm longa, auriculis rigide membranceis in sicco fere castaneis ad 9 cm longis et 1-2 cm latis apice truncato, margine integra praeter apicem ciliato-spinulosa; margines laminae valde subremote dentatae, dentibus inferioribus patentibus deltoideis ad 2 mm longis et 1.5-2 mm latis fere 1 cm separatis, dentibus superioribus reductis ad 1 mm longis circiter 5-6 mm separatis; costa media dorsaliter acute prominula e medio usque ad apicem remotiuscule dentata dentibus 1-2 mm longis. Inflorescentia feminea ternata vel quaternata, pedicellis ad 6 cm longis 5-7 mm crassis, subtriangulosis vel plano-convexis, levibus; spathae late deltoideae decrescentes ad 6 cm latae apice foliformes (externis) vel rotundatae (internis) in basi coloratae et subcarnosulae (rubrae?). Syncarpia subglobosa circiter 4.5 cm longa et 4 cm lata. Bacca (fere matura?) oblonga (ad 14 mm longa, 3 mm lata) apice anguste pyramidata parte libera 4 mm longa, apice truncata; stigmata (3) 4-8, in sicco nigra. Areola stigmatica truncata annulo brunneo nitente cincta. Semina ignota. Inflorescentia mascula quaternata, pedicellis ad 6 cm longis levibus; spadix mascula cylindracea ad 30 mm longa et 8 mm crassa; fila- menta 1.5 mm longa perminute cellulariter scabridula; antherae oblongae 0.75 mm longae apice rotundato-truncatae.

description: Caulis repens submarinus, stipulis bilaminiferis compressis basalibus. Folia (cum petiolis) usque ad 55 mm longa, 2.5-6 mm lata, laminis fere 20-30 X 2-4 mm sed basi longe cuneata et sensim cum petiolis conjungentibus. Nervi laterales a costa ad angulo obtuso divergentes lineares et e ramosi, nervis utrinque 10-16. Flores unisexuales, masc. adhuc ignot. Flores feminei (cum ovariis) 1.6 mm longi, stylis 4.8 mm longis et in 3 segmenta 12-15 mm longa divisis. Ovulae erectae 12-15.

description: Folia 0.8-2.6 cm longa, 0.1-0.7 mm lata, conspicue serrulata, dentibus secus utramque marginem 5-9. Flores axillares, solitarii; anthera 4-locularis. Semina 2.5-3 mm longa, 0.5-0.7 mm lata, papillata, curvata, apice horizontali.

description: Plants monoecious. Stems 7-22 cm long, 0.2-1 mm diam, profusely branched; internodes 0.2-4 cm long, without prickles. Leaves clustered at branch tips, 0.8- 2.6 cm long; laminae usually recurved with age, 0.1-0.7 mm wide, acute with 1 tooth at apex, conspicuously serrulate with 5-9 teeth along each margin, the terminal tooth slightly larger than but similar in structure to the lateral teeth, the teeth multicellular, the midrib without prickles; sheaths 1-1.3 mm wide, wider than the laminae, round to slightly auriculate, serrulate with 3-5 teeth per margin, the teeth similar in structure and size to those of the laminae. Flowers 1 per axil, the staminate in the upper axils, the carpellate in the lower axils, the involucre bronze colored; staminate flowers 2-3 mm long, the involucre beaks ca 0.4-0.6 mm long, 4-lobed, the anther 1.5-2 mm long, 4-loculed; carpellate flowers to 2.5 mm long, the styles less than 0.4 mm long, the stigmas 4-lobed. Seeds 2.5-3 mm long, 0.5-0.7 mm wide, greenish-brown, curved with apex directed laterally, the testa pitted, the areolae 4-angled, to 0.2 mm long, ca 0.05 mm broad, in ca 20 longitudinal rows, the end walls raised, giving the testa a papillose appearance.

description: Tree, 20 m x 15 cm. Twigs thick, 6-9 mm in diam below uppermost leaf, rust-colored, rimose, with horizontally oriented scales. Leaf-blades narrowly obovate, 35-40 x 15-19 cm, glabrous, with papillate abaxial surface, chartaceous, with 30-34 pairs of lateral veins; apices abruptly acuminate; bases obtuse; margins entire to minutely crenulate; petioles 12-20 mm long, glabrous, canaliculate. In- florescences racemose, terminal, the rachis 10-30 cm long with 3-4 widely spaced flowers, the lower 3/4 without flowers, with horizontally elongated lenticels; ped- icels jointed, sessile below joint, 5 mm long above joint, the bract and bracteoles caducous, not seen. Flowers large, ca 11 cm in diam; calyx with 6 very widely oblong to widely ovate pink lobes, 12-14 x 9-11 mm, the margins erose; petals 6, widely obovate, pink, 45 x 30 mm; hood of androecium flat, white, the prox- imal appendages with anthers, the distal appendages antherless; staminal ring with ca 940 densely packed stamens, the filaments ca 3 mm long, not markedly dilated at apex, the anthers 1 mm long; hypanthium glabrous; ovary 4 (5)-locular, each locule with 4-9 ovules attached at base of septum, the summit truncate, the style 7 mm long. Fruits depressed globose, 6.5-7 x 9-10 cm, the base truncate, the pedicel attachment prolonged into a woody knob 1 x 2 cm, the calycine ring with persistent thickened sepals, situated near base of fruit, the supracalycine zone erect, the pericarp 10 mm thick. Seeds unknown.

description: Small trees, 5 m tall. Twigs stout, 5-6 mm in diam below uppermost leaf, rimose, glabrous, with vertically oriented lenticels, without scales. Leaf-blades widely oblong, 14-15.5 x 7.4-10.2 cm, glabrous, without papillate abaxial sur- face, coriaceous, with 11-15 pairs of lateral veins; apices short acuminate; bases rounded to truncate; margins entire; petioles 10-13 mm long, glabrous. Inflores- cences racemose, terminal, the rachis 10-22 cm long, with ca 4 widely spaced flowers, the lower part without flowers, glabrous, with horizontally elongated lenticels; pedicels ca 3 mm long, the bract and bracteoles not seen. Flowers at anthesis unknown; calyx with 6 widely ovate lobes, ca 10 x 9 mm; hood of androecium flat, the proximal appendages with anthers, the distal ones antherless, the distal most appendages bent outwards to form a flap which rests on the outside of the hood; staminal ring with densely packed stamens; hypanthium glabrous, cuneate at the base, ovary 4-locular, with 20-24 ovules per locule, these attached towards base of septum, the summit truncate. Fruits truncate at apex, rounded into an abrupt knob 1-1.5 x 2 cm at base, 6-7 cm high excluding knob, 7-11 cm in diam, the pericarp ca 5 mm thick, the operculum flat to slightly convex, with the style persisting as a woody spine, the infracalycine zone convex, the supra- calycine zone erect with a thickened ring at its apex. Seeds numerous, ca 50 per fruit, leaving distinct polygonally shaped impressions on the inside, reddish-brown, 20-30 x 16 mm, the outer surface of the veins the same color as the testa, with a basally attached funicle and aril.

description: Tree to 12.0 m tall, the young branches glabrescent, not conspicuously lenticellate. Leaves with laminas elliptic, 10-14 X 5-8.2 cm, the margins crenulate, tapering to base from about mid-point, acuminate at apex, the acumen 10-12 mm long, curved, rounded at base, slightly decurrent onto petioles, glabrous beneath; midrib pro- minulous above, prominent and glabrous beneath; primary veins 25-33 pairs, prominulous on both surfaces, 2-5 mm apart at base, with distinct domatia at junction with midrib and primary veins, the domatia with a few short hairs or glabrous; petioles 12-16 mm long, slightly winged, glabrous. Inflorescences terminal and subterminal racemose panicles with many branches, pendulous, the rachis and branches sparsely puberulous, not crustaceous, not lenticellate; pedicels ca. 0.5 mm long. Hypanthium 2.5 mm long, turbinate; calyx-lobes triangular, very sparsely puberulous on exterior. Petals obovate, ca. 6 mm long, orangish-red. Androphore ca. 2 mm diam, yellow, with ca. 45-65 stamens inserted all over the inner surface. Style very short. Ovary trilocular with 3-6 ovules per locule, ovules ascending, attached to basal half of the septum. Pyxidium not seen.

description: Trees, to 30 m x 80 cm, buttressed or unbuttressed. Twigs grey or brown, 4-6 mm diam, with suborbicular lenticels, these with slight horizontal orientation. Bark brown with vertical fissues. Leaf-blades elliptic to oblong, 14-26 x 5-10.5 cm, glabrous, chartaceous, with 17-23 pairs of lateral veins; apices acuminate; bases obtuse to rounded; margins crenulate; petioles 8-20 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescences terminal or in axils of uppermost leaves, paniculate arrangement of racemes, with 2 or 3 orders of branching, often large and spreading, to 50 x 40 cm, all rachises ferrugineous, with horizontally oriented squamulae, the pedicel jointed, the lower part persisting as a knob 2-5 mm long after flowers fall. Flowers 3.5-4 cm diam; calyx of 6 broadly ovate lobes imbricate at the bases, rounded at the apices, 3-4 x 3-4 mm; petals 6, broadly obovate, 17-20 x 13-19 mm, pinkish-red to dark red or purple; hood of androecium flat, dorsiventrally ex- panded, 16-17 x 12-15 mm, the appendages nearly entirely fused, antherless; staminal ring with 194-230 stamens, the filaments 1.8-2.5 mm long, the anthers 0.4 mm long; hypanthium ferrugineous, rough, with horizontally oriented squa- mulae, contrasting with the dark smooth calyx lobes; ovary 2-locular, each locule with 13-26 ovules attached at base of septum or on floor of locule, the summit umbonate, the style not differentiated from summit of ovary. Fruits campanulate, 6-15 x 6-10 cm, with the calyx lobes indistinct, the pericarp 13-27 mm thick. Seeds elongate, 30 x 11 mm.

description: Large tree 31 m tall, the young branches glabrous. Leaf laminas oblong, coriaceous, 9-11.5 cm long, 3-4.5 cm broad, acuminate at apex, the acumen 4-5 mm long, cuneate to subcuneate at base, the margins undulate to slightly crenate, glabrous on both faces; midrib prominulous above, prominent and glabrous beneath; primary veins 14-17 pairs, together with the secondary venation prominulous on both faces; petioles 5-9 mm long, glabrous, canaliculate above, not winged. Inflorescence of terminal and subterminal racemes, the rachis and branches stellate-pubescent, bracts not seen; pedicels 4-5 mm long, densely stellate-tomentose, articulate at or near rachis. Hypanthium campanulate, ca 4 mm long, conspicuously tufted-stellate-tomentose on exterior, the calyx lobes ovate, ca 5 mm long, stellate-tomentose on exterior. Petals ovate, shortly stellate-pubescent on exterior, glabrous within. Androecium yellow, glabrous, the exterior of hood with numerous dense echinate appendages, the stamens ca 40, inserted around basal ring in several rows. Ovary 3-locular. Pyxidium not seen.

description: Tree to 35 m tall, without buttresses, the young branches glabrous, rugulose. Leaves with laminas oblong to oblong-elliptic, chartaceous, 8-18 X 4.5-8.5 cm, the margins undulate and slightly crenulate, rounded to acute or rarely bluntly acuminate at apex, subcuneate at base, glabrous on both surfaces; midrib prominulous above, very prominent beneath, with a few hispid hairs beneath; primary veins 12-16 pairs, prominulous above, prominent beneath; petioles 14-32 mm long, glabrous, slightly canaliculate, rugulose. Inflorescences of terminal and axillary racemes, the rachis shortly tomentellous, 1-9 cm long; bracts triangular, membranous, caducous, 0.5-2 mm long; pedicels 25-33 mm long, slender, glabrous to sparsely puberulous. Hypanthium campanulate, ca. 7 mm long; calyx-lobes 6, ovate-triangular, acute, sparsely puberulous on both surfaces, the margins ciliate. Petals oblong, unequal, 25- 35 mm long, sparsely and shortly puberulous and punctate on exterior, glabrous, dark red wine-colored. Androphore ca. 5 cm long, the basal ring diameter 1.5-1.8 cm, the exterior of hood rugulose-pustulate, the interior of hood smooth with a marginal rim which tightly closes the androphore; stamens ca. 35-40, inserted tightly clustered in two rows around the basal ring of androphore, not extending up the blade, purple, at base yellow externally. Ovary trilocular with 27-33 ovules per locule; placentae confined to lower part of the septum, ovules ascending. Style 1 mm long, thick. Fruit not seen.

description: Tree to 15 m tall, the trunk not buttressed, the young branches glabrous. Leaf laminas elliptic to oblong-elliptic, coriaceous, 9-12.5 cm long, 3.5-6 cm broad, rounded to acute at apex or blunfly acuminate, subcuneate at base, glabrous on both faces, the margins entire; midrib prominulous above, prominent and glabrous beneath; primary veins 10-13 pairs, prominulous on both faces; petioles 10-16 mm long, glabrous, weakly canaliculate, rugulose, not winged. Inflorescences of terminal and axillary racemes or racemose panicles, the rachis and branches puberulous. Flowers not seen. Pyxidium campanulate, broadest at apex and tapering to base, excluding the thin stipe to 4 cm long, 4.5-6 cm long, 2.8-3.6 cm broad at apex, longitudinally striate on exterior, smooth (not crustaceous) on exterior, thinly woody, the walls ca 1-1.5 mm thick, the calycine ring ca 5 mm below apex, marked by a slightly prominent ridge all around the perimeter; operculum concave with central protrusion, radially grooved, the stalk triangular; seeds oblong, symmetrical, 3.6 cm long, 1.3 cm broad.

description: Large tree 40 m tall, the trunk buttressed for 50-80 cm, the young branches sparsely puberulous, soon becoming glabrous with age. Leaf laminas charta- ceous, oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 8-17 cm long, 3-5.3 cm broad, cuneate at base, acuminate at apex, the acumen 4-7 mm long, glabrous above, stellate- pubescent beneath especially near to midrib, glabrous towards the crenulate mar- gins; midrib prominulous above, prominent beneath, stellate-pubescent beneath; primary veins 20-26 pairs, prominulous on both faces; petioles 5-9 mm long, tomentellous, lightly winged especially when young, deeply canaliculate. Stipules lanceolate-linear, inserted 1-2 mm above leaf axils, tomentellous, subpersistent. Inflorescence (only one in bud seen) a terminal few-flowered raceme, the rachis yellow-brown tomentose; bracts lanceolate, 15-25 mm long, tomentose; brac- teoles oblong; pedicels ca 3 mm long (in bud), 3-channelled, tomentellous. Calyx campanulate, 2 mm long in bud, the lobes broadly ovate, tomentellous on both surfaces, the margins ciliate. Petals broadly ovate, tomentellous on center of exterior, glabrous within, the margins ciliate. Androecium glabrous, the exterior of hood with numerous dense echinate appendages, the stamens ca 60, inserted uniformly around basal ring in 3-4 rows. Ovary 3-locular; ovules numerous.

description: Trees, 4-25 m x 5-80 cm. Bark not fissured, the outer 2 mm thick, the inner laminated, 10 mm thick, yellow when cut. Leaf-blades elliptic, 6-10 x 3.5-4.5 cm, glabrous, chartaceous, with 8-10 pairs of lateral veins, all orders of venation salient; apex acuminate; base obtuse, very narrowly decurrent; margins entire, slightly revolute; petiole 5-8 mm long, hemispherical in cross section. Inflores- cences of simple spikes or paniculate arrangements of once-branched spikes, terminal or in the axils of the uppermost leaves, the secondary branches weakly developed; rachis 3-8 cm long, with horizontally oriented squamulae. Flowers 2- 2.5 cm diam; calyx lobes 6, ovate, 2-5 x 4-5 mm; petals 4, cucullate, widely obovate, 12-14 x 15-18 mm, white; hood of the androecium yellow, curved in- wards but not forming a complete coil, the appendages angular, to 7 mm long, sometimes with minute vestigial anthers; staminal ring with ca 160 stamens, the filaments filiform, attenuated at apex, to 1.5 mm long, the anthers 0.7 mm long; ovary 2-locular, each locule with ca 10 ovules, the style to 1.5 mm long, not well differentiated from the summit of the ovary. Fruits turbinate, 4.5-5 x 6-7.5 cm, the pericarp 10-12 mm thick. Seeds semicircular or triangular in cross section, 2.5 x 2.5 cm, chestnut colored, the nerves recessed, colored as the testa.

description: Small tree, to 10 m tall. Leaf-blades elliptic, 7-10 x 2.5-4 cm, glabrous, chartaceous, with 9-12 pairs of lateral veins; apex acuminate; base acute to infrequently obtuse; margins serrate to serrulate, often crisped in herbarium material; petiole, 4-8 mm long, very narrowly winged. Inflorescences terminal or in axils of uppermost leaves, racemose; rachis 0.5-2.5 cm long, with 2-5 flowers, pedicels 3-6 mm long. Flowers ca 2.5 cm diam; calyx lobes 5 or 6, fused at base, their apices triangular, unequal, 1.5-2.5 x 3.5 mm, glabrous; petals 4, unequal, the posterior one cucullate, conforming to the androecium in bud, the remaining 3 very widely obovate, 10-18 x 12-15 mm, white or yellow; hood of the androe- cium 14-17 x 12 mm, not forming a complete coil, the appendages fleshy, angular, bearing vestigial anthers; staminal ring with 170-190 stamens, the filaments 1-1.5 mm long, clavate, the anthers 0.5 mm long; hypanthium cuneate; ovary 2-locular, each locule with 4-6 basally attached ovules, the style poorly differ- entiated, ca 1 mm long, the summit umbonate. Fruits depressed globose, 4.5-6 cm in diam, the operculum markedly umbonate in young fruit, less so in older fruit. Seeds 8-10 per fruit, 2.5 x 1.5-2 cm.

description: Tree, to 35 m tall, 80 cm in diameter above buttresses, with small to medium-sized, thick buttresses on larger trees. Bark dark brown, smooth, usually with shallow, sharp-rimmed, irregular depressions and paler lenticels disposed in ver- tical rows; outer bark very thin; inner bark pale brown or rose-brown when cut; sapwood nearly white. Branchlets glabrous, 2-3.5 mm diam. Leaf blades elliptic to narrowly ovate-elliptic, mostly 2.3-3.8 times as long as wide, 8-20 x 2.5-7 cm, some distal leaves usually smaller, glabrous, punctate abaxially, subcoriaceous or coriaceous, dark green and somewhat glossy when fresh, the midvein slightly raised above, strongly so below, the lateral veins 10-15, arising at mostly 60-75? angles from midvein, brochidodromous, all venation prominulous to obscure above, salient below; apex broadly to narrowly acuminate, the acumen to 1.5 (-2) cm long; base rounded to obtuse, very narrowly decurrent; margin entire, often very slightly repand; petiole 8-15 mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm thick, minutely wrinkled when dry; stipules very narrowly lanceolate, 0.5-0.9 mm long, with filiform tip, caducous, obvious only during leaf flush; distal cataphyll of each shoot 1-2 cm long, linear-elliptic, enclosing young shoot, caducous. Inflorescences once-branched paniculate arrangements of racemes, terminal and in upper leaf axils, sometimes (especially axillary ones) unbranched, glabrous, the rachis 2-9 cm long, the lower lateral branches to 4.5 cm long; pedicels 4-6 mm long, the articulation, bracts, and bracteoles inserted within 1 mm of base; bracteoles persistent, suborbicular-ovate, fleshy, 0.5-1.2 mm long. Flowers ca 4-5 cm diam; calyx lobes 6, green, broadly ovate, 3.5-6 x 3-5 mm, concave adaxially, carinate and slightly gibbous at base abaxially, the margins entire, the apex rounded; petals 6, white (cream- yellow in .bud), broadly elliptic but often revolute and appearing triangular, eventually reflexed, 2-2.5 x 1-1.5 cm, glabrous, the apex rounded, the margins entire or with scattered, thick, short (0.1 mm long) cilia; hood of androecium yellow, 15 mm long, 17 mm wide, forming a distinct double coil, the appendages narrowly deltoid, angular, to 6 mm long; staminal ring slightly elevated on disk 1 mm high on ligular side, with 130-160 stamens, the filaments 1-1.8 mm long, slightly swollen at apex, the anthers 0.5 mm long; ovary 2-locular, each locule with ca 8- 10 basally attached ovules, the style 0.5-1 mm long, very broadly obconical, not well differentiated from summit of ovary. Fruits with 1-6 seeds, cup-shaped to very broadly turbinate, 2.5-5 x 4-6.5 cm, broader than long, the pericarp ca 2 mm thick when dry, the calycine ring 1/3-1/2 distance from base. Seeds 2.7-4.3 x 2-3.5 cm, hemispherical or triangular (rarely round) in cross-section depending on number of seeds per fruit, dark chestnut brown with pale veins when fresh, paler when dry, with lateral, poorly developed aril. Germination from opposite ends of seed; seedlings with several squamate cataphylls below eophylls, the eophylls very obscurely dentate, with minute, marginal hairs to 0.5 mm long.

description: Canopy trees, to 30 m tall, unbuttressed. Bark scalloped, the outer bark ca 1 mm thick, the inner bark 5-7 mm thick, distinctly yellow-orange. Leaf blades elliptic to narrowly oblong, 9-13.5 x 4.5-6 cm, glabrous, chartaceous; apex short to long acuminate; base obtuse to rounded; margins entire; with 9-12 pairs of lateral veins; petiole 8-10 mm long. Inflorescences of simple racemes, terminal or axillary, the rachis gray pubescent, 1-8 cm long; pedicels pubescent, 6-7 mm long. Flowers 3-3.5 cm diam; calyx-lobes markedly imbricate, widely to very widely ovate, 4-5 x 3-7 mm; petals 15 x 10 mm, widely obovate, white; androecial hood 15 x 10 mm, light yellow; staminal ring with ca 80 stamens, extending up ligule, the filaments ca 1 mm long, the anthers ca 0.6 mm long, golden-yellow; ovary 4-locular, with 2-3 ovules attached to base of septum in each locule, the style not well differentiated from summit of ovary, ca 2 mm long. Fruits globose, 2.5-3.5 (including operculum) x 3-4 cm, the calycine ring in- serted below middle, with vestigial calyx- lobes, truncate to pedicel directly below calycine ring, the pericarp light brown, rough, 3-5 mm thick; operculum convex, with umbo. Seeds round in cross section, 2-2.3 x 2 cm, the testa smooth, light brown, with white, plane veins, the aril sunken into shallow, lateral groove.

description: Trees, to 15 m x 50 cm. Bark smooth, with lenticels. Leaf-blades elliptic to narrowly ovate, 14-20 x 6-9 cm, glabrous, chartaceous to coriaceous, with 12-15 pairs of lateral veins, all orders of venation salient; apex acuminate; base obtuse, very narrowly decurrent; margins entire to minutely crenulate, slightly revolute, with scars of caducous hairs; petiole 12-17 mm long, hemispherical in cross section. Inflorescences once-branched paniculate arrangements of spikes at ends of branches, infrequently simple spikes present in axils of uppermost leaves; rachis 9-15 cm long, with horizontally oriented squamulae. Flowers ca 4 cm diam; calyx lobes 6, green, very widely ovate, 3-5 x 6-9 mm, the margins fimbriate; petals 4, the laterals and the posterior larger and more cucullate than the anterior, orbicular to oblong, 16-29 x 19-23 mm, the margins fimbriate, white; hood of the androecium yellow, curved inwards but not forming a complete coil, the appendages angular, to 12 mm long, the innermost with vestigial anthers; staminal ring with 150-170 stamens, the filaments slightly clavate then attenuated at their apices, 2 mm long, the anthers white, 0.7 mm long; ovary 2-locular, each locule with 9-12 ovules, the style obconical, 1.5-2 mm long. Fruits turbinate, ca 8 x 11 cm, the pericarp thick.

description: Trees, to 25 m tall, but usually 10-15 m tall, without buttresses. Leaves clustered at ends of stout branches; petioles difficult to distinguish because of narrowly decurrent blades; blades oblanceolate, 110-250 X 30-60 cm, coriaceous, sometimes with pellucid red punctations abaxially, the base narrowly cuneate, the margins entire, the apex acute; venation brochidodromous, the midrib prominent, the lateral veins in 51-62 pairs. Inflorescences of 1 to many racemes arising from warty outgrowths on trunk, the racemes with 3-25 or more flowers, the rachis elongate, 30-110 cm long; pedicels 1.3-2 cm long, sometimes with warty lenticels, subtended by large, oblong, caducous bract, which leaves a conspicuous scar on falling, with 2, caducous, inconspicuous, scale-like bracteoles on lower third, these leaving inconspicuous scars on falling. Flowers ca. 8 cm in diam. at anthesis; calyx closed in bud, with circumscissile dehiscence and then forming rim 3-5 mm wide or splitting into 2-4 irregular lobes at anthesis; petals 4, oblong, 2-3.5 X 1-2 cm, reflexed, pale yellow; androecium with 39- 59 stamens, the outermost filaments ca. 10 mm, the anthers 1 mm long; stigma 4-parted, the style distinct, ca. 1.5 mm long. Fruits drupes, oblong to elliptic, the largest dried specimens ca. 10 x 6 cm, with 8 longitudinal ribs when dry. Seeds 1 per fruit.

description: Arbores usque ad 20 m altae. Laminae oblongae, ellipticae, obovatae, vel oblanceolatae, 28-81 X 10-31 cm, paribus venarum lateralium 15-23. Petioli 40-195 mm. description: Trees to 20 m tall, 16 cm dbh; leaf bearing branches 7-16 mm diam, the leaves aggregated at their ends, the petiole scars touching to 16 mm apart. Bark brown, ir- regularly fissured. Leaf blades oblong, elliptic, obovate, or oblanceolate, the apices acuminate to long acuminate, the bases acute, cuneate, or obtuse, the margins entire to serrulate, 28-81 X 10-31 cm, glabrous, chartaceous, with 15-23 pairs of lateral veins. Petioles 40-195 mm long, 2-6 mm thick, subterete in cross-section. Inflorescences cau- line, racemose, densely rusty- to grayish-white-tomentose, with up to 17 flowers, the rachis to 108 cm at maturity of the fruits; pedicels 20-75 mm with a single widely ovate or oblong caducous basal bract, 8-20 X 4-12 mm, and 2 oblong or ovate, cucullate bracteoles, 3-10 x 3-6.5 mm, usually inserted above the middle. Flowers 7.7-13.5 cm diam, calyx with 4 broadly triangular to rounded lobes, 2-4 X 10-12 mm, green or greenish-yellow; petals (6-)8, oblong, narrowly obovate or widely obovate, 40-68 X 16-44 mm, white inside, white outside with varying amounts of pink especially towards the apex, connate androphore base 8-15 mm high, yellow, the outermost filaments 14-20 mm, pink, often puberulous, the inner ones progressively shorter, yellow, the anthers 3-4 mm, yellow; ovary smooth or with 2-5 costae, rusty- gray-pubescent, (4-) 6-lobular, puberulous to white-tomentose, often with glabrous spots at the summit, the style 1-3 mm, the stigma (4-)6-lobed. description: Arbor usque ad 7.5 m alta, 17 cm diametro, ramis paucis; folia ad apicem ramulorum arcte aggregata; rami foliati 1.3-3.5 cm diametro, bracteis persistentibus, cicatricibus petiolorum contiguis; cortex leviter fissurata, brunnea. description: The stem of this species produces (1) a group of sessile foliaceous bracts; (2) a group of inflorescences, each of which is subtended by a floral bract; and (3) a tightly compacted group of petiolate leaves (Fig. 1C). In addition, there are two large, opposite bracteoles inserted on the pedicel directly below the hypanthium. At anthesis the inflorescences lie within a rosette formed by the previous year's leaves. At this time the cluster of inflorescences appears as a single terminal inflorescence (Fig. lA). The rosette of leaves obscures the inflorescences from the ground and also holds the rotting floral parts and other debris in place. This mass of inflorescences, rotting floral parts, and debris forms an interesting habitat for insects and other animals. As the fruits mature, their weight bends the branch downward making them visible from the ground. With the expansion of the petiolate leaves, the fruits assume a lateral position (Fig. 1B).

description: Trees usually unbranched, to 5 m tall, the leaves in 1-5 clusters at the branch ends, the terminal cluster with 16-28 tightly congested leaves. description: Perennial caespitose herb, 15-20 cm high. Rhizome horizontal, creeping 1.5-2 mm diam, with covering of brushy filaments of persisting sclerenchyma strands from degraded leaf bases and cataphylls, internodes very short, the culms arising in densely crowded rows. Culms erect, terete, smooth or longitudinally ridged, 0.6-1.1 mm diam. Leaves 2-3 to each culm, all basal, 5-15 cm long, mostly not overtopping the inflorescence; sheaths 1.5-2 cm long with membranaceous margins terminating in two 0.2-0.5 mm long auricles which are scarious or slightly cartilaginous towards the center; blades linear, flat, 0.8-1.3 mm wide with an adaxial band of hyaline epidermal cells occupying the width of the blade except for the 0.1 mm wide margin. Inflorescence terminal, 1.5-3 X 1-2 cm, consisting of 1-5 up to 4-flowered unilateral cymes (drepania). Lower inflorescence bract resembling a basal leaf, herbaceous, 1.5-2.5 cm long, shorter or longer than the inflorescence, upper bracts much smaller, scale-like or membranaceous. Each flower clasped by 2 obtuse, ca 2 mm long, membranaceous bracteoles. Tepals unequal, lanceolate, acuminate, stramineous, with membranaceous margins, outer ones 5-6 mm long, concave, inner ones 4.5-5 mm long, flat or slightly concave. Stamens 6, ca 2 mm long; filaments filiform; anthers linear, ca 0.8 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, acute to obtuse, round to slightly trigonous in cross section, 3.5-4 X 1.5-2.5 mm, ca 4/5 as long as the tepals, yellowish-brown, unilocular to slightly triseptate. Seeds ellipsoid, apiculate, 0.3-0.4 X ca 0.2 mm, rugose, castaneous.

description: Perennial soft caespitose herb, 10-40 cm high. Rhizome densely and irregularly branching, ca 2 mm diam. Culms erect, 1-20 cm long and always shorter than the leaves, 1-2.5 mm diam, terete, smooth or with small transverse nodules, sometimes branching in the axils of cauline leaves. Cataphylls absent or incon- spicuous. Blade-bearing leaves 1-2 basal and 0-2 cauline to each culm, 6-40 cm long; sheaths 1-6 cm long, membranaceous towards the margins and terminating in 2 rounded, 1-2.5 mm long auricles; blades 1.5-2.5 mm diam, round in cross section but usually flat in pressed specimens, conspicuously transverse-septate. Inflorescence a terminal head or a once to twice branched anthela to 7 X 10 cm with up to 7 heads; heads globose, 10 mm diam. and up to 40-flowered when single, or conical, 5 mm diam and only 6-7-flowered in many-headed inflores- cences. Lower inflorescence bract 4-20 cm long, resembling a cauline leaf, always conspicuously overtopping the inflorescence, sometimes straight, longer than the culm and appearing as a continuation of it except for being cross-septate, sheaths 1-5 cm long, blades 1-2.5 mm diam, floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 2-3 mm long, membranaceous. Tepals equal, 3-4 mm long, lanceolate, acute, brown to reddish with well marked white membranaceous margins. Stamens 6, ca 1.5 mm long; filaments filiform, whitish; anthers oblong, ca 0.5 mm long, yellow. Capsule oblong to obovoid, slightly apiculate and trigonous, 2.3-3 X 1.3-1.6 mm, thin-walled, golden to dark brown. Seeds ellipsoid, apiculate, 0.4-0.5 X ca 0.2 mm, reticulate, brown.

description: Intrageneric relationships.-Juncus planifolius belongs to the group of perennial species in the subgenus Graminifolii Buchenau (Buchenau 1875, 1890, 1906). The annual species of this subgenus, in the sense that Buchenau established it, were separated by Krechetovich and Goncharov (1935) as subgenus Juncinella. The perennial species, including J. planifolius, retained the name Graminifolii. This name is here used in this restricted sense, and its rank will be retained as subgenus, even though some authors (Vierhapper, 1930; Weimarck, 1946) have preferred the rank of section. A distinctive feature of Graminifolii is the flat, grasslike leaves, which have the flat side towards the stem. Furthermore, the flowers are condensed into heads, in which the individual flower is subtended only by a bract at the base of the pedicel. This type of inflorescence is, however, also found in the subgenera Septati, Alpini and Juncinella. Within the subgenus Graminifolii, J. planifolius is most closely related to J. antarcticus Hook.f., J. gracilis R. Br. and J. caespiticius E. Mey. from Australia, with which it shares the features of a leafless stem and lack of clear distinction between the sheath and lamina. In North America subgenus Graminifolii is represented by approximately ten species, among which J. planifolius is most easily distinguished by the combination of the following characters: leaf placement basal, leaving a naked stem; leaves with no clear distinction between the sheath and the lamina and without auricles at the junction; inner tepals obtuse with inflexed margins that apically create a little cap.

description: Arbor parva; rami hornotini brunnei, glandulis minutis breviter stipitatis et pilis sparsis obsiti; folia 1.5-2 cm longe petiolata, pinnis oppositis vel interdum alternis, rhachi primaria 13-15 cm longa non alata sparse pilosula et glandulosa, 14-16-jugis, rhachi secundaria 6-8 cm longa non alata; foliola ca. 80 sessilia, terminale lanceolatum 3.5 cm longum, 1.5 mm latum, caetera elliptica vel suborbicularia basi oblique emarginato-rotundata, apice obtusa vel rotundata, 2-2.5 mm longa, 2 mm lata, nervo medio supra impresso, subtus prominulo, lateralibus utroque latere 1 vel 2, subtus prominulis, glabra vel subtus ad nervos parce pilosula, subtus pallidiora, margine integra, valde revoluta, membranacea; inflorescentiae terminales paniculatae, 30 cm diam., ca. 15 cm longae, pilis simplicibus et glandulis adspersis obsitae; bracteae anguste ovatae, 1 mm longae; pedicelli 2-3 mm longi; calyx 3 mm longus, basi cupuliformis, apice dentatus, dentibus triangularibus acuminatis 1.5 mm longis; corolla 4-4.5 cm longa, purpureo-caerulea, extrinsecus pilosa, tubo ad basin ovatogloboso, 4 mm crasso, deinde constricto, caeterum cylindraceo-campanulato ad apicem 2-2.5 cm lato, recto, lobis orbicularibus vel semi-lunatis, intus villosis; filamenta tubo corollino ca. 1 cm supra basin adnata, 8 mm longa; antherae loculus alter lanceolato-linearis, 3 mm longus, alter nanus 0.6 mm longus; staminodium 2.5 cm longum, basi in 1/5 longitudinis glabrum, caeterum glanduloso-pilosum; discus ovario paullo crassior; ovarium ovatum glabrum; stylus glaber 1.5 cm longus, stigmatibus oblongis; capsula elliptica 4-4.5 cm longa, 2.3-2.5 cm lata, applanata, apice breviter apiculata, basi rotundata, valvis ad medium sulcatis margine incrassatis; semina cum alis ambitu subrectangularia, 8 mm longa, 1.5 cm lata, basi emarginata, semina ipsa 6 mm longa, 4 mm lata, margine plicatula, ala 3-4 mm lata.

description: Very large trees, to 50 m tall and 2 m dbh.; trunk straight, cylindrical, the crown spreading, more or less dichotomously branched; often with 4 or 5 buttresses 60 cm high; bark 1-2 cm thick, almost smooth when young, split into long shallow furrows when older, the plates between furrows breaking into scales, the color whitish gray to buff. Sapwood white to light brown; heartwood very dark olive-brown, heavy,  with lapachol abundant in vessels. Leaves palmately compound, opposite, 5- to 7-foliolate; petioles terete, glabrous, 9-13 (7-17) cm long, pulvinate, the petiolules glabrous, articulated to the leaflet base, the terminal 2.9-6.5 cm, the intermediates 2.4-5.6 cm, the laterals 1.1-3.4 cm long; leaflets lanceolate to narrowly ovate, acuminate, rounded to obtuse, the terminal 9-22 cm long, 3.7-9.5 cm wide, the intermediates 8-19 cm long, 2.8-8.3 cm wide, the laterals 6-14 cm long, 2.1-6.5 cm wide, these often partially divided (if with seven complete leaflets, the most lateral pair much smaller), entire (somewhat serrulate in seedlings), membranous, minutely lepidote especially below, stellately pubescent in axils of lateral nerves below, the hairs multicellular, usually 3-branched. Inflorescence terminal, not congested; flowers in twos or threes, opening synchronously, borne with or without leaves; peduncle and pedicels slightly stellate-rufescent. Calyx campanulate, irregularly 5-lobed to bilabiate, 7-15 mm long, 5-12 mm wide, sparsely stellate pubescent, the hairs small, rather thick. Corolla yellow, with brownish venation when dried, the dried tube reddish; infundibuliform; 6-11 cm long, bilabiate, the three longer lobes 22-33 mm, the two shorter ones 13-24 mm long; glabrous without, within with long, flattened, usually branched, 3- or 4-celled hairs in sinuses and forming four lines of villous pubescence in throat from the four lower sinuses to the level of stamen in- sertion, the two central lines uniting. Stamens didynamous, the longer filaments 15-21 mm long, the shorter filaments 11-16 mm long, staminode 3-9 mm long; anthers 3.5-6 mm long. Pistil 24-33 mm long; ovary linear, 3-5 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, terete, glabrous to somewhat lepidote; disk cupuliform, thin-walled, appearing sunken into base of ovary, 1 mm long, 1.5 mm wide. Fruit elongate-cylindrical, 29-45 cm long, 1.5-3 cm wide, glabrous; calyx deciduous; seeds biseriate, bialate, membranous-winged, 0.9-1.1 cm long, 3.5-4 cm wide.

description: Arbor usque 30 m alta; rami subteretes, cortice griseo, hornotini lepidibus brunneis densissime induti, caeterum glabri; folia petiolis 9-11.5 cm longis, teretibus striatis, laxe lepidibus brunneis suffultis; foliola plerumque 3, petiolulis apicalibus 2.5 cm longis, lateralibus 1.5-2 cm longis oblanceolata 7-10 cm longa, 2-3.8 cm lata, ad apicem latissima, apice obtusa, ad basin versus paullo angustata, basi ipsa obtusa vel subacuta, nervo medio supra impresso subtus prominente, lateralibus utroque latere 6-7, supra obsoletis subtus prominulis, ad marginem anastomosantibus, venis praesertim subtus minute reticulatis, subtus lepidota, margine plana vel paullo recurvata, coriacea; inflorescentiae terminales sessiles vel subsessiles, corymbosae multiflorae usque 15 cm longae dense lepidotae, bracteis subulatis 7 mm longis; cymulae ultimae 3-florae, flore centrali 4-6 mm longe pedicellato, lateralibus 1.5-3 cm longe pedicellatis; calyx cylindraceo-campanulatus, 1.5 cm longus, lobis brevibus obtusissimis vel rotundatis; corolla alba 7-8 cm longa extrinsecus glabra, tubo basi 3 cm longe cylindraceo, deinde valde ampliato, lobis semiorbicularibus 1.5 cm longis et latis; stamina 1 cm supra basin corollae abeuntia; filamenta breviora 7-8 mm, longiora 12 mm longa; antherarum loculi 2.7 mm longi; ovarium lineare dense lepidotum; stylus 2.6 cm longus, glaber; stigmata truncata.

description: Arbores. Folia digitata, opposita (raro alterna), foliolis 5, oblongi-obovatis, abrupte acuminatis vel apiculatis, obtusis vel truncatis, integris, lepidotis, stellato- pilosis, glabrescentibus supra, densissime infra. Inflorescentia terminalis, congesta; flores multi, non omnes in anthesi simultanei. Calyx campanulatus, 5-lobatus, lanati- pubescens, pilis brevibus stellatis necnon pilis longis et simplicibus, indumento aureo. Corolla lutea, venulis in siccatate obscuris in lobis, siccatate tubo bruneolo et lobis flavidis, infundibuliformis, leviter bilabiata, extra glabra, intus villosa in antica pagina. Stamina didynama. Ovarium lineare, lepidotum vel aliquantum pilosum. Discus patelliformis. Fructus elongatus cylindricus, aurei lanati-pubescens. Semina biseriata, bialata, membranaceialata.
