description: Lithophytic, acaulescent herb, 30-35 cm tall including the inflorescence. Roots few (3-5), simple, terete, lanuginose, 1-2 mm in diameter. Leaves 4, grouped into a loose basal rosette, distinctly petiolate, to 14 cm total length, the uppermost one funnelshaped and enclosing the base of the scape; petiole linear, channeled, 2-6 cm long; leaf blade elliptic-oblanceolate, acute, 2-9 cm long, 1-2.8 cm wide. Inflorescence a laxly flowered raceme with 12-15 flowers; scape glabrous below, gradually becoming pubescent above (trichomes sparse, simple, septate, with swollen apical cell), partially covered by 4 tubular, glabrous, acute sheaths. Floral bracts lanceolate, acute, rather sparsely pubescent as the peduncle, covering the basal one-third of the ovary, 2.5-6.5 mm long. Ovary slender, ascending, cylindrical-fusiform, pedicellate, sparsely pubescent as the scape, 6-9 mm long including the pedicel, ca. 0.75 mm in diameter. Flowers small for the genus (ca. 6 mm maximum spread), nonresupinate, greenish white, opening sequentially with most of them eventually open at the same time; perianth segments bearing sparse raphidecontaining idioblasts. Sepals sparsely pubescent outside (trichomes as in the scape), otherwise glabrous. Dorsal sepal lanceolate-elliptic, obtuse-rounded, slightly concave at apex, 3.5 mm long, 1.6 mm wide. Lateral sepals obliquely elliptic, obtuse-rounded and obscurely galeate at apex, three-veined, 3.8 mm long, 2.5 mm wide. Petals fused to the column at base for ca. 0.2 mm, obliquely oblanceolate-spatulate, asymmetrically rounded to truncate, apically papillose (especially on margin), the outer lateral margin repand, one- or two-veined, 4 mm long, 0.7-0.8 mm wide. Labellum joined basally to the ventral surface of the column, shortly clawed, three-lobed, 2.2 mm total length, 2.5 mm wide across the lateral lobes when spread out; claw rounded, with thickened margins that limit a shallow basal cavity, distinctly brownish, ca 0.5 mm long, 0.7 mm wide; lateral lobes semiorbicular, each with an elliptic darker area, ca. 1 mm in diameter; midlobe subtriangular, rounded, slightly concave, papillose on the apical margin and the inner surface, ca. 0.8 mm long, 0.6 mm wide. Column very short, more or less globose, ca. 1.5 mm long; clinandrium slightly concave, with a fleshy, rounded lobe at each side; anther oblong-ovate, rounded, two-celled, with fleshy connective; rostellum narrowly oblong-triangular, blunt after removal of the viscidium; viscidium hamular, with a retrorse dorsal point; stigma a terminal, transversely slit, reminiscent of an open mouth. Pollinia not seen. Capsule fusiform, dis- tinctly pedicellate (not seen mature).

description: Semi-scandent shrub, 1-2 m. tall; branches grayish; branchlets virgate, subterete, densely villose-pubescent with antrorse hairs; inter- nodes 4-6 cm. long; leaves decussate-opposite or subopposite; petioles 3-5 mm. long, somewhat villose-tomentose; blades membranous or rather firm, green above, paler beneath, oblong or oblong-lanceolate, 4.5-14.5 cm. long, 2-6 cm. wide, bluntly short-cuspidate or usually merely acute at apex, entire, longly ancl gently convex along the margins, acute at base and usually attenuate into the petiole, becoming glabrate above [except for the midrib and larger veins], softly short-tomentose beneath; midrib rather prominent beneath, tomentose; secondaries 6-8 pairs, slightly prominent, but not furrowing the leaf above, more or less anastomosing near the margin beneath; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes in the axils of the uppermost leaves, 1.5-6.5 cm. long, 2-3.5 cm. wide, shorter than the subtending leaves, gradually diminishing in size above, many-flowered, dense, conglomerate; paniele terminal, 3-8 cm. long, 2-4.5 cm. wide, its sympodia shortly and densely pubescent-villose with short antrorse hairs; flowers apparently not distinctly diclinous, for in one inflorescence may be found flowers with exserted stamens and somewhat reduced style, flowers with exserted style and shorter stamens, and likewise flowers with both style and stamens long-exserted; peduncles slender, 1-5 cm. long, shortly and densely villosie-pubeseent with antrorse hairs, the axillary ones divaricate; pedieels shortly and densely pubescent like the peduncles; bracts few, foliaceous, lanceolate, stipitate, to 2 cm. long and 0.8 om. wide; bractlets setaceous, shorter than the flowers, 1.5-3 mm. long, rather villose; calyx ovate-campanulate, to 3 mm. long, antrorsely strigose-pubescent, its rim 4-lobed, its lobes ovate, 1- 1.3 mm. long, acute or subacute at apex; corolla white, yellowish- brown, or orange, glabrous outside, its tube cylindric, about 8 mm. long, exserted from the calyx, not at all or but slightly ampliate below the limb, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, subequal, about 3 mm. long and 1.5 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens exserted to, 5 mm. beyond the corolla; pistil included or exserted to 5 mm. beyond the corolla; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Moldenke, Richard G. 1934. A monograph of the genus Aegiphila. Brittonia. 1 (5-6): 245-471.

description: Shrub; branchlets rather stout, acutely or obtusely tetragonal, flattened and ampliate at the nodes, very medullose, very densely appressed-strigose with extremely minute hairs, becoming merely ineanous-puberulent or pulverulent in age; internodes 1.5-3 cm. long; leaf-scars prominent, scutelliform; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 5-8 mm. long, strigose-pubeseent, becoming merely granular-pulveru- lent; blades chartaceous, dark green above, lighter beneath, lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 14-20 cm. long, 3.8-6.5 cm. wide, acute or slightly acuminate at apex, cuneate at base and long-attenuate into the petiole, margin dentate with numerous fine apiculate teeth or merely subdentate throughout, very sparsely strigillose above, but roughened by very numerous and minute elevated punctae, densely strigose-pubeseent beneath with extremely short hairs; midrib stout below, rapidly becoming slender toward the apex, very prominent beneath and slightly so above; secondaries 8-11 pairs, slender, arcuate- ascending, slightly prominent beneath, rather inconspicuously anas- tomosing near the margins; veinlets obscure; infloreseence axillary; eymes solitary, opposite, capitate or subumbellate, 3-6 cm. long, 2-4.5 cm. wide, dense and congested, conspicuously bracteate, with the bracts often large and foliaceous and forming a false involuere at the base of the capitulum; peduncles extremely slender, 2-4 cm. long, ineanous-puberulent or glabrate; pedicels 'slender and densely pubescent, 1-3 mm. long, or obsolete; bracts broadly lanceolate, ellip- tic, or oblong, 5-24 mm. long, 4-8 mm. wide, very numerous among the flowers, often simulating a basal involuere, very conspicuous; calyx eyathiform, about 6 mm. long and 5.3 mm. wide, densely strigose-pubeseent, very lax around the corolla-tube, its rim 4-toothed or 4-lobed, its lobes broad, bluntly acuminate or cuspidate; corolla infundibular, its tube narrow-cylindric, about 6.2 mm. long, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 4 mm. long and 2.3 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; description: Shrub 2-4 m tall; branchlets quadrangular, tan or gray. Leaves petiolate, opposite, with blade bright yellow-green above, pale yellow-green and dull below, densely brown-velvety pubescent above and below, margins ciliolate, oblanceolate to lanceolate, 20-30 X 5-10.5 cm, base acute to acuminate, apex acute, midrib caniculate above, prominent below, primary veins 12-17 pairs per side, all veins densely pubescent; interpetiolar stipules deciduous, terminal stipules lanceolate, 3-6 X 1.3-2 cm, densely golden-brown-pubescent. Inflorescence axillary, thrysoid, central axis 16-20 cm, densely brown-pubescent. Flowers with calyx tube 2 mm long, lobes 5, 6-8 mm long, lanceolate; corolla green, lobes 6 mm long, tube 4 mm long; stamens 5, inserted on base of tube, filaments ca. 8 mm long, anthers 3 mm long; style 3.5 mm long, stigma 2-lobed, lobes 0.8 mm long. Fruits linear-lanceolate, 2.2-4 X 0.5-0.6 cm, densely brown-pubescent, calyx lobes persistent, lanceolate, 6-7 mm long. Seeds flat, rectangular, 5 x 1 mm.

description: Low tree; branchlets medium, obtusely tetragonal or subterete, flattened and ampliate at the nodes, densely puberulent throughout; internodes 6-8.5 cmi. long; leaves decussate; petioles often rather stout, weak, 10-14 mm. long, densely puberulent; blades membranous, dark, broadly oblong, 9-16 cm. long, 4-10 cm. wide, abruptly acuminate at apex, enitire, rounded or subtruncate at base, densely pubescent on both surfaces; mlidrib stout, prominent beneath; secondaries slender, 9-11 pairs, rather regular, arcuate; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes solitary, opposite, to 5 cm. long and wide, about -3 as long as the subtendinig leaves, brachiate, bracteolate, many-flowered; panicle terminal, to 12 cm. long and 7.5 cm. wide, composed of about 5 cymes, congested, its sympodia greatly abbreviated, densely puberulent; peduncles rather slender, 1.8-5 cm. long, densely puberulent; pedicels [in fruit] slender, 5-12 mm. long, puberulent; bracts apparently few, large and foliaceous; bractlets and prophylla few, setaceous, to 5 mm. long; flowers not seen; fruitinog-calyx ind-urate, cupuliform or patelliform, abruptly truncate at base, about 2 mm. long and 7 mm. wide, puberulent, its rim entire, investing the extreme base of the mature fruit; fruit oblong, to 11 mm long and 8 mm. wide, orange, glabrate, umbilicate at apex, 4-seeded.

description: Herba 10-35 cm alta, caulibus prostratis hirsutis, foliae 20-45 mm longa X 7-17 mm lata, elliptica vel oblongo-lanceolata, utrinque hirsuta; calyx 6-sectus; corolla 6-lobata, roseola ad lilacea, infundibuliformis, 6-7 mm longa, externe lobi dorso apicale dense pilloso, tubo intus pilis moniliformibus. Stamina 6, stilus apice trifido. Mericarpia 3, 2-2.5 mm longa, papillis, usque ad 700-800 µ longis.
bibliographicCitation: Cabral, Elsa L. & Bacigalupo, Nélida M. 2005. Novelties in Spermacoceae (Rubiaceae) from Bolivia and Paraguay. Brittonia. 57 (2): 129-140.

description: Suffruticose herb, prostate; stems 10-55 cm long, subtetragonal, fistulose, hirsute. Leaves 20-45 X 7-17 mm, elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, apex acute or slightly acuminate, hirsute; stipular sheath 2.5-3.5 mm long, hirsute, the setae 5-6, each 4-9 mm long, sparsely hairy. Terminal heads (inflorescences)1.5-2.5 cm wide, 5-6 involucral bracts. Flower: hypanthium 1.5-2 mm long, papillose; calyx 6-merous, lobes 2.5-3 mm long, hirsute, with long and scattered hairs towards the apex; corolla lilac or pale pink, infundibuliform, 6-7 mm long, 6-lobed, glabrous outside, with scarce hairs at the apex, with a ring of moniliform hairs internally; anthers 0.7-1 mm long, filaments 1-1.5 mm long; style 6.5-7 mm long, trifid, stigma spatulate-recurved; ovary 3-carpelate. Schizocarp 2-4.7 mm long, mericarps obovoid, with narrow, lineal commissural face, edges and dorsal face densely papillose, papillae longer on the distal half, to 730-800 µm long. Seeds 4-4.5 mm long, obovoid, furrowed on the ventral face.
bibliographicCitation: Cabral, Elsa L. & Bacigalupo, Nélida M. 2005. Novelties in Spermacoceae (Rubiaceae) from Bolivia and Paraguay. Brittonia. 57 (2): 129-140.

description: Shrub; branchlets slender, white, very densely spreading-pilose with short white hairs, becoming more sparsely so in age; leaf-scars elevated; internodes 1.5-3 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 5-6 mm. long, spreading-pilose like the branchlets; blades membranous, similar in color on both surfaces, oblong-lanceolate, 6.5-9 cm. long, 2.8-3.8 cm. wide, acute or acuminate at apex, entire, acute at base, scabrous on both surfaces, often very pronouncedly so and often ciliate along the margins; midrib slender, prominent beneath, more or less pilose or finally only scabrous; secondaries few, slender, about 5 pairs, barely discernible on either surface; veinlets indiscernible; inflorescence eymose, loosely spreading, axillary or often terminating short axillary or subterminal twigs, few-flowered, bracteolate, very slender and lax throughout; peduncles very slender, to 24 mm. long, abbreviated on purely axillary eymes to 4 mm., pilose; pedicels filiform, 6-9 mm. long, pilose; bracts large and foliaceous, lanceolate or oblong; bractlets setaceous; calyx turbinate, about 4.1 mm. long and 3.1 mm. wide, glabrate or granular-pulverulent, its rilm subtruneate, minutely 4-apiculate; corolla infundibular, its tube cylindric, about 13.5 mm. long, glabrous, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 5.2 mm. long and 2 mm. wide, acute; stamens 4, inserted about 2 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, exserted  (in male); filaments filiform, 3.1-3.8 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Moldenke, Richard G. 1934. A monograph of the genus Aegiphila. Brittonia. 1 (5-6): 245-471.

description: Subscandent shrub, 2-4 m tall; branches slender, spreading, subterete or slightly flattened at the nodes, grayish, incanous or appressed- tomentose; branchlets short, slender, subterete or obsoletely tetragonal, tomentose; internodes 3-5 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles about 4 mm. long, slender, weak, densely yellowish-pubescent; blades membranous, shiny green above, paler beneath, oblong or ovate, 7-14 cm. long, 3-7.5 cm. wide, varying from acute to acuminate or cuspidate at apex, more or less rounded at base, entire, glabrous above except for the spreading pilose midrib, softly and rather denisely spreading pilose beneath, especially along the midrib and larger veins; midrib slender, prominent beneath, pilose on both surfaces; secondaries 10-12 pairs, slender, delicate, irregular, prominent and deensely pilose be- neath, more or less anastomosing along the margins; veinlets slender, irregular; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes only about 1.5 cm. long and 1 cm. wide, conglobate-capitate, dense, remote; panicle terminal, narrow, about 5 cm. long and 3 cm. wide, often somewhat spicate, uninterrupted; flowers subsessile, diclinous; peduncles slender, 1-2 cm. long, yellowish-pubescent; pedicels very short or obsolete; bractlets few, linear, 2-5 mm. long, strigose; calyx campanulate, about 3.5 mm. long and 1.8 mm. wide, glabrous ( ?) or laxly strigose, its rim 4-lobed, its lobes about 1 mm. long, ovate, acute or somewhat mucronate at apex; corolla infundibular, yellow, its tube slender, cylincdric, 3-5 mm. long, glabrous, its lobes 4, ovate-lingulate, about 1.8 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, acute at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 0.8 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male) or included (in female); filaments filiform, almost obsolete or to 0.1 mm. long in ?, elongate in female); anthers ovate, about 0.4 mm. long and 0.1 mm. wide; pistil long-exserted (in female); style capillary, 4.5-9 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches slender, about 4 mm. long, woolly; ovary dark, obpyriform, about 1.5 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, umbilicate at apex, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx light, cupuliform, antrorsely strigose, its rim irregularly scalloped, with 4 distinct and spreading points; fruit ovoid, flattened at both ends, glabrous.

description: Suffrutex, 25-50 cm alto, caule tereti vel subquadrangulari, puberulo vel velutino, internodiis 2-3 cm longis; folia 1-2 cm longa X 0.4-0.8 cm lata, pseudo fasciculata, elliptica vel elliptico-lanceolata, pubescentia; glomeruli florales 5-6 in ramis floriferis, 2 bracteis involucralibus quam glomerulis longioribus.
bibliographicCitation: Cabral, Elsa L. & Bacigalupo, Nélida M. 2005. Novelties in Spermacoceae (Rubiaceae) from Bolivia and Paraguay. Brittonia. 57 (2): 129-140.

description: Subshrub, 25-50 cm tall, stems terete to subquadrangular, puberulous or velutinous; internodes 2-3 cm long. Leaves 1-2 X 0.4-0.8 cm, pseudoverticillate, elliptic or elliptic-lanceolate, pubescent, with 2-3 inconspicuous pairs of secondary veins. Stipular sheath 2-2.5 mm long, pubescent with 5 setae, each 2-2.5 mm long. Heads (inflorescences) 5-6, terminal and axillary, the 2 involucral bracts longer than heads. Flower: hypanthium 1-1.5 mm long, turbinate, pubescent; calyx 2-merous, the lobes 1.5-2 mm long, linear, dentate; corolla infundibuliform, white, 4.5-7 mm long, pubescent externally, with moniliform hairs internally at the middle of the tube; stamens exserted, filaments 1.5-2 mm long, anthers ca. 1 mm long; style 6-7 mm long, stigma bifid; disk entire. Fruit a capsule, pubescent. Seed subellipsoid, 0.7-1 mm long, dark brown, the ventral furrow partially covered by a strophiole.
bibliographicCitation: Cabral, Elsa L. & Bacigalupo, Nélida M. 2005. Novelties in Spermacoceae (Rubiaceae) from Bolivia and Paraguay. Brittonia. 57 (2): 129-140.

description: Woody vine; branches and branchlets obsoletely tetragonal or subterete, densely villose-hirsute with long ferruginous hairs of various lengths and standing at right angles to the branchlets or reflexed; internodes 6.5-13 cm. long; leaves decussate-opposite or subopposite, subsessile; blades thinly membranous, dark green and subnitid above, lighter beneath, varying from ovate or ovate-elliptic to oblong, 10-18 cm. long, 6-10.3 cm. wide, short-acuminate at apex, ciliate at the margins, cordate or subcordate and often somewhat inequilateral at base, laxly strigose-hirsute or setose-hirsute on both surfaces, especially along the larger veins beneath, the hairs about 2 mm. long, ap-pressed and forward-pointing above, more setose or bristly beneath, ferruginous; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes solitary, opposite, 3-5.5 cm. long, about 3 cm. wide, many-flowered, very densely congested into a capitulum or, if subsessile, more or less glomerate, bracteolate; terminal panicle narrow, to 14 cm. long and 6 cm. wide, composed of several cymes which are sessile or subsessile and extremely dense and congested, its sympodia abbreviated, similar to the branchlets; axillary peduncles 1-3 mm. long or obsolete, terminal ones 5-6 cm. long, densely ferruginous-hirsute; pedicels slender, 1-3 mm. long, densely hirsute; bractlets filiform, exceeding the calyx, densely hirsute; calyx obconic-campanulate or cyathiform, 4-5 mm. long, about 2.5 mm. wide, densely ferruginous-hirsute, its rim 4-toothed or 4-lobed; corolla infundibular or hypocrateriform, red-purple, its tube slender, cylindric, 8-10 mm. long, its lobes 4, oblong- or ovate-lingu-late, about 3.6 mm. long and 1.5 mm. wide, subacute at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1 mm. below and mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male) or included (in female); filaments filiform, to 10 mm. long (in male), glabrate or slightly pilose; anthers oblong, about 1 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide; pistil included (in male); style capillary, about 6.7 mm. long (in male); stigma bifid, its branches about 2.6 mm. long; ovary tetragonal, flattened at both ends, about 0.5 mm. long and wide, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Moldenke, Richard G. 1934. A monograph of the genus Aegiphila. Brittonia. 1 (5-6): 245-471.

description: Liana. Hojas con los peciolos 6-12 mm de largo; liminas 4-6.5 X 1-2 cm, angostamente elípticas a angostamente ovado-elipticas, elíptice gradualmente acuminado o agudo, la base cuneada. Inflorescencias más cortas que las hojas adyacentes; pedúnculo 2-13 mm de largo, las bricteas 0.5-1.5 X 0.5 mm, los pedicelos 8-13 mm de largo; sépalos 1.5-1.75 x 1-1.3 mm, angostamente ovados, acuminados y con el apice conspicuamente reflexo apicalmente, glabros, coléter irregularmente lacerado apicalmente; corola campanulada, verde, con el interior verde amarillento, el tubo 2.5-3 mm de largo, 3-3.5 mm en diaimetro en la boca, la corona anular tenue, menos de 0.5 mm, inconspicuamente lobulada, los lóbulos 2.5-3 X 1.7-2 mm, ovados, irregularmente ciliados marginalmente; anteras ca. 3 mm de largo, glabras, con ca. la mitad de su longitud exserta, pero envueltas y ocultas por los lóbulos de la corola; ovario 0.8-1.3 mm de largo, glabro, cabeza estigmitica 0.9-1 mm de largo, los nectarios mis cortos que el ovario. Foliculos desconocidos.

Rchb.f. simile, sed foliis apice inaequaliter bilobatis (nec cuspidatis), inflorescentibus 1.5-2.5 cm longis (nec 6-12 cm) , bracteis distichis (nec spiralibus), lobo medio labelli mucronato (nec retuse), disco labelli prope apicem lamellato (nec protuberanti) differt.

description: Epiphytic plant. Stem arching or pen- dent, stout, terete, slightly flattened, to 30-40 cm long, 5-6 mm wide. Internodes 1.5-2.5 cm long. Leaves distichous, thick and fleshy, oblong, 6-12 X 1.9-2.2 cm, apex unequally bilobed and obtuse, sheathing and amplexicaulous at base, the nerves 9, raised on both surfaces when dry. Inflorescences racemose, extra-axillary, arching, 1-3-flowers, rachises flattened, about 1.5-2.5 cm long; bracts broadly triangular, lax and distichous, conduplicate-concave, fleshy, 2.5-3.0 x 3.5-4.0 mm, the apex acute and persistent. Ovary and pedicel ca. 1.5 cm long, greenish. Flowers white, becoming yellowish, glabrous, not opening wide, last- ing only one day; upper sepal elliptic, ca. 1.5 x 0.6 cm, margin entire, the apex ob- tuse and 5-nerved; lateral sepals somewhat obliquely elliptic, 1.4-1.5 x ca. 0.6 cm, 5- nerved, apex obtuse with a short tip; petals similar to but slightly smaller than sepals, oblong-ovate, ca. 1.1-1.2 x 0.6 cm, 5- nerved, apex acute; lip slightly pouched, widely ellipsoid, ca. 0.8 x 1.2 cm when spread wide, side-lobes abruptly narrowed to an acute apex, slightly curved forward, mid-lobe very short, fleshy, densely cov- ered with many mastoid hairs, disc golden- yellow, the center of disc with a single, nar- row horizontal callus and the top mucro- nate, the upper part elongating into a la- mella that is broadly linguiform, ca. 3.0 x 1.5 mm high, truncate at apex. Column short, the column foot ca. 3 mm long; an- ther cap whitish yellow, ca. 1.8 mm wide; pollinia 4, in 2 pairs. Capsule oblong, ca. 9.5 cm long, 0.6 cm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Chen, Wen H. & Shui, Yu M. 2005. A New Species of Thrixspermum (Orchidaceae) from China. Brittonia. 57 (1): 55-58.

description: Herba perennis, erecta, bulbosa; caules 55-80 cm alti; bulbus ovoideus 4-7 cm longus et 2-2.5 cm latus; spathae bractearum subaequales, 5.5-6.5 cm longae et 0.7 cm latae; pedicellus gracillimus deflexus, 5.5-6 cm longa; flores plures, nutantes, campanulati aut poculiformis, 1.3-2.5 cm diametro; tepala externa ovata, cirrata, 1.5-1.6 cm longa et 0.8-0.9 cm lata, lineis et maculis purpureis; tepala interna unguiculata, concava, ovata, cirrata, lineis et maculis purpureis, 0.9 cm longa et 0.6-0.7 cm lata; glande alba, in forma littera V inversa, partem apicem positae, 4 mm lata.
bibliographicCitation: Rodríguez, A. & García-Mendoza, Abisaí J. 2004. Tigridia amatlanensis (Tigridieae: Iridaceae), a new species from Oaxaca, Mexico. Brittonia. 56 (2): 128-131.

description: Erect, bulbous, perennial herb, 55-80 cm high, glabrous; bulb ovoid, 4.5-7 X 2-2.5 cm, the outer tunics thin, pale brown; flowering stem unbranched or bearing 1 or 2 branches; basal leaves 1, linear, plicate, 31- 94 cm X 7-9 mm, shorter or longer than the flowering stem; cauline leaves 2, the upper one much reduced, linear plicate, 19- 35 cm X 3-12 mm; inflorescence a rhipidium with subequal spathe valves, 5.5-6.5 X 0.7 cm; pedicels linear-filiform, 5.5-6 cm long; flowers 6-8 per rhipidium, nodding, campanulate, 1.3-2.5 cm wide; outer tepals ovate, cirrhous, with purple lines and spots, 1.5-1.6 X 0.8-0.9 cm; inner tepals broadly unguiculate, concave, ovate, cirrhous, 0.9 X 0.6-0.7 cm; nectary an inverted V-shaped band, 4 mm broad, covering almost the entire tepal, white, the non-nectariferous portion of the tepal with purple lines and spots; filaments connate, 3-5 mm long; anthers spreading, yellowish, 5 mm long; pollen grains bisulcate, exine reticulate; ovary clavate-lanceolate, 3-5 X 1.5 mm; style branches 5 mm long, deeply bifid into 2 arms, red to purple, a mucro present in style arm sinuses, 1-1.5 mm long; mature capsule oblong-clavate, truncate, 1.1-2.2 cm long, 0.7-0.9 cm diam.; seeds ovoid, 2.5 X 1.5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Rodríguez, A. & García-Mendoza, Abisaí J. 2004. Tigridia amatlanensis (Tigridieae: Iridaceae), a new species from Oaxaca, Mexico. Brittonia. 56 (2): 128-131.

description: Shrub or low tree, to 3.5 m. tall, branching below; stems erect, terete, very medullose [like those of a Sambucus]; branches spreading, obtusely tetragonal, conspicuously flattened at the nodes, grayish and rather densely short-pubescent; branchlets virgate, drooping, obtusely tetragonal, usually flattened and ampliate at the nodes, often noticeably constricted above them, very densely ochraceous-pubescent; internodes 5-8.5 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles rather stout, 7-13 mm. long, densely ochraceous-pubescent; blades membranous, dark green above, lighter beneath, ovate or oblong, 9.5-18 cm. long, 3.5-7 cm. wide, acuminate at apex [rarely acute], truncate or rounded or even cordate at base, sometimes slightly inequilateral, entire, densely ochraceous-pubescent on both surfaces, becoming sparsely so and extremely roughened above in age; midrib rather prominent beneath and slightly so above, densely pubescent; secondaries 6-9 pairs, irregularly placed, arcuate-ascending; inflorescence supra-axillary and terminal; cymes solitary, opposite, brachiate, 1/3 - 1/2 as long as the subtending leaves, many-flowered, bracteolate; terminal panicle to about 10 cm. long and 6 cm. wide, composed of very few dense-flowered and congested cymes; peduncles stout, 4-5.5 cm. long, densely ochraceous-pubescent, spreading, arising from above the axils of the leaves; pedicels 1-3 mm. long, densely pubescent, stout and incrassate in fruit; bractlets linear or subulate, to 7 mm. long, densely pubescent; calyx campanulate, often constricted above the ovary, 6.2-6.7 mm. long, 4.3-4.6 mm. wide, densely spreading-tomentose or hirsute with hairs that are about 1 mm. long, lax around the corolla-tube, its rim deeply 4-lobed, its lobes triangulate-ovate, 1.3-2.6 mm. long, about 2.3 mm. wide at base, acute at apex; corolla infundibular or hypocrateriform, yellowish-white, its tube cylindric, 6-6.2 mm. long, ampliate above, glabrous outside, densely pilose within, its lobes 4, oblong- or ovate-lingulate, about 4.6 mm. long and 2.6 mm. wide, patent, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1.5 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, included (in female); filaments filiform, about 1 mm. long (in female), densely pilose; anthers oblong or ovate, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.2 mm; Wide, incumbent; pistil long-exserted (in female); style capillary, to 9.5 mm. long (in female), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 5.2 mm. long; ovary subrotund, about 1.6 mm. long and wide, flattened and 4-lobed at apex, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx cupuliform, greatly enlarged and indurated, to about 10 mm. long and 15 mm. wide, pubescent, its rim deeply triangulate-lobed; fruit ovoid or subglobose, somewhat narrowed and umbilicate at apex, about 14 mm. long and 10 mm. wide, yellow or orange, glabrate, 4-seeded.

description: Lower leaves often ovate and slender-petiolate, the upper increasingly narrower, those above the middle of the stem narrowly triangular to almost linear, 7-10 (-20) mm wide at base, (3-) 4-7 cm long, usually folded along the midrib toward the upper surface and the whole blade declined and somewhat appressed to the stem; petioles 5-13 mm long, much shorter than the blades; serrations shallow and elongated with the axis of the blade, 15-25 on each side; inflorescences 1-1.7 (-3) cm long, the single [female] flower well above the base, the a part of the raceme 8-13 mm long, with 12-20 flowers; styles 1.5-1.7 mm long, connate at base only, the tips at anthesis scarcely exserted from the abundanit hairs of the ovary, the inner surfaces strongly papillose (Figure 35, upper left) seed 3 mm in diameter.

description: Shrub or tree; branches terete, light gray, glabrous; branchlets rather slender, subterete, brownish, shiny, glabrous or often sparsely pilose at the nodes, with conspicuous light-colored lenticels; buds densely villose-pubescent; internodes 3-5.5 cm. long; leaves opposite or ternate, somewhat clustered at the tips of the branchlets, often subsessile; petioles very short, to 5 mm. long (usually much less), spreading, canaliculate above, usually winged, glabrous; blades sub- coriaceous or chartaceous, shiny green on both surfaces, paler beneath, lanceolate-oblong or obovate, 7-22 cm. long, 4-10 cm. wide, often very unequally paired, the lower ones much smaller and somewhat elliptic or oval, acute or acuminate (rarely emarginate) at apex, entire, acuminate or cuneate at base, glabrous on both surfaces, very con- spicuously and finely reticulate-veined; midrib slender, prominent beneath, glabrous; secondaries very slender and delicate, 8-10 pairs, prominent beneath, glabrous; veinlets dense, conspicuously reticulate; inflorescence axillary; cymes solitary, opposite, about 5 cm. long and 2.5 cm. wide, usually trichotomous and 3-flowered, in the axils of the leaves or at the leaf-scars of the preceding year, lax, spreading; peduncles filiform, 2-3 cm. long, weak, spreading, brownish, glabrous; pedicels filiform, 10-15 mm. long, brown, glabrous; bractlets 2, at the top of the peduncle, subulate, ciliate; calyx firm, obconic or cyathi- form, broadly campanulate at apex, about 5 mm. long and 6 mm. wide, gradually merging into the pedicel below, glabrate, its rim very lax and spreading, subtruncate, with 4 short and triangular cusps; corolla infundibular, long-persistent, its tube cylindric, hardly ampli- ate above, about 4 mm. long, glabrous, its lobes 5, lanceolate-lingulate, about 6 mm. long and 1.3 mm. wide, subacute; stamens 5, inserted about 0.6 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, equaling the tube or long-exserted; filaments filiform, 0.8-5.3 mm. long, somewhat flat- tened, pubescent; anthers ovate, about 0.5 mm. long and wide, dark; pistil apparently long-exserted; style capillary, about 10 mm. long, glabrous; ovary oval, tetragonal, about 1 mm. long and wide, flattened and umbilicate at both ends, glabrous; fruiting pedicels and fruiting- calyx hardly changed; fruit ovoid, rather tetragonal, about 5 mm. long and 4 mm. wide [when immature!], umbilicate at both ends, smooth, 4-celled, semi-included by the fruiting-calyx.

description: Shrub; branchlets obtusely tetragonal or subterete, densely brown- ish or fuscous-lanate above, becoming merely densely pubescent in age; internodes 10-23 mm. long; leaf-scars large and prominent, oblong or subeircular; buds woolly; leaves decussate-opposite or ap- proximate with intervals of 1-10 mm. between the members of a pair; petioles to 5 mm. long or nearly obsolete, densely fuscous-pubeseent; blades membranous or subcoriaceous, green and nitid on both surfaces, varying from oblanceolate to obovate, 6.5-10 cm. long, 2-5.5 cm. wide, abruptly acute at apex, cuneate at base, obtusely crenate or scalloped along the margins, especially above the middle, densely brownish velvety-pubescent on both surfaces when young and mostly during anthesis, the pubescence later deciduous, leaving both surfaces of the blades densely covered with tiny punctae, often marked with glandular disks along both sides of the midrib beneath; midrib prominent on both surfaces, especially at the base beneath; secondaries slender, 5-7 pairs, prominent beneath and slightly so above, ascending, anastomos- ing near the margins; infloreseence axillary; eymes capitate or con- globate, very dense, many-flowered, about 15 mm. long and wide, densely villose-lanate throughout; peduncles slender, 4-6 mm. long, villose; flowers sessile; pedicels in fruit 1 mm. long or obsolete; calyx turbinate, 3-5.2 mm. long, about 2.6 mm. wide, densely villose-pubes- cent, its rim usually irregularly split in a somewhat 2-lipped fashion; corolla hypocrateriform, its tube cylindric, 3.1-6.2 mm. long, glabrous, its lobes 4, ovate-lingulate, about 3.1 mm. long and 1.5 mm. wide, acute at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1.3 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, included (in Y ) or exserted (in & ); filaments fili- form, 0.2-4.3 mm. long, glabrous; anthers oblong, about 0.7 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide; pistil included (in & ) or exserted (in 9 ); style light, capillary, 2-6 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches 1-1.5 mm. long; ovary pyriform, about 1.3 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, glabrous, umbilicate, 4-celled, often only 2-ovuled; fruiting-calyx en- larged and indurated, cupuliform, about 4 mm. long and 6 mm. wide, ribbed, gray-pubescent, fitting rather closely about the lower portion of the fruit, its rim rather irregularly and shallowly lobed; fruit oblong, about 7 mm. long and 5 mm. wide, very glabi )us and shiny, somewhat wrinkled in drying, apparently 1-seeded by abortion.

description: Monoecious annual, of fresh-water streams, entirely submersed. Stems slender, branched. Leaves in pseudowhorls of 3, entire, sessile, stipulate, linear, flattened, 0.5-0.8 mm wide, ca 4.5 cm long, 1-veined, the apex mucronate. Inflorescence composed of axillary pairs of flowers, 1 staminate and 1 carpellate. Flowers lacking perianth; staminate flower of 1 stamen, the filament ca 2.5 mm long, the anther 4-loculate, the connective prolonged into a blunt tip ca 0.2 mm long; carpellate flowers with 4-5 separate carpels basally surrounded by a membranous envelope, the style ca 0.3 mm long, the stigma asymmetrically funnel-shaped, ca 1 mm long, ca 0.9 mm wide. Fruits drupaceous, with membranous exocarp, fleshy mesocarp, and stony endocarp, 2.8-3.5 mm long, 0.7-1.1 mm wide, the rostrum 1.9-2 mm long, the gynopodium 0.5-0.6 mm long, the pedicel 0.9-1 mm long, the endocarp spiny. Seed one, the embryo straight.

description: Shrub, 3-4 m. tall; branehlets stoutish, blunt, subterete, often divarieate, gray, roughened-striate, sordid, short-pilose or glabreseent; internodes 3-9 em. long; leaves decussate; petioles stout, 1-9 mm. long, densely long-setose or hirsute; blades ehartaeeous, rather dark green above, lighter beneath, oblong or obovate, mostly more or less asymmetrieal, 13-25 em. long, 5-8 em. wide, aeuminate at apex, mostly unevenly angulate or sinuate along the margins, euneate at base, glabrous on both surfaees exeept for the midrib and seeondaries whieh are sparsely long-setose or hirsute with seattered hairs above, much more densely so beneath; midrib prominent beneath and slightly so above; secondaries slender, 8-12 pairs, rather regular, arcuate-aseend- ing, inconspicuously anastomosing at the margins; veinlets delicate, not discernible above; infloreseence axillary and terminal; eymes in the axils of the leaves or standing at the very apex of the blunt branchlets, 3-11 cm. long, 3-5 cm. wide, many-flowered, dense, usually subumbellate, digitately fureate, bracteate, braeteolate, often 1 long- pedunculate and 1 short-peduneulate issuing from the same axil (!); peduncles slender, straight, 2-9 cm. long, usually tetragonal and suleate, densely hirsute with brownish hairs which are 1-2 mm. long and stand at right angles to the peduncle; pedicels filiform, 5-10 mm. long, densely hirsute; bracts 2, foliaceous, at the apex of the peduncle; bractlets linear, to 17 mm. long, about 0.5 mm. wide throughout, densely hirsute with long spreading hairs; calyx campanulate, con- tracted to above the ovary, patent above to a 4-angled or tetragonal shape, about 5.2 mm. long and wide, long-hirsute or setose with hairs that are spreading and 1-2 mm. long, lax around the corolla-tube, its rim patent, subtruneate, 4-angulate, each angular tooth terminated by a greatly elongated cusp which is an additional 4-6 mm. in length and also sparsely long-setose; corolla hypocrateriform, its tube cylin- dric, about 6.7 mm. long, ampliate above, glabrous outside, pilose within, its lobes 5, oblong-lingulate, about 5 mm. long and 2.3 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 5, inserted about 2 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, iiacluded (in 9 ) or slightly exserted (in ) filaments filiform, 1.5-2 mm. long, glabrate; anthers oblong, about 2 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, much smaller in 9; pistil subincluded (in S ) or long-exserted (in 9 ); style capillary, 4-8.5 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches 2.6-4.7 mm. long, divergent; ovary barrel-shaped, flattened at both ends, about 1 mm. long and 0.7 mm. wide, puberulent, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Frutex; hornotinis crassiusculis subteretibus saepe divaricatis rugoso-striatis sordidis breviter pilosis vel glabreseentibus; foliis op- positis brevissime petiolatis vel subsessilibus; petiolis crassis longe setosis; laminis chartaceis plusminus asymmetricis acuminatis ad mar- ginem plerumque angulato-sinuatis ad basin cuneatis, utrinque glabris praeter venam mediam et venas secondarias; vena media supra leviter subtus dense longe setosa; infloreseentiis axillaribus terminalibusque; eymis pedunculatis nultifloris saepe subumbellatis densis digitate fur- catis bracteatis et bracteolatis; peduneulis gracilibus strictis ple- rumque tetragonis et suleatis longitudine variis dense hirsutis; pedi- cellis filiformibus elongatis dense hirsutis; bracteis 2 foliaceis ad apicem peduneuli; bracteolis elongatis linearibus dense hirsutis; calyce campanulato dense et longe setoso, margine 4-angulato longis- sime 4-cuspidato vel 4-caudato; corolla hypocrateriforme, lobis 5 oblongis obtusis; staminibus 5 inelusis vel breviter exsertis; pistillo subincluso vel longe exserto'; stigmate bifido; ovario minute doliiforme puberulente 4-loculare.

description: Shrub ( ?); branchlets apparently rather slender, densely short- pubescent, flattened and greatly ampliate at (at least the upper) nodes; leaves decussate; petioles stout, 2.5-3 cm. long, densely puberu- lent; blades chartaceous, rather dark green and subnitid above, lighter beneath, oblanceolate, 23-35 cm. long, 6-11.5 cm. wide, long-acuminate or caudate at apex, long-attenuate into the petiole, conspicuously den- tate along the margins except on the acumination and at the base, more densely and uniformly so above the middle, practically glabrate above, densely and uniformly puberulent beneath; midrib stout, usu- ally very prominent beneath [on mature leaves]; secondaries 12-15 pairs, slender, rather inconspicuous, decidedly arcuate, anastomosing near the margins; veinlet reticulation delicate; infloreseence axillary; peduncles very slender, 1.5-3 cm. long, densely puberulent; eymes solitary, opposite, capitate, densely many-flowered, brachiate, densely short-pubescent throughout, about 1.5 cm. long and 2 cm. wide when mature, conspicuously bracteolate; pedicels minute or obsolete; calyx campanulate, about 5.2 mm. long and 2.8 mm. wide, densely pubes- cent, its margin deeply 4-lobed, its lobes triangular-ovate, about 1.5 mm. long and wide, obtuse and subulate-apiculate at apex; corolla infundibular, its tube narrow-cylindric, about 2.6 mm. long, ampliate  above, glabrous, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 3.1 mm. long and 1.5 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 2 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, very slightly exserted (in male ); fila- ments filiform, about 1.8 mm. long (in male ), glabrous; anthers oblong, about 1.3 mm. long and 0.7 mm. wide; pistil included (in male ); style capillary, about 2 mm. long (in male ), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 1.5 mm. long; ovary subglobose, about 1 mm. long and wide, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Diffuse shrub or small tree, 2.5-7 m. tall, or loosely twining vine; branches obtusely tetragonal or subterete, grayish-brown, shortly and densely tomentose or canescent, becoming' glabrate in age, marked with numerous prominent lenticels; branchlets diffuse, brachiate, obsoletely tetragonal or terete, somewhat compressed at the nodes, varying from softly and densely incanons to tomentose-lanuginous or fulvo-pubescent; internodes 3-6 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles 4-13 mm. long, densely lanuginous-tomentose; blades membranous or the older ones subcoriaceous, grayish-green, nitid, ovate or oblong-ovate, 5-16 cm. long, 2-9 cm. wide, varying from acute or acuminate to short-cuspidate [or very rarely rounded] at apex, entire, acute or sub-cuneate [or rarely obtusely rounded] at base, sometimes slightly asymmetrical, glabrate above except for the midrib and secondaries, softly and densely canescent-tomentose beneath, especially along the midrib and secondaries, or rarely glabrate in age; midrib very prominent beneath, slightly elevated above; secondaries slender, 4-8 pairs, very prominent beneath and slightly so above, puberulent above; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes in the axils of the upper leaves, about 1/2 as long as the subtending leaves, many-flowered, bracteate, bracteolate; panicle terminal, brachiate, bracteate, embracing the uppermost cymes, its branches mostly trichotomous, often ascending, incanous or lanuginous-tomentose; peduncles 1-4.5 cm. long, lanuginous-tomentose or fulvous subappressed-pubescent; pedicels slender, about 3 mm. long, similar to the peduncles in pubescence; bracts foliaceous, scattered or in pairs at the base of the panicle-branches, oblong, stipitate, about 2.5 cm. long and 1.5 cm. wide, glabrous above or somewhat pubescent along the midrib, tomentose beneath; bractlets and prophylla narrowly linear or setaceous, about 1 mm. long, tomentose; calyx obconic-campanulate, about 4 mm. long and 2.5 mm. wide, varying from densely lanuginous-tomentose of hirtous-canescent to fulvous subappressed-pubescent, its rim 4-dentate or 4-lobed, its lobes ovate, obtuse and mucronulate or submucronulate at apex, broader than long; corolla infundibular, white or pale yellow, glabrous, its tube slender, 5-12 mm. long, gradually ampliate above, its lobes 4, elliptic or oblong-elliptic, about 4 mm. long and 2.5 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, equal [or rarely slightly unequal?], inserted about 1.8 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in J1) or included (in female);  filaments filiform, 0.5-7.5 mm. long, glabrous or slightly pubescent below; anthers broadly elliptic, about 1 mm. long and wide; pistil exserted (in female) or included (in male); style capillary, 2.5-8 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches 3-6.5 mm. long; ovary ovoid, flattened, about 0.9 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, glabrous; fruiting-calyx cupuliform, greatly enlarged and indurated, about 1 cm. wide, roughened, tomentose, its rim irregularly  and shallowly lobed; fruit obovoid, rather tetragonal and flattened at both ends, 8-10 mm. long, 6-8 mm. wide, yellow, roughened, invested at the base or to semi-included by the mature calyx.
bibliographicCitation: Moldenke, Richard G. 1934. A monograph of the genus Aegiphila. Brittonia. 1 (5-6): 245-471.

description: Branching shrub or woody vine, sometimes trailing, often high-climbing, 2-8 m. tall; branches elongate, stout, subterete or sometimes obtusely tetragonal, light-grayish, glabrate, marked with numerous elevated lenticels and elevated leaf-scars; branchlets slender, obtusely tetragonal, glabrous or minutely puberulent toward the apex; leaves decussate; petioles terete, 5-12 mm. long, often much thickened at the base, puberulent or very lightly ferruginous-pubescent; blades coriaceous (or membranous when immature), dark green above, paler beneath, very nitid, varying from ovate or oblong to elliptic, 7-20 cm. long, 2.5-9 cm. wide, abruptly attenuate or narrowly acuminate at apex, entire, blunt or rounded at base or rarely subcordate [occasionally subacute or somewhat inequilateral], glabrous above, appressed-pubescent on the midrib and larger veins beneath, becoming glabrous and often thinly glandular-punctate in age; midrib prominent beneath; secondaries slender, 9-12 pairs, prominent beneath, plainly anastomosing toward the margin; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes about 1/3 or 1/2 as long as the subtending leaves, opposite, solitary, often somewhat lax and diffuse in male more confert in female, many-flowered, usually quite distinct from the panicle above; panicle terminal, corymbose or thyrsoid, about 16 cm. long and 11 cm. wide, erect, usually naked; peduncles 1-4 cm. long, often flattened and ampliate above, minutely puberulent or glabrate; pedicels slender, 4-8 mm. long, puberulent; bracts [when present] foliaceous, varying from lanceolate to oblong or ovate, 4-7 cm. long, 1-3 cm. wide, often unequally paired, usually absent; bractlets and prophylla linear or setaceous, about 1 mm. long, pubescent; calyx varying from turbinate-infundibular to cupuliform, usually acute and ventricose at base or constricted above the ovary, 2-4 mm. long, 2.6-4.2 mm. wide, firm, lax around the corolla-tube, puberulent or pubescent, its rim membranous, distinctly 4-lobed, dilated, its lobes ovate, erect, retuse or mucronulate; corolla infundibular or hypocrateriform, yellowish, its tube slender, cylindric, 4-8 mm. long, longer in than in female its lobes 4 [rarely 5], oblong- or elliptic-lingulate, 3-6 mm. long, about 3.7 mm. wide, spreading, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 3.5 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male) or included (in female); filaments filiform, 0.3-7 mm. long, glabrous; anthers elliptic or ovate, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.4 mm. wide, erect, whitish, tabescent in; pistil long-exserted (in male) or included (in male); style capillary, 2-14 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches 2-4.5 mm. long; ovary subrotund, dark, about 0.9 mm. long and wide, flattened above, 4-celled; fruiting- calyx greatly enlarged and indurated, cupuliform, about 5 mm. long, 6-10 mm. wide, roughened, glabrate, its rim shallowly and irregularly lobed or sometimes deeply split; fruit subglobose or somewhat tetragonal, about 7 mm. long and wide, flattened at both ends, rather firm, yellow, 3-4-seeded, almost included by the calyx when immature, only semi-included when mature; seeds plano-convex.

description: Shrub or tree, 2.8-4 m. tall; branches elongate, stout, obtusely tetragonal, densely strigose with appressed forward-pointing hairs; branchlets slender, obtusely tetragonal, densely sericeous-strigose with light and appressed antrorse hairs; internodes 4-8.5 cm. long; leaves  ecussate-opposite or approximate; petioles stout, weak, 5-9 mm. long, densely appressed-sericeous or strigose; blades membranous, dark green above, much lighter beneath, oblong or ovate, 8.5-16.5 cm. long, 4-8 cm. wide, acuminate at apex, entire, rounded or obtuse at base, short-strigose or hirtous above, densely and beautifully strigose with short, whitish, forward-pointing hairs beneath, often marked with numerous small glandular disks beneath [frequently visible above]; midrib slender, prominent and beautifully strigose beneath; secondaries slender, about 12 pairs, close together, prominent beneath, ascending, slightly arcuate, anastomosing near the margins and beautifully strigose beneath; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes often terminating short axillary branchlets with 1 or 2 pairs of leaves, many-flowered, bracteate, rather dense, villous-lanate throughout when immature; panicle terminal, to 7 cm. long and 5 cm. wide, usually more abbreviated, dense, its sympodia 1.5 cm. long [or less], densely strigose, its branches short, opposite; peduncles rather slender, 1.5-3.5 cm. long, densely sericeous-strigose like the branchlets; pedicels slender, 1-5 mm. long, densely strigose; bracts few, subfoliaceous, lanceolate, stipitate; bractlets numerous, linear, to 10 mm. long; pro-phylla linear-subulate; calyx cyathiform, about 5.7 mm. long and 4.4 mm. wide, densely strigose with whitish antrorse hairs, its rim deeply 2-4-lobed; corolla hypocrateriform, yellowish-white, its tube narrow-cylindric, about 6.2 mm. long, ampliate above, glabrous, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 4.1 mm. long and 2.1 mm. wide, subacute at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 0.8 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male); filaments filiform, to 11.4 mm. long (in male) white; anthers ovate, about 1 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide; pistil included (in Male); style capillary, about 2.6 mm. long (in male); glabrous, white; stigma bifid, its branches very light, about 3.3 mm. long; ovary subglobose, dark, about 1.3 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx apparently small and cupuliform, very lax and spreading, hirtous or strigose; fruit subglobose, about 7 mm. long and wide, glabrate, 4-seeded.

description: Frutex vel arbuscula; annotinis elongatis crassis obtuse tetragonis dense strigosis; hornotinis gracilibus obtuse tetagonis dense strigosis; foliis oppositis vel approximatis petiolatis; petiolis debilibus denise strigosis; laminis membranaceis oblongis vel ovatis acuminatis in- tegerrimis ad basin rotundatis vel obtusis, supra breviter strigosis vel hirsutis, subtus dense et eleganter strigosis; vena media et venis see- ondariis gracilibus subtus valde prominentibus dense et eleganter strigosis; infloreseentiis axillaribus terminalibusque; eymis multifloris pedunculatis densis bracteatis, juventute dense villoso-lanatis; panic- ulis plerumque parvis densis; pedunculis et pedicellis dense strigosis; bracteis paucis subfoliaceis lanceolatis; bracteolis numerosis elongato- linearibus; calyce eyathiforme dense strigoso, margine profunde 2-4- loibato; corolla hypocrateriforme sufflava, lobis 4 longe exsertis; pis- tillo incluso; ovario subgloboso glabro 4-loculare; calyce fructifero hirsuto vel strigoso, margine patente perlaxo; fructibus subglobosis glabratis.

description: Subscandent shrub (?); branchlets slender, elongate, obtusely tetragonal, rather densely pubescent with appressed and brownish-gray antrorse hairs; internodes 6-9 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 8-10 mm. long, appressed-pubescent; blades membranous, olive-green and very nitid on both surfaces, oblong, 12-14 cm. long, 5-5.5 cm. wide, acuminate at apex, entire, rounded at base, glabrous above except for a very few short and scattered hairs on the lamina and the pilose midrib, more densely short-pilose beneath, especially on the midrib and secondaries, rather abundantly marked with black glandular disks of various sizes beneath; midrib slender, prominent beneath, slightly so above; secondaries slender, 10-14 pairs, arcuate-ascending, prominent beneath, beautifully and conspicuously anastomosing about 7 mm. from the margins beneath; veinlets prominent; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes solitary, opposite, capitate, dense, many-flowered, 2-3 cm. long, about 1.5 cm. wide; peduncles slender, weak, 8-18 mm. long, densely appressed-pubescent like the branchlets; bractlets scattered through the inflorescence, foliaceous, oblong, to 10 mm. long and 5 mm. wide, sessile, ciliate, 1 subtending each ultimate flower-cluster; prophylla numerous, setaceous; buds small, sparsely appressed-pubescent, too immature for accurate measurement of calyx and corolla; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Shrub; branchlets slender, obtusely tetragonal or subterete, densely ochraceous-villose; internodes 7-13 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles stout, 5-10 mm. long, densely villose; blades membranous, lanceolate-oblong or oblong, 8-16 cm. long, 3-9 cm. wide, acuminate at apex [the narrower blades long-acuminate!], entire, rounded or subcordate at base, strigose or pubescent above, especially on the midrib, densely ochraceous-villose or tomentose beneath, especially on the midrib and larger veins; midrib slender, not very prominent on either surface; secondaries 6-10 pairs, irregularly placed, arcuate-ascending, not prominent, anastomosing near the margins; inflorescence axillary and terminal; axillary cymes apparently few, solitary, opposite, 5-6 cm. long, about as long as the subtending leaves, many-flowered, bracteo-late; terminal panicle 3-4 cm. long and wide, bracteate; terminal peduncles about 1.5 cm. long, axillary ones about 3.5 cm. long, rather slender, densely ochraceous-villose with spreading hairs; pedicels slender, 2-4 mm. long, spreading-villose; bracts few, foliaceous, in the terminal inflorescence, narrow-lanceolate, to 5 cm. long and 1 cm. wide; bractlets numerous in both the axillary and terminal inflorescence, filiform, 1-2.5 cm. long, much twisted and curled, densely spreading-villose; calyx narrow-tubular or campanulate, somewhat constricted above the ovary, about 5.2 mm. long and 2.6 mm. wide, densely villose, its rim deeply 4-lobed, its lobes triangular-ovate, about 1.8 mm. long; corolla infundibular, its tube cylindric, about. 10.4 mm. long, pulverulent or glabrate, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 3.6 mm. long and 2 mm. wide; stamens 4, inserted about 2.6 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, included (in female) or exserted (in male); filaments filiform, 0.7-7 mm. long, glabrous; anthers oblong, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.3 mm. wide; pistil included or equaling the corolla-tube; style capillary, dark, 4-7.8 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 2.6 mm. long; ovary obpyriform or subglobose, about 1 mm. long and 0.7 mm. wide, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx enlarged and indurated, patelliform, lax and shallow, pubescent, its margin membranous, deeply and irregularly lobed; fruit not seen.

description: Tree, to 12 m. tall; branchlets stout, obtusely tetragonal, softly ferruginous-tomentose; buds woolly; branchlets slender, short, ascending, obtusely tetragonal, flattened and amnpliate at the nodes, ferruginous- tomentose; internodes 4.5-9 cm. long; leaves decussate-opposite or occasionally only approximate; petioles stout and stiff, 2.5-3.5 cm. long, ferruginous-tomentose; blades subcoriaceous, very dark green about 3.5 mnm. long and 1.5 mm. wide, effete in 9; pistil included (in & ) or long-exserted (in 9 ); style capillary, 3.5-18 mm. long, gla- brous; stigma bifid, its branches 3-7 mm. long; ovary subglobose, flattened at both ends, 4-sulcate, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Shrub; branches rather slender, subterete, densely puberulent or very short-pubescent; branchlets slender, subterete, somewhat flat- tened and ampliate at the nodes, yellowish-brown, densely puberulent or short-pubescent; interlnodes 6.5-11 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles slelnder, 6-17 mm. long, weak, puberulent or pubescent; blades thin-chartaceous, dark green above, lighter beneath, nitid, broadly ob- long or very slightly obovate, sometimes somewhat constricted at the middle, 10-26.5 cm. long, 5-15 eni. wide, more or less abruptly acumi- nate into a long point at apex, entire, acute or subacuminate at base, sparsely or minutely puberulent or strigillose above, densely puberu- lent beneath, especially along the larger veins, usually marked with a number of scattered glandular disks along the inidrib beneath, very fragile in drying; midrib slender, prominent on both surfaces, densely puberulent; secondaries 6-9 pairs, rather distant, prominent on both surfaces, arcuate-ascending, anastomosing 4-7mm from the margins, densely puberulent; veinlets slender, very irregular, often prominulent on both surfaces many issuing fromi the midrib between the secondaries; infloreseence axillary and terminal; eymes solitary, op- posite, numerous, 2-5.5 cm. long, 3-4 cm. wide, lax and spreading, loosely many-flowered or few-flowered, often repeatedly di- or trichoto- mous, flattened and ampliate at the fureations, bracteolate; terminal panicle. eymose, small and abbreviated, to 9 cm. long and 4 cm. wide, composed of 3-5 very small eymes which are similar to the axillary ones, its sympodia abbreviated, pubescent; peduncles slender, axillary ones 8-15 mm. long, terminal ones 5-6 cm. long, yellowish-brown, pu- bescent; pedicels slender or filiform, 6-10 cm. long, brownish, puberu- lent or pubescent; bractlets and prophylla linear or setaceous, 2-4 mm. long (or less), puberulent or pubescent; calyx membranous, campanu- late, slightly constricted above the ovary, 3-5 mm. long and wide, puberulent or pubescent, its rim truncate, shortly apiculate; corolla infundibular, light,.glabrous, its tube cylindric, about 8.5 mm. long, slightly ampliate above, its lobes 4, oblong- or elliptic-lingulate, spreading about 6 mm. long and 2.5 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1.5 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube (in male); filaments filiform, light, about 7.5 mm. long (in male), glabrous; anthers oblong, about 1.3 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, dorsifixed just above the base; pistil included (in male), very light; style capillary or somewhat flattened, about 4 mm. long (in male ), glabrous; stigma bifid, almost white, its branches about 4 mm. long, parallel; ovary obovate, about 1.5 mm. long and 1.2 mm. wide, flattened above, distinctly 4-lobed, glabrate, 4-celled;  fruiting-pedicels inerassate, stout, puberulent; fruiting-calyx enlarged and indurated, cupuliform, about 5 mm. long and 7 mm. wide, slightly verruculose, striate, puberulent, its rim shallowly lobed; fruit subglobose or oblong, glabrous, 4-seeded.

description: Tree or shrub, monoecious. Young branches velutinous, glabrescent. Stipules 7-10 mm long, triangular-lanceolate, persistent, appressed-pubescent above, more densely so on the midrib. Petiole 2-8 cm long, velutinous. Stipels 2, to 1 mm long linear-lanceolate, pubescent, caducous. Leaf blade 9-15 cm long, 5-7.5 cm wide, ovate lanceolate, membranous, the base cordate or subcordate, the apex acuminate; margin serrate; upper surface with inconspicuous minute pustules, sparsely pubescent with hairs of variable length; lower surface pubescent; venation palmate with 3-5 main nerves from base, the secondary veins 8-18 per side. Inflorescences unisexual, axillary. Female inflorescence to 25 cm long, with flowers in lax racemes; rachis filiform, hirsute-pubescent; bracts ca. 0.5 cm long, with three triangular-lanceolate lobes, the central one larger, hirsute-ciliate. Male inflorescence (immature) densely pubescent. Female flowers solitary, the pedicels to 0.8(1) mm long at anthesis, pubescent; sepals 5, ca. 0.7 mm long, triangular-lanceolate, densely ciliate; ovary 0.7-0.8 mm wide, densely papillose-muricate, with hairs ca. 1 mm long that conceal the lower half of the styles; styles 2-3 mm long, glabrous, basally papillose, laciniate into 15-18 narrow seg- ments. Male flowers not seen in anthesis. Capsule ca. 1.3 mm wide, papillose-muricate, hispid. Seeds immature.

description: Arbol 7 m de alto y 11 cm DAP, dioico; copa amplia, profusamente ramificada, decidua. Hojas opuestas, simples; limina foliosa, elfptica (3.5-)6-16 x (2-)2.7-5 cm, base cuneada, apice usualmente largo-acuminado, a menudo un poco curvo en sentido lateral, acumen frecuentemente agudo 1.5-2.5 cm de largo, margen aparentemente entero e inconspicuamente laxo-crenado hasta laxo-serrado en la porción distal de la limina, ocasionalmente repando, lustrosa y glabra en ambos lados, envés con numerosos puntos glandulares-porosos, de color café, a veces algo hundidos; 7-13 pares de nervaduras secundarias, apenas arqueadas hasta patentes, prominentes en el envés, intersecundarias presentes, terciarias laxoreticuladas, sulcadas a impresas en el envés; peciolos 3-8 mm de largo, acanalados, cafó obscuros al secar, glabros, articulados con la rama. Inflorescencias estaminadas solitarias, a veces en pares, racemosas, axilares y supraxilares, dispuestas a lo largo de las ramas hasta las porciones terminales, 5-10 mm de largo, amarillentas (en vivo), café obscuras(en seco); pedónculo con 2-3 pares de bracteolas basales, sésiles, decusadas y exteriormente convexas, los 2 primeros pares formando una copa, glandular (en vivo) en el lado abaxial, carticeas, suborbiculares hasta deltoides, 0.5-1 x 0.7-1.2 mm, aipice ampliamente obtuso hasta corto-acuminado, margen ciliado, color crema (en seco); pedónculo 3-5 mm, raquis subtetragonal. Flores 5, 7 6 9, dispuestas a lo largo del raquis en pares decusados, subopuestos hacia la base y opuestos hacia la porci6n distal, rematando en una flor terminal ebracteada; las flores decusadas estin subtendidas por una bractea, divergente hasta divaricada con relación al raquis, foliosa, obovada hasta algo oblanceolada, 2.5-3.5 x 1-2.5 mm, base atenuada, apice obtuso a redondeado, eroso, ciliolado o ciliado, cóncava y glandular (en vivo) en el lado adaxial; pedicelo 1-2 mm, articulado en la base y divergente con relación al raquis, glabro; flores 2 mm de largo, cailiz sin tubo, sdpalos 4-5, libres, angosto-triangulares, desiguales, 0.3-0.5 x 0.2-0.3 mm, aipice agudo, en ocasiones obtuso, glabros; corola ausente; estambres 4-5, episépalos, filamentos 1-1.7 mm de largo, glabros, anteras orbiculares hasta orbicular-elipticas, 0.5 x 0.3-0.4 mm; sin ovario rudimentario. description: Terrestrial herb. Stem tall, robust, leafy, 84-146 x 0.7-0.9(-1.4) cm including the inflorescence. Leaves ca. 12, spreading, linear-lanceolate to lanceolate, lowermost sheath-like, largest around the center of stem, 9-27 x 1.3-3.8 cm, upper leaves similar to the lower bracts. Inflorescence 19-28 cm long, usually elongated and many flowered; bracts oblong-lanceolate to lanceolate, 3.3-5.5 x 1-1.8 cm, shorter than the pedicel and ovary, decreasing in size towards the apex of the inflorescence, green. Flowers (5-)10-17(-27), spreading, superimposed, large for the genus, greenish to greenish yel- low; pedicellate ovary 5.2-7.5 cm, slightly arched, green. Sepals mucronate, green; dorsal sepal ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 17-23 x 9-13 mm; lateral sepals deflexed, forming a 180º angle with the dorsal sepal, obliquely ovate-lanceolate to largely lanceo- late, 22-27 x 8-11 mm. Petals bipartite, whitish at the base and light green to greenish yellow in the segments; posterior segment linear to linear-lanceolate, falcate, 18- 22 x (1.5-)2(-3) mm, base free and towards the apex connivent with the dorsal sepal; anterior segment linear, 25-35 x 1-1.5(-2) mm, projected forward, 1.3-1.7 times as long as the posterior segment. Lip tripartite, projected forward, whitish at the base and light green to greenish yellow in the seg- ments; undivided base 6-9 x 1.5-2 mm; lat- eral segments linear, 25-36 x 1-1.5(-2) mm, somewhat parallel to the anterior petals, 1.3-1.6 times as long as the middle segment; medium segment shorter and slightly wider, linear-ligulate, 20-26 x 1- 2(-2.5) mm. Spur pendent, enclosed by the bracts, with a small erect triangular tooth ca. 1 mm tall at the base, tooth obtuse, wider at the base and straighter towards the apex, 11.5-13 cm, 3-4.5 mm in the base, ca. 2 mm in the apex, base whitish and becoming green towards the apex. Column 7-8 mm tall; anthers 4-5 x 3-4 mm, whitish, apparently yellow because of the pollinia; anther-canals erect, 4-6 x 1 mm, thickened, white; connective broad, truncate to retuse, green; rostellum ca. 9 mm long; middle lobe 3.5-5 mm tall, fleshy, triangular, acute, small, about half the size of the column, completely enclosed by the anthers, green; rostellum arms erect, ca. 6 mm long, white- green; auricles erect, triangular, 2.5-3 mm tall, fleshy, verrucose, white; stigmas 2, 11-12 mm long including the base, the free part 6-8 mm long, margins curved, somewhat involute, whitish, apex not curved, truncate, 2-3.5 mm wide. Pollinaria 2, yellow, viscidia ca. 1.3 x 0.8-1 mm, spaced 1-1.5 mm apart; caudicles slender, elongate, 5-6 mm long; pollinia 2 per pollinarium, laterally flattened, ca. 4 mm long.

description: Tree, to 13 m. tall; branchlets slender, elongate, obsoletely tetragonal or subterete, flattened and ampliate at the nodes, densely canes-cent or subferruginous-pilose or tomentose-villose; internodes 5.5-8 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles 10-14 mm. long, densely canes-cent; blades membranous, dark, broadly ovate, 18-25 cm. long, 7-10 cm. wide, widest below the middle, long-acuminate or subcaudate at apex, entire, broadly rounded or subtruncate [occasionally inequilateral] at base, softly pubescent or villose above with short bulbous hairs, densely canescent or shortly lanate-villose beneath; midrib medium-stout, prominent beneath, densely pilose or pubescent; secondaries slender, 10-15 pairs, arcuate-ascending, hardly at all prominent beneath, rather inconspicuous above, very obscurely anastomosing at the margins; veinlets very slender and delicate; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes solitary, opposite, capitate, often subglobose, in the upper axils only, 1.5-4 cm. long, 1.5-2.5 cm. wide, dense, many-flowered, congested, bracteolate; panicle terminal, 3.5-12 cm. long, 1-3.3 cm. wide, composed of 1-7 cymes which are usually very small and conglobate, its sympodia very slender, abbreviated, densely canescent or pubescent-tomentose; peduncles slender, canescent or tomentose, the axillary ones 2-18 mm. long and ascending, the terminal ones 2-4.5 cm. long; pedicels 1-3 mm. long or obsolete, canescent or tomentose; bractlets numerous, linear-subulate, 5-20 mm. long, canescent, usually contorted; calyx obovoid or campanulate, contracted at the base, patent above, 4-5.3 mm. long, about 3.7 mm. wide, densely villose-pubescent, its rim deeply 2-4-toothed or -lobed; corolla infundibular, greenish-yellow, glabrous [or tomentose?], its tube cylindric, narrowed below, greatly ampliate above, about 5.3 mm. long, often slightly tomentose outside, usually more densely so within, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 4.8 mm. long and 2.6 mm. wide, obtuse or rounded at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1.3 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male) filaments filiform, to 8 mm. long (in male) pilose below; anthers oblong or ovate, about 1.5 mm. long and 0.8 mm. wide; pistil included (in male); style capillary, somewhat flattened, about 3.2 mm. long (in male), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches 2.4-3 mm. long, somewhat flattened; ovary subrotund, about 0.6 mm. long and wide, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Shrub or tree; branchlets elongate, strict, acutely or obtusely tetragonal, somewhat flattened at the nodes, very densely villose with fulvous hair which is about 1 mm. long; internodes 5-9.5 cm. long; leaf-scars elevated and prominent; leaves decussate; petioles stout, 7-8 mm. long, densely villose; blades thick-membranous or subcoriaceous, very dark green above, lighter beneath, oblong-lanceolate or oblong, 14-19 cm. long, 4.5-8 cm. wide, long-acuminate at apex, entire, sometimes slightly revolute in drying, rounded or subacute at base, densely pilose above with short bulbous hairs which easily rub off, leaving the surface roughened by numerous elevated punctae, tomentose on the midrib, very densely and beautifully lanate-tomentose or appressed-villose beneath, velvety to touch, the hairs fulvous and mostly pointing in a direction parallel with the secondaries, about 1 mm. long; midrib medium-stout, prominent beneath; secondaries slender, 6 or 7 pairs, arcuate-ascending, conspicuous beneath; veinlets very slender and delicate, impressed above; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes few, mostly only in the axils of the uppermost pair of leaves, solitary, opposite, to 6.5 cm. long and 4.3 cm. wide, brachiate, very densely many-flowered, extremely congested, bracteolate; panicle terminal, cone-shaped or pyramidal-thyrsoid, to 15 cm. long and 9 cm. wide, extremely dense, composed of about 7 stipitate cymes which are extremely dense and many-flowered, conspicuously bracteate and bracteolate, its sympodia few, densely fulvous-villose; flowers densely congested; peduncles stout, 3-4.5 cm. long, densely fulvous-villose; pedicels slender, elongate, densely villose; bracts conspicuous, foliaceous, lanceolate or spatulate, long-stipitate, 1.5-4.5 cm. long, to 1 cm. wide, densely tomentose or villose; bractlets very numerous, linear, 5-10 mm. long, contorted, densely villose; calyx light, campanulate, about 4.6 mm. long and wide, veiny, densely villose, its rim deeply 4-lobed; corolla hypocrateriform, its tube cylindric, 5.2-6.7 mm. long, slightly ampliate above, glabrous, its lobes 4, ovate-lanceolate, about 4.6 mm. long and 2 mm. wide, subacute at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male); filaments filiform, to 9 mm. long (in male) glabrate; anthers oblong, about 1.5 mm. long and 1 mm. wide; pistil included (in male); style capillary, about 4.1 mm. long (in male) glabrate; stigma bifid, its branches about 2 mm. long; ovary subglobose, about 1 mm. long and wide, glabrate, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Shrub; branchlets stout; internodes about 5 cm. long; leaves decus- sate; petioles about 8 mm. long, canaliculate above, glabrate; blades coriaceous, elliptic or oblong-elliptic, 8.5-9.5 cm. long, about 7 cm. wide, rounded above to an abrupt acumen about 4 mm. long, entire, slightly revolute in drying, truncate at base, glabrous on both sur- faces; midrib prominent beneath, faint above; secondaries 3-5 pairs, irregular, arcuate-ascending; inflorescence axillary, globose-capitate; heads opposite, densely flowered, with numerous bracts of various dimensions among the flowers and usually shorter than the calyx, but sometimes much larger; peduncles stout, incrassate, about 1.5 cm. long (or less); pedicels varying greatly in length, not obvious because of the densely clustered flowers and bracts; bracts very numerous, hiding the pedicels and most of the calyx, foliaceous, ovate, acute, usually arranged in an involucriform manner; calyx coriaceous, tur- binate, about 6.8 mm. long and 5.5 mm. wide, densely puberulent, subtended by about 4 ovate, acute, closely-appressed bracts which are 4.2-6.2 mm. long and about 2.4 mm. wide, its rim 4-lobed, its lobes about 2 mm. long; corolla infundibular, almost included, its tube about 2 mm. long, its lobes 4, thick, oblong-lingulate, about 6.2 mm. long and 3.1 ml-m. wide, obtuse or subacute at apex, somewhat puberulent outside; stamens 4, inserted just below the mouth of the corolla-tube; filaments filiform, about 1 mm. long, glabrous; anthers oblong, about 2.7 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, glabrous, dorsifixed just above the base; style capillary, about 3.1 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches 1.8-2 mm. long, glabrous; ovary obconic or obpyriform, about 2.6 mm. long and 1.8 mm. wide, flattened and ampliate at apex, puberulent; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Shrub; branchlets slender, obtusely tetragonal or subterete, densely brownish matted-tomentose; internodes about 3 cm. long or much more abbreviated at the tips of the branchlets; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 5-10 mm. long, tomentose; blades firmly membranous or sub- coriaceous, dark green above, lighter beneath, oblong-lanceolate, acute or slightly acuminate at apex, entire, cuneate at base, prominently roughened above by dense elevated punctae, each of which apparently originally bore a short hair which was soon deciduous, leaving the upper surface of the blades very rugose instead of pilose, densely matted-tomentose beneath; midrib rather prominent beneath; sec- ondaries 5-7 pairs, ascending, not very arcuate, obscurely anastomos- ing at the margins; yeinlets slender, obscured beneath; infloreseence apparently terminal, few-flowered; peduncles apparently extremely short; pedicels obsolete or to 1 mm. long and tomentose; bractlets few, linear, 2-3 mm. long, tomentose; calyx campanulate, about 4 mm. long and 5.5 mm. wide, densely tomentose, its rim conspicuously 4 [or 5?] -lobed, its lobes broadly ovate, acute at apex; corolla hypocrateriform, its tube cylindric, slightly over 4 mm. long, glabrous outside, slightly pilose in the throat within, its lobes 5, oblong-lingulate, about 3 mm. long and 1.5 mm. wide, very blunt at apex; stamens 5, inserted about 1 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, included (in 9 ?); fila- ments obsolete (in 9 ); anthers ovate, about 1 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide; pistil not seen; ovary apparently minute; fruiting-calyx cupuli- form, about 3 mm. long and 7 mm. wide, tomentose, its margin irregu- larly lobed; fruit subglobose, about 5 mm. long and wide, very smooth and shiny, apparently 4-celled, 4-seeded.

description: Tall tree; branchlets stout or slender, acutely tetragonal, very con- spicuously flattened and ampliate at the nodes, lightly puberulent or becoming glabrate; internodes varying from 5 mm. to 4 cm. in length; leaves numerous, decussate; petioles rather slender, 1-3 cm. long, striate, densely roughened-puberulent; blades membranous, very nitid, lanceolate, oblong, or slightly obovate, 6.5-29 cm. long, 3-12 cm. wide, acute at apex, entire, cuneate at base, densely short-strigillose or sub- tomentellous above when immature, becoming only granular-pulveru- lent, roughened, or even glabrate in age, very densely strigillose- tomentellous beneath, sometimes becoming only sparsely so in age, usually marked with scattered glandular disks beneath; midrib medium-stout, prominent beneath, prominulent above; secondaries slender, 9-18 pairs, rather close, ascending, not very arcuate, anas- tomosing near the margins; veinlets very slender and delicate, some- times slightly prominulent beneath; infloreseence axillary; eymes soli- tary, opposite, usually abbreviated, often conglobate-capitate and short-pedunculate, sometimes [in fruit] larger and longer-pedunculate, rather few-flowered, bracteolate, 1.5-2.5 cm. long in anthesis, appar- ently elongate to 5.5-6.5 cm. in fruit; peduncles short and stout in anthesis, elongate in fruit, 7-30 mm. long, roughened, verruculose; pedicels short in anthesis, more elongate in fruit, 1-5 mm. long, caneseent or puberulent; bractlets linear, 2-9 mm. long, caneseent; calyx heavy, obconic or turbinate, 3.1-5.2 mm. long, 2.2-5.2 mm. wide, verrucose, puberulent, often very lax around the corolla-tube, its rim subtruneate or broadly and shallowly 4-toothed; corolla hypocrateri- form, white, its tube cylindric, 2.6-5.2 mm. long, ampliate above, glabrous, its lobes 5, oblong-lingulate, 3.8-7 mm. long, 1.3-2.8 mm. wide, subacute at apex; stamens 5, inserted 0.5-1.5 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, equaling the tube or included (in 9 ) or long-exserted (in e ); filaments filiform, 0.4-6.5 mm. long, glabrous; anthers oblong, 0.5-2 mm. long, 0.2-1 mm. wide; pistil exserted (in 9 ) or included (in & ); style capillary, 3.6-7.8 mm. long, glabrate; stigma bifid, its branches 2-2.6 mm. long; ovary subrotund, about 2.3 mm. long and wide, glabrate, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx cupuliform, very dark with a lighter rim, about 5 mm. long and 8 mm. wide, striate, sparsely verrucose, glabrate, its rim subtruneate or irregularly split; fruit subglobose, about 5 mm. long and wide, glabrous, 4-seeded.

description: Shrub or low tree, 1-8 m. tall, branching above, exuding a disagreeable odor; stems einereous; branches suberect, rather stout, acutely tetragonal, sharply margined with acute angles or somewhat 4-ridged with a pair of ridges confluent with the base of each of the elevated leaf-scars at each node, glabrous; branchlets slender, acutely tetragonal, canaliculate similar to the branches, glabrous; internodes 0.8-5 cm. long; bark (when fresh) green and herbaceous, conspicuously resinous-punctate and glandulose, chestnut- or fawn-colored in drying; leaves decussate-opposite or approximnate; petioles obsolete or extremely short; blades membranous [or chartaceous in drying], very dark green above, much lighter beneath, nitid, rubiginous or blackish in drying, lanceolate or oblong, 10-12.5 cm. long, 2.5-3.7 cm. wide, acute or slightly attenuate at apex, entire or repand-dentate toward the apex, long-attenuate into the petiole at base, glabrate and densely glandular-dotted on both surfaces, the lower surface characterized by its dense and deeply-sunk glandular punctae; midrib slender, prominent beneath; secondaries very slender, 7-9 pairs, close together, very slightly prominulent beneath, obscure above, arcuate-aseending, hardly anastomosing; veinlets delicate; infloreseence axillary; eymes solitary, opposite, 3-flowered or 2-3-fid, 1.5-4 cm. long, 1-3 cm. wide, much shorter than the subtending leaves, bracteolate, its branches [if any]

description: Fruit 26-29 mm diam., pericarp ca 3.2 mm thick, stigmatic remains apical-most resembling Neoveitchia, but with a smooth epidermis, fibrous bundles more concentrated into a distinct exocarp, vascular bundles all with heavy fibrous sheaths and distributed throughout much of the pericarp (resembling Actinorhytis in this respect), lacking sclerified parenchyma in the endocarp region; distinctive also for an occasional very large compound vascular bundle in a heavy sheath (resembling Alsmithia).

description: Shrub; branches stout, obtusely tetragonal, flattened and slightly ampliate at the nodes, gray, lightly caneseent or glabrate; branchlets slender, short, obtusely tetragonal, densely and shortly yellow-villose; internodes 0.5-3.5 cm. long; leaf-scars large and elevated, their edges swollen; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 10-20 mm. long, densely caneseent; blades membranous or chartaceous, dark green above (blackening in drying), much lighter beneath, oblong-elliptic or slightly obovate, 8-23 cm. long, 4-10 cm. wide, abruptly acute at apex, entire, cuneate at base and long-attenuate into the petiole, lightly or sparsely strigillose or pilosulose above, densely lanate-tomentose be- neath or becoming merely caneseent and densely punctate in age, very brittle in drying; midrib stout, prominent beneath; secondaries slen- der, 9-12 pairs, close together, arcuate-aseending; veinlets delicate, usually obscure; infloreseence axillary [or appearing subterminal when young]; eymes solitary or in pairs, opposite, often numerous at the extreme tips of the young branchlets on which the subtending leaves have not yet developed or matured, 2-2.5 cm. long and wide, many-flowered, very dense, often capitate; peduncles slender, 3-10 mm. long, often 2 in each axil, densely pubescent; pedicels obsolete in anthesis, 1-2 mm. long and pubescent in fruit; bractlets and prophylla very few, setaceous or subulate, 1-2 mm. long, pubescent; calyx very light-textured, campanulate or somewhat eyathiform, about 3.1 mm. long and 2 mm. wide, dark and purplish-brown at the base, extremely light toward the apex, densely strigose, its rim deeply 4-lobed, its lobes blunt or subacute; corolla infundibular, very light- textured, its tube cylindric, about 3 mm. long, glabrous, its lobes 4, lanceolate-lingulate, about 2.6 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, subacute at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1 mm. below the mouth of the corolla- tube, included (in female ); filaments filiform, about 0.5 mm. long (in female ), glabrous; anthers oblong, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.2 mm. wide; pistil long-exserted (in female ); style capillary, to 5.2 mm. long (in female), gla- brous; stigma bifid, its branches about 3.5 mm. long; ovary obconic, about 1 mm. long, 1 mm. wide and flattened at apex, glabrate, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx cupuliform, about 3 mm. long and 4 mm. wide, densely canescent, its rim variously and shallowly toothed or lobed; fruit rotund, about 3 mm. long and wide when mature, glabrous, very pronouncedly wrinkled in drying, 1-4-seeded.
