description: Bush or shrub, to 3.5 m. tall; branches subterete, brownish; branchlets slender, terete or obtusely tetragonal, short-pilose or pale flavesqent-hirsute with short, dense, spreading, articulate, long-persistent, and upwardly-curved hairs, becoming less so in age; internodes 2-3 cm. long; leaf-scars large and prominent, often projecting 1-2.5 mm. leaves decussate-opposite or subopposite with an interval of 1-5 mm. between the members of a pair; petioles slender, weak, 3-5 mm. long, mostly arcuate-curvate, pilose or appressed-pubescent; blades membranous or subcoriaceous, dark olive-green above, paler beneath, nitid on both surfaces, dull in drying, oblong or elliptic or slightly obovate, broadest at or a little above the middle, 7-12 cm. long, 2.5-5.5 cm. wide, more or less short-acuminate at apex to an acute or subobtuse tip, entire or with 1-4 short, broad, and blunt teeth at about the middle, very obtuse and rounded or subacute at base, subglabrous above or very slightly scabrous with short and sparse basally-inflated hairs, very shortly pilose beneath, especially along the midrib, secondaries, and larger veinlets, sometimes marked with a few tiny glandular disks and glandular-impressed beneath; midrib rather slender, very prominent and pilose beneath; secondaries 6-8 pairs, slender, issuing arcuately below at an angle of 50-60°, slightly prominent above, very prominent and pilose beneath, prominently anastomosing on both surfaces; veinlet reticulation very prominent and dense beneath; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes in the axils of the upper leaves, solitary, opposite, few, many-flowered; panicle terminal, to 7 cm. long, dense and congested, bracteate; peduncles short or to 6 cm. long, very shortly tomentose-pilose; pedicels about 2.5 mm. long, about 0.3 mm. thick below, gradually thickening to 0.7 or 0.8 mm. below the calyx; bracts lanceolate-linear, often marked above by slightly prominent, unequally-large, small, glandulose disks; prophylla filiform, 1-3 mm. long; calyx subcylindric below, becoming broadly turbinate and slightly campanulate above, membranous or subcoriaceous, light, 3.5-4.1 mm. long, about 4 mm. wide, shortly appressed-pilose, its rim 4-lobed or 4-toothed, sometimes lightly crisped, its lobes often 1 mm. long, semi-orbicular, and rounded or subapiculate at apex; corolla infundibular, yellow, glabrous, its tube cylindric, about 5.2 mm. long, ampliate above, glabrous, its lobes 4, elliptic-oblong, about 4.6 mm. long and 3.6 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 2 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male);  filaments filiform, to 7.8 mm. long (in male), glabrous; anthers elliptic, about 1 mm. long and wide; pistil included or exserted; style capillary, 2.8-4.8 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches 2.63.3 mm. long; ovary subglobose, about 1 mm. long and 0.8 mm. wide, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx very characteristic, greatly enlarged and indurated, broadly cupuliform, 5-6 mm. long, about 5 mm. wide at base and to the center, then abruptly widening to 10 mm. at the rim, the upper portion being pronouncedly darker in color and swollen outward, pubescent, ribbed, its rim subtruncate and slightly scarious-scalloped; fruit subglobose, about 7 mm. long and wide, glabrous but roughened, 4-seeded.

description: Well-formed arborescent shrub, 2-5 m. tall, or subscandent, showing extraordinary variation in the size of its parts; branches strict, erect or deflexed, obtusely tetragonal, tomentose, canous, or ferruginous-villose, striate; branchlets acutely tetragonal or flattened above, sulcate along the sides, densely ferruginous-villose; internodes 3.5- 4.5 cm. long; leaves decussate-opposite or approximate, often very unequally paired; petioles rather stout, 10-25 mm. long, densely villose; blades coriaceous, very dark green and nitid above, varying from lanceolate to oblong or obovate, 6-20 cm. long, 2-7.5 cm. wide, subcuspidate-acuminate at apex, entire, often revolute in drying, acute or acuminate at base and attenuate into the petiole, pubescent or rather villose along the veins above, becoming glabrous, often remaining rugulose, densely ferruginous-villose beneath; midrib rather stout, very prominent beneath; secondaries slender, 6-9 pairs, indistinct or often deeply impressed above, prominent beneath and more or less anastomosing at the margins; veinlets very slender, often very deeply impressed above, sometimes obscure, prominent beneath; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes corymbose, many-flowered, in the upper axils, varying from less than half as long as to greatly exceeding the subtending leaves, 5-11 cm. long, compact (in male) or very widely and loosely spreading; panicle terminal, simple or composite, leafy, cymose or thyrsoid, often greatly reduced; peduncles rather stout, 1.5-6 cm. long, densely ferruginous-villose; pedicels stout, 2-3 mm. long (in male)or almost obsolete (in female), very densely villose; bracts few, foliaceous, lanceolate or oblong, about 4 cm. long and 1 cm. wide, very densely ferruginous-villose on both surfaces with revolute margins; bractlets linear or subulate, equaling or exceeding the pedicels, to 8 mm. long, densely villose; calyx subcoriaceous, subturbinate-tubular, subven-tricose-ampliate out of a narrow base, 10-14 mm. long or a little shorter in 5, about 6.6 mm. wide, very densely ferruginous-villose, its rim deeply 4-lobed or often bilabiately split, its lobes irregular, unequal, ovate, obtuse or acute at apex; corolla infundibular or hypocrateri-form, white or tinged with rose, glabrous, its tube 9-10 mm. long, about equaling the calyx or a little shorter in female, covered with exiguous hairs within, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, patent or reflexed, 7-8 mm. long, about 3.2 mm. wide or wider in female; stamens 4, inserted about 3.2 mm. below the month of the corolla-tube, equaling the limb or exserted in male included in female; filaments filiform, about 7.7 mm. long (in male); glabrous; anthers oblong, about 2.4 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, often contorted or curvate after anthesis, tabescent and subsessile in 5; pistil included (in male) or exserted (in female); style capillary, about 7 mm. long (in male), enlarged at base, glabrate; stigma bifid, its branches about 4.5 mm. long, puberulent; ovary subrotund, about 1 mm. long and wide, glabrate, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx greatly enlarged and indurated, dark and heavy, cupuliform when mature, obvolute and cucullate when very immature, to 8 mm. long and 20 mm. wide, often interspersed with deflorated calyces, pubescent or glabrate, its rim irregularly scalloped, dentate, or lobed; fruit massive, oblong or ovoid-globose, about 15 mm. long and wide, extremely nitid, perfectly glabrous, 1-4-seeded, completely included by the calyx when very immature, loosely invested at the base when mature.

description: Tree to 30 m tall, the trunk buttressed to 1 m; young branches glabrous. Leaves 5-8.5 cm long, 1.8-3.2 cm wide, narrowly oblong, cuneate at base, long cuspidate at apex with an acumen 10-16 mm long, coriaceous, glabrous on both surfaces; midrib prominent above, prominulous or plane beneath; primary veins 5 or 6 pairs, prominulous above, plane beneath; petioles 5-8 mm long, glabrous, slightly canaliculate, slightly swollen at base. description: Shrub; branches elongate to 3.5 m., very stout, subterete, densely hirsute with brownish hairs which are 1-3 mm. long; branchlets slender, subterete, very densely hirsute like the branches; internodes 7.5-14.5 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles rather stout, 9-12 mm. long, very densely hirsute like the branches; blades membranous, green above, much lighter beneath, ovate or oblong, 12-23 cm. long, 4.5-11.5 cm. wide, rather long-acuminate at apex, entire, ciliate, beautifully rounded at base, densely hirsute on both surfaces with hairs which are 1-2 mm. long and somewhat bulbous at base; midrib slender, prominent beneath, densely hirsute on both surfaces; secondaries slender, close together, about 13 pairs, prominent beneath, obscure above, arcuate-ascending, plainly anastomosing close to the margins; veinlets very slender, prominulent beneath; inflorescence axillary and terminal (?); cymes few, solitary, opposite, subcapitate, about 3.8 cm. long and 2.3 cm. wide, brachiate, many-flowered, bracteolate, very densely hirsute-villose throughout; peduncles about 10 mm. long, densely hirsute-villose; pedicels slender, 1-2 mm. long, hirsute; bractlets few, linear, to 11 mm. long, densely hirsute-villose; calyx campanulate, about 4.1 mm. long and 3.6 mm. wide, densely hirsute, its rim deeply 4-lobed, its lobes ovate, rounded to a short apiculation at apex; corolla infundibular, its tube cylindric, about 3.6 mm. long, its lobes 4, ovate-lingulate, about 2.6 mm. long and 1.5 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted just below the mouth of the corolla-tube, exserted; filaments filiform, about 1.5 mm. long, glabrous; anthers oblong, about 1.5 mm. long and 0.7 mm. wide; pistil slightly exserted; style capillary, about 3.2 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 1.5 mm. long; ovary oblong or subrotund, about 1.3 mm. long and wide, glabrous, 4-lobed at apex, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Shrub or small tree; branchlets rather stout, obtusely tetragonal, usually conspicuously flattened and suleate toward the apex, brownish, densely puberulent; internodes 3.5-5.5 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles slender or stoutish, weak, 5-13 mm. long, puberulent or gla- brate, ampliate at base; blades membranouis or chartaceous, dark green above, light beneath, varying from oblong-lanceolate or oblong to obovate, 9-17 cm. long, 3-8 cm. wide, usually very undate in drying, varying from abruptly acute to acuminate at apex, entire, acute or acuminate at base, densely roughened-puberulent on both surfaces; midrib prominent beneath, slightly so above; secondaries 8-10 pairs, slender, irregular, arcuate-aseending; veinlets very slender and deli- cate; infloreseence axillary and terminal; eymes solitary, opposite, to 10 cm. long and 6.5 em. wide, lhalf as long as the subtending leaves or less, often densely many-flowered, bracteolate; panicle terminal, pyra- midal, usually large and tlhyrsoid, to 30 cm. long and 21 cm. wide [at base], bracteate, its sympodia variable in length, often elongate, stout, 2-5 cm. long, usually conspicuously flattened and suleate, densely puberulent, its branecles opposite or approximate, very numerous; peduncles 1-6 cm. long, puberulent; pedicels slender, 1-2 mm. long, puberulent, inerassate in fruit; bracts large and foliaceous, similar to the leaves in all respects, but smaller; bractlets linear or narrow- lanceolate, to 16 mm. long and 7 mm. wide; prophylla linear, 1-5 mm. long; calyx obconic-campanulate, about 2.8 mm. long and 2.3 mm. wide, puberulent, its rim truncate or minutely 4-apiculate; corolla hypocrateriform, pale yellow, its tube narrow-cylindric, 5.2-7.5 mm. long, ampliate above, glabrous outside, pubescent within, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 4.1 mm. long and 2.3 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 2.8 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male) or included (in female) filaments flattened, 0.7-10.4 mm. long, somewhat pilose; anthers oblong, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.4 mm. wide; pistil included or equaling the tube in female, long-exserted in male; style capillary, 5.2-12 mm. long, glabrate; stigma bifid, its branches 0.5-2.6 mm. long; ovary very dark, oblong, about 1 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide, flattened and umbilicate at apex, glabrous, 4-lobed, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx large and indurated, cupuliform, about 5 mm. long and 10 mm. wide, veiny, puberulent, lax, its rim irregularly and shallowly lobed; fruit not seen.

description: Small tree, to 10 m. tall; trunk straight, erect, cylindric; bark grayish-white, "minutely scored vertically with very shallow con- fluent furrows and scaling off in small plates between the furrows; branches aseending and irregularly opposite, almost white; wood creamy-white, with a somewhat aromatic odor "; branchlets rather slender, elongate, obtusely tetragonal or subterete, flattened and aimpliate at the nodes, gray-green or brownish, glabrous or puberulent, becoming furrowed in dryinig; internodes 4.5-5 cm. long; leaves decussate, "8-20 per twig"y; petioles slender, 6-10 mm. long, weak, spreading, glabrate, canaliculate above; blades chartaceous, dark green above, paler beneatih, lanceolate or oblong, 11-18 cm. long, 3.5-6 cm. wide, long-acuminate at apex, entire, slightly acuminate or nar- rowly attenuate into the petiole at base, very minutely puberulent on both surfaces, especially along the midrib and secondaries, probably becoming glabrate in age, densely and minutely glandular-punctate beneath, mllarked with numerous glandular disks of varying dimensions scattered along the lamina on both sides of the midrib beneath, dis- appearing as the apex is approached; midrib slender, prominent be- neath; secondaries 9-12 pairs, slender, rather prominent on both sur- faces; veinlets delicate, but conspicuous beneath; infloreseence termi- nal; panicle dense, long and narrow, about 14 cm. long and 5.5 ecm. wide, its branches about 5 pairs, opposite, 2-3 cm. long usually trifur- cate, many-flowered, bracteate, foliose, its sympodia rather abbreviated, terete, brownish, furrowed in drying, glabrous; peduncles about 4 cm. long, terete, furrowed in drying, brownish, glabrous; pedicels [in fruit] greatly thickened, acutely tetragonal, the lateral ones 1-2 mm. long, widening to about 1.2 mm. above, the central ones shorter or obsolete, puberulent; bracts foliaceous, lanceolate, 6-10 cm. long, 1-2 cm. wide, acuminate at both ends, similar to the leaves but more densely puberulent on both suirfaces and with more glandular disks along the midrib; bractiets and prophylla apparently obsolete [in fruiting specimens]; flowers not seen; fruiting-calyx very much in- durated, cupuliforml, very distinctly tetragonal, flat and trllneate at base, about 2 mm. long and 7 mm. wide, puberulent outside, glabrous and shiny within, its rim very regular and truncate, fitting closely over the base of the mature fruit like the cUp of an acorn or subin- cluding the very immature fruit; fruit oblong, tetragonal, 9-10 mm. long, about 7 mm. wide, yellow, flattened and conspicuously umbilicate at apex, smooth and shiny even when drv, but turning brown, gibbous at the middle, subincluded by the calyx when very immature, invested very closely for less than I its length when mature, 4-seeded; seeds white.

description: Tall shrub or tree, 3-4 m. tall; branches with sordid-gray bark, glabreseent; branchlets medium or stoutish, obtusely tetragonal, white-tomentose throughout; internodes 1.5-3 cm. long, later more elongate; leaf-sears large and prominent, obeordate with thickened edges; leaves decussate; petioles thick, 2-8 mm. long, pubescent; blades chartaceous or very thinly membranous, dark green and nitid above, lighter be- neath, more or less obovate or broadly oblong-elliptic, 8-13 cm. long, 4-8 cm. wide, rounded and obtuse or subacute at apex, entire or sub- entire, often repand and rather convex above the middle, cuneate at base and often long-attenuate into the petiole, short-pubescent or puberulent above, velutinous and shortly whitish-tomentose beneath, usually marked with a number of black glandular disks along both sides of the midrib beneath; midrib slender, prominent on both surfaces, especially beneath; secondaries slender, 7 or 8 pairs, prominent beneath and often slightly prominulent above, arcuate-aseending, more or less anastomosing near the margins; veinlets slender, the reticulation rather prominent on both surfaces or hidden beneath the dense pubescence; infloreseence axillary; eymes solitary, opposite, corymbose or subumbellate, 2-3 cm. long and wide, many-flowered, dense and congested, not capitate; peduncles slender, 5-15 mm. long, tomentose; pedicels very slender, 2-4 mm. long, tomentose; bractlets linear, 2-4 mm. long, shorter than the calyx, tomentose; calyx obconic-campanu- late, 4-5.2 mm. long, 2-3 mm. wide, densely white-tomentose or villose with long forward-pointing hairs, its rim deeply 4-lobed [sometimes appearing to be subtruneate when immature], its lobes ovate, equal, 1-1.5 mm. long, obtuse or subacute at apex; corolla hypocrateriform, whitish or yellowish, varying to lilac, its tube cylindric, 5.2-8 mm. long, ampliate above, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, 2-3.6 mm. long, 1.5-2 mm. wide, obtuse or rounded at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 2 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, included (in female ) or long- exserted (in male ); filaments filiform, 1-6.2 mm. long, glabrous; anthers oblong, about 1 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide; pistil included or short- exserted in &, long-exserted in female; style capillary, light, 3-9 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 2.3 mm. long; ovary depressed-globose, about 1 mm. long and wide, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx enlarged and indurated, broadly cupuliform, 5-7 mm. long, 8-9 mm. wide, glabreseent, its rim irregularly incised or lobed; fruit early deciduous.

description: Scandent shrub. Stems 0.2-0.3 cm diam., densely scabrid. description: Shrub; stems 2.7-3.7 mm diam., densely pubescent with arbusculiform hairs. Lamina narrowly elliptic, 4.5-7.5 X 1.6-2.5 cm; adaxial surface dark green, moderately pubescent with arbusculiform hairs; abaxial surface light green, moderately pubescent with arbusculiform hairs; margin subentire or minutely denticulate; apex acuminate; base cuneate; petiole 4-6 mm long, 1.4-1.6 mm diam., densely pubescent with arbusculiform hairs. description: Suffruticose herb or subshrub from a woody base; stems ascending or scandent, sparingly branched, 0.6-1.5 m long, 0.3-0.5(-1.8) cm diam., glabrous; latex cream- colored. Calyx lobes narrowly triangular, 8-13 X 2-4 mm, glabrous; margin entire; apex acuminate. Corolla green, burmeisteroid, 35-43 mm long, glabrous; tube straight, 14-18 mm long, 6-8 mm diam. at base, narrowing to 3.5-3.8 mm diam. at middle, then flaring to 7.5-11 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 21-25 X 4-4.5 mm, acuminate at apex; lateral lobes narrowly tri- angular, falcate, 17-20 x 3-5 mm, acuminate at apex; ventral lobe narrowly triangular, straight, 12-17 X 3.5-5 mm, acuminate at apex. Staminal column exserted, emerging from the corolla above the dorsal lobes; filament tube suberect, 23-31 mm long, 1.5-1.8 mm diam., glabrous; anther tube slightly decurved, 3.1-3.3 mm diam., the surfaces glabrous; dorsal anthers 10-11 mm long; ventral anthers 8-8.5 mm long, with tufts of white hairs 2.5-4 mm long at apex. Capsule woody, broadly rhomboid, 13-17 x 12-14 mm, half-inferior, acute at apex; seeds brown, broadly el- lipsoid, 0.4 X 0.3 mm, finely reticulate.

description: Suffrutex ad 1 m altus, glaberrimus. Caulis teres, striatus, violascens, foliosus. Folia sessilia, rigida, luteo-viridia, opaca, supra nervis venisque impressis, subtus pallida, nervis prominentibus, reticulato-venosa; lamina oblonga, 4-1.4-2 cm, acuta, basi paulo angustata, margine saepe violascenter suffusa, dense callose denticulata, nervi laterales circiter 7 sub angulo acuto recte excurrentes. Flores in vertice corymbose congesti, solitarii in axillis foliorum paulo minorum. Pedicelli 3 cm longi, violascentes, ebracteolati. Calycis tubus turbinatus, 7 mm longus; lobi eius triangulari-lineares, acuti, integerrimi, erecti, rigidi, 8-9 mm longi, basi 2.5 mm lati, sinus inter eos plani. Corolla rubra, 30 mm longa: tubus curvatus, 24 mm longus, in medio 5 mm, infra limbum 7 mm latus (si compressus); lobi corollae triangulares, fere aequales, 4 mm longi. Staminum tubus inclusus, 24 mm longus: filamenta circiter 5 mm supra basin corollae adnata, glabra; tubus antherarum illi Burmeisterae simillimus, 5 mm longus, glaber, vertice pilosociliatus. Ovarium hiloculare, apice conicum, maturum certe dehiscens: Semina immatura ovoidea, gilva, reticulata, 0.5 mm longa.

description: Plants 1-3 m. high, often broader than high; leaves numerous near the tips of the branches, 1 or 2 borne on each cm. of length of twig; blades ovate to broadly lanceolate or elliptic, mostly abruptly rounded at base, mostly 1-3 cm. wide, 2.5-5 (or 8) cm. long, mostly 1.5-2.5 times as long as wide (the larger leaves sometimes as much as 5.5 cm. wide and 11 cm. long) ; petioles 0.5-1 (-2) cm. long; blades prominently rugose-reticulate above, even the minor veins impressed and evident; pedicels in fruit floccose, glabreseent, somewhat subalately angled when dry, about 1 mm. in diameter, 5-10 cm. long, sometimes abruptly bent distally (at base of hypanthium), ebracteolate, or rarely with a pair of flat linear leafy subopposite denticulate bracteoles near the middle, the bracteoles 1.5-2.5 mm. wide, 8-12 mm. long, lanate below and glabrous above; flowers mostly about 3.5 cm. long, includ- ing hypanthium; corolla "pale yellow,"' "cream-yellow-green, " or "dull grayish lavender," the lavender color, especially near the base of the tube, often not obscured by the wool; tube 17-23 mm. long, rather abruptly decurved about 5 mm. above base, below the curve cylindrical, about 4-6 mm. wide when pressed flat, above the curve abruptly expanded, campanulate, 9-16 mm. wide at the base of the lobes when pressed; lobes essentially straight, hardly if at all decurved, the dorsal pair 4-5.5 mm. wide at base, (4-) 6-9 mm. long, the-lateral pair 4-6.5 mm. wide, (4-) 6-9 mm. long, the ventral lobe similar to the lateral, a trifle shorter; filaments (14-) 18-24 mm. long, becoming free from the corolla above the narrow part of the tube; anther-tube 5.5-6 mm. long, the terminal tufts soft, white, more or less matted, often nearly wanting, the anthers usually glabrous otherwise; capsule about 6-7 mm. across, 8 mm. high; calyx-lobes narrowed immediately above the base, then elliptic, blunt-tipped, veiny, 2.5-3 mm. wide, 7-11 mm. long.

description: Shrub; branches and branchlets mediumn-thick, obtusely [or often somewhat acutely] tetragonal, often somewhat sulcate on the sides and ampliate at the nodes, very densely velutinous-pubescent; inter- nodes 1-2.5 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 3-5 mm. long, densely villous-pubescent; blades membranous, green and very nitid above, much lighter beneath, oblong-elliptic or slightly obovate, 5.5-7 cm. long, 2.5-4 cm. wide, bluntly rounded or subacute at apex, entire, acuminate or cuneate at base, roughened-strigose above, densely villose with grayish-white matted hairs beneath, marked with a few black glandular disks near the base beneath; midrib relatively stoutish, quite prominent on both surfaces; secondaries 5-8 pairs, slender, arcuate- ascending, usually more or less obscured by the dense pubescence beneath; veinlets delicate, inconspicuous; inflorescence axillary; cymes few, small, solitary, opposite, congested, conglobate-capitate, about 1.5 cm. long and 1 cm. wide, rather few-flowered; peduncles very slender, 5-6 mm. long, densely pubescent; pedicels obsolete or to 1 mm. long and densely pubescent; calyx campanulate, 2.1-2.6 mm. long, about 1.8 mm. wide, densely pubescent, its rim plainly 4- or 5-toothed, its teeth short, regular, broad at base; corolla infundibular, pilose out- side, its tube cylindric, about 2.3 mm. long, its lobes 4, oblong- lingulate, about 1.8 mm. long and 0.7 mm. wide, obtuse or subacute at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 0.8 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, included (in female ); filaments filiform, about 0.2 mm. long (in female ); anthers oblong, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.2 mm. wide; pistil exserted (in female ); style capillary, about 4.1 mm. long (in female ), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 1 mm. long; ovary rotund, about 0.5 mm. long and wide, glabrate, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx greatly enlarged and indurated, cupuliform, about 4.5 mm. long and 6 mm. wide, densely pubescent, its rim subtruncate or very shallowly scalloped; fruit subglobose, about 3.5 mm. long and wide, very smooth and shiny.

description: Plants 0.5-1 m. high. with stiff slender branches; leaves rather numerous near the tips of the branches, often about 1 to each cm. of length of twig; blades ovate to oblong or elliptic, often broadest well below the middle, mostly abruptly rounded at base, mostly 1.5-2 cm. wide, 3.5-6 cm. long, 2-2.5 times as long as wide; petioles about 1 em. long; blades prominently rugose-reticulate above, so much so as to appear blistered (bullate), even the minor veins impressed and evident, the upper surface convex and the margins rolled down and appearing irregularly toothed because of the prominent retifculation; pedicels in fruit floccose, glabres- cent, irregularly wrinkled and minutely angled when dry, often abruptly bent at the base of the hypanthium, ebracteolate, 1-1.5 mm. in diameter, 6-9 em. long; flower about 6 em. long, including hypanthium; corolla "distally cream, proxi- mally pale pink" (Ewan), the tube 30-36 mm. long, straight or nearly so, narrowest just above base where 6-9 mm. wide pressed flat, thence gradually expanded, campanulate, 20-24 mm. wide at base of lobes when pressed; lobes slightly decurved, the dorsal pair about 9 mm. wide at base, 16-20 mm. long, the lateral pair 8 mm. wide, 12-15 mm. long, the ventral lobe 8 mm. wide, 10-13 mm. long; filaments about 45 mm. long, becoming free from the corolla just above the base; anther-tube 8 mm. long (the shorter anthers 6 mm. long), the terminal tufts of stiff white to golden-yellow hairs up to 2 mm. long, the anthers otherwise glabrous except for scattered long (3-4 mm.) yellowish hairs along the connectives; capsule 10-12 mm. wide and high; calyx-lobes oblong, with expanded base, 1.5-2.5 mm. wide, 7-10 mm. long.

description: S. niveo affinis; folia basi plerumque rotundata, supra convexa et bullata, basin versus latissima; calycis lobi 1.5-2.5 mm. lati, 7-10 mm. longi; lana ochroleuca.

description: Shrub; branches and branchlets rather slender, dark purplish-black, obtusely tetragonal, flattened and umbilicate at the nodes, covered and mostly hidden by a dense coat of lanate-tomentose hairs; internodes 2.5-4.5 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 3-5 mm. long, densely lanate-tomentose; blades membranous, light green on both surfaces, oval or ovate-oblong, 7-12 cm. long, 4-6 cm. wide, acuminate at apex, entire, rounded at base, densely lanate-tomenose on both surfaces; midrib slender, slightly prominent above, more or less embedded in the pubescence beneath; secondaries about 6 pairs, obscure above; veinlets obscure; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes few, axillary, dense, many-flowered, subcapitate, about 2.5 cm. long and 2 cm. wide, bracteolate; panicle terminal, about 7 cm. long and 4 cm. wide, composed of about 3 subcapitate cymes, the two lowermost subsessile and subtended by a pair of bracts, the central one stalked and terminating the inflorescence; peduncles slender, the axillary ones about 1 cm. long or less, the terminal one 2.5-4 cm. long, densely lanate-villose; pedicels obsolete; bracts about one pair, foliace-ous, oblong, similar to the leaves but much smaller; bractlets linear, numerous, somewhat twisted, surpassing the calyx; calyx very thin-textured, tubular-turbinate, about 6.2 mm. long, densely pubescent, very lax around the corolla, its rim 4-lobed; corolla hypocrateriform, its tube narrow-cylindric, about 5 mm. long, ampliate above, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 3.6 mm. long and 2 mm. wide, acute at apex; stamens 4, inserted at the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male); filaments filiform, about 5 mm. long (in male), glabrous; anthers small, oblong; pistil included (in male)style capillary, about 2.3 mm. long (in male), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 1.5 mm. long, parallel; ovary minute, obpyriform, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Moldenke, Richard G. 1934. A monograph of the genus Aegiphila. Brittonia. 1 (5-6): 245-471.

description: Frutex; annotinis et hornotinis gracilibus purpureis obtuse tetra- gonis dense lanato-tomentosis; foliis oppositis breviter petiolatis; petiolis gracilibus dense lanato-tomentosis; laminis membranaceis ovatis vel ovato-oblongis acuminatis integerrimis, ad basin rotundatis utrinque dense lanato-tomentosis; infloreseentiis axillaribus terminali- busque; eymis axillaribus paucis dense multifloris subcapitatis brac- teolatis; paniculis terminalibus abbreviatis bracteatis; floribus sessili- bus vel subsessilibus; pedunculis gracilibus dense lanato-villosis; bracteis 2 foliaceis oblongis utrinque tomentosis; bracteolis linearibus numerosis distortis calycem superantibus; calyce leve tubuloso- turbinato dense pubeseente, margine 4-lobato; corolla hypocrateri- forme, lobis 4 oblongis acutis; staminibus 4 longe exsertis; pistillo incluso; stigmate bifido; ovario minute obpyramidale glabro 4-loculare.
bibliographicCitation: Moldenke, Harold N. 1932. Some new species of Aegiphila from Central and South America. Brittonia. 1: 185-194.

description: Caules subteretes molliter breviterque tomentosi. Folia petiolata; laminae subcoriaceae ovatae, brevissime acutatae, repandae, basi obtusae vel subrotundatae, supra glabrae rugosae, subtus densissime velutinae. Racemus terminalis confertus, bracteis linearibus vel anguste lanceolatis; pedicelli elongati densissime villosi. Hypanthium late obconicum villosum. Sepala elongata, linearia e sinibus latis rotundatis. Corolla angusta molliter pubeseens basi rubro-purpurea ad apicem flaveseens. Antherarum tubus in suturis parce hirsutulus; antherae 2 apice albo-barbatae.

description: Apparently erect, the internodes 10-4 cm. long. Stem densely and softly tomentose with simple hairs. Petioles densely pubescent, 10-15 mm. long. Leaf-blades spreading or deflexed, subcoriaceous, ovate, to 9 cm. long and 5 cm. wide, abruptly acute, irregularly repand, broadly obtuse or subrotund at base, above dull green and glabrous with lightly impressed veins, benieath densely velutinous with elevated, conspicuously reticulate veins. Raceme 1-2 dm. long, densely and softly tomentose; bracts linear-laneeolate, 1-3 cm. long; pedicels slender, spreading, 15-20 mm. long, densely pubescent. Hypanthium obconic, densely pubeseent, 2 mm. long, 4 mm. wide when pressed. Sepals narrowly linear from broadly rounded sinuses, 14 mm. long, densely pubeseent. Corolla red-purple at base, fading to yellow distally, softly pubescent, the tube 30 mm. long; lower lobes narrowly triangular, 7 mm. long; upper lobes falcate, oblong, 10 mm. long. Filaments glabrous; anther-tube 5.5 mm. long, sparsely villous in the sutures, the two lower stamens white-bearded.

description: Suffrutex 0.3-0.4 m altus; foliis caulinis confertis parvis, laminis anguste lanceolatis 2-3.5 cm longis 5-8 mm latis glabris; pedunculo 1-floro elongato subfiliformi 6.5-8.5 cm longo; calycis lobis lineari-lanceolatis vel linearibus apice obtusis vel rotundatis; corolla 3.3-3.6 cm longa.

description: Subshrub 0.3-0.4 m tall, stem erect, 4-angled or subalate, glabrous; leaves petiolate, petiole 3-5 mm long, glabrous; leaf-blades subcoriaceous, ascending, crowded, narrowly oblanceolate, obtuse or subobtuse at apex, narrowed to the base, 2-3.5 cm long, 5-8 mm wide, inconspicuously crenulate with 3-4 teeth each side, glabrous; lateral nerves 3-5 each side, elevated below; peduncle subfiliform, 6.5-8.5 cm long, 1-flowered, more or less pilosulous; hypanthium campanulate, in anthesis 3 mm long, 3-4 mm wide at summit, in fruit 10 mm long, 8 mm wide, densely pilosulous; calyx lobes 5, unequal, linear-lanceolate to linear, obtuse or rounded at apex, in anthesis 4-7 mm long, 0.5-1.5 mm wide, in fruit 7-9 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, sparsely to moderately pilosulous without, glabrous within; corolla orange-red with yellow on lobes, nearly straight, cylindric-tubular, 33-36 mm long, 8-8.5 mm wide at the middle, 5 mm wide at the narrowed base (tube 27 mm long, lobes lanceolate, subacute, 6.5-7.5 mm long, 2.5 mm wide), pilosulous without, glabrous within; anther column 5 mm long, 3 mm wide, glabrous; filament column 25 mm long, glabrous; stigma bilobed, 1 mm high, 2 mm wide; fruit capsular, turbinate, 10 mm long, 8 mm wide at summit.
bibliographicCitation: Steyermark, Julian A. 1978. New Taxa from the Avila and Naiguata Mountains, Venezuela. Brittonia. 30 (1): 39-49.

description: Shrubby or subherbaceous, up to 3 m. high; leaves well scattered, usually 1 cm. apart or more even in the infloreseence; blades narrowly to broadly elliptic, more or less attenuate to the petiole or, especially the lower, roulded at base, mostly 2.5-6 cm. wide (sometimes the upper narrower), 6-10 (-13) cm. long, mostly 2-3 times as long as wide; petioles 1-2 cm. long; blades prominently rugose- reticulate above, the primary and usually the minor veins impressed and evident; pedicels in fruit floccose, glabreseent, irregularly wrinkled and minutely angled when dry, usually not abruptly bent at base of hypanthium, 1.5-2 mm. in diameter, 6.5-9 (-11) cm.- long, apparently always ebracteolate; flowers about 4.5 (-6) cm. long, including hypanthium; corolla white or yellowish-white without, greenish-white within, the tube 25-30 mm. long, straight or essentially so, abruptly contracted above the base, 6-7 mm. wide (pressed flat) at the narrowest place, then gradually expanded and narrowly campanulate, about 16-18 mm. wide at the base of the lobes when pressed; lobes straight or slightly decurved, the dorsal pair 5-8 mm. wide, 12-16 mm. long, the lateral pair 5-6 mm. wide, 12-13 mm. long, the ventral lobes similar to the lateral, a trifle shorter; filaments (25-) 30-36 mm. long, becoming free from the corolla just above the base; anther-tube 9-11 mm. long (the shorter anthers 7-8 mm. long), the terminal tufts of stiff white or yellowish hairs up to 2 mm. long, the anthers otherwise nearly glabrous but usually with at least a few long (3-4 mm.) white hairs on the connectives; capsule about 9-12 mm. across, 10-12 mm. high, surmounted by the rim of the hypanthium which is up to 3 mm. high; calyx-lobes linear except for the expanded and usually involute base, mostly about 1.5 mm. wide, 12-16 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: McVaugh, Rogers. 1949. Studies in the South American Lobeliodeae (Campanulaceae) with special reference to Colombian species. Brittonia. 6: 450-493. 1 pl.

description: Scandent or arboreseent shrub; branches and branchlets slender, obtusely tetragonal, densely puberulent throughout; internodes 3-6.5 cm. long; leaves decussate-opposite [or approximate on young shoots]; petioles slender, very weak, 7-14 mm. long, puberulent or glabrate; blades chartaceous, dark green above, paler beneath, oblong, 10-24 cm. long, 3.5-10 cm. wide, acuminate at apex, entire, acute or acumi- nate at base, sparsely and minutely strigillose with short white for- ward-pointing hairs on both surfaces, becoming g]abrate beneath in age; midrib slender, prominent beneath; secondaries 10-12 pairs, slender, very slightly prominulent beneath, ascending; veinlets delicate, rather inconspicuous; infloreseence axillary and termiiral; eymes solitary, opposite, about 5 cm. long and 3 cm. wide, many-flowered, dense, bracteolate; panicle terminal, narrow throughout, 25-50 cm. long, 10-12 cm. wide, pendant or drooping, often long drawn-out, foliose, its component eymes about 8 cm. apart below, the intervals gradually decreasing toward the apex, its sympodia very slender, con- spicuously suleate, puberulent; peduncles very slender, 1.5-5 cm. long, tetragonal and suleate, puberulent; pedic6ls slender, 4-6 mm. long, puberulent; bracts large, foliaceous, numerous, oblong, similar to the leaves in all respects but smaller, to 11 cm. long and 4.5 cm. wide; bractlets lanceolate or linear, 5-10 mm. long; prophylla minute, subu- late; calyx campanulate, very shallow and lax, about 2 mm. long and 3 mm. wide, puberulent, its rim subtruneate, 4-apiculate; corolla in- fundibular, white, its tube very narrow-cylindric, about 4.3 mm. long, abruLptly ampliate above, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 3.7 mm. long and 2.5 mm. wide, rounded at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 0.3 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male) filaments filiform, about 8 mm. long (in male), glabrous; pistil included (in male); style capillary, about 1.6 mm. long (in male), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 1 mm. long; ovary subrotund, about 1 mm. long and wide, 4-lobed at apex, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx greatly enlarged and indurated, cupuliform, about 2 mm. long and 5 mm. wide, abruptly narrowed into the ampliate fruiting-pedicel, puberulent, closely investing the fruit, its rim truncate and entire; fruit depressed-globose, to 5 mm. long and wide [when mature!], glabrous, invested for about 1.5 mm. at its base by the closely-fitting fruiting-calyx.

description: Niveorum foliis subimbricatis, lineari-lanceolatis, 4-9 mm. latis, 20-45 mm. longis, 5-7-plo longioribus quam latioribus, costis impressis sed paginis superioribus ceterum laevibus.
bibliographicCitation: McVaugh, Rogers. 1949. Studies in the South American Lobeliodeae (Campanulaceae) with special reference to Colombian species. Brittonia. 6: 450-493. 1 pl.

description: Up to 80 cm. tall; leaves very numerous (2-5 to each cm. of length of twig or more on younger twigs), imbricate at least on growing tips, ascending or divaricate; blades linear-lanceolate, rigid and nearly or quite 1 mm. thick when dry, at maturity 4-9 mm. wide, 20-45 mm. long, (3-) 5-7 times as long as wide, tapering to a blunt point, rather gradually rounded to the stout, stiffly appressed or merely ascending petiolar base 4-6 mm. long; upper surface glabrous, irregularly rugulose when dry, the midvein prominently impressed, the lateral veins not impressed or buf indistinctly so; margins appearing entire, but actually revolute, and bearing minute glandular callosities (about 5 per cm. of margin) which are concealed by the wool of the lower surface; flowers 20 or fewer to a branch; pedicels in fruit glabreseent, subalately about 5-angled when dry, about 1.5 mm. in diameter, mostly 6-7.5 cm. long, strongly ascending, ebracteolate or with two small projections near base, abruptly decurved distally at the base of the flower; flower about 4.5-5 cm. long, including hypanthium; corolla ochroleucous, drying "gray" and papery, the tube about 2.5 cm. long, abruptly narrowed above base, when pressed flat about 8 mm. wide at 6 mm. above base, then expanding and approximately ellipsoid, slightly contracted distally, when pressed 12 mm. wide at base of lobes; lobes somewhat decurved, the dorsal pair about 4.5 mm. wide at base, 10-11 mm. long, the lateral lobes 5 mm. wide, 9 mm. long, the ventral lobes 4 mm. wide, 7 mm. long; filament-tube 30-33 mm. long, anther-tube 7-9 mm. long, 3-3.5 mm. in diameter, curved, all the anthers densely tufted at apex with bright golden hairs up to 1.5 mm. long, otherwise glabrous or with a few golden hairs on the backs; hypanthium 8-10 mm. high and 10-12 mm. broad, only very loosely united with the base of the capsule; capsule half inferior or ,a little more, 12-13 mm. high, calyx-lobes linear or the base slightly dilated, 1-1.3 mm. wide, 12-15 mm. long, glabrous and green within, entire or with occasional minute callosities.
bibliographicCitation: McVaugh, Rogers. 1949. Studies in the South American Lobeliodeae (Campanulaceae) with special reference to Colombian species. Brittonia. 6: 450-493. 1 pl.

description: Shrub or small tree; branches slender, terete, s]ightly flattened but scarcely ampliate at the nodes, grayish, glabrous; branchlets slender, obtusely tetragonal or subterete, puberulent toward the apex, becom- ing glabrate in age; internodes 3-45 cm. long; leaf-scars large and ele- vated, broadly cordate; leaves decussate; petioles slender when young, stout when mature, 5-6 mm. long, minutely puberulent-roughened or glabrate; blades firm or subcoriaceous [when mature], dark green above, paler beneath, nitid on both surfaces, oblong or slightly obo- vate, varying to elliptic, 4.5-12 cm. long, 3-6.5 cm. wide, very obtusely rounded or subacute [sometimes slightly acuminate] at apex, entire, acuminate at base, frequently falcate and partly conduplicate along the midrib at base, practically glabrate on both surfaces, densely and minutely glandular-punctate beneath with dots almost invisible to the naked eye and often marked with a few scattered glandular disks; midrib slender, prominent beneath; secondaries 5-7 pairs, slender, rather prominent beneath, arcuate-aseending, more or less anasto>mos- ing near the margins; veinlets few, delicate, sometimes rather prom- inulent beneath; infloreseence axillary and terminal, frequently termi- nating short axillary branchlets; eymes solitary, opposite, 5-7 cm. long, 4-5 cm. wide, brachiate, rather lax, many-flowered, bracteolate; panicle terminal, thyrsoid, about 6 cm. long and wide, bracteate, its sympodia and branches very short, minutely puberulent; peduncles slender, 2-4 cm. long, minutely puberulent; pedicels slender, 2-5 mm. long, minutely puberulent, becoming much thickened and verrucose in the mature fruit; bracts foliaceous, oblong, stipitate, 1-3.5 cm. long, to 1.5 cm. wide, glabrous; bractlets linear, about 6 mm. long; pro- phylla minute; calyx campanulate, about 3.5 mm. long and 2.5 mm. wide, puberulent, its rim subtruneate, 4-apiculate; corolla infundibu- lar, pale yellow, glabrous, its tube narrow-cylindric, about 5.7 mm. long, ampliate above, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 3.5 mm. long and 2.2 mm. wide, rounded at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1.3 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, included or equaling the limb in female, exserted in male; filaments filiform, about 3.7 mm. long, glabrous; anthers ovate, small; pistil long-exserted (in female); style capillary, about 7 mm. long (in female), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 3 mm. long; ovary subglobose, about 1 mm. long and wide, 4-lobed at apex, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx greatly enlarged and indurated, puberulent, at first rather decidedly obvolute and completely enclos- ing the immature fruit, later becoming shallowly cupuliform and much thickened (on almost verrucose pedieels), to 6 mm. long and 9 mm. wide, its rim subtruneate, eventually becoming irregularly and rather shallowly scalloped or split; mature fruit subglobose, about 10 mm. long and wide, orange, glabrous, nitid, 4-seeded.

description: Mature spikes dense, about 12 mm long, irregularly verticillate, the verticils subtended by small broadly reniform and shortly apiculate bracts. description: The leaves are indeed shorter than those of L. brachysiphonia, and the flower-color, as stated by Zahlbruckner and Wimmer, is different (see key to species, above). The two plants are alike, however, in having the dorsal corolla-lobes ciliate, and in the long, slender pedicels which lift the flowers well above the narrow, clustered leaves. In the absence of more complete material for study, I should prefer to accept Wimmer's disposition of these taxa as he expressed it in 1937, in the Flora of Peru.

description: Leaves relatively broad, with elliptic, oblanceolate or obovate blade, nar. rowed below the middle and prolonged into a long, dilated, sessile base; blades subentire to plainly sinuate-dentate, (2-) 5-6 (-9) mm wide, blunt-tipped, attenuate at the base; leaves as a whole 4-8 (-15) times as long as wide; corolla 15-20 mm long, white (Pennell), the tube 1015 mm long, the lobes roughened within but lacking hairs; filament-tube 10.15 mm long; calyx-lobes linear, acute, (1.2-)2-3.3 mm long, entire or the margins with one or two sessile callose teeth on each side.

description: Leaves long and narrow, (20-) 25-50 (-70) mm long, 1-3 (-4.5) mm wide, 10-20 (-40) times as long as wide, appearing entire or slightly sinuate, the margins beset with inconspicuous callose teeth; blade with a blunt or rounded tip, narrowly oblanceolate to linear, broadest above the middle and attenuate to a narrow zone somewhat below the middle, thence dilated to the base; corolla 3.2-5 cm long, the tube 26-40 mm long; filament-tube (24-) 28-42 mm long; capsule a little more than half inferior, the lower part 2-3.5 mm in diameter, 2.5-3.5 mm long, somewhat compressed tangentially, on a stout pedicel 7-15 (-30) mm long; calyx-lobes (2-) 2.5-3 mm long, entire or toothed; seeds fusiform, 1.5-1.6 mm long, with minute longitudinal cellular markings.

description:
Shrub, 2-4 m. tall; branches rather sparsely gay-tomentellous or becoming glabrate; branchlets slender, obtusely tetragonal or subterete, densely pubescent-tomentellous with gray and substrigose antrorse hairs; internodes 2-5 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 5-10 mm. long, grayish and densely pubescent-tomentellous; blades membranous or rather firm, bright green and subnitid above, grayish-green beneath, broadly ovate or elliptic, 7-11. cm. long, 3.57 cm. wide, acuminate or cuspidate at apex, entire, usually very convex, perfectly rotund at base, the uppermost ones greatly reduced and merging into the bracts, short-pubescent along the midrib and larger veins above, becoming glabrate [except for the midrib] in age, densely soft-pubescent beneath; midrib slender, prominent on both surfaces, densely pubescent; secondaries 6-9 pairs, slender, rather prominent beneath, not furrowing the leaf above, arcuate-ascending, more or less anastomosing several mm. from the margins; veinlets slender, conspicuous above, rather obscure beneath; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes in the axils of the uppermost leaves, solitary, opposite, conglomerate, 1.5-5.5 cm. long, 1.5-3 cm. wide, densely many-flowered, bracteolate; panicle terminal, 5-7 cm. long and wide, bracteate, its sympodia few, short, fastigiate, densely pubescent-tomentellous with substrigose and antrorse hairs; flowers distinctly diclinous; peduncles slender, divaricate, firm, 2.5-3 cm. long, shortly and densely pubescent-tomentellous like the sympodia; pedicels extremely short, pubescent; bracts few, subtending the lowermost cymes of the panicle, sometimes large and foliaceous [4-5 cm. long and 2-2.5 cm. wide], sometimes small and various, long-stipitate, tomentellous-pubescent; bractlets lanceolate-setaceous, 2-5 mm. long, pubescent; calyx obconic-campanulate, 3-4.1 mm. long, about 3.6 mm. wide, an-trorsely strigose-pubescent or canescent, its. rim 4-toothed or 4-lobed, its lobes ovate, about 0.5 mm. long; corolla hypocrateriform, white, glabrous, its tube cylindric, 3.6-6 mm. long, slightly ampliate above, its lobes 4, sub equal, somewhat spreading, oblong-ovate or elliptic-lingulate, 3-4.1 mm. long, 1.5-2.8 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male); filaments filiform, to 5.2 mm. long (in male), glabrous; anthers oblong-linear, 1.5-1.6 mm. long, about 1 mm. wide; pistil included (in male) style light, capillary, about 3.1 mm. long (in male), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 2.6 mm. long; ovary obovate, about 0.7 mm. long and 0.6 mm. wide, depressed at apex, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

The type of this endemic Paraguayan species was collected by Emil Hassler (No. 8056) in thickets near Bellavista, in the region of the upper course of the Rio Apa, Paraguay, and is deposited in the herbarium of the Conservatoire et Jardin Botaniques at Geneva. It has been collected in anthesis in December. The species is closely related to A. Candelabrum. 3.

description:

description: Shrub; branchlets rather stout, obtusely tetragonal, flattened and ampliate at the nodes, usually deeply suleate, especially toward the apex, very densely puberulent; leaf-scars elevated; internodes 5.5-6.5 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles weak, 7-10 mm. long, densely puberulent; blades membranous, conspicuously falcate, usually more or less plicate, especially below, oblong, 10-15 cm. long, 5-6 cm. wide, very abruptly acute at apex, entire, acute at base, very densely puberulent on both surfaces; midrib stout and prominent beneath; secondaries 7-10 pairs, slender, arcuate-aseending, obscure; veinlets almost indiscernible; infloreseence axillary or terminal; eymes solitary, opposite, to 7 cm. long and 3.5 cm. wide, many-flowered, brachiate, bracteolate; panicle terminal, pyramidal or sometimes similar to the axillary eymes only somewhat larger, 9.5-13 cm. long, 5-7 cm. wide, apparently bracteate, its sympodia slender, short, its branches opposite, few; peduncles rather slender, 2-4 ei. long, densely puberulent; pedicels about 2 mm. long, longer and inerassate in fruit, densely puberulent; bracts apparently large and foliaceous, eaducous; bractlets linear-lanceolate, to 14 min. long; prophylla setaceous, about 1 mm. long; calyx not seen except after anthesis; corolla apparently often long-persistent after anthesis; stamens 4; filaments about 14.6 mm.

description: Scandens; annotinis subgracilibus obtuse tetragonis rugulosis; hornotinis gracilibus obtuse tetragonis breviter adpresso- et flavo- pubeseentibus, pilis ad apicem et ad nodos densissimis; foliis oppositis petiolatis; petiolis dense adpresso- et flavo-pilosis; laminis firme membranaceis pernitidis oblongis vel oblongo-ovatis acutis vel brevis- sime acuminatis integerrimis in siceitate subrevolutis ad basin rotun- datis vel rare subacutis, supra (praeter venam mediam pilosam) glabris, subtus in vena media et venis secondariis pilosis, subtus plerumque discis glandulosis parvis ornatis; infloreseentiis axillaribus terminalibusque; eymis axillaribus pedunculatis subumbellatis dense multifloris bracteolatis; paniculis terminalibus pyramidatis bracteatis, sympodiis brevibus dense flavo-pilosis; floribus pedicellatis; pedun- culis et pedicellis gracilibus dense flavo-pilosis; bracteis foliaceis lanceolatis; bracteolis numerosissimis involueriformibus quamque pedicellam subtentibus, ovatis vel oblongis vel lanceolatis saepe acutis et ad basin longe attenuatis pilosis; calyce obeonico piloso, margine 4-lobato; corolla hypocrateriforme magna glabra, lobis 4 oblongis ob- tusis; staminibus 4 longe exsertis vel inelusis; pistillo incluso vel longe exserto; stigmate bifido; ovario oblongo vel obovato glabro 4-loculare ad apicem complanato.

description: Liana; branches rather slender, grayish, obtusely tetragonal, roughened; branchlets slender, obtusely tetragonal, flattened and ampliate at the nodes, very dark, covered with a yellow pubescence which is short, closely appressed and more or less forward-pointing, densest toward the apex and at the nodes; internodes 5.5-10 cm. long; leaf-scars elevated; leaves decussate; petioles medium-stout, 6-10 mm. long, densely appressed-pilose like the branchlets; blades firmly membranous, dark green above, lighter beneath, very nitid on both surfaces, especially above, oblong or somewhat oblong-ovate, 7-15 cm. long, 2.5-7 cm. wide, acute or very short-acuminate at apex, entire, slightly revolute in drying, rounded at base or rarely subacute, glabrous above except for the pilose midrib, pilose on the midrib and larger veins beneath, usually marked with a number of small glandular disks beneath [especially along the midrib below]; midrib rather stout, prominent beneath, pilose; secondaries 6-8 pairs, prominent beneath, arcuate-ascending, conspicuously anastomosing near the margins; veinlets slender, prominent; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes solitary, opposite, 1 member of the pair often not developing or developing poorly, subumbellate, to 9 cm. long and 4.5 cm. wide, densely many-flowered, bracteolate; panicle terminal, pyramidal, usually but little larger than the axillary cymes, to 12 cm. long and 7 cm. wide, bracteate, its component cymes about 5, many-flowered, bracteolate, its sympodia short, densely pilose like the branchlets; peduncles medium or slender, 1.5-5 cm. long, densely pilose like the branchlets; pedicels slender, 2-4 mm. long, pilose, practically each one subtended by several large ovate or oblong bractlets; bracts foliaceous, lanceolate, to 2 cm. long and 4 mm. wide, a pair below each pair of branches of the panicle; bractlets very numerous, apparently subtending every pedicel, often so arranged as to simulate a basal involucre about the flowers, ovate or oblong, usually shorter and wider than the bracts [sometimes lanceolate and more elongate], frequently acute at apex and long-attenuate at base, pilose; calyx obconic, about 4.1 mm. long and 3.6 mm. wide, pilose with light antrorse hairs, its rim 4-lobed, its lobes about 1.3 mm. long; corolla hypocrateriform, its tube broadly cylindric, about 10.4 mm. long, glabrous, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, about 7.2 mm. long and 3.6 mm. wide, rounded at apex; stamens 4, inserted 1.5-2.6 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male) or included (in female); filaments filiform, 1-9.8 mm. long, glabrous; anthers oblong, about 1 mm. long and' 0.7 mm. wide; pistil included (in male) or long-exserted (in female); style capillary, to 9.8 mm. long; stigma bifid, its branches about 3.3 mm. long; ovary oblong or obovate, about 1.3 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, flattened above, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Branches acutely tetragonal, puberulent; leaves long-petiolate; blades ovate-lanceolate, acuminate at apex, entire, slightly attenuate at base, glabrous and smooth above, closely reticulate and densely punctate in the areolae beneath, ashy-gray; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes axillary, nascent in the upper axils; panicle terminal, shorter than the leaves, bracteate, its branches opposite; bracts linear-lanceolate, at the base of the branches of the panicle; calyx-rim 4-toothed; corolla-tube slightly longer than the calyx, cylindric, ampliate below the limb; stamens included; filaments very short; anthers perhaps imperfect.

description: Shrub, 1-4 m. tall; branches and branchlets stout, obtusely tetragonal or subterete, ampliate at the nodes, densely and often very closely appressed strigose-pubescent; internodes 3.5-8 cm. long; leaf-scars large and elevated; leaves decussate; petioles stout, about 6 mm. long; blades usually very thick-coriaceous and leathery, usually gray-green above, paler beneath, very nitid, oblong or oblong-ovate, 8-18 cm. long, 4-7 cm. wide, narrowed to an acuminate point at apex, entire, rounded [or occasionally acute] at base, roughened and appressedly short-strigose-hirtous above [or becoming subglabrate], densely strigose pubescent beneath, often marked with small glandular disks on both surfaces, especially beneath; midrib rather stout, very prominent beneath, prominulent above; secondaries 6-9 pairs, slender, very prominent beneath, arcuate-ascending, beautifully anastomosing several mm. from the margins; veinlets slender, very prominent beneath; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes in the axils of the uppermost leaves, solitary, opposite, usually few, corymbose, to 10 cm. long and 5.5 cm. wide, many-flowered; panicle terminal, pyramidal-thyrsoid or sometimes spreading-corymbose, often very ample, 8-21 cm. long, 7-10 cm. wide, brachiate, bracteate, its branches and sympodia rather stout, densely appressed strigose-pubescent; peduncles stout, 3-6 cm. long, divaricate, densely appressed strigose-pubescent; pedicels slender, 1-2 mm. long, pubescent; bracts varying from large and foliaceous, lanceolate, acute at both ends, and about 5 cm. long, to very narrow-linear and only 4-6 mm. long; bractlets and prophylla linear or setaceous, 1-3 mm. long, pubescent; calyx firmly membranous or light, obconic-cyathiform, constricted above the ovary, 4-7 mm. long, 3-4.1 mm. wide, densely appressed-pilose or strigose, lax around the corolla-tube, its rim deeply 4-lobed, its lobes broadly ovate or triangular, about 2 mm. long, acute or short-acuminate at apex; corolla infundibular, yellow, ochraceous-white, or white, its tube narrow-cylindric, 4.5-8 mm. long, slightly ampliate above, glabrous outside, more or less pubescent within, usually white, its lobes [3 -] 4, usually greenish-yellow, erecto-patent, lanceolate or ovate-lingulate, 3-5.2 mm. long, 2-2.5 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 4 [or rarely 5] inserted 1.1-2.5 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, long-exserted (in male) or included (in female); filaments filiform, 2-8 mm. long, glabrous or slightly pilose at base; anthers oblong or ovate, 1.1-1.3 mm. long, 0.5-0.8 mm. wide; pistil included (in male) or long-exserted (in female); style capillary, 3.6-15 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches 2.6-6.7 mm. long; ovary depressed-globose, tetragonal, 1-1.3 mm. long, 1.2-1.3 mm. wide, truncate at both ends or umbilicate at apex, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx enlarged and indurated, conspicuously obvolute and cucullate when immature, deeply lobed, densely puberulent; fruit about 4 mm. long and 2.5 mm. wide, flattened and umbilicate at both ends, smooth, completely included by the calyx when immature, only closely semi-included at maturity.

description: Small shrub; branches slender, dark, obtusely tetragonal, ap-pressed-villose or tomentose; branchlets short, slender, obtusely tetragonal, densely ochraceous-villose; internodes 12-24 mm. long; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 3-5 mm. long, densely villose; blades thinly membranous, dark green above, much lighter beneath, oblanceo-late, 4.5 [-9.5] cm. long, 2 [-3.8] cm. wide, acute at apex, entire, attenuate at base, lightly short-villose or tomentose above, densely ochraceous-villose beneath; midrib slender, prominent beneath; secondaries 6-8 pairs, very slender, ascending, not conspicuous; veinlets indiscernible; inflorescence axillary and terminal, similar throughout; cymes few, conglobate-capitate, about 3 cm. long, densely many-flowered, the axillary ones double in each axil, the terminal ones apparently solitary; peduncles very slender, 2-2.3 cm. long, densely villose, the axillary ones bifurcate at almost the base, each branch bearing a pair of bractlets and a conglobate cyme at its apex; pedicels obsolete; calyx campanulate, about 7.8 mm. long and 4.6 mm. wide, densely villose with long whitish hairs, its rim deeply 4-lobed; corolla infundibular, its tube cylindric, about 5.2 mm. long, its lobes 4, ovate-elliptic, about 1.8 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1.3 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, very slightly exserted or subincluded (in female); filaments filiform, 1.1-1.4 mm. long (in female), glabrate; anthers oblong, about 0.6 mm. long and 0.4 mm. wide; pistil long-exserted (in female); style capillary, about 6.6 mm. long (in female), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 5.2 mm. long; ovary oblong, about 1 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide, 4-lobed at apex, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Shrub or tree, to 8 m. tall; trunk measuring to 15 cm. in diameter; bark gray; branches strong and stout, acutely tetragonal with flat- tened sides, very medullose, calveseent or griseous; branchlets usually comparatively stout, divaricate, acutely or obtusely tetragonal, some what flattened at the nodes, shortly grayish pubeseent-tomentose; internodes 1.5-4 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles 6-12 mm. long or less, spreading caneseent-hirtous; blades thinly membranous, dark green above, much lighter beneath, obovate-oblong or elliptic, 5-19 cm. long, 2.5-10 cm. wide, rounded or shortly and mostly obtusely acuminate at apex, entire or obsoletely angulate-dentate, cuneate at base and attenuate into the petiole, caneseent-sublanuginous or pubeseent-hirtous above when young, becoming glabrous in age, lanuginous-pubeseent or subtomentose-caneseent beneath, becoming more sparsely so in age; midrib slender or stout, prominent beneath; secondaries 10-15 pairs, slender, often close together, prominent beneath, arcuate-aseending, anastomosing near the margins; veinlets slender, usually conspicuously reticulate beneath; inflorescence axil- lary; eymes solitary, opposite, conglobate or capitate, much shorter than the subtending leaves, about 5 cm. long and 2-2.5 cm. wide, densely many-flowered, bracteolate; peduncles slender, ascending, 0.5-2 cm. long, spreading-hirtous or caneseent, sometimes almost obsolete in fruit; pedicels filiform, 1-5 mm. long in male, almost obsolete in female, canescent; bractlets numerous, paired, subulate, about 3 mm. long, caneseent; prophylla minute, linear, caneseent; calyx obconic, about 4 mm. long and 3.2 mm. wide, appressedly caneseent- subsericeous or cano-tomentose, its rim plainly 4-toothed or -lobed, its lobes wide, varying from truncate or obtuse to acute or apiculate at apex; corolla infundibular, yellowish or greenish-white, its tube narrow-cylindric, 4-4.5 ium. long, glabrous, its lobes 4, oblong-lingu- late, patent, about 3 mm. long and 1.8 mm. wide, obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 0.8 mm. below the mouth of the corolla- tube, included (in female) or long-exserted (in male) filaments filiform, 0.3-6 mm. long, glabrous; anthers oblong or subrotund, about 1 mm. long and 0.4 mm. wide, effete in female, pistil included in male or long exserted (in female); style capillary, 1.8 -3.7 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its  branches 1.6-3 mm. long; ovary depressed-pyriform, light, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.8 mm. wide, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting- calyx enlarged and indurated, cupuliform, about 5 mm. long and wide, striate, lightly pubescent or caneseent, its rim irregularly repand, scalloped, or lobed; fruit ellipsoid, obtuse, about 8 mm. long and 6 mm. wide, corticated, yellow or fuscous, smooth and nitid, semi-included by the mature calyx, 1-4-seeded; cotyledons thick, oily, accumbent, with very short inferior radicle.

description: Arbor parva; ramulis moderate crassis pallido-brunneis glabris; foliis 8-12 (16) cm. longis 4.5-8.5 cm. latis ellipticis vel oblongo-ellipticis integris, basi late obtusa cordata, apice late obtuso vel brevissimo-obtuso-acuminato, adultis dure coriaceis, costa excepta nervis inconspicue impressis, petiolo crasso 3-6 mm. longo, stipulis caducis non visis; inflorescentiis axillaribus pseudoterminali- busque; paniculis 5-12 cm. longis, ramis cymosis patentibus vel reflexis, bracte- olis 1-2 mm. longis obtusis vel acutis, ciliolatis; floribus plus-minus zygomorphis, calycis tubo carnoso 5-7 mm. longo 6-8 mm. lato campanulato posterius gibberoso, extus intusque glabro disco excepto, abrupte contracto in stipitem 5-7 mm. longo; sepalis 5 imbricatis inaequalibus late rotundatis 4-5 mm. longis ciliolatis, lateralibus brevioribus; petalis orbicularibus 8-10 cm. longis plus-minus inaequalibus ciliolatis; disco in corona 1.0-1.5 mm. alta reflexo-hirsuto, corona expansa posterius in ligulam staminiferam 8-10 mm. longam ca. 5 mm. latam producta; stamninibus ca. 15 unilateralibus 1-seriatis, filamentis in lamina ligulata lata elongata aestivatione circinata connatis apice incurvo 5-8 mm. libero, antheris oblongo-orbicularibus; ovario unilateraliter posterius corona inserta apice hirsuto 1-loculari; stylo ca. 1.5 cm. longo subulato glabro basi dilatata hirsuta, stigmate minuto; ovulis 2 ascendentibus collateralibus ad basim loculi affixis; fructibus ignotis.
bibliographicCitation: Maguire, Bassett. 1951. The genus Acioa in America. Brittonia. 7: 271-273.

description: Ramulis 3-5 mm. crassis pallidis glabris; foliis (10) 12-15 cm. longis, 6-9 cm. latis, late ellipticis vel elliptico-oblongis integris, apice rotundato vel subtruncato, plus-minus retuso, basi rotundata subconduplicata, adultis dure coriaceis, nervis 6-8 jugis prominulis, petiolo crasso rimoso 8-10 mm. longo 3-4 mm. diam., stipulis non visis; inflorescentiis axillaribus pseudoterminalibusque fasciculatis, paniculis 5-6 cm. longis, ramis cymosis ascendentibus, bracteolis caducis non visis; floribus plus-minus zygomorphis, calycis tubo 18-20 mm. longo anguste tubuloso-obconico, sursum ca. 5 mm. diam. a stipite linsensibiliter angustato 4-5 mm. longo, 1 mm. diam., intus glabro disco excepto, sepalis 5 imbricatis inaequalibus obovato-orbicularibus maioribus 5-6 mm. longis, extus glabris, intus cane scentibus; petalis non visis; disco in corona ca. 0.75 mm. alta reflexo-hirsuto, corona expansa posterius in ligulam staminiferam 10-12 mm. longam ca. 2 mm. latam producta, staminibus ca. 15 unilateralibus 1-seriatis, filamentis in lamina ligulata angusta aestivatione circinata connatis, apice incurvo 6-8 mm. libero, antheris oblongo-orbicularibus; ovario unilateraliter posterius corona inserta 1- loculari omnino dense hirsuto; stylo ca. 15 mm. longo subter medio sparse hirsuto base dilatata dense hirsuta, stigmate minuto; ovulis 2 ascendentibus collateralibus ad basim loculi affixis; fructibus ignotis.

description: Shrub; branchlets rather slender and weak, much elongated, obtusely tetragonal, greenish, harshly yellowish-scurfy and strigose or merely pubescent, becoming minutely puberulent in age; internodes 3-6 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 4-10 mm. long, weak, thickened at base, strigose-pubescent; blades membranous, dark green and nitid on both surfaces, varying from ovate or lanceolate-ovate to oblong or obovate, 7-12 cm. long, 2-5 cm. wide, attenuate-acuminate at apex [sometimes somewhat abruptly so], entire, rounded or sometimes subacute at base [occasionally faintly inequilateral], very sparsely strigillose-roughened or [usually] glabrous above or sparsely strigose along the midrib and larger veins, more densely strigose on the reticulation beneath; midrib slender, prominent beneath, strigose; secondaries 8-10 pairs, slender, prominent beneath, arcuate-ascending, distinctly anastomosing near the margins, strigose (especially beneath); veinlets very slender, prominulent on both surfaces; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes few, in the axils of the uppermost leaves only, solitary, opposite, about half as long as the subtending leaves or less, divaricate, extremely dense-flowered: and congested, bracteate, bracteolate; panicle terminal, thyrsoid, almost hemispheric at first, later pyramidal, with a rounded summit, about 5-10 cm. long and 5-6.5 cm. wide, usually short, extremely dense-flowered, bracteate, its branches opposite and rather close together, its sympodia puberulent, the upper ones few and short, completely hidden by the mass of flowers; flowers often interspersed with fruiting-calyces; peduncles stout, 1-5.5 cm. long, strigose-tomentose or becoming merely pubescent or puberulent; pedicels slender, 3-7 mm. long or less, strigose-tomentose; bracts foliaceous, usually 1 or 2 pairs, lanceolate or ovate, 1.5- 5.5 cm. long, to 1.5 cm. wide, long-stipitate, acuminate at apex, inconspicuously puberulent on both surfaces, especially on the midrib; bractlets and prophylla very numerous, linear or linear-lanceolate, 1-2 cm. long, weak, pubescent or slightly setose; calyx turbinate, 4-5 mm. long, about 3 mm. wide, strigose-setose or hispid, its rim deeply 4-lobed, its lobes erect, equal, ovate, about 2 mm. long, acute or obtuse at apex; corolla infundibular, apparently reddish-purple (?), strongly obpyriform with a rounded apex in bud, its tube cylindric, 6-7 mm. long, 1.3-2 mm. in diameter, minutely puberulent outside, its lobes 4, obovate- or broadly ovate-lingulate, 3-3.5 mm. long, 1.6 -2.5	mm. wide, rounded at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 0.8 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, included (in female) or long-exserted (in male); filaments filiform, 0.2-8 mm. long, glabrous; anthers ovate, 0.8-1.2 mm. long, about 0.8 mm. wide, effete in female pistil slightly exserted (in male or long-exserted (in female; style capillary, 3.2-8 mm. long, often contorted, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches 2.6-5 mm. long, twisted, pubescent; ovary oblong or subglobose, blackish, 0.8-2 mm. long, 0.6-1 mm. wide, truncate and 4-lobed at apex, 4-sulcate along the sides, glabrate, “on a short and thickened base', fruiting-calyx greatly enlarged and indurated, light, turbinate or narrow-cupuliform, about 4 mm. long and wide, its rim regularly and deeply 4-lobed; fruit ovoid, light brown, about 4.5 mm. long and 4 mm. wide, smooth and shiny, umbilicate at both ends, not wrinkled in drying, 4-seeded, closely invested to 2/3 its length by the mature calyx, practically included when immature.

description: Arbor vel scandens; hornotinis obtuse tetragonis vel subteretibus ineano-puberulentibus vel brevissime substrigosis; foliis oppositis petiolatis; petiolis gracilibus debilibus ineanis; laminis membranaceis nitidis lanceolatis breviter acuminatis integerrimis ad basin acutis supra glabris, subtus in venlis et veniulis ineano-strigosis et cliscis glandulosis numerosis ornatis; venis et venulis supra plerumque im- pressis subtus valde prominentibus; infloreseentiis axillaribus termi- nalibusque; eymis pedunculatis multifloris bracteatis et bracteolatis; paniculis terminalibuis abbreviatis bracteatis, sympodiis brevibus gracilibus ineanis; floribus pedicellatis parvis; peduneulis gracilibus ad basin ampliatis ineano-strigosis; pedicellis filiformibus ineanis; braeteis foliaceis lanceolatis stipitatis glandulosis; bracteolis et pro- phyllis linearibus vel elongatis; calyce campanulato, parvissimo glabro, margine 4-lobato; corolla hypocrateriforme sufflava glabra, lobis 4 oblongo-ellipticis subacutis; staminibus 4 inclusis; pistillo longe exserto; stigmate bifido; ovario obovato, 4-lobato glabro 4-loeu- lare; calyce fructifero patelliforme sparse hirsuto, margine profunde lobato; fruetibus drupaceis subglobosis parvis valde verruculosis ad apieem complanatis.

description: Branchlets medium-thick, subterete, light gray, densely spreading- setose or hispid; internodes 9.5-11 cm. long [or longer]; leaves decus- sate; petioles stout, 7-9 mm. long, hispid with long spreading hairs like the branchlets; blades membranous, dark, oblong, 22-24 cm. long, 8-8.5 cm. wide, rather long-acuminate at apex, entire, cordate or sub- cordate at base, sparsely setose with long hairs pointing in all direc- tions above, more densely so beneath, especially along the midrib and larger veins; midrib stout, prominent beneath and slightly so above; secondaries about 10 pairs, slender, irregular; infloreseence apparentlv axillary, glomerate, subsessile [or short-pedunculate?], dense; flowers not seen; fruiting-calyx very large and indurated, to 8 mm. long and 17 mm. wide, heavy, glabrate or very sparsely pilose, its rim sub- truncate, shallowly repand; fruit oblong, apparently 15 mm. long [or longer], 4-celled, 4-seeded.

description: Frutex; hornotinis subteretibus leueophaeis dense patenti-setosis vel hispidis; internodis valde elongatis, 9.5-11 cm. longis; foliis oppo- sitis petiolatis; petiolis crassis hispidis 7-9 mm. longis; laminis mem- branaceis oblongis 22-24 cm. longis 8-8.5 cm. latis longe acuminatis integerrimis ad basin cordatis vel subcordatis, supra leviter subtus dense longo-setosis; infloreseentiis axillaribus glomeratis subsessilibus (vel brevissime pedunculatis?) densis; calyce fructifero magno ad 8 miim. longo et 17 mm. lato indurato ponderoso glabrato vel leviter piloso, margine subtrLneato subrepalndo; fructibus drupaceis magnis ad 15 mm. longis 4-locularibus.

description: Tree to 40 m tall, the trunk often with thick buttresses; young branches glabrescent, inconspicuously lenticellate. Leaves 4.5-12 cm long, 3-9.5 cm wide, broadly ovate, cordate at base, abruptly acuminate at apex, the acumen 1-3 mm long, coriaceous, glabrous on both surfaces, shiny above, the midrib prominulous above, prominent beneath; primary veins 9-12 pairs, lightly prominulous above, prominulous beneath; petiole 1-3 mm long, short and thick, glabrous. Stipules to 1.7 cm long, very early caducous. Inflorescences of terminal and subterminal racemes 4-8 cm long, borne in single or more often in paired branches, the rachis densely tomentellous; bracts and bracteoles ovate, tomentellous, early caducous. Receptacle 5-7 mm long, conical to campanulate, tomentellous on exterior, puberulous within, sessile; calyx lobes slightly unequal, tomentellous on both surfaces. Petals ca 7 mm long, obovate, glabrous. Stamens ca 10, inserted on one side of ring, the filaments 10-12 mm long. Ovary densely pilose. Style slender, hirsutulous on lower portion. Fruit (fide Cockburn) 6 cm long, 5 cm wide, ovoid; epicarp crustaceous verrucose; mesocarp 5 mm thick, fibrous, hard; endocarp thin.

description: Dioecious? erect branched herb, to 2 m tall, lacking rhizomes. Stems fleshy, green or reddish, swollen at base and nodes, branched, internodes to 20 cm long; branches green or often tinged red particularly at base and on nodes or occasionally red throughout, glabrous or with microscopic hairs, 4-10 mm diam., branches usually flexuous towards their apices. Stipules deciduous, opaque green, ovate-lanceolate to lanceolate, 8.5-29 X 1.5-8.5 mm, apex acuminate, glabrous or with sparse microscopic hairs. Leaves: petioles 1-7(-17) cm long, joining lamina at a transverse angle, glabrous or with sparse short-glandular hairs; lamina green above, paler green beneath with veins sometimes tinged pink, both surfaces glabrous to sparsely hairy, especially on veins beneath, asymmetric, usually ovate to ovate-lanceolate, larger leaves elliptic-acuminate, 10-27 X 2.5-12 cm, apex acuminate to long acuminate, basal sinus truncate to 12 mm deep, basal lobes unequal, not overlapping, inner lobe 1.7-7.3 cm long, margin shortly toothed and ciliate or occasionally bidentate, larger teeth to 1 cm deep, veins 5-7, palmate. Inflorescences axillary, 1-5-flowered, a once branched dichasium in which the primary peduncle branches vary from 1-3(-50) mm long so that the inflorescence appears to be either umbellate or cymose, flowers fragrant; bracts deciduous, ovate, 4-10 X 1-3.5 mm, apex acute to glandular setose; bracteoles absent. Pedicels glabrous or with sparse microscopic glandular hairs, those of male flowers to 1.4 cm long, those of female flowers 4-10 mm long. Male flowers: perianth segments white, sometimes flushed pink near base of inner surface, 4, outer pair usually obovate-elliptic, 10-18 X 6-15 mm, outer surface with microscopic glandular hairs, apex rounded, inner pair ovate to elliptic-obovate, 5.5-16 X 3-8.5 mm, glabrous, apex rounded; sta- mens yellow, 60-100, filaments free, at- tached to a raised receptacle, receptacle to 1.5 mm tall, filaments equal in length, 2-2.6 mm long, anthers rectangular to obovate, 1.5-3 mm long, dehiscing via vertical slits along sides of anther, connective projecting 0.3-1 mm, apex rounded, often wider than locules. Female flowers: perianth segments white to pale pink, 4, usually broadly ellip- tic, sometimes broadly ovate or almost orbicular, outer pair 6-9.5 X 6-12 mm, outer surface with minute glandular hairs, inner pair 6-7 X 3.5-6 mm, glabrous, apex usu- ally rounded; ovary green, 4-angled or very rarely 3-angled on same plant, 3-15 X 4- 11 mm, wings present on central part of each locule, triangular, often narrowly so, with microscopic glandular hairs, (3-)4-locular on same plant, placentation axile, placentae bifid, bearing ovules on both surfaces of placental branches; styles 4, caducous to eventually deciduous, slender, ca. 5 mm long, base fused for 0.5-1 mm, bifid from about halfway, branches erect, stigmatic papillae twice spirally twisted. Infructescence usually single fruited, but sometimes bearing up to 3 fruits; fruiting pedicels 10-12.5 mm long; fruit fleshy, glossy light green, pendulous, rhomboidal to spherical, 12-15 X ca. 17 mm, wings triangular to 5.5 mm tall, base ca. 4 mm wide, apex acute, glabrous.

description: Woody vine (?); branchlets slender, obtusely tetragonal, densely appressed-pubescent or strigose with gray antrorse hairs; internodes 4.5-7.5 cm. long; leaf-scars elevated; leaves decussate; petioles slender, 7-13 mm. long, weak, appressed-pubescent or strigose; blades firmly membranous, dark above, lighter beneath, lanceolate, 8.5-12.5 cm. long, 2.8-4.7 cm. wide, long-acuminate at apex, entire, rounded or subacute at base, pubescent on both surfaces, very lightly so above, much more densely so and more yellowish beneath, especially along the midrib and larger veins; midrib slender, prominent beneath, slightly prominulent above, densely pubescent; secondaries slender, short, 8-12 pairs, slightly arcuate, prominent beneath, beautifully anastomosing 4-6 mm. from the margins; inflorescence axillary and terminal; terminal panicle simulating a loose compound spike, 4-7 cm. long, about 1.5 cm. wide, composed of several abbreviated short-stalked cymes; axillary cymes solitary, opposite, few, in the uppermost axils, 1.5 - 5.5 cm. long, 1-3 cm. wide, more or less conglobate in anthesis, brachiate in fruit, rather few-flowered, bracteolate; peduncles slender, 0.7-3 cm. long, densely appressed-pubescent or strigose; pedicels practically obsolete in anthesis, to 3 mm. long in fruit, densely pubescent; bractlets linear-setaceous, 1-4 mm. long, densely pubescent; prophylla minute, setaceous; calyx campanulate, 4 - 4.9 mm. long, about 3 mm. wide, rather deeply 4-lobed, very densely strigose-pubescent, its lobes triangular-ovate, about 1 mm. long and 1.5 mm. wide at base, rounded or acute at apex; corolla infundibular or hypocrateriform, thick, purple, its tube cylindric, 4-5 mm. long, glabrous, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, 2-3 mm. long, about 1 mm. wide, rounded at apex, abruptly spreading or reflexed when mature; stamens 4, inserted about 2 mm. above the base of the corolla-tube, included (in female); filaments filiform, about 0.5 mm. long (in female) glabrous; anthers oblong, about 1 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide; pistil exserted (in female) style capillary, 8-11 mm. long (in female), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches 5-6.5 mm. long; ovary globose, about 1 mm. long and wide, 4-lobed, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx light, shallowly cupuliform, about 3.5 mm long and 7 mm. wide, densely pubescent with light and antrorsely appressed hairs, its rim apparently irregularly lobed or split; fruit subglobose, about 7 mm. long and wide, glabrate, 4-seeded.
