description: Monoecious, erect herb, at least 30 cm tall [lower portion of stem missing], stems branched, glabrous. Stipules caducous, oblong. Leaves alternate; petioles 6-10 cm long, slender, sparsely minutely glandular hairy; lamina thin (in sicco), ovate, 9-10.5 X 6.5-8 cm, apex acute, base strongly asymmetric, cordate, lobes unequal, margin short-toothed, teeth ciliate, bright green on both sides, glabrous above, below with sparse microscopic glandular hairs, veins 7, palmate. Inflorescences axillary, racemose, 1-2-flowered, male flowers borne in upper leaf axils, females in lower leaf axils; peduncles very short, to 2 mm long; bracts deciduous, white, oblong, ca. 5 mm long, apex truncate or obtuse. Pedicels slender, glabrous, those of male flowers to 1.4 cm long, those of female flowers ca. 1.3 cm long. Male flowers: tepals 2, orbicular, offwhite with a pink margin, ca. 5 mm; stamens 25-30, filaments free to base, slender, more or less equal, anthers elliptic-oblong, to 1 mm long, apex obtuse, locules dehiscing via longitudinal slits along inner surface of anther, not separated by connective, connective not projecting. Female flowers: tepals 5, off-white with a pink margin, outer 2 oblong, truncate, ca. 4 X ca. 3 mm, inner 3 narrower; ovary succulent, elliptic, ca. 4 X 3 mm, shortly 3-winged, wings ca. 1 X ca. 1.5 mm, basal half of ovary and pedicels covered with microscopic glandular hairs, 3-locular; styles caducous, 3, ca. 1.5 mm long, fused at base, bifid, branches erect, stigmatic papillae once spirally twisted. Infructescences ca. 18 mm long. Fruit not known.

description: Monoecious, erect herb, to ca. 1 m tall, stems green or reddish, especially at internodes, fleshy, branched from near the base, sparsely and minutely glandular hairy. Stipules caducous, ovate to ovate-lanceolate. Leaves alternate; petioles green to reddish, to 23 cm long, sparsely and minutely glandular hairy; lamina chartaceous or herbaceous, ovate, 10-20 X 7-14 cm, apex acute, base strongly asymmetric, cordate, lobes unequal, margin short-toothed, teeth ciliate, bright green above, paler below, glabrous or occasionally sparsely microscopic glandular hairy above, below with sparse minute glandular hairs, veins often reddish, 7, palmate. Inflorescences bisexual, protogynous, terminal, racemose, rachis to 2.5 cm long, female flowers 2-12, in pairs in the lower half, male flowers 5-25, in pairs in the upper half; bracts deciduous, ovate. Pedicels minutely glandular hairy, those of male flowers slender, to 2.5 cm long, those of female flowers broader, reddish, 10-23 mm long. Male flowers: tepals 2, orbicular to elliptic, white to pink, 5-10 X 4-12 mm; stamens 20-60, in a cone-shaped mass, filaments free to base, slender, anthers elliptic-oblong, ca. 1.5 mm long, apex obtuse, locules dehiscing via longitudinal slits along inner surface of anther, not separated by connective, connective not projecting. Female flowers: tepals 5, white to pink, outer 2 orbicular to elliptic, 6-12 X 3.75-7 mm, inner 3 narrowly elliptic, 6-9 X 2.25-4 mm; ovary white to green, succulent, elliptic 6-12 X 7-12 mm, 3-winged, wings arcuate-deltoid, truncate, ovary and pedicels covered with microscopic glandular hairs, 3-locular; styles caducous, 3, usually 3-4 mm long, fused at base, bifid, branches erect, stigmatic papillae once spirally twisted. Infructescences to 2.5 cm long, 1-12-fruited, frutit somewhat fleshy, becoming red.

description: Herbaceous perennials; rhizomes repent, internodes 0.6-1.1 cm long, 2.4-2.5 cm diam, appearing glabrous to very spaningly glandular or pilose. Leaf blade chartaceous, oblique, oblong-elliptic to obovate, 23-39 x 17-29.5 cm, cordate, abruptly short acuminate, undulate to dentate at ends of major nerves and ciliate- denticulate, very sparingly pilose above and below, with trichomes most conspicuous below on principal nerves, 11 or 12-palmatinerved. Petiole 25-56 cm x 1-8.5 mm, sparingly pilose with stout, occasionally branching, often glandular- tipped villi 1-2 mm long, lenticellate. Stipules deciduous, ovate-triangular, 2.3- 3.8 x 1.6-2.8 cm, keeled, marginally entire, glandular but only rarely sparingly pilose, or the keel only sparingly fimbriate-pilose. Inflorescence generally greatly exceeding the foliage, symmetrically cymose, many-flowered, 9-24 cm diam. Pe- duncle 46-119 cm x 5-11 mm, very sparingly pilose but glabrescent with age. Bracts deciduous, the lowermost asymmetrically ovate-triangular, occasionally connate basally, 1.5 x 1.5 cm, entire, revolute, glandular within and without. Pedicels of staminate flowers 7-13 mm, those of pistillate flowers 5-10 mm long, in fruit becoming 10-15 mm long. Flowers d: sepals 2, broadly ovate to subor- bicular, 6.5-11 x 6-9.5 mm, white to white suffused pink, externally glandular; petals wanting; stamens 18-26; filaments 0.4-1 mm long, borne on a slightly raised torus; anthers oblong to obovate, 1.3-2 x 0.4-0.9 mm. Flowers Q: bracteoles wanting or 1-2, ovate-elliptic, 1.5-2.5 x 1-2 mm; sepals 2, broadly ovate to suborbicular, 6-10 x 5.5-10 mm, white or white suffused pink, externally glandular; petals wanting; ovary 4.5-5.5 mm long, glandular; styles 2-2.5 mm long, connate half their length, stigmas lunate. Capsules trilocular, 7-8.5 mm long, locule chambers externally appearing broadly ovate to suborbicular or broadly transversely elliptic, 5-6 x 5-6 mm; wings unequal, the largest ovate to oblong- elliptic or subdolabriform, 1.2-1.6 x 0.9-1.2 cm, the second asymmetrically lu- nate to triangular, 6-7.5 mm x 6-8 mm, the third subequal to the second, lunate.

description: Herbaceous perennials; rhizomes repent, often branching, 2.5-8 cm long; internodes 2-4 x 2.5-5.5 mm, sparsely puberulent but glabrate with age. Leaf blades chartaceous to subcoriaceous, straight or slightly oblique, asymmetrically elliptic to obovate or rhombic, 3-8.5 (9.7) x 1.1-2.8 (5.8) cm, basally cuneate, apically attenuate-acuminate, marginally with a broad prominent lobe on one side of the midnerve, densely ciliate, obsoletely undulate, irregularly denticulate-ser- rulate; glabrous above and sparingly puberulent below in intercostal regions but on principal nerves moderately to densely so; 4-5 (6)-palmatinerved. Petioles 2.5-7.5 (9.1) cm x 0.5-1.5 mm, moderately to densely hirtellous with spreading villi 0.3-2 mm long. Stipules caducous, asymmetrically narrowly ovate, 5- 8 x 2.5-4 mm, often strongly keeled. Inflorescences exceeding the leaves, mod- erately to strongly asymmetrically cymose, few-flowered, 1.5-3 mm diam. Pe- duncles 7.3-23 cm x 0.5-2 (3) mm, sparingly glandular-hirtellous. Bracts ca- ducous to subpersistent, the lowermost ovate to oblong-elliptic, 2.7-4.5 x 1.7- 2.7 mm, keeled. Pedicels of staminate flowers 3.7-6.5 (9) mm long, those of pistillate flowers 4-5 mm, in fruit becoming 10-12 mm. Flowers d: sepals 2, suborbicular to elliptic, 3-6 x 3-6 mm, glabrous, petals wanting; stamens 11-13 (19); filaments 0.2-0.5 mm, borne on a raised torus; anthers narrowly elliptic to oblong or obovate, 0.7-1 (1.5) x (0.3) 0.5-0.7 mm. Flowers Y: bracteoles want- ing; sepals 2, suborbicular to broadly obovate, 3-3.5 x 3-4 mm, glabrous; petals wanting; ovary 2-3 mm long, glabrous to sparingly glandular, occasionally sparse- ly pubescent basally; styles 3, 1.5 mm long, connate 2/3 their length, stigmas lunate. Capsules trilocular, 3-4 mm long; locules externally appearing transverse- ly elliptic to broadly cordate, 2.5-3 x 3.5 mm, wings unequal, the largest straight to subfalcate and narrowly ovate to oblong, 9-10 x 5 mm, the second and third marginiform.

description: Herbs, 0.5-0.7 m tall, scabrous; cystoliths present; indumentum of scales and short glandular trichomes, the scales ca. 0.05 mm long, palmate to 2-3-branched, with digitate-glandular apices. Stems striate, the internodes 1.5-7.5 cm long, scaly to scabrous. Stipules becoming papyraceous, persistent, 1.5-3.5 cm long, symmetric, elliptic to broadly ovate; apex acute; base truncate; margins entire; lower surface carinate, with glandular trichomes on midrib. Petioles 7-15 cm long, cylindric in cross section, densely scaly. Leaf blades basifixed, 12-25 X 6-14.5 cm, chartaceous to coriaceous, asymmetric, transversely elliptic to transversely ovate; apex cuspidate; base auriculate; margins ciliate, sometimes inflexed; proximal lobes rounded, overlapping the petiole; upper surface glabrous; lower surface densely covered with scales and glandular trichomes; venation actinod- romous; veins 6-11. Cymes 15-30(-41) cm long, 20-40 flowered, 4-6 dichotomously branched, proximal hypopodia 12-23(-29) cm long, scabrous, loosely pilose to gla- brous, light pink. Bracts deciduous, elliptic, ca. 2 cm long; apex rounded to retuse; base truncate; margins ciliate, loosely pilose on midrib of lower surface. Staminate flowers: 1-2 cm long; prophylls absent; epipodia 0.5-1.2 cm long, glabrous, light pink; tepals 4, white; outer pair of tepals 10-22 X 10- 16 mm, broadly ovate, orbicular to obovate, the apex rounded, the base rounded, the margins entire, the upper surface loosely scaly with short, red, glandular trichomes; inner pair of tepals 10-20 X 6-9 mm, ob- ovate, the apex rounded, the base acute to attenuate, the margins entire, glabrous; sta- mens 38-52, 2.5-4 mm long, the filaments 0.4-1.5 mm long, free, the anthers oblong, 2-3 mm long, laterally fissured, the con- nective prominently projecting, the apex obtuse. Pistillate flowers: 1.8-2 cm long; prophylls 2, deciduous, 3-7 mm long, elliptic, ovate to obovate, the margins fimbriate; epipodia 3-6 mm long, glabrous; tepals 5, white, unequal, 10-12 X 5-10 mm, elliptic to obovate, the apex rounded, the base acute, the margins entire to irregularly crenate, glabrous; ovary elliptic, 2-3 mm long, the styles 3, cylindric, spirally twisted, the stigma ca. 3 mm long, 2-branched with stigmatic papillae entirely covering the branches, the placentae bilamellate with ovules on both sides of the lamellae. Capsules hyaline, 7-9 X 10-17 mm, dehiscent on basal portion; sparsely scaly; styles persistent; pericarp chartaceous; wings hornlike, 3-6 mm long. Seeds oblong.

description: Herbaceous perennials; rhizomes repent; internodes 4-7 mm long, 4-8 mm diam, densely villous-squamose. Leaf blade chartaceous, oblique or rarely almost straight, asymmetrically obovate, or if straight, ovate, 7.4-13 x 4.4-8.8 cm, cordate, acuminate or rarely acute, occasionally dentate opposite major nerves, pilose above becoming glabrate in age, densely tomentose-lanate throughout beneath but becoming sparingly so with age in intercostal regions, 7-9-palmatinerved. Petiole 7.5-19 cm x 2-4 mm, densely lanate, with whiplash trichomes to 2 mm long. Stipules persistent, triangular, 0.5-1.5 cm x 3.5-10 mm, glabrous or sparingly to densely villous, often strongly keeled. Inflorescence generally greatly ex- ceeding the foliage, weakly asymmetrically cymose, few-flowered, 3-6.5 cm diam. Peduncle 15.5-31.5 cm x 2-4 mm, densely tomentose-lanate becoming densely pilose with age. Bracts deciduous, the lowermost navicular, oblong-elliptic, 7.5 x 6.5 mm, glabrous. Pedicels of staminate flowers 0. 8-2.1 cm long, those of pistillate flowers 0.7-0.8 cm long, in fruit becoming 1.2-1.7 cm long. Flowers d: sepals 2, reniform to broadly transversely elliptic, rarely appearing suborbicular, 5.5-8 x 7-11 mm, glabrous, petals wanting; stamens 22-38; filaments 0.3-1.8 mm long; anthers oblong to obovate, 1-1.3 x 0.6-0.7 mm. Flowers 9: bracteoles wanting; sepals 2, transversely oblong-elliptic, 5-5.5 x 6.5 mm, glabrous; petals wanting; ovary 6 mm long, glabrous; styles 1 mm long, connate basally, stigmas bicornute. Capsules trilocular, 8-9 mm long; locule chambers externally appearing suborbicular to broadly ovate, 6 x 5.5 mm; wings unequal, the largest asymmetrically triangular, 0.9-1.1 x 0.6-0.8 cm, the second well-developed, asymmetrically triangular, 0.5-0.6 x 0.7-0.8 cm, the third subequal to the second.

description: Monoecious, erect branched herb to 2 m tall, lacking rhizomes, stems fleshy, dull red, glabrous, 0.4-1.2 cm diam. ribbed (when dry) internodes 7-18 cm long. Stipules caducous, ovate to narrowly lanceolate, 0.8-2 X 0.2-0.45 cm, apex setose, elsewhere glabrous. Leaves: petioles 2.5-16.5 cm long, 1-3 mm diam. (when dry) glabrous, joining lamina at a transverse angle; lamina green on both surfaces, beneath paler, both surfaces glabrous, or below with very sparse microscopic glandular hairs in basal portion, asymmetric, broadly elliptic, 10-22 X 4-14 cm, apex acute to acuminate, basal sinus cordate, 1-3 cm deep, basal lobes almost equal, overlapping, inner lobe 4-9.5 mm long, margin remotely short and somewhat irregularly bidentate, larger teeth angular, smaller teeth serrate, veins 6- 7, palmate. Inflorescences axillary, a 2-3-branched dichasium, with up to 20 flowers, bearing male and female flowers synchronously on same inflorescence; peduncles ca. 1 cm long, glabrous; bracts caducous, narrowly ovate, 4-6 x 2.5 mm; bracteoles absent. Pedicels: those of male flowers with sparse microscopic glandular hairs, 6-7 mm long, those of female flowers glabrous, ca. 5 mm long. Male flowers: perianth segments white to pale pink, 4, outer pair broadly ovate to elliptic, concave, with very sparsely microscopic glandular hairs, 4-8 X 3-5 mm, apex rounded, inner pair broadly ovate to elliptic, glabrous, 3-8.5 X 2.8- 4.2 mm, apex rounded; stamens 25-50, filaments 1-1.5 mm long, those in center slightly longer than the outer ones, fused at base, anthers wedge-shaped, 1.5-2 mm long, connective projecting ca. 0.2 mm, apex rounded, dehiscing via longitudinal slits along sides of anther. Female flowers: perianth segments white to pale pink, 6, broadly ovate to elliptic, subequal, 3.1-10 X 2.2-6 mm, pubescence as in male flowers; ovary fleshy, subglobose, 3-lobed, ca. 5 X 6.5 mm, with sparse microscopic glandular hairs, lobes with rounded riblike to obtuse-triangular wings to 1 mm long along center of each locule, 3-locular, placenta- tion axile, placentas bifid, bearing ovules on both surfaces of placental branches; styles 3, caducous, 2.4-4 mm long, free or shortly fused at base, bifid from halfway, branches erect, stigmatic papillae broad, once or twice spirally twisted. Infructescences 1-10-fruited; fruiting pedicels 0.5-1 cm long; fruit fleshy, green becoming red, subglobose, to ca. 1 X 1.2 cm, glabrous or with sparse microscopic hairs as on ovary, locules with persistent wartlike remnants of wings when dry.

description: Herbaceous perennials; rhizomes repent, 5-18 cm long; internodes 5-8 x 0.5-1.5 mm, moderately pilose with trichomes 0.5-2 mm long, glabrescent with age. Leaf blades chartaceous, oblique to transverse, asymmetric, ovate, weakly obovate or suborbicular, 12.5-20.6 x 8.5-15 cm, basally cordate, apically attenuateacuminate, occasionally abruptly so, marginally ciliate-denticulate, often with a secondary cusp on the side of the blade opposite the petiole, occasionally additional cusps present; glabrous above in intercostal regions but principal nerves moderately to densely hirsute, sparingly hirsute to glandular-hirsute below with trichomes most dense on major nerves; 9-11-palmatinerved. Petioles 12.5-31.7 cm x 1.5-4 mm, densely tomentose-pilose when immature but only sparingly to moderately so at maturity with fine sericeous villi 1-2.5 mm long often intermixed with minute glandular trichomes. Stipules persistent to subpersistent but often absent from leafless older rhizome segments, asymmetrically triangular to ovatetriangular 0.9-1.3 x 0.8-1.1 cm, strongly keeled. Inflorescences greatly exceeding the leaves, symmetric to weakly asymmetric, laxly to densely cymose, manyflowered, (7) 9.5-18 cm diam. Peduncles 30-68 (108) x 0.3-1 cm, sparingly pilose to tomentose-pilose but glabrate with age. Bracts fugacious, not seen. Pedicels of staminate flowers 2.5-8 mm long, those of pistillate flowers 4.5-8 mm, in fruit up to (5) 7-16 mm. Flowers [male]: sepals 2, suborbicular to very broadly transversely elliptic or infrequently ovate, 3-4 x 3.5-4.5 mm, externally glabrous, petals wanting; stamens 11-22; filaments 0.3-1 mm long, borne on a raised torus; anthers oblong to oblong-obovate, 0.8-1.4 x 0.4-0.7 mm. Flowers Y: bracteoles wanting; sepals 2, narrowly obovate, (3.5) 4.5-7 x 3-4 mm, externally glabrous, petals wanting; ovary 2.5-3 mm long, glabrous; styles 3, 1.5-2 mm long, fused 1/3-1/2 their length, stigmas bicornute. Capsules trilocular, 4.5-6.5 mm long; locules externally appearing broadly ovate to oblong, 4-5.5 x 4-4.5 mm; wings 3, unequal, the largest slightly asymmetric, narrowly ovate to infrequently oblong (9) 13-16 x (5) 7-10 mm, apically obtuse, rarely truncate, the second broadly but shallowly asymmetrically triangular, (3.5) 4-6 x (3) 4.5-5.5 mm, the third subequal to the second, broadly but shallowly lunate, oblong or marginiform.

description: Acaulescent herbs; rhizomes repent, often branching, 0.6-5.5 cm long; inter- nodes 1-4 x 2-6 mm, sparsely villous with very narrow entire to lacerate scales 0.4-1.6 mm long. Leaf blades membranaceous, straight or infrequently slightly oblique, asymmetrically suborbicular to broadly obovate, 1.3-4.5 x 1-4.7 cm, basally rounded to occasionally cuneate or infrequently broadly but very shal- lowly cordate, apically acute to acuminate, marginally ciliate, dentate to serrate at ends of major nerves and irregularly denticulate to serrulate; hirtellous to glandular-hirtellous above and beneath; 5-7-palmatinerved. Petioles (0.7) 1-6 (8.5) cm x 0.5-1.5 mm, sparingly to moderately hirtellous or glandular-hirtellous throughout with spreading villi 0.5-1.2 mm long. Stipules caducous, triangular, 1.5-5 x 2-3 mm, strongly keeled. Inflorescences generally exceeding the foliage, strongly asymmetric to unilateral, laxly cymose, few-flowered, (0.5) 2-3.5 (5.5) cm diam. Peduncles (2.5) 4-7.5 (9.5) cm x 0.5-1 (2) mm, sparsely puberulent or glandular-puberulent. Bracts caducous, the lowermost navicular, triangular to narrowly triangular or lance-elliptic, 1-3 x 1-1.5 mm. Pedicels of staminate flow- ers 3-9 mm long, those of pistillate flowers 5-8 mm, in fruit up to 10-12 mm. Flowers d: sepals 2, suborbicular to broadly elliptic, 3.5-4.5 (8) x 3.5-4.5 (7) mm, externally glabrous to sparingly glandular; petals wanting; stamens 7-10 (13); filaments 0.3-0.6 (1.3) mm long, borne on a raised torus; anthers oblong- obovate, 0.7-1.1 x 0.3-0.6 mm. Flowers Y: bracteoles wanting; sepals 2, broad- ly elliptic to weakly obovate, 3-4.5 x 3-3.5 mm, externally glabrous to sparingly glandular; petals wanting; ovary 3-4.5 mm long, glandular to glabrous; styles 2- 3, 1-1.5 mm long, shortly branched distally, stigmas lunate. description: Monoecious erect herb, to 60 cm tall, stems succulent, internodes long. Stipules persistent (fide Clarke, 1879), ovate-lanceolate, ca. 16 X ca. 12 mm (width at base), very sparse minutely glandular hairy. Leaves drooping; petioles erect, 2.5-10.5 cm long, glabrous; lamina ovate-acuminate, 8.5-18 X 3.5-11 cm, base strongly asymmetric, cordate, lobes unequal, sinus 1-4 cm deep, margin somewhat angular, irregularly toothed or serrate, ciliate, deep shiny green on both sides, above very sparsely minutely glandular hairy, below glabrous, veins 6, palmate. Inflorescences in upper leaf axils, once- or twice-branched cymes, 4-7-flowered, protandrous; peduncle 0.5-13 cm long; bracts deciduous, to 1 cm long, ovate lanceolate, margin entire, surfaces almost glabrous. Pedicels glabrous, those of male 1.5-4.5 cm long, those of female flowers c. 1.5 cm long. Male flowers: tepals 4, pale white with a pink margin, glabrous to sparsely hairy, outer two elliptic to broadly elliptic, 1-2.5 X 1.7-2.4 cm, apex obtuse, inner two elliptic, 0.8-1.9 X 0.3-1.4 cm, apex obtuse; stamens ca. 100, arranged in a dense cone, attached at all heights to a torus, torus 0.5-2 mm tall, broad-based, filaments free, slightly longer in center, anthers elliptic to angular-obovate, 1-1.6 mm long, locules dehiscing via vertical obovate slits along sides, separated by connective, connective projecting ca. 0.2 mm, apex rounded. Female flowers: tepals 5, pale white with a rose margin, almost equal, elliptic to obovate, ca. 1.5 X ca. 0.75 cm, apex obtuse, glabrous; ovary elliptic, ca. 1 X ca. 0.55 cm, 3-winged, one wing much longer, triangular-ovate, apex blunt, ca. 1 X 0.5-0.8 cm (width at halfway position), smaller wings broadly elliptic, apex blunt, ca. 0.3 X ca. 0.7 cm, 2-locular, placentation axillary, placentae bifid; styles deciduous, 2, ca. 0.4 cm long, bifid from slightly below halfway, branches widespreading, stigmatic papillae once spirally twisted. Infructescences not known.

description: Herba rhizomatosa, pilis stellaribus, cystolithis destituta. Caulis brevis. Folia rarius peltata; petioli basifixi, 16-26.5 cm longi; lamina cordiformis vel orbicularis. Thyrsus 20-florus, 5-6-ramealis. Tepala floris masculi rosea vel coccinea; antherae obovatae, rimosae, extrorsae. Tepala floris feminei rosea vel coccinea; placentae bilamellatae; stigmata multifida. Capsulae alis minoribus, marginibus inferioribus descendentibus.

description: Herbs rhizomatous, ca. 0.5 m tall, cystoliths absent, indumentum of stellate trichomes. Stems absent or inconspicuous. Stipules membranaceous, persistent, (1.6-) 2-2.5 cm long, symmetric, deltate; apex acuminate; base truncate; margins entire; lower surface carinate, rust-colored. Petioles 16-26.5 cm long, cylindric in cross section, rust-colored. Leaf blades basifixed, rarely peltate, 7-17 X 11.5-20 cm, papyraceous, slightly asymmetric, cordate to or- biculate; apex rounded; base auriculate to cordate; margins short-lobed, the proximal lobes 2.5-4 cm long, imbricate (rarely joined); both surfaces velutinous; venation actinodromous; veins 7-9. Thyrses 40-75 cm long, ca. 20-flowered, 5-6-branched, the peduncles ca. 41 cm long, rust-colored; proximal bracts deciduous, not seen. Staminate flowers: 1-1.5 cm long; prophylls absent; epipodia 0.5-1.3 cm long, with glandular trichomes; tepals 4, pink to carmine; outer pair of tepals 6-10 X 4-8 mm, elliptic to ovate, the apex obtuse, the base auriculate, the margins entire with glandular trichomes; inner pair of tepals 5-7 X 3- 4 mm, elliptic to obovate, the apex obtuse, the base acute, the margins slightly crenate toward the apex, glabrous; stamens 35-47, 1.5-2.5 mm long, the filaments 1-1.8 mm long, free, the anthers obovate, ca. 0.5 mm long, recurved, extrorse, the connective scarcely projecting. Pistillate flowers: ca. 2.3 cm long; prophylls absent; epipodia ca. 1.3 cm long, with glandular trichomes; tepals 5, pink to carmine, unequal, 5-8 X 4- 6 mm, elliptic to ovate, the apex acute, the margins entire, the lower surface with short glandular trichomes; ovary elliptic, ca. 7 mm wide, the styles 3, cylindric, spirally twisted, the stigma ca. 3 mm long, multibranched with stigmatic papillae only on the apex of the branches; placentae bilamellate with the ovules on both sides of the lamellae. Capsules pink to carmine, 15-17 X 19-21 mm, dehiscent on basal portion; styles deciduous; pericarp papyraceous; wings unequal, the upper margins slightly descendent, the lower margins oblique-ascendent, the largest wing 7-10 mm long, the smallest wing ca. 5 mm long. Seeds oblong.

description: Shrub or low tree, 2-4 m. tall; branches rather stout, strict, acutely tetragonal, greatly flattened and ampliate at the nodes, suleate along the sides, very minutely puberulent or glabrate, shiny; branchlets slender, obscurely or rather obtusely tetragonal, shallowly suleate along the sides, decussately ampliate at the nodes, yellowish, practically glabrate, shiny; internodes 4.5-6 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles slender, weak, 8-12 mm. long, canaliculate above, keeled below, annullate at base, very minutely puberulent; blades thinly membranous or chartaceous, very light green and nitid on both surfaces, oval or somewhat obovate, 5-10 cm. long, 2-4 cm. wide, abruptly contracted into a rather long-acuminate apex or sometimes rounded into a bluntly acute apex, entire, abruptly and very shortly produced into the petiole at base, glabrate on both surfaces; midrib prominent be]2eath; seeondaries 7-10 pairs, slender, strongly arcuate-aseending, very slightly prominulent beneath; veinlets very delicate and inconspicuous; inflorescence axillary; eymes solitary, opposite, about 1/3 as long as the subtending leaves, 2-4 cm. wide, trichotomous, lax and very spreading, bracteate, loosely many-flowered; peduncles very slender, 1.5-3 cm. long, minutely puberulent or einereous; pedicels slender, about 2 mm. long, minutely puberulent; bractlets and prophylla subulate, 1-2 mm.

description: Herba pilosa, pilis stellaribus, cystolithis destituta. Caulis internodiis 3-5.5 cm longis. Folia peltata; petioli 6.5-14.5 cm longi; lamina papyracea, transverse ovalis vel elliptica, symmetrica, 7-10-nervia. Cymae 20-150 florae, 6-ramealis. Tepala floris masculi alba; antherae oblongae, rimosae, latrorsae, connectivo obtuso, prominenti. Tepala floris feminei alba; placentae bilamellatae; stigmata bifida. Capsulae alis inaequali- bus, majoribus 5-7 mm longis, marginibus superioribus et inferioribus rotundatis, laeviter ascendentibus.

description: Herbs, ca. 1.5 m tall; cystoliths absent; indumentum of stellate trichomes. Stems erect; internodes 3-5.5 cm long, velutinous, becoming glabrous. Stipules membranaceous, deciduous, 1.5-2.5 mm long, asymmetric, elliptic or narrowly elliptic to nar- rowly ovate; apex apiculate to convolute; base truncate; margins entire; lower surface velutinous. Petioles 6.5-14.5 cm long, cylindric in cross section, sericeous. Leaf blades peltate, 12-17 X 8.5-11 cm, papyraceous, symmetric, transversely ovate to broadly elliptic; apex obtuse to acute; base rounded; margins entire to slightly involute; upper surface sparsely pilose becoming glabrous, green, the stomata aquiferous; lower surface velutinous, white; venation actinodromous; veins 7-10. Dichasial cymes 20- 30 cm, 20-150-flowered, 6-dichotomously branched; proximal hypopodia 14-37 cm long, velutinous; bracts deciduous, not seen. Staminate flowers: 1-1.5 cm long; prophylls absent; epipodia 0.5-1.4 cm long, with densely stellate hairs; tepals 4, white; outer pair of tepals 7-11 X 4-7 mm, ellip- tic, the apex obtuse, the base obtuse, the margins entire to slightly sinuate at the apex, the upper surface glabrous, the lower surface with stellate trichomes; inner pair of tepals 6-7 X 2-3 mm, elliptic to obovate, the apex obtuse to acute, the base acute, the margins entire to irregularly crenate toward the apex, glabrous; stamens 48-53, 3-3.5 mm long, the filaments 2-2.5 mm long, free, the anthers oblong, ca. 1 mm long, lat- erally fissured, the connective prominently projecting, the apex obtuse. Pistillate flow- ers (immature): ca. 13 mm long; prophylls 2, born on the epipodia, covering the hypanthium and tepals, 7-8 mm long, elliptic, with stellate trichomes; epipodia ca. 6 mm up to 19-24 mm long in fruit, with stellate trichomes; tepals 5, white, unequal, 2-10 X 1.5-4 mm, elliptic, the apex obtuse, the margins irregularly sinuate toward the apex, the lower surface with stellate trichomes; ovary elliptic, 3-4 mm long, the styles 3, cylindric, spirally twisted, the stigma ca. 1 mm long, 2-branched with stigmatic papil- lae entirely covering the branches; placentae bilamellate with the ovules on both sides of the lamellae. Capsules hyaline, loosely velutinous, 9-10 X 14-18 mm, dehiscent on basal portion; styles persistent; prophylls deciduous; pericarp papyraceous; wings unequal, the largest wing 5-7 mm long, the upper and lower margins rounded, slightly ascendent, the smallest wing 3-4 mm long, crescent-shaped. Seeds oblong.

description: Rhizomata repentia; internodia dense squamosa. Laminae asymmetrice obovatae oblongae vel reniformes 5.7-15.2 x 4.1-12.5 cm supra glabrae subtus secus nervos sparsim pilosae apice obtusae vel infrequenter acutae margine ciliatae undulatae denticulatae. Petioli trichomatibus 1.5-2 mm longis pilosi sed distalitersquamosi. Stipulae praetercarinasglabrae. Stamina 7-17. Stigmata lunata. Capsulae 1.1-1.4 cm longae; alae inaequales.

description: Herbaceous perennials; rhizomes repent, internodes 3-5 mm long, 5-11 mm diam, densely squamose with broad lacerate scales to 4.5 mm long. Leaf blade slightly oblique, asymmetrically obovate to oblong-reniform, 5.7-15.2 x 4.1-12.5 cm, cordate, typically obtuse, only rarely acute, undulate or infrequently broadly but shallowly lobed, finely denticulate, ciliate, glabrous above but sparingly pilose beneath on principal nerves, 9-10-palmatinerved. Petiole 4.4-15.4 x 1.5-2.5 mm, very sparingly pilose throughout with trichomes 1.5-2 mm long but also with dense rings of lacerate scales distally near the apex. Stipules persistent, lance-ovate, 7-14 x 7-10 mm, strongly keeled, entire, glabrous but the keel fim- briate-pilose. Inflorescence generally greatly exceeding the foliage, moderately asymmetrically cymose, few- to many-flowered, 9.5-16 cm diam. Peduncle (8.8) 29-41.5 cm x 0.5-4 mm, very sparingly pilose becoming glabrous at maturity. Bracts caducous, the lowermost navicular, ovate, 3 x 2 mm. Pedicels of staminate flowers 5-9 mm long, those of pistillate flowers 10-21 mm long extending to 19-24 mm long in fruit. Flowers 6: sepals suborbicular to broadly elliptic or elliptic, 6-9 mm x 6-8 mm, glabrous; petals wanting; stamens 7-17; filaments 0.3-0.8 mm long, borne on a raised torus; anthers obovate to oblong, 1.3-1.8 x 0.3-0.7 mm. Flowers Y: bracteoles wanting; sepals suborbicular, 5-9 x 5-9.5 mm, glabrous; petals wanting; ovary 7-10 mm long, glabrous; styles 3, 2.5 mm long, connate 1/2 their length, stigmas lunate. Capsules trilocular, 1.1-1.4 cm long; locule chambers externally appearing narrowly obovate to oblong, 1-1.2 x 0.5-0.8 cm; wings unequal, the largest asymmetrically narrowly triangular to ovate-triangular, 1.4-1.8 x 0.9-1.2 cm, occasionally ciliate distally, the second asymmetrically lunate-triangular, 0.6-0.8 x 0.8-1.1 cm, the third subequal to the second.

description: Herbaceous perennial; rhizome repent, internodes short, 0.6-1.1 cm long, 1-2 cm diam, conspicuously lenticellate, villous-squamose with trichomes to 4 mm long. Leaf blades chartaceous, oblique, asymmetrically obovate to broadly elliptic, 14-31 x 10-24.3 cm, light green above, paler below, basally deeply cordate with lobes usually overlapping, apically abruptly attenuate-acuminate, marginally dentate to cuspidate opposite major nerves and ciliate-denticulate, villous throughout above and below with trichomes 0.6-3 (4) mm long, (9) 10-12-palmatinerved. Petiole 15-53 cm long, 4-8 mm diam, lenticellate, densely villous with spreading, stout villi 1.5-5 (6) mm long, glandular throughout. Stipules persistent, triangular, 1-1.6 x 0.7-1.1 cm, light green, entire, glabrous to glandular or glandular-villous, keeled. Inflorescence generally exceeding the foliage, asymmetric to unilateral, cymose, many-flowered. Peduncles 42-89.5 long, 0.6-1.2 cm diam, light green, glandular and villous with trichomes 1.5-4.5 cm long. Bracts caducous, navicular, symmetric to asymmetric, broadly ovate, 1.1-1.5 x 0.9-1.7 cm, light green, apically acute, marginally entire and revolute proximally, usually villous and glandular especially centrally, but occasionally glabrous, keeled, the upper ovate to elliptic, glabrous. Flowers 6: pedicels 3.5-8.5 (14) mm long; sepals 2, coriaceous, weakly convex, obovate to suborbicular, (3.5) 4-5 x 3-4 (5) mm, white to light pink, glabrous to sparingly glandular; petals wanting; stamens 19-32; filaments 0.3-0.8 long, borne on a slightly raised torus; anthers narrowly obovate to oblong, 0.9-2 x 0.5-0.7 mm. Flowers Y: pedicels 4-7.5 (16) mm long; bracteoles wanting; sepals 2, obovate or elliptic to transversely broadly elliptic, 4-7.5 x (3) 4-6 mm, colored like the staminate sepals, glabrous to sparingly glandular; petals wanting; ovary 5-7 (8) mm long, white to light green, sparingly glandular; styles 1.7-2.5 mm long, connate to half their length; stigmas lunate. Capsules with pedicels 1-2.9 cm long; trilocular with bilamellate placentae, occasionally somewhat beaked, 5.5-9 (11.5) mm long; locule chambers narrowly to broadly ovate or elliptic, 4.5- 7.5 x 3.5-5 mm; wings 3, unequal, the largest asymmetric, ovate to oblong or elliptic, (9) 10-20 x 7-14 mm, the second and third subequal, asymmetrically lunate to lunate-triangular, 4-8.5 x (5) 6-10.5 mm, or occasionally marginiform.

description: Arbor; hornotinis crassiusculis obtuse tetragonis vel subteretibus dense ochraceo-puberulentibus vel adpresse purpureo-pubeseentibus; foliis oppositis vel suboppositis petiolatis; petiolis crassis teretibus dense puberulentibus vel purpureo-pubeseentibus; laminis membra- naceis vel subcoriaceis utrinque pernitidis oblongis vel oblongo-ovatis acutis vel acuminatis integerrimis saepe revolutis ad basin rotundatis vel cordatis vel subtruncatis, subtus puberulentibus vel leviter pubes- centibus, supra (praeter venam mediam) glabris; infloreseentiis axil- laribus terminalibusque; cymis axillaribus paucissimis pedunculatis brachiatis densissime multifloris bracteolatis; paniculis terminalibus thyrsoideis densissimis bracteatis, sympodiis crassis angulatis, dense puberulentibus vel purpureo-pubeseentibus; floribus pedicellatis; pedunculis crassiusculis dense purpureo-pubeseentibus; pedicellis gracilibus; bracteis variis, inferioribus magnis foliaceis, superioribus lanceolatis, eaducis; bracteolis linearibus; prophyllis setaceis pubes- centibus; calyce late obconico leviter granuloso-pulverulento, margine prave 4-lobato; corolla infundibulariforme sufflava glabra, lobis 4 oblongis acutis vel obtusis; staminibus 4 longe exsertis; pistillo in- cluso; stigmate bifido; ovario oblongo depresso glabro 4-loculare.
bibliographicCitation: Moldenke, Harold N. 1932. Some new species of Aegiphila from Central and South America. Brittonia. 1: 185-194.

description: Slender tree, 4-5 m. tall; branchlets rather stout, obtusely tetragonal or subterete, somewhat ridged toward the apex, ampliate at the uppermost nodes, densely ochraceous-puberulent or appressed purple-pubescent toward the apex; internodes 4.5-7.5 cm. long; leaf-scars very prominent, projecting 2 mm. or more; buds large; leaves decussate-opposite or subopposite; petioles stout, terete, 8-12 mm. long, densely puberulent or purple-pubescent; blades membranous or subcoriaceous, light green and nitid on both surfaces, oblong or oblong-ovate, 13.5-19 cm. long, 6.5-9.5 cm. wide, acute or acuminate at apex, entire, often revolute in drying, rounded, cordate, or subtruncate at base, puberulent or sparsely pubescent beneath, especially on the midrib and larger veins, glabrous above except for the puberulent midrib; midrib slender, very large and prominent beneath, pubescent or puberulent on both surfaces; secondaries 9-16 pairs, slender, close, more or less arcuate-ascending, prominent beneath, prominulent above, plainly anastomosing near the margins beneath; veinlets very slender, conspicuous on both surfaces; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes apparently limited to one pair in the uppermost axils, solitary, opposite, about 4 cm. long and 3 cm. wide, brachiate, very densely many-flowered, bracteolate; panicle terminal, thyrsoid, 12-16 cm. long, 7-9 cm. wide, bracteate, its cymes about 11-13, densely many-flowered, its sympodia stout, angulate, densely puberulent or purple-pubescent, its branches short, opposite, each pair subtended by a pair of bracts; peduncles stoutish, 3.5-4.5 cm. long, densely purple-pubescent; pedicels slender, about 5 mm. long [or longer]; bracts various, the lowermost large and foliaceous, the uppermost lanceolate and rapidly diminishing in size, caducous; bractlets linear; prophylla setaceous, pubescent; calyx broadly obconic, about 4.4 mm. long and 3.8 mm. wide, somewhat granular-pulverulent, its rim very irregularly 4-lobed in a somewhat 2-lipped fashion, each lobe about 1.8 mm. long on one side and 1 mm. long on the other, about 2 mm. wide [but this method of lobing is not at all constant even on the same inflorescence!], often somewhat apiculate; corolla infundibular, glabrous, its tube pale yellow, about 9 mm. long, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, bright yellow, about 5.4 mm. long and 2 mm. wide, acute or obtuse at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 5.2 mm. from the base of the corolla-tube, long-ex-sertecl (in male); filaments filiform, 17-19.5 mm. long (in male); pilose at base; anthers oblong, about 1.8 mm. long and 1.3 mm. wide, puberulent; pistil included (in male); style capillary, about 5.2 mm. long (in male), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 2.8 mm. long, glabrous; ovary depressed-oblong, about 0.8 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Moldenke, Richard G. 1934. A monograph of the genus Aegiphila. Brittonia. 1 (5-6): 245-471.

description: Monoecious, branched erect leafy herb, to 2 m tall, lacking rhizomes. Stems green or reddish, usually glabrous, occasionally sparsely hairy. Stipules deciduous, narrowly lanceolate to lanceolate-subulate, 6-17 X 1.25-3 mm, apex acute, glandular setose, otherwise glabrous, margin entire. Leaves: petioles 0.7-14 cm long, usually glabrous, occasionally with sparse hairs, joining lamina at a transverse angle; lamina green above, paler green beneath, both surfaces glabrous or veins on lower surface occasionally with sparse microscopic glandular hairs, asymmetric, lanceolate to elliptic- acuminate or broadly elliptic, 11-22 X 2.15-10.5 cm, apex gradually long acuminate, base cordate, basal lobes unequal, outer lobe 1-7.5 cm long, inner lobe very short, sinus (truncate-) 0.5-1.5(-3) cm deep, margin shallowly toothed to almost entire, often slightly wavy, ciliate, veins 5- 7, palmate. Inflorescences axillary, twice branched dichasia usually 5-7-flowered, occasionally to 10-flowered, male and female flowers borne synchronously on the same or on separate inflorescences; peduncles 3-15 mm long, glabrous to sparsely hairy; bracts caducous, narrowly lanceolate to lanceolate-subulate, 2.25-12 X 0.75-5 mm, apex acute, setose, outer surface with sparse microscopic glandular hairs, margin usually entire, rarely ciliate; bracteoles absent. Pedicels glabrous or with microscopic glandular hairs, those of male flowers 0.5-1.3 cm long, those of female flowers to 1.4 cm long. Male flowers: perianth segments usu- ally white, sometimes pale pink, 4, gla- brous, outer pair broadly ovate or obovate to elliptic, outer surface strongly concave, 4-10 X 2.5-9 mm, apex rounded, inner pair broadly ovate to linear-obovate, 3.5-8.5 X 2-7.8 mm, apex rounded; stamens 30-60, filaments 0.7-1.6 mm long, free to scarcely fused at base, occasionally attached to a raised receptacle, receptacle to 1.5 mm tall, anthers narrow-oblong to linear or elliptic, inner slightly longer than outer, 1-2.6 mm long, connective projecting 0.2-0.4 mm, apex rounded, dehiscing via vertical slits along the sides of the anther. Female flowers: perianth segments usually white, sometimes pale pink, 6, subequal, becoming gradually smaller towards center of flower, glabrous, outer 3 elliptic, 5-16 X 3.6-6 mm, apex rounded, inner 3 elliptic, 4.7-13 X 2.6-4.6 mm, apex rounded; ovary globose, 3-lobed, 3-10 X 3-7 mm, with 3 ribs along angles, occasionally with equal wings from center of each locule, wings ca. 1 mm long, triangular, glabrous or with very sparse microscopic glandular hairs, 3-locular, placentation axillary, placentas bifid, bearing ovules on both surfaces of placental branches; styles 3, deciduous, slender, 3-5 mm tall, fused at base for ca. 0.7 mm, bifid from shortly below halfway, branches erect, stigmatic papillae once to thrice spirally twisted. Infructescences often 4-fruited; fruiting pedicels ca. 1 cm long; fruit fleshy, green to reddish green, pendulous, globose to turbinate, 6-12 X 8-14 mm in dried state, apex rounded, with very sparse microscopic glandular hairs.
bibliographicCitation: Tebbitt, Mark C. 2003. Taxonomy of Begonia longifolia Blume (Begoniaceae) and Related Species. Brittonia. 55 (1): 19-29.

description: Rhizoma repens. Laminae supra opacae juxta marginem hirsutulae, 10-12-palmatinerves. Petioli trichomatibus 2 mm longis tomentosi. Inflorescentiae symmetricae vel leniter asymmetricae. Florum [male] sepala suborbicularia late et transverse elliptica vel ovata 5.5-9 x 6-10 mm extus sparsim glanduloso-puberula; stamina (16) 25-31. Florum [female] tepala ovata vel elliptica 3-6 x 2.5-4.5 mm extus sparsim glanduloso-puberula; stigmata late lunata. Placentae integrae vel debiliter inaequaliter bilamellatae. Capsulae 7-9 mm longae sparsim pilosae; alae inaequales.
bibliographicCitation: Burt-Utley, Kathleen & Utley, John F. 1987. Begonia lymansmithii (Begoniaceae), a new species from Oaxaca, Mexico. Brittonia. 39: 59-62.

description: Herbaceous perennial; rhizomes repent, internodes very short, glabrous, but nodes squamose with a sparse band of lacerate scales surrounding the petiole base or scar. Leaf blade chartaceous, oblique, asymmetrically obovate to ovate or broadly elliptic, 8.8-17.7 x 6.8-13.2 cm, basally cordate, apically rounded to acute, marginally densely lanate, dentate to undulate at ends of major nerves, upper surface dull, dark green throughout but submarginally dark red-brown, glabrous throughout except at the base of nerves and in a 1-2 mm submarginal band of dense, short villi, lower surface deep red throughout and lanate on principal nerves but less densely so in intercostal regions, 10-1 2-palmatinerved. Petiole 10-27 cm x 2-3 (5) mm, dark red, densely tomentose-lanate with basally uniseriate whiplash trichomes to 2 mm long. Stipules persistent, often becoming reflexed with age, ovate, 1.2-2.2 x 0.7-1.3 cm, glabrous, only weakly keeled distally with the costa excurrent apically or subapically. Inflorescence typically greatly exceeding the foliage, symmetrically to moderately asymmetrically cymose, many-flowered. Peduncles 23.7-39.5 cm x 2.5-3.5 mm, dark red, tomentose. Bracts deciduous, the lowermost ovate to ovate-elliptic or reniform, 4.5-11 x 6-12 mm, marginally irregularly glandular; sparingly glandular puberulous. Flowers [male]: pedicels 5-10 mm long; sepals 2, ovate to suborbicular or broadly transversely elliptic, 5.5-9 x 6-10 mm, dark pink without, lighter within, externally sparingly glandular puberulous; petals wanting; stamens (16) 25-31; filaments 0.6-2 mm long, borne on a slightly raised torus; anthers oblong to obovate, 0.9-1.3 x 0.6-0.9 mm. Flowers [female]: pedicels 5-10 mm long; bracteoles wanting; tepals 5 or rarely 4, reflexed, subequal, asymmetrically ovate to elliptic, 3-6 mm x 2.5-4.5 mm, colored like staminate sepals, externally glandular-puberulous; ovary 5.5-8 mm long, sparingly pilose; styles 3, 1-2 mm long, connate to half their length; stigmas broadly lunate. description: Shrub or tree, to 6 m. tall; branches stout, subterete, white, smooth; branchlets rather stout, obtusely tetragonal, very densely toinentose when young, gradually becoming less so, subglabrous in age; description: Monoecious, erect herb. Stems to 2.5 m tall, green, slender, simple or few branched, glabrous. Leaves: petioles 2-7 cm long, slender, glabrous, joining lamina at a transverse angle; lamina green above, paler green with red veins beneath, both surfaces with sparse microscopic glandular hairs, asymmetric, lanceolate, 8-16 X 1.8- 6.5 cm, apex acuminate, base shallowly cordate, basal lobes unequal, inner lobe 0.7-2.4 cm long, sinus 0-2.4 cm deep, margin serrate-toothed, teeth ciliate, veins 6, palmate. Inflorescence a loose axillary 1-2- branched dichasium, few-flowered, male and female flowers borne synchronously on same inflorescence; peduncles to 1 cm long; bracts caducous, ovate, ca. 6 X 2 mm, apex acuminate, with very sparse microscopic glandular hairs; bracteoles absent. Pedicels of male flowers to 1.7 cm long, of female flowers to 1 cm long. Male flowers: perianth segments 4, white to pink, glabrous, outer pair orbicular-elliptic, 4.6-6 X 3.2- 4.4 mm, apex obtuse, inner pair ovate-elliptic, 3.8-5.4 X 2.5-4 mm, apex obtuse; stamens ca. 25-30, filaments ca. 0.6 mm long, linear, free to base, central filaments slightly longer than outermost filaments, anthers linear-elliptic, ca. 1.5 mm long, dehiscing via vertical slits along side of anther, connective projecting ca. 0.2 mm, apex rounded. Female flowers: perianth segments 6, white to pink, glabrous, ovate-elliptic, outer 3 to 8 X 6 mm, apex obtuse, inner 3 to 7 X 3 mm, apex obtuse; ovary fleshy, green, spinning-top-shaped, locules inflated, with 3 very short wings running along outer angle of locules, these later drying out in fruit to become knoblike protrusions, 3-locular, placentation axile, placentae bifid, bearing ovules on both surfaces of placental branch- es; styles 3, caducous, slender, ca. 2.5 mm long, shortly fused at base, branches bifid from 1/3 of length, stigmatic papillae once spirally twisted. Infructescence 1-4-fruited, orientated at 450 to stem; fruiting pedicels to 1.3 cm long; fruit fleshy, erect, spinning- top-shaped, locules inflated, 7-13 X 8-15 cm, wingless, but with knoblike protrusions on angles of locules, apex acute, crowned by basal part of styles.

description: Shrub; branches and branchlets stout, obtusely tetragonal, usually quite abrupt, medullose, densely puberulent with extremely short brownish or einereous hairs, becoming glabrous in age; lenticels promi- nent; leaf-scars large, much elevated, very prominent on older  branches; internodes 1-2.5 cm. long; leaves opposite or approximate; petioles medium-thick, 8-15 mm. long, flattened above, slightly alate, puberulent or subglabrate; blades firmly membranous, darker above than beneath, usually becoming brownish in drying, oblong-elliptic or oblong-obovate, 8.8-13 cm. long, 3.5-4.8 cm. wide, bluntly acute at apex, entire and often slightly revolute along the margins, acuminate at base and more or less attenuate into the petiole, very lightly strigil- lose above, becoming merely roughened and quite glabrous in age, densely puberulent with extremely short hairs beneath, becoming merely punctate in age; midrib stout, prominent on both surfaces, especially beneath; secondaries very slender, numerous and close together, 13-16 pairs, ascending, not much arcuate, inconspicuously anastomosing at the margins; veinlet reticulation delicate; inflores- cence axillary; eymes subcapitate or brachiate, 1.5-3 cm. long and wide, many-flowered, usually rather dense; peduncles 8-12 mm. long, usually slightly supra-axillary, densely puberulent, verruculose; pedicels slender, 1-3 mm. long, densely puberulent; bracts absent; bractlets and prophylla linear, 1-7 mm. long, densely puberulent; calyx campanulate, 3.1-3.6 mm. long and 3.3-4.1 mm. wide, denselv short-puberulent, its rim truncate and entire or very minutely and irregularly crenate; corolla infundibular, its tube broadly cylindric, about 2.6 mm. long, ampliate above, glabrous, its lobes 5, oblong- lingulate, 3.2-5.2 mm. long, 1-2.6 mm. wide, subacute at apex; stamens 5, inserted about 1.5 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, equal- ing the corolla-lobes or exserted; filaments filiform, 2.6-3 mm. long, glabrous; anthers oblong, about 2 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide, 2-celled; pistil included; style capillary, about 2.6 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches erect, about 2.3 mm. long; ovary subglobose, about 0.7 mm. long and wide, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: Rhizoma repens. Laminae asymmetrice suborbiculares vel oblongae 6.5-15 x 7.8-10.8 cm supra et subtus hirsutulae. Petioli trichomatibus 0.3-0.7 mm longis hirsutuli. Florum [male] sepala ovata vel obovata 3 x 3 mm; stamina 8. Stigmata lunata. Capsulae 9-13 mm longae; alae inaequales.
bibliographicCitation: Burt-Utley, Kathleen. 1984. Studies on Middle American Begonia (Begoniaceae) I. Brittonia. 36: 232-235.

description: Herbaceous perennials; rhizomes repent, internodes very short, 1-2 mm long x 8-11 mm diam, appearing glabrous when mature. Leaf blades oblique to transverse, asymmetrically suborbicular to oblong, 6.5-15 x 7.8-10.8 cm, basally cordate, apically acuminate, marginally dentate to doubly dentate at ends of major nerves and ciliate-denticulate between, hirtellous above and beneath, with trichomes most dense on principal nerves, 9-palmatinerved. Petioles 10.5-16 cm x 1-2 mm, sparingly hirtellous with spreading villi 0.3-0.7 mm long. Stipules persistent, ovate-triangular, 7 x 7 mm, strongly keeled, externally glabrous to hirtellous throughout. Inflorescences exceeding the foliage, strongly asymmetric, laxly cymose, many-flowered, 8-10.5 cm diam. Peduncles 25-37 cm x 2-7 mm, glandular-hirtellous to glabrous. Bracts caducous, the lowermost not seen. Flowers 6: pedicels 6-7 mm long; sepals 2, ovate to obovate, 3 x 3 mm, externally glabrous; petals wanting; stamens 8; filaments 0.5-1 mm long, borne on a flat, broad torus; anthers oblong-obovate, 1 x 0.4-0.7 mm. Flowers Y: pedicels 4.5-6 mm long; bracteoles wanting; sepals 2, obovate to broadly elliptic, 3-5 x 3-4 mm, glabrous; petals wanting; ovary 4-5 mm long, glabrous to sparingly glandular; styles 3, 2-2.5 mm long, connate to 3/4 their length; stigmas lunate. Capsules with pedicels 9-13 mm long, trilocular with bipartite placentae, frequently somewhat beaked, 5-7 mm long; locule chambers appearing ovate, 3.5-4.5 x 2.5 mm; wings 3, unequal, the largest oblong or occasionally subfalcate, 8.5-10 x 4-6 mm, the second and third marginiform.

description:
Frutex epiphyticus, glaber. Rami herbacei, virides, fistulosi, internodia foliorum circiter 25 mm longa. Folia petiolata (petiolus tenuis 5-12 mm longus), tenuiter membranacea, fere concoloria vel subtus violascenter suffusa; lamina ovato-oblonga-elliptica, 5-12 x 1.8-5 cm, acuminata, basi rotundata, margine fere integerrimo minute denticulata, nervi et venae fere plani, nervi secundarii 8-9 sub angulo subrecto arcuatim ascendentes. Flores solitarii in axillis foliorum superiorum, non pauci quidem. Pedicelli 45 mm longi, glabri, ebracteolati, patentes. Hypanthium oblongum, 9 x 4 mm; lobi eius late ovati, plus minus integerrimi, 2 mm longi, sinus inter eos late rotundati. Corolla viridula, glabra, 20 mm longa; tubus e basi inflato angustus, 3 mm diametiens, in dorso 17 mm longus, in latere ventrali 8 mm longus; lobi lineares acuti, falcati: 2 superiores 14 mm, medii 8 mm, imus excavatus 6 mm longi. Stamina in tubum connata: filamenta pubescentia, 24 mm longa; antherarum tubus glaber, 7 mm longus, omnes orificio ciliatae. Bacca magna, valde inflata, luteo-viridis, oblongo-ellipsoidea, 48 x 32 mm. Semina oblonga, fusca, 0.8 mm longa, cellulae testae oblongae.

Similis Burmeisterae vulgari E. Wimm.; differt foliorum forma, pedicello circiter duplo longiore, filamentis glabris, bacca minore.

description: "Frutex ramis scandentibus, corollis viridibus, violaceo-maculatis et intus violaceis" (collect.). Folia oblongo-elliptica, 7-13 x 3-5 cm, basi plerumque subacuta, raro rotundata, subtus glabra vel in nervis inconspicue puberula, dum pedicelli, calyces, lobi corollae extus plus minusve hirti inveniuntur, filamenta autem et antherae densius hirtae. Flores in specimine nostro (initio florescentiae) solitari-axillares (non ut in var. carnosa "in racemo brevi"), pedicelli 4.5-7 cm longi. Cetera vix diversa.

description: Frutex glaber ramis dependentibus. Folia petiolata, tenuiter membranacea, glabra, glauco-viridia, fere concoloria; lamina oblongo-lanceolata, 10-12 x 2.5- 3.5 cm, cuspidata, basi in petiolum 8-10 mm longum angustata, margine irregulari- ter serrato-dentata (dentes arguti antrorsum curvati, conferti, minores inter majores), nervi secundarii 12-13 prominuli e costa albida prominente sub angulo fere semirecto curvatim ascendentes. Flores solitarii in axillis foliorum superi- orum lanceolatorum pedicellos superantium. Pedicelli 4.5 cm longi, glabri, ebracteolati. Hypanthium obconicum, 3 x 2 mm (in summa parte dilatata), glabrum; lobi eius triangulari-lineares, obtusiusculi, integerrimi, erecti, 5 mm longi, sinus inter eos plani. Corolla dilute viridis, glaber: tubus rectus, cylindricus, 12 x 1.5 mm; lobi falciformes, inaequales. Filamenta glabra, 21 mm longa. Tubus antherarum cupuliformis, viridulus, glaber, 5 mm longus, 2 inferiores barbatulae. Bacca fere matura globosa! 9 x 9 mm. Semina compresso-cylindrica vel -clavata, fusca, reti- culata, 0.8 mm longa, cellulae testae isodiametricae.

description: Herba 50 cm alta puberula, antherarum tubi orificio nudo; calycis lobis erectis serratis, quam hypanthio paullo brevioribus; foliis utrinque angustatis, crebro denticulatis; fructu non inflato, 1 cm longo oblongo.

description: Terrestrial herb up to 50 cm high, the stem lignified and 2-3 mm in diameter near the base; plant somewhat puberulent with flaccid several-celled yellowish-white hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long (or up to 0.5 mm long on the principal veins), the indument relatively dense on the youngest growing tips and evident on the upper stem, the petioles, and the veins of the lower leaf-surface; leaves glabrous above, elliptic, 3.5-4.5 cm wide, 12-16 cm long (the uppermost and lowermost leaves smaller), 2.8-3.5 times as long as wide, acute at base and apex (or the latter acuminate), the petiole about 1 mm thick, 2-2.5 cm long; margins closely and uniformly beset with narrow, acute, erect or somewhat ascending, ciliate teeth, these 11-18 per cm of margin, 1-2 mm high and narrowly triangular, or the intermediate ones linear and 0.5-1 mm high; flowers about 3.7 cm long including the hypanthium, green, to about 10 in number, somewhat corymbosely aggregated in the axils of the slightly reduced upper leaves; pedicels glabrous, strongly ascending, about 1 mm in diameter, 7-8 cm long in fruit, ebracteolate; corolla glabrous, the tube 19-20 mm long, its basal three-quarters narrowly cylindric, 1.7-2 mm wide when pressed, abruptly expanded into the throat, the dorsal lobes ovate-lanceolate, 3.5 mm wide, about 13 mm long, the lateral and ventral lobes similar, shorter; filament-tube 25 mm long, somewhat exserted, distally pubescent, the filaments distinct and glabrous near the base, and there fused to the corolla tube about 2 mm; anther-tube 6 mm long, enlarged distally, drying greenish-yellow, all the anthers naked at the tips, sparingly hairy on the backs; hypanthium glabrous, in anthesis 2-2.5 mm in diameter and 7-8 mm long, nearly cylindric but somewhat enlarged distally; fruit oblong-ellipsoid, not inflated, rounded at both ends and somewhat oblique, 5 mm thick, 10 mm long; calyx-lobes foliaceous, erect in flower and fruit, about 6 mm long and 2 mm wide, acute, broadest above the middle and narrowed toward the base, with 4-6 sharp ascending teeth on each side; seeds 1 mm long, oblong, somewhat flattened, pitted, the pits scarcely elongate.
bibliographicCitation: McVaugh, Rogers. 1957. Two New Species of Lobeliaceae from Costa Rica. Brittonia. 9 (1): 30-32.

description: Frutex plus minusve decumbens, circiter I m altus. Rami teretes, glabrati, in vertice hirtelli, internodia foliorum 2-4 cm longa. Lamina tenuis, pilis brevissi- mis scabra, opaca, ovato-oblonga, 6.12 x 2.2-4 cm, ad apicem acuta vel acuminato- cuspidata, basi subrotundata usque subacuta et in petiolum ad 2 cm longum angustata, remote callose denticulata, nervi secundarii 6-8 sub angulo fere 50 curvatim ascendentes. Pedicelli solitari-axillares, in vertice plus minus congesti, 4.5 cm longi, ebracteolati. Flores 8-10. Hypanthium globosum, glabrum, circiter 5 mm longum et latum; lobi eius lineari-lanceolati, obtusi, 9-10 mm longi, margine callose denticulati, glabri, patentes. Corolla viridula, glabra: tubus rectus, sub- conicus, in dorso 15 mm, in latere ventrali 9 mm longus, infra faucem inflatam 3 mm latus; lobi corollae inaequales, falcati, superiores 11, medii 6, imus 4 mm longi. Filamenta 20 mm longa, pubescentia; antherarum tubus curvato-cylindricus, glaber, 7 mm longus, apice omnes ciliatae. Fructum non vidi. Burmeisterae pennellii Gleas. similis, sed foliis, pubescentia alia, pedicellis duplo brevioribus glabris, sepalis lanceolatis, brevioribus, glabris, corolla glabra satis differt.

description: "Herba robusta. Bacca candida, vernicosa, ovoidea." Cauliscrispo-pubescens. Folia oblonga, 7-14 x 3-5 cm, ad apicem obtusiusculum subacuminata, basi sub- rotundata, margine dentibus glandulaceis fere intramarginalibus plus minus remotis munita, subtus dense puberula. Flores in corymbo congesti (in nostro specimine 9). Pedicelli 4-5 cm longi, basi bracteis foliaceis parvis (ca. 6 x 3 mm) suffulti. Calycis longe obconici lobi 2-3 mm longi. Corolla luteola ("verde amarillenta"). Filamenta parce brevissime puberula, 17 mm longa. Tubus antherarum glaber, ad 6 mm longus, 2 inferiores leviter barbatae.

description: Frutex epiphyticus. Rami teretes, glabri, 3 mm in diametro, internodia foliorum 1-2 cm longa. Folia petiolata, membranacea, glabra, opaca, subtus pallidiora, nervi prominentes, laterales 8-9 sub angulo circiter 50 subcurvatim ascendentes; lamina oblonga, 4-8 x 1.4-2.5 cm, acuminata, basi acuta et in petiolum tenuem 8-14 mm longum breviter angustata, margine callose denticulata, dentes infra apicem interdum majores. Flores in axillis foliorum superiorum solitarii, pauci. Pedicelli glabri, 4-6 (fr. 8) cm longi. Hlypanthium globosum, 5 mm longum et latum, glabrum, demum inflatum; lobi calycini anguste triangulares, basi utrinque 1 dente muniti, 2 mm longi. Corolla dilute viridis, glaber: tubus rectus, in latere dorsali 16-18 mm longus, in ventrali 11-12 mm longus, fauce inflato; lobi sub- lineares, acuti, falcati, 2 superiores 12 mm, medii 7 mm, imus triangularis obtusiusculus excavatus 5 mm longus. Stamina glabra, 29 mm longa; antherarum tubus solus 6 mm longus, subcurvatus, apice nudus. Stigma bilobum. Bacca ellipsoidea, inflata, 3 x 2 cm; semina anguste oblonga, fusca, vix 1 mm longa, cellulae testae oblongae.

description: Species insignis lamina obovata, racemo 32-33 cm longo, bracteis lanceolatis 11-18 mm longis, pedicellis complanatis 45-60 mm longis 1.9-2.5 mm latis 0.5- 0.7 mm crassis, calycis lobis lanceolatis 10-14 mm longis, corollae 41-43 mm longae tubo 22-23 mm longo, lobis dorsalibus 18-21 mm longis, et omnibus antheris ad apicem pubescentibus bene distincta.

description: Shrub, 4 m tall; stems 6.5-7.5 mm diam., sparsely pubescent with minute appressed hairs; latex white. Lamina obovate, 18-25 X 7-9 cm; adaxial surface glabrous; abaxial surface pubescent with minute appressed hairs, these densest on the veins; margin minutely denticulate; apex cuspidate; base cuneate; petiole 10-13 mm long, 1.8-2 mm diam., sparsely pubescent with minute appressed hairs. Inflorescence a 15-floweredauxotelic raceme; peduncle ascending, 21-22 cm long, 3.4-6.5 mm diam., sparsely pubescent with minute appressed hairs, bearing a few narrowly elliptic leaves 2.5-9.5 X 0.5-3 cm toward the base; rachis 10-11 cm long, moderately pubescent with minute appressed hairs; bracts lanceolate, 11-18 x 2.3-3.2 mm, rounded or obtuse at apex; pedicels ascending at anthesis, spreading afterwards, flattened, 45-60 X 1.9-2.5 mm, 0.5-0.7 mm thick, ebracteolate, minutely pubescent. Hypanthium campanulate, 7 mm long, 5 mm diam., sparsely pubescent with minute appressed hairs. Calyx lobes lanceolate, 10-14 x 2-3 mm, sparsely pubescent; margin minutely 3-5-denticulate; apex rounded. Corolla green, 41-43 mm long, nearly glabrous; tube straight, 22-23 mm long, 4-5 mm diam. for most of its length, then abruptly inflated to 9-10 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 18-21 x 4-5 mm, acuminate at apex; lateral lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 10-11 x 4-5 mm, acuminate at apex; ventral lobe ovate, deflexed, 8 x 5 mm, acute at apex. Staminal column exserted; filament tube suberect, 35 mm long, 3.5 mm diam., glabrous; anther tube 4 mm diam., the surfaces glabrous but all five with tufts of long soft white hairs at apex; dorsal anthers 8 mm long; ventral anthers 6 mm long. Mature berries and seeds not seen.

description: Lamina foliorum oblonga, 8-16 x 2.5-4 cm, acuminata, basi subacuta et in petiolum tenuem 8-14 mm longum attenuata, margine leviter repando minute callose denticulata, subtus in nervis brevissime hirtella. Calyx campanulatus lobis linearibus obtusiusculis subdenticulatis 4 mm longis. Corolla rubicunda, superne virens vel viridula, tubo in dorso 19 mm longo. Antherarum tubus 7 mm longus, apice ciliatus. Bacca globosa, circiter 10 mm longa et lata. Semina fusi- formia, fere 1 mm longa, fusca, cellulae testae oblongae. A planta typica differt imprimis foliis subtus in nervis subtiliter hirtellis, calyce campanulato (non ovoideo-turbinato), antherarum tubo majore (non 4 mm tantum longo).

description: Fleshy herb, 0.75 m tall; stems 4-4.8 mm diam., densely pubescent with pale septate spreading hairs 2-3.5 mm long. Lamina ovate, 8-11.5 X 4.5-6.8 cm; adaxial surface green, sparsely pubescent with pale septate spreading hairs, though not on the veins; abaxial surface green, moderately pubescent with pale septate spreading hairs, especially on the veins; margin ciliate, minutely denticulate; apex obtuse; base obtuse or rounded; petiole 15-30 mm long, 1.8-2 mm diam., densely pubescent with pale septate spreading hairs. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicel ascending, 80-135 mm long, 1.8-2 mm diam., bibracteolate at base, moderately pu- bescent with pale septate spreading hairs; bracteoles linear, 2.7-4 X 0.2-0.3 mm. Hypanthium oblate, 9-10 mm long, 12-13 mm diam., pubescent with scattered short hairs. Calyx lobes spreading, lanceolate, 14-18 X 4-5 mm, connate at base for 1-2 mm; margin ciliate, with 5-8 minute denticulations; apex acuminate. Corolla green on tube, dark reddish purple on limb, 32-40 mm long, glabrous; tube slightly decurved, 14- 20 mm long, 9 mm diam. at base, narrowing gradually to 5-5.5 mm diam. at middle, abruptly expanded to 10-12 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes lanceolate, subfalcate, 18-20 X 5.5 mm, acuminate at apex; lateral lobes narrowly triangular, subfalcate, 14-17 X 5-6.5 mm, acuminate at apex; ventral lobe narrowly triangular, slightly decurved, 15-16 X 6 mm, acuminate at apex. Filament tube 28-29 X 2.7-2.8 mm, glabrous; anther tube 5.4-5.5 mm in diam., the median line of each anther densely pubescent with short yellow hairs; dorsal anthers 9-10 mm long, glabrous at apex; ventral anthers 6-7 mm long, with sparse tufts of white hairs 0.7-0.8 mm long at apex. Mature berries and seeds not seen.

description: Small tree, 4-13 m. tall, with a broad crown; branchlets stout, obtusely tetragonal, covered with a pale and grayish tomentum of  short appressed hairs; internodes 8-12 mm. long; leaf-scars very large and elevated, horseshoe-shaped, about 5.5 mm. long and 4 mm. wide, the edges prominently raised, with a plainly visible concentric circle or tetrangle of fibrovascular bundle-scars; buds very large and promi- neilt at the apex of the scars, appressed-tomentose; leaves decussate; petioles stout, about 1 cm. long, pale ochraceous-pubeseent; blades firmly membranous, green above, somewhat paler beneath, obovate, 11-25 cm. long, 5-9.5 cm. wide, acute or short-acuminate at apex, entire, cuneate at base and narrowed into the petiole, sparsely and mi- nutely puberulent above, rather densely spreading short-pubescent beneath, becoming almost glabrate on both surfaces in age; midrib stout, very prominent beneath; secondaries 10-15 pairs, slender and delicate, rather straight and close together, anastomosing near the margins; infloreseence axillary; eymes small, solitary, opposite, 1.5-2 cm. long, rather densely many-flowered; peduncles obsolete or to 4 mm. long, densely and minutely appressed-tomentose; pedicels very short or obsolete, minutely appressed-tomentose; calyx turbinate or obconic, 4-5 mm. long, about 3.6 mm. wide, pulverulent, its rim truncate and entire; corolla infundibular, glabrous, its tube narrow- cylindric, about 3.6 mm. long or equaling the calyx, its lobes 5, oblong- lingulate, 3-3.1 mm. long, about 2 mm. wide, eucullate at apex; stamens 2-5 ( ?) [sometimes apparently absent?], inserted about 2 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, included (in 9 ); filaments filiform, flattened, about 1.3 mm. long (in 9 ), glabrous; anthers oblong, about 0.5 mm. long and 0.2 mm. wide; pistil exserted (in 9 ); style capillary, to 3.9 mm. long (in 9 ), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 2 mm. long; ovary oblong, about 1.3 mm. long and 0.7 mm. wide, flattened and umbilicate at apex, puberulent, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx greatly enlarged and indurated, shallowly patelliform or almost flat, somewhat verruculose, about 5 mm. long and 15 mm. wide, appressed-tomentose or glabrate, its rim shallowly and irregu- larly lobed; fruit large, very fleshy, becoming dark in drying, about 8 mm. long and 14 mm. wide, conspicuously depressed and umbilicate at apex, 4-seeded.

description: Tall shrub; branches stout, obsoletely tetragonal, densely velu-tinous-pubescent; branchlets rather slender, subterete or obtusely tetragonal, densely velutinous-pubescent; internodes to 10 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles stout, very weak, about 1 cm. long, densely velutinous-pubescent; blades subcoriaceous or membranous, oblong, 10-17 cm. long, 4-6 cm. wide, short-acuminate at apex, entire, acute at base, pubescent above, densely velutinous-tomentose beneath; midrib slender, rather prominent at base beneath; secondaries 7-11 pairs, slender, somewhat prominent beneath, arcuate-ascending, anastomosing near the margins; veinlets delicate; inflorescence axillary and terminal; cymes solitary, opposite, capitate, to 7.6 cm. long and 2.5 cm. wide, densely many-flowered, bracteolate; panicle terminal, thyrsoid-pyramidal, very narrow, foliose, about 20 cm. long, 8 cm. wide at base, its sympodia elongate, densely velutinous; peduncles slender, 1-5 cm. long, divaricate, densely velutinous; pedicels slender, 1-4 mm. long, densely velutinous; bracts foliaceous, caducous; bractlets subulate, densely velutinous; calyx campanulate, about 5.9 mm. long and 4.5 mm. wide, densely strigose-velutinous, its rim deeply and sharply 4-lobed, its lobes triangular, acute at apex; corolla infundibular, glabrous, its tube narrow-cylindric, about 7.7 mm. long, greatly ampliate above, its lobes 4, elliptic- or oblong-lingulate, about 3.2 mm. long and 2.1 mm. wide, rounded at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 2.5 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, exserted (in male); filaments filiform, about 5.3 mm. long (in male), pilose below; anthers oblong, about 1.6 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide; pistil included (in male); style capillary, about 3.2 mm. long (in male), glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 1.3 mm. long, densely pubescent; ovary subglobose, about 1 mm. long and wide, glabrous, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.

description: "Magnificent and stately tree, to 17 m. tall, with a trunk 5-7 m. long and 15-20 cm. in diameter," or merely a tall shrub; crown pyramidal-rounded; branches stout, obtusely tetragonal or subterete, light gray, verrucose with numerous elevated lenticels, glabrate; branchlets rather slender or stoutish, obtusely tetragonal, gray, ver- rucose like the branches, often striate, slightly puberulent or sub- caneseent, becoming glabrate and shiny; internodes 1-3.5 cm. long; leaf-scars large and elevated; leaves numerous, often crowded, opposite or approximate; petioles slender or rather stout, 9-20 mm. long, puberulent or subcaneseent [rarely slightly spreading-pilose at the base], sometimes subverrucose; blades membranous or subcoriaceous, dark green above, lighter beneath, nitid on both surfaces, lanceolate or lanceolate-oblong, varying to oblongf and subelliptic, 8-20 cm. long, 3-6 cm. wide, acute or subacute at apex, entire or often [on rank shoots at the base of larger branches or on young seedlings] deeply and sharply toothed, cuneate at base and narrowed into the petiole, very minutely puberulent-roughened on both surfaces, especially be- neath, becoming glabrous above and glabrate beneath except for the midrib, densely and minutely glandular-punctate on both surfaces, especially above; midrib rather slender, prominent and subcaneseent beneath, sometimes subverruculose; secondaries 7-10 pairs, slender, prominent beneath, arcuate-aseending, anastomosing close to the mar- gins; veinlets very slender, inconspicuous; infloreseence axillary; eymes solitary and opposite or aggregate, numerous, few-flowered, with very small branchlets; flowers sweetly odorous, developed at the same time as the leaves; peduncles obsolete or 1-6 mm. long, puberu- lent or subcaneseent, usually slightly verruculose; pedicels very slender, 3-8 mm. long, puberulent, often slightly verruculose; bract- lets minute, subulate, mucronate, puberulent; calyx large and leath- ery, obconic-campanulate, rounded, 6-8 mm. long, about 5 mm. wide, often verrucose, densely puberulent, lax around the corolla-tube, rather irregularly 2-5 [or more] -lobed, its lobes about 2 mm. long, broad, rounded at apex; corolla hypocrateriform, white, its tube narrow-cylindric, 6-7.8 mm. long, ampliate above, glabrous outside, pubescent within, its lobes 5, oblong- or obovate-lingulate, 6.5-10.3 mm. long, 3-3.2 mm. wide, rounded at apex; stamens 5, inserted about 0.6 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, exserted; filaments filiforim, rather flattened, to 7.2 mm. long, puberulent below; anthers linear-oblong, about 2 mm. long and 0.6 mm. wide; pistil somewhat exserted; style stout, capillary, about 4.8 mm. long, gla- brous; stigma bifid, its branches about 3.5 mm. long, somewhat twisted; ovary globose, about 1.5 mm. long and wide, 4-celled, 4-ovuled; fruiting-calyx enlarged, turbinate-cupuliform, very heavy and verrucose; fruit oblong-globose, 6-8 mm. long and wide, 4-celled but usually 1-seeded [by abortion] or apparently 1-celled, sometimes 2-4-seeded, almost included by the mature calyx; seeds hard-shelled.

description: Bush or tree, 1-4 m. tall; stems subsimple, erect, obsoletely tetrag- onal, subsericeously villose-tomentose; branches stout, obtusely tet- ragonal, subsericeously incanous-tomentose; buds densely hirtous; branchlets rather stout, obtusely tetragonal, varying from strigose or canescent to niveous-tomentose or villose-sericeous, often rather pale ferruginous or rufescent when dry; internodes usually short, 2.5-8 cm. long; leaves varying from decussate-opposite or approximate to alternate-scattered or ternate [or occasionally verticillate in 4 's]; petioles obsolete or extrenmely short; blades membranous, rather dark green above, paler beneath, varying from obovate-oblong or ovate- elliptic to elliptic or subrotund, 6-11.5 cm. long, 3.5-7.5 cm. wide, abruptly acute or very short-acuminate into an obtuse point at apex, entire, acute or acuminate at base, pubescent above, becoming calves- cent or glabrate in age, lanluginous or subsericeous-tomentose beneath, becoming sparsely so in age; midrib rather stout, prominent beneath; secondaries 4-6 pairs, slender, rather prominent beneath or hidden, ascending, more or less anastomosing near the margins; veinlets rather few, inconspicuous or sometimes somewhat coarse; inflorescence axil- lary; cymes solitary, opposite or ternate, 3-5 cm. long, 2-3.5 cm. wide. usually much shorter than the subtending leaves, brachiate, often bifurcate, usually lax but sometimes dense and congested, many- flowered, bracteolate; peduncles rather slender, 1-2 cm. long, densely pubescent; pedicels obsolete or to 5 mm. long, slender, pubescent; bractlets few, linear-subulate, about 2 mm. long, pubescent; prophylla minute, pubescent; calyx obconic or campanulate, 3-8 mm. long, 3-6 mm. wide, tomentose or lanate, its rim distinctly 4-toothed, its teeth short, broadly elliptic, acute or long-acuminate at apex; corolla in- fundibular, whitish, glabrous, its tube narrow-cylindric, about 7.5 mm. long, its lobes 4, lanceolate-lingulate, about 4.8 mm. long and 1.3 mm. wide, acute at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1 mm. below the mouth of the corolla-tube, exserted (in Male ) or included (in female ); fila- ments filiforni, 0.3-5.8 mm. long, glabrous; anthers ovate, about 1 mm. long and 0.9 mm. wide; pistil subincluded or slightly exserted in &, long-exserted in 9; style capillary, 6.4-9 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 3.2 mm. long; ovary subrotund, about 1 mm. long and wide, flattened and 4-lobed at apex, 4-celled, 4-ovuled, often abortive in &; fruiting-calyx enlarged and indurated, cupuliform, densely pubescent, its margin 4-lobed, closely investing or semi-includ- ing the fruit; fruit oblong, gray, very smooth and nitid, 1-4-seeded.

description: Bush or shrub, 2-4 m. tall; branches extremely stout and medullose, obtuse or acutely tetragonal, densely incanous-tomentose; buds completely hidden by incanous wool; branchlets stout, subterete or obtusely tetragonal, densely villose with sordid-gray or glistening white wool; internodes 3-7 cm. long; leaves decussate, somnetimes unequally- paired; petioles stout, 1-3 cm. long, densely villose; blades membranous, varying from oblong or obovate to elliptic-lanceolate, 7-40 cm. long, 5-14 cm. wide, acute or rather long-acuminate at apex, entire or often slightly dentate about the middle, long-attenuate into the petiole at base, minutely puberulent above, becoming glabrate but remaining strigose-roughened in age, especially on the midrib, densely soft-canescent and villose or incano-tomentose beneath; midrib very stout and prominent beneath; secondaries 11-16 pairs, slender, very prominent beneath; veinlets inconspicuous; inflorescence axillary; cymes solitary, opposite, corymbose or conglobate, dichotomous, compact and very dense, many-flowered; peduncles stout, 1-2 cm. long, densely incano-tomentose or villose with sordid-gray hairs; pedicels short, villose; calyx cyathiform-campanulate, 6-7.5 mm. long, about 3.7 mm. wide, densely incano-tomentose or villose with sordid-gray hairs, its rim acutely 4-toothed, its teeth regular, inucronate; corolla infundibular, greenish or whitish, glabrous, its tube narrow-cylindric, about 6.4 mm. long, its lobes 4, ovate- or elliptic-lingulate, rather fleshy, about 2.1 mm. long and 1 mm. wide, subacute at apex; stamens 4, inserted about 1.3 mm.

description: Woody vine; stems and branches stout, pithy, obtusely tetragonal, very densely long-villose with fuscous or ferruginous spreading or reflexed hairs which are 4-8 mm. long; branchlets more slender; internodes 9-18 cm. long; leaves decussate; petioles stout, 5-10 mm. long, densely long-villose; blades light green, membranous, ovoid or ovoid-elliptic, 11.5-25 cm. long, 4.5-12 cm. wide, abruptly short-acuminate at apex, entire and long-ciliate with bristly hairs on the often subrevolute margins, beautifully rounded at base, densely villose on both surfaces with fuscous bristly hairs about 3 mm. in length and usually less than 1 mm. apart; midrib more or less impressed above, very prominent beneath, densely villose, especially beneath, where the villosity simulates that seen on the petioles, branchlets, branches, stems, and peduncles; secondaries slender, 10-12 pairs, arcuate-ascending, beautifully anastomosing 5-17 mm. from the margins, densely villose; inflorescence axillary and terminal, paniculate; terminal panicle about 10 cm. long and 5.5 cm. wide, composed of about 5 cymes, densely long-villose with fuscous hairs throughout, bracteate; axillary panicles similar in all respects to the terminal one or smaller and more cymose; cymes conspicuously bracteolate; peduncles rather stout, 2.5-6 cm. long, densely long-villose throughout like the branch-lets; bracts few, lanceolate, about 1 cm. long and 4 mm. wide, attenuate at both ends, very densely long-villose on both surfaces; bract lets linear, to 17 mm. long, densely villose; calyx campanulate, light and herbaceous, about 1.5 mm. long and 3.3 mm. wide, very patent, densely long-villose on the outside, glabrous within, its rim very shallowly 4-lobed, the lobes blunt; corolla infundibular or hypocrateri-form, its tube [immature?] very narrowly cylindric, about 1.5 mm. long, glabrous, its lobes 4, oblong-lingulate, 3.8-4 mm. long, about 2.5	mm. wide, blunt at apex, glabrous; stamens 4, inserted at the mouth of the corolla-tube; filaments [immature?] filiform, about 0.7 mm. long, pilose at base; anthers oblong, about 1.3 mm. long and 0.7 mm. wide; style capillary, about 2.6 mm. long, glabrous; stigma bifid, its branches about 2 mm. long, widely spreading; ovary depressed-oblong, about 1 mm. long and 1.3 mm. wide, umbilicate and 4-lobed at apex, 4-celled; fruiting-calyx and fruit not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Moldenke, Richard G. 1934. A monograph of the genus Aegiphila. Brittonia. 1 (5-6): 245-471.

description: Branching shrub; branches pubescent; leaves short-petiolate; blades ovate, acute at apex, entire, subcordate at base, roughened with dots or sometimes with hairs above, cinereous and stellate-tomen-tose beneath, especially along the veins; inflorescence axillary and terminal; panicle terminal, often pyramidal and very wide, occasionally double, few [-flowered?], racemose, bracteate at the base, naked above, its branches and sympodia stellate-tomentose; bracts small, foliaceous, subrotund-elliptic, stipitate, obtuse; calyx cylindric, clasping the corolla-tube, pubescent outside and within, its rim 4-toothed; corolla-tube twice as long as the calyx; stamens included.

description: Shrub, to 4 m. tall; branchlets medium, strict, obtusely tetragonal or subterete, lightly cinereous; internodes 3.5-7 cm. long; leaves decLussate-opposite or approximate; petioles 4-5 mm. long, strigillose; blades membranous, dark and very nitid above, lighter and nitiduloums b,eneath, oblong or oblong-lanceolate, 7-12 cm. long, 3-5.5 cm. wide, acuminate at apex, entire, usually acute or subacute at base [some- times rounded], perfectly glabrous above exeept for the strigillose mid- rib, sparingly strigillose or appressed-pubescent beneath, especially on the midrib ancd larger veins, marked with a few glandular disks near the base or along the midrib beneath; midrib slender, prominent on both surfaces; secondaries slender, 6-8 pairs, arcuate-aseending, beau- tifully anastomosing near the margins; infloreseence axillary and terminal; eymes solitary, opposite, somewhat corymbose, to 6.5 cm. long and 3 cm. wide, brachiate, many-flowered, bracteolate; panicle terminal, pyrainidal-thyrsoid, to about 15 ecm. long and 10 cm. wide, composed of numerous, pairs of eymes, bracteate, its sympodia rather short, somewhat pubeseent, its branches divaricate, regular; prophylla linear or setaceous; calyx turbinate or broadly campanwulate, 2.6-5.2 nmm. long, 2-4.2 mm. wide, strigose-pubeseent or pilose, very lax ,around the corolla-tube, its rim deeply 4-lobed or -split, its lobes; ovate, about 1 mm. long, acute at ap,ex; corolla infundibular or hypocrateri- form, yellowish or whitish, fleshy, its tube narrow-cylindrie, 5-5.2 mm. long, glabrous outside, pubescent within, its lobes 4, ovate- or elliptic- lingulate, 3.1-4.1 mm. long, 2.3-3.1 mm. wide, acute at apex; fruiting-calyx enlarged and indurated, cupuliform, acutely toothed; fruit oblong, obtuse, smooth, 1-4-seeded.
