description: Leaves pubescent above and (almost wholly on the veins) beneath; blades elliptic, acuminate at base and apex, 8-10 cm. wide, 17-20 cm. long, about twice as long as wide, attenuate into stout margined petioles 3-5 cm. long; margins finely denticulate, the teeth dark purple, callose, uniformly spaced, 5-7 per cm., pubescent; pedicels nearly glabrous except at summit, 'in fruit 2-3 mm. in diameter, 12-14 cm. long; flower about 10 cm. long; corolla greenish yellow, the tube 6 cm. long; dorsal lobes 6-7 mm. wide just above base, 35-40 mm. long; lateral and ventral lobes 6-7 mm. wide, 20-25 mm. long; filament-tube about 7 cm. long, glabrous, the filaments united with the corolla for 2 cm. above the base; anthertube about 15 mm. long, 3-4 mm. thick, glabrous or essentially so, the apical tufts of the short anthers yellowish white, up to 2.5 mm. long; hypanthium broadly rounded in anthesis, when pressed 10-12 mm. high and 14-17 mm. broad, prolonged into a neck-like tubular calyx 7-8 mm. wide when pressed, 10-15 mm. long; mature fruit not seen; calyx-lobes arising at slightly different heights from the tube, lanceolate, attenuate into caudate tips, denticulate like the leaves, pubescent especially on the teeth and margins, 5-6 mm. wide at base, 30-40 mm. long.

description: Scandent shrub; stems branched, 2.2-7 mm diam., densely pubescent with arbus-culiform hairs. Lamina elliptic, 3.5-7.5 X 2-4 cm; adaxial surface dark green, sparsely pubescent with arbusculiform hairs; abaxial surface whitish green, moderately pubescent with arbusculiform hairs; margin minutely denticulate; apex rounded; base rounded or obtuse; petiole 4-11 mm long, 2-3.3 mm diam., densely pubescent with arbusculiform hairs. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicels ascending, 60-90 mm long, 1.3-1.5 mm diam., bibracteolate at base, densely pubescent with arbusculiform hairs; bracteoles linear, 2.5-3 X 0.2-0.3 mm. Hypanthium depressed obovoid, 6-7 X 9-10 mm, densely pubescent with arbusculiform hairs. Calyx lobes spreading, linear, 15-19 X 1-1.6 mm, sparsely pubescent with arbusculiform hairs; margin entire or with 1-3 minute denticulations; apex acuminate. Corolla bright red, inside of tube orange, 51-54 mm long, moderately pubescent with arbusculiform hairs; tube suberect, 35-40 mm long, 6-7 mm diam. at base, narrowed to 3-3.5 mm diam. just above the base, then gradually increasing to 8-9 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 14-18 X 4-5 mm, acuminate at apex; lat- eral lobes triangular, falcate, 6-8 X 3-4 mm, acuminate at apex; ventral lobe triangular, deflexed, 5-6 x 3-4 mm, acuminate at apex. Staminal column exserted, emerging above the dorsal lobes; filament tube suberect, 52-55 mm long, 1-1.4 mm diam., pubescent with long white simple hairs; anther tube 2.2-2.3 mm diam., pubescent along the sutures with long simple hairs; dorsal anthers 8-9 mm long; ventral anthers 6.5-7 mm long, with tufts of stiff white hairs 1.3-2 mm long at apex. Mature fruit and seeds not seen.

description: Herba floribus exceptis hirsuta; folia elliptico-oblonga, denticulata; flores longepedicellati, pedicellis bibracteolatis, corollis viridibus; corollae tubus 19 mm. longus (dorsaliter 21 mm.), lobi deflexi, faleati, dorsales 6 mm. lati, 31 mm. longi; filamenta dense pilosa, prope basin corollae tubi inserta, 31 mm. longa; hypanthium in tubum circa 8 mm. longum prolongatum, calycis loborum partes liberi foliacei, 5-7 mm. lati, 16-18 mm. longi; antherae breviores apice sparse fimbriatae (ut in Burmeistera) ; semina lenticularia, ut in Centropogone foveata.

description: Plants hirsute, except the flowers and the upper surfaces of the leaves, with nearly colorless pale brown spreadiuig hairs 1-2 mm. long; leaves elliptic-oblong, broadest at or above the middle, 6-7 cm. wide, 10-12 cm. long, about twice as long as wide and about 4 times as long as the petioles, which are 1.5-3 cm. long; blades rounded at base, narrowed and acute and slightly acuminate at tip, the hairs on the upper surface smaller, fewer, and shorter than on the lower; margins uniformly denticulate with 6-8 small dark callose teeth per cm.; flower 4.5-5 cm. long; corolla-tube about 19 mm. long to the lateral sinuses, 21 to the dorsal, 4-5 mm. wide in the middle when pressed; dorsal lobes 6 mm. wide above the base, about 31 mm. long, the lateral and ventral actually and relatively wider, about 7.5 mm. wide, 25 mm. long; filament-tube about 31 mm. long, densely matted pubescent, the filaments distinct at base about 6 mm., inserted immediately above the base of the corolla; anther-tube yellowish-gray (?), 10 mm. long, glabrous exceept for soft golden hairs on the connectives near base and merging with the pubescence of the filaments, the short anthers fringed apically with 1 or 2 rows of sordid hairs about 1 mm. long; hypanthium nearly glabrous, globose in anthesis and about 10-15 mm. across when pressed, prolonged into a distal tubular portion about 8 mm. long and 10-12 mm. wide when pressed; fruit probably oblate and about 1.5 cm. in diameter (not seen fully mature); calyx somewhat twolipped, the lobes 16-18 mm. long, foliaceous, triangular, callose-denticulate like the leaves, the three dorsal lobes about 5 mm. wide, the two ventral ones about 7 mm.; seeds ovoid-lenticular, the reticulation-pattern as in Centropogon.

description: Essentially glabrous except for the petioles and veins (or the calyx and pedicels puberulent also); blades broadly ovate to elliptic, subaeuminate with blunt acumen, truncate to subcordate or less often aeute at base, up to 9 cm. wide and 14 cm. long (6-8 cm. or less in the infloreseence), 1.4-2.4 times as long as wide, the margins callose-denticulate with 5-7 teeth per cm. and more or less irregularly blunt-toothed in addition; petioles up to 10 cm. long, shorter than the blades; pedicels (30-) 50-80 mm. long, 1-1.5 mm. in diameter, the bracteoles 1 mm. wide or less; flower 4-6.5 cm. long; corolla white, or the lobes mallow-purple (Pennell 10348), papillose on the inner surface, glabrous or sparsely puberulent without; tube 27-47 mm. long to the lateral sinuses (slightly more to the dorsal), 6-10 mm. wide (when pressed) at the widest part; lobes flaring in anthesis, the corolla apparently salverform; dorsal lobes 2.5-4 mm. wide, 9-14 mm. long; lateral and ventral lobes 2.5-6 mm. wide, 7-11 mm. long; filament-tube 30-50 mm. long, not or barely exserted from the corolla-tube; anther-tube 6-7.5 mm. long, glabrous, the apical tuft 1.5 mm. long or less; hypanthium cup-shaped, truncate at base, about 4 mm. high; fruit globose or oblate, 10-12 mm. in diameter (18 according to Gleason) ; calyx-lobes thin and leafy, linear to lanceolate, with very slender blunt tip, callose-denticulate, 2.5-4.5 mm. wide at base, 14-24 mm. long in fruit, with 5-7 prominent parallel nerves.

description: Shrub; stems branched, 1-3 mm diam., sparsely to moderately pubescent with arbusculiform hairs toward apex, glabrescent below. Lamina narrowly elliptic or lanceolate, 2.5-6 X 0.6-1.9 cm; adaxial surface dark green, scabrid; abaxial surface green, pubescent with arbusculiform hairs, primarily on the veins; margin minutely serrulate; apex acuminate; base attenuate or cuneate; petiole 4-17 mm long, 0.3-0.6 mm diam., sparsely to moderately pubescent with arbusculiform hairs. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicels spreading, 35-60 mm long, 0.8-1 mm diam., bi-bracteolate at the base, nearly glabrous; bracteoles linear, 2.5-4.5 X 0.2-0.3 mm. Hypanthium oblate, 3 mm long, 5 mm diam., sparsely pubescent with arbusculiform hairs. Calyx lobes 12 mm long, nearly glabrous, connate basally for 9.5 mm, forming a campanulate tube 7 mm diam. at mouth; free apical portions deltate, 2.5 X 3 mm; apex acuminate. Corolla orange with reddish purple limb, 42 mm long, moderately pubescent with arbusculiform hairs; tube slightly decurved, 30 mm long, 3 mm diam. at middle, gradually increasing to 6 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes falcate, narrowly triangular, 12 X 3 mm, acuminate at apex; lateral lobes falcate, triangular, 6 X 3 mm, acuminate at apex. Staminal column not seen. Berries dark reddish purple, oblate, 8-10 mm long, 9-14 mm diam., crowned by the persistent calyx lobes. Seeds tan, ellipsoid, 0.5-0.7 mm long, 0.3- 0.4 mm diam., the surface minutely foveolate-reticulate.

description: Glabrous herb (or shrub ?) with lanceolate crenate leaves, the blades 1-1.7 cm. wide, 8-18 cm. long, usually about 10 times as long as wide, apparently lustrous and impressed-reticulate above, paler beneath, attenuate to a mucronate or blunt tip, rounded at base or somewhat attenuate to the stout petiole 0.5-1.3 cm. long, the margins with 3-7 low teeth per cm.; flowers about 10; pedicels stiff, spreading or ascending, in fruit 1.5 mm. thick, 85-110 mm. long, the bracteoles basal, filiform or subulate, denticulate, 2.5-7 mm. long; flower 5-6 cm. long; corolla copper-brown (according to Lehmann), the tube 18-22 mm. long, about equally long to lateral and dorsal sinuses, iiearly cylindrical or narrowed in the middle, 5-6 mm. wide when pressed; lobes decurved, falcate, attenuate from the base to tips, the dorsal pair about 4 mm. wide, 20-25 mm. long, the others slightly shorter; filament-tube 30-31 mm. lonig (22-24 in some immature flowers), pubescent, the filaments adnate to the corolla-tube about 5 mm. above base; anther-tube gray, 12 mm. long, bearded along the connectives with stiff golden hairs about 0.5 mm. long, the dense apical tufts of yellowish, soft hairs 1-2 mm. long; hypanthium globose or nearly so in anthesis, about 1 cm. across when pressed, the rim at summit about 1 mm. high; fruit oblate, about 10-12 mm. in diameter and 8-10 mm. high; calyx-lobes oblong or ovate, blunt or acute, entire or sparingly denticulate, 2-3.5 mm. wide, 4-8 mm. long; seeds as in Centropogon generally.

description: Malodorous giant herb; stems erect, 2.2 m tall, 4.8-6 mm diam., pubescent; latex white. Lamina narrowly elliptic or narrowly oblong, 15-22 X 5-6.2 cm; adaxial surface green, sparsely pubescent with short hairs; abaxial surface light green, pubescent with long pale hairs, particularly along the veins; margin irregularly denticulate; apex acuminate; base cuneate; petiole 15-32 mm long, 2-2.5 mm diam., pubescent. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicels ascending at anthesis, recurving af- terward, 130-160 mm long, 2-2.5 mm diam., bibracteolate at base, pubescent; bracteoles linear triangular, 2-3 x 0.3-0.6 mm. Hypanthium campanulate, 17-20 mm long, 13-15 mm diam., pubescent. Calyx lobes triangular, 7-10 X 4-5 mm, pubescent; margin denticulate with 3-5 callose teeth; apex acuminate. Corolla green, 56- 64 mm long, densely pubescent with short clustered hairs; tube suberect, 20-24 mm long, 12-15 mm diam. throughout its length; dorsal lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 32-43 x 5.5-6.5 mm, acuminate at apex; lateral lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 26-31 x 4.5-5 mm, acuminate at apex; ventral lobe narrowly triangular, deflexed slightly, 20-21 x 5-5.5 mm. Staminal column exserted, emerging above the dorsal lobes; filament tube suberect, 46-50 mm long, 3-4 mm diam., pubescent; anther tube decurved, 5-6.5 mm diam., pubescent along the sutures with long curled sordid hairs; dorsal anthers 15-17 mm long; ventral anthers 11-12 mm long, with dense tufts of long curled sordid hairs at apex. Mature berries and seeds not seen.

description: A slender-stemmed herb or shrub, epiphytic and also terrestrial (according to Williams), the upper part of the stem 1-2 mm in diameter; plant puberulent with crisped sordid hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long, the indument dense on the young growth, the petioles, and the veins of the lower leaf-surface, sparse on the stem and the pedicels, the leaves nearly glabrous above; leaves ovate, moderately long-petiolate, the upper ones smaller; blades 1.5-2.5 cm wide, 4-6 cm long, about 2-2.5 times as long as wide, truncate or subcordate at base, acuminate at apex (the entire, narrowly triangular and minutely apiculate tip 4-6 mm long); petioles 5-12 mm long, about 0.7 mm thick; leaf-margins irregularly and shallowly angulate-dentate with 2-3 teeth per cm, and in addition with more numerous and rather evenly spaced sharp erect callose teeth up to 0.4 mm high, 6-8 per cm of margin; flowers few and widely spaced, in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicels slender and flexuous, weakly spreading, 4-6.5 cm long, about 0.7 mm thick, ebracteolate; flower "red" (Williams), about 4 cm long including hypanthium; corolla glabrous within, puberulent without, drying dark purplish-red; tube 26 mm long, straight or slightly curved, constricted above the base and there 1-1.5 mm wide when pressed, then expanded (about 5 mm above base), the distal 2 cm of the tube cylindric, 4-5 mm wide when pressed; lobes erect or essentially so, narrowly elliptic, narrowed at base, acuminate at tips, 1.5-1.8 mm wide, about 10 mm long, subequal, the dorsal pair surpassing the others (the orifice of the tube oblique, and the ventral lobe inserted 2-3 mm lower than the lateral lobes); filament-tube 30-32 mm long, slightly exserted, glabrous, the filaments distinct near the base and fused with the narrow proximal portion of the corolla-tube; anther-tube 5 mm long, bluish-gray, glabrous, the terminal tufts of the short anthers consisting of a few stiff white hairs up to 1 mm long hypanthium in anthesis glabrous, ellipsoid, about 3 mm in diameter, 5 mm. long, rounded at base, somewhat constricted at the mouth below the calyx; calyx-lobes narrowly triangular, entire, about 1 mm wide at base, 2.5-3 mm long, with blunt outcurved tips; corolla, style, and stamens dehiseent from the fruit after anthesis; fruit a globose or subglobose berry, probably about 8 mm in diameter; seeds about 0.6 mm long, ovoid-lenticular, minutely pitted.

description: Suffruticose herb, 0.6 m tall; stems 4-5 mm diam., densely pubescent with white arbusculiform hairs. Lamina elliptic, 6-8 X 2.8-3.2 cm; adaxial surface whitish green, moderately pubescent with white arbusculiform hairs; abaxial surface greenish white, densely pubescent with white arbusculiform hairs; margin minutely denticulate; apex acuminate; base rounded; petiole 13-20 mm long, 1.8-2 mm diam., densely pubescent with white arbusculiform hairs. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicels ascending, flexuous, 80 mm long, 2 mm diam., apparently ebracteolate, densely pubescent with white arbusculiform hairs. Hypanthium hemispheric, 11 mm long, 13 mm diam., densely pubescent with white arbusculiform hairs. Calyx lobes linear, 15 X 1 mm, densely pubescent with white arbusculiform hairs; margin entire; apex acute. Corolla white, 45 mm long, the exterior surfaces moderately pubescent with white arbusculiform hairs; tube slightly decurved, 36 mm long, 12 mm diam. at base, narrowing to 10 mm diam. at middle, then expanding to 19 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes deltate, slightly decurved, 9 X 8 mm, acute at apex; lateral lobes deltate, slightly decurved, 8 X 8 mm, acute at apex; ventral lobe deltate, suberect, 8 X 8 mm, acute at apex. Staminal column exserted, emerging above the dorsal lobes; filament tube suberect, 54 mm long, 1.5 mm diam., densely pubescent with long white simple hairs; anther tube 4.5 mm diam., the sutures densely pubescent with long sordid simple hairs; dorsal anthers 9 mm long; ventral anthers 7.5 mm long. description: Herb or shrub, 0.7-2 m tall; stems branched, 0.3-0.4 cm diam., pubescent; latex white. Lamina elliptic or obovate, 8-19 X 3-9 cm; adaxial surface dark green, glabrous; abaxial surface whitish green, short pubescent particularly along the midrib; margin subentire to minutely denticulate, the teeth inconspicuous; apex rounded or obtuse, rarely acute; base cuneate; petiole 12-30 mm long, 1-1.8 mm diam., pubescent. Inflorescence terminal, racemose, auxotelic, 9-28-flowered; rachis 40-60 mm long, pubescent; bracts narrowly elliptic, elliptic, or obovate, 15-35 x 4-18 mm, persistent, pubescent, obtuse or acute at apex, attenuate at base, the margin denticulate; pedicels ascending at anthesis, reflexed afterward, 20-40 mm long, 0.8-1.4 mm diam., bibracteolate above the base, pubescent; bracteoles linear triangular, 2-3 x 0.2-0.3 mm. Hypanthium depressed hemispherical, 3-5 x 5-7 mm, pubescent. Calyx lobes narrowly triangular, spreading or ascending, 11-13 X 1.5-2.5 mm, pubescent; margin entire or sparsely denticulate; apex acuminate. Corolla orange, 39-43 mm long, pubescent; tube gently curved, 27-33 mm long, 5.5-8.5 mm diam. at base, narrowing abruptly to 4-4.5 mm diam., then increasing gradually to 8.5-10 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes narrowly triangular, recurved, 10-13 x 3.5-4 mm, the apex caudate; lateral lobes triangular, recurved, 6-8 X 2.5-3.5 mm, the apex caudate; ventral lobe triangular, deflexed, 4-6 X 2-3 mm, the apex caudate. Staminal column exsert- ed, emerging between the dorsal lobes; filament tube slightly decurved, 37-43 mm long, 1.1-1.5 mm diam., glabrous; anther tube slightly decurved, 2.2-2.6 mm diam., dense pubescent along the dorsal sutures; dorsal anthers 7.5-9 mm long; ventral anthers 6-7 mm long, with a triangular appendage 1.5-2.2 mm long and tufts of hairs 0.8-1 mm long at apex. description: Herb or subshrub, glabrous except for 3- to 6-celled hyaline cylindric hairs up to 0.5 mm. long, along the rachis and principal veins of the leaves; leaves bi-pinnatipartite, triangular-ovate in outline, 6-8 cm. long, 7-10 cm. wide across the basal "pinnae," borne on very narrowly margined petioles 4-6 cm. long; blades irregularly bipinnatifid or (the upper segments) pinnatifid to dentate, the foliar tissue reduced along the midvein to a wing 1 mm. wide (near base of blade) or 1.5-2 mm. wide (near apex); "pinnae" 4-6 pairs, the lower ones subopposite, pinnately parted and the leafy tissue reduced to a niarrow wing along the midvein; ultimate segments or teeth linear to triangular, mucronate with minute callose teeth; pedicels ascending, [5]-8 cm. long, 1-1.5 mm. in diameter, the bracteoles near the base, 12-16 mm. long, linear, 1 mm. wide or distally 2 mm. wide with 1-2 coarse teeth; corolla [ ?greenish-red, 3 cm. long; tube entire, straight, about 2 cm. long, 4 mm. wide at the middle, widened to the mouth; lobes acute, falcate, sublinear, the dorsal longer, 18 mm. long, 3 mm. wide; lateral and ventral lobes 13 mm. long, 3 mm. wide] ; filaments glabrous, inserted on the corolla 1-2 mm. from base and coherent from 1-2 mm. above this; anther-tube [11 mm. long, 4 mm. in diameter, with white hairs along the commissures], the apical tufts yellowish-white, up to 2.5 mm. long; hypanthium in anthesis globose or nearly so, about 8 mm. across and 8 mm. high when pressed, prolonged into a rim 1-2 mm. high; fruit [oblate, 12 mm. long, 15 mm. wide, crowned by.the persistent calyx-lobes] ; calyx-lobes foliaceous, about 2 cm. long, about 2 mm. wide at base and separated by rounded sinuses, linear or widening to 3 mm. above the middle, with about 4 triangular or linlear teeth up to 2 mm. long on each edge.

description: F rutex sparse ramosus, partes inferiores glabrescentes, superiores dense brunneo-tomentosae. Folia petiolata, herbacea, supra strigosa (pili simplices!), subtus ozotricha et in nervis tomentosa (pili arbusculiformes sicut in petiolis, pedicellis, calycibus, corollis); lamina ovata, 10 x 5 cni, ad apicem acuta vel subacuminata, basi rotundata, margine conferte callose denticulata, nervi secundarii 12 sub angulo subrecto usque fere semirecto ascendentes. Flores in axillis foliorum superiorum solitarii. Pedicelli 4-6 cm longi. Calycis receptacu- lum depresso-globosum, 4 x 6 mm, sepala sublinearia, 4-5 mm longa, erecta. Corolla coccinea lobis intus lutescentibus, circiter 35 mm longa: tubus curvatus, supra basin constrictus ibique ad 2 mm latus, deinde usque ad faucem dilatatus et (in statu compresso) ad 7 mm latus; lobi corollae falcati, inaequilongi, 12-16 mm longi. Filamentorum columna 35 mm longa, pubescens; antherarum tubus 7 mm longus, pilis longis paucis obsitus, 2 inferiores barbatae. Stigma bilobum. Wimm. multis notis differt.

description: Shrub, 1 m tall; stems branched, 3-4 mm diam., densely pubescent with arbusculiform hairs ca. 0.5 mm long; latex white. Lamina elliptic, 8-12 X 3-5.7 cm; adaxial surface green, sparsely pubescent with min- ute arbusculiform hairs; abaxial surface light green, moderately pubescent with arbusculiform hairs; margin minutely denticulate; apex acuminate; base cuneate or attenuate; petiole 13-22 mm long, 1.4-1.8 mm diam., densely pubescent with arbusculiform hairs. description: Herb up to 30 cm. high, the stems and upper surfaces of the leaves sparsely beset with colorless multicellular hairs up to 1 mm. long, otherwise glabrous; leaves very thin, ovate or oblong-ovate, 3-5 cm. wide, 4-9 cm. long, 1.7-2 times as long as wide, the margins sinuate and closely beset with 10-16 teeth per cm., the teeth spreading at right angles, 1-2 mm. long, with dilated base and subulate tip, often uncinate; petioles 2-4 cim. long, margined, often about a third as long as the blades; pedicels 4-7 cm. long in fruit, abruptly once or twice curved near apex, ebracteolate; flower 6-6.5 cm. long; corolla "pale lavender"; tube 4.5-5.5 cm. long to the lateral sinuses, 8-11 mm. wide when pressed; dorsal lobes about 2.5 mm. wide at base, 9 mm. long, the lateral and ventral ones about 4 mm. wide and 7 mm. long; filament-tube 4.5-5.5 cm. long, included; anther-tube about 5 mm. long, gray or yellowish, the long anthers with stiff appressed beard on the apical third, the apical tufts of the short anthers yellowish, about 1 mm. long; hypanthium in anthesis hemispheric or with the base acute, 4-5 mm. wide and high when pressed; fruit oblate, trqicate at the naked apex (as in C. description: Leaves pubescent, sparsely above, more densely so beneath, especially on the rather prominent veins; blades oblong or elliptic to ovate, abruptly acute or acuminate at base and apex, 4-6 (-10) cm. wide, 6-20 cm. lolng, mostly 2-2.5 times as long as wide, usually somewhat attenuate into a (sometimes margined) petiole 1-2 (-4) cm. long and up to 2 mm. in diameter; margins irregularly dentate with 8-15 shallow teeth per cm., the teeth dark-tipped; pedicels pubescent like the stem and leaves, 10-13 cm. long in fruit, when rather strongly ascending; flower 6-7 cm. long; corolla-tube 1.9-2.1 (-2.5) cm. long to the lateral sinuses, 2.5-3 cm. to the dorsal sinus; upper (dorsal) lobes 5-7 mm. wide (about 0.5-1cm. above base), thence attenuate to the decurved tips, 3-4 cm. long; lateral and lower lobes similar, smaller, mostly less than 5 mm. wide; filament-tube 3.3-4 (-4.7) cm. long, up to 2 mm. in diameter, the filaments free at base about 1 cm., glabrous, fused to the corolla-tube about 5 mm.; anther-tube 13-14 mm. long, 3 mm. in diameter, more or less densely pubescent its whole length, and especially distally, with rather stiff sordid yellowish hairs; hypanthium and calyx-lobes glabreseent; fruit about 1.5 cm. high by 2.5 cm. in diameter; calyx-lobes and corolla persistent; calyx-lobes erect, narrowly triangular or oblong and dilated at base, attenuate, 3-5 mm. wide at base, 9-13 (-20) mm. long, with 5-7 dark callose teeth on each edge.

description: Weak terrestrial herb with ascendent, sprawling, fistulous stems up to 1.2 m long and about 7 mm in diameter, moderately pilose above with spreading hyaline trichomes 0.5-1 mm long with dark reddish end walls to the cells, and becoming glabrate below. Leaves numerous, not strikingly nor abruptly reduced in size above; the blades thin to moderately thickened and papery when dry, glabrous to more typically sparingly hyaline and pilose above especially along the impressed veins while beneath characteristically moderately spreading pilose especially along the some- what elevated primary and secondary veins with the trichomes hyaline except at the dark reddish crosswalls; blades ovate-lanceolate to ovate or ovate-oblong, mostly (5)7-12(14) cm long and (1.5)2.5-5(7) cm wide, with an acute apex and a cuneate to more typically broadly rounded to rarely barely truncate base, and with the margins conspicuously dentate with the wide spreading teeth hyaline or dark anthocyanic, about 0.5 mm long and spaced about 1-2.5 mm apart; petioles mostly 1.2 cm long and 1-2 mm in diameter, moderately pilose especially above at least when young. Flowers 7.5-8.5 cm long at anthesis, solitary in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicels 5-12 cm long and about 1.5 mm in diameter, sparingly pilose with spreading trichomes about 0.8-1.2 mm; bracteoles borne about 3-8(12) mm from base of pedicel, linear, 6-10 mm long and about 1 mm wide at base, moderately pilose, entire to sparingly dentate. Corolla magenta or reddish purple, glabrous within, sparingly to moderately pilose to spreading short pubescent externally or densely so near the apex and on the lobes where the stiffer trichomes and the enlarged appendages form a conspicuous fringe 1-1.7 mm long; the tube about 3.5-4.3 cm long, straight or very nearly so, narrowest at the base where about 4 mm in diameter and widest at the mouth where about 7-10 mm in diameter; the lobes in bud strongly arching, in anthesis erect to spreading or even recurved, linear, acute to acuminate, with the upper three about 1.8-2.5 cm long and 2-2.5 mm wide and the three lower 2.2-3 cm long and 2-3 mm wide. Filament tube glabrous, 5-6 cm long, longer than the corolla tube. Anthers 7-11 mm long, bluish gray, glabrous except for the conspicuous tuft of coarse white trichomes about 1.5 mm long, borne apically upon the two shortest anthers. Hypanthium in anthesis turbinate, about 1.2-1.5 cm long, sparingly pilose, acute to slightly rounded at base, gradually widening for about 4/5 of its length and then the sides more or less erect. Calyx lobes linear or narrowly lanceolate, acute, usually obscurely toothed, pilose along margins and externally along the elevated midvein, 1.2-1.5(1.8) cm long and 2-3 mm wide at base.

description: Plants conspicuously hirsute, except the flowers, with nearly colorless pale brown spreading hairs 1-2 mm. long; leaves ovate, the blades 2-3 times as long as the petioles, 3.5-7.5 cm. wide, 7-12 cm. long, about twice as lonig as wide, rather abruptly rounded at base, short-acuminate at apex, the petioles slender, 3-6 cm. long; margins sharply and doubly serrate-dentate, the principal teeth 2-3 per cm., 1-3 mm. high, with smaller callose teeth intervening; flower 4-4.5 cm. long; corolla-tube 11-12 mm. long to the lateral sinuses, 13-15 mm. to the dorsal sinus, 4-5 mm. wide in the middle when pressed,; dorsal lobes 4-6 mm. wide a little above the base, 24-29 mm. long, the lateral alnd ventral relatively wider, 17-20 mm. long; filament-tube pale green, about 27 mm. long, glabrous, the filaments inserted into the corolla-tube above the middle; anther-tube yellowish ( ?), 7.5-8 mm. long, glabrous, the short anthers fringed apically with soft yellowish hairs about 1.5 mm. long; hypanthium nearly glabrous, globose in anthesis and about 10 mm. across and high when pressed, the distal tubular portion 1-2 mm. high; fruit probably oblate, about 1.5 cm. in diameter, 1 cm. high; calyx-lobes ciliate, narrowly triangular, somewhat spreading in anthesis and in fruit, about 3 mm. wide at the dilated base, 9-20 mm. long, conspicuously denticulate with up to 8 callose teeth 1 mm. long, on each edge; seeds ovoid-lenticular, about 0.6 mm. long.

description: Sprawling suffrutescent herbs with erect, ascendent or arching stems 1-2 m long. Stems terete, smooth and glabrous and more or less dark reddish purple below and moderately scurfy pubescent above. Blades of the principal leaves very narrowly elliptic or linear-oblong, 7-15 cm long and 1-2 cm wide, gradually tapering to both the acute or acuminate apex and the acute base, about 5-9 times as long as wide, minutely but densely puberulent both above and beneath when young but moderately to sparingly puberulent above and beneath at maturity especially on the principal veins; margins finely serrulate with usually 4-7 teeth/cm and the teeth dark purple and closely appressed to the blade; venation conspicuously reticulate beneath with the areoles mostly 1-2 mm in diameter; petioles 5-10(-15) mm long, sparingly scurfy-puberulent. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves, 4-5 cm long spreading-ascendent, slender, sparingly to densely puberulent pedicels about 5-9 cm long bearing paired, nearly basal (within 5 mm of base), linear, minutely puberulous bracteoles 1.2-1.7(-2) mm long. Hypanthium moderately to densely and minutely scurfy-puberulent, hemispheric to somewhat urceolate at anthesis, about 4-5 mm high and 5-6 mm in diameter, greenish or greenish and dark purplish; calyx lobes deltoid to triangular, sparingly serrate to entire, acute, glabrous to very sparingly and minutely puberulent, about 1.8-2(-2.2) mm long and 1.8-2 mm wide at base, erect and closely appressed against the corolla. Corolla reddish to reddish orange with yellowish lobes, externally sparingly to moderately and minutely puberulent without, glabrous within; tube 2-2.6 cm long, more or less straight or slightly arching away from the stem, narrowly constricted 3-5 mm above the base to 2-3 mm in diameter, basally fenestrate, gradually enlarging above to 6-8 mm in diameter; lobes strongly deflexed-falcate, narrowly arching-triangular, acute, the upper to about 1.0-1.2 cm long and the lower three about 5-7 mm long. Filament tube 3-3.6 cm long, pale greenish yellow, densely spreading-pubescent with hyaline trichomes; filaments be- coming distinct from one another but fused to the corolla tube at a point just above the basal constriction; anthers 5-7 mm long with the 2 shortest bearing a dense tuft of coarse, stiff white hairs, otherwise glabrous. Berry leathery, little inflated, 7-11 mm in diameter; seeds flattened, oblong-ellipsoid, foveate-reticulate, 0.6-0.7 mm long.

description: Plant with dense brownish pubescence in the young growth, glabrescent; leaves finely rugose-reticulate, lanceolate or elliptic, the upper ones 3.5-6 (-8) cm. wide, 12-15 (-27) cm. long, 3.5-4 times as long as wide, attenuate to a narrow sharp tip, acute or abruptly rounded at base, the petioles stout, 1.5-2 cm. long; upper surfaces glabrous, deeply rugose, the lower surfaces rusty or grayish-brown with fine matted tomentum, only the principal veins prominent; margins often revolute, denticulate with 5-10 small irregularly spaced callosities per cm.; flowers 8-9 cm. long; pedicels wide-spreading in fruit, thinly stellate, the bracteoles 1.5 cm. above base, 1.5 cm. long; pubescence of flowers mostly of stellate hairs, or the hypanthium tomentose; corolla greenish-purple (?), the tube 3-3.3 cm. long, narrowest about the middle, where 8-9 mm. wide when pressed; dorsal lobes 6-8 mm. wide above base, 30-( ?40) mm. long; lateral and ventral lobes free at tips 8-10 mm., united at anthesis into a broad lower lip 2.7-3 cm. long; filament tube about 5 cm. long, thinly short-hirsute; anther-tube about 18 mm. long, 6 mm. in diameter, almost obscured by thick lines of stiff tawny hairs about 2.5 mm. long on the connectives, the shorter anthers with apical tufts of fine stiff yellowish-white hairs about 4 mm. long; hypanthium in anthesis campanulate or obovoid, thinly or densely furfuraceous, prolonged above the ovary into a short rim 3-5 mm. high; fruit probably an ovoid berry about 2-2.5 cm. long; calyx lobes appressed, nearly linear but widest near the middle, where 3-4.5 mm. wide, narrowed to base and to the attenuate but blunt tip, 3-3.5 cm. long, irregularly denticulate.

description: Succulent herb; stems branched, striate, 3.4-4.8 mm diam., minutely pubescent toward apex. Lamina elliptic or ovate, 5.5-9.5 x 2.2-3.8 cm; adaxial surface light green, minutely pubescent along the veins; abaxial surface whitish green, pubescent along the veins; margin serrulate or denticulate; apex acuminate; base cuneate, obtuse, or rounded; petiole 1.5-3 cm long, 1.1-1.6 mm diam., pubescent. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicels ascending in flower, spreading in fruit, 30-40 mm long, 0.7-1 mm diam., bibracteolate just above the base, minutely pubescent; bracteoles lanceolate, 1.1-1.6x 0.4-0.5 mm. Hypanthium globose, 6-6.5 mm long, 6-6.5 mm diam., glabrous. Calyx lobes narrowly triangular, 4.5-5 X 1.5-2 mm; margin ciliate, with 1 or 2 short teeth; apex acuminate. Corolla magenta, 52 mm long, minutely pubescent; tube gently curved, 40 mm long, 4 mm diam. at base, narrowing abruptly to 2 mm diam., then gradually increasing to 6.5 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 12 x 3 mm, acuminate at apex; lateral lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 10 X 2.7 mm, acuminate at apex; ventral lobe triangular, decurved, 7 x 2.5 mm, acuminate at apex. Staminal column scarcely exserted, the anther tube positioned between the dorsal lobes; filament tube 45 mm long, 1.5 mm diam., densely pubescent toward apex; anther tube decurved, 2.7 mm diam., the sutures densely pubescent with long purple hairs; dorsal anthers 6 mm long; ventral anthers 4.5 mm long, with dense tufts of white hairs 2-2.2 mm long at apex. Berry oblate, 13-15 mm long, 15-18 mm diam. Seeds tan, ellipsoid, 0.5-0.6 mm long, 0.3-0.4 mm diam., minutely foveate-reticulate.

description: Giant herb, 4-5 m tall, leaning on surrounding vegetation; stems 4-5 m long, ascending, unbranched, densely pubescent with branched trichomes. Lamina elliptic, 11-19 X 4-7 cm; adaxial surface dark green, dull, moderately pubescent with branched trichomes; abaxial surface olive-green, dull, densely pubescent with branched trichomes; margin denticulate; apex acute or acuminate; base rounded; petiole 6-10 mm long, 2.7-3.4 mm diam., densely pubescent with branched trichomes. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicels ascending, 140-160 mm long, 2.7-3 mm diam., bibracteolate just above the base, densely pubescent with branched trichomes; bracteoles linear, 5-6.5 X 0.8-1 mm, acute at apex. Hypanthium very broadly ovoid, 14-15 x 14-15 mm, truncate at base, densely pubescent with branched trichomes. Calyx lobes lanceolate, erect, 20-25 x 6-7.5 mm, moderately pubescent with branched trichomes; margin minutely denticulate; apex acuminate. Co- rolla light green with red margins, burmeisteroid, 55-56 mm long, the other surfaces densely pubescent with branched trichomes; tube suberect, 23-25 mm long, 11-12 mm diam. at base, gradually increasing to 16-18 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes narrowly triangular, strongly falcate, 30-33 x 6-7 mm, acuminate at apex; ventral lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 22- 23 X 6-6.5 mm, acuminate at apex, connate at base for 3-9 mm. Staminal column exserted, emerging above the dorsal lobes; filament tube light green, erect, 38-41 mm long, 2.4-2.7 mm diam., densely pubescent with long simple trichomes; anther tube 5-5.5 mm diam., slightly decurved, the surfaces densely pubescent with long simple trichomes; dorsal anthers 13-15 mm long; ventral anthers 10-11 mm long. Mature berries and seeds not seen.

description: Leaf-blades oblong or elliptic, less often ovate, acute or attenuate-acuminate at base and apex, (2-) 3-6 cm. wide, (6-) 10-16,cm. long, 2-3 times as long as wide or those subtending pedicels narrower and mostly 2.5-4 timres as long as wide, all rather abruptly attenuate into stout very narrowly margined petioles 0.5-1.5 (-2.5) cm. long; margins irregularly dentate with 8-10 dark gland tipped teeth per cm.; pedicels mostly 12-20 cm. long in fruit, when rather strongly ascending; flower 5.5-7.5 cm. long; corolla-tube 2.6-3.2 cm. long to the lateral sinuses, about the same length to the dorsal sinus, the ventral lobe separated about the same depth; tube narrow (3-5 mm. wide when pressed) for about 2 cm. above base, expanded at very base and also distally, becoming 10-13 mm. wide (pressed flat) at base of lobes; dorsal lobes 5-6.5 mm. wide, 22-27 mm. long, the lateral and lower lobes similar, smaller; filament-tube 3.2-37 (45) mm. long, glabrous or somewhat pilose distally, the filaments distinct about 1.5 cm., fused to the corolla-tube 1 cm. or less; anther-tube "gray" (Pennell), 10-12 mm. long, 3-4 mm. in diameter, more or less densely pubescent at least on the connectives distally with stiff yellow hairs up to 1.5 mm. long, the short anthers tipped with tufts of yellowish-white straight hairs up to 1.5 mm. long; hypanthium in anthesis long-campanulate with straight sides, passing abruptly into the pedicel, 1.2-1.8 cm. long, 0.7-1.1 cm. wide at mouth when pressed flat; fruit ellipsoid, 2.5-3 cm. long, about 1.5 cm. in diameter, pendent, with a narrower neck 2-5 mm. high, and surmounted by the appressed calyx-lobes which are linear, attenuate, 2 mm. wide above the short dilated base, 20-30 (-40) mm. long (often connate 1-2 mm. at base into a short tube surmounting the rim of the hypanthium), glabrous within, with 6-10 (-20) dark callose teeth on each edge.

description: Entirely glabrous except for a few minute broad-based barblike hairs on the calyx-lobes and sometimes on the hypanthium and the distal third of the pedicel; leaves "dark green above, dull green below," mostly lanceolate, varying to ovate or elliptic, (1.5-) 3-5 (-7) cm. wide, (5-) 10-15 cm. long, 2-4 times as long as wide, the margins shallowly crenate-dentate, the teeth 3-5 per cm., callose-tipped; blades acute at base, attenuate into rather short petioles 1-2 cm. long; pedicels 4-7 cm. long and about 0.6 mm. in diameter, ebracteolate; flower about 3 cm. long; corolla "dull rose" or "rich rose," very minutely and sparsely sharp puberulent without; tube 18-20 mm. long to the lateral sinuses and about 2 mm. longer to the dorsal, 6-7 mm. wide when pressed; lobes erect, the dorsal 2-2.5 mm. wide, 5-6 mm. long, the lateral and ventral ones deltoid, about 4 mm. long and 4 mm. wide at base; fllament-tube 20-23 mm-. long; anther-tube about 4 mm. long, "deep blue-lavender" (purplish-black when dry), the apical tufts 1 mm. long; hypanthium in anthesis campanulate, 4-6 mm. long and half or two-thirds as thick; fruit apparently globose, about 10 mm. in diameter; calyx-lobes linguiform, entire but antrorsely barbed, round-tipped, about 1 mm. wide at base, 1.5-2 mm. long, erect but the tips curled outward (in flower and fruit) into a hook or ring; seeds not seen.

description: Young growth arachnoid-pubescent; plants glabreseent, but all parts retaining more or less of a short crisp yellowish-brown puberulence; leaf-blades elliptic, mostly 10-12 cm. wide, 20-27 cm. long, mostly about 2.5 times as long as wide, probably abruptly acute at tip, attenuate into the stout margined petiole 1-1.5 cm. long; margins finely denticulate with 7-8 dark callose teeth per cm.; pedicels up to 21 cm. long; mature flowers not seen; corolla in bud apparently green or greenish-purple, glabrous except for the puberulent veins; filament-tube pubescent; anther-tube (in bud) 4 mm. diameter, 14 mm. long, densely bearded distally on the connectives, the dense yellow apical tufts of hairs up to 3 mm. long; hypanthium (in bud) apparently globose, 7-8 mm. long and broad when pressed; fruit apparently much flattened (oblate), about 12-13 mm. long and 20-23 mm. wide, the calyx-lobes linear, long-pointed, about 2.5 mm. wide at base, 22 mm. long, with 5-6 dark callose teeth on each edge; seeds typical of the genus, the foveolae 15-20 across the broadest face.

description: Whole plant glabrous; leaves ovate-lanceolate, rounded or obtuse at base, attenuate from about the middle, 1.5-3 cm. wide, 4-7 cm. long, 2-2.5 times as long as wide, the margins irregularly serrate with about 4 teeth per cm., the petioles mostly 6-7 mm. long; pedicels 35-60 mm. long, ebracteolate; flowers about 4 -cm. long; corolla red; tube about 25 mm. long to the lateral sinuses, 6-8 mm. wide when pressed; dorsal lobes erect, 2-3 mm. wide at base, 10-12 mm. long, the lateral and ventral ones 3-3.5 mm. wide, 8-10 mm. long; filament-tube 32-34 mm. long, surpassing the corolla-tube 6-8 mm.; anther-tube 4.5-5 mm. long, the apical tufts about 1 mm. long; hypanthium in anthesis cup-shaped, 4-6 mm. long and wide when pressed; fruit oblate, 7-9 mm. in diameter, 6-7 mm. long; calyxlobes subulate, entire, erect, (3-)6-7 -mm. long, about 1 mm. wide above the dilated base, the basal sinuses rounded; seeds slightly flattened, with about 15 foveolae across the widest diameter.

description: A Centropogone incano pube arbusculiformi, lami- na elliptica minore (9-13.5 cm longa, 4-6.5 cm lata), calycis lobis patentibus minoribus (25-30 mm longis, 1-2 mm latis), corollae brevioris (43-45 mm longae) lobis dorsalibus 16-17 mm longis, tubo filamentorum pubescenti, et antheris brevioribus (dorsalibus 12 mm, ventralibus 10 mm) differt.

description: Malodorous shrub; stems 2 m tall, 3.4-5 mm diam., densely pubescent with yellowish white arbusculiform hairs. Lamina elliptic or ovate, 9-13.5 X 4-6.5 cm; adaxial surface green, glabrous; abaxial surface completely covered with yellowish white arbusculiform hairs; apex acute; base cuneate or obtuse; petiole 15-30 mm long, 1.4-2 mm diam., densely pubescent with yellowish white arbusculiform hairs. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicels ascending, 100-120 mm long, 1.4-2.3 mm diam., bibracteolate at base, densely pubescent with yellowish white arbusculiform hairs; bracteoles narrowly oblong, 4-5.5 X 0.7-1 mm. Hypanthium very broadly obovoid or broadly campanulate, 11-12 X 10-12 mm, densely pubescent with yellowish white arbusculiform hairs. Calyx lobes linear, spreading, 25-30 X 1- 2 mm, densely pubescent with yellowish white arbusculiform hairs, though the outer surface sometimes glabrate; margin entire; apex acute. Corolla pale green, burmeisteroid, 43-45 mm long, densely pubescent with yellowish white arbusculiform hairs; tube suberect, 27-28 mm long, 9 mm diam. at base, narrowing to 6-7 mm diam. at mid- dle, and expanded to 13 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 16-17 X 5-5.5 mm, acuminate at apex; lateral lobes narrowly triangular, falcate, 12 x 5-5.5 mm, acuminate at apex; ventral lobe narrowly triangular, deflexed, 11 X 5-5.5 mm. Staminal column exserted, emerging above the dorsal lobes; filament tube suberect, 43-46 mm long, 1.4-1.8 mm diam., sparsely pubescent with long simple pale hairs; anther tube 4.5-5 mm diam., densely pubescent with long simple sordid hairs; dorsal anthers 12 mm long; ventral anthers 10 mm long, with dense tufts of yellowish hairs 2-3 mm long at apex. Mature berries and seeds not seen.

description: Vine; stems 0.4-0.5 cm diam., glabrous below, sparsely short pubescent above. Leaves glabrous; lamina elliptic, 29-30 X 7.5-8.5 cm, dark green adaxially, lighter abaxially; margin shallowly crenulate; apex acuminate, base attenuate; petiole 2-3 cm long, 1.7-1.8 mm diam. Inflorescence ter- minal, racemose, lax, anauxotelic, strictly pendent, 30-35-flowered, but only a few flowers present at any time, the flowers non-resupinate; peduncle 125 mm long, 4 mm diam., sparsely to moderately short pu- bescent; rachis 100 mm long, moderately to densely short pubescent; bracts persistent, linear or narrowly oblong, 10-15 X 1.5-2.5 mm, acute at apex; pedicels spreading, 8-9 mm long, 0.5-0.8 mm diam., bibracteolate above the base, densely short pubescent; bracteoles linear or narrowly oblong, 2.5-3 X 0.3-0.4 mm, acute at apex. Hypanthium subglobose, 3 X 3.2 mm, moderately short pubescent. Calyx lobes narrowly triangular, 5-5.5 X 1.5-2 mm, moderately short pu- bescent; margin entire; apex acute, reflexed. Corolla red, 11-13 rnm long, densely short pubescent; tube suberect, 7-8 mm long, 2 mm diam. at base and mouth, narrowed to 1.4 mm diam. at middle; dorsal lobes tri- angular, falcate, 4-5 X 2 mm, acuminate at apex; ventral lobes triangular, deflexed, 2.5-3 X 1 mm, acuminate at apex. Staminal column included, 9-11 mm long; anther tube densely pubescent with long tri- chomes, the ventral two with a triangular scale 4.5 mm long and 2 mm wide at base. Fruit and seeds not seen.

description: Herba diffusa terrestris ad 1.5 m longa, ramulis minute puberulis. Folia ovato-lanceolata usque ovato-oblonga, 6-15 cm longa et 2-5.5 cm lata, nervis subtus puberulis, pilis 0.1-0.3 mm longis; pedicelli glabri, 6-10 cm longi; bracteolae 3-5(6) mm longae, ? glabrae; corollae tubus (3.5)4-5 cm longus, puberulus, lobis non fimbriatis, 2-2.8 cm longis; hypanthia glabra; calyces lobi glabri, 0.7-1.1 cm longi.

description: Weak terrestrial herb with ascendent, sprawling, fistulous stems up to 1.5 m long and about 4-9 mm in diameter, very sparingly puberulous above with trichomes less than 0.3 mm long or more typically glabrous throughout. Leaves numerous, not strikingly nor abruptly reduced in size above; the blades thin and papery when dry, glabrous above except for the dense puberulence along the impressed midvein while beneath very inconspicuously but abundantly crispy-puberulous on the elevated prin- cipal veins with hyaline trichomes less than 0.3 mm long; blades ovate-lanceolate to ovate-oblong, mostly (6)8-12(15) cm long and (2.0)2.5-4(5.5) cm wide with an acute to even somewhat acuminate apex and a rounded to somewhat cordate base and with the margins conspicuously but finely dentate with the strongly divergent, pale yellowish teeth about 0.5 mm long or less and spaced mostly about 1 mm apart; petioles mostly (0.8)1-1.5(1.8) cm long and 1-1.5 mm in diameter, sparsely to moderately puberulous especially in the furrowed groove above. Flowers 7-9 cm long at anthesis, solitary in the axils of the upper leaves; pedicels mostly 6-10 cm long and about 1.5 mm in diameter, glabrous; bracteoles borne about 2-6 mm from base of pedicel, linear, 3-5(6) mm long and about 0.4-0.9 mm wide, often recurved, glabrous or sparingly puberulous along the margin, entire. Corolla bright reddish purple, glabrous within, very sparingly and minutely short pubescent externally with the trichomes mostly less than 0.1 mm long except on the margins of the lobes where they are up to 0.5 mm long, fringeless; tube about (3.5)4-5 cm long, straight or nearly so, narrowest at the base, where about 3-5 mm in diameter and widening gradually to the mouth where about 5-10 mm in diameter; lobes in bud strongly arching, in anthesis erect to spreading or even recurved, linear, acute to acuminate with the upper three about 2-2.6 cm long and 2-3 mm wide and the two lower about (2) 2.3-2.8 cm long and 2.5-4 mm wide. Filament tube glabrous, pale purplish, longer than the corolla tube, 5-6 cm long. Anthers about 7-10 mm long, bluish gray, glabrous except for the conspicuous tuft of coarse white trichomes 1.5-2.5 mm long borne apically on the two shortest anthers. Hypanthium in anthesis turbinate, about 1.2-1.6 cm long, glabrous, acute at base, gradually widening for about 4/W of its length and above that the sides more or less erect; in fruit up to 2.2 cm long and basally rounded. Calyx lobes narrowly triangular to lanceolate, acute, entire to obscurely toothed, glabrous, about 0.7-1.1 cm long and 1.8-2.5 mm wide at base.

description: Sparsely but prominently and uniformly hirsute with flaccid pale brown or colorless hairs up to about 1.5 mm. long, these many-celled (cells often about 10), attenuate, densely aggregated on the young growth, the petioles, pedicels and veins of the lower surfaces of the leaves; leaves very thin, ovate, 4-9 cm. wide, 6-17 cm. long, 1.3-2.1 times as long as wide, coarsely and irregularly toothed, both the larger teeth and the intervening small ones tipped with dark glandular callosities; petioles 0.5-3(-6) cm. long, usually one-eighth to one third as long as the blades, conspicuously margined and appearing stout; pedicels 2-2.5 cm. long, ebracteo- late; flower 5-6.5 cm. long; corolla bright red ("crimson," according to Mexia), densely or sparingly beset with spreading flaccid colorless or reddish 2- to 6-celled hairs 1 mm. long or less; tube 40-47 mm. long to the lateral sinuses, 7-9 mm. wide when pressed; lobes erect, the dorsal 2-4 mm. wide, 6-11 mm. long, the lateral and ventral 3-4 mm. wide, 6-9 mm. long; filament-tube 40-45 mm. long, about the length of the corolla-tube measured to the dorsal sinus; anther-tube 6-6.5 mm. long, sparsely hairy especially distally, the apical tufts white, about 1 mm. long; hypanthium in anthesis conic, attenuate into the- pedicel, 4-6 mm. wide and 6-8 mm. long when pressed; fruit obovoid, truncate at the naked apex (corolla, stamens and style deciduous cleanly, soon after anthesis), 6-7 mm. in diameter, 10-13 mm. long, topped by the weakly erect calyx-lobes which are linear- subulate, entire, usually uncinate, 1.5-2 mm. wide at base, (3-)6-10 mm. long; seeds rather dark brown, the foveolae conspicuously walled, about 10 across the widest diameter.

description: Sprawling to erect, suffrutescent herbs with stems 1-1.5 m tall. Stems terete, smooth and glabrous, and dark reddish purple below and moderately scurfy pubescent above. Blades of the principal leaves narrowly elliptic to more typically linear- lanceolate, (7-) 10-18(-24) cm long and 1-2.2 (-3.5) cm wide, apically acute to more typically somewhat acuminate and more or less rounded or gradually tapering into an acute base, about 5-10(-12) times as long as wide, minutely and moderately to densely puberulent both above and beneath when young but becoming sparingly to moderately and minutely puberulent above and beneath at maturity especially along the principal veins; margins conspicuously but finely denticulate with usually 6-10 teeth/cm and the teeth dark purplish and strongly divergent; margin finely purple- lined; venation finely but conspicuously reticulate beneath with the areoles 0.5-1 mm in diameter; petioles mostly 0.5-1.2 mm long, scurfy puberulent. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves, 4-5 cm long on spreading-ascendent, slender, sparingly to densely scurfy-puberulent, pedicels 5-9 cm long, bearing paired, basal, linear, glabrate or very sparingly and minutely scurfy-puberulous bracteoles (2.5-)3-5 mm long. Hypanthium sparingly to moderately, minutely scurfy-puberulent, hemispheric to urceolate at anthesis, about 4-5 mm high and 4-5 mm in diameter, greenish or both greenish and dark purple; calyx lobes narrowly triangular, sparingly to moderately serrulate, acute, glabrous to very sparingly puberulent, about (2-) 2.5-4 (-6) mm long and 1.5(-2) mm wide at base, erect and closely appressed against the corolla. Corolla reddish orange to orange with reddish lobes, sparingly to moderately and minutely puberulent without, glabrous within; tube 2-2.6(-3) cm long; more or less straight or slightly arching away from the stem, constricted 3-6 mm above the base to 1.5-3 mm in diameter, basally fenestrate but often tardily so, gradually enlarging above to 7-9 mm in diameter; lobes deflexed-falcate, narrowly arching-triangular to linear, acute to acuminate with the upper two lobes about 1.0-1.5(-2.1) cm long and the lower three about (6-)8-12 mm long. Filament tube (3.3-)3.5-4(-4.2) cm long, pale greenish yellow, densely spreading pubescent with hyaline trichomes; filaments becoming distinct from one another but then fused to the corolla tube at a point just above the basal constriction; anthers about 5-8 mm long with the 2 shortest bearing a dense tuft of coarse, stiff white hairs 1-2 mm long and otherwise glabrous. Berry leathery, little inflated, 7-12 mm in diameter; seeds flattened, oblong-ellipsoid, foveate-reticulate, 0.6-0.7 mm long.

description: "Berba succulenta, 40 cm alta crassis radicibus, floribus purpureis" (collect.). Caulis viridis, glaber, fistulosus, internodia foliorum 1.5 cm longa. Lamina foliorum oblonga, 8-14 x 2.7-6 cm, in apicem brevemr acuminata, ad basin in petiolum crassum brevem indefinitum angustata, margine dentibus glandulaceis intramarginalibus munita, membranacea, obscure viridis, opaca, subtus nervi laterales plani, circiter 11 sub angulo 45-60 curvatim ascendentes, folia superiora inflorescentiam subumbellatam parum superantia. Pedunculus terminalis, glaber, 6 cm longus. Bracteae foliaceae, pedicellos circiter aequantes. Pedicelli ad 16 mm longi. Hypanthium depresso-globosum, 5 x 8 mm, glabrum; limbus 5-fidus, 12 mm longus, lobi longitudine 7 mm connati, eorum partes liberae ovatae acutae denticulatae, 5 mm longae. Corolla ampla, 32 mm longa: tubus e basi dilatata ad 6 mm attenuatus, fauce inflatus (13 mm latus, si compressus); lobi falcati, triangulares, inaequales. Filamenta hirta; antherarum tubus 8 mm longus, in suturis 3 dorsalibus dense hirtus, 2 inferiores appendice cartilaginea terminatae. Cetera non visa.

description: Minutely puberulent throughout, the leaves glabrate on the upper surfaces, the puberulence sometimes very sparse; leaves ovate or broadly lanceolate, acutely pointed from about the middle, often slightly cordate at base, 2-5 cm. wide, 5-12 cm. long (sometimes smaller in the infloreseence), usually 1.6-2 times as long as wide, the margins doubly and irregularly dentate with narrow erect teeth, the principal teeth 3-6 (-8) per cm., about 1 (-2) mm. high; petioles much shorter than the blades, 1-2.5 cm. long; pedicels up to about 9 cm. long, 1 mm. in diameter, the filiform bracteoles 7 mm. long or less; flower 4.5-6.5 cm. long; corolla red; tube 40-60 mm. long to the lateral sinuses, 5-6 mm. wide at the mouth when pressed; dorsal lobes erect, often appressed to the stamens in dried material, linear or narrowly triangular, 2.5-3.5 mm. wide at base, 8-11 mm. long; filamenttube 45-57 mm. long, but slightly exserted beyond the dorsal sinus of the corolla; anther-tube 5-7 mm. long, the apical tufts 1-1.5 mm. long; hypanthium cupshaped or globose in anthesis, about 5 mm. wide when pressed, rounded at base; mature fruit probably oblate, about 7 mm. in diameter; calyx-lobes linear or subulate, dilated at base, 1-2 mm. wide, 6-10 (-12) mm. long, with several slender callose teeth on each side.

description: Herb; stems erect, 1.4-1.5 mm diam., minutely pubescent toward apex. Lamina ovate, 6-9.5 X 2.5-4 cm, green, membranaceous, thin, glabrous; margin coarsely double-serrate with 2-3 callose-acuminate teeth per cm; primary teeth narrowly tri- angular, 2.5-4.5 x 1.6-2.2 mm; secondary teeth deltate, 0.5-1 x 0.5-1 mm; apex acuminate; base truncate or subcordate; petiole 8-20 mm long, 0.7-1 mm diam., minutely pubescent. Flowers solitary in the axils of upper leaves; peduncle ascending, recurved after anthesis, 48-53 mm long, 0.7-0.8 mm diam., ebracteolate, glabrous. Hypanthium broadly ellipsoid, 4.8 x 3.7 mm, glabrous. Calyx lobes narrowly triangular, 3.5-4 x 0.7 mm, glabrous; margin entire; apex acuminate, tightly recurved. Corolla 46-47 mm long, red, glabrous; tube slightly curved, 32-33 mm long, 3.3 mm diam. at base, narrowing to 2.7 mm diam. above the base, then gradually expanding to 8.8 mm diam. at mouth; dorsal lobes narrowly triangular, spreading, 14 X 2.3 mm, acuminate at apex; ventral lobes narrowly triangular, spreading, 13 x 2.7 mm, acuminate at apex. Staminal column exserted, emerging between the dorsal lobes; filament tube suberect, 43 mm long, 0.5 mm diam., gla- brous; anther tube slightly curved, 1.9 mm diam., its surfaces sparsely pubescent toward apex; dorsal anthers 5.5 mm long; ventral anthers 4.5 mm long, with sparse tufts of hairs 1.2-1.5 mm long at apex. Mature berries and seeds not seen.

description: Leaves up to about 10 cm. wide and 30 cm. long; bracteoles 8-15 mm. long; pubescence partly of simple hairs, the stellate hairs sometimes obscured by the others; corolla cream-yellow or tinged purplish; filament-tube 4-4.5 cm. long, distally pilose; anthers "slate-color" (St. John); calyx-lobes linear-attenuate (or slightly wider near base), 2-4 mm. wide at base, 20-35 mm. long.

description: Reportedly an erect herb with fistulate stems up to 1.2 m tall and 4 mm in diameter becoming glabrous below but moderately to densely pilose above on the youngest growth. Trichomes on the vegetative and floral organs 1-1.8 mm long, tawny, with the end walls of the cells clearly visible under 40X magnification. Blades of the principal leaves ovate to ovate-oblongish, 7-9 cm long and 4.4-5.2 cm wide, abruptly short-acuminate at apex with the tapered tip about 1 cm long, broadly rounded at base, about 1.8 times as long as wide, densely pilose on both upper and lower surfaces and then appearing tomentose but in maturity inconspicuously pilose with the more or less appressed trichomes restricted to the principal veins and more abundant on the reddish purple lower surface than on the green upper surface; margins inconspicuously crenate-serrate with the individual yellowish callose teeth bent toward the apex and often not projecting beyond the edge of the blade, with about 4-7 teeth/cm; venation irregularly reticulate beneath with slightly elevated primary-tertiary veins; petioles 1.5-3.2 cm long, sparingly and inconspicuously pilose at maturity. Flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves, about 3.5-4 cm long on spreading, ascendent, slender, flexuous, sparingly to moderately pilose pedicels 7-9 cm long bearing paired, nearly basal (within 3-7 mm of base), linear, pilosely ciliate bracteoles 2.2-3 mm long. Hypanthium sparingly pilose especially along the nerves, in anthesis hemispheric, about 4.5 mm high and 6-7 mm in diameter; calyx lobes linear to very narrowly triangular, sparingly serrulate, acute, marginally ciliate but with glabrous surfaces about 4-5 mm long and 2 mm wide or less at base and mostly 1 mm wide or less, erect. Corolla "scarlet," externally more or less appressed pilose with the trichomes evenly distributed and not restricted to the rather prominently developed nerves, internally glabrous; tube about 2 cm long, more or less straight or slightly arching away from the stem, only slightly constricting about 3 mm from base to 2.5-3 mm in diameter and then very gradually expanding to a diameter of about 6 mm, basally fenestrate but apparently tardily so; lobes deflexed, falcate, narrowly arching-triangular to linear, acute to acuminate with long tapering tips, and the upper two lobes about 12 mm long and the lower three lobes about 6-8 mm long. Filament tube about 26 mm long and hence shorter than the corolla, copiously spreading pubescent with soft, hyaline trichomes; filaments becoming distinct from one another and fused to the corolla tube just above the constriction or about 5 mm from base; anthers about 5-7 mm long with the two shortest bearing a dense tuft of coarse, stiff white hairs 1-1.8 mm long and with only a few stiff trichomes borne on the dorsal surface. Fruit and seed unknown.

description: Tree, the young branches puberulous soon becoming glabrous. Leaf laminas elliptic, chartaceous, 9-16 cm long, 3.5-6.5 cm broad, rounded to subcuneate at base, apiculate at apex, the acumen 2-8 mm long, glabrous above, with a short appressed-lanate caducous pubescence beneath, midrib prominent on both surfaces, secondary veins 12-14 pairs, plane above, prominent beneath, tertiary venation prominulous ±parallel and at 90º to primary veins; petioles 4-7 mm long, tomentellous becoming glabrous with age, rugulose, canaliculate above, eglan- dular. Stipules linear-lanceolate, tomentellous, to 6 mm long, very early ca- ducous. Inflorescences of terminal and axillary little-branched panicles with cen- tral rachis and short 2-3-flowered branches, or of racemes, the rachis and branches puberulous. Bracts and bracteoles lanceolate to ovate, to 2 mm long, persistent, puberulous. Receptacle cylindrical, 7-8 mm long, sparsely grey-puberulous externally, glabrous within except for deflexed hairs at throat; pedicels ca 1 mm long. Calyx lobes rounded, 2.5 mm long, puberulous externally. Petals 5, white, the margins ciliate. Stamens 20-23, unilateral, the arc of the circle opposite to them toothed. Ovary tomentose. Style pubescent on lower portion only. Fruit ovoid, ±5 cm long x 4 cm broad, the exterior hard and smooth or crustaceous when dry, glabrous, mesocarp woody, 6-10 mm thick when dry, endocarp thin and bony, glabrous within.

description: Arbor ad 27 m alta, ramulis juvenilibus omnino glabris. Folia alternata, petiolata, petiolo 10-12 mm longo, glabro, subtus leviter canaliculato; laminae ellipticae, coriaceae, 9-11.5 cm longae, 3.8-5.3 cm latae, basi cuneatae, apice in acuminem 10-15 mm longum contractae, utrinque glabrae, costa media utrinque prominula, glabra, nervis secundariis 6-8-jugis, utrinque fere planis. Stipulae caducae (haud visae). Flores in paniculis pendulis dispositi, pedunculis ad 75 cm longis, pendentibus, glabris, ramis inflorescentiaque glabris, ramis numerosis, brevibus. Bracteae bracteo- laeque 0.5-1.5 mm longae, acutae, praeter margines leviter ciliatos glabrae. Re- ceptaculum campanulatum, tubo 4-6 mm longo in floribus adultis, in pedicellum 10-15 mm longum tenuem attentuato, intus extusque glabro. Calycis lobi 5, rotundati, inaequales, 2 quam ceteri majores, juveniles extus sparse puberuli, margine ciliati, 2 lobi extus glandibus duobus sessilibus muniti. Petala 5, glabra, rubra, caduca. Stamina 16-21, unilateralia, staminodiis ca. 8 dentiformibus opposita. Ovarium sparse villosum. Stylus e basi ovarii ortus, glaber, basim versus complanatus. Fructus mihi ignotus.

description: Tree to 25 m tall, the young branches puberulous soon becoming glabrous. Leaf laminas oblong to oblong-lanceolate, membranous to coriaceous, 4.5-16.5 cm long, 2.2-5.5 cm broad, rounded to subcuneate at base, acuminate at apex, the acumen 5-18 mm long, glabrous above, densely gray- to brown-lanate, or glabrous, or with a sparse caducous pubescence beneath, frequently with two glands at junction with petiole; secondary veins 10-15 pairs, plane above, prom- inent beneath; midrib prominulous above, prominent beneath; petioles 3-9 mm long, canaliculate above, pubescent when young, becoming glabrous and rugose with age. Stipules 1-3 mm long, linear, early caducous. Inflorescence a terminal and axillary little-branched panicle or raceme, the rachis and branches sparsely puberulous to glabrous. Bracts and bracteoles minute, membranous, ovate, ca- ducous. Receptacle cylindrical to subcampanulate, 4.5-10 (12) mm long, 1-2.5 mm broad below calyx, sparsely puberulous to glabrous externally, glabrous with- in except for deflexed hairs around throat; pedicels 0.5-4 mm long. Calyx lobes rounded, 2-2.5 mm long, puberulous or glabrous externally. Petals 5, white, ciliate. Stamens 14-30, unilateral, inserted around half of circle with short stam- inodes opposite them. Ovary villous. Style pubescent for at least half its length. Fruit rounded to ovoid, 3-4 cm long, 2.5-3 cm broad; epicarp smooth, glabrous; mesocarp thin, fleshy; endocarp thin, fragile, granular in texture, glabrous within.

description: Arbor mediocris ramis terminalibus fuscis nitidulis breviter puberulis denique glabris. Folia simplicia alterna coriacea. Lamina lanceolata vel elliptico-lanceolata basi cuneata apice acuta vel acuminata margine integerrima 9-14 cm longa 3-6 cm lata; supra glaberrima in sicco brunneo-olivacea subreticulato-scrobiculata costa impressa nervis secundariis filiformibus conspicuis; subtus siccitate brunnea costa eminenti striolata nervis secundariis ascendenti-arcuatis prominentibus 5-6 utroque latere circa marginem evanescentibus, nervis tertiis transversis filiformibus paulo prominulis sed conspicuis sub-remotis, reliquis venulis minute reticulatis, superficie subscrobiculata visu glabra sed minutissimis setis adpressis sub lente visibilibus praedita. Inflorescentiae in paniculis pauciramosis axillaribus sub-terminalibusque, in specimine ad 7 cm longae (statu fructifero), axi ramulisque moderate sericeo-pubescentibus angulosis. Flores racemose dispositi sessiles. Hypanthium fructiferum crassum 5-6 mm longum pubescens. Sepala (post anthesim) ovata obtu- siuscula vel acuminata 3-6 mm longa 3-4 mm lata, pubescenti-villosa. description: Arbor magna ramis terminalibus griseis vel brunnescentibus rugulosis lenticellatis glabris. Folia simplicia alterna rigide coriacea. Petiolus crassus rigidus 5-8 mm longus glaber. Lamina oblongo-elliptica basi totundata, apice subite angustata acutaque, margine integra, 10-12 cm longa, 4-5 cm lata; supra glabra nitida costa notata nervis secundariis filiformibus conspicuis; subtus ochracea vel ochraceo-cinerea tomento sublanato-squamuloso adpressissimo tecta, costa robusta elevata glabra nervis secundariis prominentibus circa 16 utroque latere ascendentibus parallelis 4-7 mm inter se distantibus, ceteris nervulis cum tomento velatis. Inflores centiae thyrsoideo-paniculatae terminales multiflorae folia suprema non attingentes axi ramisque robustis dense ochraceo-tomentosis, bracteis oblongo-ovatis acuminatis amplectentibus crassiusculis tomentosis 6-8 mm longis a floribus brevioribus. Flores pedicellatis pedicellis brevibus crassis tomentosis 1-2 mm longis. Hypanthium tubulosum crassum 10 mm longum extus tomentosum intus praeter faucem satis villosam glabrum. Sepala crassiuscula oblonga obtusiuscula 5-5.5 mm longa 2.5-3 mm lata utrinque dense villoso-tomentosa. Petala ovato-acuminata membranacea acutissima 5 mm longa 2.5 mm lata margine longe ciliata faciebus glabra. Stamina crebrissima margine hypanthio in orbem completum disposita filamentis glabris filiformibus flexuosis 8-10 mm longis. Antherae orbiculato-ellipticae 0.8 mm longae. description:
Perennis. Caules pauci, simplices, fere glabri. Folia brevipetiolata, cordata, marginibus undulato-crenata, utrinque parce albido-pilosa. Flores solitarii, pedunculati, pedunculis 2.5-8.5 cm longis, fere glabris. Calyx breviter (vix ad tertiam partem) dentatus, pilis nigris brevibus hirsutus. Corolla purpurea, brevissime 5-loba, lobis mucronatis, tubo laevi.

Perennial herb, 20-30 cm high, provided with a few minute scales at the base. Stems few, ascending, unbranched, terete, ridged, glabrescent to minutely pubescent, the trichomes straight, slightly curved at apex, 0.6 mm long. Leaves alternate, shortly petio- late, the petiole 0.5-2 mm long, terete, mi- nutely pubescent, the trichomes similar to those of the stem, the blade cordate, 1-2 cm long, 0.5-1.1 cm broad, broadest at the base, apex subacute, undulatecrenate, the margins plane, both surfaces softly silky tomentose, the trichomes straight, 0.3 mm long, the costa and lateral veins (4-6 pairs) not prominent, the veinlets reticulate, the venation of the upper surface inconspicuous. Flowers solitary and terminal at the branch-tips; peduncle elongate, 2.5-8.5 cm long, terete, glabrescent, at the apex minutely pubescent; calyx brownish, cylindrical, 1 cm long, 0.6 cm broad, shortly 5-dentate, the lobes 3 mm long, 3 mm broad at base, triangular and acute, hirsute, with short, straight, rigid black hairs, the hairs 0.5 mm long; corolla purple, broadly campanulate, 2.5-3 cm long, 2 cm broad at apex, abruptly narrowed to the throat, the throat glabrous, 7 mm broad, the lobes 5, 4 mm high, 8 mm broad, erect, obovate, mucronate; stamens 5, 1-1.5 cm long, the anthers cordate-ovate, connate around the style; pistil 1.5-2 cm long, the stigma capitate. Capsule not seen.

description: Arbor circa 8 m alta ramis griseis rugosis terminalibus rubescentibus nitidis sparsis pilis longis rigidissimis patulisque praeditis. Folia simplicia alterna coriacea flexilia. Petiolus crassus 2-4 mm longus rubescens glaber vel sparsis pilis rigidis longis patulisque. Lamina subovato-lanceolata basi rotundata emarginataque apice angustato-acuminata acuta margine integerrima 6-10 cm longa 1.6-3.5 cm lata; supra glabra nitidula in sicco oliva- ceo-viridis sed costa notata rubescenti, nervis secundariis et nervulis minute reticulatis prominulis; subtus pallidior visu glabra costa eminenti, nervis secundariis 6-8 utroque latere notatis patulis marginem versus arcuatis anasto- mosantibus, reliquis nervulis immersis subobsoletis sublaxe reticulatis. Pedi celli patuli rigidi pubescenti- hirtuli 3-5 mm longi. Bypanthium cupuliforme 1.5 mm latum intus nitidum tantum sursum coroniforme hispidum. Sepala ovato-elliptica obtusa 2.5 mm longa 2 mm lata extus sparse longeque pubescentia intus minute denseque pubescenti-tomentella. Petala rosea elliptica vel rotundata 2 mm longa circa 1.5 mm lata. Stamina 6 unilateralia filamento rubro glabro anthera elliptico-orbiculari 0.4-0.5 mm ampla. Ovarium longissime densissimeque hispidum (pilis rigidis circa 1 mm longis). description: Frutex ad 3 m alta, ramulis juvenilibus puberulis mox glabris. description: Shrub 2 m tall, the young branches sparsely hirsutulous soon becoming gla- brous. Leaf laminas chartaceous, oblong, 6-9.5 cm long, 2.5-3.8 cm broad, rounded at base, acuminate at apex, the acumen 9-14 mm long, glabrous beneath except for a few stiff appressed hairs on venation; secondary veins 8-11 pairs, prominulous on both surfaces, midrib prominulous above, prominent beneath; petioles 2-2.5 mm long, sparsely tomentellous, terete, eglandular. Stipules mi- nute, persistent, ca 1 mm long, tomentellous. Inflorescences 8-12 cm long, of little-branched panicles with a central rachis and small lateral branches bearing 2-3 flowers only, the rachis and branches very sparsely hirsutulous. Bracts and bracteoles 1-1.5 mm long, lanceolate, persistent, with sessile glands on some, and caducous bracteoles with large terminal gland present only in buds. Flowers 6-7 mm long. Receptacle campanulate, with a few sparse appressed hairs on exterior, glabrous within except at throat; pedicels 5-7 mm long, sparsely ap- pressed hirsute. Calyx lobes reflexed in open flowers, acute, hirsutulous exter- nally, densely gray-tomentellous within, the margins eglandular. Petals 5, gla- brous. Stamens 6, unilateral, the filaments glabrous, or with a few hairs on lower 10 mm, free to base, far exceeding calyx lobes. Style hirsute up to one third of length. Ovary inserted near mouth of receptacle, villous. Fruit not seen.

description: Tree 4 m tall, the young branches densely ferrugineous tomentose. Leaf laminas oblong-elliptic 10.5-12 cm long, 4.8-5.7 cm broad, coriaceous, shortly and abruptly acuminate at apex, the acumen 1-3 mm long, cordate at base, glabrous and shiny above, with sparse appressed hirsute pubescence on lower surface; midrib prominulous above, prominent and appressed-hirsute beneath; secondary veins 10-13 pairs, prominulous above, prominent beneath, tertiary venation prominulous on both surfaces; petioles 1-3 mm long, terete tomentellous. Stip- ules lanceolate, to 5 cm long, caducous, eglandular. Inflorescences of terminal and axillary panicles with central rachis and short, densely clustered lateral branches bearing 2-4 flowers, the rachis and branches tomentellous. Bracts and bracteoles 1-3 mm long, triangular to lanceolate, persistent, with numerous stip- itate tack-like glands. Flowers 5-7 mm long. Receptacle campanulate, tomen- tellous externally, glabrous within except for reflexed hairs at throat; pedicels 3-7 mm long. Calyx lobes acute, eglandular, tomentellous externally, puberulous within. Petals 5. Stamens 6, unilateral, the filaments far exceeding calyx lobes. Style sparsely hirsute on lower fourth. Ovary inserted at mouth of receptacle, pilose. Fruit not seen.

description: Shrub or small tree, the young branches lanate, becoming glabrous with age. Leaves 2-9 cm long, 1-4.2 cm broad, the lamina oblong, thickly coriaceous, retuse to rounded at apex, cuneate to subcuneate at base, glabrous above when mature, with a gray-lanate easily removed pubescence beneath; petioles 2-4 mm long, terete, lanate when young, soon glabrescent, smooth. Stipules lanceolate, membranous, lanate, caducous. Inflorescences small terminal and axillary cymules or panicles of cymules 5-25 mm long, the rachis and branches puberulous. Bracts and bracteoles chartaceous, pubescent, 1-2 mm long. Flowers 1.5-2 mm long; pedicels ca 1 mm long. Receptacle campanulate, gray-puberulous externally, tomentose within. Calyx lobes acute, gray-puberulous on both faces. Petals 5, glabrous. Stamens 7 or 8, unilateral, with tooth-like staminodes opposite. Ovary bilocular with one ovule in each loculus, pilose on exterior, inserted on middle of receptacle tube or towards its base. Style pilose at base, glabrous above. Fruit ellipsoid and gradually tapered towards base, bilocular, 11-15 mm long; epicarp smooth, glabrous; mesocarp thin, fleshy; endocarp thin, hard, bony, densely lanate- tomentose within.

description: Tree, the young branches sparsely puberulous soon glabrescent. Leaves 3-7 cm long, 1.2-3.2 cm broad, the lamina membranous, lanceolate, acute to bluntly acuminate at apex, cuneate at base, glabrous on both faces; primary veins 6-8 pairs, prominulous on both faces, anastomosing; petioles 3-5 mm long, shallowly cana- liculate, puberulous when young, soon glabrescent, slightly rugose to smooth. Stipules ca 1 mm long, lanceolate, caducous. Inflorescences of axillary and terminal panicles of cymules 1.2-3 cm long; rachis and branches gray-puberulous. Bracts and bracteoles ca 1.0 mm long, membranous, puberulous on both faces. Flowers ca 2 mm long; pedicels ca 1 mm long. Receptacle campanulate, tomentellous ex- ternally, tomentose within. Calyx lobes acute, tomentellous on both faces. Petals 5, glabrous except for ciliolate margins. Stamens 6-7, unilateral with small tooth-like staminodes opposite. Ovary bilocular, with one ovule in each loculus, inserted on middle of receptacle tube, lanate on exterior. Style pilose at base, glabrous above. Fruit ellipsoid, bilocular and often slightly 2-lobed, 1.5-1.9 cm long, tapered to a short pointed stipe ca 3 mm long at base; epicarp smooth, glabrous; mesocarp thin, fleshy; endocarp thin, hard, bony, densely pubescent within.
bibliographicCitation: Prance, Ghillean T. 1979. New genera and species of Chrysobalanaceae from Malesia and Oceania. Brittonia. 31: 79-95.

description: Arbor 15 m alta, ramis ramulisque teretibus glabris. Folia alterna, petiolata; petiolo 3-5 mm longo, leviter canaliculato, juvenili lanato mox glabro, leviter rugoso; laminae oblongo- lanceolatae, coriaceae, 7-13 cm longae, 2-3.7 cm latae, apice breviter acuminatae, basi cuneatae, utrinque glabrae. Stipulae 5-6.5 mm longae, lineari-lanceolatae, puberulae, subpersistentes. Flores 2-2.5 mm longi, in paniculis cymularum terminalibus vel axillaribus dispositi, rachi ramisque juvenilibus lanatis mox puberulis. Bracteae bracteolaeque membranaceae, 1-3.5 mm longae, utrinque sparse puberulo-glabrescentes; pedicellis ca 1 mm longis. Receptaculum campanulatum, extus lanato-tomentosum, intus tomentosum. Calycis lobi acuti utrinque pubescentes. Petala 5, glabra, marginibus ciliatis exceptis. Stamina 6-8, unilateralia, stami- nodiis 3-5 minutis opposita. Ovarium biloculare, extus pilosum, ad medium receptaculi insertum, ovulo uno in quoque loculo. Stylus versus basim pilosus, supra glaber. Fructus ignotus.

description: Shrub or small tree to 4 m tall, the young branches glabrous. Leaves 2-10 cm long, 1-4 cm broad, the lamina oblong, thickly coriaceous, rounded at apex, rounded to subcordate at base, glabrous on both faces; petioles 3-5 mm long, shallowly canaliculate, sparsely puberulous when young, soon glabrescent, rugose. Stipules linear-lanceolate, 2-3 mm long, glabrous, membranous, subpersistent. Inflorescence terminal and axillary panicles of cymules 2-3 cm long, the rachis and branches sparsely puberulous-glabrescent. Bracts and bracteoles chartaceous, persistent, ca 1 mm long, sparsely puberulous on both surfaces. Flowers 1.5-2 mm long,; pedicels ca 0.4 mm long. Receptacle campanulate, sparsely puberulous externally, tomentose within. Calyx lobes acute, sparsely puberulous on both faces. Petals 5, glabrous. Stamens 5-7, unilateral with tooth-like staminodes opposite to them. Ovary bilocular with one ovule in each loculus, lanate on exterior, inserted on middle of receptacle tube. Style pilose at base, glabrous above, the apex trifid. Fruit not seen.

description: Arbor 4 m alta, ramulis juvenilibus puberulis mox glabrescentibus, lenticellatis. Stipulae lance- olatae, puberulae, circa 5 mm longae, persistentes. Flores in paniculis terminalibus axillari- busque dispositi, rachi ramisque puberulis. description: Small tree, the young branches lanate, very soon glabrescent. Leaves 10-19 cm long, 4-6.5 cm broad, the lamina coriaceous, oblong-elliptic, finely acuminate at apex (the acumen 8-16 mm long), rounded to subcuneate at base, glabrous on both faces; primary veins 9-13 pairs, prominulous above, prominent beneath, con- spicuously anastomosing ca 5 mm from margin; petioles 2-4 mm long, shallowly canaliculate, sparsely puberulous when young, soon glabrescent, rugose. Stipules lanceolate, 3-6 mm long, puberulous, persistent. Inflorescences of terminal and axillary panicles, 3-10 cm long, the rachis and branches sparsely lanate-puberulous when young. Bracts and bracteoles 0.5-2 mm long, sparsely puberulous-glabrescent on both faces, membranous. Flowers 1.5-2 mm long; pedicels ca 1 mm long. Receptacle campanulate, glabrous externally, tomentose within. Calyx lobes acute, glabrous on both faces except for ciliolate margins. Petals 5, glabrous. Stamens ca 7, unilateral, with toothed staminodes opposite. Ovary bilocular, with one ovule in each loculus, inserted on middle of receptacle tube, lanate-pilose externally. Style pilose at base, glabrous above; stigma truncate. Fruit sagittate-pyriform, unilocular, to 5 cm long, the upper portion in profile triangular, 2-3.5 mm long, the base narrowly and abruptly tapered to a stipe 0.6-1 cm long; epicarp smooth, glabrous; mesocarp thin, fleshy; endocarp thin, hard, bony, lanate-tomentose within.
bibliographicCitation: Prance, Ghillean T. 1979. New genera and species of Chrysobalanaceae from Malesia and Oceania. Brittonia. 31: 79-95.

description: Shrub or tree to 10 m tall, the young branches lanate, becoming glabrous with age. Leaves 5-9 mm long, 2-4.5 cm broad, the lamina coriaceous, oblong to ovate-elliptic, bluntly acuminate at apex (the acumen to 7 mm long), subcuneate to cuneate at base, glabrous above, lanate beneath when young soon becoming glabrous; petioles 6-10 mm long, terete, lanate becoming puberulous and glabres- cent with age, slightly rugose. Stipules lanceolate, ca 2 mm long, lanate, char- taceous, caducous. Inflorescences of axillary and terminal panicles of cymules 1.5-3.5 cm long; rachis and branches gray-puberulous. Bracts and bracteoles 0.5-2 mm long, membranous, lanate-puberulous externally, puberulous within.

description: Young shoots 1-1.5 mm wide. Stipules deltoid, acute to acuminate, (1-)2-2.5x 1- 1.5 mm. Petiole (1-)3-5x 1-1.5 mm. Leaf blades obovate, apically rounded, truncate or retuse, more rarely short-acuminate, basally acute or narrowly cuneate, rarely obtuse, (1.2-)2-5(-8)x (0.8-)1.5-2.5(-3.4) cm, sometimes revolute, moderately coriaceous, olive-green or reddish brown on both surfaces, or olivegreen adaxially and reddish brown abaxially, venation prominent adaxially. Staminate flowers: sepals 1.5-2 x ca. 1 mm, stamens 3-4 mm long. Pistillate buds with pedicel ca. 1 x0.5-0.7 mm. Pistillate pedicel ca. 2 x 1-1.5 mm. Fruiting pedicel 2- 5x 1-1.5 mm. Seeds 4-6 x 2-4 mm.
