description: Caespitose, acaulous epiphytes to 21 cm tall, producing fan-shaped growths. Leaves 5-6, lanceolate, long acuminate, conduplicate at the base, midvein carinate, 15-21 x 1.5-1.9 cm, dark green, stiff, articulated to imbricating sheaths. Inflorescences lax axillary scapes. Flowers campanulate with spreading lateral sepals, pale greenish-white, the labellum cream-white with lavender and yellow markings, the column and anther cream-white, the pollinia yellow. Dorsal sepal oblong, acute, concave, 1.8 x 0.8 cm. Lateral sepals lanceolate, subacute, strongly concave, divergent, 2.6 x 0.7 cm. Petals obovate-spatulate, mucronulate, distal margins lightly pleated, 2.3 x 0.8 cm, obliquely adnate to column foot. Labellum unlobed, tubular, 2.4 x 1.8 cm, the outer 1/3 constricted and transversely thickened, verrucose across the middle, apex recurved, margins with many pleats, the callus of two elongate low, broad ribs, converging, thick- er and free at the oblique tips. Column arcuate, clavate, fleshy, 1.75 x 0.6 cm, ventral surface covered with long verrucose processes. Pollinaria to 4.5 mm long, the pollinia 4 in 2 very unequal pairs, the larger 3.5 x 1.1 mm, the smaller 2.1 x 0.9 mm, on a small ovate stipe and elliptic viscidium. Ovary and pedicel to 1.1 cm long, subtended by an ovate, acuminate floral bract to 0.5 cm long.

description: Plants perennial, but flowering the first year and often appearing annual. Culms glabrous, many noded, mostly weak, decumbent or trailing and freely branched in age, from 8 cm or less long in depauperate plants to more than 1 m long in forms with vigorous, trailing culms. Sheaths shorter than the internodes, glabrous or with a few hairs on the margins near the apex. Blades linear, thin, flat, mostly 2-4 mm broad, glabrous or more commonly ciliate along the margins below, with stiff, pustulate-based hairs, occasionally sparsely hirsute on one or both surfaces. In- florescence well exserted or partially included in the upper sheath, with usually 5-12 slender, spicate branches mostly 1.5-4 cm long. Branches deciduous with the spikelets intact, or less frequently remaining attached to the main axis until after the spikelets disarticulate above the glumes. Spikelets slender, typically widely spaced and ap- pressed to the rachis, mostly 5-10 per branch. Spikelets with a single reduced floret above the single perfect one. Glumes glabrous, broad, 1-nerved, 3.5-5 (rarely 6) mm long, acute, acuminate, or short awned, the first slightly shorter than the second. Lower (perfect) floret slender, the lemma short awned, mostly 4.5-7 mm long excluding the awns, with a tuft of stiff white hairs at the base, the body glabrous or infrequently puberulent in lines. Palea narrow, longer than the body of the lemma, the 2 nerves extended as short awns. Upper floret typically rudimentary and reduced to a cylindrical awn column with equal or nearly equal awns that diverge at the same point.

description: Annua; vaginae et laminae in superficiebus ambabus folii hispidae sparse vel dense, aliqui vel omni pilorum basibus pustulatis; inflorescentiae 4-8 ramis, axibus princi- palibus 3-10 cm longibus supra ramum basalem; rhachis ramulorum inflorescentiae nervique glumae externae typice strigulosi, rhachi saepe infra quamque spiculam caespide pilorum praedita; aristae flosculi superioris plerumque 11-14 mm longae; flosculi, vel saltem inferior, basi caespide pilorum praediti.

description: Tufted annual with erect or spreading-erect, often much branched culms 15-40 cm tall, the closely grazed or otherwise stunted plants with flowering culms 8 cm tall or less. Sheaths and both leaf surfaces sparsely to densely hispid, some or all of the hairs with pustulate bases. Inflorescence with 4-8 branches, the main axis 3-10 cm long above the basal branch. Branches bearing 3-8 spikelets, the rachis usually densely strigose-hirsute, at least on the angles of the lower portion, and with a tuft of hair below each spikelet. Glumes 6-9 mm long, acuminate or short awn-tipped, usually strigose-pubescent o-n the nerves but occasionally only scabrous. Lemma of the lower floret 3-awned, the awns about 1 mm long. Upper floret with 3 nearly equally developed awns 11-14 mm long, these usually scabrous.

description: Strong perennial with culms from hard, stout rhizomatous bases and with leaves mostly in a basal cluster. Culms unbranched above the base, generally 40-80 cm tall but shorter in depauperate plants. Rhizome typically covered by firm, coarse, flattened, light colored leaf sheaths. Leaf blades typically short and firm. In- florescence variable in length of branches, number of spikelets per branch, size of spikelets, and pubescence of the branch rachises, glumes, and lemmas. Awns of the upper floret well developed, the central one larger and longer than the lateral ones, projecting from a membranous, slightly bifid apex.

description: Weak or strong perennial with culms erect or decumbent-spreading from a soft or firm and "knotty" base. Leaves usually glabrous or sparsely hirsute, infrequently hirsute-hispid. Blades linear, flat, 1-5 mm broad, ciliate with pustulate-based hairs at least near the base. Ligule a minute ciliate fringe. Inflorescence of 4-12 short, evenly spaced spikelet-bearing branches. Inflorescence branches bearing 3-9 (occasionally to 18) imbricate spikelets, the branch deciduous with the spikelets at maturity. Spikelets 2-flowered, the lower floret perfect, the upper perfect, staminate, or sterile. Rachilla often extending as a short awn, glabrous, scabrous, or infrequently short-hispid on the nerve. First glume 4-7 mm long, the second slightly longer. Lemma of the lower floret 4.5-8 mm long, glabrous or infrequently bearded at the base, awnless or the nerves occasionally projecting as short awns. Palea of lower floret narrow, strongly 2-nerved and often minutely 2-awned, usually slightly longer than the body of the lemma, glabrous or less frequently strigose-pubescent between the nerves. Upper floret well developed, often broader than the lower floret, usually staminate but occasionally perfect. Lemma of upper floret with a membranous body and 3 awns, the central awn stout and scabrous, mostly 4-8 (infrequently to 10) mm long, the lateral ones more slender and slightly shorter, exserted well below the apex of the body. Palea of the upper floret well developed and conspicuously longer than the body of the lemma. Anthers mostly 3-4.5 mm long, usually orange or yellow, but occasionally red or purple. Caryopsis narrowly oblong, with an embryo four-fifths or more the length of the endosperm.

description: Culms slender, 35-90 cm tall, stiffly erect and unbranched from a firm, tufted base. Leaves mostly basal, nearly glabrous to conspicuously hirsute. Blades flat, filiform, mostly 1.5-2.5 mm broad, those of the basal clump 10-25 cm long, the upper shorter. Inflorescence with 7-14 branches alternating on either side of the angular, flattened main axis. Branches 2-4 cm long, bearing 9-20 or more closely placed spikelets. Branch rachis scabrous to puberulent, often with a tuft of hairs at the base of each spikelet. Spikelets 2-flowered, the lower perfect, the upper small and narrow, staminate or neuter. Glumes broad, acuminate, the first 3.5--4.5 mm long, the second 4.5-6 mm long. Lemma of the lower floret firm, with a body usually 4-6 mm long, glabrous or sparsely puberulent on the back and with a tuft of hairs at the base. Nerves of the lemma extended as awns, the central awn mostly 2-3 mm long, the lateral slightly shorter. Palea of the lower floret slightly longer than the lemma, puberulent between the minutely awn-tipped nerves. Lemma of the upper floret glabrous or minutely puberulent, usually with a tuft of silvery hairs at the base, with a stout central awn 4-7 mm long from a notched apex.

description: Planta perennis; culmi ascendentes 50-70 cm. alti; vaginae glabrae vel infimae sparsim pubescentes; ligula vix 1 mm. longa; laminae planae vel involutae, supra scaberulae, subtus glabrae, elongatae, 1-3 mm. latae, racemus 8-18 cm. longus; spiculae 4-8, 4-6-florae, 2-2.5 cm. longae (aristis exceptis), pedicellis vix 1 mm. longis; glumae acu-minatae glabrae, prima 3-5-nervia, 7-12 mm. longa, secunda quam prima longior, 5-7-nervia; lemmata scaberula ad apicem scabra vel scabro-hispida 10-12 mm. longa; arista 2-4 cm. longa.

description: Perennial; culms few in a loose tuft, rather slender, ascending from a spreading base, glabrous, 50-70 cm. tall; sheaths slightly auriculate at throat, glabrous or the lowermost sparsely pubescent; ligule a membrane less than 1 mm. long; blades flat or, especially on the innovations, more or less involute, glabrous beneath, scaberulous on the upper surface, elongate, 1-3 mm. wide; raceme nodding, 8-18 cm. long; spikelets 4-8, 4-6-flowered, 2-2.5 cm. long (excluding awns), longer or shorter than the internodes of the rachis, the pedicels less than 1 mm. long; glumes acuminate, glabrous, the margins thick, the first 3-5-nerved, 7-12 mm. long, the second longer than the first, 5-7-nerved; lemmas rounded on the back, scaberulous on lower part, scabrous or scabrous-hispid and strongly 5-nerved toward summit, 10-12 mm. long, gradually tapering into a strong straight very scabrous awn 2-4 cm. long; palea a little shorter than the body of the lemma, narrowed slightly to a minutely bidentate tip, pubescent between the scabrous keels; internodes of rachilla scabrous, hispid below the florets.

description: Culmi basi ramosi, 30-50 cm. alti; vaginae pubescentes; ligula vix 1 mm. longa, ciliata; laminae planae vel paullum involutae, subtus molliter pubescentes, supra breviter villosae, rigide acuminatae, plerumque 5-8 cm. longae, 2-5 mm. latae; racemus 6-8 cm. longus; spiculae 8-12-florae, 1.5-2 cm. longae, pedicellis vix 1 mm. longis, pubes-centibus; glumae acuminatae, pubescentes vel breviter pilosae, prima 5-nervia, 4-7 mm. longa, secunda longior, 7-9-nervia, lemmata circa 9-nervia, appresso-pilosa, circa 1 cm. longa, aristata, arista 5-8 mm. longa.

description: Culms branching at base, glabrous or more or less pubescent at and below the nodes, several-noded, 30-50 cm. tall; sheaths softly pubescent or the upper glabrescent; ligule a ciliate membrane less than 1 mm. long; blades flat or loosely involute, softly pubescent beneath, short-villous on the upper surface, rather rigidly pointed, mostly less than 10 cm. long, as much as 5 mm. wide; raceme more or less nodding, mostly 6-8 cm. long; spikelets mostly 8-12-flowered, appressed, longer than the internodes of the rachis, 1.5-2 cm. long, the pedicels pubescent, scarcely 1 mm. long; glumes acuminate, more or less pubescent or short-pilose, the first 5-nerved, 4-7 mm. long, the second longer, 7-9-nerved; lemmas rounded on the back, about 9-nerved, appressed-pilose especially toward the margins, about 1 cm. long, rather abruptly narrowed to a straight or slightly flexuous awn 5-8 mm. long or shorter on the lower lemmas; palea rounded at the summit, a little shorter than the lemma, minutely ciliate on the keels.

description: Perennial. Culms 45-105 cm. 'tall, erect. Nodes (3-)4-7(-8), retrorsely pubescent to glabrous. Internodes glabrous. Leaves with the sheaths glabrous or pubescent to pilose, the blades 14-22(-26) cm. long and 3.5-5(-6) mm. wide, glabrous or sometimes pilose. Auricles on the lower leaves, sometimes only vestigial or absent. Ligule 1 mm. long, or less, truncate, fringed to erose, glabrous. Panicle 10-17(-22) cm. long, open, the axis glabrous or puberulent, the branches ascendingspreading, 2 or 3 per node. Spikelets 1.5-3.2 cm. long with 4-12 florets. Glumes usually pubescent or occasionally glabrous, the first 5-6 mm. long, subulate, 1- or 3-nerved, the second 6-8 mm. long, subulate or with an acute tip, rarely apiculate, 3-nerved. Lemmas 7-10 mm. long, pubescent on the margins and across the back, 7-nerved, bearing an awn 1-3(-5) mm. long below an entire apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves and puberulent to pubescent between the nerves. Anthesis in August. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe slightly notched to obtuse, with or without a median thickening. Anthers 2-4 mm. long. Caryopsis 6-7 mm. long, oblanceolate-spathulate, amber-colored or rarely purpleblack, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells 36-45(-49) [L; modal diameter of the pollen grains 35-39 [t. Chromosome number 2n = 14.

description: Perennial. Culms 45-155 cm. tall, erect. Nodes (3-)4-7(-8), retrorsely pubescent or glabrous, the exposed uppermost always pubescent. Internodes glabrous or rarely puberulent just below the nodes. Leaves with glabrous to pilose sheaths, the blades 13-25(-30) cm. long and (3-)5-8(-10) mm. wide, the upper surface pubescent to pilose, or occasionally glabrous, the lower surface glabrous, rarely pubescent. Auricles absent. Ligule 1 mm. long or less. Panicle (6-)10-20 cm. long, open, the axis glabrous; branches ascending to spreading or drooping, 2 or 3 (4) per node. Spikelets 1.5-2.5 cm. long with 4-9 florets. Glumes glabrous, the first 1-rarely 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute tip, the second 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute to obtuse tip. Lemmas 10-15 mm. long, pubescent on the margins on the lower- half to three-fourths, glabrous across the back, (5- or) 7-nerved, bearing an awn 3-5(-6) mm. long below an entire apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves and glabrous between the nerves. Anthesis from middle of July through August and early September. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe obtuse or truncate, rarely minutely notched with a slight median thickening. Anthers 1-1.8(-2) mm. long, included at anthesis. Caryopsis 6-7(-9) mm. long, ellipsoidal to oblanceolate, amber-colored, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells 35-45(-49) [L. Modal diameter of the pollen grains 34-38 [L. Chromosome number 2n = 14.

description: Perennial. Culms 88-110 cm. tall, densely tufted. Nodes 3; glabrous. Internodes glabrous. Leaves with glabrous sheaths, the old basal ones becoming conspicuously fibrous, the blades up to 27 cm. long and 2-3 mm. wide, pilose to lanate or ciliate, to sparsely long-pilose on the margins toward the base, sometimes folded. Auricles absent. Throat pubescent to hirsute. Ligule up to 0.5 mm. long, sometimes obscure, erose. Panicle 9.5.19 cm. long, narrow (2 cm. wide) and somewhat dense, the axis glabrous, the branches appressed, 2 per node. Spikelets 2-3.5 cm. long with 4-11 florets. Glumes glabrous, subulate, the first 6-12 mm. long, 1-nerved, the second 9-13 mm. long, 3-nerved. Lemmas 12-15 mm. long, subulate, densely hirsute on the lower half, or scabrous, 3-nerved, bearing an awn 1-2.5 mm. long between two minute slender teeth, or below an entire apex. Palea slightly shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves and hispidulous between the nerves. Anthesis in-June and July. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe obtuse to truncate with a median thickening. Anthers 6-8.8 mm. long, exserted at anthesis. Modal length of guard cells 45-52 µ. Chromosome number (2n = 28 ?).

description: Perennial. Culms 60-155 cm. tall, erect to spreading or geniculate. Nodes 3-7, pubescent-puberulent, rarely glabrous. Internodes glabrous. Leaves with sheaths pubescent to sparsely pilose, or those on the upper part of culm nearly glabrous, the blades 10-43 cm. long, 4-13 mm. wide, usually pilose on the upper surface, glabrous or scabrous on the lower surface. Auricles usually present at least on the lower leaves. Ligule 1.5 mm. long or less, glabrous, truncate to obtuse. Panicle exserted, open, nodding, (8-)14-30 cm. long, the axis glabrous to puberulent, the branches mostly 2 or 3 per node, ascending, capillary, sometimes with prominent pulvini at their bases. Spikelets 2-3 cm. long with 3-9 florets. Glumes glabrous or pubescent to sparsely pilose, subulate, the first 9-12 mm. long, 1-(3-) nerved, the second 10-17 mm. long, 3-nerved. Lemmas 14-20 mm. long, subulate, sparsely pubescent to glabrous over the back, pilose to hirsute on the margins, 3- or (5-) nerved, bearing an awn 6-13 mm. long below an entire apex. Palea usually shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves and pubescent between the nerves. Anthesis in September. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe notched, with or without a median thickening. Anthers 2-3 mm. long, slightly exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis lanceolate-oblanceolate, 10-15 mm. long, amber-colored, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of the guard cells (38) 49-59 µ; modal diameter of the pollen grains 42 µ (based upon a single specimen). Chromosome number 2n = 28.

description: Perennial. Culms 50-100 cm. tall, erect. Nodes (1) 2 or 3, glabrous, rarely pubescent. Internodes glabrous. Leaves with glabrous or sometimes pilose sheaths, the blades 10-20 cm. long and 2-4.5 mm. wide, often involute or sometime folded, glabrous or pilose. Auricles absent. Ligule up to 1.5 mm. long, truncate, erose. Panicle 10-20 cm. long, erect, the branches erect or ascending to ascendingspreading. Spikelets 2-3(-4) cm. long with 5-8(-12) florets. Glumes glabrous and subulate, the first 7-9 mm. long, 1-nerved, the second 9-11 mm. long, 3-nerved. Lemmas 11-13 mm. long, sparsely pubescent on the back and margins to entirely glabrous, 5- or 7-nerved, bearing an awn 5-7 mm. long below an entire, subulate to acute apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves and glabrous or rarely hispidulous between the nerves. Anthesis in June. Ovarian appendage obtuse or truncate, with or without a median thickening. Anthers 4-6.5 mm. long, exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis 6-9 mm. long, amber-colored, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells (45-)49-63 pt; modal diameter of pollen grains 42-49 pt. Chromosome number 2n = 56.

description: Perennial. Culms 30-90 cm. tall, erect to spreading. tvodes 3-5, glabrous, or rarely puberulent to pubescent. Internodes glabrous. Radical leaves pubescent to pilose throughout. Culm leaves with glabrous or occasionally pilose sheaths, the blades 10-20(-23) cm. long and 3-6 mm. wide, frequently glaucous, glabrous, scabrous on at least the upper one-third. Auricles absent. Ligule 0.2-1 mm. long, truncate, often fringed, glabrous. Panicle (6) 10-20(-22) cm. long, open, nodding, the axis glabrous and smooth, or rarely scabrous, the branches ascendingRspreading, 2(-4) per node. Spikelets 1.5-2.7 cm. long with 5-10 florets. Glumes glabrous (pubescent-pilose in anomalous form of se. Arizona), the first 5.5-8 mm. long, 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute tip; the second 6-9 mm. long, 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute to obtuse tip, frequently mucronate. Lemmas 8-12 mm. long, pubescent across the back, rarely glabrous, the marginal pubescence longer; 7-nerved, the lateral nerves sometimes obscure so that they appear 3- or 5-nerved; bearing an awn (1.5) 2-4 mm. long below an entire apex. Palea slightly shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, hispidulous to pubescent between the nerves. Anthesis from middle August to the first part of September. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe slightly notched to obtuse, rarely with a slight median thickening. Anthers 1.5-3.5 mm. long. Caryopsis 6-8 mm. long, amber-colored, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of the guard cells 35-45(-49) P; modal diameter of the pollen grains 35-38 ji. Chromosome number 2n= 14.

description: Perennial. Culms 90-140 cm. tall. Nodes 3-6, retrorsely pubescent to puberulent. Internodes glabrous to puberulent just below the nodes, or sometimes puberulent throughout. Leaves with sheaths retrorsely pubescent, the blades (11.5) 15-30 cm. long, 5-12 mm. wide, densely short-pubescent on both surfaces, or sometimes only sparsely pubescent on the lower surface. Auricles short and obscure in some material from the San Bernardino Mountains, otherwise absent. Ligule (1-)2-3(-4) mm. long, obtuse, usually lacerate, pubescent to pilose on the back. Panicle (13.5-)15-22 cm. long, open with spreading branches, the axis puberulent to pubescent, the branches 2(-3) per node, rarely with prominent pulvini at their bases. Spikelets 2.5-3.5 cm. long with 7-9 flo;ets. Glumes pubescent, the first (1-) 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute tip, the second 3-(5-) nerved, subulate or with an acute to obtuse tip. Lemmas 11-14 mm. long, pubescent over the back and on the margins, 7-nerved, bearing an awn 3-6 mm. long below an entire apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, pilose to sparsely pubescent between the nerves. Anthesis in late May and through June. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe slightly notched or truncate with a slight median thickening. Anthers 3.5-6 mm. long. Caryopsis about 9 mm. long. Modal length of guard cells (35, 38) 42-53 µ.; modal diameter of the pollen grains (39-42 µ). Chromosome number 2n = 14.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 55-100(-137 ?) cm. tall, erect. Nodes 2 or 3 (4 ?), pubescent to hirsute. Internodes glabrous to pubescent. Leaves with pilose to villous sheaths, rarely glabrous, the blades 10-17(-26) cm. long and 5-9 mm. wide, usually pilose on the upper surface, pilose or glabrous on the lower. Auricles short, vestigial, or frequently absent. Ligule up to 1(-3) mm. long. Panicle 10-20 cm. long, open, with erect to ascending branches, the axis glabrous or rarely puberulent, the branches 2-5 per node. Spikelets 2.5-3 cm. long with 5-9(-12) florets. Glumes sparsely pubescent to hirsute, subulate, the first 5-9 mm. long, 1-nerved, the second 7-11 mm. long, 3-nerved. Lemmas 9-14 mm. long, sparsely pubescent to hirsute over the back and along the margins, (3-) 7-nerved, bearing an awn 2-5 mm. long below an entire or slightly emarginate apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, puberulent to pilose or sometime glabrous between the nerves. Anthesis in July. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe obtuse to acute or occasionally slightly notched, with a median thickening. Anthers (4) 5.5-7 mm. long, exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis 6-10 mm. long, ambercolored to dark brown, rarely purple, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells (44-)52-76(-80.5) µ; modal diameter of pollen grains (42-)45-49 µ. Chromosome number 2n = ca. 56.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms (15-)40-100(-155) cm. tall, erect. Nodes 2 or 3, very rarely 4, pubescent to puberulent, very rarely glabrous. Internodes glabrous or occasionally puberulent just below the nodes. Leaves with sheaths pilose to glabrous; the blades 9-17(-25) cm. long and (3-)4-8(-9) mm. wide, the upper surface pilose, rarely glabrous, the lower glabrous, rarely pilose. Auricles on lower leaves short or vestigial, or sometimes absent. Ligule (0.2-)1-2(-3) mm. long, obtuse to truncate, erose. Panicle (7.)10-17(-20) cm. long, usually erect, the axis glabrous, the branches ascending to nearly erect, or sometimes spreading, 2-4(-6) per node. Spikelets (1.8-)2.5-3.2(-3.8) cm. long with (5-)7-9(-10) florets. Glumes glabrous, the first (4-)6-9 mm. long, I-nerved, subulate, the second (5-)8-11 mm. long, 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute tip. Lemmas 7-16 mm. long, pubescent on the nerves and base of the back, and along the margins, awnless or bearing an awn up to 6 mm. long below an entire or sometimes slightly emarginate apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves and glabrous between the nerves. Anthesis from mid-June through July to the middle of August. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe slightly notched to obtuse or nearly acute, with a slight to prominent median thickening. Anthers (3.5-)4.5-7(-7.5) mm. long, exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis 7-10 mm. long, spathulate to oblanceolate or ellipsoidal-linear, amber-colored to brown, or sometimes purple, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells (46-)49-66(-76) µ; modal diameter of the pollen grains 42-50 µ. Chromosome number 2n = 56.

description: Perennial. Culms 55-95(-119) cm. tall, erect. Nodes 3-5, glabrous, or sometime puberulent. Internodes glabrous, rarely somewhat puberulent below the nodes. Leaves with the sheaths pilose or nearly glabrous on the upper portion of the culm, the blades (8--)10-15(-20) cm. long and (3.5-)5-10 mm. wide, pilose on both surfaces, often decreasing to glabrous toward the tip, at least the lower ones with tips boat-shaped. Auricles absent. Ligule 0.5 mm. long or less, truncate. Panicle (7-)8-12(-14) long, rather few-flowered, drooping; axis glabrous, the branches flexuous, 2 or 3(-6) per node. description: Perennial. Culms 50-150(-160) cm. tall, erect or spreading, frequently with a decumbent base and rooting at the lower nodes. Nodes 3-5(-6), retrorsely pubescent. Internodes retrorsely puberulent-pubescent just below the nodes, rarely with a fine puberulence throughout between the nerves. Leaves glabrous throughout (rarely pubescent), blades 13-26 cm. long and (3.5-)4-10 mm. wide, light green or glaucous. Auricles absent or vestigial to short on the radical leaves. Ligule (1-)2-4(-5) mm. long, those of the culm leaves at least 2 mm. long, truncate to obtuse, erose to somewhat lacerate, glabrous. Panicle (10-)12-20 cm. long, open, nodding, the axis hispidulous to puberulent-pubescent, the branches spreading, 2-3(-4) per node, occasionally with prominent pulvini at their bases. Spikelets 2.5-3.5(-4) cm. long with 5-11 florets. Glumes glabrous and smooth, the first 6-9 mm. long, subulate or with an acute to obtuse tip, 3-nerved. Lemmas 12-15 mm. long, densely pubescent on the margins, and unevenly sparsely-pubescent across the back, or just on the lower half, the tip acute to obtuse, 7-nerved, bearing an awn 4-6 mm. long below an entire, or rarely, slightly emarginate apex. Palea slightly shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, and puberulent to pubescent between the nerves. Anthesis from middle June to early July. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe notched to obtuse, with or without a median thickening. Anthers 3.5-5 mm. long, exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis 8-10 mm. long, linear to oblanceolate, amber-colored, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells (35-)38-32 µ; modal diameter of pollen grains 35-39 µ. Chromosome number 2n = 14.

description: Perennial. Culms (36) 45-113 cm. tall, erect. Nodes 3-5(-7), pubescent or occasionally glabrous. Internodes glabrous or puberulent just below the nodes. Leaves with sheaths lanate, the uppermost decreasing to nearly glabrous, the blades 12-28(-32) cm. long and 4-6(-8) mm. wide, glabrous and scabrous on both surfaces, usually ascending. Auricles absent. Ligule 1-2(-2.5) mm. long, obtuse to truncate, sometimes lacerate, glabrous. Panicle (7-)10-18(-24) cm. long, open, the axis glabrous, usually smooth on the lower internodes and becoming scabrous above, rarely puberulent, the branches 2-5 per node, rarely with prominent pulvini at their bases. Spikelets 1.3-3(-3.7) cm. long with 7-12(-16) florets. Glumes glabrous or sometimes with a few scattered, short hairs, the first 5-6.5(-7) mm. long, 1- or sometimes 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute tip, the second (6) 7-9 mm. long, 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute to obtuse tip. Lemmas 9-11 mm. long, pubescent over the back and along the margins, or sometimes nearly glabrous over the back, 5- or 7-nerved, the tip truncate or obtuse, bearing an awn 2-4(-5) mm. long below an entire or rarely emarginate apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves and glabrous between the nerves. Anthesis in middle July and through August. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe truncate- to slightly notched with a median thickening. Anthers 2.5-4(-4.8) mm. long, exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis 6-7 mm. long, amber-colored, spathulate, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells 45-60 µ; modal diameter of the pollen grains (35, 38) 41-45 µ. Chromosome number 2n= 28.

description: Perennial. Culms 50-135 cm. tall, erect or spreading. Nodes 5-7, retrorsely pilose to sparsely pubescent. Internodes glabrous. Radical leaves pubescent to pilose. Culm leaves with pubescent, or occasionally glabrous sheaths, the blades 20-30 cm. long and (4-)7-11 mm. wide, the upper surface pilose, the lower surface glabrous to pilose, lax. Auricles absent. Throat lanate to pilose. Ligule 1-2 mm. long, obtuse to truncate, glabrous. Panicle 12-20 cm. long, nodding, open with ascending-spreading branches, the axis glabrous and smooth or scabrous, the branches 2 or 3 per node, occasionally with pulvini at their bases. Spikelets 2-2.8 cm. long with 5-10 florets. Glumes pubescent to pilose, rarely glabrous, the first 6-8 mm. long, l-nerved, subulate, the second 2-8.5 mm. long, 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute tip, mucronate. Lemmas 10-11 mm. long, sparsely pubescent to pilose on the margins and across the back, or occasionally only on the lower half, 7-nerved, the tip acute to obtuse, bearing an awn 3-5 mm. long below an entire apex. Palea slightly shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, puberulent to pilose between the nerves. Anthesis during late August. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe slightly notched to obtuse, occasionally with a slight median thickening. Anthers 1.5-2 (3.4) mm. long. Caryop'sis 6-9 mm. long, lanceolateoblanceolate, amber-colored or purple-black, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells 42-52 µ, modal diameter of pollen grains 40-42 µ. Chromosome number 2n = 28.

description: Perennial. Culms 75-135 cm. tall, erect or spreading. Nodes 5-9, glabrous to retrorsely pubescent. Internodes glabrous, rarely puberulent near the nodes. Radical leaves glabrous or pubescent to pilose. Culm leaves with retrorsely pilose to pubescent or glabrous sheaths which are often overlapping and usually with a ring of hairs at the summit, the blades 15-35 cm. long, 6-12 mm. wide, glabrous or pilose on one or both surfaces, frequently a slick, shiny-green color, lax. Auricles absent. Ligule 1 mm. long or less, fringed to erose, truncate, those of the culm leaves sometimes puberulent to pubescent on the back. Panicle (8-)10-23 cm. long, nodding, open with ascending to spreading branches, the axis scabrous-puberulent, the branches 2-3 per node with slender pulvini at their bases. Spikelets 2-3.2 cm. long with 6-12 florets. Glumes pubescent, rarely entirely glabrous, the first 5-8 mm. long, subulate, 1-nerved, the second 7-10 mm. long, subulate or with an acute tip, 5-nerved. Lemmas 9,13 mm. long, pubescent all over the back, 7-nerved, acute, bearing an awn 5-8 mm. long below an entire apex. Palea slightly shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, puberulent to pilose between the nerves. Anthesis in late June and early July. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe slightly notched or truncate with a median thickening. Anthers 3-5 mm. long, exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis 6.5-9 mm. long, oblanceolate, usually with a purple-black pericarp, adhering tightly to the palea and lemma at maturity. Modal length of guard cells (36-)39-47 µ; modal diameter of the pollen grains 35-39 µ. Chromosome number 2n= 14.

description: Perennial. Culms 75-150 cm. tall, erect. Nodes 2-3(-4), retrorsely puberulent to pubescent. Internodes retrorsely puberulent-pubescent just below the nodes. Radical leaves glabrous throughout; culm leaves with retrorsely pilose to hirsute sheaths, rarely glabrous, the blades 12-25 cm. long and 6-12 mm. wide, sometimes glaucous, glabrous and smooth, finely scabrous on margins and tip, usually boat-shaped at the tip. Auricles absent. Ligule 1-1.5(-2) mm. long, truncate to obtuse, erose to lacerate, glabrous, or rarely puberulent on the back. Panicle 10-16(-20) cm. long, exserted 30-50 cm., erect, narrow and somewhat compact with closely ascending branches, or pyramidal with spreading to divaricate branches, the axis glabrous to antrorsely puberulent; spikelets sessile or on branches up to 9 cm. long, (1-)2-3(-4) branches per node, often with prominent pulvini at the bases. Spikelets 2-4 cm. long with 5-7(-11) florets. Glumes glabrous to pubescent, the first 5-8 mm. long, 1- or 3-nerved, occasionally consistently 3-nerved throughout panicle, subulate or with an acute tip; the second 8-10 mm. long, 3-nerved, tip acute to obtuse, occasionally mucronate. Lemmas 1-1.6 cm. long, shortpubescent to glabrous across the back, short-pubescent to scabrous on the margins, 3-, 5-, or 7-nerved, bearing a straight awn 5-7(-9) mm. long below an entire apex. Palea slightly shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, nearly glabrous or sparsely short-pubescent between the nerves. Anthesis from middle to late June. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe slightly notched to obtuse with a median thickening. Anthers 3.5-5.5 mm. long, exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis 6-9 mm. long, linear, brown to purple-black, adhering to the lemma and palea. Modal length of guard cells 45-56 ,u; modal diameter of pollen grains 36-38 1t. Chromosome number 2n= 14.

description: Perennial. Culms 90-120 cm. tall, erect. Nodes 2 or 3, retrorsely pubescent. Internodes puberulent throughout, or sometimes just below the nodes. Leaves pubescent throughout or the very lower radical leaves glabrous, the blades 10-15.5 cm. long, (3-)6-8 mm. wide, usually with boat-shaped tips. Auricles absent. Ligule 1-1.5(-2) mm. long, obtuse-truncate, erose. Panicle 11-17 cm. long, open, the axis puberulent to pubescent, rarely glabrous, the branches ascending-spreading, 2 (-3) per node. Spikelets 3-3.5 cm. long with 5-8 florets. Glumes sparsely pubescent to pubescent, the first 6-7 mm. long, subulate, 1- or rarely 3-nerved, the second 9-10.5 mm. long, subulate or with an acute to obtuse tip, 3- or rarely 5-nerved. Lemmas 12-15 mm. long, sparsely pubescent to pubescent over the back and margins, 7-(3-) nerved, bearing an awn 4-7 mm. long below an entire apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, puberulent to pubescent between the nerves. Anthesis in late June through most of July. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe truncate to obtuse with a slight median thickening. Anthers 5-7 mm. long. Caryopsis 10-11 mm. long, amber-colored, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells 45-56(63) µ; modal diameter of the pollen grains 36 µ. (based upon one specimen). (Chromosome number 2n= 14 ?)

description: Perennial. Culms 70-150(-163) cm. tall, erect. Nodes (5-)6-8, retrorsely pubescent. Internodes glabrous or sometimes pubescent just below the nodes. Leaves with pilose sheaths, the blades 20-35(-37) cm. long and 4-14 mm. wide, pilose on the upper surface and glabrous on the lower. Ligule 2-3 mm. long, truncate, erose or lacerate, glabrous. Auricles absent. Panicle 10-25(-29) cm. long, open with ascending to spreading branches; axis glabrous and smooth on the lower two internodes, becoming scabrous above, the branches 2 or 3(-4) per node, sometimes with prominent pulvini at their bases. Spikelets (1.5-)2-3 cm. long with (4-)6-10 florets. Glumes pubescent, the first 6.5-8(-9) mm. long, subulate, 1-nerved, the second 9-18 mm. long, 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute tip. Lemmas 11-12 mm. long, pubescent over the back and on the margin, (3-, 5-, or) 7-nerved, bearing an awn 4-7 mm. long below an entire apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves and pubescent to pilose between the nerves. Anthesis in late June and early July. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe truncate to obtuse or very slightly notched, usually with a median thickening. Anthers 3-4 mm. long. Caryopsis about 8 mm. long, amber-colored, ellipsoidal, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells (48) 52-56 ~t; modal diameter of the pollen grains 42-45 Chromosome number reported as 2n = 42.

description: Perennial. Culms 80-120 cm. tall, erect. Nodes about 4, retrorsely pilose. Internodes retrorsely pilose just below the nodes. Leaves with sheaths shorter than the internodes, densely and softly villous, or those on upper part of culm glabrous; blades 25-32 cm. long, 5-10 mm. wide, firm, densely pilose on both surfaces, or the upper most glabrous. Ligule 1-3 mm. long, brown, lacerate, glabrous. Panicle 18-25 cm. long, apparently nodding, the axis scabrous, the branches 2-3 per node, rather stiff, but probably arcuate-spreading, densely scabrous, the lowermost as much as 15 cm. long, undivided for as much as 5 cm. from the base, the few branchlets bearing 1 or 2 spikelets. Spikelets 2-3 cm. long with 7-9 florets. Glumes usually pilose, the first 6-9 mm. long, 1-nerved, subulate, occasionally with an awn up to 0.8 mm. long, the second 10-11 mm. long, 3-nerved, subulate or with an obtuse tip, with an awn about 1 mm. long. Lemmas 10-11 mm. long, rather evenly hirsute across the back from the base to the apex, the tip acute to obtuse, bearing an awn 5-8 mm. long below an entire apex. Palea as long as or slightly longer than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, pubescent between the nerves. Anthesis in September. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe slightly notched, with a median thickening. Anthers about 4 mm. long. Caryopsis: none available. Modal length of the guard cells 59 v; modal diameter of pollen grains: none available. Chromosome number (2n = 28?).

description: Perennial. Culms (20-)30-80(-113) cm. tall, erect, often tufted. Nodes (2-)3-4(-5), glabrous or retrorsely pubescent. Internodes glabrous or puberulent just below the nodes. Leaves with glabrous or sometimes pilose sheaths; the blades (3-)10-25(-35) cm. long and 2-5(-6) mm. wide, usually erect, glabrous, or rarely pilose on the upper surface, the apical one often surpassing the panicle; the midrib not tapered below the collar. Auricles absent. Ligule up to 2.5 mm. long, erose to lacerate, truncate or obtuse, usually decurrent. Panicle 7-15(-20) cm. long, drooping; the axis puberulent, rarely entirely glabrous, the branches ascending, arcuate, 2 or 3 (4) per node. Spikelets 13-15 mm. long with (3-)5-11(-13) florets. Glumes pubescent, rarely entirely glabrous, the first 5-7(-9) mm. long, subulate or with an acute tip, 3-nerved, the second 6-10 mm. long, subulate, or with an acute or obtuse tip, 3-nerved. Lemmas 8-13 mm. long, pubescent on the margins and across the back, rarely only on the margins, 7-(3- or 5-) nerved, with an acute or obtuse to truncate tip, bearing an awn 1.5-3(-4) mm. long below an entire apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves and pubescent (rarely entirely glabrous) between the nerves. Anthesis in July and August. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe obtuse or truncate, rarely with a slight notch or median thickening. Anthers 1.5-3.5(-4) mm. long, exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis 6-7 mm. long, linear or oblanceolate-spathulate, amber-colored, adhering to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells 35-45(-48) µ; modal diameter of pollen grains 35-39(-42) p,. Chromosome number 2n = 14.

description: Perennial. Culms 60-120 cm. tall, erect or spreading. Nodes 4-6, retrorsely pubescent to puberulent. Internodes puberulent to pubescent just below the nodes. Leaves with sheaths glabrous to pilose, the blades 8-25(-35) cm. long and 3-7.5(-10) mm. wide, pilose, frequently only on the margins, or glabrous. Auricles mostly on the lower leaves, rarely absent. Ligule 1 mm. or less long, fringed or erose-lacerate, obtuse to truncate, glabrous. Panicle 9-15(-20) cm. long, erect to nodding, open with branches ascending to spreading, the axis puberulent to pubescent, the branches-mostly 2 per node, occasionally with prominent pulvini at their bases. Spikelets 1.5-3.5 cm. long with 4-10 florets. Glumes pubescent, rarely entirely glabrous, the first 4-6 mm. long, 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute to obtuse tip, the second 6.5-8 mm. long, (3-) 5-nerved, with an acute to obtuse tip. Lemma 10-12 mm. long, pubescent over the back, or sometimes only on the margins, (5-) 7-nerved with an acute to obtuse tip, bearing an awn (2-)3-5 mm. long below an entire, or rarely, slightly emarginate apex. Palea slightly shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, hispidulous to pubescent between the nerves. Anthesis through May and early June. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe obtuse, occasionally with slight median thickening. Anthers 3.5-5(5.5) mm. long, partially to completely exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis 6-9 mm. long, ellipsoidal-oblanceolate, amber-colored, adhering to the lemma and palea. Modal length of guard cells 39-52 µ; modal diameter of the pollen grains 35-38 µ. Chromosome number 2n = 14.

description: Perennials with puberulent to pilose, or glabrous leaves. Culms 70-140 cm. tall, erect. Nodes (3-)5-7(-9), retrorsely puberulent to pubescent, or glabrous. Internodes glabrous or puberulent. Culm leaves with lax blades 15-35 cm. long, 6-15(-19) mm. wide, pilose on one or both surfaces, or glabrous, frequently conspicuously narrowed at both ends. Auricles absent. Ligule 0.5-2 mm. long, erose, obtuse to truncate, glabrous. Panicle 9-25 cm. long, erect or nodding, open, pyramidal, the axis glabrous or puberulent, the branches ascending to spreading or occasionally divaricate, sometimes becoming reflexed, (1-)2-3(.14) per node, with slender to prominent pulvini at their bases; lower branches as much as 8 cm. long. Spikelets 1.5-3(-3.7) cm. long with 5-10(-13) florets. Glumes pubescent (pubescence sometimes sparse and short), or rarely entirely glabrous, the first 4-8 mm. long, 1-nerved, subulate, the second 6-11 mm. long, 3-(5-) nerved, subulate or with an acute tip. Lemmas 8-12 mm. long, uniformly pubescent over the back, sometimes more densely so on the margins, grading off to scabrous or entirely glabrous, 7-(5-) nerved, subulate or with an acute tip, bearing an awn 4-8 mm. long below an entire apex. Palea slightly shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, puberulent to pilose, or rarely glabrous between the nerves. Anthesis from late May through June and early July. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe slightly notched to truncate, with a slight or prominent median thickening. Anthers (2-)3.5-4.5(-5.2) mm. long, exserted at anthesis. Caryopsis 7-9 mm. long, oblanceolate or cuneate; pericarp purple-black at maturity, rarely amber, adhering tightly to the palea and lemma. Modal length of guard cells (35-)40-46(-49) µ; modal diameter of pollen grains 35-39(-42) µ. Chromosome number 2n 14.

description: Perennial. Culms 85-150 cm. tall, erect. Nodes 9-20, glabrous, or rarely retrorsely puberulent-pubescent. Internodes glabrous. Radical leaves glabrous throughout. Culm leaves with glabrous to retrorsely pilose-lanate sheaths that overlap, hence longer than the internodes; blades 11-46 cm. long and 6-15 mm. wide glabrous, or rarely pilose, scabrous at least on the upper third, lax. Auricles conspicuous. Throat more or less pilose, rarely entirely glabrous. Ligule 0.2-1 mm. long, erose, truncate, pubescent-pilose on the abaxial side, occasionally glabrous. Panicle (6-)10-20(-24) cm. long, erect-nodding, pyramidal with spreading branches, the axis glabrous and smooth on the lower (2) internodes, becoming scabrous above; branches 2(-4) at a node, usually with prominent pulvini at their bases. Spikelets 1.5-3 cm. long with 4-9 florets. Glumes pubescent, rarely entirely glabrous, the first 4-7 mm. long, 1- or rarely 3-nerved, subulate, the second 6-9(-10) mm. long, subulate, occasionally mucronate. Lemmas 9-14 mm. long, pubescent on the margins and across the back, occasionally the pubescence more or less restricted to the margins, 7-nerved, bearing an awn (2-)3-5(-7) mm. long below an entire apex. Palea slightly shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves, sparsely puberulent to pubescent between the nerves. Anthesis from late July through August to early September. Caryopsis 6-8 mm. long, oblanceolate, amber-colored, adhering very little or not at all to the palea and lemma. Modal length of the guard cells 32-40(-45) [L; modal diameter of the pollen grains 35-42 [t. Chromosome number 2n = 14.

description: Perennial. Culms 55-90(-110) cm. tall, erect to spreading. Nodes (3-)4-5(-6), glabrous. Internodes glabrous. Radical leaves pubescen't or with glabrous blades. Culm leaves with pilose or glabrous sheaths, the blades 1O-25(-35) cm. long, 3-7(-9) mm. wide, entirely glabrous or frequently with a tuft of hairs at the auricle position. Auricles absent. Ligule 0.5-2(-4) mm. long, obtuse to truncate, erose or lacerate, glabrous. Panicle 10-23(-26) cm. long, open, the axis glabrous and usually smooth, the branches ascending to spreading or drooping, (1-)2-4(-5) per node, the lowest as much as 14 cm. long, rarely with prominent pulvini at their bases. Spikelets 1.7-3.3(-4.4) cm. long with (4-)6-10(-15) florets. Glumes glabrous, the first 1- or rarely 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute tip, the second 3-nerved, subulate or with an acute or obtuse tip. Lemmas (9-)10-14 mm. long, the margins pubescent on the lower half to three-fourths, glabrous across the back or slightly pubescent along the nerves and at the base, (5- or) 7-nerved, bearing an awn 3-5(-6) mm. long below an entire apex. Palea shorter than the lemma, ciliate on the nerves and glabrous between the nerves. Anthesis through August and September. Ovarian appendage with posterior lobe obtuse, truncate, or with a slight notch, sometimes with a slight median thickening. Anthers (1.7-)2-3.5(-4.5) mm. long, exserted or included at anthesis. Caryopsis 8-9(-11) mm. long, ellipsoidal to spathulate, amber, dark amber-colored, or rarely purple, adhering to the palpa and lemma. Modal length of guard cells 42.-56 µ; modal diameter of the pollen grains 41-45 µ. Chromosome number 2n = 28.

description: Perennial (?). Culms 50-95 cm. tall, erect. Nodes 2-3(-4), glabrous. Internodes glabrous or puberulent just below the nodes. Spikelets 1.5-3 cm. long with 5-7 florets. Glumes glabrous or sparsely pubescent, the first 7-11 mm. long, subulate or with an acute tip, 1- or 3-nerved, the second 9-12 mm. long, subulate or with an acute to obtuse tip, 3-nerved. Lemmas 11-15 mm. long, pubescent across the back and along the margins to nearly glabrous (3-, 5-, or) 7-nerved, bearing an awn 2-5 mm. 'long below an entire apex. description: Annual. Culms 30-75 cm. tall, erect or spreading. Nodes 3-5, retrorsely pubescent. Ligule of the culm leaves 2-3(-3.5) mm. long, obtuse, erose-lacerate, pubescent on the back. Panicle 8-15(-22) cm. long, erect to drooping, open; branches ascending, up to 9 cm. long, 1-2 per node, the axis glabrous and smooth on the internodes. Spikelets 2-3 cm. long, with 4-7 florets. Glumes glabrous to hispidubous, the first 6-9 mm. long, 1-nerved, subulate, the second 8-10.5 mm. long, 3-nerved, subulate, rarely mucronate. Lemmas 9-15 mm. long, glabrous or scabrous on the back and margins, 3- or 7-nerved, margins inrolled in fruit, olive-green colored, subulate, bearing an awn 4-8 mm. long below an entire apex. Palea slightly shorter than the lemma, scabrous on the nerves, frequently 2-toothed. Anthesis through April. description: Perennial. Culms 60-125 cm. tall, erect or spreading. Nodes (3-)4-6(-7), retrorsely pilose, rarely glabrous. Internodes glabrous or sometimes puberulent just below the nodes. Panicle (7.5-)10-15(-34) cm. long, open, the axis glabrous, the branches ascending or drooping, (1-)2-3(-5) per node. Spikelets 1.5-3 cm. long with (3-)4-9 florets. description: The only published description of this species is the original by Swallen, and this is based entirely upon pistillate plants. In most respects it is satisfactory, but study of our recent collections suggests certain modifications and additions. The flowering culms may attain a length of 12 cm, and for the most part they are prostrate, bringing the inflorescences close to the ground. Although Swallen states that the spicate branches are 1 or 2, we find that 3 is the more characteristic number; culms with 2 branches are not uncomnmon, but those bearing a single branch are rather rare. The length of the first glume is given as 3.5 mm, whereas we find them to be as much as 5 mm long-perhaps 3-5 mm was intended. Although not mentioned in the original description, the lemma is rather firm (cartilaginous), smooth, shiny, and occasionally has a few short appressed hairs on the back. The pistil bears 2 large purple feathery stigmas, and the mature caryopsis is about 3.5 mm long. Finally, the rudimentary florets in our material often attain a length of 20 mm or more. Since the staminate plants have been unknown until the present, they are described in detail below. Staminate plants: Perennial, strongly stoloniferous, the culms in small dense tufts as much as 18 (mostly 10-15) cm tall. Stolons, flowering culms, various parts of the inflorescence, and sometimes nerves of the leaves, tinged with purple. Sheaths overlapping, -+ densely pilose with white hairs ca 1 mm long; ligule a line of white hairs about 0.2 mm long on the lower leaves, but as much as 1 mm on those of the culm; blades flat to somewhat involute, attenuate, up to 8 mm long, 2-3 mm wide, -+ pilose-often densely so-with hairs like those of the sheath, the culm leaves often glabrous or nearly so, the margins scabrous; spicate branches of the inflorescence mostly 3 (often 2 or rarely 1), approximate, straight or arcuate; rachis 8-15 mm long, ca 0.4 mm wide, with a dense tuft of hairs at the base, the margins scabrous and often i pilose, the awn-like point mostly 3-5 mm long; spikelets pectinate on very short pedicels, bearded at the base; first glume pale or slightly purplish, subulate, 1-nerved, 3-4 mm long, glabrous except at the base, the nerve -+ scabrous; second glume broader, usually distinctly purplish, 1-3- nerved, 4.5-6 mm long, rarely somewhat pilose on the back, the apex entire or minutely bi- or trifid; lemma 3-nerved, equal to the second glume or slightly shorter, glabrous, the apex irregularly and minutely tridentate; palea equalling or slightly exceeding the lemma, the apex entire or minutely bifid; anthers 3, bright orange, ca 3 mm long; pistil, if present, very much reduced; rudiment above the functional floret, when present consisting of 1 or several purplish, antrorsely scabrous awns, rarely as much as 15 mm long. Chromosome number, n = 20.

description: Culms to 1 cm in diam., to 2-3 m tall, more or less erect with mature culms slightly inclined. Internodes 4-11.6 cm long, terete, glabrous, waxy. Culm leaves 7.8-17 cm long, abaxially glabrous, juncture of sheath and blade a more or less horizontal to curved, indistinct line; sheaths 5-12.4 cm long, 1.4-2.7 times as long as the blademore or less triangular; blades 2.8-5.7 cm long, triangular, erect, persistent, apex subulate; girdle poorly developed, glabrous; inner ligule 1-2 mm long, irregular, ciliolate. Nodes at mid-culm with the central bud linearly subtended by 7-18 subsidiary buds; sheath scar more or less horizontal; supra- nodal ridge prominent; root primordia absent. Branching intravaginal; central branch 41-49 cm long, erect to divergent, rebranching; leafy subsidiary branches 7-18 per node, 6-16 cm long, erect to ascending, occasion- ally rebranching from the base. Foliage leaves 10-13 per complement; sheaths persistent, glabrous to softly pubescent toward the apex; blades 2.6-5.6 cm long, 0.35-0.5 (0.7) cm wide, L:W = 6.5-1 1, stiff, adaxially and abaxially glabrous, not tessellate, apex subulate, base truncate-rounded; pseudopetiole 0.3 mm long, distinct; outer ligule a short, usually ciliolate rim, 0.2-0.3 mm long; inner ligule 0.2-0.5 mm long, truncate, abaxially pubescent. Panicles 2-5 cm long, spikelike, the base retained within the subtending sheath; rachis more or less triquetrous, scabrous-pubescent; branches to 1 cm long, appressed, angular, scabrid to pubescent; pedicels 1-3 mm long, angular, scabrid. Spikelets 6.2-8.7 mm long, the anthecium 1.1-1.3 mm wide, more or less terete to slightly dorsally compressed. Glumes 2, 0.2-0.4 mm long, less than 1/20 the spikelet length, subequal, scalelike, glabrous. Sterile lemmas 2, 1/2-2/3 the spikelet length, abaxially finely pubescent; sterile lemma I 2.8- 5.1 mm long, subulate, 1- or 3-nerved; sterile lemma II 3.1-5.5 mm long, subulate to awn-tipped, 1-, 3-, or 5-nerved. Fertile lem- ma 6-8.3 mm long, subulate to awn-tipped, glabrous to scabrous-pubescent, 7-nerved. Palea 5.8-8 mm long, subequal to the fertile lemma, sulcate only toward the apex, bimucronulate, glabrous, 4- or 6-nerved. Stamens and fruit unknown.

description: Culms 1-1.75 cm diam., 5-6(10) m long, scandent, often climbing and hanging. Internodes 27-40 cm long, terete, appressed hispid just below the node, retrorsely scabrous on the upper 1/3 (where not covered by the culm leaves), when young with a glaucous band about 1 cm wide below the nodal line. Culm leaves 17-32 cm long, persistent, the juncture of the sheath and blade abaxially obscure; sheaths 14-26 cm long, 3-5.6 times longer than the blade, abaxially retrorsely scabrous, becoming scabrid toward the base, the prickles stout, the midrib slightly raised and more prominent than the other nerves, visible on the upper 1/2 to nearly the full length of the sheath, continuous with the midrib of the blade, the overlapping margin ciliate for about the upper 2 to nearly its full length, the other margin not seen; blades (3)4- 7(8.5) cm long (tips often broken), narrowly triangular, erect, persistent, abaxially retrorsely scabrous to scabrid but the prickles sparse, the midrib slightly raised and visible for the full length, apex tapering, shortly subulate, the margins glabrous, often slightly revolute; girdle 2-7 mm wide, glabrous, dark brown to black, often thickened at the juncture with the sheath; inner ligule ca. 0.5 mm long. Nodes at midculm with one circular central bud subtended by 4-7 smaller subsidiary buds in a constellate arrange ment; nodal line horizontal, dipping mark- edly below the bud/branch complement; supranodal ridge swollen, prominent. Branching infravaginal; central branch developing horizontally at first, usually becoming geniculate, nearly as robust as the main culm; leafy subsidiary branches (5)9-11 per node, 20-56 cm long, 2-3 mm diam., geniculate, rebranching, the girdles at the lower nodes usually dark purple to black. Foliage leaves 4-8 per complement; sheaths glabrous, the margins glabrous; blades (8.4)9-21(28.6) cm long, 2.4-4.3(5.8) cm wide, L:W = 3- 6, abaxially glabrous, weakly tessellate, lighter green, the midrib slightly raised and visible for nearly the full length, adaxially glabrous, not tessellate to weakly so, the midrib barely distinguishable or only distinguishable for the lower 1/2, the base asymmetrical, one side rounded, the other round- ed-attenuate, the apex tapering, acuminate, shortly subulate, the margins finely serrulate, one often nearly glabrous; pseudopetiole 2-5(8) mm long, glabrous, pulvinate at the base, often dark purple; outer ligule 0.5-0.7 mm long, glabrous; inner ligule 2- 3(4.5) mm long, rounded, glabrous. Inforescence 2-3.5 cm long, 2-3 cm wide, capitate, congested, semiglobose, the base usually retained within the (1)2 subtending spathes, spathe I (lower or only) with the sheaths 1.6-3.4 cm long, not expanded, the blades 2.2-5.5 cm long, green, arching over the inflorescence, spathe II (upper) with the sheaths 1.5-2.6 cm long, expanded, appressed to the inflorescence, the blades 0.5- 1.7 cm long, green; rachis more or less flattened to triquetrous, glabrous; branches reduced, the longest to 0.5 cm long, angular, glabrous, the lowermost subtended by a usually bladeless bract ca. 1.8 cm long, bracts subtending other branches minute, to 0.5 mm long; pedicels 2-3(4) mm long, angular, glabrous. Spikelets 10.5-14 mm long including the awns, the body 8-9.5 mm long, laterally compressed; glume I 10-14 mm long including the awn, 1-1.5 times the length of the lemma, awned, abaxially scabrous except on body margins, adaxially pubescent, (1)3-5-nerved, the body 3-5 mm long, attenuate, the awn 6-10 mm long; glume 11 10.4-12 mm long including the awn, 1.1-1.3 times the length of the lemma, awned, abaxially scabrous except on body margins, adaxially pubescent, (3)5- nerved, the body 4-5 mm long, attenuate, the awn 6.4-8 mm long; glume III 9.5-11.4 mm long including the tip, 1.1-1.3 times the length of the lemma, subulate to awntipped, abaxially scabrid-pubescent on the upper l/3-l/2, adaxially glabrous, 5-7-nerved, the tip 1-1.9 mm long; glume IV 8.6-9.4 mm long, 1-1. 1 times the length of the lemma, mucronate, abaxially scabrid on the upper 1/2, adaxially glabrous, 5-7-nerved; lemma 7.7-8.9 mm long, mucronate, abaxially scabrid toward the apex, adaxially glabrous, 7-9-nerved, the margins slightly fused at the apex; palea 7-8.8 mm long, subequal to the lemma, bimucronulate, abaxially scabrid at the apex and between the central two nerves, adaxially pubescent just at apex, 4- nerved, sulcate only near the apex. Lodicules 3, the anterior pair 1.6-2 mm long, the posterior one ca. 1 mm long, all apically ciliate. Stamens 3; anthers 4-5 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Culmi 0.2-1 cm diam., (2)3-6 m longi, scandentes, dependentes. Folia culmorum (13.5)21.7-32.5+ cm longa, persistentia; vaginae (10)14-18 cm longae, 1.1- 1.8(3.5)-plo longiores quam laminam, abaxialiter retrorsum scabrae; laminae (2.8)7.7-14.5+ cm longae; cingulum 2-5 mm latum, pubescenti-hispidum. Ram- ificatio infravaginalis; rami subsidiarii cujusquisque nodi 12-25, (9)19-33 cm longi, 1 mm diam., geniculati. Folia cujusquisque complementi 5-11; vaginae glabrae et ciliatae ad apicem vel omnino piloso-pubes- centes; laminae (6)7.5-12 cm longae, 0.7-1.2 cm latae, long./lat. = 8-11.4, olivaceae, pilosae vel glabrae, basi rotundato-attenuatae, tantum asymmetricae. Inflorescentia 1.5-2 cm diam., capitata, congesta, semiglobosa, spathis duabus subtenta. Spiculae aristis inclusis 7.9-9(11) mm longae; gluma I 7.4-9.1 mm longa, 1- 1.5-plo longior quam lemma, aristata, abaxialiter pi- losa; gluma II 7.6-8.6 mm longa, 1-1.5-plo longior quam lemma, aristata, abaxialiter pilosa; gluma III 7.5-8.8 mm longa, lemma plus minusve aequans, sub- ulato-aristata; gluma IV 6.7-8.1 mm longa, lemma plus minusve aequans, subulata; lemma 7.4-7.7 mm longum, breviter subulatum; palea 6.4-6.7 mm longa, abaxialiter glabra.

description: Culms 0.2-1 cm diam., (2)3-6 m long, scandent, clambering and hanging. Inter- nodes ca. 15 cm long, terete, densely pilose-hispid directly below the nodes, each pilose on the upper 1/3, the lower 2/3 either glabrous or covered with scattered appressed hairs for nearly the full length. Culm leaves (few complete examples seen) (13.5)21.7-32.5+ cm long, persistent, the juncture of the sheath and blade abaxially an obscure horizontal line; sheaths (9.8)14- 18 cm long, 1.1-1.8(3.5) times longer than the blade (using estimated blade lengths), abaxially retrorsely scabrous with stout prickles, also hispid on the lower 1/3-2/3, the midrib sometimes slightly raised, distinguishable for most of the length except at the base, continuous with the midrib of the blade, the overlapping margin glabrous or ciliate for nearly the full length, the other margin glabrous or ciliate at least near apex; blades (2.8)7.7-14.5+ cm long (tips usually broken), narrowly triangular, erect, persistent, abaxially retrorsely scabrous, the prickles stout, the midrib slightly raised and visible for most of the length, adaxially glabrous to scabrid, the apex (probably) acuminate; girdle 2-5 mm wide, pubescent hispid; inner ligule 0.5-1 mm long. Nodes at mid-culm with one circular central bud subtended by 12-15 smaller subsidiary buds in a constellate arrangement; nodal line horizontal, dipping markedly below the bud/ branch complement; supranodal ridge swollen, more or less prominent. Branching infravaginal; central branch developing tardily or not at all; leafy subsidiary branches with the lower tier geniculate downward, the upper tier geniculate upward, 12-25 per node, (9)19-33 cm long, 1 mm diam., only occasionally rebranching. Foliage leaves 5- 11 per complement; sheaths glabrous with a tuft of hairs at the apex on both sides or completely pilose-pubescent, the overlapping margin glabrous to sparsely ciliate; blades (5.9)7.5-12 cm long, 0.7-1.2 cm wide, L:W = 8-11.4, tinted with olive, abaxially and adaxially pilose or both sides glabrous, a basal, abaxial tuft of hairs near the midrib present, not tessellate, the apex attenuate, the base rounded-attenuate, slightly asymmetrical, the margins always ciliate toward the apex, otherwise glabrous or ciliate, the cilia 0.5-0.7 mm long; pseudopetiole ca. 2 mm long, abaxially pilose- pubescent, adaxially pilose-pubescent or sparsely pilose, the base pulvinate, one margin usually thickened and ciliate; outer ligule 0.3-0.5 mm long, glabrous or pubescent and ciliate; inner ligule 1-1.5 mm long, rounded to asymmetrical at the apex. Inflorescence 1.5-2 cm diam., capitate, congested, the base retained within the subtending spathes, subtended by 1 or more usually 2 spathes, spathe I (lower) with sheaths 1.1-1.5 cm long, expanded, the blades 0.7-1.4(3) cm long, green, spathe II (upper) with the sheaths 1-1.2 cm long, expanded, the blades absent to 0.9 cm long, brown; rachis angular, pubescent; branches very reduced, the lowermost branch subtended by a bract to 0.9 cm long, this occasionally with a blade to 0.5 cm long, higher bracts ca. 1 mm long; pedicels ca. 0.5 mm long, angular, pubescent, subtended by bracts ca. 1 mm long. Spikelets 7.9- 9(1 1) mm long including the awns, more or less laterally compressed; glume I 7.4-9.1 mm long including the awn, 1-1.5 times the length of the lemma, awned, abaxially pi- lose except near the margins, 3-nerved, the body attenuate, the awn 3.9-5.1 mm long; glume II 7.6-8.6 mm long including the awn, 1-1.5 times the length of the lemma, awned, abaxially pilose except near the margins, 3-nerved, the body attenuate, the awn 4.1-5.1 mm long; glumes III and IV more or less equal to the length of the lemma, abaxially scabrous-pilose on the upper 1/2, 5-nerved; glume III 7.5-8.8 mm long including the awn, subulate-awned, the awn 1.5-3 mm long; glume IV 6.7-8.1 mm long, subulate; lemma 7.4-7.7 mm long, shortly subulate, abaxially scabrous or hispid-pilose on the upper 1/2, 7-nerved; palea 6.4-6.7 mm long, shorter than the lemma, bimucronulate, abaxially glabrous, adaxially pubescent at the apex, 6-nerved, sulcate only near the apex. Lodicules 3, the anterior pair ca. 2.2 mm long, the posterior one 2 mm long, all apically ciliate. Stamens 3; anthers 4-4.5 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Culmi erecti usque ad 7 m alti, internodio 1 cm diametro, gemmis verticillatis, verticillatim ramificantes. Culmorum vaginae stramineae, papilloso-echinatae. Foliorum laminae lanceolatae, 4.5-5.5 cm longae, 6-7 mm latae, infra hirtellae. Inflorescentia paniculata, angusta, usque ad 9 cm longa, 20-40 spiculata. Spiculae ovato-lanceolatae, 6.6-8 mm longae.

description: Bamboo with erect solid culms to 7 m tall, at least 1 cm in diameter; internodes glabrous, glossy, brownish-green. Culm leaves: sheath stramineous, the outer surface papillose-echinate with the rigid hairs shorter below and becoming longer toward the summit, the inner surface of the sheath appressed-pilose; blade unknown. Nodes at mid-culm containing a large central bud with small auxiliary ones forming a complete ring. Branching: the principal bud developing into a primary branch which re- branches, the subsidiary buds developing into short unbranched branches with thick nodes, the branches strongly geniculate at the lower nodes, later disarticulating at the first or second node. Foliage leaves (as found on flowering branches in the only specimen available) lanceolate, 4.5-5.5 cm long, 6-7 mm wide, with widely scattered hairs above, hirtellous below, not tessellate; inner ligule a truncate rim 0.4 mm long; outer ligule a minute rim. Inflorescence a narrow panicle of 20-40 spikelets terminating leafy branches, up to 9 cm long, with slender appressed branches. Spikelets obovate-lanceolate, 6.6-8 mm long, disarticulating between the second and third transitional glumes. Transitional glumes 4: 1 and 2 scalelike, no more than 0.4 mm long; 3 and 4 ca 3/4 or more the length of the spikelet, very thin, membranous, disintegrating with age, stramineous and contrasting with the pale green color of the lemma and palea, glabrous, except for a ciliolate tip; glume 3, 6-6.4 mm long, 5-7-nerved, obovate-lanceolate with an obtuse upper margin and short awn; glume 4, 6.1-6.6 mm long, 7-nerved, obovate-lanceolate with an obtuse upper margin and short awn. Lemma obovate-lanceolate, coriaceous, 7.3-7.5 mm long, 9- or 10-nerved, glabrous except for the ciliolate upper margin, tessellate (the cross veins manifest only on the inner surface); palea lanceolate, ca 7 mm long, membranous, 6-8-nerved, with some cross veins, the 2 central nerves forming keels, sulcate and glabrous between the keels, the upper margin bifid; todicules 3, 1.5-1.8 mm long, the 2 anterior ones spatulate, many-nerved, thickened on the lower half toward the inner edge, other- wise membranous, long-ciliate, the cilia ca 2/5 as long as the body of the lodicule. Posterior lodicule linear-ovoid, many-nerved, membranous throughout, long-ciliate; stamens 3, the anthers yellow-orange, 4.1-4.3 mm long; ovary with 2 sparingly plumose stigmas; fruit unknown.

description: Culmi erecti usque ad 10 m alti, internodio 1.5-2 cm diametro, gemmis verticillatis, verticillatim ramificantes. Culmorum vaginae chartaceae, verrucosae. Foliorum laminae lineari-lanceolatae, usque ad 7 cm longae, 3-6 mm latae, utrinque glabrae. Inflorescentia paniculata, angusta, 7-9- spiculata. Spiculae obovato-lanceolatae, 4.9 mm longae.

description: Bamboo forming open cespitose clumps with pachymorph rhizomes, the solid culms with thick walls and little pith, sub-decumbent, curved at the base, then sub-erect, becoming straight above and broadly arched with a clambering tip, to 10 m tall, 1.5-2 cm thick at the base, with 40-50 nodes; internodes glabrous, glossy, pale green or stramineous to brown. Culm leaves more or less persistent at the base of the culm, promptly deciduous above: sheath chartaceous, to 40 cm long, 4-6 cm wide, broader in the middle than at the base and narrowing greatly to a truncate summit 2-3 mm wide, purplish-green when young becoming stramineous, the surface verrucose with scattered rigid papillose hairs; blade narrow, at first erect, becoming reflexed, very small in comparison to its sheath, 2-3 cm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, caducous; inner ligule a truncate membrane 1 mm long or less, pubescent; outer ligule a tiny ciliate ridge. Nodes at mid-culm containing a large principal bud with 2 or 3 rows of small auxiliary ones forming a complete ring; on the lower less-developed nodes these buds on both sides of the node only or in a small patch on the opposite side of the principal bud in the least-developed nodes; the lowermost nodes without buds. Branching: the principal bud remaining dormant or developing into a primary branch up to 130 cm long with secondary branches up to 30 cm long forming at each of its nodes; each of the secondary branches with 2 or 3 short internodes at the base followed by the leaf complement; subsidiary branches mostly 10-15 cm long, forming all the way around the culm in verticillate fashion, not rebranching. Foliage leaves: 5 or 6 per complement; blades linear-lanceolate, up to 7 cm long, 3-6 mm wide, green above and glabrous, not tessellate, glaucous below with a tuft of hairs at the base on one side of the midvein, not tessellate; inner ligule an inconspicuous rim ca 0.5 mm long; outer ligule a minute rim; sheath light green mottled with dark green, glabrous, short-ciliate outer margin. Inflorescence a nar- row panicle of 7-9 spikelets terminating leafy branches, 3-4 cm long, with a couple of slender appressed branches, each with 2 or 3 spikelets; peduncle long- exserted; pedicels 1.7-3.8 mm long. Spikelets obovate-lanceolate, somewhat dorsally compressed 4.9-6 mm long, disarticulating between the second and third transitional glumes. Transitional glumes 4: 1 and 2 scalelike, ca 0.2 mm long, glabrous; 3 and 4 obovate, ca 1/2 the length of the spikelet, 1.8-2.7 mm long, glabrous, stramineous, membranous, 3-nerved. Lemma obovate-lanceolate, membranous, 5.4 mm long, with 9 thick nerves, glabrous; palea linear-lanceolate, membranous, with 4 nerves, the 2 central ones forming keels, sulcate and puberulent between the keels, otherwise glabrous; lodicules 3, spatulate, 0.8-0.9 mm long, the two anterior ones a little larger and thicker than the posterior, with the inner margins thickest, many-nerved, with long cilia on the upper margins, about half the length of the lodicule; stamens 3, the anthers yellow, 3.2-3.6 mm long, the filaments attached at the lower 1/4 or 1/5; ovary with 2 styles bearing sparingly plumose stigmas; fruit unknown.

description: Culmi circa 1 cm diam., 1.5-2.5 m alti, erecti. Folia culmorum 11.5-15.5 cm longa, decidua, abaxialiter pubescentia; vaginae 5.9-9.6 cm longae, 1.1-1.6-plo longiores quam laminam; laminae 5.5-7 cm longae, anguste triangulares, ad basim angustiores quam vaginorum apicem. Ramificatio intravaginalis; ramus centralis 22-38 cm longus, adscendens; rami subsidiarii cujusquisque nodi 10-14, 16-23 cm longi, erecti. Folia cujusquisque complementi 19-24; vaginae persistentes, pubescentes inter nervos; laminae 4.5-5.6 cm longae, 0.4-0.45 cm latae, ratio long./lat. = 11-14, glabrae, basi rotundato-attenuatae. Inflorescentia ignota.

description: Culms ca. I cm in diam., 1.5-2.5 m tall, erect. Internodes 6-7 cm long, slightly flattened above the branch complement, minutely pubescent for the upper 1/2, becoming nearly glabrous with age, waxy. Culm leaves 11.5-15.5 cm long, deciduous as the branches develop, the base often splitting, more or less loosely wrapped around the culm, abaxially pubescent, juncture of the sheath and blade abaxially a more or less horizontal, indistinct line; sheaths 5.9-9.6 cm long, 1.1-1.6 times as long as the blade, more or less rectangular; blades 5.5-7 cm long, narrowly triangular, persistent, adaxially scabrid, apex subulate, base narrower than the sheath apex; girdle 1 mm wide, pubescent; inner ligule 0.5-1 mm long, glabrous. Nodes not swollen, the central bud linearly subtended by 9-13 subsidiary buds; sheath scar more or less horizontal; supranodal ridge obscure; root primordia absent. Branching intravaginal; central branch 22- 38 cm long, ascending, rebranching; leafy subsidiary branches 10-14 per node, 16-23 cm long, erect, usually not rebranching. Foliage leaves 19-24 per complement; sheaths persistent, pubescent between the nerves; blades 4.5-5.6 cm long, 0.4-0.45 cm wide, L:W = 11-14, glabrous and not tessellate, apex subulate, base rounded-attenuate; pseudopetiole 0.5 mm long, distinct; outer ligule a minute, glabrous rim; inner ligule 0.5-0.8 mm long, truncate, minutely pubescent. Inflorescence unknown.

description: Culms 1-1.5 (2) cm in diam., 1-2 (3) m tall, erect at the base, inclined to arching slightly at the apices. Internodes 3.8-8.6 cm long, slightly flattened to sulcate above the branch complement, pubescent just below the nodes, glabrous on the lower half, waxy. Culm leaves (9) 11.6-23.6 cm long, persis- tent, often surpassing the next node, abax- ially scabrid to scabrous, juncture of sheath and blade abaxially an obscure, more or less horizontal line; sheaths (6) 7.5-16 cm long, 1-2.4 (4.2) times as long as the blade, fused for 1-2 cm at the base; blades (3.5) 6-9 cm long, triangular, erect, persistent, adaxially scabrid or pubescent toward base or apex, apex mucronate or subulate, base narrower than the sheath apex; girdle 1-2 mm wide, pubescent; inner ligule 0.5-1 mm long, irregular, ciliolate, sometimes absent. Nodes slightly swollen, the one triangular central bud subtended by 1 or 2 rows of smaller subsidiary buds in a constellate array; sheath scar dipping below the branch complement; supranodal ridge prominent; root primor- dia absent. Branching extravaginal; central branch 18-29 cm long, ascending, rebranching; leafy subsidiary branches 12-45 per node, 3-15 cm long, ascending, occasionally rebranching from the base. Foliage leaves 9-12 (18) per complement; sheaths persistent, pubescent between the nerves, especially toward the margins, the margins ciliate or glabrous; blades 1.3-3.7 cm long, 0.2-0.4 cm wide, L:W = 6.5-15, glabrous, not tessellate, apex subulate, base rounded to more commonly rounded-attenuate; pseudopetiole ca. 0.5 mm long, more or less distinct; outer ligule 0.1-0.2 mm, ciliolate; inner ligule 0.3-0.5 mm long, truncate. Panicles 1-4 cm long, narrow, base retained within the subtending sheath; rachis angular, pubescent; branches angular, pubescent, appressed, the lower ones to 1 cm long; ped- icels 1-3.5 mm long, angular, pubescent, appressed. Spikelets 5.4-6.9 mm long, the anthecium 1.2-1.5 mm wide, more or less terete. Glumes 2, ca. 1/10 the spikelet length, scalelike, acute to obtuse, pubescent; glume I 0.4-1 mm long, 1-nerved or nerves absent; glume II 0.4-2 mm long, 1- or 3-nerved or nerves absent. Sterile lemmas 2, 1/2-2/3 the spikelet length, mucronate or subulate, abaxially pubescent on the upper one-half to two-thirds, 3- or 5-nerved; sterile lemma I 2.9-4.2 mm long; sterile lemma II 3.1-4.7 mm long. Fertile lemma 4.9-6.7 mm long, mucronate or subulate, abaxially pubescent on the upper two-thirds, 5-, 7-, or 9-nerved. Palea 4-6.1 mm long, slightly shorter than the fertile lemma, bimucronulate, sulcate toward the apex, 4- or 6-nerved. Stamens 3, the anthers ca. 3 mm long. Lodicules 3, the anterior pair 0.8-1 mm long, the posterior one ca. 0.8 mm long, ciliate. Cary- opsis ca. 3.7 mm long, the beak 0.3 mm long, reddish-brown with a dark, linear hilum.

description: Culms 0.7-1.5 (2.5) cm in diam., 2-4 (5) m tall, erect, often slightly arching at the apex. Internodes 11-19 cm long, more or less terete, glabrous, waxy. Culm leaves 13.8- 24 cm long, caducous, juncture of sheath and blade abaxially an obscure, more or less horizontal line or an inverted "V"; sheaths 9-19.5 cm long, 1.6-5 (9) times as long as the blade, abaxially glabrous, margins glabrous, slightly scarious; blades 1.4-6 cm long, triangular to narrowly triangular, erect, persistent, abaxially and adaxially glabrous or retrorsely scabrous, apex subulate; girdle 0.5-1 mm wide, glabrous; inner ligule 1-3 mm long, ciliolate. Nodes slightly swollen, the one triangular central bud only slightly larger than the 4 or 5 more robust subsidiary buds that flank it, this tier of buds subtended by 4 or 5 tiers of medium and small-sized subsidiary buds; sheath scar dipping slightly below the bud/branch complement; supra- nodal ridge visible but not prominent; root primoridia absent. Branching modified extravaginal, the culm leaves falling as the branches develop, but the branches often split the base of the culm leaf; central branch ca. 85 cm long, ascending or divergent, rebranching; leafy subsidiary branches of two to three sizes, the smaller subsidiaries 25- 50 per node, 4-23 cm long, ascending or divergent, rebranching, the more robust medium to large subsidiaries 4-16 per node, 16-60 cm long, ascending or divergent, rebranching. Foliage leaves 5-9 per comple- ment; sheaths deciduous, maculate with light green spots, usually glabrous, sometimes pubescent between the nerves, the margins scarious; blades (3.5) 4.9-10.3 cm long, (0.3) 0.5-1.2 cm wide, L:W = 6.5-11.2 (13), adaxially glabrous, abaxially usually glabrous, rarely pilose, not tessellate, apex short subulate, base rounded to rounded-attenuate; pseudopetiole (0.5) 1-2 mm long; outer ligule 0.1-0.5 mm long, glabrous to ciliolate; inner ligules 0.2-0.5 mm long, truncate, abaxially glabrous or pubescent, often ciliolate. Panicles 1-3 cm long, narrow, base retained within the subtending sheath; rachis, branches, and pedicels angular, scabrous-pubescent to just the edges scabrous, bracts often present at the bases of the branches and pedicels; pedicels 2-6 mm long, appressed. Spikelets 6.9-8.7 mm long, glabrous, the anthecium 1.5-2.3 mm wide, dorsally compressed. Glumes 2, 0.1-0.4 mm long, no more than '/20 the spikelet length, scalelike, nerves absent. Sterile lemmas 2, mucronate or subulate; sterile lemma I 2.4- 3.3 mm long, 1/3 - 1/2 the spikelet length, 1- or 3-nerved; sterile lemma 11 3.3-3.6 mm long, 1/2-3/5 the spikelet length, 3-nerved. Fertile lemma 6.1-7.2 mm long, mucronate to short subulate, 7-nerved. Palea 6.4-7.6 mm long, overtopping the fertile lemma, sulcate only near the apex, bimucronulate, 4-nerved. Stamens 3, the anthers 4.3-4.5 mm long. Lodicules unknown. Caryopsis ca. 3.7 mm long, dark purple, beak 0.2 mm long, hilum linear, 2.8 mm long, the embryo ca. 1/3 the caryopsis length.

description: Culmi (0.2-0.4)0.9-2.5 cm diam., (0.6)2-4(5) m alti, erecti ad basim, arcuati vel scandentes apicem versus. Internodia valde sulcata, sulcata vel complanata ad dimidium superiorem. Folia culmorum (12)13.5-33 cm longa, nodum proximum superantia, decidua, fragilia; vaginae 11-24.5 cm longae, 3-10(22)-plo longiores quam laminam, abaxialiter retrorsum scabrae, glabrae ad apicem, dense hirsutae ad basim; laminae 0.7-5.7 cm longae, apice subulatae; cingulum ca. 1.5 mm latum, hirsutum. Ramificatio extravaginalis; rami subsidiarii cujusquisque nodi 80-150, 5-11 cm longi, ca. 1 mm diam., recti. Folia cujusquisque complementi 3-4; vaginae pubescentes inter nervos, apice utrinque prolongatae per 1-4(7) mm, adnatae ad ligulam interiorem, ciliatae; laminae (7.5)8.5-16(19) cm longae, (0.15)0.2-0.3 cm latae, long./lat. = 43-82(104), lineares, rigidae, basi attenuatae. Inflorescentia 6-10.5 cm longa, paniculata, angusta. Spiculae 5-6.5(7) mm longae; glumae I et II usque ad 0.2 mm longae, minutae; glumae III et IV 1/2-2/3 longiores quam spiculam, sub- ulatae, abaxialiter glabrae, nervo centrali prominenti; gluma III 2.4-4.2 mm longa; gluma IV 2.7-4.1 mm longa; lemma 4.5-5.7(6.2) mm longum, breviter subulatum vel mucronatum; palea (4)4.4-5.7 mm longa, abaxialiter scabrida, sulco scabro vel scabro-pubescenti.
