description: Perennial, cespitose; culms erect, slender, stramineous or purplish, 30-65 cm long; nodes pubescent to glabrescent. Leaves mostly basal, the upper ones with reduced blades; leaf sheath striate, shorter than the internodes, strongly nerved, one margin hyaline the other ciliate or denticulate; ligule straight, pilose, ca 0.2- 0.5 mm long, sometimes surrounded by a few white hairs up to 2 mm long; leaf blades flat and narrowly lanceolate to convolute-setaceous, 4-15 cm long and 1- 3 mm wide, strongly nerved, glabrous (except for the basal ones with a few tubercule-based hairs), margin cartilaginous, finely denticulate, apex subpungent. Inflorescence a solitary spike 2.6-6 cm long; rachis winged, 2.8-3 mm wide, foliaceous, conspicuously nerved, margins hyaline, entire. Spikelet laterally com- pressed, 3.2-4.2 mm long, shortly pilose at base; first glume 3-4 mm long, 2-lobed and finely ciliate at apex, narrow at base, 3-nerved, mid-nerve extending into a straight awn 1.5-3 mm long; second glume 3-4 mm long, 5-nerved, the lateral nerves approximate, apex obtuse, ciliate, margins ciliate especially on the lower half; lower floret staminate, the 5-nerved lemma thinner than glumes, with a tuft of hairs on each side at the base of the upper third, apex naviculate, ciliate; palea 1.5-2 mm long; upper floret hermaphroditic, 2.5-3 mm long, fertile lemma 5-nerved, slightly acuminate, apex conspicuously hispid-ciliate; palea similar to lemma in texture but slightly smaller; ovary slightly 3-angled; stigma and anthers yellow in bud and purple at anthesis; lodicules about half the length of the ovary; caryopsis stramineous, plano-convex, 1.5-2.0 mm long and about 0.8 mm wide, and with a reddish-brown, linear hilum as long as the caryopsis; embryo about half the size of the caryopsis.

description: Annual; culms 45-90 cm. tall, simple or usually branched from the very base, erect, glabrous; lowermost sheaths longer than the internodes, the upper ones shorter than the internodes, the two upper ones bladeless or nearly so, glabrous or sparsely papillose-hispid, the margins shortly but densely ciliate; ligule a dense line of short hairs; blades flat, erect, rather thin, 3-9 cm. long, 3-7 mm. wide, pilose or papillose-pilose on both surfaces, the thick white margins papillose- ciliate; raceme 7-12 cm. long; spikelets 4 mm. long; first glume 3 mm. long, obtuse, elitire, 1-nerved, arcuate, pilose on the lower part of the keel, the upper dorsal portion puberulent; second glume 3 mm. long, 3-nerved, pubescent on both sides of the midnerve, the inargins densely pilose, the hairs at maturity spreading, forming a fringe; sterile lemma 4 mm. long, acute, 3-nerved, the margins ineurved, densely appressed- pilose, at maturity forming a fringe; fruit 3 mm. long, somewhat laterally compressed at the tip; anthers 2 mm. long.

description: Perennial, sparingly stoloniferous; culms erect in small dense tufts, branching at the lower nodes, 12-33 cm. tall, glabrous, the nodes appressed-pubescent; leaves crowded at the base in a dense cluster sheaths, except the lowermost, shorter than the internodes, the upper ones elongate, bladeless or nearly so, glabrous, the margins ciliate; ligule ciliate, about 0.3 mm. long; blades flat, 1.5-6 cm. long (usually less than 3 cm.), 1-3 mm. wide, glabrous or rarely sparsely pilose, the margins papillose or papillose-hispid; raceme 3-4.5 cm. long, the rachis broadly winged, the wings papery, 2-3 mm. wide, distinctly nerved. the nlerves green; spikelets 2.7 mm. long; first glume 2.7 mm. long, 3- nerved, keeled above, rounded at the base, pilose across the back at the very base, bearing a tuft of coarse hairs as much as 2 mm. long on the midnerve about 0.5 mm. from the base; second glume as long as the first, acute, 3-nerved, short-pilose on both sides of the midnerve, the margins ciliate from the base to the apex, the hairs toward the tip somewhat longer than the others; lower floret staminate, the lemma acute, 5-nerved, the back haline, the margins firm, thick, the nerves obscure, unevenly hispid-ciliate nearly to the tip; fruit 2.2 mm. long, acuminate; anthers yellow, 1 mm. long.

description: Perennial; culms erect, 50-75 cm. tall; leaves mostly crowded toward the base; sheaths glabrous to sparsely hairy, the margins ciliate, the lower ones short, overlapping, the upper ones elongate but shorter than the internodes; ligule a line of hairs 0.3 mm. long; blades flat, 4-8 cm. long, 3-5 mm. wide, strongly nerved, firm, pubescent on the lower surface, sparsely pilose on the upper surface, the thick white margins sparsely hispid, scabrous; raceme 6-9 cm. long; spikelets 5 mm. long; first glume 4-4.5 mm. long, 0.5 mm. wide from keel to margin, 3-nerved, subobtuse, the tip notched, hispid on the lower half of the keel, scabrous on the upper half; second glume 3.5-3.7 mm. long, acute, 3-nerved, the margins long-ciliate from base to apex, the back glabrous; sterile lemma 4-4.4 mm. long, 5-nerved, the margins nearly glabrous at the base, be- coming long-ciliate upward, the hairs toward the summit 2-3 mm. long; fruit 4.2 mm. ]ong, acuminate, glabrous.

description: Perennial; culms erect, leafy, 40-70 cm. tall, glabrous; sheaths much longer than the internodes, glabrous; ligule ciliate, about 1 mm. long; blades involute, flexuous, attenuate, glabrous, 15-20 cm. long, 1 mm. wide; racem 6-8 cm. long, partly enclosed in the upper sheaths, the rachis 2 mm. wide, winged, the wings with conspicuous green veins; spikelets laterally compressed, 5 mm. long, somewhat spreading, densely villous at the base; first glume a little shorter thall the second glume anid sterile lemma, scabrous, 3-nerved, awned from between two hyaline teeth, the awn strong, straight or flexuous, 5 mm. long, scabrous; second glume and sterile lemma equal; second glume toothed, mucronate, scabrous, 5-nerved, the lateral nerves approximate, the margins ciliate in the lower half, the back with a tuft of rigid hairs about one-third from the apex; lower floret staminate with a well- developed palea, the lemma acute, 5-nerved, the lateral nerves obscure, keeled in the upper half, the keel unevenly ciliate with rather short coarse hairs, the back with a conspicuous tuft of coarse hairs on each side at the middle, otherwise somewhat scabrous; fruit 4 mm. long, acuminate, more or less compressed-keeled toward the summit, the keel and upper part of the back appressed-hispid, the hairs longer on the keel.

description: Perenne; culmi dense caespitosi, ad 55 cm. alti, glabri, nodis barbulatis; vaginae papilloso-pilosae, internodiis breviores; ligula dense ciliata, 0.5 mrn. longa; laminae 8-12 cm. longae, 2-3 mm. latae, planae firmae, acuminatae, utrinque pilosae vel papilloso-pilosae; racemus 6-8 cm. longus, erectus, argenteus; spiculae 4-5 mm. longae, appressae; gluma prima 3.5-4 mm. longa, 3-nervia, acuta, in parte inferiore denrse pilosa, marginibus in parte inferiore dense hispidis; gluma secunda 4-5 mm. longa, 3-nervia, acuta, glabra, marginibus in parte media papillosohispidis; lemma sterile 4-5 mm. longum, 7-nervium, acutum, in costa sparse pilosum marginibus papilloso-hispidis; lemma fertile 4 mm. longum, acuminatum, glabrum, minute striatum.

description: Perennial; culms tufted, erect, about 55 cm. tall, the nodes ap- pressed-pubescent; sheaths glabrous, the lowermost longer than the internodes, the others much shorter than the internodes; ligule ciliate, 0.3 mm. long; blades acuminate, involute, more or less curved or flexuous, 4-8 cm. long, 1-4 mm. wide (unrolled), glabrous or the lower ones pubescent on the lower surface; raceme 4 cm. long, the rachis winged, 1 mm. wide, with conspicuous green nerves; spikelets laterally compressed, 3.5-4 mm. long; first glume 3.5 mm. long, 3-nerved, glabrous, the tip irregularly lobed, awned from between the lobes, the awn 2.5 mm. long, strong, straight, minutely scabrous; second glume 3.5 mm. long, 5-nerved, obtuse, mucronate, the margins ciliate on the lower half, the back with a row of stiff hairs across it about one-fourth from the summit; lower floret staminate, the lemma equaling the second glume, obtuse, 5-nerved, the back thin, the margins thickened, the midnerve hispid on the upper fourth, the lateral internerves bearing a tuft of stiff hairs about the middle, the palea subacute, a little shorter than the lemma; fruit 2.8 mm. long, acute, pubescent on the upper third, obscurely keeled toward the summit, the keel shortly ciliate; anthers 1.8 mm. long, purple.

description: Annual; culms decumbent-spreading, rooting at the lower nodes, freely branching, glabrous, the nodes pubescent or pilose with spreading or appressed hairs; sheaths shorter than the internodes, glabrous or nearly so, the margins ciliate, the upper ones bladeless blades firm, flat, acuminate-pointed, 1-7 cm. long, 3-4 mm. wide, pilose or papillose-pilose on both surfaces, the margins papillose-ciliate; ligule ciliate, 0.5 mm. long; racemes terminal on the main culm and branches, 6-10 cm. long, those on the branches partly enclosed in the sheaths; spike- lets sessile, appressed, 3.5-4.5 mm. long, glabrous or nearly so; first glume very narrow, 1-nerved, arcuate, 2.5 mm. long; second glume 2.5 mm. long, 3-nerved, triangular, acute; sterile lemma acute, 3-nerved, flat on the back, the margins rather tightly clasping the fertile floret, the midnerve obscure; fruit acuminate, minutely striate, a little shorter than the sterile lemma.

description: Perennial; culms tufted, as much as 85 cm. tall; sheaths glabrous, the margins ciliate, the lower ones overlapping, the upper ones elongate, often shorter than the internodes; ligule minutely ciliate, 0.2 mm. long; blades 7-15 cm. long, 3-4 mm. wide, smooth or scaberulous, the thick white margins sparsely tuberculate or tuberculate-hispid, the upper ones very much reduced; raceme 10-15 cm. long; spikelets 4 mm. long; first glume 3-3.2 mm. long, truncate, 3-nerved, the keel hispid on the lower third, the upper part of the back scabrous; second glume 2.8-3 mm. long, appressed-pubeseent on both sides of the midnerve, the margins densely appressed-ciliate; sterile lemma 3.8-4 mmn. long, subacute, the margins ciliate with appressed hairs, the upper ones longer, exceeding the spikelet; fruit 3.2-3.4 mm. long, acute, minutely striate, the tip more or less compressed into a short beak.

description: Perennial; culms tufted, erect, 40-50 cm. tall, glabrous, or pubescent below the nodes, the nodes appressed-pilose; sheaths glabrous below, appressed-pilose toward the summit, the margins shortly ciliate, the lower ones longer than the internodes, the upper ones somewhat elongate but shorter than the internodes; ligule ciliate, about 1 mm. long; blades involute, curved, the lower culm blades and those of the innovations about 15 cm. long, the upper culm blades reduced, 2-5 cm. long, the lower surface glabrous, the upper appressed-pilose, at least toward the base, the margins scabrous; raceme 4-6 cm. long, scarcely exserted fromn the upper sheath, the rachis 0.7 mm. wide, very narrowly winged, scabrous, conspicuously hispid-ciliate; spikelets laterally compressed, about 4 mm. long; first glume 3.5 mm. long, 3-nerved, pubescent, the tip lobed, the lobes obtuse, hyaline, shortly ciliate, awned from between the lobes, the awn strong, straight, scaberulous, 3 mm. long; second glume 3 mm. long, 3-nerved, scaberulous, mucronate, the tip lobed, the lobes shallow, obtuse, shortly ciliate; sterile lemma a little longer than the second glume, firm, 5-nerved, the tip navicular, keeled, the keel hispid, the lateral internerves bearing a short tuft of stiff hairs at the middle; fruit 2.8 mm. long, subacuminate, weakly keeled, the keel conspicuously hispid-ciliate, the tip pubescent.

description: Annual; culms slender, purplish, branching, rooting at the lower nodes, 40-70 cm long; nodes pubescent. Leaf sheath glabrous, with one margin ciliate, the other glabrous; ligule straight, pilose, about 1 mm long; leaf blades linear-lanceolate, glabrous on both surfaces, 5-11 cm long and 2-5 mm wide, margins finely denticulate. Inflorescence a solitary spike, green or purplish, 5-7 cm long, straight or slightly flexuose; rachis winged, strongly nerved, 2-2.2 mm wide, margins finely ciliate-denticulate. Spikelets imbricate, pilose at base, 4-4.5 mm long; first glume scabrous, 3-nerved, awn 17-25 mm long, antrorsely barbed; second glume scabrous, 5-nerved, the lateral nerves approximate, margins ciliate, with a tuft of hairs on the back at the apex and a mucron 0.5-2 mm long: lower floret sterile, its lemma 5-nerved, with 2 tufts of hairs on each side at the base of the upper third; palea ca 2 mm long; upper floret hermaphroditic, with fertile lemma 5-nerved, ciliate on the upper part; fertile palea with the same size and texture of fertile lemma; ovary slightly striate, stigma purple; stamens 3, with purple anthers; caryopsis elliptic, about 2 mm long and about 0.8 mm wide with a linear hilum.

description: Perennial; culms tufted, erect, 40-55 cm. tall, glabrous, the nodes more or less short-pubescent; leaves crowded in a basal cluster; sheaths pubescent, sparingly pilose at the throat; blades as much as 11.5 cm. long, 2.5-4 mm. wide, flat or loosely involute, glabrous or pubescent; culm blades much reduced, 1.5-3 cm. long; ligule very short, ciliate; racemes 2.5-3.5 cm. long; spikelets 4 mm. long, conspicuously hairy with spreading hairs; first glume 4 mm. long, 3-nerved, narrow, keeled, pilose on the back at the very base and on the lower half of the keel; second glume 4 mm. long, 5-nerved, the margins infolded on each other at the tip, hairy over the entire back on the lower half, the hairs at the middle much longer than the rest, spreading; sterile lemma 4 mm. long, 5-nierved, acute, bearing just above the middle a large tuft of erect or spreading hairs, the hairs 3 mm. long; sterile palea well developed, nearly as long as the lemma; fruit a little shorter than the second, glume and sterile lemma, subacuminate, shortly pilose on the back just below the tip.

description: Caespitose perennials. Culms 20-50 cm tall, decumbent near the base, short strigulose below the nodes; internodes mostly glabrous. Sheaths 2-8 cm long, longer than the internodes, mostly glabrous to strigulose, margins hyaline, old sheaths folded. Ligules 5-9 mm long, hyaline, delicate; margins erose, apex lacerate. Blades 2-16 cm X 0.4-1.9 mm, basal and caulinar, flat to involute, occasionally folded, apically acuminate; adaxial surface strigulose; ab- axial surface scaberulous, usually with evident whitish thickened midnerve and margins. Panicles 6-16 X 0.7-3.5 cm, narrow to loosely spreading, included to short-exserted, the ascending branches closely appressed to spreading to 450; inflorescence branches 1-4.5 cm long; central axis 4-6- ribbed, scabrous. Spikelets 3-3.5 mm long, silvery olivaceous to reddish; pedicels 0.6- 4.5 mm long. Glumes 1.5-2.3 mm long, green, subequal, glabrous to scabrid, ob- long-lanceolate, 1-nerved, minutely awned, awns 0.3-0.6 mm long; the upper with a 3- toothed apex, the teeth <1/3 the length of the glume. Lemmas 2.8-3.7 mm long, oblong- elliptic, appressed pubescent along the mar- gins and the mid-nerve on the proximal half, the hairs to 0.7 mm long, silvery-olive green to sometimes purplish; apex deeply bilobed, 0.5-1 mm long, lobes rounded to obtuse; awn borne between the two lobes, 5-10 mm long, flexuous, scabrous to sca- brid especially at the bottom, silvery-oli- vaceous color, reddish near base. Paleas 2.8-3.7 mm long, narrowly oblong-elliptic, pilose, between the nerves on the proximal third, apex obtuse to truncate. Anthers 1- 1.6 mm long, oblong, greenish yellow. Caryopsis 1.4-1.6 mm long, fusiform, light brownish. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Densely caespitose perennials. Culms 50-70 cm tall, erect, branching near the base, puberulent above the basal nodes. Sheaths 7-30 cm long, longer than the low- er internode, glabrescent, stiff and papery below, mostly folded; margins membra- nous. Ligules 1-1.2 mm long, membranous, hyaline, decurrent; apex acuminate, often lacerate. Blades (11-)20-25 cm X 0.5-2 mm, flat to involute, adaxial surface sca- brid, abaxial surface glabrous to puberulent, apically acuminate. Panicles 15-25 x 0.7-4 cm, densely ramified, ascending branches appressed or spreading to 350; inflorescence branches 3-7 cm long, central axis angular 4-6-ribbed, glabrescent to scabrid. Spikelets 3.5-4 mm long. Glumes (3-)3.5-4 mm long, oblong, longer than the lemma, usually equal in length, olive-green, 1-nerved, short-pilose near base and along nerve; apex acute to obtuse, awnless, occasionally minutely erose. Lemmas (2.6-)2.8-3 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, olivaceous, pilose on the nerves, the hairs to 0.4 mm long; apex acutely pointed, merging into the awn, the awn 16-20 mm long, yellow, slightly flexuous, scabrid especially at the bottom. Paleas 2.8-3 mm long, oblong, straw-colored, proximal half loosely pilose between the nerves to glabrous; apex obtuse, mi- nutely mucronate. Anthers (1.6-)2-2.2 mm long, oblong, purple. Caryopsis not seen. Chromosome number unknown. (For an illustration, see Herrera-Arrieta & Peterson, 1992.)

description: Caespitose perennials. Culms 30-60(-100) cm high, nodes all basal, branching near base. Sheaths 10-30 cm long, shorter than the internode, glabrescent, hairs when present puberulent, margins hyaline and continuous with the ligule, old sheaths folded or flattened and papery. Ligules 5-10 mm long, membranous, hyaline, delicate; apex attenuate, usually lacerate. Blades 10- 20 cm X 0.5-2 mm, involute to occasionally flat, conspicuously curved, adaxial surface scabrid, abaxial surface scabrous; apex long acuminate. Panicles 10-25 X 1-8 cm, loosely ramified; branches ascending, vertical or perpendicular, 4-7.5 cm long; central axis 4-6-ribbed, glabrescent to scabrid. Spikelet 3.8-4.2(-4.5) mm long, light grayish green to whitish, becoming hyaline, erect to reflexed. Glumes 2.5-4.5 mm long, unequal, oblong-lanceolate, glabrous, whitish, becoming hyaline, awnless, the lower 2.5-3.3 mm long and 1-nerved, the upper 4-4.2(-4.5) mm long and 3-nerved; apex acute to acuminate, often minutely bifid to erose. Lemmas 3-3.5 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, grayish green, mottled, pilose on the whole surface, the hairs up to 1.2 mm long; apex acute to acuminate, continuous to the awn, the awn 10-15 mm long, sinuous wavy, scabrous, olive-green. Paleas 3-3.5 mm long, grayish green, appressed pu- bescent to pilose on the whole surface; apex obtuse to truncate. Anthers 1.5-2.1 mm long, oblong, purplish to brown. Caryopsis not seen. 2n = 20.

description: Caespitose perennials with short rhizomes, short. Culms 40-70 cm tall, densely branching near base, basal nodes; internodes generally glabrous to puberulent 1.5- 2.5 cm below the inflorescence. Sheaths 4-20(-25) cm long, shorter than the internodes, glabrescent, hairs when present sca- brous; margins hyaline and forming auricles; old sheaths flattened and papery. Ligules 0.5-0.7 mm long, membranous, hyaline, acute; margin erose or lacerate. Blades cauline 10-30 cm X 2-4 mm, usually flat, occasionally involute, adaxial surface glabrescent, hairs when present scabrous, abaxial surface scabrous to scabrid; apex long acuminate. Panicles (10-)15-25 cm long, shortly exserted, loosely flowered; ascending branches mostly spreading 20-50º, 3-7 cm long, central axis slightly flattened with 2 ribs, scabrous. Spikelets 6-7 mm long. Glumes 6-7 mm long, usually equal in length, longer than the lemma, olive-green, glabrous, or scabrid, oblong-lanceolate, the lower 1-nerved, mucronate, the upper 1-3- nerved, pointed; apex entire. Lemmas 5- 6.5(-7) mm long, oblong-lanceolate, straw-colored or green-olivaceous, scabrous on the bottom and the inferior margins; apex acuminate, continuous to the awn, the awn 15-20 mm long, flexuous, scabrous, yellow. Paleas 5-6 mm long, straw-colored or olive-green, pilose on the lower eighth, the hairs up to 0.8 mm long. Anthers 3-3.5 mm long, oblong, purple. Caryopsis not seen. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Caespitose perennials. Culms 20-25 cm tall, loosely branching near the base, basal nodes; internodes glabrous to scabrous near the base of the inflorescence. Sheaths 2-5(-6) cm long, scabrous, flat; margins hyaline and continuous to the ligule; old sheaths persistent and spirally coiled. Ligules 5-10 mm long, membranous, hyaline, attenuate; margins lacerate. Blades 10-20 cm X 1-1.5 mm, usually flat or involute, adaxial surface conspicuously silvery-pilose, abaxial surface scabrid; apex acuminate. Panicles included to short-exserted, 4-8(-10) cm long, narrow; branches appressed, 2.5-3 cm long; central axis flattened, scabrous. Spikelets 3.5-4 mm long. Glumes 3-3.8 mm long, subequal, olive-green, glabrous, oblong-lanceolate, 1-3-nerved, awnless; the lower 3-3.2 mm long and apex entire; the upper 3.6-3.8 mm long and apex 3-4-toothed. Lemmas 3-3.2 mm long, subulate, continuous to the awn, straw-colored, glabrous; awn 15-20 mm long, straight, scabrous, olive-green. Paleas 2.8-3 mm long, straw- colored, pilose on the lower half. Anthers 1.8-2 mm long, fusiform, purplish to brown. Caryopsis not seen. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Caespitose perennials. Culms 10-30 cm tall, branching and rounded near base, basal nodes; generally glabrous. Sheaths 1.5-3 cm long, glabrescent, hairs when present scabrous; margins hyaline and continuous to the ligule. Ligules 2-5 mm long, membranous, hyaline; apex acuminate. Blades basal and cauline, 1-6 cm X 0.5-1 mm, involute, adaxial surface glabrescent, hairs when present scabrous, abaxial surface glabrous to scabrid; apically acuminate. Panicles 3-6 X 1-2 cm, short-exserted, loosely ramified; branches appressed, 1-2 cm long; central axis slightly flattened with 2 ribs, glabrescent to scabrid. Spikelets 3-3.5 mm long. Glumes 1.2-2.2 mm long, subequal, hyaline, glabrous to scabrid; the lower 1.2-1.8 mm long, lanceolate, 1-3-nerved, short- awned to mucronate, awn 0.5-1 mm long; the upper 1.8-2.2 mm long, oblong-lanceo- late, 3-5-nerved, 3-toothed, the teeth <1/3 the length of the glume, the central tooth awned, or pointed, 0.5-1 mm long. Lem- mas 2.5-3.2 mm long, fusiform to acuminate, pale, green-spotted, glabrous to pilose on the bottom and the inferior margins, awn 1-5 mm long, flexuous, scabrous, olive-green. Paleas 2-2.5 mm long, pale, green-spotted, pilose, on the lower half, the hairs to 0.7 mm long. Anthers 1.5-2 mm long, oblong, purple. Caryopsis 1.3-1.6 mm long, fusiform, brownish. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Caespitose perennials. Culms 35-45 cm tall, densely ramified at base; internodes glabrous. Sheaths glabrous, margins membranous, grouped flabelatelly in 2 or 3 nudes, old sheaths flattened and papery. Ligules 3-8 mm long, membranous, hyaline, acute, decurrent; margin entire. Blades 2-5 cm x 1-2 mm, mainly basal, flat to folded, adaxial surface glabrescent, hairs when present scabrous, abaxial surface glabrousto puberulent. Panicles 3-9(-15) X 2-3 cm, short-exserted, dark green, sometimes with purplish, narrow, loosely ramified branches ascending, mostly spreading ca. 20-30, 1-2 cm long, central axis slightly flattened, 2-ribbed, scabrous. Spikelets 3-4 mm long, short pedicellate. Glumes 1.2-2 mm long, subequal, scabrid; the lower 1.2-1.6 mm long, ovate, 1-nerved, awnless; the upper 1.6-2 mm long, oblong-obovate, 1/2 of the lemma length, 3-nerved, 3-toothed, the teeth <1/3 the length of the glume, awnless. Lemmas 3-4 mm long, lanceolate, olive-green, pilose on the bottom and the inferior margins, awn 5-8 mm long, flexuous, scabrous, olive-green, rising from a bifid apex, to 0.5 mm long. Paleas 3-4 mm long, olive-green, scabrous. Anthers 1.8-2.1 mm long, fusiform, purple. Caryopsis not seen. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Caespitose perennials. Culms 20-30 cm tall, loosely tufted at base, basal nodes; internodes glabrous. Sheaths 1-2(-2.5) cm long, glabrescent, hairs when present puberulent, margins membranous, becoming flattened and papery. Ligules 0.2-0.5 mm long, membranous, hyaline; truncate and fimbriate. Blades 2-7(-8.5) cm X 1.5-2 mm, flat, mainly basal, glabrous to scabrous above, glabrous to puberulent below; apex long-acuminate. Panicles long-exserted, 4-5 x 1-2 cm, densely ramified; ascending branches mostly 10-40º, 2.5-3 cm long; central axis slightly flattened with 2 ribs, glabrous to scabrid. Spikelet 3.5-4 mm long. Glumes unequal, olive-green, glabrous, oblong-lanceolate; the lower (0.5-)1-1.8 mm long, 1-nerved, mucronate; the upper (3-)3.5-4.2 mm long, as long as or longer than the lemma, 1-3-nerved, 3-toothed. Lemmas (3-)3.8-4 mm long, apex entire, subulate, greenish to straw-colored, glabrous, awn 14-16 mm long, yellow, flexuous, scabrid especially at the bottom. Paleas 2.8-3.2 mm long, straw-colored, glabrous. Anthers 1.5-2 mm long, oblong, purple. Caryopsis not seen, 2n = 20 (Reeder, 1968).

description: Caespitose perennials. Culms 20-30 cm tall, densely tufted at base, basal nodes; internodes 6-8-ribbed, scaberulous to glabrous. Sheaths 2-6 cm long, longer than the lower internode, scabrous; margins hyaline and continuous with the ligule. Ligules 3-4 mm long, membranous, hyaline, acuminate, margin entire to erose. Blades (3.5-)4-6 cm X 0.5-1 mm, conspicuously basal, involute, adaxial surface glabrescent, hairs when present scabrous, abaxial surface scabrous; apically acuminate. Panicles 5-8 X 0.3-0.5 cm, loosely flowered; inflorescence branches appressed, 0.5-1 cm long. Spikelet 2.5-3 mm long. Glumes 1-1.2 mm long, subequal, 1/3 of the lemma length, ovate-truncate, pinkish, becoming hyaline, glabrous to scabrous; the lower 1-nerved, apex erose, sometimes mucronate; the upper 3-nerved, 3-toothed, the teeth <1/3 the length of the glume. Lemmas 2.5-2.8 mm long, oblanceolate, pale, green-spotted, pilose on the bottom and the inferior margins, pointed, awn 0-1 mm long, flexuous, olive-green. Paleas 2-2.2 mm long, pale, green-spotted, pilose on the lower 1/8. Anthers 1.8-2 mm long, oblong, ribbed. Caryopsis 1.2-1.5 mm long, fusiform, light brown, rugose. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Densely caespitose perennials. Culms 60-80 cm tall, branching and rounded near base, glabrous just below the mostly basal nodes; internodes glabrous. Sheaths 8-14 cm long, mostly longer than the lower internode, scaberulous, becoming flattened and conspicuously spirally coiled below, loose and papery; margins hyaline and continuous with the ligule. Ligules 4-7 mm long, membranous, hyaline, decurrent; apex acuminate. Blades (8.5-)10-20 cm X 1-3 mm, basal and cauline, flat to folded or involute, scabrous below and glabrous to sparsely hirsute above; apex long-acuminate. Panicles 12-17 X 2-4 cm, open, loosely flowered, ascending branches mostly spreading 20-50?, 0.4-3 cm long; central axis triquetrous, 3-6-ribbed, scabrous. Spikelets 4.5-5 mm long, tightly clustered, mostly paired along each branch. Glumes 4.5-5 mm long, oblanceolate, entire, longer than the lemma, usually equal in length, 1-nerved, the upper occasionally 2-nerved, olive-green, scabrous along the entire length and usually short-pilose near base and along midnerve; apex acute, awnless. Lemmas 3.5-4 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, hyaline to yellowish; midnerve and margins appressed-pubescent to pilose on the proximal 3/4; apex acute, minutely bifid, the lobes to 0.2 mm long, awned, the awn 10-15 mm long, flexuous, yellowish distally and purplish near base, scabrid especially at the bottom. Paleas 2.8-3.5 mm long, oblanceolate, straw-colored, glabrous to loosely pubescent in the proximal 1/2; apex 3-lobed, the lateral lobes obtuse and the central lobe acute. Anthers 2-2.4 mm long, oblong, reddish purple. Caryopsis not seen. Chromosome number unknown. (For an illustration, see Herrera-Axrieta & Peterson, 1992.)

description: Densely tufted perennials. Culms 45-65 cm tall, branched near base, nodes mostly basal; internodes 8-16-ribbed, scaberulose to glabrous. Sheaths 10-30 cm long, glabrous but pubescent at the collar, becoming flattened and papery; margins membranous. Ligules 6-18 mm long, membranous, hyaline, acuminate; margin entire to lacerate. Blades flat to folded, 5-30 cm X 1-2 mm, caulinar and basal, adaxial surface glabrescent, hairs when present scabrous, abaxial surface scabrid; apically acuminate. Panicles 8-25 X 1-1.5(-2) cm, densely ramified, the appressed or ascending branches mostly spreading 15-30?, 4-6 cm long; central axis slightly flattened with 2 ribs, glabrous to scabrid. Spikelets 3.5-4 mm long. Glumes 2-3.5 mm long, subequal, olive-green, short-awned to mucronate, the awn 0.5-1.5 mm long, scabrid on the nerves mainly; the lower 2-3 mm long, lanceolate, entire, 1-nerved; the upper 2.5-3.5 mm long, 3/4 of the lemma length, ovate, 3-nerved, 3-toothed, the teeth [less than or equal to]1/2 the length of the glume or more. Lemmas 3.8-4 mm long, fusiform, olive-green or pale and green-spotted, pilose on the bottom and the inferior margins, entire, merging into the awn; awn 10-15 mm long, flexuous, scabrous, olive-green. Paleas 2.8-3 mm long, green-olivaceous, pilose on the lower 1/2. Anthers 2-2.3 mm long oblong, purple. Fruit 2-2.2 mm long, longitudinally rugose, grain fusiform, brown. Caryopsis 1.8-2 mm long, fusiform, light brown. 2n = 20 and 40 (Herrera-Arrieta, 1995a).

description: Caespitose perennials. Culms 30-60 cm tall, densely tufted at base, nodes mostly basal; internodes scaberulose to glabrous, 12-16-ribbed. Sheaths 10-20 cm long, scabrous to glabrous, margins hyaline and continuous to the ligule, old sheaths conspicuously persistent and spirally coiled. Ligules 1-2 mm long, membranous, hyaline, truncate; margin erose. Blades 10-30 cm X 1-3 mm, basal and caulinear, mainly flat, sometimes involute to folded, adaxial surface scabrous to glabrous, abaxial surface scabrous; apex long-acuminate. Panicles 10-15(-20) X 1-1.5(-2) cm, exserted, loosely ramified, the ascending branches mostly spreading 20-45º, 4-7 cm long; central axis slightly flattened with 2 ribs, scabrose on the ribs; lateral pedicels 0.5-1 mm long, the terminal ones 2-5 mm long. Spikelets 4-5 mm long, grayish green, becoming whitish to hyaline. Glumes 2.5-5 mm long, unequal, conspicuously nerved, glabrous or scabrid on the nerves, whitish to hyaline; the lower 2.5-3.5 mm long, oblong-lanceolate, 1-nerved, awned to mucronate; the upper 3.5-5 mm long, oblong-obovate, 3-nerved, erose or 3-4-toothed, the teeth 1/8 the length of the glume, awnless. Lemmas 3-5 mm long, subulate, grayish green, pilose on the whole surface, hairs 0.3-0.5 mm, awned, the awn 10-15 mm long, flexuous, scabrid especially at the bottom, olive-green. Paleas 3-4.5 mm long, grayish green, pilose on the proximal half. Anthers 2-2.2 mm long, oblong, purple. Caryopsis 1.9-2 mm long, fusiform, light brown. 2n = 24 (Reeder, 1968).
bibliographicCitation: Herrera-Arrieta, Y. 1998. A revision of the Muhlenbergia montana (Nutt.) Hitchc. complex (Poaceae: Chloridoideae). Brittonia. 50: 23-50.

description: Tufted perennials. Culms 40-70 cm tall, nodes mostly basal, internodes glabrous, ribbed. Sheaths 3-6 cm long, longer than the internodes, glabrous to scabrellous, becoming folded, margins hyaline, uppermost sheath usually 10-20 cm long, surrounding the culm up to half its length. Ligules 0.5-0.7 mm long, membranous, hyaline, truncate, fimbriate. Blades 10-20 cm X 1.5-3 mm, flat-folded, keeled, mainly cauline, scabrous in both surfaces, apically acuminate. Panicles 10-15 X 1-2 cm, narrow, appressed-ascending branches 2.5-5 cm long; central axis densely scabrous-pubescent; pedicels 0.5-2 mm long or the terminal ones 3-4 mm long. Spikelets 3-3.5 mm long. Glumes 2.8-3.5 mm long, subequal, thin, elliptic-lanceolate, erose, awnless, olive-green, scabrous on the whole surface; the lower 2.8-3 mm long, 1-nerved, blunt to sharply acute; the upper 3-3.5 mm long, longer than the lemma, 1-3-nerved, erose. Lemmas 2.5-3.2 mm long, ellipsoid-subulate, green-spotted, pilose on the whole surface; apex shortly bifid, the lobes 0.2 mm long, awned, the awn 20-25 mm long, rising between the lobes, sinuous wavy, scabrous, yellow. Paleas 2.3-3.2 mm long, green spoted, pilose on the whole surface. Anthers 1.7-2 mm long, oblong, purple. Caryopsis not seen. Chromosome number unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Herrera-Arrieta, Y. 1998. A revision of the Muhlenbergia montana (Nutt.) Hitchc. complex (Poaceae: Chloridoideae). Brittonia. 50: 23-50.

description: Cespitose bamboo. Culms 1-4 m tall, to 1 cm diam., branching from the middle nodes, glabrous, nearly solid with a small, pithy lumen in the center. Leaves crowded, strongly overlapping, to 25 per complement; sheaths stramineous, glabrous, shiny, the summit slightly keeled, the summit bearing a dense mat of tangled white fimbriae to 12 mm long; outer ligule 0.2-0.5 mm long, indurate; inner ligule 1-1.3 mm long, puberulent; pseudopetiole ca. 1 mm long; blades (10-)20-34 X (1.5-)2.5-5.5 cm (those on lateral shoots much smaller, at lower end of the above range), lanceolate, obtuse and often clasping at the base, acuminate at the apex, glabrous, cross-veined or not below, with strongly cartilaginous margins 0.2-0.5 mm wide bearing clusters of 5-15 glassy, pricklelike cilia ca. 0.2 mm long at intervals of 0.5-1 mm. Peduncle 10-50 cm long, puberulent. Inflorescences terminal on all branches, 30-60 X 2-3 cm, spikelike or very narrowly pyramidal; rachis densely pubescent; branches 20-35, erect, the lowest 1.5-2 cm long, rather distant, the upper crowded. Spikelets 7-9(-10.5) mm long, purplish, often shiny, 1(-2)-flowered; glumes glabrous to puberulent, slenderly lanceolate to ovate, subaristate or more commonly with a stout, gla- brous, inrolled awn to 1/2 their lengths; glume I 4.5-9.5 mm long, 1-nerved; glume II 5.5-10.5 mm long, 1-or rarely 3-nerved, abruptly awned; glume III 4-6 mm long, ovate, acute to abruptly aristate with an awn to 1(-2) mm long, glabrous to puberulent externally, puberulent internally; floret(s) 4.5-7 mm long, ovate-elliptical, glabrous, the lemma(s) acute to subaristate, 3- or rarely 5-nerved; paleas slightly shorter to slightly longer than lemmas, obtuse. Flowers with anthers 1-2.5 mm long. Fruit not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Judziewicz, Emmet J. 1998. A revision of Myriocladus (Poaceae: Bambusoideae: Bambuseae). Brittonia. 50: 430-446.

description: Cespitose bamboo. Culms 1-3 m tall, to 1 cm diam., branching from the middle nodes, stramineous, glabrous, shiny, nearly solid. Leaves crowded, strongly overlapping, to 21 per complement; sheaths stramineous, glabrous to puberulent, shiny, occasionally glaucous, thickened near the slightly keeled summit, the summit bearing coarse, curling, white fimbriae to 5 mm long; outer ligule 0.5-0.7 mm long, indurate, conspicuously ciliolate; inner ligule 1- 1.2 mm long; pseudopetiole 2-4 mm long, crassate, glabrous; blades 10-30 X 3-5.5 cm, narrowly ovate to broadly lanceolate, truncate to slightly subcordate and clasping at the base, acuminate at the apex, glabrous except for 1-2 mm long cilia on the basal margins, the upper margins bearing solitary, scabrous prickles 0.2 mm long. Peduncle 20-40 cm long, puberulent. Inflorescences terminal on all branches, 30-60 X 5-7 cm, narrowly pyramidal; rachis ridged, densely pubescent; branches 40-60, divergent at a 450 angle, the upper crowded, the lowest 2-3.5 cm long, rather distant, bearing secondary branches to 0.5 cm long on their lower sides. Spikelets often deflexed, 5.2-7 mm long, 1-3-flowered, purplish or brownish, glabrous, smooth, shiny; glumes slenderly lanceolate, 1-nerved; glume I 2-3.7 mm long, acute; glume II 3.5-4.5 mm long, including a rather abrupt, glabrous to scabrous awn 2-3.5 mm long; glume III 3.2-5 mm long, ovate-lanceolate, acute to abruptly aristate with a pungent, often slightly recurved awn to 1.5 mm long; floret(s) 4.5-5.5 mm long, ovate-elliptical, the lemma(s) acute to subaristate, 1-3- nerved, the back often completely smooth except for the prominent midnerve above the middle, this often excurrent as a pungent mucro to 0.7 mm long; palea slightly shorter to slightly longer than lemmas, slightly emarginate at apex; rachilla often prolonged past the uppermost floret by 1-4 mm, bearing a linear, rudimentary floret 1-4 mm long. Flowers with anthers 1.7-2 mm long. Fruit not seen.

description: Cespitose bamboo 1-4 m tall. Culms yellowish to purple, glabrous, shiny, to 10 mm diam. Leaves 7-15 per complement; sheaths stramineous, glabrous to puberulent, often ridged; fimbriae 4-12 mm long, abundant, fine, white, flexuous, matted; outer ligule 0.5-1.2 mm long, often ciliolate; inner ligule 0.3-1.3 mm long; pseudo-petioles 1-4 mm long; blades 10-25(-40) X 2.3-4.5(-5.5) cm, narrowly lanceolate to lanceolate-ovate, rounded to more commonly somewhat cuneate at the base, glabrous, the margins scabrous with prickles in loose clusters; leaf blades on lateral shoots often much smaller, only 1-4 cm X 2-4 mm. Peduncle 10-35 cm long, 1-3 mm diam., glabrous. Inflorescence 25-50 X 4-10 cm, pyramidal; rachis and branches ridged, pubescent or less commonly gla- brous; branches 50-100, the lowermost 3-6 cm long, spreading, more or less densely flowered along their entire length, with few, short, appressed secondary branches. Spikelets 7.5-13 mm long, stramineous to dark reddish purple, often very shiny, glabrous or sparingly pubescent, 3-5(-7)-flowered; glumes narrowly lanceolate, sometimes tawny rather than purple, the keeled mid-nerves scabrous or hispidulous toward the apex; glume I 2-3.5 mm long, acute, 1-3- nerved; glume II 3-4.5 mm long, 3-nerved, acute or rarely subaristate; glume III 4-5.5 mm long, lanceolate, acute, rounded on the back, 3-5-nerved, the midnerve often raised, prominent, and scabrous or hispidulous near the apex; florets with lemmas 4.5-5.5 mm long, lanceolate-elliptical, ob- tuse to acute and slightly mucronate, glabrous, rounded on the back, finely to obscurely 3-, 5-, or rarely 7-nerved, the midnerve prominent only near the apex; palea slightly protruding from lemma, often puberulent near the apex. Flowers with anthers 2-3 mm long. Fruit not seen.

description: Cespitose bamboo. Culms 0.5-3 m tall, green-yellowish, glabrous or puberulent in lines, to 7 mm diam. Leaves 10-20(-33) per complement; sheaths stramineous, glabrous to puberulent; fimbriae 3-8 mm long, fine, white, flexuous; outer ligule 0.5-1 mm long; inner ligule 0.3-1.3 mm long; pseudopetioles 1-2 mm long; blades 6-27 X 1.2-5.3 cm, lanceolate, truncate or sometimes clasping at the base, glabrous or rarely puberulent, the margins scabrous with prickles in loose clusters; leaf blades on lateral shoots often much smaller, only 1-3 cm X 1-4 mm. Peduncle 5-35 cm long, 1-3 mm diam., glabrous. Inflorescence 15-35 X 4-10 cm, ovoid to narrowly ellipsoid, the rachis and branches glabrous; branches 4-12, the lowermost 10-30 cm long, loosely ascending, naked near the base, loosely flowered above. Spikelets 7.5-13 mm long, elliptical, dark reddish purple, shiny, glabrous or sparingly pubescent, 3-5(-9)-flowered; glumes narrowly lanceolate, glabrous or the keeled midnerves scabrous toward the apex; glume I 2.5-5.5 mm long, acute, 1-3-nerved; glume II 3-7.5 mm long, 3- nerved, acute or uncommonly subaristate with a tapering, slightly recurved, sometimes scabrous apex; glume III 4-6 mm long, lanceolate, acute, rounded on the back, 3-5-nerved, the midnerve often raised and prominent near the apex; florets with lemmas 4.7-5.3 mm long, narrowly elliptical, obtuse to acute and slightly mucronate, glabrous, rounded on the back, obscurely 3-5-nerved, the midnerve prominent only near the apex; palea slightly protruding from lemma, often puberulent near the apex. Flowers with anthers 3-4 mm long. Fruit not seen.

description: Cespitose bamboo 1-5 m tall. Culms ca. 1 cm diam., smooth. Leaves to 20 per complement; sheaths smooth, the summit truncate, one side bearing falcate auricles 4-8 mm long, these bearing whitish fimbriae 5- 10 mm long; outer ligule 0.7-1.3 mm long, membranous; pseudopetioles 3-5 mm long, often pubescent abaxially; blades 15-43 X (2.5-)6-15 cm, ovate-lanceolate, truncate to subcordate basally, coriaceous, glabrous above, glabrous or sparingly pubescent and evidently cross-veined beneath, the margins cartilaginous, scabrous. Peduncle 20-100 cm long, 2-5 mm diam., stout, terete, glabrous to pubescent. Inflorescence (27-)35- 70 X (4-)6-12 cm, narrowly pyramidal; rachis and branches ridged, coarsely pubescent; primary branches 60-150, the lowest 4-8 cm long, divergent, densely flowered on the lower side to the base, bearing short, appressed secondary branches <1 cm long. Spikelets 8-11 mm long, 2-3-flowered; glumes narrowly lanceolate, tawny, 1-nerved, the midnerve prominent keeled and hispidulous near the apex; glume I 1.5-3 mm long, acute; glume II 4-9 mm long, acute to awned, the awn to 4 mm long, stout; florets (in contrast to glumes) often completely glabrous, stramineous; glume III 4-5 mm long, lanceolate, 3-5-nerved, the midnerve pungent or excurrent as a mucro to 1 mm long; florets with lemmas 4.5-7 mm long, lanceolate, shiny, obscurely 3- 5-nerved, the midnerve raised only near the apex, sometimes excurrent as a mucro to 0.5 mm long; palea about as long as lemma. Flowers with anthers ca. 2.5 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Dwarf woody bamboo to 1 m tall forming dense colonies by short, pachymorph rhizomes. Culms erect, unbranched below, glabrous; internodes to 80 cm long in lower portion of culm, gradually shortening to 0.5 cm in upper portion; culms often rebranching in upper portion of leaf complement, each branch terminating in an inflorescence. Leaves to 20 per complement; sheaths broadest near summit (folded width 2 mm), glabrous, smooth, shining, apparently glaucous, rounded to somewhat keeled on the back; inner ligule 0.1 mm long, ciliolate; outer ligule a minute rim; fimbriae apparently represented by a dense mat of 3-5 mm long, very fine, white, matted cilia; pseudopetiole 1-2 mm long; blades 45-65 X 0.7-1.5 (rolled width) mm, strongly ascending, involute, glabrous, glaucous, the apex obtuse. Inflorescence 2.5-3.5 cm long, a spicate raceme bearing 4-7 spikelets, the rachis angled, glabrous, scabrous. Spikelets 7-8 mm long, 2-flowered, dark purplish- brown, with scattered minute, stiff hairs; glume I 2-2.5(-3.5) mm long, lanceolate-ovate, obtuse to acute; glume II 3.2-4(-5.5) mm long, lanceolate, 1- or rarely 3-nerved, the midnerve prominent and slightly excurrent; lowest floret 4.5-5 mm long, lanceolate, sterile, lacking a palea or flower; flo- rets 6-7 mm long, lanceolate; rachilla pro- longed 2 mm past uppermost floret and bearing a rudimentary floret 3 mm long. Flowers not seen. Fruit a caryopsis 4 X 1 mm, pyriform, acute, dark purplish brown, terete; hilum linear; embryo 0.6 mm long, basal.

description: Cespitose bamboo. Culms 0.5-5 m tall, (0.2-)1-2 cm diam., smooth, glabrous, stramineous to purple, sometimes glaucous. Leaves 7-15 per complement; sheaths stramineous, smooth, glabrous; summit with fimbriae 3-7 mm long, fine, white, flexuous; outer ligule 0.3-1.2 mm long; inner ligule ca. 0.3 mm long; pseudopetioles 1-3 mm long; blades (5-)15-50 X (1-)3-5.5(-8) cm, lanceolate-ovate, coarse, truncate or often clasping at the base, tapering to the apex, glabrous, sometimes glaucous beneath, the margins smooth to scaberulous. Peduncles (10-)20-50 cm long, 1-3 mm diam., glabrous, often glaucous. Inflorescence 25-60 X 4-12 cm, narrowly pyramidal; rachis ridged, pubescent; primary branches (10-)100-200, slender, divergent, the lowermost 8-12 cm long, unbranched, pubescent, flowered their entire length on the lower side. Spikelets 4.5-5.3 mm long, elliptical, purplish, shiny, sparingly pubescent, 2-flowered; glumes narrowly lanceolate, 1-nerved, the midnerve keeled and hispidulous near the acute, mucronate, or short-awned apex, otherwise glabrous; glume I 1.5-2.8 mm long, usually acute; glume II 3-3.8 mm long, mucronate or with an abrupt awn to 1 mm long; glume III 3.2- 3.8 mm long, lanceolate, rounded on the back, 3-nerved, glabrous except for the hispidulous, slightly mucronate midnerve near the apex; florets with lemmas 3.8-4.3 mm long, narrowly elliptical, glabrous, rounded on the back, obscurely 3-nerved, the mid-nerve prominent only near the apex; palea slightly protruding from lemma; rachilla internode prolonged 0.7-1 mm past lower floret, bearing a sterile floret 2.5-4 mm long, this usually concealed by the lower floret. Flower and fruit not seen.

description: Slender clumped bamboo. Culms 0.3-1.5 m tall, the basal internode elongate, followed by several short internodes bearing leaf complements about midway up the culm, followed by an elongate internode, and finally a series of short internodes bearing another leaf complement, this with a few short branches in the axils, these each bearing an inflorescence. Leaves in complements of up to 20; sheaths glabrous to puberulent, the truncate summit bearing fine, white, flexuous fimbriae 3-5 mm long; outer ligule 0.2-0.3 mm long; inner ligule 0.3- 0.5 mm long; blades 4.5-8 X 1.5-3 cm, lanceolate-ovate, truncate at the base, acute at the apex, glabrous or obscurely pubescent, the lower surface sometimes with a glaucous cast, the margins scabrous with prickles, these often in groups of 2-3. Peduncle included or to 15 cm long, slender, glabrous or sparingly pubescent. Inflorescence 4-10 X 1.5-2.5 cm, narrowly elliptical, compact and densely flowered; rachis and branches ridged and puberulent; lowest branches erect, 1.5-3 cm long. Spikelets 8- 12 mm long, laterally compressed, stramineous or greenish, sparingly pubescent, 2- 4-flowered; glume I 5-7 mm long, lanceolate, tapering to apex or with an abrupt mucro to 1 mm long, 1-, 3-, or rarely 5-nerved; glume II 6-10 mm long, lanceolate, acute, awnless, 1- or rarely 3-nerved; glume III 8- 10 mm long, narrowly lanceolate, with a stout, short awn to 2 mm long; florets with lemmas 7-9 mm long, lanceolate, firmly membranous, rounded on back, smooth, shiny, pungent but not awned, 3-, 5-, or rarely 7-nerved but with only the midnerve evident near the apex; palea slightly shorter than and concealed by the lemma, narrowly lanceolate, puberulent throughout or ciliolate only near the minutely truncate apex. Flowers with anthers 2.5-3 mm long. Fruit not seen.

description: Cespitose bamboo. Culms of two types, the fertile ones 1-2 m tall, the vegetative ones 2-5(-8) m tall, 1-2 cm diam., smooth, often glaucous. Leaves to 20 per complement; sheaths stramineous, smooth, shining, glabrous or pubescent in lines, the summit truncate; fimbriae 10-15 mm long, whitish, flexuous; outer ligule ca. 0.5 mm long; inner ligule ca. 0.5 mm long; pseudopetioles 1-5 mm long, often purple, glaucous, and puberulent abaxially; blades (13-)25-50 X (3-)6-13 cm, ovate to lanceolate-ovate, truncate to subcordate and clasping basally, coriaceous, glabrous, evidently tessellate beneath, the margins cartilaginous, scabrous. Peduncle 10-50 cm long, 2-5 mm diam., stout, terete, pubescent. Inflorescence (25-)40-70 X 7-15 cm, narrowly pyramidal; rachis and branches ridged, coarsely pubescent; primary branches 6-12 cm long, divergent, lacking spikelets near base, on the lower side bearing divergent secondary branches to 2 cm long. Spikelets 6-12 mm long, glabrous to puberulent, (3-)5- 8(-12)-flowered; glumes lanceolate-subulate, 1-3-nerved, the midnerve glabrous to scabrous, often tapering into a stout awn; glume I (1-)3-5(-7) mm long, the awn if present <3 mm long; glume II 5-8 mm long, with a slightly recurved awn 2-6 mm long; glume III similar to glume II but only 4.5-7 mm long, not so prominently awned; florets with lemmas 4.7-7.5 mm long, lanceolate, shiny, obscurely 3-5-nerved, the midnerve raised only near the apex and often excurrent as a short mucro; palea as long as lemma, slightly emarginate, glabrous or with scattered puberulence. Flow- ers with anthers 3.5-4.5 mm long. Fruit not seen.

description: Slender shrubby bamboo. Culms 0.5-3 m tall. Leaves 15-25 per complement; sheath summit with fimbriae 2-4 mm long, fine, white, flexuous; outer ligule ca. 0.5 mm long; inner ligule ca. 0.3 mm long; pseudopetioles 1.5-2 mm long; blades 4-6 X 0.6-1 cm, lanceolate, truncate at the base, glabrous. Peduncle 10-20 cm long, 1 mm diam., glabrous. Inflorescence 17-27 X 4- 6 cm, narrowly pyramidal, strict, the slender rachis and branches glabrous; primary branches 4-10, ascending, loosely flowered, unbranched, naked near the base, the lowermost 8-12 cm long. Spikelets 6.7-7.2 mm long, elliptical, sparingly pubescent, 2- flowered; glumes linear-lanceolate, acute, 1-nerved, orangish brown, keeled, glabrous; glume I 2.8-4 mm long; glume II 3-4.3 mm long; florets purple to plumbeous, of approximately equal size and appearance, both appearing to be inserted on the same level (i.e., the upper not distinctly elevated above the lower); florets with lemmas 4.3-5 mm long, elliptical, obtuse to acute, rounded on the back, 3-nerved; paleas slightly protruding from lemmas; rachilla internode 0.7-1 mm long, prolonged past the uppermost floret, naked. Flowers and fruit not seen.

description: Dwarf woody bamboo forming dense colonies by short, pachymorph rhizomes. Culms 0.3-1.5 m tall, 1-2 mm diam., erect, glabrous, stramineous, unbranched below, much-branched above; internodes to 12 cm long in lower portion of culm, gradually shortening to 0.5 cm in upper portion. Leaves to 30 per complement; sheaths puberulent, rounded to somewhat keeled on the back, truncate at summit; inner ligule 0.2-0.7 mm long, ciliolate; outer ligule a minute rim 0.1 mm long; fimbriae 2-4 mm long, brownish, curling, few; pseudopetiole ca. 0.5 mm long; blades 10-30 X 1.5-3.5 (rolled width) mm, ascending, lanceolate, coriaceous, striate, obtuse at the base and flat in lower portion, the upper portion somewhat inrolled and with a slightly carinate, knoblike apex, glabrous, the margins scabrous, cartilaginous-thickened, the lower surface scaberulous with minute papillae ca. 10 [im long. Peduncle included in leaf sheath, the culms often rebranching in up- per portion of leaf complement, each branch terminating in an inflorescence. In- florescence 2-3.5 cm, a spicate raceme bearing 3-7 spikelets, the rachis angled, pu- berulent, scabrous, sometimes glaucous; spikelet pedicels to 2 mm long, erect. Spike- lets (5-)6-7 mm long, greenish to purplish, the bracts often puberulent on the nerves, margins, and apices; glumes narrowly lanceolate, 1-nerved, glabrous to more often puberulent; glume I (1-)2.5-4 mm long, acute; glume 11(2-)3-4.5 mm long, acute or tapering into an awn up to 1 mm long; lowest floret (3-)4-5 mm long, sterile, the lemma lanceolate-ovate, 1-nerved, usually glabrous, the midnerve thickened and pro- longed into a small knob; floret 1, 5-6 mm long, lanceolate-ovate, usually glabrous, the lemma 1- or rarely 3-nerved; rachilla prolonged ca. 2 mm past uppermost floret and bearing a rudimentary floret 2-3.5 mm long. Flower with lodicules 3, spatulate-flabellate, hyaline, glabrous, finely 3-5- nerved, the posterior 0.7 mm long, the anterior pair 0.9-1 mm long; stamens 3, the anthers 2.7-3 mm long, linear, greenish white; gynoecium not seen. Fruit not seen.

description: Plantae perennes, valde caespitosae; culmis 1.5-4 dm longis, supra scabris; vaginis levibus sed plerumque pilis paucis 0.3-0.5 mm longis coronatis; laminis foliorum filiformibus, valde involutis, scabris, rigide erectis, plerumque 3-6 cm longis, vix 0.5 mm latis; ligulis ca. 0.3 mm longis, truncatis aut in lateribus longioribus quam ad centrum, plus minusve eroso-ciliolatis aut lacerato-ciliolatis, plerumque brevioribus quam ullis, pilis vaginis coronatis; panicula angustissima, (3) 5-6 cm longa; glumis 5-6 mm longis, latis, glabris vel minute puberulis, abrupte acuminatis, 3-nervibus, supra purpureis et membranaceis; lemmate ca. 1.5 mm breviore quam glumis, adpresso-pubescente, e sinu aristato; arista cito caduca, gracili, ca. (5-) 6 mm longa, geniculata sed valde ascendente; callo obtuso; antheris ca. 2 mm longis; lodiculis late linearibus, vix 1.5 mm longis.

description: Perelne; culmi 15-25 cm. longi, ramosi, adscendentes, geniculati, nodis pilosis, internodiis 8-14 mm. longis; vaginae internodiis multo longiores, glabrae vel papilloso-pilosae, marginibus dense papilloso- ciliatis; ligula ciliata 1.5-2 mm. longa; laminae 1.5-4 cm. longae, 4-9 mm. latae, subcordatae, ovato-lanceolatae, acutae, glabrae vel sparse pilosae, marginibus hispido-ciliatis; panicu]ae 2-3.5 cm. longae, 0.5-2 cm. latae, ramis adscendentibus vel appressis; spieulae 2.2-2.5 mm. longae, 1 mm. latae, purpureae; gluma prima 3-nervis, 1.5-1.7 mm. longa, acuta vel subobtusa; lemma sterile 9-nerve glumam secundam subaequans; lemma fertile 2.2 mm. longum, glabrum, apiculatum.

description: Perennial; culms hard, relatively stout, 15-25 cm. long, ascending, more or less geniculate at the pilose lower nodes, the internodles mostly 8-15 mm. long; sheaths much longer than the internodes, glabrous or papillose-pilose, the margins densely papillose-ciliate, 1.5-2 mm. long; blades 1.5-4 cm. long, 4-9 inm. wide, ovate-lanceolate, acute, glabrous or sparsely pilose, the rather conspicuous white margins hispid-ciliate, the hairs much longer near the base of the blade than toward the tip; panicle 2-3.5 cm. long, 0.5-2 cm. wide, the short branches ascending or appressed; spikelets 2.2-2.5 mm. long, about 1 mm. wide, purple; first glume 3-nerved, 1.5-1.7 mm. long, acute or subobtuse; second glume and sterile lemma 9-nerved, subequal, or the glume a little shorter, covering the fruit; fertile lemma 2.2 mm. long, smooth or slightly scabrous near the tip, with a prominent apicule about 0.2 mm. long.

description: Culms erect to decumbent at base, solitary from spreading rhizomes, often with a tendency for bunching, branching from the lower nodes common, 0.2 m to 1.5 m tall, glaucous and glabrous. Sheaths longer than or equal to the internodes, glabrous, glaucous. Blades ascending, firm, 3-12 mm wide, 7-35 cm long, flat at base, tapering into involute tips, margins smooth or occasionally scabrous. Ligule 2.5-3.5 mm long. Panicle at maturity contracted, 10-30 cm long, 2-6 cm wide, primary branches ascending, closely appressed to the main axis, scabrous to occasionally smooth, usually solitary, sometimes paired, rarely whorled; secondary branches appressed, scabrous or occasionally smooth; tertiary and quaternary branches sometimes present. Pedicels capillary appressed, usually scabrous. Spikelets ovate, accuminate, glabrous, 4.7-7.7 mm long, 2.0-2.8 mm wide. Glumes acuminate, the first one-half to two-thirds the length of spikelet, 7- or 9-veined, slightly shorter than or equal to second glume; the second 4.7-7.7 mm long, 7- or 9-veined. Sterile lemma acuminate, 7- or 9-veined, shorter than the second glume. Sterile palea thin membranaceous, slightly shorter than the sterile lemma. Fertile lemma and palea (fruit) smooth, shiny, 2.9-3.9 mm long, 1.3-1.8 mm wide. Caryopsis abortive. Chromosome number: 2n = 54.
bibliographicCitation: Palmer, P. 1975. A biosystematic study of the Panicum amarum=P. amarulum complex (Gramineae). Brittonia. 27: 142-150.

description: Culms erect to decumbent in dense bunches or from spreading rhizomes with a tendency toward bunching, 1-2 (-3) m tall, robust, glaucous and glabrous. Sheaths longer than or equal to the internodes, glabrous and glaucous. Blades ascending, firm, 3-12 mm wide, 10-50 cm long, flat at base tapering into involute tips, margins smooth to rarely scabrous. Ligule 2.5-3.0 mm long. Panicle at maturity contracted, 3-10 cm wide, 15-40 cm long, primary branches ascending, closely appressed to main axis, smooth to sometimes scabrous, paired or whorled, rarely solitary; secondary branches appressed, smooth to sometimes scabrous; paired or whorled, rarely solitary; tertiary and quaternary branches usually present. Pedicels capillary, appressed, smooth to sometimes scabrous. Spikelets ovate, acuminate, glabrous, 4.0-5.9 mm long, 1.8-2.5 mm wide. Glumes acuminate, the first one-half to two-thirds the length of spikelet, 3- or 5-veined; the second 4.0-5.9 mm long, 5-, 7-, or 9-veined. Sterile lemma acuminate, 7- or 9-veined, slightly shorter than the second glume. Sterile palea thin-mem- branaceous, slightly shorter than the sterile lemma. Fertile lemma and palea (fruit) smooth, shiny, 2.4-3.6 mm long, 1.0-1.5 mm wide. Caryopsis ellipsoid, gray to tan, 1.6-2.4 mm long, 1.0-1.3 mm wide, apex rounded to acute, brown ellipsoid depression present near proximal end of dorsal surface. Chromosome number: 2n = 36.

description: Perenne; culmi erecti duri rigidi glabri 1.5 m. alti; vaginae glabrae; ligula 0.5 mm. longa; laminae angustae erectae glabrae plerumque planae, 5-15 cm. longae, 3-5 mm. latae; panicula erecta angusta 10-20 cm. longa, ramis appressis tenuibus distantibus quam internodiis longi-oribus, 3-5 cm. longis; spiculae glabrae oblongo-ellipticae 2 mm. longae, breviter pedicellatae; gluma prima ovata acutiuscula circa 0.8 mm. longa; gluma secunda et lemma sterile aequalia 5-nervia; lemma fertile ellipticum acutum circa 2 mm. longum.

description: Perennial; culms rather slender, erect, stiff, hard, glabrous, several-noded, 1.5 meters tall; sheaths glabrous, striate, shorter than the internodes; ligule a narrow rim about 0.5 mm. long; blades narrow, erect, glabrous, flat or loosely involute, 5-15 cm. long, 3-5 mm. wide; panicle erect, narrow, 10-20 cm. long, the axis angled, glabrous or nearly so, the main branches appressed, distant but more or less overlapping, slender, the lower 3-5 cm. long, bearing short-pedicelled loosely arranged spikelets mostly toward one side; spikelets glabrous, oblong-elliptic, 2 mm. long; first glume ovate, acutish, less than half as long as the spikelet; second glume and sterile lemma about equal, as long as the spikelet, 5-nerved, the lemma inclosing a palea; fruit elliptic, acutish, as long as the sterile lemma.

description: Annuum; culmi 6-14 cm. longi, ramosi, geniculati, decumbentes; vaginae internodiis breviores, glabrae vel sparse papilloso-pilosae; laminae 1-2.5 Cm. longae, 2-6 mm. latae, glabrae vel sparse pilosae, sub- cordatae; panicula 2-4 cm. longa, 2-3 cm. lata, ramis divergentibus vel reflexis; pedicelli graciles, divergentes, flexuosi, 1-4.5 mm. longi; spiculae 1.4-1.5 mm. longae, 0.6 mm. latae, acutae; gluma prima 0.7- 0.8 mm. longa, acuta; lemma sterile et gluma secunda aequalia, 5-nervia, hispida; lemma fertile 1.3 mm. longum, sparse et minute pubeseens.

description: Annual; culms 6-14 cm. long, branching, geniculate, decumbent, spreading; sheaths about half as long as the internodes, glabrous or sparsely papillose-pilose; ligule membranaceous, 0.5 mm. lonlg; blades 1-2.5 cm. long, 2-6 mm. wide, glabrous or sparsely pilose, subcordate; panicles 2-4 em. long, 2-3 cm. wide, the branches stiffly and abruptly spreadilng or reflexed; pedicels slender, divergent, flexuous, 1-4.5 mm. long; spikelets 1.4-1.5 mm. long, 0.6 mm. wide, acute; first glume 0.7- 0.8 mm. long, acute; second glume and sterile lemma equal, 5-nerved, hispid toward the summit; fertile lemma 1.3 mm. long, elliptic, acute, sparsely and minutely pubeseent.

description: Gramen perenne; culmi dense caespitosi, distenti, rhizomatibus brevibus, tenuibus; vaginae carinatae, inferiores imbricatae; ligula minuta; laminae planae, 4-20 cm (plerum 7-15 cm) longae, 5-8 mm latae, interdum pubescentes; racemi 2, conjugati, rarius 3, ascendentes, 1.5-6 cm longi; spiculae solitariae, 1.6-1.7 mm longae, 1.4-1.5 mm latae, suborbiculatae, approximatae; gluma et lemma sterile aequalia, 3-nervia vel gluma 5-nervia; fructus circa 1.4 mm longus, suborbiculatus, pallidus, subtillime papilloso-striatus.

description: Perennial forming dense circular mats with numerous leafy shoots and short slender rhizomes; culms radiate-spreading to ascending; sheaths compressedkeeled, ciliate towards the summit, sometimes appressed-pubescent, the lower short, overlapping, the uppermost usually nearly reaching the base of the racemes, bladeless; ligule minute, with a row of hairs about 0.3 mm long behind it; blades flat, 4-20 cm (mostly 7-15 cm) long, 5 to 8 mm wide, ciliate toward the base, sometimes pubescent on both surfaces; racemes 2 conjugate, or occasionally 3, ascending to suberect 1.5-6 cm long; rhachis about 0.8 mm wide; spikelets 1.6-1.7 mm long, 1.4-1.5 mm wide, suborbicular, the flat side slightly raised round the edge like a coin, approximate but not imbricate; glume and sterile lemma equal, firm, smooth and shining, 3-nerved or the glume faintly 5-nerved, the midnerve sometimes obscure; fruit about 1.4 mm long, suborbicular, pale, very minutely papillose-striate, the palea slightly depressed with a minutely raised margin.

description: Perenne, caespitose; culini simplices erecti, glabri, 1-1.4 m. alti, nodis pubescentibus; vaginae internodiis longiores, papilloso-pilosae; ligula 2-2.5 nim. longa; laminae planae vel conduplicatae, subinvoluto- acuminatae, 9-25 cm. longae, 8-10 mm. latae (superiores abbreviatae), utrinque papilloso-pilosae; racemi 4-6, axi communi 2-4.5 mm. longo, erecto-subpatuli, subflexuosi, 8-12 cm. longi; radhis alata, 4 mm. lata, ultra spiculas produeta; spiculae solitariae, imbricatae, eomplanatae, oblongo-ovatae, 6.5-7.5 mm. longae, 3-3.5 mm. latae; gluma complanata, e basi auriculato-cordata, 7-9-nervia, ciliata, e apice seta 1.5-2 mm. longa prodita; lemma sterile subeordatum, quam gluma angustius et brevius, 3-nervium, hirtellum, ciliatum, e apice seta 2-2.5 mm. longa proditum; fructus vix indnratus, 5 mnm. longus, 1.3 mm. latus, lemmate apice pauci-ciliato.

description: Species haec a ceteris generis speciebus laminis longis et angustissimis costa utrinque glabris, culmis foliiferis tenuibus, et culmis floriferis elongatis differt. Gramen perenne, usque 40 cm altum. Culmi tenues, recti, fasciculos densos gerentes. Folia 6-12 in complemento; laminae lineari-lanceolatae, 50-60 x 4-7 mm, utraque superficie virides et glabrae, costae superna infernaque glabrae; petiolus brevis, pro parte maxima glaber; vagina pubescens inter nervos; ligula interna non manifesta. Inflorescentia racemiformis, 3.5-4 cm longa. Spiculae femineae ovatae, 5-7 mm longae, glabrae, nitidae; ambae glumae 5-nervatae; anthoecium ovoideum, pilosum. Spiculae masculae lineari-lanceolatae, vulgo glumis carentes; lemma 3-nervatum; palea 2-nervata; stamina 3, gynoecium rudimentale stigmate singulare elongato superatum cingentia. Caryopsis hilo lineari et embryone basali longitudinem 1/5 caryopsidis aequans.

description: Perennial grass in cespitose clumps with up to 40 or 50 tightly packed and erect wiry culms, on white sandy soil of shaded littoral woods. Culms biform, erect ones bearing leaves only (rarely terminating in an inflorescence) and decumbent ones bearing inflorescences, these subtended by sheaths with minute, reduced blades. Erect culms thin, purplish, mostly glabrous, except for a line of pubescence along one side, this increasing toward the leaf comolement, to ca 35 cm tall, with a shorter lower internode and an elongate upper internode, each node with a bladeless sheath, the culm terminating in a leaf complement. Nodes prominent, flared, pubescent. Foliage leaves 6-12 per complement; blades linear-lanceolate narrowed to an acute tip, 5-6 cm long, 4-7 mm wide, pale green and glabrous on the upper surface, sparingly hirtellous on the lower, antrorsely scabrous on the edges, the midrib prominent and glabrous on both surfaces, the short petiole glabrous on and along the margins of the lower surface and with a few hairs on the upper surface; sheath short-pubescent on the internerves, more densely so toward the summit; oral setae lacking; outer ligule lacking; inner ligule a minute ciliolate rim not manifest. Decumbent culms reaching the erect culms in length, all nodes subtended by a sheath with a minute reduced and inconspicuous blade, the lower nodes not branching and separated by elongate internodes, the upper nodes branching and separated by shortened internodes, these nodes each bearing an inflorescence or occasionally rebranching. Inflorescence racemiform, 3.5-4 cm long, the greater part of the short-pubescent peduncle covered by the sheath with only the upper part exserted, the short-pubescent axis bearing a terminal female spikelet with 2 or 3 male spikelets below it and 1 or 2 lower female spikelets accompanied or not by 1 or 2 male spikelets. Female spikelets ovate, 5-7 mm long, purplish-brown, becoming stramineous, glabrous, shiny, with thick elevated nerves; lower glume ovate and narrowed to an apiculate apex, strongly 5-nerved with transverse veinlets, hardly exceeding the upper glume in length; upper glume ovate and narrowed to an apiculate apex, strongly 5-nerved with transverse veinlets; anthecium fusiform, hard at maturity with the margins of the lemma enclosing only the margins of the palea, the latter mostly exposed, the whole shiny and sparingly covered with fine white, appressed hairs, the lemma 5-nerved, with transverse veinlets and mottled with dark brown, the palea 2-nerved with transverse veinlets and mottled with dark brown. Male spikelets linear-lanceolate, consisting usually of only lemma and palea (two 5-nerved glumes with transverse veinlets occasionally present), the lemma thin, 3-nerved; palea thin, 2-nerved; stamens 3, surrounding a rudimentary gynoecium with a single elongate plumose stigma. Caryopsis pale brown, ovoid, ca 4 mm long, with a linear hilum almost as long as the caryopsis itself and an embryo ca 1/5 its length.

description: Species haec a ceteris generis speciebus laminis oblongis magnis costam adaxialem pubescentem ferentibus differt. description: Foliage leaves 5-8 per complement; blades oblong, narrowed to a symmetric or slightly asymmetric tip, 9-13 cm long x 1.5-2.5 cm wide, pale green and glabrous on both surfaces, the midrib prominent on both surfaces, the one on the lower surface glabrous, that on the upper surface short-pubescent, the short petiole pubescent on the upper surface and densely so along both sides of the midrib below; sheath glabrous on the lower part, becoming densely short-villous toward the summit; oral setae lacking; outer ligule lacking; inner ligule not manifest. Inflorescences terminating the culm, the leaves preceding it reduced and each branch covered by sheaths with very reduced blades, the pubescent axis of each just exserted from the subtending sheath and bearing a terminal female spikelet with accompanying male spikelet and below this 2 or 3 subsessile male spikelets, with 3-5 short-pedicellate female spikelets on the axis below, each accompanied by a subsessile male spikelet, the whole flowering system ca 9 cm long, each axis 2-3 cm long. Female spikelets elliptic, ca 5.5-6 mm long, brown, glabrous, shiny, with thick elevated nerves; lower glume 5-nerved with some transverse veinlets, slightly exceeding the upper in length, apiculate; upper glume 3-nerved with some transverse veinlets, apiculate; anthecium fusiform, a little longer than the glumes, covered with fine white hairs, the lemma almost fully covering the palea except toward the base. Male spikelets fallen and not present.

description: Perennial; culms erect from a somewhat decumbent base, glabrous, 40-60 cm. tall; sheaths glabrous or the upper scaberulous; ligule 1-2 mm. long or the uppermost 3 mm.; blades more or less folded or involute, glabrous or somewhat scaberulous, mostly 10-15 cm. long, 1-2 mm. wide, the uppermost shorter; panicle open, ovoid or pyramidal, pale or purplish, 10-15 cm. long, the axis slender, scaberulous, the branches ascending, mostly in pairs, naked below, as much as 5 cm. long, the branchlets mostly appressed, few-flowered; spikelets 2-flowered, about 5 mm. long, the lateral pedicels 1-2 mm. long; glumes acuminate, scabrous on keel and back, the first narrow, about 2.5 mm. long, the second 3-nerved, longer and broader; lemmas rather distinctly 5-nerved, scaberulous on nerves and internerves, sparsely webbed at base, somewhat hyaline-tipped, the first about 4 mm. long, the second a little shorter; palea acute, about as long as the lemma, the slender prolongation of the rachilla hidden between the minutely scaberulous keels.

description: Perennis; culmi erecti glabri usque ad 1 m. alti; vaginae summo paullum scaberulae; ligula vix 1 mm. longa; laminae plerumque plica-tae vel involutae, ad apicem scabrae, 10-20 cm. longae, 1-2 mm. latae; panicula patens nutans pallida 15-20 cm. longa, ramis capillaribus infra longe nudis plerumque quaternis, usque ad 10 cm. longis; spicu-lae 3-4-florae, 4 mm. longae; glumae 2-2.5 mm. longae; lemmata oblonga obtusiuscula circiter 2.5 mm. longa, apice hyalina, in carina minute pubescentia, basi sparsim villosa.

description: Perennial; culms erect, glabrous, several-noded, as much as 1 m. tall; sheaths slightly rough toward the summit, the lowermost overlapping; ligule less than 1 mm. long; blades flat or usually folded or involute, scabrous on the margin, on the upper surface, and beneath toward the involute sharp-pointed tip, 10-20 cm. long, 1-2 mm. wide as flattened; panicle open, nodding, pale, 15-20 cm. long, the axis slender, scabrous, the branches capillary, fascicled (the fascicles 3-5 cm. apart), scabrous, naked on the lower half, the lower mostly in fours, as much as 10 cm. long, the branchlets appressed or ascending, bearing a few spikelets on the upper part; spikelets 3-4-flowered, about 4 mm. long, the lateral pedicels about 1 mm. long; glumes narrow, acutish, glabrous except the keels, the first 1-nerved, 2 mm. long, the second 3-nerved, a little longer and broader, lemmas oblong, obtusish, hyaline at the tip, distinctly nerved, minutely pubescent on the keel and minutely scaberulous on the other nerves, somewhat cobwebby at base, the lowermost about 2.5 mm. long; palea a little shorter than the lemma; rachilla glabrous, the internodes nearly 1 mm. long, the prolongation about as long, bearing at the tip a small rudiment.

description: Perennial; culms densely cespitose, with numerous innovations, erect, slightly scabrous below the panicle, bearing one node near the base, 20-40 cm. tall; sheaths compressed, faintly scaberulous, the single culm sheath 10 cm. long or more; ligule of the culm leaves narrow, about 4 mm. long, of the innovations very short; blades erect, rather stiff, involute, scabrous, sharp-pointed, mostly basal, 10-15 cm. long, the culm blade 2-4 cm. long, all 0.5 mm. thick or less; panicle long-exserted, ovoid, open, 4-7 cm. long, the axis more or less scaberulous, the branches spreading, slender, branched at base, naked on the lower part, the lowest as much as 3 cm. long, the lower internodes 2-2.5 cm. long, all the branches few-flowered; the branchlets appressed; spikelets dark purple, 2-flowered, about 4 mm. long, the lateral pedicels about 1 mm. long; glumes glabrous, scaberulous on the keels, subequal, acuminate, the first 1-nerved, about 3 mm. long, the second 3-nerved, a little longer; lemmas acute, faintly scaberulous, 5-nerved, the first 4 mm. long, the second shorter, the summit about as high as that of the first; palea of first floret about as long as its lemma or a little shorter, of the second as long as its lemma or slightly exceeding it; rachilla glabrous, the internode between the florets about 0.5 mm. long, the prolongation about the same length.

description: Apparently perennial; culms weak, slender, ascending from a decumbent or creeping base, glabrous or slightly rough below the panicle and below the nodes, as much as 1 m. long; sheaths scaberulous (rough to the touch); ligule thin, acute, 2-3 mm. long; blades flat, lax, glabrous beneath, scaberulous on the upper surface, rather abruptly acute, mostly less than 10 cm. long, 1-2 mm. wide; panicle nodding, loose and open, pyramidal, 10-15 cm. long, the axis slender, scaberulous, the branches mostly in pairs, capillary, scaberulous, naked on the lower half or two-thirds, spreading or finally reflexed, the lowermost as much as 5 cm. long, the others successively shorter, the lower pairs distant 2-3 cm., the branchlets short and appressed; spikelets 2-flow-ered, 4-5 mm. long, the rachilla continued as a slender stipe half as long as the upper floret, the internode between the florets slender, about 1 mm. long, the lateral pedicels about 0.5 mm. long; glumes subequal, acute, scaberulous on the keels and nerves, the first 1-nerved, somewhat broader than the strongly 3-nerved second; lemmas acute, glabrous, scarcely nerved below, distinctly 5-nerved toward the summit, the first about 3.5 mm. long, the second a little shorter, the nerves less distinct; palea a little shorter than the lemma, acute, narrow, sulcate between the faintly scaberulous keels.

description: Perennial; culms erect, glabrous, 1-noded near the base, 30-80 cm. tall; sheaths glabrous; ligule 1-2 mm. long; blades flat or usually loosely folded or involute, glabrous, 10-20 cm. long, 1-2 mm. wide; panicle open, 6-15 cm. long, the axis glabrous below, scabrous above, the branches capillary, widely spreading, mostly in pairs, scabernlons, flexuous, as much as 9 cm. long, spikelet-bearing near the ends, the lower pairs as much as 4 cm. apart; spikelets about 4-flowered, 5 mm. long, the lateral pedicels about 1 mm. long, slightly pubescent; glumes subequal, acutish, 3-nerved, glabrous or the second seaberulous on the keel, about 3 mm. long; lemmas acutish, distinctly 5-nerved (with a faint additional pair), glabrous except the minutely seaberulous keel, about 3.5 mm. long; palea shorter than the lemma and clasped within it; rachilla glabrous.

description: Frutex scandens lactescens robustus; rami graciles obscuri, lenti-cellis numerosis albidis ellipticis obtecti; folia obscure viridia opposita coriacea glabra, petiolus 0.5 cm. longus, lamina 8-12 cm. longa, 3-3.5 cm. lata, integerrima, elliptica, basi acuta, apice caudato-acuminata, nervi distincti subtus prominuli, secundarii oblique recti, sub ipso margine distincte arcuato-conjuncti, ad 12 in utroque latere, nervis interstitialibus aucti; inflorescentiae axillares glabrae pauciflorae, pedunculus communis 1-1.5 cm. longus, cymae bracteatae et bracteo-latae, pedicelli 5-7 cm. longi; lobi calycis patentes obtusi ciliati; corolla dilute viridis, hypocrateriformis, glabra, tubus 14 mm. longus, prope basin paulo dilatatam 2 mm. latus, lobi oblique securiformes obtusi, 7 mm. longi, 5 mm. lati, squamae faucis binae epipetalae obtusae; an-therae 4 mm. supra basin corollae insertae, ovato-oblongae, 2 mm. longae, apice in stipites 0.5 mm. longos contractae; stigma longiuscule bicaudatum; ovarium glabrum, 2 mm. altum, rimosum.

description: Gramen perenne, caespitosum, culmis 20-30 in fasciculis densis super terram elevatis. Culmi erecti, filiformes tenacesque, ca 30 cm alti. Folia per complementum 6-9; laminae lineares, 3-5 cm longae, 2-4 mm latae, ad basin rotundatae, ad apicem acutae; vaginae inter costas sparsim pilosae; pseudo- petiolus utrinque pilosus. Inflorescentiae femineae e nodis inferis exorientes, ex spicula terminali 1 vel 2 spiculis sessilibus constantes. Inflorescentiae masculae terminales, in panicula usque ad 15 spiculas continentes. Spiculae femineae ovoideo-elongatae, 3-3.8 mm longae; gluma infera 5-nervia, supera 3-nervia; lemma 5-nervium. Spiculae masculae lineares, 4.5 mm longae.

description: Cespitose perennials forming dense clumps, the culms clustered in fascicles of 20-30 with the thick roots intertwined and matlike, the whole plant elevated above the soil. Culms erect, unbranched, wiry, ca 3 dm tall, the lowest internode short, its leaf bearing a small blade, the next internode elongated and with a leaf bearing a small blade, this sometimes subtending a female inflorescence, followed by a shorter internode with a leaf bearing a full-sized blade, followed by a leaf complement of 6-9 leaves, the blades separated from one another by 1-2 cm. Blade linear-lanceolate, rounded at the base and acute at the tip, 3-5 cm long, 2- 4 mm wide, not manifestly tessellate, antrorsely scabrous along the margins, otherwise glabrous on both surfaces, the midvein prominent below; pseudopetiole short, pilose on both surfaces; sheath prominently ribbed, sparingly pilose between the ribs; ligule a thin membrane less than 1 mm long with a ciliolate margin. Female inflorescences borne singly from the lower nodes, these consisting of a terminal spikelet and 1 or 2 sessile spikelets, glabrous throughout. Male inflores- cence a panicle borne terminally and occasionally from a lower node of the leaf complement, the first node of the terminal inflorescence bracteate, the axis gla- brous, bearing 2 or 3 lower branches of sessile or short-pedicellate spikelets and spikelets singly or in pairs above, with up to 15 spikelets in the whole inflorescence. Female spikelets ovoid-elongate; glumes firm in texture and whitish with cartilag- inous margins, arising at about the same level, the lower acuminate, the upper acute; lower glume glabrous, ovate-acuminate with the tip scaberulous, 5-nerved, glabrous, 3-3.8 mm long, not manifestly tessellate; upper glume glabrous, ovate- acute with the margins rounded at the base, somewhat firm in texture, 3-nerved, 3.2-4.5 mm long, not manifestly tessellate; lemma glabrous, 2.6 mm long, thin but firm, the margins parallel but not touching, 5-nerved, not manifestly tessellate; palea same as lemma in shape and consistency, the margins meeting below, 2-nerved, not manifestly tessellate; lodicules 3, thickened and more or less trun- cate; ovary glabrous with one long style and 2 plumose stigmas. Male spikelets linear, 4.5 mm long; lemma thin, glabrous, 3-nerved without transverse veinlets; palea thin, glabrous, 2-nerved, without transverse veinlets; anthers 3, orange, 2.2- 3 mm long, the filament attached on the lower part; lodicules 3, thickened, more or less truncate. Fruit not known.
bibliographicCitation: Soderstrom, Thomas R. & Zuloaga, Fernando O. 1985. New species of grasses in Arberella, Cryptochloa, and Raddia (Poaceae: Bambusoideae: Olyreae). Brittonia. 37: 22-35.
