description: Stems 0.6-1.5 mm diam, orange. Inflorescen- ces glomerule-like cymes with 3-15 flowers, often confluent in larger, dense inflorescences; pedicels 1-2.5 mm long; bract 1 at the base of clusters, usually absent at the base of pedicels, 1-2.5 x 0.8-1.1 mm, fleshy, ovate-triangular to lanceolate, the margins entire, apices acute. Flowers 5-merous, 5-7 mm long, fleshy, white when fresh, creamy to brown when dried; papillae absent; laticifers numerous, isolated or in groups of 2-5, evident in the calyx, corolla and ovary/capsule, mostly ovoid or elongate; calyx creamy-yellow when fresh and brown when dried, campanulate, ca. 1/2-1/3 the length of the corolla tube, divided ca. 2/3 of its length, the tube 1.2-1.35 mm long, the lobes over- lapping, 1.2-1.6 x 2.2-2.8 mm, broadly-triangular lar (broader than long), auriculate, margins entire to slightly crenulate, the apices rounded; outer two calyx lobes with a spur- or crest-like projection that extends along calyx lobe for 0.7-1.5 mm and protrudes dorsally for 0.7- 1.2 mm, the projections often denticulate or provided with 2-4 thick fimbriae; corollas persistent on fruit, the tubes campanulate, 3- 3.3 mm long, the lobes initially erect, later spreading or reflexed, 2.2-2.5 mm long, ovate, auriculate, the margins entire, overlapping at base, the apices rounded, initially hooded, later flat; stamens exserted, shorter than corolla lobes, the anthers elliptic to broadly-elliptic, 0.9-1.1 x0.6-0.7 mm, filaments 0.7-1 mm long; pollen grains 22-25 tm long, prolate to lumina maximum diameter 1 µm;. supratectal process granular to conical, ± uniformly distributed; infrastraminal scales equaling corolla tube, 2.5-2.7 mm long, oblong to obovate, rounded, ± uniformly, dense fimbriate, fimbriae 0.3 -0.9 mm long; styles subulate, basally thickened, apically narrowed, 1.3 -2.5mm long, as long or shorter as the ovary; stigmas 0.4-0.6 mm in diameter, globose , convulated. CApsules dehiscent, ovoid to conical, 2-4 x 2.5 -4 mm, the base of the styles forming a conic beak, 0.9 -1.5 mm long, the intersylar aperture barely visible, the corolla persistent around the capsule. Seeds 4 per capsule, broadly elliptic, angled, 1.5-2.1 x 1.4-1.6 mm, the seed coat wrinkled in a radial pattern, not alveolate when dry, the cells slightly papillate, 18-35 pm in diameter, the epicuticular wax absent, the hilum region round, 0.5-0.7 mm diam., the vascular scar 0.18-0.25 mm long, slightly oblique.

description: Hierbas perennes, 20--40 cm, muy ramifica das desde la base. Tallos glabrescentes, con tricomas inconspicuos muy cortos, los entrenudos iguales o mis largos que las hojas. Hojas 1-2.9x 0.6-1.6 cm, coriiceas, ovado a ovado- lanceoladas, aipice agudo, margen denticulado, sobre todo hacia el Apice, base redonda, haz glabrescente, con pelos muy cortos, conspicuos en el margen, enves glabrescente , con tricomas muy cortos, visibles sobres las venas y glanduals esfericas impresas; peciolo 1-5 mm de largo. Inflorescencias 15-20 cm, laxas, terminales, cimulas con 3-6 flores, umbeliformes, pedunculadas; pedunculos 0.6 -1.5 (-2) cm; bracteas proximales similares a las hojas, mas pequenas y angostas en los nudos distales, bricteas 1-2 mm, lineares, frecuentemente con dos bracteolas filiformes; eje de la inflorescencia con glindulas diminutas, s6siles o cortamente estipitadas. Flores pediceladas, pedicelos 4-6.5 mm de largo, filiformes, diminutamente pubescentes, glandulares; ctliz campanulado, tubo 2.5-5 mm, dientes 1.2-2.5 mm de largo, subulados, abaxialmente diminuta- mente hirsutos, con pelos simples y glfindulas sisiles y corto-estipitadas, garganta no oblicua, con un anillo de tricomas blancos; corola 0.8- 1.6 cm, tubular, bilabiada, violeta, tubo 0.65- 1.3 cm, pubescente abaxialmente, labio posterior 3-4 mm, labio anterior 3-4 mm, 16bulo medio sacciforme; estambres 4, filamentos insertos, pubescentes; estilo pubescente, articulado en el tpice de las nuculas. Niculas 2, ovoides, marrones.

description:
Species insignis a congeneris colombianis internodiis ramulorum juvenilibus annulo indumenti luteo-lanuginoso munitis distincta. Magnoliae guatapensis affinis sed apice folii emarginata, subtus nervis dense luteo-lanuginosis, staminibus pluribus differt.

Arbol de hasta 13 m de altura y hasta 19 cm de didmetro; corteza externa grisicea; corteza intema blanca. Entrenudos en las ramillas 4.5-19.7 mm de largo, glabros o con indumento lanuginoso, caduco; lenticelas esparcidas. Prefoliacion conduplicada. Hojas 6.8-16.4 x 4.1-7.7 cm, obovadas, elipticas en individuos juveniles, coriiceas, con ipice frecuentemente emarginado o agudo en algunos individuos juveniles; haz glabro brillante; enves con pubescencia lanuginosa amarilla por todo, caediza, mis evidente en la nervadura principal; nervaduras 8-13 por cada lado y cicatrices lineares de la prefoliacion muy evidentes; peciolo 5.5-12.3 mm de largo, 1.4-2.8 mm de difimetro. Boton floral proximo a la antesis con una brictea de (14.7-) 21.3-22.2 x 14-15 mm, ovada, gruesa, quebradiza, de color crema a cafe con pubescencia lanuginosa escasa amarilla. Sdpalos 3, 16.2-21.1 x 9.8-18.3 mm, ovados a oblongo-ovados, carticeos, a menudo con indumento pubescente en el envds. Petalos 9- 10, (11.8-)13-19.6 x 5.7-11.5 mm, obovados a subespatulados. Estambres (6-2)75-114, dispuestos en 5-6 series espiraladas, 7-9.2 x 1.4-1.8 mm, el conectivo hasta 0.8 mm de largo. Gineceo hasta 17.8 mm de largo y 7 mm de difimetro, elipsoide; carpelos 9-11, con frecuencia cubiertos de indumento tomentoso, escaso y poco evidente. Fruto inmaduro 16.8- 28.3 cm de largo, 9-13.5 cm de diametro, elipsoide, verde oscuro; semillas 1-2 por carpelo, obtriangulares; sarcotesta cafe claro.

description:
Species insignis a congeneris colombianis petalis externis conspicue punctatis, pubescentia luteo lanuginosa distincta. Magnoliae gilbertoi affinis sed petalis 8, staminibus 39 differt

Arbol de hasta 25 m de altura y 60 cm de diimetro; corteza externa gris, levemente lenticelada; corteza intema color crema. Entrenudos en las ramillas 12.8-23.5 mm de largo, 4.9-7.5 mm de ditmetro, con indumento lanuginoso amarillo ocre, abundante; lenticelas escasas y esparcidas. Yemas foliares a menudo fuertemente pubescentes. Prefoliaci6n conduplicada, las estipulas permaneciendo en el peciolo aun despuos de la expansion completa de la hoja. Hojas 15.3-34 x 10.6-21.4 cm, eliptica a subeliptica, carticea, con indumento lanuginoso en el enves, con 8-12 nervios secundarios por cada lado; peciolo 30-86 mm de largo, con cicatriz en el lado adaxial ocupando 3/4 partes de su longitud. Flores con 3 bricteas, 33.2-48.2 mm de largo, con indumento corto, adpreso en el enves. Sepalos 3, 36-41 x 23-31 mm, obovados, ligeramente tomentosos en el enves. Petalos 8, 27-40x 7.7-20 mm, obovados, cocleariformes, camo- sos, presentando numerosas puntuaciones cafes en la cara adaxial; estambres hasta 39, dispuestos en 3-4 series espiraladas, en boton floral 8.5-9.9 x 1.8-2 mm. Gineceo elipsoide, con 8-10 carpelos. Fruto elipsoide, 7 cm de largo, 3.8 cm de didmetro; semillas no observadas.

description: Plant epiphytic or terrestrial, flowering 60- 80 cm tall, propagating by stout basal shoots; leaves 16-32, coriaceous, forming a broadly funnel form rosette; sheaths broadly funnelform rosette; sheaths broadly elliptic obovate, 16-24 x 9-11 cm, densely brown lepidote on bith sides, green on the abaxial surface; blades linear, suberect - arcuate, 52 -68 x 5- 5.5 cm, slightly if at all narrowed toward the base, apex subacute to rounded and minutely apiculate, sparsely and inconspicuously white - lepidote on both sides, green with irregular darker green spots, margins entire or irregularly and insconspicuously white - lepidote on both sides, green with irregular darker green spots, margins entire or irregularly and inconspicuously spinulose with spines ca. 0.3 mm long; scape erect, 37 -49 cm long, ca.. 1 cm in diam., glabrous; scape bracts subovate to lanceolate, acute and apiculate, entire, erect, distinctly exceeding the internodes and completely covering the scape, papyraceous, nevered sparsely and inconspicuously white-lepidote abaxially, 6 -8.5 x 3.5 -3.7 cm, red except for the upper ones which have a white apex, the upper ones resembling the floral bractsk inflorescence simple, densely spicate, cylindrical to subclavate, terete, erect, 12- 17 x 3.5 - 4.5 cm, rachis completely hidden by the bracts; floral bracts suborbicular to broadly suboblong - obovate, apex subacute to obtuse, muticouslto inconspicuously apciulate, slightly cucullate, 25- 30 x  15-26 mm, the basal 2/3 -4/5 red, the apical 1/3-1/5 white, nevered, membranaceous, inconspicuously and sparsely brown lepidote adaxially, glabrous abaxially, strongly convex and imbricate at antheses, including the erect apex, ecarinate, distinctly  exceeding the sepals, margins entire; flowers 35 -41 mm long (with extended petals), sessile, densely and polysticheously arranges, ordorless; sepals oblong - obovate, asymmetrical with the lateral membranaceous wing equaling to slightly exceeding the midnerve, 13-14 x 7-7.5 mm, connate at the base for 1- 2.5mm, pale rosewhite, glabrous, ecarinate, apex obtuse, muticous; petals subspatulate, apex subrounded, 29-30 x 6 mm, free, white, spreading at anthesis, bearing at the base 2 obovate appendages, 5.5 -6  x 2-2.5 mm, basally adnate to the petals for ca. 1mm, obtuse rounded, irregularly crenulate to subentire; filaments complanate and dilated toward apex, 22-24 x 1.5 -2 mm, the antepetalous ones adnate to the petals for ca. 15 mm, the antesepalous ones free; anthers sublinear, ca. 4.5 mm long, base sagittate and apex obtuse, dorsifixed near the middle; pollen biporate, subglobose, exine reticulate, muri slightly thickned, lumina subrounded; ovary obovate subquadrate, 6-7 mm long, 5-6 mm in diam, at the apex, green, glabrous, laterally obtusely if at all carinate; placentation apical; ovules obtuse; epigynous tube crateriform, 1.5-2 mm long; stigma exceeding the anthers, globose, ca. 2x2mm, conduplicate - spiral, white blades, obtusely and inconspicuously crenulate to nearly entire; fruits and seeds unknown.

description:
Plant epiphytic or terrestrial, flowering 60-100 cm tall, propagating by stout basal shoots; leaves 10-20, thinly coriaceous, forming a broadly Amnelform rosette; sheaths broadly elliptic, 15-19x 8-10 cm, densely brown lepidote on both sides, green on the abaxial surface, pale castaneous on the adaxial surface; blades linear, suberect-arcuate, 50-82x4.5 cm, slightly narrowed toward the base, apex acute to subrounded and minutely apiculate, sparsely and inconspicuously white-lepidote on both sides, green, margins irregularly and inconspicuously spinulose, spines ca. 0.3 mm long or shorter, densely to very sparsely arranged; scape suberect, 50-80 cm long, 0.8-1 cm in diam., red, glabrous; basal scape bracts oblong, the upper ones sublinear to oblong ovate, acute and apiculate, entire, erect, distinctly exceeding the internodes, completely covering the scape, papyraceous, nerved, sparsely and inconspicuously white-lepidote mainly abaxially, 4-9 x 2.5-3.2 cm, red except for the sometimes paler apex; inflorescence simple, densely spicate, oblong to long cylindrical, terete, erect, 7-27x4^1.5 cm, rachis 0.5-0.8 cm in diam., completely covered by the bracts; floral bracts broadly elliptic ovate, apex obtuse to slightly emarginate and inconspicuously apiculate, slightly cucullate, 32-35 x 20-25 mm, the basal 2/3 red, the apical 1/3 light blue, nerved, membranaceous, inconspicuously and sparsely brown lepidote adaxially, convex and cymbi form, densely imbricate at anthesis except for the spreading-recurved apex, ecarinate, distinctly exceeding the sepals, margins entire; flowers 32-35 mm long (including the petals), sessile, densely and polystichously arranged; sepals suboblong, asymmetrical with the lateral membranaceous wing slightly exceeding the midnerve, 13-15 x 7-8 mm, connate at the base for ca. 2.5-3 mm, pale rose toward the apex to whitish, glabrous, ecarinate, apex obtuse, muticous; petals subspatulate, apex subrounded, ca. 29x7 mm, free, white, suberect at anthesis, bearing at the base 2 obovate appendages, ca. 5X2.5 mm, basally adnate to the petals for ca. 2 mm, obtuse-rounded, crenulate; filaments complanate and dilated toward the apex, ca. 21x2 mm, the antepetalous ones adnate to the petals for ca. 16 mm, the antesepalous ones free; anthers sublinear, ca. 6 mm long, base and apex obtuse, dorsifixed slightly below the middle; pollen triporate, subglobose, exine broadly reticulate, muri narrowed, lumina rounded; ovary ca. 6.5 mm long, ca. 6 mm in diam. at the apex, greenish-white, glabrous, laterally obtusely if at all carinate; placentation apical; ovules obtuse; epigynous tube crateriform, ca. 2 mm long; stigma broadly ellipsoid to globose, conduplicate spiral, white, blades obtusely and inconspicuously crenulate to nearly entire; fruits and seeds unknown.

According to the available information, this new species is endemic to southern Bahia state and is only found in wet forest, growing in shady localities of primary or advanced secondary forest remnants, at 800-1000 m elevation. Because it is only known from the type locality, which is a montane forest fragment, this taxon needs to be assigned to the conservation category of endangered species.

description: Trees 25 m high, branched. 12 mm diam., light leaves grouped together branchlets, the internodes Leaves palmately compound, 9. Stipules 13-15 mm sericeous abaxially, glabrous apex slightly bifid, with petiole 31-37 cm long, striate longitudinally, not constricted at base Leaflets held horizontally; papery, adaxially glabrous, tently light brown-sericeous, ish. Median leaflet: petiolule terete, slightly striate on adaxial surface, not and base when dry; blade ca. 15x7.5 cm, elliptic, symmetric, base obtuse, margin entire, smooth to slightly revolute, apex caudate. Basal leaflets: petiolules 4-5 cm long, blades ca. 16 x 7 cm, otherwise similar to median one. Venation brochidodromous; main vein prominent on both surfaces, more distinctly so abaxially; secondary veins ca. 15, impressed on both surfaces; intersecondary veins present, conspicuous, progressively more similar to secondary ones toward apex. Inflorescence terminal, light brown-sericeous; peduncle ca. 1 cm long, rachis ca. 1 cm long; primary branches 3 (of which 2 are terminal), pendent, 29.5-35.5 cm long, sub-equal in length; each with 8-9 secondary branches (of which 2 are terminal), 11.5-14.5 cm long, bracts 2.5-3 mm long; tertiary branches 8-9 (2 terminal), 0.7-2 cm long, bracts ca. 1.5 mm long; ultimate inflorescence units umbels, with 8-10 flowers [2(3) hermaphroditic, others staminate]; floral bracts up to 1 mm long. Bisexual flowers with pedicel 5-8 mm long, staminate ones with pedicel 3.5-4 mm long; calyx light brown-sericeous, cup-shaped; calyx teeth 5, reduced; petals 2.8-3x 1.2-1.5 mm, triangular-ovate, apex acute, slightly cucullate, glabrescent abaxially, glabrous adaxially; disc and styles pubescent; filaments ca. 0.5 mm long; anthers ca. 2.2x 1-1.2 mm, oblong to ovate, apex retuse; styles 2, erect, free. Fruits unknown.

description: Unbranched treelets 1.5-stems 7-9 mm diam., whitish to cream colored-sericeous, the internodes 1-2.5 cm long. Leaves twice (or sometimes thrice) compound, the first division palmate, with 5 first-order units palmately arranged; each of these units then imparipinnately divided, the median unit with 5-9 leaflets and the lateral units with a progressively smaller number of leaflets, the basal-most sometimes simple. Stipules 12-20 mm long, densely whitish or cream colored-sericeous to glabrescent abaxially, glabrous adaxially, apex bifid, with lobes 3-7 mm long, acuminate; petiole 16.5-37 cm long, cylindrical, slightly striate longitudinally, glabrous, distinctly constricted at both base and apex when dry. Leaflets held horizontally; the blade plane, membranous, adaxially glabrous, abaxially glabrescent. Median first-order units: petiolule 10-19 cm long, cylindrical; rachis 11.5-18 cm long, sometimes with proximal pair of leaflets further pinnately compound; terminal leaflet: petiolule 1.5-4.6 cm, blade 6-13x2.5-4.8 cm, obovate, elliptic or ovate, symmetric to strongly asymmetric, base slightly to abruptly attenuate, margin entire, smooth, apex acuminate or long-acuminate to caudate; lateral leaflets: size progressively smaller and with shorter petiolules acropetally, except the basal pair, which is sometimes reduced and sessile. Venation (of terminal leaflet) brochidodromous; main vein prominent on both surfaces, more distincly so abaxially; secondary veins 5-7, slightly prominent on both surfaces; intersecondary veins absent or inconspicuous. Inflorescence terminal, main axis erect, creamsericeous, 1-7 cm long; primary branches 7-10, patent, becoming pendent when fruiting, sprially arranged; 15-26 cm long, sub - equal in length, bracts 2.5 -5mm long; secondary branches absent; ultimate inflorescences units racemes, with 35-45 flowers, the proximal ones staminate, the distal ones hermaphroditic; floral bracts 1- 1.5 mm long. Bisexual flowers with pedicel 1-2(5) mm long; caylx densely cream sericeous, cup shaped, caylx teeth 5, reduced; petals 5, 2.5 -3 x 1.2 -1.5 mm, ovate, apex acute, sericeous abaxially, glabrous adaxially; disc glabrous; filaments 0.3-0.7 mm long; anthers 1.5 -2 x 0.7 -0.8 mm, oblong, apex apiculate; styles 2 erect, free, recurved in fruit. Fruits drupaceous, flattened laterally, transversely elliptic, ca 7x13 mm, glabrescent, persistently sericeous along calyx rim; pedicels 1.2 -3 cm long; pyrenes 2, flattened, transversely semi- elliptic, ca. 8.5-9x 7mm.

description: Stem up to 2 m tall, up to 16 cm in diam. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 3-15(-44), 60-1 80 x 15-50 cm, erect to slightly curved, tomentu- lose when emerging; petiole 15-40 cm long, terete, sparsely to moderately armed with prickles; rachis terete, up to 40-120 cm long, with few prickles along proximal third. Leaf- lets up to 30 pairs, sessile, subcoriaceous, oblong-lanceolate, opposite to subopposite, long acuminate apically, base attenuate, mar- gins serrulate along distal third, subrevolute; articulations yellowish; median leaflets to 36 x 4 cm. Pollen strobili usually 1-3 erect, cylindrical, up to 27.5 cm long, up to 4 cm in diam, light brown to tan, tomentose, up to 8.5 cm long, up to 1.6 cm in diam; pollen sporangiophore cuneiform, distal face hexagonal truncate, fertile abaxial surface with up to 9 bisporangiate sori per lobe. Ovulate strobili usually solitary, erect, cylindrical, up to 43 cm long, 12 cm in diam, brown to greenish, tomenrulose, apex conical; peduncle densely brown tomentose, up to 5 cm long, up to 2.5 cm in diam, distal face hexagonal- truncate, 2.9 cm high, 4.7 cm wide. Seeds ovoid, sarcotesta red at maturity, up to 3 cm long, up to 2 cm in diam, sclerotesta smooth.

description: Stem hypogeous, non-25 cm long, up to 7.5 usually 1(2), up to 78.2 wide, ascending to descending; 47 cm long, subterete, prickles; rachis subterete, long, with few prickles third. Leaflets 29-31 ceous to sub-coriaceous, linear-lanceolate, opposite to subopposite, imbricate, apex acuminate, base attenuate, margins dentate to rarely entire along distal third, up to 0.3 cm, subrevolute; articulations brown in young leaflets, 0.3-0.5 cm wide; the median leaflets up to 16 cm long, 1 cm wide. Pollen strobili usually solitary, decumbent, cylindrical, up to 2.5 cm long and 1 cm in diam, light brown apex acuminate; peduncle light brown tomentose, up to 15.9 cm long, 0.2 cm in diam; pollen sporangiophores cuneiform, distal face truncate-hexagonal, 0.4 cm long, fertile abaxial surface, with 2-3 bisporangiate synangia per lobe. Ovulate strobili unknown.

description: Stem hypogeous, non-branching, 15.7 cm long, 10.1 cm in diam. Cataphylls persistent, base triangular. Leaves 1-3, ascending to descending up to 210x0.55 cm; petiole 68 cm long, subterete, armed with small prickles; rachis subterete, up to 140 cm long, unarmed. Leaflets 68 pairs sessile, sub-coriaceous, lance- olate, opposite to subopposite, falcate, apex acuminate, base attenuate, margins serrulate along distal third, subrevolute; the median leaflets 16- 31 x 2-3 cm. Pollen strobili usually 2, erect, cylindrical, 11.2 cm long, 2.6 cm in diam brown-reddish tomentulose, apex apiculate; peduncle light-brown tomentose, 16.7 cm long, 1.2 cm in diam; pollen sporangiophores cuneiform, distal face hexagonal truncate, 0.8 cm long, fertile abaxial surface with 2-3 bisporangiate synangia per lobe. Ovulate strobili usually solitary, erect, ellipsoid to cylindrical, 12 cm long, 4.5 cm in diam, brown-yellowish, tomentulose, apex long-acuminate; peduncle densely brown tomentose, 1.5 cm long; megasporangiophores peltate, distal face hexagonal-truncate, 2-2.5 cm high, 1.8-2 cm wide. Seeds ovoid, sarcotesta white when immature, 1.2-1.8 cm long, 0.5-0.7 cm in diam, sclerotesta smooth.

description: Unbranched pachycaul terminal stems subtetragonal, shoots glabrous or ±strigillose. ceolate, 2.2-4.5 cm, ±strigillose outside; terminal leaves with petioles 1-2.5 cm, ±strigillose; leaf blades deeply pinnatifid, drying thinly foliaceous to subchartaceous, obovate in general outline, 35-80 x 25- 50 cm, tapered and decurrent at the base, forming a wing 0.5-1.5 cm wide along  midrib in the basal 10-20 cm, the main lateral veins 8-10 pairs, prominent beneath, the tertiary venation obscure, the adaxial surface glabrous throughout, the papillose, abaxial surface minutely hirtellous or strigose on the veins, the margin strigillose. Inflorescences axillary, congested cymose and conspicuosly bracteate, each bearing 5-50 flowers, the peduncle 5-12 x ca. 3 mm; floral bracts bright red, foliaceous, ovate to lanceolate, 20-35 x 8-20 mm, the apex long-acuminate to caudate; pedicels obscure, to 2 mm long, glabrous or ±strigose. Calyx regularly 5-lobed, foliaceous, 23-35 mm long, red, densely short- sericeous to strigose outside at base, gradually more sparsely strigose distally, glabrous or ±short-sericeous within, with colleters clustered in patches around the sinuses, the tube 5-8 mm long, the lobes ±equal, narrowly-lanceolate, 15-28 x 2-3 mm, apex tapering, divergent at anthesis. Corolla hypocrateriform, orange or rose to red, the tube 20-27 x ca. 5 mm, glabrous without at the base, grading to yellowish-tomentose (when dry) in the distal half to two thirds, the lobes 5, oblong-lanceolate, 4-5 x ca. 2 mm, divergent at anthesis. Stamens 5, ca. 10-12 mm long, attached in the lower third of the corolla tube, densely tomentose at the base, otherwise glabrous; anthers ca. 3 mm. Ovary subcylindric or obconic, ca. 3 x 3 mm, tomentose; style 11-16 mm, glabrous; stigma ca. 3 mm. Infructescences with persistent bracts; fruits ±globose to ellipsoid, 1 1-22 x 11-18 mm, ±obtuse at the apex, dark orange or bright red, densely strigose toward apex, crowned by a persistent calyx, the tube ca. 5 mm; seeds 4.3-4.7 mm.

description: Stem hypogeous, rarely branching, globose to cylindrical, to 10 cm or more in diameter. Cataphylls chartaceous, triangular to narrowly triangular, to 8.5 x 3.0 cm, tan-tomentose with brown papyraceous wings. Ptyxis inflexed. Leaves 1-2, 1.1-3.4 m long; petioles 0.75-2.4 m long with abruptly swollen base to 4 cm wide, densely covered with stout, some- times branching prickles to 5 mm long; rachis 0.3-1 m long, curved outward, with prickles in lower half, petiole and rachis brown tomentose when emerging, gradually becoming glabrous. Leaflets 8-16 pairs, chartaceous to coriaceous, median ones 2-5.8 cm apart, insertion on rachis 6-10 mm wide, lanceolate to oblanceolate and straight to slightly falcate, alternate to subopposite, apex acute to acuminate, margins entire, basal leaflets 28-51 x 2.2-7.2 cm; median leaf- lets 24.5-55 x 4-7.1 cm; apical leaflets 19-34.5x2.1-6.6 cm wide, maroon at emergence, turning to orange or reddish tones, and gradually turning green from the leaflet apex to the base as they mature. EophyIIs with unarmed petioles 19-25 cm long, rachis to 1 cm long, typically carrying four leaflets 6. 1-6.5 x 1.7-2.2 cm. Pollen strobili conical-cylindrical, erect or slightly spreading, 5-15 +, at pollen shedding 7.1-8.1x1.5-1.7 cm, strobilar axis and proximal section of microsporophyll villous with mixed white and rust-brown hairs, peduncles tomentose, emerging white to cream and maturing maroon to brown, 14-25 x 0.8-1 cm, microsporophylls spirally arranged in 8-10 orthostichies of 13-20 sporophylls each, obtrullate, 5.9-6.3 x 3.5-4.3 mm at pollen shedding, sterile apex encompassing 1/4 to 1/2 of total length of a microsporophyll, tomentose, tan to cream colored in proximal half, speckled maroon to brown in distal half, face hexagonal to oblong hexagonal, 2.7-3 x 3.5-4 mm, extruded downward to a narrow horizontal facet, abaxial side of microsporophyll with 15-20 microsporangia limited to the proximal half and along the margins, adaxial side with 12-15 microsporangia limited to the distal half. Ovulate strobili cylindrical, typically solitary but up to 3 per crown, erect at maturity, 8-15.5 x 4-4.5 cm, sterile apex 0.5-4cm and acute to acuminate, strobilus axis villous with mixed rust-brown and white hairs, peduncles 15-50 X 1.2-2.7 cm, emerging white to cream tomentose, progressing maroon to brown tomentose, at maturity appearing green due to loss of tomentum, megasporophylls in 7-10 orthostichies of 5-11 sporophylls each, stalk 8-10 mm long, villous with mixed rust- brown and white hairs, sterile sterile apex 19-20 mm deep with hexagonal to oblong-hexagonal distal face 12.5-13.2 x 15.5-16.2 mm, extruded to a small, depressed terminal facet 2.5-3.4 x 5.7-6.3 mm, megasporophyll face tomentose, burnt amber in new strobili, rust colored when near receptivity, at maturity black with some exposed areas glabrous green. Seeds ovoid, 10-15.6 mm x 9. 5-13.2 mm, sarcotesta red and fleshy, eventually becoming evenly papyraceous at maturity.

description: Perennial herbs, 55-85 cm tall. Stem 1- 2 cm long. description: Plants herbaceous, lithophytic, short caulescent, ca. 1 m high when flowering; leaves ca. 40, erect to spreading; leaf sheaths elliptic to oblong, 13-16 x 6.5-10 cm, densely brown lepidote on both surfaces, dark brown becoming pale castaneous toward the apex, margins membranaceous and involute in dried material; description: Terrestrial herbs. Stem erect, 78-97 cm long, including the inflorescence, 2-3.5 mm wide. description: Planta epifita, aproximadamente 85-115 cm de altura, acaule. Hojas 14-20, formando una roseta amplia, 80 117.5 cm de largo, todas similares; vaina conspicua, eliptica, 20.5 - 28 x 9.5 - 10 cm, coriacea, ambas superficies concoloras, palidas, con indumento lepidoto, blanco o marronm la margen entera o con pocos dientes hacia el ápice, marrón oscuro, 1-2x1 mm, separados entre sí 2-4 mm; lámina lingüiforme, 59.5-92.5 cm de largo, 3.5- 5.3 cm de ancho hacia la base, 3.4-5.8 cm hacia el medio y 3.8-6.2 cm hacia el ápice, coriácea, no angostada hacia la base o sólo levemente, ambas superficies verde pálidas, con indumento lepidoto blanco o marrón, la margen recta, aserrada, con dientes homoge- neamente distribuidos, marrón, 1-3-1 mm, separados entre sí 2-16 mm, el ápice agudo y espinoso. Escapo conspicuo, 68-79.5 cm de largo, 3-6 mm de diámetro, verde, con indumento flocoso, marrón, los entrenudos mediales 3.5-6.8 cm de largo, los supe- riores 1 .7 - 4.3 cm de largo. Brácteas del escapo más largas que los entrenudos, las mediales 10.5-15.5x1.5-2.3 cm, las supe- riores 13.5-14.5x2.3-3.3 cm, persistentes a caedizas, planas, lanceoladas, membranosas, rojas, con indumento lepidoto blanco, la margen aserrada, los dientes caedizos distribuidos hacia la parte media y el ápice de la bráctea, orientados en varias direcciones, rojos o fucsia, <1 mmxcl mm, separados entre sí 1-2 mm, el ápice acuminado, recto, espinoso. Inflorescencia erecta, 18-25 cm de largo, 4.5- 5.0 cm de diámetro, 2-dividida, cilíndrica, ca. 30-50 espigas polísticas, distribuidas densa- mente; raquis de la inflorescencia recto, poco visible, 16-23.5 cm de largo, 4-6 mm de diámetro, verde, terete, con indumento fiocoso tomentoso, marrón, los entrenudos 3-10 mm de largo. Brácteas primarias disminuyendo gradualmente de tamaño hacia el ápice de la inflorescencia, congestionadas hacia la base de la inflorescencia, laxas, membranosas; brácteas primarias inferiores 5-12.5 x 1.2- 2.5 cm, lanceoladas, rojas o fucsia, con indumento lepidoto, marrón claro, la margen entera o con pequeños dientes deciduos, homogéneamente distribuidos, orientados en varias direcciones, rojos o fucsia, 0.5-0.8x0.5- 0.8 mm, separados entre sí 0.7-1 mm, el ápice agudo, recto, apiculado; brácteas primarias mediales y superiores 0.3-0.4x0.5 cm, triangulares, verdes, con indumento flocoso tomentoso, marrón, la margen entera, el ápice atenuado, recto. Espigas fasciculadas, 1.5-2.3 cm largo, 1-1.5 cm de diametro, con 6-9 flores distribuidas polisticamente; pedunculo de la espiga 0-4 mm de largo, 2 mm de diametro, verde, poco conspicuo, terete, con indumento flocoso - tomentoso, marron' eje de la espiga 2-3 mm de largo, 1-2 mm de diámetro, verde, flexuoso, cubierto, con indumento flocoso-tomentoso, marrón, los entrenudos 0-2 mm. Brácteas florales muy reducidas, todas similares en tamaño y forma, laxas, persistentes, 2x0.8 mm, triangulares, simétricas, membranosas, verdes, concoloras, con indumento flocoso, marrón, ecarinadas, la margen entera, el ápice atenuado, recto. Sépa los sobrepasando la bráctea floral, casi orbiculares, 5-6x3.5-4 mm, libres, asimétricos, coriáceos, verdes, concoloros, con indumento flocoso, marrón, ecarinados, con 11-12 venas, la margen entera, el ápice oblicuo, con mucrón de 1.3 mm. Pétalos sobrepasando la bráctea floral, espatulados, 18x2 mm, libres, erectos, simétricos, membranosos, blancos, concoloros, glabros, la margen recta, entera, el ápice retuso, apiculado; lígulas epipétalas lingüiformes, 10 x 1 mm, el ápice fimbriado. Androceo incluido; filamentos aplanados, 7.5 mm de largo, 0.5 mm de diámetro; anteras 2.5x1 mm, dorsifìjas e introrsas. Gineceo con ovario cilindrico, 8- 10 mm de largo, mm de diámetro, verde con violeta, con indumento flocoso-tomentoso; estilo rollizo, 8 mm de largo, 0.5 mm de diámetro; estigma conduplicado-espiralado, lxl mm. Fruto no visto.

description: Planta epífita, aproximadamente 110- 130 cm de altura, acaule. Hojas formando una roseta tubular erecta hacia la base, 46-89 cm de largo, todas similares; vaina conspicua, linguiforme a elíptica, 22-29x5-11.5 cm, coriácea, ambas superficies concoloras, aunque un poco más oscuras hacia el ápice de la haz, con indumento lepidoto, marrón, la margen membranosa, con pocos dientes de color marrón hacia el ápice, 1-2 x 1 mm, separados entre sí 5-10 mm; lámina lingüiforme, 24-66 cm de largo, 4.5-6.5 cm de ancho hacia la base, 4.5-5.5 cm hacia el medio, 4-4.5 cm hacia el ápice, coriácea, plana, no angostada hacia la base, ambas superficies verdes, con escaso indumento lepidoto, marrón en seco, la margen recta, aserrada, con dientes de color marrón homogéneamente distribuidos, 0.5-2x0.5- 1 mm, separados entre sí 4-15 mm, el ápice agudo, espinoso. Escapo parcialmente oculto por las hojas, 54-61 cm de largo, 10-13 mm de diámetro, con indumento flocoso, marrón, los entrenudos 5-6 cm hacia la parte media, 3.5-4 cm hacia el ápice. Brácteas del escapo más largas que los entrenudos, las mediales 8-11.5x3-3.5 cm, las superiores 11-12.5 x 3.5-4 cm, persistentes, no congestionadas en la base de la inflorescencia, aparentemente divaricadas, planas, ovado-lanceoladas, membranosas, con indumento Mocoso-tomentoso, blanco, la margen aserrada, con dientes distribuidos solo hacia la parte media y el apice de la bráctea, orientados en varias direcciones, rosa- dos, 0.5-2 X 1 mm, separados entre sí 2-10 mm, el ápice acuminado a agudo, recto, espinoso. Inflorescencia erecta, 40-55 cm de largo, 20-29.5 cm de diámetro, 2-dividida, cónica, coni ca. 26-33 espigas polísticas, distribuidas laxamente; raquis de la inflorescencia recto, descubierto, 38.5-52.5 cm de largo, 6-9 mm de diámetro, terete, con indumento flocoso, blanco o} marrón, los entrenudos 1-3 cm de largo. Shácteas primarias disminuyendo gradual- mente de tamaño hacia el ápice de la inflo- rescencia, congestionadas hacia la base de la inflorescencia, no imbricadas, divaricadas, lan- ceoladas a elípticas, las inferiores 10-12.5 x 2.8-3.7 cm, las mediales y superiores 3-9 x 0.5-2 cm, membranosas, con indumento flocoso-tomentoso, Щшюед, la margen recta, aserrada, con dientes distribuidos sólo hacia la parte media y el ápice: cite feibráctea, orientados en varias direcciones, rosadös, 1-2 mmx 1 mm, separados entre sí 1-9 mm, la base cuneada, el ápice atenuado a agudo, reato. Brácteas florales conspicuas, disminuyendo de tamaño gradualmente hacia el ápice de la espiga, laxas, ascendentes con respecto al eje de la espiga, cuculadas, persistentes, 1 5- 1 8 x 6-9 mm, anchamente elípticas, simétricas, coriáceas, marrón pálidas en seco, concoloras, con indu- mento flocoso hacia la base, carinadas, la margen entera, el ápice obtuso, recto, con mucrón de 0.3-0.33 mm. Sépalos iguales o sobrepasando la bráctea floral, lanceolados, 11-12x5 mm, libres, asimétricos, membrano- sos, glabros, carinados, con 17-19 venas, la margen recta, entera, el ápice oblicuo, con mucrón de 0.5 mm. Pétalos sobrepasando la bráctea floral, ligulados, 17-18x4 mm, libres, erectos, simétricos, membranosos, amarillos, concoloros, glabros, la margen recta, entera, el ápice agudo; lígulas epipétalas lingüiformes, lxl mm, el ápice fimbriado. Gineceo con ovario cónico a cilindrico, 3.5 mm de largo, 3 mm de diámetro, glabro; estilo 16 mm de largo, 0.5 mm de diámetro; estigma conduplicado- espiral, 1 x0.5 mm. Fruto no visto.

description: Planta epífita, aproximadamente 40-60 cm de altura, acaule. Hojas formando una roseta amplia, 75-137 cm de largo; vaina conspicua, elíptica, 11-12x5.7-8.5 cm, coriácea, blanquecina, con indumento lepidoto sobre ambas superficies; lámina lingüiforme, 64-125 cm de largo, 4.6-6.5 cm de ancho hacia el medio, coriácea, canaliculada, no angostada hacia la base, ambas superficies verdes, concoloras aunque levemente más claras hacia la canalicula, con indumento lepidoto únicamente en la superficie abaxial, la margen recta, aserrada, con dientes homogéneamente distribuidos, verdes, 0.5-2 mm, el ápice obtuso, espinoso. Escapo oculto por las brácteas del escapo, 26-29 cm de largo, 6-9 mm de diámetro,  blanquecino, glabro, los entrenudos 18- 20 mm de largo hacia la parte media, 2-8 mm de largo hacia el apice. Bracteas del escapo mas largas que los entrenudos, las mediales 8.5 - 10 x 2.8 - 3 cm, las superiores 8-9 x 2.4 - 2. 5 cm, persistentes, erectas, planas, lanceoladas a elipticas, coriaceas, verdes, con indumento lepidoto sobre ambas superficies, la margen aserrada, el apice agudo a acuminado, espinoso. Inflorescencia erecta o levemente inclinada, 7.5- 15 cm de largo, 6.5-7.5 cm de diámetro, simple, capitado-estrobiliforme, portando más de 50 flores sésiles y distribuidas polísticamente; eje de la inflorescencia recto, comple- tamente cubierto por las brácteas florales, no excavado, 6-12 cm de largo, 5 mm de diámetro, terete. Brácteas florales conspicuas, disminuyendo de tamaño gradualmente hacia el ápice de la inflorescencia, imbricadas, erectas a adpresas con respecto al eje de la inflorescencia, persistentes, 35-65 x 18-32 mm, las basales ovado-lanceoladas hasta ovadas en las apicales, simétricas, coriáceas, verdes, concoloras, con indumento lepidoto sobre ambas superficies, ecarinadas, la margen aserrada, el ápice agudo-acuminado, recto, espinoso. Sépa- los incluidos, lanceolados, 25-30x5-10 mm, libres, ligeramente asimétricos, coriáceos, concoloros, glabros, carinados, con 7-18 venas, la margen recta, entera, membranosa, traslúcida, el ápice agudo, mucronulado. Pétalos aparentemente igualando la bráctea floral, lingüiformes, 50-52 x 4-5 mm, libres, aparentemente erectos, simétricos, membranosos, blancos, concoloros, glabros; lígulas epipétalas no vistas. Androceo incluido, los estambres del ciclo interno completamente adnatos a los pétalos; filamentos aplanados, 22-23 mm de largo; anteras 6-7 mm de largo, dorsifijas e introrsas. Gineceo con ovario subgloboso, 8-9 mm de largo, 5-6 mm de diámetro, blanco, glabro, con alas membrano- sas que se continúan con la carina del sépalo; tubo epigíneo 2 mm de largo; estilo 32 mm de largo; estigma conduplicado-espiral, 2-3 mm de largo. Fruto no visto.

description: Planta epifita, aproximadamente 2 m de altura, acaule, estolonifera. Hojas aproximadamente 10-15, formando una roseta amplia, 105-170 cm de largo, todas similares; vaina conspicua, obovada, 22-30 x 13-16 cm, coriacea, ambas superficies negras a castano oscuras, con indumento lepidoto, marronm la margen entera; lamina linguiforme, 83- 140 cm de largo, 5.5 12 cm de ancho hacia la base, 5-6.5 cm hacia el medio, 3-4.5 cm hacia el ápice, coriácea, plana, no angostada hacia la base, ambas superficies verdes, glabras, la margen recta, aserrada, con dientes homogé neamente distribuidos, 2-10 mm de largo, 1-5 mm de ancho hacia la base, separados entre sí (5) 1 0-25 mm, aunque algunos sectores de la margen presentando 1-5 dientes reducidos entre dos dientes mayores, marrones o negros, rectos o antrorsos, el ápice agudo, recto, espinoso. Escapo conspicuo, 70-80 cm de largo, 9-14 mm de diámetro. Brácteas del escapo caedizas, no observadas. Inflorescencia erecta, 65-75 cm de largo, ca. 50 cm de diámetro, 3 -dividida, piramidal, ca. 47 primeras ramificaciones, las basales 2- divididas, con más de 30 espigas, las apicales 1 -divididas, 25-33 cm de largo, polísticas, laxas; raquis de la inflorescencia recto, descubierto, 67 cm de largo, 7-10 mm de diámetro, fucsia, terete, con indumento flocoso, marrón, los entrenudos 3 - 4.5 cm de largo. Brácteas primarias disminuyendo abruptamente de tamaño hacia el ápice de la inflorescencia, las basales no vistas, las apicales laxas, divaricadas con respecto al raquis, lineares, 3-4 x 0.5 mm, membranosas, la margen recta, entera, la base truncada, el ápice atenuado, recto. Espigas 1.5-2.3 x 0.8-1.2 cm, con 3-6 brácteas basales con flores sésiles, 3-4 apicales sin flores, distribuidas polísticamente; pedúnculo de la espiga 2-5 mm de largo, 1-2 mm de diámetro, fucsia, descubierto, terete, con indumento flocoso, marrón; eje de la espiga 0.7-1.2 cm de largo, 1-2 mm de diámetro, fucsia, recto, descubierto, terete, con indumento flocoso, marrón, los entrenudos 2-4 mm de largo. Brácteas florales conspicuas, disminuyendo de tamaño gradualmente hacia el ápice de la espiga, laxas, adpreso-ascendentes con respecto al eje de la espiga, amplexifloras, persistentes, 5-6x10-11 mm, reniformes, simétricas, coriáceas, marrón pálidas en seco, concoloras, con indumento flocoso, marrón, la margen entera, carinadas distalmente, el ápice truncado, con mucrón de 3 mm de largo. Sépalos sobrepasando la bráctea floral, orbiculares a levemente obovados, 5-6x4-5 mm, connatos 0.5-1 mm hacia la base, asimétricos, coriáceos, rosados, concoloros, glabros, ecarinados, con 14-16 venas, la margen recta, entera, el ápice asimétrico, sin mucrón. Pétalos sobrepasando la bráctea floral, espatulados, 10x2-3 mm, libres, erectos, simétricos, membranosos, morados, concoloros, glabros, con 17-18 venas, la margen entera, el ápice obtuso, apiculado; lígulas epipétalas lingüiformes, 1.8 x 0.5-1 mm, originándose 1 mm por encima de la base, el ápice fimbriado. Androceo incluido, con el ciclo interno de estambres adnatos 5 mm por encima de la base de los pétalos; filamentos aplanados, 7-8 mm de largo, 0.31-0.35 mm de diámetro; anteras 2.5 mm de largo, 0.73-0.77 mm de ancho, dorsifijas, introrsas. Gineceo con ovario subcilíndrico, 3 mm de largo y 2 mm de diámetro, glabro; estilo rollizo, 8-9 mm de largo, 0.3-0.35 mm de diámetro; estigma conduplicado-espiralado, lxl mm. Fruto elipsoidal a redondeado, 6 mm de largo y 4 mm de diámetro, rojo con verde hacia la base, glabro. Semilla aplanada, rectangular, 2x1 mm, rugosa, marrón.

description: Planta epífita, aproximadamente 40-50 cm de altura, acaule. Hojas 11 cm de largo; vaina conspicua, oblongo-elíptica, 18x4.5 cm, membranosa, con indumento lepidoto sobre ambas superficies; lamina linguiforme, 55-65 cm de largo, 4 cm de ancho hacia el medio, coriácea, plana, levemente angostada hacia la base, ambas superficies de color verde y con indumento lepidoto disperso por el envés, la margen recta, aserrada, con dientes homogéneamente distribuidos, 0.8-1 mm de largo, verdes, el ápice agudo y espinoso. Escapo conspicuo, 48.5 cm de largo, 5 mm de diámetro, con indumento fiocoso disperso, los entrenudos 47 mm hacia la parte media y 28 mm hacia la apical. Brácteas del escapo más largas que los entrenudos, persistentes, planas, elípticas a oblanceoladas, membranosas, con indumento lepidoto abaxialmente, la margen entera, el ápice agudo y apiculado, las mediales 8.7x1.6 cm y erecto-adpresas, las apicales 8.3x1.8-1.9 cm, difusas a divaricadas. Inflorescencia erecta, 8-12 cm de largo, 6.7 cm de diámetro, 2-dividida, cónica, ca. 10 primeras ramificaciones polisticas y distribuidas laxamente; raquis de la inflorescencia recto, descubierto, 9 cm de largo, 4 mm de diámetro, terete, con indumento flocoso. Brácteas primarias membranosas, no imbricadas, disminuyendo abruptamente de tamaño entre la base y el ápice de la inflorescencia, la margen entera, las brácteas primarias inferiores divaricadas, elíptico-lanceoladas, 6-8x1-1.6 cm, rojas, abaxialmente con indumento lepidoto, el ápice acuminado, recto, apiculado, las brácteas primarias mediales y las superiores ascendentes, filiformes, 5x1 mm, con indumento lepidoto hacia la base, el ápice atenuado. Racimos 3.2-4 cm de largo, 1.5-2 cm de ancho, con 3-4 flores pediceladas y sin rango discernible; pedúnculo del racimo 1-1 .2 cm de largo, 2 mm de diámetro, descubierto, terete, con indumento flocoso; eje del racimo 0.8-1 cm de largo, 2 mm de diámetro, recto, descubierto, terete, glabro o con escaso indumento flocoso. Brácteas florales inconspicuas, laxas, deciduas, ascendentes con respecto al eje del racimo, 3-4 x0.5-1 mm, filiformes, simétricas, membranosas, con escaso indumento flocoso hacia la base, ecarinadas, la margen entera, el ápice atenuado. Pedicelo 4-5 mm de largo, ca. 1 mm de diámetro. Sépalos sobrepasando la bráctea floral, 8-10x5-10 mm, connatos por 3-4 mm, asimétricos, coriáceos, con escaso indumento flocoso, carinados, la margen recta, entera, el ápice oblicuo, con mucrón de 2-3 mm de largo. Petalos no vistos. Fruit globoso, 7-10 mm de largo, 7-9 mm de diametro, verde, con indumento flocoso. Semilla aplanada, rectangular, 3x1 mm, lisa, marron.

description: Shrub or small tree, 3.5-10 m tall, usually with a single trunk, to 20 cm diam.; bark gray, nearly smooth; slash creamy tan; sapwood nearly white; branchlets densely pale stellate-tomentose when young, gradually glabrescent, the lenticels linear, later broader and plane. Leaves lanceolate, slightly falcate, distichous, hanging, 3.5-10 X 1.5-2.5 cm, long-attenuate at the tip, very unequal at the base, the basioscopic side cuneate to attenuate, the acroscopic side attached 2-3 mm lower, rounded to subcordate, strongly 3(-5)-nerved from the base, the lateral pair reaching to about the middle of the blade, adaxially green, the major veins stellate-tomentose, with a few stellae scattered on the surface, otherwise glabrous, abaxially densely and persistently, whitish appressed-tomentulose with minute stellate hairs ca. 0.4 mm wide, the major veins with scattered larger stellate hairs and glabrescent, the margin revolute, crenate, the teeth glandular; glands lacking at apex of petiole or base of blade; petiole 0.5-1.5 mm long, pale stellate-tomentose; stipules linear, 1.1-1.3 mm long, promptly deciduous. Inflorescence a terminal panicle, 4-5 cm long including the short peduncle, this usually < 1 cm long, 5-7 cm wide, the branches horizontally spreading, densely pale stellate-tomentose, the bracts subtending the lower branches narrowly lanceolate, to 5 mm long, deciduous, the bracts subtending the flowers linear, 0.5-1 mm long; flowers numerous, individually inconspicuous; pedicel 1.5-2 mm long; tepals 6(8), densely pale stellate-tomentose on the outside, less densely so within on the lobes, very similar and difficult to differentiate into sepals and petals, especially in flower, united for 0.5-1 mm (the lower 1/3), appearing valvate but the sepals very slightly overlapping the petals at the base; sepals 3(4), narrowly triangular, 1.1-1.2 X 0.5 mm; petals 3(4), ovate or obovate, slightly shorter than the sepals, 0.9-1 X 0.6-0.9 mm, apically rounded; stamens 17-23, exserted, the filaments free, ca. 1.2 mm long; anthers 0.3 mm long; ovary ovoid, 1.5 X 1 mm, glabrous; style 0.5 mm long, persistent in fruit. Fruit a berry, soft, juicy, bright orange, ca. 5 mm diam. when dried; seeds "black" when fresh, chestnut-brown in dried material, plump, angular, 1.1-1.3 mm long, obscurely longitudinally foveolate.

description: Tree, puberulous, hairs minute. Young branches compressed, bisulcate towards the upper nodes; young shoots with ca. 4 pairs of cataphylls at base. Leaves 1.3-6.3x0.9- 3.6 cm, obovate; apex round or barely forming a thick, obtuse acumen, base cuneate, decurrent on petiole, margin slightly recurved or revolute at apex and sometimes base; midvein and sometimes laterals sulcate on upper surface; laterals 6-11, straight, ascending at (55-)60-75° and forming a looped submarginal vein; interlaterals strong, admedial, multi-furcating and disappearing before reaching the midvein; both surfaces with prominulous tertiary reticulation and minute hairs when young, some persisting to maturity; upper surface eglandular, the lower with inconspicuous, darkish glands; petioles 2-5 x 0.8-1 mm, delicate, piano canaliculate, with sparse minute hairs. Flowers solitary, subtended by reduced leaves or at basal leafless nodes; pedicels 7-9 xca. 0.7 mm, puberulous, flattened; bracteoles linear, sometimes persisting to young fruit stage. Floral buds (not seen, deduced from young fruit) open type; calyx lobes 5, shallow, repand, ca. 0.6-0.9 x 2-2.7 mm, rounded or truncate; staminal disk 5 -crenate, ca. 5 mm in diam., with ca. 3 whorls of stamens, obscurely sericeous. Fruit (immature) globose or wide-ellipsoid, ca. 0.8 cm in diam., crowned by the repand, explanate calyx; seed apparently 1, testa crustaceous, embryo not yet fully developed.

description: Arbustos o arboles pequenos de hasta 6 m de alto. Tallos con ramas cilíndricas, ligeramente velloso-pubescentes a glabrescentes cuando están maduras, grises, densamente ferrugineo velloso-pubescentes cuando están inmaduras. Hojas opuestas, desiguales, láminas 5.2-12 x 2.5-6.2 cm, ovadas a ovado-elípticas, cuando secas membranáceas a cartáceas, con pelos septados, más densos en la parte abaxial que en la parte adaxial; base cuneada, obtusa o rara veces redondeada, ápice acuminado, a veces apiculado, los márgenes enteros, ciliolados; nervaduras secundarias 6-9 pares, eucamptódromas a ligeramente broquidódromas, marcadamente pubescentes, más en la parte abaxial que en la parte adaxial, conspicuas; pecíolos desiguales, 1.1-4.7 cm de largo, velloso-pubescentes; estipulas mm de largo, angostamente triangulares, con ápice agudo, en el exterior densamente hirsútulos, no persistentes. Inflorescencias 4-7 cm de largo, con 1-2(-3) flores, axilares, simples o monocasiales, densamente ferrugineo velloso-pubescentes; pedúnculos de 5-13 mm de largo, pedicelos 6-15 x 0.5 mm, brácteas subuladas a triangulares, 0.5 - 1 mm de largo. Flores con el hipanto obcónico, 5-6 mm de largo, 2-2.5 mm de diámetro; limbo calicino con el tubo 1 mm de largo los 4 lóbulos subiguales, linear-subulados, 6-18 mm de largo, densamente vellosos, ciliolados con pelos hasta 1 mm; corola amarilla brillante cuando fresca, hipocrateriforme, en el exterior blanquecino tomentosa, en el interior glabra, 29-44 mm de largo, el tubo de 26-35 mm de largo, 4-6 mm de ancho en la garganta, lóbulos 4, triangular- ovados, patentes, agudos, de 5-6 x 4-5 mm; estivación con 3 lóbulos contortos y 1 lóbulo con sus márgenes cubiertos por los 2 lóbulos contiguos; estambres 4, parcialmente exsertos, con filamentos de 1-2 mm de largo, anteras linear-elípticas, de 6-7 mm de largo, dorsifijas, dehiscencia longitudinal; ovario 2-locular, placentación axilar, óvulos numerosos; estilo de 24-38 mm de largo, estigmas 2.5-4 mm de largo, bífidos, exsertos. Frutos capsulares, oblongos a angostamente obovados, de 10- 13 mm de largo, 3.5- 4.5 mm de diámetro, velloso-pubescentes, dehiscente loculicidamente luego septicidamente, bivalvado. Semillas sub- circulares a elipsoides, angulosas, 0.5-0.6 mm de diámetro, pardas, foveolado-reticuladas.

description: Herba perennis; folia basalia 3-5, alterna, non aggregata, rosalum non formantia plantae per anthesin, cartilaginosa, margine papilloso-denticulata, ad apicem acuta, incrassata, infra scabra. Inflorescentia racemosa, 133-190 cm longa, generaliter inter nodum quintum et octavum ramis 1 vel 2, 6-24 cm longis instructa, 1-11 nodis fertilibus; flores difussi vel divaricati, infundibuli- formes, succulenti, aurei vel rosei.

description: Planta herbacea perenne. Cormo 0.5 -2.5(-3) x 0.9 - 2 cm de diametro, cilindrico, con yemas de crecimiento y raices contractiles engrosadas, de 5-13 cm de largo. Bulbo 3.5 - 5.7 x 1.7 - 2.5 (-4.2) cm de diametro, ovoide, cubierto por las bases de las hojas secas. Hojas 3-5 por roseta, en plantas estériles, alternas, espiraladas, 43-61 x (0.1 7-)0.3-0.7 (-1) cm, lineares, cartilaginosas, ápice agudo, engrosado, margen denticulado o papiloso, haz escabriúsculo, con papilas de menor tamaño que en el envés, irregularmente distribuidas; envés escabroso, con líneas de papilas sobre las nervaduras, éstas promi- nentes. Inflorescencia racemosa, (60-) 100- 190 cm de largo, porción fértil 41-98 cm, (12-) 16-44 nudos florales, generalmente con una a dos ramas de 6-24 cm de largo, entre el quinto y el octavo nudos; primera bráctea estéril 41-57(- 83) cm x 3-7 mm, linear, margen papi- loso a denticulado, ápice agudo, endurecido, base decurrente; primera bráctea floral de 1.4- 13 cm x 2.3-6 mm, linear, dos brácteolas, 0.5- 1 .5 cmx 1-2.5 mm, lineares u ovoides, hialinas, margen liso. Flores pediceladas, pedicelos 0.6- 1.9 cm; geminadas, bilaterales, en antesis difusas a divaricadas, infundibuliformes, ana- ranjadas o rosadas, suculentas, sin olor, tubo periantal 1.4-2 cmx 2-3 mm en la base de los lóbulos, papilosos dorsalmente; lóbulos externos e internos mucho más cortos que el tubo, suculentos, papilosos en ambas caras, subi- guales,l-3 x 1-3 mm, anchamente ovados o transversalmente elípticos, ápice cuculado, obtuso a redondeado, papiloso, margen hialino, erectos, rara vez con el ápice de color verde; estambres inclusos, filamentos filiformes, 5.5- 1 0 mm a partir de su inserción, insertos 5-7 mm por arriba del ápice del ovario, amarillos; anteras 5-8 x 1 mm de ancho, lineares, amari- llas, en antesis rodeando la boca del tubo; estilo 1-1.8 cm, filiforme, amarillo, incluso; estigma trilobado, papiloso; ovario 3-4x2-3 mm, cilín- drico. Fruto capsular lxl.2 cm, globoso, coronado por restos del perianto. Semillas 4-5x2.8-3.8 mm, deltoides, planas, negras, brillantes u opacas.

description: Rhizomes sympodial, pachymorph, short- necked. Culms 2-13 m x 0.5-3.5 cm, clambering with pendent fractiform apices. Internodes 12. 5-3 5 (-40) cm long, hollow, thick-walled, terete, slightly ridged above the bud, finely mottled, glabrescent with white velvet adpressed trichomes below the nodal line. Nodes solitary, the nodal line horizontal, glabrous, sometimes with white velvety trichomes on the scars of the culm leaf sheaths; intranodal area 0.6-1.6x0.9- 2.3 cm, glabrous; supranodal line smooth. Buds broadly elliptic to ovate-lanceolate, 11-18 x 8-11 mm, glabrous, the cataphylls ciliolate towards the apex. Culm leaf sheaths 8-28.5 x 2.8-12 cm, persistent, glabrescent, usually with white velvety trichomes stramineous abaxially, shiny copper-red abaxially, not mottled, the margins glabrous to ciliate; auricles 5-14 x 1.5-4 mm; fimbriae 3-6 mm long; internal ligule membranous ciliolate, 0.4-2 mm; external ligule inconspicuous; blades narrowly triangular, erect to reflexed with age, constricted at the base, not pseudopetiolate, tardily deciduous, 3.5-20 x 1.5-3 cm, adaxially pubescent, abaxially sparsely pilose to pubescent, the apex setose. Branch complement with 1 branch, often rebranching at its lower nodes to form branchlets. Foliage leaves 2-1 8 (-23) per complement; sheaths 7.1-13.3 cm long, usually glabrous, sometimes with sparse white velvety trichomes, keeled; margins glabrous, auricles present; fimbriae present or not, 0.3-1.7 cm long, erect, free, rounded, slightly wavy, stramineous; internal ligule membranous to membranous-ciliolate, 1.5-5 mm long, asymmetrical; external ligule membranous, ciliolate, ca. 0.5 mm long; pseudopetioles 1.4-5 mm long, glabrous to sparsely pubescent on both surfaces; blades lanceolate, 6.2-22.5x0.8- 3.9 cm, glabrous to sparsely pilose on the adaxial surface, sparsely pilose to pubescent, densely papillose abaxially, glaucous with a green stripe along one abaxial margin; the base asymmetrical, rounded; the apex acuminate to setose; margins antrorsely scabrous. Synflorescences 22-72x0.3-1 .1 (-1.6) cm, a spicate panicle; peduncle glabrous; the branches appressed to the main axis. Spikelets 1.5-2.6 (-3.2) x 0.1-0.2 cm, linear, terete, consisting of 2-3 glumes, 2-5 fertile florets and 1 apical rudimentary floret; glume I 2.3-4 mm long, 1- 3 -nerved, glabrous, ciliolate towards the apex, stramineous, awned, the awn 2.0-3.2 mm long; glume II 4.7-5.1 mm long, 5-6 nerved, glabrous, ciliolate towards the apex, stramineous, awned, the awn 3.5 mm; glume III 6.1-7 .0 mm long, 7-8 nerved, papillose, ciliate towards the apex, stramineus, rarely mottled, awned, the awn 3.3-3.8 mm long; fertile lemma 8 mm long, 11 nerved, papillose, mottled, awned, the awn 3.5 mm; palea 9 mm long, 8-nerved, awnless, papillose, not mottled. Lodicules 3, disimilar, lanceolate to oval-lanceolate, the apex ciliate. Stamens 3; anthers 5-5.5 mm long, purple to greenish. Ovary ca. 1.3 mm long, linear to ellipsoid, glabrous; stigmas 2, pale. Caryopsis narrowly elliptic to oblong, ca. 4.8 mm, pale to brownish; hilum linear, as long as the caryopsis; embryo pale to brownish, ca. 1/7 the length of the caryopsis.

description: Shrubs to small trees 1-8 m tall, with monopodial branching. Indumentum dentate lepidote to lepidote, silvery to yellow-orange, covering the branches, stipules, petioles, adaxial leaf surfaces, inflorescences, sepals and sometimes the petals, ovaries, and fruits. Branches cylindrical, striate, slightly exfoliating, yellow-brown to dark brown. Leaves alternate, scattered along the branches; stip- ules 4-8x1-1.2 mm, generally deciduous, narrowly triangular, the adaxial surface lepidote, the abaxial surface densely stellate- lepidote; petioles 0.8-3 cm long, cylindrical, slightly canaliculate proximally, silvery- yellow. Leaf blade oblong-elliptic to oblong, 3.6-12.4 x 1.2-5.6 cm, membranous, the base subcordate to rounded, the apex acuminate or acute, the margin entire and flat, discolorous, the upper surface green to gray-green, glab- rescent, rarely with stellate-porrect trichomes on secondary nerves, the lower surface densely lepidote, the trichomes 41-60 (im diam., with 39-69 lateral rays, silvery-yellow with central cells darker, usually orange; venation brochidodromous, the secondary veins subpatent. Racemes terminal and sub- terminal, lax, 5-22 cm long; bracts 1-3 per flower, 1.5-2x0.5-1 mm, entire or trifid, oval to triangular, the outer surface densely lep- idote, the inner surface stellate-lepidote; staminate buds globose, slightly ribbed; pistillate buds ovoid to subglobose. Staminate flowers with pedicels 4-9 mm long; sepals 5, free, triangular, 2-3.5x2-2.5 mm, lepidote externally, glabrous internally; petals 5, nar- rowly elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 4-4.2-0.8- 1 mm, the outer surface sparsely lepidote, the inner surface densely villous; stamens 10-15, filaments 6-9 mm long, pubescent throughout their length; anthers elliptic; nectary disk of 5 free, ellipsoid, glabrous glands, with horizontal suture at apex. Pistillate flowers sessile or subsessile (pedicels 0-2 mm long); sepals 5, basally connate, the lobes triangular, slightly reduplicate-valvate, 3-4x1.5-2.5 mm gererally not covering the ovary, the outer surface lepidote, the inner surface glabrescent to villous-pubescent in distal portion, reddish- brown in the mid-section; petals generally absent or rudimentary, when present filiform, 1 mm long, villous; nectary disk of 5 free, glabrous, ellipsoid segments, dorsally flattened; ovary globose, 2.8-3mm diam, with lepidote trichomes 32-90µm diam.,  diam., with 58- 96 rays, light yellow to golden; styles multifid, 5 mm long, free, villous at base. Capsule 5-8 x 6-8 mm, globose, terete, yellow-orange-lepidote, the sepals persistent, less than half as long as fruit, leaving fruit exposed; seeds 5 x 3.5-4 mm, obovate, smooth, brown to gray, with small, apical caruncle.
bibliographicCitation: Gomes, A. P. S., et al. 2010. Croton limae (Euphorbiaceae), a new species of section Argyroglossum from northeastern Brazil. Brittonia. 62 (3): 206-209.

description: Medium-sized solitary rosette, 80-190 cm wide by 0.4-1.20 m tall, acaulescent, mono- carpica; leaves gray-green to blue-glaucous green, lanceolate, 10-40 per rosette, 40- 90 cm X 6- 13 cm, widest about one-quarter from the base, generally not canaliculate (guttered), smooth to scaberulose on the adaxial side and scabridulous to rough on the abaxial side, bearing prominent leaf- margin impressions on both surfaces and occasional darker cross-banding, length: width, 4.0-7.7; margin with a 1-2 mm wide purple, aging to white, band, without undulations (teats); spines easily detached, purple-black turning to white with age, 0.5- 0.7 mm long, spaced on average 15 mm along the leaf edge and randomly flexed; leaf apex a terminal spine, 5-6 cm long, proximally channeled on the adaxial side, purple-black; panicle 2-4 m tall; peduncle 5 cm in diam. with spirally arranged triangular bracts 12-13.5x4.5-6 cm, not banded or variably cross-banded in blue- purple stripes; lateral branches 5-10, in the distal 50-70 cm of the panicle, above the densely bracteate zone, 20-30 cm long, ± capitate, subtended by ± triangular, purple Bracts, 50-65 mm wide, bracts spaced 3- 6 cm along the peduncle; flowers crowded, pedicels 5-20 mm long, bracteolate; perianth yellow-green to yellow, ± erect, 3.75-5.6 cm long; tepals 18-24x5-9.5 mm, inner and outer tepals subequal, ascending, lanceolate, apex with tufted hairs and beak, inner keeled, outer smooth, both gibbous, tip occasionally red; filaments slender, 2.9- 4.1 cm long, subequally inserted, decurrent on perianth tube; anther attachment centric or acentric, anthers 16-20.5 mm prior to dehiscing, 11-12 afterwards, yellow; pollen yellow; ovary 15-29x3-6.5 mm, light glossy green, interior fusiform; ovary neck 3- 6x2.5-6 mm, scarcely constricted, sulcate; tube 2-5.5 7-9 mm, crateriform, glabrous; style 15-49 mm, elongating after anthesis, stigma bulbous, rugose, cream-colored, vaguely 3-lobed; capsules beaked, smooth, brown when dry, oblong, 3.6-4.5 cm long, thick-walled, stipitate, up to 60 per branch; seeds black and shiny, 5-8 mm long, com- pressed, one side flat, one side convex, ±luneate, with a canaliculate, bilateral flange, hilum notch wide, testa rugulate, pustulate, and scarcely puncticulate.

description: Sufiútice erecto de 15-20 cm alto. Tallos tetrágonos, algo crasos, los entrenudos de 4- 9 cm largo, con pelos adpresos antrorsos sobre las caras, los ángulos glabros. Hojas 15-50x 10-30 mm, elípticas a elíptico-lanceoladas, la base atenuada, con pseudopecíolo nulo o de 2- 3 mm largo, glabrescente, discoloras, el haz verde opaco, el envés blanquecino, crasas cuando frescas, subcoriáceas a papiráceas cuando secas, con 2-4 pares de nervios laterales inconspicuos, los braquiblastos con 2-3 pares de hojas, de menor tamano que las del nudo correspondiente. Vaina estipular puberula, triangular, con 3-5 lacinias de 1.5 - 3 mm largo, algo crasas, rojizas, con apices gladulares. Inflorescencias en glomerulos multifloros, con 2 bracteas involucrales foliaceas. Flores con hipanto piloso en el tercio superior. Caliz 4- lobado, los lobulos desiguales, 2 mayores de 2.5 - 3mm largo, 2 menores de 1.5 - 2mm largo, verdosos, lilas hasta rojizos, angostamente ovados, los ápices obtusos, los bordes ciliados; coléteres intercalares rojizos. Corola infundibu- liforme, 6-7 mm largo, 4-lobada, los lóbulos internamente papilosos, blancos o rosados, el tubo coralino externamente glabro, internamente con anillo de pelos moniliformes en la mitad inferior. Estambres 4, exertos; filamentos 1.7-2 mm largo; anteras 1 mm largo; granos de polen pequeños (P=24.23 цт, E=26.15 цт), esferoidales, 10-11-colporados, loxocolpados, ECA cortos, de 7.1-7.3 'im (ECA/P=0.30- 0.29). ENA 3/4 la longitud de ECA; exina  tectado - perforada, uniformente espinulada. Estilo exerto de 7-7.5 mm largo; estigma bifido papilosos; disco nectarifero 2- partido. Fruto maduro no visto.

description: Borreriae santacrucianae et В. wunschmannii affinis sed difřert ab В. santacruciana imprimis foliis 20-45x1-15 (non 7-17x1-4) mm longis, venis secundariis inconspicuis (non 3-5 venis secundariis conspicuis), laciniis stipulae 3-7 (non 1-1.2) mm longis, bracteolis 3.8-4.2 mm longis, manifestis (non 0.5-1 mm longis, inconspicuis), lobis calycis 2.5-4.2 (non 1.2-1.8) mm longis, corolla 5-5.5 (non 3-3.2) mm longa, stylo 6.5-7 (non 3-4) mm longo; difřert ab В. wunschmannii vagina stipulae glabra vel glabrescenti (non pubescenti), bracteis involucralibus 2-3 (-4) ( non 5-8), glomerulo florali 5-6 (non 10- 18) mm lato, bracteolis glabris (non pilosis), lobis calycis 3.7-4.2 mm glabris sed marginibus ad basin ciliatis (non 2.5-3 mm longis pilosis), grano pollinis 7-8 (non 9-10) pantoporato.

description: Frutex glaber, foliis petiolatis lanceolato-ellipticis vel lanceolato-ovatis, coriaceis, sine domatiis. Stipulae basi connatae mox caducae, tubo 2.0-2.5 mm longo, lobis triangularibus, tubum aequantibus vel leviter eo longioribus, obtuso-mucronatis, infirme denticulatis, cystolithis elongatis albis obsitis. Cymae axillares, pedunculo articulato, internodiis uno vel duobus 2-3 mm longis, vaginis stipularibus apice praeditis, 1-3-florae, floribus subsessilibus terminalibus. Flos masculinus in alabastro ca. 7 mm longus, aliquantum pyriformis; calyx conspicue et irregulariter dentatus; corolla expansa ca. 7 mm longa, campanulata, in dimidio superiore 4 vel 5 ovato- oblongis lobis partita; stamina 4 vel 5, filamentis tenuibus, antheris 4 mm longis, exsertis, oblongo-mucronatis, purpurascentibus vel luteis. Calyx femineus conspicue et inaequaliter 4 vel 5 dentatus; corolla tubo 2 mm longo, nonnihil sursum ampliato, lobis 4 vel 5, linearibus valde recurvis, leviter quam tubo brevioribus; duo stigmata linearia valde exserta carnosa, denso-pulverulenta. Fructus in sicco late pyriformis, 7-8 mm longus, 5-6 mm latus; pyrenae duae, valde plano-convexae, endocarpio tenuiore ad externum latus convexum.

description: Tree to 10 m high; twigs glabrous, herbaceous and drying black at the very apex, but almost immediately becoming woody, with a pale brown to grey-brown bark, slightly ribbed in sicco. Stipules marcescent, triangular, acute at the apex, 3-5x3.5-5 mm, glabrous except for minutely ciliate margins (only visible under high magnification). Petioles 5-15 mm long, grooved, glabrous. Leaf blades dull dark green in vivo, dark olive green and shiny in sicco, elliptic to somewhat obovate, 9.5-21x3.5-7.5 cm, coriaceous, glabrous; apex abruptly acuminate, 7-14 mm long; base cuneate; midvein medium green in vivo, impressed above and prominent below in sicco; secondary veins 6-8 pairs, brochidodromous and arching far away from margin, impressed above and prominent below in sicco; intersecondary veins forming a wide reticulate network; domatia absent. Inflorescences axillary, paired at the nodes, congested, sessile, few-flowered (6-7 flowers). Flowers sessile, 5-merous, possi- bly heterostylous, but only one form known with style overtopping the anthers. Calyx cupular; tube ca. 1.5 mm high, glabrous; lobes rounded, unequal in width, 0.5-1 mm long, 0.6-1.6 mm wide, with minutely ciliate margin. Corolla yellow in vivo; tube slightly funnel-shaped, 2.7-3.5 mm long, glabrous outside, densely pubescent in the upper 2/3 inside; lobes with valvate aesti- vation, oblong, 4.5-5x0.9-1.2 mm, gla- brous. Stamens white, attached near the top of the corolla tube, exserted for ca. 3 mm; anthers inframedifixed, narrowly elliptic, ca. 2 mm long, glabrous. Ovary 2- locular, obconic, glabrous, 1 ovule in each locule; style exserted, glabrous, 7-8 mm long, with two stigmatic lobes to 1.5 mm long; nectary disk white, well developed. Drupes yellow and ellipsoid to ovoid in vivo, somewhat flattened and ribbed in sicco, 13-23x9-15 mm, glabrous; endocarp consisting of a solitary 2-locular pyrene. Pyrenes elliptic, flattened, ribbed, with a split at the tip and fibrous at base; seeds cylindrical.

description: Arboles de 3-12 m de alto. Ramillas robustas de 3.8-5.2 mm de diámetro, ligeramente sulca- das, hirsutas y vilosas, totalmente cubiertas con un denso indumento pardo rojizo hirsuto y abundantes tricomas aciculares solitarios en pares que sobresalen del tomento hirsuto dando una apariencia vilosa y que se concentran hacia los nudos y ápice de las ramillas. Pecíolos de (0.8- )1 - 1 .5(- 1 .8) cm de largo y 2 mm de diámetro, cubiertos con tricomas iguales a los de las ramillas, los tricomas aciculares algo adpresos y concentrados hacia la base de los pecíolos; láminas coriáceas, obovadas, oblan- ceoladas a elíptico-obovadas de (9.5-)10-14.5 (-15) X (2.7-)3-5 cm, ápice redondeado a obtuso, ocasionalmente acuminado, mucronado o no, base cuneada, no doblada, margen entero, rara vez aserrado-aristado, en ocasiones con tricomas unicelulares erectos laxamente distrib- uidos en el borde, venas secundarias de 9-15 a cada lado de la vena media, ascendentes en ángulo cercano a 45°, generalmente rectas o ligeramente curvas; superficie del haz opaca, con abundantes tricomas estrellados laxamente distribuidos y escasos tricomas unicelulares o fasciculados entre ellos, venas primaria y secun- darias pilosas hacia la base y glabrescentes hacia la parte apical, con tricomas aciculares adpresos, venas y venillas impresas; superficie del envés con abundantes tricomas fasciculados sésiles de 2-4 radios, color ámbar, concentrados sobre las venas primaria y secundarias que además llevan tricomas aciculares largos, rojizos y adpresos; venillas con tricomas fasciculados más peque- ños que los de las venas primarias y secundarias, que permiten ver los tricomas estrellados de 8- 12 radios, blanquecinos y adpresos que cubren totalmente la epidermis. Inflorescencias de 4-7 racimos fasciculados de (5.5-)6.5-13.5(-14) cm de largo, raquis de 2 mm de diámetro, ligeramente sulcado, tomentoso, cubierto con el mismo tipo de tricomas que las ramillas hacia la base y solo tricomas blanquecinos adpresos hacia el apice; bracteas en la base de las inflorescencias lanceoladas, de 7-10 x 102 mm, densamente sericeo -ferrugines. Flores con pedicelos de 4- 5mm de largo y 0.7 mm de diametro, ligeramente acrescentes en el fruto hasta de 6 mm de largo; bracteas lanceoladas de 3.5 - 4 x 0.8 mm, sericeo- ferrugineas, tardiamente caducas; sepalos ovados a anchamente ovados, obtusos, apiculados o no, de 2.4 - 2.8 x 1.8-2 mm, pilosos con el margen ciliado, pétalos oblanceolados a obovados, de 4.4-5 x 2.5-3.2 mm, ápice redondeado, truncado o emarginado, margen fimbriado, con 2-5 trico- mas unicelulares adpresos a cada lado y hacia la base de la superficie interna; filamentos de 1.8- 2.2 mm de largo, anteras sagitadas de 0.8- 1.1 mm de largo, carentes de cualquier apéndice; ovario sericeo de ca. 1.8 mm de diámetro y ca. 1.5 mm de alto, estilo de 1 .9 mm de largo. Frutos capsulares ligeramente oblados, de 2 mm de alto y ca. 4 mm de ancho. Semillas de 0.7-1 mm de largo.

description: Crotoni culiacanensi affinis, sed apice stipulac brevi, foliis trichomatibus simplicibus porrectim stellato-stipitatis praeditis, sepalis ad marginem revolutis in superficie adaxiali tomentosis, fructibus seminibusque majoribus differt Arbusto de 1-1.5 m de alto, tomentoso, con tricomas estrellados-estipitados; hojas con peciolo de 0.8-2.3 cm; estipulas 0.3-1 x 0.4-0.7 cm, base foliacea, reniforme, lineares hacia el apice, con frecuencia caducas; lamina membranacea, (3.5-)6.2-10.5 x(1.6-)5.4-7 cm, ovada u ovado-oblonga, apice corto acuminado, margen entero, base redonda o subcordada, haz pubescente, con tricomas simples y estrellado-estipitados, porrectos, enves blanco-tomentoso, con tricomas estrellado-estipitados, porrectos, palmatiner-vada, con 5-7 venas a la base; inflorescencias terminales, 9-13 cm, cimulas unisexuales, las pistiladas en nudos proximales, las esta-minadas en nudos distales, bracteas unifloras, lineares a linear-lanceoladas, tomentosas, 2 mm, las femeninas con frecuencia caducas; flores estaminadas (en boton), pedicelo de 1 mm, sepalos tomentosos en la cara adaxial, glabros en la cara abaxial; petalos tomentosos en ambas caras; estambres 15-16, filamentos pubescentes; flores pistiladas con pedicelos de 2-3 mm, c&liz con s6palos reduplicado-valvados, lobos unidos aproximadamente un tercio de la base, 5-6 mm, lobos ovado-oblongos, con una vena prominente en la cara abaxial, ambas caras blanco-tomentosas, margen entero, revoluto, apice agudo; ovario hispido-tomentoso, estilos bifurcados tres veces, pelosos; fruto 6x6 mm, semiesferico, fuertemente lobulado, con pubescencia de tricomas blancos, estrellado-estipitados, con caliz y estigmas persistentes; semillas 4-5 x 3 mm, elipticas, pardas, con superficie tuber-culada; caruncula triangular.

description: Monoecious erect shrub, 1-2 m tall, branches greenish-ferruginous, trichomes appressed stellate and fasciculate, latex trans- lucent. Leaves alternate, simple, membranaceous, penninerved, blade elliptic, 2-4.8 x 0.9- 2 cm, apex acute, base cuneate, symmetric, margin serrulate, marginal glands absent, adaxial surface greenish-ferruginous, scabrous, abaxial surface strigose, with two types of trichomes (globose, glandular, and sessile; or stipitate and appressed stellate), glands at the base of leaf blades 2, shortly stipitate, rounded; petiole 4-8 mm long, pubescent; stipules entire, linear, 2-3 mm long, deciduous. Inflorescences terminal, bisexual, 1-2 cm long, stellate, staminate flowers distal and continuous with proximal pistillate flowers; bracts linear, margin entire, 3-4 mm long. Staminate flowers yellow- green, 5-6 mm long, congested, one or two staminate flowers per node; pedicel 3-4 mm long; sepals 5, ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 2-3 x 1.5-2.5 mm, adaxial surface glabrous, abaxial surface stellate; petals 5, elliptic, 3-4x1.8- 2.5 mm; stamens 11; receptacle pilose. Pistillate flowers green-ferruginous, 6-7 mm long, congested, sessile; sepals 5, free, unequal, valvate, ovate to narrowly elliptic, 3.5-6 x 2.5-3 mm, margin entire, tips becoming somewhat revolute, adaxial surface glabrous, abaxial surface stellate, nectary disk 5-lobed, glabrous; petals reduced to glandular filaments; ovary globose, 2-3  x 2-3 mm, stellate; styles 3, united at the base, bifid, pubescent on the lower portion. Capsules green-ferruginous, 5-6 x 5-6 mm, stellate; seeds ellipsoid, 4-5 x 3-4 mm, smooth, caranculate.

description: Monoecious shrub to subshrub, erect, 0.71.5 m tall, branches silvery-green, with fasciculate and stellate-lepidote trichomes with a porrect central radius, latex clear. Leaves alternate, simple, membranaceous to papyraceous, penninerved, blade elliptic to ovate, 0.9-2.5 x 0.8-2.0 cm, apex acute, base rounded, symmetric, with 2 sessile, circular glands at the base of the blade on the lower surface, margin crenate to serrulate, adaxial surface scabrous, with fasciculate trichomes, abaxial surface tomentose, cinereous, trichomes stellate-lepidote with a porrect central radius; petiole 2-5 mm long, scabrous; stipules entire, lanceolate, 1-1.5 mm long, deciduous. Inflorescences terminal, bisexual, 2-4.5 cm long, scabrous, trichomes stellate- lepidote, staminate flowers distal and continuous with the proximal pistillate flowers; bracts linear, margin entire, 0.5-1 mm long. Staminate flowers yellowish-green, 3-5 mm long, sparsely spaced along the rachis; pedicel 1.5-2.5 mm long; sepals 5, ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 1.5-2.5 x 1-2 mm, adaxial surface glabrous, abaxial surface scabrous; petals 5, lanceolate, 2-3 x 1-1.5 mm; stamens 11-12; receptacle pilose. Pistillate flowers silvery yellow, sparsely spaced along the base of the rachis; pedicel 1-1.5 mm long; sepals 5, unequal, valvate, connate at the base, oblong to lanceolate, 3-4.5 x 1-2.5 mm, margin entire, adaxial surface pilose, abaxial surface stellate to stellate-lepidote; nectary disk 5-lobed, glabrous, petals absent, ovary globose, 2-3.5 mm diam., stellate-lepidote; styles 3, deeply bifid, pilose at the base and part way up the branches. Capsules 5-6x5-6 mm, ferruginous, incanous to tomentose; seeds ellipsoidal, 4-5 x3-4 mm, smooth, carunculate.

description: Species nova distinctissima habitu arborescenti, foliis tempore florendi ut videtur deciduis, inflorescentiis congestis, floribus parvis (<3 mm), sepalis inaequalibus, petalis valde cucullatis ad apicem fimbriatis. Tree, minutely puberlulent, leaves deciduous when in flower. Old branches with bark pale, peeling and flaking in long wide strips, the nodes somewhat expanded, slightly grooved. Leaves unknown. Inflorescences congested bracteate shoots which continue vegetative growth (precocious racemes) after flowering, terminal or at upper nodes of old, defoliated branches; bracts variable in shape, 1 mm in diam. to 5.5x2 mm, roundish and squamate at proximal end but becoming ovate, lanceolate and finally somewhat expanded towards the distal end, puberulous; pedicels ca. 6 mm, flattened, albopubescent. Flowers pentamerous, sepals free, unequal, 2 deltoid, 2 rounded and 1 truncate in alternate positions, densely sericeous-pubescent internally and externally, 1.75-2x2-2.5 mm; petals 2.5-3x1.25-2 mm, cuculiate, rapidly narrowing into a ca. 1.5 mm long limb, externally striate when dry, glabrous, the apex fimbriate-ciliate; staminal disk somewhat depressed in center, with 2-3 whorls of stamens, these ca. 110, filaments very delicate, anthers 0.3-0.4(-0.5) mm, roundish to oblong, apparently without glands; stigma capitate, ovary 4-5-loculate, ovules 4-7 per locule. Fruit unknown.

description: Monoecious shrub or subshrub, erect, 0.5- 1.5 m tall, foliage yellowish-green, trichomes stipitate, appressed stellate with a porrect central radius, latex clear. Leaves simple, alternate, appearing opposite at the branch tips, papyraceous to chartaceous, penninerved, blade elliptic to orbicular, 1.8-3 x 1.6-3 cm, apex acute to obtuse, base truncate to rounded, symmetric, margin sparsely glandular-denticulate, both surfaces tomentose to velutinous, yellowish-green to cinereous, glands absent at the base of the blades, petiole 3.5-7 mm long, tomentose; stipules fimbriate, glandular, lanceolate, 2-3 mm long, persistent. Inflorescences terminal, bisexual, 1.2 - 4 cm long, tomentose, stellate, staminate and pistillate flowers distributed continuously along the rachis; bracts linear, margin fimbriate-glandular, 2-3 mm long. Staminate flowers yellowish-white, 6.5 - 9 mm long, congested; pedicels 3-4 mm long; sepals 5, ovate-lanceolate, 2.3-4.3 x 2- 3 mm, adaxial surface glabrous, abaxial surface stellate-pubescent; petals 5, spathulate to obdeltoid, 4-5 x 3-4 mm, stamens 11-13, receptacle pilose. Pistillate flowers yellowish, 6-8 mm long, congested, sessile to subsessile; sepals 5, free, equal, valvate, lanceolate, 4-4.5 x 2.5-3 mm, margin glandular, both surfaces stellate, nectary disk 5-lobed, glabrous; petals absent, ovary globose, 3-4 mm diam., tomentose; styles 3, united at the base, 2-fid, pubescent on the connate portion, with appressed stellate trichomes with a porrect central radius. Capsules yellow-green 3-6 x 3-5.5 mm, tomentose; seeds ellipsoid, 4-4.5 x 2-3 mm, smooth, carunculate.

description: Densely (sympodially) branched shrub 1-2 m tall; stems slender, glabrous. Leaves glabrous, chartaceous, narrowly lanceolate, the blades 35-80 X 4-15 mm, narrowly acute at the apex, narrowly attenuate at the base, with scattered glandular punctations on the undersurface, the margins serrulate with dark, sharply ascending glandular teeth, secondary veins 9-14 on either side of the midvein and anastomosing into a prominent submarginal vein; petiole 4-8 mm long; stipules paired, clasping, 3-9 mm long, enveloping the terminal bud, soon deciduous, leaving lateral scars on the sub- apical leaf bases, the scars 1-1.5 mm wide and divided into a series of several dark teeth 0.3-0.4 mm long, these remnants falling off completely farther down the stem. Inflorescences subterminal, axillary spikes 2-4 cm long, laxly flowered. Flowers bisexual or staminate (plants androdioecious?), sessile, the outer bract cupular, ca. 1 mm diam., the inner bract with 2 lateral, keeled projections ca. 1.2 mm long; sepals 4, white, imbricate, basally connate for 0.5 mm, suborbicular, 2 X 1.6 mm; stamens 8, the 4 longer filaments 1 mm long and op- posite the sepals, the 4 shorter ones 0.6 mm long and alternate with the sepals; anthers bilocular, subglobose, 0.3 mm wide; disk lobes 8, spathulate and pilose, 0.3 mm long, alternating with the stamens and connate with them basally; rudimentary ovary superior, 0.2 mm tall. Fruit not seen.
