description: Small treelet, 2-6 m tall; young stems and leaves densely red-papillose, the papillae persistent on the older stems; older stems glabrate, gray, not winged; bark of the trunk gray, smooth. Leaves geminate, elliptic, widest at or just below the middle, the surfaces appearing matte above in live plants, glabrous, minutely reddish-gray-papillose along the veins below; major leaves 20-45 cm long, 14- 21 cm wide, the apex acute, the base attenuate, decurrent on the petiole but not on the stem, with 7-9 pairs of secondary veins, these prominent above and below; petiole 2.5-3 mm long, winged from the decurrent leafbases; minor leaves differing from the major ones only in size, 10-15 cm long, 6-1 1 cm wide; petiole 1-2 cm long. Inflorescences opposite the leaves or sometimes internodal, simple or occasionally furcate, 5-7 mm long, 5-20-flowered, densely reddish-gray-papillose like the young stems and leaves; pedicel scars closely spaced and overlapping, rather corky; pedicels at anthesis white and fleshy, 1.2-1.5 cm long, erect or deflexed, ca 0.75 mm in diam at the base; buds densely red-papillose, ovoid, with the tip of the closed calyx elongate and deflexed over the rest of the bud, appearing hooded, the corolla soon exserted from the calyx, then the bud appearing five-pointed from the secondary hoods of the petals; calyx tube campanulate, ca 3 mm long, the lobes long triangular-deltoid, 3-5 mm long, densely red-papillose, the margins thickened and white in dry specimens; corolla white and fleshy, 2-3 cm in diam, lobed ca 2/3 of the way to the base, the interpetalar sinuses and lobe margins thin and erose, the lobes planar at anthesis, tips of the lobes with 2 hoods, one arising from the petal tip itselfand the other (secondary hood) from a thickened ridge along the entire adaxial surface of the petal; free portion of the filaments 0.5-1 mm long, the filament tube 1-1.5 mm long, visible in the flower; anthers slightly asymmetric in flower, with two held higher than the rest (this character not apparent in dried specimens), ca 5 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, poricidal at the tips, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; ovary densely pinkish-gray-papillose, the papillae tiny in flower, but growing with the fruit; style straight, ca 7 mm long; stigma a broadened area on the tip of the style, minutely papillose. Berries globose, green, ca 3 cm in diam (immature), densely pinkish-gray-papillose; fruiting pedicels woody, deflexed or erect, ca 2 cm long, ca 2 mm in diam at the base; seeds tan, ovoid-reniform, size not measured as these are not mature, the surfaces minutely pitted. Chromosome number: n = 12 (voucher Knapp & Mallet 6266).

description: Shrubs or small trees 2-8 m high, forming flat-topped spreading crowns; trunks to 25 cm in diam., bark gray or brown. Young branches longitudinally angled and grooved, whitish to yellowish granular tomentose, the hairs sessile and short-stalked, echinoid and dendritic-echinoid. Leaves usually thick, ovate to ovate-elliptic, rarely obovate or orbicular, the apices acute, acuminate or short attenuate, the bases rounded, obtuse, or acute, usually 10-25 cm long, 3-15 cm wide, soft velutinoustomentose to finely scabridulous above, the hairs stalked, simple, porrect-stellate and multangulate, whitish tomentose below, the hairs stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate; petioles 1-10 cm long, granular tomentose, the hairs sessile, mostly multangulate and echinoid; axillary leaves absent. Inflorescences 5-16 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 3-12 cm, 1.5-3.5 mm thick, granular tomentose, the hairs mostly sessile or short-stalked, multangulate, echinoid and dendritic-echinoid; pedicels 2-10 mm long, pubescent, the hairs sessile and short-stalked, multangulate, echinoid and dendritic-echinoid. Flower buds turbinoid, 4-6 mm long at anthesis, tomentose, the hairs multangulate, echinoid and dendritic-echinoid; calyx lobe sutures obscured by tomentum. Calyx lobed 1/2 way, the lobes semi-ovate to acute, 2.3-4.3 mm long by 2.1-4.9 mm wide in flower, 2.4-6.2 mm by 2.7-7.3 mm in fruit, tomentose within, the hairs multangulate. Corolla included in calyx until anthesis, white, 11-17 mm across, the lobes within with porrect-stellate or multangulate hairs. Anthers 2.3-3.1 mm long, inserted on corolla tube 1.0-1.8 mm above base, the filaments 1.0-1.5 mm long. Ovary tomentose. Style glabrous or sometimes sparsely stellate. Fruits 9-12 mm in diam., yellow when ripe, the tomentum persistent. Seeds 1.4-2.0 mm long, 1.1-1.6 mm wide. Chromosome number: 2n = 24 (voucher: Roe 91).

description: Frutex gracilis; caules juniores dense pubescentes; caules veteres trichomatibus rigidis ad apicem crispis induti; folia ovata geminata supra glabra vel secus venas sparse, subtus dense pubescentia, apice longe acuminata, basi acuta, marginibus erosa; folia minora orbiculata; inflorescentiae foliis oppositae filiformes simplices ad basin dense pubescentes; pedicelli sub anthesi deflexi; calycis lobi deltati apiculati sparse pubescentes; corolla alba, lobis valde deflexis; bacca globosa viridis, pedicello deflexo.

description: Slender shrubs, 1-1.5 m tall; young stems and leaves densely pubescent with uniseriate trichomes 0.5-0.75 mm long, these becoming stiff and curly-tipped on older stems; larger stems glabrate, the bark reddish-gray. Leaves geminate, narrowly ovate, the blade widest just below the middle, marginally somewhat erose, 6-13 cm long, 3-6 cm wide, with 5 or 6 pairs of secondary veins, these strongly impressed above, prominent and hairy beneath, glabrous or with a few trichomes along the veins and on the lamina above, densely pubescent beneath with uniseriate trichomes 0.5-1 mm long, these denser along the veins, the apex long-acuminate, the base acute; petiole winged from the leaf bases, 6-9 mm long; minor leaves differing from the major ones in shape and size, orbicular, 1.2-2.5 cm long, 1.2-2.5 cm wide, the apex acute, the base rounded; petiole 2-4 mm long. Inflorescences opposite the leaves, slender, simple, 0.8-3.5 cm long, 3-15-flowered, bearing only 1 or 2 open flowers at a time, densely pubescent near the base with uniseriate trichomes like those of the stems, these becoming sparser distally; pedicel scars irregularly spaced 1-1.5 mm apart, beginning ca 1/3 of the way from the base; pedicels at anthesis 1.2-1.5 cm long, tapering from the calyx tube to a slender base ca 0.5 mm in diam; buds globose when young, later elliptic with the exsertion of the corolla; calyx tube broadly conical, ca 1 mm long, the lobes deltate, occasionally apiculate, 0.5-1 mm long, sparsely pubescent with uniseriate trichomes 0.5-0.75 mm long; corolla white, 1-1.3 cm in diam, lobed nearly to the base, the lobes strongly reflexed at anthesis, the tips and margins of the lobes minutely papillose and with a few uniseriate trichomes ca 0.5 mm long; free portion of the filaments 0.5-1 mm long, the filament tube 0.5-1 mm long, slightly pleated in the sinuses; anthers 2-2.5 mm long, ca 1 mm wide, poricidal at the tips, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; ovary glabrous; style straight, 5-6 mm long; stigma clavate, the surface minutely papillose. Berries globose, green, 1-1.2 cm in diam; fruiting pedicels deflexed, slightly woody, ca 2 cm long, ca 0.75 mm in diam at the base; seeds not known. Chromosome number: n = 12 (voucher Knapp & Mallet 6779).

description: Frutex vel arbor parva; caules juniores molliter pubescentes; caules veteres glabrati valde alati clare virides; nodi unifoliati; folia obovata sessilia supra glabra subtus dense molliter pubescentia, trichomatibus 0.1-0.8 mm longis, apice acuta vel acuminata; inflorescentiae foliis oppositae simplices pubescentes; pedicelli sub anthesi deflexi; calycis lobi deltato-triangulares pubescentes; corolla rotata alba plana ad basin lobata; bacca globosa sordide flavovirens, pedicello lignoso deflexo vel erecto; semina fulva ovoidea reniformia, testa foveolata.

description: Shrubs or small trees 1-4 m tall; young stems pubescent with scattered to dense, soft uniseriate trichomes, strongly winged from the decurrent leaf bases; older stems glabrate, often only partially so, remaining strongly winged even on the trunks; bark of the older stems remaining bright green, the wings becoming brittle and breaking off on very old stems. Sympodial units unifoliate. Leaves not geminate, obovate, sessile, widest just above the middle, 10-23 cm long, 3.5-10 cm wide, with 7-10 pairs of secondary veins, these impressed above, prominent beneath, glabrous or sparsely pubescent above on the veins with uniseriate trichomes, the trichomes 0.1-0.7 mm long, densely pubescent beneath with soft uniseriate trichomes 0.1-0.8 mm long, denser on the veins, the trichomes white on living plants, reddish-brown on dry specimens, the apex acute, the base at- tenuate and occasionally somewhat auriculate, winged onto the petiole and ulti- mately onto the stem; petiole consisting only of the winged leaf base. Inflorescences opposite the leaves, simple, 0.2-2 cm long, 10-20-flowered, sparsely to densely pubescent with soft uniseriate trichomes like those of the young stems and leaves; pedicel scars corky and raised, evenly spaced ca 0.2 mm apart; pedicels at anthesis slightly deflexed, 0.9-1 cm long, tapering from the calyx tube to a slender base ca 0.5 mm in diam, pubescent; buds globose, soon becoming ovoid, later long- elliptic, the corolla soon exserted from the calyx lobes; calyx tube 1-2 mm long, strongly ribbed in dry specimens from the lobe vasculature, the lobes deltate to long-acuminate-triangular, 1.5-2 mm long, the entire calyx pubescent with soft uniseriate trichomes like those of the rest of the inflorescence, these denser along the veins of the lobes; corolla white, 1.5-1.7 cm in diam, lobed 7/8 of the way to the base, the lobes planar at anthesis, keeled abaxially, with uniseriate trichomes ca 0.2 mm long along the keel, minutely papillose along the tips and margins of the lobes; free portion of the filaments ca 0.1 mm long, the filament tube ca 0.6 mm long; anthers ca 3.5 mm long, 1 mm wide, poricidal at the tips, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; ovary glabrous; style straight, ca 7 mm long; stigma 2-lobed, minutely papillose, black when dry, green in live plants. Berries globose, green, becoming a dirty greenish-yellow when ripe, ca 1.2 cm in diam; fruiting pedicels woody, erect or deflexed, 1.5-1.8 cm long, ca 1 mm in diam at the base; seeds pale tan, ovoid-reniform, ca 3 mm long, 2 mm wide, the surface minutely pitted. Chromosome number: n = 12 (vouchers Knapp & Mallet 6788, 6799).

description: Slender shrubs 2-3 m high. Young branches terete, pale yellow-brown, rough granular becoming glabrate, the hairs rather thick and moderately long-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate. Leaves thin, obovate-elliptic, 31-46 cm long, 9.5-13 cm wide, dark green, glabrate above, the hairs sparse, bulbous-based, simple except along veins where porrect-stellate and few-rayed multangulate, greenish beneath, the hairs sparse except along veins, rather thick-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate; apices attenuate, bases long attenuate, the blades decurrent along entire length of petiole or nearly so; petioles pubescent, the hairs stalked, porrectstellate and multangulate. Axillary leaves lacking. Inflorescences 19-22 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 11-16 cm, 4-5 mm thick, rough granular, the hairs stalked, mostly porrect-stellate; pedicels 3-6 mm long, pubescent, the hairs stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate. Flower buds globose, 8-9 mm long at anthesis; corolla tomentose, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate; calyx lobe sutures obscured by tomentum. Calyx thick, lobed 1/3-1/2 way to base, the lobes acute or semi-obtuse, 3-4 mm long, 2-4 mm wide in flower, 4-5 mm long and wide in fruit, pubescent within, the hairs bulbous-based, simple and few-rayed multangulate, pubescent without, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate, stalked. Corolla weakly exserted from calyx at anthesis, cream white, 15-19 mm across, the lobes 6-8 mm long, glabrous or with few simple or porrect-stellate hairs within. Anthers 3-4 mm long; filaments 1.4-1.6 mm long. Ovary tomentose, the hairs multangulate and dendritic. Style exserted from stamens, with few multangulate hairs. Fruits ca. 9 mm diam., glabrescent. Mature seeds not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Roe, Keith E. 1972. A revision of Solanum section Brevantherum (Solanaceae). Brittonia. 24: 239-278.

description: Shrubs or small trees 0.5-2 m tall; young stems and leaves sparsely pubescent with simple uniseriate 3-5-celled trichomes 1- 1.5 mm long, some with glandular tips; bark of older stems pale greenish-yellow. Sympodial units difoliate, geminate. Leaves el- liptic, widest at or just below the middle, drying olive-green, glabrous adaxially, pubescent abaxially with dense tufts of uni- seriate trichomes in the vein axils, these spreading to the veins and lamina; major leaves 9.5-15 cm long, 3-6 cm wide, with 6-7 pairs of primary veins drying yellowish abaxially, the apex acuminate, the base attenuate, the petioles 0.6-1 cm long; minor leaves differing from the majors in size only, 1.5-4.5 cm long, 1-2.5 cm wide, the apex acute, the base acute, the petioles 2-5 mm long. Inflorescences opposite the leaves, simple, 0.3-1.5 cm long, 5-7-flowered, the axis sparsely pubescent with simple uniseriate trichomes like those ofthe young stems. Pedicel scars evenly spaced ca 0.5 mm apart. Buds elliptic, strongly exserted from the calyx tube. Pedicels at anthesis filiform, gla- brous, 2-2.2 cm long, erect to slightly deflexed, ca 1.5 mm in diam at the apex, 0.5 mm in diam at the base. Flowers with the calyx tube conical, 1.5-2 mm long, the lobes quadrate with distinct apical projections, 0.5-1 mm long, pubescent with scattered uniseriate trichomes ca 1 mm long and a dense tuft of uniseriate trichomes ca 0.4 mm long on the apical projection; corolla white, 1.5-1.8 cm in diam, lobed nearly to the base, the lobes planar to slightly reflexed at anthesis, the tips and margins papillose; anthers 3.5-4 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, poricidal at the tips, the pores lengthening to slits with age; free portion of the filaments ca 0.1 mm long, the filament tube 0.5-1 mm long, glabrous; ovary glabrous; style straight, 1-1.2 cm long, glabrous; stigma slightly clavate to bilobed, the surface minutely pa- pillose. Fruit a globose, green berry, ca 1.5 cm in diam; fruiting pedicels woody, deflexed, ca 2.5 cm long, ca 3.5 mm in diam at the apex, 1.5 mm in diam at the base. Seeds dark reddish-brown, flattened-reniform with incrassate margins, ca 3 mm long, 2 mm wide, the surfaces minutely pitted. Chromosome number not known.
bibliographicCitation: Knapp, S. J. 1992. Five new species of Solanum section Geminata (Solanaceae) from South America. Brittonia. 44: 61-68.

description: Small trees 2-5 m high. Young branches terete, the pubescence whitish, usually soon glabrescent to nearly glabrous, the sparse hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate. Leaves thick, lanceolate to elliptic, 11-30 cm long, 4.5-9 cm wide, scabrous above, the hairs spaced to touching, rarely overlapping, short, stoutstalked on groups of prominent epidermal cells, simple, porrect-stellate and few-rayed multangulate, yellowish pubescent to nearly glabrous beneath, then yellowish granular punctate, the hairs distantly spaced except along veins, short, thick-stalked, porrect-stellate, the veins prominent; apices narrowly attenuate, bases cuneate to  attenuate, the blades short- or long-decurrent; petioles unwinged for 0.5-1.5 cm, sparingly pubescent or glabrous, the hairs when present thick-stalked, porrectstellate. Axillary leaves lacking. Inflorescences 7.5-23 cm long, peduncles unbranched for 3.5-15 cm, 2-5 mm thick, scabrous, the hairs sessile or short, thick-stalked porrect-stellate; pedicels short especially in bud stage, 2-4 mm long, pubescent, the hairs short-stalked, porrect-stellate. Flower buds globose to obovoid, 5-8 mm long at anthesis, corolla pubescent, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate; calyx lobe sutures not evident, the calyx splitting open early. Calyx relatively thin, somewhat translucent, lobed 1/3-1/2 way to base, the lobes acute, 1.5-3.1 mm long, 1.4-2.1 mm wide in flower, 2.2-4.8 mm by 2.5-3.1 mm in fruit, glabrous  within, stipitate-glandular and sparingly pubescent without, the hairs short to long, thick-stalked, multangulate and dendritic-multangulate. Corolla soon exserted from calyx, strongly so at anthesis, white, violet, or white with purple streaks, 12-14 mm across, the lobes 5-8.5 mm long, glabrous within or with few simple hairs in the upper half. Anthers 2.8-3.9 mm long, filaments 1-2 mm long. Ovary glabrous or porrect-stellate in the upper half. Style glabrous or sparingly pubescent in the lower half, exserted from stamens. Fruits small, 7-8 mm diam., reportedly dull white when ripe, soon glabrescent. Seeds 1.3-1.7 mm long, 1.2-1.4 mm wide.

description: Shrubs or trees 2-12 m high; trunks to 10 cm diam.; bark pale to dark brown. Young branches slightly sulcate, yellowish granular tomentose, the older stems glabrescent, the hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate, echinoid, and dendritic-echinoid. Leaves relatively thin, elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, mostly 10-24 cm long, 2.5-7 cm wide, grayish to dark green, velutinous to scabridulous above, the hairs touching to overlapping, mixed sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid, pale green to gray tomentose beneath, the hairs mixed sessile and stalked, some rather long, thick, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid; apices long attenuate or acuminate, bases obtuse, acute or cuneate or if attenuate then blades decurrent only 1/2 cm or less; petioles 1-2 cm long, granular tomentose, the hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked, mostly multangulate and echinoid. Axillary leaves present or lacking, lanceolate, elliptic or ovate-orbicular. Inflorescences 6-15 cm long (to 22 cm in fruit); peduncles unbranched for 3-13 cm, 2-4 mm thick, granular tomentose, the hairs mixed sessile and short- or longstalked, porrect-stellate, echinoid, and dendritic-echinoid; pedicels 2-4 mm long, pubescent, the hairs mixed sessile and short- or long-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid. Flower buds orbicular, 5-7 mm long at anthesis; corolla tomentose, the hairs often partly long-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate; calyx lobe sutures usually obscured by tomentum. Calyx relatively thick, midveins of lobes often prominent, lobed ca. 1/3 way to base, the lobes acute, 1.3-2.4 mm long, 1.4-2.5 mm wide in flower, 1.9-3.3 mm by 3.0-3.5 mm in fruit, glabrous within, tomentose without, the hairs sessile and short or partly long, rather thickstalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, echinoid, and dendritic-echinoid. Corolla early exserted ca. length of calyx or its lobes at anthesis, pale violet to purple, 12-14 mm across, the lobes 4-5 mm long, glabrous within or with porrect-stellate hairs on upper quarter and along midveins. Anthers 3.0-4.3 mm long; filaments 0.8-1.2 mm long. Ovary tomentose, the hairs appressed, multangulate and echinoid. Style pubescent 1/234 way from base, exserted from stamens. Fruits 10-11 mm diam., yellow to brownish when ripe, appressed tomentose or farinose. Seeds 2.2-2.8 mm long, 1.9-2.3 mm wide.

description: Robust, rhizomatous, glabrate herbs to 1.5 m high; tubers ovoid to ellipsoid or globose, tan or weakly cyanic, 1-5 cm long, minutely verrucose; eyes sparse, obscure; flesh white, starchy, not bitter; stems erect, branched, somewhat fleshy, to 2 cm in diameter at base; internodes winged along their full length from decurrent leaf-bases, the wings foliaceous, thin-textured, 1-4 mm wide, often undulate or crisped and sparsely ciliate along the margins. Leaves simple, sessile, obovate to ovate, 15-30 cm long, obtuse-acuminate at apex, cuneate to rounded and abruptly attenuate at base, entire or weakly denticulate; lateral veins prominent, 5-7 on each side; lamina thin-textured, weakly discolorous, glabrous and green above, lighter and sparsely ciliate along veins below, under-surface sometimes minutely dotted with white crystal-sand cells; each leaf-axil bearing a pair of ovate to lunate pseudostipular leaves 7-15 mm long. Inflorescences initially terminal, becoming lateral and often sub-leaf-opposed, 6-12 cm long in flower, not much larger in fruit, 5-15-flowered; peduncle 4-8 cm long, once-forked, usually bearing a large, simple, sessile, ovate, acute-tipped, leaf-like bract, 10-20 cm long; the bract decurrent on the peduncle, and the lower peduncle winged; pedicels slender, 2.5-4.5 cm long, 0.6-1 mm in diameter, articulate above middle, sometimes sparsely ciliate above, weakly expanded below calyx in fruit. Flowers large and showy; calyx with a small, campanulate tube and broadly ovate, acuminate lobes, externally ciliate or glabrate; corolla white, 4-6 cm across, rotatepentagonal, with broadly deltate lobes and ample interpetalar tissue; acumens minutely pubescent at tip; filaments 1.5-2 mm long; anthers oblong, weakly tapering, 6-9 mm long; style 1-1.3 cm long, glabrous; stigma clavate, weakly bilobed. Berries globose, 1-1.5 cm in diameter, bilocular, many-seeded, abscissing at midpedicel-articulation and falling with upper portion attached.

description: Shrubs or small trees 1-6 m high; trunks to 12 cm in diam., bark gray to pale brown. Young branches longitudinally angled and grooved, granular whitish to yellowish tomentose, the hairs sessile or short stalked, echinoid and dendriticechinoid. Leaves relatively thin, ovate or ovate-elliptic, sometimes obovate, the apices acute to acuminate, the bases short- or long-attenuate, usually 10-34 cm long, 3-14 cm wide; asperulous to finely velutinous above, the hairs rather sparse, touching to distantly spaced, mostly sessile, vestigial, simple, porrect-stellate and multangulate; moderately pubescent to whitish tomentose below, the hairs stalked, mostly porrectstellate and multangulate; petioles finely granular-tomentose, the hairs mostly echinoid, sessile; axillary leaves present or absent. Inflorescences 7-19 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 4-15 cm, 1.5-3.5 mm thick, granular, the hairs sessile or short-stalked, mostly echinoid and dendritic-echinoid; pedicels 3-8 mm long, pubescent, the hairs multangulate and echinoid. Flower buds orbicular, with distinct swollen bases, i.e., receptacles thickened, 4-5 mm long at anthesis, tomentose, the hairs multangulate and echinoid; calyx lobe sutures obscured by tomentum. Calyx lobed about 3/4 way or more, the lobes ovate, 2.2-3.9 mm long by 1.3-2.0 mm wide in flower, 2.6-5.0 mm by 1.1-2.5 mm in fruit, tomentose inside, the hairs porrectstellate and multangulate. Corolla inserted in calyx until anthesis, white, 8-14 mm across, the lobes with occasional simple or stellate hairs within. Anthers 2-3 mm long, inserted on corolla tube 1.0-1.4 mm above base, the filaments 0.9-1.3 mm long. Ovary glabrous or with occasional stellate hairs. Style glabrous or sparsely stellate. Fruits 8-11 mm in diam., yellow when ripe, glabrescent. Seeds 1.5-2.3 mm long, 1.3-1.8 mm wide. Chromosome number: 2n = 24 (voucher: Mick & Roe 326).
bibliographicCitation: Roe, Keith E. 1967. A revision of Solanum sect. Brevantherum (Solanaceae) in North and Central America. Brittonia. 19: 353-373.

description: Suffrutex aliquantum scandens vel procumbens, ad 2 m altus, omnino densissime pilosus, partibus junioribus trichomatibus longis fulvis densissime pubescentibus; caulis lignosus vel incrassato-herbaceus, ad nodos infrequenter radicans; internodia 1-2 cm longa. Folia 4-8 cm longa in foliola 2-5 divisa, plerumque foliolis majoribus tribus foliolisque diminutissimis duobus jugatis, petiolo 0.5-1.0 cm longo; foliola elliptica vel lanceolato-elliptica, basi acuta vel rotundato-truncata, apice acuta vel acuminata paginis ambabus densissime pilosa trichomatibusque glanduliferis obsita; foliolum terminale foliolis jugatis lateralibus distalibus aliquantum grandius, 1.5-4 cm longum, 1-2 cm latum; foliola lateralia 1-3 cm longa, 0.5-2.0 cm lata, brevipetiolulata vel sessilia; folia stipuliformia plerumque minus quam 1 cm longa, elliptica vel aliquantum reniformia. Inflorescentia racemosa pseudoterminalis ac/vel lateralis, floribus 2-8, pedunculo 2-4 cm longo, basi vel juxta basem folio parvo et foliis stipuliformibus prae- dito; pedicelli 0.5-1.0 cm longi, basaliter articulati copiosis trichomatibus brevibus glanduliferis dense piloso-hirsuti. Flores albi. Lobi calycis 4-9 mm longi plerumque atrovirentes, nonnulli purpureo-maculati, trichomatibus patentibus densissime piloso- hirsuti, infra medium in acumen longum constricti. Corolla stellata, rotata, 1.5-2.2 cm diametro, lobis 6-9 mm longis abaxialiter dense strigosis, trichomatibus glanduli- feris paucis deficientibusve, membranis inter petala 1.5-5 mm longis glabris. Antherae luteae ellipticae 3.5-4.5 mm longae glabrae; filamenta fere usque ad antheras con- juncta, 0.5-1.5 mm longa. Stylus 4-6.5 mm longus, glaber vel leviter papillosus; stigma parvum, capitatum. Fructus globosi vel elliptico-ovoidei, virides vittis atro- virentibus ornati 2.5 cm longi, 2 cm lati. Pollen 11.5-13.5 [m diametro. Chromo- somata: n = 12.

description: Herba perennis, rhizomatosa. Lamina folii hispida, integra vel leviter sinuata, inermis, interdum parce spinosa, supra pilis stellatis, subsessilibus, (5)-9-radiatis, radiis 0.1-0.3 mm longis, subtus pilis stellatis, stipitatis, 9-radiatis, radiis 0.4-0.6 mm et stipitibus 0.3-0.4 mm longis. Inflorescentia cimosa, extraaxillaris, generaliter omnibus floribus perfectis, interdum aliquot floribus gynoeciis reductis. Stamina inaequalia. Fructus immaturus calyce ampliato subcoopertus; fructus maturus sphaericus, viridi-griseus, 2.5 cm diam. Semina numerosa, valde compressa, 5-6 mm longa et 2.5 mm lata, subtiliter verrucosa.

description: Perennial herb, with gemmiferous roots. Stems erect, 15-30 cm tall, terete, unarmed or rarely with some yellowish, acicular prickles ca. 3 mm long, stellate-pubescent when young, the hairs stalked, 9-rayed, the rays 0.2-0.5 mm long; sympodial units difoliate or trifoliate. Leaves alternate, hispid; petiole 1-3.5 cm long, stellate-pubescent, unarmed or sometimes with a few prickles; leaf blade commonly unarmed or occasionally with some prickles abaxially on the midvein, ovate, elliptic or long-elliptic, 5-7.5 x 1.5-3 cm, margin entire to obscurely sinuate, with 5-8 pairs of pinnate veins, the apex obtuse or acute, the base truncate or cuneate, upper surface stellate-hairy, the hairs hispid, subsessile to short-stalked, (5)-9-rayed, the 8 lateral rays 0.1-0.3 mm long and the central ray shorter; lower surface covered by stalked hairs, the stalk 0.3-0.4 mm long, the 8 lateral rays 0.4-0.6 mm long and the central one shorter. Inflorescence an extra-axillary monochasial cyme, 2-5-flowered, all flowers long-styled or oc- casionally, some flowers short-styled; pe- duncles 1.5-4 cm; pedicels 1.5-3 cm long, with indument similar to the leaf, unarmed or with a few prickles ca. 2 mm long. Calyx 5-lobed, the tube 3-4 mm long, the lobes 2-6 mm long, ovate, with a prominent mid- vein prolonged into an acumen 1-2 mm long, covered outside by stellate hairs, the hairs with a stalk that is 0.15 mm long, 8 lateral rays, 0.2-0.3 mm long, and a central ray, unarmed or with acicular, glabrous, yel- lowish prickles, 1-3 mm long. Corolla 3.6- 4.2 cm diam., white, stellate, 5-lobed, the lobes elliptic, acute, 14-18 mm long, pu- bescent outside on the plicae, the hairs like those of the calyx. Stamens unequal in short- and long-styled flowers: 2 adaxial stamens with anthers 7-8 mm long, and the 3 abaxial stamens with recurved anthers, 10 mm long; filaments 2.5-3 mm long, glabrous. Gynoecium heteromorphic: 2-3 basal flowers of the inflorescence long-styled, style ca. 12 mm long, ovary 2-locular, stigma minutely 2-lobed, the ovary and basal half of the style with simple glandular hairs and some stellate hairs; 2-3 distal flowers short-styled, style ca. 2 mm long, ovary very reduced, apparently female-sterile. Pedicels deflexed in fruit, furrowed in herbarium specimens, enlarging to 4 mm diam. Immature fruit light green with darker bands, almost completely enclosed by the enlarged calyx. Mature fruit dry, spherical, 1.3-2.5 cm diam., greenish gray. Seeds brown-black, strongly flattened, rimmed, 5- 6 X 2.5 mm, slightly verrucose.

description: Arborescens; rani juniores granulosi-tomentosi, pilis ferrugineis, multangulatis et echinoideis, pro parte longe stipitatis; folia integra, basi truncata vel cuneata; calyces tenues, translucentes; corollae stellatae, exsertae ex calyces ante anthesin, cremeae, 15-16 mm diametro; antherae 3.5-4.3 mm longae; ovaria et styli tomentosi; fructus tuberculati.

description: Small trees 3-4 m high, trunks 1-5 dm diam. Young branches terete to slightly sulcate, granular tomentose, the indument ferrugineous, persistent, the hairs mixed sessile, short and long, thick-stalked, multangulate, and echinoid. Leaves relatively thick, ovate, 10-20 cm long, 3-6 cm wide, dark green, velutinous above, the hairs touching to overlapping, short, stout-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate, pale yellowish green tomentose below, the hairs mixed sessile, short and long-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate; apices acute, bases rounded, obtuse or slightly acute; petioles granular tomentose, the hairs short to long, relatively thick- stalked, multangulate and echinoid. Axillary leaves present or lacking, ovate to lanceolate. Inflorescences 10-14 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 3.5-7 cm, 2.5-4 mm thick, granular tomentose, the hairs mixed sessile, short and long, rather thick-stalked, multangulate and echinoid; pedicels 4-6 mm long (to 11 mm in fruit), pubescent, the hairs mixed sessile, short and rather long, thin-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid. Flower buds orbicular, 6-7 mm long at anthesis; corolla tomentose, the hairs matted at first, later stalked, porrect- stellate and multangulate; calyx lobe sutures obscured by tomentum. Calyx thin, translucent, lobed 1/s_2/3 way to base, the lobes acute, 2.7-3.8 mm long, 1.9-2.4 mm wide in flower, 3.3-4.0 mm by 2.8-3.4 mm in fruit, pubescent within on upper half of lobes, the hairs simple, porrect-stellate and few-rayed multangulate, tomentose without, the hairs mixed sessile, short and partly long, rather thick- stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid. Corolla exserted rather late but strongly so at anthesis, yellowish cream colored, 15-16 mm across, the lobes 6-7 mm long with a few simple and few-rayed multangulate hairs within along midvein. Anthers 3.5-4.3 mm long; filaments 1.0-1.4 mm long. Ovary tomentose, the hairs thick-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate. Style exserted from stamens, pubescent nearly to stigma, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate. Fruits 11-12 mm diam., warty by the prominent hair bases, glabrescent. Seeds large, 3.4-3.6 mm long, 2.8-3.5 mm wide. Chromosome number: 2n = 24 (Iltis & Ugent 636).

description: Shrubs 1.5-2 m tall; stems glabrescent, whitish, armed with small, straight or slightly recurved, and acicular prickles, 0.2-0.5 cm long and enlarged at the base. Stems and young branches terete, viscid, densely ferruginous-tomentose with sessile to short-stalked pauciradiate stellae bearing greatly prolonged 4-6-celled midpoints, these 0.1-0.2 cm long, gland-tipped, strongly armed with ferruginous laterally compressed prickles, these broad-based and sparsely glandular in the basal quarter. Leaves alternate; petioles terete, 1.5-4 cm, ferruginous-tomentose with indument similar to that of the stems, but longer and more compact, sparsely armed with small, acicular prickles; blades chartaceous, 4-12 X 2.5-8 cm, ovate, elliptic-ovate or cordate, entire or repand-angular, acute at the apex, oblique and rounded to cordate at the base, slightly bicolorous, above moderate to densely glandular-tomentose with ferruginous indument, with viscid, simple, glandtipped trichomes of various sizes and stellate, sessile, pauciradiate stellae bearing greatly elongate 4-6-celled midpoints, beneath yellowish velutinous with mostly stalked, radiate stellae bearing greatly elongate 4 (or more) celled midpoints, these simple or glandular, strongly armed on both surfaces with acicular, yellow prickles to 7 mm long on the midrib and secondary veins. Inflorescences lateral and terminal, extra axillary, remote from the leaves, monochasial, scorpioid, unbranched, 5-10-flowered; peduncle terete, 2.5-8 cm long, with indument similar to that of the branches and petiole, unarmed to sparsely armed with small, acicular prickles similar to those of the petiole; pedicels slender and articulate at the base, 1-1.5 cm long, 1-2 mm diam., slightly curved, the indument similar to that of the peduncle. Flowers aparently andromonoecious, the basal two or more with elongate and functional styles exceeding the anthers, the distal flowers with reduced gynoecia. Calyx unarmed, deeply lobed about 3/4 of its length, the tube ca. 3-4 mm, the lobes linear-lanceolate and recurved, dense ly stellate-tomentose, viscid-ferruginous, with hairs similar to those of the pedicels. Corolla violet, stelliform, 2.5-3 cm across, deeply lobed, the tube short, 4-5 mm long, the lobes linear-lanceolate, reflexed at anthesis, 1.2-1.5 cm long, moderately tomen- tose externally with viscid stellate hairs. Filaments glabrous, 2.5-3.5 mm long, connate in the basal 1-2 mm; anthers equal, 7- 8 mm long, lanceolate-subulate, attenuate and introrse at the apex, 1.5-1.7 mm wide at base. Ovary depressed-globose, densely glandularvillose with simple glandular hairs. Style glabrous, in basal flowers elongate and functional, 1-1.2 cm long, in the distal, staminate flowers, 4-5 mm long. Stigma clavate-truncate, minutely papillose at the tip, ca. 0.1 mm diam. Fruit globose, 1.5-2 cm diam., 4-locular, many seeded, with epicarp leathery, persistently glandular-pubescent with ferruginous, long and short gland tipped hairs; fruiting pedicels clearly reflexed. Seeds reniform, 2.5-3 mm diam., compressed, brown, the coat finely undulate and reticulate.

description: Small shrubs 5-8 dm high. Young branches sulcate or lined, yellowish, rough- granular tomentose, the indument persistent, the hairs mixed sessile and stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid. Leaves thick, oblanceolate to lanceolate, boat-shaped and curved downward toward tips, 8-18 cm long, 2-6 cm wide, pale yellowish green, velutinous above, the hairs densely overlapping, mixed sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate, and multangulate, yellowish tomentose beneath, the hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate; apices acute, bases long attenuate, blades decurrent nearly entire length of petioles, these unwinged for 0-1 cm, rough-granular tomentose, the hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate. Axillary leaves present or lacking, oblanceolate. Inflorescences short, 2-7 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 1-4.5 cm, 1-3 mm thick, granular tomentose, the hairs mixed sessile and stalked, porrect- stellate, multangulate to nearly echinoid; pedicels 3-5 mm long (to 10 mm in fruit), pubescent, the hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked, multangulate and nearly echinoid. Flower buds orbicular to oblong, large (6-8 mm long at anthesis); corolla tomentose, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate; calyx lobe sutures obscured by tomentum. Calyx relatively thin, somewhat translucent, often splitting irregularly, lobed 1/2-%/1 way to base, the lobes with prominent midveins, obtuse, acute or semi-ovate, 2.4-4.4 mm long, 2.6-4.0 mm wide in flower, 4.0-5.4 mm by 3.8-4.2 mm in fruit, sparingly to rather densely pubescent inside on upper half of lobes, the hairs simple and porrect-stellate, tomentose outside, the hairs mixed sessile and short- stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid. Corolla included in calyx until buds are quite large, but rather strongly exserted at anthesis, pale yellow, 15-18 mm across, the lobes ca. 6 mm long, a few simple and porrect-stellate hairs within on upper half. Anthers 3.3-5.6 mm long; filaments thick, 0.9-1.2 mm long. Ovary tomentose, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate, many with long rays. Style sparingly to rather densely pubescent 2/3 way from base, exserted from stamens. Stigma rather large, capitate. Fruits ca. 10 mm diam., the tomentum persistent.
bibliographicCitation: Roe, Keith E. 1972. A revision of Solanum section Brevantherum (Solanaceae). Brittonia. 24: 239-278.

description: Frutex vel arbor parva; caules dense aureo-pubescentes, trichomatibus 0.1-1 mm longis; caules veteres cortice rubrinduti; folia elliptica geminata supra sparse subtus dense trichomatibus aureis rectis pubescentia, apice acuta vel acuminata, basi acuta; inflorescentiae foliis oppositae simplices vel semel furcatae dense pubescentes; pedicelli sub anthesi deflexi pubescentes; calycis lobi anguste triangulares aureo-pubescentes; corolla rotata alba; bacca globosa viridis, pedicello lignoso deflexo vel erecto valde pubescenti.

description: Shrubs or small trees, 8-9 m tall; young stems and leaves densely pubescent with golden uniseriate trichomes of varying lengths, 0.1-1 mm long; older stems remaining pubescent and golden; bark of older stems reddish. Leaves elliptic, geminate, widest at the middle, shiny and sparsely pubescent above with erect uniseriate trichomes ca 0.5 mm long, these denser along the veins, the upper epidermis large celled, densely golden pubescent beneath with uniseriate trichomes of varying lengths, these 0.1-1 mm long, denser along the veins; major leaves 7.5-15 cm long, 3-6.5 cm wide, with 8 or 9 pairs of secondary veins, these raised and pubescent above, prominent and densely pubescent beneath, the apex acute to acuminate, the base acute, not decurrent on the petiole; petiole 1-3 cm long; minor leaves mostly smaller than, but occasionally as large as the major ones, 5.5-10 cm long, 2.2-6 cm wide, the apex acute, the base acute; petiole 1-3 cm long. Inflorescences opposite the leaves, simple 10-flowered, densely pubescent with golden young stems and leaves; pedicel scars closely spaced, slightly raised and corky, in pairs, the pairs ca 1 mm apart, the scars not obscured by the pubescence; pedicels at anthesis deflexed, ca 9 mm long, tapering from the conical calyx tube to a slender base ca 0.5 mm in diam, pubescent with golden trichomes, these 0.1-1 mm long; buds elliptic, densely golden-pubescent, the trichomes denser along the ribs of the lobes, the corolla late exserted from the tube; calyx tube conically cup-shaped, 1.5-2 mm long, strongly 5-ribbed, the sinuses hyaline, the lobes narrowly triangular, appearng as mere extensions of the ribs of the tube, 0.5-1 mm long, the entire calyx golden pubescent with uniseriate trichomes, these denser along the ribs and lobes; corolla white, 1.2-1.5 cm in diam, lobed nearly to the base, the lobes somewhat reflexed at anthesis, the tip and margins of the lobes densely pubescent with short uniseriate trichomes ca 0.2 mm long; free portion of the filaments ca 0.5 mm long, the filament tube ca 1 mm long; anthers 3-3.5 mm long, 1 mm wide, poricidal at the tip, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; ovary glabrous; style straight, 6-6.5 mm long; stigma terminal, minutely papillose. Berries globose, green, ca 1 cm in diam; fruiting pedicels woody, deflexed or appearing somewhat erect when the fruit is immature, 1.5-1.8 cm long, ca 1 mm in diam at the base, sparsely pubescent with golden uniseriate trichomes; seeds dark brown, ovoid-reniform, ca 2 mm long, 1 mm wide (immature), the surfaces minutely pitted. Chromosome number not known.

description: Shrubs or small trees, 1-4 m tall; young stems and leaves densely red-floccose, the trichomes weak and appressed to the stems, ca 0.1 mm long, soon deciduous; stems lightly winged from the decurrent leaf bases; bark of older stems deep grayish-red, shiny. Leaves distichous, giving each branch a flattened appearance, elliptic to obovate, geminate, widest at the middle or in the upper third, glabrous on both surfaces, very shiny and with the midrib prominently keeled above; major leaves 8.5-16 cm long, 3-5 cm wide, with 6-8 pairs of secondary veins, these somewhat prominent above in live plants, not at all so in dry material, prominent and reddish beneath, the apex acute to acuminate, the base cuneate to attenuate, decurrent on the petiole; petiole 0.5-1 cm long, lightly winged; minor leaves differing from the major ones in size and usually in shape, elliptic to rounded, 2- 4 cm long, 1-2 cm wide, the apex acute, the base cuneate; petiole 2-3 mm long. Inflorescences opposite the leaves, simple, 2-5 cm long, 3-8-flowered, densely reddish-floccose; pedicel scars closely spaced, often overlapping, beginning at the base of the inflorescence; pedicels at anthesis deflexed, 0.9-1.3 cm long, tapering from the calyx tube to a slender base 0.25-0.5 mm in diam; buds globose, be- coming elliptic after exsertion of the corolla, calyx appearing hyaline, completely enclosing the corolla until quite late; calyx tube broadly conical, 1-1.5 mm long, the lobes deltate, 1-1.5 mm long, glabrous or red-floccose, the trichomes often deciduous; corolla white, with a fragrance reminiscent of citronella (fide Tillett et al. 761-25), 1.1-1.3 cm in diam, lobed nearly to the base, the lobes planar or slightly reflexed at anthesis, the tip and margins minutely papillose; free portion of the filaments 0.5-1 mm long, the filament tube 0.5-1 mm long; anthers 2.5-3 mm long, 1 mm wide, poricidal at the tip, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; ovary glabrous; style straight, in short-styled flowers ca 1.5 mm long, in long-styled flowers 4-6 mm long; stigma a minutely papillose area on the broad- ened tip of the style. Berries globose, pale green, 0.8-1 cm in diam; fruiting pedicels erect and woody, corky and large-lenticellate, 1.5-1.7 cm long, often appearing longer if the fruit is from a terminal flower, 0.75-1 mm in diam at the base; seeds dark brown in dry material, ovoid-reniform, 2-2.5 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, the surfaces minutely pitted. Chromosome number not known.

description: Shrubs 2-3 m tall; young stems and leaves densely pubescent with soft uniseriate trichomes ca 0.5 mm long; older stems remaining pubescent, not glabrate, grayishbrown. Leaves narrowly ovate, occasionally geminate, widest just below the middle, sparsely pubescent above with uniseriate trichomes, these denser on the veins, densely pubescent below with soft uniseriate trichomes 0.5-0.7 5 mm long, the epidermis barely visible in dry specimens; major leaves 10-16 cm long, 2.5-5 cm wide, with 11-14 pairs of primary veins, these raised and pubescent above, prominent and yellowish beneath, the apex acuminate, the extreme tip rounded, the base attenuate; petioles channeled above, 7-8 mm long; minor leaves differing from the major ones only in size, 6.5-11 cm long, 1.5-3.5 cm wide, the apex acuminate, rounded at the very tip, the base attenuate; petioles 6-8 mm long. Inflorescences opposite the leaves, simple, 1-1.5 cm long, 10-30-flowered, pubescent along the rachis with uniseriate trichomes like those of the stems and leaves; pedicel scars closely spaced, but not overlapping, occasionally ca 0.5 mm apart; pedicels at anthesis deflexed, 8-9 mm long, tapering from the calyx tube to a slender base ca 0.5 mm in diameter, with a few uniseriate trichomes ca 0.5 mm long; buds globose, the corolla soon exserted from the calyx and the buds then ovoid to elliptic; calyx to be broadly cup-like, ca 1 mm long, the lobes broadly deltoid, 0.5-1 mm long, with tufts of uniseriate trichomes on the tips of the lobes, otherwise sparsely pubescent with uniseriate trichomes like the rest of the inflorescence; corolla probably white, 0.8-1 cm in diameter, lobed nearly to the base, the lobes reflexed at anthesis, the tips and margins of the lobes minutely papillose; anthers ca 2 mm long, 1 mm wide, poricidal at the tips, the tips paler and slightly thickened, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; free portion of the filaments ca 0.5 mm long, the filament tube ca 0.25 mm long; ovary glabrous; style straight, ca 5 mm long; stigma a minutely papillose area at the tip of the style. Berry and seeds not known; fruiting pedicels erect in immature fruit. Chromosome number: not known.

description: Shrubs or small trees, 2-6 m tall; young stems and leaves glabrous or minutely white-papillose; bark of older stems deep shiny maroon, becoming grayish on much larger stems. Sympodial units usually unifoliate. Leaves usually not geminate, elliptic to narrowly elliptic, widest at the middle, 4-11 cm long, 1.5-3.5 cm wide, glabrous above, drying pale green, pubescent with tufts of uniseriate trichomes 0.1-0.5 mm long in the axils of the secondary veins beneath, these trichomes sparse and from the veins, not the lamina, with 7-10 pairs of secondary veins, these not prominent, often yellowish and shiny beneath, the apex acute to acuminate, the base acute to obtuse; petiole 3-7 mm long. Inflorescences opposite the leaves, occasionally somewhat internodal, simple, 0.2-1.1 cm long, 5-7-flowered, glabrous except for the buds; pedicel scars closely spaced, overlapping or with the edges just meeting, beginning near the base of the inflorescence; pedicels at anthesis ca 1 mm long, deflexed, tapering from the calyx tube to a slender base ca 0.25 mm in diam; buds globose, densely to sparsely pubescent with white uniseriate trichomes ca 0.25 mm long, later elliptic with the exsertion of the corolla; calyx tube cup-shaped, ca 1 mm long, densely to sparsely pubescent with uniseriate trichomes, the lobes deltoid, 0.5-1 mm long, pubescent with the same trichomes as the calyx tube; corolla white, 1-1.2 cm in diam, lobed ca 3/4 of the way to the base, the lobes reflexed at anthesis, the tips and margins of the lobes minutely papillose, occasionally with a few uniseriate trichomes; free portion of the filaments minute, 0-0.1 mm long, the filament tube 0.5-1 mm long; anthers ca 3 mm long, 1 mm wide, poricidal at the tips, the terminal 0.5 mm paler and thickened, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; ovary glabrous; style straight, 6-7 mm long; stigma capitate, 2-lobed, the surface minutely papillose. Berries globose, green, 6-8 mm in diam (immature); fruiting pedicels woody, slender and erect, 1.5-1.7 cm long, ca 0.75 mm in diam at the base; seeds from mature fruits not known. Chromosome number not known.

description: Shrubs or small trees 2-12 m high; trunks to 18 cm diam. Young branches terete, whitish to yellowish velutinous or lanate, the indument persistent, the hairs partly to mostly long-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, echinoid, and dendriticechinoid. Leaves rather thick, elliptic, 12-30 cm long, 5-10 cm wide, pale to dark green, velutinous above, the hairs toLuching to densely overlappling, short-stalked, porrect  stellate, and few-rayed multangulate, whitish to yellowish tomentose beneath, the hairs sessile and in part long-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate; apices long-attenuate, bases acute, cuneate or if short-attenuate, the blades decurrent only slightly and only at the top of petiole; petioles unwinged for 1-7 cm, velutinous to lanate, the hairs short- to very long-stalked, porrect-stellate, mult- angulate, and echinoid. Axillary leaves present or lacking, ovate to broadly elliptic, often well developed. Inflorescences 8-22 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 6-20 cm, 2.5-7 mm thick, velutinous to lanate, the hairs short to very long-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and sometimes echinoid; pedicels 2-5 mm long, pubescent, the hairs short- to long-stalked, porrect-stellate, and multangulate. Flowers buds oblong, orbicular, or turbinate, 5-6 mm long at anthesis; corolla tomentose, the hairs short- and long-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate; calyx lobe sutures obscured by tomentum. Calyx relatively thick, rarely faintly ribbed, lobed '/2-3/4 way to base, the lobes acute to lanceolate, 1.5-3.4 mm long, 1.6-2.3 mm wide in flower, 3.7-4 mm by 1.8-3.5 mm in fruit, upper fourth to half pubescent within, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate, tomentose to lanate without, the hairs both short and long, thick-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate to nearly echinoid. Corolla barely exserted from calyx at anthesis, pale lilac to purplish, rarely white, 11-15 mm across, the lobes 4-5 mm long, glabrous within. Anthers 2.2-3.7 mm long, filaments 0.9-1.2 mm long. Ovary tomentose, the hairs multangulate and echinoid. Style glabrous to moderately pubescent on lower half, exserted from stamens. Fruits 10-12 mm diam., yellow when ripe, the tomentum persistent. Seeds 1.7-2.4 mm long, 1.4-1.9 mm wide.

description: Shrubs to 1.5 m tall; young stems glabrous and somewhat shiny; older stems glabrous, unarmed. Sympodial units difoliate and geminate, the minor leaf often deciduous and so appearing unifoliate. Leaves 2-11 x 1-4 cm, simple, dimorphic, the major leaves 7-11 x 2-4 cm, ovate to elliptic or narrowly elliptic, the minor leaves 2-5 x 1-2.7 cm, differing from the major ones only in size, thin-textured, glabrous and shiny adaxially, glabrous abaxially but with tufts of white simple uniseriate trichomes in the axils of the veins, the trichomes ca. 0.5 mm, very thin and interlaced, arising from the lamina; base acute to slightly attenuate onto the petiole; margin entire; apex acute to long-acuminate and rounded at the very tip; petioles 0.5-1 cm in major leaves, 0.5-0.7 cm in minor leaves, glabrous. Inflorescence consisting of a single flower (occasionally the scar of a second flower apparently present), opposite the leaves or occasionally somewhat internodal, all flowers perfect, the axes glabrous; peduncle and rachis absent or the pedicel appearing jointed 0.6-0.9 cm from the base; pedicels 30-35 mm in flower (to 40 mm if measured to the base of the inflorescence), deflexed, tapering from the base of the calyx tube to a slender base ca. 0.2 mm in diameter, 45-50 mm in fruit, 0.5-1 mm in diameter at the base, ca. 3 mm in diameter at the apex, pendent, slender. Buds when very young appearing globose, the corolla included within the elongate calyx lobes, the buds remaining globose until anthesis. Calyx 4-6.5 mm long, the tube 1-1.5 mm, the lobes 3-5 x ca. 0.5 mm, long-triangular, glabrous; fruiting calyx slightly accrescent, the lobes 5-6 x ca. 0.5 mm; corolla 0.8-1 cm in diameter, ca. 5 mm long, stellate, white, the tube minute, less than 0.5 mm long, the lobes ca. 0.5 x 0.3 mm at base, ovate-lanceolate, probably reflexed at anthesis, glabrous abaxially and adaxially except for the minutely papillose tips; filaments glabrous, the free portion ca. 0.5 mm, the filament tube ca. 0.5 mm; anthers 2.5-3 x ca. 1 mm, oblong, slightly sagittate at base, connivent, yellow, the pores tear-drop shaped, opening into longitudinal slits with age; ovary glabrous; style 3-4 x ca. 0.1 mm, cylindrical, straight, glabrous; stigma capitate. Fruit a globose berry, 1-1.2 cm in diameter (immature), green, glabrous. Seeds not known from mature fruit.

description: Shrub, 1-3 m tall; young stems and leaves moderately hispid with golden, curling, uniseriate trichomes ca 1 mm long; bark of older stems reddish-brown; the stems slender and arching. Sympodial units difoliate, geminate. Leaves narrowly elliptic-ovate, widest at or just below the middle, glabrous adaxially, pubescent with golden, curling, uniseriate trichomes along the veins abaxially, the trichomes denser along the midrib, the margins undulate; major leaves 6-15 cm long, 2-4 cm wide, with 7-9 pairs of primary veins, these drying golden-red abaxially, joining in a series of arches near the margin of the lamina, the apex long-acuminate, the base attenuate; petiole ca 0.5 cm long; minor leaves differing from the majors only in size, 2-4 cm long, 1-2 cm wide, the apex long-acuminate, the base at- tenuate; petioles ca 0.3 cm long. Inflorescences opposite the leaves, simple, slender, glabrous or with a few minute golden trichomes near the tips, occasionally sparsely pubescent with curling trichomes like those of the stems, 0.5-4 cm long, with up to 25 scars but bearing only 1 or 2 flowers at a time. Pedicel scars evenly spaced ca 1 mm apart. Buds globose, the corolla exserted from the calyx tube. Pedicels at anthesis filiform, deflexed, glabrous, 0.8-1 cm long, ca 0.5 mm in diam at the apex, ca 0.25 mm in diam at the base. Flowers with the calyx tube conical, 0.5-1 mm long, the lobes broadly deltate with a swollen apical pro- jection, ca 0.5 mm long, glabrous; corolla white or greenish-white, 0.8-1 cm in diam, lobed 3/4 of the way to the base, the lobes reflexed at anthesis, minutely papillose at the tips; anthers 2.5-3 mm long, 0.7 5-1 mm wide, poricidal at the tips, the pores lengthening to slits with age; free portion of the filaments ca 0.5 mm long, the filament tube ca 0.5 mm long, glabrous; ovary glabrous; styles glabrous, heteromorphic within a plant, in short-styled flowers 1.5-2 mm long, included within the anther cone, in long styled flowers 4- 4.5 mm long, exserted from the anther cone; stigma minutely papillose. Fruit a globose berry, green and occasionally white at the base, the pericarp hard at maturity; fruiting pedicel deflexed, 2-2.5 cm long, ca 0.5 mm in diam at the base, ca 2.5 mm in diam at the apex. Seeds not known. Chromosome number not known.

description: Herba repens ad nodos radicans, pilis simplicibus 2-3-cellularibus sparse pilosa, aculeis acicularibus 1.7-3.5 mm longibus sparse armata. Folia alterna, ovata, 5-7.5 × 3.5-6 cm, repanda vel non profunde lobata, subtus sparce stellato-tomentosa. Inflorescentia extra-axillaris, racemoso-cymosa, 4-5-florus; calyx inermis; corolla alba, lobis 6.5 x 3.5 mm; antherae lineari-angustatae, 5 × 1 mm; ovarium glabrum. Bacca oblongo-ovoidea, glabra.

description: Herb or vine, creeping and rooting at the nodes, or some stems erect, to 20 cm tall; stems slender, to ca. 2.5 mm in diameter, nearly glabrous to sparsely pilose with simple, 2-3-celled hairs, sparsely armed with prickles 1.7-3.5 mm long, slightly reflexed, nearly straight or slightly curved. Sympodial units 2- to 3-foliate, not geminate. Leaves 5- 7.5 x 3.5-6 cm, simple, more or less uniform in size and shape, ovate, thin-textured, glabrous adaxially, very sparsely pubescent abaxially with sessile 4-rayed stellae 0.7-1 mm wide, the midpoints shorter than the lateral rays, sparsely armed above and below with straight acicular prickles 1-3.5 mm long on the major veins; base truncate to subcordate, nearly equal to very unequal and with one side offset by up to 1 cm from the other; margin repand to shallowly lobed with 3-4 rounded to obtuse lobes per side; apex obtuse; petioles 0.7-3 cm, with hairs and prickles like those of the stems. Inflorescence 5-6 cm, extra-axillary or opposite the leaves, unbranched, with 4-5 flowers, the plants probably andromonecious and only the lowest one or two flowers fertile, the axes nearly glabrous to sparsely pilose with simple or stellate hairs and with 1 or 2 acicular prickles ca. 2 mm long; peduncle 3-4 cm; rachis ca. 2 cm; pedicels 9-11 mm in flower, to 15 mm and somewhat thickened in fruit, expanded distally to 1.5 mm in diameter, recurved, widely spaced, 7-14 mm apart, articulated at the base. Calyx 6-7 mm long, the tube 2-3 mm, the lobes in anthesis to 4 x 1.4 mm including the ca. 1 mm long caudate tip, oblong-ovate, with a few sessile stellate hairs, unarmed; fruiting calyx somewhat ac- crescent, the lobes to ca. 6.5 x 3.2 mm; corolla ca. 1.3 cm in diameter, 12 mm long, stellate to stellate-pentagonal, white, lobed about half way, the tube 6 mm, the lobes ca. 6.5 x 3.5 mm, triangular, tomentose abaxially with small sessile stellae, glabrous adaxially; filaments glabrous, the free portion ca. 2 mm, the filament tube absent; anthers ca. 5 x 1 mm, linear-tapered, not connivent, yellow, the pores minute and directed distally, not opening into longitudinal slits with age; ovary glabrous; style ca. 8 x 0.5 mm, cylindrical, straight, glabrous; stigma capitate. Fruit (immature) an oblong-ovoid berry, ca. 1 cm in diameter, the color when ripe unknown, glabrous. Seeds unknown.

description: Frutex gracilis sylvaticus; caules juniores glabri; caules veteres alati, cortice rubro-griseo induti; nodi unifoliati; folia ovata vel anguste elliptica membranacea utrinque glabra, apice longe acuminata, basi acuta valde in petiolum et caulem decurrentia; inflorescentiae foliis oppositae vel internodales simplices glabrae, cicitricibus pedicellorum arcte confertis; pedicelli sub anthesi deflexi; calycis lobi virides translucentes late deltati glabri; corolla alba vel albo-viridis, lobis reflexis, floribus dolichostylibus quam floribus longistylibus minoribus; bacca globosa viridis, pedicello frugiferi quam pedicello floriferi 2-3-plo longiori; semina fulva ovoidea reniformia, testa minute foveolata.

description: Slender, single-stemmed shrubs, 1-2 m tall; young stems and leaves glabrous or minutely red-papillose; stems winged from the decurrent leaf bases; bark of older stems pale grayish-red. Sympodial units unifoliate. Leaves not geminate, ovate to narrowly elliptic, thin and membranous, widest at or below the middle, glabrous on both surfaces, 10-30 cm long, 4-15 cm wide, with 9-11 pairs of secondary veins, these raised above, prominent and reddish-gold below in dry specimens, the apex long-acuminate, the base acute, strongly decurrent onto the petiole and then onto the stem; petiole narrowly winged, 0.8-3 cm long. Inflo- rescences opposite the leaves or internodal, simple, 0.5-2 cm long, 2-5-flowered, glabrous or minutely papillose, the papillae soon deciduous; pedicel scars closely spaced, but not overlapping, beginning near the base of the inflorescence; pedicels at anthesis deflexed, translucent green, 0.8-1 cm long, tapering from the calyx tube to a slender base ca 0.5 mm in diam; buds translucent and fleshy, globose, the corolla soon exserted from the hyaline calyx tube; calyx tube broadly and shallowly cup-shaped, 0.5-1 mm long, the lobes broadly deltate, 0.25-0.5 mm long, hyaline in dry specimens, glabrous; corolla white or greenish-white, 0.8-1 cm in diam, lobed 3/4 of the way to the base, the lobes reflexed at anthesis, the tip of the lobes minutely papillose; free portion of the filaments ca 0.5 mm long, the filament tube 0.5-1 mm long; anthers 1.5-3 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, poricidal at the tip, the terminal 0.1 mm paler and thickened, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; ovary glabrous; style straight, in long-styled flowers 4-6 mm long, in short-styled flowers 1-1.5 mm long; stigma small-capitate, minutely papillose, drying dark. Berries globose, green, 0.8-1 cm in diam; fruiting pedicels elongate, slightly woody, deflexed, 2-3 cm long, ca 0.75 mm in diam at the base; calyx lobes woody and somewhat accrescent in fruit, 3-4 mm long; seeds pale tan, ovoid-reniform, ca 4 mm long, 2 mm wide, the surfaces deeply pitted. Chromosome number: n = 12 (vouchers Knapp & Mallet 6847, 6857).

description: Liana lignosa, aculeis solum recurvis 1.5-3 mm longis armata. Folia plerumque geminata, altero minore, folia longiora anguste eliptica, 10-18 x 2.5-6.5 cm, integra vel angulati-lobata, supra inermia, subtus costa aculeis recurvis armata. Inflorescentiae extra-axillares, inermes, racemosae; calyx 3 mm longus, fere truncatus; corolla eburnea, profunde lobata, lobis lineari-lanceolatis, 12-20 x 2-2.5 mm; antherae attenuatae, 11-12 x 1.5 mm, vel nonnunquam 6-7.5 mm longae. Baccae nitidae, aurantiacae vel rubrae, 1.5-2 cm diametro; semina complanata, reniformia, 3.4-3.7 x 2.8-3.2 mm.

description: Scrambling vine; stem closely tomentose with ferruginous sessile (or nearly) 7-8- rayed stellae, 0.4 mm wide, with obsolete midpoints, eventually glabrescent, armed with uniform small recurved prickles 1.5-3 mm long from enlarged flattened bases. Sympodial units unifoliate or usually difoliate, rarely 3-foliate, geminate. Leaves 5-18 x 1.3-6.5 cm, simple, dimorphic or not, the major leaves 10-18 x 2.5-6.5 cm, narrowly elliptic, the minor leaves 5-18 x 1.3-6.5 cm, differing from the major ones only in size, thin-textured, sparsely to densely tomentose adaxially with sessile 4-8-rayed stellae 0.3- 0.5 mm wide, the midpoints absent to 1.5 mm long, the trichomes not obscuring the surface, tomentose abaxially with sessile or very short-stipitate stellae 0.6-0.7 mm wide, somewhat larger than those above but with obsolete midpoints, the surface visible, the leaf undersides with recurved prickles on the midrib similar to those of the stem; base un- equal (oblique); margin entire or very shal- lowly angulate-lobed; apex acute to attenu- ate; petioles 0.8-2.5 cm, armed with hairs and recurved prickles like those of the stem. Inflorescence 3-5.5 cm, extra-axillary, un- branched, with 5-15 flowers, all flowers ap- parently perfect, the axes stellate-tomentose, unarmed; peduncle 0.8-1.1 cm; rachis 2.5- 4.5 cm; pedicels 8-9 mm in flower, 16-20 mm in fruit, thick and enlarged at the apex, slightly curved, spaced 1-1.5 mm apart, articulated at the base. Calyx ca. 3 mm long, the tube ca. 2.5-3 mm, the margin almost truncate and lobes nearly absent, with an apicular extension of the midrib up to 1 mm long, stellate-tomentose abaxially, glabrous adaxially; fruiting calyx accrescent, to ca. 6 mm long, splitting nearly to the base, eventually breaking off irregularly, the remaining calyx tube flattened and somewhat woody; corolla 2.5-5 cm in diameter, 18-20 mm long, stellate, attenuate and slightly curved in bud, creamy white, the tube 2 mm, the lobes 12-20 x 2-2.5 mm, linear-lanceolate, tomen- tose abaxially with weak whitish stellae, glabrous adaxially; filaments obsolete; anthers (6-) 11-12 x 1.5 mm, very slender, attenuate, not connivent, yellow, the pores minute and directed distally, not opening into longitudinal slits with age; ovary sparsely tomentose at apex, glabrescent; style ca. 12 x 0.3-0.4 mm, exceeding the anthers by about 1.5 mm, clavate, straight to slightly curved, stellate-tomentose near the base; stigma truncate to capitate. Fruit a globose berry, 1.5-2 cm in diameter, shiny bright orange or red, glabrous. Seeds numerous (more than 15 per fruit), 3.4-3.7 x 2.8-3.2 mm, flattened, reniform, light brown or yellowish, the surfaces minutely pitted.

description: Shrubs ca 2 m tall; young stems and leaves densely arachnoid pubescent, the trichomes fine, delicate and dendritic, leaves and stems soon glabrate; bark of older stems dark reddish brown. Sympodial units unifoliate. Leaves elliptic to narrowly elliptic, widest at the middle, with 9-12 pairs of reddish primary veins, blades glabrous and shiny adaxially, with a few arachnoid trichomes along the midrib abaxially, 9-14 cm long, 4-5 cm wide, the apex acute to acuminate, the base attenuate, the petioles 1.5-1.6 cm long. Inflorescences opposite the leaves, simple, 1-1.3 cm long, sparsely pubescent with floccose arachnoid trichomes along the axis, especially near the apex. Pedicel scars closely spaced, not overlapping. Buds rounded when young, later elliptic, very strongly exserted from the calyx tube. Pedicels at anthesis slender, more or less deflexed, 1.5-2.5 cm long, ca 0.5 mm in diam, glabrous or occasionally sparsely pubescent with arachnoid trichomes. Flowers with the calyx tube broadly cup-shaped, nearly flat, 1-1.5 mm long, the lobes minute, broadly deltate, 0.25-0.5 mm long, very sparsely pubescent with arachnoid trichomes; co- rolla white, 0.8-1.5 cm in diam, divided ca 1/4 of the way to the base, the lobes planar at anthesis, the tips and margins of the lobes minutely papillose; anthers 3-3.5 mm long, ca 1 mm wide, poricidal at the tips, the pores lengthening to slits with age; free por- tion of the filaments ca 0.25 mm long, the filament tube ca 0.25 mm long; ovary glabrous; style straight, ca 5 mm long; stigma clavate, the surface minutely papillate. Fruit and seeds not known. Chromosome number not known.

description: Shrubs or small trees to 5 m high, bark smooth, cinereous. Young branches terete, pale yellowish pulverulent, the hairs sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate and echinoid. Leaves thin, ovate-lanceolate to broadly elliptic, the apices long acuminate, the bases abruptly short and narrowly attenuate, usually 12-24 cm long, 6-8 cm wide, glabrate above, the hairs sparse, appressed, minute, mostly porrect-stellate, minutely appressed-pubescent below, the hairs mostly porrect-stellate, some echinoid; petioles slender, minutely pubescent, the hairs short-stalked, mostly multangulate and echinoid; axillary leaves absent. Inflorescences 7-15 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 4-8 cm, 1-3 mm thick, minutely pulverulent, the hairs sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate and echinoid; pedicels 3-8 mm long, pubescent, the hairs mostly multangulate and echinoid. Flower buds globose or somewhat elongate, ca. 4 mm long at anthesis, pubescent, the hairs appressed, multangulate and echinoid; calyx minute, lobed '/3 1/2 way, the lobes ovate, acute or obtuse, 0.6-0.9 mm long by 1.1-1.3 mm wide in flower, 1.2-1.5 mm by 1.2-1.6 mm in fruit, minutely stellate within toward apices. Corolla long-exserted from calyx at anthesis, white, 1.2-1.6 cm across. Anthers 2.1-2.9 mm long, inserted on corolla tube 1.0-1.3 mm above the base, the filaments 1.6-2.1 mm long. Ovary and style tomentose. Fruit 9-11 mm in diam., sparingly pulverulent. Seeds 1.9-2.6 mm long, 1.7-2.0 mm wide.

description: Shrubs or small trees 4-6 m high forming flat-topped spreading crowns; trunks to 16 cm in diam., bark greenish-brown. Young branches terete or longitudinally angled and grooved, whitish to yellowish granular-tomentose, the hairs sessile and shortstalked, echinoid. Leaves rather thin, oblong-elliptic, the apices short attenuate, the bases often uneven, abruptly short attenuate, usually 19-35 cm long, 8-12 cm wide; finely scabridulous to velutinous, appearing whitish pulverulent above, the hairs small, mostly sessile, some short-stalked, multangulate and echinoid, the rays tending to be horizontal; appressed tomentose below, the hairs multangulate and echinoid; petioles 22-57 mm long, granular tomentose, the hairs sessile, echinoid; axillary leaves usually lacking. Inflorescences 14-17 cm long, very open branched; peduncles unbranched for 8-10 cm, 3-5 mm thick, granular tomentose, the hairs mostly sessile, echinoid; pedicels 3-6 mm long, pubescent, the hairs sessile and short-stalked, multangulate and echinoid. Flower buds globose to somewhat elongate, 4-6 mm long at anthesis, tomentose, the hairs small, multangulate and echinoid. Calyx lobed 1/4 of way, the lobes acute to ovate, minute, 0.6-1.2 mm long by 1.1-1.9 mm wide in flower, 2.1-2.3 mm by 2.4-3.1 mm in fruit, glabrous within except for tuft of minute white hairs at tip. Corolla strongly exserted from calyx at anthesis, longitudinally lined and ridged before opening, white, 11-14 mm across, the lobes with occasional simple or stellate hairs inside along midvein. Anthers 3.0-3.9 mm long, inserted on corolla tube 1.3-1.5 mm above base, the filaments 1.0-1.2 mm long. Ovary with scattered hairs, nearly glabrous. Style glabrous. Fruit 12-13 mm in diam., glabrescent. Seeds 2.1-2.6 mm long, 1.7-2.0 mm wide. Chromosome number: 2n = 24 (votucher: Roe, Roe & Mori 1242).

description: Shrubs or trees 1-15 m high; trunks to 20 cm diam., bark pale to dark brown. Young branches sulcate, soon terete, yellowish granular tomentose, the old stems glabrescent, the hairs usually a mixture of sessile and short-stalked, often appressed but some hairs rather long-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, dendritic-mult- angulate, echinoid, and dendritic-echinoid. Leaves thin, ovate, 6-40 cm long, 5-9 cm wide, pale to dark yellowish green, velutinous to scabridulous above, the hairs spaced to densely overlapping, mixed sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid, grayish or pale yellowish green beneath, the lateral veins prominent, the hairs mixed sessile and short, thin-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid; apices acute or short, abruptly attenuate, bases long, narrowly attenuate or abruptly so, blades decurrent along nearly entire length of petiole or sometimes only along upper side, petioles unwinged for 0.5-1.0 cm, granular tomentose, the hairs sessile, appressed, some short-stalked, mostly echinoid. Axillary leaves usually present, ovate to orbicular. Inflorescences 6-33 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 3-18 cm, 2-6 mm thick, granular tomentose, the hairs usually mixed sessile and short-stalked, sometimes partly long-stalked, mostly echi- noid; pedicels 2-6 mm long (to 11 mm in fruit), pubescent, the hairs mixed sessile, short and rather long stalked, mostly echinoid and dendritic-echinoid. Flower buds orbicular to elongate, 5-7 mm long at anthesis; corolla appressed- tomentose, the hairs multangulate and echinoid; calyx lobe sutures not evident, the calyx splitting open early. Calyx relatively thick, lobed 1/4-1/3 way to base, the lobes obtuse and acute, often small, 1.0-2.5 mm long, 1.3-3.0 mm wide in flower, 1.4-2.7 mm by 1.8-3.2 mm in fruit, glabrous within or pubescent in upper fourth to half of lobes, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate, tomentose without, the hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked, multangulate and echinoid. Corolla exserted early, strongly so at anthesis, midveins and plaits striate in bud, white, violet, or purple, 13-20 mm across, the lobes 5.5-6.5 mm long with porrect- stellate and multangulate hairs in the upper 1/4 within. Anthers 3.4-4.4 mm long; filaments 0.6-1.1 mm long. Ovary tomentose, the hairs multangulate and echinoid. Style pubescent ?-%4 way from base, equal to or longer than the stamens. Fruits 9-12 mm diam., minutely pubescent. Seeds 1.8-2.6 mm long, 1.3-2.0 mm wide.

description: Shrubs or small trees 1-9 m high; trunks to 10 cm in diam., bark pale gray. Young branches terete, scabrous or scabridulous, the hairs sparse to moderately dense, sessile, mostly porrect-stellate; glabrescent. Leaves rather thin, narrowly obovate or elliptic, the apices usually long acuminate, the bases long attenuate, decurrent along entire length of petiole or nearly so, usually 15-25 cm long, 4-10 cm wide; scabrous above, the hairs sessile, porrect-stellate, sparse, rarely touching; moderately pubescent below, the hairs sessile, porrect-stellate; petioles. scabrous or scabridulous, the hairs porrect-stellate; axillary leaves absent. Inflorescences 8-18 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 5-15 cm, 1.5-3.5 mm thick, scabrous, the hairs sessile, porrect-stellate; pedicels 2-9 mm long, pubescent, the hairs sessile, mostly porrect-stellate. Flower buds nearly globose or somewhat ellipsoid, 3-5 mm long at anthesis, pubescent, the hairs sessile, porrect-stellate; calyx lobe sutures obscured by tomentum. Calyx lobed 1/2 way, the lobes obtuse or acute, 1.1-2.8 mm long by 1.3-3.0 mm wide in flower, 1.5-5.4 mm by 1.4-3.5 mm in fruit, sparsely to rather densely pubescent within, the hairs mostly porrect-stellate. Corolla weakly to rather strongly exsertedl from calyx at anthesis, white, 14-16 mm across, the lobes sparsely stellate inside along midvein. Anthers 2.2-3.2 mm long, inserted on corolla tube 1.1-1.3 mm above base, the filaments 1.0-1.4 mm long. Ovary glabrous to moderately stellate pubescent. Style glabrous or sparsely stellate. Fruits 9-11 mm in diam., yellow when ripe, glabrescent or with few thick-stalked stellate hairs. Seeds 1.5-2.1 mm long, 1.1-1.7 mm wide.

description: Frutex 1-4 m altus; caulis ad 4 cm diametro; rami juniores aculeis parum recurvatis ad 7 mm longis armati, vetustiores fere semper inermes; caules dense stellato- tomentosi; folia ramorum floriferorum inermia, ovato- lanceolata, 7-15 x 3-10 cm, integra vel lobata. Inflorescentiae simplices vel 2-ramosae; calyx lobis triangulariter apiculatis; corolla rotato-quinquangula, 4-4.5 cm lata; antherae 9-11 x 2 mm, attenuatae; ovarium glabrum. Baccae glabrae, 1.2-1.4 cm diametro; semina complanata, reniformia, 2.5 x 2 mm.

description: Shrubs or treelets, 1-4 m tall; stems sparsely tomentose with sessile or stipitate 7-8-rayed stellate hairs 0.7-0.8 mm wide, the midpoints absent, grading into small prickles to at least 2 mm long with a stellate hair on the tip, fertile branches densely stellate-tomentose with sessile or short-stalked stellae, the younger parts ferruginous-tomentose, the lower part of the main stem and sprouts heavily armed with thick-based, slightly recurved prickles to 7 x 3 mm at the base, with sessile stellae on the bottom 1/3; fertile branches unarmed, or only rarely with a few short prickles. Sympodial units unifoliate or the uppermost ones difoliate and geminate. Leaves 7-15 x 3-10 cm, more or less uniform in size and shape, but younger plants or sprouts with much larger leaves (to 22 x 16 cm), ovate-lanceolate, thin-textured, ferruginous-tomentose on both sides with sessile or short-stalked stellae, scabrous adaxially with sessile 5-7-rayed stellae 0.5- 0.6 mm wide, the midpoint nearly obsolete to 0.3 mm long, the leaf surface partially visible, more densely and loosely tomentose abaxially with lighter colored short-stalked stellae obscuring the leaf surface, unarmed even on vigorous sprout leaves (except on very young plants or sprouts); base truncate to cuneate; margins of blades on fertile branches usually entire, or sometimes with 2 shallow lobes per side; apex acute; petioles 1-2.5 (-5.5) cm, densely stellate-tomentose, unarmed. Inflorescence 2-5.5 cm, extraaxillary, usually appearing terminal, eventually overtopped and lateral, unbranched or forked, with 3-10 flowers, often with one flower at the base and the rest more clustered toward the tip, all flowers perfect, the axes ferruginous-tomentose with stellate hairs, unarmed; peduncle 0-0.8 cm; rachis 2-3.5 cm; pedicels 13-15 mm in flower, up to 20 mm in fruit, spaced 3-8 mm apart, articulated at the base. Flowers with a thick sweet fragrance, the calyx ca. 5 mm long, the lobes ca. 3 x 2.5 mm, triangular, apiculate at tips, densely stellate-tomentose; fruiting calyx not accrescent, the lobes ca. 3 x 2.5 mm; corolla 4-4.5 cm in diameter, 25 mm long, rotate-stellate, pentagonal in bud, white, the tube 6 mm, the lobes ca. 10 x 15 mm, ovate-lanceolate, with ample glabrous interpetalar tissue, acute at apices, abaxially pubescent with brownish hairs on the midrib, glabrous adaxially; filaments glabrous, the free part 2-3 mm, the filament tube absent; anthers 9-11 x ca. 2 mm, tapered, not connivent, yellow, the pores small and directed distally, not opening into longitudinal slits with age; ovary glabrous; style ca. 11 x 0.5 mm, cylindrical, straight or slightly curved, glabrous; stigma capitate. Fruit a globose berry, 1.2-1.4 cm in diameter, green (perhaps not fully ripe?), glabrous. Seeds numerous (one count of 17), ca. 2.5 x 2 mm, flattened-reniform, yellow, minutely foveolate.

description: Shrubs 1.5-3 (-4) m densely ferruginous-rayed stellae 0.4-0.8 of various lengths, to irregularly glabrescent, with a few broad-long. Sympodial units Leaves simple, dimorphic, 15-23 x 7-12 cm, ovate, the minor leaves 8.5-14 x 5-9.5 cm, about the same shape as the majors, thin-textured, moderately and evenly ferruginous-tomentose adaxially with 4-8-rayed stellae 0.3-0.5 mm wide, the hairs mostly sessile and not overlapping, but with denser and more stipitate hairs on the major veins, densely pale stellate-tomentose abaxially with mixed sessile and stipitate stellae like those of the stem, usually unarmed abaxially or with a few acicular prickles up to 9 mm long on the major veins beneath; base acute to truncate or subcordate, unequal; margin usually entire, but often irregularly repand to undulate or with 1-3 shallow lobes per side; apex acute to attenuate; petioles 1-1.5(-3.5) cm, stellate-tomentose like the stem, unarmed or rarely with a few prickles like those of the leaf underside. Inflorescence 0.5-3 cm, opposite the leaves, branched, many- (more than 10-) flowered, all flowers perfect, the axes densely ferruginous-tomentose, the stellae 6-8-rayed, the midpoints slightly shorter than the rays, the stipes of various lengths, to 0.6 mm long; peduncle 0-0.7 cm; rachis 1.5-4.5 cm; pedicels ca. 8 mm in flower, to 11-20 mm long in fruit, spaced 1-2 mm apart, articulated at the base. Calyx 3 mm long, the tube 2 mm, the lobes ca. 1 x 1.5-2.5 mm, triangular, attenuate-apiculate at tips, densely stellate-tomentose abaxially; fruiting calyx not accrescent, the lobes ca. 1 x 1.5-2.5 mm; corolla ca. 2 cm in diameter, 14-16 mm long, stellate-pentagonal, white, the tube 2-3 mm, the lobes 9 x 4.5 mm, deltate, with ample interpetalar tissue, acute at apices, closely and finely stellate-tomentose abaxially on the midrib with stellae smaller than on the rest of the inflorescence, glabrous adaxially; filaments glabrous, the free part ca. 1 mm, the filament tube absent; anthers 6-7.5 x 1mm, tapered, free, yellow, the pores minute and directed distally, not opening into longitudinal slits with age; ovary densely stellate, glabrescent; style of hermaphrodite flowers ca. 8 x 0.3-0.5 mm, cylindrical, straight, stellate in the lower part; stigma capitate. Fruit a globose berry, 0-1.4 cm in diameter, green, turning yellow-orange, glabrous. Seeds numerous, 90-265 per fruit, 1.6-2.5 mm, flattened-reniform, yellow, the surface minutely foveolate.
