description: Shrubs or small trees 4-5 m high; trunks slender; bark yellowish brown. Young branches terete or somewhat sulcate, pale yellowish, granular tomentose, later glabrescent, the hairs mixed sessile and stalked, mostly echinoid. Leaves relatively thin, lanceolate or narrowly elliptic, 9-16 cm long, 1.3-4 cm wide, grayish or green, velutinous to scabridulous above, the hairs overlapping, mixed sessile and very short-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and some echinoid; leaves grayish to yellowish tomentose beneath, the veins rather prominent, the hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid; apices obtuse or acute, bases truncate to attenuate, if blades decurrent then narrowly so to within 1 cm of base; petioles unwinged for 1-3 cm, tomentose, the hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid. Axillary leaves present or lacking, lanceolate or elliptic. Inflorescences 5-13 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 3-8 cm, 1.5-3 mm thick, granular tomentose, the hairs mixed sessile and short- to long-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid; pedicels 1-3 mm long (to 8 mm in fruit), the hairs mixed sessile and short- to long-stalked, porrect- stellate, multangulate, and some echinoid. Flower buds oblong-orbicular, 5-7 mm long at anthesis; corolla tomentose, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate, not appressed; calyx lobe sutures sometimes evident as lines of minute yellowish white hairs. Calyx relatively thin, lobed 1/-2/3 way to base, the lobes slightly ribbed, often irregular, splitting unevenly, obtuse and acute, 2-4.7 mm long, 1.7-2.5 mm wide in flower, 3.6-4.8 mm by 2.4-3.5 mm in fruit, glabrous except for a few porrect-stellate hairs at tips within, tomentose without, the hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate, and echinoid. Corolla weakly ex- serted from calyx at anthesis, blue or pale blue, 12-15 mm across, the lobes 4-8 mm long, glabrous within. Anthers 3.0-3.8 mm long; filaments 0.6-1.2 mm long. Ovary tomentose, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate. Style glabrous or stellate on lower half, longer than the stamens. Fruits ca. 11 mm diam., the pubescence persistent. Seeds 1.9-2.5 mm long, 1.4-2.2 mm wide.

description: Erect tree 5 m tall; young stems thick and somewhat fleshy, densely pubescent with soft dendritic trichomes, these 1-1.5 mm long, drying golden-red; bark of older stems pale reddish-grey, the trichomes persistent. Sympodial units difoliate, geminate. Leaves fleshy, elliptic-ovoid, widest at orjust below the middle, adaxially pubescent with simple, rarely furcate, uniseriate, 2-9-celled tri- chomes, the trichomes 1-1.5 mm long, evenly spaced ca 1 mm apart over the lamina surface, denser along the veins, abaxially pubescent with soft dendritic trichomes, the trichomes ca 1 mm long, denser along the veins; major leaves 17-30 cm long, 12-16 cm wide, with 7-9 pairs of parallel primary veins, the apex acute, the base attenuate, winged onto the petiole, occasionally oblique, the petioles ca 2 cm long, winged from the decurrent leaf bases; minor leaves differing from the majors only in size, 10- 15 cm long, 6-8 cm wide, the apex acute, the base attenuate, the petioles ca 1.5 cm long, winged from the decurrent leaf bases. Inflorescences opposite the leaves or inter nodal, simple, fleshy, 1.5-3 cm long, 5-10- flowered, densely pubescent with soft den- dritic trichomes like those of the stems; pedicel scars closely spaced but not over lapping. Buds globose with the corolla in- cluded in the calyx tube when young, later elliptic with the corolla exserted from the calyx tube. Pedicels at anthesis thick and fleshy, somewhat deflexed, 1.7-2 cm long, ca 2.5 mm in diam at the apex, ca 1.5 mm in diam at the base, densely pubescent with dendritic trichomes like those of the inflo- rescence axis. Flowers with the calyx tube broadly conical, 3-4 mm long, the lobes ir- regular in shape but mostly deltate, 3-4 mm long, densely pubescent with loose dendritic trichomes like the rest of the inflorescence; corolla white, thick and fleshy (fide Stein- bach the lobes 2 mm thick), 2-2.5 cm in diam, lobed 2/3 of the way to the base, the lobes perpendicular to the anther cone, densely pubescent with dendritic trichomes abaxially, densely papillate and with an occasional dendritic trichome adaxially; an thers 6-7 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide, thickened and verrucose abaxially, poricidal at the tips, the pores lengthening to slits with age; free portion of the filaments ca 1 mm long, the filament tube ca 1 mm long, glabrous; ovary glabrous or with a few den- dritic trichomes; style 0.8-1 cm long, clavate, stigma bi-lobed and minutely papillose. Fruit and seeds not known. Chromosome number not known.

description: Frutex vel arbor parva; caules juniores pubescentes; caules veteres pubescentes, cortice griseo induti; nodi unifoliati; folia elliptica supra glabra subtus secus venas pubescentia, marginibus undulata, apice acuta vel acuminata, basi acuta; inflorescentiae foliis oppositae vel intemodales longissimae filiformes simplices vel semel ramosae, parce pubescentes; pedicelli sub anthesi deflexi filiformes; calycis lobi sub anthesi reflexi parce pubescentes; corolla rotata viridis alba, lobis planis; bacca globosa viridis pendula, pedicello fructifero quam floriferum 3-plo longiori; semina fulva ovoidea reniformia, testa foveolata.

description: Shrubs or small trees, 1-5 m tall; young stems and leaves densely pubescent with uniseriate curly tipped trichomes 0.5-0.8 mm long; older stems remaining pubescent, their bark gray. Leaves occasionally geminate on the lower stems, elliptic, widest at the middle, sparsely to densely pubescent with uniseriate trichomes 0.5-0.8 mm long along the veins beneath; major leaves 4-17 cm long, 2-9 cm wide, varying greatly in size on a single stem, with 5-7 pairs of secondary veins, the midrib raised above, the apex acute to acuminate, the base acute, decurrent on the petiole; petiole 0.4-1.5 cm long, slightly winged from the decurrent leaf base; minor leaves, if present, not differing from the major ones except perhaps in size. Inflorescences opposite the leaves or slightly below the node, very long and slender, 3-30 cm long, occasionally irregularly branched, bearing only a few open flowers at a time, but with up to 60 scars of previously borne flowers, sparsely pubescent with uniseriate trichomes like those of the leaves and stems; pedicel scars raised, unevenly spaced along the inflorescence, 0.5-1 cm apart; pedicels at anthesis deflexed, 1-1.2 cm long, filiform, tapering from the calyx tube to a slender base ca 0.25 mm in diam, sparsely pubescent with uniseriate trichomes ca 0.5 mm long; buds globose, the corolla soon exserted from the calyx lobes, the calyx lobes reflexed; calyx tube short-obconic, ca 1 mm long, the lobes longtriangular, 0.5-1 mm long, densely pubescent with uniseriate trichomes, more densely on the tube than on the lobes; corolla white, planar at anthesis, or the lobes very slightly reflexed at the tip, 0.7-1 cm in diam, lobed ca 3/4 of the way to the base, the tip of the lobes minutely papillose; free portion of the filaments 0.5-0.7 mm long, the filament tube less than 0.1 mm; anthers ca 2 mm long, 0.75-1 mm wide, poricidal at the tip, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; ovary glabrous; style straight, ca 4 mm long, drying black; stigma clavate, minutely papillose. Berries globose, green, ca 1 cm in diam; fruiting pedicels greatly elon- gated, deflexed, causing the inflorescence to be pulled down straight, 3-3.5 cm long, ca 0.75 mm in diam at the base, expanded at the apex to ca 3 mm in diam; seeds pale tan, ovoid-reniform, ca 3 mm long, 2 mm wide, the surfaces minutely pitted. Chromosome number: n = 12 (voucher Knapp & Mallet 6859).

description: Plant suffrutescent, up to 15 dm tall, sparingly to densely pilose to hirsute through- out, pubescence somewhat appressed, stems slender, strong, much branched, rooting the nodes; internodes 1-2 cm long. Leaves simple, entire, somewhat membranaceous, 3.5-7.5 cm long, 1.0-2.5 cm wide, elliptic to narrowly ovate-elliptic, the base rounded to rounded-acute, the apex acute to slightly rounded-acute, more or less densely hirsute adaxially, densely hirsute abaxially, with sparse short-glandular hairs abaxially; stipu- liform leaves less than 1 cm long, elliptic, symmetric; petiole 1.0-2.5 cm long. Inflorescence a pseudoterminal or lateral raceme with 2-4 flowers; peduncle 0.5-6.0 cm long, lengthening slightly in fruit, with a small bract and stipuliform leaves at the base; pedicels 0.5-1.0 cm long, basally articulate, densely strigose, with abundant short- glandular hairs. Flowers light purple with green abaxial midveins. Calyx 3.5-6.5 mm long, dark purple-spotted to dark green, densely pilose to strigose, the lobes constricted to below the middle, broadly rounded to abruptly acuminate, 2.0-5.0 mm long. Corolla rotate-pentagonal, patent, 1.5-2.5 cm in diameter, the lobes densely strigose abaxially, with glandular hairs few or lacking, the interpetalar membranes glaborous. Anthers deep yellow, elliptic, 2.0-3.5 mm long, the connectives dorsally pilose; filaments 1.5-3.0 mm long, connate in basal 2/3, the interstaminal membranes sparsely hairy. Style 3.0-5.0 mm long, densely pilose, the stigma capitate. Fruits subelliptic, slightly flattened, green with dark green stripes, rough surfaced, 1.0-2.0 cm long, 1.0-2.0 cm wide. Pollen 17-20 ,um in diameter. Chromosomes n = 12.

description: Shrubs or treelets, 4-5 m tall; young stems glabrous, young leaves densely red papillose; bark of older stems pale greenish-yellow, on large stems reddish with large white lenticels. Sympodial units difoliate, geminate. Leaves elliptic to ovate, widest at or just below the middle, glabrous adaxially, pubescent abaxially with tufts of simple, uniseriate trichomes in the axils of the primary veins, these occasionally extending to the lamina on either side of the midrib, the lamina with dense deposits of crystal sand, visible as tiny white specks with a dissecting microscope; major leaves 7-13 cm long, 3- 6 cm wide, with 7-9 pair of primary veins, these drying yellowish abaxially, the apex acute to acuminate, the base attenuate, slightly winged onto the petiole; petiole 0.6- 2 cm long; minor leaves differing from the majors only in size, 2.5-8 cm long, 1-4 cm wide, the apex acute to acuminate, the base attenuate; petioles 0.5-1 cm long. Inflorescences opposite the leaves or occasionally internodal, simple, 5-10-flowered, glabrous or with scattered simple, uniseriate trichomes ca 1 mm long; pedicel scars evenly spaced ca 2 mm apart. Buds elliptic, the corolla strongly exserted from the calyx tube. Pedicels at anthesis deflexed, slender, 0.9- 1.3 cm long, ca 0.25 mm in diam, abruptly widening to the swollen calyx, glabrous. Flowers with the calyx tube swollen, broadly urceolate, 3-4 mm long, the lobes minute, deltate with prominent apical projections, 0.25-0.5 mm long, with tufts of uniseriate trichomes on the apiculae; corolla white, sweetly fragrant (fide Nee, pers. comm.), 1. 5- 1.6 cm in diam, lobed ca 3/4 of the way to the base, the lobes planar at anthesis, papillose at the tips and margins of the lobes; anthers 4.5-5 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, poricidal at the tips, the pores lengthening to slits with age; free portion of the filaments ca 0.5 mm long, the filament tube ca 1 mm long, glabrous; ovary glabrous; style straight, 6-8 mm long; stigma capitate, the surface minutely papillose. Fruit a globose, green berry, ca 0.7 cm in diam (immature); fruiting pedicels woody, deflexed, 1.5-2 cm long, 0.5-1 mm in diam at the base, the calyx beneath the fruit strongly swollen and enlarged. Seeds dark brown, flattened-reniform, immature, the surfaces minutely pitted. Chromosome number not known.

description: Arbor parva; caules juniores minute aureo-puberuli; caules veteres cortice griseo-fulvo induti; folia obovata vel elliptica geminata utrinque glabra, apice basique acuta; inflorescentiae terminales vel foliis oppositae crassae simplices vel semel furcatae minute puberulae, cicatricibus pedicellorum arcte con- fertis; pedicelli sub anthesi erecti; calycis lobi deltati minute aureo-puberuli; corolla rotata alba centro viridis sub anthesi plana; bacca globosa aureo-puberula viridis, pedicello fructifero erecto turgido; semina fulva ovoidea reniformia, testa foveolata.

description: Small trees, 3-6 m tall; young stems and leaves minutely golden-puberulent with erect uniseriate trichomes less than 0.1 mm long; stems of live plants green, not winged; bark of older stems grayish-brown, smooth. Leaves geminate, obovate to elliptic, widest at or just above the middle, glabrous on both surfaces, but occasionally with a few minute uniseriate trichomes along the midrib near the petiole; major leaves 10-25 cm long, 5-15 cm wide, with 5-7 pairs of secondary veins, these prominent and occasionally yellowish beneath, the apex and base acute, not decurrent onto the petiole; petiole 1-2 cm long; minor leaves differing from the major ones in size and shape, elliptic to orbicular, 5-9.5 cm long, 3.5- 8.5 cm wide, the apex acute to rounded, the base acute; petiole 4-6 mm long. Inflorescences appearing terminal on the terminal node due to the slow expansion of leaves, but on other nodes opposite the leaves, rather stout, simple, but occasionally once-furcate, 1.5-4 cm long, 5-30-flowered, minutely golden-puberulent like the stems and young leaves, the trichomes denser near the tip; pedicel scars closely spaced, but not markedly overlapping, beginning very near the base of the inflorescence; pedicels at anthesis erect, pale green, 5-7 mm long, tapering from the base of the calyx tube to a slender base ca 0.5 mm in diam; buds globose when young, later ellipsoid with the exsertion of the corolla, the corolla 3-4 times as long as the calyx tube; calyx tube broadly cup-shaped, appearing woody in dry specimens, 1-1.5 mm long, the lobes broadly deltate, 0.3-1 mm long, edged white, the tip minutely papillose, the entire calyx puberulent with erect golden uniseriate trichomes; corolla white with a green center, 1-1.2 cm in diam, lobed nearly to the base, the lobes planar at anthesis, the tip of the lobes slightly cucullate, the tip and margins puberulent with minute uniseriate trichomes like those of the buds, each petal with a green abaxial stripe and a single medial adaxial ridge, the ridge apparent even in dry specimens; free portion of the filaments 0.25-0.5 mm long, the filament tube ca 0.25 mm long; anthers 2.5-3.5 mm long, 0.75-1 mm wide, poricidal at the tip, the terminal portion thickened and paler, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; ovary densely golden-pubescent with uniseriate trichomes 0.1-0.3 mm long; style straight, 5-6 mm long; stigma minutely capitate, the surface minutely papillose. Berries globose, tinged purplish when young, green when ripe, 1-1.2 cm in diam, the surface dull due to the persistent minute uniseriate golden trichomes 0.1-0.3 mm long; fruiting pedicels swollen, woody, and erect, 8-9 mm long, 1-2 mm in diam at the base; seeds (immature), dark brown in dry specimens, ovoid-reniform, 2-2.5 mm long, 1-1.5 mm wide, the surfaces minutely pitted. Chromosome number: n = 12 (voucher Knapp & Mallet 6765).

description: Shrubs or small trees 1-6 m high, open branched; trunks to 10 cm in diam., bark pale brown. Young branches terete, scabrous or granular pubescent, the hairs porrectstellate and multangulate, some long, coarse-stalked; glabrescent. Leaves somewhat coriaceous, lanceolate, elliptic or oblanceolate, the apices attenuate or acuminate, the bases long attenuate, decurrent along entire length of petiole or nearly so, usually 7-20 cm long, 3-7 cm wide; scabrous or scabridulous above, the hairs sparse, spaced or touching, rarely overlapping, sessile, porrect-stellate; moderately dense, whitish pubescent below, the hairs sessile and stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate; petioles scabrous, the hairs mostly porrect-stellate; axillary leaves present or absent. Inflorescences 5-18 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 3-12 cm, 1.3-4.2 mm thick, hirsute, the hairs partly long, usually coarse-stalked, porrect-stellate and multangulate; pedicels 3-6 mm long, pubescent, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate, partly long, coarse-stalked. Flower buds ellipsoid or globose, 4-6 mm long at anthesis, sparsely to rather densely pubescent, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate, partly long, coarse-stalked; stipitate-glandular at 6 X magnification; calyx lobe sutures evident as lines of minute whitish hairs. Calyx lobed 1/2-3/4 way, the lobes oblong to acute, 1.9-4.3 mm long by 1.2-3.0 mm wide in flower, 2.7-5.6 mm by 1.6-4.4 mm in fruit, glabrous or somewhat stipitate-glandular within. Corolla inserted or only slightly exserted from calyx at anthesis, white, 10-15 mm across, the lobes glabrous or with occasional simple or few-rayed stellate hairs within. Anthers 1.8-3.4 mm long, inserted on corolla tube 1.2-1.7 mm above base, the filaments 0.6-1.0 mm long. Ovary glabrous or sparsely stellate. Style glabrous. Fruits 8-11 mm in diam., yellow when ripe, glabrous. Seeds 1.2-2.1 mm long, 1.0-1.7 mm wide. Chromosome number: 2n = 24 (voucher: Roe, Roe & Mori 1356).

description: Spreading shrubs or small trees 3-6 m high; bark brownish or blackish. Young branches terete, whitish or yellowish granular tomentose, glabrescent, the hairs mixed short and long-stalked, echinoid, and some dendritic-echinoid. Leaves relatively thin, ovate to broadly elliptic, 7-27 cm long (juvenile leaves to 44 cm), 3-10 cm wide (juvenile leaves to 21 cm), yellowish to dark green, velutinous to scabridulous above, the hairs touching to overlapping, short, thick-stalked, simple and few- to many-rayed multangulate, the rays ascending, pale yellowish tomentose beneath, the hairs partly long-stalked, porrect-stellate, multangulate and mostly echinoid, especially along veins; apices acute, bases short- or long-attenuate, the blades often decurrent to within 1 cm of base of petiole; petioles unwinged for 1-4 cm, granular tomentose, the hairs mixed sessile and short- to long-stalked, mostly echinoid. Axillary leaves usually present only on young plants. Inflorescences 3-19 cm long; peduncles unbranched for 2-14 cm, 2-4 mm thick, granular tomentose, the hairs mixed sessile, short- and long-stalked, mostly echinoid and dendritic- echinoid; pedicels 3-6 mm long, pubescent, the hairs mixed short- and long-stalked, mostly echinoid. Flower buds orbicular, 5-6 mm long at anthesis; corolla appressed- tomentose, the hairs multangulate and echinoid; calyx lobe sutures obscured by tomentum. Calyx thick, opaaue, lobed 1/3-'/2 way to base, the lobes ovate to 1.2-3.0 mm long, 1.7-3.2 mm wide in flower, 2.1-3.7 mm by 2.1-3.4 mm in fruit, pubescent in upper eighth to half of lobes within, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate, tomentose without, the hairs mixed sessile and short-stalked on lobes, partly long-stalked below, multangulate and echinoid. Corolla exserted from calyx at anthesis at least by length of calyx lobes, usually more strongly so, pale violet, 16-19 mm across, often sulcate in bud, the lobes 6-7 mm long, pubescent within toward tips, the hairs few-rayed, multangulate. Anthers 3.2-3.5 mm long, filaments 1.1-1.6 mm long. Ovary tomentose, the hairs multangulate and echinoid. Style pubescent 2/3_3/4 way from base, the hairs porrect-stellate and multangulate, exserted from stamens; stigma capitate. Mature fruit not seen, apparently per- sistent-pubescent. Seeds not seen.

description: Frutex vel arbor parva, 2-8 m altus; caules aculeis muniti. Folia ovata, integra vel leviter lobata, (12-) 18- 40 x (6-) 10-20 cm, valde bicoloria, super glabrescentia viridiaque, inferne dense et persistenter albidotomentosa. Inflorescentia extra-axillaris, dense albidotomentosa, (7-) 10-25 cm, 2-9-ramosa, pedunculo 1.5-3.5 cm longo; pedicelli floriferi 2-2.5 cm longi, fructiferi 2.4-3.1 cm longi, 5-angulati; corolla alba, 4 cm diametro, profunde 5-lobata; antherae 8.5 x 2.5 mm. Fructus glaber, 1.2-1.5 diametro, viridis; semina plurrima, 2 x 1.6 mm. Solano albido Dunal valde simile sed robustius.

description: Shrub or tree, 2-8 m tall; stems densely appressed-tomentose with sessile, multirayed stellae so dense as to be individually difficult to distinguish, flowering stems usually unarmed but the lower stem with stout prickles, younger stems conspicuously striate when dry. Sympodial units difoliate, geminate. Leaves (12-) 18-40 x (6-) 10-20 cm, simple, more or less uniform in size and shape, ovate on flowering stems, strongly bicolorous, thin-textured, initially pubescent adaxially with sessile whitish stellae 0.4 mm broad and with ca. 16 rays, the midpoints very short or obsolete, soon glabrate-green, densely white-tomentose abaxially with sessile and short-stipitate stellae in interwoven layers, with about 16 rays, the midpoints obsolete, unarmed; base asymmetrically obtuse to sub-cordate, rarely acute; margin entire or obscurely sinuate-repand; apex acuminate; petioles of major leaves 4-5 cm, strongly striate or canaliculate when dry, this striation continuing onto the lower part of the midvein and onto the stem, densely whitish tomentose like the stem, unarmed. Inflorescence (7-) 10-25 cm, up to ca. 30 cm in fruit, extraaxillary, 2-9-branched, with many (up to more than 100) flowers, all flowers apparently perfect, the axes densely stellate-tomentose; peduncle 1.5-3.5 cm; rachis 4-16 cm, up to 26 cm in fruit; pedicels 20-25 mm in flower, to 24-31 mm in fruit, spaced 3-5 mm apart, straight, relatively stout, gradually enlarged toward apex, 5-angled; calyx 6-10 mm long, the tube ca. 2 mm long, 5-costate, the lobes ca. 2 x 4 mm, deltoid, apiculate at tips, densely stellate-tomentose abaxially; fruiting calyx somewhat accrescent, often splitting in the sinuses and the lobes then appearing longer, the lobes 6-7 x 3-4 mm; corolla ca. 4 cm in diameter, 21-25 mm long, rotate-stellate, white, the tube 1.5-2 mm, the lobes 19-23 x 5-6 mm, ovate-lanceolate, with ample glabrous interpetalar tissue, acute at apices, densely stellate-tomentose abaxially with stellae like those of the inflorescence, glabrous adaxially except for a few stellate hairs distally along the midrib; filaments glabrous, the free part ca. 2 mm, the filament tube absent; anthers 8.5 x 2.5 mm, slightly tapered, not connivent, yellow, the pores small, directed distally, not opening into longitudinal slits with age; ovary glabrous or minutely stipitate-glandular at apex; style 11-13 x 0.8-0.9 mm and well-exserted, cylindrical, straight or somewhatcurved, glabrous or minutely stipitate-glandular at base; stigma capitate. Fruit a globose berry, 1.2-1.5 cm in diameter, dark green when immature, the color when fully ripe unknown, glabrous. Seeds numerous (ca. 120 per fruit), ca. 2 x 1.6 mm, flattenedreniform, yellow-brown, the surface minutely foveolate.

description: Frutex parva; caules pubescentes, cortice rubro-griseo; nodi unifoliati; folia anguste elliptica vel anguste ovata, apice longe acuminata ad extremum obtusa, basi obtusa, supra glabra nitida subtus secus venas dense puberula; petioli alati breves; inflorescentiae foliis oppositae simplices filiformes puberulae; pedicelli sub anthesi deflexi; calycis lobi minuti late deltati; corolla albo-viridis minuta lobis sub anthesi reflexis; bacca globosa viridis, pedicello fructifero deflexo ad apicem expanso; semina fulva ovoidea reniformia, testa foveolata.

description: Small shrubs, 0.3-1 m tall; young stems and leaves densely and minutely puberulent with uniseriate trichomes ca 0.05-0.1 mm long; the stems not becoming glabrate, not winged; bark of older stems grayish-red; branches arched and flat- tened, giving the shrub a planar aspect. Sympodial units unifoliate. Leaves not geminate except on non-reproductive nodes, narrowly elliptic to narrowly ovate, widest at or just below the middle, 5-5.9 cm long, 1.3-2.5 cm wide, glabrous and shiny above, densely puberulent along the veins beneath with trichomes like those of the young stems, with 8 or 9 pairs of secondary veins, these converging at about the halfway point of the lamina, slightly raised above, prominent beneath, the apex long-acuminate, the extreme tip rounded, the base truncate; petiole minute, 1-2 mm long, winged from the leaf base. Inflorescences opposite the leaves, filiform, simple, 1-1.5 cm long, 4-6-flowered, but with only one flower open at a time, densely puberulent with the same golden uniseriate trichomes as the stems, ca 0.05 mm long; pedicel scars in pairs, the members of a pair ca 0.5 mm apart, the pairs ca 2 mm apart; pedicels at anthesis filiform, deflexed, 6-7 mm long, tapering from the calyx to a filiform base ca 0.1 mm in diam; buds globose when young, the corolla soon exserted from the calyx, the buds later obovoid; calyx tube broadly conical, ca 0.5 mm long, the lobes minute, broadly deltoid, often only tiny projections of the tube, ca 0.1 mm long, glabrous; corolla greenish-white, 4-5 mm in diam, lobed nearly to the base, the lobes strongly reflexed at anthesis, the tips and margins of the lobes minutely papillose; free portion of the filaments ca 0.5 mm long, the filament tube ca 0.3 mm long; anthers 1-1.2 mm long, 0.75-1 mm wide, poricidal at the tips, the pores becoming slit-like upon drying; ovary glabrous; style straight, 2-2.5 mm long; stigma clavate, the surface minutely papillose. Berries globose, green, becoming yellowish-green when ripe, 1-1.3 cm in diam; fruiting pedicels slightly woody, deflexed, ca 2 cm long, slightly expanded at the apex, 0.25-0.5 mm in diam at the base; seeds dark brown in dry material, tan in fresh material, ovoid-reniform, ca 3 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, the surfaces minutely pitted. Chromosome number: n = 12 (voucher Knapp 6613).

description: Weak shrub or suffrutex, sometimes trailing, 1-7 m tall or more. Stem glabrous to densely villose. Leaves lanceolate to ovate, glabrescent with sparse, jointed, curved hairs; unicellular hairs tipped with a multicelled gland also present. Calyx (2-)7-14 mm long, densely pubescent when young, mostly glabrous at anthesis with short jointed hairs; tube (1-)3.5-4 mm long, the lobes 2.5-10 mm long, triangular deltoid (ovate) to lanceolate, the apex long-acuminate to acute. Corolla 15-21 mm wide, white with purplish-green spots near the base of the lobes, rarely without spots; lobes 8-13 mm long ovate or lanceolate, the apex acute to shortly acuminate, densely and shortly pubescent with simple hairs outside, especially on lobes. Androecium with blue filaments 3.5-5(-7) mm; anthers (2.5-)3-4 mm long, purplish. Fruiting calyx 5.5 X 3.5 cm, 5-ribbed, the lobes acuminate. Berry globose, olive green, 0.8-1.3 cm diam. Seeds reniform, bright yellow, 1.5-2 mm diam.

description: Weak shrub or suffrutex, 0.5-2.5 m tall. Stem glabrous or pubescent but then glabrous with age with small pubescent, pilose, or even densely strigose patches in the axils of leaves and branches. Leaves ovate to lance-elliptic. Calyx truncate to shallowly sinuate, 3-10 mm long, glabrous with a ciliolate margin, or densely pubescent throughout. Corolla 11-14 mm wide with 5 darker spots made up of aggregations of olive-green dots at the base of each lobe; lobes lanceolate to deltoid-ovate, 8-10 mm long. Stamens purplish; anthers 1.5-3 mm long. Fruiting calyx 10-angled with 5 prominent angles, 2.5-5 X 2-3 cm. Berry pale green, spheroidal, ca. 1 cm diam. Seeds reniform, bright dark-orange, 1.5-2 mm diam.

description: Frutex; foliis oblanceolatis 27-32 x 7-10 mm aliquantum asymmetricis apice acutis vel rotundatis et retusis, petiolis 1-2 mm longis, costa superne caniculata infra prominula, venis utrinque obscuris; floribus solitariis, pedunculo 13-25 mm longis, bracteolis 2 suboppositis 3.5-2.5 mm apice acutis, margine atroglanduloso-serrulatis; calycis lobis 5 liberis 4.5-5 x 4 mm, duobus exterioribus margine atroglanduloso-serrulatis et tribus intimis eglandulosis integris; corollae lobis S liberis lanceolatis, 5 x 2 mm apice acutis; staminibus 24 liberis uniserialibus, filamentis 0.5-1 mm longis, antheris ca 1 mm longis; stylo 1.5-2 mm longis, ovario 2 x 2 mm, 2-loculari, 5-ovulato; fructibus incognitis.

description: Shrub 1 m tall; branchlets opposite or fasciculate, angular in cross-section, grayish. Leaves clustered toward end of branchlets, coriaceous, glabrous, oblanceolate, 27-32 x 7-10 mm, slightly asymmetrical, the base acuminate, the petiole 1-2 mm long, the apex acute to rounded, slightly retuse, the midrib caniculate above, prominulous below, the veins obscure on both surfaces, the margin entire, revolute. Flowers solitary, axillary among leaf bases; peduncles 13-25 mm long; bracteoles 2, cymbiform, subopposite, 3.5 x 2.5 mm, the apex acute, the margin black-glandular-serrulate; calyx lobes 5, free, cymbiform, 4.5-5 x 4 mm, the apex acute, the margin scattered black-glandular-serrulate on outer 2 lobes, entire on inner 3; corolla of 5 free petals, lanceolate, 5 x 2 mm, the apex acute, the margin entire; androecium of 24 uniseriate stamens, free from corolla but connate basally, the filaments 0.5-1 mm long, the anthers ca 1 mm long, the thecae parallel, dehiscence introrse; gynoecium with ovary very widely ovoid, ca 2 x 2 mm, 2-locular with 2 ovules in one locule, 3 ovules in the other, the ovules ovoid, ca 0.3 mm long, the terete stigma and style 1.5-2 mm long. description: Terrestrial herb, arising from fibrous roots and occasionally forming small tubers, 0.5-1.5 cm wide, stem 40-70 cm, cylindric-angular, simple or rarely branched, green to purplish red, glandular-puberulous, glutinous and aromatic, internodes 5-7 cm; leaves decussate, subequal, often bearing shoots in the axils, petioles 3-6 cm, purplish red, pubescent, blades 6-9(-12) X 4- 7.5 cm, ovate, cordate at base, acute at apex, margin irregularly toothed, teeth 3-6 x 3-9 mm, abaxial face green, puberulous, adaxial face pale green, glabrescent, 4-7 lateral veins; 1-2 flowers borne in the upper axils and in bracts along an axis 12-25 cm long, pending from ascending pedicels, the pedicels 2-3(-4) cm, glandular-pubescent, calyx subcampanulate, glandular-pubescent, fused for 2 mm, lobes lanceolate, 4 X 2 mm, puberulous, margin entire. Corolla tubular, 2-2.8 cm long, with a 3 mm wide annular swelling at base, abruptly narrowed to 2 mm above, gradually widened to 7-8 mm in throat, slightly grooved laterally toward base, yellow-orange in bud, at maturity scarlet-orange above, yellow with small red dots below, puberulent, throat yellow with dark red dots and glabrous, the lobes erect to slightly spreading, subequal, 5 X 4 mm, the ventral one slightly larger, red outside, yellow with red dots inside; stamens 4, included, filaments white, glabrous, anthers 2 X 1.5 mm, nectary a bilobed dorsal gland, ovary conic, style and stigma slightly exserted. Fruit a capsule, conic, ca. 1 cm, seeds ellipsoid, striate.

description: Plants pilose-hirsute throughout with hairs 0.1-0.7 mm long; leaves broadly ovate-subcordate, 15-43 mm long, 5-24 mm wide, bicolored, petioles 0.5-4 mm long. Flowers paired in upper leafy stems; corollas lavender outside, deep pink inside, 17-23 mm long.

description: Herba perennis, ramosissima, diffusa, 2-4 cm. alta; caulis retrorse pubescens; folia obovato-spathulata, 3-5 mm. longa, glabra, margine apicem versus valde revoluta et callosa, utrinque denta laterali tri-angulari obtuso onusta, sessilia; flores pauci, axillares; calyx glaber, 6 mm. longus, vix ad 1/2 in lobos ovatos acuminatos divisus; corollae extus pubescentis tubus 6 mm. longus et a calyce paulo exsertus, labium inferius 6 mm. longum lobo intermedio laterales excedente, labium superius subgaleatum bilobum 4-5 mm. longum; antherarum thecae aristas subaequales ferentes; stylus pubescens; capsula 6 mm. longa.

description: Perennial. Stems diffuse, much branched at base, pubescent with recurved hairs. Leaves glabrous, obovate-spatulate, distally with a pair of prominent triangular or triangular-ovate plane lobes, the median distal portion rhombic-oval, rounded or acutish, the apical margin strongly revolute and indurated, the blades cuneately narrowed to a sessile base; larger leaves 3-5 mm. long, 2-3 mm. wide. Inflorescence of 1 or 2 pairs of axillary flowers. Pedicels 0.5 mm. long, glabrous. Calyx 6 mm. long, glabrous; lobes 3 mm. long, rhombic-ovate, acuminate. Corolla externally finely pubescent, internally glabrous except at base of tube, "white or very pale pink"; tube 8 mm. long, narrow, slightly exceeding the calyx; upper lip 4 mm. long, slightly arched and hooded, the lobes free about 1 mm.; lower lip 6 mm. long, deflexed, the mid-anterior slightly longer than the ovate antero-lateral lobes, all retuse. Filaments glabrous above the pubescent base; anthers all coherent, the cells ciliate at margins of orifices, all awned (one awn of each posterior anther slightly longer than its mate and projecting farther down into the orifice of the corolla). Style distally pubescent. Capsule 6 mm. long, 3 mm. wide, flattened, retuse, slightly ciliolate apically. Seeds not seen.

description:
Ab Elaphoglosso auñpilo stipitibus squamis marginalibus omnino longioribus, nullis a distinguenda

Epiphytic; rhizomes 3-5 mm in diam., compact; rhizome scales 1 0-20 x 0.7- 1.2 mm, linear, concolorous, pink-gold to orange, flat, lustrous, with entire margin fronds (15-)24-42 cm long, approximate; stipes l-5(-8) cm long, (l/5-)l/10-l/20 of the frond length, stramineous; stipe scales 4- 7 mm long, subulate, orange to reddish brown, medium dense, patent, marginally entire at base and commonly sparsely dentic- ulate at apex, without hairs; blades (14-)20 38 x(2.8-)3. 5^1.9 cm, oblanceolate, papyraceous to chartaceous, attenuate at the base, acuminate at the apex; costal scales 3-5 mm long, similar to stipe scales, without hairs; abaxial blade scales 3-5 mm long, subulate, gold to light brown, sparse, marginally entire, without hairs; adaxial blade scales similar, but commonly darker than abaxial scales, hairs absent; blade margin scales 2-4 mm long, reddish-brown to dark brown, medium dense, with denticulate apex; hydathodes absent; fertile fronds 19-26 cm long; stipe 3-7 cm long, 1/6-1/3 of the frond length; fertile blades 16-19x1.6-1.8 cm, narrowly elliptic to narrowly oblanceolate, attenuate at the base, acute at the apex; intersporangial scales absent.

description: Subshrub or shrub 0.4-2(-3) m, the terete upper internodes and branchlets, petioles, primary and secondary abaxial leaf veins, and inflorescence axes covered with a dense indûment of stipitate or subsessile davate asperous hairs. Leaves of a pair somewhat unequal in size, 4-23x3-11.5 cm, elliptic to ovate, 5-7(-9)-plinerved, abruptly narrowed at the base and narrowly decurrent along the petiole, apex acute to acuminate, the margins ciliolate-denticulate, glabrous adaxially except for subsessile davate asperous hairs on the primary veins towards the base, sparsely and deciduously resinous-glandular on the higher order veins and blade surface abax- ially. Inflorescence a modified pseudolateral dichasium 2-5 cm long, mostly divaricately and laxly branched from the base; flowers 4- merous on pedicels 0.25-0.5 mm long; the  bracteoles subulate, persistent, mostly 0.5 mm long. Hypanthium bluntly 8-costate, deciduously resinous-glandular in flower. Calyx vaguely undulate, ca. 0.25 mm long, the exterior teeth bluntly triangular, 0.1- 0.25 mm long. Petals densely papillose on both surfaces with a projecting infra-apical, abaxial tooth, obovate-oblong, 0.75-1.25 x 0.75-1 mm. Filaments 1-1.5 mm long, anthers 1.5-2x0.5 mm long, linear-oblong, yellow, tapering to a ventrally inclined apical pore; connective barely prolonged dorsobasally into a gland-edged spur ca. 0.25 mm long. Ovary 4-locular, completely inferior, apex somewhat depressed, minutely and deciduously resinous-glandular puberulent. Style ca. 4-5 mm long, straight, glabrous; stigma punctiform. Berry ± compressed, initially white and turning bright orange when mature, 4-5x3 mm when dry. Seeds 0.5 mm long, the testa smooth, the raphe extending for the entire length of the seed.
bibliographicCitation: Kriebel, Ricardo & Almeda, Frank. 2009. Three new species in the neotropical genus Clidemia (Melastomataceae: Miconieae). Brittonia. 61 (3): 206-217.

description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5-3.5 m tall; uppermost terete internodes, vegetative buds, petioles, elevated primary and secondary veins on abaxial foliar surface, bracts and bracteoles, pedicels, hypanthia, calyx lobes and calyx teeth moderately to copiously covered with asperous hairs. Leaves of a pair ± equal to somewhat unequal in length; petioles 0.3-1.3 cm; blade 4.9-17.5x2.4- 6.3 cm, membranaceous, elliptic, apex acuminate to long-acuminate, base acute to attenuate, margin essentially entire, 3-5- nerved, adaxially with sparsely distributed asperous hairs on young leaves, glabrous with age, tertiary veins copiously beset with a white granulose indûment abaxially. Inflorescence a cluster of pseudofasciculate cymes in the axils of the upper leaves or lateral, usually arising on branchlets below the leaves and mainly on defoliated nodes, ca. 1-1.5 cm long; bracts and bracteoles 0.3-0.75 mm long and 0.3-0.5 mm wide at the base, triangular. Flowers 4-merous, sessile. Hypanthia (at anthesis) subcylindric to narrowly campanu- late, 2-2.5 mm long. Calyx tube obsolete; calyx lobes 0.75-1.25 mm long and 0.5- 0.75 mm wide at the base, triangular, typically reflexed, calyx teeth 1-1.25 mm long, subulate, widely spreading. Petals 2-2.75 x 1- 1.5 mm, glabrous, translucent  white, ovate- oblong, conspicuously reflexed at anthesis and with a minute and inconspicuous subapical dorsal tooth. Stamens 8, isomorphic; filaments ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers  ca. 1.25x0.5, white, linear-oblong, widest apically, emarginate at the apex with a dorsally inclined pore; connective prolonged dorso-basally into a deflexed, ± triangular, glandedged appendage ca. 0.5 mm long and also somewhat prolonged and gland-edged but unappendaged ventro-basally. Ovary 4- locular, 2/3 inferior, the apex consisting of a shallow bowl-like depression with a slightly raised perimeter, moderately but inconspicuously glandular-puberulent. Style ca. 5 mm long, glabrous; stigma punctiform. Berry ca. 4x4.5 mm, globose, bright orange at maturity, prominently 8-costate. Seeds 0.4-0.6 mm long, yellow-brown, ± triangular in outline, iugulate, somewhat angulate, with a foot-like projection at the narrow end.
bibliographicCitation: Kriebel, Ricardo & Almeda, Frank. 2009. Three new species in the neotropical genus Clidemia (Melastomataceae: Miconieae). Brittonia. 61 (3): 206-217.

description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5-3 m tall; uppermost quadrisulcate internodes, vegetative buds, petioles, elevated primary and secondary veins on abaxial foliar surface, inflorescence rachis, bracts and bracteoles moderately to copiously covered with pinoid hairs intermixed or replaced by sessile stellate and asperous hairs. Leaves of a pair equal to somewhat unequal in length; petioles 0.9-3 cm long; blade membranaceous to chartaceous, 8.1-16x4.2-7.5 cm, elliptic to elliptic-ovate, apex acuminate, base rounded to subcordate and generally subpeltate, margin subentire to denticulate or crenulate, 3-5-plinerved with the innermost pair of primary veins diverging from the midvein 0.8-1.4 cm above the blade base, adaxially glabrous in mature leaves, abaxially stellate on tertiary and higher order veins. Inflorescences laxly branched dichasia in the axils of the upper leaves or lateral, usually arising on branchlets below the leaves and paired mainly at defoliated nodes, 1.5-4 cm long; bracts and bracteoles 0.5-1 mm long, subulate. Flowers 4(5)-merous, on pedicels 1-2 mm long that lengthen to 4 mm in fruit. Hypanthia (at anthesis)l .5-2 mm long, narrowly campanulate to urceolate, apically elevated into a neck-like collar, sparsely stellate. Calyx fused in bud, shortly apiculate and rupturing into 4 irregular, broadly rounded hyaline lobes 0.25-0.75 mm long and 0.5-0.75 mm wide at the base, the exterior calyx teeth 0.25-0.5 mm long, linear-oblong. Petals 2.5-3 x 2.5-3 mm, glabrous, white, ovate to orbicular, conspicuously reflexed at anthesis. Stamens 8(-10), isomorphic; filaments 1.5 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.25 x 0.5 mm, yellow, linear-oblong, laterally compressed and deeply channeled between the thecae, truncate to slightly emarginate distally with a truncate to somewhat ventrally inclined pore; connective simple. Ovary 4-locular, completely inferior, the apex elevated into a 0.1 mm glabrous collar. Style 5 mm long, glabrous; stigma truncate to capitellate. Beny 3-4x3-4 mm, reportedly white when mature (F. Almeda & T. Daniel 7040). Seeds 0.4-0.6 mm long, yellow-brown, ± triangular in outline, rugulate.

description: Plants terrestrial. Rhizomes stout, short-creeping, 4-5 mm diam., scaly, the scales somewhat shiny, essentially concolorous, medium to dark brown, narrowly lanceolate to linear, the margins sparsely denticulate, 3-7 x 0.2-0.3 mm. Fronds monomorphic, 2-pinnate, 30-50 cm long; laminae 18-22 cm wide, discolorous; stipes approximate, ca. 2/3 of the frond, black, adaxially sulcate, the scales concolorous, brown, 2-3 mm long, narrowly lanceolate with a filiform apex, denticulate distally and ciliate proximally, appressed throughout or sometimes distally patent; rachises similar to the stipes and their indument similar; pinnae oblong-lanceolate, slightly decreasing at the base, slightly tapering toward the apex, 10-17 x 2.5-4.5 cm, the lateral pinnae 2 or 3 pairs, oblique, alternate, the terminal pinna con- form, as long as the lateral pinnae; pinnules 10-17 pairs, ca. 2.5X longer than wide, chartaceous, free-veined, without an evident midrib, the proximal pairs somewhat rounded or triangular, the median pairs dimidiate, trapeziform to quadrangular, the proximal side parallel to the rachis, the sterile apex obtuse to acute, the sterile margin entire to distantly serrate and slightly revolute, the adaxial surface of the pinnules glabrous, the veins forked and prominulous, idioblasts conspicuous or nearly so, the abaxial surface of the pinnules glabrous or with scattered brownish scales with an expanded stellate base, the veins not visible, idioblasts absent; sori oblong, to 7 or 9 per pinnule, indusia glabrous, the margin erose, spores not seen.

description: Tree 10-12 m tall; twigs pale, with paler lenticels, the youngest appressed-pubescent. Leaves alternate, 1-foliolate; petiole 1-4 cm long, with minute appressed hairs, with small stipels near apex, convex or flat and slightly margined adaxially, the petiolule absent; blade usually narrow-obovate or narrow- elliptic, acute at base, short-acuminate (rarely acute) at apex, entire, 6.5-19 x 3-6.5 cm, glabrous except for scattered appressed hairs on abaxial surface of midvein, chartaceous, the gland-dots visible on both surfaces, pellucid, the midvein flat grading to sunken at base of blade adaxially, raised abaxially, the secondary veins raised on both surfaces, a fimbrial vein absent. Inflorescence terminal long - pedunculate, rarely racemiform, usually at least once bifurcate, sometimes one of these two branches bifurcate, sometimes one of these two branches birfurcate, with no flower at base between the bifurcations and seemingly indeterminate secund branches on which flowers are arranged in two rows 11.3- 22.4 cm including a peduncle 9.5-17.4 cm, pubescent with matted and short, straight, appressed hairs especially dense on rachis, pedicels, and calyx and obscuring the surface of the latter; bracts 1.5 x 0.5 mm, caducous early in bud stage; buds rounded prior to bursting of calyx; pedicels 5-7 mm in flower, 9 mm in fruit. Calyx equally 5-denticulate, almost entire, ca. 2.5 mm long, persistent in fruit, the adaxial surface densely appressed- white-sericeous, the abaxial surface densely appressed-pubescent. Corolla zygomorphic, greenish-white or cream-colored; petals 5, imbricate (cochleate) in bud, slightly coherent by adjacent margins at level of corolla throat, ca. 15 x 3 mm, the innermost flanked by the two fertile stamens. Androecium of 2 fertile stamens and 3 staminodes free from corolla; filaments of fertile stamens ca. 10 mm long, exserted from the corolla tube ca. 4 mm, the staminodes ca. 12 mm long, narrowed and exserted from the corolla tube ca. 5 mm, all filaments bearded on adaxial surface at level of corolla throat and glabrous above; anthers narrow-oblong, 3.5x 1.5 mm (in bud), gla- brous, not gland-dotted, narrowly attached to filament, the basal appendage notched, ca. 0.2 mm long. Disc cupular, ca. 2 mm high, taller than ovary, glabrous, with denticulate rim. Ovary of 5 carpels connate at base and adnate to style base at apex, glabrous in bud, but pubescent with short erect hairs soon after flowering; style ca. 10 mm, glabrous, exsert- ed from corolla throat at maturity; stigma capitate-lobed, facing away from innermost petal. Fruit of 5 mericarps free from each other after dehiscence, each 13 x7 mm, ob- long, appressed-matted-pubescent on dorsal surface, matted-pubescent on abutting surfaces, not ridged, dehiscent adaxially and dorsally. Seeds not known.
bibliographicCitation: Kallunki, Jacquelyn A. 2009. Validation of Neoraputia (Galipeae, Rutaceae) and description of two new species from eastern Brazil. Brittonia. 61 (1): 28-34.

description: Tree or shrub 1-8 m tall, to 8 cm dbh; twigs pale, with paler lenticels, the youngest appressed-pubescent. Leaves alternate, 1-foliolate; petiole 0.6-2.3 cm long, glabrous, with a pair of stipels near apex, flat or concave adaxially, the younger ones sometimes narrowly winged, the petiolule absent; blade obovate (usually narrowly so) or elliptic, acute at base, short-acuminate or acute (rarely obtuse) at apex, entire, 5.1- 14.6x2.1-6.9 cm, glabrous even when young, chartaceous, the sometimes dark gland-dots visible on both surfaces, sometimes pellucid, the midvein and secondary veins raised on both, but especially on abaxial, surfaces; fimbrial vein absent. Inflorescence terminal, long-pedunculate, once bifurcate, with no central flower and seemingly indeterminate secund branches on which flowers are arranged in two rows, sometimes unbranched but otherwise similar, 12.2-34.6 cm including a peduncle 8.5-30 cm long, glabrous or with sparse appressed hairs more often on rachis, pedicels, and calyx; bracts 1.2-3 x 0.2-0.7 mm (occasionally 11- 19 x 6-10 mm and green), usually caducous early in bud stage; buds acuminate prior to bursting of calyx; pedicels 2-5 mm in flower, 8-12 mm in fruit. Calyx unequally 5-lobed, 9-13 mm long, persistent in fruit, the adaxial surface white-appressed-sericeous in tube and white-tomenulose on lobes, the abaxial surface sparsely appressed-pubescent but glabrescent, the lobes in flower triangular, acute, 2.5-5.5 mm long. Corolla zygomorphic, salmon-pink, often paler within and dark salmon or dusky without; petals 5, imbricate (cochleate) in bud, slightly coher- ent by adjacent margins at level of corolla throat, 20 x 6 mm (24 x 7 mm in pickled material), the innermost petal uppermost, the other four lower. Androecium of 2 fertile stamens and 3 staminodes free from corolla; filaments of fertile stamens 12-13 mm long (19 mm in pickled material), bearded on adaxial surface at level of corolla throat, the narrowed tapered part exserted from the corolla tube glabrous, ca. 6 mm long, white; the staminodes, 9.8-11 mm long [17 mm in pickled material], bearded on adaxial surface at level of corolla throat, the narrowed tapered part exserted from the corolla tube glabrous, ca. 4 mm, white; anthers oblong, 4.1-4.2x2-2.2 mm, glabrous, not glanddotted, narrowly attached to filament, the basal appendage notched, ca. 0.2 mm long. Disc cupular, 1.7-2 mm high, shorter or taller than ovary, glabrous, with undulate rim. Ovary of 5 carpels, connate ventrally, 1-2 mm tall, densely pubescent; style 12- 13 mm, glabrous, white, exserted from corolla throat at maturity; stigma capitatelobed, facing away from petal flanked by two fertile stamens. Fruit of 5 mericarps, these connate axially and basally, free from each other after dehiscence, each 12- 23 x 10- 13 mm, oblong, appressed - pubescent on dorsal surface, ascending pubescent on abuting surfaces, transvefrsely ridged, dehiscent along adaxial suture. Seeds usually 2  per carpel, smooth, dull, glabrous, mottled brown, 7-10 x 6-8 mm, the hilum circular, immediately below micropyle and above the dark crustaceous cover of the chalazal area, the testa crustaceous. Embryo curved, the radicle adxial, apical, the cotyledons conduplicate- plicate, cordate at base, the nucelar remains substantial, extended into folds of cotyledons.

description: Plants annual, rupicolous, scapose, erect, 6.5-15 cm tall, the rhizoids ca. 10 at the base of the peduncle, filiform, to 20 mm long, the stolons few, filiform, simple or little branched, to 20 mm long; leaves 2-6 at the base of the peduncle, petiolate, 3-11 mm long, the petiole 2-4(-8) mm long, the lamina ovate, very broadly ovate, or circular, 1.5-5x1.5-5 mm, the apex rounded to obtuse, membranaceous, with 3 basal veins that branch and anastomose; utricles numerous on the rhizoids and stolons, subglobose, 0.5-1.5 mm long, the stalks variable in length, from very short to longer than the utricles, the opening basal, with two flattened, deltoid appendages, these relatively long, recurved, covered with long stipitate and sessile glands, the trap body covered with sessile and subsessile, globose glands; inflorescences erect, 1-3 per plant, simple, 6-14 cm long, peduncle filiform, terete, glabrous, 4- 6.5 cm long, 0.5-1 mm in diameter, lacking scales, the bracts and bracteoles basifixed, fused at the base, narrowly ovate to deltoid, 0.5-1 mm long, membranaceous, without veins, the margin slightly denticulate, the bracteoles narrower; flowers 3-8 per inflorescence, the raceme lax, the internodes to 26 mm long, becoming shorter from the base to the apex, the pedicel erect at anthesis, reclinate in fruit, filiform, terete, to 25 mm long, becoming shorter from the base to the apex; calyx lobes unequal, membranaceous, with 2 or 3 unbranched veins, sparsely glandular, the margin erose denticulate, the upper lobe trullate to  ovate, the apex acute to subacute, 1.2 -2x 1-1.5 mm, the lower lobe shorter, ovate to broadly ovate, 1-1.5 x 1.8 mm, the apex erose denticulate or emarginate; corolla ca. 8 mm light lavender, each lobe of the upper ornamented with two violet or purple lines run parallel to the margin from the base until start of the bifurcation, lower lip adorned a violet or purple line that forms the of an inverted crown and delineates a central white area surrounding a yellow palate, upper lip 3-5 mm long, divided almost to the base into 2 linear-spatulate lobes that are in turn divided from the apex to 1/4 their length, the lobes 2-4 x 1-2 mm, the lower lip much larger than the upper lip, 3.5 - 6 x 4- 8 mm, divided nearly halfWay into 3 oblong to ovate, rounded, subequal lobes, the central lobe sometimes slightly larger than the lateral lobes; palate with a prominent, elevated, rounded ring; spur cylindrical, 2.5-4x0.5-1 mm, the apex round, light lavender; filaments curved, ca. 1 mm long, the thecae equal, confluent, 0.5-0.7 mm long; pollen spheroidal, 12-14-colporate; ovary globose; style short, terete, the lower lobe of the stigma semicircular, 0.4 mm in diameter, the upper lobe of the stigma reduced, deltoid; capsule subglobose, 1.8- 2.5x1.5-2 mm, with a persistent and enlarg- ing style, dehiscing by a longitudinal, ventral opening; seeds 30-36 per capsule, deltoid to ovoid, angular, 0.5-1 mm long, the testa reticulate with irregular, elongated cells.

description: Herbaceous climber moderate to densely villous on stems, tendrils, stipules, petioles, abaxial surface of leaves, peduncles, bracts pedicels and abaxial surface of sepals; strigose indument on abaxial surface of leaves; and pubescent and hispid indument on ovary; trichomes unicellular and pluricellular, filiform. Stem flattened adaxially, rounded abaxially, striate. Stipules 4-6 mm long, linear-subulate, apices caudate. Petioles 0.5-3.5(-6.5) cm long, eglandular. Laminae membranous to papery, urceolate, 3-lobed, 1.9-7.5 cm along central vein, 3-10.7 cm along lateral vein, 2.6-9.3 cm wide between apices of the lateral lobes, the angle between lateral veins 45-80(-105)0, lateral apex acute, apiculate, central apex acute, obtuse or retuse, apiculate, base cordate, margins entire, lamina nectaries absent. Inflorescence uniflorous, peduncles 1.5-7.8 cm long; bracts absent. Flowers with pedicel 1- 5 mm long; hypanthium patelliform; sepals 12- 25 x 2.5-4 mm, lanceolate, apex acute; petals 5 x l mm, lanceolate, apex acute; corona filaments in 1 series, 6-9 mm long, ligulate, apex dilated, united by membrane; operculum 7 mm long, plicate, apex denticulate; limen cupulate; androgynophore 6-9 mm long; staminal filaments 4-5 mm long, anthers 3-4.5x 1 mm; pollen grains large, oblate-spheroid, 12-colpo- rate, polar diameter 47.5-55 pm, equatorial diameter 52.5-60 jtm, ornamentation reticu- late, bacula in the inner of lumina; ovaries 3- 4 x 1-2.5 mm, ellipsoidal to ovoid, styles 3 mm long, stigma capitate. Fruit a capsule, 2.5-7.0 x 0.4 -2.5 cm, ovoid to fusiform; seeds 3.5 - 4x1.5-2mm, ellipsoidal, 5 or 6 sulcate, the sulci transverse.

Stipules 1.5 -3 mm long, falcate, caudate. Petioles 0.6-3 cm long, eglandular. description: Hemiepiphytic; rhizome 4-8 mm in wide, long creeping; rhizome scales sparse (rhizome visible), in two types, one 5-10 x 0.3-0.5 mm, linear, tricolorous, the central band dark brown to black, the median ribbon brownish yellow, the margins atropurpureous and toothed, the teeth simple to bifurcate, the apex long attenuate, the other scales type 0.3-1 (-3) mm long, ovate to lanceolate, bicolorous, the central band brownish yellow with margins brown to atropurpureous; fronds dimorphic; sterile fronds 50-80 cm long; stipe 12-20 cm long (1/4-1/5 of the frond length), adaxially yellowish, abaxially atropurpureous; blade 40-65 x 6-15 cm, narrowly elliptic to linear-elliptic, pinnatisect, glabrous on both surfaces, gradually reduced at both ends, with 1-3 semicircular pairs of auricules at the base, abaxially atropurpureous, brownish-yellow adaxially; 30-35 pinna pairs, ascending, arching at 40-50º angle to the costa, medial pinnae 4-10 x 1-2 cm, lanceolate, not involute, entire; costa yellowish, glabrous; without aerophores; fertile fronds not seen.

description: Rhizomate crasso, erecto, paleis brunneis, concoloribus, mollibus, lanceolatis, ad 2 cm. longis, 2 mm. latis, acuminatis, integris dense vestito; foliis dense caespitosis. Stipite stricto ad 15 cm. longo (plerum que breviore), brunneo, superne bisulcato, paleis brunneis, aliis late ovatis, ad 1 cm. longis, 4 mm. latis, parce lacerato-fimbriatis, aliis numerosis anguste lanceolatis et filiformibus primum densissime paleaceo et furfuraceo. Lamina anguste lineari, usque ad 20 cm. longa, 1 cm. lata, apice obtusa, versus basin vix angustata, rigide coriacea, in sicco brunnea, vetusta nigrescente, bipinnata, apice simpliciter imparipinnata rachi crassa superne paleis magnis, ovatis, iis stipitis similibus densissime imbricatim vestita, subtus paleis filiformibus dense villosofurfuracea aetate denuldata et asperula. Pinnis numerosis, dense compactis, rachin inferne tegentibus, 5-6 mm. longis, 2-3 mm. latis, obtusis, brevissime petiolulatis, imparipinnatis, costis paleis filiformibus longis subtus subvillosis. Pinnulis 4-5-jugis cuin impari, breve petiolulatis ca. 1.5 mm. longis et latis, semirotunldis, basi cuneatis, terminali subreniformi, marginibus integris arete reeurvis bullatis; venis paucis, flabellatim ramosis, suiperne impressis. Soris in eavitate pinnularum occultis, et eam denique omnino occupanitibus, paucis (2-3), exindusiatis. (Fig. 2.)

description: Evergreen shrub to 1.5 m tall, the shoots usually producing only a single vegetative leafy node before ending in a terminal flower, or two pairs, if the pair of small leaves associated with the flower is considered. Indumentum of multicellular, ferruginous globose-stellate hairs, minute-globular hairs, and stout, long stalked hairs, these usually non-glandular but occasionally with a minute glandular head. Young twigs terete, 0.5-2.6 mm wide, the indumentum of dense to moderate, globular stellate hairs, 0.13-0.25 mm across, along with sparse, long-stalked, non-glandular to rarely gland-headed hairs 0.3-1.9 mm long; internodes 0.45-5.3 cm long. Leaves opposite, often anisophyllous, the opposing leaves equal-sized to the larger leaf over three times the length of the smaller one, i.e., large leaf/small leaf quotient 1.00-3.14, with petiole 1-10 mm long, the indumentum dense to moderate, globular-stellate; blade 0.3-2.6 x 0.2-1.35 cm, ovate to elliptic, flat, thinly coriaceous, the apex acute to obtuse or rounded, the base rounded to subcordate, the margin plane to slightly revo- lute, entire; venation acrodromous, slightly suprabasal, with prominent midvein and 2 secondary veins, or 4 secondary veins, with 2 conspicuous secondary veins placed 0.3- 2.8 mm in from margin, and 2 inconspicuous, secondary veins much closer to margin, and several percurrent tertiary veins oriented subperpendicular to midvein, the tertiary veins not obviously connected or linked by 1 or 2 quater- nary veins, the higher order veins obscure, A reticulate; adaxial surface green, the indumentum initially of sparse, globular-stellate hairs, but very quickly glabrescent, although a few stellate hairs sometimes retained on lower portion of the midvein, the midvein and major secondary veins flat to slightly impressed, remaining veins obscure, the surface shiny when living, appearing minutely wrinkled after drying, with scattered druse crystals; abaxial surface pale green, with sparse, ferruginous globular-stellate hairs on the veins, usually 0.1- 0.28 mm across, sometimes with a few minute globular hairs on the smaller veins, the midvein conspicuously raised, the major secondary veins slightly raised to flat, the minor secondary veins and tertiary veins flat but visible, the higher order veins ± obscure. Inflorescences terminal, almost always reduced to a solitary flower (rarely a 3-flowered dichasium), which is associated with a pair of small leaves, these similar to vegetative leaves, with blades 1.5- 9x0.7-5 mm, and petiole 0.4-1.7 mm long, and a pair of linear to narrowly triangular bracteoles, 0.4-1 mm long. Flowers 4 merous, slightly zygomorphic, the pedicel to 1 mm long. Hypanthium distinctly 4-lobed, the lobes separated by longitudinal grooves, ± constricted above ovary, the free portion ca. 0.35- 0.65 mm long, the outer surface with moderate globular- stellate hairs, the inner surface glabrous and smooth. External calyx lobed 4 arising from along midline of the internal calyx lobes, 1.6 -3.35mm long (as measured from the adaxial point of attachement at apex of internal calyz love to apex of external calyx lobe), flattened parallel with the floral radii, this linear when viewed from above, and narrowly triangular and often ± falcate when viewed from the side (and 0.65 -1.25 mm across, when measured at the apex of the internal calyx lobes 4, 0.85 -1.45 mm long, 1.2 -1.55 mm wide, ovate triangular, green with red ting to red, with sparse globular stellate hairs; calyx tube 0.75 - 1.15 mm long, usually tearing nearly comletely between calyx lobes. Petals 4, 2.5 -3x 1.4-2.4 mm, ovate to elliptic, sometimes broadly so, glabrous, white and red tinged to red, with apex asymmetrically acute; margin entire. Stamens 8, isomorphic, geniculate, glabrous, ± deflexed to one side of flower at antheseis; filament 1-1.6 mm long; anther oblong to slightly ovate, straight, 1-1.25 mm long, dehiscing by a small apical pore, the connective region with a minute dorso-basal tooth. Ovary 4-loculate, fully inferior, ca. 0.85-1.9 mm long, 1.2-2.6mm in diameter, subglobose, apically glabrous, unridged, with axile plaacentation, the ovules numerous, borne on expanded placenta that extends into each locule; style straight to slightly curved, terete 2.6 -2.9 mm long, glabrous, arising from the ± flat apex of the ovary; stigma truncate, minutely papillose. Berries ca. 4.5 mm long, 5.5 mm in diam., subglobose, red (but possibly black when fully mature), with sparse globular stellate hairs. Seeds 0.3 -0.55 mm long, angular obovoid, with bulding , rectangular hylum, ± equaling in size the portion of seed that contains the embryo; testa ± smooth.

description: Arbor 20 m alta caule laevi ad basim 30 cm diametenti, ramulis terminalibus rugulosis pallide brunneo-viridibus glabris cicatricosis extremo foliis latis fasciculatis instructis. description: Shrubs 1.8-2 m tall. Branchlets with rhythmic growth, young branchlets brown, densely tomentose, rhytidome present, old branchlets gray to brown, glabrous to glabrescent. Leaves generally clustered on the tips of branchlets; petiole 1- 5(- 7) x 0.7-1.4 mm; lamina (2.3-)3-6.5(-8) x 0.8-2.9(-3.3) cm, plane, elliptic to narrowly elliptic, rarely obovate, base acute to obtuse, apex caudate, slightly caudate, acute to obtuse, rarely rounded, adaxial surface glabrous, venation raised, flat or sunken, brochidodromous, abaxial surface glabrous, glabrescent to sparsely pubescent, venation raised, secondary veins 6-11 pairs, diverging from the primary vein 60-75(-90)°, aréoles 0.2- 0.5 mm diam., without domatia. Cataphylls 2-5 x 1.5-2 mm, abaxial side densely sericeous to tomentose. Inflorescences 1.8-4.2(- 5.5) cm long, botryoid to thyrsoid, in the axils of the cataphylls or leaves, to extra-axillary, stems sparsely pubescent to tomentose. description: Shrubs 3.5 m tall; stems, nodes, and petioles tomentose, trichomes dendritic, brown; stems ovate to quadrangular in corss-section, lenticelate, lenticels elongate, whitish; nodes flattened to quadrangualar; Petioles terete, ventrally canaliculate, 1-2 cm long; leaves opposite, elliptic 5.7-10x3.2-5.5 cm, apex acute, mucronate, base acute, margin entire, slightly revolute, lustrous above, glabrescent, with sparse, brown, long-branched, dendtric trichomes, mostly on the nerves; below densely tomentose, with brown, long-branched, dendritic trichomes; venation acrodromous, suprabasal, 5- nerved including submarginals, immersed above, raised below, tertiary veins 26 -34, immersed above, raised below' acarodomatia basilaminar on abaxial leaf surface, cylindric, formed by nearly overlapping, incurving, baso-lateral tissue flaps extending out from the midrib and secondary veins, indument as on leaf abaxial surface; inflorescences paired in upper leaf axils, with  33-39 flowers, cymose, compound dichasia with three orders of branching, 15- 19.5 cm long. peduncle terete, canaliculate on proximal half, 8-12.5 cm long, abundantly lenticellate, lenticels round to oveate, whitish; pedicels conic, terete, 4-5 mm long, lenticellate, brown; calyx (fruiting) erect, graish -green to brown, lenticellate, lenticels whitish, tuberculate, rounded lobes obscure, calyx teeth mucronate, attenuate; flower not seen; fruit a berry, globose to ovoid, 0.85-0.90 x 0.45 -0.72 cm; seeds pyramidal to ovoid, numberous, yellowish, hylaine, lustrous 0.8 x 0.6 x 0.3 mm.

description: Trees to 15 m tall and 15 cm dbh; stems, nodes, and petioles with abundant, brown, dendritic trichomes; stems ovate in cross section; nodes ovate, swollen; petioles terete, ventrally canaliculate, 3.2x4.5 cm long; margin entire, bracteoles opposite, decussate, subtending each flower, 2-2.5mm long, linear to lineo - triangular, apex acute, base truncate, early casucous, tomentose with brown, dendritic trichomes, margin entire; description: Terrestrial or epipytic shrubs. Twigs angled, glabrous; mature stems subterete, the bark fissured, brown, glabrous. Leaves alternate, spirally arranged; petioles subterete, canaliculate above, narrowly winged, 2-6 mm long, glabrous; blades coriaceous, búllate, obovate, (6.7-)8-13.5x(4.7-)5-8.5 cm, the base atten- uate and decurrent, the margin entire, eciliate, revolute in dried material, the apex obtuse, glabrous above, glabrescent beneath with scat- tered, simple, multicellular, reddish, glandular hairs; venation pinnate, the midrib thickened and raised in proximal 1/3 then strongly impressed in distal 2/3 above, raised and conspicuous beneath, the secondary nerves 2- 4 per side, strongly impressed and arcuate- ascending above, anastomosing, raised and conspicuous beneath, the tertiary nerves retic- ulate, impressed and slightly conspicuous above, raised beneath. Inflorescences axillary, solitary, racemose, 1 3-20-flowered; bracts (ca. 4), floral bract, and bracteoles (2) similar, deciduous, ovate, 2-3 x 1-2 mm, the margins ciliolate with few, deciduous, simple, unicellu- lar, eglandular hairs, the apices acute; rachis sharply angled, scarred, 1.3-2.8 cm long, glabrous; pedicels articulate with calyx, 1.5- 1.9 cm long, expanding distally, 1.5 mm diam. at base, 3-3.8 mm diam. at apex, glabrous; bracteoles inserted near base of pedicel, sub- opposite. Flowers 5-merous, diplostemonous. Calyx campanulate or cylindric overall, terete and shortly apophysate at base, 6-7.5(-8) mm long, glabrous or glabrate with few, simple, multicellular and glandular hairs at base, the aestivation apparently valvate; tube subcylindric, 2.6 - 3.5 (-4) mm long; limb 3.3 - 3.5 (-4) mm long; lobes deltate, 0.9-1.5x2.6-3.5 mm, the margin eciliate, the apex acute; sinuses broadly rounded. Corolla bistratose, fleshy, red becoming white towards lobes, urceolate or conical, inflated towards base, 1 .6-2 .1 cm long, 7.8-8 mm diam., glabrous within and without, the aestivation valvate; lobes ovate, 1-1 .2 x 1.6-1.9 mm long, the apex acute. Stamens 10, equal, included, 11.5-12 mm long; filaments equal, distinct, long-triangular, straight, 2.5- 2.8 mm long, the connectives sometimes alternately spurred with the spur tips pointing upwards, with few, marginal, simple, unicellu- lar, eglandular hairs; anthers equal, distinct, 10- 10.5 mm long; thecae ca. 5.8-6.4 mm long, with or without basal appendage, minutely papillate, the cells shaped as jigsaw-puzzle pieces; tubules 2, distinct, 4.4-4.6 mm long, dehiscing by introrse slits, 2-3.5 mm long. description: Shrub or small tree, 0.5-5 m tall. Leaves 13-27 cm long; petioles 2.5-6 cm long, glabrous to sparsely puberulent; rachises 4- 11.5 cm long; leaflets 4-6; petiolules 1-4 mm long; blades narrowly elliptic to elliptic, thin, the bases attenuate or cuneate, slightly oblique at the acuminate apex, the adaxial surface glabrous with the midvein and secondary veins sunken or not, the abaxial surface glabrous or sparsely puberulent along larger veins with the midvein prominent and the secondary veins prominent or not; the terminal leaflet 8-13.5 x 2.8-5.5 cm, the largest lateral leaflet 5-12.5 x 2.2-5 cm. Inflorescences terminal or axillary, puberulent, the portion basal to each glomerule often slightly dilated and buttressing it, each glomerule of 1-12 flowers and apparently persistent; staminate racemes 1.5-12 cm long, 0.5-1 mm thick near base; pistillate racemes 1.5-3.5 cm long, ca. 1.3 mm thick near base. Staminate flowers; pedicel 0.5-0.8 mm long, puberu-lent; sepals 5, 1.5-1.7 x 0.7-1 mm, elliptic to ovate, abaxially pubescent especially along keel, adaxially glabrous; petals 5, 2.7-3.2 x 0.7-1 mm, elliptic, pubescent; anthers 5, 0.5- 0.6 mm long, the connective extending up to 0.2 mm beyond the anther sacs, the androgynophore 1.1-1.2 mm long; pistil reduced to a pubescent rudiment ca. 0.5-0.7 mm high. description: Plants slender, erect, diffusely branching, scaberulous, 3-6 dm tall. Leaves ovate, 5-10 cm in diam, 2- or 3-pinnate, the leaflets ovate, 3-13 mm in diam, crenatedentate, sparsely scaberulous; petiole slender, 3-6 cm long, very narrowly sheathing; cauline leaves gradually reduced upward. Peduncles rather slender, 3-6 cm long. Involucre of 2-5 linear-lanceolate, white-margined, entire bracts 1-5 mm long. Rays 3-5, slender, unequal, 1.5-3 cm long. Involucel of 3-6 linear-lanceolate, entire or irregularly dentate bracteoles 2-6 mm long. Umbellets 8-12-flowered, the 1-3 perfect ones peripheral, the others staminate, the mature pedicels unequal, 3-5 mm long. description: Rhizomes short creeping, scaly; the scales 0.2-0.3 cm long, castaneous, lanceolate, the margins ciliate. description: Small tree or shrub, 1-8 m tall; bark smooth, grayish brown. description: Pendent, epiphytic shrubs with branches at least 1m long, arising from lignotubers, also with roots bearing scattered, small (to 2.5 cm diam) lignotubers along length (example at hand shows primary root ca. 40 cm long bearing 5 lignotubers each 1-2 cm diam.). description: Stems prostrate or twining, 0.5-1.5 m long, 1-2 mm thick, commonly brownish with short silvery hairs. Leaves narrowly oblong, narrowly oblong-elliptic, or rarely narrowly oblong-lanceolate, mostly 2-3 cm long, 3-10 mm wide, the upper ones mostly smaller; petioles short, 1-3 mm long; apex obtuse-mucronate, mucronulate, or obtuse, never acute; base slightly cordate or obtuse, never acute; surface felty-tomentose, with distinctly thick veins. Inflorescences axillary cymes of 1-3(-5) flowers; peduncles 2.5-4.5 cm long, thinly villous or puberulous. Sepals mostly 5-8 mm long, 3-5 mm wide, with acute, acutish or acuminate apices; outside villous with silvery grey hairs (marginal areas sometimes with maroon tinge, more distinctly so on inner glabrous surfaces). Corolla pink, maroon, lavender or red (never white), 1-1.5 cm long, with distinctly lobed and notched margin. Stamens mostly partially exserted; filaments filiform, shorter than styles or nearly equaling them, mostly as long as corolla, glabrous (very rarely with scattered hairs near the bases. Ovary densely villous with long and grey hairs on outside; stylar branches almost free to the stylar bases or nearly so except the short stylopodia, almost exserted, slightly longer than filaments and corolla, mostly unequal in length, with scattered hairs near the bases; stigmas peltate or subglobose. Fruits mostly 1-seeded, rarely 2-seeded, nearly oval in shape, frequently oblique (thinner on the sides of degenerated ovules), 4-6 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, with villous apices. Seedlings with free cotyledonary petioles. Flowering from late May to August.

description: Lonchocarpo septentrionali M. Sousa similis, a quo differì statura 8-20 m (nee 6-25(-40) m), stipulis ca. 2 mm (nee 3-4 mm) longis, foliis ll-13(-17)-foliolatis (nee (13-)15-19(-21)-foliolatis), foliolis proximalibus alternis (nee generaliter oppositis), inflorescentiis floribus dispersis (nee inflorescentiis congestifloris), calyce 3.5-3.8 mm (nee 2-5-3 mm) longo, lamina vexilli ca. 13 mm (nee 17-18 mm) lata, ovario 6-7-ovulato (nee 8-ovulato), legumine dense cinereo-vel brunneo-flavo velutino (nee moderate vel sparse canescenti sericeo vel tomentuloso, glabrescenti). Arboles 8-20 m de alto; corteza interior con fluido resinoso rojizo al corte; ramitas moderadamente cinéreo a pardo-amarillento tomentulosas cuando jóvenes, posteriormente más esparcidamente, con lenticelas orbiculares a elípticas, color crema. Hojas con arreglo dístico en el tallo; estípulas ca. 2 mm de largo, oblatas, pronto caducas; pecíolo 3.5-6.2 cm, terete, estriado; hojas ll-13(-17)-folioladas; folíolos 6-10.5(-12) cm de largo, (2.3-)3.5-4.5(-5.2) cm de ancho, los proximales tienden a ser alternos, angostamente elípticos a angostamente lanceolados, subcoriáceos a coriáceos, epunteados, en el haz lustrosos y glabros, en el envés esparcidamente canescentes seríceos a tomentulosos, más densamente sobre las nervaduras, en la base algo cuneados a redondeados, en el ápice corto acuminados a más frecuentemente largo acuminados a caudados; nervadura primaria y secundarias algo impresas en el envés, nervaduras laterales 9-11. Inflorescencias (5.5-)9- 18(-23) cm de largo, largamente pedunculadas, el pedúnculo (1.2-)2.5-5 cm de largo; flores espaciadas; floración tardía; pedúnculos florales 2-floros, (2-)3-3.5(-4) mm de largo, delga- dos a robustos; pedicelos 2-3.5 mm de largo; bractéolas 1.6-2 mm de largo, suborbiculares, opuestas, cercanas al cáliz y cubriéndolo en un 1/3 de su longitud, pronto caducas. Flores 13.5-15 mm de largo; cáliz 3.5-3.8 mm de largo, ciatiforme, casi truncado, sólo presente el diente cannai, 0.3-0.4 mm, triangular, epunteado, pardo-amarillento sericeo; corola púrpura a rosado-púrpura; pétalos canescente seríceos, la lámina del estandarte ca. 13 mm de ancho, suborbicular, densamente canescente sericea adaxialmente, en la base central y uña abaxialmente; ovario 6-7-ovulado, sericeo. Legumbre 4.5-6 cm de largo cuando una semilla, ca. 8.5 cm de largo cuando dos semillas, 3.2- 3.9 cm de ancho, elíptica a oblonga, aplanada, en ocasiones codeada, suberosa, constricta entre las semillas, corto atenuada en la base, obtusa y rostrada en el ápice, densamente cinéreo a pardo-amarillento velutino, el margen vexilar y el carinal aquillados; semillas l-2(-3), 13.5-14.5 mm de largo, 6.5-8 mm de ancho, casi negras a color caoba muy oscuro.

description: Terrestrial shrubs, 2 m tall. Twigs subterete, flattened, puberulous, the hairs simple, unicellular, and eglandualar; mature branches terete, the bark fissured, glabrescent, the hairs simple, unicellular, and eglandular; prophylls 2, opposite, valvate, ovate, 1-1.2 mm long, the apex obtuse. Leaves alternate, spirally arranged; petioles subterete, 2.5 - 3mm long, puberulous, the hairs simple, unicellular, and eglandular; blades coriaceous, ovate or elliptic, 1.6 - 2.6 x 0.8 -1.2 cm, the base obtuse, the margin entire, slightly revolute towards base in dried material, ciliolate at apex of young leaves, the hairs simple, unicellular and eglandular, the apex acute and apiculate, glaberscent above with inconspicuous simple haris of two types, unicellular and elgandular and multicellular and glandular, glaberscent beneath with hairs simple, multicellular and glandular; venation 3-plinervate, impressed above, although the secondary nerves often inconspicuous, completely obscured beneath. Axillary solitary flowers; bracts 2-3, persistent, cucullate, ovate 1-1.6 mm long, the margin exiliate, the apex obtuse, glabrous on both surfaces; floral bract similar to other bracts, but 1.9 -2 mm long; pedicels continuous with calyx, 4-8mm long, glabrescent with inconspicuous simple hairs, some unicellular and elgandular, others multi-cellular and glandular' bracteoles 1 (apparently with two costae), persistent, inserted towards middle of pedicel, amplexicaul, ovate, 3-3.5 x 3.5 -5 mm, the margin sometimes apically ciliolate with the hairs simple, unicellualr and eglandular, the apex obtuse and usually torn, algbrous on both surfaces. flowers 4 - merous, diplostemonous. Caylx obconic overall, shortly winged, 8-8.5 mm long, green, glabrescent with minute simple, unicellular and eglandular hairs, along with simple, multicellular and glandular hairs, the aestivation valvate; tube obconic, 4-4.3 mm long; limb 4-4.2 mm long; lobes triangular, 2-3 x 2.5 - 3.1 mm, the margine eciliate, the apex acute; sinuses acute (V shaped). Corolla bistratose, red, urceolate, inflated at base, 1.1 - 1.3 cm long, 4-5 mm diam., externally glabrous except for few inconspicuous simple, unicellular and elgandular hairs, internally glabrate with similar hairs, the aestivation valvate; lobes triangular, 1.3 x 1,.5 mm, the apex acute. Stamens 8, equal, included, 9.6 -12 mm long; filaments distinct , equal, more or less linear, prominently geniculate often folding over, 6-7 mm long, glabrescent on both surfaces with hairs simple, unicellular and elgandular; anthers equal, 5.5-6 mm long; thecae 2.6 - 3mm long, papillate, with a not too prominent basal appendage, cells with polygonal shape; tubules 2, distinct 2.8 -3.2 mm long, smooth, dehiscing by introrse slits, 1.5 - 1.6 mm long. Ovary 4-locular, placentation axile; style exserted, 1-1.1 cm long. Fruit uknown.

description: Epiphytic shrubs. Twigs subterete, flattened, puberulous, the hairs simple, unicellular and eglandular; mature branches terete, the bark fissured, brown, puberulous or glabrescent, the hairs simple, unicellular and eglandular; prophylls 2, opposite, valvate, ovate, 0.6-0.7 mm long, the apex acute. Leaves alternate, spirally arranged; petioles subterete, 1.3-2 mm long, puberulous, the hairs simple, unicellular and eglandular; blades coriaceous, elliptic, 1.6- 2.1 x 0.4-0.7 cm, the base attenuate, the margin entire, slightly revolute towards base in dried material, ciliolate towards apex of young leaves, the hairs simple, unicellular and egland- ular, the apex bluntly acute, glabrous above sometimes glabrescent with inconspicuous simple hairs, either eglandular and unicellular, or, multicellular and glandular, glabrescent beneath with simple, multicellular and glandu- lar hairs; venation probably pinnate, but only the midrib evident and this impressed above and raised beneath. Axillary solitary flowers rarely 2-flowered fascicles; bracts and floral bract undifferentiated, 2-3, persistent, cuculiate, ovate, 0.8-1.5 mm long, the margin eciliate, the apex obtuse, glabrous on both surfaces; pedicels articulate with calyx, 1.8- 2. 1 mm long, glabrous except for a ring of hairs at articulation, the hairs simple, multicellular and glandular; bracteoles 2, distinct, persistent, inserted near middle of pedicel, ovate, 1.5- 1.7x1.6-2.2 mm, the margin occasionally ciliolate at apex, the hairs simple, unicellular and eglandular, the apex obtuse, glabrous on both surfaces. Flowers 4-merous, diplostemonous. Calyx obconic overall, conspicuously angulated, 2.4-3.2 mm long, green, glabrous, the aestivation valvate; tube obconic, 1.6-1.9 mm long; limb 0.8-1.3 mm long; lobes triangular, 0.5-0.7x0.9-1 mm, the margin eciliate, the apex acute; sinuses acute (Vshaped). Corolla bistratose, color unknown, cylindric or narrowly urceolate, 3.9-4.3 mm long, 1 .6-1 .8 mm diam., externally glabrescent and internally puberulous, in both cases the hairs simple, unicellular and eglandular, the aestivation valvate; lobes triangular, 1.1 x 0.7 - 0.9 mm, the apex acute. Stamens 8, equal, exserted, 3.5 - 4mm long; filaments equal, distinct, long- triangular, some geniculate while some are striaight (within the same flower), 1.7-2mm long, puberlous on both surfaces, the hairs simple, unicellular and eglandular; anthers equal, distinct, 2.1 -2.2 mm long; thecae 1.0 mm long, papillate with some basal papillae elongating into simple unicellular hairs, cells with polygonal shape; tubules  2, distinct, 1.1 - 1.2 mm long, minutely papillate towards base, dehiscing by introrse slits 0.6 mm long. Ovary 4- locular, placentation axile; style exserted, 4-4.3 mm long. Immature berry, more or less spherical, ca. 4.5-5 mm diam., reddish.
