description: Shrub about 2-3 m. high; leaf-rachis wingless or narrowly winged; leaflets about 3-7, elliptic to usually obovate, acute at the base, rounded or obtuse to sometimes acutish at the apex, 1-5 cm. long, 6-28 mm. wide, the lower ones the smallest, the upper ones progressively larger, all distinctly crenulate, glabrous or nearly so above, somewhat velvety beneath especially on the midrib and main veins, which are strongly raised above the surface; infloreseence puberulent with yellowish or reddish hairs; staminate flowers with sepals about 2.5 mm. long and petals 3-3.5 mm. long; perfect flowers with sepals about 1.5 mm. long and petals 2.5-3 mm. long, these reported to be greenish-white; fruiting gynophore short and broad, less than 2 mm. long, not lobed; fruit black, 4-6 mm. in diameter.

description: Shrub, height unknown, twigs castaneous, lustrous, puberulent and glabrescent. Leaves imparipinnate, 8-13 cm long, the leaflets 7, opposite or subopposite, decreasing in size towards base, the petiole and rachis seg ments narrowly winged, with the widest portion of wing at the base of the distal leaflet insertion and 0.2-0.5 mm wide; petiole 1.9—2.7(-3.7) cm long; rachis 3.5 6 cm long; blades glabrous above, glabrous below except for petiolule and base of midrib which are puberulent to glabrous but usually with sparse hairs, the apex acute to acuminate, the base acute, the margins serrate with apically oriented teeth; terminal leaflet with petiolule 5-12 mm long, the blade margins decurrent and forming wings up to 0.4 mm wide laterally along the petiolule, the blade elliptic, 3.8-4.2(-5.4)x 2-2.3(-3.1) cm; lateral leaflets with petio lules of largest leaflets 1-2 mm long, the blades elliptic to ovate or broadly so, 2.9— 4x 1.3-2.3 mm. Inflorescence at the base of new growth, axillary cymose panicle, 1.4 4 cm long, puberulent; staminate inflorescence of 10—14 flowers; pistillate (possibly bisexual) inflorescence of 3-6 flowers. Staminate flowers 4-merous; pedicels 0.5— 2 mm long, densely puberulent; sepals narrowly elliptic, 1.2—1.6 x 0.3-0.5 mm, stramineous with darker midvein, with scattered hairs especially along the midvein abaxially; petals elliptic, 1.9-2.5 x 0.8 1 mm, apex rounded to acute, stramineous with a darker midvein, with scattered hairs especially along midvein abaxially; stamens ca. 4 mm long, the filaments 2.7-3.1 mm, sparsely hispid, the anthers longitudinally dehiscent, dorsifixed, 1—1.1 mm long; disc intrastaminal, circular, consisting of 4 indis tinct lobes, one at the base of each filament; carpels rudimentary, reduced to 4 minute styles imbedded in the center of the disc. Pistillate flowers 4-merous; pedicel 3— 4.5 cm long; sepals elliptic or narrowly so, 0.7-1.4 x 0.25-0.4 mm, stramineous, gla brous or glabrate; petals elliptic, 1.8-2.4 x 0.9-1.2 mm, stramineous, apex acute to rounded, glabrous or glabrate; stamens 1.8— 2 mm long; anthers 0.6-0.8 mm long; filaments 0.9-1.2 mm long, sparsely hispid; intrastaminal disc comprising 4 lobes, one at the base of each filament; carpels separate, each attached basally at the center of the disc, obovoid to spherical, 0.8-1.6 x 0.8-0.9 mm, glabrous, brown to black; styles emerging from the summit of each carpel and uniting, each separate for 0.2 0.3 mm and connate for 0.7-1 mm; stigmas 4, separate, recurved, 1.2—1.5 mm long, papillate on the ventral surface. Fruit unknown.

description: Evergreen shrubs or small trees to 5 m high; bark gray to brown, smooth to shallowly, longitudinally fissured; young twigs quadrangular, becoming terete with age, reddish or green, becoming brown, (glabrous) occasionally with unicellular hairs, usually with multicellular multiseriate setae, or with a dense indumentum of conspicuous, whitish, matted, multicellular, stellate hairs that may congeal to form a crust that can abscise in plates, the stellate hairs (0.11-)0.18-0.30(-0.38) mm diam., twigs eventually glabrous; nodes somewhat swollen, (4.4-)5.6-6.88(-7.34) mm diam., a slightly expanded, usually conspicuous interpetiolar ridge present, with pubescence similar to that on twigs, as well as multicellular multiseriate setae, often with thickened bases, in a dense ring around the node and petiole attachment points, the setae (1.27-) 1.6-2.57(-3.1) mm long. Leaf blade coriaceous (very rarely chartaceous), ovate to elliptic or widely elliptic, (6-)7.6-9.8(-12.1) X (4.3-)4.6-6.1(-8.4) cm, usually curved abaxially near margin, apex obtuse (acute), the tip acuminate (long-acuminate) and often inrolled to such a degree so as to contact the abaxial leaf surface; base obtuse, sometimes with small cordate lobes barely over-lapping petiole apex; adaxial surface of young blades with roughened stellate hairs and unicellular hairs, mature leaves generally glabrous, sometimes with unicellular hairs and roughened stellate hairs, occasionally appearing as punctations and common near base; abaxial surface of young blades with stellate hairs, irregular white, roughened stellate hairs (0.16-)0.24-0.38(- 0.48) mm diam. that form a dense mat covering the blade and veins (falling from blade with age, but usually remaining on veins), also unicellular hairs, multicellular uniseriate hairs, and multicellular multiseriate setae along margin, mature leaves with dense white, roughened stellate hairs at base and on veins throughout, also on blade but fewer, unicellular hairs mostly on veins, scars of fallen hairs appear as yellowish-tawny dots on blade, roughened stellate hairs (0.14-)0.19-0.33(-0.48) mm diam.; margin (± plane) distinctly revolute, slightly crenate in distal 1/2 of blade; venation basal, rarely somewhat decurrent, with 2 or 3 pairs of secondary veins, and 1 pair of inconspicuous submarginal secondary veins, the tertia- ry veins (25-)27-35(-38), intergrading with quaternary veins at base and apex; midrib (slightly raised near base) distinctly impressed adaxially, raised abaxially, the secondary veins impressed adaxially, raised abaxially, the tertiary veins impressed adax- ially, raised abaxially; the quaternary veins impressed adaxially, raised to flat to im- pressed abaxially. Petiole (1-)1.3-3.3(-3.4) cm long, shallowly canaliculate, multicellular multiseriate setae (0.97-) 1.3-2.16(-2.6) mm long along sulcus above, roughened stel- late hairs like those on blade also mixed in with the setae (these occur throughout on younger petioles, deciduous from underside with age). Inflorescence terminal, cymose, corymbose, (3.9-)5.5-7.4(-8.9) X (3-)3.6- 6.7(-9) cm, with 3-4(-5) orders of branch- ing, the caducous bracts elliptic, to ca. 2.3 mm long; peduncle (0.5-)0.8-2.2(-2.8) cm long, first internode above peduncle (0.9-) 1.13-2.4(-3) cm long, first lateral internode (1.29-)1.4-2.5(-4.3) cm long, the flowers (26-)35-60(-73) per inflorescence. Pedi- cels (2.54-)2.8-4.54(-5) mm long, with unicellular uniseriate and roughened, whit- ish, stellate hairs (0.16-)0.18-0.32(-0.35) mm diam. Hypanthium cylindrical to sub- orbicular, spreading above ovary, (3.94-) 4.34-4.67(-4.8) mm long as measured from base of hypanthium to torus, (3.87-) 3.94-4.27(-4.8) mm wide, the indumentum of unicellular hairs (sparse) and white roughened stellate hairs, dense near pedicel attachment, progressively sparser approach- ing calyx lobes, the epidermis of the hypanthium frequently obscured by the indumentum, white roughened stellate hairs (0.08-)0.11-0.22(-0.29) mm diam., the portion of hypanthium free from ovary (1.25-)1.41-1.53(-1.88) mm long; inner hypanthium smooth to granular textured, often with indistinct ridges, torus to calyx apex length (1.72-)2.04-2.82(-2.94) mm, torus to calyx notch length (0.18-)0.21- 0.85(-1.28) mm. Calyx lobes 4, (1.32-)1.5- 2.19(-2.44) X (2.66-)3.07-3.6(-3.69) mm, lobes broadly triangular, the indumentum similar to that of hypanthium, the external calyx teeth (0.25-)0.33-0.72(-1.35) mm long, bluntly rounded, with apex directed upward. Petals 4, producing nectar in a bas- al, cuplike depression on the adaxial sur- face, bright red to dark red (reddish or- ange), irregularly orbicular to broadly ovate; (6.34-)6.6-7.34(-8) X (5.88-)6.27- 7.67(-7.34) mm, glabrous, many-veined, imbricate, campanulate and forming a false tube, occasionally shallowly notched at apex. Stamens 8, folded adaxially in bud, in two series, isomorphic, (9.75-)9.87- 10.75(-10.88) mm long; filaments cream, slightly tapered toward apex, 7.09-7.75 mm long, with proximal filament segment (0.69-)0.81-1.14(-1.38) mm wide, distal segment (0.56-)0.6-0.69(-0.78) mm wide; anthers yellow, (2.66-)2.72-3 (-3.16) X (0.65-)0.67-0.85(-0.88) mm, elliptic, slightly curving, opening by two longitudinal slits (1.94-)2.19-2.44(-2.54) mm long. Ovary inferior, 4-loculate, (2.35-)2.6- 3.19(-3.74) X (1.75-)1.88-2.75(-2.91) mm, lacking an apical appendage, the placentation deeply intruded axile; style cream, straight to shallowly S-shaped, glabrous, (7.6-)10-13.75(-14.75) X (0.67-) 0.81-0.95(-1.19) mm; stigma not expanded, papillose. Berries 5-7 mm diam., subglobose to globose, shiny, deep purple, juicy, with persistent calyx lobes. Seeds pyramidal, 0.70-0.95 X 0.46-0.72 mm.

description: Rhizomes short creeping, scaly; the scales 0.7-1 mm long, dark-brown, deltate, the margins glabrous. Fronds 3-4(-5) X 0.15-0.25 cm, erect; stipes often absent or to 5 X 0.3 mm, brownish, sparsely hirsute, the hairs hyaline, ca. 0.2 mm long; laminae pinnatisect, linear, papyraceous, gradually reduced at the base and apex, the basal segments decurrent on the stipe; rachises sclerenchymatous on both sides; segments 0.7- 1 X 0.7-1 mm, deltate, oblique to the rachises, the apex rounded, the margin plane or slightly revolute; indument of short, simple hyaline hairs sparsely distributed on both sides of the rachises; sinuses often narrower than the width of the segments wide; veins free, unforked, ending at the middle of the segment. Sori 1 per segment, round, superficial, having a few hyaline hairs among the sporangia.

description: Herba, foliis ovatis, subtrilobatis vel trilobatis, (4-) 6.5 - 1 2(- 14) cm longis, (2.2-)4-10(-12.5) cm latis; inflorescentiis (2-)3-multifloris; sepalis inequalibus, externis cymbiformibus, 5.4-6.5 mm longis, rotundis vel obtusis; corolla hypocrateriformi, 4.6-5.4 cm longa, alba, fauce purpurea, limbo 5-lobulato, aestivatione valvata; staminibus exsertis, antheris 6.5-7.2 mm longis, base sagittatis. McDonald próxima, sed inflorescentiis multifloris, sepalis 5.4-9 mm longis (non 5 mm vel brevioribus), corolla tubi 4.6- 6.5 cm longa (non 2.5 cm vel breviore), limbo corollae lobato (non integro), stylo et staminibus exsertis (non inclusis) differt. Planta herbácea, enredadera, de 6-10 ó más m de largo; tallo de hasta 12 mm de grueso, glabro; hojas con pecíolo (1.5-)2-8(- 10.5) cm de largo, 0.5-1 mm de grueso, glabro, la lámina ovada, subtrilobada о trilobada, (4-)6.5-12 (-14) x (2.2-)4- 10(- 12.5) cm, el ápice acuminado, apiculado, la base truncada a redondeada o subcordada, papirácea, glabra en ambas superficies, excepto en el margen ± piloso; inflorescencias en dicasios, simples o compuestos; pedúnculo primario (2.4-)10-28 cm de largo, (1.8-)2.5- 4 mm de grueso, glabro, con una bráctea parecida a las hojas pero mucho más pequeña; pedúnculos secundarios (0.4-)1.5- 4 cm de largo, 1.5-2.5(-3) mm de grueso, glabros; pedicelos 1.7-3(-4) cm de largo, 0.8-1.5 mm de grueso, glabros; flores (2-)3- 16; sépalos desiguales, los externos cimbi- formes, 5.4- 6.5 x2.5- 4(-4.5) mm, redondea- dos a obtusos en el ápice, el margen más o menos escarioso, algo carnosos a coriáceos, glabros, los internos suborbiculares a ancha- mente ovados, 7-9x4-6.5 mm, el ápice truncado a obcordado, poco escariosos en el margen, coriáceos, glabros; corola hipocra terimorfa, 4.6-5.4 cm de largo, el tubo recto, 4.3-5 cm de largo, 4-5 mm de diámetro en la base, blanco a verdoso, el limbo 5 -lobulado, los lóbulos irregulares en forma y tamaño, de color blanco, la garganta blanca a verde-amarillenta o purpúrea, la prefloración valvada; estambres exsertos, subiguales; filamentos unidos hasta más o menos 1 cm arriba de la base de la corola, glandular-pubescentes en los 8-11 mm basales, glabros en el resto, 5.3-6.4 cm de largo; anteras lanceoladas, 6.5-7.2 mm de largo, la base sagitada; ovario subcónico a ovado, de ca. 1.5 mm de largo, glabro; estilo 5.5-6.6 cm de largo, glabro, sin diferenciarse claramente del ovario; estigma bigloboso; óvulos 4, 2-2.5 mm de diámetro; finto largamente ovoide a eli- psoide, 1-1.3 cm de largo, 0.7-0.9 cm de diámetro, bilocular, 4-valvado, de color café, glabro, el ápice en forma de pico, 4.5-6 mm de largo, la base de estilo permaneciendo algún tiempo; semillas 4, triquetras, elipsoidales, 5- 7 mm de largo, los márgenes dorsales comosos, el ventral apenas con unos cuantos pelos, éstos blancos, 1-1.5 mm de largo.

description: Rhizomes short-creeping, dorsiventral, scaly; the scales 0.2 cm long, yellowish, lanceolate, ciliate on the margins and sometimes at the middle. Fronds 20-35 X 1.5- 3 cm, pendulous, with indeterminate growth; stipes 1-3(-4) X 0.05-0.1 cm, castaneous to dark-brown, with conspicuous, castaneous setae to 0.2 cm long; laminae pinnatisect, linear-lanceolate, papyraceous, gradually tapering to both ends; rachises sclerenchymatous, stramineous or slightly castaneous; segments 1.2-2.5 X 0.3-0.5 cm, linear-deltate, conspicuously symmetric at the base, perpendicular to slightly oblique to the rachises, the apex obtuse; indument of simple, castaneous setae on the stipe, rachises, laminar tissue, and segment margins, also of conspicuous, yellowish, branched hairs on the rachises and laminar tissue; sinuses often broader than the width of the segments (sometimes of equal width); veins free, 1-furcate, ending sub- marginally at the segment, inconspicuous or visible only at the segment base; hydathodes inconspicuous, lime dots lacking. Sori round, arising at the apex of the veins; sporangia conspicuously ciliate, the cilia 1-1.5X the sporangia length.

description: Rhizome compact, 2.5 mm diam.; rhizome scales linear lanceolate, dark reddish brown, lustrous, ciliate denticulate, flexuous at tip, 2-3 mm long; phyllopodia present; fronds 23-32 cm long, approximate; stipe ca. 1/6 the sterile frond length, brown; stipe scales abundant to deciduous, patent, mostly ca. 1 mm long, light brown, cilio denticulate; blade 1.8-2 cm wide, narrowly elliptic, chartaceous, apex acuminate, base narrowly cuneate; veins ca. 1 mm apart, at 70-80 angle to costa; hydathodes absent; blade glabrous adaxially, scales abaxially scattered, 0.3-5 mm long, substellate to 1 mm long lanceolate, reddish brown, cilio denticulate, 1- 1.5 mm long on margin, costal scales to 2 mm long; fertile fronds slightly shorter than the sterile, linear, 5 mm wide, stipe 1/3 the fertile frond length; intersporangial scales absent.

description: Rhizome creeping, 2-4 mm diam.; rhizome scales ca. 1 mm long, appressed, lanceolate to deltate, black, lustrous, entire; phyllopodia present; sterile fronds 22-34(-52) cm long 0.5-2cm apart; stipe 1/3 -1/2 of sterile fron length, brown, glabrous, 1mm diam; blade 3.5-5.7 (-8.7) cm wide, lanceolate, coriaceous, apex acuminate, base cuneate; veins evident, ca. 1.5 mm apart, at ca 70º angle to costa; hydathodes absent; costa prominent, glabrous on both surfaces, laminar surface glabrous on both surfaces; fertile fronds shorter than the sterile, stipe 1/2-3/4 of the fertile frond; fertile blade 1.5-4.5 x 5-15 cm, lanceolate, apex acute, base cuneate; intersporangial scales absent.

description: Rhizome compact, ca. 2 mm diam.; rhizome scales 4-6 mm long, linear-lanceolate, casta- neous to dark brown, lustrous, cilio-denticulate; phyllopodia present, 4-6 mm long, dark brown; fronds erect, 4.5-28 cm long, clumped; stipe ca. 1/10 the sterile frond length, reddish-brown; stipe scales 1.5-5 mm long, abundant especially at base, orange - tan to brown, patent, lanceolate, lustrous, ciliodenticulate; blade narrowly elliptic, 0.7- 1.5 cm wide, coriaceous, apex acuminate, base narrowly cuneate; veins evident, 1-1.5 mm apart, at 55-650 angle to costa; hydathodes absent; costa prominent, orange to castaneous; costal scales 1-2 mm long, orange-tan to dark reddish brown, lustrous, spreading to appressed, more widely scattered to sparse on adaxial surface; blade scales ca. 1 mm long, orange-tan, heavily scattered on abaxial surface, widely scattered to sparse on adaxial surface, substellate, cilio-denticulate with rays often directed upwards; fertile fronds slightly shorter to longer than the sterile, much narrower than the sterile; stipe 1/5-1/2 of fertile frond length; fertile blade linear, 3-4 mm wide, noticeably enrolled, apex attenuate, base very long decurrent; intersporangial scales absent.

description: Trunks absent; apices hidden in fascicles of petioles; adventitious buds lacking. Fronds to 0.7 m long (Fig. 4A), erect. Petioles to 20 cm long, dull dark brown to blackish, matte, sparsely muricate; scurf absent; with elliptic, brown pneumathodes to 5 x 1 mm on the sides basally; scaly only in lower third. Petiole scales to 10.0 x 2.5-3.5 mm, lanceolate (Fig. 4B), weakly shiny, concolorous auburn to deep brown to discordantly bicolorous with margins yellowish to cream-white; scales persistent only on the sides of the petioles. Laminae to 50 x 20 cm, pinnate-pinnatifid to bipinnate, long triangular to lanceolate, dark green adaxially, black when dried, gray-green abaxially, apices gradually reduced, long tapering (Fig. 4 A). Rachises inermous or sparsely verrucate, dark purpureous to castaneous, with whitish to tan, antrorsely curved or appressed, uniseriate hairs, adaxially to 1.5 mm long, abaxially 0.5-0.8(-1.0) mm long. Pinnae to 12 cm long, weakly ascend- ing, fully pinnate only in proximal half, narrowly green alate (Fig. 4 A); basal pinnae about the size of the medial pinnae, not reflexed. Costae dark purpureous to casta- neous, inermous, adaxially densely pubescent with whitish to tan, antrorsely curved, uniseriate hairs 1.0-1.5 mm long, abaxially glabrescent with shorter hairs and few brown, flattish scales with whitish, shortly fimbriate margins (Fig. 4C), most frequently in the axils; junctures of rachises and costules not swollen, each abaxially with a circular, prominent pneumathode to 1 mm diam., dark gray to black in dried specimens. Largest pinnules /ultimate segments to 1 7.0х 3.5- 4.0 mm, linear-oblong to hastate, sessile to subsessile (stalked to 0.5 mm), ca. 0.7 cm between the midveins, patent, weakly ascending, straight to distally falcate, bases cuneate to weakly cordate, tips obtuse to rounded, segment margins crenulate (Fig. 4C), often revolute when dried; segments almost glabrous or with few to many whitish to tan, erect hairs 0.5-0.8(-1.0) mm long on the veins abaxially and adaxially, none between the veins; with few brown scales on the midveins abaxially, ovate-lanceolate, flat, to 2.0x0.8 mm with weakly dentate-lacerate margins (Fig. 4D); sterile veins forked or simple, fertile veins forked (Fig. 4C). Sori 1.0-1.2 mm diam., subcostal, in vein forks; indusia hemitelioid, reaching half way around the receptacles (Fig. 4C), brown, translucent, appressed, covered completely by sori; receptacles globose to ellipsoid, 0.3-0.4 mm diam, paraphyses thin, hyaline, tan to brown, of the same length as the sporangia (0.4 mm). Spores not examined.

description: Small, short - stemmed, basally branched, annual or short- lived perennial herbs with dense white tomentum on parts of petioles, undersurfaces of leaf blades, peduncles, and margins of involucral bracts; latex lacking; single taproots to ca. 8 cm deep. Leaves crowded on short internodes, with tomentum of basal internodes and bases of lower petioles sparse; insertions of leaves opposite or subopposite, appearing loosely clustered in rosettes; petioles of larger leaves 1.2-1.5 cm long, slender from a broad and deltoid base, the basal margins flaring; laminae ovate, mostly 0.7-2.5 cm long, 0.4-1.5 cm wide, the margins slightly recurved, with irregular- sized, somewhat remote, purple, mucronate, callus denticulations from base to apex, the upper surface green, thinly tomentose to nearly glabrous, with wide-spread minute gland-like dots and often with larger purplish gland-like spots near margins and apices, the lower surface more densely whitish tomen- tose, the venation trinervate with secondary veins strongly ascending to near midblade, other secondary veins obscure. Inflorescence a corymbiform cluster of pedunculate heads; bracteoles leaf-like but smaller and mostly purple adaxially, with petioles 4-5 mm long, blades 4-6 mm long with few callose mucronate marginal denticulations; peduncles mostly 0.5-1.5 cm long, with simple, long, spreading hairs mixed with dense tomentum. Capitula heterogamous, radiate; involucres campanulate, ca. 7 mm high and wide; bracts 25-30, subimbricate in ca. 3 series, the whitish lateral margins and tips with some tomentum, with coarser spreading hairs on green or distally purplish central longitudinal band, the outer bracts 2-6 mm long, ca. 1 mm wide, linear-lanceolate, the inner bracts sub- equal, more oblong-lanceolate, 6-7 mm long, ca. 1.5 mm wide; receptacle without paleae, alveolate with sharp ridges, without hairs. Ray florets ca. 14, in 1 series; corollas pale yellow with slightly greenish basal tube and tips, the basal tube ca. 1 mm long, the lamina ca. 3.5 mm long, shortly trifid at tip, sericeous with slender hairs abaxially near tip; style without sweeping hairs. Disk florets 25- 30 corollas pale yellow, appearing rather orange because of included anthers filled with darker yellow pollen, ca. 4 mm long, the tube and throat glabrous outside, the basal tube ca. 0.7 mm long, the throat ca. 1.5 mm long, the lobes ca. 1.3 mm long, linear, distally lobes pilosulous with spreading simple and biseriate hairs; anther thecae pale, ca. 1.2 mm long, the base calcarate, inwardly curved and narrowly tapering to a slightly fringed tip; median endothecial cells oblong with elongate shields bearing pair of polarized nodes at each end; apical appendage broadly ovate, ca. 0.2 mm long; style base scarcely broadened above the short cylindrical nectary; sweeping hairs long, shortly acute, the inner surface of branches completely covered with stigmatic papillae. Achenes compressed, with 2 some- what thickened ribs, constricted above to narrow pappus and corolla insertion; raphids not evident; pappus bristles ca. 12 in a single series, highly deciduous, plumose with numerous, long, ascending, lateral hairs.

description: Epífita o terrestre; rizoma (2- )4-9 mm de diámetro, cubierto con escamas abundantes, angostamente lanceoladas a linear-lanceoladas, clatradas o subclatradas, frecuentemente iridis- centes, glabras, 1-2.5x0.3-0.8 mm, patentes, membranáceas, ápice agudo, base no auricu- lada, margen entera, castañas, ligeramente lustrosas; filopodios 0.5-2 mm de longitud. Pecíolo 1.5-3 (-5) cm de longitud, castaño, ligeramente lustroso, bordeado por un ala herbácea de ca. 0.1 mm de ancho, laxamente cubierto con pelos de 0.2-0.5 mm de longitud, castaño-rojizos, catenulados, erectos, y con pelos ctenoides escasos, suberectos; lámina pinnatisecta, linear-elíptica, 22-43(-55)x4- 7.5 cm, 7-28 veces más larga que el pecíolo, 5-10 veces más larga que ancha, membranácea, ápice agudo, base angostamente cuneada; raquis castaño, ligeramente lustroso, laxamente cubierto con pelos simples, 0.5-1 mm de longitud, erectos, castaño-rojizos; segmentos 38-73 pares, rectos, perpendiculares al raquis, los basales gradualmente reducidos, los medios linear-oblongos a angostamente oblongos, 4- 6 mm de ancho en la parte media, no imbricados, separados por una distancia menor que su ancho, apice obtuso, base sursumcurente en el tercio basal de la lamina, margen entera, tejido laminar con pelos esparcidos, romos, ca, 0.2mm de longitud, adpresos, castano rojizos; venas libres, 1- furcadas, terminadas en hidatodos claviforms evidentes, la costa perpendicular al raquis a ligeramente decurrente. Soros medios; capsulas esporangiales glabras. Esporas elipsoides, monoletes, coliculadas, no clorofilicas.

description: Habit uncertain from available material. Culms at least 4 mm in diameter, rigid, glabrous, scabrous-verruculose, the lumen about 25% of the culm diameter. Promontory poorly-developed or absent; nodal line slightly swollen, a slightly-developed supra nodal ridge present 5-6 mm above the nodal line. Branch one per node, this soon re-branching with 10-15 smaller, subequal secondary branches, these soon re-branching. Culm leaves not seen. Foliage leaves with sheaths striate, glabrous, lacking marginal fimbriae and auricles, the terminal fimbriae 2-4 mm long, fine, sparse; outer ligule 0.5 mm long; inner ligule 0.2-0.3 mm long, membranous, ciliolate; pseudopetioles 2—3 mm long, glabrous; blades 10-13 x 1 1.4 cm, linear-lanceolate, divergent-ascending (none reflexed in available material), glabrous and dark green adaxially, puberulent and glaucous abaxially except for a prom inent dark marginal stripe, the base obtuse, the apex acuminate, the margins cartilaginous and antrorsely scabrous. Peduncle 7-12 cm long. Synflorescence a few-branched, few spikeleted (3, 4, 6, and 7-spikeleted in available coflorescences), lax panicle 10—13 x 5-7 cm; branches divergent to spreading, usually subtended by a brownish, linear to lanceolate, attenuate, ciliolate bract up to 5 mm long; branches and spikelet pedicels densely puberulent with ascending to diver gent hairs; spikelet pedicels up to 3 cm long, antrorsely scabrous. Spikelets 50-55 x 3 4.5 mm, stramineous, finely puberulent throughout, the bracts all ciliolate-margined; lower glume 7-10 mm long, lanceolate, 3 nerved, tipped with a 3-6 mm long awn; upper glume 10-13 mm long, lanceolate, 7 - 11-nerved, tipped with a 3-6 mm long awn; lower floret sterile, lacking a palea, the lemma 12-16 mm long, lanceolate, 7-9 nerved, tipped with an abrupt 4-7 mm long awn; fertile florets 5-6, the lemmas 18— 21 mm long, lanceolate, 7—9(— 11)-nerved, each abruptly tipped with a 5-9 mm long awn; paleas 10-15 mm long, shorter than and concealed by the lemmas, 4-nerved, bicarinate, the keels ciliolate; apical floret reduced and sterile. Flowers with lodicules much disinte grated in the available material, ca. 2 mm long; stamens not seen; pistil not seen. Fruit (imma ture) a basic caryopsis at least 3 mm long.

description: Lonchocarpo cruento Lundell similis, a quo differt floribus (14- )15- 16 mm (nec 11-12 mm) longis, pedunculis floralibus 3-4 mm longis, gracilibus (nec 1.1-2 mm longis, crassis), pedicellis 1.5-3 mm (nec 0.8- 1.5 mm) longis, bracteolis persistentibus (nec mox caducis). Árboles 6-25(-40) m de alto, brevemente caducifolios, corteza interior con fluido resinoso ai corte; ramas jóvenes densamente pardo-amarillento tomentulosas a velutinas, posteriormente aparentemente glabrescentes a glabras. Hojas con arreglo dístico en el tallo; estípulas 3-4 mm de largo, 2-2.5 mm de ancho, ovadas, ligulares, a obovadas, caducas; pecíolo 1.5-4.5 cm, algo acanalado y estriado; hojas (13-)15-19(-21)-folioladas; folíolos (3-)6-11.5 cm de largo, (1.8-)3- 4.2 cm de ancho, lanceolados, la base redondeada, el ápice acuminado a frecuente- mente caudado, brillantes y glabros, excepto esparcidamente canescentes sobre las nerva- duras en el haz, esparcidamente canescente seríceos en el envés, subcoriáceos a coriáceos, epunteados; nervadura primaria y secundarias marcadas en el envés, nervaduras laterales 8- 11. Inflorescencias (5.5-) 10-20 cm de largo, simples, axilares, erectas, congestifloras, pedunculadas, los pedúnculos 3.5-5 cm de largo, floración tardía; pedúnculos florales 2- floros, 3-4 mm de largo, esbeltos, pedicelos 1.5-3 mm de largo; bractéolas 1.8-2 mm de largo, 2.5-3 mm de ancho, oblatas, cordatas en la base, opuestas, cercanas y aplicadas al cáliz y cubriéndolo 1/3, persistentes. Flores (14- )15- 16 mm de largo; cáliz 2.5-3 mm de largo, casi truncado, epunteado, con la superficie oculta por una densa pelosidad pardo-amarillento sericea; corola morada, epunteada, la lámina del estandarte 17-18 mm de ancho, oblata a suborbicular, moderada a densamente canes- cente sericeo adaxialmente, en el centro-base canescente peloso abaxialmente; ovario 8- ovulado, densamente pardo-amarillento sericeo. Legumbre 5-8 cm de largo cuando una semilla, 10-17 cm de largo cuando dos, tres o cuatro semillas, 20-23.5 cm de largo cuando ocho semillas, (2.6-)3.2-4.7 cm de ancho, elípticas a oblongas y linear-oblongas, indé- hiscente, casi sésil, atenuada en la base, obtusa frecuentemente rostrada en el ápice, compresa, recta a constricta entre las semillas sobre los márgenes y valvas, subleñosa a leñosa, moderada a esparcidamente canescente sericea a tomentulosa, glabrescente, el margen vexilar y carinal aquillados; semillas l-4(-8), 10-12(-14) mm de largo, 5-6.5 mm de ancho, color castaño oscuro. Plántulas con los cotiledones epigeos; eófilos opuestos, secundariamente simples, la primera hoja alterna, 1-foliolada.

description: Basally woody perennial herbs or subshrubs 0.5-1 m tall, branches brownish- green, without xylopodium. Leaves opposite; petioles 2-7 mm long; blades 3.5-9 x 1.5- 4 cm, length mostly 2 times the width, membranous, ovate to lanceolate, shortly attenuate at the base, acuminate or sometimes obtuse and mucronulate at the apex, margins serrate, adaxial surface scabridulous, the abaxial strigillose, with scattered larger tri- chomes on both faces, especially along the veins, 2 strong lateral veins above the base. Outer phyllaries 6-20 x 2-7 mm, elliptic to lanceolate, constricted at the base to panduri- form, slightly indurate at the base; inner phyllaries elliptic, slightly constricted at the middle base, then enlarged and indurate at the very base, to obovate and scarious. Paleae 5-6.5 x 1-2 mm when folded, carinate-alate, sometimes very broadly alate, with triangular tip 0.5-1 mm long. Ray florets sterile, tube 0.5-1 mm, lamina 6-12 x 3.5 - 4 mm, elliptic to oblong, glabrous, very shallowly 3-lobed. Disc florets 3-4.5 mm long, lobes sparsely setulose or glabrous abaxially. Cypselae 3-4.2 x 1.5 -2mm, thickened, subquadrangualar, densely tuberculate at maturity, wingless or with reduced wings to 0.2mm wide; pappus awnless, crown completely enfolded in corky tissue at maturity, margin entire to ciliate.

description: Liana caule, folíolo calyceque glabrescenti, calyce tubulari, corolla anguste infundibuliformi alba vel rosea, staminum filamentis glabris, gynoecii stylo pubescenti et stigmate rotundo pubescenti. Ad Lundiam erionema proxime accedit, sed calyce non calyptrato corollaque anguste infundibuliformi et stigmate rotundo recedit. Etiam ad L. corymbifera accedit, sed caule, folíolo calyceque glabrescenti, calyce tubulari et stigmate rotundo a hac recedit.

description: Liana, 3-10 m high. Young branchlets terete, striate, sparsely lenticellate, glabrous (sometimes puberulous), trichomes glandular lepidote (sometimes also simple unicellular), interpetiolar ridge absent, bark with patelliform interpetiolar glands. Prophylls broadly triangular, shortly apiculate, puberulous at the apex. Petiole 1.5-2 cm, petiolules 0.8—1.2 cm, usu ally equal (sometimes not equal) between them, glabrous (sometimes puberulous), trichomes simple multicellular and glandular lepidote. Leaves bifoliolate (sometimes trifoliolate), ten drils simple, primary venation basal actino dromous with 3(—5) veins, secondary venation brochidodromous, tertiary venation randomly reticulate, with domatia type trichome tufts in the axils of the veins, leaflets ovate (sometimes elliptic), apex short-acuminate, base cordate (sometimes rounded ) asymmetric, 6-7 cm long, 3-3.5 cm wide, margin entire (sometimes revolute), chartaceous, the abaxial surface glabrescent (sometimes puberulous at the margin), the adaxial surface glabrescent, the trichomes on the both laminar surfaces simple multicellular and glandular lepidote, patelliform glands evenly distributed on the laminar surface. Inflorescence terminal or axillary, a conical dichasium, with two orders, first order 0.5-1.2 cm, second order 0.2-0.4 cm, floral pedicel 0.3-0.5 cm, axis of the inflorescence glabrescent, trichomes glandular lepidote, bracts of the inflores cence persistent, narrow triangular, 1.8 2.5 mm, not apiculate, floral bracts broadly triangular, 0.3-1 mm long. Calyx 4-6 mm when open, 3-4 mm wide, tubular, pale green to pale yellow, shortly apiculate, lobes 0.2-0.5 mm long, the calyx base and apex chartaceous, calyptrate, the aper ture transverse, glands patelliform. Corolla 3-4.2 cm long, 0.9-1.3 cm wide at the opening of the tube, white outside (some times pale pink) and yellow inside, the tube narrow infundibuliform 2.2—2.5 cm long, lobes straight (sometimes crenulate), the upper lobes 0.7-0.9 x 0.8-1.2 cm, the apex of the upper lobes rounded (sometimes shortly acuminate) and the lower lobes rounded, internally glabrous at the top of the tube, velutinous to villous at the base, trichomes glandular capitate long- and short stalked, with pale pink nectar guides, trichomes on the nectar guides glandular capitate, short stalked. Stamens attached at the same height from the base of the corolla, 0.3-0.5 cm from the base, shorter filaments 0.8-0.9 cm long, longer filaments 1.3-1.5 cm long, the filaments glabrous, the staminode 0.3-1.6 mm (sometimes not visible), placed at 0.2-0.3 cm from the base, glabrous (sometimes puberulous at the apex), anthers 2-3 mm, white when fresh, villous. Pistil 2-2.3 cm, the ovary cylindri cal, 1.9-2.4 mm long, 0.9-1 mm wide, four series of ovules per locule, style 2-2.2 cm, completely puberulous, the stigma round, completely puberulous. Fruit unknown.

description: Ab Alsophila erinacea (H. Karst.) D. S. Conant et Alsophila cuspidata (Kunze) D. S. Conant squamis petiolorum lanceolatis atrobrunneis costisque abaxia- liter abundante et persistente pilosis (vs. squamis linealo-lanceolatis pallide brunneis costisque abaxia- liter glabrescentibus vel parce pilosis), ab Alsophila engelii R. M. Tryon et Alsophila minervae Lehnert in presentía pilorum persistentium indusiis (vs. absentia pilorum persistentium indusiis) absentiaque alarum in parte distale pinnarum differt. Trunks to 4 m high, 4 cm diam., otherwise unknown. Fronds of unknown dimensions, presumably 2-3 m long, patent to arching. Petioles 27-56 cm long, basally dark brown to blackish, distally paler brown to dark stramineous, with persistent scales and scurf of appressed lacerate squamules; aphlebiae or skeletonized basal pinnae absent. Petiole scales to 7 X 2 mm, lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, with differentiated margins of differently orientated cells, dark brown with somewhat paler margins with only one dark apical setae to 1 mm, no or few marginal setae, concolorous (Fig. 1A), of variable texture, larger scales papery, smaller ones firm, intergrading with scurf squamules and marginate squaminate spines to 6 mm long, black, with broad bases and acuminate, curved tips. Laminae to ca. 130 cm broad, broadly ovate, bipinnate-pinnatifid, opaque dark green adaxially, opaque pale green abaxially, apices abruptly reduced, non-conform to conform, i.e., pinna-like (Fig. 1С). Rachises and costae brown to dark stramineous, inermous, abaxially with fugacious flattish brown squamules to 0.5 mm long, white pericellular hairs to 1.5 mm long at least on distal parts, adaxially more abundant than abaxially, insertions of costae into rachises slightly raised abaxially, bearing a lunular, flat to concave blackish pneumathode to 5x2.5 mm. Pinnae to 65 cm long, stalked to 1.5 cm, not green-alate distally; basal ones reduced, more ore less patent. Largest pinnules to 10.5x1.8 cm, sessile, truncate basally, attenuate apically (Fig. ID); costules stramineous to tan abaxially and adaxially, with flat brown, setate scales to 1 mm long, no búllate scales present, with white to tan pluricellular hairs to 1 .5 mm long abaxially and adaxially, abaxially denser and less spreading than abaxially (Fig. IE); seg- ments to 10x2.5 mm, adnate, sessile, weakly ascending, straight (Fig. IE) to weakly falcate, the margins subentire to weakly crenate basally in the proximal segments, flat in sterile and fertile segments; midveins weakly protruding adaxially and adaxially, with white pluricellular hairs identical to those on the costules (Fig. IE), fertile veins forked once, rarely twice, sterile ones forked to simple (Fig. IE), hardly discern- able adaxially, dark gray abaxially, glabrous on both sides (Fig. IE). Sori to 0.8 mm diam., 1-3 per segment, costal, in vein forks (Fig. IE); indusia urceolate to subsphaeropteroid, either irregularly or not rupturing at maturity, firm, lustrous dark brown to tan, with persistent pluricellular hairs to 0.6 mm long (Fig. IE), receptacles 0.2-0.3 mm diam., columellar, black, paraphyses much shorter than the spor- angia, 0.1-0.2 mm long, blackish to tan. Spores not examined.

description: Trunks absent; rhizome apices hidden fascicles of petioles. Fronds to 150 presumably arching or pendent from (Fig. 5A). Petioles 40 cm long, probably more (Fig. 5 A), weakly shiny, castaneous to atropurpureous, basally blackish, inermous, without pneumathodes, only sparsely scaly in lower half, with sparse scurf consisting of appressed, strongly dissected squamules and tortuous hairs, apparently ephemeral. scales to 18.0x2.5-3.0 mm, lanceolate, almost concolorous, dark auburn to brown with paler brown to yellowish margins, long attenuate, bases round to cordate, pseudopeltately attached (Fig. 5B); differentiated margins narrow, with cells strongly exerted, with teeth or short cilia to 0.5 mm long, without setae. Laminae to 150x60-70 cm, ovate- lanceolate (Fig. 5 A), bipinnate-pinnatifid, green to dark green adaxially, blackish when dried, pale gray-green abaxially, apices grad- ually reduced, tapering. Rachises inermous, dark castaneous to purpureous, densely hairy with tan to brown, antrorsely curved, uniseriate hairs to 1.5 mm long adaxially, with white, cobwebby, tortuous hairs to 2.0 mm long abaxially, glabrescent. Pinnae to 14 cm long, patent, alternate to subopposite, stalked to 1 .2 cm, distally not or very narrowly green alate, the distal segments not decurrent; basal pinnules nearly the size of the medial pinnae, not reflexed. Costae dark brown, inermous, to 1.0(- 1.5) mm wide, adaxially with tan to brown, antrorsely curved, uniseriate hairs to 1.5 mm long, abaxially glabrescent with white scurf of tortuous hairs (Fig. 5C) and few tan to brown, flattish scales with undu- late, fimbriate to short-ciliate margins, most frequent in the axils; insertions of costae and rachises not or only abaxially weakly swollen, each with a planar, elliptic pneumathode to 2.3 X 1.5 mm, blackened in dried material. Largest pinnules to 3.8x1.0 cm, lanceolate, sessile (Fig. 5A), 1.0-1.5 cm between the costules, bases truncate to weakly rounded, tips long-acute to attenuate, pinnatifid to pinnatisect, basal segments never remote; costules adaxially prominent, ridged, with antrorsely curved, white, pluricellular, uniseriate hairs to 1.0 mm, abaxially densely covered with white, tortuous hairs to 2 mm long and some tan to brown, subclathrate, ovate-lanceolate scales to 2.0-3.0 x 1.5- 2.0 mm with fimbriate to ciliate margins; segments to 9.0-12.0 x 2.5-5.0 mm, weakly ascending, straight, the sinuses acute, to 0.5(- 1.0) mm wide, segment tips obtuse to rounded, segment margins crenulate, revo- lute, the basiscopical margins of the lowest segments not differently incised (Fig. 5C); segments with few to many deciduous, whitish, contorted, catenate hairs to 2.0 mm long, mainly abaxially and along the margins; lateral veins planar on both sides or weakly raised adaxially, blackish to carnose, with few persistent, brown, erect hairs to 1.2 mm long, not between the veins; sterile veins forked or simple, fertile veins forked. Sori to 1.0 mm diam., subcostal to costal, in vein forks, yellowish brown at maturity; indusia sphaer- opteroid, tan to dull brown, fragile, often fragmented to a cup or disc; receptacles globose, 0.3-0.4 mm diam, paraphyses thin, hyaline, white to tan, of the same length as the sporangia (0.4 mm). Spores not examined.

description: This species was described as being exindusiate and consequently classified as a species of the genus Trichipteris by Tryon (Tryon & Stolze, 1989). The presence of indusia would have necessitated its transference to Cyathea as defined by Tryon (1970, 1976) despite the fact that both genera had already been merged to Cyathea (Lellinger, 1987). The new combination Cyathea serpens was already published in the comparison with a newly described species (Lehnert, 2009b). An amended description of C. serpens seems appropriate in the context of its new taxonomie status and the additional collections that brought new information of about its morphol- ogy and distribution. Trunkless; rhizome apices hidden in fascicles of petioles; adventitious buds not reported and presumably lacking. Fronds to 7 m long, pendent from banks or trailing over adjacent vegetation. Petioles 70-200 cm long, probably longer, shiny, castaneous to atropurpureous, basally blackish, inermous, with dense, matted, white scurf consisting of appressed, strongly dissected squamules and tortuous marginal hairs, often abraded in older material; without pneumathodes, only scatteredly scaly in lower half. Petiole scales to 11.0(-15.0 )х 3.5 - 1.0(-5.0) mm, lanceolate, discordantly bicolorous, brown to dark brown or blackish with white margins (Fig. 6 A); differentiated margins to 0.6 mm wide, cell rows strongly exserted, without cilia or setae. Laminae 150-500x70-120 cm, long-triangular to lanceolate, bipinnate-pinnatifid to partly tripinnate, green to dark green adaxially, often becoming blackish when dried, pale gray- green abaxially, apices gradually reduced. Rachises inermous, dark castaneous to atropurpureous, densely pubescent with whitish to tan, cobwebby hairs to 2 mm long, abaxially often glabrescent. Pinnae to 35 cm long, patent (Fig. 6B), alternate to subopposite, stalked to 2.5-3.0 cm, distally green alate, the distal segments not decurrent into the costae; basal pinnae nearly the size of the medial pinnae, weakly reflexed. Costae and costules dark castaneous to atroprurpureous, inermous, to 2 mm broad, adaxially with tan to brown, antrorsely curved, pluricellular, uniseriate hairs to 1.5 mm long, abaxially glabrescent with white to tan scurf and few bright orange-brown flattish scales with undulated, fimbriate margins, most frequently in the axils. Pinnules to 5.5-10.5x1.5-3.0 cm, long triangular to lanceolate, stalked to 4 mm (Fig. 6B, C), 1.5-2.0 cm between the stalks, bases truncate to weakly cordate, tips long acute to attenuate, pinnatifid to pinnatisect, basal segments sometimes remote, connected by thin strands of laminar tissue; segments to 9.0-15.0 x 2.5 - 5.0 mm, weakly ascending, straight to distally falcate, the sinuses acute to obtuse, to 1-5 mm wide, the tips obtuse to rounded, segment margins crenulate to inciso-dentate, the basiscopical margins of the lowest segments often more strongly incised; costules planar to weakly protruding abaxially, ridged adaxially, yellowish to dark carnose, with many curved brown hairs to 1.2 mm long adaxially, glabrous abaxially, with broadly ovate, flat squamules to 3.0 x 2.5 mm, and búllate squamules to 2.5 x 1.0 mm, with fimbrate tips, tan to orange- brown, often with the thin margins paler brown to whitish, fimbriate to lacerate; segments with few to many deciduous, whitish, contorted, catenate hairs to 2.0 mm long, mainly abaxially and along the margins; veins planar to weakly immersed, yellowish to carnose, adaxially with few brown, erect hairs to 1.2 mm long, not between the veins; abaxially glabrous or with few trichomidia; sterile veins forked or simple, fertile veins forked. Sori to 1.2 mm diam., subcostal to costal, in fork of veins (Fig. 6C), yellowish brown to dark orange-brown at maturity; indusia hemitelioid, small, appressed, tan to dull brown, with entire margins (Fig. 6D) or with one or two marginal cilia, fragile and evanescent; receptacles globose, 0.4-0.5 mm diam. (Fig. 6D), paraphyses thin, hyaline, white to tan, longer than sporangia (0.4-0.5 mm). Spores tetrahedral-globose, dark orange-brown.

description: Árboles 7-15(-25) m de alto; corteza interior con abundante fluido resinoso al corte; ramas jóvenes pardo-amarillento tomentulosas, posteriormente glabras. Hojas con arreglo dístico en el tallo; estípulas 1.5- 2 mm de largo, triangulares a ligulares, caducas; pecíolo 2.5-3.8 cm de largo, terete, estriado; hojas 7-9-folioladas; folíolos (3.4-) 4-8(-10.5) cm de largo, (1.9-)2.5- 4.8 cm de ancho, elípticos, oblongos, algo oblanceolados, la base ligeramente cuneada a obtusa, el ápice acuminado, ligeramente brillantes y glabrescentes, excepto ligeramente canescente tomentulosos sobre las nervaduras en el haz, moderadamente canescente seríceos en el envés, cartáceos a subcoriáceos, epunteados; nervadura primaria y secundarias algo realzadas en el envés, nervaduras laterales 9- 12. Inflorescencias (7-)14-17.5 cm de largo  simples, axilares, erectas a patentes, congesti- floras, pedunculadas, el pedúnculo 2.2-5 cm de largo; floración coetánea; pedúnculos florales 2- floros, 2.5- 4 mm de largo, esbeltos; pedicelos 1-1.5 mm de largo; bractéolas 1-1.2 mm de largo, suborbiculares, opuestas, cercanas y aplicadas al cáliz cubriéndolo en un 1/4, caducas. Flores 11-11.5 mm de largo; cáliz ca. 4 mm de largo, ciatiforme, casi truncado, epunteado, pardo-amarillento sericeo; corola malva, morada, lila oscuro, epunteada, la lámina del estandarte 10-13 mm de ancho, suborbicu- lar a oblata densamente canescente sericea adaxialmente, en el centro-base canescente sericea prolongándose a la uña abaxialmente, la uña ca. 1.1 mm de largo, robusta; ovario 7-8- ovulado, densamente pardo-amarillento sericeo. Legumbre 4-5.5 cm de largo cuando una semilla, ca. 8.5 cm cuando dos semillas, ca. 11.5 cm cuando tres semillas, 3.2-3.8 cm de ancho, anchamente elíptica a oblonga, indéhiscente, sésil, a algo atenuada en la base, obtusa y algo rostrada en el ápice, compresa y constricta entre las semillas sobre los márgenes, leñosa, moderada a densamente pardo-amarillenta a canescente tomentosa, el margen vexilar y carinal aquillados; semillas 1- 2(-3), 12- 15 mm de largo, 6.5-8.3 mm de ancho, 3.5- 4.3 mm de grueso, castaño oscuro a neguzcas.

description: Lonchocarpo aequatoriali M. Sousa similis, sed differì stipulis 2-2.5 mm (nee 1-5-2 mm) longis, inflorescentiis pendulis (nee erectis vel patentibus), pedúnculo 1.5-2.2 cm (nee 2.2-5 cm) longo, pedúnculo florali 1-1.5 mm longo, crasso (nec 2.5-4 mm longo, gracili), pedicellis 2.5-3.5 mm (nec 1-1.5 mm) longis, lamina vexilli 9-9.5 mm (nec 10-13 mm) lata, legumine 2-2.4 cm lato, coriaceo, moderate tomentoso (nec 3.2- 3.8 cm lato, lignoso, moderate vel dense tomentoso). Árboles ca. 7 m de alto; corteza interior con fluido resinoso al corte; ramas jóvenes densamente pardo-amarillento tomentulosas, posteriormente glabrescentes. Hojas con arreglo dístico en el tallo, estípulas 2-2.5 mm de largo, oblongas, pronto caducas; pecíolo 2.3- 3 cm de largo, terete, algo estriado; hojas (7-) 9-folioladas; folíolos 6.5-11 cm de largo, (2.7-)4-5 cm de ancho, los proximales opuestos, elípticos a elíptico-lanceolados, cartáceos a subcoriáceos, epunteados, en el haz algo lustrosos y glabros, en el envés moderadamente pardo-amarillento tomentulosos, mas densamente sobre las nervaduras, en la base de cuneada a obtusa, en el ápice acuminado en ocasiones largo acuminado; nervadura primaria y secundarias impresas en el envés, nervaduras laterales 6-11. Inflorescencias 8- 10.5(-15) cm de largo, péndulas, pedunculadas, el pedúnculo 1.5-2.2 cm de largo; congestifloras; floración coetánea; pedúnculos florales 2-floros, 1-1.5 mm de largo, robustos; pedicelos 2.5-3.5 mm de largo, esbeltos; bractéolas 1-1.1 mm suborbiculares, opuestas, cercanas al cáliz y cubrién- dolo en un 1/3 de su longitud, prontocaducas. Flores 10.5 -11 mm de largo; caliz 3-3.2 mm de largo, ciatiforme, casi truncado, epunteado, pardo-amarillento sericeo; corola morada; pétalos canescente seríceos, la lámina del estandarte 9-9.5 mm de ancho, suborbicular, densamente sericea adaxialmente y en la base central y una abaxialmente, la uña ca. 2 mm de largo; ovario 7-9-ovulado. Legumbre 3.5^4.2 cm de largo cuando una semilla, 6.8-8 cm de largo cuando dos semillas, 2-2.4 cm de ancho, elíptica a oblonga, indéhiscente, aplanada, coriácea, constricta sobre los márgenes entre las semillas, corto atenuada en la base, obtusa y rostrada en el ápice, moderadamente canescente a pardo-amarillenta tomentosa, el margen vexilar y carinal aquillados; semillas 1-2, ca. 13.1 mm de largo, ca. 6- 8 mm de ancho, ca. 3.5 de grueso, castano oscuro, negruzcas.

description: A congeneribus diversa pedunculis floralibus 3-5 -floris, (2-)3-7 mm longis, gracilibus, pedicellis 1.5-2.5 mm longis, gracilibus, bracteolis ca. 2 mm longis, oblongis, suborbicularibus, floribus 13-15 mm longis, calyce et petalis lineari-punctatis translucentibus, legumine 3.7- 3.9 cm lato, coriaceo vel suberoso, seminibus 14.1- 16.5 mm longis, nigricantibus. Árboles 3-7 m de alto; corteza interior con abundante fluido resinoso rojizo al corte; ramas cinéreas a pardo-amarillento tomentu- losas, pronto glabrescentes, con lenticelas elípticas, color crema. Hojas con arreglo dístico en el tallo; estípulas 1-1.1 mm de largo, liguladas a suborbiculares, pronto caducas; pecíolo 3-4 cm de largo, terete, estriado; hojas 7- 9-folioladas; folíolos (3.5-) 5-9.5(-ll) cm de largo, (2.4-)3-4.2(-5.5) cm de ancho, los proximales opuestos, elípticos, lanceolados, subcoriáceos a coriáceos, epun- teados, en el haz lustrosos y glabros, en el envés esparcidamente pardo-amarillento sericeos, mas densamente sobre las nervaduras, la base obtusa a ligeramente cuneada, el ápice acuminado a largo acuminado; nervadura primaria y secundarias realzadas en el envés, nervaduras laterales 7-10. Inflorescencias (7-) 12- 19 cm de largo, largamente pedunculadas, el pedúnculo (2.5-)5-7.5(-8) cm de largo; flores espaciadas a lo largo del pedúnculo; floración tardía; pedúnculos florales 3- 5-floros, (2-)3-7 mm de largo, esbeltos; pedicelos 1.5-2.5 mm de largo, esbeltos; bractéolas ca. 2 mm de largo, 1.5-2 mm de ancho, oblongas, suborbiculares, opuestas, cercanas al cáliz y cubriéndolo en un 1/3 de su longitud, eventualmente caducas. Flores 13-15 mm de largo; cáliz 4-4.5 mm de largo, ciatiforme, casi trunco, pardo-amarillento sericeo, translúcido linear-punteado; corola rosa púrpura; pétalos canescente seríceos, lineado-punteado translúcidos, la lámina del estandarte 12-15.5 mm de ancho, densamente canescente sericea adaxialmente, en la base central y uña canescente sericea y plegado-callosa abaxialmente, la uña 3- 4 mm de largo; ovario 9-ovulado. Legumbre 4.8-5 cm de largo cuando una semilla, 7-8 cm de largo cuando dos semillas, 3.7 - 3.9 cm de ancho, eliptica a oblonga, aplandada, coriacea a algo suberosa, corto atenuada en la base, obtusa y rostradad en el apice, densamente pardoamarillento tomentosa, el margen vexilar y el carinal aquillados; semillas 1-2(-3), 14.1 - 16. 5 mm de largo, 7.5 - 8.4 mm de ancho, 3.8 - 4.1 mm de grueso, negruzcas.

description: Herba volubilis, caulibus glabrescentibus, cortice tenui pallide stramineo, longitudinaliter striata, in sicco fragili et separabili. Petiolis adpresse puberulis, 4.5-7 cm longis; lamina ex ovato deltoidea, basi cordata vel subcordata, apice acuminato 6.8-13.4 cm longa, 5.3 9.9 cm lata, supra glabriuscula, subtus adpresse puberula. Inflorescentia axillaris, cymosa, (l)2-4-flora, 5-11.9 longa, bracteis glabns subulatis patentibus vel expansis 4-8 mm longis, 0.8-1.5 mm latis subtendentibus. Sepala leviter obovata. apiculata. chartacea, adpresse puberula, 2.3-3.1 cm longa apiculum carinatum 1 mm longum includentia. Corolla subinfundibuliformis. e pallide luteo dilute aurantiaca, membrariacea, 7.1-7.3 cm longa, sparse puberula; tubo crassiore; limbo satis parvo, 2.3 cm longo. Androecium inclusum; staminibus 3.1 4 cm longis, antheris 0.9-1.1 cm longis. Fructus subglobosi, rostrati. coriacei, dehiscentia valvari septicida. 2.2-2.7 cm longi. apiculum 1.5-2.5 mm longum mclu dentes. Semina ca. 3 cm longa, comosa; corpora seminis tetrahedrico, subreniformi, fiisco, 1 cm longo, 0.5 cm lato. tomentoso; coma sericea usque 1.4 cm longa, brunneo cuprea, conspicua, secus marlines seminis disposita.

description: Twining liana. Stems terete, glabrescent; bark slender, cream-colored, longitudinally striate, fragile and detachable at dry material. Leaves simple, glabrous; petiole terete, 4.5-7 cm long, sparingly adpressed puberulous; leaf blades ovate to deltoid, base of leaf blade cordate to subcordate, and apex acuminate, 6.8-13.4x 5.3-9.9 cm, nervation prominulous on both sides; upper surface adpressed glabrescent except along the base, where adpressed puber ulous; main nerve, secondary and tertiary nerves of undersurface adpressed puberulous, densely so toward the base. Inflorescences axillary, cymose, (1-)2-4 flowered, 5-11.9 cm long; peduncles 1.1-2.3(-8.1) cm long, arched, sparingly adpressed puberulous, with the same bark as the stem; pedicels 1.1-2.4(-4.2) cm long, straight, adpressed-puberulous, subtended by subulate, glabrous bracts, the apex of the bracts hardened and revolute, patent or extended. 4-8x0.8-1.5 mm. Flowers 7.2 - 7.6 x 1.7-2.3 cm. Sepals slightly obovate, culate, subcoriaceous, adpressed puberulous toward the base and glabrescent toward apex, 2.3-3.1 cm long including the apiculum (ca. 1 mm long); external sepal 2.7-3.1 cm the inner ones progressively shorter. Corolla subinfundibuliform, yellow-creamy to pale orange, membranous, 7.1-7.3 cm long, spar ingly puberulous; tube relatively thick, 4.8 long; limbs relatively small, 2.3 cm long. Androecium included; stamens 3.1 -4 cm anthers 0.9-1.1 cm long. Pollen grains apolar, spheroidal, echinate, 94.15-114.28 µm in diam eter, pantoporate, pore number 56-84; pore circular, operculate, 6.3-8.76 µm in diameter; exine 5.28-9.04 µm thick, sexine about as thick as nexine (sexine 2.36-4.85 pm thick, nexine 2.76-4.91 µm thick); tectum nanogranulose, with nanospinules; spines broad at base, ually tapering towards the apex, with blunt apices and basal cushions; spine length 7.37 - 10.75 µm, breadth at base 4.86-6.59 pm and apex 1.53-2.79 pm. Fniits subglobose, rostrate, coriaceous, brown with valvate-septicidal cence, 2.2-2.7 cm long including an apiculum 1.5-2.5 mm long, subtended by concrescent sepals, which are subequal and 3.1-3.6 cm including a keeled apiculum ca. 1.5 cm long. Seeds approx. 3 cm long, comose; body of seed tetrahedral, subreniform, blackish brown, 1 x 0.5 cm, tomentose; coma silky, hairs to 1.4 cm long, coppery brown, conspicuous, arranged along the margins of the seed.

description: Sufratice de 10-50 cm de alto, erecto, con raices leñosas, pivotantes, desarrolladas. Ta llos basales leñosos densamente ramificados, subcilíndncos, apicales verdosos herbáceos, pubescentes; entrenudos 5—15 mm de largo. Vaina estipular 0.3-0.4 mm de largo, pubes cente, con 5-7 lacinias subiguales, de 0.2— 0.4 mm de largo, glabras. Hojas 3—5 x 0.3— 0.5 mm, sésiles, lineares o linear lanceoladas, crasas, rígidas, glabras, ápice acuminado, base atenuada. Inflorescencias parciales sub esféricas, de 0.5-1.4 mm de ancho, apicales y axilares, 5-8 glomérulos por rama florífera, 3 brácteas foliáceas, patentes. Flores sésiles; hipanto turbinado, glabro o con escasos pelos en el ápice; cáliz 2-lobado, lóbulos de 3— 3.5 mm de largo, lineares, acuminados, glabros, con 2-3 dentículos intercalares glan dulares, con tubo ausente; corola 5-6.5 mm de largo, infundibuliforme, blanca, externa mente pubérula, internamente con anillo de pelos moniliformes cerca de la base; estam bres exertos, de la misma longitud que los lóbulos de la corola; anteras de 0.6-0.8 mm de largo, blanquecinas; estilo 6-7 mm de largo; estigma bífido, papiloso. Cápsula obo voide o inversamente piriforme, glabra o con escasos pelos en el ápice; valvas coronadas por los lóbulos del cáliz; semillas 0.65 0.75 mm de largo, elipsoides, cara ventral surcada con estrofiolo persistente, cara dorsal convexa, castaño-oscuro, testa retículo foveada.

description: Species Staeliae virgatae (Link ex. Roem. & Schult.) K. Schum. próxima, sed foliis ternatis, quam brachyblastis minoribus (non foliis oppositis, pseudo verticillatis, 1.5-2.5-plo brachyblastis longioribus), capsula subsphaerica (non ellipsoidea vel obovata) differt. Sufrútice de 30-60 cm de alto, erecto, con raíces pivotantes desarrolladas. Tallos basal mente ramificados, cuadrangulares, verdosos, pubescentes; entrenudos 5-10 cm de largo. Vaina estipular glabrescente, con 3(-5) lacinias, uno mayor de 0.9-1 mm, dos menores de 0.15 0.25 mm de largo, glabras. Hojas 10-15 x 1.5— 2 mm, sésiles, lineares o linear-lanceoladas, papiráceas, glabras, nervios secundarios incon spicuos, ápice acuminado, base atenuada. Inflorescencias parciales subesféricas, de 5— 12 mm de ancho, apicales y axilares, 10-30 por rama florífera, 3 brácteas foliáceas, aplicadas hacia el eje de la inflorescencia; bractéolas filiformes glandulares. Flores sésiles; hipanto subesférico a obovoide, pubescente; cáliz 2 lobado, lóbulos de 1.5-2.3 mm de largo, angostamente triangulares, acuminados, gla brescentes, con 2-3 dentículos intercalares glandulares, tubo calicino 0.2-0.3 mm de largo; corola 5.5-7 mm de largo, infundibuliforme, blanca, externamente pubérula, internamente con un anillo de pelos moniliformes cerca de la base; estambres exertos, de la misma longitud que los lóbulos de la corola; anteras de 0.8 0.9 mm de largo, blanquecinas; estilo 6-7.5 mm de largo; estigma bítido, papiloso. Cápsula subesférica, pilosa; valvas coronadas por los lóbulos; semillas 0.7-0.8 mm de largo, obo voide, cara ventral surcada con estrofiolo persis tente, cara dorsal convexa, castaño-oscuras; testa retículo-foveadas.

description: Plants fruticose to 2 m tall; stems subquadrangular, glabrous; leaves oblong-elliptic, the blade 13-23 cm long, 4.5-7 cm wide, glabrous, cystoliths present and numerous on both surfaces, the margin obscurely crenate with an acuminate apex and attenuate base, the petiole 0.7-1.5 cm long, glabrous; inflorescence a terminal raceme or rarely a single-branched panicle (6) 9-21 cm long with up to 4 flowers in fascicles along the glabrous rachis, the pedicel 3-6 mm long, glabrous, the bracts and bractlets similar, subulate, 1.5-2 mm long, 0.5-1 mm wide at the base, with a few hairs along the margin; calyx segments narrowly triangular, 2 mm long, 0.5 mm wide at the base, glabrous except for a few hairs along the margin; corolla yellow, glabrous, tubular, 1.8-2.5 cm long, the tube 2-2.5 mm wide at the base, 5 mm wide at the throat, the upper lip with the ovate lobes 1.5-2 mm long, 1.5 mm wide at the base, the lower lips with the ovate or rarely elliptic lobes 4-5 mm long, 2 mm wide at the base; stamens extended to the edge of the corolla lobes or exserted just beyond, the filament 11 mm long, glabrous, the anther 2.5- 3 mm long; staminodes 1-2 mm long, apically capitate, glabrous; pistil included, the stigma 2-lobed, glabrous, the style 18-25 mm long, glabrous; ovary glabrous; capsules clavate, 1.8-2 cm long, 3 mm wide, 2 mm thick, 2-4-seeded.

description: Herba, caulibus erectis vel ascendentibus, subquadrangularibus, glabris vel parce puberulis; foliorum lamina lanceolato-ovata vel elliptica, aliquanto graciliter acuminata, basi cuneata, utrinque glabra vel subtus in costa inconspicue strigosa; paniculae longae, angustae, laxae, bracteis ultimis triangulari-subulatis, rhachidi et rachillis parce pilosis, pilis glandulosis; pedicelli puberuli; calycis segmenta lineari-lanceolata, glabra praeter aliquot pilis ad apices; corolla rubra, glabra, tubo basi angusto, supra abrupte dilatato, in fauce leviter angustato, labio superiore ovato, erecto, rotundato, labio inferiore apice trilobato, lobis suborbicularibus, obtusis; stamina exserta, glabra, antheris linearibus, utrinque muticis; ovarium glabrum.

description: Ascending herb, 0.5-0.8 m tall; stems subquadrangular, glabrous or sparingly puberulous, cystoliths inconspicuous; leaf blades lance-ovate to elliptic, 7-14 cm long and 2.5-4 cm wide, rather slenderly acuminate at tip, cuneate at base or the smaller uppermost blades rounded to obtuse, rather thin, entire or undulate, both surfaces glabrous except costa of the lower surface inconspicuously strigose, costa, lateral veins (6 or 7 pairs) and veinlets prominent beneath, rather obscure above, cystoliths conspicuous under magnification; petioles 0.2-1.5 cm long, sparingly appressed-pilose, cystoliths minute, numerous and parallel; flowers borne axillary and terminal in long narrow lax panicles, 5-15 cm long and 2.5-8 cm broad, the small triangular-subulate bracts 3 mm long, 0.75 mm wide at base, gradually intergrading into the stem leaves; rachis and rachilla sparingly glandular-pilose, pedicels 2 mm long, puberulous; bracts subtending flowers linear-subulate, 2 mm long, 0.25 mm wide, glabrous, cystoliths minute, conspicuous; calyx green, 4 mm long, glabrous except for a few minute acute hairs at tips of segments, these linear- lanceolate, 3.5 mm long and 0.75 mm wide at base, bearing numerous minute cystoliths conspicuous under a lens; corolla bright red, 1.8-1.9 cm long, glabrous, tube 1.5 mm broad at base, at 4 mm above base enlarged to 5.5 mm, 3 mm broad at throat, lips subequal, 3 mm long, upper lip erect, ovate, 4 mm broad, rounded, lower lip 3-lobed, lobes spreading, suborbicular, 2 mm long and 3 mm broad, obtuse; stamens exserted 1 cm beyond mouth of corolla, glabrous; anthers 3.5 mm long, 1 mm thick, muticous at both ends; pollen 2-porate, subspheroidal, 50 x 48 jtm, exine spinulose, spinulae widely spaced (Fig. 3); style exserted 7 mm beyond mouth of corolla, stigma minute; ovary glabrous; capsule not seen.

description: Suffrutex, caulibus ascendentibus, subquadrangularibus, glabris, puberulis vel pilosulis; foliorum lamina elliptica vel anguste ovata, graciliter acuminata, basi cuneata, utrinque modice puberula, piuis praecipue in costa et venis lateralibus positis; paniculae terminales et axillares, laxae, bracteis ramos panicularum subtendentibus foliaceis, anguste ovatis, sessilibus vel subsessilibus, rhachidi dense puberulo vel pilosi, pilis aliquando glandulosis, bracteis ultimis lineari-subulatis vel lineari-lanceolatis; calycis segmenta purpurea lineari-lanceolata, glabra vel pilosa; corolla purpurea, basi rubra, glabra, tubo basi angusto, supra abrupte dilatato, in fauce leviter angustato, labiis erectis subaequalibus, labio superiore ovato, labio inferiore apice trilobato, lobis ovatis, acutis vel obtusis; stamina exserta, purpurea, glabra, antheris purpureis.

description: Suffrutescent, 1-3 m tall; stems ascending, subquadrangular, glabrous, puberulous or sparingly pilosulous, especially towards tip, cystoliths inconspicuous, punctiform; leaf blades elliptic to narrowly ovate, 6-11 cm long and 2.5-4.5 cm wide, rather slenderly acuminate at tip, cuneate at base, moderately firm, entire or undulate, both surfaces moderately pubescent, the hairs erect or ascending above, rather appressed or flaccid below, confined especially to costa and lateral veins (8-10 pairs), these and the veinlets prominent both above and below, cystoliths minute, inconspicuous, subpunctiform; petioles 0.2-1 cm long and 1 mm thick, densely pubescent, the hairs appressed or spreading; flowers borne in lax terminal and axillary panicles, these 7-15 cm long and 3-6 cm wide, bracts subtending branches of panicles leaf-like, narrowly ovate, sessile or subsessile, lowermost pair 2-2.5 cm long and 1.2-1.5 cm wide, becoming gradually smaller towards tip of panicle, all acute at apex, pubescence similar to that of stem leaves, rachis densely puberulous or pilose, the hairs erect or ascending, sometimes bearing a few hairs tipped by conical elongated purplish glands, rachilla and pedicels (to 4 mm long and 0.25 mm thick) glabrous to densely pilosulous, bracts subtending flowers linear-subulate to linear-lanceolate, 2.5-3.5 mm long, 0.3-0.8 mm wide, glabrous to sparingly pilose; calyx purple, 5-6.5 mm long, glabrous or pilose, segments linear-lanceolate, 4.5-5.5 mm long and 0.8 mm wide at base, cystoliths inconspicuous, punctiform; corolla purple, base red, 1.4-2 cm long, glabrous, tube 1 mm broad at base, abruptly enlarged to 2.25 mm above base, 7-12 mm broad at middle and gradually narrowed to 4-5 mm at throat, lips subequal, upper lip erect or slightly spreading, ovate, 2.5-3 mm long and 3 mm broad, acute, obtuse or retuse, lower lip 3-lobed, lobes spreading, ovate, 2 mm long and 2.5-3 mm broad, acute to obtuse; stamens purple, exserted 0.8-2.5 cm beyond mouth of corolla tube, inserted near base, glabrous; anthers 3-4 mm long, 1.2-1.4 mm thick, oblong and slightly curved, muticous at both ends; pollen 2-porate, subspheroidal, 46 x 44 gm, exine spinulose, spinulae widely spaced (Fig. 3); style exceeding stamens, glabrous, stigma minute; ovary glabrous; capsule not seen.

description: Herba suffruticosa subsucculenta, caulibus teretiusculis, glabris; foliorum lamina elliptica vel ovata, breviter acuminata, basi cuneata, utrinque glabra vel subtus in costa et venis lateralibus parce puberula; paniculae floriferae terminales, densae, ramis subhelicoideis, 1-furcatis; paniculae inferiores parvae, forsan steriles, apetalae, calycibus reductis, parvis; bracteae ramos panicularum subtendentes cordatae, rotundatae et apiculatae, rhachidibus et rhachillis parce pilosis, bracteis ultimis lanceolatis; calycis segmenta elliptica-oblonga, glabra, subtruncata et apiculata, dilute 3- vel 5-nervata; corolla atrocas- tanea, glabra, tubo anguste infundibuliformi, labio superiore lineari, apice recurvato vel crispato, labio inferiore patulo, ovato, trilobato, lobis obtusis; stamina exserta, glabra.

description: Suffrutescent, somewhat succulent herb to 1.5 m tall; stems subterete, glabrous, cystoliths numerous and parallel; leaf blades elliptic to ovate, 9-12 cm long and 3-5.5 cm wide, short-acuminate, cuneate at base or the smaller uppermost blades rounded to obtuse, rather thin, entire or undulate, both surfaces glabrous except costa and lateral veins, these sparingly puberulous with appressed or ascending septate hairs, costa, lateral veins (6-9 pairs) and veinlets prominent beneath, rather obscure above, cystoliths small and inconspicuous; petioles 1-3 cm long, glabrous or sparingly puberulous, cystoliths minute, numerous and parallel; flower-bearing panicles terminal, 6-8 cm long and about 5 cm broad, dense; mostly sterile cymes axillary to 2 cm long, branches of terminal inflorescence subhelicoid, usually once-forked; bracts subtending branches of inflorescence cordate, 1-1.5 cm long, 1-1.5 cm wide, rounded and apiculate at apex; rachis and rachilla sparingly pilosulous; pedicels 1-2 mm long, sparingly pilosulous; bracts subtending flowers lanceolate, about 2 mm long and 1 mm wide near base; calyx 6 mm long, glabrous, segments elliptic-oblong, 5 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, subtruncate and apiculate, faintly 3- to 5-nerved, ciliate, cystoliths obscure, calyces of sterile lower axillary inflorescence 1-2.5 mm long; corolla deep maroon, glabrous, 2.5 cm long from base to tip of upper lip, tube 5 mm broad near base, narrowed at 7 mm above base to 2.5 mm, thence enlarged to 4.5 mm at mouth, upper lip linear, 13 mm long, 2 mm wide, the tip recurved or curled, cucullate and entire, lower lip spreading, ovate, 12 mm long, 8 mm wide, rounded and 3-lobed at tip, lobes 0.5 mm long, 1 mm wide, rounded; stamens exserted 15 mm beyond mouth of corolla, glabrous; anthers linear, 5 mm long, 1 mm broad, muticous at both ends; pollen 2-porate, bilateral, 47 x 53 µm, pores more or less circular, nexine densely granular, sexine tectate (Fig. 2); ovary glabrous; capsules not seen.

description: Subshrub about 1 m tall; stems subterete, glabrous, the cystoliths inconspicuous, parallel and subpunctiform; leaf blades elliptic to ovate, 11.5-13 cm long and 4-6 cm wide, slenderly acuminate, more or less curved at tip, cuneate at base, moderately thin, entire or lightly undulate, sparingly pilose above with flaccid, septate hairs, obscurely pilosulous beneath, especially on costa, lateral veins (8-10 pairs), and veinlets, these prominent both above and beneath, cystoliths slender but prominent under a lens; petioles 3-5 cm long, sparingly pilose, cystoliths minute, numerous and parallel; panicles green, rather lax, the terminal 15 cm long and 11 cm broad, the axillary panicles to 9 cm long and 6 cm wide, the branches of the inflorescence subhelicoid, usually once-forked; bracts subtending branches of the inflorescence ovate, to 2.5 cm long and 1.4 cm wide, acuminate, cordate and sessile at base, glabrous and ciliate, cystoliths purplish-punctate; rachis and rachilla sparingly puberulous; pedicels to 3 mm long, sparingly pilose; bracts subtending flowers subulate, 3 mm long and 0.75 mm wide, mucronulate at tip, glabrous or rather sparingly pilosulous; calyx green, 5 mm long, glabrous below, sparingly pilosulous toward tip, simple hairs intermixed with gland-tipped trichomes, segments narrowly lanceolate, 4 mm long and 1 mm wide at base, acute; corolla dark-red, glabrous except tips of lips (these sparingly pilosulous), 1.8 cm long from base to tip of upper lip, tube 4.5 mm broad near base, narrowed to 2.5 mm at 6 mm above base, 4 mm broad at mouth, upper lip linear, 4 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, tip recurved or curled, cucullate and acute, lower lip spreading, ovate, 9 mm long, 7-8 mm wide, rounded, 3-lobed at tip, lobes 1 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, rounded; stamens exserted about 12 mm beyond mouth of corolla, glabrous; anthers linear, 3.5 mm long, 0.5 mm broad, muticous at both ends; pollen 2-porate, subspheroidal, 50 x 46 µm, exine spinulose, spinulae widely spaced (Fig. 2); style exserted about 1.5 cm beyond mouth of corolla; stigma minute; ovary glabrous; capsule clavate, glabrous, 18 mm long, 5 mm wide; seeds wanting.

description: Herba vel suffrutex, caulibus subquadrangularibus, glabris vel parce pilosis; foliorum lamina late elliptica vel ovata, graciliter acuminata, basi rotundata in petiolum decurrens, supra modice tomentosa subtus parce puberula; paniculae terminales et axillares modice densae, bracteae ramos inflorescentiae subtendentes conspicuae, foliaceae, orbiculares, sessiles vel subsessiles, rhachidi, rhachillis et pedicellis pilosis, bracteis ultimis anguste lanceolatis pilosis; calycis segmenta anguste triangularia, infra glabra parce pilosa ad apices; corolla lutea, pilosa, tubo basi angusto, supra abrupte dilatato, in fauce leviter angustato, labio superiore ovato, erecto, apice obtuso, ciliato, labio inferiore apice trilobato, lobis obtusis; stamina exserta, glabra, antheris utrinque muticis; ovarium glabrum.

description: Herbaceous or suffrutescent plant about 1 m tall; stems ascending, subquadrangular, glabrous or sparingly pilose near tip; leaf blades broadly elliptical or ovate, 14 cm long, 8-8.3 cm wide, slenderly short-acuminate, short-cuneate (7 mm long) from a rounded base, thin, entire, moderately tomentose above, sparingly puberulous beneath, the hairs confined chiefly to costa and lateral veins (about 10 pairs), spreading or ascending, veinlets coarsely reticulate, these and the costa and lateral veins rather prominent especially beneath, cystoliths prominent under a lens, brownish; petioles 2-5 cm long and 1.75 mm thick, sparingly pilose, cystoliths numerous, conspicuous and parallel; flowers borne in moderately dense, terminal and axillary panicles, these to 30 cm long and 7 cm broad, axillary panicles 4-8 cm long; bracts subtending branches of panicle conspicuous, leaf-like, orbicular, sessile or subsessile, lowermost pair 2.5 cm long and 3 cm wide, becoming grad- ually smaller toward tip of panicle, all obtuse to acuminate, the pubescence similar to that of stem leaves; rachis pilose, the hairs spreading; rachilla and pedicels (to 7 mm long and 0.5 mm thick) pilose with erect and ascending hairs; bracts subtending flowers narrowly lanceolate, 2 mm long and 0.75 mm wide, blunt, ciliate at tip, pilose; calyx 5 mm long, glabrous below, sparingly pilosulous toward tip, segments narrowly triangular, 4 mm long and 1.5 mm wide at base, acute; corolla yellow, 18 mm long, pilose with long spreading septate hairs, tube 2 mm broad at base, at 4 mm above base abruptly enlarged to 7 mm, 4.5 mm broad at throat, lips erect, subequal, 3 mm long, upper lip ovate, 2.75 mm wide, obtuse and ciliate, lower lip 3-lobed, lobes 1 mm long and 1.5 mm broad, obtuse; description: Herbaceous or suffrutescent plant about 1 m tall; stems ascending, subquad-rangular, pilose, the hairs spreading, septate; leaf blades elliptic to narrowly ovate, 15-18 cm long, 6.5-8.5 cm wide, short-acuminate, cuneate at base, thin, entire, both surfaces moderately pilose, especially costa and lateral veins (9-11 pairs), these and reticulate veinlets moderately conspicuous, the hairs erect, septate, cystoliths minute, sparse, inconspicuous; bracts subtending branches of panicle conspicuous, leaf-like, cordate, sessile or subsessile, lowermost pair 1.5 cm long and 1 cm wide, becoming gradually smaller toward tip of panicle, all short-acuminate, moderately puberulous, rachis densely pilose, the hairs spreading, rachilla and pedicels (to 5 mm long and 0.5 mm thick) densely pilose with spreading, septate hairs; bracts subtending flowers narrowly lanceolate, 4 mm long and 0.75 mm wide, blunt at tip, densely pilose; calyx green, 6.5 mm long, glabrous below, densely pilose toward tip, hairs intermixed with gland-tipped trichomes, segments narrowly lanceolate, 6 mm long and 1.25 mm wide at base, acute; corolla red, densely pilose, 2.4 cm long, tube 4 mm broad near base, narrowed at 7 mm above base to 2.5 mm, throat about 2 mm broad, upper lip erect linear, 11 mm long, 1.25 mm wide, obtuse, lower lip spreading, obovate, 8 mm long, 6 mm wide, the tip rounded, 3-lobed, lobes small, 0.5 mm long, 1 mm wide, rounded; stamens red, exserted about 15 mm beyond mouth of corolla, glabrous; anthers linear, 4.5 mm long, 0.75 mm thick; pollen 2-porate, subspheroidal, 42 µm in diam, exine spinulose, spinulae widely spaced (Fig. 5); style exserted about 1 cm beyond mouth of corolla, stigma minute; ovary glabrous; capsule not seen.

description: Frutex ca. 1 m. altus; ramis gracilibus glabris; ramulis canis hispidulosis; foliis fasciculatis, subsessilibus lanceolatis plerumque 20-25 mm. longis, 5-7 mm. latis, glabris, margine pubeseenti ciliata excepta; spicis subsessilibus; bracteolis pallidis pubeseentibus apiculatis 1-1.5 mm. longis, imbracatis ad basim; calycis lobis 6 mm. longis lanceolatis dorsaliter pubeseentibus, ad marginem longe pubescentibus; corolla alba vel, pallide lavendulacea, 10-12 mm. longa, bilabiata; staminibus geminatis inaequalibus, antheris binis lateraliter minute connatis vel cohaerentiblus; filamentis pubeseentibus; ovario glabro; stigmatibus glabris.

description: Low, irregularly branched shrub with open crown about 1 m. high; branches slender, light yellowish to dark gray, glabrous, nodes prominent; branchlets finely hispid, grayish, leaves fasciculate, sessile or nearly so, lanceolate, mostly 20-25 mm. long, 5-7 mm. wide, glabrous except for minute, sparse pubescence along margin, minutely punctate below; midvein prominent below, pinnately branched, laterals obscure, often branched near base, reticulately anastomosing; infloreseence sessile at nodes, short-spicate, 1-3 cm. long, bearing an imbricated series of straw-colored, pubescent, apiculate bracts 1-1.5 mm. long at base; calyx subtended by 2 bractlets 3-4 mm. long similar to calyx lobes; calyx lobes 6 mm. long, lanceolate, pubescent, the tips firmly subuliferous, distinctly margined with long pubescence, glabrous within; corolla white to pale lavender, pubescent, 10-12 mm., long, bilabiate, lobes 5, conspicuously parallel-veined, the upper three clawed, broadly ovate-orbicular, the upper two much shorter, acute from a tri- angular base; stamens attached midway in corolla tube; anthers 4, in two lateral pairs each united near apex; filaments unequal, distinct, one of each lateral pair pubeseeilt, the other glabrous; ovary and stigma glabrous, the latter typically marginate.

description: Suffrutex, caulibus subquandrangularibus, glabris; foliorum lamina obovata vel elliptica, breviter acuminata, basi cuneata, utrinque minute pilosula; paniculae laxae, racemosae, conspicue bracteatae; bracteae virides, ovatae, rhachidi et rhachillis pilosulis; bracteolae subulatae vel lineari-lanceolatae; calycis segmenta lineari-lanceolata, glabra et ciliata; corolla rubra, apice purpurea, tubo basi angusto supra abrupte dilatato, valde ventricoso, in fauce leviter angustato, labio superiore obovato erecto, apice obtuso, labio inferiore late ovato, apice trilobato, lobis suborbicularibus; stamina exserta, purpurea, glabra, antheris linearibus, curvatis; ovarium glabrum.

description: Shrub to 2 m tall; stems subquadrangular, glabrous or sparingly pilose near inflorescence, the hairs appressed, spreading, septate, cystoliths inconspicuous, punctiform; leaf blades obovate to elliptic, 10-15 cm long, 3-6.5 cm wide, shortacuminate, cuneate at base, moderately thin, entire, both surfaces minutely pilosulous, pubescence on lower surface confined chiefly to costa and lateral veins (7-9 pairs), these and veinlets rather prominent, especially beneath, cystoliths conspicuous under magnification; petioles 1-4 cm long, pilosulous, the hairs spreading, ascending, cystoliths inconspicuous and parallel; flowers borne in terminal and axillary, conspicuously bracted, lax, raceme-like panicles, 8-10 cm long and 4-5 cm broad, bracts green, ovate, 16-24 mm long, 10-15 mm wide, acute, glabrous and sparingly puberulous; rachis and rachilla pilosulous, the hairs ascending; bractlets subulate or linear-subulate, 5 mm long, 0.5 mm wide, glabrous; calyx 1 cm long, surfaces glabrous and margins ciliate, bearing numerous minute, purple cystoliths conspicuous under a lens, segments linear-lanceolate, 9 mm long and 1 mm wide; corolla red with tip dark-purple, 4 cm long, lower part rathersparingly pilose, the hairs spreading and to 0.75 mm long, lips glabrous, tube 2 mm broad at base, enlarged to 3 mm at 4 mm above base, thence abruptly enlarged to 12 mm at middle and again narrowed to 6.5 mm at mouth, strongly ventricose, curved at tip, upper lip obovate, erect, 4 mm long, about 3 mm wide, obtuse and entire at tip, lower lip broadly ovate, about 3 mm long and 7 mm wide, lobes suborbicular, about 2 mm long and 2.5 mm wide; stamens purple, just barely exserted beyond lips of the corolla, glabrous, anthers linear, 4.5 mm long, 1.25 mm broad, slightly curved; pollen 2-porate, subspheroidal, 65 x 60 µm, exine spinulose, spinulae widely spaced (Fig. 2); style barely exceeding stamens, stigma minute; ovary glabrous; capsule clavate, glabrous, 1 1 mm long, about 3 mm broad, 2 mm thick, solid basal stipe about 4 mm long, retinacula 2 mm long, slender from an enlarged base, linear-cucullate at tip; seeds 2, dark purplish (immature light brown), 3 mm long and broad, strongly muricate.
