description: Suffruticose perennial 0.30-1 m tall, branched from a subligneous base. Stems erect or somewhat decumbent, quadrangular, glabrous, rooting at the nodes. Leaves on glabrous petioles 0.4-1 cm long, the blade ovate, 3-6 (-10) cm long and 1-2 (-3.5) cm wide, acute or acuminate, obtuse or rounded at the base, glabrous, the margins faintly and irregularly crenate. Flowers sessile, solitary, sometimes in twos, in reduced sessile dichasia condensed in the axils of the upper leaves, these rarely pedunculate. Bracteoles small, lanceolate, 3-5 mm long. Calyx 1- 1.8 cm long, the segments subequal, oblong- lanceolate to spathulate, rounded or obtuse to 1.5 cm long, more or less glabrous, short ciliate, the posterior longest. Corolla purple or blue, 4-5 cm long, the basal tube 1.8-2.5 cm long, the throat obconic, 1-1.5 cm in diam, the lobes spreading, suborbicular, 0.5- 1 cm wide. Stamens included, shorter pair of filaments 6 mm long, longer pair of filaments ca 8 mm long, the anthers 2.5 mm long, pollen spheroidal, 48 µm in diam, the reticulum homobrochate. Ovary and style glabrous. Capsule narrowly ovate, 1.2-1.5 cm long, 3-4 mm thick, markedly stipitate with a solid base ca 4 mm long, the surface glabrous, apiculate. Retinacula 2 mm long; seeds 2-2.5 mm in diam, glabrous, the margins pubescent and mucilaginous when wet ted.

description: Plants suffruticose; stems terete to subquadrangular, the bark tannish-red, exfo- liating, glabrous; leaves elliptic, the blade 16-18 cm long, 5-6 cm wide, glabrous, cystoliths visible on both surfaces, the margin obscurely undulate with a cuspidate apex and an attenuate to auriculate base, the petiole absent or 5-9 mm long, glabrous; inflorescence a loose terminal panicle to 26 cm long with the cymose flowers on secondary branches 0.8 cm long, the rachis pilose, the pedicel 4 mm long, pilose, the bracts subtending the secondary branches of the rachis narrowly triangular, 3 mm long, those subtending the pedicel narrowly triangular, 1.5 mm long, the bractlets 0.7 mm long, subulate, all pilose; calyx segments narrowly triangular, 2 mm long, 0.3 mm wide, pilose; corolla red, glandular without, with a few short hairs at the base of the tube, tubular, 1.8-2 cm long, the tube 1 mm long at the base, 3 mm wide at the throat, the upper lip with the shallowly elliptic lobes 1 mm long and wide, the lower lip with the ovate lobes 3 mm long, 1.5 mm wide at the base; stamens extended to the edge of the corolla lips, the filament 10 mm long, pubescent basally, the anther 1.7 mm long; staminodes 1.5-4 mm long, pubescent basally; pistil included, the stigma 2-lobed, glabrous, the style 18 mm long, glabrous; ovary glabrous; capsules not seen.

description: Liana, the young branches sparsely pubescent some becoming glabrous. Leaves oblong to broadly ovate, thickly coriaceous, 3.5-7 cm long, 2.5-5 cm broad, bluntly acuminate, rounded or retuse at apex, rounded to subcordate and markedly unequal at base, glabrous on both surfaces, the margins slightly revolute; midrib slightly impressed above, prominent and glabrous beneath; primary veins 8-12 pairs, arcuate and anastomosing; petioles 4-6 mm long, rugose, sparsely puber- ulous, shallowly canaliculate. Stipules not seen. Flowers hermaphrodite (buds only seen) sessile, borne in many-flowered sessile glomerules on upper side of petiole at junction with lamina; bracteoles ovate, 0.5 mm long, glabrous, persistent. Calyx lobes with short appressed hispid pubescence towards apex, glabrous below, the margins ciliate. Corolla of 5 separate petals, free to base, 3 larger and enveloping stamens in bud, glabrous. Fertile stamens 3, alternating with corolla lobes. Ovary trilocular with 2 ovules in each loculus, pilose. Styles consisting of 3 united but clearly distinguishable parts trifid at apex. Fruit not seen.

description: Tree 6 m tall, the young branches sparsely puberulous, glabrescent. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, 20-28 x 8-11 cm, subcuneate at base, acuminate at apex, the acumen 12-16 mm long, glabrous above, with a few stiff appressed hairs beneath, midrib lightly impressed above, prominent beneath; primary veins 10- 13 pairs, prominulous above, prominent beneath; petiole 2.2-3.3 cm long, terete, rugulose, glabrous. Stipules triangular, caducous, appressed puberulous, ca 3 mm long. Flowers hermaphrodite, borne in dense-flowered glomerules inserted on upper portion of petioles; pedicels 2-3 mm long, appressed-puberulous; bracteoles 3-6 mm long, membranous, appressed-puberulous on exterior. Calyx 5-6 mm long, gray-puberulous on exterior, the lobes unequal. Corolla white, exserted beyond calyx lobes, with 2 larger bicucullate lobes and 3 smaller simple lobes united at base to form a distinct tube, the tube densely lanate on interior. Fertile stamens 3, alternating with corolla lobes, inserted on corolla tube at base of lobes; staminodes 2, filamentous. Ovary trilocular, pilose on exterior. Style with a trifid apex, pubescent throughout. Ovules 2 per locule. Fruit not seen.

description: Shrubs 3-60 cm high, forming dense patches from superficial rhizomes. Twigs terete to somewhat angled, yellow-green, reddish green, or reddish brown, finely puberulent or rarely glabrous. Leaves usually oblanceolate, sometimes obovate or narrowly elliptical, 10-30 X 3-12 mm, green, usually glabrous above and usually somewhat glandular beneath; margin usually serrulate from the apex to at least the middle of the blade. Calyx pale green and glabrous; lobes obsolete. Corolla thin, cylindrical urceolate to globose, 4-7 mm long, 3-5 mm diam., white, white with pink striping or pink, lobes very small. Stamen filaments glabrous; staminal awns at base of thecae, pollen tetrads 27-33 pim diam. Berries usually blue and glaucous, rarely dull black, 5- 9 mm diam.; seeds ca. 1 mm long, chromosome number 2n = 24 (Schultz, 1944; Love & Love, 1966).
bibliographicCitation: Vander Kloet, S. P. & Dickinson, T. A. 1999. The taxonomy of Vaccinium section Myrtillus (Ericaceae). Brittonia. 51: 231-254.

description: Shrubs 1-7 m high, crown-forming, occasionally suckering when injured. Twigs of the current season green, sharply angled, glabrous or minutely puberulent in lines. Short lateral branches on both orthotropic and plagiotropic shoots often divaricate at 750 or less giving the shrub a distinct fasciculate aspect. Leaves oval to oblong-elliptical, 13-25 X 8-14 mm, usually glabrous above and puberulent beneath; margin entire. Calyx pale green and glabrous, lobes 5, distinct and rather broad. Corolla thin, globose to urceolate, 4-6 mm long, 3-5 mm diam., pink, bronze, to yellowish green, waxy. Filaments glabrous; staminal awns near top of thecae; pollen tetrads 32-36 µm diam.; berries red, occasionally faintly glaucous, 7-9 mm diam.; seeds ca. 1 mm long. Chromosome number 2n = 24 (Schultz, 1944; MacDougall & Vander Kloet, 1982; Darrow et al., 1944).
bibliographicCitation: Vander Kloet, S. P. & Dickinson, T. A. 1999. The taxonomy of Vaccinium section Myrtillus (Ericaceae). Brittonia. 51: 231-254.

description: Epiphyte, erect or climbing. Mature stems terete, 6 mm diam, glabrous; immature stems subterete or bluntly angled, pilose; bark tan to black when dry. Petioles round or oval in cross-section, rugose, puberulent becoming glabrous, 1-2.5 mm long and 1.5 mm diam. Leaves elliptic, ovate or obovate, 1.5-3 X 1-1.5 cm, basally cuneate, obtuse, apically rounded or obtuse, essentially glabrous but somewhat puberulent proximally above, leaves fleshy when living (fide label data), marginally thickened when dry; obscurely 5-plinerved, with secondary lateral nerves arising above the base, midrib slightly impressed or raised above, raised beneath, lateral nerves obscure above but slightly raised beneath. Flowers axillary, solitary or in pairs. Floral bracts not seen. Pedicels terete, 1-2 mm long, glabrous but with glandular fimbriae. Brac- teoles oblong, obtuse, marginally glandular-fimbriate, 1.5-2 mm long. Calyx glabrous but with scattered glandular fimbriae; tube cylindric, obconic or somewhat falcate, terete, 3-5 mm long and 2 mm broad at apex; limb including lobes (3.5) 8-12 mm long, somewhat erect-spreading but dissected nearly to base; lobes oblong, obtuse or acute, usually conspicuously 3-nerved, (2.5) 6-11.5 mm long and 2-3 mm broad at base; sinus acute. Corolla cylindric, spreading distally, 5-angled opposite the lobes, glabrous, 20-27 mm long and 3-4 mm diam, red (fide label data); lobes ovate-oblong, obtuse, 3-6 mm long, spreading at anthesis. Stamens 22-30 mm long; filaments con- nate into a tube 7-10 mm long, glabrous; anthers including tubules 18-21 mm long; thecae slightly granular, 7-10 mm long; tubules one-half the width of the thecae, 12-14 mm long, with obliquely terminal, slightly flaring pores. Style 25-32 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Shrubs 5-150 cm high, rhizomatous, forming dense mats to extensive open colonies. Twigs glaucous, occasionally green, ± terete, rarely angled, glabrous, or rarely pubescent along the veins, or puberulent. Leaves obovate, oblanceolate, or rarely elliptical, 17-35 X 9-17 mm, usually glaucous and glabrous rarely glandular throughout, but often a few glandular hairs are found along the midvein; margin usually serrate for at least the upper 2/3 of the leaf. Calyx glabrous and glaucous; lobes indistinct or shallowly 5-lobed. Corolla thin, globose to globular-urceolate, 4-6 mm long, 5-7 mm diam., pink, creamy pink or red. Stamen filaments glabrous; staminal awns at base of tubules; pollen tetrads 37-43 µm diam. Berries usually blue and glaucous, occasionally dull black, maroon, or red, 9-13 mm diam.; seed, ca. 1 mm long. Chromosome number 2n = 48 (Schultz, 1944; Pojar, 1974).
bibliographicCitation: Vander Kloet, S. P. & Dickinson, T. A. 1999. The taxonomy of Vaccinium section Myrtillus (Ericaceae). Brittonia. 51: 231-254.

description: Shrubs 0.2-3 m, forming small to exten- sive clumps, rarely crown-forming. Twigs of the current season yellow-green or reddish green, terete to slightly angled, glabrous to pubescent in lines. Leaves broadly elliptical to ovate, 25-50 X 11-23 mm, usually green on both sides, glandular beneath; margin sharply serrate. Calyx green and glabrous obscurely lobed. Corolla thin, globose to urceolate, 3-5 mm long, 5-7 mm diam., white, cream, yellowish pink or bronze. Stamen filaments glabrous; staminal awns at base of tubules; pollen tetrads 36-40 µm diam. Berries shining black, dull black, deep purple, rarely red, 9-13 mm diam.; seeds ca. 1 mm long. Chromosome number 2n = 48 (Schultz, 1944).

description: Shrubs 0.3-4 m high, crown-forming, suckering when disturbed, forming small clumps, rarely forming extensive colonies. Twigs yellow-green or golden brown, usually terete but occasionally somewhat angled, glaucous and glabrous, occasionally pubescent in lines. Leaves ovate to elliptical, rarely obovate, 25-39 X 16-20 mm; upper surface pale green, usually glabrous; lower surface paler or glaucous, usually glabrous, occasionally pubescent or glandular, or both, especially along the abaxial mid vein; margin entire to obscurely serrate. Calyx pale green or glaucous and glabrous; calyx lobes minute or absent. Corolla thin, globose, occasionally urceolate, 5-7 mm long, 4-5 mm diam., pink, bronzy pink, or greenish white, lobes 5, small. Stamen filaments glabrous to pilose at base; staminal awns near the top of thecae; pollen tetrads 33-49 µm diam. Berries blue and glaucous, dull purplish black or black, 8-10 mm diam.; seed ca. 1 mm long. Chromosome numbers 2n = 24, 48 (Schultz, 1944).

description: Shrubs 4-30 cm high, rhizomatous, forming extensive colonies. Twigs green, glabrous, angular; ultimate branches compact, often forming "broom-like" clumps or tufts. Leaves elliptical, lanceolate, or ovate-lanceolate, 7-11 X 4-6 mm, pale green and glabrous beneath; margin finely serrulate. Calyx pale green and glabrous; lobes obsolete. Corolla thin, globose to urceolate, 3-4 mm long, 3-4 mm diam., pink, very thin. Filaments glabrous; staminal awns near the base of thecae; pollen tetrads 25-29 pim diam. Berries translucent red, red, or bluish purple, 4-6 mm diam.; seeds ca. 1 mm long. Chromosome number 2n = 24 (Schultz, 1944; Pojar, 1974).

description: Epiphytic shrub with pendent branches; branchlets puberulous when young, soon glabrous; petioles subrugose, 1-2.5 mm. long; leaf- blades coriaceous, oblong-ovate, 4-6 cm. long, 1.2-2 cm. broad, rounded or obtuse at base, long-acuminate at apex, entire at margins, glabrous, 3-5-nerved from base, the costa impressed above, raised beneath, the secondary nerves and veinlets obscure or slightly elevated beneath; pedicels 12-20 mm. long, swollen distally; calyx sparsely scabrid with minute brown hairs, the tube elongate-spherical, about 1.8 mm. long and 1.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the limb erecto-patent, about 1.5 mm. long, the lobes 4 or 5, deltoid, acute, about 0.8 mm. long; corolla glabrous, cylindric, subinflated at middle, 10-12 mm. long, about 3 mm. in diameter, the lobes 4 or 5, deltoid, subacute, 1-1.3 mm. long; stamens 8 or 10, nearly as long as corolla; filaments castaneous, gla- brous, 5.5-8 mm. long; anthers about 4 mm. long, the locules slightly granular, the tubules membranous, twice as long as the locules; style swollen distally; fruit ellipsoid, subglabrous, 4-6 mm. long, 3-4 mm. broad.

description: Terrestrial shrub; stems terete, striate, ribbed, glabrous; bark grayish, exfoliating in thin strips; twigs subterete, bluntly angled, striate, densely short-pilose with white, unicellular hairs. Leaves subopposite, +/- clasping, coriaceous, broadly ovate to suborbicular, 1.5-3.6 x 1.6-4 cm, basally truncate to rounded, cordate, apically obtuse or rounded, rarely slightly retuse, glabrous but glandular-fimbriate beneath with minute, multicellular, multiseriate hairs, 5(9)-plinerved, midrib and lateral nerves (except outer pair) slightly impressed above, obscure and raised beneath, reticulate veinlets obscure above and slightly raised to obscure beneath; petiole inconspicuous, 1-3 mm long, complanate, flat above, rugose, glabrous or pilose with white, unicellular hairs. Inflorescence axillary, short-racemose, sometimes two separate rachises per axis, 2-5-flowered, flowers in pairs along rachis; rachis strongly angled, rugose, ca 4-5 mm long, densely strigose to short-pilose with white or cinerous, unicellular hairs; floral bract ovate to linear-narrowly ovate, acute, 1.6-6 mm long, densely strigose to short- pilose. Flowers 4-merous; pedicel subterete, ribbed, 8-32 mm long, moderately short- pilose with white, unicellular hairs; bracteoles near base of pedicel ovate, acuminate, 1.5-3 mm long, short-pilose; calyx articulate, winged from base to sinuses, 12-21 mm long, reddish-orange with pale yellow lobes when fresh, essentially glabrous or weakly ciliate along wing edges and calyx lobes, the hypanthium rugose, striate, obconic, 4-9 mm long, the limb erect to spreading, 8-12 mm long, the lobes triangular, acuminate, 5-10 mm long, tips pilose; corolla white, tubular or 4-angled, 17-25 mm long, densely tomentose with white, unicellular hairs without, glabrous within, the lobes oblong-deltate, subacute, 2 mm long; stamens 8, the filaments 2-3 mm long, glabrous, the anthers 12-17 mm long, the thecae 4-7 mm long, the tubules 8-10 mm long; dehiscence through elongate slits; style equaling corolla. Berry immature.
bibliographicCitation: Luteyn, James L. 1992. Plutarchia ecuadorensis (Ericaceae, Vaccinieae) : A new species and a new generic record for Ecuador. Brittonia. 44: 240-243.

description: "Lax shrub, almost vine-like" (fide label data). Branches terete to bluntly angled, smooth, short-pilose becoming glabrate when mature, glaucous, reddish-brown when dry. Petioles subterete, flattened adaxially, rugose, short pilose, 2.5-3 mm long and 1 mm diam. Leaves ovate-elliptic, (2.5) 3-3.5 X (1.2) 1.5-2 cm, basally obtuse or rounded, apically abruptly short acuminate, apiculate, glabrous, obscurely 3 (5)-plinerved, midrib nearly plane above but raised beneath, lateral nerves and veinlets slightly raised and prominent above, obscure beneath. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 2-3 flowered; rachis short-pilose, bluntly angled, 1.5-2.2 cm long and 1 mm diam, with scattered capitate, glandular hairs 1 mm long. Floral bracts lanceolate, 1.5 mm long, ciliate. Pedicels subterete, short-pilose, 15-17 mm long and about 1 mm diam, with scattered capitate, glandular hairs. Bracteoles ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 3-4 x 1.5 mm, strongly nerved, ciliate and provided with capitate, glandular hairs. Calyx short-pilose, 36-37 mm long, reddish-brown; tube obscured by wings, +/- 4.5 mm long; limb short-campanulate, 2 mm long, 3-parted, the lobes triangular, acuminate, extended slightly below the base of the tube, 10 mm broad at base, their margins and lamina with scattered capitate, glandular hairs. Corolla pink, cylindric but narrowing at throat and with lobes flaring, membranaceous, short- pilose (except at very base) without and at throat within, 35 mm long; lobes trian- gular, obtuse, 1 mm long. Stamens alternately 10 and 12 mm long; filaments pilose distally, alternately 5 and 8.5 mm long; anthers including tubules slightly unequal, alternately 5 and 5.5 mm long; thecae 2.5-3 mm long; tubules with terminal or (in shorter stamens) slightly oblique pores. Style pilose distally, ? 36 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic vine (fide label data); mature stems terete, minutely striate, glabrous, grayish-brown when dry; immature stems and twigs of new growth subterete or flattened, striate, glabrous, tan when dry. Leaves coriaceous, opposite or subop- posite, clasping the stem, oblong, elliptic or ovate-elliptic, 12-25 x 5-9 cm, basally rounded and auriculate, apically acuminate, bright green when fresh but becoming brown to somewhat flesh-colored when dry, glabrous; pinnately veined, midrib thickened and slightly elevated in proximal half becoming thin and plane to slightly impressed in distal half above, raised and conspicuous beneath, lateral nerves 5-8 per side, anastomosing near margins, impressed above and raised beneath, veinlets impressed above and slightly raised beneath; petiole ca 2 mm long, glabrous, difficult to distinguish. Inflorescences 1-3 in axils of fallen leaves, racemose, 6-flowered; rachis subterete or sharply angled, striate, glabrous, ca 1 cm long and 1-1.5 mm in diam; floral bracts persistent, ovate, ca 2 mm long and broad, marginally with a few tiny glandular fimbriae, and with a few short tufted hairs at apex; pedicels decussate, subterete, striate, glabrous, 15-18 x 1 mm; bracteoles located two-thirds up the pedicel, similar to floral bracts but 1.5 mm long and broad. Flowers: calyx glabrous, 4.5-5.5 mm long, red when fresh; hy- panthium campanulate, strongly rugose, 3-4.5 mm long and 4-5 mm in diam at apex; limb short-cylindric, 1-1.5 mm long including apiculate lobes; sinus flat; corolla cylindric when fresh but conspicuously constricted in the distal half after drying, 13-15 mm long, glabrous but with scattered glandular fimbriae in the distal half, yellowish-green with pale or whitish-green lobes, each lobe with a short red streak over a slightly thickened area in middle of lobe; lobes triangular, 1.5 mm long, slightly spreading at anthesis; stamens 10, ca 7 mm long; filaments distinct, densely short-pilose in distal half, ca 1.5 mm long, slightly widened at base; alternate connectives conspicuously thickened; anthers 6-6.5 mm long including tubules; thecae strongly granular; tubules conically narrowed to apex, 1-1.5 mm long, dehiscent nearly entire length; style exserted at anthesis, ca 18 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Frutex epiphyticus vel terrestris 2 m altus. Petioli 5-9 mm longi. Lamina coriacea, integra, elliptica vel ovato-elliptica, (4.5) 8-12 (13.5) X (2.5) 3-7 cm, apice acuminata, basi rotundata et cordata, pinnatinervia. Inflorescentia racemosa vel subcorymbosa; rhachis 1-1.5 cm longa, glabra vel sparse hirsuta, dense glanduloso-fimbriata; bracteae florales lineari-lanceolatae, 3-9 mm longae; pedicelli dense glanduloso-fimbriati, 15 mm longi. Calyx 7-9 mm longus, sparse hirsutus; tubus 2-2.5 mm longus; limbus campanulatus 5.5-7 mm longus lobis inclusis; lobi 5-6 mm longi. Corolla cylindrica, sparse hirsuta, 11-12 mm longa. Stamina 8 mm longa; filamenta 3 mm longa, dense sericea; antherae 7 mm longae; tubuli 4 mm longi. Stylus 9-10 mm longus, glaber.

description: Viney epiphyte or arching terrestrial shrub to 2 m. Mature stems green becoming reddish-brown when living but drying brown, subterete, glabrous; bark thin, crack- ing into longitudinal strips. Immature branches and twigs of new growth subterete, glabrous to densely hirsute distally. Leaves coriaceous, entire, elliptic or ovate- elliptic, (4.5) 8-12 (13.5) X (2.5) 3-7 cm, basally rounded and cordate, apically acuminate, dark green above and paler beneath when fresh but drying olive- to grayish-brown, glabrous above and sparsely to moderately hirsute beneath along the principal veins, lower surface also with numerous minute glandular fimbriae; pin- nately veined with 3 pairs of lateral nerves, the midrib with lateral and secondary veins impressed above and raised beneath causing the blades to be bullate, proximal 1-2 cm of midrib conspicuously thickened above; pseudostipules (bud scales) lan- ceolate, subulate, 3 mm long, hirsute. Petiole terete, rugose, hirsute becoming gla- brous, 5-9 mm long and 2-2.5 mm in diameter. Inflorescence axillary but often appearing terminal, racemose or subcorymbose, 8-17 flowered, wholly green when living (including rachis, pedicels, bracteoles, calyx, and corolla); rachis 1-1.5 cm long, subterete, reddish-brown, glabrous or sparsely hirsute, densely glandular-fim- briate. Floral bracts linear-lanceolate, 3-9 X 1 mm, hirsute, glandular-fimbriate, conspicuously nerved. Pedicels terete, striate, sparsely hirsute, densely glandular- fimbriate, 15 x 1 mm but extending to 26 mm in length after anthesis, articulate with the calyx. Bracteoles linear-lanceolate, 5-8 X 0.5 mm, hirsute, glandular-fim- briate. Calyx 7-9 mm long, sparsely to moderately hirsute and glandular-fimbriate; tube cylindric, 10-ribbed, slightly angled opposite the sinuses, 2-2.5 X 2-3 mm; limb campanulate, with lobes conspicuously nerved, 5.5-7 mm long including the lobes; lobes oblong or ovate, acute, often basally slightly imbricate, 5-6 X 1.75-3 mm. Corolla cylindric, sparsely hirsute and glandular-fimbriate (especially on surface of lobes), 11-12 X 5.5-7.5 mm; lobes triangular, 3 X 3 mm. Stamens 10, 8 mm long; filaments distinct, 3 mm long, basally widened, marginally densely seri- ceous especially onto the connective, translucent when fresh; anthers +/- 7 mm long, strongly curved inwards at the base; thecae granular, 3 mm long, orangish-brown when fresh; tubules 4 mm long, sparsely pilose, dehiscing by laterally oriented apical slits +/-1.5 mm long, yellowish-brown when fresh. Style included, glabrous, 9-10 mm long.

description: Both collections are from the southernmost locality of the species in Ecuador and vary from the typical form in having very small leaves 1.3-2.2 x 0.7-0.9 cm vs nor- mal (2.5-) 5-7.5 (-11) x (1-) 1.5-3 (-4.5) cm in more typical forms, short petioles 1- 3 mm long vs 4-8 mm long, inflorescences of 4-16 flowers vs (11-) 16-30 (-40), floral bracts 3-4 x 2 mm vs 5-8 x 3.5-4 mm, and bracteoles 0.2 mm long vs 0.4-0.5 mm. On first impression, the collections appear to be a distinct species because the features mentioned above represent extremes in the morphological variation of var. isernii. However, upon closer examination, all the essential characters that circumscribe var. isernii are present. Therefore, I do not feel that these extremes necessitate taxonomic recognition since they are normally variable characters in Cavendishia (see Luteyn, 1983).

description: Scandent shrub or high-climbing liana (fide label data). Mature stems subterete to bluntly angled, smooth or striate, reddish-brown when dry, moderately short-whitepilose or cinereous; bark thin, exfoliating into long strips, dark reddish-brown; immature twigs terete or bluntly angled, striate, densely short-white-pilose or somewhat arachnoid. Petioles subterete, dark brown, 5-7 X 2.5 mm, densely short-white-pilose. Leaves coriaceous, subamplexicaul, alternate, ovate, oblong or oblong-elliptic, (4) 7-10 (12.5) X (2) 3-7.5 cm, basally rounded or subcordate, apically obtuse or bluntly acute, entire, glabrous or sparsely pilose above, moderately to densely pilose beneath with curly white hairs, and sparsely glandular-fimbriate beneath; pinnatinerved with 4-5 lateral veins which anastomose to form a marginal nerve, midrib and lateral nerves impressed above and raised beneath, veinlets impressed above and raised beneath but very obscure on both surfaces. Inflorescence axillary, solitary, racemose, 10-20-flowered; rachis bluntly angled, densely appressed-white-pilose, 1-2 cm long and 3 mm in basal diam. Floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, obtuse, keeled, with prominent midrib, 3-4 (7) x 2 mm, sparsely short-white-pilose, marginally glandular-fimbriate. Pedicels terete, striate, arachnoid, 5-7 (9) mm long extending to 26 mm after anthesis and 1.5-2 mm diam. Bracteoles similar to bracts but 2-3 (4) mm long. Calyx 9-11 mm long; tube barrel-shaped, 2.5-4 mm long, densely whitepilose; limb spreading, 6-7.5 mm long including the lobes, densely short-white-pilose but becoming sparsely pilose towards the lobes; lobes ovate or oblong-ovate, shortly acute, thinner at margin than in main body, 2.5-3.5 x 3.5 mm, sparsely short-whitepilose externally and within; sinus acute. Corolla cylindric, double-layered, constricted at the throat, glabrous below becoming densely pilose distally, 6-9 x 5 mm, rosy-pinkto red (fide label data); lobes triangular, acute, 1.5 mm long, very densely mattedpilose or lanate within, white. Stamens 10, ca 6 mm long; filaments connate (sometimes only in lower half), 2.5 mm long, with few long hairs along margins distally; anthers 4-5 mm long including the tubules; thecae 3 mm long, slightly granular near the base. Style 7-8 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Hemiepiphyte (f ide label data). Stems subterete becoming terete at maturity, smooth, glabrous, drying reddish-brown. Petiole subterete, slightly rugose, glabrous, 5-7 mm long and 3-4.5 mm diam. Leaves elliptic, obovate, (3.5) 5-13 X (2) 3-8 cm, basally broadly cuneate and short attenuate, apically rounded, glabrous; pinnate veined with the 4-7 lateral nerves anastomosing near the margin, midrib impressed proximally becoming raised distally above and prominently raised beneath, lateral nerves and veinlets slightly raised on both surfaces. Inflorescence axillary, subfascic- ulate, 5-6 flowered, spherical in outline. Inflorescence bracts oval-elliptic or ovate, short pilose, 6-7.5 mm X 5 mm. Floral bracts strongly keeled, short pilose, marginally glandular-fimbriate and ciliate, obovate, 7-9 X 5.5 mm. Pedicels coarsely angled, glabrous, 1-2 mm long and 1 mm diam. Bracteoles strongly keeled, short pilose, mar- ginally glandular-fimbriate and ciliate, obovate to spathulate, apically rounded and mucronate, (7) 9-10 X 5.5-7 mm, completely enveloping the perianth in bud, tightly clasping the calyx and corolla at anthesis. Calyx 5-5.5 mm long; tube cylindric, smooth but slightly ribbed or angled, glabrous, 2-2.5 mm long; limb including lobes erect-spreading, smooth, 3 mm long; lobes triangular, acute, short pilose, 1-1.5 mm long and broad; sinus rounded at anthesis. Corolla cylindric, glabrous, yellow (fide label data), 8-8.5 (10) mm long and 3 mm diam; lobes oblong, obtuse, 1 mm long. Stamens equal, 7 mm long; filaments glabrous, 3-3.5 mm long, connate into a tube 2.5 mm long; anthers including tubules 6 mm long; thecae 3 mm long, slightly granular, basally with an appendage ca. 0.5 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphyte. Mature stems terete, striate, glabrous, drying brownish. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, 10-16 x 3.5-6 cm, basally obtuse to broadly cuneate, apically short-acuminate, marginally revolute in the proximal 1/4 to 1/3, glabrous above but densely hirsute beneath with ferrugineous trichomes to 1.2 mm long; 5 (7)-plinerved, the midrib raised in the proximal 1-2 cm but impressed distally above and conspicuously raised beneath, the inner nerves arising from 1-2 cm above the base and continuing to the apex, all lateral nerves impressed above and conspicuously raised beneath, reticulate veinlets impressed above and raised but inconspicuous beneath; petiole subterete, rugose, stout, 4-7 mm long and 3-4 mm diam, hirsute. Inflorescence 9-16-flowered, ramiflorous, long-pedunculate, short-racemose to corymbiform; the peduncle 10-11.5 cm long, verrucose, hirsute, provided with few scattered lanceolate bracts ca 1.5 mm long along its length; rachis stout, ca 0.8 cm long; floral bracts persistent, broadly ovate, ca 1 mm long; pedicels subterete, bluntly angled, expanding distally, verrucose, glabrous, 15-18 mm long; bracteoles near the middle, ovate, 0.8 mm long; calyx articulate with the pedicel, slightly stipitate, bluntly 5-winged, the wings auricled at the base, glabrous, ca 3.5-4 mm long, the hypanthium ca 1.8 mm long, the limb 1.5-2.2 mm long, the lobes ovate, acuminate, ca 1.3 mm long their margins seemingly glandular; corolla cylindric but bluntly 5-angled, slightly curved distally, glabrous except the lobes which are sparsely hirsute, ca 22 mm long, the lobes deltate, ca 1.8 mm long; stamens ca 9.2 mm long, the filaments distinct, 3 mm long, sparsely pilose distally seemingly on alternate filaments, the anthers 7 mm long including the tubules, the thecae 3.5-4 mm long, the tubules separate to the base, dehiscing by clefts 1.5-2 mm long. Fruit not seen.

description: Branches terete to subterete, minutely striate, puberulent but often becoming gla- brous, reddish-brown when dry. Petioles subterete, flattened and slightly canaliculate above, rugose, 5-8 mm long and 2-3 mm in diam, puberulent. Leaves elliptic to ovate-elliptic, (5) 9-14 X (2.5) 4.5-5.5 cm, basally rounded or obtuse, apically short acuminate, puberulent beneath but only along the nerves above; 7 (9) plin- erved, midrib conspicuously raised proximal 1-2 cm above otherwise all nerves slightly elevated on both surfaces. Inflorescence 25-33 flowered, ca. 4 flowers per cm; rachis subterete, striate, short pilose, 6.5-8 cm long and 2.5 mm in diam at base, encircled at the base by numerous, caducous, oblong to ovate bracts to 2 cm long and 1 cm broad. Floral bracts oblong or ovate, acuminate, 1.5-2 X 0.5-0.8 cm, early caducous, marginally ciliate. Pedicels terete, striate, short pilose, 8-13 mm long and 1 mm in diam. Bracteoles basal, ovate, acuminate, 1.5-2 X 1 mm, short pilose, marginally glandular-fimbriate. Calyx densely short pilose, 4-5 mm long; tube globose, non- apophysate, 2-3 mm long; limb short cylindric, 2 mm long including the apiculate lobes; sinus broadly rounded. Corolla cylindric, 26-28 mm long and 4 mm diam, densely short pilose; lobes oblong, 1-2 mm long. Stamens alternately either 8.5 mm 10 mm long; filaments connate for the basal 1.5 mm, alternately either 4.5 mm or 6.5 mm long, marginally densely puberulent; anthers including tubules 4.5-5 mm long, equal; tubules 2-2.5 mm long, dehiscing by obliquely terminal, slightly flaring, marginally erose pores. Style slightly exserted, 28-30 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Erect, spreading terrestrial subshrub, 0.5 m tall. Mature stems subterete or bluntly angled, glabrous, grayish-brown. Immature stems and twigs of new growth subterete or bluntly angled, densely puberulous, reddish-brown. Petiole subterete, slightly flattened dorsally, puberulent when young, 1-1.5 mm long and 0.5 mm in diam. Leaves coriaceous, ovate, 1-1.5 (3.5) x 0.5-1 (1.5) cm, basally rounded, apically short acuminate (the apex itself obtuse), entire, glabrous or with apical tufts of hairs, sparsely glandular-fimbriate on both surfaces, 3-pli-nerved, the nerves obscure but slightly impressed above, obscure beneath. Flowers axillary, fasciculate with 1-3 flowers per axil but usually only 1 maturing, loosely pendent. Floral bracts and bracteoles basal, ovate, 0.2-0.3 mm long, ciliate. Pedicels terete, glabrate, sparsely glandular-fimbriate, cernuous, 15-20 mm long and 0.2 mm in diam, pale green when fresh. Calyx continuous with the pedicel, glabrous except for the lobes, sparsely glandular-fimbriate, 3-4 mm long, pale green when fresh; tube obconic to campanulate, ca 2 mm long; limb campanulate, 1-2 mm long in- cluding the lobes; lobes 4, triangular, acute, ca 0.5 mm long, ciliate, eglandular; sinus rounded. Corolla infundibuliform, constricted at the throat, puberulent, 19-22 mm long and 5 mm in diam at the widest point, bright red to maroon when fresh; lobes ovate, ca 1-2 mm long, tightly reflexed and thereby exposing the tips of the anthers at anthesis. Stamens 8, equal, 18-20 mm long; filaments distinct al- though slightly coherent at extreme base, 13-15 mm long, densely pilose with spreading hairs; anthers including tubules 5-6 mm long; thecae smooth, 2 mm long; tubules dehiscent by short, obliquely terminal pores. Style 18-22 mm long, in- cluded or slightly exserted. Mature berry spherical, 5-6 mm in diam, light purple.

description: Shrub 0.5-1 m tall. Leaves coriaceous, imbricated, obovate to more typically oblong-elliptic, mostly 2.5-4.7 x 1.2-1.8 (2.3) cm, acute to apically rounded with a 1-2 mm long apiculus, seemingly entire but actually indistinctly and minutely serrulate, glabrous on the upper surface except finely whitish-appressed-pilosulous near the base and inconspicuously ciliate especially in lower quarter, lower surface indistinctly and sparingly beset with both appressed reddish-brown glandular trichomes +/- 0.2 mm long and also appressed whitish-pilosulous basally. Petioles 2-3 mm long, moderately puberulous. Inflorescence a dense, axillary raceme with softly pilosulous or puberulous rachises and pedicels. Floral bracts appressed, linear to lanceolate, 3-4 mm long, puberulent. Pedicels distinctly articulate just beneath the hypanthium, 6-10 mm long. Bracteoles appressed, linear to narrowly lanceolate, 2-3 mm long, puberulent. Hypanthium campanulate to cylindric, +/- 2.5-3.0 long and in diam, moderately puberulous with whitish trichomes +/- 0.1-0.2 mm long; calyx limb +/- 0.8-1 mm long, slightly flaring; calyx lobes triangular, acute, 1.2-1.8 mm long, puberulous externally and internally; sinus broadly rounded. Corolla tube cylindric, 8-10 x 4-5 mm, pink to red, externally appressed- to spreading-puberulous with moderately abundant hyaline trichomes +/- 0.4 mm long and internally moderately to densely pilose with hyaline trichomes; corolla lobes reflexed, triangular, 1.5-2 mm long, white, densely pilosulous both externally and internally. Stamens 10; filaments distinct, attached to the receptable, +/- 2.0-3.0 mm long, glabrous proximally but marginally with appressed-pilosulous hyaline trichomes distally; connective 1.0-1.2 mm long; anther sacs 2.5-3.5 mm long, coarsely granular, basally strongly incurved; tubules 2, separate to the base, 3.5-4.5 mm long opening by oblique, introrse pores +/- 0.6 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic glabrous shrub with slender branches; branchlets terete, brownish, becoming einereous; petioles rugose, about 2 mm. long; leaf- blades coriaceous, ovate, 4-6 cm. long, 2.4-3 cm. broad, rounded at base, long acuminate at apex, entire at margins, 3-5-pli-nerved, the nerves slightly impressed above, elevated beneath, the veinlets obscure; pedicels about 25 mm. long, swollen distally; calyx obconical, the tube about 2.5 mm. long and 1.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the limb suberect, about 1 mm. long including lobes, the lobes 4, minutely apiculate; corolla cylindric, about 15 mm. long and 3 mm. in diameter, swollen distally, 4-lobed, the lobes deltoid, acute; stamens 8, equaling the corolla; filaments dark castaneous, glabrous, about 9 mm. long; anthers about 6 mm. long, the tubules nearly twice as long as the locules.

description: Epiphytic shrub with elongate slender branches; branclilets brown- hispid (hairs 0.6-1.2 mm. long), at length glabrous and einereous; petioles deciduously hispid, about 1 mm. long; leaf-blades thin- coriaceous, ovate, 17-22 mm. long, 9-14 mm. broad, rounded or sub- cordate at base, obtuse or subacute at apex, entire at margins, glabrous or sparsely scabrid with minute brown hairs above, sparsely villose beneath (hairs 0.5-0.8 mm. long), obscurely 3- or 5-nerved from base, the costa slightly impressed above, elevated beneath, the secondary nerves and veinlets usually obscure; pedicels 6-9 mm. long, sparsely villose, swollen distally; flowers densely villose, the hairs pale, spread- ing, about 0.7 mm. long; calyx tube subglobose, 1-1.3 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the limb erecto-patent, about 1.3 mm. long, 5-lobed, the lobes acuminate, about 0.8 mm. long, the sinuses flattened; corolla cylindric, 9-10 mm. long, 3 mm. in diameter, 5-lobed, the lobes nigres- cent, deltoid, obtuse, about 0.8 mm. long and broad; stamens 10, sub- equal; filaments slender, about 6 mm. long, sparsely pale-villose; anthers about 3 mm. long, the tubules exceeding the locules in length; style slightly swollen distally.

description: Frutex epiphyticus ca 2 m altus. Folia lanceolata vel elliptico-lanceolata, apice ipso acuta vel obtusiuscula basi acuta, coriacea, glabra, margine regulariter crenulata, 0.5-4.4 mm longa, 0.5-1.3 cm lata. Racemi ex axillis superioribus 1-5 orti, laxe (4)7-10(14)-flori; rhachis angulata sicut pedicelli et calycis tubus glabra, 0.5-1.5 cm longa. Pedicelli graciles, 10-14 mm longi. Calycis tubus cupulato-campanulatus, 2 mm longus, limbus erectus 1.5 mm altus 5(6)-partitus, lobis del- toideis 1.5 mm longis. Corolla cylindrico-urceolata, 5-angulata, rosea, 9-11 mm longa, lobis erecto-paten- tibus, 1.5 mm longis. Stamina 10; filamenta linearia, sparse breviter pilosa, ca 4-4.5 mm longa; thecae ob- longae echinulatae, cum tubulis 5-6 mm longae. Discus glaber. Bacca immatura globosa, ca 5 mm diam.

description: Epiphytic shrub to 2 m tall with arching or pendent branches and woody spherical tuberous roots to 2 dm across. Branchlets subquadrate to irregularly striate-angulate and puberulent, older parts subterete, striate-corticate and glabrous with enlarged warty leaf scars. Leaves coriaceous, crenulate, lanceolate to elliptic-lanceolate, 0.5- 4.4 x 0.5-1.3 cm, apex bluntly acute to obtuse, base acute, glabrous on both surfaces at maturity but sparingly and deciduously puberulent adaxially, and on the margins and basal portions of abaxial mid- rib on young leaves; pinnately veined, the midrib with lateral and secondary veins elevated to create a conspicuous network on both surfaces when dry, occasionally the reticulation only slightly raised and obscure abaxially; petiole 1-5 mm long, canaliculate, moderately puberulent initially but glabrate with age. Inflorescence typically axillary but often aggregated distally and appearing terminal, racemes 2.5-3.5 cm long with (4)7-10(14) flowers, each subtended by a floral bract and two opposite or subopposite bracteoles inserted on the proximal third or nearly halfway up the pedicel; floral bracts chartaceous to membranaceous, lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, 1-2 mm long, 0.75-1 mm wide at base, glabrous to sparingly pilose abaxially, the margins ciliate for their entire length and often irregularly beset with glandlike excrescences basally; rachis 0.5-1.5 cm long, glabrous, angulatesulcate and slightly winged when dry, glabrous. Pedicels terete but conspicuously angulate-sulcate when dry, glabrous, 10-14 x 0.5 mm, articulate with the flower. Bracteoles linear-lanceolate, 1. 5-2.5 x 0.5 mm, glabrous, ciliate at least distally. description: Terrestrial shrub 0.8-1.5 m tall; mature stems terete, glabrous; twigs subterete, bluntly angled, ribbed, glabrous to densely pilose with white, unicellular hairs and then glabrate; bark grayish, cracking longitudi- nally and exfoliating in thin strips; buds ovoid, fusiform, the scales numerous, imbricate, ovate to narrowly ovate, glabrous, reddish-brown. Leaves alternate, coriaceous, congested, somewhat concave, oblong-elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 10-15 x 6- 10 mm, apically rounded to obtuse but shortly and sharply cuspidate to apiculate, basally obtuse to rounded, the margin conspicuously thickened and slightly revolute, entire, glabrous but with scattered, multicellular, multiseriate glandular fimbriae beneath which are 0.1-0.2 mm long; uninerved with only the midrib apparent, this impressed above and raised beneath; petiole subterete, flattened above, rugose, 1-2.5 mm long, glabrous to pilose as twigs. Inflorescence with flowers 1(-2) in axils of upper leaves; floral bract and bracteoles indistinguishable, all located at base of pedicel, ovate, acuminate, 1-1.5 x 1 mm, ciliolate. Flowers 4-merous, reflexed to pendent; pedicels inconspicuously articulate with calyx, subterete, angles, 4-5 mm long, densely short-pilose with white, unicellular hairs and also with multicellular, multiseriate glandular fimbriae distally; calyx 5-7 mm long, the hypanthium obprismatic, 4-angled, 2.5- 4 mm long, short-pilose with unicellular hairs especially in proximal half, the limb spreading, 2.5-3 mm long, the lobes deltate acuminate, 1.5-2 mm long, glabrous or ciliate; corolla cylindric, terete or 4-angled, dark red, 1 1-15 mm long, glabrous, the lobes deltate, acute, ca 1 mm long; stamens 8, 9-10 mm long, the filaments 2-2.5 mm long, pilose with unicellular hairs, the anthers 8- 10 mm long, the thecae 3-4 mm long with dehiscence through oblique slits ca 1 mm long; style exserted 1-2 mm beyond corolla, glabrous. Fruit not seen.

description: Terrestrial shrub with branches arching to 2 m. Mature stems and twigs of new growth subterete, bluntly angled, sparsely puberulous, densely glandular-fimbriate, dark blackish-brown. Petiole subterete, rugose, 7-10 mm long and 2 mm in diam, densely puberulent, dark reddish-brown. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, some- times ovate-elliptic (8) 10-14 (18.5) x (3) 4-7 cm, basally rounded or obtuse and then short-attenuate, apically short-acuminate, sparsely pilose and glandular- fimbriate above, pilose on the nerves and densely glandular-fimbriate on the lamina beneath; (3-) 5- (7)-plinerved, midrib and lateral nerves impressed above and elevated beneath, reticulate veinlets slightly elevated on both surfaces. Inflores- cence axillary, racemose, 15-25-flowered. Rachis 3-4.5 cm long, conspicuously sharply ribbed, pilose and glandular-fimbriate, pale yellowish-green when fresh. Floral bracts semi-persistent, membranaceous, obovate or oblanceolate, ca 24 mm long and 11 mm broad, glabrous but densely glandular-fimbriate on the dorsal surface, pale green suffused with pink when fresh. Pedicels terete, pilose, 12-15 mm long at anthesis elongating to 20 mm in fruit. Bracteoles aristate, 2-3 mm long, pilose. Calyx glabrous but densely glandular-fimbriate, 5-6 mm long; tube sub- spherical, 4.5 mm long; limb campanulate, 0.5-1.5 mm long; sinus rounded. Corolla cylindrical, widest at the middle, densely short pilose, 19-21 mm long, rose-red in the lower 3/4, white in the upper 1/4 when fresh; lobes spreading at an- thesis. Stamens 10, alternately unequal; filaments connate nearly to the tip, alternately 5-6 and 7-8 mm long, pilose along the margins and on the ventral surface; anthers equal, 3-4 mm long, dehiscent by short, ovate subapical pores. Berry immature but turning purple.

description: Folia elliptica vel ovato-elliptica, apice breviter acuminata et basi cuneata et decurrentes, 2.5-5 (6) X (1) 1.5-3.5 cm; petioli 4-12 mm longi, glabri. description: Epiphytic shrub 1 m tall. Mature stems glabrous, subterete and usually with nar- row, corky wings; bark gray. Immature stems and twigs of new growth glabrous, sharply angled, 3-5-winged with wings to 1 mm broad, reddish-brown when dry. Leaves alternate, exstipulate but with pseudostipules in the form of subulate bud scales 2-2.5 mm long; lamina broadly elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 2.5-5 (6) x (1) 1.5- 3.5 cm, basally cuneate and decurrent onto the petiole, apically short-acuminate with the apex ultimately either acute or obtuse, glabrous on both sides but with scattered, reddish, glandular fimbriae, margins slightly revolute, entire or distally crenate; pin- nately nerved, midrib very prominent above and raised proximal 1/3-?/2 but plane to slightly impressed distally, carinate beneath, lateral nerves arcuate and anastomosing near the margins, slightly impressed above but raised beneath, veinlets reticulate and slightly raised on both sides. Petiole 4-12 mm long, sharply angled, canaliculate or carinate above, carinate beneath, glabrous but with scattered glandular fimbriae. Inflorescence racemose, 3-4 flowered; rachis glabrous, 3-6 mm long, sharply angled, with 2-4 tiny (less than 1 mm long), ovate bracts at base. Floral bracts ovate, 1 mm long. Pedicels articulate with the calyx, subterete, striate, angled, 12-14 mm long and 0.5 mm in diameter, glabrous but with scattered glandular fimbriae. Brac- teoles basal, ovate, acute, 1-1.5 mm long, glandular-fimbriate marginally. Calyx 5.5-8 mm long and 7-9 mm across the top including the wings, broadly 5-winged, the wings alternate with and produced beyond the lobes, glabrous but glandular- fimbriate basally; tube obconic, 2-2.5 mm long; limb spreading, 2 mm long includ- ing the lobes; lobes apiculate, 0.5 mm long; wings 2-3 mm broad. Corolla light pink with white lobes, fleshy, urceolate, strongly constricted at the throat, 4 mm long and 6 mm diameter including the spurs, pentagonal in cross-section, glabrous without but densely pilose within at throat, corolla tube bearing behind each lobe vertically oriented, ovate-obtuse laterally compressed spurs about twice as tall as the lobes proper, spurs 1.5 mm broad at widest point; lobes triangular, 1 mm long, slightly reflexed at anthesis. Stamens 10, equal, 3 mm long; filaments distinct, 2 mm long, densely long-pilose in distal 1/2; anthers 1.5-1.75 mm long; thecae strongly curved inwards at the base, 1 mm long, surface slightly granular; tubules 0.5-0.75 mm long, dehiscing introrsely although somewhat latrorsely their entire length and somewhat onto the theca itself. Style 2 mm long, glabrous, included. Fruit not seen.

description: Epiphyte. Mature stems terete, smooth, puberulent, 3-4 mm diam, brown or reddish-brown when dry; immature twigs subterete, coarsely angled, densely short pilose with tan or reddish hairs; bark exfoliating into thin, rectangular strips. Petioles terete, rugose, puberulent becoming glabrous, 1-2 mm long and ca. 1 mm diam. Leaves ovate, 1.5-3 x 0.8-1.5 cm, basally rounded, apically acute or obtuse, glabrous but with scattered glandular fimbriae beneath, margins not especially thickened when dry; 5-plinerved from the base, midrib, lateral nerves and veinlets all slightly raised on both surfaces. Flowers axillary, solitary or apparently up to 3 in a cluster; rachis none. Floral bracts and bracteoles linear-subulate, less than 1 mm long, marginally glandular-fimbriate. Pedicels terete, 15-18 mm long, pilose with hairs to 1.5 mm long. Calyx densely pilose with white hairs; tube obconic to hemispheric, 1-3.5 mm long and 1.5-3 mm diam; limb including lobes 2.5-3 mm long, erect or spreading, dissected nearly to base; lobes linear-subulate, 2-2.5 mm long; sinus obtuse. Corolla cylindric, short pilose, 26 mm long and ca. 3 mm diam, red (fide label data); lobes ovate-lanceolate, 3.5 mm long, spreading at anthesis. Stamens 25-26 mm long; filaments distinct, glabrous, 5-5.5 mm long; anthers including tubules 21-22 mm long; thecae smooth, 3-3.5 mm long; tubules 18-18.5 mm long, with obliquely terminal, non-flaring pores. Style terete, 27 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphyte. Stems thin, 2 mm diam, terete or subterete, puberulent, trailing and rooting at nodes; bark thin, exfoliating, reddish-brown. Petioles subterete, rugose, puberulent and glandular-hispid, 2-2.5 mm long and 1-1.5 mm diam. Leaves elliptic, ovate-elliptic, 2-5 x 1-3 cm, basally cuneate and obtuse or rounded, apically obtuse, weakly puberulent beneath, with scattered glandular hairs along margin and beneath but becoming glabrous, inflated and subsucculent when fresh (fide label data), mar- gins thickened when dry; 3-5-plinerved from base, midrib impressed above, raised beneath, lateral nerves slightly raised on both surfaces. Inflorescence axillary, sub- fasciculate, 1-3-flowered. Floral bracts ovate, 1 mm long. Pedicels subterete, striate, short pilose and copiously glandular-hispid, 4-18 mm long. Bracteoles linear-subulate, located midway up pedicel, 1.5-2 mm long, glandular-hispid. Calyx scabrous and also with densely glandular-hispid hairs; tube cylindric to obconic, 2-4 mm long and 3 mm broad at apex; limb including lobes 4.5-5.5 mm long, erect-spreading; lobes narrowly triangular to linear-subulate, long acuminate, (2) 4-4.5 mm long and 1 mm broad at base; sinus obtuse. Corolla cylindric, short pilose and with scattered glandular-hispid hairs, 16-21 mm long and 3-5 mm diam, crimson (fide label data); lobes oblong, obtuse, 2.5-4 mm long and 2 mm broad. Stamens 15-17 mm long; filaments distinct, glabrous, 2-2.5 mm long; anthers including tubules 15.5-17.5 mm long; thecae smooth, 2.5-3 mm long; tubules 12-15 mm long, with strictly terminal, slightly flaring pores. Disc annular, pulvinate, glabrous. Style to 22 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Non-tuberous epiphyte (fide label data). Stems thin, 2 mm diam, terete, glabrous, trailing and rooting at the nodes, blackish-brown when dry. Petioles terete, rugose, puberulent, 1-2 mm long and 1.5 mm diam. Leaves orbicular or rotund, 1.4-2.1 x 1.5-2.3 cm, succulent and lenticular when fresh (fide label data), marginally thick- ened when dry; obscurely 5-plinerved from the base, the veins weakly raised on both surfaces when dry. Flowers axillary, solitary. Floral bracts minute, ovate, 1 mm long. Pedicels terete, short pilose, 2.5-4.5 mm long, with few grandular-tipped hairs at the distal tip. Bracteoles not seen. Calyx scabrous, and with scattered glandular- fimbriate hairs at base; tube obconic, bluntly 5-angled, 1.5 mm long and 2 mm broad at apex; limb including lobes 3 mm long, spreading, dissected nearly to base; lobes narrowly triangular to linear-subulate, 2.8 mm long and 0.8 mm broad at base; sinus obtuse. Corolla cylindric, short pilose, 19 mm long and 4 mm diam, scarlet (fide label data); lobes oblong, obtuse, 3 mm long, slightly spreading at anthesis. Stamens ca. 15 mm long; filaments connate at very base, glabrous, 1.5 mm long; anthers in- cluding the tubules 14-15 mm long; thecae smooth, 2 mm long; tubules 12-13 mm long, with strictly terminal, slightly flaring pores. Style 19 mm long. Disc annular, pulvinate, glabrous. Berry not seen.

description: Liana with branches 2-3 m long; mature stems terete, striate, glabrate, the bark grayish-brown and cracking longitudinally; twigs subterete, bluntly angled, striate, white puberulent, glabrate. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to elliptic, 3-10 x 1.5-3.8 cm, basally obtuse or rounded and shallowly cordate, api- cally tapering and acute to short-acuminate, entire, glabrous above, but with scattered, deciduous, glandular-fimbriate hairs beneath; 5 (-7)-plinerved from near base with the midrib, lateral nerves, and reticulate veinlets shallowly impressed above and raised beneath causing the leaves to be slightly bullate; petioles subterete, flattened and puberulent above, rugose, 3-6 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 10-22- flowered; rachis subterete, complanate to bluntly angled and ribbed, 6-21 cm long, densely and persistently puberulent; floral bract membranaceous, ovate-lanceolate, long-acuminate, 5-6 mm long, weakly pu- berulent, densely ciliolate, marginally with few caducous glandular fimbriae; pedicels subterete, striate, 14-22 mm long, puberulent, scattered glandular-fimbriate distally; bracteoles located near the base of the pedicel, similar to floral bract but 3-4 mm long. Flowers with calyx 7-8 mm long, continuous with pedicel, the hypanthium obconic, strongly bluntly 5-winged with scattered glandular fimbriae, 4.5-5 mm long, weakly puberulent along edges of wings, the limb erect, ca 3-3.5 mm long, the lobes triangular, acuminate, ca 2-2.5 mm long, ciliolate, the sinuses rounded; corolla ca 15 mm long, greenish-white, cylindric-conical in bud, the tube cylindric but broadly 5-winged at base, the wings 1.5 mm broad becoming narrowly winged to the tips of the lobes, at anthesis the lobes (9 mm long) completely reflexed and curled back on themselves exposing the anthers for ca 7-8 mm, glabrous to weakly puberulent along the wings; stamens 10, alternately 17.5 and 18 mm long, the filaments distinct, ca 4 mm long, densely short-pilose dorsally and marginally, the anthers ca 10.5-11 mm long, the thecae alternately 3.5 and 4 mm long, the tubules 7 mm long, dehiscing by lateral slits 1.5-2 mm long; disc annular-pulvinate; style ca 15 mm long, glabrous. Berry not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Luteyn, James L. 1992. New and interesting Ericaceae (Vaccinieae) from Ecuador. Brittonia. 44: 344-349.

description: Terrestrial shrub 1-3 m tall; mature stems terete, minutely striate, nitid, glabrate; bark cracking longitudinally in thin strips, grayish-brown; twigs subterete, ribbed, nitid, glabrous or moderately to densely short-pi- lose with white hairs 0.8-1 mm long. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 1.8-2.3 x 0.8-1 cm, basally rounded and subcordate, apically acute, crenate with each tooth terminated by a deciduous, glandular fimbria, glabrous on both surfaces or weakly short-pilose with simple hairs along midrib proximally, sometimes deciduously pilose along margins or moderately pubescent with multicellular, glandular-fimbriate hairs beneath; pinnately (or obscurely pli-) nerved with 3-4 lateral veins per side, but on mature leaves all venation obscured or only minutely raised on both surfaces; petioles subterete, flattened and broadly and shallowly canaliculate above, rugose, 4-5 mm long, densely short-pilose, glabrate. Inflorescence axillary, 1-3-flowered, fasciculate, subtended by a series of inflorescence bracts which are elliptic to broadly ovate, obtuse to rounded, densely ciliate, to ca 8 mm long and broad; pedicels terete, rugose, densely short-pilose, 2-2.8 mm long; bracteoles located near the pedicel base, linear-lanceolate, 8-9 mm long, ciliate, marginally glandular fimbriate. Flowers with calyx ca 13.5 mm long, bright red when fresh, the hypanthium obconical to barrel-shaped, articulate with pedicel, weakly ribbed, densely short- pilose, 3.5 mm long, the limb spreading, weakly pilose, conspicuous striate, 10 mm long, the lobes conspicuously striate, lanceolate, acute, glabrous but marginally glandular-fimbriate, 9 mm long; corolla cylindric, narrowed slightly to throat, densely short-pilose, 1 1.5 mm long and 4 mm diam., pink when fresh, the lobes erect, triangular, acute, ca 1.5 mm long; stamens 10, 8 mm long, the filaments distinct, densely short- pilose ventrally and marginally in distal half  4 mm long, the anthers 5 mm long, the the- cae 2.5 mm long, the tubules dehiscing by clefts ca 2 mm long; style glabrous, inserted, ca 9 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic shrub with branches 1.5-2 m long; mature stems subterete, glabrous, with ash-gray epidermis splitting longitudinally to expose blackish bark; twigs bluntly angled, densely short-white-pilose, epidermis brown when dry. Leaves coriaceous, broadly imbricate, 6-7 per cm, lanceolate, 1.5-2.1 x 0.4-0.6 cm, basally cuneate, apically acuminate, margins revolute in proximal one-fourth, olive-brown above and brown beneath when dry, glabrous on both surfaces al- though with scattered reddish-brown glandular fimbriae beneath, weakly 3-pli- nerved with only midrib raised and obvious on both surfaces, lamina surface wrinkled above, smooth beneath; petioles terete, densely short-white-pilose, ca 1.2 mm long and arising from thickened nodes. Inflorescence axillary, solitary; rachis none; floral bracts 1-3, ovate, 0.5-1.0 mm long, glabrous; pedicel none; bracteole 1, enveloping hypanthium, broadly ovate, apiculate, 1 mm long and 2.5 mm broad. Flowers: calyx pilose, 4 mm long; hypanthium subcylindric, 1-1.5 mm long, densely pilose with white hairs; limb erecto-patent, 2.5-3 mm long including lobes, sparsely pilose; lobes 4, triangular, acute, 1.5-2 mm long; sinus obtuse; corolla cylindric, weakly pilose without as are lobes within, 8.5-10 mm long and 2.5 mm in diam, white (fide label), lobes deltoid-oblong, obtuse, 1-1.5 mm long; stamens 8, nearly equaling corolla, 8.5 mm long; filaments distinct, pilose in upper half to three-quarters, 5.5 mm long; anthers 3 mm long including tubules; thecae slightly granular, 1-1.2 mm long; tubules dehiscing by clefts ca 1 mm long; style glabrous, 10 mm long. Berry not seen.

description: Epiphytic shrub, the branchlets terete, puberulous, at length gla- brous; petioles subrugose, puberulous, about 1.5 mm. long; leaf-blades carnose, chartaceous and pellucid when dry, broadly ovate, 25-30 mm. long, 20-23 mm. broad, lightly subcordate at base, sharply acute at apex, entire and slightly cartilaginous at margins, essentially gla- brous, 5-nerved from base, the nerves slightly elevated on both sur- faces, anastomosing distally, the veinlets copiously branched, ulti- mately free, often swollen at tips; pedicels usually paired, sparsely pilose, 15-20 mm. long, swollen distally; calyx tube pale pilose, obconi- cal, 2-2.5 mm. long, about 1.5 mm. in diameter at anthesis, the limb suberect, 2-3 mm. long including lobes, the lobes 5, tufted-setose, deltoid, acute, about 1.5 mm. long, the sinuses rounded; corolla sub- cylindric, red, pilose distally, 12-15 mm. long, about 4 mm. in diam- eter at middle, the lobes 5, oblong, subacute; stamens 10, alternately slightly unequal, nearly as long as corolla; filaments slender, glabrous; anthers nearly equalling the filaments in length, the tubules twice as long as the locules.
bibliographicCitation: Smith, Albert C. 1933. The genera Sphyrospermum and Disterigma. Brittonia. 1: 203-232.

description: Epiphytic shrub with pendent branches to 2.5 m long, arising from a lignotuber; stem terete, somewhat rugose, blackish brown when dry; twigs subterete, striate, reddish-brown, glabrous, the bark thin and cracking. Leaves thick-coriaceous, ovate-lanceolate, (2.4-)3.4-5.2(-6.3) X (0.8-)1.2-2(-2.7) cm, basally rounded or obtuse, usually shortly attenuate and narrowly decurrent onto petiole for 2-3 mm, apically bluntly and somewhat abruptly acuminate to short-acuminate, marginally entire but noticeably revolute causing the leaves to be concave beneath, glabrous, base of lamina beneath provided with 2 circular, concave, blackish glands, ca. 0.2 mm diam. (one on either side of midrib) these sometimes each bearing the base of a single glandular fimbria, 3(-5)-plinerved with usually only the midrib prominent, the midrib weakly impressed above and raised beneath, lateral nerves and reticulate veinlets generally obscure, usually plane to weakly impressed or weakly raised above (or inner pair of lateral nerves impressed and prominent in proximal half) and weakly raised beneath; petiole subterete, distally narrowly winged, rugose, 4-8 mm long, glabrous. Infiorescence axillary, solitary, racemose, 7-9(-13)-flowered; rachis subterete to bluntly angled, striate, 2- 3(-4.7) cm long, glabrous; floral bract minute, deciduous, ovate, acuminate, 0.8-1.5 mm long, glabrous; pedicel subterete, stri- ate, 14-19 mm long, glabrous but distally at articulation point surrounded by stout, blackish, glandular fimbriae; bracteoles 2, located near base, subopposite, similar to floral bract. Flowers with calyx articulate with pedicel, 10-16 mm long, glabrous; hypanthium cylindric to obconical, 4.5-8.5 mm long, striate to slightly ribbed when dry; limbs spreading to campanulate, 5.5- 7.5 mm long, conspicuously striate when dry; lobes 5, broadly ovate, acute, 2.5-3.5 X 4-5 mm, apparently tearing with age and the margins callose-thickened; sinuses sharply acute; corolla broadly cylindric-campanulate, 13-18 mm long and 9-15 mm broad at throat, green suffused with maroon to reddish maroon or purplish dis- tally in the throat and lobes, the lobes 5, themselves becoming strongly reflexed, deltate, acute, ca. 3-3.5 mm long; stamens 10, appressed to the corolla, ca. 11.5-12 mm long; filaments distinct, ca. 4.7-5 mm long, marginally long-pilose, slightly adherent to base of corolla; connectives smooth; anthers ca. 8-8.4 mm long; thecae finely granular, ca. 3.2-3.4 mm long, with a minute, blunt apiculus at base; tubules 2, slightly spreading and separate to the base, ca. 4.8- 5 mm long, long-pilose along inner surfaces, dehiscing by short, slightly latrorse clefts ca. 1.4-1.5 mm long; style inserted, glabrous, about equalling the corolla. Berry unknown, but immature fruiting calyx becoming spherical and at least 8 mm diam. with the limb still conspicuous.

description: Arbor; folia imparipinnata, 4-jugata, petiolis teretibus, ferrugineo-velutinis; rachibus 13.5-15 cm. longis, supra leviter canaliculatis, ferrugineo-velutinis; petiolulis 3 mm. longis, foliolis 8.5-14 cm. longis, 5.5-6 cm. latis, chartaceis, oblongis, oblongo-oblanceolatis, vel oblongo-ellipticis, ad basim rotundato- obtusis, ad apicem rotundatis et extremitate obtusa, margine integro; supra glabris et plumbeis, infra brunneo-velutinis; ad faciem superiorem costa et venisprimis impressis, salientibus infra, venis in paribus 7-10, ascendentibus; inflor- escentiae cauligenae, racemosae, 12-20 cm. longae, multiflorae, axi brunneo- velutino et inaequaliter sulcato, pedunculis circa 3-4 cm. longis; bracteis ca. 1 mm. longis, triangularibus, pedicellis 6-9 mm. longis; alabastra subglobosa, calyce ca. 7 mm. longo, in partes tres fortiter recurvatos inaequaliter fissa; petalum flavum, oblanceolatum, breviter unguiculatum, parte superiore fortiter reflexa, ad apicem obtusum, margine undulato, 1.8 cm. longum, 1 cm. latum, ad costam sparse sericeum; stamina numerossissima, 6 ovarium proxima multo robustiora, staminum minorum filamentis 4-7 mm. longis, filiformibus, glabris, staminum maiorum filamentis crasso-carnosis, ca. 7 mm. longis, sulcatis, leviter villosis, antheris omnibus lanceolatis, staminorum minorum 2.8 mm. longis, 0.9 mm. latis apiculo 0.8 mm. longo, staminorum maiorum 5-5.5 mm. longis, 1 mm. latis apiculo 1 mm. longo; stigmata obtusa, stylus sericeo-velutinus, 1 mm. longus, ovarium 4 mm. longum, 2 mm. latum, oblongo-falcatum, densissime sericeo- velutinum, ovulas 13 ferens, stipite 4 mm. longo, densissime sericeo-velutino; fructus immaturus 3 cm. longus, 6 mm. latus, breviter apiculatus.

description: Shrub to 5 m. high; branches light-colored, coarse, not spineseent; leaves, coriaceous, ovate, acute or subacute, entire or obscurely crenate, acute at the base, 2.5-6 cm. long, 1-2.5 cm. broad, glabrous; petiole 4-12 mm. long, coarse, glabrous; inflorescence a coarse pseudoraceme, the axis sparsely pilose, about 1.3 cm. long; bracts broadly deltoid, glabrate on the outer surface, ciliate on the margin with simple hairs; pedicels sparsely pilose below the abscission plate, glabrous above; sepals deltoid, glabrous on the dorsal surface, ciliate on the margin with simple hairs; petals ovate, truncate, glabrous, the margin irregular; fruit lavender, about 6 mm. in diameter.

description: Frutex 3 m. altus; ramulis glabris vel sparse puberulis, primo flavis deinde glaucis, saepe gracilibus, saepe frequentibus, spineseentibus; foliis tenuibus, glabris (vel spasissime puberulis deinde glabratis), 11-27 mm. longis, 4-8 mm. latis, oblanceolatis, subacutis vel obtusis mucronatisque, margille fere integro, saepe subrevoluto, ad basim subcuneatis; petiolis 1.2 mm. longis, supra sparse puberulis; infloreseentia 7-10 mm. longa, glomerata, floribus multis, axi minutissime et sparsissilme piloso; bracteis deltoideis, dorso sparsissime piloso, margine ciliolato; pedicellis circa 3 mm. longis, infra discum dividentein puberulis pilis glandularibus simplicibusque supra similibus nisi sparsius; lobis calycis deltoideis, extra fere glabris, margine ciliolato pilis brevibus; petalis ovatis, truneatis, glabris, circa 1.5 mm. longis.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Shrub to 3 m. tall; branches glabrous or very sparsely puberulent, brown becoming gray in age, moderately slender, abundant, spineseent; leaves thin, glabrous (or very sparsely puberulent becoming glabrate), 11-27 mm. long, 4-8 mnm. broad, oblanceolate, subacute or obtuse and mucronate, the margin entire or somewhat irregular, slightly subrevolute, the base subeuneate; petiole 1-2 mm. long, sparsely puberulent above; infloreseence 7-10 mm. long, congested, many-flowered, the axis very sparsely short-pilose; bracts deltoid, very sparsely pilose on the outer surface, ciliate on the margin; pedicels about 3 mm. long, puberulent below the abscission plate with clavate glandular hairs and a few simple hairs, very sparsely so above; sepals deltoid, essentially glabrous on the outer surface, ciliate on the margin with short simple hairs; petals ovate, truncate, glabrous, about 1.5 mm. long.

description: Shrub or small tree; branches at first velvety pilose, at first grayish-tan, later grayish-maroon, the branchlets slender, abundant, spineseent; leaves velvetypilose above and below, 18-35 mm. long, 13-23 mm. broad, ovate, truncate to obtuse at the apex, the margin entire or slightly irregular, flat, the base obtuse to broadly subeuneate; petiole slender, about 2 mm. long, pilose; infloreseence 2-6 mm. long, congested, many-flowered, pilose; bracts ovate, truncate, densely pilose with long hairs, ciliate on the margin with long hairs, persistent; pedicels about 2 mm. long, slender, glabrous; sepals ovate, truncate, glabrous except ciliate on the margin with long simple hairs; petals lanceolate, ovate, truncate, glabrous, about 1.5 mm. long; anthers ovate.

description: Frutex; ramulis multis, arete implicatis, ininutissime et sparse pubescentibus, primo fulvis deinde-glaucis, saepe gracilibus, rigidis, spinescentibus, ramis recte digredientibus; foliis minutissimis et sparsis pilosis vel glabris, coriaceis, venis magis minusve deprepsis, dimorphis; brevioribus obovatis, latissimis, truncatis et saepe submucronatis, ad basim obtusis, integris vel interdum undulato-crenatis vel prope apicem crenato-dentatis, 3-7 mm. longis, 4-10 mm. latis; longioribus anguste obovatis vel spatulatis, saepius obtusis, interdum acutis, ad basim cuneatis, integris vel interdum crenato-dentatis, 3-7 mm. latis, 11-17 mm. longis; petiolis circa 1 mm. longis, glabris vel sparse puberulis; inflorescentiae axi 2-5-mm. longo, sparse puberulo; bracteis deltoideo-ovatis, puberulis pilis simplicibus brevibus et pancis glandularibus clavatisque, margine sparse ciliato et similiter piloso; pedicellis circa 2 mm. longis, gracilibus, glabris; lobis calycis deltoideoovatis, acutis, margine dense ciliato; petalis anguste obovatis, truncatis, glabris, eirca 1.5 mm. longis; drupis lividis, circa 8 mm. diametro.

description: Intricately branched shrub; branches minutely sparse-pubescent or glabrous, at first tan to brown, becoming grayish, the branchlets moderately slender, rigid, numerous, approximately at right angles to the main branches, spinescent; leaves minutely sparse-pilose to glabrous, dimorphic, coriaceous, with the veins more or less deeply impressed; shorter leaves very broadly obovate, truncate at the apex, often submucronate, obtuse at the base, usually entire, rarely undulate-crenate or crenate-dentate at the apex, 3-7 mm. long, 4-10 mm. broad; longer leaves spatulate to narrowly obovate, usually obtuse (rarely acute) at the apex, cuneate at the base, entire or rarely obscurely crenate-dentate, 3-7 mm. broad, 11-17 mm. long; petiole up to 1 mm. long, glabrous or sparse-puberulent; infloreseence-axis 2-5 mm. long, unbranched, congested, many-flowered, with fine sparse puberulence; bracts deltoid-ovate, short-puberulent with simple hairs and a few clavate glandular hairs, the margin similarly sparsely ciliate; pedicels about 2 mm. long, slender, glabrous; sepals ovate-deltoid, acute, densely ciliate on the margin with short simple hairs; petals narrowly obovate, truncate, glabrous, about 1.5 mm. long; fruit dark blue, about 8 mm. in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Small tree; branches moderately slender, glabrous, dark colored; leaves coriaceous, glabrous, obtuse to subacute at the apex, irregularly sinuate-dentate, obtuse at the base, 3-5 cm. long, 1-2.5 cm. broad; petiole coarse, glabrous, 3-7 mm. long; infloreseence-axis coarse, about 7 mm. long, very sparsely short-pilose; bracts deltoid, glabrous except ciliate on the margin with simple hairs; pedicels about 2 mm. long, very sparsely pilose; sepals deltoid, narrowly obtuse, glabrous except ciliate on the margin with simple hairs; petals narrowly ovate, truncate, glabrous, about 1.8 mm. long; fruit lavender, about 5 mm. in diameter.

description: Shrub 6 to 8 meters in height; branches pilose or sparse-pilose when young, later glabrate, brown later becoming gray, the branchlets slender, moderately abundanlt, spinescent; leaves sparsely pilose below, glabrate above, dimorphic, some short, broad, some long, narrow; short leaves thinnish, obovate or obcordate, often broader than long, truncate at the apex and often emarginate, obtuse at the base, crenate-dentate across the apex, crenate-serrate or entire, 8-20 mm. long, 8-15 mm. broad; long leaves spatulate to narrowly oval, obtuse to subacute at the apex, cuneate to subcuneate at the base, entire, irregularly lobed, crenate-serrate, 18-42 mm. long, 3-17 mm. broad; petiole 1-2 mm. long, pilose; inflorescence 8-17 mmn. long, often with short side-branches, expanded, the flowers not congested, the axis pilose to sparse-pilose; sepals ovate-deltoid, pilose with long white hairs, ciliate on the margin with long white hairs and a few clavate glandular hairs, long-persistent; pedicels about 2 mm. long, slender, sparsely pilose with very long white hairs; sepals narrowly ovate, truncate, with a few very long white hairs on the dorsal surface, sparsely ciliate on the margin with long white simple hairs anld a few clavate glandular hairs; petals narrowly ovate, glabrous; anthers ovoid; fruit 5-6 mm. in diameter, violet.

description: Frutex vel arbor; ramulis gracilibus minutissime et sparse pubeseentibus, non spineseentibus; foliis arete vel latius ovatis, 30-85 mm. longis, 10-35 mm. latis, acutis vel arete obtusis, margine fere integro, ad basim truneatis vel late subcuneatis; petiolis 4-7 mm. longis sparse puberulis; infloreseentia pseudoracemosa et amplificata, axi fere 15 mm. longo, minutissime et sparse puberulo; bracteis deltoideis, acutis, extra sparse puberulis, margine ciliolato pilis simplicibus brevibusque; pedicellis sparse puberulis, fere 3 mm. longis; lobis calycis arete ovatis, apicibus obtusis, glabris, saepe 1.3 mm. longis; drupis saepe 6 mm. diametro.

description: Small tree; branches slender, very minutely and sparsely puberulent, not spineseent; leaves lance-ovate to ovate, 30-85 mm. long, 10-35 mm. broad, acute to narrowly obtuse, the margin entire or slightly irregular, the base truncate to broadlv subeuneate; petiole 4-7 mm. long, sparsely puberulent; infloreseence an expanded pseudoraceme, several-flowered, the axis about 15 mm. long, minutely and sparsely puberulent; bracts deltoid, acute, sparsely puberulent on the dorsal suirface, ciliate on the-margin with short simple hairs; pedicels sparsely puberulent, about 3 mm. long; sepals narrowly ovate, obtuse at the apex, glabrous, about 1.3 mm. long; fruit lavender, about 6 mm. in diameter.

description: Undershrubs 20-40 cm. high; branches softly woody, glabrate, thin, rarely branched except at base; leaves imparipinnately compound, at length subcoriaceous, 3-10 cm. long, glabrate (usually very sparsely long-pilose and with clavate glandular hairs) ; leaflets 3-19, usually about 13, broadly lanceolate to ovate, 6-13 mm. long, acute, entire or more often with 1-3 sinuate subpungent serrations or dentitions near the apex, euneate or subeuneate at the base, sessile; rachis-segments narrowly alate, 4-10 mm. long; petiole very narrowly alate, 3-7 mm. long; infloreseence a few-flowered contracted panicle, 5-30 mm. long, very sparsely puberulent; bracts deltoid-lanceolate to deltoid-linear, acutish, glabrous, not ciliate on the margin; pedicels glabrate, about 3 mm. long; sepals deltoid-ovate, glabrous, rarely ciliate on the margin, subentire to fimbriate; petals narrowly ovate to spatulate, obtuse, about 2 mm. long; anthers ovate; fruit about 7 mm. in diameter.

description: Trees to 36 m x 50 cm, with low but- tresses. Bark smooth, gray, thin, inner bark reddish-orange. Trichomes golden, to 0.25 mm. Leaves 19.5-47.5 cm long, 6-14-fo- liolate; petiole pubescent, 5-13 mm long; petiolules glabrous to sparsely pubescent, the lateral ones 5-10 mm long, the terminal one 8-30 mm long; leaflet blades broadly to narrowly obovate, ovate, elliptic or rarely oblong, 7.3-12.2 x 3.1-5.3 cm, coriaceous, often shining adaxially, the apex short-acuminate, rounded-truncate, emarginate or retuse, the base usually cuneate, sometimes acute or obtuse, the margin frequently revolute, both surfaces glabrous; midrib prominent abaxially, impressed adaxially; secondary veins in 8-11 pairs, prominulous to prominent abaxially, flat to prominulous adaxially; higher order veins prominulous adaxially, prominulous but less conspicuous abaxially. Inflorescences densely pubescent, 12-35 cm long; peduncle 1.5-4.7 cm long; pedicels densely pubescent, those of staminate flowers 1-2.3 mm long, those of pistillate flowers 1.8-3 mm long. Flowers hypanthium cupular; calyx lobes deltate or ovate, 1.1-2 x 1.3-1.6 mm, densely pu- bescent abaxially; petals white when fresh, ovate to narrowly ovate, 2.2-2.5 x 1.3 mm, sparsely pubescent abaxially, densely pubescent adaxially. Staminate flowers filaments 0.5-0.8 mm long, sparsely pubescent; anthers oblong, 0.8-1 mm long; pistillode cylindric, 2-2.5 mm long, glabrous, crowned by 2-3 stigmatic lobes. Pistillate flowers staminodes 0.3-0.4 mm long; rudimentary anthers ovoid or oblong; ovary light green, ovoid, 1.8 x 1.5-2.1 mm, glabrous; style ca. 1 mm long, crowned by 2-3 capitate stigmas. Mature fruit obovoid, ellipsoid or oblong, bluish green, 2.5 x 1.4 cm when dry, glabrous.

description: Aromatic evergreen gynodioecious shrub or small tree, 1-8 m high, with relatively stout, more or less reddish, subglabrous twigs, dotted with brown lenticels. Leaves simple or rarely lobed to trifoliolate, coriaceous, flat, entire to serrate, ovate-elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, rounded-obtuse at both ends, 3.0-6.0 cm long, 2.0-3.5 cm wide; petioles 3.0-7.0 mm long. Inflorescence a small, dense, terminal compound spike, ca. 4 cm long, slightly narrower. Bracts broadly deltoid, ca. 2-4 mm long. Sepals green, ca. 3 mm long, ciliate with an abundance of orange glandular, uniseriate, multicellular trichomes. Petals white to pinkish (rose in the dried state), 2.3-3.9 mm wide (mean: 3.4 mm in hermaphrodites, 2.6 mm in male steriles), obovate-rotund to spatulate, ciliate with simple trichomes. Fruit a drupe, pubescent with red glandular trichomes, ca. 10 mm in diameter. Cotyledons 15-20 mm long, ca. 12 mm wide. Coastal or on north-facing slopes of inland canyons of southern California and Baja California, Mexico.
bibliographicCitation: Young, David A. 1974. Introgressive hybridization in two southern California species of Rhus (Anacardiaceae). Brittonia. 26: 241-255.

description: Aromatic evergreen gynodioecious shrub or small tree, 2-10 m high, with stout, reddish, glabrous twigs. Leaves simple, coriaceous, folded along the midrib, entire, ovate-elliptic to broadly ovate, 4.0-11.0 cm long, 2.8-8.0 cm wvide, acuminate-acute, cuneate to obtuse at the base. Petioles 10-30 mm long. Inflorescence a rather large, dense, terminal compound spike, ca. 11 cm long, ca. half as wide. Bracts ovate, ca. 1.5 mm long, 2 mm wide. Sepals deep red, ca. 2.5 mm long, ciliate with uniseriate, unicellular trichomes only. Petals white (yellowish in the dried state), 1.5-2.7 mm wide (mean: 2.3 mm in hermaphrodites, 1.8 mm in male steriles), elliptic, ciliate with simple trichomes. Fruit a drupe, pubescent with red glandular trichomes, ca. 6-8 mm in diameter. Cotyledons ca. 8-12 mm long, 4-6 mm wide. Abundant on south- facing slopes of inland canyons, mainly away from the coast, of western and central Arizona, southern California, and Baja California, Mexico.

description: Shrub or small tree; older branches (Lorentz in GHarv) dark gray, the younger branches light gray, the very young branches tan, the branchlets moderately slender; branches few, spineseent, glabrous; leaves at first with a few long hairs but soon glabrate, spatulate, 2-5 cm. long, 3-12 mm. broad, thinnish, mostly obtuse at the apex, rarely subacute, the margin entire or irregularly subentire, the base narrowly cuneate, the petiole slender, 2-4 mm. long, glabrous; inflorescence about 1 cm. long, congested, many-flowered, the axis glabrous or rarely with a few scattered hairs; bracts deltoid to ovate, subacute, glabrous. or rarely very sparsely pilose on the dorsal surface, sparsely ciliate with simple hairs on the margin, at length deciduous; pedicels about 4 mm. long, slender, glabrous or rarely sparsely short-pilose below the abscission plate (Cabrera 507, GHarv); sepals deltoid-ovate, rounded at the apex, glabrous on the outer surface, densely ciliate with simple hairs on the margin; petals narrowly ovate, 2 mm. long, 1 mm. -broad, with a few hairs on the veins on the dorsal surface or glabrous; anthers ovate; fruit about 6 mm. in diameter, lavender.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Small tree; branches densely pilose at first; leaves 7-15 cm. long, some at length becoming subglabrate, the leaflets 3-7, mostly 5, ovate or obovate, emarginate or mucronate, the margin usually entire, rarely obscurely crenate-serrate, at first pilose but often becoming glabrate in age except on the veins, darker on the upper surface, the lateral leaflets 2-5.5 cm. long, the terminal 3-7 cm. long; rachissegments 1-2 cm. long, very narrowly alate, pilose; petiole not winged, pilose, 1.5-3 cm. long; infloreseeiices 1-9 cm. long (usually about 7 cm. long)'; bracts deltoid, subacute, subglabrous on the outer surface; pedicels about 1 mm. long, sparsely pilose; sepals deltoid-ovate, subacute, subglabrous; petals lanceolate to narrowly ovate, truncate; anthers ovate.

description: Shrub to 2 m. tall; branches densely velvety pilose, light brown becoming maroon-gray, the branchlets slender, spineseent; leaves thin, at first sparsely pilose becoming glabrate, 4-18 mm. long, 3-10 mm. broad, obovate, obtuse, entire to crenate-serrate, the base cuneate; petiole slender, short-pilose, 1-3 mm. long; infloreseence 7-10 mm. long, short-pilose, few-flowered; bracts broadly deltoid, pubescent on the outer surface, ciliate on the margin with short hairs; pedicels about 3 mm. long, sparsely pilose; sepals lance-deltoid, truncate, sparsely pilose on the outer surface, ciliate on the margin with short hairs; petals broadly ovate, emarginate, glabrous.
