description: Shrub under 2 m. high; branches very slender to moderately slender, at first brownish later dark maroon-gray, very sparsely and minutely pilose or glabrate, subpungent to spineseent; leaves subeoriaceous, glabrous (rarely sparsely shortpilose at first), 3-26 mm. long, 2-10 mm. broad, obovate-spatulate, obtuse at the apex, crenate-dentate, someAwhat subrevolute, the base cuneate or subeuneate; petiole slender, 0.5-3 mm. long, very sparsely puberulent; infloreseence usually 1-2 mm. long, sparsely short-pilose, congested, several-flowered; bracts deltoid-ovate, sparsely pilose, ciliate on the margin; pedicels slender, about 3 mm. long, sparsely minutely pilose below the abscission plate, glabrate above, sepals deltoid, subacute, glabrous or minutely puberulent on the outer surface, ciliate on the margin with simple hairs; petals ovate, truncate, glabrous, about 1.2 mm. long; fruit pink, 7 mm. in diameter.

description: Shrub or small tree to 6 m. tall; branches slender, glabrate (microscopically sparsely puberulent), much braliehed; leaves simple to imparipinnately compound, lanceolate, obtuse, very sparsely puberulent, entire, crenate-serrate, or lobed, cuneate at the base, 1.5-6 cm. long, long-petiolate; petiole 3-15 mm. long, sparsely puberulent, narrowly winged by a continuation of the lamina; compound leaves with 3-11 leaflets which are lanceolate, obtuse, very sparsely puberulent, entire, crenate-serrate, or lobed, cuneate at the base, 7-25 mm. long, sessile, the rachis-segments 3-10 mm. long, sparsely puberulent, winiged by a continuation of the lamina of the leaflets, the lateral leaflets opposite, subopposite, or alternate, the petiole sparsely puberuLlent, 4-20 mm. long, narrowly alate with a continuation of the lamina of the lowermost leaflets; infloreseence a little-branched panicle, terminal or axillary, 1-7 mm. long, puberuleiit; bracts deltoid, puberulent, ciliate on the margin with simple hairs; pedicels about 2 mm. long, puberulent below the abscission plate, glabrous above; sepals ovate, obtuse, very sparsely puberulent, ciliate on the margin with simple hairs; petals ovate, obtuse, glabrous; anthers ovate; fruits lavender-red, about-5 mm. in diameter.

description: Small trees; branches brownish later becoming grayish-brown, moderately slender, velvety pilose; leaves ovate, obtuse, irregularly sinuate-dentate (often obscurely so), obtuse at the- base, velvety pilose above and below, 2-6 cm. long, 12-32 mm. broad; infloreseence an expanded pseudoraceme, axillary or terminal, 2-4 cm. long, velvety pilose; bracts deltoid, short-pilose on the dorsal surface, ciliate with short simple hairs; pediels about 1 mm. long, sparsely long-pilose below the abscission plate, glabrous above; sepals deltoid-ovate, subacute, glabrous except ciliate with very long simple hairs; petals ovate, obtuse, glabrous, about 2.5 miim. long; fruit lavender, about 5 mm. in diameter.

description: Shrub to 3 meters; branches short-pilose (sometimes sparsely so) light tan later becoming gray, moderately slender, moderately abundant, spineseent; leaves thin, sparsely short-pilose above and below, the pilosity larger on the -veins, 8-29 mm. long, 3-8 mm. broad, oblong (ovate to spatulate), obtuse at the apex, often emarginate, the margin entire or somewhat irregular, the base subeuneate to obtuse; petiole slender, pilose; infloreseence 3-7 mm. long, congested, nmanyflowered, the axis pilose; bracts deltoid ovate, acute or subacute, long-persistent, pilose (sparsely to densely so) on the outer surface, ciliate on the margin; pedicels about 3 nmm. long, slender, sparsely pilose below the abscission plate, very sparsely pilose above; sepals deltoid, acute or subacute, very sparsely pilose on the outer surface, sparsely very-long-ciliate on, the margin; fruit lavender, about 4 mm. in diameter.

description: Branches at first a light tannish-gray, later becoming gray, the branehlets rather abundant, relatively heavy, spineseent, glabrous; leaves glabrous, mostly lanceolate, from broadly lanceolate to narrowly lanceolate, 5-8 cm. long, 6-22 mm. broad, subeoriaceous, acute at the apex, the margin entire or irregularly subentire, the base narrowly cuneate, the petiole coarse, about 5 mm. long, glabrous; infloreseences about 7 mm. long, many-flowered, very sparsely short-pilose; bracts deltoid to ovate, subacute, glabrous on the outer surface, ciliate with simple hairs, long-persistent; pedicels about 3 mm. long, slender, very sparsely short-pilose below the abscission plate; sepals deltoid-ovate, rounded at the apex, glabrous on the dorsal surface, sparsely ciliate with simple hairs oln the margin; petals lanceolate, truncate, 1 mm. long, 0.5 mm. broad, glabrous; anthers ovate; fruit about 5 mm. in diameter, glabrous, lavender.

description: Small tree; branches thick, at first pilose later appearinig glabrate; leaves 7-19 cm. long, at first ferrugineous-pilose but later often becoming subglabrate, leaflets 5-15 (mostly 11), ovate or obovate, 2.5-4.5 cm. long, slightly asymmetric, acute to obtuse, usually obscurely crenate-serrate or serrate (rarely entire or strongly serrate), at maturity sparsely pilose (or subglabrate), darker on the upper surface, sessile; radhis-seglllents 1-2 cm. lonig, broadly alate, sparsely pilose; petiole pilose, 2-4 cm. long; infloreseence 2-8 cm. long (usually 6 cm.), pilose; bracts deltoid, glabrous on the outer surface; sepals deltoid-ovate, glabrous on the outer surface; petals laineeolate, obtuse.

description: Small tree with many slender branches; branches glabrous; leaves paripinnately compound, subcoriaceous, about 6 cm. long, glabrous, the leaflets 6-12 (mostly 8), subopposite, narrowly to broadly oblanceolate, shortly acuminate to obtuse and mucronate, 10-28 mm. long, 2-9 mm. broad, entire or somewhat irregular, narrowly obtuse at the base, sessile, the same color on both faces; rachis continued above the uppermost leaflets as a deltoid-lanceolate mucro 1-5 mm. long; rachis-segments glabrous; 3-15 mm. long, alate; petiole 9-17 mm. long, glabrous, very narrowly alate; infloreseences lateral and terminal contracted panicles, 2-8 cm. (usually about 5 cm.) long, very sparsely puberulent; bracts deltoid-ovate, sparsely puberulent on the outer surface, ciliate on the margin with simple hairs; pedicels about 2 mm. long, very sparsely puberulent; sepals deltoid, subacute, very sparsely puberulent on the outer surface, ciliate on the margin with a few short simple hairs or not ciliate; petals obovate, truncate, glabrous except for a few cilia on the margin; anthers ovate; fruit lavender-pink, about 5 mm. in diameter.

description:
Shrub or small tree; branches glabrous (or rarely very sparsely pilose when young; c.f. S. Venturi 3530 in AAHarv), light brown later becoining gray, the branchlets moderately slender, rather abundant, spineseent; leaves thin, glabrous (or rarely with sparse pilosity at first soon becoming glabrate), 18-48 mm. long, 8-27 mm. broad, oblong (rarely obovate or broadly oblanceolate), truncate (rarely obtuse or subacute) and often emarginate at the apex, the margin entire or rarely somewhat irregular, the base obtuse or rarely very broadly subeuneate, the petiole slender, 3-7 mm. long, glabrous (or very rarely sparsely pilose); infloreseence usually about 3 mm. long (rarely to 7 mm.), congested, many-flowered, the axis glabrous or very sparsely pubescent, with a few minute sessile glandular hairs; bracts deltoid-ovate, mostly subacute, long-persistent, glabrous except ciliate on the margin with simple hairs and a few clavate glandular hairs; pedicels about 3 mm. long, slender, sparsely short-pilose below the abscission plate; sepals narrowly ovate, obtuse at the apex, glabrous except ciliate with simple hairs on the margin; petals narrowly ovate, 2 mm. long, 1 mm. broad, somewhat smaller in the pistillate flowers, glabrous; anithers ovate; fruit lavender, about 3 mm. in diameter.

The proportion of the leaves tends to remain constant; specimelns with leaves 45 x 25 mm. are less abundant than those with leaves 18 x 8 mm.

description: Small to medium-sized trees, 10-25 m, unbuttressed. Bark outer dark coffee-colored, inner reddish-orange. Trichomes off- white to golden, appressed to ascending, 0.15-0.25 mm. Leaves 30-35 cm long, 7- 9-foliolate; petiole 6-7.5 cm long, sparsely pubescent; rachis glabrous to sparsely pubescent, 10.5-18.8 cm long; leaflets (sub)opposite; petiolules glabrous to sparsely pubescent, the lateral ones 10-15 mm long, the terminal one 20-30 mm long; leaf let blades ovate, elliptic, or oblong, 1 1.5- 15.1 x 5.4-7 cm, usually coriaceous, the apex acuminate, the base rounded, strongly oblique, the margin slightly revolute, both surfaces essentially glabrous; midrib prominent abaxially, prominulous adaxially; sec- ondary veins in 8-11 pairs, prominent abaxially, flat adaxially; higher order veins flat or rarely prominulous on both surfaces. Inflorescences 27-35 cm long, sparsely to densely pubescent; peduncle 4.5-5.3 cm long; pedicels 1-2 mm long. Staminate flowers hypanthium shallowly cupular; calyx lobes deltate, 0.7-1.3 mm long, densely pubescent abaxially; petals greenish white to white when fresh, narrowly elliptic, 2- 2.5 x 0.8-1 mm, sparsely pubescent abax- ially, densely pubescent adaxially; filaments 0.6-2 mm long, essentially glabrous; anthers oblong, 0.5-1 mm long, densely pubescent; pistillode cylindric, slightly swollen at base, 1-2 mm long, without rudimentary stigmas, densely pubescent; pistillate flowers and fruits unknown.

description: Shrub about 2 m. tall; branches thickish, few, densely ferrugineous-pilose at first; leaves imparipinnately compound, at length thinly subcoriaceous, 9-20 cm. long, the leaflets 3-7 (mostly 5), ovate, 35-95 mm. long, subacute, crenate-serrate to entire, densely ferrugineous-pilose, darker above, shortly petiolulate, the petiolules about 3 mm. long, coarse, densely pilose; radhis segments 15-30 mm. long, at first densely ferrugineous-pilose, not winged; petiole 15-40 mm. long, at first densely ferrugineous-pilose; infloreseences axillary and terminal, little branehed, coarse panicles, densely ferrugineous-pilose; bracts deltoid, densely ferrugineouspilose; pedicels about 5 mm. long, densely long-pilose below the abscission plate, very sparsely long-pilose above; sepals deltoid, subacute, sparsely pilose, ciliate on the margin with long simple hairs; petals lanceolate, acute to acuminate, glabrous, about 2 mm. long; stamens oblong; fruit red, about 7 mm. in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Epidermis gray, stringy, peeling off, exposing a tan, pale brown, or orangish inner layer; petiole 2-8 (12) mm long; leaf blade ovate, obovate, or rhombic, (1.2) 1.5-3 (3.9) cm long, (0.8) 1-1.8 (3.2) cm wide, cuneate to obtuse or sometimes rounded basally, obtuse to rounded apically, the margins 11-21 (27)-toothed; inflorescence (1) 3-9 (13)-flowered, the pedicels and peduncles densely lanate; sepals lanceolate to triangular-ovate, (2.5) 3-7 mm long; petals (6.5) 7.5-11 (11.5) mm long, white or pinkish-white; filaments white; styles 4-6.7 mm long.

description: Shrub or tree 3-7 m. in height; branches densely velvety pilose or rarely shortpilose (Venturi 2291, 10261) or even glabrous (Kuntze, Nov. 1892), first brownish later becoming grayish-maroon, branchlets moderately slender, rather abundant, spineseent; leaves glabrous except for a few long hairs oni the veins above and below, 25-45 mm. long, 3-17 mm. broad, oblong to spatulate, truncate to obtuse, mucronate, entire or somewhat irregular, the base subeuneate; petiole 2-3 mm. long, densely long- to short-pilose; infloreseence 2-4 mm. long, with short lateral branches, the flowers not congested, the axis dlensely (usually long-) pilose; bracts deltoid, long-persistent, with long hairs on the back and sparsely ciliate with long simple hairs on the margin; pedicels slender, about 3 mm. lolng, densely long-pilose below the abscission plate with scattered long hairs above; sepals ovate, with a few long hairs, sparsely ciliate on the margin with short simple hairs and small clavate glandular hairs; petals narrowly ovate, truncate, glabrous, about 2 mm. long, 1 mm. broad; stamens 10; anthers obtuse.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Arbor 28 m alta, 30 cm diametro, glabra, stipulis caducis. Folia glabra, petioli 2.5-3.5 cm longi, rachibus 16-19 cm longis, petioluli 5-7 mm longi. Foliolorum lamina 9.5-15 cm longa, 5-6.5 cm lata, (paribus inferioribus ovatis vel elliptico-ovatis, ad basim rotundis, ad apicem abrupte acuminatis, paribus superioribus ellipticis ad basim subobtusis ad acutis, ad apicem abrupte acuminatis) tenui-coriacea, subtilissime venulosa, costis planis supra, infra salientibus. Inflorescentiae terminales, ad 3 m longae, glabrae, ramulis lateralibus 5-6 cm longis; bracteae caducae, semicirculares, 2 mm diametro, minute ciliolatae. Bracteolae ca. 3 mm longae, 2 mm latae, ovatae, obtusae, ciliolatae, deciduae; pedicellus ca. 5 mm longus. Hypanthium 5-6 mm longum, infundibiliforme, stipite 25 mm longo, sepala 22-22.5 mm longa, 8-12.5 mm lata, elliptica, acuta vel acuta et cucullata. Petalum 30 mm longum, 35-50 mm latum, flabellatum. Stamina 10 fertilia, filamentis 78 mm longis, glabris, ad basim per ca. 3.5 mm connatis, antherae 9 mm longae, 2 mm latae, oblongae. Stigma capitatum, stylus 60 mm longus, ovarium 12.5 mm longum, 3.5 mm latum, oblanceo-oblongum, glabrum, 5-ovulatum, stipite 8.5 mm longo. Fructus (immaturus) 28 cm longus, 7.5 cm latus, arcuatus, oblanceo-oblongus, carpophoro 3.5 cm longo.

description: Small to medium-sized trees 4-20 m x 30 cm. Inner bark reddish-brown. Trichomes cream-colored to yellow-orange or golden, ascending to erect, to 0.6 mm long. Leaves 33-58 cm long, 7-15-foliolate; petiole sparsely to densely pubescent, 5-14 cm long; rachis densely pubescent, 10-34.5 cm long; leaflets usually subopposite; petiolules densely pubescent, the lateral ones 4-8 mm long, the terminal one 12-32 mm long; leaflet blades narrowly oblong, lanceolate, occasionally narrowly elliptic or (ob)ovate, 11.2-23.7 x 3.6-7.2 cm, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, the apex short to long-acuminate or occasionally obtuse, the base rounded to obtuse or occasionally cuneate, often oblique, the margin sometimes revolute, usually sparsely ciliate; abaxial surface sparsely to densely pubescent, with dense tufts of trichomes present in axils of secondary veins; adaxial surface sparsely to densely pubescent on midrib, trichomes scattered elsewhere; the midrib prominent abaxially, flattened to prominulous adaxially; secondary veins in 12-19 pairs, prominent abaxially, flattened to prominulous adaxially; higher order veins prominulous abaxially, flat to prominulous adaxially. Inflorescences 28-56 cm long, densely pubescent; peduncle 3-5 cm long; pedicels 1.3- 3.5 mm long. Flowers calyx lobes deltate, 1.8-2.8 mm long, densely pubescent abaxially; petals yellow-green to white when fresh, lanceolate to oblong, 2.6-3.2 x 0.7- 1.5 mm, densely pubescent on both sur- faces. Staminateflowers hypanthium deeply cupular; filaments 0.5-0.8 mm long, glabrous to sparsely pubescent; anthers oblong, 0.9-1.25 mm long, glabrous; pistillode narrowly ellipsoid, constricted to a long stylode, 2.5-3 mm long overall, densely pubescent with ascending trichomes; rudimentary stigma capitate, sometimes apically notched. Pistillate flowers hypanthium cupular; staminodes without rudimentary anthers; ovary ovoid, 2 x 2.3 mm, densely pubescent; style 1.5 mm long; stigma capitate. Fruit globose at maturity, 1.8 cm diam., densely pubescent.

description: Shrub or tree; branches at first puberulent, soon glabrate; leaves 7-16 cm. lonlg, at first minutely puberulent, soon glabrate, leaflets 3-9 (mostly 5 or 7), obovate, obtuse, crenate to subentire, very slightly subrevolute, glabrate, darker on the upper surface, the lateral leaflets 1.5-7 cm. long, the terminal 5-7.5 cm. long; rachis-segments 5-22 mm. long, narrowly alate, sparsely puberulent; bracts deltoid, sparsely glandular; pedicels minutely puberuleilt below the abscission plate, glabrous above; sepals deltoid-ovate, subacute, glabrous on the outer surface; petals lanceolate, obtuse, about 1.5 mm. long, glabrous.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Arbor 2-5 m. alta; ramulis pilosis, deinde glabratis, prima fulvis deinde glaucis, saepe raris, saepe magnis, spineseentibus; foliis ad venas utrinque pilosis, inter venas sparse pilosis, 18-40 mm. longis, 4-8 mm. latis, spatulatis, obtusis, margine integro vel saepe irregularibus, saepe revolutis, ad basim cuneatis; petiolis 1-2 mm. longis, pilis longis; infloreseentia circa 2.5 mm. longa, amplificata, axim pilosa; bracteis deltoideo-ovatis, obtusis, diu manentibus, glabris, margine ciliolato pilis simplicibus longisque; pedicellis circa 2 mm. longis, infra discum dividentem pilis longissimis densisque, supra sparse pilosis; lobis calyeis deltoideis, subacutis, extra pilis simplicibus longisque, margine ciliolato pilis simplicibus longisque et pilis glandularibus clavatisque; petalis anguste ovatis, subsessilibus, 3 mm. longis, 1.2 mm. latis, glabris.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Tree to 5 m.; bralilehes pilose, becoming glabrate in age, at first brownish later becoming gray; branchlets few, relatively heavy, spineseent; leaves pilose on the veins above and below, sparsely long-pilose betweell the veins, 18-40 mm. long, 4-8 mm. broad, spatulate, obtuse at the apex, the margin entire or slightly irregular, somewhat reflexed, the base cuneate; petiole 1-2 mm. long, long-pilose; inflorescence about 2.5 cm. long, expanded, the flowers not congested, pilose; bracts deltoid-ovate, obtuse, long-persistent, glabrous on the outside with very long simple hairs, ciliate on the margin with long simple hairs; pedicels about 2 mm. long, densely very long pilose below the abscission plate, sparsely long-pilose above; sepals deltoid, subacute, with a few very long simple hairs on the outer surface, ciliate on the margin with long simple hairs and a few clavate glandular hairs; petals narrowly ovate, subsessile, 3 mm. long, 1.2 mm. broad, glabrous.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Small trees to 10 m. tall; branches minutely and very sparsely puberulent, slender, not spineseenit; leaves very sparsely and minutely puberulent, of two somewhat dissimilar types, the common type ovate, 3-8 cm. long, 9-30 mm. broad, obtuse' at the apex, regularly obscurely crenate, obtuse at the base, the less common type lance-ovate, 5.5-12.5 cm. long, 18-35,mm. broad, subacute, regularly and coarsely crenate-serrate, subacute at the base; petioles 5-25 mm. long, sparsely puberulent; infloreseence a contracted panicle, axillary or sometimes terminal, the axis puberulent, about 2 cm. long; bracts deltoid, densely puberulent, ciliate on the margins with short simple hairs; pedicels densely short-pilose below the abscission disk, sparsely so above, about 4 mm. long, slender; sepals deltoid, acute, puberulent, ciliate on the margin with simple hairs; petals broadly deltoid-ovate, acute, very sparsely ciliate on the margin, otherwise glabrous; fruit violaceous, about 6 mm. in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Arbor minima; ramulis pilis mollibus, gracilibus, non spineseentibus; foliis ovatis, 2.5-8 cm. longis, 9-20 mm. latis, obtusis, regulariter sparse crenatis; infloreseentia panicula glomerata circa 1 cm. longa, pilosa; bracteis deltoideis, saepe caduceis, dense pilosis; pedicellis gracilibus, pilis mollibus, circa 4 mm. longis; lobis calycis deltoideis, pilis densis et longis, margine ciliolato; petalis ovatis, circa 1.5 mm. longis, margine ciliolato pilis longis.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Small tree; branches velvety pilose, slender, not spineseent; leaves ovate, 2.5-8 cm. long, 9-20 mm. broad, obtuse at apex, regularly obscurely crenate, obtuse at the base, velvety pilose on the veins, otherwise sparsely pilose; infloreseence a contracted panicle about 1 cm. long, pilose; bracts deltoid, mostly caducous, densely pilose; pedicels slender, velvety pilose, about 4 mm. long; sepals deltoid, densely long-pilose, ciliate on the margin; petals ovate, about 1.5 mm. long, ciliate on the margins with long hairs.

description: Shrub or small tree; branches velvety pilose when young, later glabrate, light brown, the branchlets moderately slender, rather abundant, spineseent; leaves velvety-pilose, 18-31 mm. long, 8-15 mm. broad, obovate to oblong, obtuse to truncate and emarginate, the margin entire to coarsely dentate, subrevolute to strongly revolute, the veins deeply sunken in the upper surface, the base cuneate to subcuneate, the petiole slender, long, pilose.

description: Shrub to 3 m. high; branches slender; glabrous, little branched; leaves imparipinnately compound, at length subcoriaceous, 10-15 cm. long, glabrate; leaflets usually 9-17, usually about 15, oblanceolate or lanceolate, 15-30 mm. long, acute, entire or with few-several sharp serrations toward the apex, cuneate at the base, sessile; rachis-segments 7-15 mm. long, narrowly winged (or rarely broadly winged); petiole 1-2.5 cm. long, narrowly winged; infloreseence a contracted panicle about one-third-one-half as long as the leaves (1.5-8 cm. long), puberulent with clavate glandular hairs (or with a few simple non-glandular hairs on the ultimate branches); bracts deltoid to lanceolate, acutish, glabrous except with a few simple hairs on the margin; pedicels glabrous, about 1.5 mm. long; sepals deltoid, acute or obtuse, glabrous (rarely with a few cilia on the margin); petals narrowly ovate, obtuse, about 2 mm. long; anthers ovate; fruit about 9 mm. in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Barkley, F. A. 1944. Schinus L. Brittonia. 5: 160-198. f. 1-22.

description: Large trees to 30 m x 38 cm, without buttresses. Bark pale brown, with vertical and horizontal fissures revealing darker brown below, inner bark reddish-brown with paler streaks. Trichomes golden to ferrugineous, appressed, to 0.5 mm long. Leaves 32- 58 cm long, 10-14-foliolate; petiole densely pubescent, 5.7-8 cm long; rachis densely pubescent, 13-26 cm long; leaflets usually distinctly alternate; petiolules densely pubescent, the lateral ones 5-15 mm long, the terminal one 10-20 mm long; leaflet blades narrowly oblong to lanceolate or occasion- ally narrowly elliptic, 14-17.3 x 4.8-6.5 cm, (sub)coriaceous, the apex short- to long acuminate, the base rounded, oblique, the margin sometimes revolute; abaxial surface sparsely to densely pubescent; adaxial surface glabrous except midrib sparsely to densely pubescent; midrib prominent abaxially, prominulous adaxially; secondary veins in 12-17 pairs, prominent abaxially, impressed to prominulous adaxially; higher order veins prominulous abaxially, flat to prominulous adaxially. Inflorescences 15.5- 19 cm long, densely pubescent, peduncle 0.5-1.5 cm long; pedicels 1.3-3 mm long. Staminateflowers hypanthium cupular; ca- lyx lobes deltate, 2-2.5 mm long; petals (greenish) white when fresh, drying ferrugineous, narrowly ovate to oblong, 2.9-3.5 x 1.3-2 mm, densely pubescent on both surfaces; filaments 0.2-0.5 mm long, gla- brous; anthers oblong, 1.3-1.4 mm long, pubescent, especially at apex; pistillode cylindric, 2-2.5 mm long, glabrous to sparsely pubescent; rudimentary stigma capitate, sometimes irregularly notched. Pistillate flowers hypanthium cupular; calyx lobes broadly ovate, the apex acuminate; staminodes with rudimentary anthers, 0.5-0.7 mm long; ovary ovoid, 2 x 2.3 mm, glabrous; style 0.2-0.5 mm long; stigma capitate. Fruit maturing black, broadly ellipsoid, 3.2-3.5 x 2.3-2.5 cm when dry, glabrous.

description: Small to large trees, 8-35 m x 50 cm; with shallow buttresses to 50 cm high. Bark brown, thin, longitudinally fissured, inner bark reddish-orange. Trichomes brown, appressed, to 0.3 mm long. Leaves 29-93 cm long, 8-11 -foliolate; petiole glabrous to sparsely pubescent, 8.7-22 cm long; rachis sparsely pubescent, 11.2-62 cm long; leaflets alternate or sub-opposite; petiolules glabrous to sparsely pubescent, the lateral ones 6-10 mm long, the terminal one 9-25 mm long; leaflet blades narrowly oblong, lan- ceolate or occasionally narrowly elliptic, ovate or obovate, 10.2-27.5 x 4.2-10.2 cm, usually coriaceous, often shiny adaxially, the apex usually long-acuminate, the base rounded to obtuse or occasionally cuneate, sometimes oblique, the margin sometimes revolute; abaxial surface glabrous to sparsely pubescent; adaxial surface glabrous; mid - rib prominent abaxially, impressed to prominulous adaxially; secondary veins in long, glabrous; rudimentary stigma capitate, sometimes apically notched. description: Arbor 11 m alta, 20 cm diametro, ramulis novellis et petiolis pilosulis, mox glabrescentibus. Stipulae deciduae, 9 mm longae, glabrae. Petiolus 3-4 mm longus foliolum sessile, lamina 5.5-7.5 cm longa, 2.5-3.5 cm lata, elliptica, ad basim acuta, ad apicem acuta sed extremitate obtusa et emarginata, puberula supra costam, infra glabra et minute punctulata, costis salientibus, venulae conspicuae. Inflorescentiae axillares et terminales, sessiles, 4 cm longae, axe glabro, bracteis 2 mm longis, 1.5 mm latis, caducis, minute ciliolatis. Pedicelli 5.5-6 mm longi, glabri; bracteolae connatae. 5 mm longae, 2.5 mm latae, obovatae, ad apicem ciliolatae; hypanthium 5 mm longum, glabrum, 4 mm diametro, infundibuliforme, stipite 4.5-5 mm longo, glabro. Sepala 10 mm longa, 3.5-5.5 mm lata, glabra, elliptica, imbricata. Petala 5, aequalia, 6.5-8 mm longa, 1-1.5 mm lata, lineari-lanceolata, acuta, punctata, longo-ciliata. Staminarum 3 fertilium fila- menta 21 mm longa, longo-villosa, cum staminodiis connata ad basim per 1-2 mm, antherae oblongae, 4.5 mm longae, 1 mm latae, glabrae; 6 staminodia subulata, 3-4.5 mm longa, villosa. Stigma capitellatum; stylus ca. 16 mm longus, glaber; ovarium 4 mm longum, 1.5 mm latum, glabrum, oblongum, stipite 1.5 mm longo, glabro. Fructus immaturus.

description: Arbor ad 20 m. alta, ramulis teretibus, nitidis, glabris; stipulae 3-3.5 mm. longae, falcato-lanceolatae, crasso-coriaceae, glabrae, persistentes; petioli 3 mm. longi, 1.5-2.5 mm. diametro, valde corrugati, glabri; laminae 4.5-7.5 cm. longae, 3-5 cm. latae, rigido-coriaceae, late ovales vel orbiculares, saepe obliquae, ad basim rotundato-obtusae, ad apicem obtuso-acutae vel obtusae, margine integro, utrinque glabrae; costa utrinque valde salienti, venis in paribus 6-7, utrinque leviter salientibus; inflorescentiae 7.5-14 cm. longae, in axillis foliorum summorum dense racemosae; pedunculis 6-15 mm. longis, 1-2 mm. diametro, appresso-puberulis, axibus supra sulcatis; bracteis 1.5 mm. longis, ovato-lanceolatis, bracteolis supra medium pedicellum affixis, 0.5 mm. longis, lanceolatis, pedicellis 2-5 mm. longis, puberulis; alabastra obliquo-lanceolata, acuta, dense appresso-puberulentia, calyx crasso-coriaceus, in partem unam (vel plures) irregulariter fissus, mox deciduus; petala 5, obovata ad orbiculata, ca. 5 mm. diametro, glabra, alba ad basim rubicundo-tincta, unguicilo 1-1.5 mm. longo; stamina 11, inaequalia, 2-2.7 mm. longa, glabra, antheris obscuro-flavis, 6 mm. longis, 0.7 mm. latis, linearo-lanceolatis, ad apicem longo-acuminatis, filamentis albis, alternis longioribus, 1.3-2 mm. longis; stigma simplex, stylus ca. 4 mm. longus, filiformis, basi excepta glaber, ovarium 3.5 mm. altum, 1.3 mm. diametro, 8-ovulare; fructus ignotus.

description: Arbor; folia imparipinnata, 3-5-jugata, petiolis 2.5-4 cm. longis, teretibus, ferrugineo-pilosis; rachibus 5-11.5 cm. longis, exalatis; petiolulis 2-5 mm. longis, foliolis 4.5-12 cm. longis, 2-4 cm. latis, ad basim foliorum brevioribus et lanceo- ovatis, foliolis superioribus oblongo-lanceolatis, ad basim rotundato-obtusis, ad apicem gradatim caudato-acuminatis, margine integro; supra glabris, infra aureo- brunneo-pilosis; costa et venis primis in facie superiore impressis sed infra salientibus, venis in paribus 17-20, ascendentibus; inflorescentiae fasciculatae, cauligenae, racemosae, 10-11 cm. longae, omnibus partibus brunneo-pilosis; pedunculis 0.5-1.5 cm. longis, bracteis obovatis, navicularibus, pedicellis 2.5-3 cm. longis; alabastra globosa, obtuse apiculata, calyce circa 1 cm. longo, in 3-4 partes recurvatos inaequaliter fisso; petalum unum (vel duo), orbiculatum, unguiculatum, 2 cm. diametro (petalis duobus tum minoribus et suborbiculatis), dorso appresso-sericeum; stamina numerosissima, 2-3 longiora, filamentis glabris, staminum maiorum antheris oblongis, 2.5-3.5 mm. longis, 1-1.5 mm. latis, stami- num minorum oblongis, 1.5 mm. longis, 1 mm. latis; stigma capitatum, stylus ca. 10 mm. longus, subrectus, ovarium densissime brunneo-sericeum, oblongum, ca. 10 mm. longum, 6-ovulare, stipite 7 mm. longa, sparse sericeo; fructus ignotus.

description: Caule circa 5 dm. alto, erecto, ramoso, piloso vel subter glabrato; foliis 5-foliolatis, vel ramorum floralium 3-foliolatis; petiolis 5-10 mm. longis; foliolis obovatis, 1-2 cm. longis, glabris et superne valde glandulari-punetatis, subtus pilosis; racemis 3-5 cm. longis, rachide conspicue pilosa cunm pilis patentibus; floribus plerumque 2 ad nodum singulum; calyce piloso; tubo circa 1 mm. longo, lobis lanceolatis, 1..5 mnm. longis; corolla alba, 5-6 mm. longa; fructu ovali, 6 mm. longo, dense glanduloso; rostro brevi, forti; seminibus circa 5 mm. longis, 4 mm. latis, fuscis.

description: Frutex (?) 15 m. altus, ramulis juvenilibus strigulis, glabrescentibus. Folia 7-12.5 cm. longa, 9-foliolata, imparipinnata, petiolo 1.5-3.5 cm. longo, brunneopilosulo, rachibus 3-5 cm. longis, anguste canaliculatis. Folio,a alterna ad subopposita, petiolulis 2-2.5 mm. longis, brunneo-pilosulis; laminae 3-4 cm. longae, 1-1.5 cm. latae, ellipticae, ad basim apicemque obtusae, ad apicem mucronatae, glabrae et lucidae supra, infra tessellatae, pallidiores, brunneopilosulae, praecipue in costa, venulis conspicuis infra, supra subobsoletis. Inflorescentiae axillares vel terminales, ad 15 cm. longae, brunneo-pilosulae, bracteis 3-3.5 mm. longis, lineari-lanceolatis, acuminatis, bracteolis 2-3 mm. longis, subulatis, pedicelli circa 0.5 mm. longi. Calyx 8 mm. longus, campanulatus, in alabastro arcuatus, extus brunneo-pilosulus, lobis inaequalibus, 1.5-2.5 mm. longis, fere semirotundis, hypanthium circa 3 mm. longum. Corolla lutea, glabra, vexilli unguicilo 4 mm. longo, lamina orbiculari, 12 mm. diametro, alis 12 mm. longis, lamina plus minusve obovata, 5 mm. lata, unguicilo 5 mm. longo, carinarum laminae 9.5 mm. longae, 4 mm. latae, oblongae, unguicilo 4 mm. longo. Stamina 10, monadelpha, glabra, filamentorum tubo supra aperto. Ovarium circa 6 mm. longum, 1.5 mm. latum, oblongum, brunneo-strigulum, 6-ovulatum, stipite 2.5 mm. longo, glabro, stylus 8 mm. longus, ad basim brunneo-strigosulus, stigma simplex. Fructus orbicularis ad orbiculari-ovalis, 4.5-5.5 cm. diametro, ad basim inaequalis, venosus, coriaceus, brunneo-puberulus, stipite 1.5-2 cm. longo.

description: Arbor 15 m alta, 20 cm diametro, ramulis glabris; petiolus 15-27 mm longus, parce minuteque strigulosus, rachibus 4-8.5 cm longis, minute strigulosis; f oliola 3-jugata, petiolulis 5-6 mni longis; laminae rigido-coriaceae, glabrae, nitidae, lanceolato-oblongae vel ellipticae, 8-12.5 cm longae, 4-6 cm latae, basi leviter cordatae, apice acuminatae; infloreseentiae terminales, ca. 12 cm longae, inillute strigulosae et parce strigosae, pedicellis 30-32 mm longis, minute strigulosis et parce strigosis; bracteolae crasso-coriaceae, eoneavae, 25 mm longae, 15 mm latae, externe minute strigulosae et parce strigosae, intus glabrae, apice glandula inconspicua praeditis; calycis lobi oblongo-elliptici, obtusi, 22 mm longi, 10-14 mm lati, intus glabri, externe strigulosi; petala 5, inaequalia, externe sericea, intus glabra, uno rotundato, stipite 3 mm longo, lamina ca. 25 mm diametro, quattuor petalis ellipticis vel ovalibus, stipite 3-6 mm longo, laminis 20 mm longis, 15-18 mm latis; ovarium dense strigosum; fructus dense strigulosus et strigosus.

description: A tree 15 m tall, 20 cm in diameter, with glabrous branchlets; petioles 15-27 mm long, sparsely and minutely strigulose, the rachis similarly pubescent, 4-8.5 cm long, terete; leaflets 3-jugate, the petiolules 5-6 mm long, the blades rigid-coriaceous, glabrous, shining on both surfaces, 8-12.5 cm long, 4-6 cm wide, lanceolate-oblonog or elliptic, subcordate at the base, the apex acuminate; costa impressed on the upper surface, salient beneath, the venules obscure above, prominulous beneath; inflorescences terminal, racemose, about 12 cm long, the axis minutely strigulose and sparingly strigose, the bracts caducous; pedicels 30-32 mm long, minutely strigulose and sparingly strigose, the bracteoles thickcoriaceous, concave, with a gland at the apex of each, 25 mm long, 15 mm wide, minutely strigulose and sparingly strigose externally, glabrous within, free from the cupular, densely strigulose, 6-mm-long hypanthium; sepals four, 22 mm long, 10-14 mm wide, glabrous within, densely strigillose externally, obtuse, slightly concave; petals 5, one rather rotund and with a stipe 3 mm long, the other four elliptic to oval with stipes 3-6 mm long, the blades 20 mm long and 15-18 mm wide; filaments ligulate, 25 mm long, villose basally, the anthers villose on the inner surfaces, oblong, 8mm long; stigma capitate, the style glabrous, the ovary densely strigose; immature fruits oblong, slightly arcuate, beaked with the stylar remnant, sessile, 10-11 cm long, ea 3 cm wide, densely stigulose and sparingly strigose.

description: Stem low, 1-7 dm. high, erect or ascending, sparsely branched, sometimes very short, sterile, bearing only a cluster of leaves-the inflorescence borne on a naked or slightly leafy lateral shoot, arising from near or slightly below ground level. Pubescence usually evident on lower portion of stem, becoming scanty with age. Trichomes about 1 mm. in length, curved, upwardly appressed or subspreading in various directions; a secondary indumentum of minute curled or hooked hairs is commonly observable. Stipules frequently conspicuous, striate-lanceolate, up to 1.3 cm. in length, 0.25 cm. in basal width. Leaves clustered or scattered, con- siderably exceeded by inflorescence, scarcely reduced upwards. Petioles 3-8 cm. in length, glabrate, or sparingly pubescent; pulvini conspicuously hairy, often considerably darkened. Leaflets ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 2.2-2.8 times as long as wide, acuminate-pointed at tip, tapering or rounded at base; terminal blades usually exceeding laterals, up to 15 dni. in length, symmetrical, tapering at base; lateral leaflets rounded or tapering at base, frequently strongly oblique. Main lateral nerves curved parallel to leaflet margin and not extending into it. Blades frequently appearing distinctly 3-nerved; some transverse veins present but terti- ary reticulum very weakly developed. Leaves somewhat shiny above, lighter be- neath, glabrous or appearing so, usually with a few hooked hairs along midrib, both above and beneath, sometimes with submicroscopic hairs (similar to those of D. laxumr) below, and (or) longer appressed trichomes above. Stipels filiform, de- ciduous or persistent. Inflorescence usually of terminal, or terminal and axillary racernes, sometimes arising as a separate naked shoot. Rachis rather slender and lax at anthesis, becoming stiffer as fruit matures, finely uncinate-pubescent and with a few longer hairs. Calyx about 2 mm. high. Petals similar to those of D. laxumr, thin, about 5 mm. long. Wings distinctly spurred, closely associated with keel. Fruiting pedicel ca. 10-13 mm., stalk 10-16 mm., stamen column 5-6 mm. in length. Loment 2-3 jointed, dark brown at maturity, extremely large; segments 12-15 mm. long, ca. 5 mm. high; posterior-ventral margins continuous, straight, strongly extended; anterior margin nearly straight or somewhat concave, oblique or nearly vertical, the ventral-anterior angle commonly protruded in a gibbosity, but scarcely hooked.

description: Meristems auxotelic, RGUs monomorphic; inflorescences metameric, the axis persistent, leaves late-suppressed hysteranthous and the inflorescence at anthesis a pseudoraceme of capitula; axillary branch buds monomorphic, sylleptic and proleptic, when sylleptic forming paraclades.

description: Liana or scandent shrub 3-15 m tall, 4-8 cm dbh; young shoot apices crowned by clusters of hard coriaceous overlapping cataphylls. Leaves 14-49 cm long, stipules persistent, deltoid, spinescent, 6-7 (-20) x 3-5 mm; rachis tomentose; leaflets 7-9 (-15), obovate or elliptic, 6-22 x 2.5-8 cm, lustrous above, glabrous below, the margin repand, the base rounded to obtuse, the apex cuspidate; midvein prominent; secondary venation camptodromous; tertiary venation reticulate; petiolule 3.5-6 mm long. Inflorescence an axillary or terminal panicle, 15-45 cm long; bracts spinescent, 5-7 x 3-5 mm; peduncle brown-yellowish hirsute. Flowers violet with pale pink to white marks, 16-20 mm long; pedicel 4 mm long; bracteoles ovate, 9 x 8 mm; calyx 5 mm long, yellowish-brown hirsute, with five obtuse teeth; banner 10 x 9 mm, hirsute on adaxial surface; keel petals 8 x 5 mm; wing petals 11 x 5 mm, sparsely hairy on the outer surface; stamens monadelphous, 8 mm long, the free part of filament 1.5-2 mm long; style curved, 7 mm long, hirsute to woolly. Fruit a one-seeded samara, 6-8.5 x 1.5-2.2 cm, sparsely yellowish-brown hirsute; seed 12 mm long.

description: Arbor 5-13 m alta, trunco 20-80 cm diametro, ramulis glabris; stipulae persistentes, intrapetiolares, crassae, tornatis corporibus conjunctis; folia glabra, alterna, paripinnata, petiolis teretibus, 18-25 mm longis, rhachibus teretibus, 25-65 mm longis, foliola opposita, 2- vel 3-juga, petiolulis tortis, ca 1 mm longis, laminis leviter arcuatis, ellipticis, ad basem apicemque acutis usque ad subobtusis vel obtusis, tenuiter coriaceis, 6.5-8.5 cm longis, 3.5-4 (6.5) cm latis, costa venisque primariis plus minusve salientibus; inflorescentiae axillares vel terminales, 10-11 cm longae, paniculatae, puberulae, bracteis bracteolisque mox caducis, rotundatis, concavis, pedicellis 4.5-8 mm longis, puberulis; hypanthium cylindricum, 10-12 mm longum, 3-4 mm diametro, stipitatum, stipite 5-6 mm longo, puberulo; sepala 4, imbricata, uno pari in alio pari incluso, aequalia, extus puberula, intus tomentella, elliptica ad ovalia, 11-12.5 mm longa et 6.5-9 mm lata; petala 5, libera, subaequalia, extus glabra, intus tomen- tosa, brevi-unguiculata, unguiculo 2-4.5 mm longo, lamina 11-13 mm longa, 4.5-7 mm lata elliptica vel anguste elliptica, ad apicem acutis, attenuatis versus basem; stamina 10, filamentis ad basem brevissime in tubo ca 0.5 mm longo cohaerentibus, 50-55 mm longis, antheris versatilibus, oblongo- ellipticis 2-2.5 mm longis et 1 mm latis; stigma capitatum, stylo filamentoso, ca 55 mm longo, ovario oblongo, ca 5 mm longo, 1.5 mm lato, marginibus tomentosis sed lateraliter glabro, gynophoro (parte libera) 1.5 mm longo, parte residua cum hypanthio adhaerenti; fructus elliptico-oblongus, ca 13 cm longus et 6.5 cm latus, planus, glaber, faciebus transverse venosus, exocarpio tenui crustoso ex endocarpio secedenti; semina nigra, transverse elongata, oblonga, ca 25 mm longa et 18 mm lata, arillo parvo annulari instructa.

description: Arbor 10-15 m alta, trunco 20 cm diametro, ramulis juvenilibus micropuberulis sed mox glabris; stipulae persistentes, coriaceae, oblatae usque ad semicirculares, 3.5-7.5 cm longae, 4.5-8.5 cm latae, glabrae, nitidae, supra evenosae sed infra distincte venulosae; folia glabra, paripinnata, petiolo 6.5- 8.5 cm longo, tereti, rhachi 10-12.5 cm longo, tereti; foliola 3- vel 4-juga, glabra, petiolulo 6-12 mm longo, tereti, lamina 10-25 cm longa, 4.5-10 cm lata, oblonga, subconcava, ad apicem rotunda et emarginata, ad basem subobtusa usque ad obtusa, coriacea, supra nitida, faciebus ambobus paene evenulosa, costa supra impressa, infra valde salienti; inflorescentiae terminales et in axillis superior- ibus, ca 14 cm longae (vel longiores), racemosae vel paniculato-racemosae, partibus omnibus casta- neo-velutinae, bracteis et bracteolis deciduis, ca 5 mm longis et 6 mm latis, hemisphaericis, extus castaneo-velutinis, intus versus basem strigulosis; flores albi, immaturi, pedicellis 12-20 mm longis, teretibus, hypanthio turbinato, ca 8 mm longo et 9 mm diametro; sepala late ovalia usque ad late rotundato-triangularia, 8.5-10 mm longa, 8-8.5 mm lata, pubescentia ut bracteae; petala immatura; stamina immatura, in alabastro introrso-plicata, filamentis 12 mm longis, antheris oblongis 6 mm longis et 2 mm latis, glabris, connectivo parce apiculato; stigma peltatum, stylo praeter basem sericeum glabro, ovario ca 9 mm longo et 4 mm lato, oblongo, castaneo-sericeo, gynophoro 2.5 mm longo; fructus non visus.

description: Arbor 10 m alta, trunco 30 cm diametro, ramulis glabris, stipulis caducis, ca 6 mm longis, 0.8 mm latis, anguste lineari-lanceolatis, acicularibus, juvenilibus parce strigulosis sed mox glabrescentibus; folia fere glabra (foliolorum juvenilium petiolulis et lamina supra ad costam parce strigulosis); petioli 26-30 mm longi, teretes; rachis marginata, 19-21 cm longa, foliolorum in quoque pari minute bisti- pellata; foliola 9- vel 10-juga, petiolulis 2 mm longis, laminis 7-8.5 mm longis, 2 cm latis, anguste ellipticis vel elliptico-lanceolatis, ad apicem acutis vel acuminatis, ad basem inaequilateraliter acutis, maturis glabris, infra pallidioribus, costa venulisque supra planis, costa infra salienti; inflorescentiae ramigerae, racemoso-paniculatae, 13-25 cm longae, axe primario glabro versus basem, aliter axibus minute strigulosis, bracteis caducis, triangularibus, ca 1.5 mm longis et I mm latis, extus sericeis, intus glabris; alabastra globosa, verticali-costata, umbonulata, ca 9 mm diametro, pedicellis com- pressis, strigulosis, 18-20 mm longis, supra medium bibracteolatis, bracteolis deciduis, ca 1 mm longis et 0.5 mm latis, anguste ovatis, extus sericeis, intus glabris; calycis segmenta 4, intus glabra, extus sericea, decidua; petalum album, lamina oblata, 11-13 mm longa, 15-20 mm lata, ad basem cordata, unguiculo 4-5 mm longo; 2 staminorum maiorum filamenta caduca, ca 14 mm longa, infra medium villosula, antheris 2.5-3 mm longis et 1 mm latis, oblongis, glabris, staminibus minoribus multis, mox deciduis, filamentis ca 10-15 mm longis, glabris; gynoecium sericeum, stigmata obtusa, stylo 2.5 mm longo, de latere directo, ovario anguste elliptico, 7 mm longo et 3 mm lato, valde marcescenti, gynophoro 6 mm longo; fructus non visus.

description: Arbor 5 m alta, ramulis juvenilibus brunneo-tomentellis; stipulae persistentes 15-16 mm longae et 5-8 mm latae, lanceolatae, acuminatae, extus tomentellae, intus glabrae; petioli 20-26 mm longi, tomentelli sed mox glabrescentes supra excepti, teretes, rhachibus 17.5-26 cm longis, tomentellis, ad foliolorum basem bistipellatis, stipellis 3-4.5 mm longis, acicularibus; foliola 19-24-juga, petiolulis ca 1 mm longis, tomentellis, laminis 30-68 mm longis et 7-10 mm latis, anguste oblongo-lanceolatis, ad apicem acutis et mucronatis, ad basem cordatis, supra nitidis et infra sericeis, ad marginem revolutis, costa supra impressa, infra salienti, venulis obscuris; inflorescentiae axillares, 7.5-15 cm longae, racemosae vel pauci-ramuloso-paniculatae, axibus brunneo-tomentellis, bracteis deciduis, ovatis, acutis, 5-6 mm longis et 3.5-4 mm latis, extus tomentellis, intus glabris nisi ad basem sericeis; pedicelli 5 mm longi, tomentelli, ad medium bibracteolati, bracteolis deciduis, 3.5-4 mm longis, 1.5 mm latis, lanceolatis, extus sericeis, intus glabris; calycis segmenta 4 vel 5, extus sericea, intus dense velutina; petalum glabrum, album, unguiculo 2 mm longo, lamina oblata 8-9 mm longa, 10-11 mm lata, ad basem cordata; 4 staminum maiorum filamenta 9-10 mm longa, parce villosa, antheris ca 3.5 mm longis et 2 mm latis, ovalibus, glabris; filamenta staminum minorum glabra, ca 8 mm longa, antheris 1 mm longis latisque, oblongis; stigma punctiforme, stylo ca 1 mm longo, ovario arcuato- elliptico, ca 8 mm longo et 3 mm lato, sericeo, gynophoro 3 mm longo, sericeo; fructus non visus.

description: Leaflets commonly to 20 cm long, chartaceous, broadly ovate, acuminate to a medium long, obtuse tip; pubescence short, white, moderately dense on petiolule, very sparse on both surfaces of blade. Bracteoles 1 mm long, obtuse. Pedicel 2 mm long . Calyx 13 mm long; pubescence short, white, very sparse; upper lip slightly shorter than tube, upper edge constricted behind non-apiculate tip; lowest tooth 2 mm long, acute, equalling obtuse laterals. Standard 3 cm long. Pod commonly to 25 × 4.5 cm, compressed, spirally dehiscent, pale brown; each with sutural ribs and an extra rib ea 6 mm from ventral rib. Seeds to 30 X 18 × 13 mm, oblong-elliptic, moderately compressed, red, sometimes buoyant but not impermeable to water; hilum ea 12 mm long.

description: Shrubs or more often small trees 5-10 m tall, the trunks slender, 8-10 cm in diam., the bark pale gray, longitudinally fissured, the branchlets pale, glabrous; stipules triangular, deciduous or persistent, acute, 1-1.5 mm long and wide, minutely ciliolate; leaves unifoliolate, glabrous; petioles 4.5-6 mm long, the petiolules 1.8-2.5 mm long; leaf-blades thinly coriaceous, narrowly elliptic to elliptic-oblong or oblong, 16.5-42 cm long, 4.5-13 cm wide, the base rotund- obtuse, sometimes somewhat cordate, the apex acuminate, the midrib prolonged beyond the leaflet-apex in a short mucro, costa and primary veins prominulous, the costa salient on the underside; inflorescences axillary, racemose, (3.5) 7-9 cm long, sessile, the axis minutely puberulous, the bracts and bracteoles triangular- ovate, 0.7-1.5 mm long and 0.5-1 mm wide, ciliolate; bracts glabrous, or puberu- lous on the outer surface; bracteoles puberulous externally; flowers white, fragrant, the pedicels puberulous, 10-18 mm long, the buds puberulous oval or subglobose, 10-13 mm long, 7-13 mm in diam., obtuse or more or less apiculate; calyx sub- carnose, minutely puberulous externally, more or less minutely appressed-puberu- lous on the inner surfaces, segments (2) 3 or 4, reflexed after anthesis, elliptic, acute; petals 5, sessile, attenuate basally, more or less equal in size and shape, elliptic or oblanceolate or sometimes oblong, acute, glabrous except ciliate in basal parts, 16-21 mm long, 5-8 mm wide, the petals like the stamens arising from the tomentulose torus; stamens 10, the filaments free, glabrous, introrsely-extrorsely complanate, 3-3.5 mm long, the anthers dorsifixed near the base, alternately slightly shorter and longer, the longer ones 9-13 mm long and 1-1.5 mm wide, the shorter 8-12.5 mm long and 1.5 mm wide, all narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, long- mucronate, laterally densely long-tomentose, otherwise glabrous, the hairs white, intertwined, producing a loosely coherent, oval androecial body; pollen grains globose, tricolporate, the colpi discontinuous at the poles, the tectum finely reticulate with numerous obtuse projections on the reticulum; gynoecium sessile, white, the stigma punctiform, the style 4-5.5 mm long, subulate, the ovary densely white-puberulous, 5.5-6 mm long and 2-2.5 mm wide, oblong, 10-15-ovulate; fruit oval in outline, 8.5 cm long and 5 cm in diam., one suture slightly sulcate, the pericarp green, soft-fleshy, oily, very fragrant, about 0.75 mm thick, the mesocarp white, soft, 6 mm thick, the endocarp membranous, translucent, the two seeds more or less oval in outline and in section, 3.5-5 cm long, 2.5-3.5 cm wide.

description: Shrub or small tree 1-4 m tall. Stems brittle, mostly 4-6 mm diam, with well developed pith. Leaflets lanceolate to linear-ovate, variously pubescent, the upper surfaces glabrate to merely puberulent at maturity but never tomentose, and the veins not prominently raised beneath as in P. tomentosus; stipules 8-14 mm long; middle leaflet similar to but somewhat larger than the laterals, 2-15 cm long, 1-4 cm wide. Inflorescence similar to P. tomentosus. Flowers "bright" yellow, the banner sometimes with "purple-brown" or "greyish" markings. Calyx 13-16 mm long, moderately to densely pubescent, the lobes acute, 2-6 mm long, upper two somewhat longer and fused so as to appear cleft. Banner broadly cordate, ca 25 mm long, 20 mm wide, notched at the apex, the claw ca 6 mm long. Wings similar to but somewhat shorter than the keel; keel petals 28-32 mm long, the blade ca 25 (rarely 21-24) mm long, the claw ca 8 mm long. Stamens 24-28 mm long. Ovary densely tomentose to glabrous and merely ciliate along the margins. Fruit a flattened, 2-10-seeded, puberulent to glabrate, stipitate pod, 3-22 cm long, 0.8-2.0 cm wide; seeds 4-6 mm long, 4.1-5.0 mm wide.

description: Affinis D. myriadenae Ulbr., sed foliolis anguste oblanceolatis arcte conduplicatis 0.4-0.8 (nec 1.5- 3) mm usque latis, calycis dentibus anguste triangularibus +/- 1.5-2 (nec depresso-deltatis 0.6-1.2) mm usque longis, necnon calycis vexillique glandulis minimis 0.1-0.2 (nec 0.5-0.7) mm usque diametro diversa. Fruticulus gracilis diffusus +/- 4 dm altus, praeter calyces sericeos stipulasque ciliolatas undique glaber; foliorum rachis cum petiolo 2-24 mm longa, foliolis 7-13 anguste oblanceolatis 4-6 mm longis; inflorescentia terminalis sublaxe spicata; flores fere D. cylindricae Hook., bractea persistenti suffulti; calycis a basi sericeo-villosi dentes anguste triangulares +/- 1.5-2 x 1-1.2 mm longi; petala bicoloria, vexillo primum ochroleuco mox rubescenti, petalis epistemoneis vivide violaceo-purpureis vel coe- ruleo-lilacinis.

description: Slender subshrubs with decumbent or ascending, low-verruculose stems +/- 2-3 dm long, glabrous except for ciliolate stipules and white-silky calyces, the gland- dotted leaves greenish or glaucescent, many of them crowded on lateral brachy- blasts below mid-stem, the subcompact flower-spike raised well above foliage on peduncle terminal to hornotinous long-shoots. Stipules lance-acuminate, includ- ing the associated leaf-spur 2-6 mm long, the blade glabrous or dorsally reddish- brown, becoming dry fuscous, persistent. Leaf-stalks 2-24 mm long, the inter- foliolar intervals 1.5-4 mm long; leaflets (7) 9-13, subequilong, the 3 distal ones palmate or almost so, the blades linear-oblanceolate 4-6 x 0.4-0.8 mm, con- duplicate, acute mucronulate, ventrally smooth eglandular, the fuscous, scarcely protuberant glands of dorsal face randomly scattered. Peduncles 2.5-4.5 cm long; flower-spikes mostly 2-4.5 cm long; bracts persistent through anthesis, each folded around a calyx, the body oblong-oblanceolate, in profile 3.5-4 x 1.5-2 mm, broadly pallid-marginate and either from base upward or only beyond middle blackish and densely glandular-verruculose, at apex abruptly contracted into a livid subulate tail 2-2.7 mm long. Calyx 5.8-6.4 mm long, the 10-ribbed tube +/- 4-4.5 mm, its intercostal membranes minutely gland-sprinkled; petals bicol- ored, the banner ochroleucous early rubescent, the epistemonous ones either lilac- blue or vivid violet-purple; banner +/- 8.5 mm long, the blade +/- 4.7 x 4.2 mm, the subapical gland very small; wings and keel perched 2-2.5 mm above hypanthium, the keel +/- 10 mm long, its blades 6.5 x 4 mm, the subapical gland minute or 0; androecium 8 mm long; ovary pilosulous distally; pod not seen.

description: Habitu toto, bracteis floralibus parvulis et ovario sericeo-piloso cum L. amazonica congrua, sed grandiflora, florifera Styracem revocans, calyce ad anthesin 6-7.5 (nec 3-4) mm petalisque (ab hypanthio separatis) 9-11 (nec 4-6) mm longis manifeste diversa.

description: Trees 10-25 m tall, with straight, fluted trunk and flexuous, fuscous annotinous branchlets, glabrous below the crisply silky-pilosulous axes of inflorescence, the simple, sessile but wrinkled-pulvinate leaves chartaceous and subconcolorous, the nodding flowers borne in short, loosely few-flowered, simple racemes or depauperate panicles in the axils of coeval leaves. Stipules submembranous, ovate or lanceolate, 1-2.5 mm long, deciduous. Pulvinus of leaflets 3-5.5 mm long, deeply transversely rugulose, and on ventral side sulcate lengthwise, jointed to a short leaf-spur. Leaf-blades elliptic or ovate-elliptic from a slightly inequilateral base, (7) 8-17 mm long, 3-6 mm wide, 2.1-3.2 times as long as wide, short-acuminate below the obtuse or subacute apex, the subrevolute margin randomly short-toothed by excurrent veinlets. Venation of leaf-blades prominulous on both faces, the straight or gently falcate midrib giving rise on each side to 4-6 major (and several weaker, intercalary) incurved-ascending secondary veins brochidodrome well within the margin, these in turn generating a sharply defined reticulum of tertiary and subsequent venules. Racemes both solitary and fasciculate by 2 or 3 in leaf- axils, sometimes weakly branched at base, the main axis (5) 10-16-flowered, becoming 2-5 cm long; bracts ovate, 1-1.5 mm long, brown and glabrate dorsally, minutely ciliolate, not visibly veined; pedicels at anthesis 3.5-10 mm long, in fruit thickened, straight, up to 10 (-?) mm long; bracteoles 2 above mid-pedicel, resembling bracts but slightly smaller. Calyx crateriform, 6-7.5 mm long, glabrate externally, minutely ciliolate at the truncate orifice, the hemispherical, dorsally subgibbous hypanthium +/- 2-2.5 mm long, 3.5-4.2 mm diam, slightly constricted at the mouth and shallowly 1 0-grooved externally, the campanulate, almost entire limb 4-5.5 mm long, 5-6.5 mm diam. Petals white, brunnescent when dried, of subequal length; banner 8.8-11 mm long, 6.5-8 mm wide, depressed-deltate at apex; wing- and keel-petals 9.5-10 mm long, the claw a trifle longer than the lance-elliptic, obtuse, obscurely 5-nerved blade. Filaments 10, alternately 5-6.5 and 5 mm long, the antepetalous set shorter; anthers lanceolate, 1.3-1.7  0.7-0.8 mm wide, barbellate at apex. Ovary shortly stipitate, the stipe +/- as long as hypanthium, the body densely silky-pilosulous, the straight style 5.5-6 mm long, puberulent at very base, thence glabrous, well-exserted at anthesis, the stigma not enlarged; ovules 4-5, only one maturing. Pod subsessile, plumply oblong- ellipsoid, rounded at each end, abruptly mucronate by the style-base, the body 24-37 mm long, 15-20 mm diam, a little laterally compressed, the fleshy, when ripe mushy, valves +/- 5 mm thick, glabrescent externally, green becoming pinkish- brown, when dried crumpled and prunelike, apparently indehiscent. Seed solitary, almond-like, 20-25 mm long, 11-15 mm wide, 6-8 mm thick, the smooth, brown testa 0.4-0.6 mm thick, the firm, white cotyledons closely appressed and con- cealing the radicle; endosperm none.

description: Slender shrub scarcely 1 m tall with terete but striate, pale brown, remotely verruculose stems freely widely branched distally, thinly silky-puberulent nearly throughout with fine ascending hairs less than 0.3 mm long, the leaflets green, thin-textured, dotted beneath with fuscous, hemispherical glands 0.1-0.15 mm diam, the numerous, densely many-flowered spikes of small, white and pale purple flowers terminal to all distal branchlets, together forming a pyramidal panicle, each produced at apex into a sterile axis clothed in imbricated bracts. Stipules lanceolate, 1.5-2 mm long, membranous, orange-brown, early dry, and fragile. Leaf-stalk of primary cauline leaves +/- 15-33 mm long, that of some distal leaves (no further described) shorter; leaflets 8-13 pairs, each pair subtended by 2 trans- lucent mammiform glands +/- 0.2 mm long, the petiolules +/- 0.2 mm long, the furthest pair of leaflets forming with the odd terminal one an exact trefoil; blade of leaflets oblong-obovate, obtuse or obscurely apiculate, the largest +/- 3.5-5 x 1.5-2 mm. Peduncles at most 1 cm; flower-spikes lanceolate or narrowly ovate in outline, without petals or androecium +/- 5 mm diam, the calyces so crowded as to conceal the axis, this at full anthesis 12-33 mm long, its sterile tip exserted 3-7 mm beyond the furthest perfect flower; bracts subtending fertile flowers ovate- apiculate 0.7-1 mm long, submembranous, charged dorsally with a few protuberant glands, minutely ciliolate, tardily deciduous; calyces sessile, subtended on each side by a minute spicule, obliquely campanulate 2.3-2.7 x 1.7-2 mm, glabrous except for microscopically ciliolate orifice, the obtusely pleated, 10- nerved tube charged in each intercostal panel with 3 or 4 hemispherical honey colored glands 0.2-0.3 mm diam, the depressed-deltate teeth 0.2-0.5 mm long, each tipped with a gland but not laterally spurred; petals bicolored, the banner ochroleucous, the blade of wings and keel purplish over the abaxial 2/3, pallid adaxially, all glabrous and eglandular; banner 4.5-5 mm, the linear claw and orbicular blade of subequal length; epistemonous petals inserted 0. 7-1.5 mm from base of androecium, the claws 1-1.4 mm long, the blade of wings oblong ? 2.2 x 1.2 mm, that of keel elliptic-obovate 2.4 mm long, the outer keel-margins weakly adherent by their edges; androecium 9-merous, 6-7 mm long, the tassel  +/-  2 mm long; ovary glabrous, carinate ventrally, charged on each face with few blister-glands; style exserted from androecium; ovules 2. Pod unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Barneby, Rupert C. 1990. Two new taxa in Dalea (Fabaceae: Amorpheae) from southern Mexico and northern Chile. Brittonia. 42: 89-91.

description: Genus Leguminosum Caesalpinioideum affinitatis ambiguae, his notulis recognitum: habitus arboreus; folia imparipinnata, foliolis oppositis; inflorescentia terminalis cymosa 2-3-chotoma, pedicellis 2-bracteolatis; sepala in praefloratione valvata, ad anthesin ultra hypanthium gamosepala; petala aut 5 aut 4, inter se subsimilia, adaxiale, si adsit, in alabastro hinc exterius illinc interius; androecium 16-17-merum, filamentis liberis circum hypanthii marginem orientibus, antheris versatilibus, rima laterali untrinque dehiscentibus; ovarium ex hypanthii basi oriens, liberum, ovulis 3-4; legumen latolineare, plano-compressum, elastice dehiscens, valvulis contortis; semina rectembryonica, exarillata, endospermio carentia. Sp. unica: Orphanodendron bernalii Barneby & Grimes.

description: Trees attaining 15 m, with glabrous, vertically striped, elenticellate annotinous branches, the stems dichotomously or trichotomously forked at each node upward through the terminal efoliate, loosely racemose-paniculate inflorescence, the foliage appearing glabrous but the ample, elliptic-caudate, dull olivaceous leaflets minutely strigulose dorsally, the inflorescence densely golden-brown-sericeous. Stipules either 0 or early caducous (none seen); an unequal, collateral pair of clavate buds in the axil of most upper leaves. Leaf-stalks including corrugated pulvinus 5.5-9.5 cm, obscurely sulcate ventrally, continuous between pairs of opposite or subopposite leaflets, the petiole 8-18 x 0.6-1 mm, the longer inter- foliolar segments +/- 2-3.5 cm; leaflets either 7 or 9, the odd terminal one raised above the distal pair; pulvinules 4-5 x 0.8-1 mm, atrocastaneous, densely corrugate; blades a little accrescent and proportionally narrower distally, either broadly or narrowly elliptic from symmetrically cuneate base and contracted upward into a linear obtuse acumen 12-20 x 1-2 mm, the distal ones 6.5-12 x 2.2-4.4 cm; venation pinnate, the centric midrib shallowly sulcate on ventral face, ca- riniform on dorsal one, the secondary nerves incurved-ascending, the major ones +/- 8 pairs, camptodrome well within the entire, when dry undulate margin, a faint tertiary venulation barely perceptible externally, the intervenium finely reticulate, the larger polygonal areolae up to 0.3-0.4 mm diam. Inflorescence twice or thrice forked into 2 equally strong and often a third weaker branch, the ultimate divisions simply loosely racemose, 4-10-flowered, the whole (measured from first dichot- omy) 7-10 cm long and about as wide; bracts subtending branches of panicle and individual pedicels minute caducous; pedicels widely ascending, laterally com- pressed, 5-6 mm, minutely bibracteolate near middle; flower-buds plumply ellipsoid, obscurely 5-angulate above middle; calyx at anthesis 7-8 mm long, the turbinate, weakly ribbed hypanthium +/- 2 mm, the firm, widely spreading limb cleft through +/- 2/3 its length into 5 subequal, deltate lobes 3.5-4 mm; petals fugacious, white, 8.5-9.5 mm, the dorsal one (often lacking) obovate, the lateral pair symmetrically broad-oblanceolate or obovate obtuse, 3.4-6 mm wide, the abaxial pair asymmetrically oblanceolate, +/- 3-3.5 mm wide, their mid-nerve slightly displaced from center; filaments 6-7 mm, attenuate distally; anthers 1.6- 1.8 x 0.4 mm; pollen tricolporate, subcircular to angulaperturate in polar view (Fig. 2A, C), globose-spherical in equatorial view (Fig. 2B, D), 20-25 µm in long axis, 18-23 Am in short axis, exine finely foveate-reticulate; ovary densely loosely sericeous; style gently incurved +/- 2 mm, glabrous; ovules 3-4. Pod ascending, subsessile, at first plano-compressed becoming low-biconvex at maturity, in profile oblanceolate +/- 10-12 x 3 cm, straight, the highly lustrous brown, externally veinless but randomly punctate valves framed by thickened sutures (the adaxial one +/-  3 mm, the abaxial +/- 1 mm wide), in texture woody but becoming brittle when ripe, +/- 0.7 mm thick in section, fracturing randomly by transverse fissure; seeds basipetal on very short fleshy funiculus, obovoid-compressed, in broad view 20-25 x 14-17 mm, 4-5 mm thick, the dry papery testa light brown, smooth but scarcely lustrous, the periphery girdled with a raised nerve; embryo straight, the basal lobes of the horny cotyledons concealing the radicle, endosperm 0.

description: Foliis unifoliolatis longipetiolatis L. crotalarioidem Mart. ex Benth. revocans, sed foliolorum lamina anguste elliptica 0.9-1.6 (nec 2-4) cm usque lata, foliis infra mediam plantam confertis (nec secus caulem laxe dispersis), stipulis submembranaceo-chartaceis basi brevissime amplexicaulibus (nec herbaceis infra nodos alato-decurrentibus), necon floribus paullo majoribus, vexillo 13.5-17.5 (nec 9- 12.5) mm longo facile distinguenda.

description: Perennial herb, including the exserted racemes of pale blue flowers 3-4 dm tall, except for glabrous corolla silky-pilose throughout with fine longer ascending and shorter subappressed hairs, the greenish unifoliolate leaves crowded along the lower 1/2-1/3 of stem, the internodes surpassed by stipules. Stipules 9-12 mm, adnate to petiole through 4-6 mm, the submembranous free blade narrowly lance-attenuate erect, the stipular sheath obscurely amplexicaul at very base but not decurrent on the stem. Leaves near mid-stem 4-8 cm, the narrowly elliptic, abruptly apiculate blade 3.5-7 x 0.9-1.8 cm, narrowed at base into a petiole 6-20 mm, obtusely carinate dorsally by midrib, plane ventrally, the narrowly ascending secondary nerves weak and faint. Racemes erect subsessile, loosely +/- 25-40-flowered, the widely ascending flowers scattered along an axis 10-22 cm; bracts submembran- ous, narrowly lance-attenuate 4.5-6 mm, caducous before anthesis of subtended flower; pedicels at anthesis 3.5-4 mm, in fruit thickened and up to 5-6 mm; bracteole at lateral sinuses of calyx lanceolate 2.5-3 mm; calyx 9-13 mm, the tube +/- 2.5-3 mm, the upper lip 4-6 mm, bidentate 1/3-1/2 its length, the lower lip narrowly lanceolate 6.5-10 mm, minutely 3-denticulate at apex; petals glabrous, the banner recurved through +/- 40º, clasping the wings only at base, its blade broadly ovate-cuneate acute 15-17.5 x 10-13.5 mm; wings nearly as long, the blade (including auricle) 13-13.5 x 6-8 mm; keel 14-16 mm, the lunate blade +/- 4.5 mm wide at middle, the beak maculate, concealed by wings; ovary sessile, densely silky, the style glabrous; ovules 6. Pods sessile, in profile linear-elliptic 45-50 x 9-10 mm, faintly sigmoidally arcuate, 5-6-seeded, at apex attenuate into the persistent style, the leathery valves densely sericeous overall; ripe seeds not seen.

description: Foliolorum numero, floribus majusculis et perianthio subglabro D. paruensi Cowan manifeste propinqua, sed ab ea foliolis subdimidio amplioribus (10- 15.5 x 5.5-9, nec 6-11 x 3.5-5 cm), pulvinulo longiori (8-12, nec 3-6 mm longo) fultis, pedicellis brevioribus (6-12, nec 18-20 mm longis), petalis duplo et ultra longioribus (+/- 5 x 0.9, nec 1-2.5 x 0.4 mm), necnon ovario subsessili (nec gynophoro 3-5 mm longo elevato) diversa.

description: Trees +/- 5 m tall with atropurpureous low- tuberculate branchlets and ample, stiffly chartaceous, either pari- or imparipinnate 3-5-foliolate leaves, glabrous below the ter- minal, narrowly racemose-paniculate inflorescence, the leaflets (dry) bicolored, darker brown and finely venose above, the hypophyllum paler brown, almost nerveless but minutely glandular-punctate, the relatively large flowers densely brown-silky-puberulent overall with appressed hairs less than 0.25 mm. Stipules 0. Leaf-stalks including moderately swollen pulvinus 5-9 cm; leaflets irregularly inserted, either singly or in opposite pairs, either one or two terminal; pulvinules 8-12 x 1.8-2 mm; leaflets subequilong, the blade ovate from broadly rounded or shallowly cordate base, 10-1 5.5 x 5.5-9 cm, shortly obtusely acuminate; venation of 6-9 major (but slender, and of indefinite weaker intercalary) secondary nerves widely incurved-ascending to anastomosis well short of the plane margin, these giving rise to an elaborate reticulum of veinlets enclosing areoles much less than 1 mm diam. Primary axis of inflorescence 7-18 cm, that of its strictly ascending secondary or tertiary branches 1.5-4 cm; bracts early caducous from a narrow ledge subtending the pedicel, the blade not seen; pedicels stout 6-12 mm; flower-buds (including bracte- oles) erect, narrowly clavate, obtuse; bracteoles thickly coriaceous, oblong-oblanceolate obtuse 28-30 x 8-12 mm, adnate through +/- 5-6 mm to hypanthium, charged near apex with a shallow concave nectary +/- 0.5 mm diam, internally cymbiform and glabrous except for a narrow band of yel- lowish tomentum around the periphery; hypanthium narrowly cupular, +/-  1 cm deep, the part free beyond the bracteoles 3-7 mm, blackish, glabrate; sepals 5, firm but membranous-margined, lance-acuminate 9-14 x 2-4 mm, glabrous facially but sometimes ciliolate; petals 5, membranous, linear-lan- ceolate +/- 5 x 0.8-1 mm; stamens 10, the filament +/-2.5 cm, puberulent at very base, thence glabrous, the linear anther +/-  5-6 x 1.2 mm; ovary subsessile at hypanthium rim, densely silky-pubescent; style glabrous, the stigma dilated to +/-0.6 mm diam. Fruit unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Barneby, Rupert C. 1992. Centennial beans: A miscellany of American Fabales. Brittonia. 44: 224-239.

description: Shrub or treelet 3 m tall with slender lenticellate annotinous branchlets, except for minutely silky-puberulent inflorescence glabrous throughout, the simple, nearly entire but (mostly) prickly-denticulate, chartaceous leaves olivaceous concolorous, the slender racemes of small white flowers both axillary and terminal to branchlets. Stipules stiffly erect, subulate and linear-lanceolate 1-9 x 0.3-1.1 mm, 1-nerved, persistent. Leaves sessile, the wrinkled pulvinus 3-4.5 mm, grooved ventrally; leaf-blades oblong or elliptic-oblong from rounded or broadcuneate base, 4.5-8.5 x 1.6-4.2 cm (2-3.1 times as long as wide), acute or shortly acuminate, pinnately and reticulately venose, the centric midrib giving rise on each side to +/-8-16 secondary nerves, these in most blades both camptodrome and forked shortly within the continuously corneous marginal nerve, their posterior fork excurrent into a porrect, triangular-acuminate tooth 0.5-2 mm. Racemes subsessile +/- 10-25- flowered, the axis +/- 2-4 cm; bracts trian- gular-subulate 0.6-1.4 mm, faintly 1 nerved, persistent; pedicels 0.5-0.8 mm; bracteoles at base of calyx +/- 0.6 mm, caducous;flower- buds prior to anthesis pyriform; calyx at anthesis 5-7.5 mm, the hypanthium 1.2-2 mm deep, the broadly triangular-obovate, minutely apiculate and penicillate, internally silky-strigulose lobes +/- 1.3-2 mm; petals whitish, subisomorphic, spatulate- oblanceolate 9-10 mm, the blade about as long as claw or slightly shorter, 2.5-3 mm wide; filaments 5 mm; anthers 2-2.7 mm, thinly pilose at tip and base; ovary densely sericeous, the glabrous gynophore +/- 2.5 mm, the glabrous style 0.8-1.8 mm. Fruit unknown.

description: Inter Bacillares partibus junioribus aureo-pilosulis, foliolis amplis aequilateraliter ellipticis, racemis plerisque axillaribus (nec paniculatim exsertis), sepalis mediocribus (? 5-7 mm longis) dorso dense puberulis, necnon antheris heteromorphis (tribus abaxialibus medianas quatuor manifeste superantibus) insignis, ulterius legumine longissimo (3-6 dm longo) moniliformi seminibusque uniseriatis ab illas omnes diversa. A S. macranthera var. andina Irwin & Barneby, quoad flores haud dissimili et in iisdem Andium peruvianorum vallibus obvia, foliolis maximis 12-15 cm usque longis, acuminatis (nec 2-3.5 cm longis, obtusis) primo intuitu distat.

description: Subshrub +/- 8 dm, the erect simple stems foliate up to the terminal, shortly exserted, few-branched panicle of loosely flowered racemes, the stiff plane reticulate, comeous marginate leaflets bicolored, lustrous-olivaceous and glabrous above, pallid dull and densely softly puberulent beneath; indumentum of stems and ovaries double, of fine minute villi underlying horizontal, smooth livid setae up to 5-8 mm, these tapering from dilated base, not gland-tipped nor obviously viscid. Stipules stiffly erect, linear subulate or subsetiform 2-3 mm, 1-nerved, tardily deciduous. Leaf-stalks 3.5-5 cm, the petiole at middle 1-1.4 mm diam, the one interfoliolar segment about as long; pulvinules in dorsal view 2-3.5 mm; leaflets 2 pairs, ascending face upward, the distal pair a little longer, the blades of all ovate or narrowly ovate from inequilaterally rounded base, acuminulate or mucronate at apex, the distal pair 4.5-7 x 2.2-4 cm; venation prominulous on both faces, more sharply ele- vated dorsally, the almost straight and centric midrib giving rise to +/- 10-12 major (and random intercalary) secondary venules and a close reticulum of veinlets, the ulti- mate areoles deeply depressed-alveolate on dorsal face. Axis of racemes mostly 1-2 dm, glabrous or almost so, esetose; bracts and bracteoles linear-subulate caducous; pedicels at anthesis +/-12-16 mm, attaining 27 mm in fruit; flower-buds ovoid-apiculate glabrous, the sepals lance-acuminate, up to 10-13 mm; petals of Ch. ochrosperma, the cucullus +/- 14-15 mm; ovary puberulent and coarsely setose; ovules 6-8. Pod sessile, broad-linear from cuneate base, in profile 4-7 x 0.85-1 cm, abruptly acuminulate, the pinkish-brown valves thinly fuscous-setose, at maturity puberulent only along the su- tures; seeds compressed-pyriform, in broad view +/- 7.5 x 5 mm, the atrocastaneous testa densely minutely pitted.

description: Trees attaining 8 m, except for minutely ciliolate floral bracts vegetatively glabrous throughout, the branchlets fuscous becoming gray and in age closely lenticellate, the broad chartaceous leaflets bicolored, lustrously brown-olivaceous above, paler opaque beneath, the inflorescence composed of short dense subsessile racemes fas- ciculate by 2-7 in leaf-axils and at some lately defoliolate nodes. Stipules not seen Leaf-stalks 5-9 cm, the true petiole including discolored pulvinus 8-13 mm, the interfoliolar segments 15-26 x 1-1.3 mm, widely openly sulcate ventrally, the groove constricted at insertion of leaflets but continuous between them; leaflets 3-4 pairs, distally accrescent, appearing subsessile but the wrinkled pulvinule in dorsal view +/- 1.5- 2 mm, the blades ovate or oblong-elliptic from inequilaterally rounded or minutely cordate base, at apex obtuse-emarginate or obscurely short-acuminate, the furthest pair +/- 5-8 x 2-4 cm, 2-2.5 times as long as wide; venation weak except for costa pro- minulous on each face, the numerous, very fine secondary nerves ascending at +/- 450 and weakly camptodrome within the margin but not forming an intramarginal nerve. Ra- ceme-axis angulate 2-5.5 cm; bracts ovate- triangular apiculate 1.2-1.8 mm, caducous before anthesis of subtended flower; flower buds narrowly obovoid-ellipsoid, dorsally gibbous at base; pedicels at full anthesis 2- 4 x 0.5-0.8 mm; bracteoles submembran- ous, at anthesis free almost or quite to base, ovate-elliptic 5-7 x 3-4.5 mm, minutely penicillate at apex but otherwise glabrous, orange-brown when dry; hypanthium ovoid, gibbous abaxially at base, +/- 1 mm; sepals 4, heteromorphic, 2.5-3.5 mm; vexillum spatulate 8-9 mm, white but medially brownish-yellow when dry, the crenulate undulate blade nearly as long as the linear claw, this bilobulate at very base and there thinly pilose; filaments lilac 18-20 mm, pi- lose at base; gynoecium glabrous, the gynophore +/- 3 mm; style +/- 11 mm, the stigma 0.1-0.15 mm diam. Fruit unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Barneby, Rupert C. 1992. Centennial beans: A miscellany of American Fabales. Brittonia. 44: 224-239.

description: Trees 5-17 m with trunk 0.5-7 dm DBH and densely sordid-pilosulous hornotinous branchlets, the distichous plurifoliolate leaves olivaceous subconcolorous, the thin textured oblong leaflets glabrous except for dorsally puberulent midrib, the short racemes mostly axillary to a coeval leaf, glabrous throughout except for pilosulous filaments and gynoecium. Stipules erect, linear-lanceolate 2.5-5.5 mm, becoming dry and fragile but persistent. Leaf-stalks 4-6 cm, the narrowly green-marginate interfo- liolar segments 5-9.5 mm; pulvinules in dorsal view +/- 1 mm, but the blade of leaflets proximally decurrent to leaf-rachis; leaflets 7-9 pairs, little graduated, in outline oblong from inequilateral, obliquely subtruncate base, broadly shallowly emarginate at apex and minutely mucronulate by excurrent midrib, the larger blades 15-19 x 6.5-9 mm: midrib straight, tending to diagonal, prominulous only dorsally, the fine secondary nerves ascending at +/-45-50º, weakly camp- todrome shortly within the plane margin. Racemes subsessile 2-3.5 cm; bracts ovate 1-2 mm, deciduous; pedicels at full anthesis 2.5-4.5 mm; bracteoles oblong-ovate, ob- tuse or acute 4.5-6 x 2.5-4 mm, glabrous, free to base; hypanthium subsessile, campanulate 1.5-2.2 mm; sepals lanceolate 2- 4 mm, early reflexed; petal white, spatulate 6.5-7 mm, the erect, undulately marginate blade +/- as long as claw; filaments purple 18-22 mm, pilosulous below middle; gynophore weakly adnate dorsally to hypanthium, free through 2-4 mm, densely pallid- pilosulous like margin of the ovary. Pod oblong-elliptic in profile, 8-10.5 x 2.8-3.5 cm, asymmetrically cuneate at base, obtuse at apex, 1-2-seeded, the valves rigidly crustaceous, the exocarp tan-brown, smooth and glabrous; seed in profile suborbicular +/- 20 x 17 x 6 mm, the testa fuscous-castaneous.

description: Stiffly intricately branched, microphyllous shrublet +/-  5 dm tall with fuscous, rigidly sinuous, glabrate older branchlets and vertically splitting bark, the new stems and 4-foliolate leaves thinly livid-glandular verruculose and minutely puberulent, the firm plane leaflets facially glabrous, verruculose on margin, the loosely 1-3-flowered racemes terminal to lateral short-shoots, the first flower commonly subtended by an expanded leaf. Stipules subulate-acicular 0.5- 1.2 mm, tardily deciduous. Leaf-stalks 3- 7.5 mm, the petiole 1. 5-4.5 mm, the one interfoliolar segment as long or scarcely shorter; leaflets of each pair subequilong, obovate or elliptic-obovate from inequilateral base, 3.5-5.5 x 2.5-3 mm, abruptly mucronate-apiculate; midrib subcentric, 3- 4-branched on each side, the secondary nerves brochidodrome beyond mid-blade, the tertiary venules sinuous, the venation prominulous on both faces but less sharply so above. Peduncles 9-15 mm, bracteolate below middle; flower-buds obtuse, subglo- bose; perianth yellow, the sepals thinly livid-verruculose, the petals golden-yellow, glabrous; sepals little graduated, obovate- elliptic, obtuse, 6.5-7.5 x 2.5-3 mm; 4 petals 11-12.5 mm, the vexillar one up to 9 mm wide, the rest narrower, the cucullus boomerang-shaped, 17 x 6 mm; stamens isomorphic, the filament 1 mm, the linear- oblong anther ?4.5 x 1.3 mm, glabrous except for ciliolate lateral sutures. Ovary both verruculose and minutely pilosulous; pod unknown.

description: Macrophyllidious shrubs 1.5-2.5 m with yellow wood, yellow inner bark, and fuscous obtusangulate new branches, puberulent nearly throughout with fine whitish hairs to 0.3-0.4 mm, the 4-foliolate leaves bicolored, dark green, glabrescent and lustrous on upper face, pallid dull and more densely pubescent beneath, the flowers compactly racemose in distal leaf-axils or some furthest leaves reduced to rudimentary leaf stalk and nectary and the inflorescence then becoming a narrow panicle ofracemes. Stip- ules erect, linear or falcately linear-ellipti +/- 4-6 x 0.6-1 mm, 1-nerved, caducous. Leafstalks of well developed leaves 2.5-6.5 cm, the petiole 5-18 mm, the one interfoliolar segment 2-4.5 cm, the terminal appendage setiform deciduous; nectary be- tween each pair of leaflets plumply subulate or narrowly ovoid 2-3.2 x 0.6-1.6 mm; leaflets 4, the petiolules 3-4.5 x 1 mm; distal pair of leaflets inequilaterally elliptic from postically rounded or shallowly semicordate, antically cuneate base, abruptly deltate-acuminulate and mucronulate, in larger leaves 7.5-12.5 x (2.7) 3-5.5 cm, 2.1-2.9 times as long as wide, the pairs of subequal width but the distal pair +/- 1/3 longer; ve- nation pinnate, immersed on upper face, prominulous beneath, the gently incurved midrib subcentric, the major secondary veins 7-10 on each side, the tertiary ven- ulation faint. Racemes 4-8-flowered, the axis including peduncle less than 1 cm; bracts ovate-elliptic 2-3 mm, caducous; pedicels becoming 1.4-2 cm; perianth almost gla- brous, the yellow petals completely so, the membranous, greenish-yellow sepals ciliolate and the two exterior ones remotely puberulent below middle; sepals graduated, obovate-suborbicular, the outermost +/- 7 mm, the innermost +/- 10-11 mm; petals obovate-cuneate, subequiform, 14-17 x 9-10 mm; androecium glabrous, the 3 adaxial staminodes oblanceolate ? 2.5 mm, the 7 fertile stamens subequiform, the filament 1.7-2.4 mm, the narrowly lance-ovoid anther, including short declined beak, 5.3-5.8 x 1. 8-2 mm, the beak dehiscent by U-shaped slit; ovary densely white-pilosulous, the style 6-7 mm, scarcely dilated to ward apex, the stigma +/- 1 mm diam., its ciliolate orifice 0.6 mm diam.; ovules 20- 24. Pod ascending, stipitate, the stipe 4-5 mm, the tumescent but somewhat laterally compressed body narrowly oblong, gently decurved, in profile +/- 25 x 6 mm, abruptly contracted into the persistent style, the valves fleshy, greenish-yellow becoming coriaceous fuscous glabrate; dehiscence not seen; seeds biseriate, transverse, +/- 4.5 x 2.5 mm, the testa lustrous brown; pleurogram 0.
