description: Subherbaceous subshrub with slender procumbent radiating stems from woody rootstock, simple and foliate in lower 2/3, sparsely few-branched and incurved distally, thinly glandular-punctate throughout but not setose, the olivaceous, amply bifoliolate leaves lustrous above, dull but hardly paler beneath, the inflorescence a narrow, simple or few-branched, efoliate terminal raceme of orange-yellow flowers. Stipules subulate, scarcely 1 mm, caducous. Petioles 11-23 mm, at middle 0.8-1.4 mm diam., shallowly openly sulcate ventrally, very narrowly green-winged; pulvinules 1.5-1.8 mm, shallowly wrinkled; leaflets stiffly papery, broadly obovate or elliptic-obovate from postically semi-cordate base, broadly rounded and apiculate at apex, the larger ones 2.5-4.3 X 1.5-2.6 cm, 1.5-1.7 times longer than wide, the margin plane, erose; venation slenderly prominulous on both faces, the midrib forwardly arched and displaced to divide blade ±1:2, the palmate ascending lateral nerves 3-4 posterior, 1 weak anterior, the stronger secondary nerves from each side of costa 3-5. Racemes ±6-8-flowered, the axis becoming 1-2 dm, the ovoid-acuminate flower-buds elevated well above expanded flowers; bracts and bracteoles subulate, to 1.5 mm, deciduous; pedicels narrowly ascending 3-5.5 cm; sepals red where exterior in bud, pallid where covered, all ovate-acuminate 11-13 X 4-5 mm; petals deep yellow, obovate-cuneate ± 14 X 12 mm, four of them shallowly concave, the cucullus incurved and folded over base of androecium; sta- mens 10, the thick filaments scarcely 1 mm, the anthers oblong to 5 X 1.4 mm, minutely pilosulous along the sides; ovary oblong 3 mm, glandular-verruculose but not setulose, the style ±6 mm, a trifle thickened upward but the stigma poriform. description: Unarmed trees attaining 5 m with trunk to 13 cm diam. and smooth glabrous castaneous, ± resinous branchlets, the leaflets subcoriaceous bifacial, glutinous lustrous resin-spotted dorsally, paler matte-olivaceous ventrally, glabrous except for micropuberulent margin, the corymbiform racemes of large golden-yellow flowers terminal, simple or few-branched. Stipules (and floral bracts) caducous, narrowly lanceolate to 3 mm, castaneous glutinous. Leafstalks including peduncle ±6-9 cm, the longer interfoliolar segments 13-17 mm; petiolar nectary 0; pulvinules 3.5-4.5 mm; leaflets 4-5 pairs, subequilong, the blades lance-elliptic from shallowly cordate base, 33-50 X 15-18 mm, at apex obtuse but appendiculate by excurrent midrib; venulation prominulous dorsally, almost immersed ventrally, the straight centric costa closely pinnate, the tertiary venulation faint. Racemes ±5-10-flowered, the axis of each ±34 cm, the plumply ovoid-apiculate flower-buds elevated nearly to level of the 1-2 contemporary flowers; pedicels 14-30 mm, bibracteolate near apex; perianth gla- brous; sepals submembranous yellow, ovate-elliptic 15-18 mm, faintly 7-9-nerved; petals unequal, the 3-4 larger ones amply obovate-flabellate to ±3 cm diam., the cucullus nearly as long but thick-clawed, narrower, involute; filaments ±1.5 mm; anthers (of sect. Absus) not seen complete (predated); ovary micropuberulent; fruit unknown.

description: Fruitices erecti 0.5-1 m alti. Rami distales sparsim strigosi. Petioli 0.2-1 cm longi moderate strigosi; laminae foliorum anguste ellipticae, 2-7 X 0.6-2.2 cm, supra et subtus strigosae. description: Erect shrubs 0.5-1 m tall. Distal branches sparsely appressed strigose; nodes sparsely setose with hairs 1-2 mm long; internodes 1-5 cm long. Petioles 0.2-1 cm long, moderately strigose; leaf blades nar- rowly elliptic, 2-7 X 0.6-2.2 cm, the apex acuminate, the base rounded, sometimes oblique, 5-nerved from the base, the upper surface strigose with the hairs adnate to the surface for ca. 1/4 to 1/3 their length, the lower surface including the raised veins sparsely strigose, the margin entire, beset with setae ca. 1 mm long, ca. 0.5-1 mm distant. Inflorescences simple dichasia or cymes, terminal, axillary in the uppermost leaves, or terminal on lateral branches, 2.5-10 cm long, with 3-9 flowers; peduncles 1.5-3 cm long, sparsely strigose; bracts lanceolate to nar- rowly triangular, 1.5-3 mm long, strigose adaxially, glabrous abaxially, caducous; pedicels 2-7 mm long, strigose. Hypanthia campanulate, 5-6 mm long, 4-5 mm broad at the torus, densely strigose, the hairs light tan, tightly appressed (Fig. 1). Calyx lobes 5, lanceolate to very narrowly triangular, 3-6 mm long, 0.7-1.5 mm broad at base, strigose adaxially and abaxially. Petals 5, magenta, obovate, 1-1.6 x 0.8-1 cm, ciliate along margin, with a terminal seta. Stamens 10, moderately dimorphic in size, all yellow; larger stamens with filaments 7-8 mm long, thecae 5.5-7 mm long, the connective 1-1.5 mm long with bulbous basal lobes ca. 0.5 mm long; smaller stamens with filaments 4-5 mm long, thecae 4-5 mm long, the connective ca. 0.5 mm long with minute basal lobes. Ovary ovoid, 4-5 mm long, with 5 strigose appendages at apex; styles 1-1.2 cm long. Capsules ovoid, 5-7 mm long; seeds ca. 0.5 mm long.

description: Frutices erecti vel effusi 0.5-1 m alti. Rami distales glabri vel sparsissime strigosi. Petioli 0.4-1.3 cm longi sparsim vel moderate strigosi; laminae foliolum ellipticae vel anguste ellipticae, 3.5-5(-7.1) x 0.1-2.5 cm, supra et subtus sparsim hirsutae. Inflorescentiae usque ad 4.5 cm longae congestae; bracteae florales liberae chartaceae caducae; pedicelli glandulosohirsuti; hypanthia colore rubro suffusa, trichomatibus glandulosis ad apicem rubris; lobi calycis 5 hypanthio breviores, sparsim strigosi secus costam ac margines; petala 5, 1-1.6 X 0.7-0.9 cm; stamina penitus flava in amplitudine dimorpha; ovarium ca. 4.5 mm longum ad apicem setosum.

description: Erect to spreading shrubs 0.5-1 m tall. Distal branches glabrous to very sparsely strigose; nodes sparsely setose with hairs 1- 1.5 mm long; internodes 2-8 cm long. Petioles 0.4-1.3 cm long, sparsely to moderately strigose; leaf blades narrowly elliptic to elliptic, 3.5-5(-7.1) X 0.1-2.5 cm, the apex acuminate, the base rounded to broadly cuneate, 3-nerved at the base with an additional pair of veins close to the margin, the primary veins raised beneath, the upper and lower surfaces sparsely hirsute with hairs 0.5-1 mm long, the margin entire, beset with setae 0.5-1 mm long, ca. 0.5-1 mm distant. Inflorescences congested, compound dichasia, terminal on terminal branches or less often lateral (these often with fewer-flowered inflorescences), much-branched at the base (with 5-9 basal branches), thus the inflorescence appearing densely congested, to 4.5 cm long, with ca. 6-21 flowers; peduncles 2-7 mm long, sparsely strigose; bracts triangular, 1.5-3 mm long, to 2.5 mm broad at base, brown-tan, chartaceous, sparsely strigose to glabrous abaxially, glabrous adaxially, strigose along the margin, caducous; pedicels 1-4 mm long, glandular hirsute. Hypanthia urceolate, (4-)5-6 mm long to the torus, 4- 5 mm broad at torus, suffused with red glandular hairs (Fig. 3). Calyx lobes 5, lanceolate to lanceolate-triangular, shorter than the hypanthium, 3-5 mm long, 1-2 mm broad at base, strigose along margin and midvein, glabrous adaxially. Petals 5, light to dark pink, obovate, 10-16 X 7-9 mm, retuse, acute, or round at apex, glandular-ciliate along the margin, usually without a terminal seta. Stamens 10, dimorphic in size, all yellow; larger stamens with fila- ments ca. 7 mm long, thecae 6-7 mm long, the connective 1.5-2.3 mm long with bul- bous basal lobes ca. 0.5 mm long; smaller stamens with filaments 5-7 mm long, the- cae 4-5.5 mm long, connective 0.7-1 mm long with minute basal bulbous lobes. Ova- ry ovoid, ca. 4.5 mm long, setose and with 5 appendages at apex; styles 1-1.4 cm long. Capsules ovoid, 4-5 mm long; seeds 0.5- 0.7 mm long.

description: Frutices erecti ca. 0.3 m alti. Rami distales strigosi. Petioli 0.4-1.7 cm longi strigillosi; laminae foliorum ellipticae 0.8-4.5 X 0.5-2.2 cm, supra et subtus moderate strigillosae. Flores solitarii in axillis foliorum superiorum vel in cymis simplicibus ad apices ramorum; bracteae florales foliaceae 0.5-1.2 cm longae, persistentes, florem amplectentes in dimidio infero hypanthii, ut videtur connatae sed ad basim liberae; hypanthia strigillosa; lobi calycis 5 hypanthio longiores, supra et subtus strigillosi; petala 5, 1-1.2 X 0.6- 1 cm; stamina penitus flava in amplitudine parum dimorpha; ovarium 3.5-4.5 mm longum in quarta distali setosum.

description: Erect shrubs ca. 0.3 m tall. Distal branches moderately strigose with whitish hairs <0.3 mm long; nodes sparsely setose with 1-5 stiff setae 0.5-1 mm long; internodes ca. 2-5 cm long. Petioles 0.4-1.7 cm long, strigillose with whitish hairs; leaf blades elliptic, 0.8-4.5 X 0.5-2.2 cm, the apex acute, the base cuneate and decurrent on the petiole, 3-nerved from the base, the larger leaves with an obscure pair of lateral veins near the margin, both surfaces moderately strigillose with whitish hairs ca. 0.3 mm long, the margin entire, beset with setae ca. 0.5 mm long, 0.5-1 mm distant. Inflores- cences consisting of solitary flowers in the upper leaf axils or simple cymes at the end of branches; peduncles 0.8-2.5 cm long, strigillose; bracts leaf-like, round to ovate, 0.5-1.2 x 0.4-0.8 cm, clasping the flower in the lower half of hypanthium, appearing connate but actually free to base, the upper half of the bracts spreading, moderately strigillose abaxially and adaxially, persis- tent; pedicels 2-7 mm long on flowers in upper leaf axils or terminal cymes, to 1.5 cm long on flowers in lowermost leaf axils. Hypanthia urceolate, 4-5 mm long, 3-3.5 mm broad at the torus, strigillose with white hairs ca. 0.2-0.4 mm long (Fig. 4). Calyx lobes 5, longer than the hypanthium, broadly lanceolate to narrowly spatulate, 5- 7 mm long, ca. 1 mm broad, moderately strigillose adaxially and abaxially. Petals 5, obovate, 1-1.2 X 0.6-1 cm, deep pink to purple when dried, glandular-ciliate, with a terminal seta. Stamens 10, slightly dimorphic in size, all yellow; larger stamens with filaments 6-7 mm long, thecae 5.5-6 mm long, the connective ca. 1 mm long with basal bulbous lobes ca. 1 mm long; smaller stamens with filaments 4.5-5 mm long, thecae 4-4.5 mm long, the connective ca. 0.5 mm long with basal bulbous lobes ca. 1 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 3.5-4.5 mm long, setose in distal 1/4, lacking apical appendages; styles 1-1.3 cm long, usually glabrous, sometimes basally strigose. Capsules ovoid, ca. 4 mm long; seeds not seen.

description: Frutices erecti 0.3-1.5 m alti. Rami distales setosi. Petioli 0.3-2.6 cm longi dense setosi; laminae foliorum ellipticae 2.3-10.2 X 1.1-4.1 cm, 5-nerviae ad basim, supra et subtus strigosae. Inflorescentiae congestae floribus in dichasiis compositis dispositis; bracteae florales lanceolatae setosae caducae; hypanthia campanulata 3-4 mm longa setosa; lobi calycis 5 secus margines setosi; petala 5, rosea vel magentea, 0.6-0.8 X 0.4-0.6 cm; stamina penitus flava in amplitudine leviter dimorpha; ovarium ca. 3 mm longum appendicibus 5 brevibus setosis ad apicem provisum.

description: Erect shrubs 0.3-1.5 m tall. Distal branches sparsely to moderately setose, the hairs 1-3 mm long, widely spreading, often pinkish; nodes setose with the hairs 3-6 mm long; internodes 2-11 cm long. Petioles 0.3-2.6 cm long, densely setose; leaf blades elliptic, 2.3-10.2 X 1.1-4.1 cm, the apex acuminate, the base rounded to broadly cuneate, 5-nerved from the base, the primary and secondary veins raised and setose beneath, the upper surface moderately strigose, the hairs adnate to the surface for ca. 1/4-1/2 their length, the lower surface moderately strigose, the hairs free, the margin denticulate with each tooth terminating in a seta 1-2 mm long. Inflorescences compact compound dichasia, 2.5-8(-15) cm long, with ca. 13-45 flowers; peduncles 1-4 cm long, moderately setose, the hairs spreading; bracts lanceolate, 2-5 mm long, setose, caducous; pedicels 1-4 mm long, moderately setose, the hairs spreading. Hypanthia campanulate, 3-4 mm long, 2-3 mm broad at torus, sparsely setose, the hairs spread- ing. Calyx lobes 5, very narrowly triangular to lanceolate, shorter than the hypanthium, 2-3 mm long, setose along margin. Petals 5, pink to magenta, obovate, 0.6-0.8 X 0.4-0.6 cm, ciliate, usually with a terminal seta. Stamens 10, very slightly dimorphic in size, all yellow; larger stamens with filaments 4-6 mm long, thecae ca. 3-3.5 mm long, the connective ca. 0.5 mm long with minute basal lobes; smaller stamens with filaments 3-4 mm long, thecae 2-2.5 mm long, the connective ca. 0.3 mm long with minute basal lobes. Ovary ovoid, ca. 3 mm long, with 5 short setose appendages at apex; styles 0.6-1 cm long. Capsules ovoid, 3-4 mm long, with 10 prominent ribs; seeds ca. 0.3 mm long.

description: Suffrutices erecti ca. 17 cm alti. Rami distales dense hispiduli. Petioli 1-2 cm longi dense strigosi; laminae foliorum parvae ellipticae 0.7-1.3 x 0.5-0.8 cm dense strigosiae. Flores solitarii terminalis vel in summis axillis; bracteae florales foliaceae demum marcescentes; hypanthia sparsim glanduloso-strigillosa; lobi calycis 5 hypanthio plerumque breviores, oblanceolati supra ac subtus et secus margines sparsim strigosi; petala 5, 1-1.5 X 1-1.5 cm marginibus glanduloso-ciliatis; stamina 10, penitus flava in amplitudine parum dimorpha; ovarium 4-4.5 mm longum in quarta distali setosum.

description: Erect subshrubs with branches to 17 cm long. Distal branches densely hispidulous, brown, the lower branches with peeling epidermis; nodes densely hispidulous and with setose hairs 1-1.5 mm long; internodes 0.1- 1.1 cm long. Petioles 1-2 mm long, densely strigose with whitish hairs; leaf blades elliptic, 0.7-1.3 X 0.5-0.8 cm, the apex acute, the base attenuate to rounded, 3-nerved at the base, the upper and lower leaf surfaces densely strigose, the margin entire, beset with setae ca. 0.5 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm distant. Flowers solitary, terminal or axillary in the uppermost nodes; bracts very similar to the leaves, 4-5 X 2-3 mm, strigose, withering with age; pedicels 2-3 mm long, brown-hispidulous. Hypanthia urceolate, 4-6.5 mm long, 3-4 mm broad at the torus, sparsely glandular-strigose (Fig. 6). Calyx lobes 5, usually shorter than the hypanthium, oblanceolate, 5-5.5 X 1.5 mm, reddish at base, sparsely strigose adaxially, abaxially and along margin. Petals 5, dark pink, obovate, 1-1.5 X 1-1.5 cm, generally the length and widest part of petal equal, glandular-ciliate, with or without a terminal seta. Stamens 10, slightly dimorphic in size, all yellow; larger stamens with filaments 5- 6 mm long, thecae 5-6 mm long, the connective ca. 1.5 mm long including 2 basal bulbous lobes; smaller stamens with filaments 4-5 mm long, thecae ca. 4 mm long, the connective 0.5-1 mm long including 2 basal bulbous lobes. Ovary globose to ovoid, 4-4.5 mm long (1-2 mm shorter than the hypanthium), setose in distal 1/4, lacking apical emergences; styles 1.2-1.5 cm long. Mature capsules not seen.

description: Frutices erecti 1-4 m alti. Rami distales sparsim hirtelli trichomatibus patentibus plerumque rubescentibus. Petioli 0.3-2.5 cm longi; laminae foliorum anguste ellipticae vel late ellipticae, (3.2-)4-9.2 X (0.8-)1.5- 4.5 cm supra et subtus sparsim strigosae. Inflorescentiae terminales vel foliis summis axillares, floribus 3-19 in dichasiis simplicibus vel compositis; bracteae florales triangulares 1.5-2 mm long brunneae caducae secus margines setosae; hypanthia campanulata 4-6 X 4-6 mm sparsim hirtella; lobi calycis 5 angustissime triangulares vel lanceolati 3-5(-6) mm longi secus margines hirtelli; petala 5, rosea vel purpurata 1.2-1.9 X 0.8-1.3 cm; stamina penitus flava in amplitudine moderate dimorpha; ovarium 4-5 mm longum sparsim strigosum in quarta distali.

description: Erect subshrubs 1-4 m tall. Distal branches sparsely hirtellous, the hairs spreading and often reddish; nodes sparsely hirtellous, the hairs 1-3 mm long, often retrorsely appressed; internodes 1.5-10.5 cm long. Petioles 0.3-2.5 cm long, moderately hirtellous; leaf blades narrowly to broadly elliptic, (3.2-)4-9.2 X (0.8-)1.5-4.5 cm, the apex acuminate, the base usually rounded to rarely cuneate, 3-nerved from the base, the larger leaves with an additional lateral pair of veins arising above the base on the outer primaries, the upper surface sparsely strigose, the hairs appressed and adnate to the surface for 1/4-1/3 their length the lower surface sparsely strigose with the hairs free to the base, the primary and secondary veins raised and sparsely setose beneath, the margin denticulate with each tooth terminating in a seta ca. 1 mm long. Inflorescences terminal or axillary in the uppermost leaves, simple or compound dichasia, 2-5 cm long, with 3-19 flowers; peduncles 0.6-6(-10) cm long, hirtellous; bracts triangular, 1.5-2 mm long, brown, setose along margin, caducous; pedicels 2-12 mm long, sparsely hirtellous. Hypanthia campanulate, 4-6 mm long, 4-6 mm broad at the torus, sparsely hirtellous (Fig. 7). Calyx lobes 5, very narrowly triangular to lanceolate, shorter or longer than the hypanthium, 3-5(-6) mm long, hirtellous along margin, otherwise glabrous. Petals 5, pink to purple, obovate, 1.2-1.9 X 0.8-1.3 cm, rounded or acute at apex, ciliate, with a terminal seta. Stamens 10, moderately dimorphic in size, all yellow; larger stamens with filaments 5-8 mm long, thecae 5-6 mm long, the connective 1 mm long with basal lobes 0.5-1 mm; smaller stamens with filaments 4-6 mm long, thecae 3.5-4 mm long, the connective ca. 0.5 mm long with basal lobes ca. 0.5 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 4-5 mm long, sparsely strigose in distal 1/4, lacking apical appendages; styles 1-1.4 cm long, often hooked at apex. Capsules ovoid, 6-7 mm long; seeds ca. 0.4-0.5 mm long.

description: Frutices ca. I m alti. Rami distales hispiduli ac strigillosi. Petioli 0.3-0.9 cm longi hirsutulosi; laminae foliorum anguste ellipticae 2.5-5.1 x 0.7-2 cm supra et subtus sparsim hirsutulosi. Flores solitarii vel in cymis simplicibus; bracteae florales cordatae ad basim unguiculatae hypanthium amplectentes, persistentes plerumque rubescentes; pedicelli hispidulosi; hypanthia appressi-setosa; lobi calycis 4 hypanthio breviores, setosi secus costam ac margines; petala 4, 1.2-1.8 x 0.7-1.4 cm; stamina 8, in amplitudine ac colore valde dimolpha; ovarium 4.5-5.5 mm longum ad apicem setosum protuberationis 4 triangularibus setosis.

description: Shrubs ca. 1 m tall. Distal branches his- pidulous and strigillose with hairs (generally <0.5 mm long) appressed or spreading, white or red giving branches a reddish brown cast; nodes setose with hairs 0.5-1 mm long; internodes 0.9-6 cm long. Petioles 0.3-0.9 cm long, ca. 0.5 mm thick, hirsutulous, reddish to brownish; leaf blades narrowly elliptic, 2.5-5.1 X 0.7-2 cm, the apex acuminate, the base rounded, 3-nerved from the base, the larger leaves sometimes with an obscure pair of lateral veins near the margin, the upper and lower surfaces hirsutulous with hairs generally <0.5 mm long, the margin entire, beset with setae ca. 0.5 mm long, ca. 0.5 mm distant. Inflorescences composed of simple, terminal or axillary cymes, or flowers solitary; peduncles 2-4 mm long, hirsutulous; bracts cordate, 0.5-1 X 0.4-0.6 cm, strigose abaxially, glabrous adaxially, clawed at the base, acuminate at apex, often reddish, hirsutulous, clasping the hypanthium, persistent; pedicels 1-2 mm long, hispidulous. Hypanthia urceolate, 0.4-0.6 cm long, appressed setose with hairs ca. 1 mm long (Fig. 8). Calyx lobes 4, narrowly triangular, shorter than the hypanthium, 4-8 mm long, 1.5- 2.5 mm broad at base, long acuminate at apex, setose along the midvein and margin, otherwise glabrous. Petals 4, obovate, 1.2- 1.8 X 0.7-1.4 cm, pink, acute to rounded at apex, with a terminal seta. Stamens 8, dimorphic; larger stamens with filaments 6.5-9 mm long, thecae 6-7 mm long, red, the connective 3.5-4 mm long with two yellow bulbous basal lobes; smaller stamens with filaments 6-7 mm long, thecae ca. 5 mm long, yellow, the connective 1-2 mm long with two bulbous basal lobes ca. 1 mm long. Ovary 4.5-5.5 mm long, ovoid, setose in distal 1/4, with 4 triangular setose emergences extending above torus; styles 1.2-1.4 cm long. Capsules ovoid, 0.6-0.7 cm long; mature seeds not seen.

description: Subfrutices erecti 0.3-1 m alti. Rami distales mod- erate strigosi. Petioli 2-3.5 mm longi dense strigosi; laminae foliorum lanceolatae vel anguste ellipticae 1.2-3.4 X 0.3-0.9 cm supra et subtus dense hirsuti. Flores solitarii ad apices ramorum terminalium vel lateralium; bracteae florales lineari vel angustissime spathulati, persistentia, dense strigosae; hypanthia dense strigosa; lobi calycis 5 vel 6, anguste triangulari, subtus dense hirsuti supra glabri; petala 5 vel 6, 1-1.5 X 0.7-1.1 cm; stamina 10 vel 12, penitus flava in amplitudine dimorpha; ovarium ca. 5 mm longum in quarta distali dense strigosum.

description: Erect subshrubs 0.3-1 m tall. Distal branches ca. 0.5 mm thick, glabrous or sparsely strigose; nodes with white appressed hairs 1-2 mm long; internodes 1- 4.8 cm long, moderately strigose, with white, appressed hairs ca. 0.5-1 mm long. Petioles 2-3.5 mm long, densely strigose with white appressed hairs; leaf blades lanceolate to narrowly elliptic, 1.2-3.4 X 0.3- 0.9 cm, the apex acute, the base rounded, 3-nerved, the upper and lower surfaces densely hirsute, with whitish hairs 1-2 mm long. Flowers solitary at the apex of terminal or lateral branches; peduncles 1-3 mm long, sparsely strigose; bracts linear to very narrowly spatulate, 2-4 mm long, densely strigose abaxially and adaxially, persistent; pedicels 1-1.5 mm long, densely strigose completely covered with white hairs. Hypanthia campanulate, 4-5 mm long to the torus, 4-5 mm broad at the to- rus, densely strigose (Fig. 9). Calyx lobes 5 or 6, narrowly triangular, 3-7 mm long, 1.5-2 mm broad at base, densely hirsute abaxially, glabrous adaxially. Petals 5 or 6, pink to purple, obovate, 1-1.5 X 0.7-1.1 cm, ciliate along the margin, with a terminal seta. Stamens 10 or 12, dimorphic in size, all yellow; larger stamens with filaments 6.5-8 mm long, anthers 7-7.5 mm long, thecae ca. 6 mm long, the connective ca. 1 mm long with basal lobes ca. 1 mm long; the smaller stamens with filaments 5-6 mm long, anthers 5.5-6 mm long, thecae (3-)4-5 mm long, the connective 0.7-1 mm long with basal lobes ca. 0.5 mm long. Ovary ca. 5 mm long, densely setose in distal 1/4, without apical appendages; styles 1.1- 1.4 mm long. Capsules 5-6 mm long; seeds ca. 0.3 mm long.

description: Suffiutices vel herbae erectae 15-30 cm altae. Rami distales setosi trichomiatibus pallidis appressis plerumnque glandulosis. Petioli 0.2-0.4 cm longi; laminae foliorum anguste ellipticac vel ellipticac, 2.2-6 x 0.9-2.1 cm, supra setosae trichomatibus paginae semiadnatis, subtus strigosae trichomatibus plerumque glandularibus in foliis junioribus. Flores solitarii ad apices ramorum lateralium vel in cymis simplicibus ad apices ramorum terminalium; bracteae florales caducae; hypanthia appresso-setosa: lobi calycis 5 spathulati 10-12 mm longi; petala 5, rosca glanduloso-ciliata; stamina in amplitudine valde dimorpha, majorum thecis roseis vel rubris 7-8 mm long, minorum thecis flavis 3.5-7 mm longis; ovarium 4-5 mm longum ad apicem setosum.

description: Erect herbs or subshrubs 15-30 cm tall. Distal branches sparsely setose to setose with light-colored, often glandular, appressed hairs 1-2 mm long; nodes setose with hairs 2-4 mm long; internodes 1-4 cm long. Petioles 0.2-0.4 cm long, setose with appressed hairs 2-4 mm long; leaf blades narrowly elliptic to elliptic, 2.2-6 x 0.9- 2.1 cm, the apex acute, the base broadly attenuate to rounded, 3-nerved from the base, larger leaves sometimes with an obscure pair of lateral veins near the margin, the upper surface sparsely setose with hairs 1-2.5 mm long and adnate to the leaf surface for ca. 1/2 their length, the lower surface sparsely strigose with hairs 1.5-2 mm long, these sometimes glandular on young leaves; the margin entire, beset with setae 1.5-2 mm long, ca. 1 mm distant. Inflorescences consisting of simple cymes at the apex of terminal branches or flowers solitary at the apex of lateral branches; peduncles 4.5-5 mm long, setose; bracts apparently early caducous; pedicels 3-6 mm long, setose. Hypanthia urceolate, 8-9 mm long, 4-6 mm broad at the torus, sparsely setose with hairs 1-2 mm long (Fig. 10). Calyx lobes 5, spatulate, 10-12 mm long, 1-nerved, sparsely setose adaxially, sparsely setose on the vein below. Petals 5, pink, obovate, 0.7-1.3 X 0.3-0.8 cm, glabrous, glandular-ciliate, with a terminal seta. Stamens 10, strongly dimorphic; the larger stamens with filaments 7-10 mm long, anthers 10-13 mm long, thecae 7-8 mm long, pink to red, the connective 3-4.5 mm long with bulbous, yellow lobes 0.5-1 mm; smaller stamens with filaments 4-6.5 mm long, anthers 4-7 mm long, thecae 3.5-7 mm long, connective ca. 1 mm long with bulbous lobes ca. 0.5 mm long. Ovary ovoid, 4-5 mm long, setose at the apex, without apical appendages; styles 10-13 mm long. Capsules ovoid, ca. 5 mm long; seeds ca. 0.5 mm long.

description: Branched, glabrous plant with straight, terete, brown stems and alternate phyllotaxy. Leaves to 4 x 3.5 cm, obovate, apex rounded, smooth, base tapering into short petiole 1-2 mm long; blade leathery, with 3 obscure veins in palmate pattern; base of lateral stems and flowers surrounded by inconspicuous crater fragments. Flowers 1-3 per axil, the second and third in prophyllar positions, each on a separate peduncle to 23 mm long which is articulate above the middle and expanded into a terminal cupule 4 mm wide; margin of cupule smooth except for 2 or 3 small clusters of very short, multicellular hairs. Mature buds 4 cm long, straight or slightly sigmoid, ovary ovoid, 5 x 3.5 mm, calyculus smooth; petals 6, slightly less than 4 cm long, rather stout, bright red to red-orange, with 1 x 1 mm tongue-like ligule 7-8 mm above base; filaments straight, attached 22 mm above base, anthers 4-4.5 x 1.5 mm, dorsifixed, in two slightly overlapping series, the tips of the upper ones rounded, of the lower ones bluntly angled; pollen apparently the same as that of L. cuneifolia, as seen under the light microscope. Style as long as the petals, the base dilated into a 2 x 1 mm pulvinate nectary, stigma bluntly capitate, smooth, placed above the anthers. Fruit with conspicuous calyculus, at least 1 cm in length but not seen in mature condition.

description: Caules (sub)teretes, glabri; phyllotaxis irregulariter decussata; lamina ad 15 x 6 cm, late lanceolata ad ovata. Planta ut videtur dioecia. description: Shoots ca 8-12 cm long, purplish to yellow; internodes 0.3-1 cm long (mean 0.4 cm), 2-4 mm wide. Staminate inflorescence elongate and deciduous after anthesis, often bright yellow, the flowers verticillate in whorls of 6-8, mostly 4-merous, individual flowers ca 6 mm long, 5 mm in diameter; perianth segments ca 1 mm long, ca 0.75 mm wide, the apex acute. Pistillate plants brownish to purplish, flowers ca 1 mm long, ca I mm in diameter. Fruit 1-1.5 cm long, 5-7 mm wide, ovate-elliptical; proximal portion grayish, ca 6-7 mm long; distal portion olive- green; maturation requiring ca 18 months. Anthesis from approximately March through mid-April.

description: Herbaceous vines; stems stout, 2-3 mm diam, mostly pilose. Leaf blades ovate or broadly ovate, 5-9 cm long and 3-7 cm wide, the apex acute and distinctly mucronate, the base truncate to slightly cordate, both surfaces velutinous with the upper sometimes less dense; petioles 1-4 (8) cm long, 1 mm diam, densely pubescent. Inflorescence a capitate cyme; peduncles exceeding the leaves, 10-26 cm long and 1-3 mm diam, densely pubescent; outer bracts narrowly ovate or lanceolate, 1-2.5 cm long, 0.3-1 cm wide, abaxially pilose with trichomes 2-6 mm long; inner bracts similar, slightly smaller. Sepals 5, slightly unequal, the outer longer and broader than the inner, ovate to narrowly ovate with acuminate apices, 1.5-2 cm long and 5-8 mm wide, abaxially densely villous with trichomes 2-4 mm long, adaxially glabrous; corolla white, 2.5-4 cm long, the 5 midpetaline bands densely pubescent with long, spreading trichomes; stamens somewhat unequal, included, inserted on the corolla tube 1 cm from the base, glandular pubescent below, the free portions 5-10 mm long; style 1.5-2 cm long, nearly equalling the stamens, somewhat persistent; stigmatic lobes globose, 0.5-1 mm diam. Mature capsules and seeds not seen.

description: Shrub to 3 m; branches terete, striate, hispid, crispate-hairy to glabrate. Leaves coriaceous, lucid, oblong to ovate, 3.5-11 cm long, 1.5-6.5 cm broad, 2-3 times longer than broad, glabrous, pinnately veined, the veins relatively obscure above, more conspicuous beneath, the ultimate venation finely reticulate; areoles less than 0.5 mm diam; margin entire, undulate; apex mostly obtuse; base rounded to subcordate; petioles 1-3 cm long, glabrous to somewhat hispid. Male inflorescences axillary, usually clustered, paniculate, densely congested, much shorter than the petiole, ascending to spreading, slender, villous; peduncles 0-1 mm long; rachis 0.5-1.5 mm long; bracts lanceolate, 0.6-1 mm long, ca 0.3 mm broad, villous; pedicels 1.5-5 mm long; bractlets 3, ovate, ca 1.2 mm long, ca 1 mm broad, glabrous. Flowers greenish-yellow, glabrous; sepals 6 in 2 series, the outer ovate, ca 2 mm long, ca 1.2 mm broad, the inner broadly ovate, ca 2 mm long, ca 1.6 mm broad; petals 6 in 2 similar series, obovate, ca 1 mm long, ca 0.7 mm broad; stamens 6; filaments ca 1 mm long. Female inflorescences axillary, usually solitary in fruit, racemose, shorter than the petiole, ascending to spreading, slender, villous becoming glabrate; peduncles 0.1-5 mm long; rachis 0.1-8 mm long; bracts lanceolate, ca 0.7 mm long, ca 0.2 mm broad, sparsely villous; pedicels 1- 5 mm long; bractlets 0-3, lanceolate, ca 0.5 mm long, ca 0.2 mm broad, glabrous. Flowers greenish-yellow (?), glabrous; sepals 6 in 2 series, the outer narrowly ovate, ca 1.3 mm long, ca 0.9 mm broad, the inner broadly ovate to orbicular, ca 1.3 mm long and broad; petals 6 in 2 similar series, obovate, ca 0.8 mm long, ca 0.5 mm broad; carpels 3 or 4, obovoid, ca 0.8 mm long, ca 0.5 mm broad, glabrous. Fruits obovoid to globose, glabrous, 10-17 mm long, 8-13 mm broad, slightly compressed, the apex broadly rounded.

description: Shrub or small spreading tree to 10 m; branches terete, gray, glabrous to hispid. Leaves coriaceous, lucid, narrowly to broadly ovate or obovate, 3-8 cm long, 1.5-5.5 cm broad, no more than twice as long as broad, glabrous to rarely sparingly hispid on the midrib beneath, pinnately veined with few, relatively incon- spicuous primary veins, the ultimate venation inconspicuously to finely reticulate; areoles less than 0.5 mm in diam; margin entire, usually undulate; apex obtuse to retuse, apiculate, rarely acute; base narrowed to rounded; petioles 0.5-1.5 cm long, glabrous to rarely hispid. Male inflorescences axillary, usually clustered, racemose, usually equal to or longer than the petiole, ascending to spreading- ascending, filiform, villous; peduncles 0-7 mm long; rachis 0.8-2.3 cm long; bracts lanceolate, 0.6-1.1 mm long, ca 0.3 mm broad, villous; pedicels 0-2 mm long; bractlets 3, lanceolate, ca 0.6 mm long, ca 0.2 mm broad, glabrous to villous. Flowers greenish-yellow, glabrous; sepals 6 in 2 series, the outer ovate, ca 1.5 mm long, ca 1 mm broad, the inner broadly ovate, ca 1.8 mm long, ca 1.3 mm broad; petals 6 in 2 similar series, obovate, ca 0.5 mm long, ca 0.3 mm broad; stamens 6; filaments ca 0.5 mm long. Female inflorescences axillary, usually solitary, racemose, usually longer than the petiole, ascending, slender to stout, sparsely to densely villous becoming glabrate with age; peduncles 0-11 mm long; rachis 0.3-3.7 mm long; bracts lanceolate, 0.7-1 mm long, ca 0.3 mm broad, villous; pedicels 0-2 mm long; bractlets 3, lanceolate, ca 0.5 mm long, ca 0.2 mm broad, villous. Flowers greenish-yellow; sepals 6 in 2 series, the outer ovate, ca 1.2 mm long, ca 0.8 mm broad, sparsely villous, the inner broadly ovate, ca 1.5 mm long, ca 1.2 mm broad, glabrous; petals 6 in 2 similar series, obovate, ca 0.8 mm long, ca 0.5 mm broad, glabrous; carpels 3 or 4, ovoid, ca 0.8 mm long, ca 0.5 mm broad, glabrous. Fruit black, globose, glabrous, 12-14 mm long and broad, slightly compressed, the apex broadly rounded.

description: Small perennial herbs 6.5-30 cm high; stems several to many arising from a slender rhizome bearing slender roots, basally decumbent, then becoming erect, usually branching near the base, quadrangular in cross-section, with prominent decurrent ribs, internodes glabrous to scabrous, nodes glabrous, papillate or scabrous. Leaves membranaceous to subcoriaceous, decussate, sometimes forming a pseudowhorl just below the inflorescences; mid-stem leaves sessile to short-petiolate, 3-9 pairs per stem, the petioles 1-2 mm long, the blades ovate to elliptic, occasionally obovate, narrowly ovate or oblong, acute to obtuse at the apex, cuneate at the base, mostly longer than the internodes, 1.1-3.5 X 0.5-1.8 cm, glabrous above and beneath; the basal leaves often spatulate; the pseudowhorled or opposite bracteate leaves below the inflorescence identical in appearance to the mid-stem leaves; the interpetiolar stipules membranaceous, deltate, ca. 1 X ca. 1 mm. Inflorescences solitary, axillary and termi- nal, sessile, erect at anthesis, 1.5-6.5 cm long with 3-12 flowers per axis; rachis glabrous; pedicels ca. 1 mm long; bracts ca. 1 mm long; calyx lobes 5, narrowly triangular, glabrous to papillate or scabrous along the margins, 2-6 X <1 mm, erect in fruit and longer than the capsule at maturity; corollas white with two purple stripes on each lobe and with tinges of purple on the outer side of the lobe margins, white inside, funnelform, glabrous, 9-19 mm long; throats 2-4 mm wide; lobes 5, ovate to narrowly ovate, strongly plicate in bud, acute to ob- tuse at the apex, 3-7 X 1-2 mm, spreading at anthesis; stamens 5, included, filaments ca. 1 mm long and adnate to the lower half to middle of the tube; anthers 1-2 mm long, connivent around the pistil ca. 2 mm below its apex; pistils included; ovaries ca. 1 mm long, glabrous; styles 6-7 mm long, pubes cent along the upper 2-3 mm, articulated 2-3 mm above the ovary; stigmas capitate; capsules glabrous to papillate on the apex, shallowly bilobed, 3-4 X 4-5 mm; the persistent style segments erect, 1-3 mm long; the subtending persistent disk emarginate at the tips, 3-5 mm long; seeds ca. 1 mm long, tuberculate.

description: Erect perennial herbs 30-34 cm high; stems arising from a thick rhizome bearing thick fibrous roots, succulent, rarely branching laterally, terete, with prominent decurrent ribs, densely villous with multicellular hairs. Leaves slightly succulent, decussate, not in pseudowhorls; mid-stem leaves sessile, 2-3 pairs per stem, the blades ovate to elliptic, acute to mucronate at the apex, rounded to cordate at the base, shorter than to longer than the internodes, 3-7.5 X 1.2- 3.3 cm, densely pilose on both surfaces; the bracteate leaves just below the inflorescence identical to the mid-stem leaves; the basal leaves scale-like and appressed; stipules absent. Inflorescences solitary, terminal, erect at anthesis, generally 6-11 cm long with 7-16 flowers per cyme, long-pedunculate; rachis villous; peduncles 2-5 cm long; pedicels ca. 2 mm long; bracts ca. 2 mm long; calyx lobes 5, triangular, with the apices often recurved, sparsely to densely pilose or villous, 5-7 mm long; corollas red with yellow lobes, funnelform, throats not constricted, sparsely pilose outside especially on the lobes, 63-78 mm long; throats 5-7 mm wide; lobes 5, narrowly ovate, acute, ca. 10 X 2-3 mnm, spreading at anthesis; stamens 5, about equalling the lobes; filaments 7-9 mm long, adnate at the throat; anthers ca. 4 mm long, connivent around the pistil 2-5 mm below its apex; pistils exserted; ovaries ca. 1 mm long, glabrous; styles 65-79 mm long, pubescent along the upper 2-3 mm, articulated ca. 50 mm above the ovary; stigma capitate, pubescent, ca. 1 X <1 mm; mature capsules not seen, but persistent style segments apparently thread-like, ca. 50 mm long, and drying light-golden; the subtending disks not seen; seeds not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Gould, Kathryn R. 1999. Three new species of Spigelia (Strychnaceae) from Mexico. Brittonia. 51: 407-414.

description: Erect to prostrate perennial herbs 20-50 cm high; roots not seen; stems usually branching several times, terete, with prominent decurrent ribs, puberulent to scabrous at the internodes, scabrous at the nodes. Leaves membranaceous, decussate, not in pseudo-whorls; sessile; mid-stem leaves 2-5 pairs per stem, blades ovate to elliptic or occasionally obovate, shortly acuminate or occasionally acute to obtuse at the apex, cuneate to rounded at the base, shorter than to longer than the internodes, 1.2-5.3 X 0.5- 3 cm, sparsely scabrous to hispid above, densely so on the margins, glaucous beneath, occasionally hispid on the veins beneath; the bracteate leaves just below the inflorescences sessile, the blades ovate to elliptic, acute to shortly acuminate, 1.7-3.5 X 0.5-2.8 cm; the lower stem leaves orbicular; the basal leaves scale-like and appressed; the interpetiolar stipules laciniate, <1 X ca. 1 mm. Inflorescences (1-)3 per node, terminal, erect at anthesis, 5-8 cm long with 3-10 flowers per cyme, sessile to pedunculate; peduncles 0.2-1 cm long; pedicels 2-3 mm long; bracts minute, recurved, ca. 1 mm long; calyx lobes 5, narrowly ovate with recurved apices, puberulent to scabrous, margins purplish, 5-6 X ca. 1 mm, longer than the capsule at maturity; corollas red externally and white internally, funnelform, glabrous outside, densely papillose inside the upper portion of the lobes, 40-50 mm long; throats 4-6 mm wide; lobes 5, narrowly ovate, acuminate, ca. 10 X 1-2 mm, spreading at anthesis; stamens 5, about equalling the lobes; filaments adnate at the throat, ca. 8 mm long; anthers 1-2 mm long, connivent around the pistil 3-4 mm below its apex; pistils exserted; ovaries ca. 1 mm long, glabrous; styles 46- 54 mm long, slightly puberulent just below the apex, articulated 5-6 mm above the ovary; stigmas capitate, <1 mm wide; capsules puberulent mainly on the upper half, deeply obcordate, 4-5 mm high, ca. 6 mm wide; persistent style segments threadlike, green to light brown when dried, 5-6 mm long; the subtending, persistent disks emarginate at the tips, ca. 6 mm long; seeds 2- 3 mm long, tuberculate.

description: Frutex 1.5 m usque altus, ramis basalibus, compluribus foliis plerumque coriaceis. Petala flava; vexillum trapozoideum vel orbiculatum, apice rotundum vel ad 1 mm fissum, basi non auriculatum, ungue 4-5 mm longo; alis ad marginem dorsalem superne lobatis.

description: Shrub to 1.5 m tall with commonly >5 main stems, branches commonly reddish brown, younger branches beige, these, the calyx, and the leaves, especially along the midvein when young, glabrous or rarely sparsely pilose with hairs <0.4 mm long, the plant otherwise glabrous. Stipules 0.6-1.6 X 0.2-0.8(-1) cm, obliquely wide-ovate to lanceolate or sometimes obovate, the base cordate or rarely rounded base, the apex acute, obtuse or sometimes rounded, normally persistent, the venation rather inconspicuous, the lower lobe well-developed and forming a (20-)30-50º angle with the longitudinal axis of the stipule, the upper lobe present (rarely poorly developed) and forming a -100º to -160º (to -170º) angle with the longitudinal axis of the stipule, the edge of the stipules adjacent to the petiole excurvate. Leaves imparipinnate with (9-)13-25 (-29) pairs of opposite or subopposite leaflets (the distance between subopposite leaflets ca. 3.5 mm); petiole (0.2-)0.4-1.7 cm long; rachis (1.6-)3.5-8.5 cm long; stipels (0.5-)1-2 mm long, 1 mm wide at the base, yellowish green sometimes reddish, thick and stout or thin and slender, sometimes absent or reduced; petiolule (0.8-)1-2 mm long; leaflets (0.7-)1-1.7 X (0.3-)0.5-0.7 cm, the coriaceous lamina narrowly to broadly elliptic, or sometimes ovate, the base acute, obtuse or rounded, the apex acute, with a mucro (0.1-)1-1.7 mm long. The yellow borne solitary or paired at base of leafy nodes, never on leafless flowering branches; peduncles 0.7-1.5 cm long; bracteoles 3-4(-7) X 1-3 mm, narrowly triangular to deltate, persistent or deciduous, opposite, or rarely subopposite (displaced to 1 mm); calyx 1-1.6 X (0.4-)0.5-0.7 cm, campanulate to subtubular, with white hairs <0.4 mm long, the two vexillar lobes (4.5-) 5-7 X (2.2-)3-6(-7) mm, free (1/4-)1/6-1/7 of their length, the lateral lobes 4.5-5.5(-6) X 2.2-3(-4.5) mm, triangular to deltate, the carinal lobe (4.7-)5-7 X 2-3.2 mm, nar- rowly triangular to triangular; standard 1.6- 2 (claw included) X 1.5-2 cm, reflexed 1000 (in early anthesis) to 150? (in late an- thesis), macula green and outlined by red which extends into the nervation of the standard, the blade of the standard trapezoidal or orbiculate, non-auriculate, apex rounded or shallowly cleft (to 1 mm deep), the claw 4-4.5 X 1-1.3 mm; wing petals (1.5-)1.7-1.9 cm (claw included) X 8-8.5 mm, narrowly ovate and with a lobe on the upper dorsal margin, the claw 4-4.8 X 0.8 mm, the auricula forming an 80-100º angle with the claw; keel petals 1.75-1.95 cm (claw included) X (5-)7.5-9.5 mm, semi- lunate, ventral edge of the keel straight, the claw 4-4.5 X 0.6 mm, the auricula of the keel forming a 90-100º angle with the claw; androecium 1.8-1.9 cm long, the anthers 1.6-1.8 mm long; ovary 2-2.2 cm long, with 4(-6) ovules, with an intrastaminal brownish annular disk 0.5 mm long at the base, the style to 1.2 cm long, com- monly exserted to 5 mm. Legume 2.2-4.3 X 1-1.9 cm, ovate to oblanceolate, sometimes oblong, the stipe 2.5-5 mm long, the mucro 1-2.2 mm long, carinal suture winged 0.4-0.8 mm wide, 2-4(-6) seeds per fruit. Seeds (5-)6-7.6 X (3.8-)4.8-6.8 mm, 2-2.8 mmn-thick, ellipsoidal to wide ellipsoidal, light brown.

description: Woody climbers; branches terete, young branches, inflorescences, petioles and abaxial leaf surface sparsely covered by sessile or short-stalked glands, there more dense and with longer stalks at the nodes. Leaves 2.8-7 x 1.4-4.5 cm, elliptic to oval, apex acuminate and apiculate, base cordate to rounded, margin denticulate along the upper half, revolute, membranaceous, concolorous in dry materials, nerves 3, basal, with a faint additional pair of marginals, main veins prominent on the abaxial surface and impressed on the adaxial surface, transversal nerves and reticulation barely visible on both surfaces, these smooth, neither bullate or foveolate; petioles 7-17 mm long. Panicles 6-17 x 4-12 cm, terminal, frondose-bracteose, many-flowered, with 3-7 pairs of decussate paraclades, the basal paraclades consisting of small panicles with dichasial branching, the distal ones double or single dichasia; bracts 6-31 x 2-14 mm, the basalmost ones similar to the leaves, the distal ones smaller, petiolate, lanceolate to oblong lanceolate, acuminate, base acute, glabrous; bracteoles 2, ca. 0.8 mm long, subulate, entire, glabrous. Flowers 7-merous, on pedicels 1.5-2.6 mm long. Hypanthium 1.4-1.8 x 2.4-3.6 mm, broad-campanulate, reddish, abaxially sparse to moderately covered by sessile or shortstalked glands, adaxially glabrous; torus glabrous. Calyx tube ca. 0.5 mm long, thick, both surfaces with the same glands, but these sometimes tufted on abaxial surface; lobes 0.7-0.8mm long, triangular, conduplicate, acute, dorsal teeth robust, acute, seta-tipped. Petals 5-7.9 x 2.4-3.7 mm, oblong to elliptic, obtuse, entire, eciliate. Stamens slightly dimorphic in size, all grouped in a zygomorphic bundle, their anthers perpendicular to the style, with the ventral surfaces facing the flower axis, and with the appendages "whip-like" (coiled), with no precise direction; filaments 2.3-2.7 mm long; connective appendage 4.1-6.2 mm long, purple; anthers 2.1-2.5 mm long, yellow, slightly arcuate, apex acute, the basal lobes rounded, robust. Ovary 1.4-1.9 mm long, 3-4-celled, free to basally 1/4 inferior; style 4.1-6 mm long, slightly sigmoid. Capsule 4.3-5.1 x 4.7-5.3 mm, pale brown; seeds 1.4-1.7 x 0.3-0.7 mm, long-cuneate.

description: Erect, annual herb, to 20 cm tall, with fibrous roots. Herbage glabrous. Leaves linear, slightly thick, 1.5-2 cm long, to 0.1 cm wide, the margins entire, the apex rounded. Flowers in the axils of foliage leaves, 1 per node; pedicels 2 mm long, becoming longer in fruit, glandular-pubescent; sepals lanceolate, 2 mm long, less than 1 mm wide, glandular-pubescent, the margins hyaline, the apex acute; corolla tube saccate, 2-3 mm long, glandular-pubescent within, the upper lobes 2 mm long, 1 mm wide, the apex rounded, the lateral lobes 1-2 mm long, 1 mm wide above the middle, narrowing toward the base, the apex rounded, the median lobe 1-2 mm long, 1 mm wide, unornamented; stamens to 1 mm long; ovary to 1 mm long, the style 2 mm long, the stigma terminal, unlobed. Capsule globose, 3-4 mm diam, light brown, dull, borne on a pendent pedicel to 4 mm long; seeds triangulate, to 1 mm long, with reticulate echinate exotesta.

description: Erect, perennial herb, to 30 cm tall, with a thickened root-stock. Herbage glabrous. Leaves narrowly oblanceolate, 1.5-2.5 cm long, 0.1-0.2 cm wide, slightly thick, the margins entire, the apex acute. Flowers in the axils of foliage leaves, 1 per node; pedicels 2-4 mm long, glabrous; sepals lanceolate, 3-4 mm long, 1 mm wide, glabrous, the margins hyaline, the apex acute, cuspidate; corolla tube 3-5 mm long, glandular-pubescent within, the upper lobes 2-3 mm long, 1 mm wide, the apex rounded, the lateral lobes 3-5 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, widest above the middle, the apex rounded, the median lobe 3-5 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, unornamented; stamens 2-3 mm long; ovary 2 mm long, the style 2 mm long, the stigma terminal, unlobed. description:
M. quintuplinervi Naud. affinis, sed foliis indistincte plinerviis, infloreseentia multiflora, hypanthio minore non costato, antheris dimorphicis.

Rami obtuse quadrangulati primum modice setulosi (setis ad 1 mm longis) et dense brunneo-furfuracei demum glabrati. Petioli 2-5 cm pubeseentia ramorum eadem; lamina 9-15 X 5-9 cm elliptica apice hebetissime acuta basi rotundata, inconspicue 5-plinervia (nervis interioribus ca. 2 mm supra basim insertis) nervis nervulisque supra subplanis subtus leviter elevatis nervulis vix reticulatis, ad marginem apicem versus inconspicue remoteque sinuato-denticulata, supra primrum in nervulis furfuracea mox glabrata, subtus modice puberula pilo basi indistincte stellato cum seta simplici 0.3-0.5 mm longa terminato (demum glabrata?). Inflorescentia multiflora, floribus ad apices ramulorum 3-6-faseiculatis, omnino cum pedicellis hypanthioque densiuscule furfuracea et setulosa. Pedicelli 3-6 mm; flores 4-5-meri. Hypanthium 3.5 (ad torum) X 3.5 mm demum glabratum; calycis tubus ca. 1.3 mm altus, lobis subirregulariter fissis ca. 1.2 X 3.8 mm apice rotundatis extus unituberculatis tuberculo acuto ca. 0.9 mm alto lobi apicem aequante. Petala 12 X 11 mm asymmetrice obovata apice rotundata vel oblique truneata. Stamina distincte dimorphica. Staminum maiorum: filamenta 8 mm longa; thecae 7.5 mm longae apice paulo attenuatae, connectivo basi dorsaliter calearato appendice acuta 0.5-0.8 mm longa. Staminum minorum: filamenta 6 mm longa; thecae siibsteriles 1.6 mm longae, connectivo sub theca 2.5 mmli prolongato et ad basim dorsaliter sub)ealcarato. Stylus 17-19 × 0.8 mm; stigma truneatum; ovarium 4-5-loculare glabrum apice truneatum.

description:

description: Rami teretes cum petiolis pedunculis venisque laminae principalibus subtus primum dense puberuli (pilis laxis ad 1 mm longis irregulariter papillosis) tarde glabrati. description: A slender trailing or twining lignescent perennial vine. Stems 2-8 m long, no more than 5 mm in diameter, branching primarily from the base, strongly angled with conspicuous exfoliating bark on old growth, cylindrical and glaucous on new growth, the internodes 2-22 cm long. Leaves petiolate on vegetative branches, often subsessile or sessile on fertile branches; petioles up to 62 mm long, darker than stem, glabrous, or with scattered hirsute hairs along upper surface; blade simple, variable, ovate, ovate-elongate, or sagittate-hastate, 2.5-10 cm long, 1.2-7 cm wide, the blades of climbing stems generally basally cordate, those of prostrate stems generally hastate, the margins entire, the basal lobes 5-37 mm long, 6-35 mm wide, occasionally dentate, with 1-3 extended teeth, apex acuminate or attenuate. Flowers axillary, solitary; peduncle usually shorter and more slender than the pedicel, 5-20 mm long, ca 1 mm in diameter, glabrous, cylindrical; the pedicels 8-30 mm long, subtended by minute bracteoles. Sepals unequal, the inner 6-7 mm long, 3-4 mm wide, expanded when in fruit, the outer 3-5 mm long, ca 3 mm wide, ovate, or elliptic, obtuse, coriaceous with hyaline margins. Corolla subsalverform, the limbs gradually flaring at summit, 4-6 cm long, base ca 2 mm in diameter, throat 6-8 mm in diameter, limbs 30-35 mm across when fully expanded, pale lavender-blue, the androecium and style included just below plane of limb; stamens unequal, 24-35 mm long, anthers and filaments white, style shorter than longest stamens, 23-30 mm long. Fruit a conical 4-valved capsule, ca 11 mm long, 7 mm wide at base, coriaceous before dry, 2-locular. Seeds 4, dark brown, minutely puberulent, subrotund, 3-angular, 3-4 mm wide, 4-5 mm long.

description: Perennial woody vine, trailing or twining, up to 10 m long, glabrous, without herbaceous spines or warts. Stems covered by thin, grayish to yellowish bark without punctations, partially exfoliating on woody portions. Nature of juice unknown. Petioles 2.5-5.5 cm long. Leaves glabrous above, glabrate and usually bearing scattered brown punctations below, 6-8 cm long, 5-6 cm wide, with 6-8 lateral nerves on each side of midrib, not coriaceous, cordate, long acuminate, usually bearing 2-6 deltoid acuminate teeth 2-5 mm long on the lower portion of the leaf, or entire. Inflorescences axillary, with one flower, longer than subtending leaves. Peduncles about 2.5 cm long. Pedicels about 3 cm long, striate, slightly thickened at apex and enlarging slightly in fruit. Bracts 2, fugacious, about 2 mm long. Sepals 5, lanceolate, long-acuminate, mucronulate at apex, outer ones bearing gland-like processes at their bases, outer two 1.5-2.5 cm long, inner three 3.5-4 cm long, not enlarging or becoming coriaceous or reflexed in fruit. Corolla salverform, no fragrance recorded; tube 6-7 cm long, 4-6 mm wide, white, glabrous without and minutely pubescent within. Stamens long-exserted, white, subequal, filaments bearing conspicuous crinkled hairs from insertion on upper portion of corolla tube to 3/4 the way to the anthers. Stigma long-exserted, about equal to anthers, capitate, 2-lobed. Capsules nearly spherical, 1.5-2 cm in diameter, 2-celled, 4-seeded, on slightly thickened erect pedicels with erect sepals. Seeds (only ones available were crushed when pressed) 8-18 mm long, about 6 mm wide, finely covered by minute tawny hairs, probably spheroidal, brown. Chromosome number unknown.

description: Description: A woody vine; stems and branchlets iiot seen; petioles slender, elongate, 8.5-14 cm. long, conspicuously ampliate at base and inerassate at apex, glabrate; leaf blades subcoriaceous, subnitid, oblong- ovate, 21.5-25.5 cm. long, 8.7-12.5 cm. wide, abruptly short-acuminate at apex, entire, abruptly acute or subacuminate at base, glabrate on both surfaces; midrib slender, flat above, very prominent to the apex beneath; secondaries slender, about 7 per side, all irregularly disposed or the lower ones opposite, flat above, prominent beneath, not anasto- mosing, arcuate-aseending; tertiaries very slender, flat but plainly visible above, prominulent beneath; vein and veinlet reticulation extremely fine and abundant, only the larger portions discernible above, plainly discernible to the ultimate reticulum under a hand-lens be- neath; staminate infloreseence axillary, racemiform or rather obscurely subpaniculate, 19-21 cm. long, 1-2 cm. wide at anthesis, many-flowered, rather dense; rachis and its branches slender, rather densely short- pubescent with subappressed brownish hairs; pedicels very slender, 2-7 mm. long, very sparsely strigillose; staminate flowers: sepals 6, very similar, the 3 outer ones slightly lighter and narrower, elliptic or widest slightly below the middle, about 2.4 mm. long and 1.2 mm. wide, decidedly concave, somewhat narrowed at both ends, the 3 inner ones obovate, widest slightly above the middle, about 2.4 mm. long and 1.5 mm. wide, rather obtuse at both ends, somewhat or decidedly concave; petals 6, conspicuous, longer than the stamens, obovate, about 0.7 mm. long and 0.5 mm. wide, conspicuously involute along the margins and at apex, obtuse at apex, subacute at base; stamens 6, connate at base with the petal-base, about 0.51 mm. long and equilateral (ca. 0.25 mm.) throughout; pistillate infloreseences and fruit not known.

description: Suffrutescent, to 1.5 m tall; root unknown; stem moderately leafy in upper part, naked toward the base, strict, sparsely branched, ca 4 mm thick, fistulose, glabrous below, spreading-pilosulose above; leaves ascending, light green, undivided, nar- rowly ovate, ca 11 cm long, much reduced in the inflorescence, the blade ca 7.5 cm long, 2 cm wide, serrate-dentate, obtuse at the tip, tapering to the petiole, cinereous- puberulent on both sides, the vesture consisting of simple, narrowly triangular, spreading hairs ca 0.4 mm long, uniformly scattered on the upper and lower surface but more heavily concentrated on the midvein and the principal lateral veins of the lower surface; inflorescence a compound dichasium, terminal, diffuse, ca 12 cm wide at young maturity, the ultimate branches scorpioid, 6-8 mm long, leafy-bracteate, the bracts ca 2.2 mm long, subtending and overtopping the achenes, glabrous; pistillate corolla white, subcampanulate-infundibuliform, gibbous, the tube 0.8 mm long, twice as long as the limb, the limb spreading, ca 0.4 mm long, the throat glabrous inside, the 3 abortive stamens sterile; staminate flowers not seen; style exserted, sparsely hairy inside the throat; achenes (immature) ovate-oblong, 2 mm long, 1-1.1 mm wide, narrowly winged, mostly glabrous, sometimes sparingly hirtellous on both sides; calyx-limb short-cupuliform, more or less dentate.

description: Tree, reproductive height (8) 20-46 m x 60-70 cm, with thin, tall plank buttresses; bark light gray to brown, whitish or reddish gray, finely lenticellate, smooth, with incomplete hoop marks; resin clear and sticky when fresh. Branchlets robust, in flower 4- 5.5 mm diam. at 2 cm from apex, in fruit 3.8-6 mm diam. with sparse to scattered hairs to 0.1 mm long, conspicuously lenticellate. Leaves 3-5-jugate, (20.2) 26.5-40.5 (50) cm long; petiole longer than interjuga, (4.2) 5.4-11 (13) cm x 2.2-3.7 (6) mm, with scattered to sparse appressed hairs to 0.1 mm long or rarely glabrous; interjuga (1.8) 2.2-4.5 (5.2) cm long; petiolules long and slender, 0.5-1.2 (1.7) cm long, terminal petiolule shorter than interjuga, 0.5-1.1 (1.5) cm long; leaflets coriaceous, dull, lateral ones acute-oblong to (narrowly) elliptic, base oblique, proximal side acute, distal side obtuse, basal pair (7.2) 9-14.5 (17.5) x (2.3) 3.6-5.6 cm, ultimate pair larger, 10-19 (21) x 3.2-5.2 (7) cm, terminal leaflet elliptic to oblanceolate, (9.3) 10-17.2 (21) x (2.8) 4- 5.5 (7.5) cm, base acute to obtuse, all with apex abruptly acuminate, acumen usually long and narrow, 0.5-1.1 (1.8) cm long, drying pale green, abaxial surface with scattered appressed hairs to 0.1 mm long along mid-vein and secondary vein, sometimes over all of surface, midvein acutely prominent, secondary veins obtusely prominent, rest of veins prominulous to flat, adaxial surface glabrous, midvein narrowly obtusely prominent or prominulous, remaining veins flat. Panicles subterminal, initiating a new flush of growth, relatively short and robust, (3.5) 5-9.5 (15) cm x 1.1-2.4 mm (in fruit 2.2- 3.5 (4.5) mm diam.); secondary axes short and robust, 0.4-5 (5.8) cm long (to 8 cm long in fruit); tertiary branches congested,  usually reduced to simple cymules, all axes with scattered to sparse appressed hairs to 0.1 mm long; inflorescence bracts ovate, acute, those on primary axes 0.3-0.8 (1.2) mm long, those on secondary axes 0.2-0.6 (0.8) mm long; pedicel relatively short, subcylindric to slightly clavate, with sparse to scattered appressed hairs to 0.1 mm long, in staminate flowers 0.5-1.2 x 0.35-0.5 mm, in pistillate flowers longer and stouter, 0.9-1.5 x 0.4-0.6 mm. Flowers 4-merous, (2) 2.5-3.2 (4) mm long overall; calyx shal- lowly cupuliform, exceeded by disk in both sexes, (0.6) 0.9-1.2 x (2) 2.2-2.5 mm over- all, with hairs as on pedicel, lobes short, rounded depressed-deltate, 0.2-0.4 mm long; petals pale green to yellowish-green, ovate, somewhat fleshy, 3-3.3 (4.1) x 1.6- 2 (2.2) mm, at anthesis slightly inflexed or reflexed, apex acute with conspicuously thickened and strongly inflexed apiculum 0.25-0.4 mm long, abaxial surface with sparse to scattered appressed hairs to 0.1 mm long, adaxial surface short-papillate, also with scattered appressed to ascending hairs 0.1-0.25 mm long, distributed along three discrete vertical lines, apex and margin usually short-papillate; in staminate flowers antepetalous stamens 1.7-1.95 mm long and antesepalous ones 1.85-2.05 mm long, filaments slender, 1.05-1.3 and 1.2- 1.4 mm long, anthers orange, the dorsiventral view narrowly obtuse-oblong (after dehiscence broadly obtuse-oblong) with lobulate base, the lateral view obtuse-oblong, 0.6-0.7 mm long; disk relatively deep and broad, 0.35-0.5 mm high x 0.3-0.5 mm thick; pistillode greatly exceeding disk, 0.6- 0.8 x 0.6-0.7 mm overall, ovoid to de- pressed-ovoid, with dense appressed hairs 0.1-0.2 mm long, provided with locules and reduced ovules, gradually contracted into a thick stylode 0.1-0.25 mm long, flared and 4-lobulate distally, each lobule with a vertical sulcus, lobules erect or divergent; in pistillate flowers staminodes almost reaching stigmas, 1.65-1.85 and 1.75-2.05 mm long, filaments somewhat fleshy, 0.9-1.1 and 1-1.25 mm long, antesepalous filaments broadened at base, rudimentary anthers large, the dorsiventral view broadly obtuse- oblong with base slightly broadened and lobulate, the lateral view acute-oblong, 0.7- 0.85 mm long; disk relatively deep and broad, 0.4-0.5 (0.6) mm high x (0.3) 0.35- 0.5 mm thick; pistil 1.6-2. 1 x 1. 1-1.25 (1.4) mm overall, ovary sessile, ovoid, with dense appressed hairs to 0.15 mm long (often scattered on style as well), gradually contracted to a thick style 0.25-0.4 x 0.4-0.5 mm, stigmas lateral, sessile, slightly compressed- globose, stigmatal area 0.3-0.35 mm high. Fruiting pedicel terete, 1.5-2.8 (3) x (1.8) 2-2.6 (2.8) mm, fruit with substipitate ova- ry, green or sometimes gray, obliquely ovoid, gibbous, large, 2.2-2.9 x (1.6) 1.8-2 mm (to 2.5 mm wide when more than 1 pyrene), sharply acute, glabrous, drying smooth or fruits sometimes lenticellate and rough-textured; pyrene thickly cartilaginous, ca 2 x 1.7 cm (Daly et al. 4069), the dorsiventral view orbicular with truncate base, apex abruptly broad-acuminate, apex acute, the lateral view on dorsal side broadly obovoid with obtuse base and apex, on ventral side elliptic with acute base and apex with a lateral subapical depression, embryo unknown.

description: Shrub, 0.6-2.5 m tall; stems glabrous. Leaves membranaceous, obovate, 10-22 x 2.5-7 cm; base attenuate; margin serrate; apex acuminate; principal nerve prominent below, with 8-12 unpaired, arcuate lateral nerves on each side and fine intersecondaries and subparallel tertiaries perpendicular to the secondaries; petiole 3-4 mm long. Inflorescence terminal, spiciform, rarely 1- 2-branched, straight; axis pilose and pedicels pilose, the latter 6-7 mm long. Flowers: sepals 5, free, coriaceous, ovate, 9 x 2.5-3 mm; petals 5, membranous, obovate, 11 x 5 mm; stamens 10, sessile, 8 mm long; carpels 5; style 6 mm long. Fruiting carpels 1-2, oblong, 8 x 7 mm; carpophore plane, 5 x 7 mm.

description: Herba terrestris saxicola vel epiphytica; caules glabri virides repentes e nodis radicantes; nodi nonnulli tuber pedicellatum ferentes; folia peltata alterna, petiolo 10-100 mm longo laminae mediae affixo, limbo in vivo carnoso in sicco membranaceo pellucido, late elliptico vel orbiculari, 1-4.5 X 1-3.5 cm, minute glanduloso- punctato, adaxialiter pilis erectis multicellularibus praedito; venae primariae 6-8. Amenta axillaria, laxiflora, 4-6 cm X 1.5 mm, pedunculo glabro 1.5-1.7 cm longo suffulta; bracteae rotundatae 0.4 mm diametris, glabrae, peltatae; flores diandri; pistillum 1, ovario globoso; fructus maturi ignoti. A Peperomia transparente Miquel et P. hydrocotyloide Miquel caule repente, foliis peltatis, petiolo laminae pilis erectis adaxialiter obsitae in centro affixo, amentisque breviter pedunculatis differt.
bibliographicCitation: Görts-van Rijn, Anne R. A. 1998. Peperomia gracieana (Piperaceae), a new species from French Guiana. Brittonia. 50: 56-58.

description: Terrestrial, epilithic, or epiphytic herb; creeping and rooting at the nodes (Fig. 1). Stems whitish green, slender, <1 mm thick when dried, glabrous. Some nodes bearing small tubers, 1-1.5 mm diam. on slender stalks. Leaves alternate, peltate with the petiole attached in the center; petioles pale green, 10-100 mm long, ca. 1 mm thick when dry, glabrous; blades thick and fleshy when fresh, thinly membranous and almost transparent when dried, dark green above, pale green beneath, widely elliptic to circular, 1-4.5 X 1-3.5 cm, pilose with multicellular, erect trichomes above (Fig. 1), glabrous beneath, minutely glandular-dotted; primary veins 6-8, prominulous, the lesser veins reticulate, inconspicuous in dried state. Spikes axillary, simple, green, 4-6 cm long, 1.5 mm thick; peduncles green, slender, 1.5-1.7 cm long, glabrous. Flowers laxly distributed; floral bracts peltate, circular, ca. 0.4 mm diam., glabrous; stamens 2, anthers 0.3 X 0.2 mm; pistil 1, style absent. Young fruits green, globose, ca. 0.3 mm diam., flat at apex; mature fruits not yet collected.

description: Arbuscula parva subglabra; foliis oblongo-ellipticis sublanceolatisve, apice abrupte acuminatis, basi inaequilateraliter rotundatis, latere altero quam cetero breviori supra glabris subtus in venis minute puberulis a tertio supero deorsum pinnatim venosis, nerviis utrinque 5 vel 6 sub margine laqueatis, petiolo glabro ad laminam vaginato-alato; drupa plus minusve e latere compressa apice rotundata, stigmatibus lanceolatis sessilibus.

description: A small, essentially glabrous tree, 1.75 m tall. Leaves "thick, pale beneath," oblong-elliptic or sublanceolate, the apex abruptly short-acuminate, the base rounded, inequilateral, one side gradually rounded, 3-5 mm shorter and abruptly acute at the petiole, the longer side abruptly rounded, obtuse, 7.5-9.5 cm wide and 20-24 cm long, pinnately nerved to the upper third, the nerves mostly 5 or 6 on each side, with cross-connecting-anastomosing nervules, the areoles comparatively large, submarginally loop-connected, glabrous above, the smaller nervules beneath minutely puberulent, drying firm, opaque, the lower surface light brown, the petiole 2.5-4.5 cm long, glabrous, vaginate and narrowly winged to the blade. Spikes 5 mm thick and 7 cm long, the peduncle slender, glabrous, 1.8 cm long, the bracts triangular-subpeltate, fringed, the drupe  obovoid, round, or somewhat flattened laterally, the apex rounded, rather loose when mature, the stigmas lanceolate, sessile.

description: Rhizomes erect, densely scaly, the scales 10-15 X 0.3-1 mm, lanceolate, brown or stramineous, the margins with bifid teeth and 1-4 rows of black sclerotic cells. Leaves 40-110 cm, slightly dimorphous, fertile leaves longer and often narrower than sterile ones, the adult and juvenile leaves entire to sinuate toward the base, nearly sessile or petiolate up to 2.5 cm. Petioles (when present) scaly, the scales 7-14 X 0.2 mm, widely ovate, stramineous to brown, with bifid teeth and 1-4 rows of castaneous to blackened marginal cells. Laminae 35-80 X 7-16 cm, narrowly elliptic to oblanceolate, sometimes shallowly lobed toward the base, olive-green when fresh on the adaxial side, dull green on the abaxial side, the base attenuate, decurrent, the apex acute to acuminate; costae without adaxial wings, scaly abaxially, the scales 6-10 X 2 mm, ovate-lanceolate, the margins slightly darkened and with bifid teeth; veins copiously anastomosing between the costae to margins, costules slightly conspicuous, at least 30 pairs, costal areoles narrow, nearly perpendicular (not parallel) to the costae; abaxial surfaces of the laminae between veins with tawny to ferruginous or hyaline amorphous hairs. Sori 0.8-3.2 cm. Sporangia with 13-16 annular cells. Spores (31-) 35-59(-74) X (20-)25-39(-43) µm.

description: Rhizomes erect, densely scaly, the scales to 12 X 2 mm, ovate-lanceolate, brown, the margins blackish, with 2 rows of sclerotic cells and black bifid teeth. Leaves 40-100 cm, 1-pinnate (the juveniles only pinnati- fid). Petioles 21-47 X 0.6-1 cm, sparsely scaly, the scales to 0.5 X 0.2 cm, the margins with 1-4 rows of blackish sclerotic cells and bifid teeth. Laminae 21-46 X 15- 30 cm, coriaceous, ovate-lanceolate, dark brown when dry, tapering gradually to a pinnatifid apex with 3 or 4 pairs of entire segments separated by rounded sinuses. Ra- chises straight (not flexuous), scaly, the scales 1-2 X 0.2-0.5 mm, linear-lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate. Free proximal pinnae 2-3 pairs, 7-14 X 2-5 cm, subequilateral, opposite to subopposite, oblong, patent, base truncate to slightly reduced, petiolules 1-2 cm, apices acute to acuminate, margins entire, the bases stalked, the stalk 1-2 cm, with a low, adaxial wing; costae not winged adaxially, scaly abaxially, the scales 0.5-1 X 0.2 mm. description: Rhizomes erect, decumbent, scaly, the scales 1 X 0.1-0.2 cm, linear-lanceolate, brown, the margins with bifid teeth and 2 rows of blackened sclerotic cells. description: Rhizomes erect or decumbent, densely scaly, the scales 10-21 X 1-2 mm, lanceolate, brown, the margins with bifid teeth and 1-3 rows of black sclerotic cells. Rachises sometimes flexuous, scaly abaxially, the scales 1-6 X 1-2 mm, like those of the rhizome. description: Rhizomes erect to decumbent, densely scaly, the scales 1.5-2.5 X 0.15-0.25 cm, linear-lanceolate, brown, acuminate, the margins blackish or castaneous with bifid teeth and 2 rows of sclerotic cells. description: Rhizomes and petioles unknown. Laminae 1-pinnate, papyraceous when dry, shiny on the adaxial side, the apex gradually tapering, pinnatifid, consisting of about 7 pairs of entire segments separated by acute sinuses. description: Rhizomes decumbent, scales 0.6-1 X 0.1-0.3 cm, linear-lanceolate, brown, concolorous, or bicolorous with brown margins and 1 or 2 rows of sclerotic cells, with bifid teeth. Leaves 1.3-1.5 m, 1-pinnate, the juvenile leaves not seen. Petioles 59-67 cm, scaly, the scales to 0.5 X 0.05 cm, irregu- lary toothed with 1 row of sclerotic cells. Rachises straight, scaly, the scales 5-7 x 0.3-1 mm, linear-lanceolate, brown, concolorous, with bifid marginal teeth. Free pinnae 4-7 pairs, 20-33 X 4.8-11 cm, inequilateral, the basiscopic side more developed than the acroscopic (especially in the basal and proximal pinnae), sessile to slightly petiolulate, the petiolules to 2 mm, the apices acuminate, the margins entire or sometimes lobed on the basal pinnae; costae scaly, the scales to 4 X 0.2 mm, like those of the rachis. description: Rhizomes erect, sparsely scaly, the scales to 10 X 0.5 mm, linear-lanceolate, stramineous to castaneous, the margin with bifid teeth and 2 rows of sclerotic cells. Petioles 17-66 X 0.8-1.5 cm, scaly, the scales to 0.05 cm wide, ferruginous, stellate, these mixed with a few, scattered, stramineous, castaneous, ovate scales 3-10 X 0.3-0.5 mm, the margin with 1 row of sclerotic cells. Laminae 20-150 X 25-30 cm, oblong-deltate, the apices tapering gradually and consisting of 3-7 pairs of entire segments separated by acute sinuses, brown when dry. Rachises straight (not flexuous), sparsely scaly abaxially, the scales 2-5 cm wide, ferruginous. Free pinnae 3-4 pairs, 1 adnate distal pair, 13-35 X 4.7-10.5 cm, the basal pair inequilateral at base, the rest subequilateral, alternate, oblong-lanceolate, lanceolate, the proximal pair shallowly, broadly lobed on the basis copic side, distant, ascending, sessile, to slightly petiolulate, the apices acute or acuminate, margins entire; costae without wings adaxially, sparsely scaly, the scales 5-7 X 0.2-0.5 mm, linear-lanceolate, the body of the scale delicate, the margins ferruginous with bifid teeth, these mixed with stellate scales; the adaxial surface glabrous or rarely with stellate scales. description: Rhizomes erect to decumbent, densely scaly, the scales 10-17 x 1-2 mm, lance- olate, brown, the margin blackish with bifid teeth, with 2 or 3 rows of sclerotic cells. Petioles 28-96 X 0.5-2.2 cm, scaly, the scales 1-1.6 X 1.5-2 mm, with 1-4 rows of blackened sclerotic cells and bifid teeth. description: Rhizomes erect or decumbent, sparsely scaly, the scales to 15 X 1 mm, ovate to lanceolate, dull brown, the margins some- times with castaneous to blackish bifid teeth and up to 3 rows of sclerotic cells. description: Rhizomes erect, decumbent, scaly, the scales 9-15 X 1.5-2 mm, ovate-lanceolate, light brown, acuminate, the margin brown to blackish with bifid teeth and 2 or 3 rows of sclerotic cells. description: Rhizomes erect, short, densely scaly, the scales to 10 X 7 mm, linear-lanceolate, the margins dark brown to blackish with bifid teeth and with 2 rows of blackened, sclerotic cells. Leaves 1-2 m, 1-pinnate, the juvenile ones only entire or lobed at the base. Petioles 47-115 x 1.5-2 cm, densely scaly, the scales 7-10 x 1-1.5 mm, linear-lanceolate, the margins with bifid teeth and 1 row of dark brown sclerotic cells, the apices filiform. Laminae 48-150 x 37-60 cm, subcoriaceous, ovate-lanceolate, tapering gradually to a pinnatifid apex consisting of 6 or 7 pairs of entire segments separated by rounded sinuses, the segments sometimes overlapping, the lamina dark green adaxially when fresh, light green abaxially. description: Árboles 3-6m, raramente arbustos, andromonoicos. Hojas 2-folioladas, foliolos divaricados a paralelos entre sí; lámina (2-) 4-9(-12.5) x (1-) 1.5-3.5(-4) cm, lanceolada, ligeramente falcada, carticea a subcoriácea, 3-nervada (raramente 4-nervada), glabra, adaxialmente lustrosa, glabra, abaxialmente opaca, base cordada, ápice acuminado, margen sinuado; estipulas 0.8-1.5x 1-1.8mm, ovado-lanceoladas, densamente estrigulosas, no ferrugineas; peciolos (0.7-) 1.5-4(-4.5) cm de largo, glabrescentes a escasamente pilosos. Flores 1-10, subterminales y axilares; bracteas 1.0-1.6 x 0.7-0.8 mm, lanceoladas, densamente estrigulosas, no ferrugineas; bractéolas 2-2.5 x 0.4-0.6 mm, lanceoladas, densamente estrigulosas, no ferrugineas; pedicelos (2-)4-10 mm de largo, estrigulosos. Flores hermafroditas; hipantio estriguloso; cailiz 1.3-3 x 0.5-1 cm, escasamente estriguloso, 1óbulos 0.5-1 cm de largo; pétalos 2.5-4 (- 4.5) cm de largo, limina 1-2.5 x 0.4-1.5 cm, ovada a elfptica, rosa a violeta, glabra, ufia 1.4-2.2 cm de largo, tomentosa; estambre fértil 1, 2-2.6 cm de largo, antera 5-8 x 2.3-3 mm, eliptica a oblonga, escasamente estrigulosa; nectario ca. 4 x ca. 1.7 mm, densamente estriguloso; estaminodios 9, 4-10 mm de largo, connatos desde la base hasta 1/3 de su longitud, estrigulosos; gineceo 2-3 cm de largo, esparcidamente piloso, ovario con tricomas gruesos, estigma 0.6-0.8(-1) mm de diam.; flores masculinas similares. Legumbre (3-)7.5-16 x 1.5-2 cm, estrechamente oblonga, pardo-verdosa, esparcidamente pilosa a glabra, estipite 1-1.7 cm de largo, rostro 3-7 mm de largo; semillas 7-10 x 3-7 mm, oblongas.

description: Huberia laurincae affinis, praesertim indumento insuper glanduloso-villoso, foilis membranaceis apice saepe acuminatis attenuatisve, necnon nervis secundariis magis numerosis, pedicellisque ac fructibus minoribus diversa.

description: Tree, 4-8 m tall, the indumentum glandular- furfuraceous, the vegetative shoots and their adjacent axillary regions, petioles and adaxial surface of the foliar blades when young also sparsely glandular-villous. Trunk 2.5-5 m, 3-10 cm diam., terete, straight, the bark smooth or rough. Branches quadrangular to subquadrangular, slightly sulcate when young. Petioles 0.8-2 cm long. Leaf blades 4.5-14.6 X 1.8-4.2 cm, membranaceous, usually oblong or narrowly elliptic, sometimes obovate or ovate, the base acute to obtuse, sometimes subrounded, the apex frequently acuminate or attenuate-acuminate, sometimes acute, rarely obtuse to rounded, the margin entire or basally entire and distally sparsely crenulate to denticulate; 3-nerved, the lateral veins arising from the base where they usually join to the margin, the marginal secondary veins inconspicuous, the central secondary veins 16-24, slightly oblique-ascendant, conspicuous on the abaxial surface. Inflorescences terminal, corymbose or umbelliform cymoids, 3.6-7 cm, sessile, with (9-)15-37 flowers, the branches 4, 6, or 8, frequently as triads or sometimes an umbelliform cymes with 7 or 8 flowers, rarely pedunculate monads, distal node usually a triad, sometimes an umbelliform cyme with 7-9 flowers, rarely a monad; bracts petiolate to sessile, foliaceous or not, membranaceous to thickened, the petiole 2-6 mm or absent, the blade 1-22 X 0.1-6 mm, narrowly elliptic to ovate or linear to linear-subulate, sometimes slightly concave, the apex acuminate to acute, the margin entire; prophylls 1-2, 0.4-0.8 X 0.1-0.2 mm, thickened, linear to narrowly triangular, acute. Flowers 4-merous; pedicel 7-11.5 mm long, terete; hypanthium 6-8 X 2-2.3 mm, inconspicuously 8-angled; calyx lobes usually of equal size, 3.8-5.2 X 1.1-1.6 mm, narrowly triangular-subulate, ribbed on the abaxial surface, the base laminar, rigidly membranaceous, the apex oblong, laterally flattened to subterete, thickened, rounded; petals 15-23 X 6.5-11.5 mm, white, asymmetric, narrowly obovate, the base subunguiculate, the apex rounded-acuminate; stamens unequal in size, yellow, the filaments 5.8-9.5 mm, the anthers oblong-subulate, the thecae 7.5-9.5 mm, conspicuously undulate, bilocular at the base and pseudo-bilocular to unilocular at the apex, the tube unilocular 0.8-1.7 mm, the connective appendage 2.5-4 mm, zigzag shaped, the apex sinuous; ovary median, ca. 4 X 1.6 mm, 2/3-3/4-free, 4-locular, the ovules 1.3-1.5 mm; style 20-24 mm, subterete, the stigma punctiform. Fruit a ruptidium, 21-26 X 5-6.5 mm, (3-)4-valved, inconspicuously 8-angled at apex, the pedicel 9.5-12 mm; seeds (35-)50-75, 3.1-6.2 X 0.8-1.8 mm, winged, flat to concave or sometimes navicular, elliptic to narrowly obovate or sometimes linear or narrowly ovate; embryo 1.3-2.1 mm.

description: Shrub or tree, 0.7-12 m high, the indumentum glandular-furfuraceous; trunk straight, the bark thick and suberose. Branches quadrangular to subquadrangular, brownish to grayish, young branches flattened to quadrangular, brown, sometimes longitudinally striate. Petioles 0.8-2.5 cm. Leaf blades 3.5-10.4(-11.4) X 1.5-4.8 cm, subchartaceous or chartaceous, sometimes membranaceous, obovate to elliptic or sometimes oblong or slightly ovate, the base acute to obtuse, apex rounded, rounded-apiculate or obtuse, sometimes acute or acuminate, rarely emarginate, the margin entire, sometimes crenulate to slightly undulate, thickened, both surfaces glabrescent or not; 3-nerved, the lateral veins arising from the base where they join to the margin or not, the marginal secondary veins inconspicuous, the central secondary veins 7-14, transverse to obliquely ascendant, tenuous, prominulous on the abaxial surface, sometimes inconspicuous, straight or forming a brochidodrome pattern at the apical and basal regions of the blade. Inflorescences terminal, cymoids, corymbose or not, 3-7 cm, usually sessile, sometimes pedunculate, with (7-)11-50 flowers, the branches (2, 4)6, 8, or 10(11), as corymbose cymoids with 9-10 flowers, an umbelliform cymes with 5-7 flowers, or as triads and/or sessile monads, distal node usually a triad, sometimes an umbelliform cyme with 9 flowers, rarely a diad; bracts petiolate to sessile, foliaceous or not, membranaceous to thickened, the petiole 1.5-11 mm or absent, the blade 0.4-27 X 0.1-15 mm, obovate, narrowly elliptic or obovate or linear to triangular, sometimes broadly elliptic, the apex obtuse to rounded or sometimes acute, the margin entire, the adaxial surface sometimes slightly concave; prophylls 1-2, 0.2-0.5 X 0.08-0.15 mm, thickened, linear-triangular, obtuse to rounded. Flowers 4-merous; pedicel 6.5-24 mm, subterete to terete; hypanthium 4-8.5 x 1.8-2.5 mm, slightly 8-angled; calyx lobes (0.4-)0.6-1.7 X 0.3-0.8 mm, oblong, gibbous and thickened, the apex subterete, rounded; petals 12-25 X 4-12.3 mm, white, symmetric or asymmetric, obovate, oblong or narrowly obovate or elliptic, the base sometimes thickened and subunguiculate, the apex usually acuminate to acute, sometimes obtuse or subrounded; stamens of two sizes, yellow, the antepetalous ones longer than the antesepalous ones, the filaments of the longer 7.2-10 mm, of the shorter 6-9.1 mm, the anthers narrowly triangular, the thecae of the longer 6.2-10.5 mm, of the shorter 5.2-9.2 mm, conspicuously undulate or sometimes undulate at the base and slightly undulate to the apex, bilocular at the base and pseudo-bilocular to unilocular at the apex, tube unilocular 0.3-2.5 mm, the connective appendage of the longer 1.3-4.7 mm and of the shorter 1.4-4.1 mm, straight or slightly sinuous to the apex; ovary median, 3.8-5 X 2.2-2.3 mm, 2/3-4/5-free, 4-locular, ovules 0.5-1.3 mm; style 14-26 mm long, subterete, spirally twisted at the apex, the stigma punctiform. Fruit a ruptidium 21.5-36 x 3.8-8 mm, (3-)4-valved, slightly 8-angled, the pedicel 12-23 mm; seeds 106-323, 2.4-6.3 X 0.3-1.1 mm, winged, flat to concave, sometimes navicular, linear, narrowly obovate or elliptic, sometimes ovate; embryo 1-1.3 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Baumgratz, José F. A. 2000. Two new species of Huberia (Melastomataceae: Merianieae) from Brazil. Brittonia. 52 (1): 24-33.

description: Herba scandens, radice incrassata. Folia forma variabilia, 5-7-partita vel grosse 5-angulata, utrinque puberula, supra scabrescentia. Flores monoici, masculini femineique in inflorescentias diversas in eadem axilla dispositi; inflorescentia masculina racemosa vel paniculata pauciramosa, corolla 4-5(rarius 6)-partita, marsupiis binis nectariferis ad basim cujusque lobi pulvino albo elevato pentagono tectis; antherae in capitulum globosum connatae; inflorescentia feminea pedunculata, floribus 3-5-umbellatis; ovarium nudum. Fructus obovoideus, anguste 5-9-sulcatus; mesocarpium fibrosum; semen unicum.
