description: Plants 1-8 dm high; leaves pinnately decompound, usually 3 divisions at a node on the rachis; petioles hyaline-bordered, 1-1.5 cm long; peduncles 2.0-9.5 cm long; involuere conspicuous, usually 3-cleft; involueel inconspicuous, entire; primary rays 5-21, 1-3.5 cm long; petals white, rarely pink; anthers purplish; styles short, 0.2-0.5 mm long, equaling the stylopodium; fruit suborbicular, the dorsal ribs filiform and acute, the lateral ribs inconspicuous; oil tubes brown or dull black; corky band prominent. Pollen grains 17.0-22.0 µ long; 10.2-13.6 µ wide. Chromosome number: n= 7. Florida to eastern Texas, north to Kansas, Missouri, and Kentucky, northward along the Atlantic coast to Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts. June to October.

description: Stems at maturity becoming generally woody; internodes 10-45 mm long (mean 26 mm), 1-3 mm wide (mean 2.2 mm); young branches often densely pubeseent, the older branches subglabrous; leaves lanceolate to falcate, 37-90 mm long (mean 65 mm), 12-35 mm wide (mean 21.6 mm); apex acute-attenuate; base usually acute; veins usually 5, often quite conspicuous on the lower surface; blades generally moderately pubescent, and sometimes velvety to the touch; petioles 5-10 mm long, 1-2 mm wide, generally densely pubeseent; inflorescences moderately pubescent, especially the bracts; anthesis approximately from December through February; staminate inflorescence with 2-5 segments (mean 3.1); individual segments with 18-32 flowers (mean 24.7) ; pistillate inflorescence with 2-4 segments (mean 2.6); individual segments with 12-26 flowers (mean 18.0); fruit white, 4 mm in diameter, glabrous; n = 14.

description: A moderate-sized succulent herb. Stem 2-3 mm thick at the base when dry, decumbent and rooting at the lower nodes, branching from the base, thinly puberulent, the hairs upwardly curved, the internodes 1-3 cm long above to 6-9 cm near the base, drying somewhat glossy and yellowish. Leaves commonly opposite above, ternate below, elliptic, the apex narrowly long-acuminate, the tip bluntly rounded, the base cuneate, 1.5-2.2 cm wide and 5.5-7 cm long, thinly hirtellous above, at least along the midrib, glabrous beneath, the tip sparsely bristly hirtellous, palmately 3- or 5-nerved, if 5-nerved the outermost pair of lateral nerves very slender and inconspicuous, the midrib conspicuous, with numerous slender cross-connecting-anastomosing nervules and small areoles as viewed by transmitted light, drying rather firm, the margin revolute, the petiole 3-5 mm long, moderately hirtellous on the flattened upper side. Spikes terminal and axillary, 1-2 mm thick and 12-14 cm long, the peduncle scarcely 1 cm long, thinly hirtellous, the bracts ovate, pointed, peltate, the drupe about 0.9 mm long, globose, with curved, strongly subulate, style-like beak, the stigma apical.

description: Lianoid shrub, climbing to at least 9 m; stem terete to subterete, the bark tan to reddish brown when dry; twigs subterete, bluntly angled, somewhat striate, glabrous, reddish brown when dry. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic to lance-elliptic, (15-)19-27 X (4-)7-14 cm, basally cuneate then usually long-attenuate and shortly decurrent onto petiole, to rounded, apically narrowing and very short-acuminate, glabrous on both surfaces but with scattered, minute (ca. 0.1 mm long), reddish, glandular fimbriae beneath, 3(-5)-plinerved with the inner pair of lateral nerves arising from (1.5-)2-3 cm above the base, the midrib conspicuously thickened and raised in the proximal 2-2.5 cm above then becoming progressively thinner and plane distally, conspicuously raised beneath, lateral nerves slightly raised proximally above becoming weakly impressed distally, raised beneath, reticulate veinlets plane to weakly impressed above and slightly raised beneath; petiole subterete, strongly rugose, (6-)9-15 mm long, slightly winged distally due to decurrent leaf blade, glabrous. Inflorescences cauliflorous or arising in the axils of old leaf nodes, solitary or several in pin cushion-like growths, short-racemose, 4-11-flowered; rachis subterete, sharply to bluntly angled, 0.5-0.9 cm long, moderately densely glandular-fimbriate, otherwise glabrous; floral bract apparently continuous with rachis (not articulate), persistent, strongly spreading to reflexed, ovate to elliptic-ovate, 1.3-2.5 mm long, marginally glandular-fimbriate, otherwise glabrous; pedicel thin, striate, 19-21 mm long, glabrous; bracteoles 2, nearly basal, ovate-lanceolate, short-acu- minate, ca. 0.8-2 mm long, marginally glandular-fimbriate, otherwise glabrous. Flower with calyx articulate with pedicel, ca. 2-4.5 mm long, sometimes seemingly slightly stipitate, glabrous; hypanthium cy- lindric to bluntly pentagonal, ca. 1-2.5 mm long, basally apophysate when dry, rugose; limb rotate-campanulate, often spreading and reflexed, ca. 1-2 mm long; lobes apic- ulate, to ca. 0.5 mm long; sinuses broadly rounded; corolla carnose, essentially tubular but bluntly pentagonal and conspicuously swollen in basal 1/4-1/5 (especially notice- able when fresh), 21-36 mm long and ca. 13-15 mm diam. at base becoming ca. 2-4 mm diam. at throat (when dry sometimes shrinking and only 21-23 mm long and ca. 5-7 mm diam. at base becoming ca. 1.8-2 mm diam. at throat), glabrous or sparsely short-puberulent in distal half, also bearing few, scattered glandular fimbriae distally, red at base but becoming green at limb and lobes, the lobes themselves erect, ovate, acute, 1.5-3 mm long when dry; stamens alternately ca. 8-9 mm and 9-10 mm long; filaments equal, connate into a tube ca. 3- 4.5 mm long, glabrous below but ciliate distally, also dorsal surface of tube glandular- fimbriate; anthers alternately ca. 4.8-6 mm and 5.5-7 mm long, the thecae and tubules nearly indistinguishable and about equal; tubules distally acuminate, alternately somewhat ornate; style equalling corolla, sometimes extrorse while in bud. Berry not seen.

description: Vine. Laminas of the larger leaves 4.5- 5.2 X 1.7-2.5 cm, narrowly ovate to elliptical, apex acuminate to briefly caudate, base cordate or shallowly so, adaxially sparsely velutinous to glabrate, abaxially velutinous, the hairs V-shaped, sessile or subsessile, the arms unequal, 0.2-0.6 mm long, with 2 impressed glands near the base and 2 additional glands distally just below the apex; petiole 0.4-0.5 cm long, tomen- tose, eglandular; stipules 1.5-1.6 mm long, linear, interpetiolar. Inflorescence unit a congested pseudoraceme of 12-16 flowers, the pseudoracemes aggregated in a simple or compound terminal thyrse. Peduncles 3-4 mm long, 0.3-0.4 X as long as pedicels, appressed-tomentose; pedicels 8.5-11.3 mm long, appressed-tomentose. Bracts 1-1.3 X 0.3-0.4 mm, narrowly ovate or elliptical with scarious margins, eglandular. Bracteoles equal, 0.7-1 X ca. 0.4 mm, narrowly ovate or elliptical with scarious margins, eglandular, the pair subopposite, inserted at or near the base of the peduncle. Calyx of 4 biglandular lateral sepals and 1 eglandular anterior sepal; lateral sepals exceeding the glands by ca. 1 mm, the glands ca. 2 mm long, decurrent. Petals 5, yellow, glabrous, the limb orbicular, abaxially slightly carinate, the margin erose, eglandular; lateral petals: claw 2 X 0.5 mm, limb ca. 4.5 X ca. 4.5 mm; posterior petal: claw 1.5 X 0.6 mm, limb ca. 4.3 X ca. 4.3 mm. Androecium of 10 subequal stamens; filaments 1.8-2.2 mm long, the anterior one the longest, the posterior one the shortest and ca. 1.5 X as wide as the rest, connate at base; anthers 1.6-1.8 mm long, glabrous. Ovary tomentose-sericeous; styles erect or slightly divergent, anterior style ca. 2 X 0.3 mm, the apex dorsally rounded or acute, posterior styles 2.5-2.6 X 0.5 mm, the apex dorsally acute. Samara unknown.

description: A suffrutescent perennial herb to 1 m tall with fine decumbent to erect branches densely hirtellous with erect or somewhat curved, flattened, unicellular white hairs about 0.5 mm long, from the base well into the inflorescence. The lower leaves are oblanceolate, the principal leaves elliptical with the apices obtuse to broadly acute, the margins entire to remotely or moderately serrate, sometimes strongly toothed apleally ill the basal leaves, somewhat as in P. schaffneri; the veins, margins, and laminae are strongly to sparingly hirtellous like the stem. Axillary fascicles are frequently present but rarely strongly developed. Peduncles are erect or ascendant, 2-4 cm long, with very small lanceolate bracteoles, the longest pedicels shorter than the peduncles, both moderately to strongly glandular-pubescent. The sepals are elliptic to lanceolate, aeute, entire or with a few teeth, the lower margins narrowly searious, rather strongly glandular-pubescent, 8 mm long by 2-3 mm broad. The corolla is abruptly inflated above a tube about the length of the calyx to a broad ventricose throat and bilabiate limb of spreading rounded lobes, glandular without and somewhat shaggy-villose on the lower lip within; the total length 30-35 mm, the width (pressed) 12-18 mm. The lips are deep reddish purple, 2.5RP 3/8, in the Munsell system, the throat outside the same color or lighter, to strong violet, 10PB 3-4/10, the throat inside a uniform light violet, 10PB 6/8, without guidelines. The stanmens are included, the sacs divaricate, naviculate, with a prominent median ridge, to 3 mm long. The staminode is dilated and truncated distally, and is sparingly yellowish-villose. The capsule is narrowly ovoid-acuminate, 12-15 mm high, 6 mm broad, glabrous, with black, angular seeds 1.5-2 mm long.

description: Woody vine to 5 m long, not producing milky sap. Stems obscurely aculeate at base, acutely 5-costate, setulose, the setae yellowish; cross section of stems with xylem radially divided into 5 subequal parts. Axillary buds covered with overlapping, minute (ca. 2.5 mm long) scales or perules. Stipules oblong, ca. 2 mm long, early deciduous. Leaves biternate, subsessile; rachises broadly winged, yellowish setulose on margins and along veins, primary rachis 1.8-3 cm long, lateral rachis 3-4 mm long; petiole not winged, 2-5 mm long; leaflets chartaceous, glabrous, sessile, the venation brochidodromous, the apex acuminate and mucronate, the margins remotely glandularserrate, with scattered, minute glandular hairs, terminal leaflet ovate-lanceolate, 3.4-10 X 1.4-4 cm, attenuate at base, lateral leaflet 2.4-6.3 X 0.9-2.6 cm, oblong-elliptic, asymmetrical (obtuse-acute) at base, lateral basal leaflet 1-1.8 X 0.8-1.5 cm, ovate. Inflorescence axillary, simple or compound; axes 4-angled, with glandular and simple pubescence, glabrescent; rachis obtusely angled, furrowed, glandular-pubescent; bracts 2-2.5 mm long, subulate, glandular-pubescent; bracteoles similar to the bracts but smaller; cincinni alternate or verticillate, 3-9 mm long, glandular-pubescent, 4-flowered. Sepals and disc glands persistent at the base of fruit; sepals 5, oblong, the external ca. 2.5 mm long, the internal ca. 3.2 mm long; disc glands 4, the central ones ovate, the lateral ones circular, smaller. Mericarps oblong, 2.7-3 cm long, with prominent reticulate venation, the apex obtuse-rounded, margins undulate, continuous from apex to base, coccus lentil-shaped, 7-8 X 5-6 mm, not reaching the margin, minutely pubescent, partitioning wall with elliptic outline, 4-5 mm wide; endocarp glabrous. Seeds hemicircular, ca. 4.5 mm wide, laterally subcompressed, dark brown, attached to base of locule, hilum semicircular; external cotyledon curved, internal cotyledon biplicate.

description: Woody vine, glabrous. Branches subterete, glabrous, becoming triangular, hollow, and lenticellate with age; cross section of stems with a central, large, trigonous stele and 3(-4) peripheral, smaller, equidistant steles, embedded into the central one. Stipules glabrous, triangular, ca. 1 mm long. Leaves biternate; petioles 1-3.2 cm long, canaliculate; rachises canaliculate, primary rachis 2.3-4.3 cm long, lateral rachis 0.6-2.2 cm long; leaflets subcoriaceous, glabrous, the apex acute to shortly acuminate, the margins revolute, remotely glandularserrate, the adaxial surface slightly glossy, the abaxial surface opaque, the venation mixed craspedodromus terminal leaflets elliptic to obovate, 6.2-8.7 X 3-4 cm, attenuate at base, the petiolule 4-8 mm long; lateral leaflets elliptic or oblong-elliptic, 5-8.5 X 2-3.4 cm, asymmetrical obtuse-cuneate at base, petiolule ca. 2 mm long. Inflorescence axillary or terminal. Sepals and disc glands persistent at the base of fruit; sepals 5, oblong, the external ca. 2.5 mm long, the internal ca. 3.2 mm long; disc glands 4, the central ones ovate, the lateral ones circular, smaller. Mericarps hemicordiform, 4-4.6 cm long, glabrous, strongly reticulate-veined, the coccus transversely ellipsoid, woody, not margined or winged dorsally, the wing 3.2-4.2 X 1.6-1.9 cm, narrowed below the cocci; partitioning wall with trigonous outline, ca. 5 mm wide, endocarp glabrous. Seeds ca. 7 X 5 mm, brown, obovoid, hilum crescent-shaped; external cotyledon curved, internal cotyledon biplicate.

description: Rhizomes short-creeping, 2-4 mm diam.; rhizome scales lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, attenuate at the apex, orange, occasionally black with age, ca. 3 mm long, subentire with occasional short teeth; phyllopodia distinct, 0.4-2(-4) cm long; fronds approximate, 12-21(-40) X 1.4-2.5 cm; stipes 1/3-1/2 the sterile frond length, with scales ca. 1 mm long, scattered, mostly appressed, stellate, proximally with a few lanceolate scales like those of rhizome; blades narrowly elliptic, chartaceous, the apex acute to acuminate, the base narrowly to broadly cuneate; veins free, simple or 1-forked, ca. 1 mm distant, at a 60-70º angle; hydathodes lacking; blade scales adaxially scattered, substellate, mostly ca. 0.5 mm long, abaxially with simple to 3-armed trichomidia subtended or not by resinous dots; abaxial costa with scattered lanceolate scales (0.5-0.7 mm long) mixed with stellate scales and trichomidia; fertile fronds surpassing the sterile in length, stipe ca. 2/3 the fertile frond length, with a few lanceolate scales on the abaxial costa and with trichomidia adaxially.

description: Liana. Lamina foliorum majorum 4.5-12 X 2.7-6.6 cm, elliptica vel obovata vel ovata, supra sparsim velutina vel glabrescens, subtus velutina, pilis V-formibus; petiolus 0.5-1.5 cm longus. description: Vine to 20 m; branches velutinous when young, becoming glabrous in age; flowering shoots leafy. Lamina of the larger leaves 4.5-12 X 2.7-6.6 cm, elliptical to obovate or sometimes ovate, apex acuminate, base rounded to truncate or shallowly cordate, adaxially sparsely velutinous to glabrescent, abaxially white-velutinous, the hairs V-shaped and sessile, the arms (0.3-)0.5-1.8 mm long, with 0-2(-3) impressed glands distally but not near the base, with 2 marginal glands just below the apex; petiole 0.5-1.5 cm long, densely sericeous to velutinous, eglandular; stipules 0.8-1.3 mm long, linear, interpetiolar. Inflorescence an axillary, solitary, congested corymbose pseudoraceme of (7-)9-12(-16) flowers, borne on an axis (0.3-)0.6-1.7 cm long, the two lowest flowers usually separated a short distance from the aggregate. Peduncles 5-9 mm long, 0.5-0.8 X as long as pedicels, velutinous; pedicels 9-15 mm long, veluti- nous, sometimes less densely so than the peduncles. Bracts 1.3-2.2(-3) X ca. 0.3 mm, linear, eglandular. Bracteoles subequal, 1-1.3(-1.6) X 0.3(-0.5) mm, linear, com- monly one bracteole of each pair with a prominent to stalked gland near the base, rarely both eglandular, the gland 0.2-0.4(- 0.6) mm diam., to 0.3 mm high; pair of bracteoles subopposite or sometimes to 1 mm apart, inserted usually at or near the apex of the peduncle or sometimes to 4 mm below it. Calyx of 4 biglandular lateral sepals and 1 eglandular anterior sepal; lateral sepals exceeding the glands by ca. 1 mm, the glands ca. 2 mm long, decurrent. Petals 5, yellow, glabrous, the limb abaxially carinate, briefly hastate at base, margin erose-denticulate, eglandular; lateral petals: claw ca. 1.6 X 0.4 mm, limb ca. 4.5 X 4.5 mm, orbicular or suborbicular; posterior petal: claw ca. 2 X 0.5 mm, limb ca. 5 X ca. 4 mm, elliptical. Androecium of 10 subequal stamens; filaments 2-2.7 mm long, the anterior one the longest, the posterior one the shortest, slightly connate at base; anthers ca. 0.9 mm long, glabrous. Styles erect to slightly divergent, anterior style ca. 2.2 X 0.4 mm, posterior styles ca. 2.7 X 0.4 mm, the apex dorsally rounded to acute. Samara 2.2-3 cm diam., suborbicular to orbicular, the lateral wing continuous at base and at apex except for a distal notch 1.5-3(-4) mm deep, sparsely sericeous; central dorsal winglet 6.5-8.2 X 1.5-2 mm; nut 4-4.5 mm high; torus 2.5 mm high, surrounded by a wide, glabrous, 3-lobed, disciform outgrowth of the receptacle.

description: Caule crasso terete dense tomentoso; petiolis crassis tomentosis; foliorum laminis ovatis, ovato-oblongis, vel obovato-oblongis abrupte acuminatils basi rotundatis 7-pli-nerviis supra scaberrimis, pilis basi tuberculatis, subtus brunneis stellato-tomentosis; infloreseentia sparse ramosa stellato-tomentosa; floribus 5-6-meris sessilibus in glomerulis lateralibus et terminalibus ad ramos paniculae; hypanthio subhemi- sphaerico dense stellato-tomentoso, pilis sessilibus et stipitatis; sepalis erectis membranaceis oblongis sinubus angustis sejunctis sparse stel- lato-pubeseentibus; dentibus exterioribus minutis toto adnatis; petalis orbicularibus retusis; staminibus isomorphis; filamentis basi dilatatis; antheris crassis oblongis; connectivo dorso elevato ad basin in lobum dorsalem producto; ovario 3-loculare glabro; stigmate peltato.

description: Stem stout, terete, densely stellate-tomentose with stipitate hairs nearly 1 mm. long, the internodes 4-7 cm. long; petioles stout, tomen- tose like the stem, 10-13 mm. long; blades firm, drying dull green above, brown beneath, ovate to ovate-oblong or sometimes obovate- oblong, as much as 78 mm. long and 48 mm. wide, abruptly and ob- scurely acuminate, broadly rounded at base, apparently ciliate by the projecting of surface hairs, 7-pli-nerved, the laterals arising only 3 mm. from the base; secondaries averaging 2 mm. apart, set at an angle of 70-80º; upper surface very scabrous with stout tuberculate hairs, the contiguous bases 0.3-0.4 mm. in diameter, their total length 0.8-1 mm., the hairs usually in groups of 4 separated by the smaller veins; lower surface densely brown tomentose with sessile stellate hairs, the tertiaries reticulate, foveolate under each hair of the upper side; inflorescence sparsely branched, tomentose like the stem, the lower lateral branches bearing a terminal and 1 or 2 sessile axillary glomerules, the upper a terminal gloinerule only, and the central axis distally an axillary and a terminal glomerule; flowers 5-(rarely 6-)merous; hypanthium broadly campanulate-hemispheric, densely brown-tomentose with sessile and stipitate stellate hairs; sepals erect, truncate, depressed-oblong, membranous, 0.5 mm. long, separated by narrow sinuses, sparsely pubescent with sessile stellate hairs; exterior teeth reduced to minute adnate protuberances; petals nearly orbicular, retuse; stamens isomorphic; filaments broadened at base; anthers oblong, ob- tuse; connective elevated into a prominent dorsal ridge, prolonged at base into a short dorsal spur; ovary 3-celled, its free summit conic and glabrous; style glabrous; stigma peltate.

description: Floribus pentameris et praesertim stylo ramoso P. pallido Cuatrec. et P. cuneato Swart ut videtur affinis, sed calyce quam discum semper breviori necnon fructu juniori stipitato et anguste longi-acuminato (nec substipitato et late breviter acuminato) diversum. description: Tree, reproductive size approximately 20 m X 20 cm. Trunk cylindrical, with simple plank buttresses. Outer bark gray, smooth, with scattered white lenticels and hoop marks; inner bark dark orange (possibly after oxidation) and approx. 2 mm thick (Boom & Mori 2359). Resin clear and sticky, reportedly without odor (M. J. Pires & N. T. Silva 1918, 1919). Trichomes of two types: 1) fine, erect simple hairs to 0.05 mm long and 2) thicker, appressed simple hairs to 0.15 mm long. Branchlets slender. Leaves 1-3-jugate, 12.5-27 cm long; petiole 1.6-4.6 cm X 1.2-2.2 mm, the interjuga 2-4.3 cm long, the petiole and rachis with sparse to scattered (less often dense) erect hairs and scattered to sparse appressed hairs; petiolules slender, the laterals 0.5-1.3 cm long, the terminal 1.3-2.8 cm long, the pulvinuli relatively conspicuous; leaflets subcoriaceous, drying tan below and grayish brown above, often glossy, the apex abruptly and narrowly long-acuminate, the acumen 0.6-1.3 cm long, the lateral leaflets 6-12.5 X 2.5-4.4 cm, the base asymmetric (proximal side acute, distal side rounded to truncate), the basal pair of leaflets ovate to broadly elliptic, the other laterals (broadly) elliptic, the terminal leaflet broadly elliptic to slightly obovate, 6.5-11.8 X 3-4.8 cm, the abaxial veins all prominent, the adaxial veins narrowly prominulous (sometimes the higher-order veins flat), on the abaxial surface the midrib usually with scattered erect hairs, sometimes with scattered hairs of both types, rest of surface glabrous or with a few scattered appressed hairs (less often with both hair types), on the adaxial surface the midrib with sparse to scattered erect hairs, rest of surface glabrous. Inflorescences axillary, paniculate, often (pseudo-)fasciculate, 4.6-8.5 cm X 0.6-1.3 mm, slender, exceeding the petiole, secondary axes usually poorly developed, to 4 cm long, axes with sparse to scattered hairs of both types (rarely erect hairs dense); bracts subtending inflorescences subulate to ovate, to 1.4 mm long, those on the axes semi-clasping and (broadly) ovate, to 1 mm long, bracteoles subtending flowers to 0.5 mm long; pedicel (1.7-)2-3.5(-3.7) X 0.3-0.4 mm, usually glabrous but occasionally with a few scattered erect hairs as well as sparse appressed hairs at the base. Flowers 5-mer- ous, at anthesis 1.7-2 mm long; calyx shal- lowly cupular, 0.6-0.8 X 1.5-1.7 mm, ex- ceeded by the disk, the lobes broadly del- tate and slightly acuminate, 0.2-0.3 mm long; petals greenish yellow, lanceolate to ovate, 2.1-2.4 X 1.1-1.4 mm, slightly re- flexed at anthesis, minutely inflexed-apicu- late at apex, the margin short-papillate, ca- lyx and corolla glabrous or rarely with a few scattered hairs of both types. Staminate flowers with antesepalous petals 1.35-1.55 mm long and antepetalous ones 1.25-1.45 mm long, the filaments strap-shaped, the anthers (broadly) lanceolate in dorsiventral view, 0.35-0.5 mm long; disk 0.2-0.3 X 0.2-0.3 mm; pistillode depressed-ovoid, 0.25-0.5 X 0.4-0.7 mm, provided with locules and aborted ovules, densely pubescent with appressed hairs, also with sparse thick glandular hairs <0.05 mm long, the stylode laterally 5-lobulate, 0.05 mm long, the stigmatal region 0.1 mm high. Pistillate flowers with staminodes 0.85-1 and 0.9-1 mm long, the anthers lanceolate in dorsiventral view, 0.35-0.4 mm long; disk 0.25-0.3 X 0.25-0.3 mm; pistil ovoid, 0.9-1.1 x 0.7- 0.85 mm, the pubescence as on pistillode, the style 0.1-0.25 mm long, laterally 5- branched, the stigmatal region 0.15-0.25 mm high. Fruits stipitate when immature, obliquely ovoid, apparently glabrescent; mature fruits (and therefore morphology of the pyrene, pseudaril, and cotyledons) unknown.

description: Tree, reproductive size (12-)20-35 m X 15-20+ cm. Trunk with simple plank buttresses. Outer bark with large orange-green patches (Loubry 542), rough due to numerous, small, raised lenticels. Resin thin, clear, drying white and powdery. Branchlets slender. Trichomes of two types: 1) appressed simple hairs to 0.2 mm long and 2) rather thick, erect simple hairs <0.05 mm long. Leaves 0-3(-4)-jugate, 7.9-26 cm long; petiole 1.2-2.8 cm X 0.8-1.4 mm, the interjuga 1.8-2.8 cm long, the petiole and rachis with scattered to sparse appressed hairs and sparse to scattered erect hairs (rarely both types dense); the petiolules long and slender, sometimes inconspicuously winged, the laterals 0.4-0.9 cm long, the terminal 1.4-3.2 cm long; pulvinuli relatively conspicuous; leaflets somewhat coriaceous, drying brown to greenish brown, the apex gradually long-acuminate, the acumen 0.6-1.3 cm long, lateral leaflets 3.7-11.2 X 1.1-3.8 cm, the base subsymmetric and acute (sometimes asymmetric, the distal side obtuse), the basal pair of leaflets ovate to elliptic, the other laterals elliptic, the ter- minal one elliptic to oblanceolate, 4.9-11 X 1.5-4 cm, the abaxial midrib narrowly prominent to prominulous, rest of venation narrowly prominulous, the adaxial veins all narrowly prominulous, both surfaces glabrous or the midrib flanked by scattered appressed hairs. Inflorescences axillary, pseudofasciculate, the staminate ones to 2.7 cm long, the pistillate ones to 0.7 cm long, 0.5-1 mm diam. in both sexes (0.8-1.3 mm diam. in fruit), sometimes exceeding the petiole, the secondary axes usually poorly developed, all axes with dense to scattered appressed hairs, glabrescent in fruit; bracts usually semi-clasping, those subtending the inflorescences broadly lanceolate, 0.4-0.5 mm long, fleshy, those on the inflorescence axes ovate, 0.4-0.5 mm long, coriaceous, bracteoles subtending flowers ovate to lanceolate, 0.25-0.5 mm long, coriaceous; pedicels glabrous, those of the staminate flowers terete, 1-2 X 0.3-0.4 mm, those of the pistillate flowers often slightly clavate, 0.5-1 x 0.3-0.5 mm long. Flowers 4-merous, at anthesis 2.5-3 mm long; calyx shal- lowly cupular, 0.7 x 1.4-1.5 mm, exceeded by the disk in both sexes, the lobes negli- gible, discrete and separated by a flat sinus, 0-0.1 mm long, glabrous except for the pa- pillate apex with a few appressed hairs; pet- als white, narrowly ovate, 2-2.2 X 1-1.15 mm, slightly reflexed at anthesis, the api- culum 0.2 mm long, the abaxial surface gla- brous, the margin short-papillate. Staminate flowers with antesepalous stamens 1.4-1.5 mm long and antepetalous ones 1.35 mm long, the filaments slightly strap-shaped, the anthers broadly lanceolate in dorsiventral view, 0.6 mm long; disk 0.25-0.3 X 0.2- 0.25 mm; pistillode depressed-ovoid, 0.65- 0.7 X 0.35-0.4 mm, glabrous, provided with locules and aborted ovules, the stylode vertically 4-sulcate, 0.25-0.35 mm long. Pistillate flowers with staminodes reaching the stigmas, 1.1 and 1.2 mm long, the filaments slightly strap-shaped, the anthers lanceolate in dorsiventral view, 0.55-0.65 mm long; disk 0.15-0.25 X 0.15 mm, glabrous; pistil ovoid, subsessile, 1.2-1.25 X 0.5-0.65 mm, glabrous, the style 0.5 x 0.35-0.4 mm long, the stigmatal region 0.25 mm high, the stigmas rounded-discoid, oriented upward and outward. Fruiting pedicel 2-3.3 X 1.2-1.3 mm. Fruits narrowly spindle-shaped when very young, maturing red (shortly before dehiscence), stipitate, obliquely ovoid above the stipe, 2.2-2.6 X 1.1-1.3 cm, the base obtuse or usually truncate to somewhat concave, the apex long- acuminate; pseudaril white, virtually covering the pyrene (Sabatier & Prevost 4176); pyrene ovate in dorsiventral view, essen- tially broadly lanceolate in lateral view, 1.4-1.5 X 1-1.1 cm, thinly cartilaginous; funicular scar 20-35% the distance apex to base; fully mature fruits (and therefore cot- yledons) unknown.

description: Liana reaching the canopy, glabrous throughout. Young stems terete. Tendrils long and thin when young. Stipules not seen, soon deciduous. Leaves: petiole 1-2 cm long, with 2 adaxial glands at the edge of the blade; blade ovate to lanceolate, 7- 13 X 3.5-8 cm, obtuse or rounded to emarginate at the apex, rounded at the base, the margin entire, drying dark brown with pale veins adaxially and paler with dark veins abaxially, 6-8 main lateral veins on each side of the midrib, tertiary venation somewhat scalariform. description: Liana reaching the canopy, glabrous throughout. Young stems terete, becoming woody with irregular secondary growth. Tendrils pinkish red when young. Stipules not seen, soon deciduous. Leaves: petiole ca. 3 cm long, with 2 adaxial glands at the edge of the blade; blade ovate to lanceolate, 10-11 X 5-6.5 cm, rounded to emarginate at the apex, rounded at the base, sometimes slightly cuneate around the petiolar glands, the margin entire, drying dark brown with pale veins adaxially and paler with dark veins abaxially, 6-8 main lateral veins on each side of the midrib, tertiary venation scalariform. Inflorescences numerous, cauliflorous, 1-6 m long, produced at the nodes of old woody stems, mostly from ground level to 2.5 m above it, sometimes loosely branched, branches 5 cm to 2 m long. Pedicels ca. 15 mm long, jointed 4-5 mm from the base. Flowers pink; hypanthium cylindrical, 4.5 cm long, ca. 5 mm diam., rose- red; sepals pink or light gray outside, pink or purple to dark gray inside, 12-25 mm long (to 60 mm long in fruit), 5-6 mm wide; petals usually somewhat more pink than the sepals; corona in 2 rows, the outer row of filaments ca. 3 mm long, dark purple to blackish, the inner row a ridge or a series of tubercles 0.3 mm thick; operculum borne 6-7.5 mm from the base of the hypanthium, a deeply 5-10-cleft membrane 5 mm long, bearing at apex 1-2.5 mm long filaments; disk white; androgynophore 4.5-5 cm long, pale pink; stamen filaments ca. 5.5 mm long, pale pink, anthers dorsifixed, rectangular, 3.5-4 X 1.5 mm, yellow; ovary slightly obovoid, whitish, glabrous; styles pale pink to blackish red, 3-4 mm long; stigmas yellow to greenish, ca. 1 mm wide. Fruit pendent, oblong ellipsoid, somewhat hexagonal in section, tapering at base, round to tapering, dark purplish green turning to dark red, 6-10 X 2.5-5 cm; seeds oblong, slightly curved, 6 X 3-4 mm, flattened, ca. 1 mm thick at margin and <2 mm thick in the middle, margin of each half crenate, the swollen, pale suture being in a depression between the crenate margins, sides reticulate-foveate.

description: Liana, glabrous throughout. Young stem terete. Tendrils thick. Stipules narrowly triangular, minute, 0.2-0.3 mm long, early deciduous. Leaves: petiole 2-3 cm long, with 2 adaxial glands at the limit with the blade; blade ovate to suborbicular, 10-11 X 6-8 cm, obtuse at the apex and slightly emarginate, rounded at the base, margin entire, drying dark green with lighter brown veins adaxially, and light green with darker brown veins abaxially (glaucous green when fresh), 4 or 5 pairs of main lateral veins, tertiary veins not obvious, intermediate between scalariform and forming a loose net. Inflorescence cauliflorous, 10-80 cm long, the longer one resuming vegetative growth on the apical 10 cm, nodes 1-flowered; pedicels 18-24 mm long, jointed 6-8 mm from the base; bracts minute. Flowers red: hypanthium 3.5-4 cm long, not ventricose at the base, gently funnel- shaped, ca. 3 times as wide at the throat than at the base; sepals 15-30 mm long, rounded at the apex; petals 12-25 mm long; corona in 3 rows, the outmost row of flat- tened filaments, rounded at apex, slightly curved, 6 mm long, the inner 2 rows of filaments, 1.5 and 0.5 mm long respectively, somewhat flattened and irregular in shape; operculum inserted 1.3 cm from the base of the hypanthium, filamentous, 5-8 mm long; androgynophore 5-5.5 cm long; stamen fil- aments flat, 6 mm long, anther dorsifixed, 7.5 X 4 mm, rectangular; ovary 7-8 X 3 mm, styles 3 mm long, stigmas 4.5 mm diam. Fruit not seen.

description: Arbores parvac: ramulis dense pubescentibus; foijis ellipticis vel anguste ellipticis, pinnatinervis vel tripli- nervis, in apice acuminatis, base acutis, breviter decurrentibus, laminis adultis supra glabris, infra dense pubescentibus, trichomatibus strictis, adpressis, in pluribus directionibus dispositis, domatiis praesentibus ad axillas venarum secundariarum, ad margines villosis; inflorescentiis thyrsoideis, dense pubescentibus; floribus parum rotatis, bisexualibus, tepalis extus sericeis, intus ad bases sericeis, ad apice minute papillosis, staminibus novemii, staminodis manifestis, hypanthio non profundo, extus dense sericco. intus saltem ex parte sericeo; cupulis fructuum patelliformibus.

description: Trees 3-5(-7) m tall. Bark of old branches reddish-brown or dark brown. Young branches densely pubescent, the trichomes 0.2 mm long, appressed to ascending, yellowish-brown or light yellow, persistent, covering branches entirely. Petioles (5-) 6.5-9.5(-11) X 0.7-1.2 mm, rounded abaxially, flat adaxially, densely pubescent. Leaves (3.5-)6-10(-13) X 1.5-3(-4.5) cm, elliptic to narrow elliptic, the base acute, shortly decurrent, the apex acuminate, the surface glabrous above (when mature), densely pubescent below, the trichomes 0.1-0.2 mm long, appressed and oriented in several directions, straight; midvein flattened and ± appressed pubescent above, elevated and densely pubescent below; secondary veins 3-4 pairs, pinnate or tripli- nerved, plane and ± pubescent above, slightly elevated and densely pubescent below; domatia present (3-4 pairs), axillary to secondary veins, slightly raised above, slightly sunken below, densely villous on the border, with trichomes reclinate on glabrous lumen; secondary domatia axillary to tertiary veins sometimes present. Inflorescences (2.5-)4-7 cm long, usually at the base of new shoots, axillary to small deciduous bracts or occasionally axillary to nor- mal leaves, thyrsoid, densely pubescent; peduncle 1.3-2 cm long; flower pedicel 1.5- 2.3 mm long, densely pubescent. Flowers ± rotate, whitish; tepals 1.8-1.9 x 0.7-0.9 mm, elliptic, sericeous outside (mainly on central area), minutely papillose inside toward tip, ± sericeous at base, glabrous or glabrescent in rest of area; stamens of whorls I and II, 1.1-1.3 mm long, the filaments glabrous except for ± sericeous base adaxially, the anthers 0.6 mm long, glabrous, the sporangia four, introrse; stamens of whorl III, 1.2-1.4 mm long, the filaments glabrous except for the sericeous lower half abaxially; the anthers 0.7 mm long, glabrous, with four sporangia, the upper two latrorse, the lower ones extrorse, glands close to base of filament short but clearly pedicellate, reniform, glabrous; staminodes 0.7 mm long, the filaments glabrous adaxially and ± setose abaxially, the apices 0.4 mm long, trullate in outline but not capitate, glabrous; hypanthium 0.5 mm deep, densely sericeous outside, evenly or unevenly sericeous inside; pistil ca. 2 mm long; ovary glabrous. Fruit 12-16 X 8.5- 12 mm, ellipsoid; tepals deciduous (or per- sistent at very base?); cupule 1.2-1.5 X 6.5-7.5 mm, hardly accrescent, patelliform; pedicel 11-13 mm long, swollen, obconic.

description: Arbores; ramulis dense puberulis; foliis ellipticis, interdum anguste ellipticis vel oblanceolatis, pinnatinervis, in apice acutatis vel acuminatis, base acutis, laminis supra glabratis, infra puberulis vel glabratis, trichomatibus strictis, erectis, domatiils carentibus; inflorescentiis thyrsiformibus, puberulis; floribus cupulatis, bisexualibus, tepalis extus puberulis, intus puberulis, staminibus novem, staminodiis manifestis vel diminutis vel nullis, hypanthio profundo, extus puberulo, intus glabro; cupulis fructuum patelliformibus.

description: Trees 7-18(-35?) m. Bark of old branches grayish or yellowish-brown. Young branches densely puberulent, the trichomes 0.1 mm long, appressed to erect, light yellow, rather persistent. Petioles (9-)12-20(-28) X (1.2-)1.6-2.2(-2.6) mm, rounded or keeled abaxially, flat or slightly sulcate adaxially, puberulous. Leaves (8.5-)15-29(- 42) X (2.5-)5.5-12(-19.5) cm, elliptic, sometimes narrowly elliptic or oblanceolate, the base acute to rounded, the apex acute to acuminate, often slightly falcate, the surface glabrous above, puberulent below, sometimes glabrescent with age, the trichomes 0.1-0.2 mm, erect; midvein flattened or slightly convex toward the apex and glabrous or puberulent above, strongly elevated and puberulent below; secondary veins with (7-)9-11(-12) pairs, pinnate, flattened and glabrous or rarely puberulent above, elevated and puberulent below; do- matia absent. Inflorescence 9-14 cm long, axillary to normal leaves, thyrsoid, the ultimate axes often shortened, the flowers appearing fasciculate, puberulent, the trichomes erect; peduncle 0.3-4 cm long; flower pedicel 1.5-2.5 mm long, puberulent. Flowers cupulate; tepals 1.8-2.2 x 1.2-1.6 mm, those of external whorl elliptic to ovate, those of internal whorl ovate to widely ovate, all densely puberulent outside, puberulent inside (at least in lower half); the stamens of whorls I and H, 1.4- 1.6 mm long, the filaments with three lines of trichomes adaxially, one on each margin and one along middle, pubescent (whorl 1) or glabrous (whorl Il) abaxially, the anthers ca. 0.9 mm long, glabrous, the sporangia four, introrse; stcamens of whorl III, ca. 1.6 mm long, the filaments pubescent along the middle adand abaxially, the anthers 0.8 mm long, glabrous (except at very base adaxially), with four sporangia, the upper two conspicuously smaller than the lower ones, latrorse, the lower ones latrorse-extrorse, glands at the base of the filament more or less round with an irregular surface, glabrous; staminodes 0.4-0.7 mm long, the filaments pilose, tip not differentiated; hypanthium 0.6-0.7 mm deep, puberulent outside, glabrous inside, pistil 1.7-2 mm long; ovary glabrous. Fruit 32-36 x 16-20 mm, ellipsoid; tepals in fruit not persistent; cupule 2.5-3.5 x 13.5-15.5 mm, patelliform; pedicel 16-22 mm long, thickened, obconic.

description: Arbores; ramulis glabris vel parce puberulis; foliis anguste ellipticis, ellipticis vel lanceolatis, pinnatinervis vel triplinervis, in apice acutatis vel acuminatis, base obtusis, interdum obliquis, laminis supra glabris, infra glabris vel parce puberulis, trichomatibus adpressis, domatiis plerumque praesentibus ad axillas venarum secundariarum, ad margines villosis; inflorescentiis thyrsoideis, glabris vel glabratis; floribus cupulatis, bisexualibus, tepalis extus puberulis, intus plus minusve sericeis, staminibus novem, staminodiis manifestis, hypanthio non profundo, extus puberulo, intus saltem ex parte sericeo; cupulis fructuum crateriformibus.

description: Trees (6-)15-20 m tall. Bark of old branches light grayish-brown. Young branches glabrous or sparsely and inconspicuously puberulous, the trichomes ca. 0.1 mm, appressed, straight. Petioles (8.5-)11.5-20.5(-26) X 1-1.5 mm, rounded abaxially, channeled adaxially, glabrous or glabrescent. Leaves (5-)8.5-14.5(-17) X (1.5-)3-4.5(-5.5) cm, narrowly elliptic or elliptic or lanceolate, the base obtuse, sometimes oblique, the apex acute to acuminate; glabrous above, glabrous or sparsely and inconspicuously puberulous below, the trichomes as on twigs; midvein slightly convex and glabrous above, slightly elevated and glabrous or sparsely puberulous below; secondary veins 5-8 pairs, pinnate or triplinerved, flat and glabrous above, nearly flat and glabrous below; domatia present (1-3 pairs), at least a single one on some leaves, axillary to secondary veins, slightly elevated on upper surface, slightly sunken on lower surface, densely villous on the margin, the trichomes straight, reclinate on the lumen. Infiorescences (5.5-)7-12.5 cm long, at base of new shoots or axillary to small deciduous bracts or occasionally ax- illary to normal leaves, thyrsoid or thyrso- paniculate, glabrous or glabrescent; pedun- cle 2-6.5 cm long; flower pedicel (2-)3-5.5 mm long, puberulous. Flowers cupulate; te- pals 2.1-2.7 X 1.3-1.9 mm, ovate, puber- ulous outside, more or less sericeous inside but glabrous toward margins; stamens of whorls I and 11, 1.5-2.2 mm long, the fil- aments tomentose along middle section in lower half or full length adaxially, tomen- tose abaxially, the anthers 0.9-1.1 mm long, tomentose along connective adaxially, glabrous or tomentose along connective in lower half abaxially, the sporangia four, in- trorse; stamens of whorl III, 1.5-2.3 mm long; the filaments glabrescent adaxially, to- mentose abaxially, the anthers 0.7-1 mm long, glabrous or more or less tomentose at base on margins, sparsely tomentose at base along midsection, with four sporangia, the upper two latrorse, the lower latrorse-extrorse, glands near base of filament short- pedicellate, thick-lenticular, glabrous except for junction with pedicel; staminodes 0.8- 1.3 mm long, the filaments densely tomentose ad- and abaxially or glabrous adaxially, the apex 0.3-0.5 mm long, narrowly triangular, not wider than filament, glabrous; hypanthium 0.7-0.9 mm deep, puberulous outside, sericeous inside, at least some patches of trichomes on lower half; pistil 2.7-3 mm long; ovary glabrous. Fruit ca. 30 x 20 mm, ellipsoid; tepals in fruit deciduous; cupule ca. 7 X 12 mm, thick, crateriform; pedicel ca. 7 mm long, thickened, obconic.

description: Sagenia, rhizomate valido adscendente; stipitibus validis exalatis ca. 4 cm. longis, castaneis, paleis atrocastaneis linearibus 1 cm. longis patentibus vestitis, deinde alatis fere 20 cm. altis, ala 10-16 mm. lata; fronde aut simplice, 35 cm. alta, 12 cm. lata, integra, aut tripartita et majore, segmento mediale 40-45 cm. longa, 16 cm. lata, lateralibus 16 cm. longis, 10 cm. latis, supra basin basiscopice dilatatis, herbacea, primno utraque facie pubeseente sed mox glabreseente; venis primariis coiispicuis patentibus, secondariis manifestis areolas primarias usque ad 12 inter costam et marginem definientibus; sons in areolis pri- mariis biseriatis, in serie quaeque costae paralleli 4-6, parvis, orbicu- laribus, indusio parvo, dense ciliato, persistente sed inconspicio.

description: Stipite 40 cm. alto, fusco, ad basin paleis paucis parvis castaneis donato, sursum minute et eaduce puLberulo; fronde 50 cm. vel ultra alta, 30 cm. lata, bipinnatifida, apice pinnatifida, rhachi decidue pubeseente; pinnis supremis adnatis lanceolatis, aliis stipituLlatis, in- fimis horizontalibus, 15 cm. longis, 6 cm. latis, basin versus angus- tatis, deinde praecipue basiscopice dilatatis, niedialibus basi truneatis, subacutis, 16 cm. longis, 4 cul. latis, ad alam, 6 mm. latam pinnatifidis, costis glabreseentibus, aliter omnino glabris, membranaceis; segmen- tis 3-5 mm. latis, anguste oblongis, subfaleatis, obtusis, integris vel obseure crenulatis, sinubus rotunldatis haud ciliatis; velLulis reticu- latis, areolis parvis, venulis liberis fere carentibus; soris niediocribus, rotuLidis, mediatim inter costulam et marginem seriatis.

description: Shrub; branches heavy, dark, glabrous, not spineseent; leaves coriaceous, glabrous, ovate, acute, crenate-serrate, the base obtuse, 1.5-5 cm. long, 9-26 mm. broad; pedicels coarse, glabrous, 2-8 mm. long; infloreseence-axis glabrous, coarse, about 7 mm. long, a contracted pseudoraceme; bracts deltoid, glabrous except ciliate with simple hairs; pedicels glabrous, about 3 mm. long; sepals deltoid-ovate, subacute, glabrous except ciliate with short simple hairs; petals narrowly ovate, truncate, glabrous.

description: Herbaceous, twining or trailing, vines, to 2 m long. Root thick and 10-15 cm long. Stem cylindrical, green, 1-1.25 mm diam., striate, with odes 8-8.5 cm long, sparsely strigose, retrorse hairs of two sizes, the long 0.45 mm, the short ones 0.1-0.15 mm; stipules deltoid, 2-2.5 mm x 1 mm at the base, 3-(4-) nerved, adaxially covered by hairs 0.3-0.35 mm long. Leaves pinnately trifoliolate, 10-12 cm long, membranaceous to papyraceous, deep to light green, with prominent purple-red (in living material) veins in upper side, or with white veins not prominent in either upper or lower side; petiole 3-3.5 cm long, terete, sparsely covered with long and short hairs, canaliculate; rachis 1-1.5 cm long, canaliculate; lateral pulvinuli 3-3.5 mm long, the central one 2- 2.5 mm, adaxially covered by straight long hairs; stipels oblong, 1-nerved, 1.5 mm long; central leaflet very variable in shape, either elongated and thin, 0.8-1.2 cm wide with two lobes at the base, or triangular sublobed, or triangular with or without two lobes at the base, 5-6.5 cmx3-4 cm, apex acuminate, slightly apiculate, the upper and lower surfaces sparsely strigose, the margins ciliate; lateral leaflets with unequal base, ovate, or with a lateral lobe above the base, or triangular with unequal basal lobes. Inflorescence a pseudoraceme or a scarcely devel- oped panicle; peduncle 0.7 mm diam., striate, 30-40 cm long, puberulent; rachis 15-22 cm, with uncinate hairs 0.5 mm long, with 4-10 nodes, each node bearing 2-4 flowers; primary bract lanceolate, 3-3.5 mmx 0.65 mm, with 2-3 (occasionally 5) green veins, lustrous, abaxially pubescent, persistent; pedicel 6-9 mm at anthesis, 1.0-1.2 cm in fruit, adaxially green, abaxially purple, with uncinate hairs 0.05 mm long; bracteole ovate to lancelolate, 1-nerved or neverless, 0.75 mm  long, ciliate, purple or green, persistent. Flowers purple to lavender, fading to yellow-brown; calyx campanulate, 5.6-6.2 mmx 4.3-5.6 mm, inner surface of tube strigillose, outer surface covered with short hairs, abundantly so on lower lobe, upper lobes connate, emarginate, the three lower lobes deltoid, unequal, lower lobe 1.7-3 mm long; standard usually wider than long, recurved at anthesis, with the upper part hood-like, thickened at point of folding up, margins of blade rolled backwards, auriculate at base with quadrate flap-like appendages, 0.9-1 cm high, 0.91.1 cm wide; wings convex, slightly unequal, 0.9-1.0 cm x 5-6 mm, 2-3 mm at the narrowest part that adheres to the keel, claws 3.54.5 mm long; keel incurved and rotated laterally above the curve, ca. 1 cm long, distally coiled with 1.5 spirals; androecium diadelphous, vexillar stamen with a gibbous appendage, 1-1.5 mm broad, 0.6-0.7 mm from the base; stamens connate into a tube 0.9-1 cm, with two lobe-like appendices 1 mm from the base; anthers oblong, 0.650.75 mmx0.25-0.35 mm; pollen tricolporate, exine sculpturing narrowly reticulate, operculum hemispheric, surface rugulate (Fig. 2); gynoecium surrounded at base by a cylindrical nectary, less than 1 mm long; ovary densely strigose, 5.3-6 mmx 1.2-1.55, 4-5-ovular; style distally thickened, with a pollen brush; stigma subapical, introrse. Fruit linear falcate, densely strigose (immature) to hirsute, valves elastically dehiscent along both sutures and curling, 3.5-4.5 cmx7.5-8 mm, with a straight, 5-6 mm beak. Seeds 2-4, brown, rounded and flattened, 4.2-5 mm long, 3.5-4.3 mm wide, 2.5-3.2 mm thick, hilum ovate 1.23-1.45 mmx0.75-0.9 mm. Seedling with hypogeal germination, eophylls simple and opposite, ovate and acute at the tip, petiolate.

description: Arbor ca. 24.5 m alta, ex sylvis palustribus orae atlanticae brasiliensis oriens. M. mediterraneo (Mart. ex Benth.) R. Koeppen affine sed statura majore, habitatione, foliolis apice acutis, basi rotundatis vel cuneatis, nervo mediano in facie abaxiali glabro vel sparse strigoso, inflorescentiis, alabastris, petalis que minoribus differt.

description: Tree, ca. 24.5 m tall, DBH 92.9 cm; buttresses present, extending upward to 1 m; young branches glabrous or sparsely strigose; indumentum yellowish gold. Vegetative buds fusiform; cataphylls yellow gold sericeous. Leaves (7.2-)10.5-14.6(-20) X 6.3-9.7(-11.5) cm, alternately pinnate, the stipules caducous, not seen; petiole (1.3-)1.6-2.2 cm, cylindrical, slightly pulvinate, sparsely strigose; rachis (2.2-)3.4-6.6(-9.4) cm, cylindrical, sparsely strigose. Leaflets 6-8, (4.1-)5.4-7.7 X (1.5-)2.1-3.4 cm, alternate, petiolulate, ovate or elliptic; apices acute and minutely mucronate, entire; margins undulate and thickened; bases rounded or cuneate; surfaces glabrous on both sides or with sparsely strigose nerve on abaxial surface, coriaceous, shiny on adaxial surface; sizes unequal (the proximal leaflets smaller and wider); venation yellow, pinnate, plane on both surfaces; tertiary veins finely reticulate, sometimes inconspicuous on adaxial surface; petiolules 2.3-3.9(-4.6) mm, cylindrical, sparsely strigose, articulate at point of attachment to rachis. Inflorescences with 15-45 flowers, axillary, few-flowered compound cymes or very dense and many-flowered contracted terminal thyrses, the axillary ones 4.2-5.7 X 2.5-4.5 cm, the terminal ones 5.8 X 8.4 cm; peduncles 1-1.3 cm, the branches strigose; bracts 3.3 X 2.9 mm, cordiform, pilose, caducous; pedicels 5-12 mm, cy- lindrical, strigose. Flower buds 1.5-1.6 cm long, ovate, straight or very slightly bent at apex. Flowers at anthesis 2.6-2.9 cm diam.; sepals 5, quincuncial, unequal in size, narrow-triangular or lanceolate, 15-19 X 2-4 mm, acute at apex, sparsely strigose except on overlapped margins, carnose, reflexed at anthesis; petals 5, el- liptic, 16-18 X 6-9 mm, the apex acute, the margin sparsely erose and undulate, the base cuneate, yellow, glabrous, papery except for the carnose base at center; sta- mens 5, unequal, 10-16 mm long, gla- brous, 2-sporangiate, 4-thecate, the fila- ments short, 1.1- 1.7 mm long, cylindrical, the connectives inconspicuous, the inter- nal thecae ending below anther apex, the anthers fusiform, 8-14 mm long, straight, acute at apex, rounded at base, opening through apical pores; staminodes not observed; ovary 16 X 3 mm, fusiform, compressed, sparsely strigose chiefly on margin, the style ca. 11 mm long, slightly flattened, bent along abaxial side, very sparsely pilose, the stigma terminal, ventral, heart-shaped, papillose, ca. 0.5 mm diam., the ovule 1, almost apical, anatro- pous. Fruit a samara (only immature ones observed), 8.5-9.9 X 4.5-5.4 cm, elliptic, acute at apex, cuneate or oblique at base, sparsely pilose, drying minutely honey-combed and conspicuously nerved, brown and sparsely white-dotted, the dorsal wing 11-13 mm wide, the ventral wing 10-12 mm wide; seeds not seen.

description: Low saxicolous herbs, rosette-like, with fibrous roots, hairy except on corolla lobes and nectary. Stem sappy, ca. 3 cm long on type collection, decumbent, tomentose, unbranched, with adventitious roots. Leaves opposite, petiolate, equal to unequal in a pair; lamina ovate-elliptic, 5.5-8 X 2.4-6 cm, apex barely acute to blunt; base round to slightly cordate and sometimes asymmetrical; margin crenate; variegated; main veins 7-9 pairs; bullate; adaxial side pilose on mounds with appressed hairs pointing toward top of mound; abaxial surface minutely and loosely pilose on areolae and tomentose on veins; foliar nectaries lacking; petiole 3-7.5 cm long, clasping at base, tomentose. Infiorescences axillary, cymose, many-flowered; peduncle ca. 17 cm long, with loose small hairs; bracts elliptic, 6-8 x 2.1-2.4 mm, 3-5-toothed in distal third with glandular teeth at tip; loose small hairs present; pedicels 0.6 cm long, pilose; bracteoles elliptic, 4-5 x 2-2.2 mm long, with loose small hairs. Sepals free to base, oblique, subequal, elliptic, 4-6 X 2-2.2 mm, 3-5-toothed in distal third with glandular teeth at tip; apex acute; tomentose becoming pilose outside, having a few short hairs present inside; parallel veins 3; dorsal sepal slightly larger, more erect, lanceolate. Corolla erect, white or pale purple, with ventral yellow markings on throat, campanulate, the outside shortly tomentose in all parts exposed in bud, the inside glabrous; tube 2-3 mm long, 2 mm wide at base, not spurred, ca. 6-7 mm wide at throat; limb slightly zygomorphic; lobes subequal, spreading (ventral lobe less so), suborbicular, 2-3.5 mm long, the ventral and dorsal lobes dentate-fimbriate at margin, rounded at apex; stamens included, inserted on lower half of corolla tube; filaments free, short, glabrous; anthers not coherent, orbicular, dehiscing by longitudinal slits; staminode dorsal, 0.5 mm long, without anther; nectary consisting of a dorsal gland obtuse to obscurely 3-lobed and a ventral gland acute to apiculate, 1-1.2 mm tall, glabrous; ovary ovoid, 1 x 1.5 mm, densely covered with ascending hairs; style 3.5-4 mm long, curved in proximal 1/3 and at apex toward ventral lobe of corolla, glabrescent; stigma capitate, 1 X 0.7-0.8 mm, with long papillae (another ovary had a style 1 mm long and a patelliform stigma, 0.5 X 1.2 mm). Capsule surrounded by persistent sepals, valves 2.5-3 X 4-5 mm wide, wider in distal half, truncate at apex, laterally compressed, with short appressed hairs; seeds black, variable in shape, often elliptic, 0.75 mm long, striate longitudinally, with long funicles.

description: Liana, ramis mox glabrescentibus. Lamina foliorum majorum 3.9-10.7 cm longa, 1.8-4.7 cm lata, membranacea, elliptica, late lanceolata, ovata, ovato-lanceolata vel ovato-cordata, glabrescens, marginibus integris; petiolus 7-15 mm longus, basi biglandulifer. Panicula 9-13.2 cm longa, laxa, deflexa, umbellis 3-4-floris, pedunculo florifero nullo, pedicellis 6-7 mm longis. Petala lutea, in alabastro exposita, valde reflexa; stamina glabra, connectivis nigrescentibus; styli arcuati, 2 stylis posticis in apice dorsaliter rotundatis, stylo antico in apice dorsaliter brevi-apiculato truncato.

description: Liana, climbing to 8 m; stems cylindrical, striate, soon glabrate, developing small scattered lenticels. Leaves opposite; petiole 7-15 mm long, glabrate, bearing a pair of impressed glands at base, each gland ca. 1 mm diam.; stipules not seen; lamina of larg- er leaves (3.9-)5.5-10.7 X (1.8-)2.3-4.7 cm, membranous, elliptical, ovate, broadly lanceolate, ovate-lanceolate or occasionally ovate-cordate to obovate-oblong, the base obtuse to cuneate or slightly cordate, the apex acute or acuminate to obtuse, the margins entire, the surfaces (both?) initially sparsely sericeous becoming glabrate at ma- turity, the abaxial surface bearing many small impressed glands midway between margin and midrib, with lateral veins and reticulum visible. Infiorescence paniculate, open, terminal or axillary, pendulous, seri- ceous to glabrate, 9-13.2 cm long; primary branches 8-16, 0.5-6.2 cm long; secondary branches 6-8, 0.2-0.5 cm long; ultimate units in 3-4-flowered umbels, occasionally with an additional pair of flowers borne more proximally; inflorescence bracts 1.7-1.9 X 1 mm, linear-lanceolate, the margins entire and eglandular; peduncle absent; flo- ral bracts ca. 0.5 X 0.4 mm, ovate, eglandular, sericeous abaxially, glabrous adaxially; bracteoles like bracts but smaller, eglandular; pedicel 6-7 X 0.6-1.5 mm, sericeous, straight. Sepals 2-2.6 X 1.3 mm, rounded at apex, appressed in anthesis, sericeous abaxially, glabrous adaxially, eglandular or the anterior sepal eglandular and the lateral 4 biglandular, the glands ca. 1.1 mm long, elliptical or orbicular. Petals exposed in the enlarging bud, presumably yellow, glabrous, slightly erose at margin, smooth abaxially, all 5 reflexed in anthesis, often deciduous; lateral petals with claw 1.5-1.6 mm long, limb 1.5-1.7 X 1.3 mm; posterior petal with claw ca. 1.7 mm long, limb 1.5 X 1-1.2 mm. Stamens glabrous, unequal; filaments 1.4-2.1 X 0.1-0.6 mm, connate ca. 1/2 their length; anthers 0.5-0.7 mm long, all alike, glabrous, erect to reflexed, the connective uniformly black. Ovary 1.2-1.4 mm high, densely sericeous; styles 1.7-1.9 mm long, equaling or slightly exceeding anthers, glabrous; anterior style straight, the apex truncate and short-apiculate dorsally; 2 posterior styles divergent or arcuate-ascending at middle and then bend- ing inward distally, the apex rounded; stigmas internal, all 3 facing center of flower. Fruit unknown.

description: Liana ramis teretibus, striatis, glabrescentibus. Lamina foliorum majorum 10-14.2 cm longa, 4-6.9 cm lata, elliptica, lanceolata, oblongo-lanceolata vel obovata, marginibus integris, subtus dense sericea; petiolus 7-10 mm longus, basi biglandulosus. Panicula 5-13 cm longa, flosculosa, deflexa, floribus 80-600, in umbellis congestis 4-8-floris dispositis, pedunculo florifero nullo, pedicello 0.3-0.7 mm diametro. Petala in alabastro exposita; stamina glabra, filamentis 0.9-1.6 mm longis, connectivo nigro; styli in apice dorsaliter rotundati; stylus anticus curvatus versus petalum posticum.

description: Liana; stems ca. 5 mm diam., cylindrical, strongly striate, twisted, soon glabrate; lenticels not seen. Leaves opposite; petiole 7-10 mm long, densely sericeous to eventually glabrate, bearing a pair of impressed glands at base, each gland ca. 0.8 mm diam.; stipules not seen; lamina of larger leaves 10-14.2 X 4-6.9 cm, membranous, elliptical, widely-lanceolate, oblong-lanceolate to sometimes obovate, the base acute to obtuse, the apex acute to obtuse or rarely acuminate, the adaxial surface sparsely sericeous to usually glabrous, the abaxial surface densely and persistently silvery-sericeous and bearing an irregular row of many small impressed glands midway between margin and midrib, the margins entire, the adaxial and abaxial surfaces with lateral veins visible and reticulum obscure. Info- rescence an elongated panicle, terminal or axillary, pendulous, densely sericeous, (5-)10-13 cm long, containing 80-400(- 600) or more minute flowers; primary branches 4-20, 0.5-8 cm long; secondary branches 4-8, 0.2-0.6 cm long or absent; ultimate units in congested and dense 4-6(- 8)-flowered umbels; inflorescence bracts ca. 4 X 0.9 mm, linear-lanceolate, the margins entire, the base biglandular, the glands 0.3- 0.7 mm diam.; peduncle absent; floral bracts ca. 0.8 X 0.3 mm, ovate, eglandular, sericeous abaxially, glabrous adaxially; bracteoles similar to bracts but smaller, eglandular; pedicel 4.7-6 X 0.3-0.7 mm, densely sericeous, slender, slightly curved. Sepals ca. 1.2 X 0.8 mm, brown, rounded at apex, erect in anthesis, sericeous abaxi- ally, glabrous adaxially, eglandular. Petals exposed in the enlarging bud, yellow, gla- brous, slightly erose along margin, smooth abaxially, all 5 reflexed in anthesis or with posterior petal erect and laterals reflexed, persistent; lateral petals with claw ca. 1 mm long, limb 2.1-3.2 X 1.4-2.3 mm; posterior petal with claw ca. 1.3 mm long, limb ca. 3.2 X 1.6 mm. Stamens glabrous, unequal; filaments 0.9-1.6 X 0.1-0.3 mm, connate ca. 1/3 their length; anthers 0.6-0.8 mm long, all alike, glabrous, erect to reflexed, the connective uniformly black. Ovary ca. 1 mm high, densely sericeous; styles ca. 1.5 mm long, glabrous, equaling or slightly ex- ceeding the anthers; anterior style nearly straight, inclined slightly toward posterior petal, the apex short-apiculate dorsally; 2 posterior styles strongly bowed, the apex rounded or truncate dorsally; stigmas inter- nal, all 3 facing center of flower. Fruit unknown.

description: Liana, ramis teretibus glabrescentibus. Folia appres- sa; laminae 5-11 cm longae, 2.4-5 cm latae, ovatae, oblongae, lanceolatae, ovato-oblongae vel ovato-lanceolatae, utrinque glabratae, marginibus aliquot glandulis parvis munitis; petiolus 6-17 mm longus, basi biglandulosus. Panicula erecta, 6-32 cm longa, 4-20- floribus decussatis, pedunculo florifero nullo, pedicellis 1.6-2.5 mm latis. Petala flava, in alabastro exposita, patentia, dorsaliter carinata, margimbus integris; stamina glabra; stylis arcuatis, in apice dorsaliter apiculatis. Samara rosea, 30-32 mm longa, 9-13 mm lata, nuce lateraliter laevi.

description: Liana, climbing to 1.5-10 m; basal stems 8-8.5 mm diam., cylindrical, twisted, glabrate, developing small, scattered lenticels. Leaves mostly erect, decussate, frequently appressed; petiole 6-17 mm long, glabrous or initially sparsely sericeous and soon glabrate, bearing a pair of impressed glands at base, each gland ca. 0.6 mm diam.; stipules ca. 0.3 mm long, seldom evident, borne on base of petiole; lamina of larger leaves (5-)6.1-11 X 2.4-3.7(-5) cm, subcoriaceous, ovate, oblong, ovate-lanceolate, ovate-oblong to oblong-obovate or sometimes lanceolate, rarely orbicular or oblong-lanceolate, the base acute to obtuse or rarely rounded, the apex acute, obtuse, or retuse, rarely truncate or apiculate, the margins bearing many small bordered glands, initially sparsely sericeous but very soon glabrescent, the lateral veins and reticulum prominulous on both sides, slightly more so below than above. Inflorescence paniculate, 6-32 cm long, terminal or rarely axillary, erect, densely and persistently brown-sericeous, the flowers borne ultimately in 6-18 elongated pseudoracemes, these 1.2-17 cm long and containing 4-20 mostly decussate flowers; inflorescence bracts 4-4.3 X 0.8- 1.5 mm, lanceolate, bright green, the mar- gins entire, the base biglandular, the glands ca. 1.2 mm diam.; peduncle absent; floral bracts ca. 0.6 X 1.5 mm, rounded, biglandular with each gland ca. 0.8 mm diam., densely sericeous abaxially, glabrous adax- ially; bracteoles similar to bracts but eglan- dular and smaller; pedicel 3.5-5.7 X 1.6- 2.5 mm (4-6 X 2-2.7 mm in fruit), densely brown-sericeous, somewhat thicker distally, curved. Sepals ca. 2.6 X 2 mm, brown, rounded at apex, pressed against filaments in anthesis, densely brown-sericeous abaxially, glabrous adaxially, the anterior sepal eglandular, the lateral 4 biglandular, the glands 1.1-2.5 mm long, elliptical. Petals exposed in the enlarging bud, vivid yellow, glabrous, keeled abaxially; lateral petals spreading, the margin entire, the claw 2-2.5 mm long, the limb 4.2-5 X 3.7-6.2 mm; posterior petal erect, the margin minutely glandular-thickened, the claw 3.5-4.5 mm long, the limb 2.9-3.8 X 3.4-3.8 mm. Stamens glabrous, unequal; filaments 1.4-3 X 0.3-1.2 mm, connate ca. 1/3 their length; anthers 1.1-1.8 mm long, all alike, glabrous, erect to reflexed, the connective proximally 2/3-4/5 dark red, distally 1/3- 1/5 white. Ovary ca. 1.2 mm high, sericeous; styles 3-4.3 mm long, equaling or slightly exceeding anthers, glabrous or proximally sericeous, the apex dorsally strong-apiculate or pedaliform; anterior style erect and somewhat straight; 2 posterior styles strongly arcuate outward from base; stigmas internal, all 3 facing center of flower. Samara reddish pink at maturity, 30-32 mm long, borne horizontally, sparsely tomentose to glabrate; dorsal wing 24- 27 X 9-13 mm; nut 4-5 mm diam., subspheroidal, with smooth surface, without lateral crests or winglets.

description: Trees, to 30 m tall, 50 cm dbh; bole with small buttresses; bark scaly, reddish brown, the inner bark red; branchlets stout, terete, 4-5 mm diam., finely lenticellate, longitudinally fissured, glabrous. Leaf blades oblanceolate to obovate-elliptic, ca. 8-15 X 4-7 cm, sparsely punctate-glandulose, glabrous, rigid-coriaceous, cuneate or attenuate at base, rounded and emarginate at apex, sometimes shortly acuminate; secondary veins in 7-9 pairs, ascendant, arcuately anastomosed, the basal ones running along margin, the apical ones loop-connected; petioles sulcate, thickened at base, 8-10 mm long. Inflorescences paniculate-cymose, terminal or axillary, shorter than leaves, the rachis to 12 cm long, axes minutely pubescent; pedicels ca. 2 mm long, minutely pubescent; bracts deciduous.Flower buds ca. 12 mm long, green, sometimes tinged with pink at apex. Calyx 5-lobed; lobes ca. 2 mm long, minutely pubescent aband adaxially, ciliate at margin, often glanduliferous; petals linear-triangular, 9-13 X 3.5 mm, greenish white, sparsely appressed pubescent abaxially, white, glabrous adaxially; stamens ca. 120-200, united at base; filaments ca. 6-12 mm long, white; anthers lanceolate, 1.1 mm long, orangish yellow, the 2 thecae bilocular, 0.5 mm long, basal on thick connective acute at apex; disk thick, cupular, dentate, 1.2 mm high, densely crisp-pubescent aband adaxially; ovary turbinate-globose, ca. 2.5 mm high, densely crisp-pubescent, 6- or 7- locular, the style ca. 6-7 mm long, sparsely pilose at base, the stigma inconspicuously capitate. Drupes ovoid to ovoid-oblong, ca. 5-7 X 4-5 cm, dull green; exocarp ca. 5 mm thick, firm-fleshy; endocarp ovoid, ± acute at apex, ca. 4-6 X 3-4.5 cm, woody, smooth, with 6 or 7 linear, 6-10 mm wide, tongue-shaped valves alternating with 10-13 mm wide, discontinuously and superficially grooved ribs.

description: Small shrub with flexuous branchlets; branches and branchlets sparsely appressed-pubescent (trichomes glandular) to glabrescent when mature; older branches with flaky, longitudinally fissured bark. Leaves coriaceous, oblanceolate or rarely obovate, 1.5-14 X 1-4 cm, the base cuneate, the apex bluntly acute or rotundate, emarginate; blades shiny on the upper surface, glabrous on the lower surface except along the midribs, these sparsely appressed pubescent, glabrescent when mature, the margins strongly revolute, entire; secondary veins elevated below, with 5-9 parallel nerves on each side of mid-nerve, convergent and joining 2 mm from margin; petioles 2-4 X 2-3 mm, winged, glabrescent. Inflorescence a few-flowered thyrse, axillary or terminal, 2-7 cm long, the rachis sparsely appressed pubescent, with simple trichomes; bracteoles lanceolate-ovate, 3-6 mm long, glabrous on both sides, the margins ciliate; pedicels 5-12 mm long, pubescence same as rachis of inflorescence. Flowers androdioecious. Bisexual flowers 5-merous; sepals unequal, imbricate, broadly ovate to orbicular, the outer sepals 4-6 mm long, the inner sepals 5-7 mm long, papillate and sparsely-appressed pubescent externally, glabrous internally but sparsely-appressed pubescent close to margin, the margins ciliate; petals 5, imbricate, broadly ovate to orbicular, white, glabrescent or sparsely pilose on both sides, 5-7 mm long; stamens 150-200, the filaments 2-2.5 mm, glabrous, the anthers oblong, ca. 0.50 mm long; carpels 4-7, ca. 2 mm long, glabrous, but with a few large white dorsal trichomes. Staminate flowers 5-merous; sepals unequal, broadly ovate, papillate and sparsely appressed-pubescent externally, glabrous internally, the margins ciliate, the outer sepals 3, 4-6 mm long, the inner sepals 2, 5-7 mm long; petals 5, obovate, white, glabrous, 10-15 mm long; stamens 200-300, the filaments 4-5 mm, glabrous, the anthers oblong, ca. 0.5 mm long. Fruit 4-7 follicles, 9-16 mm long, glabrous or sparsely ciliate, the style persistent. Seeds yellow, 1 per follicle, ca. 5 mm long; aril orange, laciniate and completely covering the seed.

description: Tree (6-)18-30 m tall. Branch bark gray to beige, peeling to dark reddish gray or dark brown, the indumentum rufous-velutinous, persistent on new growth unit, patchy at region separating previous growth unit and current one, slowly glabrescent; lenticels few to numerous, minute to 0.5 mm diam., granular, plane, rufous to brown. Leaves simple, sometimes bilobed, thin-coriaceous, long-petiolate, the upper surface glaucous, matte, appressed-ferrugineous-pilose, the lower surface pale greenish brown, densely rufous-velutinous, the hairs persistent especially toward base of lamina and along mid-rib and lateral veins. Petiole not well differentiated, (1.5-)2.5-7(-8) cm long X 1.1-1.5 mm broad at midlength, terete at base, semiterete toward lamina, flattening out above or at times sulcate, rufous-velutinous over entire petiole in leaves of current growth unit, the hairs persistent near the base adax- ially in mature leaves, fading to gray. Lamina 4.5-12(-14) X 3-7.5(-9) cm, length: breadth 1 .2-2(-2.5): 1, suborbiculate or broadly-elliptic, rarely elliptic; base (acute-) 900 to obtuse (-rounded), strongly decurrent onto petiole, usually symmetrical; apex mostly obtuse-acuminate, less frequently rounded, attenuate or emarginate, often folded, the midvein not protruding; margin entire to slightly undulate, revolute at base, less pronouncedly revolute toward apex; venation above obscure; midrib and lateral veins below plane to slightly impressed, conspicuous and prominent, eucamptodromous to craspedodromous; midvein reaching the apex; secondary veins joining to form a faint marginal vein; lateral veins in (3-)4-5(-7) pairs, diverging from midrib at 30-40º at base to 20-30º apically, at times branching halfway between the midrib and margin, and again near margin. Inflorescences (3.6-)8.5- 13.5 X 1.5-2.5 cm, axillary, unbranched, rufous-velutinous, the flower pairs densely clustered; peduncle 0.4-1.5 cm X 1.5-2 mm, with few to many sterile bracts at the base; common bracts 1-1.3 X 0.7-1.5 mm, dense, rufous, tomentose-strigose on the out- side, glabrous within; flower-pair axis ab- sent; pedicels 1-2.3 X 0.6-1 mm, the in- dumentum sparse, straggly, rufous to ferru- gineous- tomentose to densely velutinous; flower buds 1-1.5 mm broad at the apex, ca. 0.5 mm broad at midlength, the indumentum as for pedicels. Flowers 7-10 mm long; fil- aments to 1.5 mm long, attached 4.5-7 mm from the base of the tepals; anthers 2-2.8 X 0.5-0.8 mm; nectary lobes 0.4 mm long, separated; ovary 1-2 X 0.7-1.3 mm, the indumentum long, sericeous-villous, the hairs rufous to pale ferrugineous, extending 1.3-1.5 mm from base of ovary, covering the entire ovary, erect to appressed; ovules 0.4-0.6 X 0.2-0.3 mm. Infructescence 11-14 cm long, short rufous tomentose; fruiting pedicel 4 X 2 mm, the pubescence sparser than on rhachis. Fruit 5-6 X ca. 2 cm, elongate, both sutured and unsutured edges curved equally with the sutured edge commonly the thinner of the two, purple- to rufous-velutinous, glabrescent except persistent at the base, rugulose, mid-brown beneath, the base constricted for 0.5-1.2 cm, the apex not constricted for ca. 1 mm and strongly curved; style not persistent; seed 4 X 1.7 cm, becoming thicker for ca. 1.2 cm at the apical end.

description: Liana basi ramis teretibus, triangulatis, complanatis vel trilobis. Lamina foliorum majorum 6.5-20.3 cm longa, 4.3-13 cm lata, rotundata, orbiculata, ovata, elliptica, late lanceolata, oblongo-lanceolata interdum oblonga, utrinque glabrata; petiolus 10-22 mm longus, basi biglandulifer. Panicula plerumque contracta, 19.5- 26 cm longa, erecta vel suberecta, umbellis 4-6-floris interdum 2 floribus proximalibus adjectis, pedunculo florifero nullo, pedicello 8.5-10 longo, 1.5-2.8 mm diametro, gradatim incrassato versus apicem. Petala lutea, in alabastro exposita, patentia, dorsaliter carinata; filamenta inaequalia; styli postici lyrati, apice pedaliformes dorsaliter apiculati. Samarae 45-48 mm longae, nuce lateraliter laevi.
bibliographicCitation: Amorim, André M. 2003. The anomalous-stemmed species of Heteropterys subsect. Aptychia (Malpighiaceae). Brittonia. 55: 127-145.

description: Liana, climbing to 3-10 m; stems at base 1-3 cm diam., the cross-section cylindrical, triangular, flattened, or deeply divided into 3 lobes, twisted, glabrate, developing small scattered lenticels. Leaves mostly plane, opposite, spreading; petiole (10-)15-22 mm long, initially densely sericeous and soon glabrate, bearing a pair of glands at base, each gland 1.5-2.2 mm diam.; stipules present on petiole, above base, as minute protuberances ca. 0.2 mm long, seldom evident, apparently absent from old leaves; lamina of larger leaves (6.5-)8.2-16.7(- 20.3) X (4.3-)6.5-13 cm, papery to subcoriaceous, often rounded, orbicular, ovate, elliptic, broadly lanceolate, oblong-lanceolate, or sometimes oblong, obtuse, rounded, cuneate, or slightly cordate at base (sometimes with the petiole partially covered by the base of lamina), rounded, acute, or slightly retuse at apex, the margins bearing many glands and short cilia, especially in young leaves, occasionally with impressed glands scattered below, glabrous or initially sericeous (with short, appressed, medifixed hairs) and soon glabrescent or sometimes thinly sericeous proximally on and near midrib and veins, the lateral veins and reticulum more visible below than above. Inflorescence paniculate, often contracted, 19.5-26 cm long or more, primary branches 4-22, 0.2-13.5 cm long, secondary branch- es 2-14, 0.1-4 cm long, tertiary branches if present very reduced, accessory branches 0.3-4.7 cm or absent; terminal or axillary, erect to sub-erect, densely and persistently brown-sericeous, with the flowers borne ultimately in 4-6-flowered umbels, sometimes with another pair of umbels below; inflorescence bracts like leaves and abruptly reduced to 1.7-4.3 X 1.5-2 mm, triangular to lanceolate, the margins entire or sometimes bearing short cilia, biglandular at base, the glands 1.2-1.5 mm diam., bright green; peduncle absent; bracts 0.8-0.9 X 1.5-1.7 mm, rounded, eglandular, abaxially sericeous, adaxially glabrous; bracteoles like bracts but smaller; pedicel 8.5-10 X 1.5-2.5(-2.8) mm, slightly curved upward or sometimes straight in flower, densely brown-sericeous, gradually thickened distally. Sepals 1.8-2.5 X 1.8-2.4 mm, brown, triangular at apex, appressed against filaments in anthesis, abaxially densely sericeous, adaxially glabrous, eglandular or the anterior sepal eglandular and the lateral 4 biglandular, the glands 1.9-3 mm long, elliptic or occasionally orbicular. Petals exposed in the enlarging bud, vivid yellow lacking red, glabrous; lateral petals spreading, margins entire or slightly erose proximally, claw 2.5-3 mm long, limb 4.5-5.5 X 4.5-5 mm, strongly dorsally carinate with the keel 0.3-1 mm wide, slightly decurrent; posterior petal sub-erect, minutely glandular-thickened at margins, claw 3-3.3 mm long, limb 4-4.5 X ca. 4.2 mm, suborbicular, slightly carinate, margins revolute in anthesis. Stamens glabrous; filaments un- equal, 3-4.2 X 0.2-0.9 mm, connate ca. 1/3 their length, the 2 opposite stamens posterior-lateral petals, 4-4.3 mm long, the longest stamen longest opposite anterior sepal, 4-4.2 mm long, the shortest stamen opposite posterior petal, 3-3.2 mm long, the other stamens 3.5-4 mm long; anthers 1.7-2 mm long, slightly unequal, erect to slightly reflexed in anthesis, connective not widened and equalling the locules, the proximal 2/3-4/5 dark red, the distal 1/5-1/3 pale yellow. Ovary 1.5-1.8 mm high, densely sericeous; styles 4-4.5 mm long, equalling or slightly exceeding the anthers, glabrous, all 3 dorsally apiculate at apex, with a flattened elliptic top and internal stigma; anterior style nearly straight, posterior styles somewhat lyrate. Samara brown at maturity, 45- 48 mm long, borne obliquely, thinly sericeous or tomentose to glabrate; dorsal wing 30-38 X 15-17 mm, the abaxial edge straight or curved upward; nut 6-8 mm diam., generally ovoid, smooth-sided, without lateral crests or winglets.

description: Slender liana; stems terete, densely yellowish-hispid when young, glabrate in age; cross section of stem with a single stele. Leaves 3-foliolate; petioles 2.5-10 cm, exalate; leaflets elliptic to oblong-obovate, 11-20 X 4-12 cm, obscurely serrate above the middle, acute to acuminate at apex, the base obtuse on lateral leaflets, attenuate on distal leaflets, moderately hispid abaxially, glabrate adaxially, lateral leaflets sessile, distal leaflet petiolulate; stipules 4-10 X 1 mm, linear, scarious, sparsely hispid, early deciduous. Inflorescences clustered or solitary racemes on leafless stems, 9-17 cm long; pedicels minutely puberulent. Flower buds white; sepals minutely puberulent; immature petals narrowly oblong-obovate, glabrous except for the sparsely long-ciliate margins, adaxially papillate. Mature flowers at anthesis unknown. Fruits obovoid, stipitate, red to rose-red, distally winged (wing 2-4.5 mm wide), 2-2.2 cm long, 0.9-1.2 cm wide, 3-locular, externally glabrous with prominently raised nerves, densely and minutely creamish-puberulent inside; seeds 1 or 2, subglobose, black and shiny, minutely puberulent, 5-7 mm diam.

description: Tree to 31 m (sometimes to over 45 m) tall. Stems thin, spindly; bark gray superficially, dark reddish brown to black beneath, the indumentum dense and pilose at the apices of new twigs, the hairs orange-brown, rapidly glabrescent; lenticels numerous, minute (<0.5 mm diam.), inconspicuous, granular, becoming raised, orange-brown to brown. Leaves simple, chartaceous, short-petiolate, brown when dry, matte or shiny above, minutely bullate (with white gland dots on new leaves); young leaves pilose, the hairs short and yellow to orange-brown above, longer rufous beneath, more abundant along lower midrib, leaving orange to red specks on lower lamina when trichomes have broken off. Petiole not well defined, 0.5-1(-1.5) cm long X ca. 1 mm broad at midlength, ca. 1/7-1/5 the length of the lamina, subterete, glabrous. Lamina 4.5-15 X 2-4.5 cm, length:breadth ratio 2-3.5(-4): 1, oblong to narrowly oblong, sometimes elliptic; base cuneate (-acute), usually somewhat decurrent onto petiole, flat when pressed, symmetrical; apex attenuate, less frequently acute or obtuse, the midvein not protruding; margin entire, slightly undulate, revolute almost to apex; venation above plane, inconspicuous except for the midrib which is paler than the rest of the lamina and sometimes narrowly grooved above; venation beneath only slightly raised except for the prominent midrib; marginal vein semicraspedodromous, fractiflexed midvein reaching the apex; lateral veins in 6-9 pairs. Inflorescence unknown. Infructescence ax- illary, unbranched, 8.5-9 cm long, gray to black velutinous, patchy toward the apex; fruiting pedicels ca. 2 X 1.8-2 mm, the indumentum as for infructescence. Fruit 4.7- 4.8 X 1.4-1.5 cm, gray, glabrous, smooth (minutely blistered), oblong, flat-sided, the unsutured edge flat, the sutured edge gently curved, the base constricted for 0.7-0.9 mm, the apex curved, not constricted, ending in a small point; style not persistent; seed not seen.

description: Tree 18-40 m tall, to 80 cm diam. Branch bark initially brown, later dark gray, the indumentum short, appressed, brown-pilose, fading to whitish gray, glabrescent; lenticels absent to numerous, inconspicuous, minute to 0.5 mm along longest axis, granular, plane to slightly raised, orange-brown. Leaves simple, thin-coriaceous, petiolate, olive green to dark brown when dry, shiny or matte above, glabrous. Petiole 2-4.5 cm long times ca. 1.5 mm wide at mid-length, ca. 1/3-1/2 the length of the lamina, subterete at the base, flattening out above and at times slightly canaliculate, glabrous except short-tomentose at base adaxially, the hairs orange brown fading to gray. Lamina 6-9 X 4-7 cm, length:breadth 1.4-1.5: 1, broadly obovate; base obtuse to acute-cuneate, decurrent onto petiole, symmetrical, flat; apex rounded, flat, the midvein not protruding; margin entire to undulate, revolute at the base; venation above semicras-pedodromous, plane, not conspicuous; venation below raised and conspicuous below; midvein not reaching apex, branching 0.5-1.4 cm below the apex; lateral veins in 4 pairs. Inflorescence unknown. Infructescence unbranching, ca. 8 cm long, sparsely ferrugineous-pilose, denser around pedicel insertions; common bracts 0.7 X 0.6 mm, rufous-strigose on the outside, glabrous within; fruiting pedicels ca. 3 X 2 mm, sparsely ferrugineous-pilose. Fruit 5.5-6 X 2.5-2.7 cm, oval, mid-brown or beige, peeling to dark brown beneath, glabrous, appearing smooth but with small tubercles seen at high magnification, the sutured and unsutured edges more or less curved equally, the base strongly curved and constricted for 0.8-1.3 cm, the apex strongly curved to a beak with the apical point commonly facing backward; seed not seen.

description: Herba repens vel scandens. Folia ovato-triangularia valde aristata. Flores staminati 5-meri, 2-3 antheris partim connatis. Flores pistillati 4-5-meri, stigmate 3- lobo, lobis linguiformibus, reflexis. A Sicyos galeottii Cogn. praecipue fructibus siccis 0.2-0.8 X 0.2-0.5 cm, triangulari-ovoideis, basim versus minute verrucosis differt.
